meanings_zh: n. 图书馆；藏书室 | n. 资料库；收藏
definition_en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials. | An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.
example1_en: I reserved a study room at the library before the midterm.
example1_zh: 期中考试前，我在图书馆订了一间自习室。
example2_en: The library lends laptops so students can finish research when their own computers fail.
example2_zh: 图书馆出借笔记本电脑，方便学生在自己的电脑出故障时完成研究。
collocations: public library｜公共图书馆 ; library card｜借书证 ; digital library｜数字图书馆 ; library resources｜图书馆资源
tip_zh: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

meanings_zh: n. 学生
definition_en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university
example1_en: Each student needs an ID card to enter the lab.
example1_zh: 每位学生都需要学生证才能进实验室。
example2_en: The survey asked every student how many hours they sleep during exam week.
example2_zh: 这项调查询问每位学生考试周睡多少小时。
collocations: university student｜大学生 ; international student｜国际学生 ; student loan｜学生贷款 ; student accommodation｜学生住宿
tip_zh: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

meanings_zh: n. 大学
definition_en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research
example1_en: She chose the university because of its engineering program.
example1_zh: 她因为工程专业而选择了这所大学。
example2_en: The university requires first-year students to attend a short course on academic honesty.
example2_zh: 这所大学要求一年级学生参加一门关于学术诚信的短课。
collocations: go to university｜上大学 ; university degree｜大学学位 ; university campus｜大学校园 ; university tuition fees｜大学学费
tip_zh: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。

meanings_zh: n. 课程 | n. 路线；进程 | n. 一道菜
definition_en: A series of lessons about a particular subject. | The route something follows or the way events develop. | One part of a meal served separately from other parts.
example1_en: This course meets on Tuesdays in the science building.
example1_zh: 这门课每周二在科学楼上课。
example2_en: The course combines a weekly lecture with a smaller discussion section.
example2_zh: 这门课把每周一次的讲座和规模更小的讨论课结合在一起。
collocations: take a course｜修读课程 ; training course｜培训课程 ; change course｜改变路线 ; main course｜主菜
tip_zh: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记本；笔记簿 | n. 笔记本电脑
definition_en: A book of blank pages for writing notes. | A small portable computer with a folding screen.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a spiral notebook.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论螺旋装订笔记本。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a spiral notebook.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论螺旋装订笔记本的材料。
collocations: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写 ; a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本 ; a notebook computer｜笔记本电脑
tip_zh: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

meanings_zh: n. 考试；测验
definition_en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.
example1_en: Our professor circled exam results on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了考试成绩。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of exam results.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得考试成绩这个例子。
collocations: take an exam｜参加考试 ; pass an exam｜通过考试 ; revise for an exam｜复习备考 ; exam results｜考试成绩
tip_zh: exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

meanings_zh: n. 班级；课 | n. 社会阶层；类别 | v. 把…归类
definition_en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend. | A social group or category sharing particular characteristics. | To place someone or something in a particular category.
example1_en: Our professor circled social class on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会阶层。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of social class.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得社会阶层这个例子。
collocations: attend a class｜上课 ; class size｜班级规模 ; social class｜社会阶层 ; be classed as｜被归类为
tip_zh: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭作业 | n. 事前准备工作
definition_en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons. | Research or preparation done before making a decision.
example1_en: Our professor circled hand in homework on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了交作业。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hand in homework.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论交作业的材料。
collocations: do homework｜做家庭作业 ; hand in homework｜交作业 ; do your homework｜做好事前准备
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

meanings_zh: n. 学院；高等专科学校 | n. 大学的学院
definition_en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses. | A constituent institution or division within a university.
example1_en: Office hours began with community college.
example1_zh: 答疑从社区学院开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss community college.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论社区学院的材料。
collocations: go to college｜上大学或学院 ; college student｜大学生；学院学生 ; college education｜大学教育 ; community college｜社区学院
tip_zh: 美式常泛指大学；英式多指学院或继续教育院校。

meanings_zh: n. 教授
definition_en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.
example1_en: The professor posted the slides after class.
example1_zh: 教授课后上传了课件。
example2_en: The professor asked us to question the method before accepting the conclusion.
example2_zh: 教授让我们在接受结论之前先质疑研究方法。
collocations: university professor｜大学教授 ; professor of economics｜经济学教授 ; visiting professor｜客座教授
tip_zh: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

meanings_zh: n. 论说文；短文；随笔
definition_en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.
example1_en: His essay opened with a clear claim.
example1_zh: 他的文章以一个明确的主张开头。
example2_en: A strong essay explains the evidence before it states what the evidence implies.
example2_zh: 一篇好的文章会先解释证据，再说明证据意味着什么。
collocations: write an essay｜写一篇短文 ; essay question｜论述题 ; an essay on｜一篇关于……的文章
tip_zh: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；办法 | n. 条理；系统性
definition_en: A particular way of doing something. | An organized and systematic approach to an activity.
example1_en: We changed the method after the first trial failed.
example1_zh: 第一次试验失败后，我们改了方法。
example2_en: The passage contrasts a traditional method with a newer way to measure sleep.
example2_zh: 文章把一种传统方法和一种更新的睡眠测量方式做了对比。
collocations: teaching method｜教学方法 ; research method｜研究方法 ; method of payment｜付款方式 ; effective method｜有效方法
tip_zh: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

meanings_zh: n. 自然环境 | n. 生活或工作环境
definition_en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things. | The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.
example1_en: Noise in the dorm affects the study environment.
example1_zh: 宿舍里的噪音会影响学习环境。
example2_en: The lecture linked a warming environment to changes in when plants flower.
example2_zh: 讲座把变暖的环境与植物开花时间的变化联系了起来。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; natural environment｜自然环境 ; working environment｜工作环境 ; learning environment｜学习环境
tip_zh: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

meanings_zh: n. 行为；举止 | n. 运行特性；反应方式
definition_en: the way a person or animal acts | the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions
example1_en: Sleep loss can change a student's behavior in class.
example1_zh: 睡眠不足会改变学生在课堂上的行为。
example2_en: Researchers recorded behavior during the task so they could compare the two groups.
example2_zh: 研究者记录了任务过程中的行为，以便比较两组受试者。
collocations: good behavior｜良好行为 ; consumer behavior｜消费者行为 ; animal behavior｜动物行为 ; patterns of behavior｜行为模式
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 打字；键盘输入
definition_en: The activity of entering words using a keyboard.
example1_en: Office hours began with touch typing.
example1_zh: 答疑从盲打开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss touch typing.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论盲打的材料。
collocations: typing speed｜打字速度 ; touch typing｜盲打 ; typing skills｜打字技能 ; typing error｜打字错误
tip_zh: 作名词时不可数；也是type的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 男性的；雄性的 | n. 男性；雄性动物
definition_en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm. | A male person or animal.
example1_en: The textbook introduces male students in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了男学生。
example2_en: The author returns to male students when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了男学生。
collocations: male students｜男学生 ; male nurse｜男护士 ; male and female｜男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip_zh: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐专辑 | n. 相册；集邮册
definition_en: A collection of recorded music released as one product. | A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.
example1_en: The textbook introduces debut album in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了首张专辑。
example2_en: The author returns to debut album when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了首张专辑。
collocations: release an album｜发行专辑 ; debut album｜首张专辑 ; photo album｜相册
tip_zh: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

meanings_zh: v. 设计；构思 | n. 设计；设计方案 | n. 装饰图案
definition_en: plan how something will look or work before making it | the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan | a decorative pattern on an object or surface
example1_en: The professor asked us to design a building.
example1_zh: 教授让我们设计建筑。
example2_en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to design a building.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们设计建筑。
collocations: design a building｜设计建筑 ; be designed to do something｜旨在做某事 ; graphic design｜平面设计 ; interior design｜室内设计
tip_zh: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

meanings_zh: n. 小提琴
definition_en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about violin lessons.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于小提琴课的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to violin lessons when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了小提琴课。
collocations: play the violin｜拉小提琴 ; violin lessons｜小提琴课 ; a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip_zh: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗鲁的；无礼的
definition_en: speaking or behaving without respect for others
example1_en: Office hours began with rude behaviour.
example1_zh: 答疑从粗鲁的行为开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of rude behaviour.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得粗鲁的行为这个例子。
collocations: rude to someone｜对某人无礼 ; rude behaviour｜粗鲁的行为 ; rude remark｜无礼的话
tip_zh: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

meanings_zh: v. 发音；读出 | v. 正式宣布；宣告
definition_en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking. | To state an official decision or judgment.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to pronounce a word.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何读出单词。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pronounce a word.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来读出单词。
collocations: pronounce a word｜读出单词 ; pronounce correctly｜正确发音 ; pronounce someone innocent｜宣布某人无罪
tip_zh: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

meanings_zh: n. 能力；才能
definition_en: the skill or power needed to do something
example1_en: Office hours began with academic ability.
example1_zh: 答疑从学业能力开始。
example2_en: The author returns to academic ability when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学业能力。
collocations: the ability to learn｜学习能力 ; develop an ability｜培养一种能力 ; academic ability｜学业能力 ; natural ability｜天赋
tip_zh: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

meanings_zh: n. 录音机；记录器 | n. 竖笛 | n. 记录员
definition_en: a device that captures sound, images, or information | a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes | a person who keeps an official record
example1_en: The textbook introduces digital recorder in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了数字录音机。
example2_en: The author returns to digital recorder when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数字录音机。
collocations: digital recorder｜数字录音机 ; voice recorder｜录音设备 ; play the recorder｜吹竖笛
tip_zh: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

meanings_zh: n. 金；黄金 | n. 金牌 | adj. 金制的；金色的
definition_en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money | The medal awarded for first place in a competition | Made of gold or having its yellow colour
example1_en: The textbook introduces pure gold in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯金。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss pure gold.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纯金的材料。
collocations: pure gold｜纯金 ; gold medal｜金牌 ; gold jewellery｜黄金首饰 ; gold reserves｜黄金储备
tip_zh: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

meanings_zh: n. 发音；读音
definition_en: the way a word or language is spoken
example1_en: Our professor circled clear pronunciation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了清晰的发音。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss clear pronunciation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论清晰的发音的材料。
collocations: clear pronunciation｜清晰的发音 ; correct pronunciation｜正确的发音 ; improve your pronunciation｜改善发音 ; pronunciation practice｜发音练习
tip_zh: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

meanings_zh: n. 日常饮食 | n. 特定饮食；节食方案 | v. 节食
definition_en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes. | A planned way of eating for health or weight control. | To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a balanced diet.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论均衡饮食。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a balanced diet.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论均衡饮食的材料。
collocations: a balanced diet｜均衡饮食 ; a diet rich in fibre｜富含纤维的饮食 ; go on a diet｜开始节食
tip_zh: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。

meanings_zh: n. 陆军；军队 | n. 大群；大批
definition_en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land. | A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an army of volunteers.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于大批志愿者的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an army of volunteers.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大批志愿者展开说明。
collocations: join the army｜参军 ; serve in the army｜在陆军服役 ; an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip_zh: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

meanings_zh: adj. 社会的 | adj. 社交的；交际的 | adj. 群居的
definition_en: relating to society and how people live together | relating to meeting people and spending time with them | living naturally in organised groups rather than alone
example1_en: Our professor circled social inequality on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会不平等。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around social inequality.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕社会不平等展开说明。
collocations: social inequality｜社会不平等 ; social skills｜社交技能 ; social activities｜社交活动 ; social change｜社会变革
tip_zh: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

meanings_zh: n. 欧元
definition_en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the euro area.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于欧元区的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the euro area.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论欧元区的材料。
collocations: the euro area｜欧元区 ; pay in euros｜用欧元支付 ; adopt the euro｜采用欧元
tip_zh: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

meanings_zh: n. 规则；规定 | n. 统治；管辖 | v. 统治；裁定
definition_en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required | control of a country or people by a leader or group | to govern a country or make an official legal decision
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rule out.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论排除。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rule out.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论排除的材料。
collocations: follow the rules｜遵守规则 ; break a rule｜违反规定 ; as a rule｜通常 ; rule out｜排除
tip_zh: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

meanings_zh: n. 孙子；外孙
definition_en: the son of your son or daughter
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on youngest grandson.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论最小的孙子或外孙。
example2_en: The reading connects youngest grandson with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把最小的孙子或外孙和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙 ; eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip_zh: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

meanings_zh: n. 旗；旗帜 | v. 标记；提醒注意 | v. 衰退；减弱
definition_en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation | to mark something as needing attention | to become weaker or less energetic
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on national flag.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论国旗。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss national flag.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论国旗的材料。
collocations: raise a flag｜升旗 ; national flag｜国旗 ; flag an issue｜标记问题 ; flagging energy｜逐渐减退的精力
tip_zh: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

meanings_zh: v. 与……结婚；结婚 | v. 为……主持婚礼
definition_en: To become someone's husband or wife. | To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to marry young.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何年纪轻轻就结婚。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to marry young.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得年纪轻轻就结婚。
collocations: marry someone｜与某人结婚 ; get married｜结婚 ; marry young｜年纪轻轻就结婚
tip_zh: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

meanings_zh: n. 使用者；用户
definition_en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.
example1_en: Our professor circled road user on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道路使用者。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of road user.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得道路使用者这个例子。
collocations: user account｜用户账户 ; user feedback｜用户反馈 ; road user｜道路使用者 ; regular user｜经常使用者
tip_zh: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 塑料 | adj. 塑料制的 | adj. 可塑的
definition_en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes | made of plastic | able to be shaped or changed easily
example1_en: The textbook introduces single-use plastic in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一次性塑料。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of single-use plastic.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得一次性塑料这个例子。
collocations: single-use plastic｜一次性塑料 ; plastic waste｜塑料垃圾 ; plastic packaging｜塑料包装 ; recycled plastic｜再生塑料
tip_zh: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

meanings_zh: n. 西兰花
definition_en: A green vegetable with thick stems and tightly clustered flower buds.
example1_en: The textbook introduces steamed broccoli in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了蒸西兰花。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of steamed broccoli.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得蒸西兰花这个例子。
collocations: broccoli florets｜西兰花小朵 ; steamed broccoli｜蒸西兰花 ; a head of broccoli｜一整颗西兰花
tip_zh: 通常不可数；小朵西兰花可说broccoli florets。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；防护
definition_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to protect the environment.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何保护环境。
example2_en: The passage says students who can protect the environment follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够保护环境的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; protect against disease｜预防疾病 ; protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害 ; protect privacy｜保护隐私
tip_zh: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

meanings_zh: n. 婆婆；岳母
definition_en: the mother of your husband or wife
example1_en: I wrote mother-in-law on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把mother-in-law和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses mother-in-law when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了婆婆。
collocations: future mother-in-law｜未来的婆婆或岳母 ; supportive mother-in-law｜给予支持的婆婆或岳母
tip_zh: 指配偶的母亲；复数mothers-in-law。

meanings_zh: n. 博客；网络日志 | v. 写博客
definition_en: A website or page with regularly added posts. | To write and publish posts on a blog.
example1_en: The textbook introduces travel blog in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了旅行博客。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss travel blog.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论旅行博客的材料。
collocations: write a blog｜写博客 ; blog post｜博文 ; travel blog｜旅行博客 ; blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip_zh: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

meanings_zh: adj. 数字技术的；数码的
definition_en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits
example1_en: Our professor circled digital technology on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数字技术。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss digital technology.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数字技术的材料。
collocations: digital technology｜数字技术 ; digital skills｜数字技能 ; digital divide｜数字鸿沟 ; digital camera｜数码相机
tip_zh: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

meanings_zh: adj. 有礼貌的；客气的
definition_en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about polite request.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于礼貌的请求的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss polite request.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论礼貌的请求的材料。
collocations: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌 ; polite request｜礼貌的请求 ; polite conversation｜客气的交谈 ; polite refusal｜婉言拒绝
tip_zh: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

meanings_zh: n. 精力；活力 | n. 能量；能源
definition_en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity | Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity
example1_en: The textbook introduces full of energy in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精力充沛。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around full of energy.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕精力充沛展开说明。
collocations: full of energy｜精力充沛 ; renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; save energy｜节约能源
tip_zh: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

meanings_zh: n. 政府 | n. 治理；政体
definition_en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region | the activity or system of controlling a country
example1_en: Office hours began with local government.
example1_zh: 答疑从地方政府开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used local government to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用地方政府来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: local government｜地方政府 ; central government｜中央政府 ; government policy｜政府政策 ; a system of government｜政体
tip_zh: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

meanings_zh: adv. 正确地；恰当地
definition_en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules
example1_en: The professor told us to correctly identify and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们正确识别，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to correctly identify before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先正确识别。
collocations: answer correctly｜回答正确 ; correctly identify｜正确识别 ; correctly interpret｜正确解读 ; if I remember correctly｜如果我没记错
tip_zh: 修饰动作；correct是形容词或动词，不作副词使用。

meanings_zh: adj. 公平的；合理的 | adj. 肤色白皙的；浅色的 | n. 展销会；集市
definition_en: treating people equally or reasonably | having pale skin or light hair | an event where people display or sell goods and services
example1_en: The textbook introduces trade fair in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了贸易展览会。
example2_en: A campus survey used trade fair to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用贸易展览会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: fair treatment｜公平待遇 ; a fair price｜合理的价格 ; fair hair｜浅色头发 ; trade fair｜贸易展览会
tip_zh: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

meanings_zh: n. 工具；用具 | n. 手段；辅助工具
definition_en: An object used to build, repair, or make things. | Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.
example1_en: I copied a useful tool into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把实用工具抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a useful tool.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论实用工具的材料。
collocations: hand tools｜手工工具 ; power tools｜电动工具 ; a useful tool｜实用工具 ; a tool for learning｜学习工具
tip_zh: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 脚踝；踝关节
definition_en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a swollen ankle.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肿胀的脚踝。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a swollen ankle.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论肿胀的脚踝的材料。
collocations: sprain an ankle｜扭伤脚踝 ; a swollen ankle｜肿胀的脚踝 ; ankle support｜护踝
tip_zh: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争 | n. 比赛；竞赛
definition_en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal. | An organised event in which people try to win.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fierce competition.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论激烈竞争。
example2_en: The reading connects fierce competition with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把激烈竞争和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fierce competition｜激烈竞争 ; competition for jobs｜求职竞争 ; enter a competition｜参加比赛 ; win a competition｜赢得比赛
tip_zh: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 讨论；商讨 | v. 论述
definition_en: to talk about something and exchange ideas | to examine a subject in speech or writing
example1_en: The professor asked us to discuss a problem.
example1_zh: 教授让我们讨论问题。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to discuss a problem.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得讨论问题。
collocations: discuss a problem｜讨论问题 ; discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事 ; discuss in detail｜详细讨论
tip_zh: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

meanings_zh: n. 零食；小吃 | v. 吃零食；吃点心
definition_en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals. | To eat small amounts of food between main meals.
example1_en: Our professor circled a healthy snack on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了健康零食。
example2_en: A campus survey used a healthy snack to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用健康零食来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: a healthy snack｜健康零食 ; a light snack｜少量点心 ; snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip_zh: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

meanings_zh: n. 模型；模式 | n. 模范；榜样 | n. 模特儿
definition_en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised | someone or something that provides a good example to follow | a person who displays clothes or poses for artists
example1_en: Office hours began with scale model.
example1_zh: 答疑从比例模型开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scale model.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕比例模型展开说明。
collocations: scale model｜比例模型 ; computer model｜计算机模型 ; role model｜榜样 ; fashion model｜时装模特
tip_zh: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚弱的；无力的 | adj. 薄弱的；缺乏说服力的 | adj. 淡的；微弱的
definition_en: lacking physical strength or energy | not effective, convincing, or well supported | having little intensity, flavour, or power
example1_en: The textbook introduces weak evidence in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了薄弱的证据。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around weak evidence.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕薄弱的证据展开说明。
collocations: feel weak｜感到虚弱 ; weak evidence｜薄弱的证据 ; weak signal｜微弱的信号 ; weak tea｜淡茶
tip_zh: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

meanings_zh: v. 发明；创造 | v. 编造；虚构
definition_en: To design or make something that did not exist before. | To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to invent a device.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发明装置。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to invent a device.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们发明装置。
collocations: invent a device｜发明装置 ; invent an excuse｜编造借口 ; invent a story｜虚构故事
tip_zh: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: v. 发现
definition_en: to find something or learn something previously unknown
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to discover a cure.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发现疗法。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to discover a cure.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发现疗法。
collocations: discover a cure｜发现疗法 ; discover a new species｜发现新物种 ; discover the truth｜发现真相
tip_zh: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

meanings_zh: n. 设计师；设计者 | adj. 名牌设计师设计的
definition_en: Someone who plans how something will look or work. | Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.
example1_en: Our professor circled fashion designer on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了时装设计师。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fashion designer.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论时装设计师的材料。
collocations: fashion designer｜时装设计师 ; graphic designer｜平面设计师 ; interior designer｜室内设计师 ; designer clothes｜设计师品牌服装
tip_zh: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

meanings_zh: n. 小学生；中学生 | n. 瞳孔
definition_en: A child who attends school. | The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on primary school pupil.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小学生。
example2_en: A campus survey used primary school pupil to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用小学生来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: primary school pupil｜小学生 ; former pupil｜校友；昔日学生 ; dilated pupils｜扩大的瞳孔
tip_zh: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

meanings_zh: n. 词汇量；词汇 | n. 专业词汇
definition_en: The words someone knows or uses in a language. | The words used in a particular subject or activity.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on expand your vocabulary.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论扩大词汇量。
example2_en: A campus survey used expand your vocabulary to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用扩大词汇量来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: expand your vocabulary｜扩大词汇量 ; a limited vocabulary｜有限的词汇量 ; academic vocabulary｜学术词汇 ; technical vocabulary｜专业术语
tip_zh: 单个词用word；vocabulary通常指词汇总量或集合。

meanings_zh: n. 香烟；纸烟
definition_en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.
example1_en: Office hours began with cigarette smoke.
example1_zh: 答疑从香烟烟雾开始。
example2_en: The reading connects cigarette smoke with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把香烟烟雾和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: cigarette smoke｜香烟烟雾 ; a packet of cigarettes｜一包香烟 ; cigarette taxes｜香烟税
tip_zh: 可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的；电动的 | adj. 令人激动的
definition_en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity. | Full of excitement and energy.
example1_en: I copied electric car into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电动汽车抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of electric car.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得电动汽车这个例子。
collocations: electric car｜电动汽车 ; electric current｜电流 ; electric shock｜电击 ; electric atmosphere｜热烈的气氛
tip_zh: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

meanings_zh: n. 战争 | n. 斗争；对抗
definition_en: armed fighting between countries or groups | a determined effort to defeat something harmful
example1_en: Our professor circled civil war on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了内战。
example2_en: The author returns to civil war when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了内战。
collocations: civil war｜内战 ; at war｜处于交战状态 ; declare war｜宣战 ; war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip_zh: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 读者；阅读者 | n. 阅读器；读卡器 | n. 分级读物；阅读课本
definition_en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines | A device that displays written material or reads stored information | A book designed to help learners develop reading skills
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an avid reader.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热衷阅读的人。
example2_en: The reading connects an avid reader with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把热衷阅读的人和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人 ; a card reader｜读卡器 ; a graded reader｜分级读物
tip_zh: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

meanings_zh: n. 教育；受教育过程
definition_en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on higher education.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高等教育。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of higher education.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得高等教育这个例子。
collocations: higher education｜高等教育 ; compulsory education｜义务教育 ; access to education｜受教育的机会 ; education system｜教育体系
tip_zh: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

meanings_zh: n. 风格；方式 | n. 款式；时尚 | v. 设计造型
definition_en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas. | The design of something or a fashionable appearance. | To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on writing style.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论写作风格。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss writing style.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论写作风格的材料。
collocations: writing style｜写作风格 ; architectural style｜建筑风格 ; in style｜流行的 ; style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip_zh: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

meanings_zh: n. 护士 | v. 护理；照料
definition_en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people. | To care for someone who is ill or injured.
example1_en: I copied registered nurse into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把注册护士抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to registered nurse when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了注册护士。
collocations: registered nurse｜注册护士 ; community nurse｜社区护士 ; nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

meanings_zh: adj. 已离婚的 | adj. 脱离的；分离的
definition_en: No longer married because the marriage legally ended. | Separated from something that should be closely connected.
example1_en: The textbook introduces divorced parents in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了离异父母。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss divorced parents.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论离异父母的材料。
collocations: get divorced｜离婚 ; divorced parents｜离异父母 ; divorced from reality｜脱离现实
tip_zh: get divorced表示离婚；脱离某事用divorced from。

meanings_zh: n. 意思；含义 | n. 意义；价值
definition_en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates. | The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.
example1_en: The textbook introduces literal meaning in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了字面意思。
example2_en: The reading connects literal meaning with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把字面意思和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the meaning of a word｜词义 ; literal meaning｜字面意思 ; convey meaning｜传达含义 ; give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip_zh: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 活跃的；积极参与的 | adj. 运作中的；起作用的 | adj. 主动语态的
definition_en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part | currently working or producing an effect | describing a verb whose subject performs the action
example1_en: The textbook introduces an active lifestyle in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了积极运动的生活方式。
example2_en: The author returns to an active lifestyle when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了积极运动的生活方式。
collocations: stay active｜保持活力 ; an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式 ; play an active role｜发挥积极作用 ; active ingredient｜有效成分
tip_zh: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

meanings_zh: adj. 网上的；联网的 | adv. 在网上；联网地
definition_en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network. | Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about available online.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于可在网上获取的的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects available online with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可在网上获取的和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: online shopping｜网上购物 ; online learning｜在线学习 ; go online｜上网 ; available online｜可在网上获取的
tip_zh: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐家；乐手
definition_en: someone who plays music, especially professionally
example1_en: I copied professional musician into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把职业音乐人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects professional musician with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把职业音乐人和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: professional musician｜职业音乐人 ; talented musician｜有才华的音乐家 ; street musician｜街头乐手
tip_zh: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

collocations: sharp pain｜剧痛；刺痛 ; chronic pain｜慢性疼痛 ; relieve pain｜缓解疼痛 ; emotional pain｜情感上的痛苦
tip_zh: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

meanings_zh: adv. 肯定地；确实；当然
definition_en: certainly, with no doubt about something
example1_en: The professor told us to definitely worth and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们绝对值得，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to definitely worth before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先绝对值得。
collocations: definitely worth｜绝对值得 ; definitely agree｜完全赞同 ; definitely not｜绝对不
tip_zh: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 计算器
definition_en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations
example1_en: I copied scientific calculator into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把科学计算器抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to scientific calculator when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了科学计算器。
collocations: use a calculator｜使用计算器 ; scientific calculator｜科学计算器 ; pocket calculator｜袖珍计算器
tip_zh: calculator指工具；calculation指计算过程或结果。

meanings_zh: n. 月亮；月球 | n. 天然卫星
definition_en: the natural object that moves around Earth | a natural object that moves around a planet
example1_en: Office hours began with full moon.
example1_zh: 答疑从满月开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used full moon to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用满月来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: full moon｜满月 ; crescent moon｜新月；月牙 ; the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip_zh: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

meanings_zh: n. 嗓音；说话声 | n. 发言权；影响力 | v. 表达；吐露
definition_en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing. | The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions. | To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a voice in decisions.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论决策中的发言权。
example2_en: The reading connects a voice in decisions with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把决策中的发言权和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: raise your voice｜提高嗓门 ; a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权 ; voice concerns｜表达担忧 ; lose your voice｜嗓子失声
tip_zh: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

meanings_zh: n. 国王
definition_en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position
example1_en: The professor explained king with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了国王。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up king while discussing evidence about public institutions.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了国王。
collocations: become king｜成为国王 ; crown a king｜为国王加冕 ; the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip_zh: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

meanings_zh: n. 差异；不同之处 | n. 分歧；意见不合 | n. 差额；差值
definition_en: A way in which people or things are not alike | A disagreement between people or groups | The amount by which one quantity exceeds another
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a significant difference.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于显著差异的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a significant difference to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用显著差异来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: the difference between｜……之间的区别 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; a significant difference｜显著差异 ; settle differences｜解决分歧
tip_zh: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 金属
definition_en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity
example1_en: Our professor circled scrap metal on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了废金属。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scrap metal.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕废金属展开说明。
collocations: scrap metal｜废金属 ; precious metal｜贵金属 ; metal frame｜金属框架 ; heavy metal｜重金属
tip_zh: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；供应 | v. 供养；赡养
definition_en: To give someone something they need or make it available. | To support someone financially by supplying what they need.
example1_en: The assignment is to provide support, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先提供支持，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to provide support.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们提供支持。
collocations: provide support｜提供支持 ; provide access to｜提供使用……的机会 ; provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物 ; provide for a family｜养家
tip_zh: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病
definition_en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants
example1_en: The textbook introduces heart disease in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了心脏病。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of heart disease.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得心脏病这个例子。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; infectious diseases｜传染病 ; prevent disease｜预防疾病 ; the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 同班同学
definition_en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.
example1_en: I copied a former classmate into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把以前的同班同学抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a former classmate to explain a pattern in student life.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用以前的同班同学来解释校园生活中的一种模式。
collocations: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学 ; help a classmate｜帮助同班同学 ; a new classmate｜新同学
tip_zh: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

meanings_zh: n. 死亡；去世
definition_en: the end of a person's or animal's life
example1_en: The textbook introduces premature death in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过早死亡。
example2_en: The author returns to premature death when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了过早死亡。
collocations: cause of death｜死因 ; premature death｜过早死亡 ; prevent deaths｜防止死亡 ; death rate｜死亡率
tip_zh: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 流行音乐 | v. 爆开；发出砰声 | v. 短暂去；顺手放
definition_en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures | to burst or make a short, sharp sound | to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly
example1_en: I copied pop music into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把流行音乐抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects pop music with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把流行音乐和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pop music｜流行音乐 ; pop a balloon｜弄爆气球 ; pop into a shop｜顺便进店 ; pop up｜突然出现
tip_zh: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 国际的；跨国的 | n. 国际比赛；国家队选手
definition_en: Involving two or more countries. | A match between countries, or a player representing a country.
example1_en: Office hours began with international trade.
example1_zh: 答疑从国际贸易开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of international trade.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国际贸易这个例子。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; international cooperation｜国际合作 ; an international flight｜国际航班 ; international students｜国际学生
tip_zh: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

meanings_zh: n. 活动；重大事件 | n. 比赛项目
definition_en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion. | A particular contest within a sports competition.
example1_en: Office hours began with major event.
example1_zh: 答疑从重大事件开始。
example2_en: The reading connects major event with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把重大事件和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: organise an event｜组织活动 ; major event｜重大事件 ; sporting event｜体育赛事 ; in the event of｜万一发生
tip_zh: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

meanings_zh: adv. 然而；不过 | adv. 无论多么 | conj. 无论以何种方式
definition_en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement. | No matter how much or to what degree. | In any way that someone chooses.
example1_en: However, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
example1_zh: 然而，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。
example2_en: However, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
example2_zh: 然而，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。
collocations: however difficult｜无论多困难 ; however much｜无论多少 ; however hard you try｜无论你多努力
tip_zh: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何人；有人
definition_en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.
example1_en: Office hours began with hardly anybody.
example1_zh: 答疑从几乎没有人开始。
example2_en: The reading connects hardly anybody with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把几乎没有人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: anybody else｜其他人 ; hardly anybody｜几乎没有人 ; anybody at all｜任何人
tip_zh: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

meanings_zh: v. 打架；战斗 | v. 抗争；努力争取 | n. 打斗；斗争
definition_en: To use physical force against another person or group. | To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal. | An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.
example1_en: The professor asked us to fight poverty.
example1_zh: 教授让我们与贫困作斗争。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to fight poverty.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与贫困作斗争。
collocations: fight poverty｜与贫困作斗争 ; fight for equality｜争取平等 ; fight against discrimination｜反对歧视 ; get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢的；欠考虑的
definition_en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a stupid mistake.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于愚蠢的错误的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a stupid mistake to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用愚蠢的错误来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a stupid mistake｜愚蠢的错误 ; a stupid idea｜愚蠢的主意 ; feel stupid｜觉得自己很傻
tip_zh: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

meanings_zh: n. 孙女；外孙女
definition_en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter
example1_en: The textbook introduces youngest granddaughter in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最小的孙女或外孙女。
example2_en: A campus survey used youngest granddaughter to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用最小的孙女或外孙女来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: youngest granddaughter｜最小的孙女或外孙女 ; granddaughter's birthday｜孙女或外孙女的生日
tip_zh: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。

meanings_zh: n. 文章；报道 | n. 物品；一件东西 | n. 冠词
definition_en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website. | A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group. | A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a newspaper article.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论报纸文章。
example2_en: A campus survey used a newspaper article to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用报纸文章来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: a newspaper article｜报纸文章 ; write an article｜写文章 ; an article of clothing｜一件衣物 ; the definite article｜定冠词
tip_zh: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 网站主页
definition_en: The main page of a website, linking to other sections.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on website homepage.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论网站主页。
example2_en: A campus survey used website homepage to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用网站主页来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: website homepage｜网站主页 ; homepage design｜主页设计 ; visit the homepage｜访问主页
tip_zh: 也可写作home page；不等于网站中的任意网页。

meanings_zh: adv. 百分之……
definition_en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.
example1_en: The professor explained percent with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了百分之。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses percent when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了百分之。
collocations: ten percent of｜百分之十的 ; a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长 ; one hundred percent｜百分之百
tip_zh: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

meanings_zh: n. 十三至十九岁青少年
definition_en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.
example1_en: Our professor circled a young teenager on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了十三四岁的青少年。
example2_en: The author returns to a young teenager when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了十三四岁的青少年。
collocations: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年 ; as a teenager｜在青少年时期 ; teenagers' needs｜青少年的需求
tip_zh: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭主妇
definition_en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.
example1_en: Our professor circled a full-time housewife on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了全职家庭主妇。
example2_en: A campus survey used a full-time housewife to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用全职家庭主妇来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a full-time housewife｜全职家庭主妇 ; work as a housewife｜做家庭主妇
tip_zh: 复数为housewives；homemaker不限定性别。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；完全的 | n. 总数；总额 | v. 总计达；合计
definition_en: including everything, or complete in degree | the amount obtained by adding everything together | to reach a particular amount or add amounts together
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about total cost.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于总费用的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss total cost.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论总费用的材料。
collocations: total cost｜总费用 ; in total｜总共 ; a total of｜总计…… ; total energy consumption｜能源总消耗
tip_zh: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

meanings_zh: n. 士兵；军人
definition_en: a person who serves in an army
example1_en: The textbook introduces professional soldier in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了职业军人。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around professional soldier.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕职业军人展开说明。
collocations: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役 ; professional soldier｜职业军人 ; train soldiers｜训练士兵
tip_zh: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

meanings_zh: n. 画廊；美术馆 | n. 楼座；旁听席 | n. 图片集；图库
definition_en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold. | A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre. | A collection of images available to view, especially online.
example1_en: The textbook introduces art gallery in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了美术馆；画廊。
example2_en: The author returns to art gallery when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了美术馆；画廊。
collocations: art gallery｜美术馆；画廊 ; public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席 ; photo gallery｜图片集
tip_zh: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 脂肪；食用油脂 | adj. 肥胖的；肥的
definition_en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking | having a large amount of body fat
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on body fat.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论体脂。
example2_en: The author returns to body fat when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了体脂。
collocations: body fat｜体脂 ; saturated fat｜饱和脂肪 ; low in fat｜脂肪含量低
tip_zh: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

meanings_zh: n. 出售；销售 | n. 降价促销 | n. 销售额；销量
definition_en: the act of exchanging something for money | a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices | the amount sold or money earned from selling goods
example1_en: The textbook introduces a clearance sale in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了清仓促销。
example2_en: A campus survey used a clearance sale to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用清仓促销来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: for sale｜待售 ; on sale｜出售中；降价出售 ; sales figures｜销售数据 ; a clearance sale｜清仓促销
tip_zh: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

meanings_zh: n. 密码；口令
definition_en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.
example1_en: I copied a strong password into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把安全性高的密码抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a strong password to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用安全性高的密码来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: a strong password｜安全性高的密码 ; reset a password｜重置密码 ; enter a password｜输入密码 ; password protection｜密码保护
tip_zh: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

meanings_zh: n. 结尾；结局 | n. 词尾
definition_en: the final part of a story, event, or activity | a final word part that often shows grammatical information
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a happy ending.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于圆满结局的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a happy ending.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得圆满结局这个例子。
collocations: a happy ending｜圆满结局 ; a surprise ending｜出人意料的结局 ; a verb ending｜动词词尾
tip_zh: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

meanings_zh: v. 支持；帮助；供养 | v. 支撑；承托 | n. 支持；援助；支撑
definition_en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone | to hold something up or bear its weight | help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up
example1_en: The professor asked us to support a family.
example1_zh: 教授让我们养家。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers support a family before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要养家。
collocations: financial support｜资金支持 ; support a family｜养家 ; support an argument｜为论点提供依据 ; emotional support｜情感支持
tip_zh: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

meanings_zh: n. 烟；烟雾 | v. 吸烟 | v. 冒烟
definition_en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns | to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco | to produce smoke
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on thick smoke.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓烟。
example2_en: The author returns to thick smoke when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了浓烟。
collocations: thick smoke｜浓烟 ; smoke alarm｜烟雾报警器 ; smoke cigarettes｜吸香烟 ; give off smoke｜冒烟
tip_zh: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

meanings_zh: n. 录音；录像 | n. 录制；记录
definition_en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing | the process of saving sounds, images, or information
example1_en: Office hours began with audio recording.
example1_zh: 答疑从音频录音开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used audio recording to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用音频录音来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: make a recording｜录音；录像 ; recording studio｜录音棚 ; audio recording｜音频录音 ; accurate recording｜准确记录
tip_zh: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 禁止吸烟的 | adj. 不吸烟的
definition_en: describing a place where smoking is not allowed | describing someone who does not smoke
example1_en: The professor explained non-smoking with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了禁止吸烟的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up non-smoking while discussing evidence about public health.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了禁止吸烟的。
collocations: non-smoking room｜无烟客房 ; non-smoking area｜禁烟区 ; non-smoking household｜无人吸烟的家庭
tip_zh: 可指场所禁烟，也可指人不吸烟。

meanings_zh: n. 兴趣；关注 | n. 利息 | v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something | money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings | to make someone want to know or learn more
example1_en: Our professor circled stimulate interest on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了激发兴趣。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss stimulate interest.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论激发兴趣的材料。
collocations: take an interest in｜对……产生兴趣 ; stimulate interest｜激发兴趣 ; interest rate｜利率 ; pay interest｜支付利息
tip_zh: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

meanings_zh: v. 意思是；意味着；打算 | adj. 刻薄的；吝啬的 | n. 平均值
definition_en: to express, involve, or intend something | unkind or unwilling to share or spend money | the total of several values divided by how many exist
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to mean value.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何平均值。
example2_en: The reading asks you to mean value and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你平均值，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: mean to do something｜打算做某事 ; mean doing something｜意味着做某事 ; mean value｜平均值 ; be mean to someone｜对某人刻薄
tip_zh: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

meanings_zh: n. 梦；梦境 | n. 梦想；理想 | v. 做梦；梦想
definition_en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping | something you strongly hope to achieve or experience | to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about dream of becoming.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于梦想成为的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around dream of becoming.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕梦想成为展开说明。
collocations: have a dream｜做梦 ; pursue a dream｜追求梦想 ; dream of becoming｜梦想成为 ; a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip_zh: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。

meanings_zh: v. 出席；参加；上学 | v. 处理；照料
definition_en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution | to deal with something or care for someone
example1_en: I heard the lecturer attend a meeting during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时参加会议。
example2_en: The passage says students who can attend a meeting follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够参加会议的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: attend a meeting｜参加会议 ; attend school｜上学 ; attend to a problem｜处理问题
tip_zh: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的；基础的 | adj. 简单的；无额外设施的
definition_en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something. | Having only necessary features, without anything extra.
example1_en: The textbook introduces basic skills in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了基本技能。
example2_en: A campus survey used basic skills to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用基本技能来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: basic skills｜基本技能 ; basic needs｜基本需求 ; basic knowledge｜基础知识 ; basic principles｜基本原则
tip_zh: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

meanings_zh: adj. 公众的；公用的；公开的 | adj. 政府的；公立的 | n. 公众；民众
definition_en: For everyone to use, see, or know about. | Provided or controlled by the government. | Ordinary people in society considered as a group.
example1_en: Our professor circled the general public on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了普通民众。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the general public.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得普通民众这个例子。
collocations: public transport｜公共交通 ; public services｜公共服务 ; the general public｜普通民众 ; in public｜在公共场合
tip_zh: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾；废物 | n. 废话；胡说
definition_en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them. | Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about household rubbish.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于生活垃圾的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of household rubbish.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得生活垃圾这个例子。
collocations: household rubbish｜生活垃圾 ; rubbish bin｜垃圾桶 ; collect rubbish｜收集垃圾 ; talk rubbish｜胡说八道
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

meanings_zh: n. 选择；选择权 | n. 可选之物；选择范围 | adj. 优质的；精选的
definition_en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities | something you can choose, or the range of available options | of especially good quality
example1_en: The textbook introduces freedom of choice in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了选择自由。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of freedom of choice.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得选择自由这个例子。
collocations: make a choice｜作出选择 ; have no choice｜别无选择 ; a wide choice of｜种类丰富的 ; freedom of choice｜选择自由
tip_zh: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

meanings_zh: n. 戏剧；戏剧艺术 | n. 戏剧性事件；激动场面
definition_en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them. | An exciting or emotional event or situation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on television drama.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电视剧。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss television drama.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电视剧的材料。
collocations: drama club｜戏剧社 ; television drama｜电视剧 ; study drama｜学习戏剧 ; historical drama｜历史剧
tip_zh: 戏剧艺术用不可数drama；一部戏剧用a drama。

meanings_zh: n. 逗号
definition_en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.
example1_en: Our professor circled a misplaced comma on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了位置不当的逗号。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a misplaced comma.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕位置不当的逗号展开说明。
collocations: add a comma｜加逗号 ; a misplaced comma｜位置不当的逗号 ; separate items with commas｜用逗号分隔各项
tip_zh: comma是逗号，句号通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

meanings_zh: v. 摧毁；毁灭 | v. 彻底破坏；使丧失
definition_en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used. | To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.
example1_en: The professor asked us to destroy habitats.
example1_zh: 教授让我们摧毁栖息地。
example2_en: The passage says students who can destroy habitats follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够摧毁栖息地的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: destroy habitats｜摧毁栖息地 ; destroy evidence｜销毁证据 ; destroy confidence｜摧毁信心 ; completely destroy｜彻底摧毁
tip_zh: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

meanings_zh: n. 耳机的一个听筒
definition_en: one of two earpieces worn over the ears for listening
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on headphone jack.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论耳机插孔。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss headphone jack.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论耳机插孔的材料。
collocations: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机 ; wireless headphones｜无线耳机 ; headphone jack｜耳机插孔
tip_zh: 日常说耳机通常用复数headphones，一副用a pair of。

meanings_zh: v. 改善；提高；变好
definition_en: To become better or make something better.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to improve performance.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求提高表现。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to improve performance.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得提高表现。
collocations: improve performance｜提高表现 ; improve access to｜改善获取……的机会 ; improve significantly｜显著改善 ; improve living standards｜提高生活水平
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

meanings_zh: n. 人际关系；恋爱关系 | n. 关联；联系
definition_en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other. | A connection between things or the way they affect each other.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a close relationship.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于亲密关系的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a close relationship to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用亲密关系来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: build a relationship｜建立关系 ; a close relationship｜亲密关系 ; the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip_zh: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

meanings_zh: n. 爵士乐
definition_en: Music with strong rhythms and often freely invented melodies.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about jazz band.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于爵士乐队的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around jazz band.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕爵士乐队展开说明。
collocations: jazz band｜爵士乐队 ; jazz festival｜爵士音乐节 ; jazz musician｜爵士乐手
tip_zh: 表示音乐类型时通常不可数，不加 a。

meanings_zh: v. 印刷；打印 | n. 印刷文字；字体 | n. 印痕；印迹
definition_en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine | Letters and words produced on paper by printing | A mark left by something pressed against a surface
example1_en: The assignment is to print a document, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先打印文件，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to print a document.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们打印文件。
collocations: print a document｜打印文件 ; small print｜小号字；细则 ; in print｜已出版且仍可购得 ; out of print｜已绝版
tip_zh: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

meanings_zh: n. 许可；准许
definition_en: agreement allowing someone to do something
example1_en: After the lecture, we used permission in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了许可。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up permission while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了许可。
collocations: ask for permission｜请求许可 ; give permission｜给予许可 ; without permission｜未经许可 ; permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip_zh: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

meanings_zh: adj. 困倦的；想睡的 | adj. 安静冷清的
definition_en: feeling tired and ready to sleep | quiet and having very little activity
example1_en: Our professor circled sleepy village on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了宁静的村庄。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sleepy village.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论宁静的村庄的材料。
collocations: feel sleepy｜感到困倦 ; sleepy village｜宁静的村庄 ; sleepy eyes｜惺忪的睡眼
tip_zh: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

meanings_zh: adj. 生病的；不舒服的 | adj. 恶心的；想吐的 | adj. 厌烦的；受够了的
definition_en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell. | Feeling that you might vomit. | Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.
example1_en: Office hours began with sick leave.
example1_zh: 答疑从病假开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used sick leave to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用病假来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: sick leave｜病假 ; feel sick｜觉得恶心；不舒服 ; be sick of｜厌烦 ; call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip_zh: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

meanings_zh: n. 名词
definition_en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about countable noun.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于可数名词的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss countable noun.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可数名词的材料。
collocations: countable noun｜可数名词 ; uncountable noun｜不可数名词 ; proper noun｜专有名词 ; noun phrase｜名词短语
tip_zh: 名词不只指实物，也可指advice等抽象概念。

meanings_zh: n. 平板电脑 | n. 药片 | n. 碑；刻字板
definition_en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen | a small solid dose of medicine swallowed whole | a flat stone or metal slab bearing an inscription
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about vitamin tablet.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于维生素片的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to vitamin tablet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了维生素片。
collocations: tablet computer｜平板电脑 ; take a tablet｜服用药片 ; vitamin tablet｜维生素片
tip_zh: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 牙痛
definition_en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area
example1_en: The textbook introduces severe toothache in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了剧烈牙痛。
example2_en: The author returns to severe toothache when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧烈牙痛。
collocations: have toothache｜牙痛 ; severe toothache｜剧烈牙痛 ; relieve toothache｜缓解牙痛
tip_zh: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

meanings_zh: n. 温度；气温；体温 | n. 发烧
definition_en: A measure of how hot or cold something is. | A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.
example1_en: I copied room temperature into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把室温抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to room temperature when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了室温。
collocations: room temperature｜室温 ; body temperature｜体温 ; take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温 ; have a temperature｜发烧
tip_zh: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

meanings_zh: n. 敌人；敌方 | n. 危害物；大敌
definition_en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another. | Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.
example1_en: Our professor circled bitter enemy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了死敌。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bitter enemy.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕死敌展开说明。
collocations: bitter enemy｜死敌 ; common enemy｜共同的敌人 ; enemy forces｜敌军
tip_zh: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；要点 | n. 尖端；尖头 | v. 指向；指给……看
definition_en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing | the sharp, narrow end of something | show a direction or object with a finger or tool
example1_en: The textbook introduces main point in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了要点。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of main point.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得要点这个例子。
collocations: make a point｜提出观点 ; main point｜要点 ; point of view｜观点；看法 ; point at something｜指着某物
tip_zh: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

meanings_zh: n. 海洋；大洋
definition_en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.
example1_en: Our professor circled ocean currents on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了洋流。
example2_en: The author returns to ocean currents when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了洋流。
collocations: ocean currents｜洋流 ; the ocean floor｜海底 ; ocean pollution｜海洋污染
tip_zh: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。

meanings_zh: v. 似乎；看来
definition_en: To appear to be a certain way.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to seem likely.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求似乎有可能。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to seem likely.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们似乎有可能。
collocations: seem likely｜似乎有可能 ; seem to be｜似乎是 ; it seems that｜看来
tip_zh: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

meanings_zh: n. 世纪；一百年
definition_en: A period of one hundred years.
example1_en: I copied the twentieth century into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把二十世纪抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to the twentieth century when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了二十世纪。
collocations: the twentieth century｜二十世纪 ; over a century ago｜一个多世纪以前 ; the turn of the century｜世纪之交
tip_zh: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

meanings_zh: v. 行动；表现；扮演 | n. 行为；举动 | n. 法令；法案
definition_en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role. | Something that someone does. | A law formally approved by a legislative body.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to act quickly.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求迅速行动。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to act quickly.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来迅速行动。
collocations: act quickly｜迅速行动 ; act as｜充当 ; an act of kindness｜善举 ; pass an act｜通过法案
tip_zh: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

meanings_zh: v. 猜测；猜中 | n. 猜测；推测 | v. 认为；想来
definition_en: To give an answer without having enough information to be certain. | An answer or opinion given without being certain. | To think something is probably true, without being completely sure.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to guess correctly.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须猜对。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to guess correctly.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猜对。
collocations: make a guess｜猜一猜 ; an educated guess｜有依据的猜测 ; guess correctly｜猜对
tip_zh: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

meanings_zh: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表 | v. 为…安排时间
definition_en: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen. | To arrange when an event or activity will happen.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about train timetable.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于列车时刻表的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects train timetable with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把列车时刻表和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: train timetable｜列车时刻表 ; school timetable｜学校课程表 ; a revised timetable｜调整后的时间表
tip_zh: 英式常用timetable；美式常用schedule。

meanings_zh: n. 公主；王妃
definition_en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a royal princess.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于王室公主的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a royal princess.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论王室公主的材料。
collocations: a royal princess｜王室公主 ; a fairy-tale princess｜童话公主
tip_zh: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

meanings_zh: n. 克
definition_en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a gramme of salt.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一克盐的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a gramme of salt.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一克盐的材料。
collocations: a gramme of salt｜一克盐 ; per gramme｜每克 ; weigh in grammes｜以克称重
tip_zh: gramme是英式变体；gram更常用，单位符号为g。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾；废弃物 | n. 废话；无价值的东西
definition_en: waste material that people throw away | something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about garbage collection.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于垃圾收集的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects garbage collection with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把垃圾收集和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: take out the garbage｜把垃圾拿出去 ; garbage collection｜垃圾收集 ; a garbage bag｜垃圾袋 ; a garbage can｜垃圾桶
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常见于美式英语，英式多用rubbish。

meanings_zh: n. 学位 | n. 程度 | n. 度；度数
definition_en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course | the amount or level of something | a unit used to measure temperature or angles
example1_en: Our professor circled a bachelor's degree on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学士学位。
example2_en: A campus survey used a bachelor's degree to explain a pattern in student life.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用学士学位来解释校园生活中的一种模式。
collocations: a degree in economics｜经济学学位 ; a bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; to some degree｜在某种程度上 ; degrees Celsius｜摄氏度
tip_zh: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

meanings_zh: n. 教科书；课本 | adj. 典型的；标准的
definition_en: A book used to study a particular subject. | Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.
example1_en: Our professor circled school textbook on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学校教材。
example2_en: The author returns to school textbook when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校教材。
collocations: school textbook｜学校教材 ; textbook example｜典型例子 ; textbook publisher｜教材出版商
tip_zh: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

meanings_zh: n. 酸奶
definition_en: A thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about plain yogurt.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于原味酸奶的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects plain yogurt with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把原味酸奶和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: plain yogurt｜原味酸奶 ; low-fat yogurt｜低脂酸奶 ; a pot of yogurt｜一小罐酸奶
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。

meanings_zh: n. 应用程序
definition_en: A computer program designed for a particular task.
example1_en: The textbook introduces mobile app in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了移动应用。
example2_en: The reading connects mobile app with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把移动应用和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: download an app｜下载应用程序 ; mobile app｜移动应用 ; install an app｜安装应用程序 ; language learning app｜语言学习应用
tip_zh: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

meanings_zh: n. 嘴唇 | n. 边缘；边沿
definition_en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth. | The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.
example1_en: I copied upper lip into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把上嘴唇抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of upper lip.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得上嘴唇这个例子。
collocations: upper lip｜上嘴唇 ; dry lips｜干燥的嘴唇 ; bite your lip｜咬嘴唇 ; the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip_zh: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

meanings_zh: n. 室友
definition_en: A person who shares a room or apartment.
example1_en: My roommate and I split the grocery list.
example1_zh: 我和室友分开列了购物清单。
example2_en: A noisy roommate can affect sleep and, with it, attention in morning lectures.
example2_zh: 吵闹的室友会影响睡眠，进而影响早课的注意力。
collocations: college roommate｜大学室友 ; roommate agreement｜室友公约
tip_zh: 美式校园听力里极常见；英式也说 flatmate。

meanings_zh: v. 疼痛；使受伤 | v. 伤感情；损害 | adj. 受伤的；伤心的
definition_en: To feel pain or cause physical injury. | To cause emotional pain or damage something. | Physically injured or emotionally upset.
example1_en: The assignment is to hurt your back, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先伤到背部，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers hurt your back before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要伤到背部。
collocations: hurt your back｜伤到背部 ; hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情 ; get hurt｜受伤
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

meanings_zh: n. 指示；操作说明 | n. 命令；指令 | n. 指导；教学
definition_en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something | An order telling someone what they must do | The activity of teaching someone a skill or subject
example1_en: Office hours began with practical instruction.
example1_zh: 答疑从实践指导开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of practical instruction.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得实践指导这个例子。
collocations: follow instructions｜遵照指示 ; step-by-step instructions｜逐步操作说明 ; give instructions｜发出指示 ; practical instruction｜实践指导
tip_zh: 操作说明常用复数instructions；表示教学时不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 下载 | n. 下载；下载的文件
definition_en: to copy data from the internet onto your device | the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way
example1_en: I heard the lecturer download a file during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时下载文件。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to download a file.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来下载文件。
collocations: download a file｜下载文件 ; download an app｜下载应用 ; free download｜免费下载 ; download speed｜下载速度
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

meanings_zh: n. 姓；姓氏
definition_en: the name shared by members of a family
example1_en: Office hours began with family surname.
example1_zh: 答疑从家族姓氏开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of family surname.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得家族姓氏这个例子。
collocations: family surname｜家族姓氏 ; common surname｜常见姓氏 ; change your surname｜更改姓氏
tip_zh: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最后。

meanings_zh: n. 记忆力；记忆 | n. 回忆 | n. 计算机内存
definition_en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences | something from the past that you remember | the part of a computer that stores information
example1_en: The textbook introduces short-term memory in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了短期记忆。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss short-term memory.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论短期记忆的材料。
collocations: short-term memory｜短期记忆 ; childhood memories｜童年回忆 ; from memory｜凭记忆 ; computer memory｜计算机内存
tip_zh: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机程序 | v. 编写程序；设定运行 | n. 计划；课程；节目
definition_en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do. | Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically. | An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.
example1_en: Office hours began with computer program.
example1_zh: 答疑从计算机程序开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of computer program.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得计算机程序这个例子。
collocations: computer program｜计算机程序 ; run a program｜运行程序 ; program a computer｜给计算机编程 ; training program｜培训计划
tip_zh: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

meanings_zh: prep. 每；每一
definition_en: For each unit of something.
example1_en: The professor explained per with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了每。
example2_en: Students who can explain per usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释每的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: per person｜每人 ; per hour｜每小时 ; per capita｜人均 ; per year｜每年
tip_zh: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

meanings_zh: n. 化学 | n. 化学组成与变化 | n. 默契；相互吸引
definition_en: the science of substances and how they react | the chemical properties and processes of a substance | a natural connection or attraction between people
example1_en: I copied organic chemistry into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有机化学抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used organic chemistry to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有机化学来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: organic chemistry｜有机化学 ; study chemistry｜学习化学 ; soil chemistry｜土壤化学
tip_zh: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

meanings_zh: n. 健康；身体状况 | n. 良好状况；兴旺
definition_en: The condition of someone's body and mind. | How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.
example1_en: The textbook introduces mental health in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了心理健康。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mental health.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论心理健康的材料。
collocations: mental health｜心理健康 ; public health｜公共卫生 ; in good health｜身体健康 ; economic health｜经济运行状况
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

meanings_zh: adj. 可移动的；流动的 | adj. 移动通信的 | n. 手机
definition_en: able to move or be moved easily between places | relating to phones or services used while away from home | a telephone you can carry and use almost anywhere
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mobile phone.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论手机。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of mobile phone.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得手机这个例子。
collocations: mobile phone｜手机 ; mobile clinic｜流动诊所 ; mobile workforce｜流动劳动力 ; mobile network｜移动通信网络
tip_zh: 英式英语常用a mobile指手机；美式常说a cell phone。

meanings_zh: n. 决定；抉择
definition_en: a choice made after considering different possibilities
example1_en: Our professor circled informed decision on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基于充分了解的决定。
example2_en: The reading connects informed decision with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把基于充分了解的决定和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip_zh: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

meanings_zh: n. 数学
definition_en: The study of quantities, shapes, patterns, and their relationships.

example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于应用数学的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects applied mathematics with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把应用数学和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: applied mathematics｜应用数学 ; pure mathematics｜纯数学 ; mathematics teacher｜数学教师
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，作学科名用单数谓语；英式简称maths。

meanings_zh: v. 更喜欢；宁愿

example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要比起B更喜欢A。

tip_zh: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

meanings_zh: n. 无线网络；无线联网技术
definition_en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.

example2_en: A campus survey used free wifi to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用免费无线网络来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip_zh: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；成本 | v. 价钱为；使花费 | n. 代价；损失
definition_en: the money needed to buy or do something | to require a particular amount of money | something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the cost of living.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于生活成本的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the cost of living.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论生活成本的材料。
collocations: the cost of living｜生活成本 ; cover the cost｜支付费用 ; at all costs｜不惜一切代价 ; cost a fortune｜花一大笔钱
tip_zh: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

meanings_zh: n. 大脑；脑 | n. 智力；头脑
definition_en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity. | The ability to think clearly and understand things.

example1_zh: 答疑从大脑功能开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around brain function.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大脑功能展开说明。

tip_zh: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

meanings_zh: v. 承诺；答应 | n. 承诺；诺言 | n. 潜力；前景

example2_en: The reading asks you to promise to do something and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你承诺做某事，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: keep a promise｜信守承诺 ; break a promise｜违背诺言 ; promise to do something｜承诺做某事 ; show promise｜展现潜力
