meanings_zh: n. 观点；看法 | n. 景色；视野 | v. 看待；观看
definition_en: An opinion or belief about something. | What you can see from a particular place. | To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sea view.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论海景。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a sea view.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得海景这个例子。
collocations: express a view｜表达观点 ; in my view｜在我看来 ; a sea view｜海景 ; view something as｜将某事视为

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；生病

example2_en: The author returns to serious illness when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重病。
collocations: serious illness｜重病 ; mental illness｜精神疾病 ; recover from an illness｜病后康复 ; due to illness｜因病
tip_zh: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 头痛 | n. 令人头痛的难题
definition_en: Pain felt in the head. | A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.
example1_en: Office hours began with a severe headache.
example1_zh: 答疑从剧烈头痛开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a severe headache when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧烈头痛。
collocations: have a headache｜头痛 ; a severe headache｜剧烈头痛 ; a major headache｜一大难题
tip_zh: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

meanings_zh: n. 邀请；请帖

example2_en: A campus survey used an invitation to dinner to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用晚餐邀请来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

meanings_zh: n. 奖品；奖金；奖项 | v. 珍视；高度重视
definition_en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something | to value something very highly

example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of first prize.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得一等奖这个例子。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; first prize｜一等奖 ; prize money｜奖金 ; highly prized｜备受珍视的
tip_zh: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

meanings_zh: n. 药丸；药片 | n. 口服避孕药
definition_en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow | an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy

example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论维生素片的材料。

meanings_zh: adj. 醒着的 | v. 醒来；唤醒
definition_en: not sleeping | to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

example2_en: A campus survey used wide awake to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用完全清醒的来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: wide awake｜完全清醒的 ; stay awake｜保持清醒 ; lie awake｜躺着睡不着

meanings_zh: n. 噪音；响声

example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around background noise.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕背景噪音展开说明。

meanings_zh: adj. 女性的；雌性的 | n. 雌性动物；女性
definition_en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs. | An animal or person of the female sex.

example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论女生。
example2_en: A campus survey used female students to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用女生来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

collocations: imagine doing something｜想象做某事 ; hard to imagine｜难以想象 ; imagine the future｜设想未来
tip_zh: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 文件；档案；文件夹 | v. 归档；提交 | n. 锉刀
definition_en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers. | To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority. | A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about file documents.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于将文件归档的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used file documents to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用将文件归档来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: save a file｜保存文件 ; attach a file｜附加文件 ; file a complaint｜正式提出投诉 ; file documents｜将文件归档
tip_zh: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；提议 | n. 暗示；细微迹象
definition_en: an idea offered for someone to consider | a slight sign that something exists or may be true
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a useful suggestion.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有用的建议。
example2_en: The author returns to a useful suggestion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有用的建议。
collocations: make a suggestion｜提出建议 ; a useful suggestion｜有用的建议 ; a suggestion of｜一丝；些许
tip_zh: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 女演员
definition_en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films
example1_en: Our professor circled leading actress on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了女主角。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of leading actress.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得女主角这个例子。
collocations: leading actress｜女主角 ; supporting actress｜女配角 ; award-winning actress｜获奖女演员
tip_zh: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

meanings_zh: adj. 受欢迎的；流行的 | adj. 大众的；通俗的
definition_en: Liked or enjoyed by many people. | Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on increasingly popular.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论越来越受欢迎。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around increasingly popular.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕越来越受欢迎展开说明。
collocations: popular with students｜受学生欢迎 ; increasingly popular｜越来越受欢迎 ; popular culture｜大众文化 ; popular science｜通俗科学
tip_zh: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

meanings_zh: v. 表现；举止 | v. 守规矩 | v. 运转；作出特定反应
definition_en: to act in a particular way | to act politely and do what is expected | to work or react in a particular way
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to behave responsibly.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何负责任地行事。
example2_en: The passage says students who can behave responsibly follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够负责任地行事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: behave responsibly｜负责任地行事 ; behave well｜表现良好 ; behave yourself｜规矩一点 ; behave like｜表现得像
tip_zh: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

meanings_zh: v. 创造；创作 | v. 造成；引起
definition_en: to make something new or bring something into existence | to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop
example1_en: The assignment is to create opportunities, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先创造机会，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to create opportunities.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来创造机会。
collocations: create opportunities｜创造机会 ; create jobs｜创造就业机会 ; create a problem｜造成问题 ; create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip_zh: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

meanings_zh: n. 组织；机构；团体 | n. 组织安排；条理
definition_en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose. | The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.
example1_en: Office hours began with charitable organisation.
example1_zh: 答疑从慈善组织开始。
example2_en: The author returns to charitable organisation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了慈善组织。
collocations: charitable organisation｜慈善组织 ; international organisation｜国际组织 ; non-governmental organisation｜非政府组织 ; require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip_zh: 英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

meanings_zh: adj. 古代的 | adj. 非常古老的
definition_en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past | having existed for a very long time
example1_en: Our professor circled ancient history on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了古代史。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of ancient history.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得古代史这个例子。
collocations: ancient history｜古代史 ; ancient civilisation｜古代文明 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗址 ; ancient monument｜古代历史遗迹
tip_zh: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

meanings_zh: n. 自拍照
definition_en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on selfie stick.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自拍杆。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss selfie stick.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自拍杆的材料。
collocations: take a selfie｜拍自拍照 ; post a selfie｜发布自拍照 ; selfie stick｜自拍杆
tip_zh: 拍自拍照用take a selfie，不用make a selfie。

meanings_zh: n. 计划；方案；课程 | n. 电视或广播节目 | v. 安排；设定运行方式
definition_en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose | a show broadcast on television or radio | to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically
example1_en: The textbook introduces training programme in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了培训项目。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of training programme.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得培训项目这个例子。
collocations: training programme｜培训项目 ; television programme｜电视节目 ; degree programme｜学位课程 ; launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip_zh: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

meanings_zh: n. 演讲者；发言者 | n. 说某种语言的人 | n. 扬声器；音箱
definition_en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others | a person who speaks a particular language | a device that produces sound from electrical signals
example1_en: Office hours began with guest speaker.
example1_zh: 答疑从特邀演讲者开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around guest speaker.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕特邀演讲者展开说明。
collocations: guest speaker｜特邀演讲者 ; native speaker｜母语使用者 ; fluent speaker｜说话流利的人 ; wireless speaker｜无线音箱
tip_zh: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

meanings_zh: n. 侄女；外甥女
definition_en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about young niece.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于年幼的侄女或外甥女的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around young niece.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕年幼的侄女或外甥女展开说明。
collocations: young niece｜年幼的侄女或外甥女 ; nieces and nephews｜侄子侄女及外甥外甥女
tip_zh: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐会；演唱会
definition_en: a live musical performance given before an audience
example1_en: I copied concert hall into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把音乐厅抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of concert hall.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得音乐厅这个例子。
collocations: attend a concert｜出席音乐会 ; give a concert｜举办音乐会 ; concert hall｜音乐厅 ; live concert｜现场音乐会
tip_zh: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

meanings_zh: v. 加入；参加 | v. 连接；接合
definition_en: Becoming a member of a group or taking part. | Connecting two or more things together.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to joining a club.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求加入俱乐部。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to joining a club.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得加入俱乐部。
collocations: joining a club｜加入俱乐部 ; joining forces｜联手合作 ; joining two pieces together｜把两块连接起来
tip_zh: 是join的-ing形式；加入组织直接接宾语，不加in。

meanings_zh: n. 问候；招呼 | n. 祝愿；祝福
definition_en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone. | Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.
example1_en: Our professor circled a warm greeting on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了热情的问候。
example2_en: The author returns to a warm greeting when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了热情的问候。
collocations: a warm greeting｜热情的问候 ; exchange greetings｜互致问候 ; a greeting card｜贺卡 ; birthday greetings｜生日祝福
tip_zh: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。

meanings_zh: adj. 半价的 | adv. 以半价
definition_en: costing half the usual price | at half the usual price
example1_en: After the lecture, we used half-price in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了半价的。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses half-price when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了半价的。
collocations: half-price tickets｜半价票 ; half-price sale｜半价促销 ; buy something half-price｜以半价购买某物
tip_zh: 名词前常写half-price；at half price不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道 | v. 报告；报道 | v. 报到
definition_en: A spoken or written account giving information about something | To give information about an event or situation | To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge
example1_en: I copied a news report into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把新闻报道抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a news report.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕新闻报道展开说明。
collocations: write a report｜撰写报告 ; a news report｜新闻报道 ; report a problem｜报告问题 ; report for duty｜报到上班
tip_zh: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；机灵的 | adj. 巧妙的
definition_en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions. | Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.
example1_en: Office hours began with clever idea.
example1_zh: 答疑从巧妙的主意开始。
example2_en: The reading connects clever idea with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把巧妙的主意和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: clever idea｜巧妙的主意 ; clever at｜擅长 ; clever solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip_zh: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

meanings_zh: n. 现金；现款 | v. 将支票兑现
definition_en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes | Exchange a cheque for money
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about withdraw cash.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于提取现金的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects withdraw cash with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把提取现金和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pay in cash｜用现金付款 ; withdraw cash｜提取现金 ; cash a cheque｜兑现支票 ; cash flow｜现金流
tip_zh: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

meanings_zh: n. 肩；肩膀 | v. 承担；肩负
definition_en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body | to accept responsibility for something difficult
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about shoulder to shoulder.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于肩并肩的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of shoulder to shoulder.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得肩并肩这个例子。
collocations: shoulder responsibility｜承担责任 ; shoulder the burden｜承担重担 ; shoulder to shoulder｜肩并肩 ; look over your shoulder｜回头看
tip_zh: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

meanings_zh: n. 王子；亲王 | n. 公国君主
definition_en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son. | A male ruler of a small independent state.
example1_en: Our professor circled crown prince on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了王储。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of crown prince.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得王储这个例子。
collocations: crown prince｜王储 ; young prince｜年轻的王子
tip_zh: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。

meanings_zh: n. 石油；原油 | n. 油；食用油；润滑油 | v. 给…加润滑油
definition_en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals. | A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes. | To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.
example1_en: I copied crude oil into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把原油抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects crude oil with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把原油和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: crude oil｜原油 ; oil prices｜石油价格 ; cooking oil｜食用油 ; oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

meanings_zh: v. 介绍；引见 | v. 引进；推行 | v. 使初次了解
definition_en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet. | Bring something into use or a place for the first time. | Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to introduce yourself.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求介绍自己。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to introduce yourself.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们介绍自己。
collocations: introduce yourself｜介绍自己 ; introduce someone to someone｜把某人介绍给某人 ; introduce new measures｜推行新措施 ; introduce someone to a subject｜引导某人了解一门学科
tip_zh: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。

meanings_zh: n. 舞者；舞蹈演员
definition_en: someone who dances, especially as a job
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on professional dancer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论专业舞蹈演员。
example2_en: The reading connects professional dancer with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把专业舞蹈演员和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: professional dancer｜专业舞蹈演员 ; ballet dancer｜芭蕾舞演员 ; talented dancer｜有天赋的舞者
tip_zh: dancer不限定性别，也不一定指职业舞者。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可能的 | adj. 极难应付的
definition_en: unable to happen, exist, or be done | extremely difficult to deal with or satisfy
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about almost impossible.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于几乎不可能的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around almost impossible.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕几乎不可能展开说明。
collocations: almost impossible｜几乎不可能 ; impossible task｜不可能完成的任务 ; make it impossible to｜使……无法做到
tip_zh: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

meanings_zh: adv. 很可能；大概
definition_en: Used when something is likely but not certain.
example1_en: The professor told us to probably not and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们大概不会，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: Students who probably not are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够大概不会的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: will probably｜很可能会 ; probably not｜大概不会 ; probably because｜很可能是因为
tip_zh: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

meanings_zh: v. 分享；共用；分担 | n. 一份；份额 | n. 股份
definition_en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others. | One part of something divided among people or groups. | One of the equal units of ownership in a company.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to share responsibility.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何分担责任。
example2_en: The passage says students who can share responsibility follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够分担责任的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物 ; share responsibility｜分担责任 ; market share｜市场份额 ; buy shares｜购买股份
tip_zh: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

meanings_zh: adj. 相似的；类似的
definition_en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.
example1_en: Office hours began with broadly similar.
example1_zh: 答疑从大致相似开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used broadly similar to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用大致相似来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: similar to｜与……相似 ; similar characteristics｜相似的特征 ; broadly similar｜大致相似
tip_zh: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

meanings_zh: n. 想法；念头 | n. 思考；考虑 | v. 想；认为（过去式）
definition_en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind | the process of thinking carefully about something | past tense and past participle of think
example1_en: Our professor circled deep in thought on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了陷入沉思。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deep in thought.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论陷入沉思的材料。
collocations: give something some thought｜考虑某事 ; deep in thought｜陷入沉思 ; a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头 ; food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip_zh: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 重量；体重 | n. 重物；砝码 | n. 重要性；影响力
definition_en: How heavy someone or something is. | A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight. | The importance or influence given to something.
example1_en: The professor explained weight with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了重量。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up weight while discussing evidence about public health.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了重量。
collocations: lose weight｜减重 ; gain weight｜增重 ; lift weights｜举重训练 ; give weight to｜重视
tip_zh: weight是名词；weigh是动词：How much does it weigh?

meanings_zh: v. 偷窃；盗用 | v. 偷偷移动 | n. 极便宜的东西
definition_en: to take something without permission and keep or use it | to move quietly without attracting attention | something bought for much less than its usual price
example1_en: The professor asked us to steal an idea.
example1_zh: 教授让我们盗用创意。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to steal an idea.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来盗用创意。
collocations: steal from someone｜偷某人的东西 ; steal an idea｜盗用创意 ; steal the show｜抢尽风头
tip_zh: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

meanings_zh: adj. 现代的；近代的 | adj. 新式的；时髦的
definition_en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times. | Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.
example1_en: Our professor circled modern society on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了现代社会。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss modern society.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论现代社会的材料。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; modern technology｜现代技术 ; modern architecture｜现代建筑
tip_zh: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

meanings_zh: n. 意见；看法
definition_en: a belief or judgement about someone or something
example1_en: The textbook introduces public opinion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公众舆论。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss public opinion.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论公众舆论的材料。
collocations: in my opinion｜在我看来 ; public opinion｜公众舆论 ; express an opinion｜表达意见 ; a difference of opinion｜意见分歧
tip_zh: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

meanings_zh: n. 病人；患者 | adj. 有耐心的；能忍耐的
definition_en: Someone receiving medical care. | Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.
example1_en: Our professor circled patient care on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了患者护理。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of patient care.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得患者护理这个例子。
collocations: treat a patient｜治疗患者 ; patient care｜患者护理 ; be patient with｜对……有耐心

meanings_zh: n. 机器人；自动机械

example2_zh: 这篇阅读把工业机器人和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: industrial robot｜工业机器人 ; robot arm｜机械臂 ; autonomous robot｜自主机器人

meanings_zh: n. 公公；岳父
definition_en: the father of your husband or wife

example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了公公。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up father-in-law while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了公公。
collocations: future father-in-law｜未来的公公或岳父 ; elderly father-in-law｜年迈的公公或岳父

meanings_zh: n. 药店（兼售日用品）
definition_en: an American shop selling medicines and various everyday products

example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了当地药店。
example2_en: A campus survey used local drugstore to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用当地药店来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: local drugstore｜当地药店 ; drugstore chain｜连锁药店 ; drugstore counter｜药店柜台
tip_zh: 主要用于美式英语；英式常用chemist’s或pharmacy。

meanings_zh: n. 顾客；客户
definition_en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about regular customer.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于常客的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects regular customer with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把常客和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: customer service｜客户服务 ; regular customer｜常客 ; customer satisfaction｜客户满意度 ; customer loyalty｜客户忠诚度
tip_zh: customer泛指顾客；client常指专业服务的客户。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法；魔术 | n. 魅力；奇妙之处 | adj. 有魔力的；魔术的
definition_en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it. | A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful. | Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.
example1_en: I copied magic trick into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把魔术戏法抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss magic trick.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论魔术戏法的材料。
collocations: magic trick｜魔术戏法 ; magic wand｜魔杖 ; magic solution｜神奇的解决办法
tip_zh: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题
definition_en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study
example1_en: Office hours began with a controversial topic.
example1_zh: 答疑从有争议的话题开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a controversial topic.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得有争议的话题这个例子。
collocations: a topic of discussion｜讨论的话题 ; a controversial topic｜有争议的话题 ; change the topic｜转换话题 ; research topic｜研究课题
tip_zh: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

meanings_zh: prep. 反对；与……对抗 | prep. 靠着；紧贴 | prep. 防备；抵御
definition_en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them. | Touching or supported by a surface. | For protection from something harmful or unwanted.
example1_en: I copied vote against into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把投票反对抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used vote against to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用投票反对来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: vote against｜投票反对 ; lean against｜倚靠 ; protect against｜防护；抵御 ; against the law｜违法
tip_zh: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 智能手机
definition_en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about smartphone app.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于智能手机应用的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects smartphone app with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把智能手机应用和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: smartphone app｜智能手机应用 ; smartphone user｜智能手机用户 ; smartphone addiction｜智能手机成瘾
tip_zh: smartphone是可数名词，通常写成一个词。

meanings_zh: adj. 精确的；确切的 | v. 强求；索取
definition_en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error. | Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.
example1_en: Our professor circled exact location on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了确切位置。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss exact location.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论确切位置的材料。
collocations: exact location｜确切位置 ; exact amount｜准确数量 ; exact copy｜完全相同的复制品 ; exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip_zh: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

meanings_zh: n. 吸烟
definition_en: The activity or habit of breathing in smoke from tobacco.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on passive smoking.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论被动吸烟。
example2_en: The reading connects passive smoking with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把被动吸烟和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: give up smoking｜戒烟 ; passive smoking｜被动吸烟 ; smoking ban｜禁烟令
tip_zh: 表示吸烟活动时不可数；戒烟可用give up smoking。

meanings_zh: v. 比较；对比 | v. 把……比作 | v. 比得上；可相比
definition_en: To examine things to find similarities and differences. | To describe something as similar to another thing. | To be as good as, or similar to, something else.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer compare prices during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时比较价格。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers compare prices before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要比较价格。
collocations: compare prices｜比较价格 ; compare A with B｜将A与B比较 ; compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B ; compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip_zh: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

meanings_zh: n. 海报；招贴画
definition_en: A large printed picture or announcement displayed on a surface
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on advertising poster.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论广告海报。
example2_en: A campus survey used advertising poster to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用广告海报来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: put up a poster｜张贴海报 ; design a poster｜设计海报 ; advertising poster｜广告海报 ; poster campaign｜海报宣传活动
tip_zh: poster 是海报；postcard 是明信片，注意区分。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能 | adv. 或许（委婉建议或请求）
definition_en: Used when something is possible but not certain. | Used to make a suggestion or request sound less direct.
example1_en: The lab manual says to perhaps not before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先也许不是，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will perhaps not when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会也许不是。
collocations: perhaps not｜也许不是 ; perhaps the best｜或许是最好的 ; perhaps we could｜或许我们可以
tip_zh: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

meanings_zh: n. 邻居；邻近的人或事物
definition_en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another
example1_en: The textbook introduces next-door neighbour in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了隔壁邻居。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of next-door neighbour.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得隔壁邻居这个例子。
collocations: next-door neighbour｜隔壁邻居 ; close neighbours｜近邻 ; neighbouring countries｜邻国
tip_zh: 英式拼写neighbour，美式拼写neighbor。

meanings_zh: v. 点击 | n. 咔嗒声；点击 | v. 突然明白；恍然大悟
definition_en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen | a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen | to suddenly become clear or understood
example1_en: I heard the lecturer click on a link during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时点击链接。
example2_en: The reading asks you to click on a link and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你点击链接，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: click on a link｜点击链接 ; a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击 ; a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip_zh: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

meanings_zh: n. 脖子；颈部 | n. 瓶颈；狭长部分
definition_en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders | a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle
example1_en: The textbook introduces a stiff neck in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了脖子僵硬。

example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得脖子僵硬这个例子。
collocations: neck pain｜颈部疼痛 ; a stiff neck｜脖子僵硬 ; the neck of a bottle｜瓶颈
tip_zh: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

meanings_zh: n. 双胞胎之一 | adj. 成对的；双胞胎的
definition_en: One of two children born to the same mother together. | Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.
example1_en: Our professor circled twin sister on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了双胞胎姐妹。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of twin sister.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得双胞胎姐妹这个例子。
collocations: identical twins｜同卵双胞胎 ; twin sister｜双胞胎姐妹 ; twin beds｜两张单人床
tip_zh: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

meanings_zh: n. 设备；器材；装备
definition_en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于体育器材的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sports equipment.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论体育器材的材料。
collocations: sports equipment｜体育器材 ; medical equipment｜医疗设备 ; safety equipment｜安全装备 ; a piece of equipment｜一件设备

meanings_zh: v. 争吵；争论 | v. 论证；主张
definition_en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way. | To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to argue that.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求主张……。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to argue that.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们主张……。

meanings_zh: n. 行为；举止 | n. 运行方式；反应特性
definition_en: The way a person or animal acts. | The way something functions or reacts under particular conditions.

example1_zh: 答疑从良好行为开始。
example2_en: The author returns to good behaviour when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了良好行为。

tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式拼写behaviour，美式拼写behavior。

definition_en: To strike your hands together, often to show approval. | A sudden loud sound, especially from hands striking together.

example1_zh: 实验说明要求拍手。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to clap your hands.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得拍手。
collocations: clap your hands｜拍手 ; clap along｜跟着节奏拍手 ; a clap of thunder｜一声霹雳
tip_zh: 过去式clapped；现在分词clapping，双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 讨论；商讨 | n. 论述；探讨
definition_en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject. | A detailed examination of a subject in speech or writing.

example2_en: A campus survey used group discussion to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用小组讨论来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: have a discussion｜进行讨论 ; group discussion｜小组讨论 ; under discussion｜在讨论中 ; in-depth discussion｜深入探讨
tip_zh: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wedding ceremony.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕婚礼仪式展开说明。

meanings_zh: n. 血；血液 | n. 血缘；家世

example2_en: A campus survey used donate blood to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用献血来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

meanings_zh: phr. 据……所说；根据 | phr. 按照；依据
definition_en: As stated or reported by someone or something | In a way determined by a rule or particular factor

example1_zh: 答疑从根据研究开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss according to research.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论根据研究的材料。

meanings_zh: n. 人群；观众 | v. 挤满；聚集
definition_en: A large group of people gathered in one place. | To gather closely together or fill a place with people.
example1_en: Our professor circled a large crowd on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一大群人。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a large crowd.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一大群人的材料。

tip_zh: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。

meanings_zh: n. 发动机；引擎 | n. 推动力 | n. 专用软件引擎
definition_en: a machine that produces power to make something move | something that strongly drives growth or change | software that performs a particular core task within a system
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about jet engine.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于喷气发动机的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of jet engine.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得喷气发动机这个例子。
collocations: start the engine｜启动发动机 ; jet engine｜喷气发动机 ; search engine｜搜索引擎 ; an engine of growth｜增长的推动力
tip_zh: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

meanings_zh: n. 法律；法规 | n. 法学 | n. 定律；规律

example1_zh: 我把law和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up law while discussing evidence about public institutions.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了法律。

tip_zh: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时杀灭病菌。

example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来杀灭病菌。

example2_en: A campus survey used a distant planet to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用遥远的行星来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

meanings_zh: adj. 传统的；沿袭已久的

example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于传统习俗的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around traditional customs.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕传统习俗展开说明。
collocations: traditional customs｜传统习俗 ; traditional crafts｜传统手工艺 ; traditional methods｜传统方法
tip_zh: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

meanings_zh: n. 软件
definition_en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks

example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于安装软件的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects install software with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把安装软件和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip_zh: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。

meanings_zh: n. 小偷；窃贼
definition_en: someone who steals another person's belongings

example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于偷自行车的人的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a bicycle thief to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用偷自行车的人来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a bicycle thief｜偷自行车的人 ; catch a thief｜抓住小偷 ; a petty thief｜小偷小摸的人

example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a spider's web.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得蜘蛛网这个例子。
collocations: browse the web｜浏览网页 ; a spider's web｜蜘蛛网 ; a web of relationships｜错综复杂的关系网
tip_zh: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

meanings_zh: n. 描述；描写
definition_en: an account explaining what someone or something is like
example1_en: I copied a detailed description into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把详细描述抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a detailed description when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了详细描述。
collocations: a detailed description｜详细描述 ; give a description of｜描述 ; a job description｜岗位职责说明 ; an accurate description｜准确描述
tip_zh: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

meanings_zh: n. 原因；起因 | v. 导致；引起 | n. 事业；奋斗目标
definition_en: something that makes an event or situation happen | make something happen, especially something unpleasant | an aim or principle that people support and work towards
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about root cause.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于根本原因的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used root cause to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用根本原因来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: cause of｜……的原因 ; cause damage｜造成损害 ; root cause｜根本原因 ; a good cause｜公益事业
tip_zh: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

meanings_zh: n. 知识；学识 | n. 知晓；了解
definition_en: information and understanding gained through learning or experience | awareness of a particular fact or situation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about practical knowledge.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于实用知识的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of practical knowledge.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得实用知识这个例子。
collocations: gain knowledge｜获取知识 ; practical knowledge｜实用知识 ; knowledge of｜对……的了解 ; without someone's knowledge｜在某人不知情的情况下
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可说a good knowledge of某领域。

meanings_zh: n. 胃；腹部 | v. 忍受；容忍
definition_en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area | To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted
example1_en: Office hours began with an empty stomach.
example1_zh: 答疑从空腹开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an empty stomach.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论空腹的材料。
collocations: an empty stomach｜空腹 ; stomach ache｜胃痛；肚子痛 ; stomach pain｜胃痛
tip_zh: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。

meanings_zh: n. 注意；注意力 | n. 照料；处理；关心
definition_en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something. | Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.
example1_en: I copied attract attention into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把吸引注意抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to attract attention when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了吸引注意。
collocations: pay attention to｜注意 ; attract attention｜吸引注意 ; medical attention｜医疗救治 ; attention span｜注意力持续时间
tip_zh: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。

meanings_zh: n. 练习册 | n. 电子表格工作簿
definition_en: A book containing exercises for learners to complete | A computer file containing one or more spreadsheets
example1_en: I copied a grammar workbook into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把语法练习册抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a grammar workbook.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕语法练习册展开说明。
collocations: complete a workbook｜做完练习册 ; workbook exercises｜练习册习题 ; a grammar workbook｜语法练习册
tip_zh: workbook侧重练习；textbook侧重讲解知识。

meanings_zh: n. 形容词
definition_en: a word that describes a person, thing, or state
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a descriptive adjective.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论描写性形容词。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a descriptive adjective.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得描写性形容词这个例子。
collocations: a descriptive adjective｜描写性形容词 ; a comparative adjective｜比较级形容词 ; adjective order｜形容词排列顺序
tip_zh: 形容词常放在名词前或系动词后，如a cold day。

meanings_zh: n. 皮肤 | n. 果皮；外皮 | v. 剥去皮
definition_en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body. | The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables. | Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: Office hours began with dry skin.
example1_zh: 答疑从干性皮肤开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of dry skin.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得干性皮肤这个例子。
collocations: dry skin｜干性皮肤 ; sensitive skin｜敏感皮肤 ; skin care｜皮肤护理 ; potato skins｜土豆皮
tip_zh: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。

meanings_zh: v. 决定；选定 | v. 决定结果
definition_en: To choose what to do after considering the possibilities. | To determine the result of something.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to decide on.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须选定。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to decide on.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们选定。
collocations: decide to do something｜决定做某事 ; decide on｜选定 ; decide against｜决定不采用 ; decide the outcome｜决定结果
tip_zh: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 疼痛的；引起疼痛的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；令人难堪的
definition_en: causing physical pain or hurting | causing sadness, distress, or embarrassment
example1_en: I copied a painful injury into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把令人疼痛的伤抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a painful injury.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕令人疼痛的伤展开说明。
collocations: a painful injury｜令人疼痛的伤 ; a painful experience｜痛苦的经历 ; painful memories｜痛苦的回忆 ; painful to touch｜一碰就疼
tip_zh: painful可指身体疼痛，也可指情感痛苦或难堪。

meanings_zh: n. 儿童游乐场；操场
definition_en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.
example1_en: I copied school playground into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把学校操场抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around school playground.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕学校操场展开说明。
collocations: school playground｜学校操场 ; playground equipment｜游乐场设施 ; adventure playground｜探险游乐场
tip_zh: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。

meanings_zh: n. 膝盖；膝关节
definition_en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about knee joint.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于膝关节的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around knee joint.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕膝关节展开说明。
collocations: knee joint｜膝关节 ; knee injury｜膝部损伤 ; bend your knees｜弯曲膝盖 ; on your knees｜跪着
tip_zh: 词首k不发音；复数knees读作/niːz/。

meanings_zh: n. 拼写；拼写能力 | n. 拼法
definition_en: forming words correctly using their written characters | the particular way a word is written
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on check your spelling.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论检查拼写。
example2_en: A campus survey used check your spelling to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用检查拼写来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: spelling mistake｜拼写错误 ; check your spelling｜检查拼写 ; correct spelling｜正确拼写
tip_zh: 指拼写能力通常不可数；指具体拼法可数。

meanings_zh: n. 头脑；心智；思维 | v. 介意；反对 | v. 留意；小心；照看
definition_en: The part of you that thinks, feels, and remembers. | To feel annoyed or uncomfortable about something. | To pay attention to something or take care of someone.
example1_en: Office hours began with peace of mind.
example1_zh: 答疑从内心安宁开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used peace of mind to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用内心安宁来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: change your mind｜改变主意 ; keep in mind｜牢记 ; mind doing something｜介意做某事 ; peace of mind｜内心安宁
tip_zh: 表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

meanings_zh: n. 小测验；知识问答 | v. 测验；详细询问
definition_en: A short test or game involving questions. | To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about general knowledge quiz.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于常识问答的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of general knowledge quiz.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得常识问答这个例子。
collocations: take a quiz｜参加小测验 ; general knowledge quiz｜常识问答 ; quiz someone on｜就……测问某人
tip_zh: 复数为quizzes；过去式为quizzed。

meanings_zh: n. 动画片 | n. 漫画；讽刺画
definition_en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images | a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about animated cartoon.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于动画片的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of animated cartoon.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得动画片这个例子。
collocations: cartoon character｜卡通人物 ; animated cartoon｜动画片 ; political cartoon｜政治讽刺漫画
tip_zh: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；广为人知的
definition_en: known or recognised by many people
example1_en: After the lecture, we used well-known in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了著名的。
example2_en: Students who can explain well-known usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释著名的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: well-known author｜著名作家 ; well-known landmark｜著名地标 ; well-known fact｜众所周知的事实
tip_zh: 名词前通常加连字符；表语位置通常写well known。

meanings_zh: n. 脚趾 | n. 鞋尖；袜尖
definition_en: One of the five separate parts at the foot's end | The part of a shoe or sock covering the toes
example1_en: Office hours began with big toe.
example1_zh: 答疑从大脚趾开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of big toe.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得大脚趾这个例子。
collocations: big toe｜大脚趾 ; little toe｜小脚趾 ; stub your toe｜脚趾撞到硬物 ; from head to toe｜从头到脚
tip_zh: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

meanings_zh: adj. 人的；人类的 | n. 人；人类成员
definition_en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines. | A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on human beings.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人类。
example2_en: A campus survey used human beings to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用人类来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: human beings｜人类 ; human rights｜人权 ; human activity｜人类活动 ; human error｜人为失误
tip_zh: human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

meanings_zh: n. 和平；和睦 | n. 安宁；平静
definition_en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement | a state of quietness or freedom from worry
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lasting peace.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论持久和平。
example2_en: A campus survey used lasting peace to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用持久和平来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: lasting peace｜持久和平 ; peace and quiet｜清静 ; peace of mind｜安心 ; peace talks｜和平谈判
tip_zh: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

meanings_zh: n. 预约；约定会面 | n. 任命；委任
definition_en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time. | The act of choosing someone for a job or position.
example1_en: I wrote appointment on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把appointment和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on public health uses appointment when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了预约。
collocations: make an appointment｜预约 ; cancel an appointment｜取消预约 ; by appointment only｜仅接受预约 ; appointment of a director｜董事的任命
tip_zh: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。

meanings_zh: n. 便士；一便士硬币 | n. 一美分硬币
definition_en: A British coin or unit worth one hundredth of a pound. | An American coin worth one hundredth of a dollar.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on every penny.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论每一分钱。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of every penny.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得每一分钱这个例子。
collocations: every penny｜每一分钱 ; not a penny｜一分钱也没有 ; worth every penny｜物有所值
tip_zh: 英国金额复数用pence；指多枚硬币用pennies。

meanings_zh: n. 英镑 | n. 磅（重量单位） | v. 连续猛击；怦怦跳
definition_en: the main unit of money used in the United Kingdom | a unit of weight equal to about 454 grams | to hit repeatedly with force or beat strongly
example1_en: The textbook introduces the British pound in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了英镑。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the British pound.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕英镑展开说明。
collocations: the British pound｜英镑 ; a pound of butter｜一磅黄油 ; pound on the door｜猛敲门 ; heart pounding｜心怦怦直跳
tip_zh: 英镑和重量单位磅都用pound；复数通常加s。

meanings_zh: n. 目标 | n. 进球；进球得分 | n. 球门
definition_en: Something you want to accomplish through effort. | A score made by sending a ball into a goal. | A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a long-term goal in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了长期目标。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a long-term goal.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论长期目标的材料。
collocations: set a goal｜设定目标 ; achieve a goal｜实现目标 ; a long-term goal｜长期目标 ; score a goal｜进球得分
tip_zh: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

meanings_zh: n. 剧院 | n. 戏剧；戏剧艺术 | n. 手术室
definition_en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances. | The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays. | A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.
example1_en: The textbook introduces musical theatre in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐剧。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around musical theatre.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕音乐剧展开说明。
collocations: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏 ; a theatre company｜剧团 ; musical theatre｜音乐剧 ; an operating theatre｜手术室
tip_zh: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

meanings_zh: n. 科学家
definition_en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments
example1_en: I copied research scientist into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把科研人员抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects research scientist with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把科研人员和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: research scientist｜科研人员 ; leading scientist｜顶尖科学家 ; environmental scientist｜环境科学家
tip_zh: scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

meanings_zh: conj. 虽然；尽管
definition_en: despite the fact that
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on although not always.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论虽然并非总是。
example2_en: A campus survey used although not always to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用虽然并非总是来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: although it is true that｜虽然确实…… ; although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip_zh: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记本电脑
definition_en: A portable computer with a screen that folds over its keyboard.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on laptop computer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论笔记本电脑。
example2_en: The reading connects laptop computer with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把笔记本电脑和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: laptop computer｜笔记本电脑 ; laptop charger｜笔记本电脑充电器 ; laptop battery｜笔记本电脑电池
tip_zh: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

meanings_zh: n. 牙医
definition_en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a qualified dentist.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有执业资格的牙医。
example2_en: The author returns to a qualified dentist when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有执业资格的牙医。
collocations: see a dentist｜看牙医 ; a dentist's appointment｜牙科预约 ; a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip_zh: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

meanings_zh: n. 练习；训练 | n. 惯例；做法 | n. 实践；实际应用
definition_en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill. | A usual or established way of doing something. | The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.
example1_en: Our professor circled regular practice on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了定期练习。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around regular practice.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕定期练习展开说明。
collocations: regular practice｜定期练习 ; common practice｜惯常做法 ; in practice｜实际上 ; put into practice｜付诸实践
tip_zh: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

meanings_zh: adj. 生病的；身体不适的 | adv. 恶劣地；不友善地
definition_en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell. | In a bad or unkind way.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on seriously ill.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论病得很重。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of seriously ill.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得病得很重这个例子。
collocations: seriously ill｜病得很重 ; fall ill｜生病 ; speak ill of｜说……的坏话
tip_zh: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

meanings_zh: n. 出生；分娩 | n. 起源；诞生
definition_en: The event or process of a baby being born. | The beginning of something new.
example1_en: I copied date of birth into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把出生日期抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used date of birth to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用出生日期来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: give birth to｜生下；产生 ; date of birth｜出生日期 ; birth rate｜出生率 ; the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip_zh: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

meanings_zh: v. 上升；增加；上涨 | v. 起身；站起来 | n. 上升；增长；上涨
definition_en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level. | To get up from sitting or lying down. | An increase in amount, level, or value.
example1_en: The professor asked us to rise steadily.
example1_zh: 教授让我们稳步上升。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to rise steadily.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得稳步上升。
collocations: a sharp rise｜急剧上涨 ; rise steadily｜稳步上升 ; rise to your feet｜站起身 ; a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip_zh: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；推测 | v. 假设；设想
definition_en: To think something is probably true without being certain. | To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer suppose that during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时假设；认为。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to suppose that.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得假设；认为。
collocations: I suppose so｜我想是吧 ; suppose that｜假设；认为 ; be supposed to do｜应该做；按安排做
tip_zh: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 私人的；非公开的 | adj. 私营的；私有的 | adj. 私密的；保密的
definition_en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone. | Owned or managed independently of the government. | Not intended to be known or shared with others.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on private property.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论私有财产。
example2_en: The reading connects private property with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把私有财产和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: private property｜私有财产 ; private sector｜私营部门 ; private life｜私生活 ; in private｜私下地
tip_zh: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

meanings_zh: num. 一百万
definition_en: the number equal to a thousand thousands
example1_en: Office hours began with a million people.
example1_zh: 答疑从一百万人开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a million people with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一百万人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a million people｜一百万人 ; two million pounds｜两百万英镑 ; millions of people｜数百万人
tip_zh: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

meanings_zh: n. 药；药物 | n. 医学；医术
definition_en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness. | The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.
example1_en: I copied preventive medicine into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把预防医学抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects preventive medicine with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把预防医学和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: take medicine｜服药 ; study medicine｜学医 ; preventive medicine｜预防医学 ; prescribe medicine｜开药
tip_zh: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 学习 | n. 学问；学识
definition_en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience. | Knowledge gained through extensive study.
example1_en: Our professor circled lifelong learning on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了终身学习。
example2_en: A campus survey used lifelong learning to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用终身学习来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: lifelong learning｜终身学习 ; independent learning｜自主学习 ; a learning environment｜学习环境 ; a steep learning curve｜陡峭的学习曲线
tip_zh: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。

meanings_zh: adj. 确信的；有把握的 | adj. 必然的；确定的 | adj. 某个；某些
definition_en: having no doubt about something | definitely going to happen | particular but not named or fully described
example1_en: I copied certain of into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把对……有把握抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used certain of to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用对……有把握来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: certain of｜对……有把握 ; certain to happen｜必然发生 ; make certain｜确保 ; certain types of｜某些类型的
tip_zh: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

meanings_zh: n. 枪；炮 | n. 枪状工具
definition_en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells | a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance
example1_en: The textbook introduces a loaded gun in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了装有弹药的枪。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a loaded gun.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕装有弹药的枪展开说明。
collocations: gun control｜枪支管制 ; a loaded gun｜装有弹药的枪 ; a glue gun｜胶枪 ; a spray gun｜喷枪
tip_zh: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

meanings_zh: n. 照料；护理 | v. 关心；在意 | n. 小心；谨慎
definition_en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help | To feel concern or consider something important | Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on medical care.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医疗护理。
example2_en: The author returns to medical care when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了医疗护理。
collocations: medical care｜医疗护理 ; take care of｜照顾 ; care about｜关心；在意 ; with care｜小心地
tip_zh: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

meanings_zh: n. 时尚；流行款式 | n. 方式 | v. 制作；塑造
definition_en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time | A particular way of doing something | Make or shape something, often using simple materials
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about out of fashion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于过时的的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of out of fashion.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得过时的这个例子。
collocations: in fashion｜流行的 ; out of fashion｜过时的 ; fashion industry｜时装行业 ; in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip_zh: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 心脏 | n. 内心；感情 | n. 核心；中心
definition_en: The organ that pumps blood around the body. | The part of someone associated with feelings and love. | The central or most important part of something.
example1_en: Our professor circled heart disease on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了心脏病。
example2_en: The author returns to heart disease when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了心脏病。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; at the heart of｜处于……的核心 ; learn by heart｜背熟 ; lose heart｜灰心
tip_zh: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

meanings_zh: n. 笔迹；手写字
definition_en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.
example1_en: Our professor circled neat handwriting on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了工整的笔迹。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around neat handwriting.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕工整的笔迹展开说明。
collocations: neat handwriting｜工整的笔迹 ; illegible handwriting｜难以辨认的笔迹 ; improve your handwriting｜改善书写
tip_zh: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

meanings_zh: n. 节日；庆祝活动 | n. 艺术节；系列展演活动
definition_en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event | An organised series of performances or other cultural events
example1_en: The textbook introduces music festival in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐节。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around music festival.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕音乐节展开说明。
collocations: celebrate a festival｜庆祝节日 ; music festival｜音乐节 ; film festival｜电影节 ; hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip_zh: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

meanings_zh: v. 连接；接通 | v. 联系；把…关联起来 | v. 与人建立良好关系
definition_en: to join things together or link them electronically | to recognize or establish a relationship between things | to develop a good relationship with someone
example1_en: The assignment is to connect to the internet, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先连接互联网，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to connect to the internet.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得连接互联网。
collocations: connect to the internet｜连接互联网 ; connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来 ; connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip_zh: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

meanings_zh: n. 痕迹；记号 | n. 分数；成绩 | v. 做标记；批改评分
definition_en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface | a score showing the quality of a student's work | to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work
example1_en: The professor explained mark with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了痕迹。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses mark when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了痕迹。
collocations: leave a mark｜留下痕迹 ; get high marks｜获得高分 ; mark an exam｜批改试卷 ; full marks｜满分
tip_zh: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

meanings_zh: n. 流行性感冒
definition_en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness
example1_en: Office hours began with flu symptoms.
example1_zh: 答疑从流感症状开始。
example2_en: The author returns to flu symptoms when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了流感症状。
collocations: have the flu｜患流感 ; flu symptoms｜流感症状 ; a flu vaccine｜流感疫苗 ; a flu outbreak｜流感暴发
tip_zh: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

meanings_zh: n. 广告
definition_en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.
example1_en: I copied online advertisement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把网络广告抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around online advertisement.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕网络广告展开说明。
collocations: an advertisement for｜关于……的广告 ; place an advertisement｜刊登广告 ; online advertisement｜网络广告
tip_zh: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

meanings_zh: n. 演讲；发言 | n. 说话能力；言语
definition_en: A formal talk given to an audience. | The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on freedom of speech.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论言论自由。
example2_en: A campus survey used freedom of speech to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用言论自由来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: give a speech｜发表演讲 ; freedom of speech｜言论自由 ; speech therapy｜言语治疗 ; opening speech｜开幕致辞
tip_zh: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 段落
definition_en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.
example1_en: The textbook introduces opening paragraph in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了开头段。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of opening paragraph.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得开头段这个例子。
collocations: opening paragraph｜开头段 ; concluding paragraph｜结尾段 ; a short paragraph｜一个短段落
tip_zh: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

meanings_zh: n. 机会 | n. 可能性 | n. 偶然；运气
definition_en: An opportunity to do something. | The likelihood that something will happen. | Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a chance to learn in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学习的机会。
example2_en: A campus survey used a chance to learn to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用学习的机会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a chance to learn｜学习的机会 ; a good chance of｜很有可能 ; by chance｜偶然 ; take a chance｜冒险一试
tip_zh: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

meanings_zh: n. 图画；素描 | n. 绘画；素描技法
definition_en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool. | The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.
example1_en: Our professor circled pencil drawing on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了铅笔画。
example2_en: The author returns to pencil drawing when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了铅笔画。
collocations: pencil drawing｜铅笔画 ; drawing skills｜绘画技巧 ; drawing class｜绘画课
tip_zh: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 食堂 | n. 便携式水壶
definition_en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace | a container used to carry drinking water outdoors
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on school canteen.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学校食堂。
example2_en: The author returns to school canteen when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校食堂。
collocations: school canteen｜学校食堂 ; staff canteen｜员工食堂 ; canteen food｜食堂饭菜 ; a water canteen｜便携式水壶
tip_zh: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。

meanings_zh: v. 解决；解答
definition_en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery
example1_en: The assignment is to solve a problem, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先解决问题，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers solve a problem before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要解决问题。
collocations: solve a problem｜解决问题 ; solve a puzzle｜解开谜题 ; solve an equation｜解方程
tip_zh: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

meanings_zh: v. 不同意；意见不合 | v. 不一致；不相符
definition_en: To have a different opinion from someone else. | To give different information or results.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to disagree with someone.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求不同意某人的看法。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to disagree with someone.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们不同意某人的看法。
collocations: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法 ; disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合 ; strongly disagree｜强烈反对
tip_zh: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

meanings_zh: n. 作者；作家 | v. 撰写；创作
definition_en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works. | To write a book, report, or other written work.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a bestselling author.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于畅销书作家的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bestselling author.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论畅销书作家的材料。
collocations: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者 ; a bestselling author｜畅销书作家 ; author a report｜撰写报告
tip_zh: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

meanings_zh: n. 肥皂 | n. 肥皂剧 | v. 用肥皂擦洗
definition_en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects. | A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships. | To rub or wash something with soap.
example1_en: Office hours began with a bar of soap.
example1_zh: 答疑从一块肥皂开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bar of soap.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一块肥皂的材料。
collocations: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂 ; liquid soap｜洗手液；液体皂 ; soap and water｜肥皂和水 ; soap opera｜肥皂剧
tip_zh: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

meanings_zh: adj. 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的 | adj. 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
definition_en: Having many bright colours | Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details
example1_en: Our professor circled colourful flowers on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了色彩鲜艳的花朵。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around colourful flowers.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕色彩鲜艳的花朵展开说明。
collocations: colourful flowers｜色彩鲜艳的花朵 ; a colourful display｜绚丽的展示 ; a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物 ; a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip_zh: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

meanings_zh: prep. 据……所述；根据 | prep. 按照；依照
definition_en: as stated or reported by someone or something | following a rule, plan, or particular standard
example1_en: After the lecture, we used according to in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了根据。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses according to when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了根据。
collocations: according to research｜根据研究 ; according to plan｜按计划 ; according to the rules｜按照规则
tip_zh: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

meanings_zh: v. 解释；说明 | v. 说明……的原因
definition_en: to make something clear or easy to understand | to give or be the reason why something happens
example1_en: The assignment is to explain why, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先解释为什么，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers explain why before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要解释为什么。
collocations: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事 ; explain why｜解释为什么 ; explain in detail｜详细解释 ; explain the difference｜说明区别
tip_zh: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

meanings_zh: adv. 可能；也许 | adv. 究竟；无论如何
definition_en: Used when something may happen or may be true. | Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.
example1_en: I wrote possibly on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把possibly和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up possibly while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了可能。
collocations: could possibly｜或许能够 ; quite possibly｜很有可能 ; can't possibly｜绝不可能
tip_zh: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

meanings_zh: n. 副本；一本；一份 | v. 复制；抄写；模仿 | n. 待刊稿件；广告文案
definition_en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document | To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions | Written material prepared for publication or advertising
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a digital copy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电子副本的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a digital copy.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得电子副本这个例子。
collocations: a copy of｜一份；一本 ; a digital copy｜电子副本 ; copy and paste｜复制粘贴 ; advertising copy｜广告文案
tip_zh: 复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 警察；警官 | n. 军官 | n. 官员；主管人员
definition_en: A member of the police. | A member of the armed forces with authority to command. | Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.
example1_en: I copied police officer into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把警察抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of police officer.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得警察这个例子。
collocations: police officer｜警察 ; army officer｜陆军军官 ; housing officer｜住房事务官员 ; chief executive officer｜首席执行官
tip_zh: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

meanings_zh: v. 增加；提高 | n. 增加；增长
definition_en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater | A rise in the amount, size, or level of something
example1_en: The lab instructions say to increase by.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求增加了。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to increase by.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来增加了。
collocations: increase by｜增加了 ; increase to｜增加到 ; an increase in demand｜需求的增长 ; a significant increase｜显著增长
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

meanings_zh: v. 属于；归某人所有 | v. 应在某处；归入 | v. 有归属感
definition_en: To be owned by someone | To have a proper place or category | To feel accepted as part of a group
example1_en: The lab instructions say to belong in a museum.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求应放在博物馆。
example2_en: The reading asks you to belong in a museum and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你应放在博物馆，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: belong to someone｜归某人所有 ; belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆 ; feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip_zh: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 磁带录音机
definition_en: A device that records and plays sound using magnetic tape.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used tape-recorder in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了磁带录音机。
example2_en: Students who can explain tape-recorder usually follow the rest of a lecture on technological change.
example2_zh: 能解释磁带录音机的学生，通常跟得上一节关于技术变革的讲座。
collocations: a portable tape-recorder｜便携式磁带录音机 ; a cassette tape-recorder｜盒式磁带录音机
tip_zh: 现代通常写作tape recorder，不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 气体 | n. 燃气；天然气 | n. 汽油（美式）
definition_en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container. | Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking. | Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.
example1_en: I copied greenhouse gas into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把温室气体抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss greenhouse gas.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论温室气体的材料。
collocations: greenhouse gas｜温室气体 ; natural gas｜天然气 ; a gas leak｜燃气泄漏 ; a gas station｜加油站（美式）
tip_zh: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

meanings_zh: v. 庆祝 | v. 赞颂；颂扬
definition_en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable. | To praise someone or something publicly.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to celebrate a birthday.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求庆祝生日。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to celebrate a birthday.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们庆祝生日。
collocations: celebrate a birthday｜庆祝生日 ; celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就 ; celebrate diversity｜赞颂多样性
tip_zh: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

meanings_zh: v. 建议；提议 | v. 表明；暗示
definition_en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration. | To indicate that something may be true.
example1_en: The assignment is to suggest a solution, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先提出解决方案，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to suggest a solution.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们提出解决方案。
collocations: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案 ; suggest doing something｜建议做某事 ; strongly suggest｜强烈暗示 ; evidence suggests that｜证据表明
tip_zh: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 音乐的；有音乐天赋的 | n. 音乐剧；歌舞片 | adj. 悦耳的
definition_en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it. | A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing. | Having a pleasant sound resembling music.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a stage musical in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了舞台音乐剧。
example2_en: The author returns to a stage musical when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了舞台音乐剧。
collocations: musical instrument｜乐器 ; musical talent｜音乐天赋 ; musical performance｜音乐表演 ; a stage musical｜舞台音乐剧
tip_zh: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

meanings_zh: v. 预料；预计 | v. 要求；期望 | v. 等待；期待到来
definition_en: to believe that something will probably happen | to regard something as necessary or reasonably required | to believe someone or something will arrive soon
example1_en: The assignment is to expect to do something, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先预计做某事，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers expect to do something before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要预计做某事。
collocations: expect to do something｜预计做某事 ; expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事 ; fully expect｜完全预料到 ; as expected｜正如预料
tip_zh: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

meanings_zh: n. 骨；骨头 | v. 剔去……的骨头
definition_en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame. | To remove the bones from meat or fish.
example1_en: Our professor circled bone strength on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了骨骼强度。
example2_en: The author returns to bone strength when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了骨骼强度。
collocations: break a bone｜骨折 ; bone strength｜骨骼强度 ; bone marrow｜骨髓 ; bone density｜骨密度
tip_zh: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。

meanings_zh: n. 讲座；大学课堂讲授 | v. 讲课；作讲座 | v. 训斥；说教
definition_en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students | to give an educational talk to an audience | to criticize someone at length about their behaviour
example1_en: Our morning lecture met in the science building.
example1_zh: 我们的早课讲座在科学楼进行。
example2_en: The lecture explained how glaciers record changes in climate over thousands of years.
example2_zh: 这场讲座解释了冰川如何记录数千年来的气候变化。
collocations: attend a lecture｜听讲座 ; give a lecture｜作讲座 ; lecture on biology｜讲授生物学 ; lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip_zh: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

meanings_zh: n. 大学校园；校区
definition_en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college
example1_en: New students toured the campus before classes began.
example1_zh: 新生在开学前参观了校园。
example2_en: The reading describes how campus design can help students from different majors meet.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读描述了校园设计如何帮助不同专业的学生相遇交流。
collocations: on campus｜在校园内 ; off campus｜在校外 ; university campus｜大学校园 ; campus facilities｜校园设施
tip_zh: 表示“在校园内”通常用on campus，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 研究；调查 | v. 研究；调查
definition_en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge. | To study a subject carefully to discover information.
example1_en: She joined a research group in her second year.
example1_zh: 她在二年级加入了一个研究小组。
example2_en: The passage compares two research methods used to study sleep in college students.
example2_zh: 文章比较了两种用于研究大学生睡眠的研究方法。
collocations: conduct research｜开展研究 ; research into｜对……的研究 ; research findings｜研究结果 ; scientific research｜科学研究
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

meanings_zh: n. 实验；试验 | v. 做实验；尝试
definition_en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea | test ideas or methods to see what happens
example1_en: The lab experiment took the whole afternoon.
example1_zh: 这次实验用了整个下午。
example2_en: Students had to say whether the experiment controlled every factor that could change the result.
example2_zh: 学生必须说明实验是否控制了每一个可能改变结果的因素。
collocations: conduct an experiment｜进行实验 ; a controlled experiment｜对照实验 ; experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip_zh: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 学期（学年两学期制）
definition_en: one of the two main periods of an academic year
example1_en: The semester starts the last Monday in August.
example1_zh: 这学期从八月的最后一个星期一开始。
example2_en: Tuition for the semester is due before students can register for the next term.
example2_zh: 学生必须在注册下一学期之前缴清本学期学费。
collocations: first semester｜第一学期 ; fall semester｜秋季学期 ; semester break｜学期间的假期 ; end of the semester｜学期末
tip_zh: 通常指一学年两学期中的一学期，不等于半年。

meanings_zh: n. 作业；任务 | n. 分配；指派
definition_en: A piece of work someone is required to complete. | The act of giving someone a task, role, or place.
example1_en: The assignment is due on Friday at noon.
example1_zh: 这份作业周五中午前截止。
example2_en: The assignment asks students to summarize the lecture and then challenge one claim.
example2_zh: 这份作业要求学生先概述讲座，再质疑其中一个主张。
collocations: complete an assignment｜完成作业或任务 ; submit an assignment｜提交作业 ; on assignment｜执行任务中 ; assignment of duties｜职责分配
tip_zh: 指具体作业时可数；homework通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 政策；方针；原则 | n. 保险单；保险合同
definition_en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions | a contract describing the insurance cover someone has bought
example1_en: The college changed its attendance policy this year.
example1_zh: 学院今年修改了出勤政策。
example2_en: The lecture asked whether public policy should weigh economic growth against environmental cost.
example2_zh: 讲座问到公共政策是否应当在经济增长与环境代价之间权衡。
collocations: government policy｜政府政策 ; implement a policy｜实施政策 ; insurance policy｜保险单 ; foreign policy｜外交政策
tip_zh: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

meanings_zh: n. 文化；习俗 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: The seminar compared student culture on two campuses.
example1_zh: 研讨课比较了两所学校的学生文化。
example2_en: Historians study how culture changes when people move and bring new customs with them.
example2_zh: 历史学者研究当人们迁徙并带去新习俗时，文化如何变化。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_zh: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

meanings_zh: n. 争论；争吵 | n. 论点；论据
definition_en: An angry disagreement between people. | A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.
example1_en: Her paper led with a clear argument.
example1_zh: 她的论文以一个清晰的论点开头。
example2_en: In the listening, the professor said the argument was weak because it rested on a single study.
example2_zh: 听力里，教授说这个论点站不住，因为它只依赖一项研究。
collocations: have an argument｜发生争吵 ; a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据 ; an argument for｜支持……的论据 ; an argument against｜反对……的论据
tip_zh: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

meanings_zh: n. 结论；推断 | n. 结尾；结束
definition_en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence | the final part or ending of something
example1_en: The conclusion should follow from the evidence.
example1_zh: 结论应当从证据中得出。
example2_en: The author reached a conclusion that later studies have only partly supported.
example2_zh: 作者得出的结论只得到了后来研究的部分支持。
collocations: reach a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw a conclusion｜作出推断 ; jump to conclusions｜贸然下结论 ; in conclusion｜总而言之
tip_zh: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

meanings_zh: v. 影响 | v. 使感动；使悲伤
definition_en: to cause a change in someone or something | to cause someone to feel a strong emotion
example1_en: Lack of sleep can affect your score on a quiz.
example1_zh: 睡眠不足会影响你在小测中的成绩。
example2_en: The study measured how screen time can affect attention during an evening lecture.
example2_zh: 这项研究测量了屏幕时间如何影响晚间讲座中的注意力。
collocations: affect health｜影响健康 ; adversely affect｜产生不利影响 ; deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人 ; affect performance｜影响表现
tip_zh: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；效果 | v. 实现；使发生
definition_en: A change or result caused by something. | To bring about a change or result.
example1_en: We measured the effect of caffeine on focus.
example1_zh: 我们测量了咖啡因对专注力的影响。
example2_en: A small sample can hide the real effect and make a weak result look important.
example2_zh: 样本太小会掩盖真实影响，让一个微弱的结果看起来很重要。
collocations: have an effect on｜对……有影响 ; side effect｜副作用 ; take effect｜生效；起作用 ; effect change｜促成变革
tip_zh: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

meanings_zh: n. 好处；益处 | v. 使受益；得益于 | n. 福利金；补助金
definition_en: a helpful or positive effect of something | to help someone or receive help or an advantage | money provided by the government to people needing support
example1_en: Office hours are a real benefit for new students.
example1_zh: 对新生来说，答疑时间是实实在在的好处。
example2_en: The passage weighs the benefit of the new transit line against its cost to nearby parks.
example2_zh: 文章权衡了新公交线路的好处及其对附近公园的代价。
collocations: health benefits｜健康益处 ; benefit from｜从……中受益 ; unemployment benefit｜失业救济金 ; mutual benefit｜互利
tip_zh: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

meanings_zh: n. 结构；构造 | n. 建筑物；构筑物 | v. 组织；安排
definition_en: The way parts are arranged and connected within a whole. | Something built from connected parts, such as a bridge. | Arrange parts or activities into an organised whole.
example1_en: Outline the structure before you draft the essay.
example1_zh: 起草文章之前，先列出结构。
example2_en: The lecture showed how the structure of a cell limits what can pass through its membrane.
example2_zh: 讲座说明了细胞的结构如何限制物质穿过细胞膜。
collocations: social structure｜社会结构 ; sentence structure｜句子结构 ; structure an essay｜组织文章 ; supporting structure｜支撑结构
tip_zh: structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。

meanings_zh: n. 过程；程序 | v. 处理；加工
definition_en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result. | Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.
example1_en: Registration is a slow process in the first week.
example1_zh: 开学第一周，注册是一个缓慢的过程。
example2_en: The process described in the passage turns raw data into a chart the class can read.
example2_zh: 文章描述的过程把原始数据变成全班都能看懂的图表。
collocations: a gradual process｜渐进的过程 ; in the process of｜在……过程中 ; process data｜处理数据 ; processed food｜加工食品
tip_zh: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 识别；辨认 | v. 找出；确定 | v. 产生共鸣；认同
definition_en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is. | To discover or establish something through examination. | To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.
example1_en: Identify the claim before you look at the chart.
example1_zh: 看图表之前，先识别出主张。
example2_en: Students learn to identify the assumption that an argument never states out loud.
example2_zh: 学生学习识别论点从未明说的那个假设。
collocations: identify a problem｜发现问题 ; identify the cause｜确定原因 ; identify someone as｜认出某人是 ; identify with｜与……产生共鸣
tip_zh: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

meanings_zh: v. 给…下定义；解释含义 | v. 明确规定；界定 | v. 构成…的特征
definition_en: To state exactly what a word or idea means. | To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly. | To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.
example1_en: Define the term before you use it in the essay.
example1_zh: 在文章里使用这个术语之前，先给它下定义。
