example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of calm.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宁静感展开说明。
collocations: stay calm｜保持镇静 ; calm down｜平静下来 ; calm waters｜平静的水面 ; a sense of calm｜宁静感
tip_zh: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

meanings_zh: adj. 抑郁的；沮丧的 | adj. 经济萧条的；不景气的
definition_en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness | having little economic activity or few opportunities
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about severely depressed.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于严重抑郁的的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to severely depressed when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了严重抑郁的。
collocations: feel depressed｜感到沮丧 ; severely depressed｜严重抑郁的 ; economically depressed area｜经济萧条地区
tip_zh: depressed形容人的感受；depressing形容令人沮丧的事。

meanings_zh: n. 乐器 | n. 仪器；器械 | n. 手段；工具
definition_en: an object played to produce musical sounds | a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work | something used to achieve a particular purpose
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about musical instrument.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于乐器的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of musical instrument.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得乐器这个例子。
collocations: musical instrument｜乐器 ; scientific instrument｜科学仪器 ; surgical instrument｜外科器械 ; instrument of change｜推动变革的工具
tip_zh: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。

meanings_zh: n. 未婚夫
definition_en: A man who is engaged to be married.
example1_en: The textbook introduces her fiance in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了她的未婚夫。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around her fiance.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕她的未婚夫展开说明。
collocations: her fiance｜她的未婚夫 ; my fiance and I｜我和我的未婚夫
tip_zh: 也写作fiancé；未婚妻是fiancee或fiancée。

meanings_zh: n. 抗议；抗议活动 | v. 抗议；反对
definition_en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition. | Express strong disagreement with something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on peaceful protest.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论和平抗议。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around peaceful protest.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕和平抗议展开说明。
collocations: peaceful protest｜和平抗议 ; protest against｜抗议；反对 ; in protest at｜为抗议…… ; under protest｜不情愿地；抗议着
tip_zh: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

meanings_zh: n. 囚犯；被拘禁者 | n. 战俘；俘虏
definition_en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving. | A person captured and held by an enemy during war.
example1_en: I copied prisoner of war into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把战俘抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prisoner of war.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕战俘展开说明。
collocations: release a prisoner｜释放囚犯 ; prisoner of war｜战俘 ; take someone prisoner｜俘虏某人
tip_zh: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。

meanings_zh: n. 宇航员；航天员
definition_en: a person trained to travel and work in space
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about astronaut training.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于宇航员训练的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used astronaut training to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用宇航员训练来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: astronaut training｜宇航员训练 ; a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员 ; astronaut crew｜宇航员乘组
tip_zh: astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

meanings_zh: v. 道歉；认错
definition_en: To tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong
example1_en: The professor asked us to apologize sincerely.
example1_zh: 教授让我们真诚道歉。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to apologize sincerely.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们真诚道歉。
collocations: apologize to someone｜向某人道歉 ; apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉 ; apologize sincerely｜真诚道歉
tip_zh: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

meanings_zh: n. 外国人
definition_en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize foreigner in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出外国人。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses foreigner when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了外国人。
collocations: as a foreigner｜作为外国人 ; foreigners living abroad｜在海外生活的外国人 ; welcome foreigners｜欢迎外国人
tip_zh: 泛指外国人；特指游客时用visitor更自然。

meanings_zh: adj. 已订婚的 | adj. 忙于；参与的 | adj. 占线的；使用中的
definition_en: Having formally agreed to marry someone. | Actively involved in an activity or task. | Currently being used and therefore unavailable.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the line is engaged in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了电话占线。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the line is engaged.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得电话占线这个例子。
collocations: get engaged｜订婚 ; engaged to someone｜与某人订婚 ; engaged in research｜从事研究 ; the line is engaged｜电话占线
tip_zh: 订婚对象前用to；参与的活动前用in。

meanings_zh: n. 傻瓜；蠢人 | v. 欺骗；愚弄
definition_en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment | to make someone believe something that is not true
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fool around.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论胡闹。
example2_en: The reading connects fool around with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把胡闹和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; make a fool of yourself｜出洋相 ; fool around｜胡闹
tip_zh: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

meanings_zh: n. 休假；不上班的时间
definition_en: Time when you are not working or attending school.
example1_en: I wrote time off on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把time off和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain time off usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释休假的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: take time off｜请假；休假 ; paid time off｜带薪休假 ; time off work｜不上班的时间
tip_zh: 通常不可数；请一天假可说 take a day off。

meanings_zh: adj. 浪漫的；爱情的 | adj. 理想化的；不切实际的 | n. 浪漫的人；理想主义者
definition_en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings | seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are | someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about romantic relationship.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于恋爱关系的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of romantic relationship.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得恋爱关系这个例子。
collocations: romantic relationship｜恋爱关系 ; romantic dinner｜浪漫晚餐 ; romantic comedy｜爱情喜剧 ; a romantic view of｜对……的理想化看法
tip_zh: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

meanings_zh: n. 增长；增加 | n. 生长；成长；发展 | n. 赘生物；肿块
definition_en: An increase in size, amount, or level. | The process of growing physically or developing over time. | An unusual lump of tissue growing in or on the body.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about economic growth.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于经济增长的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects economic growth with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把经济增长和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: economic growth｜经济增长 ; population growth｜人口增长 ; rapid growth｜快速增长 ; personal growth｜个人成长
tip_zh: 表示增长通常不可数；a growth可指一个肿块。

meanings_zh: n. 故事；传说 | n. 经历的讲述；叙述
definition_en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events | an account of something that happened to someone
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a fairy tale.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于童话的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a fairy tale.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕童话展开说明。
collocations: a fairy tale｜童话 ; a folk tale｜民间故事 ; a cautionary tale｜警示故事 ; tell a tale｜讲故事
tip_zh: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。

meanings_zh: adj. 先前的；以前的
definition_en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed
example1_en: The textbook introduces previous experience in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了以往经验。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around previous experience.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕以往经验展开说明。
collocations: previous experience｜以往经验 ; previous studies｜先前研究 ; the previous year｜前一年
tip_zh: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

meanings_zh: n. 素食者 | adj. 素食的；不含肉鱼的
definition_en: A person who does not eat meat or fish. | Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about vegetarian diet.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于素食饮食的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to vegetarian diet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了素食饮食。
collocations: vegetarian diet｜素食饮食 ; vegetarian option｜素食选项 ; become a vegetarian｜成为素食者
tip_zh: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

meanings_zh: n. 宣传册；资料手册
definition_en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.
example1_en: I copied travel brochure into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把旅游宣传册抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of travel brochure.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得旅游宣传册这个例子。
collocations: travel brochure｜旅游宣传册 ; university brochure｜大学招生手册 ; promotional brochure｜推广宣传册
tip_zh: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

meanings_zh: n. 信号；暗号 | n. 电子信号 | v. 示意；表明
definition_en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message. | An electrical or radio wave carrying information. | Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.
example1_en: Office hours began with a weak signal.
example1_zh: 答疑从微弱的信号开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a weak signal to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用微弱的信号来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: give a signal｜发出信号 ; a weak signal｜微弱的信号 ; signal a change｜预示变化
tip_zh: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

meanings_zh: n. 考试 | n. 检查；仔细审查
definition_en: a formal test of knowledge or ability | the act of looking at something carefully to assess it
example1_en: The textbook introduces a medical examination in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了体检。
example2_en: A campus survey used a medical examination to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用体检来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: take an examination｜参加考试 ; pass an examination｜通过考试 ; a medical examination｜体检 ; close examination｜仔细检查
tip_zh: 考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。

meanings_zh: adj. 负责的；有责任的 | adj. 造成某事的；应担责的 | adj. 可靠的；有责任心的
definition_en: having a duty to manage or look after something | being the cause of something, especially something bad | sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions
example1_en: I copied responsible for into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把对……负责抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of responsible for.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得对……负责这个例子。
collocations: responsible for｜对……负责 ; responsible behaviour｜负责任的行为 ; hold someone responsible｜认定某人应担责
tip_zh: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。

meanings_zh: adj. 电子的；电子设备的 | adj. 电子形式的；数字化的
definition_en: using circuits to control electrical signals | stored, sent, or accessed using computers
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on electronic devices.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电子设备。
example2_en: A campus survey used electronic devices to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用电子设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: electronic devices｜电子设备 ; electronic records｜电子档案 ; electronic payment｜电子支付 ; electronic waste｜电子垃圾
tip_zh: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

meanings_zh: adv. 大约；近似地
definition_en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.
example1_en: The professor told us to approximately equal and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们大致相等，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences asks the class to approximately equal before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先大致相等。
collocations: approximately equal｜大致相等 ; approximately half｜大约一半 ; approximately double｜大约两倍
tip_zh: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 飓风
definition_en: a powerful tropical storm with extremely strong winds
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on powerful hurricane.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论强烈的飓风。
example2_en: A campus survey used powerful hurricane to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用强烈的飓风来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: powerful hurricane｜强烈的飓风 ; hurricane season｜飓风季 ; hurricane warning｜飓风警报 ; hurricane damage｜飓风造成的破坏
tip_zh: hurricane和typhoon均属热带气旋，名称因海域而异。

meanings_zh: v. 复述；重新讲述
definition_en: to tell a story or describe events again
example1_en: I heard the lecturer retell a story during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时复述故事。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to retell a story.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来复述故事。
collocations: retell a story｜复述故事 ; retell events｜重述事件 ; retell in your own words｜用自己的话复述
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为retold。

meanings_zh: n. 扬声器；扩音器
definition_en: A device that makes recorded or transmitted sound audible
example1_en: Office hours began with portable loudspeaker.
example1_zh: 答疑从便携式扬声器开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of portable loudspeaker.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得便携式扬声器这个例子。
collocations: loudspeaker system｜扩音系统 ; over the loudspeaker｜通过扩音器 ; portable loudspeaker｜便携式扬声器
tip_zh: loudspeaker指设备；speaker还可指说话者。

meanings_zh: n. 网；网状物 | adj. 净的；扣除费用后的 | v. 净赚；获得
definition_en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them | remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted | to earn as profit or successfully obtain something
example1_en: The textbook introduces fishing net in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了渔网。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fishing net.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕渔网展开说明。
collocations: fishing net｜渔网 ; net profit｜净利润 ; net income｜净收入 ; net gain｜净增益
tip_zh: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。

meanings_zh: n. 相似；相似点
definition_en: The state of being alike, or a shared feature
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on striking similarity.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论惊人的相似。
example2_en: A campus survey used striking similarity to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用惊人的相似来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: striking similarity｜惊人的相似 ; similarity between｜……之间的相似性 ; bear a similarity to｜与……相似
tip_zh: 相似性常不可数；具体相似点可数，常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 武器；兵器
definition_en: an object used for fighting or causing physical harm
example1_en: Our professor circled nuclear weapon on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了核武器。
example2_en: A campus survey used nuclear weapon to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用核武器来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: nuclear weapon｜核武器 ; carry a weapon｜携带武器 ; weapon sales｜武器销售
tip_zh: 可数名词；武器的总称也可用weaponry。

meanings_zh: adv. 就个人而言 | adv. 亲自；本人 | adv. 针对个人地
definition_en: used to introduce your own opinion or preference | by a particular person rather than someone acting for them | as relating to someone's character rather than their actions
example1_en: The lab manual says to personally speaking before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先就个人而言，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will personally speaking when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会就个人而言。
collocations: personally speaking｜就个人而言 ; take something personally｜认为某事针对自己 ; personally responsible｜负有个人责任 ; know someone personally｜与某人本人相识
tip_zh: take it personally指把事情看作针对自己。

meanings_zh: n. 喉咙；咽喉
definition_en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sore throat.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论喉咙痛。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sore throat.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕喉咙痛展开说明。
collocations: a sore throat｜喉咙痛 ; clear your throat｜清嗓子 ; throat infection｜咽喉感染
tip_zh: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

meanings_zh: v. 敢于；胆敢 | v. 激将；挑战 | n. 激将；挑战
definition_en: to have enough courage to do something | to challenge someone to do something requiring courage | a challenge to do something difficult or frightening
example1_en: The professor asked us to dare to ask.
example1_zh: 教授让我们敢于提问。
example2_en: The passage says students who can dare to ask follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够敢于提问的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: dare to ask｜敢于提问 ; dare someone to do something｜激某人做某事 ; not dare｜不敢 ; for a dare｜为了应对激将
tip_zh: 敢做用dare to do；激将用dare sb to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 自信的 | adj. 确信的；有把握的
definition_en: believing in your own ability to succeed | certain that something is true or will happen
example1_en: I wrote confident on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把confident和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on human behavior uses confident when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于人类行为的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了自信的。
collocations: feel confident｜感到自信 ; confident about the future｜对未来有信心 ; confident that｜确信
tip_zh: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 成绩；等级 | n. 年级 | v. 评分；分级
definition_en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality | a school year level, especially in the American system | to assess work or sort things by quality
example1_en: I copied grade assignments into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把给作业评分抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss grade assignments.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论给作业评分的材料。
collocations: get a good grade｜取得好成绩 ; grade assignments｜给作业评分 ; in sixth grade｜在六年级 ; high-grade materials｜优质材料
tip_zh: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

meanings_zh: n. 剧集的一集 | n. 一段经历；事件 | n. 疾病的一次发作
definition_en: one part of a television or radio series | a particular event or period within a longer story | a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom
example1_en: Office hours began with the final episode.
example1_zh: 答疑从最后一集开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the final episode.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕最后一集展开说明。
collocations: the final episode｜最后一集 ; an episode of｜……的一集 ; a pilot episode｜试播集 ; a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip_zh: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

meanings_zh: n. 恋人；情人 | n. 爱好者
definition_en: Someone in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person. | Someone who enjoys or admires something very much.
example1_en: Office hours began with a music lover.
example1_zh: 答疑从音乐爱好者开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a music lover.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论音乐爱好者的材料。
collocations: young lovers｜年轻恋人 ; a music lover｜音乐爱好者 ; a nature lover｜自然爱好者
tip_zh: 表爱好者常用名词＋lover；单用可能指情人。

meanings_zh: n. 肘；肘部 | v. 用肘推挤
definition_en: the joint where your arm bends | to push someone or something with your elbow
example1_en: Our professor circled bend your elbow on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了弯曲手肘。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of bend your elbow.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得弯曲手肘这个例子。
collocations: bend your elbow｜弯曲手肘 ; rest your elbows on｜将双肘搁在……上 ; elbow your way through｜用肘推挤着穿过
tip_zh: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。

meanings_zh: n. 文具；信纸信封
definition_en: Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.
example1_en: Office hours began with office stationery.
example1_zh: 答疑从办公文具开始。
example2_en: The reading connects office stationery with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把办公文具和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: office stationery｜办公文具 ; stationery supplies｜文具用品 ; stationery shop｜文具店
tip_zh: 不可数；勿与stationary（静止的）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 心理压力；催迫 | n. 压力；压强 | v. 迫使；向…施压
definition_en: Worry or demands that make someone feel forced to act | Force pressing on a surface or within a substance | Try to make someone do something through strong persuasion
example1_en: I copied blood pressure into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把血压抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss blood pressure.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论血压的材料。
collocations: under pressure｜承受压力 ; put pressure on｜向…施压 ; blood pressure｜血压 ; pressure someone into doing something｜迫使某人做某事
tip_zh: under pressure表示承压；动词常接into doing。

meanings_zh: n. 健身锻炼；健身操
definition_en: Physical exercises done to stay healthy and fit.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize keep-fit in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出健身操。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up keep-fit while discussing evidence about public health.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了健身操。
collocations: keep-fit classes｜健身课 ; keep-fit exercises｜健身运动
tip_zh: 主要用于英式英语；动词短语keep fit不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 晒伤
definition_en: red, painful skin caused by too much exposure to sunlight
example1_en: Office hours began with severe sunburn.
example1_zh: 答疑从严重晒伤开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss severe sunburn.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严重晒伤的材料。
collocations: get sunburn｜被晒伤 ; severe sunburn｜严重晒伤 ; prevent sunburn｜预防晒伤
tip_zh: 英式常说get sunburn；美式也常说get a sunburn。

meanings_zh: n. 注射 | n. 资金等的注入
definition_en: Putting medicine into the body using a needle. | The addition of money or resources to improve something.
example1_en: I copied a cash injection into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把一笔现金注入抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a cash injection when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一笔现金注入。
collocations: give an injection｜打针 ; receive an injection｜接受注射 ; a cash injection｜一笔现金注入 ; an injection of funding｜资金的注入
tip_zh: 注入资金可说an injection of cash，属于比喻用法。

meanings_zh: n. 表演者；演出者 | n. 表现出某种水平的人或事物
definition_en: someone who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or playing | a person or thing achieving a particular level of success
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a street performer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论街头艺人。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a street performer.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论街头艺人的材料。
collocations: a street performer｜街头艺人 ; a live performer｜现场表演者 ; a top performer｜表现优异者
tip_zh: 不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

meanings_zh: v. 认出；识别 | v. 承认；意识到 | v. 正式认可；表彰
definition_en: Identify someone or something known or seen before. | Accept or understand that something is true or important. | Officially accept someone's status, qualifications, or achievements.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to recognize a face.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何认出一张脸。
example2_en: The reading asks you to recognize a face and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你认出一张脸，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: recognize a face｜认出一张脸 ; recognize the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; recognize someone as｜认可某人为…… ; internationally recognized｜国际公认的
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作recognise；表示“认出”时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 震惊；意外打击 | v. 使震惊 | n. 休克；电击
definition_en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected | to make someone feel very surprised or upset | a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body
example1_en: I copied culture shock into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把文化冲击抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used culture shock to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用文化冲击来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: come as a shock｜令人震惊 ; culture shock｜文化冲击 ; electric shock｜电击 ; in a state of shock｜处于震惊状态
tip_zh: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。

meanings_zh: n. 症状 | n. 征兆；问题的表现
definition_en: a physical or mental change that suggests an illness | a sign that an underlying problem exists
example1_en: Office hours began with common symptom.
example1_zh: 答疑从常见症状开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used common symptom to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用常见症状来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: common symptom｜常见症状 ; symptom of illness｜疾病症状 ; relieve symptoms｜缓解症状
tip_zh: 常用a symptom of；症状缓解用relieve symptoms。

meanings_zh: v. 翻译 | v. 转化；转变为
definition_en: To express words or writing in another language | To change something into a different form or practical result
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to translate into English.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须翻译成英语。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to translate into English.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来翻译成英语。
collocations: translate into English｜翻译成英语 ; translate from Chinese｜从中文翻译 ; translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip_zh: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

meanings_zh: n. 努力；精力 | n. 尝试；有组织的行动
definition_en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something | an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a joint effort.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论共同努力。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a joint effort.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得共同努力这个例子。
collocations: make an effort｜作出努力 ; put effort into｜投入精力于 ; a joint effort｜共同努力 ; considerable effort｜相当大的努力
tip_zh: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 电池；蓄电池 | n. 一系列；一组
definition_en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity. | A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a rechargeable battery.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于可充电电池的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a rechargeable battery with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可充电电池和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a rechargeable battery｜可充电电池 ; battery life｜电池续航时间 ; charge a battery｜给电池充电 ; a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip_zh: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；货物 | n. 个人财物
definition_en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade. | Movable possessions belonging to a person.
example1_en: Our professor circled consumer goods on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了消费品。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss consumer goods.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论消费品的材料。
collocations: consumer goods｜消费品 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; household goods｜家用物品 ; transport goods｜运输货物
tip_zh: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。

meanings_zh: v. 提交；呈递 | v. 屈服；服从
definition_en: To send a document or application for consideration | To accept another person's authority or control
example1_en: The assignment is to submit an application, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先提交申请，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to submit an application.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们提交申请。
collocations: submit an application｜提交申请 ; submit a report｜提交报告 ; submit something to｜向……提交某物 ; submit to authority｜服从权威
tip_zh: 过去式 submitted；submit sth to sb 表示向某人提交。

meanings_zh: adj. ……岁的 | adj. 年迈的
definition_en: Having reached a particular age. | Very old, especially when describing people.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about children aged five.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于五岁的儿童的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects children aged five with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把五岁的儿童和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: children aged five｜五岁的儿童 ; aged eighteen and over｜年满十八岁的 ; aged relatives｜年迈的亲属
tip_zh: 表岁数读/eɪdʒd/；表年迈读/ˈeɪdʒɪd/。

meanings_zh: adj. 当前的；现行的 | n. 水流；气流；电流
definition_en: happening, existing, or being used now | a continuous movement of water, air, or electricity
example1_en: I copied a strong current into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把强劲水流抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a strong current to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用强劲水流来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: the current situation｜当前形势 ; current affairs｜时事 ; a strong current｜强劲水流 ; electric current｜电流
tip_zh: 形容词指当前的；名词可指水流或电流。

meanings_zh: adj. 震惊的；惊愕的 | adj. 愤慨的；十分反感的
definition_en: Very surprised and upset by something unexpected. | Feeling strong disapproval at something offensive or wrong.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about deeply shocked.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于深感震惊的的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of deeply shocked.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得深感震惊的这个例子。
collocations: deeply shocked｜深感震惊的 ; shocked by the news｜被消息震惊 ; shocked to hear｜听到后震惊
tip_zh: shocked形容人的感受；shocking形容令人震惊的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 筋疲力尽的 | adj. 耗尽的；枯竭的
definition_en: extremely tired and lacking energy | completely used up, with nothing remaining
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on physically exhausted.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论身体疲惫不堪。
example2_en: The reading connects physically exhausted with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把身体疲惫不堪和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: feel exhausted｜感到筋疲力尽 ; physically exhausted｜身体疲惫不堪 ; mentally exhausted｜心力交瘁 ; exhausted resources｜耗尽的资源
tip_zh: 人感到累用exhausted；事情令人累用exhausting。

meanings_zh: n. 享受；乐趣
definition_en: The pleasure you get from doing or experiencing something
example1_en: Our professor circled pure enjoyment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纯粹的享受。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of pure enjoyment.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得纯粹的享受这个例子。
collocations: get enjoyment from｜从……中获得乐趣 ; for enjoyment｜为了享受乐趣 ; pure enjoyment｜纯粹的享受
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示从某事获得乐趣可用get enjoyment from。

meanings_zh: n. 相信；信心 | n. 信念；信仰
definition_en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable. | An idea accepted as true, especially about life or religion.
example1_en: Office hours began with a widely held belief.
example1_zh: 答疑从普遍持有的看法开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a widely held belief.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论普遍持有的看法的材料。
collocations: belief in someone｜对某人的信任 ; religious beliefs｜宗教信仰 ; a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法 ; contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip_zh: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

meanings_zh: v. 爆炸；使爆炸 | v. 激增；迅速扩大 | v. 突然爆发情绪
definition_en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently. | To increase extremely quickly in size, amount, or popularity. | To express strong feelings suddenly and forcefully.
example1_en: The professor asked us to explode into flames.
example1_zh: 教授让我们突然起火。
example2_en: The passage says students who can explode into flames follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够突然起火的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: explode into flames｜突然起火 ; explode with anger｜勃然大怒 ; demand explodes｜需求激增 ; a firework explodes｜烟花炸开
tip_zh: 爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。

meanings_zh: n. 社区；当地居民 | n. 群体；共同体
definition_en: people living in the same area | people sharing interests, beliefs, or a particular background
example1_en: Office hours began with local community.
example1_zh: 答疑从当地社区开始。
example2_en: The reading connects local community with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把当地社区和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: local community｜当地社区 ; community centre｜社区活动中心 ; scientific community｜科学界 ; sense of community｜社区归属感
tip_zh: 既指同地区居民，也指有共同背景或兴趣的群体。

meanings_zh: n. 意图；打算；目的
definition_en: Something that you plan or mean to do.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used intention in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了意图。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up intention while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了意图。
collocations: have no intention of｜无意做… ; with the intention of｜抱着…的目的 ; announce an intention to｜宣布做…的打算 ; good intentions｜善意
tip_zh: 用intention to do或intention of doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 严格的；严厉的 | adj. 严谨的；严格限定的
definition_en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met | following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions
example1_en: Our professor circled strict rules on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了严格的规定。
example2_en: A campus survey used strict rules to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用严格的规定来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: strict rules｜严格的规定 ; strict about punctuality｜严格要求守时 ; strict with children｜对孩子严格 ; in the strict sense｜严格意义上
tip_zh: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人害怕的；骇人的
definition_en: Making someone feel afraid.
example1_en: Our professor circled frightening experience on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可怕的经历。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of frightening experience.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得可怕的经历这个例子。
collocations: frightening experience｜可怕的经历 ; frightening thought｜令人害怕的想法 ; frightening prospect｜令人担忧的前景
tip_zh: frightening指事物吓人；frightened指人感到害怕。

meanings_zh: v. 生产；创作 | v. 产生；引起 | n. 农产品
definition_en: To make, grow, or create something. | To cause a result or effect. | Food grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to produce electricity.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发电。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers produce electricity before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要发电。
collocations: produce electricity｜发电 ; produce results｜产生效果 ; fresh produce｜新鲜农产品
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 经济的；经济学的
definition_en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.
example1_en: The textbook introduces economic growth in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济增长。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around economic growth.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济增长展开说明。
collocations: economic growth｜经济增长 ; economic development｜经济发展 ; economic policy｜经济政策 ; economic recession｜经济衰退
tip_zh: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。

meanings_zh: n. 燃料 | v. 给……加燃料 | v. 加剧；推动
definition_en: material burned or used to produce heat or power | to supply something with fuel | to make a feeling or situation stronger
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fuel consumption.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论燃料消耗。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fuel consumption.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕燃料消耗展开说明。
collocations: fossil fuels｜化石燃料 ; fuel consumption｜燃料消耗 ; fuel prices｜燃料价格 ; fuel speculation｜助长猜测
tip_zh: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。

meanings_zh: adj. 财务的；财政的；金融的
definition_en: relating to money or how it is managed
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial support.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济支持。
example2_en: The author returns to financial support when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济支持。
collocations: financial support｜经济支持 ; financial difficulties｜经济困难 ; financial stability｜金融稳定；财务稳定 ; financial services｜金融服务
tip_zh: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

meanings_zh: adv. 基本上；从根本上说
definition_en: considering only the main facts or most important features
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to basically the same.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习基本相同。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to basically the same before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先基本相同。
collocations: basically the same｜基本相同 ; basically sound｜基本合理 ; basically means｜基本意思是
tip_zh: 用于概括核心情况；不等于“几乎不”的barely。

meanings_zh: adj. 回收再制的
definition_en: made from waste materials processed for use again
example1_en: I copied recycled paper into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把再生纸抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to recycled paper when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了再生纸。
collocations: recycled paper｜再生纸 ; recycled plastic｜再生塑料 ; recycled materials｜再生材料
tip_zh: recycled 指已回收再制；recyclable 指可回收。

meanings_zh: n. 线索；提示
definition_en: Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.
example1_en: Office hours began with a clue to.
example1_zh: 答疑从关于…的线索开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a clue to.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕关于…的线索展开说明。
collocations: a clue to｜关于…的线索 ; provide clues｜提供线索 ; not have a clue｜完全不知道
tip_zh: a clue to中的to是介词，后接名词等。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真相 | n. 真理
definition_en: what is real or actually happened | a fact or principle generally accepted as true
example1_en: I wrote truth on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把truth和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain truth usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释事实的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: tell the truth｜说实话 ; discover the truth｜发现真相 ; the truth about something｜关于某事的真相
tip_zh: 说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。

meanings_zh: n. 海盗 | v. 盗版；非法复制 | n. 盗版者
definition_en: someone who attacks ships and steals from them | to copy or distribute protected material without permission | someone who illegally copies or distributes protected material
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about pirate ship.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于海盗船的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of pirate ship.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得海盗船这个例子。
collocations: pirate ship｜海盗船 ; pirated software｜盗版软件 ; pirate films｜盗版电影
tip_zh: pirated强调被非法复制；piracy是对应名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 明确的；确定的 | adj. 确实的；明显的
definition_en: Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty. | Clearly noticeable or unquestionably present.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a definite answer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论明确的答复。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a definite answer.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得明确的答复这个例子。
collocations: a definite answer｜明确的答复 ; definite plans｜确定的计划 ; a definite advantage｜明显的优势
tip_zh: definite是形容词；definitely是副词，意为肯定地。

meanings_zh: n. 喜剧演员
definition_en: a performer who entertains people by making them laugh
example1_en: The textbook introduces professional comedian in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了职业喜剧演员。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss professional comedian.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论职业喜剧演员的材料。
collocations: stand-up comedian｜单口喜剧演员 ; professional comedian｜职业喜剧演员 ; talented comedian｜有才华的喜剧演员
tip_zh: comedian指人，comedy指喜剧或喜剧作品。

meanings_zh: n. 表现；业绩；性能 | n. 表演；演出 | n. 执行；履行
definition_en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something. | An occasion when someone entertains an audience by performing. | The act of carrying out a task or duty.
example1_en: The textbook introduces academic performance in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学业表现。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of academic performance.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得学业表现这个例子。
collocations: academic performance｜学业表现 ; job performance｜工作表现 ; live performance｜现场演出 ; performance of duties｜履行职责
tip_zh: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。

meanings_zh: n. 学生宿舍；集体寝室
definition_en: a building or shared room where students sleep
example1_en: The textbook introduces college dorm in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大学宿舍。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss college dorm.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论大学宿舍的材料。
collocations: dorm room｜宿舍房间 ; dorm life｜宿舍生活 ; college dorm｜大学宿舍
tip_zh: dorm是dormitory的非正式简称，多见于美式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 趋势；潮流 | v. 成为热门话题
definition_en: a general direction of change or development | to become widely discussed or shared online
example1_en: Our professor circled an upward trend on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了上升趋势。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an upward trend.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得上升趋势这个例子。
collocations: an upward trend｜上升趋势 ; a growing trend｜日益明显的趋势 ; follow a trend｜追随潮流 ; a trend towards｜朝向……的趋势
tip_zh: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

meanings_zh: v. 使确信；使信服 | v. 说服
definition_en: to make someone believe something is true | to persuade someone to do something
example1_en: The lab instructions say to convince someone of something.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求使某人相信某事。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to convince someone of something.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使某人相信某事。
collocations: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; convince someone that｜使某人确信 ; convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip_zh: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；降低；缩小
definition_en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to reduce costs.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求降低成本。
example2_en: When the class discussed environmental policy, the speaker told us to reduce costs.
example2_zh: 全班讨论环境政策时，讲者让我们降低成本。
collocations: reduce costs｜降低成本 ; reduce emissions｜减少排放 ; reduce the risk｜降低风险 ; reduce waste｜减少浪费
tip_zh: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

meanings_zh: n. 学术期刊；专业杂志 | n. 日记；日志
definition_en: a publication containing articles about a particular subject | a personal record of experiences, thoughts, or events
example1_en: Our professor circled an academic journal on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学术期刊。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an academic journal.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论学术期刊的材料。
collocations: an academic journal｜学术期刊 ; a medical journal｜医学期刊 ; keep a journal｜写日记 ; a journal article｜期刊论文
tip_zh: journal常指专业期刊；表示私人记录时近似diary。

meanings_zh: v. 说服；劝服
definition_en: getting someone to act or believe something by giving reasons
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to persuading someone to act.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须说服某人采取行动。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to persuading someone to act.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们说服某人采取行动。
collocations: persuading someone to act｜说服某人采取行动 ; persuading someone of the benefits｜使某人相信其益处 ; persuading someone that｜使某人相信……
tip_zh: persuade的-ing形式；劝某人做某事用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 雕塑作品 | n. 雕塑艺术
definition_en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials | the art of creating solid forms from materials
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a bronze sculpture.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论青铜雕塑。
example2_en: The author returns to a bronze sculpture when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了青铜雕塑。
collocations: a bronze sculpture｜青铜雕塑 ; public sculpture｜公共雕塑 ; a sculpture garden｜雕塑园 ; abstract sculpture｜抽象雕塑
tip_zh: 指艺术门类不可数；指一件作品可数。

meanings_zh: n. 需求 | n. 坚决要求 | v. 强烈要求；需要
definition_en: the desire or need for particular goods or services | a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed | to insist on receiving something or require something essential
example1_en: Our professor circled demand for housing on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了住房需求。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around demand for housing.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕住房需求展开说明。
collocations: demand for housing｜住房需求 ; meet demand｜满足需求 ; in high demand｜需求旺盛 ; demand an explanation｜要求解释
tip_zh: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 古典音乐的 | adj. 古希腊罗马的；古典的 | adj. 传统理论的
definition_en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas | relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture | based on established theories rather than newer approaches
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on classical music.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论古典音乐。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss classical music.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古典音乐的材料。
collocations: classical music｜古典音乐 ; classical architecture｜古典建筑 ; classical civilisation｜古典文明 ; classical mechanics｜经典力学
tip_zh: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

meanings_zh: n. 煤；煤炭
definition_en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on burn coal.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论烧煤。
example2_en: The reading connects burn coal with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把烧煤和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: coal mine｜煤矿 ; burn coal｜烧煤 ; coal-fired power station｜燃煤发电站
tip_zh: coal指煤，charcoal指木炭；煤通常用作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 承认 | v. 准许进入；接收
definition_en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly | to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution
example1_en: The lab instructions say to admit a mistake.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求承认错误。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to admit a mistake.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来承认错误。
collocations: admit a mistake｜承认错误 ; admit doing something｜承认做过某事 ; admit that｜承认…… ; be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip_zh: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

meanings_zh: v. 交流；沟通 | v. 传达；表达
definition_en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others | to make information or feelings known to someone
example1_en: The lab instructions say to communicate with.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求与……交流。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to communicate with.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与……交流。
collocations: communicate with｜与……交流 ; communicate effectively｜有效沟通 ; communicate ideas｜传达想法
tip_zh: 与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。

meanings_zh: v. 宣布；公布
definition_en: To make information known publicly or officially.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to announce plans.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求宣布计划。
example2_en: The reading asks you to announce plans and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你宣布计划，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: announce plans｜宣布计划 ; announce a decision｜宣布决定 ; announce the results｜公布结果
tip_zh: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

meanings_zh: n. 社会 | n. 协会；社团
definition_en: People living together in an organised community. | An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on modern society.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论现代社会。
example2_en: A campus survey used modern society to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用现代社会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; an ageing society｜老龄化社会 ; society as a whole｜整个社会 ; join a society｜加入社团
tip_zh: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 广告
definition_en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity
example1_en: Office hours began with online ad.
example1_zh: 答疑从网络广告开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used online ad to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用网络广告来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: online ad｜网络广告 ; job ad｜招聘广告 ; place an ad｜刊登广告 ; ad campaign｜广告宣传活动
tip_zh: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 肌肉 | n. 实力；影响力
definition_en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement | power or influence used to achieve something
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about financial muscle.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于财力的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to financial muscle when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了财力。
collocations: build muscle｜增强肌肉 ; pull a muscle｜拉伤肌肉 ; muscle strength｜肌肉力量 ; financial muscle｜财力
tip_zh: muscle中的c不发音；pull a muscle指拉伤肌肉。

meanings_zh: n. 女佣；女清洁服务员
definition_en: a woman employed to clean rooms or do household work
example1_en: Office hours began with hotel maid.
example1_zh: 答疑从酒店女清洁服务员开始。
example2_en: The reading connects hotel maid with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把酒店女清洁服务员和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: hotel maid｜酒店女清洁服务员 ; work as a maid｜当女佣
tip_zh: 指女性家务或清洁雇员；酒店中常用room attendant。

meanings_zh: v. 道歉
definition_en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer apologise sincerely during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时真诚道歉。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers apologise sincerely before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要真诚道歉。
collocations: apologise to someone｜向某人道歉 ; apologise for something｜为某事道歉 ; apologise sincerely｜真诚道歉
tip_zh: 英式拼写；美式常用apologize，后接to人、for事。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；患病 | n. 恶心；呕吐
definition_en: the state of being ill | the feeling of needing to vomit, or vomiting itself
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on travel sickness.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论晕车晕船。
example2_en: The author returns to travel sickness when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了晕车晕船。
collocations: travel sickness｜晕车晕船 ; morning sickness｜孕吐 ; altitude sickness｜高原反应 ; sickness absence｜因病缺勤
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式英语中也常指恶心、呕吐。

meanings_zh: n. 政治；政治活动 | n. 政治观点；政治立场
definition_en: activities concerning government and how a country is run | a person's beliefs about government and public affairs
example1_en: Our professor circled local politics on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了地方政治。
example2_en: The author returns to local politics when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了地方政治。
collocations: local politics｜地方政治 ; enter politics｜从政 ; discuss politics｜讨论政治 ; party politics｜政党政治
tip_zh: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻记者；新闻工作者
definition_en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about investigative journalist.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于调查记者的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around investigative journalist.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕调查记者展开说明。
collocations: investigative journalist｜调查记者 ; freelance journalist｜自由撰稿记者 ; broadcast journalist｜广播电视记者
tip_zh: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

meanings_zh: n. 会计；会计师
definition_en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records
example1_en: I copied qualified accountant into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把合格的会计师抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around qualified accountant.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕合格的会计师展开说明。
collocations: qualified accountant｜合格的会计师 ; chartered accountant｜特许会计师 ; hire an accountant｜聘用会计师
tip_zh: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。

meanings_zh: n. 比较；对照
definition_en: Examining things to see how they are similar or different.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a direct comparison.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于直接比较的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a direct comparison.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得直接比较这个例子。
collocations: make a comparison｜进行比较 ; in comparison with｜与……相比 ; by comparison｜相比之下 ; a direct comparison｜直接比较
tip_zh: 两者之间的比较用comparison between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 化学品；化学物质 | adj. 化学的
definition_en: A substance produced or used in a chemical process. | Relating to substances and how they combine or change.
example1_en: Our professor circled a chemical reaction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了化学反应。
example2_en: A campus survey used a chemical reaction to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用化学反应来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a chemical reaction｜化学反应 ; harmful chemicals｜有害化学物质 ; the chemical industry｜化学工业 ; chemical waste｜化学废料
tip_zh: chemical作名词可数；化学物质不一定有害。

meanings_zh: n. 谜；无法解释的事 | n. 神秘感 | n. 悬疑故事；推理小说
definition_en: Something that is unknown or cannot be explained | The quality of being strange, secret, or difficult to understand | A story about solving a puzzling event, often a crime
example1_en: Our professor circled a sense of mystery on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了神秘感。
example2_en: A campus survey used a sense of mystery to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用神秘感来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: solve a mystery｜解开谜团 ; remain a mystery｜仍然是个谜 ; a sense of mystery｜神秘感 ; mystery novel｜推理小说
tip_zh: 表示一个谜用a mystery；表示神秘感通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 打字员；打字者
definition_en: A person who types, especially as a job.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a fast typist.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于打字快的人的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a fast typist when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了打字快的人。
collocations: a fast typist｜打字快的人 ; a skilled typist｜熟练的打字员 ; a touch typist｜能盲打的人
tip_zh: 指人；typing指打字活动，typewriter指打字机。

meanings_zh: n. 菠菜
definition_en: A vegetable with dark green leaves eaten raw or cooked.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fresh spinach in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了新鲜菠菜。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of fresh spinach.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得新鲜菠菜这个例子。
collocations: fresh spinach｜新鲜菠菜 ; spinach leaves｜菠菜叶 ; steamed spinach｜蒸菠菜
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一片菠菜叶说a spinach leaf。

meanings_zh: n. 舒适；安逸 | n. 安慰；慰藉 | v. 安慰；抚慰
definition_en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation. | Relief from sadness or worry, or something providing it. | To help someone feel less sad, worried, or upset.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used comfort in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了舒适。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up comfort while discussing evidence about human behavior.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人类行为的证据时提到了舒适。
collocations: in comfort｜舒舒服服地 ; take comfort in｜从……中获得慰藉 ; comfort someone｜安慰某人 ; creature comforts｜物质上的舒适享受
tip_zh: 表示舒适或慰藉时通常不可数；作动词直接接人。

meanings_zh: adj. 对……过敏的 | adj. 过敏引起的
definition_en: Having an allergy to a particular substance | Caused by an allergy
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about allergic reaction.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于过敏反应的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects allergic reaction with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把过敏反应和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: be allergic to｜对……过敏 ; allergic reaction｜过敏反应 ; allergic to pollen｜对花粉过敏
tip_zh: 说对某物过敏用be allergic to，不用allergic with。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；连接 | n. 链接 | v. 连接；联系起来
definition_en: a connection between people, things, or ideas | a clickable element that opens another webpage or digital resource | to connect things or show a relationship between them
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a link between.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论……之间的联系。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a link between.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得……之间的联系这个例子。
collocations: a link between｜……之间的联系 ; click a link｜点击链接 ; link A to B｜将A与B联系起来 ; transport links｜交通连接
tip_zh: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

meanings_zh: adj. 非正式的；随意的 | adj. 口语化的；非正式语体的 | adj. 非官方的；非正规的
definition_en: Relaxed and friendly rather than following strict social rules. | Suitable for casual communication rather than formal writing or speech. | Not officially arranged, recognized, or controlled.
example1_en: I copied informal chat into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把闲聊抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around informal chat.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕闲聊展开说明。
collocations: informal chat｜闲聊 ; informal language｜非正式语言 ; informal learning｜非正规学习
tip_zh: 表示不拘礼节，不等于不礼貌或不专业。

meanings_zh: n. 磁带录音
definition_en: sound recorded on magnetic tape
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize tape-recording in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出磁带录音。
example2_en: Students who can explain tape-recording usually follow the rest of a lecture on technological change.
example2_zh: 能解释磁带录音的学生，通常跟得上一节关于技术变革的讲座。
collocations: make a tape-recording｜制作磁带录音 ; listen to a tape-recording｜听磁带录音 ; a tape-recording of an interview｜访谈的磁带录音
tip_zh: 也常写作 tape recording；数字录音通常用 recording。

meanings_zh: adj. 未知的；不为人知的 | n. 未知因素；无名之辈
definition_en: Not known, identified, or familiar. | Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.
example1_en: Office hours began with the unknown.
example1_zh: 答疑从未知事物开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used the unknown to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用未知事物来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: remain unknown｜仍然未知 ; unknown to someone｜某人不知道的 ; an unknown cause｜不明原因 ; the unknown｜未知事物
tip_zh: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

meanings_zh: n. 口音 | n. 重音；重音符号 | v. 强调；突出
definition_en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group | emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation | to give special emphasis or prominence to something
example1_en: I copied regional accent into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把地方口音抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to regional accent when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了地方口音。
collocations: regional accent｜地方口音 ; strong accent｜浓重的口音 ; speak with an accent｜说话带口音 ; accent mark｜重音符号
tip_zh: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

meanings_zh: n. 风车；风力磨坊
definition_en: A structure whose wind-driven sails power machinery, often for grinding grain.
example1_en: Our professor circled a traditional windmill on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了传统风车。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a traditional windmill.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕传统风车展开说明。
collocations: a traditional windmill｜传统风车 ; restore a windmill｜修复风车 ; windmill sails｜风车翼板
tip_zh: 现代发电风机通常叫wind turbine。

meanings_zh: n. 百分比；百分率
definition_en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a high percentage of.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于很高比例的的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a high percentage of.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得很高比例的这个例子。
collocations: a high percentage of｜很高比例的 ; a small percentage of｜小部分的 ; percentage point｜百分点 ; percentage increase｜百分比增幅
tip_zh: 数字后用percent；谈比例用percentage。

meanings_zh: adj. 有罪的；有过错的 | adj. 内疚的
definition_en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong. | Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.
example1_en: I copied plead guilty into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把认罪抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects plead guilty with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把认罪和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: guilty of｜犯有……罪的 ; find someone guilty｜裁定某人有罪 ; plead guilty｜认罪 ; feel guilty about｜因……感到内疚
tip_zh: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。

meanings_zh: v. 出口；输出 | n. 出口；出口商品 | v. 导出数据
definition_en: to send goods to another country for sale | selling goods abroad, or goods sold to another country | to save computer data in a format another program uses
example1_en: I heard the lecturer export goods during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时出口商品。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to export goods.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来出口商品。
collocations: export goods｜出口商品 ; export markets｜出口市场 ; export earnings｜出口收入 ; export data｜导出数据
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争对手 | n. 参赛者；选手
definition_en: A person or organisation trying to succeed against others. | Someone taking part in a competition.
example1_en: Our professor circled a major competitor on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了主要竞争对手。
example2_en: The reading connects a major competitor with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把主要竞争对手和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a major competitor｜主要竞争对手 ; a direct competitor｜直接竞争对手 ; a strong competitor｜强劲的竞争者
tip_zh: competitor指竞争者；competition指竞争或比赛。

meanings_zh: v. 呼吸
definition_en: take air into your lungs and let it out
example1_en: I heard the lecturer breathe deeply during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时深呼吸。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers breathe deeply before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要深呼吸。
collocations: breathe deeply｜深呼吸 ; breathe in｜吸气 ; breathe out｜呼气 ; breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip_zh: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

meanings_zh: v. 预测；预言
definition_en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to predict the outcome.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何预测结果。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to predict the outcome.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来预测结果。
collocations: predict the outcome｜预测结果 ; accurately predict｜准确预测 ; difficult to predict｜难以预测
tip_zh: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 机械修理工；汽车修理工
definition_en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.
example1_en: Our professor circled car mechanic on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了汽车修理工。
example2_en: A campus survey used car mechanic to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用汽车修理工来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: car mechanic｜汽车修理工 ; a qualified mechanic｜合格的机械修理工 ; work as a mechanic｜当机械修理工
tip_zh: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

meanings_zh: v. 使娱乐；使开心 | v. 招待；款待 | v. 考虑；心怀
definition_en: to keep someone interested or amused | to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities | to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling
example1_en: The lab instructions say to entertain an audience.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求为观众提供娱乐。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to entertain an audience.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来为观众提供娱乐。
collocations: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐 ; entertain guests｜招待客人 ; entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法
tip_zh: entertain an idea指考虑某想法，并非已经接受。

meanings_zh: n. 酒；含酒精饮品 | n. 酒精；乙醇
definition_en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk | a colourless liquid used in drinks, cleaning products, and fuels
example1_en: I copied rubbing alcohol into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把外用消毒酒精抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rubbing alcohol.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论外用消毒酒精的材料。
collocations: alcohol consumption｜饮酒量；饮酒 ; alcohol abuse｜酗酒 ; alcohol content｜酒精含量 ; rubbing alcohol｜外用消毒酒精
tip_zh: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。

meanings_zh: v. 打喷嚏 | n. 喷嚏
definition_en: To suddenly force air out through your nose and mouth. | A sudden, involuntary burst of air from the nose and mouth.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to sneeze into a tissue.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何对着纸巾打喷嚏。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers sneeze into a tissue before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要对着纸巾打喷嚏。
collocations: sneeze into a tissue｜对着纸巾打喷嚏 ; a fit of sneezing｜一阵喷嚏 ; stifle a sneeze｜忍住喷嚏
tip_zh: 动词不及物；“打一个喷嚏”可说give a sneeze。

meanings_zh: n. 治疗；疗法 | n. 对待；待遇 | n. 处理；加工
definition_en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury | the way someone behaves towards a person or group | a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance
example1_en: The textbook introduces receive treatment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了接受治疗。
example2_en: A campus survey used receive treatment to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用接受治疗来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: receive treatment｜接受治疗 ; medical treatment｜医疗 ; equal treatment｜平等对待 ; wastewater treatment｜废水处理
tip_zh: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。

meanings_zh: adj. 诚实的；正直的 | adj. 坦率的；真诚的
definition_en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing. | Expressing what you really think or feel.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an honest person.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于诚实的人的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects an honest person with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把诚实的人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an honest person｜诚实的人 ; an honest answer｜坦率的回答 ; to be honest｜说实话
tip_zh: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

meanings_zh: n. 拖拉机
definition_en: A powerful farm vehicle used to pull equipment or loads
example1_en: Our professor circled tractor driver on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了拖拉机驾驶员。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss tractor driver.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论拖拉机驾驶员的材料。
collocations: drive a tractor｜驾驶拖拉机 ; tractor driver｜拖拉机驾驶员 ; tractor tyre｜拖拉机轮胎
tip_zh: tractor是拖拉机；truck是卡车，注意区别。

meanings_zh: n. 受害者；受骗者
definition_en: someone harmed by an accident, crime, or unfair treatment
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on victim of crime.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论犯罪受害者。
example2_en: A campus survey used victim of crime to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用犯罪受害者来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: victim of crime｜犯罪受害者 ; fall victim to｜成为……的受害者 ; flood victims｜洪灾受害者
tip_zh: 表示某事的受害者，用victim of。

meanings_zh: n. 损坏；损害 | v. 损坏；损害
definition_en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy. | Harm something or make it less effective.
example1_en: I copied environmental damage into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把环境破坏抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss environmental damage.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论环境破坏的材料。
collocations: cause damage｜造成损害 ; damage to property｜财产损坏 ; environmental damage｜环境破坏 ; damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip_zh: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

meanings_zh: v. 逮捕；拘捕 | n. 逮捕；拘捕 | v. 阻止；使停止
definition_en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority | the act of taking someone into police custody | to stop the progress or development of something
example1_en: The assignment is to arrest the decline, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先遏制衰退，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to arrest the decline and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你遏制衰退，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: arrest someone for theft｜因盗窃逮捕某人 ; under arrest｜被捕 ; make an arrest｜实施逮捕 ; arrest the decline｜遏制衰退
tip_zh: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

meanings_zh: adj. 逗人发笑的；有趣的
definition_en: funny or entertaining in a pleasant way
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about amusing story.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于有趣的故事的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to amusing story when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有趣的故事。
collocations: amusing story｜有趣的故事 ; find something amusing｜觉得某事好笑 ; amusing anecdote｜趣闻
tip_zh: amusing形容事物逗人笑；amused形容人觉得好笑。

meanings_zh: adj. 感激的；感谢的
definition_en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about deeply grateful.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于深表感激的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deeply grateful.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论深表感激的材料。
collocations: grateful to someone｜感激某人 ; grateful for something｜感谢某事 ; deeply grateful｜深表感激
tip_zh: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

meanings_zh: n. 腰；腰部 | n. 衣服的腰部
definition_en: The middle part of your body above your hips. | The part of a garment that fits around your waist.
example1_en: The textbook introduces waist size in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了腰围。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around waist size.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕腰围展开说明。
collocations: waist size｜腰围 ; around the waist｜围绕腰部 ; from the waist up｜从腰部往上
tip_zh: waist指腰，与表示浪费的waste同音。

meanings_zh: n. 字幕 | n. 副标题 | v. 给……配字幕
definition_en: written dialogue or translation displayed on a screen | an additional title explaining a work's main title | to add written dialogue or translation to a film
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize subtitle in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出字幕。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up subtitle while discussing evidence about public communication.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共传播的证据时提到了字幕。
collocations: English subtitles｜英语字幕 ; turn on subtitles｜开启字幕 ; add a subtitle｜添加副标题
tip_zh: 影视字幕通常用复数subtitles；单数也可指副标题。

meanings_zh: v. 康复；恢复 | v. 找回；重新获得
definition_en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty | get back something lost, stolen, or spent
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to recover from an illness.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须病后康复。
example2_en: The passage says students who can recover from an illness follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够病后康复的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: recover from an illness｜病后康复 ; fully recover｜完全恢复 ; recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据 ; recover costs｜收回成本
tip_zh: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

meanings_zh: n. 小号 | v. 大肆宣扬；鼓吹 | v. 发出喇叭般的声音
definition_en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound. | To announce or praise something loudly and publicly. | To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.
example1_en: Our professor circled trumpet player on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了小号手。
example2_en: The reading connects trumpet player with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把小号手和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: play the trumpet｜吹小号 ; trumpet player｜小号手 ; trumpet achievements｜大肆宣扬成就
tip_zh: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

meanings_zh: n. 传统；惯例
definition_en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.
example1_en: The textbook introduces family tradition in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了家庭传统。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of family tradition.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得家庭传统这个例子。
collocations: family tradition｜家庭传统 ; preserve a tradition｜保留传统 ; break with tradition｜打破传统 ; oral tradition｜口述传统
tip_zh: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。

meanings_zh: n. 力气；力量 | n. 长处；优势 | n. 强度；坚固程度
definition_en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something. | A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective. | How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about physical strength.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于体力的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used physical strength to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用体力来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: physical strength｜体力 ; strengths and weaknesses｜优点与缺点 ; tensile strength｜抗拉强度 ; build strength｜增强力量
tip_zh: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

meanings_zh: n. 海军 | n. 深蓝色；藏青色 | adj. 深蓝色的
definition_en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea | a very dark blue colour | having a very dark blue colour
example1_en: Our professor circled navy blue on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了藏青色。
example2_en: A campus survey used navy blue to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用藏青色来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: join the navy｜加入海军 ; serve in the navy｜在海军服役 ; navy blue｜藏青色
tip_zh: navy指海军整体；具体的一艘军舰用warship。

meanings_zh: adj. 简短的；短暂的 | v. 向……介绍情况 | n. 任务说明；工作要求
definition_en: Lasting a short time or using few words. | To give someone essential information or instructions. | Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.
example1_en: Our professor circled a design brief on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了设计任务说明。
example2_en: A campus survey used a design brief to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用设计任务说明来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a brief summary｜简要总结 ; a brief pause｜短暂停顿 ; brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况 ; a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip_zh: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

meanings_zh: adj. 独一无二的；独特的 | adj. 特有的；独有的
definition_en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind | Found only in a particular person, place, or thing
example1_en: I copied unique opportunity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把难得的机会抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss unique opportunity.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论难得的机会的材料。
collocations: unique opportunity｜难得的机会 ; unique features｜独有的特点 ; unique to the region｜该地区特有的
tip_zh: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 贷款；借款 | n. 借用；出借 | v. 借出；贷给
definition_en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back | the temporary use of something belonging to someone else | to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return
example1_en: Office hours began with student loan.
example1_zh: 答疑从学生贷款开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss student loan.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论学生贷款的材料。
collocations: take out a loan｜申请贷款 ; repay a loan｜偿还贷款 ; student loan｜学生贷款 ; on loan｜借用中；出借中
tip_zh: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

meanings_zh: adj. 被禁止的；不准的
definition_en: not allowed by a rule, law, or authority
example1_en: I copied strictly forbidden into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把严格禁止的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used strictly forbidden to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用严格禁止的来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: strictly forbidden｜严格禁止的 ; forbidden territory｜禁区 ; forbidden by law｜法律禁止的
tip_zh: 也是forbid的过去分词；过去式为forbade。

meanings_zh: n. 短语；词组；惯用语 | v. 措辞；用语言表达
definition_en: a group of words expressing an idea or forming a unit | to express something using particular words
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a common phrase.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于常见短语的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a common phrase.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕常见短语展开说明。
collocations: a common phrase｜常见短语 ; a noun phrase｜名词短语 ; phrase a question｜为问题措辞 ; a useful phrase｜实用短语
tip_zh: phrase是短语，不一定构成完整句子。

meanings_zh: adj. 难过的；心烦的 | v. 使难过；使心烦 | v. 打乱；扰乱
definition_en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something. | To make someone feel unhappy or worried. | To disturb the usual arrangement or balance of something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on upset someone's plans.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论打乱某人的计划。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss upset someone's plans.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论打乱某人的计划的材料。
collocations: feel upset｜感到难过 ; upset about something｜为某事心烦 ; upset the balance｜打破平衡 ; upset someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip_zh: 动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: adj. 个人的；单独的 | n. 个人；个体 | adj. 独特的；有个性的
definition_en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group | One person or living thing considered separately from others | Having qualities that make someone or something different from others
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a talented individual.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于有才华的人的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a talented individual.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得有才华的人这个例子。
collocations: individual needs｜个人需求 ; individual responsibility｜个人责任 ; individual differences｜个体差异 ; a talented individual｜有才华的人
tip_zh: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。

meanings_zh: adj. 参与的；涉及的 | adj. 复杂难懂的
definition_en: taking part in or connected with something | complicated and difficult to understand
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about actively involved.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于积极参与的的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used actively involved to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用积极参与的来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: get involved in｜参与 ; actively involved｜积极参与的 ; an involved process｜复杂的过程
tip_zh: 参与某事用be involved in；修饰名词可后置。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；陈列；显示 | n. 展览；陈列 | n. 显示屏
definition_en: Put something where people can see it | An arrangement of things for people to look at | A screen that shows information or images
example1_en: I heard the lecturer display information during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时显示信息。
example2_en: The reading asks you to display information and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你显示信息，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: on display｜在展出 ; display information｜显示信息 ; a colourful display｜色彩缤纷的陈列 ; digital display｜数字显示屏
tip_zh: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

meanings_zh: prep. 减去；扣除 | adj. 负的；零下的 | n. 缺点；不利因素
definition_en: with a particular amount taken away | below zero | a disadvantage or negative feature
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on minus ten degrees.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论零下十度。
example2_en: The author returns to minus ten degrees when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了零下十度。
collocations: minus ten degrees｜零下十度 ; minus sign｜减号；负号 ; pluses and minuses｜优缺点
tip_zh: minus可表减去，也可置于温度前表示零下。

meanings_zh: adj. 被偷的；失窃的 | v. 偷窃（steal的过去分词）
definition_en: taken from its owner without permission | taken something without permission, as the past participle of steal
example1_en: Office hours began with stolen goods.
example1_zh: 答疑从赃物开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used stolen goods to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用赃物来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: stolen goods｜赃物 ; a stolen vehicle｜被盗车辆 ; stolen data｜被盗数据
tip_zh: 变化为steal—stole—stolen；stolen不能单独作过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 快乐；满足 | n. 乐事；令人愉快的经历
definition_en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment | An activity or experience that brings enjoyment
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a great pleasure.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一大乐事的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a great pleasure.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一大乐事展开说明。
collocations: take pleasure in｜从……中获得乐趣 ; for pleasure｜为了消遣 ; a great pleasure｜一大乐事 ; with pleasure｜乐意地
tip_zh: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

meanings_zh: n. 进步；进展 | v. 进步；逐步发展
definition_en: improvement or movement towards a goal | to improve or move towards a more advanced stage
example1_en: Our professor circled steady progress on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了稳步进展。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of steady progress.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得稳步进展这个例子。
collocations: make progress｜取得进步 ; steady progress｜稳步进展 ; in progress｜进行中
tip_zh: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。

meanings_zh: n. 贫穷；贫困 | n. 匮乏；贫乏
definition_en: The condition of lacking money for basic needs. | A serious lack of something needed or valued.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about reduce poverty.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于减少贫困的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around reduce poverty.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕减少贫困展开说明。
collocations: live in poverty｜生活贫困 ; reduce poverty｜减少贫困 ; extreme poverty｜极端贫困 ; a poverty of ideas｜思想贫乏
tip_zh: 不可数名词；“生活贫困”用live in poverty。

meanings_zh: adj. 官方的；正式的 | n. 官员；高级职员
definition_en: approved or issued by a government or organisation | someone with a position of authority in an organisation
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on government official.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论政府官员。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of government official.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得政府官员这个例子。
collocations: official statement｜官方声明 ; official statistics｜官方统计数据 ; government official｜政府官员 ; official language｜官方语言
tip_zh: official强调官方认可；formal强调形式或场合正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人恶心的；令人反感的 | adj. 令人愤慨的；不可接受的
definition_en: extremely unpleasant, making you feel sick or strongly dislike something | so bad or wrong that it causes strong disapproval
example1_en: I copied absolutely disgusting into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把极其恶心的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects absolutely disgusting with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把极其恶心的和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a disgusting smell｜令人恶心的气味 ; disgusting behaviour｜令人反感的行为 ; absolutely disgusting｜极其恶心的
tip_zh: disgusting形容事物令人反感；disgusted形容人感到反感。

meanings_zh: v. 齐步行进；坚定地走 | n. 游行；行军 | n. 进行曲
definition_en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group. | An organised walk by a group, often to protest. | Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to march through the streets.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须列队穿过街道。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to march through the streets.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来列队穿过街道。
collocations: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道 ; a protest march｜抗议游行 ; a peaceful march｜和平游行 ; a military march｜军队进行曲
tip_zh: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

meanings_zh: n. 印象；感受 | n. 模仿表演 | n. 压痕；印记
definition_en: An idea or feeling formed about someone or something. | A performance copying someone's voice, appearance, or behaviour. | A mark left by pressing something into a surface.
example1_en: The textbook introduces first impression in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了第一印象。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around first impression.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕第一印象展开说明。
collocations: first impression｜第一印象 ; make an impression on｜给……留下印象 ; be under the impression that｜以为…… ; do an impression of｜模仿……
tip_zh: under the impression that表示“以为”，常暗示误解。

meanings_zh: n. 主教座堂；大教堂
definition_en: The main church of a district led by a bishop.
example1_en: Office hours began with medieval cathedral.
example1_zh: 答疑从中世纪大教堂开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used medieval cathedral to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用中世纪大教堂来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: medieval cathedral｜中世纪大教堂 ; cathedral tower｜大教堂塔楼 ; cathedral restoration｜大教堂修复
tip_zh: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。

meanings_zh: n. 优势；有利条件 | n. 好处；益处
definition_en: Something that makes success more likely than for others. | A useful or positive feature of something.
example1_en: Our professor circled competitive advantage on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了竞争优势。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss competitive advantage.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论竞争优势的材料。
collocations: competitive advantage｜竞争优势 ; have an advantage over｜比……有优势 ; take advantage of｜利用；占……便宜 ; a major advantage｜一大优势
tip_zh: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人不快的；难受的 | adj. 不友善的；粗鲁的
definition_en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness. | Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.
example1_en: Office hours began with an unpleasant smell.
example1_zh: 答疑从难闻的气味开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of an unpleasant smell.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得难闻的气味这个例子。
collocations: an unpleasant smell｜难闻的气味 ; an unpleasant experience｜不愉快的经历 ; unpleasant side effects｜令人难受的副作用 ; unpleasant to someone｜对某人不友善
tip_zh: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

meanings_zh: n. 类别；种类
definition_en: a group of things sharing particular features
example1_en: The textbook introduces broad category in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大类。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss broad category.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论大类的材料。
collocations: fall into a category｜属于某类别 ; broad category｜大类 ; age category｜年龄组 ; divide into categories｜分类
tip_zh: 常用fall into a category表示“归入某类别”。

meanings_zh: adv. 热情地；亲切地 | adv. 暖和地
definition_en: in a friendly and welcoming way | in a way that keeps someone comfortably warm
example1_en: I wrote warmly on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把warmly和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on human behavior uses warmly when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于人类行为的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了热情地。

meanings_zh: n. 教练；指导教师 | n. 大学讲师（美国）
