meanings_zh: n. 负载；装载量 | v. 装载；加载 | n. 工作量；负担

example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论沉重的负载。

meanings_zh: n. 送信人；传信者

example1_zh: 答疑从自行车送件员开始。
example2_en: The author returns to bike messenger when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了自行车送件员。

meanings_zh: v. 出版；刊登 | v. 公布；发布

example1_zh: 作业是先出版书籍，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to publish a book.

meanings_zh: n. 幽默；幽默感 | n. 心情；情绪 | v. 迁就；顺着

example1_zh: 我把幽默感抄进了课堂笔记。

example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕幽默感展开说明。

meanings_zh: v. 收费；索价 | n. 费用；收费 | v. 给……充电

example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须收取费用。

example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们收取费用。

meanings_zh: n. 乱扔的垃圾 | v. 乱扔垃圾；使杂乱 | n. 一窝幼崽

collocations: drop litter｜乱扔垃圾 ; pick up litter｜捡垃圾 ; a litter of puppies｜一窝小狗

example1_zh: 教授让我们污染环境。

example2_zh: 全班讨论环境政策时，讲者让我们污染环境。
collocations: pollute the environment｜污染环境 ; pollute the air｜污染空气 ; heavily polluted｜受到严重污染的

meanings_zh: n. 细胞 | n. 牢房；小隔间 | n. 电池单元

example1_zh: 我把牢房抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a prison cell.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论牢房的材料。
collocations: blood cells｜血细胞 ; stem cells｜干细胞 ; a prison cell｜牢房 ; a fuel cell｜燃料电池
tip_zh: 生物语境常指细胞；prison cell指牢房。

meanings_zh: n. 传单；宣传单
definition_en: A small printed sheet giving information or advertising something.

example2_en: The author returns to information leaflet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了信息单。
collocations: hand out leaflets｜分发传单 ; information leaflet｜信息单 ; promotional leaflet｜宣传单

meanings_zh: adj. 文化的；与文化有关的 | adj. 艺术的；文艺的
definition_en: relating to a group's customs, beliefs, and way of life | relating to activities such as music, literature, and theatre

meanings_zh: v. 获得；增加 | n. 增长；收益

collocations: gain experience｜积累经验 ; gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会 ; gain weight｜体重增加 ; financial gain｜经济收益

meanings_zh: adj. 技术的；工艺的 | adj. 专业的；专门的
definition_en: relating to practical skills, machinery, or scientific methods | using specialist knowledge or language in a particular subject

example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论技术技能。

meanings_zh: n. 交易；协议 | v. 处理；应付 | v. 分发；发牌

example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了诗。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up poem while discussing evidence about the humanities.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人文学科的证据时提到了诗。
collocations: write a poem｜写诗 ; recite a poem｜背诵诗歌 ; a collection of poems｜诗集
tip_zh: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

meanings_zh: adj. 固态的；坚实的 | adj. 可靠的；扎实的 | n. 固体
definition_en: having a firm shape rather than being liquid or gas | strong, dependable, or based on good evidence | a substance that keeps its shape rather than flowing
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about solid evidence.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于可靠证据的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss solid evidence.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可靠证据的材料。
collocations: solid evidence｜可靠证据 ; solid foundation｜坚实基础 ; solid waste｜固体废物 ; solid wood｜实木
tip_zh: solid作名词指固体；solid evidence表示可靠证据。

meanings_zh: v. 申请 | v. 应用；适用 | v. 涂；敷
definition_en: To formally ask for a job, place, or permission | To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation | To spread a substance onto a surface
example1_en: The professor asked us to apply for a job.
example1_zh: 教授让我们申请工作。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to apply for a job.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们申请工作。
collocations: apply for a job｜申请工作 ; apply to a university｜向大学提出申请 ; apply knowledge｜应用知识 ; apply sunscreen｜涂防晒霜
tip_zh: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；量
definition_en: the amount or number of something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on quality over quantity.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论质量优于数量。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around quality over quantity.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕质量优于数量展开说明。
collocations: a large quantity of｜大量的 ; in small quantities｜少量地 ; quality over quantity｜质量优于数量
tip_zh: quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。

meanings_zh: v. 使受伤
definition_en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to injure your knee.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须伤到膝盖。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to injure your knee.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得伤到膝盖。
collocations: injure your knee｜伤到膝盖 ; seriously injured｜严重受伤 ; injure yourself｜使自己受伤
tip_zh: injure通常指身体受伤；损坏物品常用damage。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者
definition_en: Someone who plays the piano, especially professionally.
example1_en: The textbook introduces concert pianist in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐会钢琴家。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around concert pianist.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕音乐会钢琴家展开说明。
collocations: concert pianist｜音乐会钢琴家 ; professional pianist｜职业钢琴家 ; accompanying pianist｜钢琴伴奏者
tip_zh: pianist指演奏者；乐器钢琴是piano。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；专业性职业 | n. 某职业的全体从业者 | n. 公开表白；声明
definition_en: A job requiring specialist knowledge and usually advanced training. | All the people working in a particular specialist occupation. | An open statement of a belief, feeling, or intention.
example1_en: I copied the medical profession into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把医学界抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used the medical profession to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用医学界来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: enter a profession｜进入某职业领域 ; by profession｜就职业而言 ; the medical profession｜医学界 ; a profession of faith｜信仰的公开表白
tip_zh: profession通常指需专门训练的职业，比job范围窄。

meanings_zh: n. 瑜伽
definition_en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.
example1_en: Our professor circled yoga mat on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了瑜伽垫。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of yoga mat.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得瑜伽垫这个例子。
collocations: do yoga｜练瑜伽 ; yoga mat｜瑜伽垫 ; yoga instructor｜瑜伽教练
tip_zh: 练瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不正确的
definition_en: Not accurate, true, or right.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on factually incorrect.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论事实有误的。
example2_en: A campus survey used factually incorrect to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用事实有误的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: incorrect information｜错误信息 ; incorrect answer｜错误答案 ; factually incorrect｜事实有误的
tip_zh: incorrect比wrong正式，常用于答案、信息或数据。

meanings_zh: adv. 身体上；体力上 | adv. 实际上；亲身地
definition_en: In a way related to the body or physical effort. | In a real, material way rather than virtually or theoretically.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to physically active.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习经常运动的。
example2_en: A lecture on public health asks the class to physically active before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先经常运动的。
collocations: physically active｜经常运动的 ; physically demanding｜耗费体力的 ; physically present｜亲自在场的
tip_zh: 强调身体层面时，常与mentally形成对比。

meanings_zh: n. 目的；目标 | v. 力求；旨在 | v. 瞄准；对准
definition_en: something you want or plan to achieve | to intend or try to achieve something | to point something towards a particular target
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the main aim.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于主要目标的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to the main aim when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主要目标。
collocations: the main aim｜主要目标 ; aim to do something｜力求做某事 ; with the aim of｜以……为目的 ; aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip_zh: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的 | adj. 极大的；强烈的
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable. | Very great in amount, degree, or intensity.
example1_en: I copied terrific job into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把出色的工作抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used terrific job to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用出色的工作来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: terrific job｜出色的工作 ; terrific opportunity｜极好的机会 ; terrific speed｜极快的速度 ; terrific noise｜巨大的响声
tip_zh: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 意识到；明白 | v. 实现；使成为现实
definition_en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation | to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real
example1_en: The lab instructions say to realise that.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求意识到……。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to realise that.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们意识到……。
collocations: realise that｜意识到…… ; realise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; realise an ambition｜实现志向 ; realise your potential｜发挥你的潜能
tip_zh: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 全体员工；工作人员 | v. 为…配备员工
definition_en: The people employed by an organisation. | To provide workers for an organisation or service.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a member of staff.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一名员工的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a member of staff with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一名员工和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a member of staff｜一名员工 ; staff training｜员工培训 ; teaching staff｜全体教师 ; staff shortage｜人员短缺
tip_zh: 单个员工用a member of staff，不说a staff。

meanings_zh: n. 纪录片；纪实节目 | adj. 文件的；文献的
definition_en: A film or programme presenting facts about real subjects. | Consisting of or supported by written documents.
example1_en: I copied documentary film into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把纪录电影抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to documentary film when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了纪录电影。
collocations: documentary film｜纪录电影 ; documentary evidence｜书面证据 ; documentary about wildlife｜关于野生动物的纪录片
tip_zh: 作名词指纪录片；documentary evidence指书面证据。

meanings_zh: v. 受苦；患病 | v. 遭受；受损
definition_en: To experience physical pain or mental distress. | To experience something harmful or become worse.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to suffer from headaches.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须受头痛困扰。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers suffer from headaches before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要受头痛困扰。
collocations: suffer from headaches｜受头痛困扰 ; suffer a loss｜遭受损失 ; suffer damage｜遭到损坏 ; suffer badly｜遭受严重影响
tip_zh: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

meanings_zh: n. 金属丝；电线 | v. 给…接线；安装电线
definition_en: Thin metal drawn into strands, often used to carry electricity. | To install or connect electrical wires in something.
example1_en: Our professor circled copper wire on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了铜线。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of copper wire.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得铜线这个例子。
collocations: copper wire｜铜线 ; electrical wire｜电线 ; wire fence｜铁丝围栏 ; wire up a house｜给房屋安装电线
tip_zh: wire可指单根金属丝；cable通常更粗或由多股组成。

meanings_zh: adv. 强烈地；坚定地
definition_en: With great force, intensity, or conviction.
example1_en: The lab manual says to strongly recommend before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先强烈建议，再记下数字。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior asks the class to strongly recommend before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先强烈建议。
collocations: strongly recommend｜强烈建议 ; strongly oppose｜坚决反对 ; strongly believe｜坚信 ; strongly associated with｜与……密切相关
tip_zh: 常修饰recommend、oppose、believe，强调态度。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人放松的
definition_en: making you feel calm and free from stress
example1_en: Our professor circled relaxing atmosphere on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了轻松的氛围。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around relaxing atmosphere.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕轻松的氛围展开说明。
collocations: relaxing atmosphere｜轻松的氛围 ; relaxing music｜令人放松的音乐 ; relaxing holiday｜轻松的假期
tip_zh: relaxing形容事物令人放松；relaxed形容人感到放松。

meanings_zh: adj. 不确定的；无把握的 | adj. 未定的；难以预测的
definition_en: not sure about something | not known, settled, or predictable
example1_en: Office hours began with uncertain about.
example1_zh: 答疑从对……不确定开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of uncertain about.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得对……不确定这个例子。
collocations: uncertain about｜对……不确定 ; an uncertain future｜未卜的前途 ; remain uncertain｜仍不确定
tip_zh: 人没把握用uncertain about；事情未定用remain uncertain。

meanings_zh: n. 贸易；交易 | v. 买卖；交换 | n. 手艺；职业
definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services | to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services | a skilled job, especially one involving practical work
example1_en: Office hours began with international trade.
example1_zh: 答疑从国际贸易开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of international trade.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得国际贸易这个例子。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; trade agreement｜贸易协定 ; trade with｜与……做生意 ; learn a trade｜学一门手艺
tip_zh: trade A for B指用A换B；by trade指职业上。

meanings_zh: adj. 出生地的；母语的 | adj. 本土的；原生的 | n. 本地人；出生于某地者
definition_en: connected with the place or language of someone's early life | living or growing naturally in a particular region | a person born in a particular place
example1_en: Our professor circled native language on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了母语。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss native language.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论母语的材料。
collocations: native language｜母语 ; native speaker｜母语使用者 ; native species｜本土物种 ; be native to｜原产于
tip_zh: a native of指某地出生者；the natives可能带贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 监狱 | n. 监禁
definition_en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes. | The state of being kept in a prison.
example1_en: I copied prison sentence into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把监禁刑期抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to prison sentence when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了监禁刑期。
collocations: in prison｜在服刑 ; go to prison｜入狱服刑 ; prison sentence｜监禁刑期 ; prison reform｜监狱改革
tip_zh: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

meanings_zh: n. 歌剧；歌剧艺术
definition_en: a musical drama in which performers sing most words
example1_en: The textbook introduces an opera singer in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了歌剧演员。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of an opera singer.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得歌剧演员这个例子。
collocations: an opera singer｜歌剧演员 ; an opera house｜歌剧院 ; perform an opera｜演出歌剧
tip_zh: 泛指歌剧艺术时不可数；一部歌剧用an opera。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂的 | n. 综合建筑群
definition_en: Having many connected parts and being difficult to understand. | A group of buildings used for related activities.
example1_en: Our professor circled sports complex on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了综合体育场馆。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sports complex.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕综合体育场馆展开说明。
collocations: complex issue｜复杂问题 ; complex system｜复杂系统 ; sports complex｜综合体育场馆
tip_zh: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

meanings_zh: n. 雇主；用人单位
definition_en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.
example1_en: I copied a major employer into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把大型用人单位抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a major employer when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了大型用人单位。
collocations: a major employer｜大型用人单位 ; a prospective employer｜潜在雇主 ; current employer｜现雇主
tip_zh: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

meanings_zh: v. 投资 | v. 投入时间、精力或资金
definition_en: To put money into something hoping to gain financial returns. | To devote resources to something for a future benefit.
example1_en: The assignment is to invest in property, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先投资房地产，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to invest in property and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你投资房地产，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: invest in property｜投资房地产 ; invest heavily in｜大量投资于 ; invest time in｜投入时间于 ; invest wisely｜明智地投资
tip_zh: 常用invest in；投入时间做事可用invest time in doing。

meanings_zh: n. 工程学；工程技术
definition_en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems
example1_en: Our professor circled civil engineering on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了土木工程。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of civil engineering.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得土木工程这个例子。
collocations: civil engineering｜土木工程 ; mechanical engineering｜机械工程 ; electrical engineering｜电气工程 ; an engineering project｜工程项目
tip_zh: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害健康的 | adj. 不健康的；身体虚弱的 | adj. 不正常的；有害的
definition_en: likely to damage physical or mental health | not in good physical condition | harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an unhealthy diet.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论不健康的饮食。
example2_en: The author returns to an unhealthy diet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不健康的饮食。
collocations: an unhealthy diet｜不健康的饮食 ; an unhealthy lifestyle｜不健康的生活方式 ; unhealthy competition｜恶性竞争 ; an unhealthy obsession｜有害的痴迷
tip_zh: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

meanings_zh: adj. 科学的；符合科学方法的
definition_en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about scientific research.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于科学研究的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used scientific research to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用科学研究来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: scientific research｜科学研究 ; scientific evidence｜科学证据 ; scientific method｜科学方法
tip_zh: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

meanings_zh: n. 证书；证明书
definition_en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a birth certificate.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于出生证明的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a birth certificate.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论出生证明的材料。
collocations: a birth certificate｜出生证明 ; a medical certificate｜医生证明 ; a professional certificate｜专业资格证书 ; award a certificate｜颁发证书
tip_zh: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的；电气的
definition_en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about electrical equipment.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电气设备的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to electrical equipment when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了电气设备。
collocations: electrical equipment｜电气设备 ; electrical engineering｜电气工程 ; electrical fault｜电路故障 ; electrical wiring｜电气线路
tip_zh: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

meanings_zh: n. 解释；说明 | n. 原因；解释理由
definition_en: information that makes something easier to understand | a reason given for why something happened
example1_en: Our professor circled clear explanation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了清楚的解释。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss clear explanation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论清楚的解释的材料。
collocations: clear explanation｜清楚的解释 ; give an explanation｜作出解释 ; explanation for｜对……的原因解释 ; explanation of｜对……的说明
tip_zh: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

meanings_zh: adj. 失望的；沮丧的
definition_en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.
example1_en: I copied deeply disappointed into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把深感失望抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deeply disappointed.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论深感失望的材料。
collocations: disappointed with｜对……失望 ; deeply disappointed｜深感失望 ; disappointed to hear｜听到……感到失望
tip_zh: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 竞争；争夺 | v. 参加比赛
definition_en: Try to win or succeed against others. | Take part in a sporting event or other contest.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to compete with.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何与……竞争。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers compete with before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要与……竞争。
collocations: compete with｜与……竞争 ; compete for｜争夺 ; compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip_zh: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

meanings_zh: n. 定期通讯；简报
definition_en: a regular printed or electronic report for a particular group
example1_en: I copied monthly newsletter into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把月度简报抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used monthly newsletter to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用月度简报来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: monthly newsletter｜月度简报 ; email newsletter｜电子邮件通讯 ; subscribe to a newsletter｜订阅通讯
tip_zh: 可指纸质或电子通讯；订阅用subscribe to。

meanings_zh: adj. 合理的；通情达理的 | adj. 价格公道的 | adj. 尚可的；过得去的
definition_en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement. | Not too expensive. | Acceptable in quality or amount, though not excellent.
example1_en: Office hours began with a reasonable explanation.
example1_zh: 答疑从合理的解释开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a reasonable explanation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论合理的解释的材料。
collocations: a reasonable explanation｜合理的解释 ; a reasonable price｜公道的价格 ; reasonable expectations｜合理的期望 ; a reasonable standard｜尚可的水平
tip_zh: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；工作 | n. 军事占领 | n. 居住；使用
definition_en: the type of work someone does to earn money | control of a place by a foreign army | the act of living in or using a building
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on current occupation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论目前职业。
example2_en: The author returns to current occupation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了目前职业。
collocations: current occupation｜目前职业 ; military occupation｜军事占领 ; under occupation｜处于占领之下 ; ready for occupation｜可供入住
tip_zh: 表示职业时较正式，常见于表格；不要与职位混同。

meanings_zh: adj. 独立自主的 | adj. 不受控制的；独立的 | adj. 无关联的；互不影响的
definition_en: able to live or act without relying on others | not controlled by another person, organisation, or country | not connected with or affected by something else
example1_en: The textbook introduces financially independent in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济独立的。
example2_en: A campus survey used financially independent to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经济独立的来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: financially independent｜经济独立的 ; independent research｜独立研究 ; independent of｜不依赖；不受影响 ; independent judgement｜独立判断
tip_zh: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

meanings_zh: n. 传单 | n. 乘飞机的人
definition_en: A small printed sheet advertising an event, product, or service. | A person who travels by plane.
example1_en: The textbook introduces promotional flyer in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宣传单。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of promotional flyer.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得宣传单这个例子。
collocations: hand out flyers｜分发传单 ; promotional flyer｜宣传单 ; frequent flyer｜常乘飞机的人
tip_zh: 传单也可写作flier；常乘飞机的人用frequent flyer。

meanings_zh: v. 祈祷 | v. 热切盼望；祈求
definition_en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship. | To hope very strongly that something will happen.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to pray for peace.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求祈求和平。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pray for peace.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来祈求和平。
collocations: pray for peace｜祈求和平 ; pray to God｜向上帝祈祷 ; pray that｜祈求……
tip_zh: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

meanings_zh: n. 对话；意见交流 | n. 对白
definition_en: A conversation or discussion, especially to exchange views | The words spoken by characters in a story or performance
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about engage in dialogue.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于参与对话的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used engage in dialogue to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用参与对话来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: open dialogue｜坦诚对话 ; engage in dialogue｜参与对话 ; dialogue between communities｜社区间的对话 ; natural dialogue｜自然的对白
tip_zh: 既指现实中的交流，也指小说、电影等作品中的对白。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷人的；讨人喜欢的
definition_en: very pleasant or attractive in a way that delights people
example1_en: Our professor circled charming smile on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了迷人的微笑。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss charming smile.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论迷人的微笑的材料。
collocations: charming smile｜迷人的微笑 ; charming village｜迷人的村庄 ; charming personality｜讨人喜欢的性格
tip_zh: 既可形容人讨喜，也可形容地方迷人。

meanings_zh: n. 大学一年级学生
definition_en: A student in the first year of high school or college.
example1_en: Every freshman attends the library tour.
example1_zh: 每位大一学生都要参加图书馆参观。
example2_en: The study followed one freshman cohort from orientation to the end of spring.
example2_zh: 这项研究跟踪了一届大一学生，从迎新一直到春季学期结束。
collocations: freshman year｜大一学年 ; a freshman seminar｜新生研讨课
tip_zh: 复数是 freshmen。指大二到大四常用 sophomore, junior, senior。

meanings_zh: v. 集中注意力；聚焦 | n. 重点；关注中心 | n. 清晰度；焦点
definition_en: direct attention or effort towards one particular thing | the main subject receiving attention or effort | image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to focus on.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何集中于。
example2_en: The passage says students who can focus on follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够集中于的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: focus on｜集中于 ; the main focus｜主要关注点 ; in focus｜影像清晰 ; out of focus｜影像模糊
tip_zh: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

meanings_zh: adj. 面对面的；当面的 | adv. 面对面地；当面地
definition_en: Involving people physically present together and looking at each other. | With people physically present together rather than communicating remotely.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize face-to-face in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出当面的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up face-to-face while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了当面的。
collocations: a face-to-face meeting｜面对面会议 ; face-to-face communication｜面对面交流 ; a face-to-face interview｜当面访谈
tip_zh: 名词前通常加连字符；作状语时常写face to face。

meanings_zh: n. 艺术；艺术活动 | n. 文科；人文学科
definition_en: Creative activities such as painting, music, theatre, and dance. | Subjects such as languages, literature, philosophy, and history.
example1_en: I copied the performing arts into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把表演艺术抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of the performing arts.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得表演艺术这个例子。
collocations: the performing arts｜表演艺术 ; arts subjects｜文科科目 ; arts centre｜艺术中心 ; Bachelor of Arts｜文学学士
tip_zh: the arts 指艺术的总称；arts subjects 指文科科目。

meanings_zh: n. 资源；财力；人力 | n. 资料；学习资源 | v. 为…提供资源
definition_en: Something useful that people or organisations can draw on. | Material that provides information or support for learning. | To supply an organisation or activity with necessary support.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used resource in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了资源。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up resource while discussing evidence about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于环境政策的证据时提到了资源。
collocations: natural resources｜自然资源 ; human resources｜人力资源 ; learning resources｜学习资源 ; allocate resources｜分配资源
tip_zh: 资源总称常用复数resources；动词意为提供资源。

meanings_zh: n. 雨林；热带雨林
definition_en: a dense forest in an area receiving very heavy rainfall
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on tropical rainforest.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热带雨林。
example2_en: A campus survey used tropical rainforest to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用热带雨林来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: tropical rainforest｜热带雨林 ; rainforest canopy｜雨林树冠层 ; rainforest conservation｜雨林保护 ; rainforest destruction｜雨林破坏
tip_zh: 常写作rainforest；rain forest也正确。

meanings_zh: n. 保险 | n. 防范措施；保障
definition_en: An arrangement providing financial protection against specified risks. | Something that protects against a possible future problem.
example1_en: The textbook introduces health insurance in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了医疗保险。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around health insurance.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕医疗保险展开说明。
collocations: take out insurance｜购买保险 ; health insurance｜医疗保险 ; insurance premium｜保险费 ; insurance claim｜保险索赔
tip_zh: 通常不可数；保险费用premium，保单用policy。

meanings_zh: adj. 失明的 | adj. 盲目的；未察觉的 | n. 卷帘；百叶窗
definition_en: Unable to see. | Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems. | A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on roller blind.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论卷帘。
example2_en: A campus survey used roller blind to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用卷帘来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: blind passengers｜失明乘客 ; blind faith｜盲目信任 ; blind to the risks｜无视风险 ; roller blind｜卷帘
tip_zh: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 固定的；不变的 | adj. 牢固安装的
definition_en: set and not changing or adjustable | securely attached in one position
example1_en: The textbook introduces fixed price in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了固定价格。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fixed price.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕固定价格展开说明。
collocations: fixed price｜固定价格 ; fixed income｜固定收入 ; fixed rate｜固定费率 ; fixed term｜固定期限
tip_zh: fixed price是固定价格；fixed也可作fix的过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 离婚 | v. 与…离婚；离婚 | v. 使分离；使脱离
definition_en: the legal ending of a marriage | to legally end a marriage | to separate something from something closely connected with it
example1_en: The textbook introduces file for divorce in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了提出离婚申请。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of file for divorce.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得提出离婚申请这个例子。
collocations: get a divorce｜办理离婚 ; file for divorce｜提出离婚申请 ; divorce something from something｜将某事与某事分离
tip_zh: divorce sb表示与某人离婚，不加with。

meanings_zh: n. 组织；机构；团体 | n. 组织工作；安排
definition_en: A group of people working together for a shared purpose. | The process of planning activities and arranging things efficiently.
example1_en: I copied a non-profit organization into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把非营利组织抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a non-profit organization.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕非营利组织展开说明。
collocations: a non-profit organization｜非营利组织 ; an international organization｜国际组织 ; the organization of an event｜活动的组织安排 ; poor organization｜组织不善
tip_zh: 指机构时可数，指组织工作时不可数；英式也写organisation。

meanings_zh: v. 坚决要求；坚持主张 | v. 坚持说；坚称
definition_en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement | to state firmly that something is true
example1_en: The assignment is to insist that, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先坚决要求；坚称，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can insist that follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够坚决要求；坚称的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: insist on doing something｜坚持做某事 ; insist that｜坚决要求；坚称 ; insist on payment｜坚持要求付款
tip_zh: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

meanings_zh: v. 抢劫；盗取财物 | v. 剥夺；使丧失
definition_en: To take money or property illegally from someone or somewhere. | To unfairly take away something valuable or important.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rob a bank.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抢银行。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to rob a bank.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得抢银行。
collocations: rob a bank｜抢银行 ; rob someone of something｜抢走某人某物 ; rob someone of opportunities｜剥夺某人的机会
tip_zh: rob接人或地点；steal接被偷的物品。

meanings_zh: n. 研究人员；研究者
definition_en: Someone who studies a subject carefully to discover new information.
example1_en: The textbook introduces medical researcher in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了医学研究人员。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medical researcher.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论医学研究人员的材料。
collocations: medical researcher｜医学研究人员 ; lead researcher｜首席研究员 ; a team of researchers｜一组研究人员
tip_zh: researcher可数；research作名词通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 代表；代理 | v. 象征；描绘 | v. 构成；相当于
definition_en: To speak or act officially for someone or a group. | To stand for or show someone or something. | To amount to something or form part of a whole.
example1_en: The assignment is to represent a country, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先代表国家，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers represent a country before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要代表国家。
collocations: represent a country｜代表国家 ; represent someone's interests｜代表某人的利益 ; represent a significant proportion｜占很大比例
tip_zh: represent是动词；on behalf of是“代表”的介词短语。

meanings_zh: v. 存在 | v. 生存；勉强维生
definition_en: To be real or present in the world. | To stay alive, especially with very limited resources.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to exist in nature.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须存在于自然界。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to exist in nature.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们存在于自然界。
collocations: already exist｜已经存在 ; continue to exist｜继续存在 ; exist in nature｜存在于自然界 ; exist on limited resources｜靠有限资源维生
tip_zh: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。

meanings_zh: adj. 实际操作的；实践的 | adj. 实用的；可行的 | adj. 务实的；动手能力强的
definition_en: involving real activities and experience rather than only ideas | useful or suitable for real situations | good at solving everyday problems and making or repairing things
example1_en: The textbook introduces practical experience in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了实践经验。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around practical experience.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕实践经验展开说明。
collocations: practical experience｜实践经验 ; practical skills｜实用技能 ; practical solution｜可行的解决办法 ; practical advice｜实用建议
tip_zh: practical可强调亲手实践，也可表示实用、可行。

meanings_zh: n. 回收利用 | n. 待回收物品
definition_en: the process of turning waste into materials usable again | waste materials collected to be processed and used again
example1_en: Our professor circled household recycling on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了家庭废物回收。
example2_en: The reading connects household recycling with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把家庭废物回收和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: recycling centre｜回收中心 ; recycling bin｜回收物桶 ; recycling scheme｜回收计划 ; household recycling｜家庭废物回收
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示回收活动或待回收的物品。

meanings_zh: n. 哭泣；哭声 | adj. 迫切的；极其明显的
definition_en: the act or sound of shedding tears from emotion or pain | extremely serious or obvious, especially when needing attention
example1_en: Our professor circled a crying need on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了迫切的需求。
example2_en: The author returns to a crying need when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了迫切的需求。
collocations: stop crying｜停止哭泣 ; a crying need｜迫切的需求 ; a crying shame｜极其遗憾的事
tip_zh: 也是cry的现在分词；a crying need指迫切需求。

meanings_zh: n. 实验室；研究室
definition_en: a room or building equipped for scientific work
example1_en: Office hours began with research laboratory.
example1_zh: 答疑从研究实验室开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss research laboratory.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论研究实验室的材料。
collocations: laboratory equipment｜实验室设备 ; laboratory tests｜实验室检测 ; research laboratory｜研究实验室
tip_zh: 常缩写为lab；英美发音的重音位置不同。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓励；给予信心 | v. 促进；鼓励发展
definition_en: Give someone confidence or support to do something | Make an activity or development more likely
example1_en: The assignment is to encourage participation, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先鼓励参与，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers encourage participation before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要鼓励参与。
collocations: encourage someone to do something｜鼓励某人做某事 ; strongly encourage｜大力鼓励 ; encourage participation｜鼓励参与
tip_zh: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 难以置信的 | adj. 极好的；极糟的
definition_en: So surprising or unlikely that it is hard to believe. | Extremely good or bad, causing strong surprise.
example1_en: Our professor circled an unbelievable story on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了难以置信的故事。
example2_en: The author returns to an unbelievable story when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了难以置信的故事。
collocations: an unbelievable story｜难以置信的故事 ; unbelievable results｜惊人的效果 ; unbelievable luck｜难以置信的好运
tip_zh: 既可表示不可信，也可口语强调极好或极糟。

meanings_zh: n. 毫米
definition_en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a millimetre thick.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一毫米厚。
example2_en: The author returns to a millimetre thick when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一毫米厚。
collocations: a millimetre thick｜一毫米厚 ; a few millimetres｜几毫米 ; measured in millimetres｜以毫米计量
tip_zh: 缩写为mm；美式拼写为millimeter；一厘米等于十毫米。

meanings_zh: adj. 计划好的；预先安排的 | v. 计划；筹划
definition_en: arranged or decided before it happens | made arrangements or decisions about a future action
example1_en: The textbook introduces carefully planned in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精心策划的。
example2_en: The reading connects carefully planned with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把精心策划的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: planned expansion｜计划中的扩建 ; planned maintenance｜计划性维护 ; as planned｜按计划 ; carefully planned｜精心策划的
tip_zh: plan变planned需双写n；as planned意为按计划。

meanings_zh: v. 由…组成 | v. 在于
definition_en: to be formed from particular parts or members | to have something as the essential feature
example1_en: The professor asked us to consist of.
example1_zh: 教授让我们由…组成。
example2_en: The reading asks you to consist of and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你由…组成，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: consist of｜由…组成 ; consist mainly of｜主要由…组成 ; consist in｜在于
tip_zh: consist of表组成，不用被动；consist in表在于。

meanings_zh: adj. 每年的；年度的 | n. 年刊；年鉴 | n. 一年生植物
definition_en: Happening once a year or relating to a whole year | A book or magazine published once each year | A plant that completes its life cycle within one year
example1_en: The textbook introduces annual report in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了年度报告。
example2_en: The reading connects annual report with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把年度报告和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: annual report｜年度报告 ; annual income｜年收入 ; annual leave｜年假 ; annual event｜一年一度的活动
tip_zh: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

meanings_zh: n. 象征；标志 | n. 符号
definition_en: Something that represents an idea, quality, or group. | A written mark used to represent information.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a status symbol.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论身份地位的象征。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a status symbol.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论身份地位的象征的材料。
collocations: a symbol of peace｜和平的象征 ; a status symbol｜身份地位的象征 ; a mathematical symbol｜数学符号
tip_zh: “……的象征”用 a symbol of，不用 symbol for。

meanings_zh: n. 止痛药
definition_en: a medicine that reduces or removes pain
example1_en: The professor explained painkiller with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了止痛药。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up painkiller while discussing evidence about public health.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了止痛药。
collocations: take a painkiller｜服用止痛药 ; prescribe painkillers｜开止痛药 ; over-the-counter painkillers｜非处方止痛药
tip_zh: 可数名词；“服用止痛药”用take a painkiller。

meanings_zh: v. 选择；挑选 | adj. 精选的；优等的
definition_en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options. | Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to select a candidate.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求挑选候选人。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to select a candidate.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们挑选候选人。
collocations: select a candidate｜挑选候选人 ; select from a list｜从列表中选择 ; select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色 ; a select group｜精选的一群人
tip_zh: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；关联 | n. 连接；接通 | n. 换乘；接续交通工具
definition_en: a relationship between people, things, or ideas | a link that allows devices or systems to work together | a further bus, train, or flight taken during a journey
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about internet connection.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于网络连接的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used internet connection to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用网络连接来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: a connection between｜……之间的联系 ; internet connection｜网络连接 ; miss a connection｜错过换乘 ; in connection with｜与……有关
tip_zh: 表示两者的联系用connection between A and B。

meanings_zh: adj. 按字母顺序的
definition_en: arranged in the order of the alphabet
example1_en: The textbook introduces alphabetical order in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了字母顺序。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around alphabetical order.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕字母顺序展开说明。
collocations: alphabetical order｜字母顺序 ; alphabetical list｜按字母排序的列表 ; alphabetical index｜字母顺序索引
tip_zh: 常用in alphabetical order表示按字母顺序。

meanings_zh: n. 缺口；间隙 | n. 差距；分歧 | n. 间隔；中断
definition_en: An empty space between things or within something. | A difference between people, groups, or situations. | A period when something stops or does not happen.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the generation gap.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于代沟的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the generation gap.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论代沟的材料。
collocations: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口 ; narrow the gap｜缩小差距 ; the generation gap｜代沟 ; a gap year｜间隔年
tip_zh: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 感恩；感恩祈祷 | n. 感恩节
definition_en: The expression of gratitude, especially in prayer. | A holiday for expressing gratitude, celebrated in the US and Canada.
example1_en: Office hours began with a prayer of thanksgiving.
example1_zh: 答疑从感恩祷告开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a prayer of thanksgiving when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了感恩祷告。
collocations: in thanksgiving for｜为感谢…… ; a prayer of thanksgiving｜感恩祷告 ; Thanksgiving dinner｜感恩节晚餐
tip_zh: 指节日时首字母大写；泛指感恩时用小写。

meanings_zh: n. 政治家；政客
definition_en: Someone whose work involves politics, especially an elected government member.
example1_en: Office hours began with a local politician.
example1_zh: 答疑从地方政治人物开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a local politician.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论地方政治人物的材料。
collocations: a local politician｜地方政治人物 ; an elected politician｜民选政治人物 ; a senior politician｜资深政治人物
tip_zh: politician指从政者，本身不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 来源；源头 | n. 资料来源；消息来源 | v. 寻找并获取
definition_en: A place, person, or thing that something comes from. | A person or document that provides information. | To find and obtain something from a particular supplier.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a reliable source.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可靠的消息来源。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a reliable source.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得可靠的消息来源这个例子。
collocations: a source of income｜收入来源 ; a reliable source｜可靠的消息来源 ; source materials locally｜在当地采购材料
tip_zh: 来源常用source of；作动词可用source…from…。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人紧张的；压力大的
definition_en: Causing worry or mental strain
example1_en: Office hours began with a stressful situation.
example1_zh: 答疑从令人紧张的处境开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a stressful situation.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得令人紧张的处境这个例子。
collocations: a stressful situation｜令人紧张的处境 ; a stressful job｜压力大的工作 ; a stressful experience｜令人紧张的经历
tip_zh: stressful形容压力来源；stressed形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: n. 望远镜 | v. 压缩；缩短 | v. 套叠伸缩
definition_en: An instrument that makes distant objects appear closer and clearer | To fit events or activities into a shorter period | To slide overlapping sections into or out of each other
example1_en: Our professor circled space telescope on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了太空望远镜。
example2_en: The reading connects space telescope with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把太空望远镜和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: look through a telescope｜用望远镜观察 ; space telescope｜太空望远镜 ; radio telescope｜射电望远镜 ; telescope something into｜把某事压缩到
tip_zh: 观星常用telescope；双筒望远镜通常叫binoculars。

meanings_zh: v. 证明；证实 | v. 结果是；证明是
definition_en: Show that something is true using evidence | Turn out to be a particular thing or quality
example1_en: The assignment is to prove a point, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先证明一个观点，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to prove a point.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来证明一个观点。
collocations: prove a point｜证明一个观点 ; prove effective｜证明有效 ; prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip_zh: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 发明家；发明者
definition_en: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing
example1_en: The textbook introduces a brilliant inventor in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了杰出的发明家。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a brilliant inventor.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得杰出的发明家这个例子。
collocations: a brilliant inventor｜杰出的发明家 ; the inventor of｜……的发明者 ; an aspiring inventor｜有志成为发明家的人
tip_zh: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 非法的；违法的
definition_en: Not allowed by law
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about illegal activity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于违法活动的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used illegal activity to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用违法活动来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: illegal activity｜违法活动 ; illegal trade｜非法贸易 ; illegal fishing｜非法捕捞 ; make something illegal｜将某事定为违法
tip_zh: 常用句型：It is illegal to do sth.。

meanings_zh: n. 友谊；朋友关系
definition_en: a relationship between people who like and support each other
example1_en: Office hours began with lasting friendship.
example1_zh: 答疑从持久的友谊开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used lasting friendship to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用持久的友谊来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: close friendship｜亲密的友谊 ; form a friendship｜建立友谊 ; lasting friendship｜持久的友谊 ; a bond of friendship｜友谊的纽带
tip_zh: 泛指友谊不可数；具体一段友谊可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 高效的；节省资源的
definition_en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly efficient.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论效率很高的。
example2_en: The reading connects highly efficient with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把效率很高的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: energy-efficient buildings｜节能建筑 ; efficient use of resources｜高效利用资源 ; highly efficient｜效率很高的 ; efficient service｜高效的服务
tip_zh: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

meanings_zh: n. 外貌；外观 | n. 出现；露面
definition_en: the way someone or something looks | an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present
example1_en: I copied physical appearance into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把外貌抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects physical appearance with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把外貌和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: physical appearance｜外貌 ; make an appearance｜露面 ; outward appearance｜外表 ; improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip_zh: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

meanings_zh: n. 对话；对白 | n. 对话；意见交流 | n. 对话框
definition_en: A conversation, especially between characters in a story or play. | Discussion between people or groups to improve understanding. | A small computer window requesting information or a choice.
example1_en: Our professor circled dialog between groups on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了群体间的对话。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of dialog between groups.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得群体间的对话这个例子。
collocations: open dialog｜公开对话 ; dialog between groups｜群体间的对话 ; dialog box｜对话框
tip_zh: dialog是美式变体；英式通常用dialogue。

meanings_zh: n. 打字机
definition_en: A machine with keys that print characters directly onto paper.
example1_en: I copied manual typewriter into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把手动打字机抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of manual typewriter.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得手动打字机这个例子。
collocations: manual typewriter｜手动打字机 ; electric typewriter｜电动打字机 ; typewriter ribbon｜打字机色带
tip_zh: typewriter指打字机器，typist指打字员。

meanings_zh: n. 比赛；竞争 | v. 质疑；对……提出异议 | v. 争夺；参加竞选
definition_en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win | to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result | to compete for a position, prize, or political seat
example1_en: I copied a close contest into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把势均力敌的比赛抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a close contest.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得势均力敌的比赛这个例子。
collocations: enter a contest｜参加比赛 ; a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛 ; contest a decision｜对决定提出异议 ; contest an election｜参加竞选
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 主人；主持人 | v. 主办；主持；招待 | n. 大量；许多
definition_en: someone who welcomes guests or presents a programme or event | to organise an event, present a programme, or receive guests | a large number of people or things
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about television host.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电视节目主持人的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to television host when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了电视节目主持人。
collocations: host country｜东道国 ; host an event｜举办活动 ; a host of problems｜一大堆问题 ; television host｜电视节目主持人
tip_zh: a host of后接复数名词，表示“大量”。

meanings_zh: adj. 商定的；达成一致的
definition_en: accepted or decided by everyone involved
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about agreed time.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于商定的时间的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects agreed time with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把商定的时间和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: agreed time｜商定的时间 ; agreed terms｜商定的条款 ; agreed price｜议定价格 ; be agreed on｜就……达成一致
tip_zh: the agreed price指议定价格；Agreed!可表示赞同。

meanings_zh: n. 示意图；图解 | v. 用图解表示
definition_en: a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged | to explain or represent something using a simple drawing
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a labelled diagram.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于带标注的示意图的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a labelled diagram.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论带标注的示意图的材料。
collocations: draw a diagram｜画示意图 ; a labelled diagram｜带标注的示意图 ; a flow diagram｜流程图
tip_zh: 侧重结构或原理的图解，不等同于数据图表。

meanings_zh: n. 防晒霜
definition_en: A cream or lotion that protects skin from sunlight.
example1_en: The textbook introduces apply sunblock in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了涂防晒霜。
example2_en: The author returns to apply sunblock when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了涂防晒霜。
collocations: apply sunblock｜涂防晒霜 ; wear sunblock｜涂着防晒霜 ; water-resistant sunblock｜防水防晒霜
tip_zh: 通常不可数；名称不意味着能完全阻挡紫外线。

meanings_zh: n. 标题；小标题 | n. 航向
definition_en: words introducing the subject of a document or section | the direction in which a ship or aircraft travels
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a section heading.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论章节标题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a section heading.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得章节标题这个例子。
collocations: a section heading｜章节标题 ; a main heading｜主标题 ; under the heading｜在该标题下
tip_zh: heading常指章节标题；headline多指新闻标题。

meanings_zh: n. 基础；依据 | n. 方式；频率
definition_en: The main facts or ideas supporting something. | The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a sound basis.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于坚实的基础的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a sound basis with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把坚实的基础和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: on a daily basis｜每天 ; on the basis of｜根据 ; form the basis of｜构成……的基础 ; a sound basis｜坚实的基础
tip_zh: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

meanings_zh: n. 生物学家
definition_en: A scientist who studies living things.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on marine biologist.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论海洋生物学家。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of marine biologist.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得海洋生物学家这个例子。
collocations: marine biologist｜海洋生物学家 ; wildlife biologist｜野生生物学家 ; evolutionary biologist｜进化生物学家
tip_zh: 研究海洋生物的专家称为marine biologist。

meanings_zh: v. 雇用 | v. 使用；采用
definition_en: Pay someone to work for you. | Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer employ staff during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时雇用员工。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers employ staff before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要雇用员工。
collocations: employ staff｜雇用员工 ; employ someone as｜雇用某人担任 ; employ a strategy｜采用策略
tip_zh: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

meanings_zh: n. 心情；情绪 | n. 气氛；氛围
definition_en: the way someone feels at a particular time | the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates
example1_en: I copied mood swings into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把情绪波动抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mood swings.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论情绪波动的材料。
collocations: in a good mood｜心情好 ; in the mood for｜有心情做…… ; mood swings｜情绪波动 ; set the mood｜营造气氛
tip_zh: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 视力；视觉 | n. 看见；视野 | n. 景象；名胜
definition_en: The ability to see. | The act of seeing or the area that can be seen. | Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on out of sight.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论在视野之外。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around out of sight.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕在视野之外展开说明。
collocations: lose one's sight｜失明 ; out of sight｜在视野之外 ; at first sight｜乍一看 ; the sights｜名胜景点
tip_zh: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

meanings_zh: v. 安装；设置 | v. 正式任命；使就职
definition_en: to put equipment or software in place for use | to formally place someone in an important position
example1_en: The professor asked us to install software.
example1_zh: 教授让我们安装软件。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to install software.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得安装软件。
collocations: install software｜安装软件 ; install solar panels｜安装太阳能板 ; install an alarm｜安装警报器
tip_zh: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。

meanings_zh: n. 历史学家；史学研究者
definition_en: Someone who studies or writes about the past.
example1_en: Office hours began with a leading historian.
example1_zh: 答疑从杰出的历史学家开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a leading historian.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕杰出的历史学家展开说明。
collocations: a leading historian｜杰出的历史学家 ; a social historian｜社会史学家 ; a historian of science｜科学史学家
tip_zh: historian指研究者；historical表示与历史有关。

meanings_zh: v. 使恼怒；使烦躁
definition_en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to annoy someone.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何惹某人生气。
example2_en: The reading asks you to annoy someone and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你惹某人生气，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: annoy someone｜惹某人生气 ; annoyed with someone｜生某人的气 ; annoying habit｜烦人的习惯
tip_zh: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

meanings_zh: adv. 进一步；更远地 | adj. 更多的；进一步的 | v. 促进；推进
definition_en: to a greater degree or a more distant place | additional or more advanced | to help something develop or succeed
example1_en: The professor told us to further information and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们更多信息，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will further information when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会更多信息。
collocations: further information｜更多信息 ; further research｜进一步研究 ; discuss further｜进一步讨论 ; further your career｜促进职业发展
tip_zh: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

meanings_zh: n. 体检；健康检查
definition_en: a medical examination to assess your general health
example1_en: I wrote check-up on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把check-up和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on public health uses check-up when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了体检。
collocations: annual check-up｜年度体检 ; dental check-up｜牙齿检查 ; routine check-up｜常规体检
tip_zh: check-up是名词；check up on意为查看或核查。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；压力大的 | adj. 重读的 | adj. 受应力的
definition_en: Feeling worried and unable to relax | Pronounced with greater emphasis than surrounding sounds | Experiencing physical force that may cause strain or damage
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on stressed about exams.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论为考试焦虑。
example2_en: The reading connects stressed about exams with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把为考试焦虑和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: feel stressed｜感到有压力 ; stressed about exams｜为考试焦虑 ; a stressed syllable｜重读音节 ; highly stressed components｜承受高应力的部件
tip_zh: 也可作stress的过去式或过去分词，表示“强调”。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
definition_en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy
example1_en: Office hours began with highly enjoyable.
example1_zh: 答疑从非常令人愉快的开始。
example2_en: The author returns to highly enjoyable when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了非常令人愉快的。
collocations: enjoyable experience｜愉快的经历 ; enjoyable activity｜有趣的活动 ; highly enjoyable｜非常令人愉快的 ; an enjoyable evening｜愉快的夜晚
tip_zh: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

meanings_zh: n. 一系列；连续的一组 | n. 系列节目；丛书
definition_en: several related things or events following one another | a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject
example1_en: I copied a television series into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电视系列节目抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a television series.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得电视系列节目这个例子。
collocations: a series of events｜一连串事件 ; a television series｜电视系列节目 ; a lecture series｜系列讲座
tip_zh: 单复数同形：a series；two series。

meanings_zh: n. 汗；汗水 | v. 出汗
definition_en: Liquid produced by your skin when hot or nervous. | To produce liquid through your skin.
example1_en: The textbook introduces wipe away sweat in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了擦去汗水。
example2_en: A campus survey used wipe away sweat to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用擦去汗水来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: break into a sweat｜突然出汗 ; wipe away sweat｜擦去汗水 ; sweat heavily｜大量出汗
tip_zh: 汗水通常不可数；出一身汗可说a sweat。

meanings_zh: adj. 特定的；某一的 | adj. 特别的；格外的 | adj. 讲究的；挑剔的
definition_en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation | greater or more noticeable than usual | having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy
example1_en: I copied a particular reason into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把某个特定原因抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a particular reason when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了某个特定原因。
collocations: a particular reason｜某个特定原因 ; particular attention｜特别关注 ; in particular｜尤其；特别 ; particular about｜对……很讲究
tip_zh: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。

meanings_zh: v. 带领；引导；导致 | n. 领先地位；优势 | n. 铅
definition_en: To guide people or cause something to happen | The position of being ahead of others | A soft, heavy, grey metal that can be poisonous
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to lead to.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何导致。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers lead to before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要导致。
collocations: lead to｜导致 ; lead a team｜带领团队 ; take the lead｜取得领先 ; lead poisoning｜铅中毒
tip_zh: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。

meanings_zh: n. 作用；职责 | n. 角色
definition_en: The function or responsibility someone or something has. | A character played by an actor in a performance.
example1_en: I copied a key role into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把关键作用抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a key role to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用关键作用来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用 ; a key role｜关键作用 ; take on a role｜承担职责 ; a leading role｜主角
tip_zh: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

meanings_zh: v. 作弊 | v. 欺骗；骗取 | n. 作弊者；骗子
definition_en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage. | To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly. | A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.
example1_en: The professor asked us to cheat in an exam.
example1_zh: 教授让我们考试作弊。
example2_en: The reading asks you to cheat in an exam and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你考试作弊，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊 ; cheat at cards｜打牌作弊 ; cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip_zh: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。

meanings_zh: n. 经济；经济体 | n. 节约；节省
definition_en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services | careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste
example1_en: I copied local economy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把地方经济抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used local economy to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用地方经济来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: local economy｜地方经济 ; global economy｜全球经济 ; boost the economy｜提振经济 ; fuel economy｜燃油经济性
tip_zh: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。

meanings_zh: n. 安全；安全保障 | n. 安保人员；保安工作 | n. 稳定；保障
definition_en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access | People or activities responsible for protecting a place | Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support
example1_en: Our professor circled data security on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数据安全。
example2_en: A campus survey used data security to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用数据安全来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: security measures｜安全措施 ; data security｜数据安全 ; job security｜工作保障 ; security guard｜保安
tip_zh: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

meanings_zh: n. 个性；性格 | n. 个人魅力 | n. 名人
definition_en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves | lively or appealing qualities that make someone interesting | a well-known person, especially in entertainment or broadcasting
example1_en: I copied outgoing personality into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把外向的性格抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of outgoing personality.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得外向的性格这个例子。
collocations: outgoing personality｜外向的性格 ; personality traits｜性格特征 ; strong personality｜鲜明的个性 ; television personality｜电视名人
tip_zh: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。

meanings_zh: adj. 职位较低的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
definition_en: Having a lower rank or less experience in an organisation | Intended for younger people or involving them | A younger person, or a student below the final year
example1_en: The textbook introduces junior staff in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了初级员工。
example2_en: The author returns to junior staff when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了初级员工。
collocations: junior staff｜初级员工 ; junior position｜初级职位 ; junior championship｜青少年锦标赛
tip_zh: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

meanings_zh: adj. 全球的；世界性的 | adj. 整体的；全面的
definition_en: Involving or affecting the whole world. | Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about global warming.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于全球变暖的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to global warming when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了全球变暖。
collocations: global warming｜全球变暖 ; global economy｜全球经济 ; global cooperation｜全球合作 ; global perspective｜全球视角
tip_zh: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。

meanings_zh: n. 抱怨；投诉 | n. 疾病；不适
definition_en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory | an illness or physical problem
example1_en: The textbook introduces a formal complaint in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了正式投诉。
example2_en: The reading connects a formal complaint with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把正式投诉和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: make a complaint｜提出投诉 ; a formal complaint｜正式投诉 ; handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip_zh: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 不断增加的；日益增长的
definition_en: becoming greater in amount, size, number, or degree
example1_en: I copied increasing demand into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把日益增长的需求抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of increasing demand.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得日益增长的需求这个例子。
collocations: increasing demand｜日益增长的需求 ; increasing pressure｜越来越大的压力 ; an increasing number of｜越来越多的 ; increasing concern｜日益加深的担忧
tip_zh: increasing修饰名词；increasingly修饰形容词等。

meanings_zh: n. 生产；制造 | n. 制作；演出作品
definition_en: the process of making or growing things for use | the making of a film or play, or the resulting work
example1_en: I copied mass production into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把大规模生产抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mass production.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大规模生产展开说明。
collocations: mass production｜大规模生产 ; food production｜食品生产 ; production costs｜生产成本 ; film production｜电影制作
tip_zh: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 自助餐厅；食堂
definition_en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.
example1_en: Office hours began with a school cafeteria.
example1_zh: 答疑从学校食堂开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a school cafeteria when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校食堂。
collocations: a school cafeteria｜学校食堂 ; a hospital cafeteria｜医院食堂 ; a cafeteria tray｜食堂托盘
tip_zh: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。

meanings_zh: n. 模式；规律 | n. 图案；花纹
definition_en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done. | An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a floral pattern.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于花卉图案的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a floral pattern.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕花卉图案展开说明。
collocations: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式 ; sleep patterns｜睡眠规律 ; a floral pattern｜花卉图案 ; follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip_zh: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

meanings_zh: n. 仆人；佣人
definition_en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home
example1_en: Office hours began with domestic servant.
example1_zh: 答疑从家佣开始。
example2_en: The author returns to domestic servant when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了家佣。
collocations: domestic servant｜家佣 ; civil servant｜公务员 ; public servant｜公职人员
tip_zh: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

meanings_zh: n. 液体 | adj. 液态的 | adj. 易变现的；流动的
definition_en: A substance that flows and takes the shape of its container. | In a form that flows freely rather than remaining solid. | Available as cash or easily converted into cash.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on clear liquid.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论透明液体。
example2_en: A campus survey used clear liquid to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用透明液体来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: clear liquid｜透明液体 ; liquid water｜液态水 ; liquid soap｜洗手液 ; liquid assets｜流动资产
tip_zh: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

meanings_zh: n. 曲调；旋律 | v. 为乐器调音 | v. 调节；调谐
definition_en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern | to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes | to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly
example1_en: I copied catchy tune into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把朗朗上口的曲调抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects catchy tune with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把朗朗上口的曲调和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: catchy tune｜朗朗上口的曲调 ; in tune｜音调准确 ; out of tune｜走调 ; tune a piano｜给钢琴调音
tip_zh: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。

meanings_zh: n. 肉贩；肉类分割工 | v. 屠宰；分割肉类 | v. 把……弄糟
definition_en: someone who prepares and sells meat | to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat | to do something very badly, spoiling the result
example1_en: Our professor circled local butcher on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了当地肉贩。
example2_en: The reading connects local butcher with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把当地肉贩和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: local butcher｜当地肉贩 ; butcher's shop｜肉店 ; butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip_zh: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。

meanings_zh: n. 典礼；仪式 | n. 礼节；客套
definition_en: A formal event marking an important occasion. | Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.
example1_en: I copied opening ceremony into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把开幕式抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used opening ceremony to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用开幕式来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: opening ceremony｜开幕式 ; graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; without ceremony｜不拘礼节地
tip_zh: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸
definition_en: the process of taking air into and out of the lungs
example1_en: The textbook introduces deep breathing in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了深呼吸。
example2_en: A campus survey used deep breathing to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用深呼吸来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: deep breathing｜深呼吸 ; breathing exercises｜呼吸练习 ; breathing difficulties｜呼吸困难 ; heavy breathing｜粗重的呼吸
tip_zh: breathing可作名词，也是breathe的现在分词。

meanings_zh: n. 名人；明星 | n. 名望；名气
definition_en: A person who is widely known by the public. | The state of being famous.
example1_en: The textbook introduces achieve celebrity in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了成名。
example2_en: The author returns to achieve celebrity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了成名。
collocations: celebrity endorsement｜名人代言 ; celebrity culture｜名人文化 ; achieve celebrity｜成名
tip_zh: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 相关的；有联系的 | adj. 有亲属关系的
definition_en: connected with something in some way | belonging to the same family
example1_en: I copied closely related into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把密切相关的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of closely related.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得密切相关的这个例子。
collocations: related to｜与……有关 ; closely related｜密切相关的 ; related issues｜相关问题 ; related by marriage｜有姻亲关系的
tip_zh: 常用be related to；to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 狂欢节；嘉年华 | n. 游乐会
definition_en: A public celebration with music, costumes, and street entertainment. | An outdoor event with rides, games, and entertainment.
example1_en: I copied an annual carnival into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把年度嘉年华抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an annual carnival.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年度嘉年华的材料。
collocations: a carnival parade｜嘉年华游行 ; a carnival atmosphere｜狂欢气氛 ; an annual carnival｜年度嘉年华
tip_zh: 美式英语中也可指有游戏和游乐设施的游乐会。

meanings_zh: adj. 平均的；普通的 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional. | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on above average.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高于平均水平。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of above average.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得高于平均水平这个例子。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_zh: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

meanings_zh: n. 图书馆员
definition_en: A person who manages library resources and helps library users.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on school librarian.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学校图书馆员。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of school librarian.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得学校图书馆员这个例子。
collocations: school librarian｜学校图书馆员 ; chief librarian｜图书馆馆长 ; ask a librarian｜咨询图书馆员
tip_zh: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。

meanings_zh: v. 删除
definition_en: To remove written material or stored information.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to delete a file.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何删除文件。
example2_en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers delete a file before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要删除文件。
collocations: delete a file｜删除文件 ; delete an account｜删除账户 ; permanently delete｜永久删除
tip_zh: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

meanings_zh: n. 发明物 | n. 发明；创造 | n. 虚构的事；编造
definition_en: something new that someone has designed or created | the act of creating something that did not exist before | a story or explanation created rather than based on facts
example1_en: Office hours began with a useful invention.
example1_zh: 答疑从实用的发明开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a useful invention.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕实用的发明展开说明。
collocations: a useful invention｜实用的发明 ; the invention of｜……的发明 ; a recent invention｜近期的发明
tip_zh: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: n. 金字塔；棱锥体 | n. 金字塔式体系
definition_en: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point | a system with fewer members at each successively higher level
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about ancient pyramid.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于古代金字塔的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of ancient pyramid.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得古代金字塔这个例子。
collocations: ancient pyramid｜古代金字塔 ; square-based pyramid｜四棱锥 ; management pyramid｜管理金字塔
tip_zh: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。

meanings_zh: n. 惊险小说；惊悚片
definition_en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.
example1_en: I copied a crime thriller into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把犯罪惊悚作品抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a crime thriller to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用犯罪惊悚作品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品 ; a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品 ; a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip_zh: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

meanings_zh: adj. 超重的
definition_en: heavier than is considered healthy, suitable, or officially allowed
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overweight luggage.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论超重行李。
example2_en: The reading connects overweight luggage with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把超重行李和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: be slightly overweight｜略微超重 ; overweight luggage｜超重行李 ; become overweight｜变得超重
tip_zh: 常作形容词；obese指肥胖，程度更重。

meanings_zh: n. 奢华；奢侈的享受 | n. 奢侈品；非必需的享受 | adj. 奢华的；高档的
definition_en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions. | Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential. | Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.
example1_en: Our professor circled luxury goods on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了奢侈品。
example2_en: A campus survey used luxury goods to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用奢侈品来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: live in luxury｜过奢华生活 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; luxury hotel｜豪华酒店 ; afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip_zh: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 祝贺；贺词
definition_en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.
example1_en: I copied a letter of congratulation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把贺信抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a letter of congratulation to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用贺信来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: congratulations on｜为……表示祝贺 ; a letter of congratulation｜贺信 ; warm congratulations｜热烈祝贺
tip_zh: 祝贺通常用复数congratulations，后接on加成就。

meanings_zh: n. 十年；十年期
definition_en: a period of ten years
example1_en: The textbook introduces the next decade in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了未来十年。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the next decade.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕未来十年展开说明。
collocations: over the past decade｜在过去十年间 ; for decades｜数十年来 ; the next decade｜未来十年
tip_zh: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

meanings_zh: v. 涉及；包含；需要 | v. 使参与
definition_en: to include something as a necessary part | to make someone take part in an activity
example1_en: The professor asked us to involve doing something.
example1_zh: 教授让我们需要做某事。
example2_en: The passage says students who can involve doing something follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够需要做某事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: involve doing something｜需要做某事 ; involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事 ; be closely involved｜密切参与
tip_zh: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；影响力 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves | to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development
example1_en: Office hours began with a positive influence.
example1_zh: 答疑从积极的影响开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a positive influence with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把积极的影响和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; a positive influence｜积极的影响 ; influence a decision｜影响决定
tip_zh: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 装饰品 | n. 装饰；装潢 | n. 勋章；奖章
definition_en: An object added to make something look more attractive. | The process or style of making a place look attractive. | An official award worn to honour service or bravery.
example1_en: Office hours began with interior decoration.
example1_zh: 答疑从室内装饰开始。
example2_en: The author returns to interior decoration when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了室内装饰。
collocations: interior decoration｜室内装饰 ; party decorations｜派对装饰品 ; table decoration｜餐桌装饰品
tip_zh: 指装饰过程时不可数；指单件装饰品时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 管理；经营 | n. 管理层；管理人员
definition_en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources. | The people responsible for running an organisation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on time management.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论时间管理。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss time management.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论时间管理的材料。
collocations: time management｜时间管理 ; waste management｜废物管理 ; senior management｜高层管理人员 ; management skills｜管理技能
tip_zh: 指管理工作时不可数；the management可指管理层。

meanings_zh: n. 水手；海员；帆船运动者
definition_en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on experienced sailor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经验丰富的海员。
example2_en: The author returns to experienced sailor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经验丰富的海员。
collocations: experienced sailor｜经验丰富的海员 ; professional sailor｜职业海员 ; a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip_zh: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

meanings_zh: n. 会员身份；成员资格 | n. 全体会员；会员人数
definition_en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation | all members of a group, or the total member count
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on annual membership.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论年度会员资格。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss annual membership.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年度会员资格的材料。
collocations: membership fee｜会员费 ; annual membership｜年度会员资格 ; renew your membership｜续办会员资格 ; union membership｜工会会员身份
tip_zh: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

meanings_zh: n. 工作室；录音室；演播室 | n. 电影制片公司 | n. 单间公寓
definition_en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced | A company that makes films | A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on recording studio.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论录音室。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of recording studio.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得录音室这个例子。
collocations: recording studio｜录音室 ; art studio｜艺术工作室 ; film studio｜电影制片公司 ; studio flat｜单间公寓
tip_zh: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

meanings_zh: v. 使害怕；吓唬
definition_en: To make someone feel afraid.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to frighten someone away.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求把某人吓跑。
example2_en: The reading asks you to frighten someone away and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你把某人吓跑，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: frighten someone away｜把某人吓跑 ; frighten someone into doing｜吓得某人去做 ; frighten someone to death｜把某人吓坏
tip_zh: frightened指感到害怕的；frightening指令人害怕的。

meanings_zh: n. 摄影；摄影术
definition_en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.
example1_en: The textbook introduces digital photography in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了数码摄影。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around digital photography.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕数码摄影展开说明。
collocations: digital photography｜数码摄影 ; wildlife photography｜野生动物摄影 ; portrait photography｜人像摄影 ; take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip_zh: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

meanings_zh: n. 脚后跟 | n. 鞋跟
definition_en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle. | The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.
example1_en: Office hours began with heel pain.
example1_zh: 答疑从足跟疼痛开始。
example2_en: The author returns to heel pain when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了足跟疼痛。
collocations: heel pain｜足跟疼痛 ; high heels｜高跟鞋 ; low heels｜低跟鞋
tip_zh: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

meanings_zh: n. 买家；购买者 | n. 采购员
definition_en: a person or organisation that purchases something | someone whose job is choosing goods for a business
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about potential buyer.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于潜在买家的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of potential buyer.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得潜在买家这个例子。
