collocations: potential buyer｜潜在买家 ; first-time buyer｜首次购房者 ; a buyer's market｜买方市场
tip_zh: buyer 指买方；customer 更强调店铺或服务的顾客。

meanings_zh: n. 服务费；学费；酬金
definition_en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.
example1_en: The textbook introduces entrance fee in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了入场费。
example2_en: A campus survey used entrance fee to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用入场费来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: tuition fees｜学费 ; entrance fee｜入场费 ; legal fees｜法律服务费 ; pay a fee｜支付费用
tip_zh: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

meanings_zh: n. 食欲；胃口 | n. 强烈欲望；渴求
definition_en: The desire to eat food. | A strong desire to have or experience something.
example1_en: Our professor circled a healthy appetite on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了好胃口。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a healthy appetite.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕好胃口展开说明。
collocations: lose your appetite｜失去食欲 ; a healthy appetite｜好胃口 ; work up an appetite｜使胃口大开 ; an appetite for｜对……的渴望
tip_zh: appetite for 除食欲外，也可表示对知识等的渴求。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻标题 | v. 成为头条新闻；领衔演出
definition_en: the title of a news report | to be the main news story or featured performer
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about front-page headline.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于头版标题的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects front-page headline with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把头版标题和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: front-page headline｜头版标题 ; make headlines｜成为头条新闻 ; misleading headline｜误导性标题
tip_zh: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。

meanings_zh: v. 考虑；仔细斟酌 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think carefully about something before deciding | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: The professor asked us to consider the consequences.
example1_zh: 教授让我们考虑后果。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers consider the consequences before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要考虑后果。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

meanings_zh: n. 赊购；信贷 | n. 赞扬；认可 | n. 学分
definition_en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money. | Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement. | A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.
example1_en: The textbook introduces buy on credit in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了赊购。
example2_en: A campus survey used buy on credit to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用赊购来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: buy on credit｜赊购 ; give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳 ; earn credits｜修得学分 ; credit card｜信用卡
tip_zh: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩盖；掩饰
definition_en: A covering worn over part or all of the face. | To hide something or make it less noticeable.
example1_en: Office hours began with face mask.
example1_zh: 答疑从口罩；面膜开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used face mask to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用口罩；面膜来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: wear a mask｜戴口罩；戴面具 ; face mask｜口罩；面膜 ; mask the smell｜掩盖气味 ; mask the problem｜掩盖问题
tip_zh: mask 作动词直接接宾语，表示掩盖问题或感受。

meanings_zh: adj. 王室的；国王或女王的 | n. 王室成员
definition_en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family. | A member of a royal family.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the royal family.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于王室的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the royal family.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕王室展开说明。
collocations: the royal family｜王室 ; a royal palace｜王宫 ; royal duties｜王室职责
tip_zh: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

meanings_zh: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years. | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: Our professor circled mild climate on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了温和的气候。
example2_en: The author returns to mild climate when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了温和的气候。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_zh: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

meanings_zh: n. 小说；虚构文学 | n. 虚构之事；编造
definition_en: Stories about imagined people and events. | Something invented that is presented as true.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on science fiction.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论科幻小说。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss science fiction.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论科幻小说的材料。
collocations: science fiction｜科幻小说 ; historical fiction｜历史小说 ; a work of fiction｜一部小说作品 ; fact and fiction｜事实与虚构
tip_zh: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

meanings_zh: v. 编辑；修改；剪辑
definition_en: To improve or prepare writing, images, or recordings by making changes.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to edit an essay.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何修改文章。
example2_en: The reading asks you to edit an essay and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你修改文章，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: edit an essay｜修改文章 ; edit a video｜剪辑视频 ; edit out｜删去；剪掉
tip_zh: edit强调修改或剪辑，publish才是出版或发布。

meanings_zh: adj. 勇敢的 | v. 勇敢面对；冒着
definition_en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid. | To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.
example1_en: Office hours began with a brave decision.
example1_zh: 答疑从勇敢的决定开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a brave decision.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得勇敢的决定这个例子。
collocations: a brave decision｜勇敢的决定 ; brave enough to｜有足够勇气做 ; brave the cold｜冒着严寒
tip_zh: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

meanings_zh: adv. 显然；明显地
definition_en: in a way that is easy to see or understand
example1_en: The lab manual says to obviously pleased before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先明显很高兴，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who obviously pleased are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够明显很高兴的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: obviously pleased｜明显很高兴 ; obviously wrong｜显然错误 ; obviously important｜显然重要
tip_zh: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

meanings_zh: n. 聚会；联欢会
definition_en: an informal meeting of friends, relatives, or colleagues
example1_en: After the lecture, we used get-together in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了聚会。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up get-together while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了聚会。
collocations: family get-together｜家庭聚会 ; informal get-together｜非正式聚会 ; organise a get-together｜组织聚会
tip_zh: 名词带连字符；动词短语get together不带。

meanings_zh: n. 磁盘；计算机存储盘 | n. 圆盘；盘状物
definition_en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface | a flat, thin, round object
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about hard disk.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于硬盘的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used hard disk to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用硬盘来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: hard disk｜硬盘 ; disk space｜磁盘空间 ; disk drive｜磁盘驱动器 ; disk failure｜磁盘故障
tip_zh: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

meanings_zh: adv. 其次；第二
definition_en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.
example1_en: The professor told us to secondly, consider and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们其次，考虑，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will secondly, consider when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会其次，考虑。
collocations: firstly and secondly｜首先和其次 ; secondly, consider｜其次，考虑
tip_zh: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

meanings_zh: n. 改善；进步 | n. 改进之处
definition_en: The process or result of becoming better. | A change that makes something better.
example1_en: Our professor circled significant improvement on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了显著改善。
example2_en: The reading connects significant improvement with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把显著改善和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: significant improvement｜显著改善 ; room for improvement｜改进空间 ; an improvement on｜比…更好的事物 ; make improvements｜作出改进
tip_zh: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。

meanings_zh: n. 勇气；胆量
definition_en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize courage in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出勇气。
example2_en: Students who can explain courage usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
example2_zh: 能解释勇气的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_zh: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

meanings_zh: v. 处理；应付 | v. 拿；触摸；操纵 | n. 把手；柄
definition_en: To deal with a situation, task, or person. | To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands. | The part of an object used for holding or moving it.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to handle complaints.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何处理投诉。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to handle complaints.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们处理投诉。
collocations: handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; handle with care｜小心轻放 ; door handle｜门把手 ; handle pressure｜应对压力
tip_zh: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。

meanings_zh: v. 交换；兑换 | n. 交换；交流 | n. 交易所
definition_en: to give something and receive something else in return | an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas | a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to exchange ideas.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何交流想法。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to exchange ideas.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们交流想法。
collocations: exchange ideas｜交流想法 ; exchange rate｜汇率 ; in exchange for｜作为……的交换 ; stock exchange｜证券交易所
tip_zh: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

meanings_zh: adj. 满意的；满足的 | adj. 确信的；信服的
definition_en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations. | Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about fully satisfied.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于完全满意的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects fully satisfied with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把完全满意和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: satisfied with｜对……满意 ; fully satisfied｜完全满意 ; satisfied that｜确信……
tip_zh: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

meanings_zh: n. 讲义；分发的资料 | n. 救济款物；施舍物
definition_en: A document given to people attending a lesson or meeting. | Money or goods given free to someone in need.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on course handout.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论课程讲义。
example2_en: The reading connects course handout with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把课程讲义和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: course handout｜课程讲义 ; distribute handouts｜分发讲义 ; government handouts｜政府救济款物
tip_zh: handout是名词；hand out是动词短语，意为分发。

meanings_zh: adj. 合群的；爱交际的
definition_en: Enjoying meeting people and spending time with them.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a sociable person.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于爱交际的人的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a sociable person.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得爱交际的人这个例子。
collocations: a sociable person｜爱交际的人 ; a sociable atmosphere｜友好的社交氛围 ; sociable activities｜社交活动
tip_zh: sociable指爱交际；social多指社会或社交的。

meanings_zh: n. 奖励；回报；酬金 | v. 奖励；酬谢
definition_en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement. | To give something to someone for their efforts or help.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial reward.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济回报。
example2_en: The reading connects financial reward with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把经济回报和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: financial reward｜经济回报 ; reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人 ; reap the rewards｜收获回报
tip_zh: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

meanings_zh: n. 全体船员；机组人员 | n. 工作组；团队 | v. 担任船员
definition_en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft | A group working together on a particular practical task | Work as a member of a boat's crew
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on cabin crew.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论客舱乘务组。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of cabin crew.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得客舱乘务组这个例子。
collocations: cabin crew｜客舱乘务组 ; crew member｜机组成员；船员 ; film crew｜摄制组 ; rescue crew｜救援队
tip_zh: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；保卫 | v. 辩护；捍卫 | v. 防守
definition_en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example1_en: The lab instructions say to defend against attack.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求抵御攻击。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to defend against attack.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来抵御攻击。
collocations: defend against attack｜抵御攻击 ; defend human rights｜捍卫人权 ; defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；听众 | n. 读者群；受众
definition_en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme | People who read or receive particular content
example1_en: Office hours began with a large audience.
example1_zh: 答疑从众多观众开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a large audience.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得众多观众这个例子。
collocations: a large audience｜众多观众 ; a target audience｜目标受众 ; reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众 ; audience participation｜观众参与
tip_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

meanings_zh: n. 紧急情况；突发事件
definition_en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a state of emergency.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论紧急状态。
example2_en: The reading connects a state of emergency with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把紧急状态和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下 ; emergency services｜应急救援部门 ; emergency evacuation｜紧急疏散 ; a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip_zh: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

meanings_zh: v. 复习 | v. 修订；修改
definition_en: To study material again in preparation for an examination. | To change something to correct or improve it.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to revise for an exam.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须复习备考。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to revise for an exam.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来复习备考。
collocations: revise for an exam｜复习备考 ; revise a draft｜修改草稿 ; revise an estimate｜修正估算 ; revise a policy｜修订政策
tip_zh: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

meanings_zh: n. 毕业；毕业典礼
definition_en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.
example1_en: Office hours began with after graduation.
example1_zh: 答疑从毕业后开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss after graduation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论毕业后的材料。
collocations: graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; after graduation｜毕业后 ; graduation gown｜学位袍
tip_zh: 表示从某校毕业，动词用graduate from。

meanings_zh: n. 收银员
definition_en: Someone who receives customers' payments in a shop or bank
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on supermarket cashier.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论超市收银员。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of supermarket cashier.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得超市收银员这个例子。
collocations: work as a cashier｜当收银员 ; supermarket cashier｜超市收银员 ; pay the cashier｜向收银员付款
tip_zh: cashier负责收款，accountant负责会计核算。

meanings_zh: n. 便宜货；划算的买卖 | v. 讨价还价；商谈条件 | n. 协议；约定
definition_en: Something bought for less than its usual price | To discuss prices or conditions to reach an agreement | An agreement about what each person will do
example1_en: I copied a real bargain into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把真正的便宜货抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a real bargain to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用真正的便宜货来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a real bargain｜真正的便宜货 ; bargain with someone｜与某人讨价还价 ; strike a bargain｜达成协议 ; keep your side of the bargain｜履行自己约定的义务
tip_zh: 便宜货用可数名词；bargain with sb表示与某人议价。

meanings_zh: adj. 情绪的；情感的 | adj. 情绪激动的；易动情的
definition_en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs. | Showing or experiencing strong feelings.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on emotional support.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论情感支持。
example2_en: The reading connects emotional support with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把情感支持和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: emotional support｜情感支持 ; emotional well-being｜情绪健康 ; emotional development｜情感发展 ; become emotional｜变得激动
tip_zh: emotional不一定指悲伤，也可指喜悦等强烈情绪。

meanings_zh: v. 教育；培养 | v. 使了解；普及知识
definition_en: To teach someone and develop their knowledge or skills. | To give people information about a particular subject.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to educate children.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须教育儿童。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers educate children before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要教育儿童。
collocations: educate children｜教育儿童 ; educate people about｜向人们普及……知识 ; educate the public｜教育公众
tip_zh: educate强调教育培养；teach也可直接接学科。

meanings_zh: adj. 钦佩的；印象深刻的
definition_en: Feeling admiration because someone or something is particularly good.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about deeply impressed.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于印象极为深刻的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects deeply impressed with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把印象极为深刻和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: impressed by｜对……印象深刻 ; impressed with｜对……感到钦佩 ; deeply impressed｜印象极为深刻
tip_zh: impressed描述人的感受；impressive描述令人赞叹的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 服从；遵守
definition_en: to do what someone orders or what a rule requires
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to obey orders.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须服从命令。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to obey orders.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们服从命令。
collocations: obey orders｜服从命令 ; obey the law｜遵守法律 ; obey instructions｜遵从指示
tip_zh: 直接接人、命令或规则，不加to：obey the law。

meanings_zh: n. 兴奋；激动 | n. 令人兴奋的事；刺激
definition_en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation | something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm
example1_en: Our professor circled a sense of excitement on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了兴奋感。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a sense of excitement.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论兴奋感的材料。
collocations: with excitement｜兴奋地 ; a sense of excitement｜兴奋感 ; generate excitement｜引发兴奋 ; contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋之情
tip_zh: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。

meanings_zh: v. 攻击；猛烈抨击 | n. 攻击；抨击 | n. 疾病发作
definition_en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly | An act of violence or strong criticism | A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms
example1_en: The professor asked us to attack a proposal.
example1_zh: 教授让我们抨击一项提案。
example2_en: The passage says students who can attack a proposal follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够抨击一项提案的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击 ; heart attack｜心脏病发作 ; attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

meanings_zh: adv. 确实；的确 | adv. 甚至；实际上
definition_en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true. | Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.
example1_en: Indeed, the class checked the chart a second time.
example1_zh: 确实，全班又核对了一次图表。
example2_en: Indeed, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
example2_zh: 确实，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。
collocations: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用 ; indeed the case｜确实如此 ; if indeed｜如果确实
tip_zh: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸的空气；气息 | n. 一次呼吸
definition_en: air moving into or out of your lungs | one act of taking air into your lungs
example1_en: I copied out of breath into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把上气不接下气抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss out of breath.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论上气不接下气的材料。
collocations: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气 ; out of breath｜上气不接下气 ; hold your breath｜屏住呼吸 ; catch your breath｜喘口气
tip_zh: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

meanings_zh: n. 私人教师；导师 | v. 辅导；个别指导
definition_en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups | to teach someone individually or in a small group
example1_en: I copied private tutor into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把私人教师抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of private tutor.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得私人教师这个例子。
collocations: private tutor｜私人教师 ; personal tutor｜个人导师 ; tutor someone in maths｜辅导某人数学
tip_zh: tutor强调个别或小组辅导，不一定是教授。

meanings_zh: n. 过敏；过敏症
definition_en: A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance
example1_en: Office hours began with food allergy.
example1_zh: 答疑从食物过敏开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used food allergy to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用食物过敏来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: food allergy｜食物过敏 ; pollen allergy｜花粉过敏 ; have an allergy to｜对……过敏
tip_zh: 常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

meanings_zh: n. 状态；状况 | n. 国家；州；政府 | v. 陈述；明确说明
definition_en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time | a country, its government, or a region within a country | to express something clearly in speech or writing
example1_en: The textbook introduces state of mind in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了心理状态。
example2_en: The author returns to state of mind when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了心理状态。
collocations: in a good state｜处于良好状态 ; state of mind｜心理状态 ; state funding｜政府资助 ; state clearly｜明确说明
tip_zh: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

meanings_zh: n. 竖列；栏 | n. 专栏 | n. 柱；柱状物
definition_en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section | a regular newspaper or magazine feature on a particular subject | a tall upright structure, often supporting a roof
example1_en: Our professor circled a newspaper column on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了报纸专栏。
example2_en: A campus survey used a newspaper column to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用报纸专栏来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: a column of figures｜一列数字 ; a newspaper column｜报纸专栏 ; a stone column｜石柱 ; a column of smoke｜烟柱
tip_zh: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；提倡 | v. 晋升；提拔 | v. 宣传；推销
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted | to give someone a higher position at work | to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales
example1_en: I heard the lecturer promote economic growth during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时促进经济增长。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to promote economic growth.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得促进经济增长。
collocations: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; promote awareness｜提高意识 ; be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理 ; promote a product｜推销产品
tip_zh: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

meanings_zh: n. 管弦乐队
definition_en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on symphony orchestra.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论交响乐团。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of symphony orchestra.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得交响乐团这个例子。
collocations: symphony orchestra｜交响乐团 ; conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队 ; play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip_zh: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体的；体力的 | adj. 物质的；有形的 | adj. 物理的
definition_en: Relating to the body rather than the mind. | Existing as something real that can be touched or measured. | Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.
example1_en: I copied physical activity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把身体活动抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects physical activity with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把身体活动和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: physical activity｜身体活动 ; physical health｜身体健康 ; physical properties｜物理性质 ; physical evidence｜实物证据
tip_zh: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

meanings_zh: num. 十亿 | n. 数十亿；大量
definition_en: one thousand million | an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a billion dollars.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于十亿美元的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a billion dollars.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得十亿美元这个例子。
collocations: a billion dollars｜十亿美元 ; billions of people｜数十亿人 ; a billion years｜十亿年
tip_zh: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

meanings_zh: adj. 医学的；医疗的 | n. 体格检查
definition_en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness. | An examination to check a person's health.
example1_en: The textbook introduces medical treatment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了医疗。
example2_en: The author returns to medical treatment when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了医疗。
collocations: medical treatment｜医疗 ; medical research｜医学研究 ; medical care｜医疗护理 ; have a medical｜接受体检
tip_zh: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。

meanings_zh: n. 编辑；主编 | n. 剪辑师 | n. 编辑程序
definition_en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication | someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound | software used to change digital content
example1_en: Office hours began with chief editor.
example1_zh: 答疑从主编开始。
example2_en: The reading connects chief editor with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把主编和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: chief editor｜主编 ; film editor｜电影剪辑师 ; text editor｜文本编辑器 ; editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip_zh: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

meanings_zh: n. 笑；笑声
definition_en: The sound or action of laughing
example1_en: I copied burst into laughter into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把突然大笑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss burst into laughter.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论突然大笑的材料。
collocations: burst into laughter｜突然大笑 ; roar with laughter｜放声大笑 ; a burst of laughter｜一阵笑声 ; infectious laughter｜有感染力的笑声
tip_zh: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。

meanings_zh: n. 自豪；得意 | n. 自尊；自负 | v. 以……为傲
definition_en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value. | Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance. | To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sense of pride in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自豪感。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a sense of pride.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得自豪感这个例子。
collocations: take pride in｜为……感到自豪 ; a sense of pride｜自豪感 ; hurt someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊 ; pride yourself on｜以自身的……为傲
tip_zh: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难；灾祸 | n. 彻底的失败；糟糕的事
definition_en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss. | Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about natural disaster.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于自然灾害的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of natural disaster.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得自然灾害这个例子。
collocations: natural disaster｜自然灾害 ; disaster relief｜灾害救援 ; avert disaster｜避免灾难 ; a complete disaster｜彻底的失败
tip_zh: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

meanings_zh: n. 入室盗贼
definition_en: someone who enters a building illegally to steal things
example1_en: I copied burglar alarm into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把防盗警报器抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around burglar alarm.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕防盗警报器展开说明。
collocations: burglar alarm｜防盗警报器 ; deter burglars｜震慑入室盗贼 ; catch a burglar｜抓住入室盗贼
tip_zh: burglar指入室盗贼；robber通常指使用威胁的劫匪。

meanings_zh: n. 庄稼；农作物 | n. 一季的收成 | v. 裁剪；剪短
definition_en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses | the amount of a plant harvested at one time | to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a bumper crop.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论大丰收。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a bumper crop.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大丰收展开说明。
collocations: grow crops｜种植庄稼 ; crop yields｜农作物产量 ; a bumper crop｜大丰收 ; crop a photo｜裁剪照片
tip_zh: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

meanings_zh: v. 使钦佩；留下深刻印象 | v. 使铭记；使意识到重要性
definition_en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something | to make someone understand how important something is
example1_en: The assignment is to impress someone with, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先以……给某人留下好印象，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to impress someone with.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们以……给某人留下好印象。
collocations: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象 ; be impressed by｜对……印象深刻 ; impress upon someone｜使某人牢记
tip_zh: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

meanings_zh: n. 药店；药房 | n. 药剂学
definition_en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines. | The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.
example1_en: Office hours began with community pharmacy.
example1_zh: 答疑从社区药店开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around community pharmacy.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕社区药店展开说明。
collocations: community pharmacy｜社区药店 ; hospital pharmacy｜医院药房 ; study pharmacy｜学习药剂学
tip_zh: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

meanings_zh: n. 男校长
definition_en: A man who is in charge of a school.
example1_en: The textbook introduces school headmaster in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学校男校长。
example2_en: The reading connects school headmaster with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把学校男校长和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: school headmaster｜学校男校长 ; deputy headmaster｜男副校长 ; headmaster's office｜校长办公室
tip_zh: 指男性；英式headteacher不分性别，美式常用principal。

meanings_zh: adj. 体贴的；关心他人的 | n. 照护工作
definition_en: kind and concerned about other people's needs | the work of looking after people who need help
example1_en: Office hours began with a caring attitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从关怀的态度开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a caring attitude with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把关怀的态度和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a caring attitude｜关怀的态度 ; a caring profession｜照护类职业 ; a caring environment｜充满关怀的环境
tip_zh: caring指关心别人；careful指做事小心。

meanings_zh: n. 乘法 | n. 大量增加；繁殖
definition_en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together. | An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.
example1_en: Our professor circled rapid multiplication on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了快速繁殖；迅速增加。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around rapid multiplication.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕快速繁殖；迅速增加展开说明。
collocations: multiplication table｜乘法表 ; multiplication sign｜乘号 ; rapid multiplication｜快速繁殖；迅速增加
tip_zh: 乘法用multiplication；乘以可用multiplied by。

meanings_zh: v. 不喜欢；厌恶 | n. 反感；不喜欢
definition_en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable. | A feeling of not liking someone or something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to dislike doing something.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求不喜欢做某事。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to dislike doing something.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来不喜欢做某事。
collocations: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事 ; a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感 ; take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip_zh: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

meanings_zh: v. 钦佩；敬佩 | v. 欣赏；赞赏
definition_en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements | To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive
example1_en: The professor asked us to admire the view.
example1_zh: 教授让我们欣赏风景。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers admire the view before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要欣赏风景。
collocations: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人 ; greatly admire｜十分钦佩 ; admire the view｜欣赏风景
tip_zh: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

meanings_zh: adj. 纯的；无杂质的 | adj. 纯粹的；完全的 | adj. 纯理论的
definition_en: not mixed with other substances | complete and containing nothing of a different kind | concerned with theory rather than practical uses
example1_en: The textbook introduces pure water in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯净水。
example2_en: The author returns to pure water when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了纯净水。
collocations: pure water｜纯净水 ; pure wool｜纯羊毛 ; pure chance｜纯属偶然 ; pure mathematics｜纯数学
tip_zh: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

meanings_zh: v. 打哈欠 | n. 哈欠
definition_en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom. | An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.
example1_en: The assignment is to yawn widely, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先张大嘴打哈欠，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to yawn widely.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们张大嘴打哈欠。
collocations: give a yawn｜打个哈欠 ; stifle a yawn｜忍住哈欠 ; yawn widely｜张大嘴打哈欠
tip_zh: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

meanings_zh: n. 期中考试 | adj. 期中的
definition_en: An exam given about halfway through a course. | Happening in the middle of a term.
example1_en: The midterm covers the first six lectures.
example1_zh: 期中考试涵盖前六次讲座。
example2_en: Students who review a little each week usually find the midterm less rushed.
example2_zh: 每周复习一点的学生，通常不会把期中考试复习得太赶。
collocations: midterm exam｜期中考试 ; before the midterm｜期中考试前
tip_zh: 也可写作 mid-term。托福听力里多指考试，不是政治上的中期选举，除非语境如此。

meanings_zh: adj. 有天赋的；有才能的
definition_en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about highly talented.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于极具天赋的的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly talented.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕极具天赋的展开说明。
collocations: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家 ; a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家 ; highly talented｜极具天赋的
tip_zh: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 嫉妒的 | adj. 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
definition_en: unhappy because someone has something you want | upset because someone you love shows interest in another person
example1_en: Office hours began with a jealous partner.
example1_zh: 答疑从爱吃醋的伴侣开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a jealous partner with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把爱吃醋的伴侣和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: jealous of someone｜嫉妒某人 ; feel jealous｜感到嫉妒 ; a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip_zh: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

meanings_zh: n. 花生；花生米 | n. 极少的钱
definition_en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell | a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts
example1_en: Office hours began with peanut butter.
example1_zh: 答疑从花生酱开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used peanut butter to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用花生酱来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: peanut butter｜花生酱 ; peanut allergy｜花生过敏 ; roasted peanuts｜烤花生 ; work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip_zh: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 法律的；与法律有关的 | adj. 合法的；法律允许的
definition_en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them | Allowed by the law
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on perfectly legal.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论完全合法。
example2_en: A campus survey used perfectly legal to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用完全合法来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: legal advice｜法律意见 ; legal action｜法律诉讼 ; legal rights｜法定权利 ; perfectly legal｜完全合法
tip_zh: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

meanings_zh: adj. 随和的；不易烦躁的
definition_en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried
example1_en: The professor explained easy-going with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了随和的。
example2_en: Students who can explain easy-going usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
example2_zh: 能解释随和的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。
collocations: an easy-going personality｜随和的性格 ; an easy-going attitude｜随和的态度 ; an easy-going manner｜随和的举止
tip_zh: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；技巧；手法 | n. 技艺；技术水平
definition_en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill. | The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.
example1_en: Our professor circled improve your technique on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了提高技艺。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss improve your technique.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论提高技艺的材料。
collocations: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法 ; relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; improve your technique｜提高技艺 ; teaching techniques｜教学方法
tip_zh: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

meanings_zh: n. 赞美；称赞 | v. 称赞；赞美
definition_en: A remark expressing admiration or approval. | To tell someone that you admire something about them.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sincere compliment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了真诚的赞美。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sincere compliment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕真诚的赞美展开说明。
collocations: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人 ; compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面 ; accept a compliment｜接受赞美 ; a sincere compliment｜真诚的赞美
tip_zh: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

meanings_zh: n. 权力；影响力 | n. 动力；电力 | v. 为…提供动力
definition_en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions. | Energy used to make machines and equipment work. | To supply energy that makes something work.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on political power.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论政治权力。
example2_en: The reading connects political power with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把政治权力和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: political power｜政治权力 ; renewable power｜可再生能源电力 ; power supply｜电源；电力供应 ; the power to decide｜决定权
tip_zh: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

meanings_zh: n. 播客；播客节目 | v. 制作并发布播客
definition_en: An online audio programme available to stream or download. | To produce and distribute an online audio programme.
example1_en: Our professor circled podcast episode on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一期播客。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around podcast episode.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一期播客展开说明。
collocations: listen to a podcast｜收听播客 ; podcast episode｜一期播客 ; host a podcast｜主持播客节目 ; subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip_zh: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

meanings_zh: v. 误解；误会
definition_en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly
example1_en: The lab instructions say to misunderstand instructions.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求误解指示。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to misunderstand instructions.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来误解指示。
collocations: misunderstand instructions｜误解指示 ; misunderstand someone's intentions｜误会某人的意图 ; easily misunderstood｜容易被误解
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

meanings_zh: adj. 基础的；初级的 | adj. 小学的
definition_en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning. | Relating to the first years of formal school education.
example1_en: Office hours began with elementary knowledge.
example1_zh: 答疑从基础知识开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around elementary knowledge.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕基础知识展开说明。
collocations: elementary knowledge｜基础知识 ; elementary school｜小学 ; elementary education｜小学教育 ; elementary level｜初级水平
tip_zh: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

meanings_zh: n. 移动；动作 | n. 社会运动 | n. 乐章
definition_en: an act of changing position or moving the body | an organised effort by people seeking shared social change | one main section of a long piece of music
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on freedom of movement.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论行动自由。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of freedom of movement.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得行动自由这个例子。
collocations: freedom of movement｜行动自由 ; sudden movement｜突然的动作 ; environmental movement｜环保运动 ; social movement｜社会运动
tip_zh: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 专家；行家 | adj. 专业的；熟练的
definition_en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject. | Having or showing great knowledge or skill.
example1_en: Office hours began with medical expert.
example1_zh: 答疑从医学专家开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of medical expert.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得医学专家这个例子。
collocations: an expert on｜某方面的专家 ; expert advice｜专家建议 ; medical expert｜医学专家
tip_zh: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

meanings_zh: n. 庆祝活动；庆典 | n. 庆祝
definition_en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion. | The act of showing happiness about something special.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on birthday celebration.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论生日庆祝活动。
example2_en: A campus survey used birthday celebration to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用生日庆祝活动来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动 ; in celebration of｜为庆祝…… ; birthday celebration｜生日庆祝活动
tip_zh: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 三角形 | n. 三角铁
definition_en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles. | A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.
example1_en: The textbook introduces right-angled triangle in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了直角三角形。
example2_en: A campus survey used right-angled triangle to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用直角三角形来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: right-angled triangle｜直角三角形 ; equilateral triangle｜等边三角形 ; love triangle｜三角恋
tip_zh: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

meanings_zh: n. 图表 | v. 记录；跟踪；绘制图表 | n. 海图；航图
definition_en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes | to record or show how something develops over time | a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air
example1_en: The textbook introduces bar chart in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了条形图。
example2_en: The author returns to bar chart when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了条形图。
collocations: bar chart｜条形图 ; pie chart｜饼图 ; chart progress｜记录进展 ; navigation chart｜航海图
tip_zh: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

meanings_zh: n. 天赋；才能 | n. 人才；有才能的人
definition_en: A natural ability to do something well. | People who have strong abilities in a particular field.
example1_en: Our professor circled natural talent on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了天生的才能。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around natural talent.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕天生的才能展开说明。
collocations: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋 ; natural talent｜天生的才能 ; nurture talent｜培养人才 ; attract talent｜吸引人才
tip_zh: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 放松；休息 | n. 肌肉松弛 | n. 规定的放宽
definition_en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension. | The process of muscles becoming less tight. | The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.
example1_en: I copied muscle relaxation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把肌肉松弛抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of muscle relaxation.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得肌肉松弛这个例子。
collocations: relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; muscle relaxation｜肌肉松弛 ; relaxation of restrictions｜限制的放宽
tip_zh: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；有格调的
definition_en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about stylish clothes.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于时髦的衣服的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects stylish clothes with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把时髦的衣服和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: stylish clothes｜时髦的衣服 ; a stylish design｜有格调的设计 ; a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip_zh: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

meanings_zh: adj. 国家的；全国的 | n. 某国国民
definition_en: relating to a whole country or its people | a person who is a citizen of a particular country
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about foreign national.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于外国公民的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of foreign national.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得外国公民这个例子。
collocations: national identity｜国家认同 ; national park｜国家公园 ; national government｜中央政府 ; foreign national｜外国公民
tip_zh: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

meanings_zh: n. 长笛
definition_en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.
example1_en: I copied a flute solo into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把长笛独奏抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a flute solo.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得长笛独奏这个例子。
collocations: play the flute｜吹长笛 ; a flute solo｜长笛独奏 ; flute lessons｜长笛课
tip_zh: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

meanings_zh: n. 想象力；想象
definition_en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.
example1_en: The textbook introduces vivid imagination in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了丰富的想象力。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vivid imagination.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕丰富的想象力展开说明。
collocations: use your imagination｜发挥想象力 ; vivid imagination｜丰富的想象力 ; capture the imagination｜引发遐想 ; a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip_zh: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

meanings_zh: adj. 不友好的；冷淡的 | adj. 不利的；难以使用的
definition_en: not kind or welcoming towards others | making an activity difficult or causing harm
example1_en: The textbook introduces environmentally unfriendly in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对环境不利的。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of environmentally unfriendly.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得对环境不利的这个例子。
collocations: unfriendly atmosphere｜冷淡的氛围 ; unfriendly attitude｜不友好的态度 ; environmentally unfriendly｜对环境不利的
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 挑战；艰巨任务 | v. 质疑；提出异议 | v. 向…挑战；考验
definition_en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities. | Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable. | Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.
example1_en: The professor explained challenge with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了挑战。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses challenge when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了挑战。
collocations: face a challenge｜面临挑战 ; meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战 ; challenge an assumption｜质疑假设 ; challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip_zh: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

meanings_zh: v. 上传 | n. 上传；上传的文件
definition_en: to transfer files from a device to an online system | the transfer of a file online, or the file itself
example1_en: I heard the lecturer upload a file during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时上传文件。
example2_en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers upload a file before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要上传文件。
collocations: upload a file｜上传文件 ; upload photos｜上传照片 ; upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip_zh: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

meanings_zh: n. 纸巾 | n. 组织
definition_en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping. | A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about muscle tissue.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于肌肉组织的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around muscle tissue.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕肌肉组织展开说明。
collocations: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾 ; muscle tissue｜肌肉组织 ; damaged tissue｜受损组织 ; tissue repair｜组织修复
tip_zh: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 陈述；说法 | n. 声明 | n. 账单；结算单
definition_en: something said or written to express information or an opinion | a formal public announcement about a particular matter | a record showing financial transactions over a period
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a bank statement.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于银行对账单的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a bank statement.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得银行对账单这个例子。
collocations: make a statement｜作出陈述 ; issue a statement｜发表声明 ; a bank statement｜银行对账单 ; a witness statement｜证人陈述
tip_zh: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

meanings_zh: n. 新娘；准新娘
definition_en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.
example1_en: I copied a beautiful bride into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把美丽的新娘抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a beautiful bride to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用美丽的新娘来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: bride and groom｜新娘与新郎 ; a beautiful bride｜美丽的新娘 ; a bride-to-be｜准新娘
tip_zh: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

meanings_zh: adj. 困惑的；糊涂的 | adj. 混乱的；难懂的
definition_en: unable to understand something or think clearly | unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation
example1_en: I copied confused about into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把对……感到困惑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects confused about with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……感到困惑和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: confused about｜对……感到困惑 ; look confused｜显得困惑 ; a confused account｜混乱的叙述
tip_zh: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: n. 最低限度；最小量 | adj. 最低的；最小的
definition_en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed. | Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a minimum of in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了至少。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a minimum of.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论至少的材料。
collocations: a minimum of｜至少 ; keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度 ; minimum wage｜最低工资 ; minimum requirements｜最低要求
tip_zh: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

meanings_zh: n. 公告；宣布
definition_en: a public statement giving people information or news
example1_en: Office hours began with official announcement.
example1_zh: 答疑从官方公告开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used official announcement to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用官方公告来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: make an announcement｜发布公告 ; official announcement｜官方公告 ; public announcement｜公开声明
tip_zh: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

meanings_zh: n. 胸部；胸腔 | n. 大箱子；储物箱
definition_en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs. | A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a wooden chest.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论木箱。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a wooden chest.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得木箱这个例子。
collocations: chest pain｜胸痛 ; a chest infection｜胸部感染 ; a wooden chest｜木箱 ; a chest of drawers｜抽屉柜
tip_zh: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。

meanings_zh: n. 安全；平安
definition_en: the state of being protected from danger or harm
example1_en: Our professor circled road safety on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道路安全。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of road safety.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得道路安全这个例子。
collocations: road safety｜道路安全 ; safety standards｜安全标准 ; for safety reasons｜出于安全考虑 ; reach safety｜到达安全地带
tip_zh: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜欢的；喜爱的 | adj. 深情的；温情的
definition_en: having a liking or affection for someone or something | showing or expressing warmth and affection
example1_en: The textbook introduces fond memories in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了温馨的回忆。
example2_en: The reading connects fond memories with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把温馨的回忆和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: be fond of｜喜欢 ; fond memories｜温馨的回忆 ; a fond farewell｜深情的告别
tip_zh: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 展览；展览会
definition_en: A public display of art, objects, or products.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on art exhibition.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论艺术展。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss art exhibition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论艺术展的材料。
collocations: art exhibition｜艺术展 ; hold an exhibition｜举办展览 ; on exhibition｜在展出
tip_zh: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

meanings_zh: n. 蒸汽；水汽 | v. 蒸；用蒸汽烹调
definition_en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist. | To cook food using steam from boiling water.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about steam engine.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于蒸汽机的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used steam engine to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用蒸汽机来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: steam engine｜蒸汽机 ; steam vegetables｜蒸蔬菜 ; give off steam｜冒出蒸汽 ; run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip_zh: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

meanings_zh: n. 惊恐；震惊；厌恶 | n. 恐怖作品类型
definition_en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust | a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sense of horror in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了恐惧感。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of horror.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕恐惧感展开说明。
collocations: in horror｜惊恐地 ; a horror film｜恐怖片 ; a sense of horror｜恐惧感
tip_zh: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

meanings_zh: n. 传记
definition_en: a written account of someone's life by another person
example1_en: Our professor circled an authorised biography on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经本人授权的传记。
example2_en: A campus survey used an authorised biography to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经本人授权的传记来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: write a biography｜写传记 ; a biography of someone｜某人的传记 ; an authorised biography｜经本人授权的传记
tip_zh: biography是他人为某人写的传记；自传用autobiography。

meanings_zh: n. 协议；协定 | n. 同意；意见一致 | n. 语法上的一致关系
definition_en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups | the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal | a grammatical match between related words in a sentence
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about subject–verb agreement.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于主谓一致的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to subject–verb agreement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主谓一致。
collocations: reach an agreement｜达成协议 ; sign an agreement｜签署协议 ; be in agreement｜意见一致 ; subject–verb agreement｜主谓一致
tip_zh: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 网络；关系网 | n. 广播网；电视网 | v. 建立人脉
definition_en: A system of connected people, things or places. | A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes. | To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.
example1_en: Office hours began with transport network.
example1_zh: 答疑从交通网络开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss transport network.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论交通网络的材料。
collocations: transport network｜交通网络 ; wireless network｜无线网络 ; support network｜支持网络 ; network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip_zh: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

meanings_zh: n. 宗教；宗教信仰
definition_en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices
example1_en: The textbook introduces freedom of religion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宗教自由。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around freedom of religion.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教自由展开说明。
collocations: freedom of religion｜宗教自由 ; organised religion｜制度化宗教 ; religious beliefs｜宗教信仰
tip_zh: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 小睡；打盹 | v. 小睡；打盹
definition_en: a short sleep, usually during the day | to sleep briefly, usually during the day
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an afternoon nap.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论午后小睡。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an afternoon nap.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕午后小睡展开说明。
collocations: take a nap｜小睡一下 ; an afternoon nap｜午后小睡 ; a power nap｜恢复精力的短睡
tip_zh: 动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

meanings_zh: n. 许可证；执照 | n. 自由发挥的许可
definition_en: an official document allowing someone to do something | freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on driving licence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论驾驶执照。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss driving licence.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论驾驶执照的材料。
collocations: driving licence｜驾驶执照 ; apply for a licence｜申请许可证 ; renew a licence｜续办许可证 ; poetic licence｜诗意的自由发挥
tip_zh: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

meanings_zh: n. 毕业文凭；课程证书
definition_en: an official document showing successful completion of a course
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on high school diploma.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高中文凭。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around high school diploma.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕高中文凭展开说明。
collocations: earn a diploma｜取得文凭 ; high school diploma｜高中文凭 ; diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip_zh: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

meanings_zh: n. 发现；被发现的事物
definition_en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found
example1_en: I copied scientific discovery into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把科学发现抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scientific discovery.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕科学发现展开说明。
collocations: make a discovery｜有所发现 ; scientific discovery｜科学发现 ; major discovery｜重大发现 ; accidental discovery｜意外发现
tip_zh: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

meanings_zh: n. 娱乐；娱乐活动
definition_en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.
example1_en: The textbook introduces family entertainment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了适合全家的娱乐。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around family entertainment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕适合全家的娱乐展开说明。
collocations: live entertainment｜现场娱乐表演 ; the entertainment industry｜娱乐业 ; family entertainment｜适合全家的娱乐 ; a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip_zh: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

meanings_zh: v. 想知道；琢磨 | n. 惊叹；惊奇 | n. 奇观；奇迹
definition_en: to think about something you do not know | a feeling of surprise and admiration | something unusually impressive or surprising
example1_en: The lab instructions say to wonder whether.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求想知道是否。
example2_en: The reading asks you to wonder whether and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你想知道是否，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: wonder whether｜想知道是否 ; wonder about｜对……感到好奇 ; in wonder｜惊叹地 ; natural wonders｜自然奇观
tip_zh: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

meanings_zh: v. 递送；送达 | v. 发表；讲授 | v. 兑现；实现
definition_en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination | to give a speech, lecture, or presentation | to produce the results or benefits that were promised
example1_en: The professor asked us to deliver a parcel.
example1_zh: 教授让我们递送包裹。
example2_en: The passage says students who can deliver a parcel follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够递送包裹的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: deliver a parcel｜递送包裹 ; deliver a speech｜发表演讲 ; deliver results｜取得成效 ; deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip_zh: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

meanings_zh: adj. 欢乐的；愉快的
definition_en: Cheerful and full of enjoyment.
example1_en: Our professor circled merry laughter on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了欢快的笑声。
example2_en: The reading connects merry laughter with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把欢快的笑声和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: merry laughter｜欢快的笑声 ; a merry crowd｜欢乐的人群 ; make merry｜欢庆作乐
tip_zh: 常形容欢庆气氛；make merry意为欢庆作乐。

meanings_zh: v. 通知；告知 | v. 影响；为……提供依据
definition_en: To give someone facts or tell them about something. | To provide knowledge that shapes a decision, opinion, or approach.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to inform policy.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为政策提供依据。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to inform policy.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得为政策提供依据。
collocations: inform someone of something｜告知某人某事 ; keep someone informed｜随时告知某人最新情况 ; inform policy｜为政策提供依据
tip_zh: 告知某人某事用inform sb of/about sth。

meanings_zh: n. 折扣 | v. 打折出售 | v. 不予考虑；低估
definition_en: a reduction in the usual price | to sell something at a reduced price | to consider something unlikely or less important
example1_en: The professor explained discount with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了折扣。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up discount while discussing evidence about economic policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了折扣。
collocations: offer a discount｜提供折扣 ; at a discount｜以折扣价 ; discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

meanings_zh: n. 鬼魂；幽灵 | n. 一丝；隐约的痕迹
definition_en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive. | A very slight trace of a feeling, expression, or quality.
example1_en: I copied a ghost story into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把鬼故事抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a ghost story.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕鬼故事展开说明。
collocations: a ghost story｜鬼故事 ; a ghost town｜废弃的城镇 ; a ghost of a smile｜一丝微笑 ; see a ghost｜看见鬼魂
tip_zh: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。

meanings_zh: v. 雇用 | v. 租用 | n. 租用；租借
definition_en: To pay someone to do a job. | To pay to use something for a limited time. | An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to hire staff.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须雇用员工。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to hire staff.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们雇用员工。
collocations: hire staff｜雇用员工 ; hire a car｜租车 ; for hire｜供出租 ; car hire｜汽车租赁
tip_zh: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

meanings_zh: adj. 失业的
definition_en: Without a paid job but available for work
example1_en: Office hours began with the long-term unemployed.
example1_zh: 答疑从长期失业者开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the long-term unemployed.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论长期失业者的材料。
collocations: become unemployed｜失业 ; unemployed workers｜失业工人 ; the long-term unemployed｜长期失业者
tip_zh: the unemployed指失业者群体，谓语用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 积极乐观的；有益的 | adj. 确信的；肯定的 | adj. 阳性的；正数的
definition_en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect. | Completely certain that something is true. | Showing a condition is present, or mathematically greater than zero.
example1_en: Our professor circled positive attitude on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了积极的态度。
example2_en: The author returns to positive attitude when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了积极的态度。
collocations: positive attitude｜积极的态度 ; positive impact｜积极影响 ; positive result｜阳性结果；良好结果
tip_zh: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。

meanings_zh: n. 鼓手
definition_en: A person who plays drums, especially in a musical group.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a skilled drummer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论技艺娴熟的鼓手。
example2_en: A campus survey used a skilled drummer to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用技艺娴熟的鼓手来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a skilled drummer｜技艺娴熟的鼓手 ; a jazz drummer｜爵士乐鼓手 ; the band's drummer｜乐队的鼓手
tip_zh: drum加-er构成drummer，注意双写m。

meanings_zh: v. 认出；辨认出 | v. 承认；意识到 | v. 正式认可；表彰
definition_en: to identify someone or something known from before | to accept or understand that something is true or important | to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to recognise a face.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何认出一张脸。
example2_en: The reading asks you to recognise a face and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你认出一张脸，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: recognise a face｜认出一张脸 ; recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; officially recognise｜正式认可
tip_zh: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。

meanings_zh: n. 身体损伤；受伤
definition_en: Physical harm to someone's body, often caused by an accident
example1_en: The textbook introduces a serious injury in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了重伤。
example2_en: The reading connects a serious injury with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把重伤和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: suffer an injury｜受伤 ; a serious injury｜重伤 ; a knee injury｜膝部损伤 ; risk of injury｜受伤风险
tip_zh: 具体伤处可数；泛指身体伤害时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 表面；表层 | v. 浮出水面 | v. 显露；被发现
definition_en: The outside or top layer of something | To rise to the top of water | To become known or noticeable after being hidden
example1_en: I copied a smooth surface into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把光滑的表面抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a smooth surface with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把光滑的表面和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a smooth surface｜光滑的表面 ; the Earth's surface｜地球表面 ; beneath the surface｜表面之下 ; surface tension｜表面张力
tip_zh: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

meanings_zh: n. 版本；改编形式 | n. 个人叙述；说法
definition_en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms | One person's account of an event
example1_en: Our professor circled the latest version on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了最新版本。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the latest version.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论最新版本的材料。
collocations: the latest version｜最新版本 ; an updated version｜更新版 ; a version of events｜对事件的一种说法 ; a film version｜电影改编版
tip_zh: version指同一事物的不同形式，也指个人对事件的说法。

meanings_zh: v. 融化；使熔化 | v. 使心软；使感动
definition_en: To become liquid through heat, or make something become liquid | To become gentler emotionally, or make someone feel this way
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to melt ice.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使冰融化。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to melt ice.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使冰融化。
collocations: melt ice｜使冰融化 ; melt away｜逐渐消失 ; melt someone's heart｜打动某人的心
tip_zh: melt指受热融化；dissolve指溶于液体。

meanings_zh: adv. 广泛地；普遍地 | adv. 差异很大地
definition_en: Across many places or among many people | With a large difference between people, things, or situations
example1_en: The professor told us to widely available and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们随处可得的，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: Students who widely available are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够随处可得的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: widely available｜随处可得的 ; widely used｜广泛使用的 ; widely accepted｜普遍接受的 ; vary widely｜差异很大
tip_zh: widely指范围广；wide还可表示充分张开。

meanings_zh: n. 订书机
definition_en: a device that joins papers using small metal staples
example1_en: Our professor circled a desk stapler on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了桌面订书机。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a desk stapler.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得桌面订书机这个例子。
collocations: use a stapler｜使用订书机 ; a desk stapler｜桌面订书机 ; refill a stapler｜给订书机装钉
tip_zh: stapler是订书机，staple是订书钉，也可作动词。

meanings_zh: adj. 急救用的；急救的
definition_en: Used for immediate basic care after injury or sudden illness.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize first-aid in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出急救的。
example2_en: Students who can explain first-aid usually follow the rest of a lecture on public health.
example2_zh: 能解释急救的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共卫生的讲座。
collocations: first-aid kit｜急救包 ; first-aid training｜急救培训 ; first-aid equipment｜急救设备
tip_zh: 名词写作first aid；置于名词前可加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 喜悦；欢乐 | n. 令人高兴的人或事
definition_en: A feeling of great happiness | A person or thing that brings great happiness
example1_en: I copied jump for joy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把高兴得跳起来抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects jump for joy with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把高兴得跳起来和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: bring joy｜带来欢乐 ; jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来 ; tears of joy｜喜悦的泪水 ; the joys of parenthood｜为人父母的乐趣
tip_zh: 表喜悦通常不可数；表乐事可数，如a joy。

meanings_zh: n. 警卫；守卫 | v. 守卫；保护；看守 | n. 防护装置
definition_en: a person whose job is to protect people or places | to protect someone or something from danger or escape | a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage
example1_en: The textbook introduces security guard in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了保安。
example2_en: A campus survey used security guard to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用保安来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: security guard｜保安 ; guard against｜防范 ; on guard｜警戒着 ; protective guard｜防护罩
tip_zh: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。

meanings_zh: v. 在…下面画线 | v. 强调；凸显
definition_en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase | to show that something is especially important
example1_en: The assignment is to underline a word, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先在单词下面画线，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to underline a word.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来在单词下面画线。
collocations: underline a word｜在单词下面画线 ; underline the importance of｜强调…的重要性 ; underline the need for｜凸显对…的需要
tip_zh: 本义是在下方画线，也常用于强调重要性。

meanings_zh: n. 芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞剧
definition_en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.
example1_en: The textbook introduces classical ballet in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了古典芭蕾舞。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss classical ballet.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古典芭蕾舞的材料。
collocations: ballet dancer｜芭蕾舞演员 ; ballet company｜芭蕾舞团 ; ballet lessons｜芭蕾舞课 ; classical ballet｜古典芭蕾舞
tip_zh: 词尾t不发音；英式重音在前，美式在后。

meanings_zh: n. 失望；沮丧 | n. 令人失望的人或事
definition_en: sadness because something was not as good as expected | someone or something that fails to meet your hopes
example1_en: Office hours began with a bitter disappointment.
example1_zh: 答疑从极其令人失望的事开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a bitter disappointment with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把极其令人失望的事和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: to my disappointment｜令我失望的是 ; a bitter disappointment｜极其令人失望的事 ; cope with disappointment｜应对失望
tip_zh: 指情绪通常不可数；指令人失望的事可用a disappointment。

meanings_zh: n. 锻炼；健身训练
definition_en: a period of physical exercise to improve strength or fitness
example1_en: I copied daily workout into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把每日锻炼抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of daily workout.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得每日锻炼这个例子。
collocations: daily workout｜每日锻炼 ; intense workout｜高强度训练 ; workout routine｜健身训练安排
tip_zh: workout是名词；动词短语work out要分开写。

meanings_zh: n. 天使 | n. 善良可爱的人
definition_en: A spiritual being believed to carry messages from God | Someone who is exceptionally kind or helpful
example1_en: Our professor circled guardian angel on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了守护天使。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around guardian angel.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕守护天使展开说明。
collocations: guardian angel｜守护天使 ; an absolute angel｜大好人 ; angel wings｜天使的翅膀
tip_zh: 称某人为an angel，可表示对方善良或帮了大忙。

meanings_zh: n. 丧失；遗失；损失 | n. 亏损；亏损额 | n. 失败；输掉比赛
definition_en: The fact of no longer having someone or something. | Money lost when costs are higher than income. | A defeat in a game or competition.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about hearing loss.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于听力丧失的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of hearing loss.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得听力丧失这个例子。
collocations: hearing loss｜听力丧失 ; job losses｜工作岗位流失 ; at a loss｜亏本地；不知所措 ; a financial loss｜财务损失
tip_zh: loss是名词，lose是动词，过去式和过去分词为lost。

meanings_zh: n. 农业；农场经营
definition_en: Growing crops or raising animals for food and other products
example1_en: I copied organic farming into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有机农业抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects organic farming with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把有机农业和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: organic farming｜有机农业 ; dairy farming｜奶牛养殖 ; intensive farming｜集约化农业 ; sustainable farming｜可持续农业
tip_zh: 泛指农业时通常不可数；养殖也可用farming。

meanings_zh: n. 成就；成绩 | n. 实现；达成
definition_en: Something valuable accomplished through effort or skill. | The successful completion of a goal through effort.
example1_en: I copied a major achievement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把重大成就抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a major achievement.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕重大成就展开说明。
collocations: a major achievement｜重大成就 ; a sense of achievement｜成就感 ; academic achievement｜学业成绩 ; the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip_zh: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 账户；账号 | n. 叙述；报告 | v. 解释；占（比例）
definition_en: an arrangement for managing money or accessing a service | a spoken or written description of events | with for: explain something or constitute a share of something
example1_en: The textbook introduces account for in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了解释；占。
example2_en: A campus survey used account for to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用解释；占来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: open an account｜开立账户 ; give an account of｜叙述 ; account for｜解释；占 ; take into account｜考虑到
tip_zh: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不友善的；刻薄的
definition_en: not caring about others' feelings or treating them kindly
example1_en: I copied unkind remarks into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把刻薄的话抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss unkind remarks.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论刻薄的话的材料。
collocations: unkind remarks｜刻薄的话 ; be unkind to someone｜对某人不友善 ; unkind behaviour｜不友善的行为
tip_zh: 表示“对某人不友善”用be unkind to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 国界；边界 | n. 边缘；装饰边 | v. 与……接壤；紧邻
definition_en: the dividing line between countries or regions | a strip around the outside edge of something | to share a boundary with a place
example1_en: I copied a decorative border into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把装饰边抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a decorative border when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了装饰边。
collocations: cross the border｜越过边境 ; border controls｜边境管制 ; share a border｜接壤 ; a decorative border｜装饰边
tip_zh: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。

meanings_zh: adj. 可接受的；合格的
definition_en: good enough or suitable to be allowed or approved
example1_en: Our professor circled socially acceptable on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会认可的。
example2_en: The author returns to socially acceptable when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会认可的。
collocations: acceptable standard｜合格标准 ; socially acceptable｜社会认可的 ; acceptable to everyone｜人人都能接受的
tip_zh: acceptable表示达到要求，不等于优秀。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人尴尬的；使人难堪的
definition_en: Making someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable
example1_en: I copied deeply embarrassing into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把极其尴尬的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to deeply embarrassing when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极其尴尬的。
collocations: an embarrassing mistake｜令人尴尬的错误 ; an embarrassing situation｜令人难堪的处境 ; deeply embarrassing｜极其尴尬的
tip_zh: 事物令人尴尬用embarrassing；人感到尴尬用embarrassed。

meanings_zh: n. 小册子
definition_en: a small, thin book, usually containing practical information
example1_en: Office hours began with an information booklet.
example1_zh: 答疑从资料手册开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of an information booklet.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得资料手册这个例子。
collocations: an information booklet｜资料手册 ; an instruction booklet｜说明书 ; a booklet on｜关于……的小册子
tip_zh: -let常表示小；booklet是薄薄的小册子。

meanings_zh: n. 长篇小说 | adj. 新颖的；新奇的
definition_en: A long written story about imaginary people and events. | New and different from what is already known.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about historical novel.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于历史小说的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of historical novel.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得历史小说这个例子。
collocations: write a novel｜写长篇小说 ; historical novel｜历史小说 ; novel approach｜新颖的方法
tip_zh: 作名词指长篇小说；作形容词指新颖的。

meanings_zh: adj. 有智慧的；明智的
definition_en: Showing good judgment based on knowledge and experience.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a wise decision.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论明智的决定。
example2_en: The author returns to a wise decision when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了明智的决定。
collocations: a wise decision｜明智的决定 ; wise advice｜睿智的忠告 ; wise to do something｜做某事是明智的
tip_zh: wise强调判断明智；clever更强调聪明、学得快。

meanings_zh: n. 神父；祭司；教士
definition_en: a person authorised to perform religious ceremonies
example1_en: The textbook introduces a parish priest in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了堂区神父。
example2_en: A campus survey used a parish priest to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用堂区神父来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a parish priest｜堂区神父 ; a Catholic priest｜天主教神父 ; be ordained a priest｜被授予神父圣职
tip_zh: 并非所有宗教人士都称priest；僧侣通常称monk。

meanings_zh: adj. 消极的；不利的 | adj. 否定的；阴性的 | adj. 负的；小于零的
definition_en: expressing pessimism or having a harmful effect | expressing refusal or showing that something tested for is absent | less than zero
example1_en: Our professor circled negative impact on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了负面影响。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of negative impact.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得负面影响这个例子。
collocations: negative impact｜负面影响 ; negative attitude｜消极态度 ; test negative for｜检测结果为阴性 ; negative number｜负数
tip_zh: 检测结果为negative指未检出，并非结果不好。

meanings_zh: n. 消费者
definition_en: A person who buys goods or services for personal use.
example1_en: The textbook introduces consumer rights in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了消费者权益。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of consumer rights.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得消费者权益这个例子。
collocations: consumer rights｜消费者权益 ; consumer demand｜消费需求 ; consumer goods｜消费品 ; consumer protection｜消费者保护
tip_zh: consumer强调消费身份；customer强调与商家的交易关系。

meanings_zh: n. 婚姻；结婚 | n. 紧密结合
definition_en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses | a successful combination of different things
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a happy marriage.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于幸福的婚姻的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a happy marriage.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论幸福的婚姻的材料。
collocations: a happy marriage｜幸福的婚姻 ; marriage certificate｜结婚证 ; marriage ceremony｜结婚仪式 ; marriage to someone｜与某人的婚姻
tip_zh: marriage指婚姻关系；wedding主要指婚礼。

meanings_zh: adj. 怀孕的；妊娠的
definition_en: having a baby developing inside the body
example1_en: Office hours began with heavily pregnant.
example1_zh: 答疑从怀孕临近足月的开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss heavily pregnant.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论怀孕临近足月的的材料。
collocations: become pregnant｜怀孕 ; pregnant women｜孕妇 ; heavily pregnant｜怀孕临近足月的
tip_zh: 表示怀孕多久可说six months pregnant。

meanings_zh: v. 说服；劝服 | v. 使相信；使信服
definition_en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons | To make someone believe something is true
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to persuade someone to do something.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何说服某人做某事。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to persuade someone to do something.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们说服某人做某事。
collocations: persuade someone to do something｜说服某人做某事 ; persuade someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; hard to persuade｜难以说服
tip_zh: persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。

meanings_zh: n. 炸弹 | v. 轰炸；投弹于
definition_en: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage. | To attack a place using bombs.
example1_en: Our professor circled an unexploded bomb on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了未爆炸弹。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of an unexploded bomb.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得未爆炸弹这个例子。
collocations: an unexploded bomb｜未爆炸弹 ; defuse a bomb｜拆除炸弹引信 ; a bomb disposal team｜拆弹小组
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。

meanings_zh: n. 兽医 | v. 审查；仔细检查
definition_en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals | to check someone or something carefully before giving approval
example1_en: I copied vet applicants into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把审查申请人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to vet applicants when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了审查申请人。
collocations: take a pet to the vet｜带宠物看兽医 ; vet applicants｜审查申请人 ; vetting process｜审查流程
tip_zh: 动词过去式vetted，动名词vetting，均双写t。

meanings_zh: n. 一代人；一代 | n. 产生；发电 | n. 产品的一代
definition_en: people born and living at roughly the same time | the process of producing something, especially electricity | a stage in the development of a product or technology
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about electricity generation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于发电的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of electricity generation.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得发电这个例子。
collocations: future generations｜后代 ; generation gap｜代沟 ; electricity generation｜发电 ; younger generation｜年轻一代
tip_zh: 表示“一代人”时可数；表示“产生”时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 诊所；门诊部
definition_en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about dental clinic.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于牙科诊所的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects dental clinic with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把牙科诊所和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: dental clinic｜牙科诊所 ; outpatient clinic｜门诊部 ; attend a clinic｜去门诊就诊
tip_zh: clinic指诊所或门诊部；“临床的”用clinical。

meanings_zh: n. 王冠；皇冠 | v. 为……加冕；授予冠军称号 | n. 顶部；头顶；树冠
