definition_en: a ceremonial headpiece worn by a king or queen | to officially make someone a monarch or declare them champion | the highest part of a head, tree, or other object
example1_en: The professor explained crown with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了王冠。
example2_en: Students who can explain crown usually follow the rest of a lecture on historical change.
example2_zh: 能解释王冠的学生，通常跟得上一节关于历史变迁的讲座。
collocations: wear a crown｜戴王冠 ; be crowned champion｜荣获冠军 ; the crown of the head｜头顶 ; the crown of a tree｜树冠
tip_zh: be crowned champion意为“被授予冠军称号”。

meanings_zh: n. 犯罪；犯罪活动 | n. 罪行
definition_en: illegal activities considered as a whole | an action that breaks the law
example1_en: I copied prevent crime into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把预防犯罪抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used prevent crime to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用预防犯罪来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: commit a crime｜犯罪 ; prevent crime｜预防犯罪 ; crime rate｜犯罪率 ; violent crime｜暴力犯罪
tip_zh: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。

meanings_zh: adj. 中级的；中间的 | n. 中级学习者
definition_en: Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages. | A learner whose skills are between beginner and advanced levels.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on intermediate level.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论中级水平。
example2_en: The author returns to intermediate level when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了中级水平。
collocations: intermediate level｜中级水平 ; an intermediate course｜中级课程 ; an intermediate stage｜中间阶段
tip_zh: 常指介于beginner与advanced之间的水平。

meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许 | n. 许可证；通行证 | v. 使成为可能
definition_en: to officially allow someone to do something | an official document allowing a particular activity | to make an action or situation possible
example1_en: I heard the lecturer permit someone to do something during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时允许某人做某事。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to permit someone to do something.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来允许某人做某事。
collocations: permit someone to do something｜允许某人做某事 ; work permit｜工作许可 ; building permit｜建筑许可证 ; weather permitting｜天气允许的话
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。

meanings_zh: v. 减去；扣除
definition_en: to take one number or amount away from another
example1_en: The professor asked us to subtract from.
example1_zh: 教授让我们从……中减去。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to subtract from.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来从……中减去。
collocations: subtract from｜从……中减去 ; subtract the cost｜扣除费用
tip_zh: subtract A from B 表示用B减去A。

meanings_zh: n. 救护车
definition_en: A vehicle that transports sick or injured people for medical care.
example1_en: The textbook introduces ambulance service in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了救护车服务。
example2_en: A campus survey used ambulance service to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用救护车服务来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: call an ambulance｜叫救护车 ; ambulance service｜救护车服务 ; ambulance crew｜救护车急救人员
tip_zh: 以元音音素开头，前用an；叫救护车用call an ambulance。

meanings_zh: adv. 起初；原先 | adv. 原本来自
definition_en: at first, before later changes | in relation to where someone or something first came from
example1_en: The professor told us to originally planned and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们原先计划的，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will originally planned when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会原先计划的。
collocations: originally planned｜原先计划的 ; originally intended for｜原本用于 ; originally from｜原本来自
tip_zh: 表示最初情况，常暗示后来有变化；不等于currently。

meanings_zh: v. 判断；评价 | n. 法官 | n. 裁判；评委
definition_en: To form an opinion after considering someone or something. | An official who oversees court proceedings and makes legal decisions. | Someone who assesses performances or decides the winner of a competition.
example1_en: The professor asked us to judge by appearances.
example1_zh: 教授让我们以貌取人。
example2_en: The passage says students who can judge by appearances follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够以貌取人的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: judge by appearances｜以貌取人 ; judge fairly｜公正评判 ; a panel of judges｜评审团 ; a court judge｜法院法官
tip_zh: judge A by B表示依据B判断A。

meanings_zh: n. 责任；义务 | n. 工作职责；值勤 | n. 关税；税
definition_en: something you should do because it is right or required | work required by a job or a period of service | a tax charged on certain goods
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sense of duty in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了责任感。
example2_en: A campus survey used a sense of duty to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用责任感来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a sense of duty｜责任感 ; on duty｜值班 ; import duty｜进口关税 ; carry out duties｜履行职责
tip_zh: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。

meanings_zh: n. 申请；申请书 | n. 应用；运用 | n. 应用程序
definition_en: a formal request for a job, place, or permission | the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods | a computer program designed to perform particular tasks
example1_en: I copied practical application into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把实际应用抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around practical application.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕实际应用展开说明。
collocations: submit an application｜提交申请 ; application form｜申请表 ; practical application｜实际应用 ; software application｜软件应用程序
tip_zh: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

meanings_zh: n. 防晒霜；防晒用品
definition_en: A substance applied to skin to protect it from sunlight.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on apply sunscreen.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论涂防晒霜。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around apply sunscreen.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕涂防晒霜展开说明。
collocations: apply sunscreen｜涂防晒霜 ; reapply sunscreen｜补涂防晒霜 ; water-resistant sunscreen｜防水防晒霜
tip_zh: 通常不可数；涂防晒霜用apply或put on。

meanings_zh: n. 碳
definition_en: A chemical element present in all living things.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on carbon dioxide.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论二氧化碳。
example2_en: The reading connects carbon dioxide with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把二氧化碳和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: carbon dioxide｜二氧化碳 ; carbon emissions｜碳排放 ; carbon footprint｜碳足迹 ; carbon neutral｜碳中和的
tip_zh: carbon是碳元素；carbon dioxide才是二氧化碳。

meanings_zh: adv. 诚实地；坦诚地 | adv. 说实话；确实
definition_en: In a truthful way, without lying or cheating. | Used to emphasize sincerity or introduce a frank opinion.
example1_en: The professor told us to honestly believe and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们真心相信，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will honestly believe when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会真心相信。
collocations: answer honestly｜如实回答 ; honestly believe｜真心相信 ; speak honestly｜坦诚地说
tip_zh: honestly重在诚实；表示公正通常用fairly。

meanings_zh: n. 童年；幼年时期
definition_en: the period of life when someone is a child
example1_en: The textbook introduces early childhood in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了幼儿时期。
example2_en: The author returns to early childhood when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了幼儿时期。
collocations: early childhood｜幼儿时期 ; childhood memories｜童年回忆 ; a happy childhood｜快乐的童年
tip_zh: during childhood泛指童年；in my childhood指我的童年。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂的；难懂的
definition_en: Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly complicated.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论极其复杂的。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly complicated.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得极其复杂的这个例子。
collocations: complicated procedure｜复杂的程序 ; complicated relationship｜复杂的关系 ; highly complicated｜极其复杂的
tip_zh: 强调复杂难懂；complex也可仅指结构复杂。

meanings_zh: n. 客户；委托人 | n. 客户端
definition_en: someone who pays for professional services | a computer or program using services from a server
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on potential client.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论潜在客户。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of potential client.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得潜在客户这个例子。
collocations: potential client｜潜在客户 ; client needs｜客户需求 ; client base｜客户群 ; client confidentiality｜客户信息保密
tip_zh: client常购买专业服务；customer泛指购买商品或服务的人。

meanings_zh: adv. 出声地
definition_en: With an audible voice rather than silently.
example1_en: I wrote aloud on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把aloud和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain aloud usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释出声地的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: read aloud｜朗读 ; think aloud｜把想法说出来 ; say aloud｜出声说
tip_zh: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。

meanings_zh: n. 温度计；体温计
definition_en: An instrument used to measure temperature.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about digital thermometer.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电子温度计的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of digital thermometer.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得电子温度计这个例子。
collocations: digital thermometer｜电子温度计 ; clinical thermometer｜体温计 ; read a thermometer｜读取温度计示数
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节；测体温常用take someone's temperature。

meanings_zh: adj. 醉酒的 | adj. 陶醉的；忘乎所以的 | n. 醉汉；酗酒者
definition_en: Unable to think or act normally after drinking alcohol | So excited by something that sensible judgment is lost | Someone who is drunk or frequently drinks too much alcohol
example1_en: Our professor circled drunk driving on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了酒后驾车。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss drunk driving.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论酒后驾车的材料。
collocations: get drunk｜喝醉 ; drunk driving｜酒后驾车 ; drunk with power｜因权力而忘乎所以
tip_zh: drunk通常作表语；修饰名词也常用drunken。

meanings_zh: n. 姐夫；妹夫；配偶的兄弟
definition_en: your spouse's brother, or your sibling's or spouse's sibling's husband
example1_en: I wrote brother-in-law on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把brother-in-law和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses brother-in-law when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了姐夫。
collocations: my brother-in-law｜我的姻亲兄弟 ; a future brother-in-law｜未来的姻亲兄弟
tip_zh: 复数是brothers-in-law；不指堂兄弟或表兄弟。

meanings_zh: adj. 痛苦的；难过的 | adj. 悲惨的；令人难受的
definition_en: Very unhappy or uncomfortable | Extremely unpleasant or of very poor quality
example1_en: Our professor circled miserable weather on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了令人难受的天气。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss miserable weather.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论令人难受的天气的材料。
collocations: feel miserable｜感到难过 ; miserable weather｜令人难受的天气 ; miserable conditions｜恶劣的条件
tip_zh: 既可形容人的心情，也可形容天气或生活条件。

meanings_zh: n. 羞愧；耻辱 | n. 遗憾的事 | v. 使羞愧；使蒙羞
definition_en: A painful feeling caused by doing something wrong or embarrassing. | Something that causes disappointment or regret. | To make someone feel guilty or embarrassed about their behaviour.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sense of shame.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论羞耻感。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a sense of shame.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得羞耻感这个例子。
collocations: feel shame｜感到羞愧 ; a sense of shame｜羞耻感 ; a real shame｜真遗憾 ; shame someone into doing something｜使某人因羞愧而做某事
tip_zh: 羞愧义通常不可数；It's a shame表示真遗憾。

meanings_zh: adj. 愿意的；乐意的 | adj. 积极肯干的
definition_en: ready and happy to do something | eager to help or work without needing persuasion
example1_en: The textbook introduces a willing volunteer in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了热心的志愿者。
example2_en: The reading connects a willing volunteer with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把热心的志愿者和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: be willing to do something｜愿意做某事 ; a willing volunteer｜热心的志愿者 ; a willing helper｜乐于帮忙的人
tip_zh: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。

meanings_zh: n. 戏服；装扮服装 | n. 民族服装；时代服饰
definition_en: clothes worn to look like a particular character or creature | clothing typical of a particular country, culture, or historical period
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on traditional costume.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论传统服饰。
example2_en: The author returns to traditional costume when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了传统服饰。
collocations: traditional costume｜传统服饰 ; a costume designer｜戏服设计师 ; a costume party｜化装舞会
tip_zh: 指特定角色或文化的服装，不泛指日常衣服。

meanings_zh: n. 失败；失败的事物 | n. 故障；衰竭 | n. 未做；未履行
definition_en: a lack of success, or something that does not succeed | a situation in which a machine or organ stops working | not doing something that is expected or required
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about end in failure.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于以失败告终的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to end in failure when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了以失败告终。
collocations: end in failure｜以失败告终 ; power failure｜停电 ; heart failure｜心力衰竭 ; failure to comply｜未遵守
tip_zh: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 聋的；听力严重受损的
definition_en: Unable to hear, or able to hear very little.
example1_en: Our professor circled born deaf on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了先天失聪。
example2_en: The author returns to born deaf when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了先天失聪。
collocations: deaf people｜聋人 ; born deaf｜先天失聪 ; go deaf｜失去听力
tip_zh: 读音同def；大写Deaf可强调聋人文化身份。

meanings_zh: n. 怀疑；不确定 | v. 怀疑；认为不大可能
definition_en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible. | To feel uncertain about something or think it unlikely.
example1_en: The textbook introduces no doubt in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无疑。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of no doubt.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得无疑这个例子。
collocations: have doubts about｜对……有疑虑 ; no doubt｜无疑 ; cast doubt on｜使人怀疑 ; beyond doubt｜毫无疑问
tip_zh: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体不适的；生病的
definition_en: feeling ill or not in good health
example1_en: The textbook introduces slightly unwell in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了略感不适。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around slightly unwell.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕略感不适展开说明。
collocations: feel unwell｜感觉不舒服 ; become unwell｜身体开始不适 ; slightly unwell｜略感不适
tip_zh: 常放在feel或be后作表语，不常放在名词前。

meanings_zh: adj. 最初的；原来的 | adj. 独创的；新颖的 | n. 原件；原作
definition_en: existing at the beginning, before any changes | new and different rather than copied from something else | the first version from which copies are made
example1_en: I copied original plan into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把最初的计划抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around original plan.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕最初的计划展开说明。
collocations: original plan｜最初的计划 ; original design｜原创设计 ; original research｜原创研究 ; original version｜原始版本
tip_zh: 可指最初的，也可指原创的；看语境区分。

meanings_zh: v. 祝贺；恭喜
definition_en: Tell someone you are pleased about their success or good fortune.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer congratulate someone on something during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时就某事祝贺某人。
example2_en: The reading asks you to congratulate someone on something and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你就某事祝贺某人，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: congratulate someone on something｜就某事祝贺某人 ; congratulate someone warmly｜热烈祝贺某人
tip_zh: 用congratulate sb on sth，介词不是for。

meanings_zh: n. 亲戚；亲属 | adj. 相对的；比较而言的
definition_en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage. | Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.
example1_en: I copied a close relative into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把近亲抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a close relative with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把近亲和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a close relative｜近亲 ; a distant relative｜远亲 ; relative importance｜相对重要性 ; relative to｜相对于
tip_zh: 作名词指亲属；作形容词常与to连用表示比较。

meanings_zh: adv. 必然地；一定
definition_en: As an unavoidable result or something that must be true
example1_en: The professor told us to necessarily involve and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们必然涉及，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: Students who necessarily involve are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够必然涉及的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: not necessarily｜不一定 ; necessarily involve｜必然涉及 ; necessarily imply｜必然意味着
tip_zh: not necessarily 意为“不一定”，不是“一定不”。

meanings_zh: n. 受训人员；实习生
definition_en: Someone learning the skills needed for a particular job.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on management trainee.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论管理培训生。
example2_en: A campus survey used management trainee to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用管理培训生来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: trainee teacher｜实习教师 ; management trainee｜管理培训生 ; graduate trainee｜毕业生培训员工
tip_zh: trainee接受培训；trainer负责培训他人。

meanings_zh: adj. 有效的；起作用的 | adj. 生效的 | adj. 实际的；事实上的
definition_en: producing the intended or desired result | officially in force from a particular time | existing in practice, even if not officially recognised
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly effective.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论非常有效。
example2_en: The author returns to highly effective when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了非常有效。
collocations: effective treatment｜有效的治疗 ; effective in doing something｜在做某事方面有效 ; highly effective｜非常有效 ; effective from｜自……起生效
tip_zh: effective强调达到效果；efficient强调省时省力。

meanings_zh: v. 意识到；明白 | v. 实现愿望或潜力
definition_en: To become aware of something or understand it clearly | To make a hope happen or achieve possible success
example1_en: The professor asked us to realize that.
example1_zh: 教授让我们意识到……。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to realize that.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得意识到……。
collocations: realize that｜意识到…… ; realize a dream｜实现梦想 ; realize your potential｜发挥你的潜力 ; fully realize｜充分认识到
tip_zh: 英式也拼作realise；意识到某事可接that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 欢呼；喝彩 | n. 欢呼声；喝彩声 | v. 使振奋；使高兴
definition_en: shout happily to show approval or encouragement | a loud shout expressing happiness, approval, or encouragement | make someone feel happier or more hopeful
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to cheer for a team.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须为球队喝彩。
example2_en: The passage says students who can cheer for a team follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够为球队喝彩的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: cheer someone on｜为某人加油 ; cheer someone up｜使某人振作 ; a loud cheer｜响亮的欢呼声 ; cheer for a team｜为球队喝彩
tip_zh: cheer on指加油助威；cheer up指振作或使高兴。

meanings_zh: adv. 如今；现今
definition_en: At the present time, especially compared with the past.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to nowadays, many people.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习如今许多人。
example2_en: A lecture on social change asks the class to nowadays, many people before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先如今许多人。
collocations: nowadays, many people｜如今许多人 ; more common nowadays｜如今更常见 ; rarely used nowadays｜如今很少使用
tip_zh: 常与一般现在时连用，强调今昔对比；不用加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 口香糖 | n. 牙龈 | n. 树胶；胶质
definition_en: A sweet substance chewed but not swallowed | The firm pink flesh surrounding the bases of teeth | A sticky substance from plants, often used for making glue
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about chewing gum.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于口香糖的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around chewing gum.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕口香糖展开说明。
collocations: chewing gum｜口香糖 ; a piece of gum｜一片口香糖 ; gum disease｜牙龈疾病 ; natural gum｜天然树胶
tip_zh: 口香糖不可数；牙龈通常用复数gums。

meanings_zh: n. 人口；全体居民 | n. 种群
definition_en: all people living in an area, or their total number | all organisms of one species living in a particular area
example1_en: Office hours began with ageing population.
example1_zh: 答疑从老龄化人口开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of ageing population.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得老龄化人口这个例子。
collocations: population growth｜人口增长 ; ageing population｜老龄化人口 ; population density｜人口密度 ; bird population｜鸟类种群
tip_zh: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。

meanings_zh: n. 慈善机构 | n. 慈善；救济
definition_en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need | help, especially money, given to those in need
example1_en: I copied donate to charity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把向慈善事业捐款抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around donate to charity.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕向慈善事业捐款展开说明。
collocations: donate to charity｜向慈善事业捐款 ; raise money for charity｜为慈善事业筹款 ; charity event｜慈善活动
tip_zh: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 主题；中心思想 | n. 主题曲；主旋律
definition_en: the main subject or idea in a work or discussion | a recognisable tune associated with a programme or musical work
example1_en: I copied central theme into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把核心主题抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss central theme.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论核心主题的材料。
collocations: central theme｜核心主题 ; recurring theme｜反复出现的主题 ; theme music｜主题音乐 ; theme park｜主题公园
tip_zh: theme侧重贯穿作品的思想；topic多指讨论话题。

meanings_zh: v. 提及；指的是 | v. 查阅；参考 | v. 转介；移交
definition_en: mention someone or something, or have them as the meaning | look at a source to find information | send someone or something elsewhere for expert help or consideration
example1_en: The lab instructions say to refer to a report.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求查阅或提及报告。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to refer to a report.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们查阅或提及报告。
collocations: refer to a report｜查阅或提及报告 ; refer to something as｜将某物称为 ; refer someone to a specialist｜将某人转诊给专科医生
tip_zh: 常接to；过去式referred，分词referring。

meanings_zh: adj. 犯罪的；刑事的 | n. 罪犯
definition_en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime | a person who has committed a crime
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about criminal offence.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于刑事犯罪的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used criminal offence to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用刑事犯罪来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: criminal offence｜刑事犯罪 ; criminal record｜犯罪记录 ; criminal justice system｜刑事司法体系 ; criminal behaviour｜犯罪行为
tip_zh: criminal 可作形容词或名词；crime 是“罪行”。

meanings_zh: v. 吸引；引起兴趣 | v. 吸引靠近
definition_en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something | Pull something closer through a physical force
example1_en: The professor asked us to attract attention.
example1_zh: 教授让我们吸引注意。
example2_en: The reading asks you to attract attention and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你吸引注意，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: attract attention｜吸引注意 ; attract tourists｜吸引游客 ; attract investment｜吸引投资 ; attract customers｜吸引顾客
tip_zh: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 战斗；战役 | n. 斗争；艰苦努力 | v. 奋力斗争；搏斗
definition_en: A fight between armed forces. | A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem. | To struggle hard against someone or something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an uphill battle.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于艰巨的斗争的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects an uphill battle with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把艰巨的斗争和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: win a battle｜赢得战斗 ; an uphill battle｜艰巨的斗争 ; battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争 ; battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip_zh: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

meanings_zh: n. 益智游戏；拼图 | n. 谜；难以理解的事 | v. 使困惑
definition_en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills. | Something that is difficult to understand or explain. | To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a jigsaw puzzle.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于拼图的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a jigsaw puzzle.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕拼图展开说明。
collocations: solve a puzzle｜解开谜题 ; a jigsaw puzzle｜拼图 ; puzzle over something｜苦思某事 ; a crossword puzzle｜填字游戏
tip_zh: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: v. 流血；出血
definition_en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.
example1_en: The professor asked us to bleed heavily.
example1_zh: 教授让我们大量出血。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to bleed heavily.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们大量出血。
collocations: bleed heavily｜大量出血 ; bleed internally｜内出血 ; stop the bleeding｜止血
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

meanings_zh: n. 合唱团；唱诗班
definition_en: An organised group of people who sing together.
example1_en: I copied church choir into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把教堂唱诗班抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of church choir.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得教堂唱诗班这个例子。
collocations: join a choir｜加入合唱团 ; church choir｜教堂唱诗班 ; choir practice｜合唱排练
tip_zh: 发音近似quire，开头不是常见的/ch/音。

meanings_zh: n. 要素；组成部分 | n. 化学元素 | n. 恶劣天气
definition_en: An important or basic part of something. | A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances. | Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a key element.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论关键要素。
example2_en: The author returns to a key element when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了关键要素。
collocations: a key element｜关键要素 ; a chemical element｜化学元素 ; exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中
tip_zh: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。

meanings_zh: adj. 有创造力的；创新的
definition_en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about creative thinking.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于创造性思维的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects creative thinking with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把创造性思维和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: creative thinking｜创造性思维 ; creative writing｜创意写作 ; a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip_zh: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

meanings_zh: n. 谋杀；谋杀案 | v. 谋杀
definition_en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone | to deliberately and unlawfully kill someone
example1_en: I copied commit murder into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把实施谋杀抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around commit murder.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕实施谋杀展开说明。
collocations: commit murder｜实施谋杀 ; attempted murder｜谋杀未遂 ; murder investigation｜谋杀案调查 ; be charged with murder｜被控谋杀
tip_zh: murder强调非法且故意杀人；kill含义更广。

meanings_zh: v. 不同；有区别 | v. 意见不合
definition_en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways. | To have a different opinion from another person.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer differ from during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时与……不同。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to differ from.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们与……不同。
collocations: differ from｜与……不同 ; differ in size｜大小不同 ; differ widely｜差异很大 ; differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip_zh: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；总体的 | adj. 大致的；非具体的 | n. 将军
definition_en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations | describing main points rather than particular details | an officer with a very high rank in the army
example1_en: Our professor circled general public on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公众。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around general public.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕公众展开说明。
collocations: in general｜一般来说 ; general public｜公众 ; general knowledge｜常识 ; general overview｜总体概述
tip_zh: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

meanings_zh: v. 责怪；归咎于 | n. 责任；责备
definition_en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem. | Responsibility for something bad that has happened.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer blame someone for something during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时因某事责怪某人。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to blame someone for something.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来因某事责怪某人。
collocations: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人 ; blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人 ; take the blame｜承担责任 ; be to blame｜应负责任
tip_zh: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

meanings_zh: adv. 想必；总该 | adv. 必定；确实
definition_en: Used when expecting others to agree that something is true | Certainly, or in a way that will achieve a result
example1_en: The professor told us to surely not and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们总不至于吧，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will surely not when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会总不至于吧。
collocations: surely not｜总不至于吧 ; slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地 ; will surely lead to｜必将导致
tip_zh: 是副词；句首常表示期待对方赞同。

meanings_zh: adj. 中等教育的；中学的 | adj. 次要的；辅助的
definition_en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education. | Less important than something else.
example1_en: Office hours began with secondary school.
example1_zh: 答疑从中学开始。
example2_en: The author returns to secondary school when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了中学。
collocations: secondary school｜中学 ; secondary education｜中等教育 ; of secondary importance｜次要的 ; secondary to｜次于
tip_zh: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许
definition_en: allowed something; the past tense and past participle of permit
example1_en: The professor explained permitted with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了允许。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses permitted when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了允许。
collocations: be permitted to do something｜获准做某事 ; not permitted｜不被允许 ; legally permitted｜法律允许的
tip_zh: permit过去式双写t；被动式后接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 纪念碑；纪念建筑 | n. 历史遗迹；古迹
definition_en: A structure built to honour a person or important event. | An old structure valued for its historical importance.
example1_en: Office hours began with an ancient monument.
example1_zh: 答疑从古迹开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used an ancient monument to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用古迹来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a monument to｜纪念……的建筑 ; an ancient monument｜古迹 ; a historic monument｜历史遗迹 ; erect a monument｜树立纪念碑
tip_zh: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

meanings_zh: n. 实践研讨会；工作坊 | n. 车间；作坊
definition_en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together. | A room or building where things are made or repaired.
example1_en: Our professor circled a training workshop on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了培训研讨会。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a training workshop.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕培训研讨会展开说明。
collocations: attend a workshop｜参加工作坊 ; run a workshop｜举办工作坊 ; a training workshop｜培训研讨会 ; a repair workshop｜维修车间
tip_zh: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。

meanings_zh: n. 朋友；伙伴 | n. 动物的配偶 | v. 交配；使交配
definition_en: A friend or someone you share an activity with | An animal's partner for breeding | To breed, or bring animals together to breed
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a close mate.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论亲密的朋友。
example2_en: The author returns to a close mate when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了亲密的朋友。
collocations: a close mate｜亲密的朋友 ; find a mate｜寻找配偶 ; mate for life｜终生配对
tip_zh: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。

meanings_zh: n. 公民 | n. 市民；居民
definition_en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities. | A person who lives in a particular town or city.
example1_en: Our professor circled a senior citizen on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了老年人。
example2_en: The author returns to a senior citizen when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了老年人。
collocations: become a citizen｜成为公民 ; a senior citizen｜老年人 ; a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip_zh: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；主要的 | adj. 小学的；初等教育的 | adj. 最初的；直接的

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；显而易见的

meanings_zh: v. 批准；核准 | v. 赞成；认可

meanings_zh: n. 报告；演示 | n. 呈现方式；外观 | n. 颁发；赠送

meanings_zh: n. 限度；限制 | v. 限制；限定

example2_en: The author returns to speed limit when explaining the conclusion.

meanings_zh: n. 建筑师 | n. 缔造者；设计者
definition_en: Someone whose job is to design buildings | Someone who plans and develops an important change or project

meanings_zh: n. 志向；抱负 | n. 进取心；雄心
definition_en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal. | Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.

meanings_zh: adj. 先进的 | adj. 高级的；高阶的 | adj. 后期的；晚期的

example2_en: The author returns to advanced technology when explaining the conclusion.

meanings_zh: n. 耳机；耳塞式耳机

example2_en: A reading on technological change uses earphone when the author sets up the main claim.

meanings_zh: adj. 尴尬的；难为情的
definition_en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.

example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于因……而难为情的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss embarrassed about.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论因……而难为情的材料。
collocations: feel embarrassed｜感到尴尬 ; embarrassed about｜因……而难为情 ; too embarrassed to ask｜难为情而不敢问
tip_zh: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事令人尴尬用embarrassing。

meanings_zh: v. 使兴奋；使激动 | v. 激起；引发
definition_en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager | to cause a particular feeling or reaction
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to excite interest.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何引起兴趣。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to excite interest.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来引起兴趣。
collocations: excite interest｜引起兴趣 ; excite curiosity｜激起好奇心 ; excite the imagination｜激发想象力
tip_zh: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

meanings_zh: adj. 残忍的；刻薄的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；无情的
definition_en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings. | Causing great suffering or disappointment.

example1_zh: 答疑从刻薄的话开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a cruel remark with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把刻薄的话和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物 ; a cruel remark｜刻薄的话 ; a cruel blow｜沉重的打击

meanings_zh: n. 地图册
definition_en: A book containing maps of the world or particular regions.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on world atlas.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论世界地图册。
example2_en: The reading connects world atlas with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把世界地图册和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: world atlas｜世界地图册 ; historical atlas｜历史地图集 ; road atlas｜公路地图册
tip_zh: atlas是成册的地图；复数为atlases。

meanings_zh: n. 库存；储备 | n. 股票；股份 | v. 备有；供应；储存
definition_en: Goods available for sale or supplies kept for future use. | Shares representing ownership in a company. | To keep goods available for sale or use.
example1_en: I copied out of stock into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把缺货抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to out of stock when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了缺货。
collocations: in stock｜有现货 ; out of stock｜缺货 ; the stock market｜股票市场 ; stock up on food｜囤积食物
tip_zh: 库存通常不可数；表示不同公司的股票时可用stocks。

meanings_zh: n. 陌生人 | n. 初到某地的人；外来者
definition_en: someone you do not know | someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community
example1_en: Office hours began with complete stranger.
example1_zh: 答疑从完全不认识的人开始。
example2_en: The reading connects complete stranger with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把完全不认识的人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: complete stranger｜完全不认识的人 ; stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人 ; no stranger to｜对……并不陌生
tip_zh: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

meanings_zh: n. 选举 | n. 当选
definition_en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives | the act of being chosen for a position by voting
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on general election.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论大选。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around general election.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大选展开说明。
collocations: hold an election｜举行选举 ; general election｜大选 ; election campaign｜竞选活动 ; win an election｜赢得选举
tip_zh: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

meanings_zh: n. 药物 | n. 毒品 | v. 给…下药
definition_en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness. | A substance taken for its effects on mind or body. | To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about prescription drug.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于处方药的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prescription drug.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕处方药展开说明。
collocations: prescription drug｜处方药 ; drug development｜药物研发 ; drug abuse｜毒品滥用 ; drug resistance｜耐药性
tip_zh: 可指治病的药，也可指毒品，须看语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 含酒精的 | adj. 酒精依赖的；酒精引起的 | n. 酒精依赖者
definition_en: Containing alcohol. | Affected by alcohol dependence, or caused by alcohol. | A person who is dependent on alcohol.
example1_en: The textbook introduces alcoholic drinks in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了含酒精饮品。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss alcoholic drinks.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论含酒精饮品的材料。
collocations: alcoholic drinks｜含酒精饮品 ; alcoholic beverages｜酒精饮料 ; alcoholic liver disease｜酒精性肝病
tip_zh: 指人时宜用person with alcohol dependence，更尊重。

meanings_zh: adj. 不公平的；不公正的
definition_en: not treating people equally or reasonably
example1_en: Office hours began with unfair treatment.
example1_zh: 答疑从不公平待遇开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of unfair treatment.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得不公平待遇这个例子。
collocations: unfair treatment｜不公平待遇 ; unfair advantage｜不公平的优势 ; unfair competition｜不公平竞争 ; unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip_zh: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 警探；私人侦探
definition_en: Someone whose job is to investigate crimes or discover facts
example1_en: The textbook introduces private detective in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了私人侦探。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around private detective.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕私人侦探展开说明。
collocations: private detective｜私人侦探 ; detective work｜侦查工作 ; detective novel｜侦探小说
tip_zh: detective novel中detective作名词定语。

meanings_zh: n. 证明；确凿证据 | n. 校样 | adj. 能防……的；耐……的
definition_en: Facts or information showing that something is true. | A printed or digital copy checked before final publication. | Able to resist damage or effects from something.
example1_en: Our professor circled conclusive proof on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了确凿证据。
example2_en: The reading connects conclusive proof with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把确凿证据和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: proof of identity｜身份证明 ; conclusive proof｜确凿证据 ; burden of proof｜举证责任 ; proof against｜能抵御……的
tip_zh: 表示证据时通常不可数；数学证明可用a proof。

meanings_zh: n. 火箭 | v. 飞涨；迅速上升
definition_en: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space | Rise or increase very quickly
example1_en: Our professor circled prices rocket on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了价格飞涨。
example2_en: The author returns to prices rocket when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了价格飞涨。
collocations: launch a rocket｜发射火箭 ; rocket engine｜火箭发动机 ; prices rocket｜价格飞涨
tip_zh: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

meanings_zh: n. 文学；文学作品 | n. 文献；资料
definition_en: Written works valued for their artistic qualities. | Written material about a particular subject.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on English literature.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论英国文学；英语文学。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss English literature.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论英国文学；英语文学的材料。
collocations: English literature｜英国文学；英语文学 ; scientific literature｜科学文献 ; literature review｜文献综述 ; children's literature｜儿童文学
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。

meanings_zh: n. 翻译 | n. 译文；译本
definition_en: The process of expressing meaning in another language. | A spoken or written version in another language.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about accurate translation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于准确的翻译的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss accurate translation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论准确的翻译的材料。
collocations: accurate translation｜准确的翻译 ; machine translation｜机器翻译 ; literal translation｜直译 ; translation into English｜译成英语
tip_zh: 翻译成某语言用into；从某语言翻译用from。

meanings_zh: adj. 不太可能的 | adj. 出人意料的；非典型的
definition_en: Not expected to happen or be true. | Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.

example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论极不可能的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly unlikely.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕极不可能的展开说明。
collocations: unlikely to happen｜不太可能发生 ; highly unlikely｜极不可能的 ; an unlikely friendship｜出人意料的友谊
tip_zh: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

meanings_zh: n. 代金券；兑换券 | n. 凭单；凭证
definition_en: A document exchangeable for goods, services, or a discount. | A document supporting a payment or accounting entry.
example1_en: The textbook introduces gift voucher in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了礼品券。
example2_en: The author returns to gift voucher when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了礼品券。
collocations: gift voucher｜礼品券 ; travel voucher｜旅行代金券 ; redeem a voucher｜兑换代金券 ; payment voucher｜付款凭证
tip_zh: 常用a voucher for；兑换券用redeem a voucher。

meanings_zh: n. 性格；品质；特色 | n. 角色；人物 | n. 字符；文字
definition_en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive | a person represented in a story, play, or film | a written or printed symbol, such as a letter
example1_en: Our professor circled main character on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了主要角色。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss main character.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论主要角色的材料。
collocations: main character｜主要角色 ; strength of character｜坚强品格 ; distinctive character｜独特风貌 ; Chinese characters｜汉字
tip_zh: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性 | n. 可考虑的选择；可能的事
definition_en: the chance that something might happen or be true | something that might happen or could be chosen

example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了确实存在的可能性。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a real possibility.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕确实存在的可能性展开说明。
collocations: a real possibility｜确实存在的可能性 ; the possibility of｜……的可能性 ; explore the possibilities｜探索各种可能的选择 ; rule out the possibility｜排除可能性
tip_zh: 常用possibility of doing或possibility that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 拥抱；抱紧 | n. 拥抱
definition_en: Put your arms around someone and hold them close | An act of holding someone close with your arms
example1_en: I heard the lecturer hug someone tightly during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时紧紧拥抱某人。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to hug someone tightly.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们紧紧拥抱某人。
collocations: give someone a hug｜拥抱某人 ; a warm hug｜温暖的拥抱 ; hug someone tightly｜紧紧拥抱某人
tip_zh: 过去式hugged、现在分词hugging均双写g。

definition_en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论历史建筑。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss historic building.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论历史建筑的材料。
collocations: historic building｜历史建筑 ; historic event｜历史性事件 ; historic landmark｜历史地标 ; historic agreement｜具有历史意义的协议
tip_zh: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。

meanings_zh: n. 化学家；化学研究人员 | n. 药剂师；药店（英式）
definition_en: A scientist who studies chemicals and how they react. | A pharmacist, or a shop that sells medicines, in British English.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about analytical chemist.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于分析化学家的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects analytical chemist with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把分析化学家和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: analytical chemist｜分析化学家 ; research chemist｜化学研究员 ; at the chemist's｜在药店
tip_zh: 英式中还指药剂师；chemist's常指药店。

meanings_zh: n. 元音；元音字母
definition_en: An unrestricted speech sound, or a letter representing such a sound.

example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了长元音。
example2_en: The author returns to long vowel when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了长元音。
collocations: vowel sound｜元音音素 ; long vowel｜长元音 ; short vowel｜短元音
tip_zh: a或an的选择看后接词的首音是否为元音，不看字母。

example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了非常惊讶的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up amazed while discussing evidence about human behavior.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人类行为的证据时提到了非常惊讶的。
collocations: be amazed at｜对……感到惊讶 ; be amazed by｜因……而惊讶 ; be amazed to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip_zh: amazed描述人的感受；amazing描述令人惊讶的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 价值；价格；重要性 | v. 重视；珍惜；估价 | n. 价值观；行为准则
definition_en: the worth, price, or importance of something | consider something important or estimate how much it is worth | beliefs about what is right and important in life
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about property value.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于房产价值的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of property value.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得房产价值这个例子。
collocations: value for money｜物有所值 ; place a high value on｜高度重视 ; property value｜房产价值 ; shared values｜共同价值观
tip_zh: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

meanings_zh: n. 建筑学；建筑设计 | n. 建筑风格 | n. 系统架构
definition_en: The art and practice of designing buildings. | The style and appearance of buildings. | The way a computer system or other complex structure is organised.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about modern architecture.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于现代建筑的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around modern architecture.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕现代建筑展开说明。
collocations: modern architecture｜现代建筑 ; sustainable architecture｜可持续建筑设计 ; software architecture｜软件架构
tip_zh: architecture通常不可数；architect指建筑师。

meanings_zh: adj. 自私的；只顾自己的

example2_en: A campus survey used selfish behaviour to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用自私的行为来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: selfish behaviour｜自私的行为 ; selfish motives｜自私的动机 ; selfish of someone｜某人这样做很自私

meanings_zh: n. 办事员；文员 | n. 店员；接待员
definition_en: someone whose job involves records, documents, or routine office tasks | someone serving customers in a shop or at a desk
example1_en: The textbook introduces office clerk in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了办公室文员。
example2_en: The author returns to office clerk when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了办公室文员。
collocations: office clerk｜办公室文员 ; bank clerk｜银行职员 ; desk clerk｜接待员 ; court clerk｜法院书记员
tip_zh: 英式读音中元音为/ɑː/；美式常指店员。

meanings_zh: n. 装置；设备 | n. 手法；策略
definition_en: an object or machine designed for a particular purpose | a method used to achieve an effect or particular result
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an electronic device.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电子设备。
example2_en: A campus survey used an electronic device to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用电子设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: an electronic device｜电子设备 ; a medical device｜医疗设备 ; a safety device｜安全装置 ; a literary device｜文学手法

meanings_zh: v. 表达；表露 | adj. 快速的；特快的 | adj. 明确的；明示的
definition_en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion. | Providing a faster service than usual. | Clearly and directly stated.

example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须表示担忧。

meanings_zh: n. 优惠券；赠券 | n. 债券息票；票面利息
definition_en: A ticket or code giving a discount or free item. | An interest payment on a bond, or its claiming slip.

example1_zh: 答疑从折扣券开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around discount coupon.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕折扣券展开说明。

example2_en: A campus survey used a clear definition to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用明确的定义来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了生活水平。

example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers punish severely before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要严厉惩罚。
collocations: punish someone for something｜因某事惩罚某人 ; punish severely｜严厉惩罚 ; punish offenders｜处罚违法者
tip_zh: punish sb for sth表示因某事惩罚某人。

meanings_zh: n. 有礼貌的男士；绅士 | n. 先生；男士
definition_en: A man who behaves politely and considers other people. | A polite or formal way to refer to a man.
example1_en: Our professor circled a perfect gentleman on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了十足的绅士。
example2_en: The reading connects a perfect gentleman with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把十足的绅士和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a perfect gentleman｜十足的绅士 ; an elderly gentleman｜年长的先生 ; ladies and gentlemen｜女士们、先生们
tip_zh: 复数为gentlemen；正式称呼男性时未必强调品行。

meanings_zh: v. 持续隐痛 | n. 持续的隐痛 | v. 渴望；向往
definition_en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp | a steady pain that lasts for some time | to want something very deeply
example1_en: The lab instructions say to ache for.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求渴望。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to ache for.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得渴望。
collocations: a dull ache｜隐隐作痛 ; aches and pains｜各种酸痛 ; ache for｜渴望
tip_zh: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。

meanings_zh: adj. 相等的；平等的 | v. 等于；比得上 | n. 同等的人；匹敌者
definition_en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity. | To be the same in quantity, value, or quality. | Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on equal opportunities.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论平等机会。
example2_en: A campus survey used equal opportunities to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用平等机会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: equal opportunities｜平等机会 ; equal access｜平等的使用机会 ; equal to｜等于；胜任 ; treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip_zh: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

meanings_zh: v. 捐赠；捐献
definition_en: To give money, goods, or blood to help others
example1_en: I heard the lecturer donate money to charity during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时向慈善机构捐款。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers donate money to charity before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要向慈善机构捐款。
collocations: donate money to charity｜向慈善机构捐款 ; donate blood｜献血 ; donate organs｜捐献器官
tip_zh: 用donate something to someone，不用双宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 退休；退役 | v. 退出比赛
definition_en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age. | To leave a competition before finishing it.
example1_en: The assignment is to retire early, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先提前退休，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to retire early.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来提前退休。
collocations: retire early｜提前退休 ; retire from work｜退休 ; retire from a race｜退出比赛
tip_zh: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。

meanings_zh: v. 引用；引述 | v. 报价 | n. 引文；报价
definition_en: To repeat someone's exact words in speech or writing. | To state the price you will charge for something. | Repeated words from a source, or a stated price.
example1_en: The assignment is to quote a source, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先引用来源，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to quote a source.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得引用来源。
collocations: quote a source｜引用来源 ; quote someone a price｜向某人报价 ; a direct quote｜直接引语 ; get a quote｜获取报价
tip_zh: quote引用原话；paraphrase用自己的话转述。

meanings_zh: n. 引语；引用 | n. 报价；报价单
definition_en: words repeated exactly from another person or source | a statement of the expected price of goods or services
example1_en: Office hours began with a quotation from.
example1_zh: 答疑从引自……的话开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a quotation from with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把引自……的话和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a quotation from｜引自……的话 ; quotation marks｜引号 ; request a quotation｜索取报价 ; provide a quotation｜提供报价
tip_zh: 引语来自某人或作品用from；报价常接for。

meanings_zh: n. 手腕；腕关节
definition_en: The joint connecting your hand to your arm.
example1_en: Our professor circled sprain your wrist on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了扭伤手腕。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sprain your wrist.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论扭伤手腕的材料。
collocations: a wrist injury｜手腕损伤 ; sprain your wrist｜扭伤手腕 ; a wrist support｜护腕
tip_zh: 开头的w不发音；手腕是wrist，脚踝是ankle。

meanings_zh: n. 副词
definition_en: a word modifying a verb, adjective, adverb, or whole sentence
example1_en: Our professor circled adverb of frequency on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了频率副词。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around adverb of frequency.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕频率副词展开说明。
collocations: adverb of frequency｜频率副词 ; adverb of manner｜方式副词 ; adverb placement｜副词的位置
tip_zh: adverb是名词；表示“副词的”用adverbial。

meanings_zh: n. 国家；国民 | n. 民族
definition_en: A country considered together with its people | A people united by shared history, culture, or language
example1_en: I copied developing nation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把发展中国家抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around developing nation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕发展中国家展开说明。
collocations: developing nation｜发展中国家 ; the entire nation｜全国人民 ; host nation｜东道国 ; nation building｜国家建设
tip_zh: nation强调国家及人民，state常强调政权或政治实体。

meanings_zh: v. 表演；演出 | v. 执行；履行 | v. 表现；运转
definition_en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music | to carry out a task, action, or duty | to work or achieve results in a particular way
example1_en: The professor asked us to perform on stage.
example1_zh: 教授让我们登台表演。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to perform on stage.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得登台表演。
collocations: perform on stage｜登台表演 ; perform a task｜执行任务 ; perform well｜表现出色 ; perform surgery｜实施手术
tip_zh: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

meanings_zh: n. 重要性
definition_en: The quality of having great value or a strong effect.
example1_en: Our professor circled attach importance to on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了重视。
example2_en: A campus survey used attach importance to to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用重视来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: attach importance to｜重视 ; of great importance｜非常重要的 ; recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip_zh: importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。

meanings_zh: v. 打算；计划 | v. 意欲；为某用途而设计
definition_en: To have a plan or purpose in mind. | To mean something or design it for a particular purpose.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to intend to do something.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须打算做某事。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to intend to do something.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来打算做某事。
collocations: intend to do something｜打算做某事 ; be intended for｜供……使用 ; be intended to｜旨在
tip_zh: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。

meanings_zh: adj. 疼痛的；酸痛的 | n. 疮；溃疡 | adj. 恼怒的；不快的
definition_en: painful, especially when touched or moved | a painful damaged area on the skin | upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about sore throat.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于咽喉痛的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects sore throat with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把咽喉痛和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: sore throat｜咽喉痛 ; sore muscles｜肌肉酸痛 ; feel sore｜感到酸痛
tip_zh: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

meanings_zh: n. 预测；预言
definition_en: A statement about what is expected to happen in the future.
example1_en: Our professor circled accurate prediction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了准确的预测。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around accurate prediction.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕准确的预测展开说明。
collocations: make a prediction｜作出预测 ; accurate prediction｜准确的预测 ; prediction model｜预测模型 ; prediction comes true｜预测成真
tip_zh: 作出预测用make a prediction，不用do。

meanings_zh: n. 数字；数值 | n. 人物；人影；身形 | v. 认为；估计
definition_en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information | a person, their outline, or the shape of their body | to think or decide something after considering it
example1_en: Our professor circled a leading figure on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了领军人物。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a leading figure.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得领军人物这个例子。
collocations: sales figures｜销售数据 ; a leading figure｜领军人物 ; figure out｜弄清楚 ; a rough figure｜大致数值
tip_zh: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

meanings_zh: n. 盒式磁带；卡带
definition_en: a plastic case containing magnetic tape for recording sound
example1_en: The textbook introduces audio cassette in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了录音磁带。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss audio cassette.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论录音磁带的材料。
collocations: cassette tape｜盒式磁带 ; cassette player｜盒式磁带播放器 ; audio cassette｜录音磁带
tip_zh: 注意重音在第二音节；播放器叫cassette player。

meanings_zh: n. 青年时期；青春 | n. 青年群体 | n. 年轻男子
definition_en: the period of life when someone is young | young people considered as a group | a young man, especially a teenager
example1_en: The textbook introduces youth unemployment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了青年失业。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of youth unemployment.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得青年失业这个例子。
collocations: in one's youth｜在某人年轻时 ; youth unemployment｜青年失业 ; youth centre｜青年活动中心
tip_zh: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

meanings_zh: n. 风俗；惯例 | adj. 定制的 | n. 惠顾；光顾
definition_en: a traditional or usual way of behaving | made to meet a particular customer's needs | the business customers give to a shop or company
example1_en: The textbook introduces an ancient custom in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了古老的习俗。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an ancient custom.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古老的习俗的材料。
collocations: local customs｜当地风俗 ; an ancient custom｜古老的习俗 ; custom furniture｜定制家具 ; regular custom｜经常光顾
tip_zh: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

meanings_zh: adj. 极有吸引力的；迷人的
definition_en: so interesting that it holds your attention completely
example1_en: The textbook introduces absolutely fascinating in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了极其迷人的。
example2_en: The author returns to absolutely fascinating when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极其迷人的。
collocations: absolutely fascinating｜极其迷人的 ; fascinating insight｜引人入胜的见解 ; fascinating discovery｜令人着迷的发现
tip_zh: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人着迷用fascinated。

meanings_zh: n. 力；力量 | v. 强迫；迫使 | n. 武力；暴力
definition_en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape | to make someone do something against their wishes | physical strength used to control or overpower someone
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on gravitational force.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论引力。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss gravitational force.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论引力的材料。
collocations: force someone to do something｜迫使某人做某事 ; by force｜用武力 ; gravitational force｜引力 ; labour force｜劳动力
tip_zh: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

meanings_zh: n. 谋杀犯
definition_en: Someone who deliberately and unlawfully kills another person.
example1_en: I copied convicted murderer into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把已定罪的谋杀犯抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used convicted murderer to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用已定罪的谋杀犯来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: convicted murderer｜已定罪的谋杀犯 ; identify the murderer｜查明谋杀犯身份 ; catch a murderer｜抓获谋杀犯
tip_zh: 指故意非法杀人者；killer的含义更广。

meanings_zh: n. 频道；渠道 | n. 水道；海峡 | v. 引导；将…用于
definition_en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things | A passage of water connecting areas or allowing boats through | Direct energy, money, or resources towards a particular purpose
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a television channel.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电视频道的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a television channel with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把电视频道和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a television channel｜电视频道 ; communication channels｜沟通渠道 ; a shipping channel｜航道 ; channel resources into｜将资源投入
tip_zh: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

meanings_zh: n. 恋爱；爱情；浪漫情调 | n. 爱情小说；爱情电影
definition_en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love | a story or film mainly about love
example1_en: Office hours began with a holiday romance.
example1_zh: 答疑从假日恋情开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a holiday romance.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论假日恋情的材料。
collocations: a holiday romance｜假日恋情 ; a whirlwind romance｜迅速发展的恋情 ; a sense of romance｜浪漫感
tip_zh: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 有用的；有价值的 | adj. 贵重的；值钱的
definition_en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose. | Worth a large amount of money.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on valuable experience.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论宝贵经验。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around valuable experience.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宝贵经验展开说明。
collocations: valuable experience｜宝贵经验 ; valuable advice｜宝贵建议 ; a valuable contribution｜重要贡献 ; valuable jewellery｜贵重珠宝
tip_zh: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。

meanings_zh: adj. 历史的；有关历史的
definition_en: connected with history or events in the past
example1_en: Our professor circled historical records on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了历史记录。
example2_en: The author returns to historical records when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了历史记录。
collocations: historical records｜历史记录 ; historical evidence｜历史证据 ; historical context｜历史背景 ; historical novel｜历史小说
tip_zh: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。

meanings_zh: n. 手术 | n. 运行；运作；经营 | n. 有组织的行动
definition_en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body. | The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business. | A planned activity involving several people working together.
example1_en: Our professor circled rescue operation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了救援行动。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around rescue operation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕救援行动展开说明。
collocations: have an operation｜接受手术 ; perform an operation｜做手术 ; in operation｜运行中 ; rescue operation｜救援行动
tip_zh: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

meanings_zh: n. 信任；信赖 | v. 信任；相信 | n. 信托；信托机构
definition_en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe. | To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe. | An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about mutual trust.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于相互信任的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mutual trust.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论相互信任的材料。
collocations: build trust｜建立信任 ; trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事 ; mutual trust｜相互信任 ; a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip_zh: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 一场；一次活动时间 | n. 会议；开庭期
definition_en: a period spent doing a particular activity | a formal meeting or period when an official body meets
example1_en: The textbook introduces a training session in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一次训练。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a training session.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一次训练的材料。
collocations: a training session｜一次训练 ; a revision session｜一次复习 ; a question-and-answer session｜问答环节 ; in session｜正在开会；正在开庭
tip_zh: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。

meanings_zh: v. 投票；表决 | n. 选票；投票；表决
definition_en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision. | A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.
example1_en: The professor asked us to vote for.
example1_zh: 教授让我们投票支持。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to vote for.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得投票支持。
collocations: vote for｜投票支持 ; vote against｜投票反对 ; cast a vote｜投票 ; the right to vote｜投票权
tip_zh: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

meanings_zh: v. 原谅；宽恕 | v. 免除债务
definition_en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did. | Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.
example1_en: The assignment is to forgive a mistake, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先原谅错误，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers forgive a mistake before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要原谅错误。
collocations: forgive someone for something｜原谅某人某事 ; forgive a mistake｜原谅错误 ; forgive a debt｜免除债务
tip_zh: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。

meanings_zh: adj. 慷慨的；大方的 | adj. 充足的；大量的
definition_en: willing to give money, time, or help freely | larger or more plentiful than usual or expected
example1_en: I copied generous donation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把慷慨捐助抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around generous donation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕慷慨捐助展开说明。
collocations: generous donation｜慷慨捐助 ; generous portion｜丰盛的一份 ; generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip_zh: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

meanings_zh: n. 洪水；水灾 | v. 淹没；被水淹 | n. 大量涌来的人或事物
definition_en: Water covering land that is normally dry. | To cover with water or become covered with water. | A large amount of something arriving at once.
example1_en: Our professor circled flash flood on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了山洪；暴洪。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of flash flood.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得山洪；暴洪这个例子。
collocations: flash flood｜山洪；暴洪 ; flood defences｜防洪设施 ; flood damage｜洪灾损失 ; a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip_zh: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

meanings_zh: adj. 摄氏的
definition_en: Using the temperature scale with water freezing at zero
example1_en: The textbook introduces degrees centigrade in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了摄氏度。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of degrees centigrade.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得摄氏度这个例子。
collocations: degrees centigrade｜摄氏度 ; centigrade scale｜摄氏温标
tip_zh: 通常说degrees centigrade；现代科学更常用Celsius。

meanings_zh: n. 几何学
definition_en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on plane geometry.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论平面几何。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of plane geometry.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得平面几何这个例子。
collocations: plane geometry｜平面几何 ; solid geometry｜立体几何 ; study geometry｜学习几何
tip_zh: 学科名，不可数；通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 气氛；氛围 | n. 大气；大气层
definition_en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation | the mixture of gases surrounding a planet
example1_en: Office hours began with relaxed atmosphere.
example1_zh: 答疑从轻松的氛围开始。
example2_en: The reading connects relaxed atmosphere with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把轻松的氛围和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: relaxed atmosphere｜轻松的氛围 ; create an atmosphere｜营造氛围 ; Earth's atmosphere｜地球大气层
tip_zh: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

meanings_zh: n. 地方议会；委员会
definition_en: A group chosen to govern an area or manage affairs.
example1_en: I copied local council into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把地方议会抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used local council to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用地方议会来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: local council｜地方议会 ; city council｜市议会 ; council member｜议会成员 ; student council｜学生会
tip_zh: council指议会或委员会；counsel指建议或劝告。

meanings_zh: v. 分析；仔细研究
definition_en: Examine something carefully to understand its parts or meaning.
example1_en: We will analyze the survey before Friday's seminar.
example1_zh: 我们会在周五研讨课之前分析这份问卷。
example2_en: The lecture showed how to analyze a graph before trusting the speaker's conclusion.
example2_zh: 讲座演示了如何在相信讲者的结论之前先分析图表。
collocations: analyze data｜分析数据 ; analyze results｜分析结果 ; analyze a problem｜分析问题
tip_zh: 美式拼写为analyze，英式通常写analyse。

meanings_zh: n. 证据；迹象 | v. 表明；证明
definition_en: Facts or signs that help establish whether something is true. | To show clearly that something exists or is true.
example1_en: The essay needs evidence, not just an opinion.
example1_zh: 这篇文章需要证据，不能只有观点。
example2_en: The professor said the evidence supports the claim but does not prove it.
example2_zh: 教授说这些证据支持该主张，但并不能证明它。
collocations: strong evidence｜有力证据 ; scientific evidence｜科学证据 ; evidence of｜……的证据 ; provide evidence｜提供证据
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

meanings_zh: adj. 重大的；显著的 | adj. 意味深长的
definition_en: large or important enough to deserve attention | expressing a meaning that is not directly stated
example1_en: The difference was too small to be significant.
example1_zh: 这个差异太小，算不上显著。
example2_en: A significant result still needs a clear explanation of why the change happened.
example2_zh: 一个显著的结果仍然需要清楚解释变化为什么会发生。
collocations: a significant increase｜显著增长 ; a significant impact｜重大影响 ; statistically significant｜统计上显著的 ; a significant glance｜意味深长的一瞥
tip_zh: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。

meanings_zh: n. 背景；具体环境 | n. 上下文；语境
definition_en: The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it. | The surrounding words that help explain a word or statement.
example1_en: Read the sentence in context before you choose.
example1_zh: 选择之前，先在上下文里读这个句子。
example2_en: The meaning of the term shifts with the context of the discipline that uses it.
example2_zh: 这个术语的含义会随使用它的学科语境而变化。
collocations: in context｜结合背景；在语境中 ; out of context｜脱离上下文 ; historical context｜历史背景 ; social context｜社会背景
tip_zh: out of context指脱离语境，常用于断章取义。

meanings_zh: n. 因素；要素 | v. 把…计入考虑
definition_en: something that influences a result or situation | to include something when calculating or making a decision
example1_en: Cost was the main factor in their decision.
example1_zh: 费用是他们做决定时的主要因素。
example2_en: The study isolated one factor so the others would not confuse the result.
example2_zh: 这项研究分离出一个因素，以免其他因素干扰结果。
collocations: key factor｜关键因素 ; contributing factor｜促成因素 ; risk factor｜风险因素 ; factor in the cost｜把成本考虑在内
tip_zh: 动词常用factor in，表示把某因素考虑在内。

meanings_zh: n. 概念；观念
definition_en: an idea or principle used to understand or plan something
example1_en: The concept is easier with a concrete example.
example1_zh: 有了具体例子，这个概念就更容易理解。
example2_en: The lecture built the concept step by step from an everyday campus situation.
example2_zh: 讲座从一个日常的校园情境出发，一步步建立这个概念。
collocations: basic concept｜基本概念 ; grasp a concept｜理解概念 ; the concept of｜……的概念 ; abstract concept｜抽象概念
tip_zh: 可数名词；常用the concept of引出具体概念。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；处理方式 | v. 接近；靠近 | v. 着手处理；接洽
definition_en: A way of dealing with a task or problem. | To move nearer to someone or something. | To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.
example1_en: Her approach to the problem was simple and direct.
example1_zh: 她处理这个问题的方法简单直接。
example2_en: The two teams took a different approach and therefore measured different things.
example2_zh: 两组采用了不同的方法，因此测量的东西也不一样。
collocations: an approach to learning｜学习方法 ; adopt an approach｜采用一种方法 ; approach a problem｜着手处理问题 ; approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip_zh: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 数据；资料
definition_en: facts or information collected for analysis or computer use
example1_en: Back up the data before you leave the lab.
example1_zh: 离开实验室之前先备份数据。
example2_en: The data in the chart come from one campus and may not describe other colleges.
example2_zh: 图表中的数据来自一所学校，未必能描述其他大学。
collocations: collect data｜收集数据 ; analyse data｜分析数据 ; personal data｜个人数据 ; data protection｜数据保护
tip_zh: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

meanings_zh: v. 假定；想当然地认为 | v. 承担；就任 | v. 呈现；具有
definition_en: To accept something as true without having proof. | To take on a duty, responsibility, or position. | To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.
example1_en: Do not assume the graph starts at zero.
example1_zh: 不要假定这张图的起点是零。
example2_en: Readers may assume a cause when the passage only shows that two trends happened together.
example2_zh: 文章只说明两种趋势同时出现时，读者却可能假定其中有因果关系。
collocations: assume that｜假定…… ; assume responsibility｜承担责任 ; assume office｜就任
tip_zh: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

meanings_zh: v. 解释；理解 | v. 口译
definition_en: To explain or understand the meaning of something | To translate someone's speech into another language as they speak
example1_en: Interpret the result before you write the discussion.
example1_zh: 写讨论部分之前，先解释结果。
example2_en: Two scholars can interpret the same passage and still defend different claims.
example2_zh: 两位学者可以解释同一段文字，却仍然为不同的主张辩护。
collocations: interpret data｜解读数据 ; interpret something as｜将某事理解为 ; interpret for someone｜为某人口译
tip_zh: interpret可指口译；笔译通常用translate。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评价
definition_en: Carefully judge the quality, value or effectiveness of something
example1_en: Evaluate the source before you cite it.
example1_zh: 引用之前先评估来源。
example2_en: The assignment asks you to evaluate the method, not only to praise the finding.
example2_zh: 这份作业要求你评估方法，而不是只称赞研究发现。
collocations: evaluate the impact｜评估影响 ; evaluate effectiveness｜评估有效性 ; evaluate performance｜评估表现 ; critically evaluate｜批判性地评估
tip_zh: 强调依据标准作判断；不只是描述事物。

meanings_zh: n. 偏见；偏向 | n. 偏差 | v. 使产生偏见；使偏向
definition_en: an unfair preference for or against a person or group | a systematic distortion that makes research results less accurate | to unfairly influence someone's judgement or a study's results
example1_en: A small sample can hide a serious bias.
example1_zh: 样本太小会掩盖严重的偏差。
example2_en: The professor warned that personal bias can shape which studies a writer chooses to cite.
example2_zh: 教授提醒，个人偏见会影响作者选择引用哪些研究。
collocations: bias against｜对……的偏见 ; gender bias｜性别偏见 ; sampling bias｜抽样偏差 ; unconscious bias｜无意识偏见
tip_zh: bias against 指对……有偏见；in favour of 指偏袒。

meanings_zh: n. 心理学 | n. 心理特点；心理状态
definition_en: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour. | The characteristic ways a person or group thinks and behaves.
example1_en: She is taking an introductory psychology course.
example1_zh: 她在上一门心理学入门课。
example2_en: The psychology lecture compared how memory works in the lab and in everyday life.
example2_zh: 这节心理学讲座比较了记忆在实验室和日常生活中的运作方式。
collocations: clinical psychology｜临床心理学 ; educational psychology｜教育心理学 ; consumer psychology｜消费者心理 ; study psychology｜学习心理学
tip_zh: 开头的p不发音；psychologist指心理学家。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；视角 | n. 透视法 | n. 客观判断力
definition_en: A particular way of considering a situation or issue. | A drawing technique that makes objects appear realistically distant. | The ability to judge the relative importance of things.
example1_en: The discussion added a historical perspective.
example1_zh: 这次讨论补充了一个历史视角。
example2_en: A second perspective can show a limit in the theory that insiders no longer notice.
example2_zh: 第二个视角能揭示圈内人已经注意不到的理论局限。
collocations: from a different perspective｜从不同视角 ; broaden your perspective｜拓宽视野 ; put things into perspective｜客观看待事物 ; a sense of perspective｜透视感；分寸感
tip_zh: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 结果；后果 | n. 重要性
definition_en: Something that happens because of an action or situation. | The quality of being important or worth considering.
example1_en: One consequence of the policy is longer commutes.
example1_zh: 这项政策的一个后果是通勤时间变长。
example2_en: The author treats the drought as a consequence of warmer seasons, not as an isolated event.
example2_zh: 作者把这场干旱视为暖季的后果，而不是孤立事件。
collocations: as a consequence｜因此 ; face the consequences｜面对后果 ; of little consequence｜无关紧要
tip_zh: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

meanings_zh: adj. 抽象的 | adj. 抽象艺术的 | n. 摘要
definition_en: relating to ideas rather than physical objects or specific examples | using shapes and colours rather than realistic images | a short summary of a research paper or other document
example1_en: The idea is too abstract without an example.
example1_zh: 没有例子的话，这个想法太抽象了。
example2_en: An abstract of the paper states the question, the method, and the main result.
example2_zh: 论文摘要会写明问题、方法和主要结果。
collocations: an abstract concept｜抽象概念 ; abstract art｜抽象艺术 ; abstract thinking｜抽象思维 ; a research abstract｜研究摘要
tip_zh: 形容词和名词重音在首音节；动词重音在后。

meanings_zh: n. 理论；学说 | n. 推测；看法 | n. 理论知识
definition_en: an organized explanation of facts or how something works | an idea offered to explain something, not yet proved | the principles of a subject rather than their practical application
example1_en: The professor introduced the theory with a simple case.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简单案例介绍了这个理论。
example2_en: A useful theory lets researchers predict what a new experiment should find.
example2_zh: 一个有用的理论能让研究者预测新实验应当发现什么。
collocations: in theory｜理论上 ; support a theory｜支持一种理论 ; test a theory｜检验一种理论 ; theory and practice｜理论与实践
tip_zh: in theory意为“理论上”，常与in practice对比。

meanings_zh: v. 强调；着重
definition_en: To give special importance to something.
example1_en: The professor emphasized the definition, not the anecdote.
example1_zh: 教授强调的是定义，不是那个轶事。
example2_en: Writers emphasize a contrast by placing the two claims in neighboring sentences.
example2_zh: 作者把两个主张放在相邻的句子里，以强调对比。
collocations: emphasize the importance of｜强调…的重要性 ; emphasize that｜强调说
tip_zh: 美式拼写 emphasize；英式常用 emphasise。托福写作用美式即可。

meanings_zh: adj. 一致的；一贯的
definition_en: Always acting or happening in the same way, or in agreement with something.
example1_en: Her lab notes were consistent from week to week.
example1_zh: 她的实验笔记一周又一周都保持一致。
example2_en: The result is consistent with the hypothesis, but it does not prove it.
example2_zh: 结果与假说一致，但并不能证明假说。
collocations: consistent with｜与…一致 ; a consistent pattern｜一贯的模式
tip_zh: 表示“与…相符”用 consistent with，不是 consistent to。

meanings_zh: n. 现象
definition_en: A fact or event that can be observed and studied.
example1_en: The lab treats the flicker as a phenomenon, not as a broken lamp.
example1_zh: 实验室把这种闪烁当作一种现象，而不是坏掉的灯。
example2_en: The lecture asked which phenomenon the graph was actually measuring.
example2_zh: 讲座问这张图实际上在测量哪一种现象。
collocations: a natural phenomenon｜自然现象 ; explain a phenomenon｜解释一种现象
tip_zh: 复数是 phenomena，不是 phenomenons。

meanings_zh: n. 感知；看法
definition_en: The way someone notices or understands something.
example1_en: Lighting in the lab can change visual perception.
example1_zh: 实验室的光线会改变视觉感知。
example2_en: The study measured perception of risk, not the risk itself.
example2_zh: 这项研究测量的是对风险的感知，而不是风险本身。
collocations: visual perception｜视觉感知 ; public perception｜公众看法
tip_zh: 作“看法”时，后面常用 of。

meanings_zh: n. 抄袭；剽窃
definition_en: Using someone else's words or ideas as your own without credit.
example1_en: The syllabus says plagiarism can mean a failing grade.
example1_zh: 教学大纲写明抄袭可能导致课程不及格。
example2_en: Changing a few words does not prevent plagiarism if the structure is still copied.
example2_zh: 如果结构仍是抄来的，只改几个词也不能避免抄袭。
collocations: commit plagiarism｜抄袭 ; plagiarism policy｜抄袭处理规定
tip_zh: 学术写作里，引用是 citation，抄袭是 plagiarism。

meanings_zh: v. 激励；激发积极性 | v. 成为……的动机
definition_en: to make someone eager to do something | to provide the reason for someone's actions
example1_en: The lab instructions say to motivate someone to do something.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求激励某人做某事。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to motivate someone to do something.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们激励某人做某事。
collocations: motivate someone to do something｜激励某人做某事 ; highly motivated｜积极性很高的 ; be motivated by｜出于……的动机
tip_zh: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。

meanings_zh: n. 恼怒；烦躁 | n. 刺激；发炎不适
definition_en: the feeling of being annoyed | soreness or discomfort in a part of the body
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about skin irritation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于皮肤刺激的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss skin irritation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论皮肤刺激的材料。
collocations: skin irritation｜皮肤刺激 ; eye irritation｜眼部刺激 ; a source of irritation｜令人恼火的事物
tip_zh: 既可指情绪上的恼怒，也可指皮肤等受到刺激。

meanings_zh: n. 坑；深洞 | n. 赛车维修区 | n. 果核
definition_en: A large hole in the ground | An area where racing cars stop for servicing | The hard central part of certain fruits
example1_en: I copied a deep pit into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把深坑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a deep pit.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得深坑这个例子。
collocations: dig a pit｜挖坑 ; a deep pit｜深坑 ; a pit stop｜赛车进站检修 ; a peach pit｜桃核
tip_zh: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 哲学 | n. 人生观；指导理念
definition_en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values | A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about moral philosophy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于道德哲学的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects moral philosophy with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把道德哲学和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: study philosophy｜学习哲学 ; moral philosophy｜道德哲学 ; personal philosophy｜个人处世哲学 ; philosophy of education｜教育哲学
tip_zh: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

meanings_zh: n. 预测；预报 | v. 预测；预报
definition_en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future. | To say what will probably happen, using available information.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on weather forecast.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论天气预报。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of weather forecast.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得天气预报这个例子。
collocations: weather forecast｜天气预报 ; economic forecast｜经济预测 ; forecast growth｜预测增长 ; forecast demand｜预测需求
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

meanings_zh: n. 商标 | n. 标志性特征 | v. 将……注册为商标
