definition_en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products. | A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something. | To register a name or symbol for legal protection.
example1_en: Office hours began with registered trademark.
example1_zh: 答疑从注册商标开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of registered trademark.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得注册商标这个例子。
collocations: registered trademark｜注册商标 ; trademark protection｜商标保护 ; trademark infringement｜商标侵权 ; trademark smile｜标志性笑容
tip_zh: 商标用trademark；版权用copyright，保护对象不同。

meanings_zh: adj. 亲切友善的；易于交谈的 | adj. 易懂的；容易欣赏的
definition_en: friendly and easy to talk to | easy to understand or enjoy without special knowledge
example1_en: Our professor circled friendly and approachable on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了友善且平易近人的。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of friendly and approachable.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得友善且平易近人的这个例子。
collocations: an approachable teacher｜亲切的老师 ; friendly and approachable｜友善且平易近人的 ; an approachable style｜浅显易懂的风格
tip_zh: 形容人时重在容易交谈、让人敢于求助。

meanings_zh: v. 释放；放出 | v. 发布；发行 | n. 释放；发布；发行物
definition_en: To let someone or something go free or escape. | To make information or a product available to the public. | The act of freeing or publishing; something newly made available.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to release a report.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发布报告。
example2_en: The passage says students who can release a report follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够发布报告的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: release a report｜发布报告 ; release a prisoner｜释放囚犯 ; release gases｜释放气体 ; a press release｜新闻稿
tip_zh: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 感人的；动人的 | v. 触摸；碰（现在分词）
definition_en: making you feel affection, sympathy, or gentle sadness | putting a hand or another body part against something
example1_en: Our professor circled a touching story on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了感人的故事。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a touching story.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得感人的故事这个例子。
collocations: a touching story｜感人的故事 ; a touching gesture｜暖心的举动 ; a touching tribute｜感人的致敬
tip_zh: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感动。

meanings_zh: n. 新手；初学者
definition_en: someone with little experience in a particular activity
example1_en: Our professor circled a complete novice on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了完全的新手。
example2_en: The reading connects a complete novice with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把完全的新手和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a complete novice｜完全的新手 ; a novice driver｜新手司机 ; a novice at｜……方面的新手
tip_zh: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

meanings_zh: n. 托儿所；幼儿园 | n. 苗圃 | n. 婴儿室；儿童房
definition_en: a place where young children are cared for | a place where young plants are grown for sale | a room in a home for a baby or young child
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on plant nursery.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论苗圃。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around plant nursery.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕苗圃展开说明。
collocations: nursery school｜幼儿园 ; nursery staff｜托幼工作人员 ; plant nursery｜苗圃 ; nursery rhyme｜童谣
tip_zh: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。

meanings_zh: n. 学者 | n. 奖学金获得者
definition_en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject. | A student awarded money to study because of their abilities.
example1_en: I copied a leading scholar into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把杰出学者抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a leading scholar.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得杰出学者这个例子。
collocations: a leading scholar｜杰出学者 ; a visiting scholar｜访问学者 ; a distinguished scholar｜著名学者
tip_zh: scholar通常指学者，不是普通学生。

meanings_zh: n. 公众集会 | v. 集结；团结支持 | v. 恢复；振作；回升
definition_en: A large public meeting supporting a cause or expressing opinions. | To gather people together to support someone or something. | To regain strength or improve after a difficult period.
example1_en: Office hours began with rally support.
example1_zh: 答疑从争取支持开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around rally support.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕争取支持展开说明。
collocations: hold a rally｜举行集会 ; rally support｜争取支持 ; rally around someone｜团结起来支持某人
tip_zh: rally support for表示“为……争取支持”。

meanings_zh: n. 一致性；稳定性 | n. 稠度；黏稠度
definition_en: The quality of staying similar in behaviour, standards, or results. | How thick, firm, or smooth a substance is.
example1_en: Our professor circled maintain consistency on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了保持一致性。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss maintain consistency.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论保持一致性的材料。
collocations: consistency in quality｜质量的稳定性 ; maintain consistency｜保持一致性 ; a smooth consistency｜细腻均匀的质地
tip_zh: 表示某方面的一致性用 consistency in。

meanings_zh: n. 提及；涉及 | n. 参考；引文出处 | n. 推荐信；证明人
definition_en: a mention of someone or something | consultation for information, or a source used in writing | a recommendation or someone who recommends you for work
example1_en: The professor explained reference with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了提及。
example2_en: Students who can explain reference usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释提及的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: make reference to｜提及 ; for future reference｜供日后参考 ; provide a reference｜提供推荐信
tip_zh: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

meanings_zh: n. 乐观；乐观态度
definition_en: The belief that good things will happen.
example1_en: Office hours began with cautious optimism.
example1_zh: 答疑从谨慎乐观开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cautious optimism.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论谨慎乐观的材料。
collocations: cautious optimism｜谨慎乐观 ; optimism about the future｜对未来的乐观态度 ; grounds for optimism｜乐观的理由
tip_zh: 不可数名词；对某事乐观常用optimism about。

meanings_zh: n. 原则；行为准则 | n. 原理；基本法则
definition_en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour. | A basic truth explaining how something works.
example1_en: I copied basic principle into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把基本原则；基本原理抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects basic principle with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把基本原则；基本原理和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: basic principle｜基本原则；基本原理 ; in principle｜原则上；理论上 ; on principle｜出于原则 ; guiding principle｜指导原则
tip_zh: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。

meanings_zh: v. 实施；执行 | n. 工具；器具
definition_en: to put a plan or decision into action | a tool used for a particular task
example1_en: The assignment is to implement a policy, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先实施政策，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to implement a policy and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你实施政策，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: implement a policy｜实施政策 ; implement a plan｜执行计划 ; agricultural implements｜农具
tip_zh: 动词重音在首音节；名词末音节读/mənt/。

meanings_zh: v. 确保；保证
definition_en: To make certain that something happens or is true
example1_en: The assignment is to ensure safety, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先确保安全，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can ensure safety follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够确保安全的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: ensure safety｜确保安全 ; ensure access｜确保能够获得 ; ensure that｜确保
tip_zh: ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。

meanings_zh: n. 物种
definition_en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.
example1_en: Our professor circled endangered species on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了濒危物种。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around endangered species.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕濒危物种展开说明。
collocations: endangered species｜濒危物种 ; native species｜本地物种 ; invasive species｜入侵物种 ; species diversity｜物种多样性
tip_zh: 单复数同形：one species，many species。

meanings_zh: n. 程度；范围
definition_en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the full extent of.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于……的全部程度或范围的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the full extent of.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕……的全部程度或范围展开说明。
collocations: to some extent｜在某种程度上 ; the full extent of｜……的全部程度或范围 ; to a large extent｜在很大程度上
tip_zh: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。

meanings_zh: n. 爪；爪子 | n. 螯；钳 | v. 用爪抓；用力抓挠
definition_en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot | a jointed gripping part on a crab or similar animal | to scratch or pull at something with claws or fingers
example1_en: The professor explained claw with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了爪。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses claw when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了爪。
collocations: sharp claws｜锋利的爪子 ; crab claws｜蟹螯 ; claw at something｜使劲抓挠某物
tip_zh: claw是尖爪；paw指猫狗等动物的整个脚掌。

meanings_zh: n. 黎明；拂晓 | n. 开端；萌芽 | v. 开始明白；破晓
definition_en: the early morning when daylight first appears | the beginning of a new period or development | to become understood, or to begin growing light
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize dawn in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出黎明。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses dawn when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了黎明。
collocations: at dawn｜在黎明时分 ; from dawn to dusk｜从早到晚 ; the dawn of a new era｜新时代的开端 ; dawn on someone｜使某人开始明白
tip_zh: It dawned on me that…表示“我开始明白……”。

meanings_zh: n. 抚育；家庭教养
definition_en: The way parents care for and teach a child
example1_en: Office hours began with a strict upbringing.
example1_zh: 答疑从严格的家庭教育开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a strict upbringing to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用严格的家庭教育来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a strict upbringing｜严格的家庭教育 ; a sheltered upbringing｜备受呵护的成长经历 ; a privileged upbringing｜优越的成长环境
tip_zh: 指童年养育及家庭教育，不等同于学校教育。

meanings_zh: n. 卡路里；热量单位
definition_en: A unit measuring heat energy or energy supplied by food.
example1_en: The textbook introduces calory intake in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了热量摄入。
example2_en: The reading connects calory intake with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把热量摄入和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: calory intake｜热量摄入 ; calory content｜热量含量
tip_zh: calory是罕用变体；现代写作请用calorie。

meanings_zh: n. 小标题；分标题
definition_en: a title introducing a section within a longer piece
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on clear subheading.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论清晰的小标题。
example2_en: A campus survey used clear subheading to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用清晰的小标题来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: clear subheading｜清晰的小标题 ; descriptive subheading｜说明性小标题 ; add a subheading｜添加小标题
tip_zh: 指文章内部的分标题，不指影视字幕。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；得到 | v. 源于；来自
definition_en: to obtain something from a particular source | to come or develop from something else
example1_en: I heard the lecturer derive pleasure from during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时从……获得乐趣。
example2_en: The reading asks you to derive pleasure from and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你从……获得乐趣，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: derive pleasure from｜从……获得乐趣 ; derive income from｜从……获得收入 ; derive from｜源于 ; be derived from｜由……衍生而来
tip_zh: derive A from B指从B获得A；derive from指源于。

meanings_zh: adj. 同伴的；同类的 | n. 男子；家伙 | n. 学会会员；学院研究员
definition_en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone | A man or boy, referred to informally | A member of a learned society or certain academic institutions
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on research fellow.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论研究员。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around research fellow.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕研究员展开说明。
collocations: fellow students｜同学 ; fellow passengers｜同行乘客 ; research fellow｜研究员 ; a friendly fellow｜友善的男子
tip_zh: 形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。

meanings_zh: adj. 浅的 | adj. 肤浅的；浅薄的 | adj. 呼吸浅的
definition_en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom | Lacking serious thought, understanding, or emotional depth | Taking only a small amount of air into the lungs
example1_en: Office hours began with shallow water.
example1_zh: 答疑从浅水开始。
example2_en: The author returns to shallow water when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了浅水。
collocations: shallow water｜浅水 ; a shallow dish｜浅盘 ; shallow breathing｜浅呼吸 ; a shallow understanding｜肤浅的理解
tip_zh: 水浅或思想肤浅都可用shallow，反义词为deep。

meanings_zh: v. 吃草；放牧 | v. 擦伤；擦过 | n. 擦伤
definition_en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it | to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing | a small injury where skin has been scraped off
example1_en: The lab instructions say to graze on grass.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求吃草。
example2_en: The reading asks you to graze on grass and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你吃草，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: graze on grass｜吃草 ; graze cattle｜放牛 ; graze your knee｜擦伤膝盖
tip_zh: 动物吃草可说graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

meanings_zh: v. 出现；显露 | v. 逐渐形成；崭露头角
definition_en: To become visible or known after being hidden. | To develop or become important and noticeable.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to emerge from.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须从……中出现。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to emerge from.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得从……中出现。
collocations: emerge from｜从……中出现 ; emerge as a leader｜崭露头角成为领导者 ; evidence emerges｜证据浮现
tip_zh: 不及物动词；常用emerge from或emerge as。

meanings_zh: adj. 谦逊的 | adj. 简陋的；地位低微的 | v. 使谦逊；使认识到不足
definition_en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others. | Simple or low in social position, wealth, or importance. | To make someone feel less proud or important.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about humble origins.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于卑微的出身的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of humble origins.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得卑微的出身这个例子。
collocations: remain humble｜保持谦逊 ; humble origins｜卑微的出身 ; a humble home｜简陋的家 ; in my humble opinion｜依我拙见
tip_zh: 谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 管理；行政工作 | n. 政府；行政管理层 | n. 施用；给予
definition_en: The work of organising and running an institution or business. | The people responsible for managing a government or organisation. | The act of giving medicine or treatment to someone.
example1_en: Our professor circled public administration on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公共行政。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of public administration.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得公共行政这个例子。
collocations: public administration｜公共行政 ; business administration｜工商管理 ; school administration｜学校行政管理 ; administration of medication｜给药
tip_zh: 指管理工作时通常不可数；指一届政府时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 酒精依赖；酒瘾
definition_en: a condition involving dependence on alcohol and difficulty controlling drinking
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on treatment for alcoholism.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论酒精依赖的治疗。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss treatment for alcoholism.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论酒精依赖的治疗的材料。
collocations: treatment for alcoholism｜酒精依赖的治疗 ; recover from alcoholism｜从酒精依赖中康复 ; chronic alcoholism｜慢性酒精依赖
tip_zh: 指酒精依赖这一疾病，不指嗜酒的人。

meanings_zh: adj. 满怀希望的 | adj. 有希望的；有望成功的 | n. 有望成功的人；竞争者
definition_en: feeling that something good is likely to happen | suggesting that a good result is likely | someone hoping to succeed in a competition or particular career
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a hopeful sign.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于令人看到希望的迹象的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a hopeful sign to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用令人看到希望的迹象来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: hopeful about the future｜对未来充满希望 ; hopeful that｜希望…… ; a hopeful sign｜令人看到希望的迹象
tip_zh: 人满怀希望用hopeful；事物有前景常用promising。

meanings_zh: n. 单簧管；黑管
definition_en: A woodwind instrument with a single reed and finger-operated keys.
example1_en: Our professor circled a clarinet solo on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了单簧管独奏。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a clarinet solo.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕单簧管独奏展开说明。
collocations: play the clarinet｜吹单簧管 ; a clarinet solo｜单簧管独奏 ; a clarinet player｜单簧管演奏者
tip_zh: 演奏乐器通常说play the clarinet，注意加the。

meanings_zh: n. 鸽子 | n. 主和派人士
definition_en: a bird often associated with peace | someone who favours peaceful solutions rather than military action
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a white dove.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论白鸽。
example2_en: A campus survey used a white dove to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用白鸽来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a white dove｜白鸽 ; a symbol of peace｜和平的象征 ; a political dove｜政治上的主和派人士
tip_zh: 指主和派时，与主张强硬手段的hawk相对。

meanings_zh: adj. 有意义的；令人满足的 | adj. 回报丰厚的
definition_en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement | providing substantial financial benefits
example1_en: The textbook introduces financially rewarding in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济回报丰厚的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around financially rewarding.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济回报丰厚的展开说明。
collocations: rewarding experience｜有意义的经历 ; rewarding career｜有成就感的职业 ; financially rewarding｜经济回报丰厚的
tip_zh: 多指带来满足感；强调赚钱可加financially。

meanings_zh: v. 禁止；不准
definition_en: To order someone not to do something or disallow it
example1_en: The lab instructions say to forbid someone to do something.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求禁止某人做某事。
example2_en: The passage says students who can forbid someone to do something follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够禁止某人做某事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: forbid someone to do something｜禁止某人做某事 ; forbid someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事 ; strictly forbidden｜严禁的
tip_zh: 过去式forbade，过去分词forbidden；可接动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 更好的；更优质的 | n. 上级；上司 | adj. 自以为优越的；高傲的
definition_en: Better in quality or performance than another | Someone with a higher position or rank than you | Behaving as though you are better than other people
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about immediate superior.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于直属上司的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around immediate superior.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕直属上司展开说明。
collocations: superior quality｜更优的质量 ; superior to｜优于 ; immediate superior｜直属上司 ; a superior attitude｜高傲的态度
tip_zh: 比较时用superior to，不用superior than。

meanings_zh: n. 惊讶；震惊
definition_en: a feeling of very great surprise
example1_en: Our professor circled express astonishment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了表示惊讶。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of express astonishment.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得表示惊讶这个例子。
collocations: in astonishment｜惊讶地 ; to someone's astonishment｜令某人惊讶的是 ; express astonishment｜表示惊讶
tip_zh: 通常不可数；to one's astonishment表示令某人惊讶的是。

meanings_zh: n. 修改；改进
definition_en: A change made to improve something or suit a purpose.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about minor modification.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于小幅修改的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around minor modification.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕小幅修改展开说明。
collocations: make a modification｜作出修改 ; minor modification｜小幅修改 ; genetic modification｜基因改造
tip_zh: 可数时指具体改动，不可数时指修改过程。

meanings_zh: n. 拍卖 | v. 拍卖出售
definition_en: a sale where an item goes to the highest bidder | to sell something to the person offering the most money
example1_en: The textbook introduces online auction in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了网上拍卖。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around online auction.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕网上拍卖展开说明。
collocations: at auction｜通过拍卖 ; hold an auction｜举行拍卖 ; auction off｜拍卖掉 ; online auction｜网上拍卖
tip_zh: at auction可不加冠词；auction off表示拍卖掉。

meanings_zh: n. 盔甲；装甲 | n. 装甲车辆；装甲部队
definition_en: Strong protective covering worn in battle or fitted to vehicles. | Military vehicles with protective covering, considered as a group.
example1_en: Our professor circled a suit of armour on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一套盔甲。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a suit of armour.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得一套盔甲这个例子。
collocations: a suit of armour｜一套盔甲 ; body armour｜防护甲 ; heavy armour｜重型装甲
tip_zh: 英式armour，美式armor；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 酷刑；折磨 | v. 拷打；使受折磨
definition_en: deliberately inflicted severe pain, or an extremely distressing experience | to deliberately cause severe physical or mental suffering
example1_en: Our professor circled psychological torture on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了精神折磨。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around psychological torture.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕精神折磨展开说明。
collocations: psychological torture｜精神折磨 ; pure torture｜十足的煎熬 ; prohibit torture｜禁止酷刑 ; subject someone to torture｜使某人遭受酷刑
tip_zh: 语气很强；日常可夸张表达煎熬，不只是普通不适。

meanings_zh: adj. 足够的；充分的
definition_en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sufficient evidence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论充分的证据。
example2_en: A campus survey used sufficient evidence to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用充分的证据来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: sufficient evidence｜充分的证据 ; sufficient funds｜充足的资金 ; sufficient time｜足够的时间 ; sufficient for｜足以满足
tip_zh: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 胶囊 | n. 太空舱；密闭小舱
definition_en: a small soluble case containing medicine that you swallow | a small enclosed compartment carrying people or equipment in space
example1_en: I copied space capsule into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把太空舱抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to space capsule when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了太空舱。
collocations: swallow a capsule｜吞服胶囊 ; space capsule｜太空舱 ; time capsule｜时间胶囊
tip_zh: 药物capsule有外壳；tablet通常是压制成的药片。

meanings_zh: n. 理解；理解力
definition_en: The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.
example1_en: I copied reading comprehension into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把阅读理解抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of reading comprehension.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得阅读理解这个例子。
collocations: reading comprehension｜阅读理解 ; listening comprehension｜听力理解 ; beyond comprehension｜无法理解
tip_zh: 通常不可数；comprehensive意为“全面的”。

meanings_zh: n. 口号；标语
definition_en: a short memorable phrase promoting an idea, group, or product
example1_en: Our professor circled catchy slogan on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了朗朗上口的口号。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of catchy slogan.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得朗朗上口的口号这个例子。
collocations: catchy slogan｜朗朗上口的口号 ; advertising slogan｜广告语 ; campaign slogan｜宣传活动口号 ; chant slogans｜反复高呼口号
tip_zh: slogan用于宣传；motto多指座右铭或行为准则。

meanings_zh: adj. 贪婪的；贪心的 | adj. 贪吃的
definition_en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs | wanting to eat more food than one needs
example1_en: The textbook introduces greedy for money in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了贪财的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around greedy for money.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕贪财的展开说明。
collocations: greedy for money｜贪财的 ; greedy for power｜贪恋权力的 ; a greedy investor｜贪婪的投资者
tip_zh: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。

meanings_zh: n. 舞厅
definition_en: A large room used for formal social dancing
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a hotel ballroom.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于酒店舞厅的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a hotel ballroom.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕酒店舞厅展开说明。
collocations: ballroom dancing｜交谊舞 ; a hotel ballroom｜酒店舞厅 ; a grand ballroom｜豪华大舞厅
tip_zh: ballroom dancing 指交谊舞，不是夜店蹦迪。

meanings_zh: adj. 有遮阴的；背阴的 | adj. 涂有阴影的
definition_en: Protected from direct sunlight. | Made darker with colour or drawn marks.
example1_en: I copied shaded area into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把遮阴区域；阴影区域抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used shaded area to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用遮阴区域；阴影区域来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: shaded area｜遮阴区域；阴影区域 ; shaded path｜林荫小路 ; shaded seating｜有遮阴的座位区
tip_zh: 也可作shade的过去式或过去分词，表示遮挡阳光。

meanings_zh: n. 大袋；麻袋 | v. 解雇 | n. 解雇
definition_en: A large, strong bag used for storing or carrying things. | To dismiss someone from their job. | Dismissal from a job, used in the phrase the sack.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sack of potatoes in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一大袋土豆。
example2_en: A campus survey used a sack of potatoes to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一大袋土豆来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a sack of potatoes｜一大袋土豆 ; get the sack｜被解雇 ; sack someone for misconduct｜因行为不当解雇某人
tip_zh: 表示解雇时常用于英式口语；正式用dismiss。

meanings_zh: n. 灵魂；心灵 | n. 人 | n. 灵魂乐
definition_en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body. | A person, especially when describing their character. | Expressive popular music combining gospel and rhythm and blues.
example1_en: Office hours began with heart and soul.
example1_zh: 答疑从全心全意开始。
example2_en: The reading connects heart and soul with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把全心全意和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: heart and soul｜全心全意 ; a kind soul｜心地善良的人 ; not a soul｜一个人也没有 ; soul music｜灵魂乐
tip_zh: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

meanings_zh: n. 晶体；结晶 | n. 水晶 | n. 水晶玻璃；水晶玻璃制品
definition_en: A solid whose particles form a regular, repeating pattern. | Clear quartz used in jewellery and decorative objects. | High-quality glass, or objects made from it.
example1_en: The textbook introduces crystal structure in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了晶体结构。
example2_en: The reading connects crystal structure with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把晶体结构和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: salt crystals｜盐晶体 ; crystal structure｜晶体结构 ; crystal glass｜水晶玻璃 ; crystal clear｜清澈透明的；十分清楚的
tip_zh: crystal clear既可形容水清澈，也可表示意思十分清楚。

meanings_zh: v. 选举；推选 | v. 选择；决定
definition_en: to choose someone for a position by voting | to choose to do something
example1_en: The assignment is to elect a president, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先选举总统，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to elect a president.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得选举总统。
collocations: elect a president｜选举总统 ; elect someone to office｜选举某人任职 ; elect to do something｜选择做某事
tip_zh: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 丰富的；充裕的
definition_en: Available in large amounts, often more than needed.
example1_en: The textbook introduces abundant resources in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了丰富的资源。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss abundant resources.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论丰富的资源的材料。
collocations: abundant resources｜丰富的资源 ; abundant evidence｜充分的证据 ; abundant wildlife｜丰富的野生动植物
tip_zh: abundant强调数量充足；名词搭配an abundance of。

meanings_zh: v. 使启动；使激活 | adj. 活化的；经活性处理的
definition_en: Made a device or process start working. | Treated to increase chemical activity or ability to absorb substances.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to activated carbon.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何活性炭。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to activated carbon.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们活性炭。
collocations: activated carbon｜活性炭 ; activated charcoal｜活性炭 ; voice-activated device｜声控设备
tip_zh: 是activate的过去式和过去分词；不表示性格活泼。

meanings_zh: n. 风景；地貌 | n. 局面；格局 | v. 对……进行景观美化
definition_en: The visible features of an area of land. | The overall conditions and features of a particular field. | To improve land by arranging plants and other outdoor features.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rural landscape.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论乡村景观。
example2_en: A campus survey used rural landscape to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用乡村景观来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: rural landscape｜乡村景观 ; natural landscape｜自然景观 ; political landscape｜政治格局 ; landscape design｜景观设计
tip_zh: landscape可数，指一片景观；scenery通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 录像带 | v. 用录像带录制
definition_en: Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound. | To record moving images and sound onto magnetic tape.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an old videotape.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一盘旧录像带的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects an old videotape with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一盘旧录像带和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an old videotape｜一盘旧录像带 ; on videotape｜以录像带形式 ; videotape a performance｜用录像带录制演出
tip_zh: 指磁带录像；现代数字录像通常用video或record。

meanings_zh: adj. 无望的；绝望的 | adj. 极不擅长的；极差的
definition_en: Having no hope, or offering no chance of success. | Very bad at doing something.
example1_en: Office hours began with a hopeless situation.
example1_zh: 答疑从无望的处境开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a hopeless situation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论无望的处境的材料。
collocations: a hopeless situation｜无望的处境 ; feel hopeless｜感到绝望 ; hopeless at cooking｜极不擅长做饭 ; a hopeless case｜无可救药的人或事
tip_zh: “不擅长做某事”用hopeless at doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 匿名的；不知姓名的 | adj. 无特色的
definition_en: Having a name that is unknown or kept secret. | Lacking distinctive features that make something easy to recognize.
example1_en: I copied anonymous donor into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把匿名捐赠者抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to anonymous donor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了匿名捐赠者。
collocations: remain anonymous｜保持匿名 ; anonymous donor｜匿名捐赠者 ; anonymous survey｜匿名调查 ; anonymous source｜匿名消息来源
tip_zh: 匿名是anonymous；保密是confidential，含义不同。

meanings_zh: n. 盟友；同盟国；支持者 | v. 结盟；联合
definition_en: A person or country that supports another. | To join with someone for a shared purpose.
example1_en: I copied a close ally into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把亲密盟友抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a close ally.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论亲密盟友的材料。
collocations: a close ally｜亲密盟友 ; a powerful ally｜强大的盟友 ; ally yourself with｜与……结盟
tip_zh: 名词重音通常在前；动词通常读/əˈlaɪ/。

meanings_zh: n. 平民；非军职人员 | adj. 平民的；民用的
definition_en: A person who is not a member of the armed forces | Relating to people or activities outside the armed forces
example1_en: Office hours began with civilian population.
example1_zh: 答疑从平民人口开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of civilian population.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得平民人口这个例子。
collocations: civilian population｜平民人口 ; civilian life｜平民生活 ; civilian aircraft｜民用飞机 ; protect civilians｜保护平民
tip_zh: civilian指非军人；公务员通常是civil servant。

meanings_zh: adj. 诚实的；如实的
definition_en: Telling the truth or accurately describing what happened.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a truthful account.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于如实的叙述的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a truthful account.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论如实的叙述的材料。
collocations: be truthful about something｜如实说明某事 ; a truthful account｜如实的叙述 ; a truthful answer｜诚实的回答
tip_zh: truthful指诚实或如实；“真正的朋友”用true。

meanings_zh: n. 寄宿学校
definition_en: a school where students live as well as study
example1_en: I wrote boarding school on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把boarding school和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up boarding school while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了寄宿学校。
collocations: attend boarding school｜就读寄宿学校 ; send a child to boarding school｜送孩子去寄宿学校
tip_zh: boarding指食宿；寄宿学校既提供教学也提供住宿。

meanings_zh: adj. 低风险的
definition_en: having little chance of harm, loss, or failure
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize low-risk in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出低风险的。
example2_en: Students who can explain low-risk usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释低风险的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: low-risk investment｜低风险投资 ; low-risk activity｜低风险活动 ; low-risk strategy｜低风险策略
tip_zh: low-risk表示风险较低，不等于完全无风险。

meanings_zh: v. 加速；使加快
definition_en: to move faster or make something happen more quickly
example1_en: I heard the lecturer accelerate growth during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时加快增长。
example2_en: The reading asks you to accelerate growth and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你加快增长，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: accelerate growth｜加快增长 ; accelerate the process｜加快进程 ; accelerate rapidly｜迅速加速
tip_zh: 既可指车辆加速，也可指进程加快；可及物或不及物。

meanings_zh: adj. 无效的；不起作用的
definition_en: not producing the result that is wanted
example1_en: I copied prove ineffective into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把结果证明无效抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of prove ineffective.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得结果证明无效这个例子。
collocations: ineffective treatment｜无效的治疗 ; ineffective policy｜无效的政策 ; prove ineffective｜结果证明无效
tip_zh: ineffective指无效果；inefficient指效率低。

meanings_zh: n. 劳动；劳动力 | v. 辛苦工作；努力做 | n. 分娩；产程
definition_en: work, especially physical work, or the workers who perform it | to work hard, often with considerable physical effort | the process of giving birth to a baby
example1_en: Our professor circled manual labor on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了体力劳动。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss manual labor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论体力劳动的材料。
collocations: manual labor｜体力劳动 ; labor market｜劳动力市场 ; labor costs｜劳动力成本 ; go into labor｜开始分娩
tip_zh: labor为美式拼写，英式作labour。

meanings_zh: adj. 天真的；轻信的
definition_en: Too willing to trust because of limited experience.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about politically naive.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于政治上幼稚的的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects politically naive with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把政治上幼稚的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: naive assumption｜天真的假设 ; naive optimism｜天真的乐观 ; politically naive｜政治上幼稚的
tip_zh: 常含缺乏经验、容易轻信之意，并非单纯褒义。

meanings_zh: v. 扩大；膨胀；扩展 | v. 详述；进一步说明
definition_en: to become larger or make something larger | to add more details to an explanation or discussion
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to expand rapidly.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须迅速扩大。
example2_en: The passage says students who can expand rapidly follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够迅速扩大的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: expand rapidly｜迅速扩大 ; expand access to｜扩大获得……的机会 ; expand a business｜拓展业务 ; expand on an idea｜进一步阐述想法
tip_zh: “详述”用expand on/upon；扩大某物可直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 谈判；协商达成 | v. 顺利通过；越过
definition_en: Discuss terms with others to reach an agreement. | Successfully move past an obstacle or along a difficult route.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to negotiate an agreement.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求协商达成协议。
example2_en: The reading asks you to negotiate an agreement and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你协商达成协议，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: negotiate an agreement｜协商达成协议 ; negotiate with employers｜与雇主谈判 ; negotiate a bend｜顺利通过弯道
tip_zh: 与某人谈判用with；也可直接接agreement。

meanings_zh: n. 军队；士兵；部队 | n. 一群；一队 | v. 成群结队地走
definition_en: soldiers collectively, or an organized military unit | an organized group of people or a group of animals | to walk somewhere together as a group
example1_en: Our professor circled a troop of monkeys on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一群猴子。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a troop of monkeys.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得一群猴子这个例子。
collocations: deploy troops｜部署部队 ; withdraw troops｜撤军 ; a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子
tip_zh: 表示士兵常用复数troops；演员团用troupe。

meanings_zh: adj. 立方的；立方体的
definition_en: relating to volume measured in cubes, or shaped like a cube
example1_en: I copied cubic metre into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把立方米抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cubic metre.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论立方米的材料。
collocations: cubic metre｜立方米 ; cubic centimetre｜立方厘米 ; cubic capacity｜容积
tip_zh: cubic用于体积单位；square用于面积单位。

meanings_zh: n. 贵族；领主 | n. 上帝；主
definition_en: a man with a high noble rank or historical authority | a title used to address or refer to God
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a powerful lord.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有权势的领主。
example2_en: A campus survey used a powerful lord to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有权势的领主来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a powerful lord｜有权势的领主 ; lord of the manor｜庄园领主 ; the Lord｜上帝；主 ; lord it over someone｜对某人作威作福
tip_zh: 指上帝用the Lord；置于姓名前作头衔也大写。

meanings_zh: v. 使接触；使暴露于 | v. 揭露；揭发 | v. 露出；使显露
definition_en: To put someone or something in contact with an influence | To reveal something hidden, especially wrongdoing | To uncover something previously hidden or protected
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to expose corruption.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何揭露腐败。
example2_en: The passage says students who can expose corruption follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够揭露腐败的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: expose someone to risk｜使某人面临风险 ; expose corruption｜揭露腐败 ; expose children to music｜让儿童接触音乐
tip_zh: expose A to B表示使A接触B，B不一定有害。

meanings_zh: n. 无知；不了解
definition_en: a lack of knowledge or awareness about something
example1_en: Office hours began with admit ignorance.
example1_zh: 答疑从承认不了解开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss admit ignorance.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论承认不了解的材料。
collocations: ignorance of｜对……的不了解 ; in ignorance of｜在不知……的情况下 ; admit ignorance｜承认不了解
tip_zh: 不可数；常用ignorance of/about表示对某事不了解。

meanings_zh: n. 银行家；银行高级职员
definition_en: someone who owns a bank or holds a senior banking position
example1_en: I copied investment banker into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把投资银行家抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around investment banker.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕投资银行家展开说明。
collocations: investment banker｜投资银行家 ; central banker｜中央银行官员 ; senior banker｜银行高管
tip_zh: 通常指银行家或高级职员，不泛指银行柜员。

meanings_zh: n. 喜爱；关爱
definition_en: A warm feeling of love or fondness for someone or something.
example1_en: I copied a sign of affection into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把喜爱的表示抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sign of affection.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕喜爱的表示展开说明。
collocations: show affection｜表达关爱 ; deep affection for｜对……的深厚感情 ; a sign of affection｜喜爱的表示
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某人的喜爱用affection for。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；人生态度 | n. 前景；展望 | n. 景色；视野
definition_en: a person's general attitude towards life or a situation | the likely future situation | the view from a particular place
example1_en: The textbook introduces positive outlook in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了积极的心态。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss positive outlook.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论积极的心态的材料。
collocations: outlook on life｜人生观 ; positive outlook｜积极的心态 ; economic outlook｜经济前景 ; broaden your outlook｜拓宽视野
tip_zh: 态度常接on；前景常接for，如outlook for growth。

meanings_zh: n. 迹象；暗示
definition_en: a sign suggesting that something exists or may happen
example1_en: The textbook introduces a clear indication in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了明确的迹象。
example2_en: The author returns to a clear indication when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了明确的迹象。
collocations: a clear indication｜明确的迹象 ; give an indication of｜显示出……的迹象 ; little indication｜几乎没有迹象
tip_zh: 常用 indication of sth 或 indication that 从句。

meanings_zh: n. 苔藓
definition_en: A small green plant growing in soft patches on damp surfaces.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a patch of moss in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一片苔藓。
example2_en: The author returns to a patch of moss when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一片苔藓。
collocations: a patch of moss｜一片苔藓 ; thick moss｜厚厚的苔藓 ; moss-covered rocks｜长满苔藓的岩石
tip_zh: 常作不可数名词；lichen指地衣，不等于moss。

meanings_zh: n. 接受；同意 | n. 接纳；认可 | n. 接受现实；认同事实
definition_en: The act of agreeing to receive or do something offered. | Willingness to welcome someone or regard something as suitable. | Recognition that a situation is real and must be faced.
example1_en: I copied widespread acceptance into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把广泛认可抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used widespread acceptance to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用广泛认可来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: acceptance of an offer｜接受提议 ; gain acceptance｜获得认可 ; widespread acceptance｜广泛认可 ; social acceptance｜社会接纳
tip_zh: 通常不可数；acceptance of后接接受的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 武器；军备 | n. 手臂（复数）
definition_en: Weapons and military equipment. | The body parts extending from the shoulders to the hands.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about arms trade.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于武器贸易的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss arms trade.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论武器贸易的材料。
collocations: arms trade｜武器贸易 ; arms race｜军备竞赛 ; arms control｜军备控制 ; lay down arms｜放下武器
tip_zh: 表示武器时用复数arms；an arm通常指一条手臂。

meanings_zh: n. 通货膨胀 | n. 充气
definition_en: A general rise in prices that reduces money's purchasing power. | The process of filling something with air or gas.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the rate of inflation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于通货膨胀率的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of the rate of inflation.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得通货膨胀率这个例子。
collocations: the rate of inflation｜通货膨胀率 ; rising inflation｜不断加剧的通胀 ; curb inflation｜抑制通胀 ; keep pace with inflation｜跟上通胀
tip_zh: 经济语境指物价普遍上涨，不只某件商品涨价。

meanings_zh: n. 口译员 | n. 解释程序
definition_en: Someone who translates spoken or signed communication between languages. | A program that reads and executes code directly.
example1_en: I copied a qualified interpreter into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把合格的口译员抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a qualified interpreter.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得合格的口译员这个例子。
collocations: a qualified interpreter｜合格的口译员 ; a conference interpreter｜会议口译员 ; a sign language interpreter｜手语翻译员
tip_zh: interpreter 通常做口译；translator 通常做笔译。

meanings_zh: n. 矛；长矛 | v. 刺；戳起
definition_en: a long pole with a sharp point, used as a weapon | to push a pointed object into or through something
example1_en: I copied wooden spear into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把木矛抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss wooden spear.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论木矛的材料。
collocations: wooden spear｜木矛 ; spear tip｜矛尖 ; spear a piece of food｜叉起一块食物
tip_zh: spear是长矛，不是枪械；动词可指用叉子戳起食物。

meanings_zh: v. 抽泣；啜泣 | n. 抽泣声；啜泣
definition_en: to cry with short, sudden breaths | a short, broken breath or sound made while crying
example1_en: The professor asked us to sob quietly.
example1_zh: 教授让我们轻声抽泣。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to sob quietly.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得轻声抽泣。
collocations: sob quietly｜轻声抽泣 ; uncontrollable sobs｜无法抑制的抽泣 ; between sobs｜抽泣间隙
tip_zh: 过去式sobbed，进行式sobbing，均双写b。

meanings_zh: n. 草稿；草案 | v. 起草；草拟
definition_en: an early version of writing that may be changed | to write an early version of a document
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about first draft.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于初稿的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around first draft.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕初稿展开说明。
collocations: first draft｜初稿 ; final draft｜定稿 ; draft a proposal｜起草提案 ; draft legislation｜立法草案
tip_zh: 表“草稿”英美均用draft；穿堂风英式用draught。

meanings_zh: n. 颌；颚
definition_en: either bone structure in the mouth that holds the teeth
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lower jaw.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论下颌。
example2_en: The reading connects lower jaw with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把下颌和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: lower jaw｜下颌 ; upper jaw｜上颌 ; clench your jaw｜咬紧牙关 ; jaw injury｜颌部损伤
tip_zh: jaw指颌骨或颌部；chin仅指脸部最下方的下巴。

meanings_zh: n. 纯素食者 | adj. 纯素的；不含动物制品的
definition_en: Someone who avoids animal foods and usually other animal products. | Using or containing no animal products.
example1_en: Our professor circled a vegan diet on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纯素饮食。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a vegan diet.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕纯素饮食展开说明。
collocations: a vegan diet｜纯素饮食 ; vegan food｜纯素食品 ; go vegan｜开始采用纯素生活方式 ; vegan leather｜非动物皮革
tip_zh: vegan不吃蛋奶；vegetarian通常可吃蛋奶。

meanings_zh: v. 省略；遗漏
definition_en: to leave something out, deliberately or accidentally
example1_en: The assignment is to omit details, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先省略细节，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to omit details.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得省略细节。
collocations: omit details｜省略细节 ; omit information｜遗漏信息 ; omit something from a report｜从报告中删去某项内容
tip_zh: 过去式omitted，进行式omitting，均双写t。

meanings_zh: adj. 农业的；农用的
definition_en: relating to farming, including growing crops and raising animals
example1_en: The textbook introduces agricultural land in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了农业用地。
example2_en: A campus survey used agricultural land to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用农业用地来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: agricultural land｜农业用地 ; agricultural production｜农业生产 ; agricultural machinery｜农业机械 ; agricultural practices｜农业生产方式
tip_zh: 形容词，常修饰 land、production、machinery。

meanings_zh: n. 主管；监督者 | n. 研究导师
definition_en: A person who oversees other people's work or activities. | An academic who guides a student's research.
example1_en: Our professor circled immediate supervisor on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了直属主管。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss immediate supervisor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论直属主管的材料。
collocations: immediate supervisor｜直属主管 ; research supervisor｜研究导师 ; shift supervisor｜轮班主管
tip_zh: 职场中指主管；英国大学中也常指研究导师。

meanings_zh: adv. 积极地；肯定地 | adv. 确切地；明确地 | adv. 简直；确实
definition_en: In a way that shows approval, confidence, or optimism. | With certainty and no doubt. | Used to strongly emphasise a description.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to positively identify.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习确切辨认。
example2_en: Students who positively identify are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够确切辨认的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: respond positively｜积极回应 ; positively identify｜确切辨认 ; positively influence｜产生积极影响 ; positively delighted｜确实欣喜万分
tip_zh: positively可强调语气，也可表示积极态度或确定性。

meanings_zh: n. 故事情节 | n. 小块土地 | v. 密谋；秘密策划
definition_en: the connected events that make up a story | a small piece of land used for a particular purpose | secretly plan something harmful or dishonest
example1_en: The textbook introduces a complex plot in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了复杂的情节。
example2_en: A campus survey used a complex plot to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用复杂的情节来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a complex plot｜复杂的情节 ; a plot of land｜一小块土地 ; a garden plot｜一小块菜园地 ; plot against someone｜密谋对付某人
tip_zh: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

meanings_zh: n. 采纳；采用 | n. 收养
definition_en: the act of beginning to use an idea or method | the legal process of becoming a child's parent
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about widespread adoption.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于广泛采用的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used widespread adoption to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用广泛采用来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: adoption of technology｜技术的采用 ; widespread adoption｜广泛采用 ; child adoption｜儿童收养 ; adoption agency｜收养机构
tip_zh: adoption是采用或收养；adaptation是适应或改编。

meanings_zh: n. 信任；信心 | n. 宗教信仰；宗教
definition_en: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something. | Belief in a god, or a particular religious system.
example1_en: Office hours began with religious faith.
example1_zh: 答疑从宗教信仰开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around religious faith.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教信仰展开说明。
collocations: have faith in｜信任；相信 ; lose faith in｜对……失去信心 ; religious faith｜宗教信仰 ; in good faith｜真诚地；善意地
tip_zh: 表示对某人或某事有信心，用have faith in。

meanings_zh: adj. 精力充沛的；充满活力的
definition_en: Having or showing plenty of energy and enthusiasm.
example1_en: I copied energetic children into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把精力旺盛的孩子抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used energetic children to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用精力旺盛的孩子来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: feel energetic｜感到精力充沛 ; energetic children｜精力旺盛的孩子 ; energetic approach｜积极有力的做法
tip_zh: energetic形容人或活动有活力；energy是名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 激烈的；大幅度的
definition_en: Extreme or severe, causing a major change
example1_en: I copied drastic measures into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把严厉措施抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of drastic measures.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得严厉措施这个例子。
collocations: drastic measures｜严厉措施 ; drastic action｜果断的重大行动 ; drastic cuts｜大幅削减 ; drastic changes｜剧烈变化
tip_zh: 强调程度大、影响强，不等于表示速度快的rapid。

meanings_zh: n. 剑；刀
definition_en: A weapon with a long blade and a handle.
example1_en: Office hours began with a double-edged sword.
example1_zh: 答疑从双刃剑开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a double-edged sword to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用双刃剑来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: draw a sword｜拔剑 ; a sword blade｜剑刃 ; a double-edged sword｜双刃剑
tip_zh: w不发音；双刃剑可比喻既有利又有弊的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 忍受；容忍 | v. 耐受；经受住
definition_en: To accept something unpleasant or unwanted without stopping it. | To withstand difficult conditions or substances without serious harm.
example1_en: The professor asked us to tolerate noise.
example1_zh: 教授让我们忍受噪声。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers tolerate noise before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要忍受噪声。
collocations: tolerate noise｜忍受噪声 ; tolerate uncertainty｜容忍不确定性 ; tolerate heat｜耐热 ; refuse to tolerate｜拒绝容忍
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：tolerate doing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 电影配乐；影视声轨
definition_en: The recorded music, speech, and sounds accompanying a film or programme.
example1_en: Office hours began with a film soundtrack.
example1_zh: 答疑从电影原声开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a film soundtrack when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了电影原声。
collocations: a film soundtrack｜电影原声 ; an original soundtrack｜原创影视配乐 ; compose a soundtrack｜创作影视配乐
tip_zh: 不仅指配乐，也可指含对白和音效的完整声轨。

meanings_zh: n. 伤口；创伤 | v. 使受伤 | v. 伤害感情
definition_en: An injury involving damage to skin or other body tissue. | To injure someone's body, especially by damaging the skin. | To hurt someone's feelings deeply.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a deep wound.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论很深的伤口。
example2_en: The reading connects a deep wound with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把很深的伤口和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a deep wound｜很深的伤口 ; treat a wound｜处理伤口 ; wound someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
tip_zh: 伤口读/wuːnd/；wind的过去式wound读/waʊnd/。

meanings_zh: n. 恐惧；惊恐 | n. 恐怖活动；恐怖手段
definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of fear. | Violence or threats used to frighten and control people.
example1_en: Office hours began with sheer terror.
example1_zh: 答疑从极度恐惧开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sheer terror.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕极度恐惧展开说明。
collocations: in terror｜惊恐地 ; sheer terror｜极度恐惧 ; a sense of terror｜恐惧感 ; a campaign of terror｜一连串恐怖活动
tip_zh: 表示强烈恐惧，程度比fear深；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 喂养；进食
definition_en: The act of giving or taking food.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on bottle feeding.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论奶瓶喂养。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bottle feeding.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕奶瓶喂养展开说明。
collocations: feeding time｜喂食时间 ; feeding habits｜进食习惯 ; bottle feeding｜奶瓶喂养 ; a feeding schedule｜喂养时间安排
tip_zh: 既可作名词，也可作feed的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 进步的；支持改革的 | adj. 逐步发展的；渐进的 | n. 进步人士；改革支持者
definition_en: supporting new ideas and changes intended to improve society | happening or developing gradually over time | a person who supports social or political reform
example1_en: The textbook introduces progressive policies in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了进步的政策。
example2_en: The author returns to progressive policies when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了进步的政策。
collocations: progressive policies｜进步的政策 ; progressive outlook｜进步的观念 ; progressive change｜渐进的变化 ; progressive taxation｜累进税制
tip_zh: 既可指支持改革，也可指逐步发展，未必变好。

meanings_zh: n. 角；角度 | n. 视角；考虑问题的角度 | v. 斜放；倾斜
definition_en: The space between two lines or surfaces that meet. | A particular way of considering or presenting something. | To position something so that it slopes or faces sideways.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a right angle.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论直角。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a right angle.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕直角展开说明。
collocations: a right angle｜直角 ; at an angle｜倾斜地 ; from a different angle｜从不同角度 ; a viewing angle｜观看角度
tip_zh: angle 是角度；angel 才是天使，注意字母顺序。

meanings_zh: adj. 有说服力的
definition_en: Able to make people believe something or agree with you
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on persuasive argument.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有说服力的论点。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of persuasive argument.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得有说服力的论点这个例子。
collocations: persuasive argument｜有说服力的论点 ; persuasive evidence｜有说服力的证据 ; persuasive speaker｜善于说服人的演讲者
tip_zh: 通常形容论点或表达有说服力，不作名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 无意义的；徒劳的
definition_en: Having no useful purpose or chance of achieving anything.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a pointless exercise.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于徒劳之举的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a pointless exercise to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用徒劳之举来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a pointless exercise｜徒劳之举 ; pointless arguments｜无意义的争论 ; seem pointless｜显得毫无意义
tip_zh: 常用 it is pointless to do，表示做某事徒劳。

meanings_zh: adj. 至关重要的；关键的 | adj. 批评的；批判性的 | adj. 危急的；严重的
definition_en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something | expressing disapproval or carefully judging strengths and weaknesses | so serious that someone may die or something may fail
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about critical to success.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于对成功至关重要的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects critical to success with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对成功至关重要和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: critical to success｜对成功至关重要 ; critical thinking｜批判性思维 ; critical of someone｜批评某人 ; in critical condition｜情况危急
tip_zh: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。

meanings_zh: n. 小牛；某些大型动物的幼崽 | n. 小腿肚
definition_en: A young cow or another large mammal, such as an elephant. | The fleshy back part of the leg below the knee.
example1_en: I copied a newborn calf into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把刚出生的小牛抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a newborn calf.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕刚出生的小牛展开说明。
collocations: a newborn calf｜刚出生的小牛 ; calf muscles｜小腿肌肉 ; raise a calf｜饲养小牛
tip_zh: 复数为calves；字母l不发音。

meanings_zh: n. 犹豫；迟疑
definition_en: A pause or delay caused by uncertainty or nervousness.
example1_en: Office hours began with a moment's hesitation.
example1_zh: 答疑从片刻犹豫开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a moment's hesitation.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得片刻犹豫这个例子。
collocations: without hesitation｜毫不犹豫地 ; a moment's hesitation｜片刻犹豫 ; have no hesitation in doing｜毫不犹豫地做
tip_zh: 毫不犹豫做某事：have no hesitation in doing。

meanings_zh: n. 纳税人
definition_en: A person or organisation that pays taxes.
example1_en: The textbook introduces taxpayer money in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纳税人的钱。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of taxpayer money.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得纳税人的钱这个例子。
collocations: taxpayer money｜纳税人的钱 ; at taxpayers' expense｜由纳税人承担费用 ; taxpayer funding｜纳税人提供的资金
tip_zh: 通常指纳税的个人，也可指纳税机构。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；大宗货物
definition_en: A raw material or basic product that can be bought and sold.
example1_en: Coffee is both a campus habit and a traded commodity.
example1_zh: 咖啡既是校园习惯，也是被交易的大宗商品。
example2_en: The article explains how a commodity price can fall even when local shops stay expensive.
example2_zh: 文章解释了为什么大宗商品价格下跌时，本地商店仍可能很贵。
collocations: a commodity price｜大宗商品价格 ; commodity market｜商品市场
tip_zh: 复数 commodities 常指整类大宗商品。

meanings_zh: adj. 道德的；合乎道德的 | n. 寓意；教训
definition_en: concerning right and wrong, or following accepted standards of goodness | a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on moral responsibility.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论道德责任。
example2_en: A campus survey used moral responsibility to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用道德责任来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: moral responsibility｜道德责任 ; moral dilemma｜道德困境 ; moral support｜精神支持 ; the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip_zh: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

meanings_zh: adv. 恭敬地；尊重地
definition_en: In a way that shows politeness and regard for others.
example1_en: The professor told us to respectfully disagree and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们礼貌地表示不同意，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will respectfully disagree when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会礼貌地表示不同意。
collocations: respectfully disagree｜礼貌地表示不同意 ; respectfully request｜恭敬地请求 ; treat someone respectfully｜尊重地对待某人
tip_zh: 勿混respectively（分别地）；本词强调尊重。

meanings_zh: n. 天文学家
definition_en: a scientist who studies stars, planets, and space
example1_en: Our professor circled professional astronomer on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了专业天文学家。
example2_en: A campus survey used professional astronomer to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用专业天文学家来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: professional astronomer｜专业天文学家 ; amateur astronomer｜业余天文学家
tip_zh: astronomer研究天体；astrologer是占星师。

meanings_zh: adj. 多变的；变化无常的
definition_en: Likely to change frequently or unexpectedly.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about highly changeable.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于极易变化的的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to highly changeable when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极易变化的。
collocations: changeable weather｜多变的天气 ; a changeable mood｜变化无常的情绪 ; highly changeable｜极易变化的
tip_zh: 常形容天气或情绪多变；注意保留change末尾的e。

meanings_zh: n. 输入的信息；投入 | n. 意见；建议 | v. 输入
definition_en: information or resources supplied to a system or process | ideas or advice contributed to a discussion or task | to enter information into a computer or other device
example1_en: Our professor circled data input on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数据输入。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around data input.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕数据输入展开说明。
collocations: data input｜数据输入 ; valuable input｜宝贵意见 ; input data｜输入数据 ; labour input｜劳动力投入
tip_zh: 作动词时，过去式可用 input 或 inputted。

meanings_zh: v. 通勤；往返上班 | n. 通勤路程 | v. 减轻刑罚
definition_en: To travel regularly between home and work. | A regular journey between home and work. | To replace a legal punishment with a less severe one.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to commute to work.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求通勤上班。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to commute to work.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得通勤上班。
collocations: commute to work｜通勤上班 ; daily commute｜每日通勤 ; commute by train｜乘火车通勤 ; commute a sentence｜减刑
tip_zh: 通勤用 commute to work；减刑用 commute a sentence。

meanings_zh: n. 相关性；关联
definition_en: A relationship in which changes in things are linked
example1_en: Our professor circled strong correlation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了高度相关。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss strong correlation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论高度相关的材料。
collocations: strong correlation｜高度相关 ; positive correlation｜正相关 ; negative correlation｜负相关 ; correlation between｜……之间的相关性
tip_zh: correlation不等于causation：相关不代表因果。

meanings_zh: n. 读写能力 | n. 某领域的基本素养
definition_en: The ability to read and write. | Basic knowledge and skills needed in a particular area.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about adult literacy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于成人读写能力的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects adult literacy with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把成人读写能力和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: adult literacy｜成人读写能力 ; literacy rates｜识字率 ; digital literacy｜数字素养 ; financial literacy｜金融素养
tip_zh: 不可数；digital literacy指数字素养，不只是识字。

meanings_zh: n. 引用；引文
definition_en: A note that tells the reader where a fact or quotation came from.
example1_en: Every chart in the paper needs a citation.
example1_zh: 论文里的每张图都需要引用出处。
example2_en: A missing citation makes it hard to check whether the claim is fair.
example2_zh: 缺少引用会让人难以核对这个主张是否公允。
collocations: a citation style｜引文格式 ; in-text citation｜文内引用
tip_zh: cite 是动词，citation 是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 杰作；代表作
definition_en: an exceptionally fine work of art, literature, or skill
example1_en: I copied a literary masterpiece into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把文学杰作抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a literary masterpiece with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把文学杰作和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a literary masterpiece｜文学杰作 ; an artistic masterpiece｜艺术杰作 ; create a masterpiece｜创作杰作
tip_zh: 通常指作品，不用来指才华出众的人。

meanings_zh: n. 孤儿 | v. 使成为孤儿
definition_en: a child whose parents have both died | to cause a child to lose both parents through death
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize orphan in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出孤儿。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up orphan while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了孤儿。
collocations: be orphaned at a young age｜幼年失去双亲 ; care for orphans｜照料孤儿 ; an orphaned child｜失去双亲的孩子
tip_zh: 常用be orphaned表示因双亲去世而成为孤儿。

meanings_zh: adj. 想象中的；虚构的
definition_en: existing only in the mind, not in reality
example1_en: I copied imaginary friend into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把想象中的朋友抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss imaginary friend.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论想象中的朋友的材料。
collocations: imaginary friend｜想象中的朋友 ; imaginary world｜虚构的世界 ; imaginary situation｜假想情境
tip_zh: imaginary指想象中的；imaginative指富有想象力的。

meanings_zh: n. 痛苦；苦难
definition_en: Physical or mental pain experienced by people or animals.
example1_en: Our professor circled alleviate suffering on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了缓解痛苦。
example2_en: The reading connects alleviate suffering with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把缓解痛苦和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: alleviate suffering｜缓解痛苦 ; human suffering｜人类的苦难 ; unnecessary suffering｜不必要的痛苦
tip_zh: 泛指痛苦时通常不可数；sufferings指种种苦难。

meanings_zh: adj. 一次性的；用后丢弃的 | adj. 税后可支配的
definition_en: intended to be thrown away after use | available for spending or saving after taxes are paid
example1_en: Our professor circled disposable income on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可支配收入。
example2_en: A campus survey used disposable income to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用可支配收入来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: disposable income｜可支配收入 ; disposable gloves｜一次性手套 ; disposable packaging｜一次性包装 ; disposable cups｜一次性杯子
tip_zh: disposable income指税后收入，不是扣除生活费后的余额。

meanings_zh: n. 青铜 | n. 铜牌 | adj. 青铜制的；古铜色的
definition_en: A brownish metal made mainly from copper and tin. | A medal awarded for finishing third in a competition. | Made of bronze, or having its reddish-brown color.
example1_en: The textbook introduces cast in bronze in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了用青铜铸造。
example2_en: A campus survey used cast in bronze to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用用青铜铸造来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: bronze statue｜青铜雕像 ; bronze medal｜铜牌 ; cast in bronze｜用青铜铸造
tip_zh: bronze是青铜；brass是黄铜；copper是铜。

meanings_zh: v. 寻找；寻求 | v. 试图；设法
definition_en: To try to find or obtain something. | To try to do or achieve something.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer seek advice during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时征求意见。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to seek advice.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们征求意见。
collocations: seek advice｜征求意见 ; seek employment｜求职 ; seek to improve｜力求改善 ; seek help｜寻求帮助
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sought；后直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adv. 有效地 | adv. 实际上；事实上
definition_en: in a way that achieves the intended result | in practice, although not officially or in every detail
example1_en: The lab manual says to effectively impossible before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先实际上不可能，再记下数字。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to effectively impossible before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先实际上不可能。
collocations: communicate effectively｜有效沟通 ; work effectively｜有效发挥作用 ; effectively impossible｜实际上不可能
tip_zh: effectively侧重效果；efficiently侧重效率。

meanings_zh: n. 颅骨；头骨
definition_en: the bony structure of the head that protects the brain
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a human skull.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人类头骨。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a human skull.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人类头骨的材料。
collocations: a skull fracture｜颅骨骨折 ; the base of the skull｜颅底 ; a human skull｜人类头骨
tip_zh: skull指头部骨骼，brain指内部的大脑。

meanings_zh: n. 怀疑；嫌疑 | n. 猜疑；不信任 | n. 一点儿；少许
definition_en: a belief that something is wrong without definite proof | a feeling that someone or something cannot be trusted | a very small amount of something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on arouse suspicion.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论引起怀疑。
example2_en: A campus survey used arouse suspicion to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用引起怀疑来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: arouse suspicion｜引起怀疑 ; under suspicion｜受到怀疑 ; on suspicion of theft｜涉嫌盗窃 ; a suspicion that｜怀疑……
tip_zh: 常用suspicion of或suspicion that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 消化；消化能力
definition_en: the process of breaking down food so the body absorbs nutrients
example1_en: Our professor circled aid digestion on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了帮助消化。
example2_en: The reading connects aid digestion with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把帮助消化和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: aid digestion｜帮助消化 ; healthy digestion｜健康的消化功能 ; poor digestion｜消化不良
tip_zh: 通常不可数；消化不良常用 indigestion。

meanings_zh: n. 不满；不满意
definition_en: the feeling that something is not as good as expected
example1_en: Office hours began with express dissatisfaction.
example1_zh: 答疑从表达不满开始。
example2_en: The author returns to express dissatisfaction when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了表达不满。
collocations: dissatisfaction with｜对……的不满 ; express dissatisfaction｜表达不满 ; widespread dissatisfaction｜普遍的不满 ; job dissatisfaction｜对工作的不满
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某事不满用dissatisfaction with。

meanings_zh: n. 简单；简易 | n. 简朴；朴素
definition_en: The quality of being easy to understand or use. | The quality of having little decoration or unnecessary detail.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on elegant simplicity.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论典雅简约。
example2_en: The reading connects elegant simplicity with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把典雅简约和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: for simplicity｜为简便起见 ; simplicity of design｜设计的简洁 ; elegant simplicity｜典雅简约
tip_zh: simplicity通常不可数；simple的名词形式。

meanings_zh: v. 扭伤关节 | n. 关节扭伤
definition_en: To injure a joint by twisting it too far. | An injury caused by twisting a joint too far.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to sprain an ankle.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须扭伤脚踝。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers sprain an ankle before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要扭伤脚踝。
collocations: sprain an ankle｜扭伤脚踝 ; sprain a wrist｜扭伤手腕 ; a severe sprain｜严重扭伤
tip_zh: sprain指关节扭伤；strain常指肌肉或肌腱拉伤。

meanings_zh: n. 政府的部 | n. 牧师职务；宗教服务
definition_en: a government department responsible for a particular area | the work or duties of a religious minister
example1_en: The textbook introduces education ministry in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了教育部。
example2_en: A campus survey used education ministry to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用教育部来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: education ministry｜教育部 ; foreign ministry｜外交部 ; Ministry of Health｜卫生部
tip_zh: 政府部门名称常用Ministry of加领域名词。

meanings_zh: v. 向……敬礼；致敬 | v. 赞扬；颂扬 | n. 敬礼；致敬
definition_en: To show respect through a formal gesture, especially in the military. | To publicly express admiration for someone or their achievements. | A formal gesture or action showing respect.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to salute an officer.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须向军官敬礼。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to salute an officer.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来向军官敬礼。
collocations: salute an officer｜向军官敬礼 ; give a salute｜行礼 ; salute someone's courage｜赞扬某人的勇气
tip_zh: 作动词直接接人：salute someone，无需加to。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；庞大的
definition_en: extremely large in size or amount
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gigantic task.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论艰巨的任务。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a gigantic task.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕艰巨的任务展开说明。
collocations: a gigantic task｜艰巨的任务 ; a gigantic structure｜巨型建筑 ; a gigantic wave｜巨浪
tip_zh: 语气强于big，可形容体积、规模或任务。

meanings_zh: n. 潮汐；潮水 | n. 趋势；潮流
definition_en: the regular rise and fall of the sea | a strong movement or change in events or opinion
example1_en: I copied high tide into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把高潮；涨潮最高点抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss high tide.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论高潮；涨潮最高点的材料。
collocations: high tide｜高潮；涨潮最高点 ; low tide｜低潮；落潮最低点 ; turn the tide｜扭转局势 ; a tide of change｜变革浪潮
tip_zh: tide是海水的周期性涨落，wave是单个波浪。

meanings_zh: adj. 至关重要的；必不可少的 | adj. 维持生命所必需的
definition_en: extremely important or necessary | necessary for keeping a living body alive
example1_en: Our professor circled vital importance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了极端重要性。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vital importance.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕极端重要性展开说明。
collocations: play a vital role｜发挥关键作用 ; vital importance｜极端重要性 ; vital organs｜重要器官 ; vital for survival｜生存所必需的
tip_zh: 常用be vital for/to，表示对……至关重要。

meanings_zh: adj. 逾期未付的
definition_en: not paid by the date when payment was required
example1_en: The professor explained past-due with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了逾期未付的。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses past-due when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了逾期未付的。
collocations: past-due bill｜逾期账单 ; past-due payment｜逾期款项 ; past-due account｜欠款逾期的账户
tip_zh: 名词前可加连字符；表语通常写作 past due。

meanings_zh: v. 治愈；治好 | n. 疗法；治愈方法
definition_en: to make a disease disappear or someone healthy again | a treatment that makes a disease or condition disappear
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to cure a disease.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须治愈疾病。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cure a disease.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得治愈疾病。
collocations: cure a disease｜治愈疾病 ; a cure for｜……的疗法 ; cure someone of｜治好某人的……病
tip_zh: cure强调治好；treat只表示治疗，不保证痊愈。

meanings_zh: n. 手枪
definition_en: A small gun designed to be held in one hand.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a starting pistol.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于发令枪的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a starting pistol.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕发令枪展开说明。
collocations: carry a pistol｜携带手枪 ; a starting pistol｜发令枪 ; an antique pistol｜古董手枪
tip_zh: pistol指手枪；rifle通常指步枪。

meanings_zh: adj. 失业的；无工作的
definition_en: Without paid employment, especially when wanting to work.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the jobless.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于失业者群体的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the jobless.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕失业者群体展开说明。
collocations: jobless workers｜失业工人 ; the jobless｜失业者群体 ; jobless rate｜失业率
tip_zh: the jobless指失业者群体，作主语时谓语用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 会计；会计学
definition_en: The work or study of recording and reporting financial transactions.
example1_en: Office hours began with financial accounting.
example1_zh: 答疑从财务会计开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss financial accounting.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论财务会计的材料。
collocations: accounting software｜会计软件 ; accounting standards｜会计准则 ; financial accounting｜财务会计
tip_zh: 表示会计工作或学科时不可数；会计师是 accountant。

meanings_zh: adv. 有点；稍微
definition_en: To a limited degree; rather, but not very.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to somewhat different.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习有些不同。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to somewhat different before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先有些不同。
collocations: somewhat different｜有些不同 ; somewhat limited｜有些有限 ; somewhat concerned｜有些担忧
tip_zh: 比a bit正式，常用于缓和判断或语气。

meanings_zh: adj. 占主导地位的；支配的 | adj. 显性的
definition_en: More powerful, influential, or noticeable than others. | Expressed when at least one copy of a gene is present.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a dominant role.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论主导作用。
example2_en: The author returns to a dominant role when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主导作用。
collocations: a dominant role｜主导作用 ; a dominant position｜优势地位 ; the dominant culture｜主流文化 ; a dominant gene｜显性基因
tip_zh: dominant是形容词；dominate是动词。

meanings_zh: n. 月光 | v. 兼职；私下兼第二份工作
definition_en: The light that reaches Earth from the moon. | To do another paid job alongside your main job, often secretly.
example1_en: I copied pale moonlight into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把淡淡的月光抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects pale moonlight with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把淡淡的月光和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: in the moonlight｜在月光下 ; pale moonlight｜淡淡的月光 ; moonlight as a waiter｜兼职当服务员
tip_zh: 月光是不可数名词；动词常接as表示兼职身份。

meanings_zh: v. 给予权利或资格 | v. 给……命名；题名
definition_en: To give someone the right to have or do something. | To give a name to a book, film, or other work.
example1_en: The assignment is to entitle someone to benefits, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使某人有资格享受福利，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to entitle someone to benefits.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使某人有资格享受福利。
collocations: entitle someone to benefits｜使某人有资格享受福利 ; be entitled to compensation｜有权获得赔偿 ; be entitled to vote｜有权投票
tip_zh: entitle sb to sth或to do sth；常用于被动语态。

meanings_zh: v. 加深；增强 | v. 变深；挖深 | v. 使声音低沉；变低沉
definition_en: To become stronger or more complete, or make something so | To become physically deeper, or make something deeper | To become lower in pitch, or make a sound lower
example1_en: I heard the lecturer deepen understanding during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时加深理解。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to deepen understanding.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得加深理解。
collocations: deepen understanding｜加深理解 ; deepen a crisis｜加剧危机 ; deepen a channel｜挖深航道 ; a voice deepens｜声音变低沉
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：deepen trust；a crisis deepens。

meanings_zh: adj. 无限的；无穷的 | adj. 极大的；无尽的
definition_en: Having no end or limit | Extremely great in amount or degree
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about infinite possibilities.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于无限的可能性的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects infinite possibilities with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把无限的可能性和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: infinite possibilities｜无限的可能性 ; infinite patience｜无尽的耐心 ; an infinite supply｜无限的供应
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；表示“无穷”常用名词infinity。

meanings_zh: n. 版本；版次 | n. 报刊的一期；节目的一期
definition_en: A particular version of a book or other published work. | One particular issue of a newspaper or broadcast programme.
example1_en: Our professor circled first edition on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了第一版。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss first edition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论第一版的材料。
collocations: first edition｜第一版 ; revised edition｜修订版 ; limited edition｜限量版 ; evening edition｜晚间版
tip_zh: edition指版本或期次；一本实体书通常叫a copy。

meanings_zh: adj. 地区的；区域性的
definition_en: Relating to a particular area within a country or world.
example1_en: I copied regional development into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把区域发展抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects regional development with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把区域发展和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: regional development｜区域发展 ; regional differences｜地区差异 ; regional economy｜区域经济 ; regional cooperation｜区域合作
tip_zh: regional范围通常比local大，比national小。

meanings_zh: adj. 不准确的；有误的
definition_en: not completely correct or exact
example1_en: The textbook introduces factually inaccurate in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了事实有误的。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of factually inaccurate.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得事实有误的这个例子。
collocations: inaccurate information｜不准确的信息 ; inaccurate estimate｜不准确的估计 ; factually inaccurate｜事实有误的
tip_zh: 指信息或测量不准确；不一定意味着故意造假。

meanings_zh: adj. 口头的；口述的 | adj. 口腔的；经口的
definition_en: spoken rather than written | relating to the mouth or taken through the mouth
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on oral examination.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论口试。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss oral examination.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论口试的材料。
collocations: oral examination｜口试 ; oral tradition｜口述传统 ; oral health｜口腔健康 ; oral medication｜口服药物
tip_zh: oral既指口头的，也指口腔的；oral medication是口服药。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；讨喜的
definition_en: very pleasant, enjoyable, or charming
example1_en: Our professor circled a delightful experience on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了愉快的体验。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a delightful experience.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕愉快的体验展开说明。
collocations: a delightful experience｜愉快的体验 ; a delightful surprise｜令人欣喜的意外 ; a delightful place｜宜人的地方
tip_zh: delightful形容令人愉快；delighted指感到高兴。

meanings_zh: adj. 主观的
definition_en: Based on personal feelings or opinions rather than independent facts
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly subjective.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论非常主观的。
example2_en: The author returns to highly subjective when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了非常主观的。
collocations: subjective judgement｜主观判断 ; subjective experience｜主观体验 ; highly subjective｜非常主观的
tip_zh: subjective强调个人感受；objective强调客观事实。

meanings_zh: n. 不可能性；不可能的事
definition_en: the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen
example1_en: Office hours began with a practical impossibility.
example1_zh: 答疑从实际上不可能的事开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a practical impossibility.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得实际上不可能的事这个例子。
collocations: a practical impossibility｜实际上不可能的事 ; a physical impossibility｜客观条件下不可能的事 ; the impossibility of doing something｜做某事的不可能性
tip_zh: 指不可能性时不可数；指一件不可能的事时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 闲置的；未运转的 | adj. 懒散的；无所事事的 | v. 发动机空转
definition_en: Not being used or doing any work. | Avoiding work or spending time doing nothing. | For an engine to run while the vehicle remains still.
example1_en: The textbook introduces idle machinery in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了闲置的机器。
example2_en: The reading connects idle machinery with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把闲置的机器和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: stand idle｜闲置着 ; idle machinery｜闲置的机器 ; an idling engine｜空转的发动机 ; idle gossip｜无聊的闲言碎语
tip_zh: idle可指人闲着、设备闲置，也可指发动机空转。

meanings_zh: n. 机构；院校 | n. 制度；惯例
definition_en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose. | An established custom or system within a society.
example1_en: Office hours began with educational institution.
example1_zh: 答疑从教育机构开始。
example2_en: The reading connects educational institution with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把教育机构和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: educational institution｜教育机构 ; financial institution｜金融机构 ; the institution of marriage｜婚姻制度
tip_zh: 可指具体机构，也可指婚姻等社会制度。

meanings_zh: n. 洗脸盆；盆 | n. 流域 | n. 盆地
