definition_en: A wide, open container for water or washing. | The land drained by a river and its smaller rivers. | A broad area of low land surrounded by higher ground.
example1_en: The textbook introduces wash basin in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了洗脸盆。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of wash basin.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得洗脸盆这个例子。
collocations: wash basin｜洗脸盆 ; river basin｜河流流域 ; drainage basin｜集水区
tip_zh: river basin指整个流域，不只是河道。

meanings_zh: adj. 垂直的；竖直的 | n. 垂直线；竖直位置
definition_en: pointing straight up or down, perpendicular to a horizontal surface | a vertical line, direction, or position
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a vertical line.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于垂直线的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a vertical line.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得垂直线这个例子。
collocations: a vertical line｜垂直线 ; vertical stripes｜竖条纹 ; vertical farming｜垂直农业 ; a vertical axis｜纵轴
tip_zh: vertical指竖直方向；horizontal指水平方向。

meanings_zh: n. 商业；贸易
definition_en: The activity of buying and selling goods and services.
example1_en: I copied international commerce into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把国际贸易抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around international commerce.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕国际贸易展开说明。
collocations: international commerce｜国际贸易 ; electronic commerce｜电子商务 ; chamber of commerce｜商会
tip_zh: commerce通常不可数，侧重商品和服务的买卖活动。

meanings_zh: v. 任命；委派 | v. 指定；约定
definition_en: to officially choose someone for a job or responsibility | to officially decide a time or place for something
example1_en: The professor asked us to appoint a committee.
example1_zh: 教授让我们任命委员会成员。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers appoint a committee before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要任命委员会成员。
collocations: appoint someone as｜任命某人为 ; appoint a committee｜任命委员会成员 ; at the appointed time｜在约定的时间
tip_zh: 任命某人可用appoint sb as或appoint sb to职位。

meanings_zh: adj. 视听的
definition_en: Using both sound and images to communicate information
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize audio-visual in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出视听的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up audio-visual while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了视听的。
collocations: audio-visual equipment｜视听设备 ; audio-visual aids｜视听教具 ; audio-visual materials｜视听材料
tip_zh: 也写作audiovisual，常缩写为AV。

meanings_zh: v. 忽略；未注意到 | v. 俯瞰；面向 | v. 宽容；不追究
definition_en: To fail to notice or consider something. | To have a view of somewhere from above. | To deliberately ignore a mistake or fault.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to overlook a detail.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求忽略细节。
example2_en: The passage says students who can overlook a detail follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够忽略细节的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: overlook a detail｜忽略细节 ; overlook the fact that｜忽略这一事实 ; overlook the sea｜俯瞰大海 ; overlook a mistake｜不追究错误
tip_zh: overlook可指忽略或俯瞰；不要与监督的oversee混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 使精疲力竭 | v. 耗尽；用完 | n. 废气；排气管
definition_en: To make someone extremely tired. | To use all of something, leaving none remaining. | Waste gases from an engine, or the pipe releasing them.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer exhaust natural resources during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时耗尽自然资源。
example2_en: The passage says students who can exhaust natural resources follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够耗尽自然资源的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: exhaust natural resources｜耗尽自然资源 ; exhaust all possibilities｜尝试所有可能的办法 ; exhaust fumes｜废气 ; an exhaust pipe｜排气管
tip_zh: exhausted 指人累极了；exhausting 指事物令人疲惫。

meanings_zh: n. 目录；商品目录册 | v. 编入目录；分类记录 | n. 一连串坏事
definition_en: An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures | Make an organised record of items and their details | A series of unpleasant events or failures
example1_en: Our professor circled library catalogue on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了图书馆目录。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss library catalogue.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论图书馆目录的材料。
collocations: library catalogue｜图书馆目录 ; product catalogue｜产品目录 ; catalogue a collection｜为藏品编目 ; a catalogue of errors｜一连串错误
tip_zh: 英式拼写catalogue；美式常写catalog。

meanings_zh: adj. 幼稚的；不成熟的 | adj. 孩子的；孩子气的
definition_en: Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult. | Typical of or connected with children.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about childish behaviour.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于幼稚的行为的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of childish behaviour.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得幼稚的行为这个例子。
collocations: childish behaviour｜幼稚的行为 ; childish argument｜幼稚的争论 ; childish delight｜孩子般的喜悦
tip_zh: childish 常含贬义；childlike 多指天真无邪。

meanings_zh: n. 树篱 | n. 防范损失的手段 | v. 回避明确表态；含糊其辞
definition_en: a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary | something that reduces the risk of financial loss | to avoid giving a clear or definite answer
example1_en: Office hours began with a hedge against inflation.
example1_zh: 答疑从对冲通胀的手段开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a hedge against inflation to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用对冲通胀的手段来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: trim a hedge｜修剪树篱 ; a hedge against inflation｜对冲通胀的手段 ; hedge your bets｜多方下注以分散风险
tip_zh: 金融义常用 a hedge against，表示防范某种风险。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人不安的
definition_en: Making someone feel worried, upset, or uncomfortable.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about deeply disturbing.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于极其令人不安的的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used deeply disturbing to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用极其令人不安的来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: disturbing news｜令人不安的消息 ; a disturbing trend｜令人担忧的趋势 ; deeply disturbing｜极其令人不安的
tip_zh: disturbing指事物令人不安；disturbed指人感到不安。

meanings_zh: n. 器官 | n. 管风琴；风琴
definition_en: A body part that performs a particular function. | A keyboard instrument producing sound through pipes or electronic equipment.
example1_en: I copied organ donation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把器官捐献抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around organ donation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕器官捐献展开说明。
collocations: internal organs｜内脏器官 ; organ donation｜器官捐献 ; organ transplant｜器官移植 ; play the organ｜弹风琴
tip_zh: organ指器官；organism指完整的生物体。

meanings_zh: n. 交响曲
definition_en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements
example1_en: The textbook introduces symphony orchestra in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了交响乐团。
example2_en: The reading connects symphony orchestra with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把交响乐团和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: compose a symphony｜创作交响曲 ; perform a symphony｜演奏交响曲 ; symphony orchestra｜交响乐团
tip_zh: symphony指交响曲；交响乐团用symphony orchestra。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；瑕疵 | v. 叛离；投奔另一方
definition_en: A fault that makes something imperfect or unable to work properly. | To leave a country or group and join an opposing one.
example1_en: Our professor circled a design defect on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了设计缺陷。
example2_en: The reading connects a design defect with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把设计缺陷和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a design defect｜设计缺陷 ; a manufacturing defect｜制造缺陷 ; a birth defect｜先天缺陷 ; defect to the opposition｜转投反对派
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/dɪˈfekt/。

meanings_zh: n. 变化；差异 | n. 变体；变种
definition_en: A difference or change in amount, level, form, or quality. | A version of something that differs from its usual form.
example1_en: Office hours began with seasonal variation.
example1_zh: 答疑从季节性变化开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss seasonal variation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论季节性变化的材料。
collocations: seasonal variation｜季节性变化 ; variation in temperature｜温度变化 ; genetic variation｜遗传变异 ; a variation on a theme｜同一主题的变体
tip_zh: variation in指某方面的差异；variation on指变体。

meanings_zh: n. 荣誉；尊敬；荣幸 | v. 尊敬；表彰 | v. 履行承诺；遵守协议
definition_en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege. | To show deep respect or publicly recognize someone's achievements. | To do what a promise or agreement requires.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a great honour.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论莫大的荣幸。
example2_en: A campus survey used a great honour to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用莫大的荣幸来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a great honour｜莫大的荣幸 ; in honour of｜为纪念；向……致敬 ; honour a commitment｜履行承诺 ; a guest of honour｜贵宾
tip_zh: 英式honour，美式honor；h不发音，用an。

meanings_zh: v. 否认 | v. 拒绝给予；不准
definition_en: Say that something is not true or did not happen. | Refuse to give or allow someone something.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to deny an allegation.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须否认指控。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to deny an allegation.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来否认指控。
collocations: deny doing something｜否认做过某事 ; deny an allegation｜否认指控 ; deny access to｜不准使用或进入
tip_zh: 否认做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。

meanings_zh: n. 纽带；亲密关系 | n. 债券 | v. 建立亲密关系；黏合
definition_en: a close connection between people or groups | an investment representing a loan with promised repayment and interest | to develop a close relationship or join things firmly together
example1_en: The textbook introduces a strong bond in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了牢固的纽带。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a strong bond.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得牢固的纽带这个例子。
collocations: a strong bond｜牢固的纽带 ; form a bond｜建立亲密关系 ; government bonds｜政府债券 ; bond with｜与……建立亲密关系
tip_zh: bond with sb指增进感情；issue bonds指发行债券。

meanings_zh: n. 地球仪 | n. 地球；世界 | n. 球体；球状物
definition_en: A ball-shaped model of Earth showing its land and oceans. | The Earth, especially when considering all its regions. | An object shaped like a ball.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a glass globe in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了玻璃球。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a glass globe.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕玻璃球展开说明。
collocations: across the globe｜遍及全球 ; around the globe｜世界各地 ; a glass globe｜玻璃球
tip_zh: a globe常指地球仪；the globe常指整个世界。

meanings_zh: n. 栖息地；生存环境
definition_en: the natural environment where an animal or plant lives
example1_en: Our professor circled natural habitat on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了自然栖息地。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of natural habitat.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得自然栖息地这个例子。
collocations: natural habitat｜自然栖息地 ; habitat loss｜栖息地丧失 ; habitat destruction｜栖息地破坏 ; protect habitats｜保护栖息地
tip_zh: habit 是习惯，habitat 是动植物的栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 评估；评价 | n. 学习考核
definition_en: A judgement about something based on careful examination. | A task or process used to measure a learner's progress.
example1_en: I copied risk assessment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把风险评估抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used risk assessment to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用风险评估来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: risk assessment｜风险评估 ; continuous assessment｜持续性考核 ; carry out an assessment｜进行评估
tip_zh: 评估某事用assessment of；动词形式是assess。

meanings_zh: n. 耻辱；丢脸 | n. 可耻的人或事 | v. 使蒙羞
definition_en: loss of respect caused by unacceptable behaviour | a person or thing deserving strong disapproval | to cause someone or something to lose respect
example1_en: I copied a disgrace to into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把给……丢脸的人或事抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a disgrace to when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了给……丢脸的人或事。
collocations: in disgrace｜蒙羞地 ; bring disgrace on｜使……蒙羞 ; a disgrace to｜给……丢脸的人或事 ; disgrace yourself｜使自己丢脸
tip_zh: 泛指耻辱时不可数；a disgrace指可耻的人或事。

meanings_zh: v. 起诉；提起诉讼
definition_en: To take legal action against someone, usually seeking compensation.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to sue for damages.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何起诉要求损害赔偿。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers sue for damages before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要起诉要求损害赔偿。
collocations: sue for damages｜起诉要求损害赔偿 ; sue a company｜起诉公司 ; sue for negligence｜因过失提起诉讼
tip_zh: sue someone for something：因某事起诉某人。

meanings_zh: n. 电子学；电子技术 | n. 电子设备
definition_en: the study and use of electronic circuits and devices | devices that operate using electronic circuits
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about consumer electronics.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于消费类电子产品的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around consumer electronics.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕消费类电子产品展开说明。
collocations: consumer electronics｜消费类电子产品 ; electronics industry｜电子工业 ; study electronics｜学习电子学
tip_zh: 指电子学时虽以s结尾，谓语仍用单数。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；实施；进行 | v. 传导热或电 | n. 行为；举止
definition_en: to organize and carry out an activity | to allow heat or electricity to pass through | the way a person behaves, especially towards others
example1_en: The professor asked us to conduct research.
example1_zh: 教授让我们开展研究。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers conduct research before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要开展研究。
collocations: conduct research｜开展研究 ; conduct a survey｜进行调查 ; conduct electricity｜导电 ; code of conduct｜行为准则
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

meanings_zh: n. 确信；确定性 | n. 必然发生的事；确定的事
definition_en: The state of being completely sure about something. | Something that is definitely true or sure to happen.
example1_en: I copied absolute certainty into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把绝对确定抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used absolute certainty to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用绝对确定来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: with certainty｜确定地 ; absolute certainty｜绝对确定 ; a degree of certainty｜一定程度的把握
tip_zh: 表确信通常不可数；a certainty指确定的事。

meanings_zh: n. 心理咨询师；辅导员 | n. 顾问
definition_en: Someone trained to help people discuss and manage personal problems. | Someone who gives professional advice on a particular subject.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a school counsellor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学校辅导员。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a school counsellor.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得学校辅导员这个例子。
collocations: a school counsellor｜学校辅导员 ; a marriage counsellor｜婚姻咨询师 ; a careers counsellor｜职业顾问
tip_zh: 英式counsellor，美式counselor；勿混councillor议员。

meanings_zh: adj. 海洋的；海生的 | adj. 海运的；船舶的 | n. 海军陆战队员
definition_en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it | Relating to ships and transport by sea | A soldier trained to serve on land and at sea
example1_en: The textbook introduces marine life in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了海洋生物。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of marine life.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得海洋生物这个例子。
collocations: marine life｜海洋生物 ; marine ecosystem｜海洋生态系统 ; marine pollution｜海洋污染 ; marine transport｜海上运输
tip_zh: marine侧重海洋；海军的通常用naval。

meanings_zh: n. 疗法；药物 | n. 解决办法；补救措施 | v. 补救；纠正
definition_en: A treatment or medicine used to relieve an illness. | A way of correcting a problem or improving a situation. | To correct a problem or improve an unsatisfactory situation.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about home remedy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于家庭疗法的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects home remedy with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把家庭疗法和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: home remedy｜家庭疗法 ; a remedy for｜针对……的疗法或办法 ; remedy a problem｜纠正问题 ; remedy the situation｜改善局面
tip_zh: 名词常接for；动词直接接问题，不加for。

meanings_zh: n. 认出；识别 | n. 认可；赞赏 | n. 承认；正式认可
definition_en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before. | Public appreciation of someone's achievements or value. | Acceptance that something exists, is true, or has official status.
example1_en: Our professor circled facial recognition on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了人脸识别。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss facial recognition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人脸识别的材料。
collocations: facial recognition｜人脸识别 ; gain recognition｜获得认可 ; in recognition of｜为表彰；为肯定 ; official recognition｜正式承认
tip_zh: 通常不可数；in recognition of常用于表彰贡献。

meanings_zh: v. 合作；配合
definition_en: working together or helping by doing what is requested
example1_en: The assignment is to cooperating with colleagues, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先与同事合作，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers cooperating with colleagues before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要与同事合作。
collocations: cooperating with colleagues｜与同事合作 ; cooperating on research｜合作开展研究 ; cooperating closely｜密切合作
tip_zh: cooperate的-ing形式；与某人合作用with。

meanings_zh: n. 药物过量 | v. 过量服药
definition_en: an amount of a drug taken that exceeds safe limits | to take a dangerously large amount of a drug
example1_en: Office hours began with an accidental overdose.
example1_zh: 答疑从意外用药过量开始。
example2_en: The reading connects an accidental overdose with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把意外用药过量和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an accidental overdose｜意外用药过量 ; a drug overdose｜药物过量 ; overdose on medication｜过量服用药物
tip_zh: 动词用 overdose on sth；名词用 an overdose of sth。

meanings_zh: adj. 负担得起的
definition_en: Not too expensive for someone to pay for.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on affordable housing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可负担的住房。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss affordable housing.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可负担的住房的材料。
collocations: affordable housing｜可负担的住房 ; affordable prices｜可承受的价格 ; affordable healthcare｜负担得起的医疗服务
tip_zh: 强调价格在承受范围内，不一定意味着绝对便宜。

meanings_zh: n. 布局；版面设计
definition_en: the way parts of a space or page are arranged
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about page layout.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于页面布局的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of page layout.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得页面布局这个例子。
collocations: page layout｜页面布局 ; room layout｜房间布局 ; an open-plan layout｜开放式布局
tip_zh: 名词layout写成一词；动词lay out分开写。

meanings_zh: v. 转变；改造；转换 | v. 改变宗教信仰；皈依 | n. 皈依者；新拥护者
definition_en: to change something into a different form, purpose, or system | to adopt a different religion or persuade someone to do so | someone who has adopted a new religion, belief, or practice
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to convert into.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须转变为。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to convert into.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来转变为。
collocations: convert into｜转变为 ; convert to｜改用；皈依 ; convert energy｜转换能量 ; convert a building｜改造建筑
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 运输；海运；装运 | n. 运费 | n. 船舶总称
definition_en: the business or process of transporting goods | the charge for delivering goods | ships considered together as a group
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about free shipping.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于免运费的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss free shipping.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论免运费的材料。
collocations: shipping costs｜运输费用 ; free shipping｜免运费 ; shipping industry｜航运业 ; shipping lanes｜航道
tip_zh: 通常不可数；网购中的shipping也可指非海运配送。

meanings_zh: n. 蚱蜢；蚂蚱
definition_en: An insect with long back legs used for jumping.
example1_en: Our professor circled a green grasshopper on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一只绿色蚱蜢。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a green grasshopper.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得一只绿色蚱蜢这个例子。
collocations: a green grasshopper｜一只绿色蚱蜢 ; a grasshopper leaps｜蚱蜢跳跃 ; grasshopper species｜蚱蜢种类
tip_zh: locust指能形成迁飞群的某些蝗虫。

meanings_zh: n. 海湾 | n. 巨大差距；严重分歧
definition_en: A large area of sea partly surrounded by land. | A major difference separating people, groups, or ideas.
example1_en: I copied a wide gulf into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把巨大差距抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a wide gulf.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论巨大差距的材料。
collocations: a wide gulf｜巨大差距 ; bridge the gulf｜弥合差距 ; the gulf between rich and poor｜贫富差距
tip_zh: gulf可指海湾，也常用gulf between表示巨大差距。

meanings_zh: adj. 永恒的；永久的 | adj. 无休止的；没完没了的
definition_en: Lasting forever, without an end. | Seeming to continue endlessly, often in an annoying way.
example1_en: The textbook introduces eternal life in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了永生。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around eternal life.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕永生展开说明。
collocations: eternal life｜永生 ; eternal love｜永恒的爱 ; eternal optimism｜始终不灭的乐观
tip_zh: eternal强调无终点；eternal complaints可夸张指抱怨不断。

meanings_zh: adj. 不同的；有区别的 | adj. 明显的；清晰的
definition_en: clearly different or separate from something else | easy to notice, hear, see, or recognize
example1_en: Our professor circled distinct from on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了与……不同。
example2_en: The reading connects distinct from with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把与……不同和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: distinct from｜与……不同 ; two distinct groups｜两个不同的群体 ; distinct advantage｜明显优势
tip_zh: distinct from表示“与……不同”；勿混淆为distant。

meanings_zh: v. 推测；猜测 | v. 投机买卖
definition_en: Form ideas about something without having enough evidence. | Buy and sell assets hoping to profit from price changes.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to speculate about the cause.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求推测原因。
example2_en: The reading asks you to speculate about the cause and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你推测原因，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: speculate about the cause｜推测原因 ; speculate that｜推测…… ; speculate in property｜炒作房地产
tip_zh: 推测常接about或that从句；投机领域用in。

meanings_zh: n. 存在 | n. 生活；生存状态
definition_en: the state of being real or present | a person's way of living, especially under particular conditions
example1_en: Our professor circled a peaceful existence on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了平静的生活。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a peaceful existence.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得平静的生活这个例子。
collocations: come into existence｜开始存在；形成 ; in existence｜现存的 ; the existence of｜……的存在 ; a peaceful existence｜平静的生活
tip_zh: 表示“存在”通常不可数；a quiet existence指平静生活。

meanings_zh: v. 面对；正视 | v. 当面对质；质问
definition_en: To face and deal with a difficult situation or problem. | To challenge someone directly about something they have done.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to confront a problem.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何正视问题。
example2_en: The passage says students who can confront a problem follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够正视问题的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: confront a problem｜正视问题 ; be confronted with｜面临 ; confront someone about something｜就某事质问某人
tip_zh: 直接接问题；be confronted with表示面临。

meanings_zh: adj. 实验的；基于实验的 | adj. 试验性的；尝试性的
definition_en: Relating to scientific tests or based on their results | Using new ideas or methods whose success is not yet established
example1_en: I copied experimental evidence into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把实验证据抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss experimental evidence.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论实验证据的材料。
collocations: experimental evidence｜实验证据 ; experimental design｜实验设计 ; experimental method｜实验方法 ; experimental treatment｜试验性治疗
tip_zh: experimental指实验的或试验性的，不是“有经验的”。

meanings_zh: n. 违法行为；犯规 | n. 冒犯；被冒犯的感受
definition_en: An act that breaks a law or rule. | Hurt or anger caused by something rude or disrespectful.
example1_en: I copied a criminal offence into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把刑事犯罪抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a criminal offence to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用刑事犯罪来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: commit an offence｜违法；犯罪 ; a criminal offence｜刑事犯罪 ; take offence｜感到被冒犯 ; cause offence｜引起反感
tip_zh: 英式拼写offence，美式offense；take offence表示生气。

meanings_zh: adj. 弄错的；误解的
definition_en: Wrong about something or based on an incorrect belief.
example1_en: Our professor circled if I am not mistaken on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了如果我没弄错。
example2_en: The author returns to if I am not mistaken when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了如果我没弄错。
collocations: be mistaken about｜对……弄错 ; mistaken belief｜错误观念 ; mistaken identity｜身份误认 ; if I am not mistaken｜如果我没弄错
tip_zh: 人作主语时常用be mistaken about，表示对某事弄错。

meanings_zh: n. 电报
definition_en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in written form
example1_en: After the lecture, we used telegram in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了电报。
example2_en: Students who can explain telegram usually follow the rest of a lecture on historical change.
example2_zh: 能解释电报的学生，通常跟得上一节关于历史变迁的讲座。
collocations: send a telegram｜发电报 ; receive a telegram｜收到电报 ; deliver a telegram｜递送电报
tip_zh: telegram是电报消息；telegraph指电报通信系统。

meanings_zh: n. 生物多样性
definition_en: The variety of living things in a habitat or on Earth.
example1_en: The field course measured biodiversity along the campus stream.
example1_zh: 野外课测量了校园溪流一带的生物多样性。
example2_en: The reading links biodiversity to how well a forest recovers after a fire.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把生物多样性和火灾后森林的恢复能力联系起来。
collocations: biodiversity loss｜生物多样性丧失 ; protect biodiversity｜保护生物多样性
tip_zh: 不可数名词，前面通常不加 a。

meanings_zh: adj. 负担不起的
definition_en: Too expensive for someone to pay for.
example1_en: I copied unaffordable housing into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把难以负担的住房抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects unaffordable housing with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把难以负担的住房和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: unaffordable housing｜难以负担的住房 ; unaffordable rents｜负担不起的租金 ; become unaffordable｜变得难以负担
tip_zh: 强调超出支付能力，不只是价格高。

meanings_zh: adj. 自雇的；个体经营的
definition_en: Working for yourself rather than being employed by an organisation.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used self-employed in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了自雇的。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses self-employed when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了自雇的。
collocations: self-employed workers｜自雇劳动者 ; become self-employed｜开始自主经营 ; self-employed consultant｜独立执业顾问
tip_zh: 指为自己工作，不等于失业；注意保留连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 筹款；募捐活动
definition_en: The activity of collecting money for an organization or cause.
example1_en: I wrote fund-raising on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把fund-raising和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses fund-raising when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了筹款。
collocations: fund-raising event｜筹款活动 ; fund-raising campaign｜筹款行动 ; fund-raising target｜筹款目标
tip_zh: 也常拼作fundraising；raise funds意为筹款。

meanings_zh: v. 批准；发许可证给 | n. 执照；许可证
definition_en: to give official permission for an activity | an official document permitting an activity or ownership
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to license someone to do something.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何许可某人做某事。
example2_en: The passage says students who can license someone to do something follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够许可某人做某事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: license someone to do something｜许可某人做某事 ; a driving license｜驾驶执照 ; apply for a license｜申请许可证 ; a licensed operator｜持牌经营者
tip_zh: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。

meanings_zh: n. 甲虫
definition_en: An insect with hard outer wings covering its flying wings.
example1_en: The textbook introduces dung beetle in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了蜣螂。
example2_en: A campus survey used dung beetle to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用蜣螂来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: dung beetle｜蜣螂 ; stag beetle｜锹甲 ; beetle species｜甲虫种类
tip_zh: 指甲虫；不要用它表示“近视的人”。

meanings_zh: n. 氢；氢气
definition_en: the lightest chemical element, a colourless gas that burns easily
example1_en: Office hours began with hydrogen fuel.
example1_zh: 答疑从氢燃料开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of hydrogen fuel.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得氢燃料这个例子。
collocations: hydrogen fuel｜氢燃料 ; hydrogen gas｜氢气 ; hydrogen fuel cell｜氢燃料电池
tip_zh: hydrogen是不可数名词，表示化学元素氢或氢气。

meanings_zh: n. 研究结果；调查发现
definition_en: information or conclusions obtained through research or investigation
example1_en: I copied research findings into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把研究结果抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around research findings.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕研究结果展开说明。
collocations: research findings｜研究结果 ; key findings｜主要发现 ; publish findings｜公布研究结果 ; preliminary findings｜初步结果
tip_zh: 常用复数：the findings suggest，谓语不用单数。

meanings_zh: adj. 畅销的
definition_en: selling in very large quantities compared with similar products
example1_en: After the lecture, we used best-selling in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了畅销的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up best-selling while discussing evidence about the humanities.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人文学科的证据时提到了畅销的。
collocations: best-selling novel｜畅销小说 ; best-selling author｜畅销书作家 ; best-selling product｜畅销产品
tip_zh: best-selling作形容词；bestseller是畅销书或商品。

meanings_zh: adj. 行政的；管理的
definition_en: Related to organising and running an institution or business.
example1_en: I copied administrative staff into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把行政人员抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around administrative staff.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕行政人员展开说明。
collocations: administrative staff｜行政人员 ; administrative costs｜行政成本 ; administrative tasks｜行政事务
tip_zh: 指机构的行政管理，不等于政府本身。

meanings_zh: n. 思想家；善于思考的人
definition_en: someone who thinks deeply or develops important ideas
example1_en: I copied independent thinker into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把独立思考者抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to independent thinker when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了独立思考者。
collocations: independent thinker｜独立思考者 ; critical thinker｜善于批判性思考的人 ; influential thinker｜有影响力的思想家 ; original thinker｜有独创思想的人
tip_zh: thinker指人；thinking指思考过程或思维方式。

meanings_zh: adj. 完全的；彻底的 | v. 说出；发出声音
definition_en: Complete or total, used to emphasise something | To say something or make a sound with your voice
example1_en: Office hours began with utter chaos.
example1_zh: 答疑从彻底混乱开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used utter chaos to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用彻底混乱来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: utter chaos｜彻底混乱 ; utter disbelief｜完全不敢相信 ; utter a word｜说一个字 ; utter a sound｜发出声音
tip_zh: 形容词utter只放名词前；副词用utterly。

meanings_zh: n. 感激；感恩
definition_en: A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.
example1_en: Office hours began with express gratitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从表达感激开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used express gratitude to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用表达感激来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: express gratitude｜表达感激 ; gratitude to someone｜对某人的感激 ; gratitude for something｜对某事的感激 ; a token of gratitude｜一点谢意
tip_zh: 对人感激用to，对某事感激用for；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 蒸发；使蒸发 | v. 逐渐消失；消散
definition_en: to change from liquid into gas, or cause this change | to disappear, especially gradually
example1_en: The professor asked us to evaporate rapidly.
example1_zh: 教授让我们迅速蒸发。
example2_en: The reading asks you to evaporate rapidly and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你迅速蒸发，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: water evaporates｜水蒸发 ; evaporate rapidly｜迅速蒸发 ; moisture evaporates｜水分蒸发 ; hopes evaporate｜希望逐渐破灭
tip_zh: 蒸发不一定要沸腾；evaporate也可比喻希望等消失。

meanings_zh: adj. 可预测的；意料之中的 | adj. 老套的；缺乏新意的
definition_en: Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected. | Boring because nothing surprising or original happens.
example1_en: Office hours began with highly predictable.
example1_zh: 答疑从十分容易预测的开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly predictable.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕十分容易预测的展开说明。
collocations: predictable outcome｜可预料的结果 ; predictable pattern｜可预测的模式 ; highly predictable｜十分容易预测的
tip_zh: 既可表示结果可预料，也可贬指情节老套。

meanings_zh: v. 发现；揭露 | v. 揭开覆盖物
definition_en: to discover something previously hidden or unknown | to remove something covering an object or surface
example1_en: The lab instructions say to uncover evidence.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发现证据。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to uncover evidence.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发现证据。
collocations: uncover evidence｜发现证据 ; uncover the truth｜揭示真相 ; uncover a problem｜发现问题
tip_zh: 既可指揭去实物覆盖，也可指发现隐藏事实。

meanings_zh: adj. 严厉的；苛刻的 | adj. 严酷的；恶劣的 | adj. 刺耳的；刺眼的；刺激的
definition_en: unkind or excessively severe in judging or treating others | very difficult or unpleasant to live in or experience | unpleasantly strong and uncomfortable to the senses
example1_en: Our professor circled harsh criticism on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了苛刻的批评。
example2_en: The author returns to harsh criticism when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了苛刻的批评。
collocations: harsh criticism｜苛刻的批评 ; harsh conditions｜恶劣的条件 ; harsh punishment｜严厉的惩罚 ; harsh light｜刺眼的光
tip_zh: 比strict更强调严厉得令人不快或难以承受。

meanings_zh: n. 命运；天意 | n. 结局；遭遇
definition_en: a power believed to control what happens in people's lives | what eventually happens to someone or something, often something bad
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on seal someone's fate.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论决定某人的命运。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around seal someone's fate.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕决定某人的命运展开说明。
collocations: leave something to fate｜让某事听天由命 ; seal someone's fate｜决定某人的命运 ; suffer the same fate｜遭遇同样的结局
tip_zh: 表示天意时通常不可数；a terrible fate指悲惨结局。

meanings_zh: adj. 绝望的；不顾一切的 | adj. 极度渴望的；急需的 | adj. 危急的；极严重的
definition_en: Feeling nearly hopeless and ready to try anything. | Wanting or needing something very badly. | Extremely serious or dangerous and needing immediate action.
example1_en: The textbook introduces desperate for help in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了急需帮助。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss desperate for help.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论急需帮助的材料。
collocations: desperate for help｜急需帮助 ; desperate to escape｜拼命想逃脱 ; a desperate attempt｜孤注一掷的尝试 ; desperate measures｜不得已的极端措施
tip_zh: 渴望某物用desperate for；急切做某事用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 骨骼；骨架 | n. 基本框架；梗概
definition_en: The framework of bones supporting a human or animal body. | A basic structure to which more details can be added.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about human skeleton.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于人体骨骼的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss human skeleton.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人体骨骼的材料。
collocations: human skeleton｜人体骨骼 ; dinosaur skeleton｜恐龙骨架 ; skeleton staff｜最低限度的工作人员
tip_zh: skeleton staff指维持运转所需的最少人员。

meanings_zh: n. 预防措施；防范措施
definition_en: an action taken to prevent danger, damage, or problems
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a precaution against fire.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论防火措施。
example2_en: The author returns to a precaution against fire when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了防火措施。
collocations: take precautions｜采取预防措施 ; as a precaution｜作为预防措施 ; safety precautions｜安全防范措施 ; a precaution against fire｜防火措施
tip_zh: 常用 take precautions；as a precaution 表示以防万一。

meanings_zh: n. 候选人；求职者 | n. 应试者
definition_en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position. | Someone taking an examination.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on suitable candidate.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论合适的人选。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around suitable candidate.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕合适的人选展开说明。
collocations: candidate for a position｜某职位的候选人 ; suitable candidate｜合适的人选 ; election candidate｜竞选候选人 ; exam candidate｜考生
tip_zh: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。

meanings_zh: n. 百科全书
definition_en: A book or website explaining many subjects or one field.
example1_en: I copied online encyclopedia into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把在线百科全书抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to online encyclopedia when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了在线百科全书。
collocations: online encyclopedia｜在线百科全书 ; encyclopedia entry｜百科全书条目 ; consult an encyclopedia｜查阅百科全书
tip_zh: 英式英语也常拼作encyclopaedia。

meanings_zh: adj. 肿胀的 | adj. 水位上涨的
definition_en: larger than normal because of injury or illness | carrying more water than usual after heavy rain
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a swollen ankle.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肿胀的脚踝。
example2_en: The author returns to a swollen ankle when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了肿胀的脚踝。
collocations: a swollen ankle｜肿胀的脚踝 ; swollen glands｜肿大的腺体 ; a swollen river｜水位上涨的河流
tip_zh: 也作swell的过去分词；过去式是swelled。

meanings_zh: n. 名声；声誉
definition_en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.
example1_en: I copied damage someone's reputation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把损害某人的声誉抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects damage someone's reputation with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把损害某人的声誉和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: build a reputation｜建立声誉 ; damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉 ; a reputation for quality｜品质优良的口碑
tip_zh: 用reputation for接特点；名声可好可坏。

meanings_zh: n. 家政服务员；客房服务员
definition_en: Someone employed to clean and look after homes or hotel rooms.
example1_en: Office hours began with hotel housekeeper.
example1_zh: 答疑从酒店客房服务员开始。
example2_en: The author returns to hotel housekeeper when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了酒店客房服务员。
collocations: hotel housekeeper｜酒店客房服务员 ; live-in housekeeper｜住家家政服务员 ; hire a housekeeper｜雇用家政服务员
tip_zh: 指受雇打理家务或客房的人，不限性别。

meanings_zh: n. 压力；负担 | v. 拉伤；使过度用力 | n. 品种；菌株；毒株
definition_en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources | to injure or overwork a muscle or body part | a particular type of plant, animal, or microorganism
example1_en: Office hours began with a strain of virus.
example1_zh: 答疑从一种病毒株开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a strain of virus.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一种病毒株展开说明。
collocations: put a strain on｜给……造成压力 ; under strain｜承受压力 ; strain a muscle｜拉伤肌肉 ; a strain of virus｜一种病毒株
tip_zh: strain可指拉伤；sprain主要指关节扭伤。

meanings_zh: n. 准确性；精确度
definition_en: the quality of being correct or free from errors
example1_en: I copied improve accuracy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把提高准确性抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to improve accuracy when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了提高准确性。
collocations: check the accuracy of｜核查……的准确性 ; improve accuracy｜提高准确性 ; a high degree of accuracy｜高度准确 ; historical accuracy｜史实准确性
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是accurate。

meanings_zh: n. 辩论；讨论 | v. 辩论；讨论 | v. 仔细考虑；权衡
definition_en: A discussion in which people express different views. | To discuss a subject by considering different views. | To think carefully about options before making a decision.
example1_en: Our professor circled public debate on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公开讨论。
example2_en: The author returns to public debate when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公开讨论。
collocations: public debate｜公开讨论 ; heated debate｜激烈的辩论 ; debate an issue｜讨论一个问题 ; debate whether to｜斟酌是否要
tip_zh: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

meanings_zh: n. 收割；收成 | v. 收割；采收
definition_en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered | to gather crops when they are ready
example1_en: Office hours began with a good harvest.
example1_zh: 答疑从好收成开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a good harvest.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得好收成这个例子。
collocations: a good harvest｜好收成 ; harvest season｜收获季节 ; harvest crops｜收割庄稼
tip_zh: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。

meanings_zh: v. 创立；建立 | v. 找到（find的过去式及分词）
definition_en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement | past tense and past participle of find
example1_en: The assignment is to found a company, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先创办公司，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to found a company.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们创办公司。
collocations: found a company｜创办公司 ; found a school｜创办学校 ; found a charity｜创办慈善机构
tip_zh: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

meanings_zh: n. 钙
definition_en: A chemical element needed for strong bones and teeth
example1_en: Our professor circled a source of calcium on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了钙的来源。
example2_en: The reading connects a source of calcium with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把钙的来源和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: calcium intake｜钙摄入量 ; calcium deficiency｜缺钙 ; calcium supplements｜钙补充剂 ; a source of calcium｜钙的来源
tip_zh: 不可数名词；化学符号为Ca。

meanings_zh: adv. 在经济上 | adv. 节约地；经济实惠地
definition_en: in a way relating to money, trade, or the economy | using little money, fuel, or other resources
example1_en: The lab manual says to economically viable before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先经济上可行的，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will economically viable when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会经济上可行的。
collocations: economically viable｜经济上可行的 ; economically disadvantaged｜经济条件不利的 ; economically dependent｜经济上依赖的 ; live economically｜节俭度日
tip_zh: 兼有economic的“经济上”和economical的“节约地”之意。

meanings_zh: n. 堡垒；要塞
definition_en: A strong building or enclosed place built for military defence.
example1_en: I copied coastal fort into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把海岸要塞抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects coastal fort with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把海岸要塞和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: build a fort｜建造堡垒 ; coastal fort｜海岸要塞 ; abandoned fort｜废弃的堡垒
tip_zh: fort侧重军事防御；castle常兼作贵族住所。

meanings_zh: n. 灌木
definition_en: A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree
example1_en: Our professor circled flowering shrub on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了开花灌木。
example2_en: The author returns to flowering shrub when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了开花灌木。
collocations: flowering shrub｜开花灌木 ; evergreen shrub｜常绿灌木 ; native shrubs｜本地灌木 ; plant shrubs｜种植灌木
tip_zh: 可数名词，指灌木植株；一片灌木可用shrubbery。

meanings_zh: adj. 学业的；学术的 | n. 大学教师；学者 | adj. 纯理论的；无实际意义的
definition_en: related to education, study, or research | someone who teaches or researches at a university | theoretical rather than useful in a practical situation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about academic achievement.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于学业成就的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to academic achievement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学业成就。
collocations: academic achievement｜学业成就 ; academic research｜学术研究 ; academic year｜学年 ; academic qualifications｜学历
tip_zh: 作名词指大学教师或研究者，通常不指大学生。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾填埋场 | n. 垃圾填埋
definition_en: A place where waste is buried in the ground. | The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.
example1_en: I copied landfill site into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把垃圾填埋场抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around landfill site.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕垃圾填埋场展开说明。
collocations: landfill site｜垃圾填埋场 ; send waste to landfill｜将垃圾送去填埋 ; landfill capacity｜填埋场容量
tip_zh: 指填埋场时可数；指填埋处理时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 经销商；商人 | n. 发牌者
definition_en: A person or business that buys and sells particular goods. | The person who gives out cards in a card game.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a car dealer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论汽车经销商。
example2_en: The reading connects a car dealer with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把汽车经销商和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a car dealer｜汽车经销商 ; an art dealer｜艺术品商人 ; a reputable dealer｜信誉良好的经销商
tip_zh: 常在前面加商品类别，如car dealer，明确经营范围。

meanings_zh: n. 诗；韵文 | n. 诗节；歌词的一段
definition_en: Writing arranged with rhythm, often using rhyme. | A group of lines forming part of a poem or song.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about free verse.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于自由诗的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss free verse.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自由诗的材料。
collocations: free verse｜自由诗 ; blank verse｜无韵诗 ; in verse｜以韵文形式 ; the opening verse｜开篇诗节
tip_zh: 泛指韵文时不可数；指某一诗节时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 偏爱；偏好 | n. 优先待遇；优先权
definition_en: a greater liking for one thing than for another | an advantage given to someone or something over others
example1_en: The textbook introduces personal preference in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了个人偏好。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around personal preference.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕个人偏好展开说明。
collocations: a preference for｜对……的偏好 ; personal preference｜个人偏好 ; give preference to｜优先考虑 ; in preference to｜优先于；而不是
tip_zh: 对某物的偏好用preference for，不用to。

meanings_zh: n. 时代；历史时期
definition_en: A period distinguished by particular events, developments, or ways of life.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about digital era.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于数字时代的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss digital era.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数字时代的材料。
collocations: digital era｜数字时代 ; a new era｜新时代 ; the end of an era｜一个时代的终结
tip_zh: era强调具有共同特征的时代，不指固定年数。

meanings_zh: n. 特征；性格特点
definition_en: A particular quality in someone's character or an organism's nature.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about personality trait.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于性格特征的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects personality trait with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把性格特征和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: personality trait｜性格特征 ; inherited trait｜遗传特征 ; distinctive trait｜独特特征
tip_zh: trait是可数名词，常指性格或遗传特征。

meanings_zh: adj. 同性恋的 | adj. 与同性恋者相关的
definition_en: Romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex. | Relating to gay people, their lives, or their culture.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on openly gay.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公开同性恋身份的。
example2_en: The reading connects openly gay with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把公开同性恋身份的和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: gay couple｜同性伴侣 ; gay rights｜同性恋者权利 ; openly gay｜公开同性恋身份的
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；“快乐的”义现已少用。

meanings_zh: adj. 同情的；体谅的 | adj. 赞同的；支持的
definition_en: showing understanding and care for someone's difficulties | showing approval or support for an idea or proposal
example1_en: Office hours began with a sympathetic listener.
example1_zh: 答疑从体贴的倾听者开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a sympathetic listener when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了体贴的倾听者。
collocations: a sympathetic listener｜体贴的倾听者 ; a sympathetic attitude｜体谅的态度 ; sympathetic to a proposal｜赞同一项提议
tip_zh: 常接to或towards；不表示“讨人喜欢的”。

meanings_zh: n. 青少年 | adj. 青春期的；青少年的
definition_en: a young person developing from a child into an adult | relating to the stage between childhood and adulthood
example1_en: The textbook introduces adolescent development in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了青少年发育。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of adolescent development.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得青少年发育这个例子。
collocations: adolescent development｜青少年发育 ; adolescent behaviour｜青少年行为 ; adolescent mental health｜青少年心理健康
tip_zh: 既可作名词也可作形容词；比 teenager 更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 雄孔雀
definition_en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out
example1_en: Our professor circled peacock feathers on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了孔雀羽毛。
example2_en: A campus survey used peacock feathers to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用孔雀羽毛来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: peacock feathers｜孔雀羽毛 ; a peacock's tail｜雄孔雀的尾羽 ; as proud as a peacock｜像孔雀般得意
tip_zh: 严格说peacock指雄孔雀，雌孔雀叫peahen。

meanings_zh: n. 游行；列队表演 | v. 列队行进；游行 | v. 炫耀；展示
definition_en: An organised procession of people or vehicles watched by spectators. | To walk together in an organised public procession. | To show something publicly, often to attract admiration.
example1_en: I copied a street parade into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把街头游行抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a street parade when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了街头游行。
collocations: a street parade｜街头游行 ; a carnival parade｜嘉年华游行 ; parade through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip_zh: parade重在列队展示；抗议游行常用march。

meanings_zh: adj. 有益的；有利的
definition_en: Having a helpful or positive effect.
example1_en: I copied mutually beneficial into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把互利的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to mutually beneficial when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了互利的。
collocations: beneficial effect｜有益影响 ; beneficial to health｜有益健康 ; mutually beneficial｜互利的
tip_zh: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

meanings_zh: adj. 经典的；公认优秀的 | adj. 典型的 | n. 经典作品
definition_en: Widely admired for lasting quality and value. | Showing the most recognizable features of a particular kind. | A work admired over time for its excellent quality.
example1_en: Our professor circled timeless classic on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了永恒的经典。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of timeless classic.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得永恒的经典这个例子。
collocations: classic example｜典型例子 ; classic novel｜经典小说 ; timeless classic｜永恒的经典
tip_zh: classic指经典或典型；古典音乐用classical。

meanings_zh: v. 打鼾；打呼噜 | n. 鼾声
definition_en: to breathe noisily through your nose and throat while sleeping | a noisy breath made by someone who is sleeping
example1_en: The lab instructions say to snore loudly.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求大声打鼾。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to snore loudly.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们大声打鼾。
collocations: snore loudly｜大声打鼾 ; start snoring｜开始打鼾 ; a loud snore｜一声响亮的鼾声
tip_zh: 作动词通常不及物；snoring可指打鼾这一现象。

meanings_zh: v. 消化 | v. 理解；吸收信息 | n. 摘要；文摘
definition_en: Break down food inside the body so it can be used. | Think about information until you understand it. | A short collection of the main points from longer material.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to digest food.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须消化食物。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to digest food.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们消化食物。
collocations: digest food｜消化食物 ; digest information｜理解信息 ; a monthly digest｜月刊文摘
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，读 /ˈdaɪdʒest/。

meanings_zh: n. 座右铭；格言
definition_en: A short phrase expressing someone's guiding belief or purpose.
example1_en: Our professor circled a personal motto on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了个人座右铭。
example2_en: The author returns to a personal motto when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了个人座右铭。
collocations: a personal motto｜个人座右铭 ; a school motto｜校训 ; adopt a motto｜采用一句格言
tip_zh: motto强调指导信念；slogan更常指宣传口号。

meanings_zh: v. 忍受；承受 | v. 持续；长存
definition_en: To suffer something difficult or unpleasant without giving up. | To continue existing despite difficulties or the passage of time.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to endure hardship.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须忍受艰苦。
example2_en: The reading asks you to endure hardship and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你忍受艰苦，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: endure hardship｜忍受艰苦 ; endure pain｜忍受疼痛 ; endure for centuries｜延续数世纪
tip_zh: 表“忍受”直接接宾语；表“持续”可不接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 水坝 | v. 在……筑坝；拦水
definition_en: A barrier across a river that holds back water. | To block a river or stream with a barrier.
example1_en: Our professor circled a hydroelectric dam on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了水电站大坝。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of a hydroelectric dam.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得水电站大坝这个例子。
collocations: build a dam｜修建水坝 ; a hydroelectric dam｜水电站大坝 ; dam a river｜在河上筑坝
tip_zh: dam是拦水的坝；reservoir是蓄水的水库。

meanings_zh: adj. 极地的 | adj. 完全相反的
definition_en: Relating to the regions around the Earth's poles. | Completely opposite in character, direction, or opinion.
example1_en: I copied polar regions into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把极地地区抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to polar regions when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极地地区。
collocations: polar regions｜极地地区 ; polar ice caps｜极地冰盖 ; polar bear｜北极熊 ; polar opposites｜截然相反的人或事物
tip_zh: polar指两极地区；polar opposites表示截然相反。

meanings_zh: n. 欣喜；快乐 | v. 使欣喜；使高兴 | n. 令人愉快的事物
definition_en: a feeling of great pleasure or happiness | to give someone great pleasure | something or someone that gives great pleasure
example1_en: The professor explained delight with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了欣喜。
example2_en: Students who can explain delight usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
example2_zh: 能解释欣喜的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。
collocations: with delight｜欣喜地 ; to someone's delight｜令某人高兴的是 ; take delight in｜以…为乐 ; delight in doing something｜乐于做某事
tip_zh: delighted形容人感到高兴；delightful形容事物令人愉快。

meanings_zh: n. 不确定；无把握 | n. 不确定的因素
definition_en: a state of not knowing what is true or will happen | something that is unknown or cannot be predicted
example1_en: Our professor circled economic uncertainty on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济不确定性。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economic uncertainty.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济不确定性的材料。
collocations: economic uncertainty｜经济不确定性 ; a period of uncertainty｜不确定的时期 ; reduce uncertainty｜减少不确定性 ; uncertainty about the future｜对未来的不确定
tip_zh: 泛指不确定状态通常不可数；具体未知因素可用复数。

meanings_zh: int. 好哇；万岁
definition_en: Used to express happiness, excitement, or approval.
example1_en: Our professor circled shout hurrah on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了高声欢呼。
example2_en: The reading connects shout hurrah with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把高声欢呼和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: shout hurrah｜高声欢呼 ; a final hurrah｜最后一次精彩表现
tip_zh: 与hooray意思相同；常独立使用，后接感叹号。

meanings_zh: adj. （能源、资源）可再生的 | adj. 可续期的
definition_en: Naturally replaced and therefore available for continued use. | Able to be extended for another period of time.
example1_en: Our professor circled renewable energy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可再生能源。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around renewable energy.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕可再生能源展开说明。
collocations: renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; renewable resources｜可再生资源 ; renewable sources｜可再生来源 ; renewable contract｜可续期合同
tip_zh: 名词renewables用复数，指可再生能源。

meanings_zh: v. 旋转；使转动 | v. 轮换；轮流
definition_en: to turn around a central point or axis | to change positions or duties in a regular order
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rotate clockwise.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须顺时针旋转。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to rotate clockwise.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们顺时针旋转。
collocations: rotate clockwise｜顺时针旋转 ; rotate crops｜轮作 ; rotate duties｜轮换职责
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：rotate the wheel；the wheel rotates。

meanings_zh: n. 热情；积极性
definition_en: Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.
example1_en: I copied generate enthusiasm into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把激发热情抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to generate enthusiasm when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了激发热情。
collocations: enthusiasm for｜对……的热情 ; with enthusiasm｜热情地 ; generate enthusiasm｜激发热情 ; lose enthusiasm｜失去热情
tip_zh: 对某事的热情用enthusiasm for，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 王座；宝座 | n. 王位；王权
definition_en: A special chair used by a king or queen. | The position or power of a king or queen.
example1_en: I wrote throne on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把throne和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on historical change uses throne when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于历史变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了王座。
collocations: sit on a throne｜坐在王座上 ; ascend the throne｜登基 ; heir to the throne｜王位继承人
tip_zh: the throne可指王位，不一定指实体座椅。

meanings_zh: n. 缺点；不利方面
definition_en: a disadvantage or negative aspect of something
example1_en: Our professor circled a potential downside on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了潜在的不利之处。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a potential downside.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得潜在的不利之处这个例子。
collocations: the downside of｜……的弊端 ; a potential downside｜潜在的不利之处 ; on the downside｜从不利方面看
tip_zh: 常用the downside of/to sth，表示某事的弊端。

meanings_zh: v. 护送；陪同 | n. 护送者；陪同人员
definition_en: To accompany someone to guide or protect them | A person or group accompanying someone for protection or guidance
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to escort someone to.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须陪同某人前往。
example2_en: The reading asks you to escort someone to and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你陪同某人前往，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: escort someone to｜陪同某人前往 ; a police escort｜警方护送人员 ; under escort｜在护送下
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词英/ˈeskɔːt/，美/ˈeskɔːrt/。

meanings_zh: v. 传输；发送 | v. 传播；传染
definition_en: to send signals, information, or energy between places | to pass a disease from one living thing to another
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to transmit data.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何传输数据。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to transmit data.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来传输数据。
collocations: transmit data｜传输数据 ; transmit a signal｜发送信号 ; transmit a virus｜传播病毒
tip_zh: 过去式transmitted，进行式transmitting，均双写t。

meanings_zh: n. 识别；鉴定 | n. 身份证明 | n. 认同；共鸣
definition_en: the process of establishing who or what someone or something is | a document that proves who you are | a feeling of connection with another person or group
example1_en: Our professor circled proof of identification on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了身份证明。
example2_en: The reading connects proof of identification with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把身份证明和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: proof of identification｜身份证明 ; species identification｜物种鉴定 ; early identification｜早期识别 ; identification with｜对……的认同
tip_zh: 表示身份证明时通常不可数，可简称 ID。

meanings_zh: n. 运动；移动 | n. 动议；正式提议 | v. 用动作示意
definition_en: the act or process of moving | a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting | to signal something using a movement of your hand or head
example1_en: After the lecture, we used motion in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了运动。
example2_en: Students who can explain motion usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释运动的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: in motion｜运动中 ; set in motion｜使启动 ; pass a motion｜通过动议 ; motion to someone｜向某人示意
tip_zh: 动议可用pass或reject；in motion表示在运动中。

meanings_zh: n. 疯狂；极其愚蠢的行为 | n. 精神失常
definition_en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous behaviour. | An old-fashioned term for severe mental illness.
example1_en: I copied absolute madness into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把完全是胡闹抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used absolute madness to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用完全是胡闹来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: absolute madness｜完全是胡闹 ; sheer madness｜极其愚蠢 ; a moment of madness｜一时冲动
tip_zh: 指精神疾病的用法陈旧且可能冒犯，避免用于诊断。

meanings_zh: adj. 不知道的；未察觉的
definition_en: Not knowing or noticing that something exists or is happening.
example1_en: I copied completely unaware into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把完全不知情抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used completely unaware to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用完全不知情来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: unaware of｜未察觉到 ; completely unaware｜完全不知情 ; remain unaware｜仍不知情
tip_zh: 常用be unaware of或be unaware that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 同龄人；同等地位者 | v. 仔细看；费力地看 | n. 英国贵族
definition_en: Someone of similar age, status, or ability | To look carefully, especially when something is difficult to see | A person holding a British noble title
example1_en: I copied peer pressure into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把同伴压力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of peer pressure.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得同伴压力这个例子。
collocations: peer pressure｜同伴压力 ; peer review｜同行评审 ; peer group｜同龄群体 ; peer through｜透过……仔细看
tip_zh: 名词常用复数peers；动词常接through、at或into。

meanings_zh: n. 防御；保护 | n. 辩护；答辩 | n. 防守；防守队员
definition_en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm. | An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized. | Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.
example1_en: The textbook introduces self-defence in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自卫。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around self-defence.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕自卫展开说明。
collocations: defence against｜对……的防御 ; in defence of｜为……辩护 ; self-defence｜自卫 ; defence spending｜国防开支
tip_zh: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

meanings_zh: n. 直径
definition_en: a straight line through a circle's centre joining opposite edges
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about internal diameter.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于内径的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of internal diameter.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得内径这个例子。
collocations: in diameter｜直径为 ; measure the diameter｜测量直径 ; internal diameter｜内径 ; external diameter｜外径
tip_zh: 直径是diameter，半径是radius；尺寸后常接in diameter。

meanings_zh: adj. 高级的；资深的 | adj. 年长的；老年人的 | n. 毕业班学生；老年人
definition_en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation. | Older than someone else, or relating to older people. | A final-year school or college student, or an older adult.
example1_en: I copied senior management into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把高级管理层抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used senior management to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用高级管理层来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: senior management｜高级管理层 ; a senior position｜高级职位 ; senior citizen｜老年人 ; senior to someone｜级别高于某人
tip_zh: 比较级别用senior to，不用senior than。

meanings_zh: v. 激活；启动
definition_en: Make a device, system, or process start working.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer activate an account during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时激活账户。
example2_en: The reading asks you to activate an account and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你激活账户，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: activate an account｜激活账户 ; activate an alarm｜触发警报 ; activate a system｜启动系统
tip_zh: 强调使设备或系统开始运作；反义词为deactivate。

meanings_zh: v. 把…归因于；认为是…所作 | n. 特征；属性
definition_en: To regard something as caused or created by someone or something. | A quality or feature of a person or thing.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to attribute success to.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须把成功归因于。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to attribute success to.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们把成功归因于。
collocations: attribute success to｜把成功归因于 ; be attributed to｜被归因于 ; a key attribute｜一个关键特征
tip_zh: attribute A to B指把A归因于B；名词重音在首音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 多功能的
definition_en: Designed to perform several different tasks.
example1_en: I copied a multifunction printer into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把多功能打印机抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a multifunction printer.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕多功能打印机展开说明。
collocations: a multifunction printer｜多功能打印机 ; a multifunction device｜多功能设备 ; a multifunction display｜多功能显示屏
tip_zh: 作形容词，常放设备名词前；也可用multifunctional。

meanings_zh: v. 同情；体谅 | v. 赞同；支持
definition_en: To understand and care about someone's suffering or difficulties. | To agree with someone's ideas, aims, or position.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer sympathize with a cause during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时支持某项事业。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to sympathize with a cause.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来支持某项事业。
collocations: sympathize with someone｜同情某人 ; sympathize with a cause｜支持某项事业
tip_zh: 不直接接宾语：用 sympathize with；英式也拼 sympathise。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋白质
definition_en: A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about high in protein.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于富含蛋白质的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around high in protein.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕富含蛋白质展开说明。
collocations: high in protein｜富含蛋白质 ; a source of protein｜蛋白质来源 ; plant protein｜植物蛋白 ; protein intake｜蛋白质摄入量
tip_zh: 作营养物质通常不可数；指不同种类时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 逻辑；推理方式 | n. 逻辑学
definition_en: Reasoning that connects ideas in a clear, consistent way. | The study of rules for reasoning correctly.
example1_en: Office hours began with sound logic.
example1_zh: 答疑从严密的逻辑开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sound logic.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严密的逻辑的材料。
collocations: the logic behind something｜某事背后的逻辑 ; sound logic｜严密的逻辑 ; flawed logic｜有缺陷的逻辑 ; formal logic｜形式逻辑
tip_zh: 通常不可数；the logic behind表示背后的道理。

meanings_zh: n. 辐射；辐射能 | n. 放射治疗
definition_en: Energy travelling through space or matter as waves or particles. | Medical treatment using radiation to destroy cancer cells.
example1_en: I copied ultraviolet radiation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把紫外线辐射抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects ultraviolet radiation with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把紫外线辐射和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: ultraviolet radiation｜紫外线辐射 ; exposure to radiation｜受到辐射照射 ; radiation therapy｜放射治疗 ; solar radiation｜太阳辐射
tip_zh: 通常不可数；辐射不只指核辐射，也包括阳光。

meanings_zh: adj. 专业的；专用的
definition_en: Designed for a particular purpose or requiring specific expert knowledge.
example1_en: The textbook introduces highly specialised in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了高度专业化的。
example2_en: The reading connects highly specialised with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把高度专业化的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: specialised equipment｜专用设备 ; specialised knowledge｜专业知识 ; specialised training｜专业培训 ; highly specialised｜高度专业化的
tip_zh: 英式常用specialised，美式常用specialized。

meanings_zh: n. 松树；松木 | v. 苦苦思念；憔悴
definition_en: An evergreen tree with needles, or the wood it produces. | Long deeply for someone or something, sometimes becoming weak.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on pine forest.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论松林。
example2_en: The reading connects pine forest with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把松林和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pine forest｜松林 ; pine cone｜松果 ; pine for someone｜苦苦思念某人 ; pine away｜因思念而日渐憔悴
tip_zh: pine for表示渴望或思念；pine away指日渐憔悴。

meanings_zh: n. 人们 | adj. 民间的；传统的 | n. 民间音乐；民谣
definition_en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group. | Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people. | Music rooted in the traditions of a community.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about local folk.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于当地人的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of local folk.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得当地人这个例子。
collocations: local folk｜当地人 ; folk music｜民间音乐 ; folk tale｜民间故事 ; folk dance｜民间舞蹈
tip_zh: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。

meanings_zh: n. 纪律；自律 | n. 学科 | v. 惩戒；训练自律
definition_en: Controlled behaviour achieved by following rules or managing yourself. | A particular field of study or knowledge. | To punish misconduct or train someone to follow rules.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about self-discipline.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于自律的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used self-discipline to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用自律来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: self-discipline｜自律 ; maintain discipline｜维持纪律 ; academic discipline｜学科 ; discipline yourself to do something｜约束自己做某事
tip_zh: 表示纪律通常不可数；表示学科时可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 焦虑地；担忧地 | adv. 急切地
definition_en: In a worried or nervous way. | With a strong desire for something to happen.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to anxiously await.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习急切地等候。
example2_en: Students who anxiously await are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够急切地等候的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: wait anxiously｜焦急地等待 ; look anxiously at｜担忧地看着 ; anxiously await｜急切地等候
tip_zh: 常含担忧色彩；纯粹高兴地期待多用eagerly。

meanings_zh: n. 边界；分界线 | n. 界限；限度
definition_en: A line marking where one area ends and another begins | A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something
example1_en: I copied a national boundary into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把国界抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a national boundary.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国界这个例子。
collocations: a national boundary｜国界 ; set boundaries｜设定界限 ; cross a boundary｜越过边界 ; push the boundaries｜突破界限
tip_zh: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

meanings_zh: adj. 自由职业的 | adv. 以自由职业方式 | v. 从事自由职业
definition_en: Working independently for different clients rather than one employer | Independently, for different clients rather than one employer | To work independently, offering services to different clients
example1_en: The textbook introduces freelance writer in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自由撰稿人。
example2_en: The reading connects freelance writer with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把自由撰稿人和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: freelance writer｜自由撰稿人 ; work freelance｜从事自由职业 ; freelance work｜自由职业工作
tip_zh: work freelance中作副词；freelancer是自由职业者。

meanings_zh: n. 地平线 | n. 眼界；见识范围
definition_en: The line where the sky seems to meet land or sea. | The limits of someone's knowledge, experience, or interests.
example1_en: I wrote horizon on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把horizon和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up horizon while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了地平线。
collocations: on the horizon｜在地平线上；即将发生 ; broaden your horizons｜拓宽眼界 ; beyond the horizon｜在地平线之外
tip_zh: 表示眼界通常用复数：broaden your horizons。

meanings_zh: n. 方面；层面 | n. 尺寸；大小 | n. 维；维度
definition_en: A particular aspect of a situation, problem, or experience. | A measurement of something, such as its length or width. | An independent direction of measurement, such as length, width, or height.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a social dimension.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于社会层面的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a social dimension with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把社会层面和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a social dimension｜社会层面 ; add a new dimension｜增添新层面 ; physical dimensions｜实际尺寸 ; in three dimensions｜以三维形式
tip_zh: 表示长宽高等具体尺寸时，通常用复数dimensions。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；从而 | adv. 如此；以这种方式
definition_en: As a result of what has just been stated | In this way
example1_en: Thus, the lab report still needs a clearer definition.
example1_zh: 因此，实验报告仍然需要一个更清楚的定义。
example2_en: Thus, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
example2_zh: 因此，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。
collocations: thus reducing costs｜从而降低成本 ; thus enabling｜从而使……成为可能 ; thus far｜迄今为止
tip_zh: thus是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立句。

meanings_zh: n. 纺织品；织物 | adj. 纺织的
definition_en: cloth made by weaving, knitting, or other fibre processing | relating to cloth or its production
example1_en: Office hours began with textile industry.
example1_zh: 答疑从纺织业开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss textile industry.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纺织业的材料。
collocations: textile industry｜纺织业 ; textile production｜纺织品生产 ; textile waste｜纺织废料 ; textile factory｜纺织厂
tip_zh: 表示各类纺织品时常用复数textiles。

meanings_zh: n. 工匠；手艺人
definition_en: A skilled person, especially a man, who makes things by hand.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a skilled craftsman in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了技艺娴熟的工匠。
example2_en: The reading connects a skilled craftsman with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把技艺娴熟的工匠和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a skilled craftsman｜技艺娴熟的工匠 ; a master craftsman｜工艺大师 ; a traditional craftsman｜传统手艺人
tip_zh: 复数为craftsmen；性别中性表达可用craftsperson。

meanings_zh: v. 排放；发出
definition_en: to release gas, heat, light, or sound
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to emit light.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发光。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to emit light.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发光。
collocations: emit light｜发光 ; emit radiation｜释放辐射 ; emit greenhouse gases｜排放温室气体
tip_zh: 过去式 emitted，进行式 emitting，均双写 t。

meanings_zh: n. 不耐烦；焦躁 | n. 急切；迫不及待
definition_en: annoyance caused by waiting, delays, or other people's behaviour | a strong desire for something to happen soon
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about growing impatience.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于日益强烈的焦躁的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects growing impatience with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把日益强烈的焦躁和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: impatience with delays｜对延误的不耐烦 ; show impatience｜显出不耐烦 ; growing impatience｜日益强烈的焦躁 ; with impatience｜急切地；不耐烦地
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某人或事不耐烦常接with。

meanings_zh: adj. 有机种植的；有机的 | adj. 有机物的；生物体的 | adj. 自然发展的
definition_en: produced without artificial fertilizers or most synthetic pesticides | relating to living things or carbon-based substances | developing gradually and naturally rather than through outside intervention
example1_en: Office hours began with organic food.
example1_zh: 答疑从有机食品开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around organic food.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕有机食品展开说明。
collocations: organic food｜有机食品 ; organic farming｜有机农业 ; organic matter｜有机物 ; organic growth｜自然增长
tip_zh: 食品语境指有机生产；化学语境通常指含碳化合物。

meanings_zh: v. 不予考虑；不理会 | v. 解雇；开除 | v. 让离开；解散
definition_en: to decide something is not worth considering | to officially remove someone from their job | to tell someone or a group they may leave
example1_en: The lab instructions say to dismiss concerns.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求不理会担忧。
example2_en: The reading asks you to dismiss concerns and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你不理会担忧，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: dismiss concerns｜不理会担忧 ; dismiss an idea｜否定想法 ; dismiss someone from a job｜解雇某人 ; dismiss something as irrelevant｜认为某事无关而不予考虑
tip_zh: dismiss A as B：认为A是B而不予考虑。

meanings_zh: n. 移民入境；移居 | n. 入境检查；入境检查处
definition_en: The process of entering another country to live there. | The official checks or checkpoint for people entering a country.
example1_en: I copied immigration policy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把移民政策抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used immigration policy to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用移民政策来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: immigration policy｜移民政策 ; immigration control｜入境管制 ; immigration officer｜入境事务官员 ; go through immigration｜接受入境检查
tip_zh: immigration强调迁入；emigration强调迁出。

meanings_zh: n. 利益关系；股份 | n. 桩；尖头木棍 | v. 以……冒险；押上
definition_en: a financial share or personal interest in something | a pointed post driven into the ground | to risk money or something valuable on an outcome
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a stake in.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论在……中的权益。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a stake in.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论在……中的权益的材料。
collocations: a stake in｜在……中的权益 ; at stake｜处于危险中 ; stake a claim｜主张权利 ; stake your reputation on｜以声誉赌……
tip_zh: have a stake in指有利益关系；at stake指面临风险。

meanings_zh: n. 伏特（电压单位）
definition_en: A unit used to measure electrical potential difference
example1_en: I copied a twelve-volt battery into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把十二伏电池抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a twelve-volt battery.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得十二伏电池这个例子。
collocations: measure in volts｜以伏特计量 ; a twelve-volt battery｜十二伏电池 ; a voltage of five volts｜五伏电压
tip_zh: 伏特衡量电压；瓦特 watt 衡量功率。

meanings_zh: n. 肥料
definition_en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about chemical fertilizer.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于化肥的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used chemical fertilizer to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用化肥来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: chemical fertilizer｜化肥 ; organic fertilizer｜有机肥 ; apply fertilizer｜施肥
tip_zh: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 出版；发表 | n. 出版物
definition_en: The process of making written material available to the public. | A book, magazine, or other work made available to readers.
example1_en: Our professor circled academic publication on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学术出版物。
example2_en: The author returns to academic publication when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学术出版物。
collocations: publication date｜出版日期 ; publication of findings｜研究结果的发表 ; academic publication｜学术出版物
tip_zh: 指出版行为时不可数；指具体出版物时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 弱点；不足 | n. 虚弱；无力 | n. 特别喜爱；嗜好
definition_en: a feature that makes someone or something less effective | a lack of physical strength or energy | a strong liking that is difficult to resist
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about muscle weakness.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于肌肉无力的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects muscle weakness with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把肌肉无力和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: strengths and weaknesses｜优点与缺点 ; muscle weakness｜肌肉无力 ; a weakness for chocolate｜对巧克力的特别喜爱
tip_zh: 弱点通常可数；虚弱不可数；偏爱用a weakness for。

meanings_zh: n. 掌声；鼓掌 | n. 赞许；赞扬
definition_en: the sound of people clapping to show approval | strong approval or praise for someone or something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a round of applause.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一阵掌声。
example2_en: A campus survey used a round of applause to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一阵掌声来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a round of applause｜一阵掌声 ; thunderous applause｜雷鸣般的掌声 ; burst into applause｜突然鼓起掌来
tip_zh: 不可数；“一阵掌声”用 a round of applause。

meanings_zh: adj. 中世纪的
definition_en: relating to European history from about AD 500 to 1500
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on medieval architecture.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论中世纪建筑风格。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of medieval architecture.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得中世纪建筑风格这个例子。
collocations: medieval architecture｜中世纪建筑风格 ; a medieval castle｜中世纪城堡 ; medieval history｜中世纪史 ; medieval Europe｜中世纪欧洲
tip_zh: 通常指欧洲约公元500至1500年的中世纪。

meanings_zh: n. 指导；指引
definition_en: help or advice about what to do or how to proceed
example1_en: Office hours began with career guidance.
example1_zh: 答疑从职业指导开始。
example2_en: The author returns to career guidance when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了职业指导。
collocations: career guidance｜职业指导 ; provide guidance｜提供指导 ; seek guidance｜寻求指导 ; under someone's guidance｜在某人的指导下
tip_zh: 不可数名词；说some guidance，不说a guidance。

meanings_zh: n. 创业者；企业家
definition_en: someone who starts a business and takes financial risks
example1_en: I copied a successful entrepreneur into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把成功的企业家抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a successful entrepreneur.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕成功的企业家展开说明。
collocations: a successful entrepreneur｜成功的企业家 ; a young entrepreneur｜年轻创业者 ; a social entrepreneur｜社会企业家
tip_zh: 强调创办企业并承担风险，不泛指经理。

meanings_zh: v. 向……行贿 | n. 贿赂；贿赂物
definition_en: Offer rewards to make someone act dishonestly in your favour. | Money or gifts offered to influence someone dishonestly.
example1_en: The professor asked us to bribe an official.
example1_zh: 教授让我们贿赂官员。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to bribe an official.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来贿赂官员。
collocations: offer a bribe｜行贿 ; accept a bribe｜受贿 ; bribe an official｜贿赂官员 ; bribe someone into doing something｜贿赂某人做某事
tip_zh: bribe的宾语是受贿者；bribery指行贿受贿行为。

meanings_zh: adj. 非凡的；引人注目的
definition_en: unusual or impressive enough to deserve special attention
example1_en: The textbook introduces remarkable achievement in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了非凡的成就。
example2_en: The author returns to remarkable achievement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了非凡的成就。
collocations: remarkable achievement｜非凡的成就 ; remarkable recovery｜惊人的康复 ; remarkable progress｜显著的进步 ; remarkable ability｜非凡的能力
tip_zh: 表示值得注意，常含赞赏，但不一定只描述好事。

meanings_zh: n. 切割工具；切割机
definition_en: A tool or machine used to cut materials.
example1_en: I copied laser cutter into my lecture notes.
