example1_zh: 我把激光切割机抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around laser cutter.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕激光切割机展开说明。
collocations: laser cutter｜激光切割机 ; pastry cutter｜面点切模 ; wire cutters｜剪线钳
tip_zh: 常与材料或技术名连用；wire cutters通常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 费力的；要求高的 | adj. 苛求的；难以满足的
definition_en: Requiring considerable effort, skill, time, or attention. | Expecting a great deal of attention or effort from others.
example1_en: Office hours began with physically demanding.
example1_zh: 答疑从耗费体力的开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around physically demanding.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕耗费体力的展开说明。
collocations: physically demanding｜耗费体力的 ; mentally demanding｜耗费脑力的 ; demanding job｜要求高的工作 ; demanding customer｜苛求的顾客
tip_zh: 修饰任务指费力；修饰人指要求高、难满足。

meanings_zh: adv. 据说；据信
definition_en: according to what people say, though it may be untrue
example1_en: The lab manual says to supposedly true before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先据说属实的，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will supposedly true when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会据说属实的。
collocations: supposedly true｜据说属实的 ; supposedly harmless｜据称无害的 ; supposedly independent｜号称独立的
tip_zh: 常暗示对说法存疑，不表示自己凭空想象。

meanings_zh: v. 雕刻 | v. 切成片
definition_en: to shape wood or stone by cutting away material | to cut cooked meat into slices for serving
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to carve wood.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须雕刻木头。
example2_en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers carve wood before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要雕刻木头。
collocations: carve wood｜雕刻木头 ; carve a statue｜雕刻雕像 ; carve meat｜把肉切片 ; carve out a career｜开创事业
tip_zh: carve强调削刻成形；carve out a career指开创事业。

meanings_zh: adj. 水平的；横向的
definition_en: Flat or level, running parallel to the ground
example1_en: I copied horizontal axis into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把横轴抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used horizontal axis to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用横轴来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: horizontal axis｜横轴 ; horizontal line｜水平线 ; horizontal position｜水平位置
tip_zh: horizontal是水平的，vertical是垂直的。

meanings_zh: n. 策略；战略
definition_en: a planned approach for achieving a particular goal
example1_en: Office hours began with long-term strategy.
example1_zh: 答疑从长期战略开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of long-term strategy.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得长期战略这个例子。
collocations: develop a strategy｜制定策略 ; implement a strategy｜实施策略 ; long-term strategy｜长期战略 ; a strategy for growth｜增长策略
tip_zh: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。

meanings_zh: n. 马达；电动机 | adj. 机动车的 | adj. 肌肉运动的
definition_en: A machine that supplies power to move or operate something. | Relating to vehicles powered by engines or motors. | Relating to muscles, movement, or the nerves controlling them.
example1_en: I copied an electric motor into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电动机抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an electric motor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电动机的材料。
collocations: an electric motor｜电动机 ; motor vehicles｜机动车 ; the motor industry｜汽车工业 ; fine motor skills｜精细动作技能
tip_zh: motor skills指身体动作技能，与汽车无关。

meanings_zh: n. 灭绝；消亡
definition_en: the complete disappearance of a species or type of thing
example1_en: Office hours began with face extinction.
example1_zh: 答疑从面临灭绝开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss face extinction.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论面临灭绝的材料。
collocations: face extinction｜面临灭绝 ; on the brink of extinction｜濒临灭绝 ; mass extinction｜大规模灭绝 ; prevent extinction｜防止灭绝
tip_zh: extinct是形容词；extinction是通常不可数的名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 暴力的；凶暴的 | adj. 猛烈的；剧烈的
definition_en: Using physical force to hurt people or damage things. | Extremely strong, sudden, or forceful.
example1_en: Office hours began with violent behaviour.
example1_zh: 答疑从暴力行为开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of violent behaviour.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得暴力行为这个例子。
collocations: violent behaviour｜暴力行为 ; violent crime｜暴力犯罪 ; a violent storm｜猛烈的暴风雨
tip_zh: 既可指行为有暴力，也可形容风暴、震动猛烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 机密的；保密的
definition_en: Intended to remain private and not be shared without permission.
example1_en: I copied strictly confidential into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把绝密的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around strictly confidential.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝密的展开说明。
collocations: confidential information｜机密信息 ; keep something confidential｜对某事保密 ; strictly confidential｜绝密的
tip_zh: confidential指保密的；confident指有信心的。

meanings_zh: n. 优先事项；首要任务 | n. 优先权；优先地位
definition_en: something considered more important than other things | the right to receive attention or action before others
example1_en: Office hours began with top priority.
example1_zh: 答疑从首要任务开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used top priority to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用首要任务来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: top priority｜首要任务 ; give priority to｜优先考虑 ; take priority over｜比……优先 ; set priorities｜确定优先次序
tip_zh: give priority to后接优先考虑的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 大理石 | n. 弹珠
definition_en: a hard stone with patterns, used for buildings and sculptures | a small glass ball used in children's games
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about marble floor.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于大理石地板的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects marble floor with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把大理石地板和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: marble floor｜大理石地板 ; marble statue｜大理石雕像 ; play marbles｜玩弹珠
tip_zh: 指大理石时不可数；指弹珠时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 勇敢；勇气
definition_en: The courage to face danger, pain, or difficult situations.
example1_en: The textbook introduces remarkable bravery in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了非凡的勇气。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of remarkable bravery.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得非凡的勇气这个例子。
collocations: show bravery｜表现出勇气 ; remarkable bravery｜非凡的勇气 ; an act of bravery｜英勇之举
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一次英勇行为用an act of bravery。

meanings_zh: n. 组成部分；零部件 | adj. 组成的；构成的
definition_en: One of the parts that together form a whole. | Forming part of a larger whole.
example1_en: I copied a key component into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把关键组成部分抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a key component to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用关键组成部分来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: a key component｜关键组成部分 ; electronic components｜电子元件 ; component parts｜组成部件
tip_zh: a component of表示“……的组成部分”。

meanings_zh: adv. 以前；从前
definition_en: in the past, but not now
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to formerly known as.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习以前称为。
example2_en: A lecture on historical change asks the class to formerly known as before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于历史变迁的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先以前称为。
collocations: formerly known as｜以前称为 ; formerly owned by｜以前归……所有 ; formerly used for｜以前用于
tip_zh: formerly指“以前”；formally指“正式地”。

meanings_zh: n. 陶艺；陶瓷制作 | n. 陶瓷制品
definition_en: the art and process of making objects from fired clay | objects made from clay and hardened by heat
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about traditional ceramics.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于传统陶瓷制品的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used traditional ceramics to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用传统陶瓷制品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: ceramics class｜陶艺课 ; traditional ceramics｜传统陶瓷制品 ; ceramics studio｜陶艺工作室
tip_zh: 指陶艺时作单数；指多件陶瓷制品时作复数。

meanings_zh: n. 自然环境保护 | n. 节约；资源保护 | n. 文物保护；保存
definition_en: the protection of wildlife and natural environments | careful use of resources to avoid waste | the protection and repair of valuable old objects or buildings
example1_en: The textbook introduces wildlife conservation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了野生动物保护。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of wildlife conservation.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得野生动物保护这个例子。
collocations: wildlife conservation｜野生动物保护 ; energy conservation｜节能 ; water conservation｜节约用水 ; conservation efforts｜保护工作
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可指保护自然，也可指节约能源。

meanings_zh: v. 移居国外
definition_en: To leave your country to live permanently in another
example1_en: The lab instructions say to emigrate from.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求从……移居国外。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers emigrate from before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要从……移居国外。
collocations: emigrate from｜从……移居国外 ; emigrate to｜移居到 ; emigrate permanently｜永久移居国外
tip_zh: emigrate强调迁出，immigrate强调迁入；搭配from或to。

meanings_zh: n. 听力；听觉 | n. 听证会；庭审
definition_en: The ability to notice sounds through your ears. | An official meeting to consider evidence or arguments.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a public hearing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公开听证会。
example2_en: The author returns to a public hearing when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公开听证会。
collocations: hearing loss｜听力损失 ; a hearing aid｜助听器 ; a public hearing｜公开听证会 ; a court hearing｜庭审
tip_zh: 指听力时不可数；指听证会时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 整合；使结合 | v. 融入；使融入
definition_en: To combine separate parts so they work together effectively. | To join, or help someone join, a group or society.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer integrate A into B during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时将A融入B。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers integrate A into B before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要将A融入B。
collocations: integrate A into B｜将A融入B ; integrate with｜与……结合 ; integrate into society｜融入社会
tip_zh: 常用integrate A into B，也可用integrate A with B。

meanings_zh: n. 批改；评分 | n. 斑纹；标线
definition_en: The work of checking and grading students' answers. | A visible pattern or line on an animal or surface.
example1_en: The textbook introduces marking scheme in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了评分细则。
example2_en: A campus survey used marking scheme to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用评分细则来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: marking scheme｜评分细则 ; road markings｜道路标线 ; distinctive markings｜独特的斑纹
tip_zh: 批改义通常不可数；斑纹、道路标线常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 准许进入；录取 | n. 入场费 | n. 承认；供认
definition_en: Permission to enter a place or join an institution | The money paid to enter a place | A statement accepting that something is true, often something unpleasant
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about free admission.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于免费入场的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects free admission with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把免费入场和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: admission to university｜大学录取 ; admission fee｜入场费 ; free admission｜免费入场 ; admission of guilt｜认罪
tip_zh: 进入某处用admission to；承认某事用admission of。

meanings_zh: adj. 独有的；专用的 | adj. 高档的；仅限少数人的 | n. 独家新闻
definition_en: Available only to a particular person or group. | Expensive and available mainly to wealthy or privileged people. | A news story published by only one media organisation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mutually exclusive.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论互不相容的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mutually exclusive.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕互不相容的展开说明。
collocations: exclusive access｜专享使用权 ; exclusive rights｜独家权利 ; exclusive interview｜独家采访 ; mutually exclusive｜互不相容的
tip_zh: exclusive to表示“为……独有”；exclusive of指不含。

meanings_zh: n. 尊严 | n. 庄重；自尊的仪态
definition_en: A person's worth and right to be treated with respect. | Calm, controlled behaviour that earns respect.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about human dignity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于人的尊严的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to human dignity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了人的尊严。
collocations: human dignity｜人的尊严 ; preserve someone's dignity｜维护某人的尊严 ; treat someone with dignity｜有尊严地对待某人 ; a sense of dignity｜尊严感
tip_zh: 通常不可数；with dignity可表示有尊严地。

meanings_zh: n. 策略；手段；战术
definition_en: Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about marketing tactics.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于营销策略的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used marketing tactics to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用营销策略来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: change tactics｜改变战术 ; marketing tactics｜营销策略 ; negotiating tactics｜谈判策略 ; delaying tactics｜拖延手段
tip_zh: strategy侧重整体战略，tactics侧重具体手段。

meanings_zh: v. 抱怨；发牢骚 | n. 牢骚；抱怨 | v. 发出低沉轰鸣声
definition_en: to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way | a complaint about something that annoys you | to make a low, deep rumbling sound
example1_en: The assignment is to grumble about delays, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先抱怨延误，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to grumble about delays.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们抱怨延误。
collocations: grumble about delays｜抱怨延误 ; grumble at someone｜向某人发牢骚 ; a common grumble｜常见的抱怨
tip_zh: 常用grumble about sth，表示抱怨某事。

meanings_zh: n. 肉；肌肉组织 | n. 果肉
definition_en: The soft tissue between the skin and bones. | The soft inner part of a fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: The textbook introduces soft flesh in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了柔软的肉。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around soft flesh.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕柔软的肉展开说明。
collocations: soft flesh｜柔软的肉 ; fruit flesh｜果肉 ; in the flesh｜本人；亲身 ; flesh and blood｜血肉之躯；亲骨肉
tip_zh: 一般不可数；食用的肉通常用meat，不用flesh。

meanings_zh: n. 显微镜
definition_en: An instrument that makes very small objects appear much larger.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on electron microscope.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电子显微镜。
example2_en: The reading connects electron microscope with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把电子显微镜和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: under a microscope｜在显微镜下 ; electron microscope｜电子显微镜 ; light microscope｜光学显微镜
tip_zh: microscope看微小物体；telescope看远处物体。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽慰的；放心的
definition_en: No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided
example1_en: Our professor circled visibly relieved on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了明显松了一口气。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around visibly relieved.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕明显松了一口气展开说明。
collocations: feel relieved｜感到宽慰 ; relieved to hear｜听到后感到放心 ; visibly relieved｜明显松了一口气
tip_zh: 常用be relieved to do或be relieved that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 入门的；介绍性的 | adj. 首次推出时优惠的
definition_en: Providing basic information or presenting something for the first time. | Offered at a special price when something first becomes available.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on introductory course.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论入门课程。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of introductory course.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得入门课程这个例子。
collocations: introductory course｜入门课程 ; introductory remarks｜开场白 ; introductory offer｜新品推广优惠
tip_zh: introductory course指入门课，通常面向初学者。

meanings_zh: v. 继续进行 | v. 前往；行进
definition_en: Continue an activity or move to its next stage. | Move forward or travel towards a particular place.
example1_en: The professor asked us to proceed with a plan.
example1_zh: 教授让我们继续实施计划。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to proceed with a plan.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来继续实施计划。
collocations: proceed with a plan｜继续实施计划 ; proceed to the next stage｜进入下一阶段 ; proceed cautiously｜谨慎推进
tip_zh: proceed是动词；表示收入的名词是proceeds。

meanings_zh: v. 怀疑；猜想 | n. 嫌疑人 | adj. 可疑的；不可靠的
definition_en: To think something is likely true without being certain. | A person believed to have possibly committed a crime. | Not trustworthy or possibly wrong, unsafe, or dishonest.
example1_en: The professor asked us to suspect that.
example1_zh: 教授让我们怀疑……。
example2_en: The passage says students who can suspect that follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够怀疑……的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: suspect that｜怀疑…… ; suspect someone of something｜怀疑某人有某种行为 ; a prime suspect｜主要嫌疑人 ; suspect evidence｜可疑的证据
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词、形容词读/ˈsʌspekt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；最重要的 | n. 校长；学院院长 | n. 本金
definition_en: most important among several things | the person in charge of a school or college | money borrowed or invested, excluding interest
example1_en: Our professor circled a school principal on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了校长。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a school principal.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论校长的材料。
collocations: the principal reason｜主要原因 ; a principal aim｜主要目标 ; a school principal｜校长 ; repay the principal｜偿还本金
tip_zh: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

meanings_zh: v. 反对；抵制
definition_en: Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer oppose a proposal during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时反对一项提议。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to oppose a proposal.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们反对一项提议。
collocations: strongly oppose｜强烈反对 ; oppose a proposal｜反对一项提议 ; oppose doing something｜反对做某事
tip_zh: oppose 后直接接名词或动名词，不加 to。

meanings_zh: adj. 所谓的；号称的 | adj. 通常称作的
definition_en: Described a certain way, though that description may be doubtful. | Known by a particular name or term.
example1_en: I wrote so-called on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把so-called和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain so-called usually follow the rest of a lecture on public communication.
example2_zh: 能解释所谓的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共传播的讲座。
collocations: so-called experts｜所谓的专家 ; so-called benefits｜所谓的好处 ; so-called green products｜号称环保的产品
tip_zh: 置于名词前，常含质疑，但也可中性引出名称。

meanings_zh: adj. 图形的；视觉艺术的 | adj. 生动详尽的 | n. 图形；图像
definition_en: Relating to pictures, drawings, or visual design. | Describing something very clearly, often with unpleasant details. | An image or diagram used to present information.
example1_en: I copied graphic design into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把平面设计抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects graphic design with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把平面设计和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: graphic design｜平面设计 ; a graphic designer｜平面设计师 ; a graphic description｜生动详尽的描述
tip_zh: graphic description常指令人不适的详细描述。

meanings_zh: n. 基础设施
definition_en: Basic systems such as transport, power, and water that a place needs.
example1_en: Aging infrastructure delayed the new lab's opening.
example1_zh: 老化的基础设施推迟了新实验室的启用。
example2_en: The lecture compared spending on infrastructure with spending on short-term repairs.
example2_zh: 讲座比较了基础设施开支和短期维修开支。
collocations: public infrastructure｜公共基础设施 ; transport infrastructure｜交通基础设施
tip_zh: 通常不可数；指具体系统时偶尔用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 人造卫星 | n. 天然卫星
definition_en: A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information. | A natural object that moves around a planet.
example1_en: Our professor circled communications satellite on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了通信卫星。
example2_en: The reading connects communications satellite with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把通信卫星和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: launch a satellite｜发射卫星 ; communications satellite｜通信卫星 ; satellite imagery｜卫星影像 ; natural satellite｜天然卫星
tip_zh: 可指人造或天然卫星；月球是地球的天然卫星。

meanings_zh: v. 投降；屈服 | v. 交出；放弃 | n. 投降；屈服
definition_en: to stop resisting and accept another side's control | to give up something, often because officially required | the act of stopping resistance and accepting another side's control
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to surrender to.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须向……投降。
example2_en: The reading asks you to surrender to and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你向……投降，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: surrender to｜向……投降 ; surrender control｜交出控制权 ; unconditional surrender｜无条件投降
tip_zh: surrender to sb指向某人投降；交出物品直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 分析；解析
definition_en: Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning
example1_en: Office hours began with data analysis.
example1_zh: 答疑从数据分析开始。
example2_en: The author returns to data analysis when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数据分析。
collocations: data analysis｜数据分析 ; detailed analysis｜详细分析 ; carry out an analysis｜进行分析 ; critical analysis｜批判性分析
tip_zh: 复数为analyses；英式动词为analyse。

meanings_zh: v. 巡逻；巡查 | n. 巡逻；巡逻队
definition_en: To move around an area regularly to maintain safety. | An activity or group that checks an area for danger.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to patrol the streets.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何巡逻街道。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to patrol the streets.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来巡逻街道。
collocations: on patrol｜在巡逻 ; patrol the streets｜巡逻街道 ; border patrol｜边境巡逻；边境巡逻队 ; regular patrols｜定期巡逻
tip_zh: 过去式patrolled，进行式patrolling，均双写l。

meanings_zh: n. 辅音；辅音字母 | adj. 一致的；相符的
definition_en: a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol | agreeing with or matching something
example1_en: The textbook introduces final consonant in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了末尾辅音。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss final consonant.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论末尾辅音的材料。
collocations: consonant sound｜辅音 ; consonant cluster｜辅音群 ; final consonant｜末尾辅音 ; consonant with｜与……一致
tip_zh: 作形容词较正式，常用consonant with表示相符。

meanings_zh: adj. 随后的
definition_en: Happening or coming after something else.
example1_en: Subsequent lectures built on that first definition.
example1_zh: 随后的讲座都建立在第一个定义之上。
example2_en: A subsequent study used a larger sample and found a smaller effect.
example2_zh: 随后的一项研究使用了更大的样本，发现的效应更小。
collocations: subsequent research｜后续研究 ; in subsequent years｜在随后几年
tip_zh: subsequent 是形容词；副词是 subsequently。

meanings_zh: n. 横幅；旗帜 | n. 网页横幅广告
definition_en: a long piece of cloth displaying a message or design | a wide advertisement displayed across part of a webpage
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about banner advertising.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于横幅广告的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss banner advertising.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论横幅广告的材料。
collocations: hang a banner｜挂横幅 ; carry a banner｜举横幅 ; banner advertising｜横幅广告
tip_zh: 网页上的横幅广告常称banner ad。

meanings_zh: adj. 在前的；前面的
definition_en: Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the preceding year.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论前一年。
example2_en: A campus survey used the preceding year to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用前一年来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: the preceding year｜前一年 ; the preceding paragraph｜上一段 ; the immediately preceding period｜紧接此前的时期
tip_zh: preceding指所谈时间或事物之前的，不等于现在之前。

meanings_zh: adj. 合乎逻辑的；合理的 | adj. 逻辑学的
definition_en: Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly. | Relating to the formal rules of correct reasoning.
example1_en: The textbook introduces logical conclusion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了合乎逻辑的结论。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of logical conclusion.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得合乎逻辑的结论这个例子。
collocations: logical conclusion｜合乎逻辑的结论 ; logical reasoning｜逻辑推理 ; logical sequence｜逻辑顺序 ; logical argument｜合乎逻辑的论证
tip_zh: logical强调推理合理，不表示事实一定正确。

meanings_zh: n. 尝试；努力 | v. 尝试；试图
definition_en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult. | To try to do something, especially something difficult.
example1_en: I copied a successful attempt into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把成功的尝试抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a successful attempt.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕成功的尝试展开说明。
collocations: make an attempt｜作出尝试 ; attempt to do something｜尝试做某事 ; a successful attempt｜成功的尝试 ; in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip_zh: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

meanings_zh: n. 山坡；山腰
definition_en: The sloping surface of a hill.
example1_en: I copied a steep hillside into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把陡峭的山坡抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a steep hillside with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把陡峭的山坡和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a steep hillside｜陡峭的山坡 ; a wooded hillside｜林木覆盖的山坡 ; on the hillside｜在山坡上
tip_zh: 指山的斜坡部分；在山坡上用 on the hillside。

meanings_zh: n. 判断力 | n. 看法；评价 | n. 判决；裁决
definition_en: the ability to make sensible decisions after considering information | an opinion formed after considering something carefully | an official decision made by a court
example1_en: I copied sound judgement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把明智的判断力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of sound judgement.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得明智的判断力这个例子。
collocations: sound judgement｜明智的判断力 ; make a judgement｜作出判断 ; exercise judgement｜运用判断力 ; court judgement｜法院判决
tip_zh: 英式可写judgement或judgment；美式通常用后者。

meanings_zh: adj. 不道德的
definition_en: Contrary to accepted principles of right and wrong.
example1_en: The textbook introduces immoral behaviour in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了不道德的行为。
example2_en: The author returns to immoral behaviour when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不道德的行为。
collocations: immoral behaviour｜不道德的行为 ; immoral practices｜不道德的做法 ; consider something immoral｜认为某事不道德
tip_zh: immoral指违背道德；amoral指无道德观念。

meanings_zh: n. 全体演员 | v. 投；抛；投射 | v. 选派角色
definition_en: All the actors appearing in a film or play. | To throw something or send light or shadow onto something. | To choose an actor for a particular role.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a supporting cast.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于配角阵容的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a supporting cast to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用配角阵容来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a supporting cast｜配角阵容 ; cast a shadow｜投下阴影 ; cast doubt on｜使人怀疑 ; cast someone as｜选某人扮演
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为cast；全体演员用单数形式。

meanings_zh: v. 开药；开处方 | v. 规定；指定
definition_en: officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional | state officially what must be done or how
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to prescribe medication.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须开药。
example2_en: The passage says students who can prescribe medication follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够开药的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: prescribe medication｜开药 ; prescribe treatment｜指定治疗方案 ; prescribe antibiotics｜开抗生素 ; prescribed by law｜法律规定的
tip_zh: prescribe是开药；describe是描述，注意区分。

meanings_zh: adj. 极不理智的；荒唐的 | adj. 精神失常的
definition_en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous. | Severely mentally ill; an outdated term except in legal contexts.
example1_en: Office hours began with an insane idea.
example1_zh: 答疑从荒唐的想法开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of an insane idea.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得荒唐的想法这个例子。
collocations: an insane idea｜荒唐的想法 ; an insane risk｜极不理智的冒险 ; drive someone insane｜把某人逼疯
tip_zh: 口语可指荒唐；用于精神疾病已过时且可能冒犯。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；开支 | n. 代价；损害
definition_en: money spent or needed for a particular purpose | harm or disadvantage caused while benefiting someone or something else
example1_en: The professor explained expense with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了费用。
example2_en: Students who can explain expense usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释费用的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: living expenses｜生活开支 ; cover the expense｜支付费用 ; at the expense of｜以…为代价 ; spare no expense｜不惜费用
tip_zh: 日常各项开支常用复数expenses；expensive是形容词。

meanings_zh: adj. 数字的；用数字表示的
definition_en: Relating to numbers or expressed using numbers.
example1_en: I copied numerical data into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把数值数据抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects numerical data with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把数值数据和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: numerical data｜数值数据 ; numerical order｜数字顺序 ; numerical value｜数值 ; numerical analysis｜数值分析
tip_zh: numerical指数字相关；numerous指数量多。

meanings_zh: n. 决心；毅力 | n. 确定；测定；裁定
definition_en: the firm intention to continue despite difficulties | the process of establishing a fact or making an official decision
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sheer determination.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论坚定不移的决心。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sheer determination.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论坚定不移的决心的材料。
collocations: sheer determination｜坚定不移的决心 ; determination to succeed｜成功的决心 ; determination of eligibility｜资格的认定
tip_zh: 表决心常接to do；表确定常接of。

meanings_zh: adj. 差劲的；令人鄙夷的 | adj. 可怜的；令人怜悯的
definition_en: so poor or ineffective that it deserves strong criticism | making you feel pity because of suffering or helplessness
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a pathetic excuse.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于蹩脚的借口的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a pathetic excuse to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用蹩脚的借口来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: a pathetic excuse｜蹩脚的借口 ; a pathetic attempt｜差劲的尝试 ; a pathetic sight｜可怜的景象
tip_zh: 常带强烈贬义，不宜随意用来形容他人。

meanings_zh: n. 租约；租赁合同 | v. 租用；出租
definition_en: a legal agreement to use property for payment | to use or let someone use property for regular payment
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a long-term lease.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于长期租约的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a long-term lease.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕长期租约展开说明。
collocations: sign a lease｜签订租约 ; renew a lease｜续租 ; a long-term lease｜长期租约 ; lease equipment｜租用设备
tip_zh: lease from指租入；lease to指租给别人。

meanings_zh: n. 破产
definition_en: The legal state of being unable to pay your debts
example1_en: Office hours began with file for bankruptcy.
example1_zh: 答疑从申请破产开始。
example2_en: The author returns to file for bankruptcy when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了申请破产。
collocations: file for bankruptcy｜申请破产 ; declare bankruptcy｜宣布破产 ; face bankruptcy｜面临破产 ; bankruptcy protection｜破产保护
tip_zh: 通常不可数；多起破产事件可用复数bankruptcies。

meanings_zh: adj. 昏昏欲睡的
definition_en: Feeling sleepy and finding it hard to stay awake
example1_en: The textbook introduces drowsy driving in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了疲劳驾驶。
example2_en: The author returns to drowsy driving when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了疲劳驾驶。
collocations: feel drowsy｜感到困倦 ; make someone drowsy｜使某人昏昏欲睡 ; drowsy driving｜疲劳驾驶
tip_zh: 常描述人困倦；药物使人困倦可用make someone drowsy。

meanings_zh: adj. 智力的；思维的 | n. 知识分子
definition_en: Relating to thinking, reasoning, and understanding complex ideas | Someone who studies and discusses complex ideas seriously
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on intellectual development.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论智力发展。
example2_en: The author returns to intellectual development when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了智力发展。
collocations: intellectual development｜智力发展 ; intellectual challenge｜智力挑战 ; intellectual property｜知识产权 ; intellectual curiosity｜求知欲
tip_zh: intellectual强调思维活动；intelligent强调聪明。

meanings_zh: n. 评级；等级 | n. 收视率；收听率 | n. 额定值
definition_en: a judgement of quality, performance, or suitability on a scale | a measure of audience size for a broadcast programme | the maximum power or load equipment is designed to handle
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a high rating.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于高评分的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a high rating.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕高评分展开说明。
collocations: a high rating｜高评分 ; an energy rating｜能效等级 ; audience ratings｜收视率；收听率 ; a power rating｜额定功率
tip_zh: 表示收视率通常用复数ratings；也可作rate的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 故意的；有意的 | adj. 从容谨慎的 | v. 仔细考虑；商议
definition_en: Done intentionally rather than by accident. | Slow and careful, rather than hurried. | To consider something carefully before making a decision.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a deliberate attempt.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于有意的尝试的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a deliberate attempt when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有意的尝试。
collocations: a deliberate attempt｜有意的尝试 ; deliberate damage｜故意损坏 ; deliberate movements｜从容谨慎的动作 ; deliberate on a proposal｜仔细考虑提案
tip_zh: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 高潮；最精彩的部分 | v. 达到高潮
definition_en: The most exciting or important point of an event | Reach the most exciting or important point
example1_en: Office hours began with a dramatic climax.
example1_zh: 答疑从扣人心弦的高潮开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a dramatic climax to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用扣人心弦的高潮来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: reach a climax｜达到高潮 ; a dramatic climax｜扣人心弦的高潮 ; climax with｜以……达到高潮
tip_zh: climactic指高潮的；别与climatic（气候的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 与性有关的 | adj. 有性生殖的
definition_en: Relating to sex or physical attraction between people. | Involving reproduction through the joining of male and female cells.
example1_en: The textbook introduces sexual health in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了性健康。
example2_en: The reading connects sexual health with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把性健康和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: sexual health｜性健康 ; sexual reproduction｜有性生殖 ; sexual attraction｜性吸引
tip_zh: sexual指与性有关；sexy才常表示性感的。

meanings_zh: n. 参与；参加
definition_en: the act of taking part in an activity or event
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about active participation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于积极参与的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss active participation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论积极参与的材料。
collocations: participation in｜参与…… ; active participation｜积极参与 ; public participation｜公众参与 ; encourage participation｜鼓励参与
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示参与某活动，用participation in。

meanings_zh: v. 使着迷；深深吸引
definition_en: to attract and hold someone's attention very strongly
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to fascinate an audience.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须深深吸引观众。
example2_en: The reading asks you to fascinate an audience and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你深深吸引观众，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: fascinate an audience｜深深吸引观众 ; be fascinated by｜对……着迷 ; never cease to fascinate｜始终令人着迷
tip_zh: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人感到着迷用fascinated。

meanings_zh: n. 轴；旋转轴线 | n. 坐标轴
definition_en: a real or imaginary line around which something turns | a reference line used to locate points on a graph
example1_en: I copied horizontal axis into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把横坐标轴抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used horizontal axis to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用横坐标轴来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: rotate on its axis｜绕自身轴线旋转 ; horizontal axis｜横坐标轴 ; vertical axis｜纵坐标轴 ; axis of rotation｜旋转轴
tip_zh: 复数是 axes /ˈæksiːz/，注意与 axe 的复数区分。

meanings_zh: n. 统计数据 | n. 统计学
definition_en: numerical facts collected and organised to describe something | the study of collecting, analysing, and interpreting numerical data
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on official statistics.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论官方统计数据。
example2_en: The author returns to official statistics when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了官方统计数据。
collocations: official statistics｜官方统计数据 ; compile statistics｜汇编统计数据 ; statistics show that｜统计数据显示 ; study statistics｜学习统计学
tip_zh: 指数据时谓语用复数；指统计学时谓语用单数。

meanings_zh: n. 储存；存放 | n. 数据存储；存储空间
definition_en: The act of keeping things somewhere until they are needed. | The capacity or process of keeping digital information for future use.
example1_en: Office hours began with energy storage.
example1_zh: 答疑从储能开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around energy storage.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕储能展开说明。
collocations: storage space｜储物空间 ; energy storage｜储能 ; cloud storage｜云存储 ; in storage｜存放着
tip_zh: storage通常不可数；一间储藏室用a storeroom。

meanings_zh: n. 连词 | n. 结合；同时发生
definition_en: a word that connects words, phrases, or clauses | a combination of things or events occurring together
example1_en: Our professor circled coordinating conjunction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了并列连词。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around coordinating conjunction.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕并列连词展开说明。
collocations: in conjunction with｜与……结合；与……共同 ; coordinating conjunction｜并列连词 ; subordinating conjunction｜从属连词
tip_zh: in conjunction with常表示“与……共同或结合”。

meanings_zh: v. 冥想；静思 | v. 沉思；深思
definition_en: to focus your mind calmly, often as a mental exercise | to think deeply and carefully about something
example1_en: I heard the lecturer meditate daily during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时每天冥想。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to meditate daily.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得每天冥想。
collocations: meditate daily｜每天冥想 ; meditate on something｜深入思考某事 ; learn to meditate｜学习冥想
tip_zh: 表示深思某事，常用meditate on或upon。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；担忧的 | adj. 渴望的；急切的
definition_en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain. | Very eager to do something or for something to happen.
example1_en: The textbook introduces anxious about in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……感到焦虑。
example2_en: The reading connects anxious about with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……感到焦虑和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: anxious about｜对……感到焦虑 ; anxious to please｜急于讨好 ; feel anxious｜感到焦虑
tip_zh: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

meanings_zh: v. 证明合理；为…辩护
definition_en: Give good reasons for an action, decision, or belief.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to justify a decision.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为决定提供理由。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to justify a decision.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得为决定提供理由。
collocations: justify a decision｜为决定提供理由 ; justify the cost｜证明费用合理 ; justify doing something｜证明做某事合理
tip_zh: justify后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

meanings_zh: n. 天才人物 | n. 天赋；非凡才能
definition_en: someone with exceptional intelligence or creative ability | exceptional natural ability in a particular area
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a mathematical genius.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论数学天才。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a mathematical genius.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得数学天才这个例子。
collocations: a mathematical genius｜数学天才 ; creative genius｜创造天赋 ; a genius at｜在……方面极有才干的人 ; a stroke of genius｜绝妙的主意
tip_zh: 指天才人物时可数；指非凡才能时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 参考书目；文献目录
definition_en: a list of sources used or relevant to a subject
example1_en: The textbook introduces annotated bibliography in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了附注释的参考书目。
example2_en: The reading connects annotated bibliography with a larger point about student life.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把附注释的参考书目和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: compile a bibliography｜编制参考书目 ; annotated bibliography｜附注释的参考书目 ; extensive bibliography｜详尽的参考书目
tip_zh: bibliography是资料清单；biography是人物传记。

meanings_zh: v. 继承财产 | v. 经遗传获得 | v. 接手；承袭
definition_en: Receive money or property from someone who has died | Receive physical characteristics genetically from your parents | Receive responsibilities or problems left by a previous person
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to inherit property.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何继承财产。
example2_en: The passage says students who can inherit property follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够继承财产的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: inherit property｜继承财产 ; inherit a fortune｜继承巨额财富 ; inherit traits｜遗传获得特征 ; inherit from｜从……继承
tip_zh: 常用inherit sth from sb；遗传特征也可用。

meanings_zh: n. 松鼠 | v. 储藏；积攒
definition_en: A small rodent with a bushy tail, often living in trees. | To store something secretly for later use, usually with away.
example1_en: I copied a grey squirrel into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把灰松鼠抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a grey squirrel.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕灰松鼠展开说明。
collocations: a grey squirrel｜灰松鼠 ; a red squirrel｜红松鼠 ; squirrel away money｜悄悄攒钱
tip_zh: 作动词通常用squirrel away，指悄悄储存。

meanings_zh: n. 铝
definition_en: A light, silver-coloured metal used in cans and aircraft.
example1_en: Office hours began with recycled aluminium.
example1_zh: 答疑从再生铝开始。
example2_en: The author returns to recycled aluminium when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了再生铝。
collocations: aluminium foil｜铝箔 ; aluminium alloy｜铝合金 ; aluminium can｜铝罐 ; recycled aluminium｜再生铝
tip_zh: 美式通常写作aluminum，读作/əˈluːmɪnəm/。

meanings_zh: n. 间谍；密探 | v. 从事间谍活动；暗中监视 | v. 突然发现；瞥见
definition_en: Someone who secretly gathers information about a country or organisation | To secretly watch someone or gather information about them | To notice someone or something, especially after looking carefully
example1_en: Office hours began with spy novel.
example1_zh: 答疑从间谍小说开始。
example2_en: The reading connects spy novel with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把间谍小说和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: spy on someone｜暗中监视某人 ; spy novel｜间谍小说 ; spy network｜间谍网
tip_zh: 监视某人用spy on；过去式和过去分词为spied。

meanings_zh: n. 人质
definition_en: someone held captive to force others to meet demands
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on hostage negotiations.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人质谈判。
example2_en: A campus survey used hostage negotiations to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用人质谈判来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: take someone hostage｜劫持某人作人质 ; hold someone hostage｜扣押某人作人质 ; release a hostage｜释放人质 ; hostage negotiations｜人质谈判
tip_zh: take或hold someone hostage中，hostage前不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 异常的；反常的
definition_en: Different from what is usual or expected, often causing concern.
example1_en: Office hours began with abnormal behaviour.
example1_zh: 答疑从反常行为开始。
example2_en: The author returns to abnormal behaviour when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了反常行为。
collocations: abnormal behaviour｜反常行为 ; abnormal growth｜异常生长 ; abnormal heart rhythm｜心律异常
tip_zh: 常用于医学或异常现象，不宜随意用来评价人。

meanings_zh: v. 提升；增强；改善
definition_en: Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something
example1_en: The professor asked us to enhance performance.
example1_zh: 教授让我们提升表现。
example2_en: The reading asks you to enhance performance and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你提升表现，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: enhance performance｜提升表现 ; enhance the quality of｜改善……的质量 ; enhance someone's reputation｜提升某人的声誉
tip_zh: 强调质量、效果或价值提升，不单指数量增加。

meanings_zh: n. 打击乐器；打击乐声部
definition_en: Musical instruments played by hitting, shaking, or scraping them.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on percussion instruments.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论打击乐器。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around percussion instruments.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕打击乐器展开说明。
collocations: percussion instruments｜打击乐器 ; play percussion｜演奏打击乐器 ; percussion section｜打击乐声部
tip_zh: 总称时不可数；一件打击乐器用a percussion instrument。

meanings_zh: v. 赔偿；补偿 | v. 弥补；抵消
definition_en: To give someone money or something else for loss or harm. | To balance a disadvantage by providing something beneficial.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer compensate for a lack of during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时弥补……的不足。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to compensate for a lack of.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们弥补……的不足。
collocations: compensate someone for a loss｜赔偿某人的损失 ; compensate for a lack of｜弥补……的不足 ; fully compensate｜充分补偿
tip_zh: 赔偿某人用compensate sb for sth；弥补用for。

meanings_zh: v. 犯（罪或错误） | v. 承诺；使承担义务 | v. 投入（资金或资源）
definition_en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong. | To promise firmly to do something or support someone. | To make money, time, or resources available for a purpose.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to commit a crime.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求犯罪。
example2_en: The reading asks you to commit a crime and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你犯罪，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: commit a crime｜犯罪 ; commit to doing something｜承诺做某事 ; commit resources to｜向……投入资源 ; commit oneself to｜致力于
tip_zh: commit to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 投入；奉献
definition_en: To give time, effort, or resources to someone or something.
example1_en: The assignment is to devote time to, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先投入时间于，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to devote time to.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们投入时间于。
collocations: devote time to｜投入时间于 ; devote resources to｜投入资源于 ; devote oneself to｜致力于
tip_zh: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 自我；本来面貌
definition_en: The personality and qualities that make you who you are.
example1_en: Office hours began with a sense of self.
example1_zh: 答疑从自我意识开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a sense of self.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自我意识的材料。
collocations: a sense of self｜自我意识 ; your true self｜真实的自己 ; your usual self｜你平常的状态
tip_zh: self是名词；表达“我自己”通常用myself。

meanings_zh: adj. 牙齿的；牙科的
definition_en: Relating to teeth or their care and treatment
example1_en: I copied dental care into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把牙齿保健抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dental care.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论牙齿保健的材料。
collocations: dental care｜牙齿保健 ; dental treatment｜牙科治疗 ; dental check-up｜牙齿检查 ; dental floss｜牙线
tip_zh: dental是形容词；牙医是dentist。

meanings_zh: v. 漂流；飘移 | v. 逐渐偏离；无目的移动 | n. 大意；主旨
definition_en: To move slowly, carried by water or air. | To move or change gradually without clear purpose or control. | The general meaning of what someone says or writes.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to drift apart.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求逐渐疏远。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers drift apart before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要逐渐疏远。
collocations: drift apart｜逐渐疏远 ; drift off to sleep｜渐渐入睡 ; drift away｜慢慢离开 ; get the drift｜领会大意
tip_zh: drift强调随水、风移动，或缺乏明确方向。

meanings_zh: v. 适应；使适应 | v. 改编；改装
definition_en: to change behaviour or features to suit new conditions | to change something for a different use or audience
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to adapt to change.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须适应变化。
example2_en: The reading asks you to adapt to change and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你适应变化，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: adapt to change｜适应变化 ; adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法 ; adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip_zh: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

meanings_zh: n. 诱惑；诱惑物
definition_en: A strong desire for something, or something causing that desire.
example1_en: Our professor circled resist temptation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了抵制诱惑。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of resist temptation.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得抵制诱惑这个例子。
collocations: resist temptation｜抵制诱惑 ; give in to temptation｜经不住诱惑 ; the temptation to do something｜做某事的诱惑
tip_zh: 常用the temptation to do，表示想做某事的诱惑。

meanings_zh: n. 雪茄烟
definition_en: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves made for smoking
example1_en: I copied cigar smoke into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把雪茄烟雾抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects cigar smoke with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把雪茄烟雾和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: cigar smoke｜雪茄烟雾 ; cigar box｜雪茄盒 ; smoke a cigar｜抽雪茄
tip_zh: cigar是雪茄；cigarette是通常用纸卷制的香烟。

meanings_zh: adj. 相互的；彼此的 | adj. 共同的；共有的
definition_en: Felt or done by each person towards the other. | Shared by two or more people or groups.
example1_en: Our professor circled mutual respect on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了相互尊重。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mutual respect.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕相互尊重展开说明。
collocations: mutual respect｜相互尊重 ; mutual benefit｜互利 ; mutual friend｜共同的朋友 ; by mutual agreement｜经双方同意
tip_zh: mutual friend是共同朋友，不是彼此的朋友。

meanings_zh: n. 善良；美德 | n. 营养；有益成分 | int. 天哪
definition_en: the quality of being kind and morally good | the substances in food that help keep you healthy | used to express surprise, worry, or shock
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about natural goodness.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于天然营养的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss natural goodness.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论天然营养的材料。
collocations: out of the goodness of your heart｜纯粹出于好心 ; natural goodness｜天然营养 ; thank goodness｜谢天谢地 ; my goodness｜天哪
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数；My goodness表示惊讶。

meanings_zh: n. 木炭 | n. 绘画用炭笔
definition_en: A black material made by heating wood with little air. | Charcoal sticks used for drawing.
example1_en: Office hours began with activated charcoal.
example1_zh: 答疑从活性炭开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of activated charcoal.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得活性炭这个例子。
collocations: charcoal grill｜炭火烤架 ; charcoal drawing｜炭笔画 ; activated charcoal｜活性炭 ; charcoal production｜木炭生产
tip_zh: charcoal通常不可数；coal是煤，不是木炭。

meanings_zh: n. 肋骨 | n. 排骨 | v. 善意地取笑
definition_en: One of the curved bones surrounding the chest. | A piece of meat containing an animal's rib bones. | To tease someone in a friendly way.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on broken rib.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论断裂的肋骨。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of broken rib.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得断裂的肋骨这个例子。
collocations: broken rib｜断裂的肋骨 ; rib cage｜胸廓 ; grilled ribs｜烤排骨 ; rib someone about something｜拿某事善意地取笑某人
tip_zh: 表示排骨通常用复数ribs；动词rib属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的 | adj. 偏僻冷清的
definition_en: Feeling unhappy because you lack company | Quiet and remote, with few or no people
example1_en: The textbook introduces a lonesome road in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一条偏僻冷清的路。
example2_en: A campus survey used a lonesome road to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一条偏僻冷清的路来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: feel lonesome｜感到寂寞 ; a lonesome road｜一条偏僻冷清的路
tip_zh: 多见于美式英语；lonely更通用，alone只表示独自一人。

meanings_zh: n. 棺材；灵柩
definition_en: A box holding a dead person's body for burial or cremation.
example1_en: Our professor circled a wooden coffin on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了木棺。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a wooden coffin.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得木棺这个例子。
collocations: a wooden coffin｜木棺 ; carry a coffin｜抬棺 ; a nail in the coffin｜促使失败的因素
tip_zh: casket在美式英语中也常指棺材。

meanings_zh: n. 交易；业务办理
definition_en: an act of buying, selling, or exchanging money
example1_en: The textbook introduces financial transaction in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了金融交易。
example2_en: The reading connects financial transaction with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把金融交易和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: financial transaction｜金融交易 ; complete a transaction｜完成交易 ; transaction fee｜交易手续费 ; online transaction｜线上交易
tip_zh: 通常可数：一笔交易是a transaction。

meanings_zh: v. 繁殖；培育 | n. 品种 | v. 滋生；导致
definition_en: To produce young, or keep animals to produce young. | A group of domestic animals sharing particular inherited characteristics. | To cause something, especially something harmful, to develop.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to breed animals.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何繁育动物。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers breed animals before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要繁育动物。
collocations: breeding season｜繁殖季节 ; a breed of dog｜一种犬种 ; breed animals｜繁育动物 ; breed resentment｜滋生怨恨
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bred；品种breed不同于物种species。

meanings_zh: n. 神经 | n. 勇气；胆量 | n. 厚颜；放肆
definition_en: A fibre carrying signals between the brain and body. | The courage to do something difficult or frightening. | Rude confidence that makes someone behave without respect.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on nerve damage.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论神经损伤。
example2_en: The reading connects nerve damage with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把神经损伤和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: nerve damage｜神经损伤 ; lose your nerve｜失去勇气 ; have the nerve to do something｜竟敢做某事
tip_zh: nerve指勇气常不可数；nerves可指紧张情绪。

meanings_zh: n. 提议；建议；方案 | n. 求婚
definition_en: A suggested plan for others to consider. | An act of asking someone to marry you.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a marriage proposal in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了求婚。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a marriage proposal.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得求婚这个例子。
collocations: put forward a proposal｜提出方案 ; approve a proposal｜批准方案 ; a proposal to do something｜做某事的提议 ; a marriage proposal｜求婚
tip_zh: proposal to do表示做某事的提议，通常为可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 不破坏环境的；可持续的 | adj. 可长期维持的
definition_en: Using resources without exhausting them or causing lasting environmental damage. | Able to continue over a long period.
example1_en: Office hours began with sustainable development.
example1_zh: 答疑从可持续发展开始。
example2_en: The author returns to sustainable development when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可持续发展。
collocations: sustainable development｜可持续发展 ; sustainable agriculture｜可持续农业 ; sustainable transport｜可持续交通 ; sustainable growth｜可持续增长
tip_zh: renewable强调可再生；sustainable强调可持续。

meanings_zh: n. 陶器 | n. 制陶；陶艺 | n. 陶器作坊；陶器厂
definition_en: Objects shaped from clay and hardened by heating. | The activity of making objects from clay. | A place where clay objects are made.
example1_en: I copied handmade pottery into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把手工陶器抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of handmade pottery.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得手工陶器这个例子。
collocations: handmade pottery｜手工陶器 ; pottery class｜陶艺课 ; pottery wheel｜陶轮 ; pottery fragments｜陶器碎片
tip_zh: 指陶器统称时不可数；一件用a piece of pottery。

meanings_zh: n. 依赖；依靠 | n. 成瘾；依赖性
definition_en: the need to rely on someone or something | a strong physical or mental need for a substance
example1_en: The textbook introduces reduce dependence in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了减少依赖。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of reduce dependence.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得减少依赖这个例子。
collocations: dependence on｜对……的依赖 ; reduce dependence｜减少依赖 ; financial dependence｜经济依赖 ; drug dependence｜药物依赖
tip_zh: 固定搭配dependence on，不用dependence of。

meanings_zh: adj. 保守的；守旧的 | adj. 谨慎的；偏低的 | n. 保守派人士
definition_en: preferring traditional ideas and avoiding major changes | deliberately low or cautious to avoid overestimating | someone who favours traditional values and limited change
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on conservative views.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论保守观点。
example2_en: The reading connects conservative views with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把保守观点和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: conservative views｜保守观点 ; conservative estimate｜保守估计 ; conservative approach｜谨慎的做法
tip_zh: 小写通常指保守；大写可表示保守党的。

meanings_zh: n. 芜菁；蔓菁
definition_en: a round root vegetable, usually white with a purple top
example1_en: Our professor circled turnip greens on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了芜菁叶。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss turnip greens.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论芜菁叶的材料。
collocations: roasted turnips｜烤芜菁 ; turnip greens｜芜菁叶 ; turnip soup｜芜菁汤
tip_zh: 指芜菁；不要与radish（萝卜）或swede（芜菁甘蓝）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 指挥 | n. 导体 | n. 乘务员；售票员
definition_en: Someone who directs an orchestra or choir | A material that allows heat or electricity to pass through | Someone who checks or sells tickets on public transport
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an orchestra conductor.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于管弦乐队指挥的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an orchestra conductor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论管弦乐队指挥的材料。
collocations: an orchestra conductor｜管弦乐队指挥 ; a good conductor of heat｜热的良导体 ; a train conductor｜列车乘务员
tip_zh: 导体常搭配of heat或of electricity。

meanings_zh: v. 遇到；遭遇 | n. 偶遇；相遇
definition_en: meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly | an unexpected meeting or experience involving someone or something
example1_en: The lab instructions say to encounter difficulties.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求遇到困难。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to encounter difficulties.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得遇到困难。
collocations: encounter difficulties｜遇到困难 ; encounter resistance｜遭遇阻力 ; a chance encounter｜一次偶遇 ; an encounter with｜与……的相遇
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an encounter with。

meanings_zh: n. 酸；酸性物质 | adj. 酸性的；酸味的 | adj. 尖刻的；讽刺的
definition_en: A chemical substance with a pH below seven. | Containing acid or having a sharp, sour taste. | Expressing criticism in a sharp and unkind way.
example1_en: I copied stomach acid into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把胃酸抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to stomach acid when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了胃酸。
collocations: acid rain｜酸雨 ; stomach acid｜胃酸 ; acid soil｜酸性土壤 ; an acid remark｜尖刻的评论
tip_zh: acid可作名词或形容词；acidic常指呈酸性的。

meanings_zh: n. 比例；部分 | n. 比例关系；相称
definition_en: a part or share of a whole | the relationship in size or amount between things
example1_en: Office hours began with out of proportion.
example1_zh: 答疑从不成比例开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss out of proportion.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论不成比例的材料。
collocations: a large proportion of｜很大一部分 ; in proportion to｜与……成比例 ; out of proportion｜不成比例
tip_zh: a proportion of后谓语单复数取决于所指名词。

meanings_zh: adv. 忠诚地；忠实地 | adv. 如实地；准确地
definition_en: with continuing loyalty or commitment | in a way that accurately matches the original
example1_en: After the lecture, we used faithfully in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了忠诚地。
example2_en: Students who can explain faithfully usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释忠诚地的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: serve faithfully｜忠诚地服务 ; reproduce faithfully｜忠实再现 ; Yours faithfully｜谨上（正式信函结尾）
tip_zh: 英式正式信函不知收信人姓名时常用Yours faithfully。

meanings_zh: n. 告别；辞别 | int. 再见；珍重 | adj. 告别的；送别的
definition_en: An act of saying goodbye, especially before a long separation. | Used to say goodbye in a formal or emotional way. | Held or given to mark someone's departure.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a fond farewell in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了深情的告别。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a fond farewell.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕深情的告别展开说明。
collocations: a farewell party｜欢送会 ; bid someone farewell｜向某人道别 ; a fond farewell｜深情的告别
tip_zh: 比goodbye正式，常用于长久分别或郑重告别。

meanings_zh: n. 鸟群；羊群 | v. 蜂拥；成群聚集
definition_en: A group of birds, sheep, or goats | Go or gather somewhere in large numbers
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a flock of sheep.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一群羊的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a flock of sheep.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一群羊展开说明。
collocations: a flock of sheep｜一群羊 ; a flock of birds｜一群鸟 ; flock to｜蜂拥前往 ; flock together｜聚集在一起
tip_zh: 鸟群、羊群常用flock；牛群通常用herd。

meanings_zh: n. 发电机 | n. 发生器；生成器
definition_en: A machine that converts other forms of energy into electricity. | A device or program that produces something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a backup generator.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于备用发电机的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a backup generator to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用备用发电机来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: a backup generator｜备用发电机 ; a diesel generator｜柴油发电机 ; a random number generator｜随机数生成器
tip_zh: 由generate加-or构成，既指机器也可指程序。

meanings_zh: n. 农药；杀虫剂
definition_en: A substance used to kill pests that damage crops.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on pesticide use.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论农药使用。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of pesticide use.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得农药使用这个例子。
collocations: pesticide use｜农药使用 ; pesticide residues｜农药残留 ; spray pesticides｜喷洒农药 ; reduce pesticide use｜减少农药使用
tip_zh: pesticide泛指农药；insecticide专指杀虫剂。

meanings_zh: n. 冲突；时间撞期 | v. 冲突；不协调 | n. 金属碰撞声
definition_en: A conflict between people, ideas, or scheduled events. | To conflict, occur simultaneously, or look unpleasant together. | A loud ringing sound made when metal objects strike together.
example1_en: I copied a scheduling clash into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把日程冲突抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a scheduling clash when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了日程冲突。
collocations: a clash of interests｜利益冲突 ; clash with｜与…冲突 ; a scheduling clash｜日程冲突 ; a clash of cymbals｜铙钹撞击声
tip_zh: clash with可指时间冲突、意见相左或颜色不搭。

meanings_zh: n. 小数 | adj. 十进制的；小数的
definition_en: A number with a fractional part shown after a point. | Using a system based on ten or involving decimal fractions.
example1_en: The textbook introduces decimal point in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了小数点。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss decimal point.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论小数点的材料。
collocations: decimal point｜小数点 ; decimal place｜小数位 ; decimal system｜十进制
tip_zh: 保留两位小数可说to two decimal places。

meanings_zh: n. 肝脏 | n. 食用肝脏
definition_en: An organ that processes nutrients and removes harmful substances from blood. | An animal's liver prepared or eaten as food.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on liver disease.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肝病。
example2_en: A campus survey used liver disease to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用肝病来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: liver disease｜肝病 ; liver function｜肝功能 ; liver transplant｜肝移植
tip_zh: 指器官常说 the liver；作食物时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 代表；为了某人的利益
definition_en: Used in phrases meaning representing someone or supporting their interests.
example1_en: Office hours began with act on behalf of.
example1_zh: 答疑从代表……行事开始。
example2_en: The author returns to act on behalf of when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了代表……行事。
collocations: on behalf of someone｜代表某人 ; on someone's behalf｜代表某人；为某人 ; act on behalf of｜代表……行事
tip_zh: 通常用于on behalf of或on someone's behalf。

meanings_zh: n. 透镜；镜片 | n. 眼球晶状体
definition_en: A curved transparent piece that focuses or spreads light. | The transparent part inside the eye that focuses light.
example1_en: Office hours began with camera lens.
example1_zh: 答疑从相机镜头开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of camera lens.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得相机镜头这个例子。
collocations: camera lens｜相机镜头 ; contact lens｜隐形眼镜 ; wide-angle lens｜广角镜头
tip_zh: 复数为lenses；隐形眼镜常用contact lenses。

meanings_zh: adv. 非常；深深地 | adv. 深入地；至深处
definition_en: Very much, especially in relation to feelings or beliefs | Far into something or a long way below the surface
example1_en: The lab manual says to deeply concerned before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先深感担忧的，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will deeply concerned when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会深感担忧的。
collocations: deeply concerned｜深感担忧的 ; deeply rooted｜根深蒂固的 ; breathe deeply｜深呼吸 ; deeply affected｜深受影响的
tip_zh: 表示程度时常修饰情感词，如 deeply worried。

meanings_zh: n. 章鱼
definition_en: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms
example1_en: I copied a giant octopus into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把一只巨型章鱼抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a giant octopus.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一只巨型章鱼展开说明。
collocations: octopus arms｜章鱼的腕 ; octopus behaviour｜章鱼的行为 ; a giant octopus｜一只巨型章鱼
tip_zh: 常用复数是octopuses；腕通常称arms。

meanings_zh: adj. 以前的；前任的 | adj. 前者的
definition_en: having a particular role or condition in the past | being the first of two people or things just mentioned
example1_en: Office hours began with former colleague.
example1_zh: 答疑从以前的同事开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of former colleague.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得以前的同事这个例子。
collocations: former colleague｜以前的同事 ; former president｜前任总统 ; former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip_zh: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

meanings_zh: n. 天文学
definition_en: The scientific study of stars, planets, and space.
example1_en: Office hours began with observational astronomy.
example1_zh: 答疑从观测天文学开始。
example2_en: The reading connects observational astronomy with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把观测天文学和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: study astronomy｜学习天文学 ; observational astronomy｜观测天文学 ; amateur astronomy｜业余天文学
tip_zh: astronomy是天文学；astrology是占星术。

meanings_zh: n. 电路；回路 | n. 环形路线；绕行一圈 | n. 巡回活动路线

example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得冒犯性语言这个例子。

tip_zh: 表示觉得被冒犯用offended，不用offensive。

meanings_zh: n. 领土；辖区 | n. 动物的领地 | n. 领域；范围
definition_en: land controlled by a particular country or authority | an area an animal defends against others of its kind | an area of knowledge, experience, or activity
example1_en: I copied national territory into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把国家领土抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to national territory when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了国家领土。
collocations: national territory｜国家领土 ; defend territory｜保卫领土；守卫领地 ; unfamiliar territory｜不熟悉的领域 ; enter new territory｜进入新领域
tip_zh: 领土义可不可数；一块辖区可用a territory。

meanings_zh: n. 仓库；货栈 | v. 将货物存入仓库
definition_en: A large building where goods are stored before distribution | Store goods in a warehouse
example1_en: The textbook introduces automated warehouse in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自动化仓库。
example2_en: A campus survey used automated warehouse to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用自动化仓库来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: warehouse worker｜仓库工人 ; warehouse space｜仓储空间 ; automated warehouse｜自动化仓库
tip_zh: 指储存货物的大型建筑；动词用法较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 名声；名望
definition_en: The state of being known by many people.
example1_en: Our professor circled achieve fame on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了成名。
example2_en: A campus survey used achieve fame to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用成名来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: achieve fame｜成名 ; rise to fame｜声名鹊起 ; international fame｜国际声誉 ; lasting fame｜长久的名声
tip_zh: fame通常不可数；形容词famous常接for。

meanings_zh: adj. 先前的；事先的
definition_en: existing or happening before something else
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on prior experience.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论先前的经验。
example2_en: The reading connects prior experience with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把先前的经验和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: prior experience｜先前的经验 ; prior knowledge｜已有知识 ; prior notice｜事先通知 ; prior to｜在……之前
tip_zh: prior常放名词前；prior to相当于before。

meanings_zh: n. 污水；生活污物
definition_en: Wastewater and human waste carried away through drains
example1_en: I copied raw sewage into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把未经处理的污水抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss raw sewage.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论未经处理的污水的材料。
collocations: raw sewage｜未经处理的污水 ; sewage treatment｜污水处理 ; sewage disposal｜污水处置 ; sewage system｜污水排放系统
tip_zh: 不可数；sewage是污水，sewer才是下水道。

meanings_zh: n. 比；比率
definition_en: A comparison showing the relative sizes of two quantities.
example1_en: Our professor circled student-teacher ratio on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了生师比。
example2_en: A campus survey used student-teacher ratio to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用生师比来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: the ratio of A to B｜A与B之比 ; student-teacher ratio｜生师比 ; a high ratio｜高比率
tip_zh: A与B之比用the ratio of A to B，注意顺序。

meanings_zh: n. 民意调查 | n. 投票；选举投票 | v. 调查民意；获得选票
definition_en: A survey asking people about their opinions or preferences | The process of voting in an election | To survey people's opinions, or receive votes in an election
example1_en: Our professor circled opinion poll on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了民意调查。
example2_en: The reading connects opinion poll with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把民意调查和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: opinion poll｜民意调查 ; conduct a poll｜开展民意调查 ; go to the polls｜前往投票 ; poll results｜民调结果
tip_zh: 民调常用opinion poll；the polls指选举投票。

meanings_zh: n. 周围环境；周围事物
definition_en: The places, objects, and conditions around a person or thing.
example1_en: Office hours began with peaceful surroundings.
example1_zh: 答疑从宁静的环境开始。
example2_en: The reading connects peaceful surroundings with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把宁静的环境和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: peaceful surroundings｜宁静的环境 ; natural surroundings｜自然环境 ; unfamiliar surroundings｜陌生的环境 ; pleasant surroundings｜舒适的环境
tip_zh: 始终用复数形式，作主语时谓语也用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 难以忍受的
definition_en: Too unpleasant, painful, or intense to tolerate
example1_en: Our professor circled unbearable pain on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了难以忍受的疼痛。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around unbearable pain.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕难以忍受的疼痛展开说明。
collocations: unbearable pain｜难以忍受的疼痛 ; unbearable heat｜难耐的酷热 ; unbearable noise｜令人无法忍受的噪声
tip_zh: 这里的bear指忍受；unbearable语气很强。

meanings_zh: n. 过滤器；滤网 | v. 过滤；筛选 | v. 缓缓透入；逐渐传开
definition_en: a device that removes unwanted substances from liquid or air | to remove unwanted substances or select information using particular conditions | to pass through or spread gradually
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on air filter.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论空气过滤器。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of air filter.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得空气过滤器这个例子。
collocations: air filter｜空气过滤器 ; filter out impurities｜滤除杂质 ; filter search results｜筛选搜索结果 ; light filters through｜光线透过
tip_zh: filter out后接被滤除的东西，不是保留下来的。

meanings_zh: v. 消耗；耗费 | v. 吃；喝 | v. 充满内心；吞噬
definition_en: to use resources, energy, or time | to eat food or drink liquids | to fill someone's mind or destroy something completely
example1_en: The professor asked us to consume energy.
example1_zh: 教授让我们消耗能源。
example2_en: The passage says students who can consume energy follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够消耗能源的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: consume energy｜消耗能源 ; consume food｜食用食物 ; be consumed by fear｜内心充满恐惧
tip_zh: 表示吃喝时比eat、drink正式；名词为consumption。

meanings_zh: v. 害怕；担忧 | n. 恐惧；忧虑
definition_en: Feel very worried about something unpleasant that may happen. | Strong fear or worry about something that may happen.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to dread doing something.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何害怕做某事。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to dread doing something.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们害怕做某事。
collocations: dread doing something｜害怕做某事 ; a sense of dread｜恐惧感 ; fill someone with dread｜使某人充满恐惧
tip_zh: 表示害怕做某事通常用 dread doing。

meanings_zh: n. 叙述；故事 | n. 解释性叙事；观点框架 | adj. 叙事的
definition_en: A description of connected events, real or imagined. | A particular account used to explain events and shape understanding. | Related to telling stories or describing connected events.
example1_en: Office hours began with personal narrative.
example1_zh: 答疑从个人叙事开始。
example2_en: The reading connects personal narrative with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把个人叙事和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: personal narrative｜个人叙事 ; dominant narrative｜主导叙事 ; narrative structure｜叙事结构
tip_zh: 作名词指故事或叙述；作形容词常修饰结构、技巧。

meanings_zh: n. 火山喷发 | n. 突然爆发
definition_en: a sudden release of lava, ash, and gases from a volcano | a sudden, forceful outbreak of an emotion or activity
example1_en: Office hours began with volcanic eruption.
example1_zh: 答疑从火山喷发开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around volcanic eruption.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕火山喷发展开说明。
collocations: volcanic eruption｜火山喷发 ; an eruption of anger｜怒火的爆发 ; predict an eruption｜预测火山喷发
tip_zh: 常与volcanic搭配；也可指情绪等突然爆发。

meanings_zh: n. 条款 | n. 分句；从句
definition_en: A separate condition or requirement in a legal document. | A group of words containing a subject and a verb.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about main clause.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于主句的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss main clause.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论主句的材料。
collocations: a clause in a contract｜合同中的条款 ; include a clause｜加入一项条款 ; main clause｜主句 ; relative clause｜关系从句
tip_zh: 语法中clause含主语和谓语；phrase通常不含。

meanings_zh: v. 订阅；订购 | v. 赞同；认同
definition_en: To arrange regular access to a publication or service. | To agree with a particular belief or view.
example1_en: The assignment is to subscribe to a magazine, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先订阅杂志，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers subscribe to a magazine before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要订阅杂志。
collocations: subscribe to a magazine｜订阅杂志 ; subscribe to a channel｜订阅频道 ; subscribe to the view that｜赞同……的观点
tip_zh: 订阅和赞同都常用subscribe to，to是介词。

meanings_zh: n. 鸟喙；鸟嘴
definition_en: The hard, pointed mouth of a bird.
example1_en: I copied a sharp beak into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把尖锐的鸟喙抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sharp beak.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕尖锐的鸟喙展开说明。
collocations: a sharp beak｜尖锐的鸟喙 ; a curved beak｜弯曲的鸟喙 ; in its beak｜在它的喙中
tip_zh: 鸟嘴可说beak或bill；人的嘴通常用mouth。

meanings_zh: n. 副歌 | n. 合唱团；齐声 | v. 齐声说；齐声唱
definition_en: A repeated section of a song, usually with unchanged words. | A group singing together, or many voices sounding together. | To say or sing something together at the same time.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a chorus of approval.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一片赞同声的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a chorus of approval with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一片赞同声和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: sing the chorus｜唱副歌 ; join in the chorus｜加入副歌合唱 ; a chorus of approval｜一片赞同声
tip_zh: 歌曲的chorus是反复出现的副歌，与verse主歌相对。

meanings_zh: adj. 给予支持和帮助的
definition_en: giving help, encouragement, or understanding
example1_en: Our professor circled a supportive family on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了给予支持的家庭。
example2_en: A campus survey used a supportive family to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用给予支持的家庭来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: a supportive family｜给予支持的家庭 ; a supportive environment｜支持性的环境 ; supportive of｜支持……的
tip_zh: 常用be supportive of表示支持某人或某事。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；彻底地
definition_en: completely, used to strongly emphasise a description
example1_en: The lab manual says to utterly exhausted before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先筋疲力尽，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who utterly exhausted are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够筋疲力尽的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: utterly exhausted｜筋疲力尽 ; utterly impossible｜完全不可能 ; utterly ridiculous｜荒谬至极
tip_zh: 常修饰强烈或负面形容词，如 impossible、ridiculous。

meanings_zh: adj. 民主的；民主制度的 | adj. 平等参与决策的
definition_en: Based on government by people or their elected representatives. | Allowing everyone involved an equal opportunity to influence decisions.
example1_en: The textbook introduces democratic society in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了民主社会。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around democratic society.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕民主社会展开说明。
collocations: democratic society｜民主社会 ; democratic elections｜民主选举 ; democratic process｜民主程序 ; democratic principles｜民主原则
tip_zh: 小写democratic泛指民主的，不特指某个政党。

meanings_zh: n. 半岛
definition_en: Land almost surrounded by water but connected to a larger landmass.
example1_en: Office hours began with a narrow peninsula.
example1_zh: 答疑从狭长的半岛开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a narrow peninsula with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把狭长的半岛和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a narrow peninsula｜狭长的半岛 ; the tip of the peninsula｜半岛的尖端 ; on a peninsula｜在半岛上
tip_zh: 半岛与大陆相连；island指四面环水的岛。

meanings_zh: adj. 必定的；很可能的 | adj. 前往某地的 | v. 跳跃着跑
definition_en: Certain or very likely to happen | Travelling towards a particular destination | To move with long, energetic jumps
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about bound by law.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于受法律约束的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of bound by law.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得受法律约束这个例子。
collocations: be bound to do｜必定会做 ; be bound for｜前往 ; bound by law｜受法律约束 ; bound up with｜与……密切相关
tip_zh: bound to后接动词；bound for后接目的地。

meanings_zh: n. 提交；提交的文件 | n. 屈服；服从
definition_en: the act of presenting something, or the material presented | accepting another person's authority or control
example1_en: Office hours began with a written submission.
example1_zh: 答疑从提交的书面材料开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a written submission to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用提交的书面材料来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: submission deadline｜提交截止日期 ; submission of an application｜申请的提交 ; a written submission｜提交的书面材料 ; submission to authority｜对权威的服从
tip_zh: 表示提交行为通常不可数；一份提交材料可数。

meanings_zh: n. 津贴；定期零用钱 | n. 限额；定量 | n. 体谅；酌情考虑
definition_en: Money given regularly to cover particular needs | An amount you are permitted to use or have | An adjustment made to account for someone's circumstances or difficulties
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a housing allowance.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于住房津贴的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a housing allowance with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把住房津贴和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a housing allowance｜住房津贴 ; a daily allowance｜每日津贴 ; baggage allowance｜行李限额 ; make allowances for｜体谅；考虑到
tip_zh: 零用钱义常见于美式英语；英式常用pocket money。

meanings_zh: v. 走私；偷运；偷带
definition_en: To move goods or people secretly and against the rules.
example1_en: The assignment is to smuggle goods, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先走私货物，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to smuggle goods.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们走私货物。
collocations: smuggle goods｜走私货物 ; smuggle something into a country｜将某物走私入境 ; smuggle something across a border｜跨境偷运某物
tip_zh: 常用smuggle sth into/out of某地，表示偷运进出。

meanings_zh: v. 使十分惊讶
definition_en: To surprise someone very much.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to astonish an audience.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使观众惊叹。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers astonish an audience before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使观众惊叹。
collocations: astonish an audience｜使观众惊叹 ; be astonished at｜对……十分惊讶 ; be astonished to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip_zh: 人感到惊讶用astonished；事物令人惊讶用astonishing。

meanings_zh: adj. 现实的；切实可行的 | adj. 逼真的；写实的
definition_en: Based on what is actually possible or likely | Looking or sounding very much like real life
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about realistic expectations.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于现实的期望的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss realistic expectations.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论现实的期望的材料。
collocations: realistic expectations｜现实的期望 ; set realistic goals｜制定切实可行的目标 ; a realistic portrait｜逼真的肖像
tip_zh: realistic强调符合现实或逼真，real强调真实存在。

meanings_zh: n. 珍珠
definition_en: A smooth, usually pale gem formed inside certain shellfish.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on cultured pearl.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论养殖珍珠。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of cultured pearl.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得养殖珍珠这个例子。
collocations: pearl necklace｜珍珠项链 ; cultured pearl｜养殖珍珠 ; a string of pearls｜一串珍珠 ; pearls of wisdom｜智慧之言
tip_zh: a pearl是一颗珍珠；一串用a string of pearls。

meanings_zh: n. 威胁；潜在危险 | n. 恐吓；威胁的话
definition_en: Something that could cause harm or damage. | A statement expressing an intention to cause harm.
example1_en: Office hours began with a serious threat.
example1_zh: 答疑从严重威胁开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a serious threat to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用严重威胁来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: pose a threat to｜对……构成威胁 ; under threat｜受到威胁 ; make a threat｜发出威胁 ; a serious threat｜严重威胁
tip_zh: 名词用 threat；动词用 threaten。

meanings_zh: v. 解决；消除 | v. 决心；决定 | n. 决心；坚定信念
definition_en: To find a satisfactory solution to a problem or disagreement. | To decide firmly to do something. | Strong determination to achieve something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to resolve a dispute.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求解决争端。
