example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to resolve a dispute.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们解决争端。
collocations: resolve a dispute｜解决争端 ; resolve an issue｜解决问题 ; resolve to do something｜决心做某事 ; strengthen someone's resolve｜坚定某人的决心
tip_zh: resolve a problem是解决；resolve to do是决心做。

meanings_zh: n. 追求；寻求 | n. 追赶；追捕 | n. 爱好；消遣
definition_en: The effort to achieve or obtain something | The act of following someone to catch them | An activity you enjoy doing regularly
example1_en: Office hours began with the pursuit of knowledge.
example1_zh: 答疑从对知识的追求开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the pursuit of knowledge.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论对知识的追求的材料。
collocations: in pursuit of｜追求；追赶 ; the pursuit of knowledge｜对知识的追求 ; leisure pursuits｜休闲活动
tip_zh: 表示追求或追赶通常不可数；消遣活动可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 原子的 | adj. 原子能的；核能的
definition_en: Relating to atoms, the basic units of chemical elements. | Relating to energy released from the nuclei of atoms.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about atomic structure.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于原子结构的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to atomic structure when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了原子结构。
collocations: atomic structure｜原子结构 ; atomic energy｜原子能 ; atomic number｜原子序数 ; atomic clock｜原子钟
tip_zh: atomic强调原子；nuclear更侧重原子核或核能。

meanings_zh: v. 集思广益；头脑风暴 | n. 头脑风暴；集体构思
definition_en: generate many ideas freely, often with other people | a session of freely generating ideas
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to brainstorm ideas.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须集思广益想点子。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers brainstorm ideas before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要集思广益想点子。
collocations: brainstorm ideas｜集思广益想点子 ; brainstorm solutions｜集体构思解决方案 ; brainstorming session｜头脑风暴会议
tip_zh: 常作动词，直接接ideas或solutions等宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 职业技能的；职业的
definition_en: Relating to practical skills and training for a particular job
example1_en: The textbook introduces vocational training in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了职业培训。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss vocational training.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论职业培训的材料。
collocations: vocational training｜职业培训 ; vocational education｜职业教育 ; vocational qualifications｜职业资格 ; vocational course｜职业课程
tip_zh: 常修饰education、training，强调具体职业技能。

meanings_zh: n. 方式；方法 | n. 举止；态度 | n. 礼貌；礼仪
definition_en: The way something is done or happens. | The way someone behaves towards other people. | Socially acceptable ways of behaving, usually expressed in the plural.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a friendly manner.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于友好的态度的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a friendly manner.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论友好的态度的材料。
collocations: in a professional manner｜以专业的方式 ; a friendly manner｜友好的态度 ; good manners｜有礼貌 ; table manners｜餐桌礼仪
tip_zh: 表示“礼貌、礼仪”用复数manners。

meanings_zh: n. 清除；处置 | n. 供支配；供使用
definition_en: The process of getting rid of unwanted things | The state of being available for someone's use
example1_en: I copied waste disposal into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把废弃物处理抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used waste disposal to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用废弃物处理来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: waste disposal｜废弃物处理 ; safe disposal｜安全处置 ; at your disposal｜任你使用
tip_zh: at someone's disposal 表示供某人使用或支配。

meanings_zh: n. 孤立；隔绝 | n. 隔离
definition_en: The state of being separated from other people or places. | Keeping someone or something apart to prevent contact or infection.
example1_en: I copied social isolation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把社会孤立抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used social isolation to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用社会孤立来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: social isolation｜社会孤立 ; in isolation｜孤立地；单独地 ; isolation ward｜隔离病房 ; a sense of isolation｜孤独感
tip_zh: in isolation可指独自，也可指脱离背景单独考虑。

meanings_zh: n. 公开争议；争论
definition_en: Strong public disagreement about a particular issue.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about spark controversy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于引发争议的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of spark controversy.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得引发争议这个例子。
collocations: spark controversy｜引发争议 ; controversy over｜关于……的争议 ; a subject of controversy｜有争议的话题 ; amid controversy｜在争议声中
tip_zh: 多指公众对某议题的争议，不是普通口角。

meanings_zh: v. 掌握；精通 | n. 大师；能手 | adj. 主要的；总的
definition_en: To learn to do something very well. | A person with exceptional skill in a particular activity. | Main or controlling all other related parts.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to master a skill.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何掌握一项技能。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to master a skill.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得掌握一项技能。
collocations: master a skill｜掌握一项技能 ; a master of｜某方面的大师 ; master plan｜总体规划 ; master's degree｜硕士学位
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；硕士学位写作master's degree。

meanings_zh: n. 肥胖症
definition_en: A condition involving excess body fat that can harm health.
example1_en: I copied childhood obesity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把儿童肥胖症抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to childhood obesity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了儿童肥胖症。
collocations: childhood obesity｜儿童肥胖症 ; obesity prevention｜肥胖症预防 ; obesity rates｜肥胖率
tip_zh: 不可数名词；可用people with obesity称患者。

meanings_zh: adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的 | adj. 情感麻木的；呆滞的 | v. 使麻木；使失去知觉
definition_en: Unable to feel physical sensations in part of the body. | Unable to feel emotions, often because of shock. | To make a body part or someone's feelings less sensitive.
example1_en: Our professor circled numb with shock on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了震惊得呆住。
example2_en: A campus survey used numb with shock to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用震惊得呆住来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: go numb｜变得麻木 ; feel numb｜感觉麻木 ; numb with shock｜震惊得呆住 ; numb the pain｜麻痹痛感
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；既可指身体麻木，也可指情感麻木。

meanings_zh: v. 观察；注意到 | v. 遵守；奉行 | v. 评论；说
definition_en: to watch carefully or notice something | to follow a rule or practise a custom | to make a comment about something
example1_en: The lab instructions say to observe closely.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求仔细观察。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to observe closely.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们仔细观察。
collocations: observe closely｜仔细观察 ; observe the rules｜遵守规则 ; observe a tradition｜遵循传统
tip_zh: observe sb doing sth 表示观察到某人正在做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 销售网点；专卖店 | n. 表达渠道；宣泄途径 | n. 出口；排放口
definition_en: A shop or other place where goods are sold. | A way to express feelings, energy, or creative abilities. | An opening through which liquid, gas, or air can escape.
example1_en: Office hours began with retail outlet.
example1_zh: 答疑从零售网点开始。
example2_en: The reading connects retail outlet with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把零售网点和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: retail outlet｜零售网点 ; creative outlet｜发挥创造力的途径 ; an outlet for frustration｜宣泄挫败感的途径 ; water outlet｜出水口
tip_zh: outlet for常指表达渠道；美式英语中也指电源插座。

meanings_zh: n. 媒体关注；公众关注 | n. 宣传；推广
definition_en: Attention given to someone or something by the media. | Activities intended to attract public attention to something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on positive publicity.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正面宣传报道。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss positive publicity.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论正面宣传报道的材料。
collocations: positive publicity｜正面宣传报道 ; adverse publicity｜负面报道 ; generate publicity｜引起媒体关注 ; publicity campaign｜宣传活动
tip_zh: 不可数；不同于advertising，不一定是付费广告。

meanings_zh: n. 条约；国家间协议
definition_en: a formal agreement between countries
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about peace treaty.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于和平条约的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used peace treaty to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用和平条约来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: sign a treaty｜签署条约 ; peace treaty｜和平条约 ; ratify a treaty｜批准条约 ; treaty obligations｜条约义务
tip_zh: 通常指国家间正式协议，不表示谈判过程。

meanings_zh: n. 分割；分配 | n. 部门；分部 | n. 分歧；分裂
definition_en: the act of separating something into parts or shares | a major section of a company or organisation | disagreement that separates people into opposing groups
example1_en: I copied a research division into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把研究部门抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a research division.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论研究部门的材料。
collocations: division of labour｜劳动分工 ; division of responsibilities｜职责划分 ; a research division｜研究部门 ; social division｜社会分裂
tip_zh: 还可指数学中的除法；divide 是对应动词。

meanings_zh: n. 公鸡
definition_en: An adult male chicken.
example1_en: Office hours began with a rooster crows.
example1_zh: 答疑从公鸡啼叫开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a rooster crows.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论公鸡啼叫的材料。
collocations: a rooster crows｜公鸡啼叫 ; a rooster's crow｜公鸡的啼叫声
tip_zh: rooster常用于美式英语；cockerel尤指年轻公鸡。

meanings_zh: n. 概念；看法
definition_en: An idea or belief about something.
example1_en: The notion sounds simple until you try to measure it.
example1_zh: 这个概念听起来简单，直到你试图测量它。
example2_en: The author rejects the notion that one test can capture a whole ability.
example2_zh: 作者拒绝“一次测验就能抓住全部能力”这种看法。
collocations: the notion that｜认为…的看法 ; a vague notion｜模糊的概念
tip_zh: notion that 后面接完整从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 能胜任的；有能力的
definition_en: Having enough skill and knowledge to do something well.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about technically competent.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于技术过硬的的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects technically competent with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把技术过硬的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: competent teacher｜称职的教师 ; competent at｜能胜任 ; technically competent｜技术过硬的
tip_zh: 常用be competent at doing，表示能胜任某事。

meanings_zh: n. 页边空白；边缘 | n. 差额；差距；余地 | n. 利润率；利润差额
definition_en: the blank space around a page or an area's edge | the difference between amounts or extra space for safety | the difference between selling price and production cost
example1_en: Our professor circled a wide margin on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了宽阔的页边空白；很大的差距。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a wide margin.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论宽阔的页边空白；很大的差距的材料。
collocations: a wide margin｜宽阔的页边空白；很大的差距 ; profit margin｜利润率 ; margin of error｜误差幅度 ; a safety margin｜安全余量
tip_zh: by a narrow margin表示以微小差距获胜等。

meanings_zh: adj. 传统的；常规的
definition_en: following methods or ideas that are usual and widely accepted
example1_en: Office hours began with conventional methods.
example1_zh: 答疑从常规方法开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around conventional methods.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕常规方法展开说明。
collocations: conventional methods｜常规方法 ; conventional wisdom｜普遍看法 ; conventional medicine｜常规医学 ; conventional farming｜常规农业
tip_zh: conventional强调符合常规，不一定指历史悠久。

meanings_zh: n. 堡垒；要塞
definition_en: A strongly defended building or place designed to resist attack.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a medieval fortress.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于中世纪堡垒的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a medieval fortress with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把中世纪堡垒和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a medieval fortress｜中世纪堡垒 ; a heavily fortified fortress｜防御严密的要塞 ; an island fortress｜岛上要塞
tip_zh: 指防御坚固的要塞；castle更强调城堡建筑。

meanings_zh: adj. 不足的；不够好的 | adj. 感到能力不足的
definition_en: not enough or not good enough for a particular purpose | feeling unable to handle a situation successfully
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about inadequate funding.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于资金不足的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects inadequate funding with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把资金不足和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: inadequate funding｜资金不足 ; inadequate facilities｜设施不足 ; inadequate for the task｜不足以胜任任务 ; feel inadequate｜感到力不从心
tip_zh: 常用inadequate for；指数量不足或质量不达标。

meanings_zh: n. 有效性；成效
definition_en: the degree to which something produces the intended result
example1_en: Office hours began with evaluate effectiveness.
example1_zh: 答疑从评估有效性开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss evaluate effectiveness.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论评估有效性的材料。
collocations: evaluate effectiveness｜评估有效性 ; improve effectiveness｜提高成效 ; demonstrate effectiveness｜证明有效性 ; cost effectiveness｜成本效益
tip_zh: effectiveness重效果；efficiency重时间与资源效率。

meanings_zh: n. 污染物
definition_en: A substance that makes air, water, or soil dirty or harmful.
example1_en: Office hours began with air pollutant.
example1_zh: 答疑从空气污染物开始。
example2_en: The author returns to air pollutant when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了空气污染物。
collocations: air pollutant｜空气污染物 ; harmful pollutants｜有害污染物 ; industrial pollutants｜工业污染物
tip_zh: pollutant指具体污染物，可数；pollution指污染。

meanings_zh: n. 映像；倒影 | n. 沉思；反思 | n. 反映；体现
definition_en: an image seen in a mirror or shiny surface | careful thought about an experience, idea, or decision | something that shows the nature or condition of something else
example1_en: Our professor circled a reflection of society on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会的写照。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a reflection of society.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕社会的写照展开说明。
collocations: a reflection in the mirror｜镜中的映像 ; on reflection｜仔细考虑后 ; a reflection of society｜社会的写照
tip_zh: on reflection表示仔细考虑后；a reflection of表示……的体现。

meanings_zh: adj. 实际的；真实的
definition_en: real, rather than imagined, estimated, or claimed
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on actual cost.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论实际成本。
example2_en: The author returns to actual cost when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了实际成本。
collocations: actual cost｜实际成本 ; actual results｜实际结果 ; actual size｜实际大小
tip_zh: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

meanings_zh: adv. 痛苦地；愤愤地 | adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: with strong sadness, anger, or disappointment | extremely, especially when describing cold or unpleasant feelings
example1_en: The professor told us to bitterly disappointed and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们极度失望，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will bitterly disappointed when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会极度失望。
collocations: bitterly disappointed｜极度失望 ; bitterly cold｜严寒的 ; complain bitterly｜愤愤地抱怨 ; weep bitterly｜痛哭
tip_zh: 常修饰负面情绪或cold，不宜泛用于积极形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 碎片；片段 | v. 破碎；使分裂
definition_en: A small piece broken off or separated from something larger. | To break something, or become broken, into smaller separate parts.
example1_en: Office hours began with sentence fragment.
example1_zh: 答疑从不完整句开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sentence fragment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕不完整句展开说明。
collocations: a fragment of glass｜一块玻璃碎片 ; bone fragments｜骨头碎片 ; fragment into｜碎裂成 ; sentence fragment｜不完整句
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/fræɡˈment/，重音在后。

meanings_zh: v. 废除；取消
definition_en: to officially end a law, system, or established practice
example1_en: The professor asked us to abolish a law.
example1_zh: 教授让我们废除法律。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to abolish a law.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们废除法律。
collocations: abolish a law｜废除法律 ; abolish a tax｜取消某项税收 ; abolish slavery｜废除奴隶制
tip_zh: 常接法律、制度或惯例，不用于取消普通预约。

meanings_zh: n. 竹；竹材
definition_en: A tall plant with hollow woody stems, or its strong material.
example1_en: I copied a bamboo forest into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把竹林抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a bamboo forest to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用竹林来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a bamboo forest｜竹林 ; bamboo shoots｜竹笋 ; bamboo furniture｜竹制家具
tip_zh: 泛指竹子或竹材时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 说唱音乐；说唱歌曲 | v. 表演说唱 | v. 快速敲击
definition_en: music with words spoken rhythmically over a strong beat | to speak words rhythmically over a musical beat | to hit a surface with short, sharp blows
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rap music.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论说唱音乐。
example2_en: The author returns to rap music when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了说唱音乐。
collocations: rap music｜说唱音乐 ; rap artist｜说唱艺人 ; rap on the door｜急促敲门
tip_zh: rap重读闭音节结尾：rapped、rapping双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 牧羊人 | v. 引领；护送；照看
definition_en: A person who looks after sheep | To guide people carefully in a particular direction
example1_en: Our professor circled shepherd visitors through on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了引导游客穿过。
example2_en: The reading connects shepherd visitors through with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把引导游客穿过和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a flock of sheep｜一群羊 ; a shepherd's hut｜牧羊人的小屋 ; shepherd visitors through｜引导游客穿过
tip_zh: 作动词通常及物：shepherd sb into/through某处。

meanings_zh: n. 版权；著作权 | v. 为……取得版权保护
definition_en: the legal right to control copying and use of creative work | to secure copyright protection for a creative work
example1_en: Our professor circled copyright protection on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了版权保护。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around copyright protection.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕版权保护展开说明。
collocations: copyright protection｜版权保护 ; copyright holder｜版权所有者 ; copyright infringement｜侵犯版权 ; under copyright｜受版权保护
tip_zh: 版权是copyright；专利权是patent，勿混用。

meanings_zh: n. 厌恶；反感 | v. 使厌恶；使反感
definition_en: a strong feeling of dislike caused by something unpleasant | to make someone feel strong dislike or revulsion
example1_en: The textbook introduces express disgust in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了表达厌恶。
example2_en: The reading connects express disgust with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把表达厌恶和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: in disgust｜厌恶地 ; express disgust｜表达厌恶 ; disgust at｜对……的厌恶
tip_zh: disgusted形容人的感受；disgusting形容令人厌恶的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 完成；实现
definition_en: to successfully finish something or achieve a goal
example1_en: The assignment is to accomplish a task, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先完成任务，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can accomplish a task follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够完成任务的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: accomplish a task｜完成任务 ; accomplish a goal｜实现目标 ; accomplish a great deal｜取得很大成果
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接任务或目标，不接不定式。

meanings_zh: adj. 敌意的；强烈反对的 | adj. 恶劣的；不利的 | adj. 敌方的；敌对的
definition_en: unfriendly or strongly opposed to someone or something | having conditions that make life or progress difficult | belonging to an enemy or acting against another side
example1_en: The textbook introduces hostile to change in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了抵制变革的。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hostile to change.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论抵制变革的的材料。
collocations: hostile to change｜抵制变革的 ; hostile reception｜不友好的接待 ; hostile environment｜恶劣的环境 ; hostile forces｜敌方部队
tip_zh: hostile to后接名词或动名词，表示敌视或反对。

meanings_zh: n. 台风
definition_en: A powerful tropical storm in the western Pacific Ocean.
example1_en: Office hours began with a powerful typhoon.
example1_zh: 答疑从强台风开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a powerful typhoon.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得强台风这个例子。
collocations: a powerful typhoon｜强台风 ; a typhoon hits｜台风袭来 ; typhoon warning｜台风预警
tip_zh: 与hurricane均指热带气旋，名称因发生海域而异。

meanings_zh: n. 郡；县
definition_en: An administrative area within a country or state.
example1_en: The textbook introduces county council in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了郡议会。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of county council.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得郡议会这个例子。
collocations: county council｜郡议会 ; county town｜郡治所在地 ; county boundary｜郡界
tip_zh: 英国的county通常译为“郡”，美国的译为“县”。

meanings_zh: adv. 而且；此外
definition_en: Used to add another fact supporting what was just said.
example1_en: Moreover, the class checked the chart a second time.
example1_zh: 而且，全班又核对了一次图表。
example2_en: Moreover, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
example2_zh: 而且，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。
collocations: moreover, it is important to｜此外，重要的是要 ; moreover, there is evidence that｜而且，有证据表明
tip_zh: 正式递进副词；连接独立句时，前用句号或分号。

meanings_zh: n. 和谐；融洽 | n. 协调；一致 | n. 和声
definition_en: A peaceful relationship in which people cooperate and agree. | A pleasing match or agreement between different things. | Different musical notes played or sung together to support a melody.
example1_en: Office hours began with social harmony.
example1_zh: 答疑从社会和谐开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of social harmony.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得社会和谐这个例子。
collocations: live in harmony｜和睦相处 ; social harmony｜社会和谐 ; in harmony with nature｜与自然和谐共处 ; sing in harmony｜用和声演唱
tip_zh: 常用in harmony with表示与……和谐或一致。

meanings_zh: adj. 相关的；切题的
definition_en: closely connected with the subject or situation being considered
example1_en: The textbook introduces highly relevant in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了高度相关的。
example2_en: The reading connects highly relevant with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把高度相关的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: relevant to｜与……相关 ; relevant experience｜相关经验 ; relevant information｜相关信息 ; highly relevant｜高度相关的
tip_zh: 表示“与……相关”用relevant to，不用with。

meanings_zh: n. 旋律；曲调
definition_en: A sequence of musical sounds forming a recognisable tune.
example1_en: Office hours began with gentle melody.
example1_zh: 答疑从轻柔的旋律开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of gentle melody.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得轻柔的旋律这个例子。
collocations: gentle melody｜轻柔的旋律 ; catchy melody｜朗朗上口的曲调 ; compose a melody｜谱写旋律
tip_zh: melody指可哼唱的旋律；rhythm指节奏。

meanings_zh: v. 创作；撰写 | v. 组成；构成 | v. 使镇定
definition_en: To create music or carefully write a piece of writing | To be the parts that together form a whole | To calm yourself and regain control of your emotions
example1_en: The assignment is to compose music, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先作曲，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to compose music.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来作曲。
collocations: compose music｜作曲 ; compose a poem｜作诗 ; be composed of｜由……组成 ; compose yourself｜使自己镇定
tip_zh: be composed of表示“由……组成”。

meanings_zh: n. 住房抵押贷款 | v. 将房产抵押借款
definition_en: A property loan secured against the property itself. | To borrow money using property as security.
example1_en: I copied mortgage repayments into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把房贷还款抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to mortgage repayments when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了房贷还款。
collocations: take out a mortgage｜申请住房抵押贷款 ; pay off a mortgage｜还清房贷 ; mortgage repayments｜房贷还款 ; mortgage interest rates｜房贷利率
tip_zh: mortgage中的t不发音；还清房贷用pay off。

meanings_zh: adj. 有前途的；有希望的
definition_en: Showing signs of likely future success or improvement.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about promising results.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于令人鼓舞的结果的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of promising results.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得令人鼓舞的结果这个例子。
collocations: promising results｜令人鼓舞的结果 ; promising career｜前景光明的职业生涯 ; promising young artist｜有前途的年轻艺术家 ; look promising｜看起来有希望
tip_zh: 表示有成功的潜力，不等于已经成功。

meanings_zh: n. 方言
definition_en: A language variety used in a particular region or community.
example1_en: Our professor circled local dialect on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了当地方言。
example2_en: The reading connects local dialect with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把当地方言和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: local dialect｜当地方言 ; regional dialect｜地区方言 ; speak a dialect｜说方言
tip_zh: dialect涉及词汇和语法，accent主要指口音。

meanings_zh: n. 外科医生
definition_en: a doctor trained to perform operations
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about experienced surgeon.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于经验丰富的外科医生的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of experienced surgeon.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得经验丰富的外科医生这个例子。
collocations: experienced surgeon｜经验丰富的外科医生 ; heart surgeon｜心脏外科医生 ; orthopaedic surgeon｜骨科医生
tip_zh: surgeon指外科医生；surgery可指外科手术。

meanings_zh: adj. 有活力的；积极进取的 | adj. 动态的；不断变化的 | n. 互动模式；作用关系
definition_en: Full of energy and eager to make things happen. | Continuously changing or developing. | A pattern of interaction between people or forces.
example1_en: The textbook introduces dynamic leader in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了有活力的领导者。
example2_en: A campus survey used dynamic leader to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有活力的领导者来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: dynamic leader｜有活力的领导者 ; dynamic economy｜充满活力的经济 ; group dynamics｜群体互动模式
tip_zh: 形容人指有活力；形容系统指不断变化。

meanings_zh: n. 后续行动；跟进 | adj. 后续的；跟进的
definition_en: An action continuing or checking earlier work or treatment. | Done after something to continue it or check its results.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used follow-up in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了跟进。
example2_en: A reading on public health uses follow-up when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了跟进。
collocations: a follow-up appointment｜复诊预约 ; a follow-up study｜后续研究 ; a follow-up question｜追问 ; a follow-up visit｜回访
tip_zh: 名词、形容词带连字符；动词短语follow up不带。

meanings_zh: n. 自雇；个体经营
definition_en: working for yourself rather than for an employer
example1_en: After the lecture, we used self-employment in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了自雇。
example2_en: Students who can explain self-employment usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释自雇的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: go into self-employment｜开始自雇 ; income from self-employment｜自雇收入 ; self-employment opportunities｜自雇机会
tip_zh: 不可数；指为自己工作，不一定是创办公司。

meanings_zh: n. 物质 | n. 实质；要旨 | n. 实质内容；根据
definition_en: A particular type of material with specific physical properties. | The central meaning or most important content of something. | Meaningful content or a solid basis for belief.
example1_en: Our professor circled chemical substance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了化学物质。
example2_en: The author returns to chemical substance when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了化学物质。
collocations: harmful substances｜有害物质 ; chemical substance｜化学物质 ; the substance of｜……的实质 ; lack substance｜缺乏实质内容
tip_zh: 表示物质种类时可数；表示实质或根据时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害的
definition_en: causing or likely to cause damage or injury
example1_en: I copied potentially harmful into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把可能有害的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects potentially harmful with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可能有害的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: harmful to health｜有害健康 ; harmful effects｜有害影响 ; harmful substances｜有害物质 ; potentially harmful｜可能有害的
tip_zh: 表示对……有害用harmful to，不用harmful for。

meanings_zh: n. 矿物；矿物质 | adj. 矿物的；矿产的
definition_en: a natural substance found in rocks, soil, food, or water | relating to minerals found in the earth
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mineral resources.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论矿产资源。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mineral resources.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕矿产资源展开说明。
collocations: mineral resources｜矿产资源 ; mineral deposits｜矿床 ; essential minerals｜必需矿物质 ; mineral water｜矿泉水
tip_zh: 营养语境中minerals指矿物质，不等于维生素。

meanings_zh: adv. 纯粹地；仅仅
definition_en: Only for the stated reason or in the stated way.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to purely by chance.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习纯属偶然。
example2_en: Students who purely by chance are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够纯属偶然的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: purely by chance｜纯属偶然 ; purely for pleasure｜纯粹为了乐趣 ; purely personal｜纯属个人的 ; purely theoretical｜纯理论的
tip_zh: 常放在for、by或形容词前，强调不含其他因素。

meanings_zh: n. 重要性；意义 | n. 含义
definition_en: the importance of something, especially its effects | the special meaning that something carries or suggests
example1_en: I copied great significance into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把重大意义抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to great significance when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重大意义。
collocations: great significance｜重大意义 ; historical significance｜历史意义 ; the significance of｜……的重要性或含义 ; attach significance to｜重视
tip_zh: be of great significance相当于be very significant。

meanings_zh: n. 乐意；意愿
definition_en: The readiness to do something without needing to be forced.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on willingness to learn.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学习意愿。
example2_en: The author returns to willingness to learn when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学习意愿。
collocations: willingness to learn｜学习意愿 ; show willingness｜表现出意愿 ; a willingness to cooperate｜合作的意愿
tip_zh: 不可数名词，常接to do表示做某事的意愿。

meanings_zh: n. 技术员；技师
definition_en: a trained worker who operates, maintains, or repairs technical equipment
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about laboratory technician.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于实验室技术员的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects laboratory technician with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把实验室技术员和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: laboratory technician｜实验室技术员 ; maintenance technician｜维修技术员 ; qualified technician｜合格的技术员
tip_zh: technician 侧重设备操作维护，不等同于 engineer。

meanings_zh: n. 大豆；大豆制品 | n. 酱油
definition_en: beans grown for their protein, or food made from them | a salty brown sauce made from fermented beans
example1_en: The textbook introduces soy milk in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了豆奶。
example2_en: The reading connects soy milk with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把豆奶和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: soy milk｜豆奶 ; soy sauce｜酱油 ; soy protein｜大豆蛋白 ; soy products｜大豆制品
tip_zh: 英式英语也常用soya；“酱油”通常说soy sauce。

meanings_zh: v. 下降；衰退 | n. 下降；衰退 | v. 谢绝；婉拒
definition_en: To become smaller, weaker, or less successful. | A reduction in amount, strength, quality, or importance. | To politely refuse an offer, invitation, or request.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer decline an invitation during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时谢绝邀请。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to decline an invitation.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来谢绝邀请。
collocations: a sharp decline｜急剧下降 ; a decline in sales｜销售额下降 ; decline an invitation｜谢绝邀请 ; decline to comment｜拒绝评论
tip_zh: 下降用decline in；婉拒做某事用decline to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 失去知觉的；昏迷的 | adj. 无意识的；未察觉的
definition_en: unable to see, hear, or respond because awareness is lost | done without awareness, or unaware of something
example1_en: Office hours began with unconscious bias.
example1_zh: 答疑从无意识偏见开始。
example2_en: The reading connects unconscious bias with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把无意识偏见和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fall unconscious｜失去知觉 ; remain unconscious｜仍处于昏迷状态 ; unconscious bias｜无意识偏见 ; unconscious of｜未察觉到
tip_zh: unconscious of表示未察觉；昏迷不是普通睡眠。

meanings_zh: adv. 不可避免地；必然地
definition_en: in a way that cannot be prevented or avoided
example1_en: The lab manual says to inevitably lead to before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先必然导致，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will inevitably lead to when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会必然导致。
collocations: inevitably lead to｜必然导致 ; inevitably involve｜不可避免地涉及 ; almost inevitably｜几乎不可避免地
tip_zh: 语气比probably强，表示结果无法避免。

meanings_zh: adj. 不了解的；不知道的 | adj. 无知的；缺乏教养的
definition_en: not knowing about a particular fact or subject | lacking knowledge, education, or understanding
example1_en: I copied an ignorant remark into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把无知的言论抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects an ignorant remark with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把无知的言论和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: ignorant of the facts｜不了解事实 ; remain ignorant｜仍然不知情 ; an ignorant remark｜无知的言论
tip_zh: 常用be ignorant of；直接形容人可能带贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 熟人 | n. 了解；熟悉
definition_en: Someone you know, but who is not a close friend. | Some knowledge of a person or subject.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a casual acquaintance in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了泛泛之交。
example2_en: A campus survey used a casual acquaintance to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用泛泛之交来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a casual acquaintance｜泛泛之交 ; make someone's acquaintance｜结识某人 ; acquaintance with｜对…的了解
tip_zh: 指熟人时可数；表示了解时常接with。

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；显而易见的 | adj. 表面上的；看似的
definition_en: Easy to see or understand. | Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.
example1_en: I copied apparent contradiction into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把表面上的矛盾抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects apparent contradiction with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把表面上的矛盾和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: become apparent｜变得明显 ; for no apparent reason｜无明显原因 ; apparent contradiction｜表面上的矛盾
tip_zh: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 受挫感；懊恼
definition_en: Annoyance caused by being unable to achieve what you want.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a sense of frustration.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于挫败感的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a sense of frustration.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得挫败感这个例子。
collocations: in frustration｜懊恼地 ; a sense of frustration｜挫败感 ; express frustration｜表达不满 ; growing frustration｜日益加深的挫败感
tip_zh: 人感到frustrated；令人受挫的事物是frustrating。

meanings_zh: n. 谚语；俗谚
definition_en: a familiar short saying expressing advice or a general truth
example1_en: Office hours began with traditional proverb.
example1_zh: 答疑从传统谚语开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss traditional proverb.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论传统谚语的材料。
collocations: traditional proverb｜传统谚语 ; quote a proverb｜引用谚语 ; as the proverb goes｜常言道
tip_zh: proverb是流传的完整俗谚；idiom多为固定习语。

meanings_zh: n. 转变；过渡时期 | v. 转变；过渡
definition_en: A change from one state, stage, or situation to another. | To change from one state or situation to another.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a smooth transition.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于平稳过渡的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a smooth transition.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得平稳过渡这个例子。
collocations: a smooth transition｜平稳过渡 ; transition from A to B｜从甲到乙的转变 ; a transition period｜过渡期
tip_zh: 常用transition from A to B表示两种状态间转变。

meanings_zh: adv. 据说；看来；似乎
definition_en: According to available information, though not necessarily certain.
example1_en: The lab manual says to apparently harmless before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先看似无害的，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will apparently harmless when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会看似无害的。
collocations: apparently harmless｜看似无害的 ; apparently unaware｜似乎不知情的 ; apparently simple｜表面上简单的
tip_zh: 表示据现有信息推测，不保证事实确实如此。

meanings_zh: n. 粉刺；丘疹
definition_en: A small raised spot on the skin, often red.
example1_en: Our professor circled a pimple on your chin on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了下巴上的痘痘。
example2_en: A campus survey used a pimple on your chin to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用下巴上的痘痘来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: get a pimple｜长痘痘 ; squeeze a pimple｜挤痘痘 ; a pimple on your chin｜下巴上的痘痘
tip_zh: pimple指单颗痘痘；acne指痤疮这种皮肤问题。

meanings_zh: v. 挨饿；饿死；使挨饿 | v. 使严重缺乏
definition_en: To suffer or die from insufficient food | To deny someone or something an essential resource
example1_en: The lab instructions say to starve to death.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求饿死。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to starve to death.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来饿死。
collocations: starve to death｜饿死 ; be starving｜饿极了 ; be starved of resources｜严重缺乏资源
tip_zh: 日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。

meanings_zh: n. 羡慕；嫉妒 | v. 羡慕；嫉妒 | n. 令人羡慕的人或事物
definition_en: a feeling of wanting something that someone else has | to wish you had another person's possessions, qualities, or advantages | a person or thing that others wish to equal or possess
example1_en: I copied green with envy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把十分嫉妒抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of green with envy.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得十分嫉妒这个例子。
collocations: envy someone something｜羡慕某人拥有某物 ; with envy｜羡慕地 ; the envy of｜令……羡慕的人或事物 ; green with envy｜十分嫉妒
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语：envy someone，不加of。

meanings_zh: n. 假定；未经证实的看法 | n. 承担；就任
definition_en: Something accepted as true without definite proof. | The act of taking on responsibility, power, or a role.
example1_en: Office hours began with underlying assumption.
example1_zh: 答疑从隐含假设开始。
example2_en: The reading connects underlying assumption with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把隐含假设和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: make an assumption｜作出假设 ; underlying assumption｜隐含假设 ; challenge an assumption｜质疑假设 ; assumption of responsibility｜承担责任
tip_zh: 常用assumption that从句，表示未经证实的看法。

meanings_zh: n. 危机；紧要关头
definition_en: a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on housing crisis.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论住房危机。
example2_en: The reading connects housing crisis with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把住房危机和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: face a crisis｜面临危机 ; housing crisis｜住房危机 ; crisis management｜危机管理 ; in times of crisis｜在危机时期
tip_zh: 复数为crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/，注意词尾发音。

meanings_zh: n. 标识；徽标
definition_en: a design or symbol that represents an organisation or product
example1_en: Office hours began with company logo.
example1_zh: 答疑从公司徽标开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used company logo to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用公司徽标来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: company logo｜公司徽标 ; design a logo｜设计徽标 ; distinctive logo｜独特的徽标
tip_zh: logo指视觉标识；slogan指宣传口号。

meanings_zh: v. 开花 | n. 花朵；开花 | v. 蓬勃发展；焕发光彩
definition_en: To produce flowers. | A flower, or the state of producing flowers. | To develop successfully or become more confident and attractive.
example1_en: I wrote bloom on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把bloom和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses bloom when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了开花。
collocations: in full bloom｜盛开 ; come into bloom｜开始开花 ; spring blooms｜春日花朵
tip_zh: bloom可作动词；表示正在开花用in bloom。

meanings_zh: n. 祖先；祖宗 | n. 祖先物种；原型
definition_en: a family member who lived several generations before you | an earlier species or form from which something developed
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on common ancestor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论共同祖先。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around common ancestor.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕共同祖先展开说明。
collocations: common ancestor｜共同祖先 ; distant ancestor｜远祖 ; human ancestors｜人类祖先
tip_zh: ancestor指祖先；descendant指后代。

meanings_zh: adj. 占有欲强的 | adj. 所有格的；表示所属的
definition_en: Wanting exclusive control over someone or something. | Showing who owns something or how things are related.
example1_en: The textbook introduces possessive about in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……占有欲强。
example2_en: The reading connects possessive about with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……占有欲强和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: possessive about｜对……占有欲强 ; possessive behaviour｜占有欲强的行为 ; possessive pronoun｜物主代词 ; possessive form｜所有格形式
tip_zh: 对物占有欲强常用about；语法中指所属关系。

meanings_zh: adj. 积极的；有动力的 | adj. 出于某种动机的
definition_en: Eager and willing to work towards a goal. | Driven by a particular reason or purpose.
example1_en: I copied highly motivated into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把积极性很高的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects highly motivated with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把积极性很高的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: highly motivated｜积极性很高的 ; stay motivated｜保持动力 ; motivated by profit｜受利润驱动的
tip_zh: motivated to do表示有动力做；by引出动机。

meanings_zh: n. 重大突破；重大进展
definition_en: An important discovery or advance that overcomes a difficult problem.
example1_en: I copied scientific breakthrough into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把科学突破抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used scientific breakthrough to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用科学突破来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: make a breakthrough｜取得突破 ; scientific breakthrough｜科学突破 ; breakthrough in treatment｜治疗方面的突破
tip_zh: 名词写成一个词；动词短语break through分开写。

meanings_zh: n. 惯例；习俗 | n. 大会；代表大会 | n. 国际公约；协定
definition_en: An accepted way of behaving or doing something. | A large meeting of people with shared interests or work. | A formal agreement between countries about a particular issue.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about social convention.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于社会习俗的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of social convention.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得社会习俗这个例子。
collocations: social convention｜社会习俗 ; annual convention｜年度大会 ; international convention｜国际公约 ; by convention｜按照惯例
tip_zh: 惯例与大会通常可数；by convention意为按惯例。

meanings_zh: n. 批准；许可 | n. 赞同；认可
definition_en: official permission for something to happen | a positive opinion of someone or something
example1_en: Our professor circled obtain approval on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了获得批准。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around obtain approval.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕获得批准展开说明。
collocations: obtain approval｜获得批准 ; seek approval｜寻求批准 ; give approval｜给予许可 ; meet with approval｜得到认可
tip_zh: approval of常指赞同；approval for常指项目许可。

meanings_zh: adj. 难忘的；值得记住的
definition_en: Special or unusual enough to be remembered for a long time.
example1_en: I copied memorable experience into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把难忘的经历抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around memorable experience.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕难忘的经历展开说明。
collocations: memorable experience｜难忘的经历 ; memorable occasion｜难忘的时刻 ; memorable performance｜令人难忘的表演
tip_zh: memorable形容事物难忘，不表示某人记忆力好。

meanings_zh: v. 误导；使产生错误认识
definition_en: to cause someone to believe something incorrect
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to mislead consumers.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何误导消费者。
example2_en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers mislead consumers before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要误导消费者。
collocations: mislead consumers｜误导消费者 ; mislead someone into believing｜误导某人相信 ; deliberately mislead｜故意误导
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为misled；常接into doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人担忧的；惊人的
definition_en: Causing worry or fear that something bad may happen.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an alarming rate.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论惊人的速度。
example2_en: The author returns to an alarming rate when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了惊人的速度。
collocations: an alarming rate｜惊人的速度 ; an alarming increase｜令人担忧的增长 ; an alarming trend｜令人担忧的趋势
tip_zh: alarming形容事物令人担忧；alarmed形容人感到惊恐。

meanings_zh: v. 表扬；赞扬 | n. 表扬；赞美
definition_en: To express approval or admiration for someone or something. | Words expressing approval or admiration.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to praise someone for something.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求因某事表扬某人。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to praise someone for something.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们因某事表扬某人。
collocations: praise someone for something｜因某事表扬某人 ; win praise｜赢得赞誉 ; high praise｜高度赞扬 ; lavish praise on｜大加赞扬
tip_zh: praise sb for sth；名词通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 外科手术；外科学 | n. 诊所；诊疗室
definition_en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair damage. | A place where a doctor or dentist sees patients.
example1_en: Office hours began with undergo surgery.
example1_zh: 答疑从接受手术开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used undergo surgery to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用接受手术来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: undergo surgery｜接受手术 ; emergency surgery｜急诊手术 ; minor surgery｜小手术 ; a doctor's surgery｜医生诊所
tip_zh: 手术义通常不可数；英式英语中诊所义可数。

meanings_zh: n. 可能的影响；后果 | n. 言外之意；暗示 | n. 牵连；涉及
definition_en: a possible effect or consequence of an action or decision | an idea suggested without being stated directly | involvement in something wrong or illegal
example1_en: The professor explained implication with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了后果。
example2_en: Students who can explain implication usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释后果的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: implications for employment｜对就业的潜在影响 ; far-reaching implications｜深远的影响 ; by implication｜以暗示的方式
tip_zh: 表示潜在影响常用复数 implications，后接 for。

meanings_zh: adj. 三倍的；三部分的 | v. 增至三倍；使成三倍
definition_en: Three times as much, or consisting of three parts. | To become three times as much, or make something so.
example1_en: Office hours began with triple room.
example1_zh: 答疑从三人间开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of triple room.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得三人间这个例子。
collocations: triple the cost｜三倍的费用 ; triple room｜三人间 ; triple in size｜规模增至三倍 ; triple glazing｜三层玻璃
tip_zh: triple表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍。

meanings_zh: adj. 基因的；遗传的
definition_en: relating to genes or characteristics passed from parents to offspring
example1_en: Office hours began with genetic factors.
example1_zh: 答疑从遗传因素开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around genetic factors.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕遗传因素展开说明。
collocations: genetic factors｜遗传因素 ; genetic variation｜遗传变异 ; genetic engineering｜基因工程 ; genetic disorder｜遗传性疾病
tip_zh: genetic指基因或遗传的；genetics是遗传学。

meanings_zh: n. 鸵鸟
definition_en: a very large flightless bird with long legs and neck
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about ostrich egg.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于鸵鸟蛋的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects ostrich egg with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把鸵鸟蛋和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: ostrich egg｜鸵鸟蛋 ; ostrich feather｜鸵鸟羽毛 ; ostrich farm｜鸵鸟养殖场
tip_zh: 复数为ostriches；“埋头沙中逃避”并非真实习性。

meanings_zh: n. 营养；营养摄取 | n. 营养学
definition_en: the process of obtaining and using food for health | the study of how food affects health and growth
example1_en: Our professor circled good nutrition on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了良好的营养。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of good nutrition.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得良好的营养这个例子。
collocations: good nutrition｜良好的营养 ; adequate nutrition｜充足的营养 ; nutrition education｜营养教育
tip_zh: nutrition不可数；nutrient指具体的营养物质。

meanings_zh: n. 创造；创作；建立 | n. 创作物；作品
definition_en: the process of bringing something new into existence | something new that someone has made or designed
example1_en: The textbook introduces job creation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了创造就业机会。
example2_en: The author returns to job creation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了创造就业机会。
collocations: job creation｜创造就业机会 ; the creation of wealth｜财富的创造 ; an original creation｜原创作品
tip_zh: 指创造过程通常不可数；指具体作品时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 腐烂；腐朽 | n. 腐烂；腐朽 | n. 衰败；衰退
definition_en: to gradually break down through natural processes | the natural process of rotting or breaking down | a gradual loss of strength, quality, or importance
example1_en: The professor explained decay with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了腐烂。
example2_en: Students who can explain decay usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释腐烂的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: tooth decay｜蛀牙；龋齿 ; urban decay｜城市衰败 ; decaying vegetation｜腐烂的植物 ; prevent decay｜防止腐烂
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；tooth decay指龋齿，不是掉牙。

meanings_zh: n. 哺乳动物
definition_en: A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.
example1_en: I copied marine mammal into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把海洋哺乳动物抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of marine mammal.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得海洋哺乳动物这个例子。
collocations: marine mammal｜海洋哺乳动物 ; small mammal｜小型哺乳动物 ; mammal species｜哺乳动物物种
tip_zh: 鲸和海豚也是哺乳动物；不能按栖息地判断。

meanings_zh: adj. 精神的；心灵的 | adj. 宗教的
definition_en: Connected with inner feelings and meaning rather than material things. | Related to religious beliefs or experiences.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about spiritual well-being.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于精神健康的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used spiritual well-being to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用精神健康来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: spiritual well-being｜精神健康 ; spiritual beliefs｜宗教信仰 ; spiritual growth｜心灵成长
tip_zh: 可指心灵层面，不一定涉及宗教。

meanings_zh: adj. 每季度的 | adv. 每季度一次地 | n. 季刊
definition_en: Happening or produced every three months. | Once every three months. | A magazine published every three months.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about quarterly report.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于季度报告的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around quarterly report.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕季度报告展开说明。
collocations: quarterly report｜季度报告 ; quarterly meeting｜季度会议 ; pay quarterly｜按季度付款
tip_zh: quarterly指每三个月一次，不是每四个月一次。

meanings_zh: n. 卵石；小圆石
definition_en: A small, smooth stone, often found near water.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a smooth pebble.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论光滑的卵石。
example2_en: The author returns to a smooth pebble when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了光滑的卵石。
collocations: a smooth pebble｜光滑的卵石 ; a pebble beach｜卵石海滩 ; collect pebbles｜捡卵石
tip_zh: pebble强调小而光滑；stone泛指石头。

meanings_zh: n. 陶工；制陶者 | v. 悠闲地做琐事
definition_en: someone who makes pots and other objects from clay | to spend time doing small tasks without hurrying
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a skilled potter.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论熟练的陶工。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a skilled potter.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论熟练的陶工的材料。
collocations: a skilled potter｜熟练的陶工 ; a potter's wheel｜陶轮 ; potter about the garden｜在花园里悠闲地忙活
tip_zh: 作动词常用potter about/around，表示悠闲忙活。

meanings_zh: adj. 色盲的
definition_en: unable to distinguish some colours from others
example1_en: I wrote color-blind on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把color-blind和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain color-blind usually follow the rest of a lecture on public health.
example2_zh: 能解释色盲的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共卫生的讲座。
collocations: red-green color-blind｜红绿色盲的 ; color-blind users｜色盲用户
tip_zh: 英式通常拼作colour-blind；不一定完全看不见颜色。

meanings_zh: n. 大学的院；系 | n. 全体教员 | n. 官能；能力
definition_en: A university division covering a particular group of subjects. | The teaching staff of a university, college, or school. | A natural mental or physical ability.
example1_en: Office hours began with the faculty of science.
example1_zh: 答疑从理学院开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the faculty of science.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论理学院的材料。
collocations: the faculty of science｜理学院 ; faculty members｜教职人员 ; mental faculties｜心智能力
tip_zh: 英式常指大学院系，美式常指全体教员。

meanings_zh: v. 成熟；使成熟
definition_en: to become ripe or make fruit or crops ripe
example1_en: The professor asked us to ripen naturally.
example1_zh: 教授让我们自然成熟。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to ripen naturally.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得自然成熟。
collocations: ripen naturally｜自然成熟 ; ripen on the vine｜在藤上成熟 ; ripen in the sun｜在阳光下成熟
tip_zh: ripe是形容词；ripen是动词，可及物也可不及物。

meanings_zh: v. 满足需求；提供服务 | v. 提供餐饮服务
definition_en: to provide what a particular person or group needs | to supply food and drinks for an event
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to cater for different needs.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须满足不同需求。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cater for different needs.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得满足不同需求。
collocations: cater for different needs｜满足不同需求 ; cater to individual tastes｜迎合个人喜好 ; cater for a wedding｜为婚礼提供餐饮
tip_zh: cater for指满足需求或供餐；cater to常指迎合。

meanings_zh: n. 例外 | n. 异议；反对
definition_en: someone or something not included in a general rule or pattern | an objection, especially in the phrase take exception to
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize exception in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出例外。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up exception while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了例外。
collocations: an exception to the rule｜规则的例外 ; with the exception of｜除……之外 ; make an exception｜破例 ; take exception to｜对……表示不满
tip_zh: 规则的例外用exception to，不用exception of。

meanings_zh: n. 侧面；侧面轮廓 | n. 简介；概况 | n. 公众关注度
definition_en: The outline of a face or object seen from the side. | A short description of someone's life, work, or characteristics. | The amount of public attention someone or something receives.
example1_en: Our professor circled a detailed profile on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了详细简介。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a detailed profile.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论详细简介的材料。
collocations: in profile｜从侧面看 ; a detailed profile｜详细简介 ; raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度 ; keep a low profile｜保持低调
tip_zh: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。

meanings_zh: adj. 异国情调的；奇异的 | adj. 外来的；非本土的
definition_en: Unusual and interesting, especially because of a connection with distant countries. | Originating outside the region where something is now found.
example1_en: Our professor circled exotic fruit on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了异国水果。
example2_en: A campus survey used exotic fruit to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用异国水果来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: exotic fruit｜异国水果 ; exotic destination｜富有异国情调的目的地 ; exotic species｜外来物种
tip_zh: 生态语境中指非本土的，不一定具有入侵性。

meanings_zh: v. 侵蚀；风化 | v. 逐渐削弱；损害
definition_en: To gradually wear away soil or rock through natural forces. | To gradually reduce strength, value, or confidence.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer erode the soil during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时侵蚀土壤。
example2_en: A lecture on environmental policy showed why researchers erode the soil before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于环境政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要侵蚀土壤。
collocations: erode the soil｜侵蚀土壤 ; erode public trust｜削弱公众信任 ; erode purchasing power｜削弱购买力 ; coastal erosion｜海岸侵蚀
tip_zh: 可指自然侵蚀，也可指信任、价值等逐渐受损。

meanings_zh: n. 裁缝 | v. 量身定制；使适合
definition_en: someone who makes or alters clothes, especially suits | to make or adapt something for particular needs
example1_en: The textbook introduces tailor-made clothes in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了定制衣服。
example2_en: The reading connects tailor-made clothes with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把定制衣服和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: tailor a suit｜定做西装 ; tailor something to individual needs｜按个人需求调整 ; tailor-made clothes｜定制衣服
tip_zh: tailor A to B表示“根据B调整或定制A”。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧张的；绷紧的 | n. 时态 | v. 使绷紧；变得紧绷
definition_en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly. | A verb form that indicates time. | To tighten muscles or become physically stiff.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about past tense.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于过去时的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects past tense with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把过去时和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: feel tense｜感到紧张 ; a tense atmosphere｜紧张的气氛 ; past tense｜过去时 ; tense your muscles｜绷紧肌肉
tip_zh: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

meanings_zh: n. 文明社会；文明 | n. 文明生活；现代便利
definition_en: an organized society with developed institutions, culture, and technology | the comforts and services associated with modern society
example1_en: The textbook introduces ancient civilization in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了古代文明。
example2_en: The author returns to ancient civilization when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了古代文明。
collocations: ancient civilization｜古代文明 ; the rise of civilization｜文明的兴起 ; human civilization｜人类文明
tip_zh: 英式也拼作 civilisation；某个文明可用 a civilization。

meanings_zh: n. 考虑；斟酌 | n. 体谅；关心 | n. 需要考虑的因素
definition_en: Careful thought about something before making a decision. | Care for other people's feelings, needs, or comfort. | Something important to think about when making a decision.
example1_en: Our professor circled careful consideration on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了仔细考虑。
example2_en: The reading connects careful consideration with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把仔细考虑和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: careful consideration｜仔细考虑 ; take into consideration｜将……考虑在内 ; under consideration｜正在考虑中 ; show consideration for｜体谅
tip_zh: 表考虑或体谅通常不可数；表考虑因素时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；探究 | n. 询问；咨询
definition_en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge | a request for information about something
example1_en: The textbook introduces public inquiry in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公开调查。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of public inquiry.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得公开调查这个例子。
collocations: public inquiry｜公开调查 ; inquiry into｜对……的调查 ; make an inquiry｜进行咨询 ; scientific inquiry｜科学探究
tip_zh: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

meanings_zh: v. 联合；团结；使统一
definition_en: To join together or bring people together for a shared purpose.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer unite against during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时联合起来反对。
example2_en: The reading asks you to unite against and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你联合起来反对，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: unite against｜联合起来反对 ; unite behind a leader｜团结支持一位领袖 ; unite efforts｜汇聚力量
tip_zh: unite可及物也可不及物，强调为共同目标联合。

meanings_zh: n. 界面；接口 | n. 交界面；接触点 | v. 连接；相互对接
definition_en: a system through which users or devices interact | a boundary or connection between two things | connect and work together with another system or group
example1_en: Our professor circled user interface on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了用户界面。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss user interface.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论用户界面的材料。
collocations: user interface｜用户界面 ; graphical interface｜图形界面 ; interface design｜界面设计 ; interface with｜与……对接
tip_zh: 计算机语境常指界面；作动词常接with。

meanings_zh: n. 大使馆
definition_en: An official office representing a country in another country.
example1_en: I copied foreign embassy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把外国大使馆抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects foreign embassy with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把外国大使馆和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: contact the embassy｜联系大使馆 ; embassy staff｜大使馆工作人员 ; foreign embassy｜外国大使馆
tip_zh: embassy指大使馆；consulate指领事馆。

meanings_zh: n. 积极性；动力 | n. 动机；原因
definition_en: The desire and energy that make you want to act. | A reason for doing something or behaving in a particular way.
example1_en: I copied lack of motivation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把缺乏动力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of lack of motivation.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得缺乏动力这个例子。
collocations: lack of motivation｜缺乏动力 ; intrinsic motivation｜内在动力 ; motivation to learn｜学习动力 ; motivation behind a decision｜决定背后的动机
tip_zh: 动力常不可数；具体动机可数，常接for或behind。

meanings_zh: adj. 无色的 | adj. 平淡无趣的
definition_en: having no colour | lacking interesting or distinctive qualities
example1_en: The textbook introduces colorless liquid in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无色液体。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of colorless liquid.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得无色液体这个例子。
collocations: colorless liquid｜无色液体 ; colorless gas｜无色气体 ; colorless personality｜乏味的个性
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为colourless。无色不等于透明。

meanings_zh: n. 悲痛；忧虑 | n. 危难；困境 | v. 使悲痛；使忧虑
definition_en: great emotional pain, worry, or unhappiness | a situation involving danger or serious difficulty | to cause someone great worry or unhappiness
example1_en: Office hours began with emotional distress.
example1_zh: 答疑从情绪上的痛苦开始。
example2_en: The author returns to emotional distress when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了情绪上的痛苦。
collocations: emotional distress｜情绪上的痛苦 ; in distress｜处于危难中 ; cause distress｜造成痛苦 ; a distress signal｜求救信号
tip_zh: distress比一般sadness强烈，也可指危难。

meanings_zh: n. 暴乱；骚乱 | v. 聚众闹事；发生暴乱
definition_en: Violent public disorder involving a crowd of people. | To behave violently as part of a crowd in public.
example1_en: Office hours began with a riot breaks out.
example1_zh: 答疑从骚乱爆发开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a riot breaks out.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕骚乱爆发展开说明。
collocations: a riot breaks out｜骚乱爆发 ; riot police｜防暴警察 ; spark a riot｜引发暴乱
tip_zh: riot涉及暴力骚乱，不等于和平的protest。

meanings_zh: v. 提议；提出 | v. 求婚 | v. 打算；计划
definition_en: Suggest an idea or plan for others to consider. | Ask someone to marry you. | Intend or plan to do something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to propose a solution.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求提出解决方案。
example2_en: The passage says students who can propose a solution follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够提出解决方案的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: propose a solution｜提出解决方案 ; propose doing something｜提议做某事 ; propose to someone｜向某人求婚 ; propose a motion｜提出动议
tip_zh: propose doing是提议；propose to do通常是打算。

meanings_zh: v. 吐唾沫；吐出 | n. 唾液；口水
definition_en: To force saliva or something else out of your mouth. | The liquid produced naturally inside your mouth.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer spit out during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时吐出。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to spit out.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们吐出。
collocations: spit out｜吐出 ; spit into a tissue｜吐进纸巾 ; spit it out｜有话直说
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词英式常用spat，美式也用spit。

meanings_zh: n. 规模；程度 | n. 刻度；等级；比例尺 | n. 鳞；鳞片
definition_en: The size or extent of something | A measurement system or ratio representing relative size | One of the small hard plates covering a fish or reptile
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a scale model.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于比例模型的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a scale model to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用比例模型来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: on a large scale｜大规模地 ; the scale of the problem｜问题的严重程度 ; a scale model｜比例模型 ; fish scales｜鱼鳞
tip_zh: 表示规模用on a large scale；表示秤通常用复数scales。

meanings_zh: n. 犁 | v. 犁地；耕地
definition_en: A farm tool that turns soil before crops are planted | To turn soil with a plough before planting
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a horse-drawn plough.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论马拉犁。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a horse-drawn plough.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕马拉犁展开说明。
collocations: plough a field｜犁田 ; a horse-drawn plough｜马拉犁 ; plough through｜费力地完成或穿过
tip_zh: 美式拼作plow；两种拼写都读/plaʊ/。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机硬件 | n. 五金器具
definition_en: the physical parts of a computer or electronic system | tools and metal goods used for building and household repairs
example1_en: Our professor circled computer hardware on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了计算机硬件。
example2_en: The author returns to computer hardware when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了计算机硬件。
collocations: computer hardware｜计算机硬件 ; hardware store｜五金店 ; hardware upgrade｜硬件升级 ; hardware failure｜硬件故障
tip_zh: 不可数名词；hardware指硬件，software指软件。

meanings_zh: adj. 被禁止的
definition_en: Not allowed by a law or rule.
example1_en: Office hours began with strictly prohibited.
example1_zh: 答疑从严格禁止的开始。
example2_en: The author returns to strictly prohibited when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了严格禁止的。
collocations: strictly prohibited｜严格禁止的 ; prohibited by law｜法律禁止的 ; prohibited items｜违禁物品
tip_zh: 也是prohibit的过去式和过去分词；禁止做某事用prohibit doing。

meanings_zh: n. 愤怒；怒气 | v. 激怒；使生气
definition_en: a strong feeling of displeasure about something wrong or unfair | to make someone feel angry
example1_en: Office hours began with control your anger.
example1_zh: 答疑从控制怒气开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used control your anger to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用控制怒气来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: control your anger｜控制怒气 ; express anger｜表达愤怒 ; public anger｜公众的愤怒 ; anger management｜愤怒情绪管理
tip_zh: anger作名词通常不可数；形容词是angry。

meanings_zh: n. 宽慰；焦虑消除 | n. 疼痛等的缓解 | n. 救济；救援物资
definition_en: Comfort felt when worry or fear ends | A reduction in pain or discomfort | Help given to people suffering from disaster or poverty
example1_en: Our professor circled a sigh of relief on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了如释重负的一声叹息。
example2_en: A campus survey used a sigh of relief to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用如释重负的一声叹息来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: a sigh of relief｜如释重负的一声叹息 ; pain relief｜缓解疼痛 ; disaster relief｜灾害救援 ; to someone's relief｜令某人宽慰的是
tip_zh: relief是名词，relieve是动词；疼痛缓解用pain relief。

meanings_zh: v. 分类；归类 | v. 将…列为机密
definition_en: To arrange things in groups according to shared characteristics. | To officially restrict access to sensitive information.
example1_en: The professor asked us to classify as.
example1_zh: 教授让我们归类为。
example2_en: The reading asks you to classify as and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你归类为，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: classify as｜归类为 ; classify according to｜按照…分类 ; classify information｜将信息列为机密
tip_zh: classify A as B表示“将A归类为B”。

meanings_zh: n. 询问；咨询 | n. 调查；查究
definition_en: A question or request for information. | An organised attempt to discover facts about a matter.
example1_en: Our professor circled public enquiry on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公开调查。
example2_en: The author returns to public enquiry when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公开调查。
collocations: make an enquiry｜进行咨询 ; enquiry about｜关于……的询问 ; public enquiry｜公开调查 ; enquiry desk｜问讯处
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数enquiries；美式通常写inquiry。

meanings_zh: adj. 有男性特征的 | adj. 语法上阳性的
definition_en: Having qualities or appearances traditionally associated with men | Belonging to a grammatical gender category in some languages
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on masculine appearance.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论男性化的外表。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of masculine appearance.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得男性化的外表这个例子。
collocations: masculine appearance｜男性化的外表 ; masculine identity｜男性身份认同 ; masculine noun｜阳性名词
tip_zh: male表示生理性别；masculine多指特征或语法性别。

meanings_zh: n. 肾；肾脏
definition_en: Either of two organs that filter blood and produce urine.
example1_en: Our professor circled kidney disease on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了肾病。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of kidney disease.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得肾病这个例子。
collocations: kidney disease｜肾病 ; kidney function｜肾功能 ; kidney stone｜肾结石 ; kidney transplant｜肾移植
tip_zh: kidney是可数名词；医学形容词renal表示“肾的”。

meanings_zh: v. 预见；预料
definition_en: to know or expect something before it happens
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to foresee problems.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何预见问题。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to foresee problems.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得预见问题。
collocations: foresee problems｜预见问题 ; foresee consequences｜预见后果 ; difficult to foresee｜难以预料
tip_zh: 过去式foresaw，过去分词foreseen。

meanings_zh: adj. 已登记的；已注册的
definition_en: Officially recorded on a list or in a system.
example1_en: Office hours began with registered nurse.
example1_zh: 答疑从注册护士开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss registered nurse.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论注册护士的材料。
collocations: registered nurse｜注册护士 ; registered charity｜注册慈善机构 ; registered owner｜登记所有人 ; registered post｜挂号邮寄
tip_zh: registered nurse指具备正式执业资格的护士。

meanings_zh: n. 视力；视觉 | n. 愿景；远见 | n. 幻象
definition_en: the ability to see | an imagined future or the ability to plan for it | an image experienced as real but not physically present
example1_en: I copied blurred vision into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把视力模糊抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of blurred vision.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得视力模糊这个例子。
collocations: blurred vision｜视力模糊 ; peripheral vision｜周边视觉 ; a clear vision｜明确的愿景 ; a vision for the future｜未来愿景
tip_zh: 表示视力通常不可数；具体愿景可用a vision。

meanings_zh: n. 大公司；法人企业 | n. 市政当局
definition_en: A legally established company, especially a large one. | A governing body responsible for a town or city.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about multinational corporation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于跨国公司的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss multinational corporation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论跨国公司的材料。
collocations: multinational corporation｜跨国公司 ; large corporation｜大型公司 ; municipal corporation｜市政法人机构
tip_zh: 常指大型公司；勿与cooperation（合作）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 体贴的；替他人着想的
definition_en: Careful not to upset or inconvenience other people.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about considerate of others.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于为他人着想的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of considerate of others.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得为他人着想这个例子。
collocations: considerate of others｜为他人着想 ; considerate behaviour｜体贴的行为 ; considerate neighbour｜体贴的邻居
tip_zh: considerate是体贴的；considerable是相当大的。

meanings_zh: n. 脚印；足迹 | n. 占用空间 | n. 环境影响程度
definition_en: A mark left by a foot on a surface. | The amount of ground or space something occupies. | The environmental impact of a person, product, or activity.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on carbon footprint.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论碳足迹。
example2_en: The author returns to carbon footprint when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了碳足迹。
collocations: leave footprints｜留下脚印 ; carbon footprint｜碳足迹 ; a small footprint｜占地面积小
tip_zh: carbon footprint指碳排放影响，不是实际脚印。

meanings_zh: n. 牲畜；家畜
definition_en: farm animals kept for food, materials, or work
example1_en: I copied livestock farming into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把畜牧业抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to livestock farming when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了畜牧业。
collocations: raise livestock｜饲养牲畜 ; livestock farming｜畜牧业 ; livestock feed｜牲畜饲料 ; livestock production｜畜牧生产
tip_zh: 集合名词，不加-s；表示活的农场动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 不公正的；不公平的
definition_en: not fair or morally right
example1_en: I copied unjust treatment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把不公正待遇抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects unjust treatment with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把不公正待遇和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: unjust treatment｜不公正待遇 ; an unjust law｜不公正的法律 ; an unjust punishment｜不公正的惩罚
tip_zh: unjust强调违背公正原则；unfair使用范围更广。

meanings_zh: v. 坦白；供认 | v. 承认难以启齿的事
definition_en: to admit doing something wrong or illegal | to admit something personal that you feel embarrassed about
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to confess a crime.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何供认罪行。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to confess a crime.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得供认罪行。
collocations: confess to doing something｜坦白做过某事 ; confess a crime｜供认罪行 ; confess that｜承认……
tip_zh: confess to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 社会主义
definition_en: A political and economic system favouring public ownership of productive resources
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on democratic socialism.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论民主社会主义。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of democratic socialism.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得民主社会主义这个例子。
collocations: democratic socialism｜民主社会主义 ; socialism and capitalism｜社会主义与资本主义 ; principles of socialism｜社会主义原则
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；socialist可指社会主义者。

meanings_zh: n. 一段时间；持续时间 | n. 跨度；跨距 | v. 持续；横跨；涵盖
definition_en: The period during which something lasts or happens | The distance from one end of something to the other | To extend across a period, area, or range
example1_en: Our professor circled attention span on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了注意力持续时间。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around attention span.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕注意力持续时间展开说明。
collocations: attention span｜注意力持续时间 ; a short time span｜短暂的一段时间 ; span several decades｜持续数十年 ; a bridge span｜桥梁跨度
tip_zh: span作动词直接接时间或范围，无需加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 肺
definition_en: Either of the two chest organs used for breathing.
example1_en: I copied lung disease into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把肺病抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss lung disease.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论肺病的材料。
collocations: lung disease｜肺病 ; lung capacity｜肺活量 ; lung cancer｜肺癌
tip_zh: 单个肺用lung；谈双肺或肺部通常用lungs。

meanings_zh: adj. 总体的；全部的 | adv. 总体上；总的来说
definition_en: considering or including every part of something | when everything is considered together
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overall cost.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论总费用。
example2_en: The author returns to overall cost when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了总费用。
collocations: overall cost｜总费用 ; overall performance｜整体表现 ; overall impact｜总体影响 ; overall improvement｜整体改善
tip_zh: 形容词放名词前；副词可放句首概括整体情况。

meanings_zh: v. 组装；装配 | v. 集合；召集
definition_en: to join separate parts together to make something | to gather together or bring people or things together
example1_en: The lab instructions say to assemble furniture.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求组装家具。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to assemble furniture.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来组装家具。
collocations: assemble furniture｜组装家具 ; assemble a team｜组建团队 ; assemble evidence｜汇集证据 ; assemble in the hall｜在大厅集合
tip_zh: 组装物品时及物；表示人集合时也可不及物。

meanings_zh: adv. 无疑；毫无疑问地
definition_en: Certainly true, with no reasonable doubt.
example1_en: The lab manual says to undoubtedly true before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先无疑属实，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who undoubtedly true are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够无疑属实的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: undoubtedly true｜无疑属实 ; undoubtedly important｜无疑很重要 ; will undoubtedly benefit｜无疑会受益
tip_zh: 语气很肯定；证据不足时宜用probably等弱化表达。

meanings_zh: n. 常态；通常标准 | n. 行为规范
definition_en: a usual situation or accepted standard | an accepted rule for behaviour within a group
example1_en: The textbook introduces the norm in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了常态。
example2_en: The author returns to the norm when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了常态。
collocations: the norm｜常态 ; social norms｜社会规范 ; cultural norms｜文化规范 ; become the norm｜成为常态
tip_zh: 表示“常态”常用the norm；行为规范常用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 蜇；刺痛 | n. 蜇伤；刺痛 | v. 刺伤感情；使难受
definition_en: Cause sharp pain with a pointed body part or irritating substance | A painful insect injury or a sudden sharp pain | Make someone feel suddenly upset or hurt
example1_en: After the lecture, we used sting in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了蜇。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses sting when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了蜇。
collocations: a bee sting｜蜜蜂蜇伤 ; a wasp sting｜黄蜂蜇伤 ; stinging criticism｜尖刻的批评
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

meanings_zh: adj. 不情愿的；勉强的
definition_en: Unwilling or hesitant to do something.
example1_en: I copied reluctant to admit into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把不愿承认抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to reluctant to admit when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不愿承认。
collocations: reluctant to admit｜不愿承认 ; reluctant to change｜不愿改变 ; reluctant agreement｜勉强同意
tip_zh: 常用be reluctant to do，表示不愿做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性；预期 | n. 前景；成功机会 | v. 勘探矿藏
definition_en: The possibility or expectation that something will happen. | Chances of future success or improvement. | To search an area for valuable minerals or fuels.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a realistic prospect in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了切实的可能性。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a realistic prospect.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论切实的可能性的材料。
collocations: the prospect of｜……的可能性 ; employment prospects｜就业前景 ; a realistic prospect｜切实的可能性 ; prospect for gold｜勘探金矿
tip_zh: 前景常用复数prospects；of后可接动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓舞；激励 | v. 赋予灵感；启发 | v. 激起；唤起
definition_en: to make someone feel eager and able to do something | to give someone an idea for something creative | to cause a particular feeling in someone
example1_en: The professor asked us to inspire confidence.
example1_zh: 教授让我们激发信心。
example2_en: The passage says students who can inspire confidence follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够激发信心的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: inspire someone to act｜激励某人行动 ; inspire confidence｜激发信心 ; inspire creativity｜激发创造力 ; be inspired by nature｜从自然中获得灵感
tip_zh: 常用 inspire sb to do sth，表示激励某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 犯罪团伙；帮派 | n. 一群伙伴；一队工人
definition_en: A group of people involved in crime or violence. | A group of friends or people working together.
example1_en: Our professor circled a criminal gang on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了犯罪团伙。
example2_en: The reading connects a criminal gang with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把犯罪团伙和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a criminal gang｜犯罪团伙 ; gang violence｜帮派暴力 ; a gang of workers｜一队工人 ; gang up on someone｜结伙欺负某人
tip_zh: 指朋友群体时较口语化；正式语境常指犯罪团伙。

meanings_zh: n. 怀孕；妊娠期
definition_en: The condition or period of carrying a developing baby.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about early pregnancy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于孕早期的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects early pregnancy with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把孕早期和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: during pregnancy｜在怀孕期间 ; early pregnancy｜孕早期 ; pregnancy test｜妊娠检测
tip_zh: during pregnancy意为孕期；形容词是pregnant。

meanings_zh: n. 研讨课；研讨会
definition_en: A meeting where a group studies or discusses a subject.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a seminar on education.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论关于教育的研讨会。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a seminar on education.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕关于教育的研讨会展开说明。
collocations: attend a seminar｜参加研讨会 ; lead a seminar｜主持研讨课 ; a seminar on education｜关于教育的研讨会
tip_zh: seminar强调讨论交流；lecture通常以教师讲授为主。

meanings_zh: n. 适应；适应性变化 | n. 改编作品 | n. 改装；调整
definition_en: The process of changing to suit new conditions. | A work changed into another form, such as a film. | A change made to something to suit a particular purpose.
example1_en: Our professor circled climate adaptation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了气候适应。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss climate adaptation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论气候适应的材料。
collocations: adaptation to change｜对变化的适应 ; climate adaptation｜气候适应 ; a film adaptation｜电影改编作品 ; evolutionary adaptation｜进化适应
tip_zh: 适应某事用adaptation to；改编自用adaptation of。

meanings_zh: adj. 好斗的；挑衅的 | adj. 强势进取的；积极有力的
definition_en: Ready to argue, threaten, or attack. | Using forceful, determined methods to achieve a goal.
example1_en: Our professor circled aggressive behaviour on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了攻击性行为。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around aggressive behaviour.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕攻击性行为展开说明。
collocations: aggressive behaviour｜攻击性行为 ; aggressive marketing｜强势营销 ; an aggressive approach｜强硬的做法
tip_zh: 形容行为常含贬义；商业语境可指强势进取。

meanings_zh: v. 呻吟 | v. 抱怨；发牢骚 | n. 呻吟声；抱怨
definition_en: To make a low sound expressing pain or unhappiness. | To complain, especially in an annoying or repeated way. | A low sound of pain, or an expression of complaint.
example1_en: The assignment is to moan in pain, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先痛苦地呻吟，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to moan in pain and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你痛苦地呻吟，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: moan in pain｜痛苦地呻吟 ; moan about something｜抱怨某事 ; let out a moan｜发出一声呻吟
tip_zh: 表示抱怨时较口语化，常用moan about。

meanings_zh: n. 插图；图解 | n. 例证；说明
