definition_en: A picture that accompanies or explains something. | An example that makes an idea clearer.
example1_en: The textbook introduces book illustration in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了书籍插图。
example2_en: The author returns to book illustration when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了书籍插图。
collocations: a clear illustration of｜对……的清楚说明 ; book illustration｜书籍插图 ; by way of illustration｜举例说明
tip_zh: 插图或例证可数；表示举例说明这一行为时常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；购得 | v. 学到；习得
definition_en: Get or become the owner of something. | Develop knowledge or skills through learning or experience.
example1_en: The assignment is to acquire skills, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先习得技能，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to acquire skills and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你习得技能，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: acquire skills｜习得技能 ; acquire knowledge｜获取知识 ; acquire a company｜收购公司 ; an acquired taste｜后天养成的喜好
tip_zh: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 空中的；从空中进行的 | n. 天线
definition_en: Happening in the air or done from above the ground. | A device that receives or sends radio or television signals.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a television aerial.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电视天线的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a television aerial.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕电视天线展开说明。
collocations: aerial photography｜航空摄影 ; an aerial view｜鸟瞰景象 ; an aerial survey｜航空调查 ; a television aerial｜电视天线
tip_zh: 作“天线”主要用于英式英语；美式常用antenna。

meanings_zh: adj. 基于事实的；事实性的
definition_en: Based on facts rather than opinions or invented details.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on factual information.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论事实信息。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of factual information.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得事实信息这个例子。
collocations: factual information｜事实信息 ; factual accuracy｜事实准确性 ; a factual error｜事实性错误 ; a factual account｜如实的叙述
tip_zh: 强调依据事实，不等于actual所指的实际存在。

meanings_zh: adj. 人口统计的 | n. 人群划分
definition_en: Relating to the structure of a population. | A group in a population defined by age, income, or similar facts.
example1_en: The report includes a demographic table in the appendix.
example1_zh: 报告在附录里放了一张人口统计表。
example2_en: A demographic shift on campus can change which courses fill up first.
example2_zh: 校园里的人口结构变化会改变哪些课最先报满。
collocations: demographic change｜人口结构变化 ; demographic data｜人口数据
tip_zh: 作名词时，demographics 更常表示各类人口数据。

meanings_zh: adj. 特定的 | adj. 明确的；具体的 | adj. 特有的
definition_en: relating to one particular thing rather than things in general | giving exact details rather than general information | found only in a particular person, place, or thing
example1_en: Our professor circled specific needs on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了特定需求。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of specific needs.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得特定需求这个例子。
collocations: specific needs｜特定需求 ; specific details｜具体细节 ; specific targets｜明确的目标 ; specific to｜为……所特有
tip_zh: specific to表示“为……所特有”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不幸的；倒霉的 | adj. 令人遗憾的；不妥的
definition_en: Experiencing bad luck or caused by bad luck. | Regrettable or likely to cause problems or embarrassment.
example1_en: I copied an unfortunate accident into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把不幸的意外抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to an unfortunate accident when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不幸的意外。
collocations: an unfortunate accident｜不幸的意外 ; unfortunate circumstances｜不幸的境况 ; an unfortunate choice of words｜不妥的措辞
tip_zh: It is unfortunate that…可表示“令人遗憾的是……”。

meanings_zh: v. 采用；采取 | v. 收养 | v. 正式通过；采纳
definition_en: To start using a method, idea, or approach. | To legally take someone else's child into your family. | To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer adopt an approach during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时采用一种方法。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to adopt an approach.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来采用一种方法。
collocations: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法 ; adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策 ; adopt a child｜收养孩子 ; adopt a resolution｜通过决议
tip_zh: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

meanings_zh: n. 恼怒；烦躁 | n. 烦人的事物
definition_en: The feeling of being slightly angry or irritated. | Something or someone that makes you feel irritated.
example1_en: Our professor circled a minor annoyance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了小困扰。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a minor annoyance.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得小困扰这个例子。
collocations: to my annoyance｜令我恼火的是 ; a minor annoyance｜小困扰 ; a source of annoyance｜令人烦恼的根源
tip_zh: 指情绪时不可数；指具体烦人事物时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 专注；专心 | n. 浓度 | n. 集中；聚集
definition_en: The ability to keep your attention on one activity. | The amount of a substance present in a mixture. | A large amount of something gathered in one place.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about improve concentration.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于提高专注力的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss improve concentration.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论提高专注力的材料。
collocations: lose concentration｜注意力分散 ; improve concentration｜提高专注力 ; a high concentration of｜高浓度的；大量集中的 ; a concentration of wealth｜财富集中
tip_zh: 专注通常不可数；某物的浓度用concentration of。

meanings_zh: n. 权力；职权 | n. 当局；主管机构 | n. 权威人士；专家
definition_en: the power or right to make decisions and enforce rules | an official body responsible for a particular area or service | a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about abuse of authority.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于滥用职权的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around abuse of authority.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕滥用职权展开说明。
collocations: have authority to do something｜有权做某事 ; local authorities｜地方当局 ; an authority on｜某方面的权威 ; abuse of authority｜滥用职权
tip_zh: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

meanings_zh: n. 总部；指挥部
definition_en: The main place from which an organisation is directed.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on corporate headquarters.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论企业总部。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around corporate headquarters.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕企业总部展开说明。
collocations: corporate headquarters｜企业总部 ; regional headquarters｜地区总部 ; headquarters staff｜总部员工
tip_zh: 单复数同形，词尾始终保留s。

meanings_zh: n. 工会 | n. 联合；联盟
definition_en: an organisation that protects workers' rights and interests | the joining of people or groups, or the resulting organisation
example1_en: The textbook introduces trade union in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了工会。
example2_en: The author returns to trade union when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了工会。
collocations: join a union｜加入工会 ; trade union｜工会 ; union representative｜工会代表 ; political union｜政治联盟
tip_zh: union以辅音/j/开头，因此说a union而非an union。

meanings_zh: n. 烟雾；雾霾
definition_en: Polluted air forming a thick cloud over an area.
example1_en: I copied thick smog into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把浓重的雾霾抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around thick smog.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕浓重的雾霾展开说明。
collocations: thick smog｜浓重的雾霾 ; smog levels｜雾霾程度 ; photochemical smog｜光化学烟雾
tip_zh: 通常不可数；smog指污染性烟雾，不是普通雾。

meanings_zh: adj. 残暴的；残忍的 | adj. 严酷的；毫不留情的
definition_en: Extremely cruel or violent | Extremely harsh, difficult, or direct
example1_en: Office hours began with brutal treatment.
example1_zh: 答疑从残暴的对待开始。
example2_en: The author returns to brutal treatment when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了残暴的对待。
collocations: brutal treatment｜残暴的对待 ; brutal attack｜残暴的袭击 ; brutal honesty｜毫不留情的坦诚 ; brutal winter｜严酷的冬天
tip_zh: brutal honesty指直言不讳到令人难以接受。

meanings_zh: n. 葬礼
definition_en: a ceremony held to remember and honour someone who has died
example1_en: Office hours began with funeral service.
example1_zh: 答疑从葬礼仪式开始。
example2_en: The author returns to funeral service when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了葬礼仪式。
collocations: attend a funeral｜参加葬礼 ; funeral service｜葬礼仪式 ; funeral procession｜送葬队伍 ; funeral arrangements｜葬礼安排
tip_zh: 通常是可数名词：attend a funeral参加葬礼。

meanings_zh: v. 怒目而视 | n. 刺眼的强光 | n. 怒视
definition_en: Look at someone angrily for a sustained moment. | A strong, bright light that makes seeing difficult. | An angry, fixed look directed at someone.
example1_en: The assignment is to glare at someone, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先怒视某人，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers glare at someone before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要怒视某人。
collocations: glare at someone｜怒视某人 ; give someone a glare｜瞪某人一眼 ; reduce glare｜减少眩光 ; the glare of the sun｜刺眼的阳光
tip_zh: glare at是怒视；stare at只是盯着看。

meanings_zh: adv. 不顾；无论如何
definition_en: Despite difficulties, objections, or other circumstances.
example1_en: The lab manual says to regardless of age before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先不论年龄，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will regardless of age when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会不论年龄。
collocations: regardless of age｜不论年龄 ; regardless of cost｜不计成本 ; carry on regardless｜不顾困难继续
tip_zh: regardless是副词；接名词时用regardless of。

meanings_zh: adj. 忠诚的；忠实的
definition_en: Continuing to support someone or something, even during difficulties.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on loyal to.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论忠于。
example2_en: The reading connects loyal to with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把忠于和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: loyal to｜忠于 ; a loyal customer｜忠实顾客 ; remain loyal｜保持忠诚 ; a loyal supporter｜忠实支持者
tip_zh: 表示忠于某人或组织，用loyal to，不用loyal with。

meanings_zh: n. 顾问；指导教师
definition_en: someone whose job is to give guidance or expert advice
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial advisor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论财务顾问。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around financial advisor.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕财务顾问展开说明。
collocations: financial advisor｜财务顾问 ; academic advisor｜学业指导教师 ; careers advisor｜职业顾问
tip_zh: advisor与adviser均正确；英式英语常用后者。

meanings_zh: adv. 最终；最后 | adv. 归根结底；根本上
definition_en: in the end, after a series of events | when considering the most important underlying fact
example1_en: Ultimately, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
example1_zh: 最终，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。
example2_en: Ultimately, readers should separate what the passage proves from what it only suggests.
example2_zh: 最终，读者应当区分文章证明了什么，又仅仅暗示了什么。
collocations: ultimately depend on｜归根结底取决于 ; ultimately lead to｜最终导致 ; ultimately responsible｜负最终责任的
tip_zh: 强调最终结果或根本因素，不用于列举中的最后一项。

meanings_zh: n. 叛乱；起义 | n. 反抗；叛逆
definition_en: Organized resistance, often violent, against a government or ruler. | Refusal to accept authority, rules, or expected behaviour.
example1_en: The textbook introduces armed rebellion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了武装叛乱。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of armed rebellion.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得武装叛乱这个例子。
collocations: armed rebellion｜武装叛乱 ; teenage rebellion｜青少年叛逆 ; rebellion against authority｜对权威的反抗 ; crush a rebellion｜镇压叛乱
tip_zh: 常接against，说明反抗的对象。

meanings_zh: adj. 极度的；极端的 | adj. 偏激的；过激的 | n. 极端；极限
definition_en: very great in degree or far beyond what is usual | far beyond what most people consider reasonable or acceptable | either end of a range of conditions or behaviour
example1_en: Our professor circled extreme weather on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了极端天气。
example2_en: The reading connects extreme weather with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把极端天气和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: extreme weather｜极端天气 ; extreme poverty｜极度贫困 ; extreme views｜偏激的观点 ; go to extremes｜走极端
tip_zh: 副词用extremely；名词常见go to extremes。

meanings_zh: n. 乘务员；活动服务人员 | n. 管理人；守护者 | v. 管理；妥善照管
definition_en: Someone who assists passengers or people attending an event. | Someone responsible for caring for property or resources. | To manage or protect resources responsibly.
example1_en: Office hours began with a ship's steward.
example1_zh: 答疑从船上乘务员开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a ship's steward.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕船上乘务员展开说明。
collocations: a ship's steward｜船上乘务员 ; a steward of natural resources｜自然资源守护者 ; steward resources｜妥善管理资源
tip_zh: 不只指乘务员；a steward of也可指资源守护者。

meanings_zh: n. 援助；救助 | v. 帮助；促进 | n. 辅助工具
definition_en: Help provided through money, supplies, services, or practical support. | To help someone or make a process easier. | An object or device that helps someone do something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about humanitarian aid.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于人道主义援助的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used humanitarian aid to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用人道主义援助来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: humanitarian aid｜人道主义援助 ; financial aid｜经济援助 ; first aid｜急救 ; hearing aid｜助听器
tip_zh: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

meanings_zh: adj. 相反的；相违背的 | n. 相反的情况
definition_en: opposite to something or inconsistent with it | the opposite of what has been said or suggested
example1_en: The textbook introduces contrary to expectations in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了出乎预料。
example2_en: A campus survey used contrary to expectations to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用出乎预料来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: contrary to expectations｜出乎预料 ; contrary evidence｜相反证据 ; on the contrary｜恰恰相反 ; to the contrary｜表明相反情况的
tip_zh: on the contrary用于纠正前述观点，意为恰恰相反。

meanings_zh: n. 完美；尽善尽美
definition_en: The state of being completely without faults or weaknesses
example1_en: I copied strive for perfection into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把力求完美抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss strive for perfection.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论力求完美的材料。
collocations: strive for perfection｜力求完美 ; achieve perfection｜达到完美 ; to perfection｜完美地；恰到好处 ; pursuit of perfection｜对完美的追求
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；to perfection指做得恰到好处。

meanings_zh: n. 顶峰；山峰；最高点 | v. 达到最高点 | adj. 最高的；高峰期的
definition_en: A mountain's top or the highest level of something. | To reach the highest level or amount. | At the highest level of activity, demand, or achievement.
example1_en: The textbook introduces mountain peak in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了山峰。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mountain peak.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论山峰的材料。
collocations: reach a peak｜达到顶峰 ; peak demand｜需求高峰 ; mountain peak｜山峰 ; peak season｜旺季
tip_zh: peak at后接峰值；peak season表示旺季。

meanings_zh: v. 给……接种疫苗
definition_en: To give a vaccine that helps protect against a disease.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to vaccinate against measles.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何接种麻疹疫苗。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers vaccinate against measles before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要接种麻疹疫苗。
collocations: vaccinate against measles｜接种麻疹疫苗 ; vaccinate children｜给儿童接种疫苗 ; get vaccinated｜接种疫苗
tip_zh: 用vaccinate someone against某疾病。

meanings_zh: n. 贡献；促成作用 | n. 捐款；捐赠物 | n. 投稿；稿件
definition_en: Something done or provided to help achieve a shared result. | Money or goods given to support a person or cause. | A piece of writing supplied for a publication.
example1_en: Office hours began with a significant contribution.
example1_zh: 答疑从重大贡献开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a significant contribution.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论重大贡献的材料。
collocations: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献 ; a significant contribution｜重大贡献 ; a voluntary contribution｜自愿捐款
tip_zh: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 海面下的；海底的
definition_en: Located or happening below the surface of the sea
example1_en: Office hours began with undersea cable.
example1_zh: 答疑从海底电缆开始。
example2_en: The author returns to undersea cable when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了海底电缆。
collocations: undersea cable｜海底电缆 ; undersea exploration｜海底勘探 ; undersea tunnel｜海底隧道
tip_zh: 常放在名词前；强调海面以下，而非所有水下环境。

meanings_zh: n. 暴风雪
definition_en: A severe snowstorm with strong winds.
example1_en: Our professor circled a severe blizzard on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了猛烈的暴风雪。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a severe blizzard.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论猛烈的暴风雪的材料。
collocations: a severe blizzard｜猛烈的暴风雪 ; blizzard conditions｜暴风雪天气
tip_zh: 比普通snowstorm更强调强风和恶劣天气。

meanings_zh: v. 相符；相对应 | v. 通信
definition_en: To match something or have an equivalent role or position. | To exchange letters or messages with someone.
example1_en: The assignment is to correspond to, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先对应于，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to correspond to.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来对应于。
collocations: correspond to｜对应于 ; correspond with someone｜与某人通信 ; correspond closely｜高度相符
tip_zh: 对应常用correspond to；与人通信接with。

meanings_zh: adj. 广阔的；巨大的
definition_en: Extremely large in area, size, amount, or degree.
example1_en: Our professor circled the vast majority on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绝大多数。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the vast majority.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝大多数展开说明。
collocations: the vast majority｜绝大多数 ; vast amounts of｜大量的 ; a vast area｜广阔的区域 ; vast resources｜巨大的资源储备
tip_zh: the vast majority of表示……中的绝大多数。

meanings_zh: n. 部分；片段；瓣 | v. 分割；划分
definition_en: one part of something divided into separate sections | to divide something into separate parts or groups
example1_en: I copied market segment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把细分市场抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around market segment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕细分市场展开说明。
collocations: market segment｜细分市场 ; orange segment｜一瓣橙子 ; segment customers｜划分顾客群体
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/seɡˈment/。

meanings_zh: n. 孤独；寂寞
definition_en: Sadness caused by feeling alone or lacking close relationships
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on feelings of loneliness.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论孤独感。
example2_en: The author returns to feelings of loneliness when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了孤独感。
collocations: feelings of loneliness｜孤独感 ; ease loneliness｜缓解孤独 ; social isolation and loneliness｜社会隔离与孤独
tip_zh: loneliness强调难过；solitude可指享受独处。

meanings_zh: adj. 传染性的 | adj. 有感染力的
definition_en: able to spread disease between people or organisms | causing others to share the same feeling or behaviour
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly infectious.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论传染性很强的。
example2_en: A campus survey used highly infectious to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用传染性很强的来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: infectious disease｜传染病 ; highly infectious｜传染性很强的 ; infectious enthusiasm｜有感染力的热情 ; infectious laughter｜有感染力的笑声
tip_zh: infectious表示有传染性；infected表示已被感染。

meanings_zh: n. 危险因素；隐患 | v. 冒险提出
definition_en: Something that could cause harm, damage, or an accident. | To suggest something despite uncertainty about whether it is correct.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about health hazard.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于健康隐患的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of health hazard.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得健康隐患这个例子。
collocations: health hazard｜健康隐患 ; fire hazard｜火灾隐患 ; pose a hazard｜构成危险 ; hazard a guess｜大胆猜测
tip_zh: 名词指危险来源；动词常见于hazard a guess。

meanings_zh: n. 考古学家
definition_en: someone who studies past societies through objects and physical remains
example1_en: I copied a leading archaeologist into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把杰出的考古学家抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a leading archaeologist.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得杰出的考古学家这个例子。
collocations: a team of archaeologists｜一队考古学家 ; a leading archaeologist｜杰出的考古学家 ; a field archaeologist｜田野考古学家
tip_zh: 考古研究人类遗存；研究恐龙的通常是古生物学家。

meanings_zh: n. 共和国；共和政体
definition_en: A country whose head of state is not a monarch.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a parliamentary republic in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了议会制共和国。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a parliamentary republic.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论议会制共和国的材料。
collocations: become a republic｜成为共和国 ; establish a republic｜建立共和国 ; a parliamentary republic｜议会制共和国
tip_zh: 共和国没有君主，但并不必然实行民主制度。

meanings_zh: n. 主席；董事长；会议主持人
definition_en: a person, usually a man, who leads a meeting or organisation
example1_en: I copied committee chairman into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把委员会主席抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used committee chairman to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用委员会主席来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: chairman of the board｜董事长 ; committee chairman｜委员会主席 ; appoint a chairman｜任命主席
tip_zh: 性别中性的表达可用chair或chairperson。

meanings_zh: n. 捐赠；捐赠物
definition_en: Money or goods given to help a person or organisation.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about generous donation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于慷慨的捐赠的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss generous donation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论慷慨的捐赠的材料。
collocations: make a donation｜捐款；捐赠 ; generous donation｜慷慨的捐赠 ; blood donation｜献血
tip_zh: 常用make a donation to，表示向某方捐赠。

meanings_zh: n. 和解；解决协议 | n. 定居点；聚居地 | n. 结算；清偿
definition_en: An agreement that ends a dispute. | A place where people establish a community. | The payment of money owed.
example1_en: Office hours began with a peace settlement.
example1_zh: 答疑从和平协议开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a peace settlement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了和平协议。
collocations: reach a settlement｜达成和解 ; a peace settlement｜和平协议 ; a rural settlement｜乡村聚居地 ; settlement of debts｜债务清偿
tip_zh: 可指争议的解决协议，也可指人们居住的定居点。

meanings_zh: n. 霸凌；欺凌行为 | v. 欺负；恐吓
definition_en: Repeated behaviour intended to hurt, frighten, or control someone | Repeatedly hurting or frightening someone with less power
example1_en: Our professor circled school bullying on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了校园霸凌。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss school bullying.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论校园霸凌的材料。
collocations: school bullying｜校园霸凌 ; online bullying｜网络霸凌 ; prevent bullying｜预防霸凌
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数；也可作bully的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 夸大的；言过其实的 | adj. 刻意夸张的
definition_en: Presented as greater, worse, or more important than it really is | Made unusually large or noticeable for emphasis or effect
example1_en: I copied greatly exaggerated into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把大大夸大的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects greatly exaggerated with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把大大夸大的和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: exaggerated claims｜夸大的说法 ; greatly exaggerated｜大大夸大的 ; exaggerated gestures｜夸张的手势
tip_zh: 形容说法或表现被夸大；不要与“准确的”混用。

meanings_zh: n. 入侵者；侵略者 | n. 入侵物种
definition_en: a person or force entering a place without permission | an organism spreading into an area and threatening native life
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on biological invader.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论生物入侵者。
example2_en: A campus survey used biological invader to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用生物入侵者来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: foreign invaders｜外国侵略者 ; repel invaders｜击退入侵者 ; biological invader｜生物入侵者
tip_zh: invader指入侵者；invasion指入侵这一行为。

meanings_zh: adj. 免息的；无息的
definition_en: Requiring no interest payments on borrowed money.
example1_en: The professor explained interest-free with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了免息的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up interest-free while discussing evidence about economic policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了免息的。
collocations: interest-free loan｜免息贷款 ; interest-free credit｜免息信贷 ; interest-free period｜免息期
tip_zh: 免息不等于免费：本金仍须偿还。

meanings_zh: adj. 看不见的；隐形的 | adj. 不被注意的；被忽视的
definition_en: Impossible to see. | Not noticed or acknowledged by other people.
example1_en: Our professor circled almost invisible on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了几乎看不见的。
example2_en: The reading connects almost invisible with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把几乎看不见的和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: invisible to the naked eye｜肉眼看不见的 ; almost invisible｜几乎看不见的 ; remain invisible｜仍不被看见
tip_zh: invisible指看不见；与看不懂的incomprehensible不同。

meanings_zh: n. 专长；专业领域 | n. 特色食品；特产
definition_en: a subject or activity someone has particular knowledge or skill in | a food or product a person or place is known for
example1_en: Our professor circled medical specialty on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了医学专科。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of medical specialty.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得医学专科这个例子。
collocations: medical specialty｜医学专科 ; local specialty｜地方特产 ; house specialty｜本店招牌菜 ; area of specialty｜专长领域
tip_zh: 美式常用specialty；英式也常用speciality。

meanings_zh: n. 小册子；宣传册
definition_en: A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject
example1_en: Our professor circled an information pamphlet on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了信息手册。
example2_en: The author returns to an information pamphlet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了信息手册。
collocations: an information pamphlet｜信息手册 ; distribute pamphlets｜分发小册子 ; a pamphlet on health｜健康宣传册
tip_zh: 通常指介绍专题的薄册子，比普通书籍篇幅短。

meanings_zh: n. 数据库；资料库
definition_en: An organized collection of information stored and accessed electronically.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on customer database.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论客户数据库。
example2_en: The author returns to customer database when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了客户数据库。
collocations: search a database｜检索数据库 ; update a database｜更新数据库 ; customer database｜客户数据库
tip_zh: 可数名词；在数据库中通常用 in a database。

meanings_zh: v. 使沮丧；使消沉 | v. 使降低；使萧条 | v. 按下；压下
definition_en: To make someone feel unhappy and without hope. | To reduce an amount, value, or level of activity. | To push something down.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to depress demand.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抑制需求。
example2_en: The reading asks you to depress demand and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你抑制需求，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: depress demand｜抑制需求 ; depress prices｜压低价格 ; depress a pedal｜踩下踏板
tip_zh: depressed形容人感到沮丧，depressing形容事物令人沮丧。

meanings_zh: n. 加工；处理 | n. 数据处理
definition_en: preparing or changing materials through a series of operations | using a computer to organise, change, or analyse information
example1_en: I copied food processing into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把食品加工抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around food processing.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕食品加工展开说明。
collocations: food processing｜食品加工 ; data processing｜数据处理 ; processing plant｜加工厂 ; processing time｜处理时间
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；processing plant指加工厂。

meanings_zh: n. 货摊；摊位 | v. 使停滞；拖延 | v. 使熄火；熄火
definition_en: A small stand or space where goods are sold. | To stop progress or deliberately delay action. | For an engine to stop unexpectedly, or cause this.
example1_en: Our professor circled market stall on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了市场摊位。
example2_en: A campus survey used market stall to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用市场摊位来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: market stall｜市场摊位 ; stall for time｜拖延时间 ; stall an engine｜使发动机熄火
tip_zh: 作动词可指发动机熄火，也可指谈判等陷入停滞。

meanings_zh: n. 微风 | n. 轻而易举的事 | v. 轻松通过；轻快走动
definition_en: A light, gentle wind | Something that is very easy to do | Move or complete something easily and confidently
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gentle breeze.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论轻柔的微风。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a gentle breeze.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轻柔的微风的材料。
collocations: a gentle breeze｜轻柔的微风 ; a sea breeze｜海风 ; be a breeze｜轻而易举 ; breeze through an exam｜轻松通过考试
tip_zh: be a breeze是口语，表示“轻而易举”。

meanings_zh: adj. 正式的；官方的 | adj. 庄重的；拘谨的 | adj. 正规的；系统的
definition_en: Following established rules or officially recognised procedures. | Suitable for serious occasions rather than relaxed situations. | Organised and structured, especially within an educational institution.
example1_en: Office hours began with formal agreement.
example1_zh: 答疑从正式协议开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss formal agreement.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论正式协议的材料。
collocations: formal agreement｜正式协议 ; formal complaint｜正式投诉 ; formal education｜正规教育 ; formal dress｜正装
tip_zh: formal不等于former：前者“正式的”，后者“以前的”。

meanings_zh: n. 冥想；静坐 | n. 沉思；深思
definition_en: The practice of focusing attention to calm and train the mind. | Deep, careful thought about a particular subject.
example1_en: I copied practise meditation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把练习冥想抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects practise meditation with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把练习冥想和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: practise meditation｜练习冥想 ; mindfulness meditation｜正念冥想 ; meditation session｜冥想练习时段 ; deep meditation｜深度冥想；沉思
tip_zh: 指冥想练习时通常不可数；meditation on可指对某事的沉思。

meanings_zh: n. 聚光灯；聚光灯光束 | n. 公众关注；关注焦点 | v. 突出呈现；使受到关注
definition_en: A lamp directing a strong beam onto a small area. | Public attention directed towards a person or issue. | To draw particular attention to someone or something.
example1_en: I wrote spotlight on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把spotlight和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain spotlight usually follow the rest of a lecture on public communication.
example2_zh: 能解释聚光灯的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共传播的讲座。
collocations: in the spotlight｜处于公众关注之下 ; put the spotlight on｜使成为关注焦点 ; turn the spotlight on｜将注意力转向
tip_zh: in the spotlight常比喻成为公众关注的焦点。

meanings_zh: n. 黄昏；薄暮
definition_en: The time when daylight fades before night.
example1_en: I wrote dusk on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把dusk和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up dusk while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了黄昏。
collocations: at dusk｜在黄昏 ; from dawn to dusk｜从黎明到黄昏 ; as dusk falls｜暮色降临时
tip_zh: 在黄昏用at dusk；dawn表示黎明。

meanings_zh: adj. 不安的；忧虑的 | adj. 不稳定的；勉强维持的
definition_en: Feeling worried or uncomfortable about a situation. | Not fully settled, secure, or free from tension.
example1_en: Our professor circled an uneasy truce on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不稳固的停战。
example2_en: A campus survey used an uneasy truce to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用不稳固的停战来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: feel uneasy｜感到不安 ; uneasy about something｜对某事感到担忧 ; an uneasy truce｜不稳固的停战 ; an uneasy relationship｜紧张的关系
tip_zh: uneasy意为不安，不是“不容易”；常接about。

meanings_zh: n. 进步；进展 | v. 前进；促进；推进 | adj. 预先的；事先的
definition_en: An improvement or development in a particular field | Move forward or help something develop | Done or provided before a particular time or event
example1_en: Our professor circled a major advance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了重大进展。
example2_en: The reading connects a major advance with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把重大进展和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a major advance｜重大进展 ; in advance｜提前 ; advance notice｜事先通知 ; advance knowledge｜推动知识发展
tip_zh: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

meanings_zh: n. 自立；自主 | n. 国家独立
definition_en: The ability to live or act without relying on others. | A country's freedom from control by another country.
example1_en: Office hours began with financial independence.
example1_zh: 答疑从经济独立开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used financial independence to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经济独立来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: financial independence｜经济独立 ; gain independence｜获得独立 ; maintain independence｜保持自主 ; independence from｜不受……支配
tip_zh: 通常不可数；independence from表示不依赖或不受控制。

meanings_zh: adj. 酷热的；灼热的
definition_en: Extremely hot, especially when describing weather.
example1_en: Our professor circled scorching heat on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了酷热。
example2_en: A campus survey used scorching heat to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用酷热来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: scorching heat｜酷热 ; scorching hot｜热得灼人 ; a scorching summer｜酷热的夏季
tip_zh: 表示极热，常说scorching hot，一般不用very修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 估算；估计 | n. 评价；看法
definition_en: The process of judging an approximate amount, size, or value. | An opinion about someone's character or something's value.
example1_en: Office hours began with cost estimation.
example1_zh: 答疑从成本估算开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around cost estimation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕成本估算展开说明。
collocations: cost estimation｜成本估算 ; rough estimation｜粗略估计 ; in my estimation｜在我看来
tip_zh: estimation常指估算过程；具体估价常用estimate。

meanings_zh: n. 烟草；烟叶
definition_en: A plant whose dried leaves are used to make smoking products
example1_en: The textbook introduces tobacco products in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了烟草制品。
example2_en: The reading connects tobacco products with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把烟草制品和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: tobacco products｜烟草制品 ; tobacco industry｜烟草业 ; tobacco farming｜烟草种植 ; tobacco control｜烟草控制
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；一片烟叶用a tobacco leaf。

meanings_zh: n. 专家组；评审小组 | n. 镶板；嵌板 | n. 控制面板；仪表盘
definition_en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise | a flat piece forming part of a surface | a surface containing controls or instruments
example1_en: I copied a judging panel into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把评审团抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a judging panel to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用评审团来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a panel of experts｜专家小组 ; a judging panel｜评审团 ; control panel｜控制面板 ; wooden panel｜木质镶板
tip_zh: 专家组用a panel of experts；成员称panellist。

meanings_zh: adj. 陶瓷的 | n. 陶瓷材料；陶瓷制品
definition_en: Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat. | A material hardened by heat, or an object made from it.
example1_en: Office hours began with ceramic tiles.
example1_zh: 答疑从陶瓷砖开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used ceramic tiles to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用陶瓷砖来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: ceramic tiles｜陶瓷砖 ; ceramic bowl｜陶瓷碗 ; ceramic coating｜陶瓷涂层 ; ceramic materials｜陶瓷材料
tip_zh: ceramics可指陶瓷制品，也可指陶艺或陶瓷工艺。

meanings_zh: adj. 微不足道的；不重要的
definition_en: Too small or unimportant to have much effect.
example1_en: Office hours began with statistically insignificant.
example1_zh: 答疑从统计上不显著的开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of statistically insignificant.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得统计上不显著的这个例子。
collocations: an insignificant amount｜微不足道的量 ; seem insignificant｜显得微不足道 ; statistically insignificant｜统计上不显著的
tip_zh: 强调不重要或影响小，不等同于meaningless。

meanings_zh: v. 为…祈福；祝福 | v. 使有幸拥有
definition_en: To ask for divine protection or favour for someone or something. | To give someone something good or fortunate.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to bless you.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何愿你安好。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to bless you.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得愿你安好。
collocations: bless someone｜为某人祈福 ; be blessed with｜有幸拥有 ; bless you｜愿你安好
tip_zh: be blessed with表示有幸拥有某种优点或资源。

meanings_zh: n. 惨剧；灾难；不幸事件 | n. 悲剧；悲剧作品
definition_en: An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss. | A serious play or story ending in suffering or death.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a terrible tragedy in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了可怕的惨剧。
example2_en: The reading connects a terrible tragedy with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可怕的惨剧和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a terrible tragedy｜可怕的惨剧 ; prevent a tragedy｜防止悲剧 ; tragedy strikes｜灾难降临 ; classical tragedy｜古典悲剧
tip_zh: 既指现实中的惨事，也指文学悲剧；后者与comedy相对。

meanings_zh: n. 集会；集合 | n. 装配；组装 | n. 议会；立法机构
definition_en: A gathering of people for a shared purpose. | The process of joining parts to make something complete. | A group elected to discuss public matters and make laws.
example1_en: Office hours began with school assembly.
example1_zh: 答疑从学校集会开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used school assembly to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用学校集会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: school assembly｜学校集会 ; assembly line｜装配流水线 ; legislative assembly｜立法议会 ; freedom of assembly｜集会自由
tip_zh: 集会义通常可数；组装义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 劝阻；阻碍 | v. 使气馁
definition_en: Make someone less willing or likely to do something | Make someone lose confidence or hope
example1_en: The professor asked us to discourage car use.
example1_zh: 教授让我们减少汽车使用意愿。
example2_en: The reading asks you to discourage car use and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你减少汽车使用意愿，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: discourage someone from doing something｜劝阻某人做某事 ; discourage car use｜减少汽车使用意愿 ; feel discouraged｜感到气馁
tip_zh: 用discourage sb from doing，不用from to do。

meanings_zh: n. 火花；电火花 | v. 引发；激起 | n. 一丝；触发因素
definition_en: A tiny burning particle or a brief flash of electricity. | To cause something to begin or develop suddenly. | A small amount of a quality, or something initiating change.
example1_en: Office hours began with electrical spark.
example1_zh: 答疑从电火花开始。
example2_en: The author returns to electrical spark when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了电火花。
collocations: spark a debate｜引发讨论 ; spark interest｜激发兴趣 ; a spark of hope｜一丝希望 ; electrical spark｜电火花
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接interest、debate等，表示“引发”。

meanings_zh: v. 急剧上升 | v. 高飞；翱翔
definition_en: to increase quickly to a very high level | to fly high in the air, often without moving wings
example1_en: The professor asked us to soar above.
example1_zh: 教授让我们在……上空翱翔。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to soar above.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来在……上空翱翔。
collocations: soaring prices｜飞涨的价格 ; soar above｜在……上空翱翔 ; soar to record levels｜飙升至创纪录水平
tip_zh: 表示价格等猛涨时为不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 冲动；一时的念头 | n. 脉冲；神经冲动 | n. 推动力；刺激
definition_en: A sudden strong desire to act without thinking carefully. | A brief electrical signal travelling through a nerve or circuit. | Something that encourages an activity or development.
example1_en: I copied impulse buying into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把冲动购物抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around impulse buying.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕冲动购物展开说明。
collocations: on impulse｜一时冲动 ; resist the impulse to｜克制做……的冲动 ; nerve impulses｜神经冲动 ; impulse buying｜冲动购物
tip_zh: on impulse表示一时冲动；后接动作常用impulse to do。

meanings_zh: n. 手册；指南
definition_en: A book giving practical information or instructions about a subject
example1_en: Office hours began with employee handbook.
example1_zh: 答疑从员工手册开始。
example2_en: The author returns to employee handbook when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了员工手册。
collocations: employee handbook｜员工手册 ; student handbook｜学生手册 ; practical handbook｜实用手册
tip_zh: 指便于查阅的实用指南，不是普通课本。

meanings_zh: adj. 不当班的；下班的
definition_en: not working during a particular period
example1_en: I wrote off-duty on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把off-duty和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses off-duty when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了下班的。
collocations: off-duty staff｜不当班的员工 ; an off-duty nurse｜不当班的护士 ; off-duty hours｜非工作时间
tip_zh: 名词前用off-duty；作表语通常写off duty。

meanings_zh: adj. 准确的；精确的 | adj. 精准的；命中目标的
definition_en: correct and free from mistakes | able to hit or reach the intended target
example1_en: I copied highly accurate into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把高度精确的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of highly accurate.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得高度精确的这个例子。
collocations: accurate information｜准确信息 ; accurate measurements｜精确测量 ; highly accurate｜高度精确的 ; an accurate prediction｜准确的预测
tip_zh: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

meanings_zh: adj. 尊重他人的；恭敬的
definition_en: showing politeness and consideration towards someone or something
example1_en: Our professor circled respectful attitude on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了尊重他人的态度。
example2_en: The reading connects respectful attitude with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把尊重他人的态度和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: respectful attitude｜尊重他人的态度 ; respectful of others｜尊重他人 ; respectful silence｜恭敬的静默
tip_zh: respectful尊重他人的；respectable值得尊敬的。

meanings_zh: adj. 核能的；原子核的 | adj. 细胞核的
definition_en: Relating to atomic nuclei or the energy they release. | Relating to the nucleus of a cell.
example1_en: Office hours began with nuclear energy.
example1_zh: 答疑从核能开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss nuclear energy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论核能的材料。
collocations: nuclear energy｜核能 ; nuclear power station｜核电站 ; nuclear waste｜核废料 ; nuclear weapons｜核武器
tip_zh: nuclear可指原子核或细胞核，依语境判断。

meanings_zh: n. 规章；条例 | n. 监管；调节
definition_en: An official rule controlling how something must be done. | The process of controlling an activity or maintaining a condition.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on government regulation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论政府监管。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around government regulation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕政府监管展开说明。
collocations: safety regulations｜安全规定 ; comply with regulations｜遵守规定 ; government regulation｜政府监管 ; temperature regulation｜温度调节
tip_zh: 具体条例可数；表示监管这一过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 优雅的；雅致的 | adj. 简洁巧妙的
definition_en: attractive and graceful in appearance or style | simple and effective in solving a problem
example1_en: Office hours began with elegant design.
example1_zh: 答疑从雅致的设计开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around elegant design.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕雅致的设计展开说明。
collocations: elegant design｜雅致的设计 ; elegant solution｜简洁巧妙的解决方案 ; elegant dress｜优雅的连衣裙
tip_zh: 既可形容外观优雅，也可形容方案简洁巧妙。

meanings_zh: n. 赌博者；赌徒 | n. 冒险者
definition_en: Someone who risks money on uncertain outcomes | Someone willing to take risks for possible rewards
example1_en: I copied problem gambler into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有赌博问题的人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around problem gambler.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕有赌博问题的人展开说明。
collocations: problem gambler｜有赌博问题的人 ; compulsive gambler｜嗜赌成瘾者 ; professional gambler｜职业赌徒
tip_zh: gamble是赌博或冒险；gambler指从事这种行为的人。

meanings_zh: adj. 最终的；终极的 | adj. 最出色的；极致的
definition_en: Being the final or most important aim or result. | The best or most extreme example of something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on ultimate goal.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论最终目标。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of ultimate goal.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得最终目标这个例子。
collocations: ultimate goal｜最终目标 ; ultimate responsibility｜最终责任 ; the ultimate in comfort｜极致舒适
tip_zh: ultimate强调最终目标或极致，不指最近一次。

meanings_zh: v. 监管；管制 | v. 调节；控制
definition_en: control an activity through rules or laws | adjust something to maintain a suitable level or rate
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to regulate an industry.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何监管一个行业。
example2_en: The passage says students who can regulate an industry follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够监管一个行业的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: regulate an industry｜监管一个行业 ; regulate emissions｜管制排放 ; regulate body temperature｜调节体温 ; strictly regulated｜受到严格监管的
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；regulate temperature指调温。

meanings_zh: n. 默认设置；默认选项 | n. 违约；拖欠 | v. 拖欠；违约
definition_en: a setting used automatically unless you choose another | failure to pay a debt or fulfil a legal obligation | to fail to pay a debt or meet an obligation
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on debt default.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论债务违约。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of debt default.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得债务违约这个例子。
collocations: by default｜默认地 ; default setting｜默认设置 ; default on a loan｜拖欠贷款 ; debt default｜债务违约
tip_zh: by default 表示默认；拖欠贷款用 default on a loan。

meanings_zh: n. 补助金；拨款 | v. 正式准许；授予 | v. 承认
definition_en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose | to officially give someone something they request | to accept that something is true, often reluctantly
example1_en: I copied research grant into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把研究拨款抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used research grant to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用研究拨款来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: apply for a grant｜申请补助金 ; research grant｜研究拨款 ; grant permission｜准许 ; take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip_zh: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

meanings_zh: n. 副职；代理人 | n. 议员
definition_en: someone authorised to assist or act for a more senior person | an elected member of parliament in some countries
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on act as deputy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论担任代理人。
example2_en: A campus survey used act as deputy to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用担任代理人来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: deputy director｜副主任；副局长 ; deputy head｜副校长 ; appoint a deputy｜任命副手 ; act as deputy｜担任代理人
tip_zh: 常置于职务前，如deputy director；不泛指所有代表。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻率的；鲁莽的 | n. 皮疹
definition_en: Done without enough thought about possible risks or consequences. | An area of irritated skin covered with spots.
example1_en: I copied a skin rash into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把皮疹抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a skin rash with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把皮疹和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a rash decision｜轻率的决定 ; a rash promise｜轻率的承诺 ; develop a rash｜出现皮疹 ; a skin rash｜皮疹
tip_zh: 作形容词指鲁莽；作名词指皮疹，常用a rash。

meanings_zh: n. 残余物；剩余部分 | n. 遗迹；遗址 | n. 遗骸
definition_en: Parts left after something has been used, damaged, or destroyed. | Surviving parts of ancient buildings or objects. | The body or bones of a dead person or animal.
example1_en: Our professor circled archaeological remains on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了考古遗迹。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of archaeological remains.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得考古遗迹这个例子。
collocations: the remains of a meal｜餐后剩余物 ; archaeological remains｜考古遗迹 ; human remains｜人类遗骸
tip_zh: 作名词用复数谓语；也可为remain的单数动词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 树桩；残余根部 | v. 难倒；使困惑
definition_en: the base remaining after a tree or object is cut | to leave someone unable to answer or solve something
example1_en: Office hours began with a tree stump.
example1_zh: 答疑从树桩开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a tree stump.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕树桩展开说明。
collocations: a tree stump｜树桩 ; remove a stump｜清除树桩 ; be stumped by a question｜被问题难倒
tip_zh: be stumped by表示被难倒，并非被绊倒。

meanings_zh: v. 呕吐；吐出 | n. 呕吐物
definition_en: To bring food or liquid from the stomach through the mouth. | Food or liquid brought up from the stomach.
example1_en: The professor asked us to vomit repeatedly.
example1_zh: 教授让我们反复呕吐。
example2_en: The reading asks you to vomit repeatedly and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你反复呕吐，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: start to vomit｜开始呕吐 ; vomit repeatedly｜反复呕吐 ; nausea and vomiting｜恶心与呕吐
tip_zh: 名词指呕吐物；呕吐这一过程常用vomiting。

meanings_zh: n. 革命；政权变革 | n. 重大变革 | n. 旋转一周；公转一周
definition_en: a major change in government, often achieved by force | a dramatic change in how something works or is done | one complete turn around a point or axis
example1_en: The textbook introduces political revolution in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政治革命。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of political revolution.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得政治革命这个例子。
collocations: political revolution｜政治革命 ; industrial revolution｜工业革命 ; digital revolution｜数字革命 ; a complete revolution｜旋转一整周
tip_zh: revolution强调根本变革；reform通常指渐进改革。

meanings_zh: n. 消耗；消费 | n. 食用；饮用；摄入量
definition_en: the use of resources, energy, goods, or services | the act or amount of eating or drinking something
example1_en: The textbook introduces energy consumption in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能源消耗。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss energy consumption.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论能源消耗的材料。
collocations: energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; water consumption｜用水量 ; household consumption｜家庭消费 ; fit for human consumption｜适合人类食用
tip_zh: 通常不可数；消费的人是consumer，不是consumption。

meanings_zh: adj. 长期的
definition_en: continuing or having effects over a long period
example1_en: After the lecture, we used long-term in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了长期的。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses long-term when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了长期的。
collocations: long-term goal｜长期目标 ; long-term impact｜长期影响 ; long-term investment｜长期投资
tip_zh: 作定语常用连字符；in the long term不加。

meanings_zh: adj. 坐立不安的；难以休息的 | adj. 不满足现状的
definition_en: Unable to relax, stay still, or sleep peacefully. | Eager for change because the present situation feels unsatisfying.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about grow restless.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于变得焦躁不安的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around grow restless.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕变得焦躁不安展开说明。
collocations: restless sleep｜不安稳的睡眠 ; feel restless｜感到坐立不安 ; grow restless｜变得焦躁不安 ; a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
tip_zh: restless指难以安静；restful指令人放松的。

meanings_zh: adj. 数学的
definition_en: relating to mathematics
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mathematical model.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论数学模型。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of mathematical model.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得数学模型这个例子。
collocations: mathematical model｜数学模型 ; mathematical skills｜数学技能 ; mathematical calculation｜数学计算
tip_zh: mathematics是学科名，虽以s结尾但用单数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 不公正；不公正的事
definition_en: Unfair treatment or a particular example of it.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on social injustice.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论社会不公。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around social injustice.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕社会不公展开说明。
collocations: social injustice｜社会不公 ; a sense of injustice｜不公平感 ; suffer an injustice｜遭受不公正待遇 ; challenge injustice｜挑战不公
tip_zh: 泛指不公时不可数；具体不公事件可用 an injustice。

meanings_zh: n. 畅销书；畅销商品
definition_en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.
example1_en: Our professor circled international bestseller on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了国际畅销书。
example2_en: A campus survey used international bestseller to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用国际畅销书来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: international bestseller｜国际畅销书 ; become a bestseller｜成为畅销书 ; bestseller list｜畅销书榜
tip_zh: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

meanings_zh: n. 英亩
definition_en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an acre of land.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一英亩土地的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects an acre of land with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一英亩土地和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an acre of land｜一英亩土地 ; per acre｜每英亩 ; hundreds of acres｜数百英亩
tip_zh: 面积单位：1英亩约4047平方米，不等于一公顷。

meanings_zh: n. 形成；组建 | n. 构造物；地层 | n. 队形；编队
definition_en: The process of developing or bringing something into existence. | A natural structure with a particular shape or arrangement. | An organised arrangement of people, vehicles, or animals.
example1_en: I copied cloud formation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把云的形成抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around cloud formation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕云的形成展开说明。
collocations: cloud formation｜云的形成 ; rock formations｜岩石构造 ; the formation of a government｜政府的组建 ; fly in formation｜编队飞行
tip_zh: formation可指形成过程，也可指形成的结构或队形。

meanings_zh: adj. 密集的；强化的 | adj. 集约的；投入密集的
definition_en: involving much work or effort within a short period | using large amounts of resources to produce high output
example1_en: The textbook introduces an intensive course in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了强化课程。
example2_en: A campus survey used an intensive course to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用强化课程来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: an intensive course｜强化课程 ; intensive care｜重症监护 ; intensive farming｜集约化农业 ; labour-intensive production｜劳动密集型生产
tip_zh: intensive 强调集中投入；intense 强调感受或程度强烈。

meanings_zh: n. 霜；霜冻 | v. 结霜于；覆以霜 | v. 给糕点涂糖霜
definition_en: Thin ice crystals on surfaces, or weather that forms them. | To cover or become covered with a thin layer of ice. | To cover a cake with a sweet, creamy topping.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sharp frost in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了严重霜冻。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sharp frost.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕严重霜冻展开说明。
collocations: a sharp frost｜严重霜冻 ; ground frost｜地面霜冻 ; frost damage｜霜冻损害 ; frost a cake｜给蛋糕涂糖霜
tip_zh: frost是霜，不是雪；涂糖霜这一动词义多见于美语。

meanings_zh: adv. 精确地；准确地 | adv. 恰好；正是
definition_en: Exactly and accurately, without any difference or error. | Used to emphasize that something is exactly the case.
example1_en: The lab manual says to precisely measure before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先精确测量，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who precisely measure are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够精确测量的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: precisely measure｜精确测量 ; precisely define｜准确界定 ; precisely because｜正是因为
tip_zh: precisely because表示“正是因为”，强调原因。

meanings_zh: v. 诊断疾病 | v. 查明问题原因
definition_en: to identify an illness by examining symptoms and test results | to identify the cause or nature of a problem
example1_en: The professor asked us to diagnose a disease.
example1_zh: 教授让我们诊断疾病。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers diagnose a disease before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要诊断疾病。
collocations: diagnose a disease｜诊断疾病 ; be diagnosed with｜被诊断患有 ; diagnose a fault｜查明故障
tip_zh: 诊断某人患病用diagnose someone with某病。

meanings_zh: n. 臭氧
definition_en: A gas whose molecules each contain three oxygen atoms.
example1_en: Office hours began with ground-level ozone.
example1_zh: 答疑从近地面臭氧开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ground-level ozone.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论近地面臭氧的材料。
collocations: ozone layer｜臭氧层 ; ground-level ozone｜近地面臭氧 ; ozone depletion｜臭氧消耗 ; ozone levels｜臭氧浓度
tip_zh: 臭氧不可数；高空臭氧有保护作用，近地面臭氧有害。

meanings_zh: n. 实习；实习岗位 | n. 摆放；布置 | n. 安置；安排
definition_en: A temporary job that provides practical experience during training. | The act of putting something in a particular position. | The act of finding someone a suitable position or home.
example1_en: I copied job placement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把就业安置抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects job placement with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把就业安置和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: work placement｜工作实习 ; job placement｜就业安置 ; product placement｜植入式广告
tip_zh: 英式英语中work placement常指课程中的实习。

meanings_zh: n. 格式；编排方式 | v. 设置格式；编排 | v. 格式化存储设备
definition_en: the way information or an event is arranged or presented | to arrange the appearance of a document or information | to prepare a storage device so it can store data
example1_en: Our professor circled file format on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了文件格式。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss file format.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论文件格式的材料。
collocations: file format｜文件格式 ; digital format｜数字格式 ; format a document｜设置文档格式 ; standard format｜标准格式
tip_zh: 动词过去式formatted，现在分词formatting。

meanings_zh: v. 敦促；力劝 | n. 强烈欲望；冲动
definition_en: To strongly encourage someone to do something. | A strong desire to do something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to urge caution.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求力劝谨慎行事。
example2_en: The reading asks you to urge caution and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你力劝谨慎行事，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: urge someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事 ; a strong urge to｜想……的强烈冲动 ; resist the urge｜克制冲动 ; urge caution｜力劝谨慎行事
tip_zh: 动词用urge sb to do；名词用an urge to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 组织机构的 | adj. 统筹安排的
definition_en: Relating to the structure or management of an organization. | Relating to planning activities and arranging things effectively.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on organizational structure.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论组织架构。
example2_en: A campus survey used organizational structure to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用组织架构来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: organizational structure｜组织架构 ; organizational change｜组织变革 ; organizational skills｜统筹能力 ; organizational culture｜组织文化
tip_zh: 英式也写作organisational。

meanings_zh: adj. 适度的；中等的 | adj. 温和的；不极端的 | v. 缓和；节制
definition_en: Neither very large nor very small in amount or degree | Avoiding extreme political views or actions | To become or make something less extreme or intense
example1_en: Our professor circled moderate exercise on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了适度运动。
example2_en: A campus survey used moderate exercise to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用适度运动来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: moderate exercise｜适度运动 ; moderate growth｜温和增长 ; moderate views｜温和的观点 ; moderate your expectations｜适当降低期望
tip_zh: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 乐于合作的；合作的 | n. 合作社
definition_en: willing to help others or work together | a business owned and run jointly by its members
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on agricultural cooperative.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论农业合作社。
example2_en: A campus survey used agricultural cooperative to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用农业合作社来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: cooperative approach｜合作方式 ; cooperative learning｜合作学习 ; agricultural cooperative｜农业合作社
tip_zh: 作形容词表示合作；作名词指合作社。

meanings_zh: adj. 自愿的；非强制的 | adj. 志愿的；无偿的
definition_en: done by choice rather than because it is required | done without payment to help people or an organisation
example1_en: I copied voluntary work into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把志愿工作抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of voluntary work.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得志愿工作这个例子。
collocations: voluntary work｜志愿工作 ; voluntary participation｜自愿参与 ; voluntary organisation｜志愿组织 ; voluntary contributions｜自愿捐款
tip_zh: voluntary是形容词；“志愿者”用volunteer。

meanings_zh: v. 干涉；插手 | v. 妨碍；干扰
definition_en: To become involved in others' affairs without being wanted. | To prevent something from working or progressing properly.
example1_en: The assignment is to interfere in someone's affairs, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先干涉某人的事务，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to interfere in someone's affairs and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你干涉某人的事务，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: interfere in someone's affairs｜干涉某人的事务 ; interfere with concentration｜干扰注意力 ; interfere with sleep｜妨碍睡眠
tip_zh: interfere in多指干涉事务；with多指妨碍正常进行。

meanings_zh: v. 监禁；关押
definition_en: To put someone in prison or keep them confined.
example1_en: The assignment is to imprison someone for life, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先终身监禁某人，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to imprison someone for life and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你终身监禁某人，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: be imprisoned for｜因……被监禁 ; imprison someone for life｜终身监禁某人 ; false imprisonment｜非法拘禁
tip_zh: be imprisoned for后可接罪名，也可接监禁时长。

meanings_zh: adv. 独立地；不依赖他人地 | adv. 分别地；互不关联地
definition_en: Without needing help or support from others. | Separately, without being connected to or influenced by something else.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to independently of.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习不依赖于；独立于。
example2_en: Students who independently of are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够不依赖于；独立于的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: live independently｜独立生活 ; work independently｜独立工作 ; independently of｜不依赖于；独立于 ; independently verified｜经独立核实的
tip_zh: 表示“不依赖于……”用independently of。

meanings_zh: n. 语言流利度 | n. 流畅；娴熟
definition_en: The ability to use a language easily and smoothly. | The quality of performing an activity smoothly and confidently.
example1_en: I copied oral fluency into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把口语流利度抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of oral fluency.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得口语流利度这个例子。
collocations: fluency in English｜英语流利度 ; oral fluency｜口语流利度 ; develop fluency｜提高流利度
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示某种语言的流利程度用fluency in。

meanings_zh: n. 口渴 | n. 渴望；强烈欲望
definition_en: The feeling of needing or wanting something to drink. | A strong desire to have or learn something.
example1_en: Office hours began with quench your thirst.
example1_zh: 答疑从解渴开始。
example2_en: The reading connects quench your thirst with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把解渴和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: quench your thirst｜解渴 ; a thirst for knowledge｜求知欲 ; a thirst for adventure｜对冒险的渴望
tip_zh: 口渴常说be thirsty；thirst for表示对……的渴望。

meanings_zh: v. 超过；超出
definition_en: to be greater than a particular amount, limit, or expectation
example1_en: The assignment is to exceed expectations, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先超出预期，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to exceed expectations.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来超出预期。
collocations: exceed expectations｜超出预期 ; exceed the limit｜超出限度 ; exceed demand｜超过需求 ; exceed the budget｜超出预算
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接数量或限度，不加than。

meanings_zh: adj. 外交的 | adj. 说话得体的；圆融的
definition_en: relating to official relations between countries | handling people sensitively to avoid offence or conflict
example1_en: Office hours began with diplomatic relations.
example1_zh: 答疑从外交关系开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of diplomatic relations.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得外交关系这个例子。
collocations: diplomatic relations｜外交关系 ; diplomatic efforts｜外交努力 ; a diplomatic solution｜外交解决方案 ; a diplomatic answer｜得体的回答
tip_zh: 既可指国家间外交，也可形容说话处事得体。

meanings_zh: n. 参与者；参加者
definition_en: Someone who takes part in an activity or event.
example1_en: I copied active participant into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把积极参与者抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects active participant with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把积极参与者和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: active participant｜积极参与者 ; participant in a study｜研究参与者 ; study participants｜研究对象
tip_zh: 常作名词；表示某活动的参与者用participant in。

meanings_zh: n. 试演；试镜；试音 | v. 参加试演；让…试演
definition_en: A short performance to show suitability for a performing role. | Perform or test someone for a role in a production.
example1_en: The professor explained audition with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了试演。
example2_en: Students who can explain audition usually follow the rest of a lecture on the humanities.
example2_zh: 能解释试演的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人文学科的讲座。
collocations: attend an audition｜参加试演 ; hold auditions｜举办试演 ; audition for a role｜为某个角色试镜
tip_zh: 现代常用义是试演、试镜，不是一般的听力。

meanings_zh: n. 婴儿 | adj. 婴儿的；初期的
definition_en: a baby or very young child | relating to babies or an early stage of development
example1_en: Our professor circled infant care on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了婴儿护理。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around infant care.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕婴儿护理展开说明。
collocations: infant care｜婴儿护理 ; infant mortality｜婴儿死亡率 ; infant formula｜婴儿配方奶 ; an infant industry｜新兴产业
tip_zh: 比baby正式；infant mortality专指婴儿死亡率。

meanings_zh: adv. 相对地；比较而言
definition_en: To a particular degree when compared with something else.
example1_en: The professor told us to comparatively low and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们相对较低的，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will comparatively low when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会相对较低的。
collocations: comparatively low｜相对较低的 ; comparatively inexpensive｜相对便宜的 ; comparatively little｜相对较少
tip_zh: 常修饰形容词原级，如comparatively cheap。

meanings_zh: n. 预期；预料 | n. 期望；要求
definition_en: A belief that something will happen. | A standard of success or behaviour someone hopes for.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used expectation in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了预期。
example2_en: Students who can explain expectation usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释预期的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: in expectation of｜预料到；期待着 ; meet expectations｜达到期望 ; exceed expectations｜超出预期 ; high expectations｜很高的期望
tip_zh: 表示对表现的期望时常用复数expectations。

meanings_zh: adj. 敏感的；易受影响的 | adj. 体贴的；善解人意的 | adj. 需谨慎处理的；敏感的
definition_en: Easily affected by emotions, substances, or changes | Aware of and considerate towards other people's feelings | Requiring careful handling because of possible harm or offence
example1_en: The textbook introduces sensitive skin in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了敏感皮肤。
example2_en: A campus survey used sensitive skin to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用敏感皮肤来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: sensitive skin｜敏感皮肤 ; sensitive to criticism｜对批评敏感 ; sensitive information｜敏感信息 ; sensitive issue｜敏感问题
tip_zh: sensitive指敏感的；sensible指明智的，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 帆布 | n. 油画布；油画
definition_en: Strong, heavy cloth used for tents, bags, and sails. | Cloth used for painting, or a painting on this cloth.
example1_en: The textbook introduces oil on canvas in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了布面油画。
example2_en: The author returns to oil on canvas when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了布面油画。
collocations: canvas bag｜帆布包 ; canvas tent｜帆布帐篷 ; oil on canvas｜布面油画 ; blank canvas｜空白画布
tip_zh: 帆布作材料时不可数；指一幅油画时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 供认；坦白 | n. 宗教上的忏悔
definition_en: an admission that you have done something wrong | the act of admitting sins, especially to a priest
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a false confession.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于虚假供认的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a false confession when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了虚假供认。
collocations: make a confession｜作出坦白 ; extract a confession｜逼取口供 ; a false confession｜虚假供认 ; go to confession｜去忏悔
tip_zh: confession to 后接名词或动名词；不表示“自由”。

meanings_zh: adv. 公开地；当众 | adv. 由政府或公众出资地
definition_en: in a way that people generally can see or know | through government or community funding or ownership
example1_en: The lab manual says to publicly available before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先公众可获取的，再记下数字。
example2_en: A lecture on social change asks the class to publicly available before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先公众可获取的。
collocations: publicly available｜公众可获取的 ; publicly funded｜由公共资金资助的 ; publicly acknowledge｜公开承认 ; publicly owned｜公有的
tip_zh: 拼写是publicly，不是publically。

meanings_zh: adj. 可进入的；可使用的 | adj. 易懂的
definition_en: easy to reach, enter, obtain, or use | easy for people to understand
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on wheelchair accessible.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可供轮椅通行的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wheelchair accessible.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕可供轮椅通行的展开说明。
collocations: accessible to everyone｜人人可使用的 ; wheelchair accessible｜可供轮椅通行的 ; readily accessible｜很容易获取的 ; accessible language｜通俗易懂的语言
tip_zh: 常用accessible to sb；易懂的内容也可用此词。

meanings_zh: n. 铁锈 | v. 生锈；使生锈
definition_en: A reddish-brown substance that forms on iron exposed to moisture. | To develop rust or cause metal to develop rust.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on remove rust.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论除锈。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of remove rust.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得除锈这个例子。
collocations: remove rust｜除锈 ; prevent rust｜防锈 ; rust away｜锈蚀损坏
tip_zh: 技能生疏常用rusty：My French is rusty。

meanings_zh: adj. 阴天的；乌云密布的
definition_en: Covered with clouds, making the sky dull and grey.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an overcast sky.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于阴云密布的天空的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an overcast sky.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论阴云密布的天空的材料。
collocations: an overcast sky｜阴云密布的天空 ; an overcast day｜阴天 ; overcast conditions｜阴天天气状况
tip_zh: 指天空被云层覆盖，不一定下雨。

meanings_zh: n. 细枝；嫩枝 | v. 突然明白；察觉
definition_en: a small, thin branch of a tree or bush | to suddenly understand or notice something
example1_en: After the lecture, we used twig in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了细枝。
example2_en: Students who can explain twig usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释细枝的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: dry twigs｜干树枝 ; snap a twig｜折断细枝 ; twig that｜突然意识到
tip_zh: 动词义为英式非正式用法；过去式twigged。

meanings_zh: n. 原木；木柴 | n. 日志；记录 | v. 记录
definition_en: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree | a detailed record of events or activities | to record information about events, activities, or measurements
example1_en: The textbook introduces a fallen log in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了倒下的树干。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a fallen log.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得倒下的树干这个例子。
collocations: a fallen log｜倒下的树干 ; keep a log｜记日志 ; log data｜记录数据 ; log in｜登录
tip_zh: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。

meanings_zh: n. 观察；监测 | n. 观察所得；评论
definition_en: The act of watching carefully to learn or check something. | Something noticed or a comment based on what you notice.
example1_en: The textbook introduces direct observation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了直接观察。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around direct observation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕直接观察展开说明。
collocations: close observation｜仔细观察 ; under observation｜受到观察或监测 ; make an observation｜发表观察意见 ; direct observation｜直接观察
tip_zh: 观察活动通常不可数；一条观察意见可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 富有的；富裕的
definition_en: Having a large amount of money or valuable possessions.
example1_en: I copied wealthy family into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把富裕家庭抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wealthy family.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕富裕家庭展开说明。
collocations: wealthy family｜富裕家庭 ; wealthy countries｜富裕国家 ; wealthy individuals｜富裕人士
tip_zh: the wealthy指富人群体；wealthy本身是形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 升级；改进 | n. 升级；改良版本
definition_en: To improve something or replace it with a better version. | An improvement or a newer, better version of something.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to upgrade software.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须升级软件。
example2_en: The reading asks you to upgrade software and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你升级软件，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: upgrade software｜升级软件 ; upgrade to｜升级为 ; a system upgrade｜系统升级
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: adj. 犹豫的；迟疑的
definition_en: slow to act or speak because you feel uncertain
example1_en: Office hours began with hesitant to agree.
example1_zh: 答疑从犹豫着不肯同意开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around hesitant to agree.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕犹豫着不肯同意展开说明。
collocations: hesitant to agree｜犹豫着不肯同意 ; hesitant about change｜对改变犹豫不决 ; a hesitant smile｜迟疑的微笑
tip_zh: 常用 hesitant to do 或 hesitant about sth。

meanings_zh: n. 容量；容纳能力 | n. 能力；生产能力 | n. 身份；职务
definition_en: the maximum amount something can hold or accommodate | the ability or resources to do or produce something | a particular role in which someone acts
example1_en: Office hours began with seating capacity.
example1_zh: 答疑从座位容量开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around seating capacity.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕座位容量展开说明。
collocations: seating capacity｜座位容量 ; production capacity｜生产能力 ; capacity to learn｜学习能力 ; in a professional capacity｜以专业人士身份
tip_zh: 能力用capacity to do；身份用in one's capacity as。

meanings_zh: n. 询问；疑问 | v. 询问；对……提出质疑
definition_en: A question or request for information | To ask about something or question whether it is correct
example1_en: The textbook introduces a database query in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了数据库查询。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a database query.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得数据库查询这个例子。
collocations: answer a query｜回答询问 ; raise a query｜提出疑问 ; query a charge｜质疑一笔收费 ; a database query｜数据库查询
tip_zh: query作动词可直接接所质疑的费用或决定。

meanings_zh: n. 罪；罪孽 | v. 犯宗教或道德上的罪
definition_en: an action that breaks a religious or moral rule | to break a religious or moral rule
example1_en: Office hours began with sin against.
example1_zh: 答疑从违背；冒犯开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of sin against.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得违背；冒犯这个例子。
collocations: commit a sin｜犯下罪过 ; confess one's sins｜忏悔罪过 ; sin against｜违背；冒犯
tip_zh: 侧重宗教或道德上的罪，不等于法律上的crime。

meanings_zh: v. 抵制；反抗 | v. 忍住；抵挡诱惑 | v. 耐受；抵御
definition_en: Oppose something or try to prevent it from happening | Stop yourself from doing something tempting | Remain undamaged or unaffected by something harmful
example1_en: The assignment is to resist change, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先抵制变革，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to resist change.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们抵制变革。
collocations: resist change｜抵制变革 ; resist temptation｜抵挡诱惑 ; resist pressure｜顶住压力 ; resist corrosion｜耐腐蚀
tip_zh: 表示忍住做某事，用resist doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 干旱；旱灾
definition_en: A long period with little or no rain.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about severe drought.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于严重干旱的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around severe drought.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕严重干旱展开说明。
collocations: severe drought｜严重干旱 ; prolonged drought｜长期干旱 ; drought conditions｜干旱状况 ; drought relief｜抗旱救助
tip_zh: 读音押韵于out；不要与draught混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 吸引；使投入 | v. 参与；从事 | v. 雇用；聘请
definition_en: To attract someone's attention and keep them interested or involved. | To take part in an activity. | To hire someone to perform a particular job.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to engage in discussion.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何参与讨论。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to engage in discussion.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们参与讨论。
collocations: engage in discussion｜参与讨论 ; engage with an audience｜与观众互动 ; engage someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意 ; engage a consultant｜聘请顾问
tip_zh: 参与活动用engage in；与人互动用engage with。

meanings_zh: n. 议会；国会
definition_en: A country's group of representatives that debates and makes laws
example1_en: Office hours began with member of parliament.
example1_zh: 答疑从议会议员开始。
example2_en: The reading connects member of parliament with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把议会议员和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: member of parliament｜议会议员 ; parliamentary debate｜议会辩论 ; dissolve parliament｜解散议会
tip_zh: 特指某国议会时常大写；英国议员简称MP。

meanings_zh: adj. 荒谬的；可笑的
definition_en: Extremely silly or unreasonable and deserving to be laughed at.
example1_en: Office hours began with absolutely ridiculous.
example1_zh: 答疑从简直荒唐开始。
example2_en: The reading connects absolutely ridiculous with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把简直荒唐和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a ridiculous idea｜荒谬的想法 ; look ridiculous｜看起来可笑 ; absolutely ridiculous｜简直荒唐
tip_zh: 语气较强，强调荒唐不合理，不只是有趣。

meanings_zh: v. 歧视；区别对待 | v. 辨别；区分
definition_en: Treat people unfairly because of their group or personal characteristics | Recognise differences between things
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to discriminate against.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何歧视。
example2_en: The reading asks you to discriminate against and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你歧视，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: discriminate against｜歧视 ; discriminate on the basis of age｜基于年龄区别对待 ; discriminate between｜区分
tip_zh: 歧视某人用against；区分两者用between。

meanings_zh: n. 谈判；协商
definition_en: Discussion aimed at reaching an agreement between different parties.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about negotiation skills.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于谈判技巧的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of negotiation skills.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得谈判技巧这个例子。
collocations: enter into negotiations｜开始谈判 ; negotiation skills｜谈判技巧 ; under negotiation｜正在协商中 ; peace negotiations｜和平谈判
tip_zh: 谈判过程常用不可数形式；多轮会谈常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 胆小鬼；懦夫
definition_en: Someone who avoids danger or difficulty because of fear
example1_en: Office hours began with a complete coward.
example1_zh: 答疑从十足的胆小鬼开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a complete coward.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论十足的胆小鬼的材料。
collocations: a complete coward｜十足的胆小鬼 ; call someone a coward｜称某人为懦夫
tip_zh: coward是名词，形容词用cowardly；称人时含贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 微型的；缩小的 | n. 微缩模型；微型画
definition_en: Much smaller than the usual size of something. | A very small model or finely detailed small painting.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on miniature model.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论微缩模型。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of miniature model.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得微缩模型这个例子。
collocations: miniature model｜微缩模型 ; miniature railway｜微型铁路 ; in miniature｜以缩小形式
tip_zh: in miniature 表示“以缩小的形式”。

meanings_zh: adj. 执政的；统治的 | n. 裁决；裁定
definition_en: Having political power over a country or group | An official decision made by a judge or authority
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a court ruling.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论法院裁决。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a court ruling.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得法院裁决这个例子。
collocations: the ruling party｜执政党 ; the ruling class｜统治阶级 ; a court ruling｜法院裁决 ; issue a ruling｜作出裁决
tip_zh: 作形容词通常放在名词前；作名词指正式裁决。

meanings_zh: adj. 初步的
definition_en: Coming before a fuller study or a final result.
example1_en: These preliminary results may change after we add more data.
example1_zh: 补充更多数据后，这些初步结果可能会变。
example2_en: The speaker labeled the finding preliminary and asked the class not to overstate it.
example2_zh: 讲者把这一发现标为初步结果，并请全班不要夸大。
collocations: preliminary results｜初步结果 ; a preliminary study｜初步研究
tip_zh: 美式读音末尾更接近 /neri/。

meanings_zh: v. 保留；保持 | v. 记住 | v. 聘请；留聘
definition_en: keep or continue to have something | keep information in your memory | pay to keep someone's professional services available
example1_en: The assignment is to retain control, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先保持控制权，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to retain control and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你保持控制权，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: retain control｜保持控制权 ; retain information｜记住信息 ; retain staff｜留住员工 ; retain moisture｜保持水分
tip_zh: 正式用词，直接接宾语；记住知识也可用retain。

meanings_zh: v. 逃离；逃走
definition_en: To leave quickly to escape danger or an unpleasant situation.
example1_en: The professor asked us to flee danger.
example1_zh: 教授让我们逃离危险。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to flee danger.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得逃离危险。
collocations: flee danger｜逃离危险 ; flee the country｜逃离该国 ; flee from persecution｜逃避迫害
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为fled；可直接接逃离的地点。

meanings_zh: n. 自由；自主权 | n. 免受；摆脱
definition_en: The right or ability to act without unnecessary restrictions. | The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.
example1_en: The textbook introduces academic freedom in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学术自由。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss academic freedom.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论学术自由的材料。
collocations: freedom of speech｜言论自由 ; freedom to choose｜选择的自由 ; academic freedom｜学术自由 ; freedom from fear｜免于恐惧
tip_zh: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

meanings_zh: v. 使厌烦；使无聊 | v. 钻孔；凿洞 | n. 无趣的人或事
definition_en: To make someone feel uninterested or tired of something. | To make a hole using a tool or machine. | A person or activity that is dull and uninteresting.
example1_en: The assignment is to bore a hole, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先钻孔，再说明它为什么重要。
