example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers bore a hole before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要钻孔。
collocations: bore someone to tears｜使某人极其厌烦 ; bore a hole｜钻孔 ; a terrible bore｜极其无趣的人或事
tip_zh: 人感到无聊用bored；事物令人无聊用boring。

meanings_zh: n. 面纱；面罩 | n. 遮蔽物；掩饰 | v. 遮掩；掩饰
definition_en: a thin piece of material covering the face or head | something that hides or makes something else less clear | to hide something or prevent it from being clearly understood
example1_en: The textbook introduces a veil of secrecy in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了神秘的掩盖。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a veil of secrecy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论神秘的掩盖的材料。
collocations: wear a veil｜戴面纱 ; a veil of secrecy｜神秘的掩盖 ; thinly veiled criticism｜几乎不加掩饰的批评
tip_zh: a veil of可比喻一层遮掩；veiled也表示含蓄的。

meanings_zh: n. 一批；一炉 | v. 分批处理
definition_en: A group of things made or dealt with together. | Arrange or process things together in groups.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a batch of.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一批……的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a batch of.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一批……展开说明。
collocations: a batch of｜一批…… ; in batches｜分批地 ; batch production｜分批生产 ; batch processing｜批量处理
tip_zh: batch强调一起生产或处理的一批，常接of。

meanings_zh: n. 光线；射线 | n. 一线；少许 | n. 鳐鱼
definition_en: A narrow beam of light or other radiation | A small amount of something positive | A flat sea fish with broad fins and a long tail
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a ray of sunlight.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一缕阳光。
example2_en: The author returns to a ray of sunlight when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一缕阳光。
collocations: a ray of sunlight｜一缕阳光 ; ultraviolet rays｜紫外线 ; a ray of hope｜一线希望
tip_zh: a ray of hope是比喻，意为“一线希望”。

meanings_zh: n. 疫苗
definition_en: a substance that trains the immune system to resist disease
example1_en: I copied vaccine safety into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把疫苗安全性抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vaccine safety.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕疫苗安全性展开说明。
collocations: develop a vaccine｜研发疫苗 ; receive a vaccine｜接种疫苗 ; vaccine safety｜疫苗安全性 ; vaccine development｜疫苗研发
tip_zh: 接种某病疫苗常用a vaccine against某疾病。

meanings_zh: n. 演示；示范 | n. 示威；游行 | n. 证明；表露
definition_en: An act of showing how something works or is done | A public gathering expressing strong opinions about an issue | An action or event that clearly shows something
example1_en: Office hours began with a peaceful demonstration.
example1_zh: 答疑从和平示威开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a peaceful demonstration when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了和平示威。
collocations: give a demonstration｜进行演示 ; a peaceful demonstration｜和平示威 ; a demonstration of support｜支持的表示
tip_zh: 演示如何做某事常用demonstration of。

meanings_zh: n. 蜂箱；蜂巢 | n. 繁忙的场所
definition_en: A structure where a colony of bees lives. | A place full of busy people and activity.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a bee hive.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于蜂箱的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bee hive.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论蜂箱的材料。
collocations: a bee hive｜蜂箱 ; a hive of activity｜繁忙的场所 ; inspect a hive｜检查蜂箱
tip_zh: a hive of activity形容人们忙碌活动的场所。

meanings_zh: n. 接收器；接收机 | n. 电话听筒 | n. 接收者；收受者
definition_en: A device that receives radio, television, or other electronic signals. | The part of a telephone held to the ear and mouth. | A person who receives something.
example1_en: Office hours began with satellite receiver.
example1_zh: 答疑从卫星接收器开始。
example2_en: The author returns to satellite receiver when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了卫星接收器。
collocations: satellite receiver｜卫星接收器 ; radio receiver｜无线电接收机 ; pick up the receiver｜拿起电话听筒 ; put down the receiver｜放下电话听筒
tip_zh: receiver可指设备或人；收件人通常用recipient。

meanings_zh: adj. 内陆的；内地的 | adv. 向内陆；在内陆
definition_en: Located away from the coast, towards the country's interior | Away from the coast, towards or within the interior
example1_en: I copied inland areas into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把内陆地区抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss inland areas.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论内陆地区的材料。
collocations: inland areas｜内陆地区 ; inland waterways｜内陆水道 ; move inland｜迁往内陆
tip_zh: 与coastal相对；作副词时也常重读第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 监护人 | n. 守护者；保护者
definition_en: Someone legally responsible for a child or an adult needing care. | A person or organization that protects something valuable.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about legal guardian.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于法定监护人的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around legal guardian.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕法定监护人展开说明。
collocations: legal guardian｜法定监护人 ; parent or guardian｜家长或监护人 ; guardian of tradition｜传统的守护者
tip_zh: 法律语境中指监护人，不一定是孩子的父母。

meanings_zh: n. 困苦；艰难境况
definition_en: severe difficulty or suffering, especially from lacking basic necessities
example1_en: Our professor circled financial hardship on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济困难。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss financial hardship.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济困难的材料。
collocations: financial hardship｜经济困难 ; face hardship｜面临困境 ; endure hardship｜忍受困苦
tip_zh: 泛指困苦通常不可数；具体磨难可用 hardships。

meanings_zh: n. 策略；手段；战术
definition_en: A particular action used to achieve a goal.
example1_en: I copied effective tactic into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有效策略抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects effective tactic with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把有效策略和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: effective tactic｜有效策略 ; marketing tactic｜营销手段 ; change tactics｜改变策略
tip_zh: strategy指整体战略，tactic指具体手段。

meanings_zh: adj. 轰动的；耸人听闻的 | adj. 极好的；令人惊叹的
definition_en: Causing great excitement or shock, sometimes through exaggeration. | Extremely impressive or enjoyable.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sensational news.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论轰动的新闻。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sensational news.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轰动的新闻的材料。
collocations: sensational news｜轰动的新闻 ; sensational reporting｜耸人听闻的报道 ; sensational performance｜精彩绝伦的表演
tip_zh: 形容报道常含夸张之意；形容表演可意为精彩。

meanings_zh: v. 使计算机化
definition_en: To use computers to manage a task, system, or information
example1_en: The lab instructions say to computerize records.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求将记录计算机化。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to computerize records.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们将记录计算机化。
collocations: computerize records｜将记录计算机化 ; computerize a system｜使系统计算机化 ; a computerized database｜计算机数据库
tip_zh: 英式也拼作computerise；常接records或system。

meanings_zh: adv. 然而；尽管如此
definition_en: Despite what has just been mentioned.
example1_en: Nevertheless, the lab report still needs a clearer definition.
example1_zh: 然而，实验报告仍然需要一个更清楚的定义。
example2_en: Nevertheless, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
example2_zh: 然而，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。
collocations: but nevertheless｜但尽管如此 ; nevertheless remain｜尽管如此仍然保持
tip_zh: 是副词，不是连词；连接独立句时可用分号。

meanings_zh: n. 样品；样本 | v. 取样；试尝；体验
definition_en: A small amount or group examined to understand a larger whole. | Take a small amount for testing, or try something.
example1_en: Office hours began with a representative sample.
example1_zh: 答疑从代表性样本开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a representative sample.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得代表性样本这个例子。
collocations: a representative sample｜代表性样本 ; a blood sample｜血样 ; a free sample｜免费样品 ; sample local food｜品尝当地食物
tip_zh: sample强调从整体取出的一部分；example常用于举例。

meanings_zh: n. 替代选择；替代品 | adj. 可替代的；另一种的 | adj. 非传统的
definition_en: something you can choose instead of something else | available to use or choose instead of something else | different from what is usual or widely accepted
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a viable alternative.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可行的替代方案。
example2_en: The author returns to a viable alternative when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可行的替代方案。
collocations: an alternative to｜……的替代选择 ; alternative energy｜替代能源 ; a viable alternative｜可行的替代方案 ; have no alternative｜别无选择
tip_zh: 替代某物用alternative to，不限于二选一。

meanings_zh: n. 保险丝；熔断器 | v. 熔合；融合 | n. 导火线；引信
definition_en: A safety device that breaks a circuit when current is excessive. | To join together into one whole, often through heat. | A cord or device that makes an explosive charge go off.
example1_en: I copied fuse together into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把融合在一起抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects fuse together with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把融合在一起和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: blow a fuse｜烧断保险丝；大发雷霆 ; replace a fuse｜更换保险丝 ; fuse together｜融合在一起 ; light a fuse｜点燃导火线
tip_zh: 作动词指融合；blow a fuse也可比喻大发雷霆。

meanings_zh: n. 小径；路线 | n. 踪迹；一串痕迹 | v. 拖；落在后面
definition_en: A path through countryside, forests, or mountains. | A series of marks or objects left by something moving. | To drag behind something or move slowly behind others.
example1_en: Office hours began with a hiking trail.
example1_zh: 答疑从徒步路线开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a hiking trail to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用徒步路线来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a hiking trail｜徒步路线 ; a trail of footprints｜一串脚印 ; trail behind｜落在后面
tip_zh: trail作名词可指小径或痕迹；trail behind指落在后面。

meanings_zh: n. 预算；预算额 | v. 编制预算 | adj. 廉价的；经济型的
definition_en: A plan for spending money, or the amount available. | To plan how much money to spend on particular things. | Low in price compared with similar products or services.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on budget for expenses.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论为开支做预算。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of budget for expenses.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得为开支做预算这个例子。
collocations: on a tight budget｜预算紧张 ; within budget｜在预算内 ; budget for expenses｜为开支做预算 ; budget accommodation｜经济型住宿
tip_zh: budget for后接预计开支；on a budget指经费有限。

meanings_zh: adj. 根本的；基本的 | n. 基本原理；基础知识
definition_en: Forming the essential basis of something. | A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about fundamental to.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于对……至关重要的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects fundamental to with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……至关重要和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fundamental to｜对……至关重要 ; a fundamental principle｜基本原则 ; fundamental change｜根本性改变 ; the fundamentals of｜……的基础知识
tip_zh: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

meanings_zh: adj. 无效的；不被认可的 | adj. 不成立的；缺乏依据的
definition_en: not legally or officially acceptable | not supported by sound reasoning or reliable evidence
example1_en: I copied invalid ticket into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把无效票证抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to invalid ticket when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了无效票证。
collocations: invalid ticket｜无效票证 ; invalid argument｜不成立的论证 ; invalid data｜无效数据 ; declare something invalid｜宣布某事物无效
tip_zh: 名词“病弱者”重音在首音节，现已较少使用。

meanings_zh: n. 护肤；皮肤护理
definition_en: the practice of keeping skin clean, healthy, and protected
example1_en: Our professor circled daily skincare on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了日常护肤。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of daily skincare.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得日常护肤这个例子。
collocations: skincare routine｜日常护肤步骤 ; skincare products｜护肤品 ; daily skincare｜日常护肤
tip_zh: 通常不可数；也可写成两个词skin care。

meanings_zh: v. 哭泣；流泪
definition_en: To cry, usually because of strong emotion
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to weep with joy.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须喜极而泣。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to weep with joy.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们喜极而泣。
collocations: weep with joy｜喜极而泣 ; weep for someone｜为某人哭泣 ; weep bitterly｜痛哭
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为wept；比cry更书面。

meanings_zh: v. 消除；排除 | v. 淘汰
definition_en: To remove or get rid of something completely. | To defeat someone so they cannot continue in a competition.
example1_en: The assignment is to eliminate the need for, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先消除对……的需要，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to eliminate the need for.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来消除对……的需要。
collocations: eliminate the need for｜消除对……的需要 ; eliminate errors｜消除错误 ; eliminate a possibility｜排除一种可能性 ; be eliminated from a competition｜在比赛中被淘汰
tip_zh: 比reduce更彻底，强调完全去除或排除。

meanings_zh: adj. 致命的 | adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: Causing death or likely to cause death. | Extremely or completely, especially with certain adjectives.
example1_en: Office hours began with a deadly disease.
example1_zh: 答疑从致命疾病开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a deadly disease when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了致命疾病。
collocations: a deadly disease｜致命疾病 ; a deadly poison｜致命毒物 ; deadly serious｜极其认真的 ; deadly dull｜极其乏味的
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，deadly也常作形容词，意为致命的。

meanings_zh: n. 坟墓；墓穴 | adj. 严重的；严峻的 | adj. 神情严肃的
definition_en: A place in the ground where a dead person is buried. | Very serious and giving cause for concern. | Showing a serious or solemn expression or manner.
example1_en: Office hours began with a grave threat.
example1_zh: 答疑从严重威胁开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a grave threat.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严重威胁的材料。
collocations: visit a grave｜扫墓；探访墓地 ; a grave threat｜严重威胁 ; grave consequences｜严重后果
tip_zh: 作形容词比serious更正式，常修饰威胁或后果。

meanings_zh: n. 事件；意外事件
definition_en: An event, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant.
example1_en: I copied a serious incident into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把严重事件抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a serious incident when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了严重事件。
collocations: report an incident｜报告事件 ; a serious incident｜严重事件 ; an isolated incident｜个别事件 ; without incident｜平安无事地
tip_zh: incident指具体事件；incidence指发生率。

meanings_zh: n. 鳕鱼；鳕鱼肉
definition_en: A large sea fish, or its white flesh eaten as food.
example1_en: I copied cod fillet into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把鳕鱼片抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used cod fillet to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用鳕鱼片来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: cod fillet｜鳕鱼片 ; cod liver oil｜鱼肝油 ; cod stocks｜鳕鱼资源量
tip_zh: 鱼的单复数均为cod；指鳕鱼肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 美容的；化妆用的 | adj. 表面的；装点门面的 | n. 化妆品
definition_en: intended to improve or change physical appearance | changing appearances without solving underlying problems | a product used to improve or change physical appearance
example1_en: The textbook introduces cosmetic products in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了美容化妆产品。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cosmetic products.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论美容化妆产品的材料。
collocations: cosmetic products｜美容化妆产品 ; cosmetic surgery｜整容手术 ; cosmetic changes｜表面上的改变
tip_zh: 作名词表示“化妆品”时通常用复数cosmetics。

meanings_zh: n. 丰富；多样 | n. 浓郁；醇厚
definition_en: The quality of containing many varied or valuable elements. | A deep, strong, or full quality of flavour or colour.
example1_en: The textbook introduces cultural richness in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了文化的丰富性。
example2_en: The reading connects cultural richness with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把文化的丰富性和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: cultural richness｜文化的丰富性 ; species richness｜物种丰富度 ; richness of flavour｜风味的浓郁
tip_zh: 常指内容丰富或味道浓郁；个人财富多用wealth。

meanings_zh: n. 可靠性；可信度
definition_en: The quality of working well or being worthy of trust.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on improve reliability.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论提高可靠性。
example2_en: A campus survey used improve reliability to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用提高可靠性来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: improve reliability｜提高可靠性 ; long-term reliability｜长期可靠性 ; the reliability of data｜数据的可信度
tip_zh: reliability通常不可数；形容词是reliable。

meanings_zh: v. 有关；使有联系 | v. 理解；产生共鸣 | v. 讲述；叙述
definition_en: To have or establish a connection between things. | To understand someone's feelings through similar personal experience. | To tell someone about events or experiences.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer relate to during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时与……有关；理解。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers relate to before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要与……有关；理解。
collocations: relate to｜与……有关；理解 ; relate A to B｜把A与B联系起来 ; relate an experience｜讲述一段经历
tip_zh: relate to可指“与……有关”，也可指“产生共鸣”。

meanings_zh: adv. 严格地；严厉地 | adv. 仅限于；完全地 | adv. 严格说来；精确地
definition_en: with rules followed or enforced exactly | only, without including anything or anyone else | in a completely exact or accurate way
example1_en: The professor told us to strictly prohibited and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们严禁，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will strictly prohibited when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会严禁。
collocations: strictly prohibited｜严禁 ; strictly confidential｜严格保密的 ; strictly speaking｜严格说来 ; strictly limited to｜严格限于
tip_zh: strictly speaking是固定表达，意为“严格说来”。

meanings_zh: n. 检查员；督察员 | n. 督察；警官
definition_en: an official who checks that rules and standards are followed | a police officer of a particular rank
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on safety inspector.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论安全检查员。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around safety inspector.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕安全检查员展开说明。
collocations: safety inspector｜安全检查员 ; building inspector｜建筑检查员 ; police inspector｜警务督察
tip_zh: inspect是检查；inspector指执行检查的人。

meanings_zh: v. 威胁；恐吓 | v. 危及；可能造成
definition_en: Say you will cause harm or trouble unless demands are met | Put something at risk or make something harmful seem likely
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to threaten someone's safety.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何危及某人的安全。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to threaten someone's safety.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来危及某人的安全。
collocations: threaten to do something｜威胁要做某事 ; threaten someone's safety｜危及某人的安全 ; threaten livelihoods｜威胁生计 ; be threatened with closure｜面临关闭的威胁
tip_zh: threaten to do指威胁要做；threaten sth可指危及某物。

meanings_zh: v. 发抖；打哆嗦 | n. 颤抖；寒战
definition_en: To shake slightly because of cold, fear, or excitement | A brief shaking movement caused by cold or strong emotion
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to shiver with cold.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须冷得发抖。
example2_en: The reading asks you to shiver with cold and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你冷得发抖，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: shiver with cold｜冷得发抖 ; shiver with fear｜害怕得发抖 ; a shiver down your spine｜脊背一阵发凉
tip_zh: 常用shiver with cold或fear表示发抖原因。

meanings_zh: n. 图形；图像
definition_en: Images or designs used on screens or in printed materials.
example1_en: Office hours began with computer graphics.
example1_zh: 答疑从计算机图形开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used computer graphics to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用计算机图形来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: computer graphics｜计算机图形 ; high-quality graphics｜高质量图像 ; graphics card｜显卡
tip_zh: 指多个图像时用复数谓语：the graphics are。

meanings_zh: n. 羽毛
definition_en: One of the light, soft structures covering a bird's body.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize feather in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出羽毛。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses feather when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了羽毛。
collocations: a bird's feathers｜鸟的羽毛 ; tail feathers｜尾羽 ; as light as a feather｜轻如鸿毛
tip_zh: feather指单根羽毛；fur通常指动物浓密的毛。

meanings_zh: n. 省；行政区 | n. 职责范围；专属领域
definition_en: A major administrative area within a country | An area of responsibility or expertise belonging to someone
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a coastal province.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论沿海省份。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a coastal province.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论沿海省份的材料。
collocations: a coastal province｜沿海省份 ; provincial capital｜省会 ; the province of experts｜专家的领域
tip_zh: 表示“职责领域”时常用the province of。

meanings_zh: n. 可持续性
definition_en: The ability to continue without using up resources or causing serious harm.
example1_en: The campus plan lists sustainability next to new construction.
example1_zh: 校园规划把可持续性和新建工程放在一起。
example2_en: The reading asks whether sustainability is a technical problem or also a social one.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读问可持续性究竟只是技术问题，还是同时也是社会问题。
collocations: environmental sustainability｜环境可持续性 ; sustainability report｜可持续发展报告
tip_zh: 形容词 sustainable 在托福阅读里更常见。

meanings_zh: adj. 有免疫力的 | adj. 免疫系统的 | adj. 不受影响的；获豁免的
definition_en: Protected against a particular disease. | Relating to the body's defence against disease. | Not affected by something, or protected from a legal obligation.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about immune to infection.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于对感染有免疫力的的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of immune to infection.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得对感染有免疫力的这个例子。
collocations: immune to infection｜对感染有免疫力的 ; the immune system｜免疫系统 ; an immune response｜免疫反应 ; immune from prosecution｜免于被起诉的
tip_zh: immune to指不受影响；immune from常指获豁免。

meanings_zh: n. 雷达
definition_en: A system using radio waves to locate and track objects.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on weather radar.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论气象雷达。
example2_en: The author returns to weather radar when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了气象雷达。
collocations: radar system｜雷达系统 ; radar screen｜雷达屏幕 ; weather radar｜气象雷达
tip_zh: under the radar比喻未引起注意。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；事务 | n. 婚外情；私情
definition_en: a matter, event, or activity concerning someone | a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner
example1_en: The textbook introduces a private affair in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了私事。
example2_en: A campus survey used a private affair to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用私事来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: current affairs｜时事 ; foreign affairs｜外交事务 ; a private affair｜私事 ; have an affair｜有婚外情
tip_zh: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

meanings_zh: n. 古董；古玩 | adj. 古董的；年代久远的
definition_en: An old object valued for its age, beauty, or rarity | Old and valuable because of age, beauty, or rarity
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an antique shop.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于古董店的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects an antique shop with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把古董店和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an antique shop｜古董店 ; antique furniture｜古董家具 ; an antique dealer｜古董商
tip_zh: antique强调古老且有收藏价值，不只是旧。

meanings_zh: adj. 多个的；多种的 | n. 倍数
definition_en: Involving or consisting of more than one person or thing. | A number obtained by multiplying another number by an integer.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about multiple causes.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于多种原因的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to multiple causes when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了多种原因。
collocations: multiple causes｜多种原因 ; multiple choice｜多项选择 ; multiple sources｜多个来源 ; a multiple of｜……的倍数
tip_zh: 表示“多个的”时通常修饰复数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 壮观的；引人注目的 | adj. 惊人的；显著的
definition_en: extremely impressive to see or experience | unusually great or impressive in degree
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about spectacular scenery.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于壮观的风景的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss spectacular scenery.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论壮观的风景的材料。
collocations: spectacular scenery｜壮观的风景 ; a spectacular display｜精彩的展示 ; spectacular growth｜惊人的增长
tip_zh: 既可形容壮观景象，也可修饰growth等抽象名词。

meanings_zh: v. 赌博；打赌 | v. 冒险；碰运气 | n. 冒险之举
definition_en: to risk money on an uncertain result hoping to win more | to take a risk in the hope of success | an action with an uncertain outcome and a risk of loss
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to gamble on.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须押注于；冒险指望。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to gamble on.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们押注于；冒险指望。
collocations: gamble on｜押注于；冒险指望 ; gamble away savings｜赌光积蓄 ; take a gamble｜冒一次险
tip_zh: gamble on后接所押注或冒险指望的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 居住于；栖息于
definition_en: To live in a particular place or environment
example1_en: I heard the lecturer inhabit an island during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时居住在岛上。
example2_en: The passage says students who can inhabit an island follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够居住在岛上的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: inhabit an island｜居住在岛上 ; inhabit coastal waters｜栖息于近海水域 ; densely inhabited areas｜人口密集地区
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接地点，不加in。

meanings_zh: v. 排练；预演
definition_en: to practise a performance or activity before doing it publicly
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rehearse a play.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须排练戏剧。
example2_en: The reading asks you to rehearse a play and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你排练戏剧，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: rehearse a play｜排练戏剧 ; rehearse a speech｜练习演讲 ; rehearse for a performance｜为演出排练
tip_zh: rehearse后直接接排练内容；为演出排练用for。

meanings_zh: v. 描绘；描述 | v. 扮演；饰演
definition_en: To represent someone or something in words or images | To play a character in a film or performance
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to portray a character.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须饰演角色。
example2_en: The reading asks you to portray a character and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你饰演角色，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: portray someone as｜将某人描绘为 ; accurately portray｜准确描绘 ; portray a character｜饰演角色
tip_zh: 常用portray A as B，表示把A描绘成B。

meanings_zh: n. 银行柜员
definition_en: A bank employee who handles customers' money
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about bank teller.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于银行柜员的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to bank teller when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了银行柜员。
collocations: bank teller｜银行柜员 ; teller window｜银行柜台窗口 ; automated teller machine｜自动取款机
tip_zh: 常指银行柜员，不是商店里收款的cashier。

meanings_zh: adj. 破产的 | v. 使破产 | n. 破产者
definition_en: legally unable to pay the debts you owe | to cause a person or business to become unable to pay debts | a person legally declared unable to pay their debts
example1_en: I copied declare someone bankrupt into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把宣告某人破产抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around declare someone bankrupt.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宣告某人破产展开说明。
collocations: go bankrupt｜破产 ; declare someone bankrupt｜宣告某人破产 ; bankrupt company｜破产公司
tip_zh: 常说go bankrupt；名词“破产”是bankruptcy。

meanings_zh: adj. 中空的；空心的 | adj. 空洞的；不真诚的 | v. 挖空；凿空
definition_en: having an empty space inside | lacking real meaning, value, or sincere feeling | to remove the inside of something, leaving an empty space
example1_en: The textbook introduces a hollow tree in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了空心树。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a hollow tree.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论空心树的材料。
collocations: a hollow tree｜空心树 ; hollow promises｜空洞的承诺 ; a hollow sound｜空洞的声音 ; hollow out｜挖空
tip_zh: hollow指内部中空；empty指里面没有东西。

meanings_zh: n. 代表；代理人 | adj. 有代表性的；典型的
definition_en: someone chosen to speak or act for other people | showing the usual features of a larger group
example1_en: I copied a sales representative into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把销售代表抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a sales representative with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把销售代表和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a representative sample｜有代表性的样本 ; a sales representative｜销售代表 ; representative of｜能代表……的 ; an elected representative｜民选代表
tip_zh: 形容词常接of：representative of某群体。

meanings_zh: adv. 看似；表面上
definition_en: In a way that appears true but may not be.
example1_en: The lab manual says to seemingly impossible before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先看似不可能的，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will seemingly impossible when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会看似不可能的。
collocations: seemingly impossible｜看似不可能的 ; seemingly endless｜似乎无穷无尽的 ; seemingly harmless｜看似无害的
tip_zh: 常置于形容词前，强调表象未必等于事实。

meanings_zh: n. 措辞；用语
definition_en: The particular words chosen to express something.
example1_en: Our professor circled careful wording on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了严谨的措辞。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around careful wording.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕严谨的措辞展开说明。
collocations: careful wording｜严谨的措辞 ; exact wording｜确切的原话 ; change the wording｜修改措辞
tip_zh: 通常不可数；强调具体措辞，不是笼统的语言。

meanings_zh: n. 碳水化合物；糖类
definition_en: Nutrients such as sugars and starches that provide the body energy
example1_en: I copied complex carbohydrates into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把复合碳水化合物抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects complex carbohydrates with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把复合碳水化合物和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: complex carbohydrates｜复合碳水化合物 ; refined carbohydrates｜精制碳水化合物 ; rich in carbohydrates｜富含碳水化合物
tip_zh: 这是carbohydrate的复数；糖和淀粉都属于此类。

meanings_zh: adj. 富有想象力的；有创意的
definition_en: able to produce original ideas, or showing this ability
example1_en: The textbook introduces imaginative thinking in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了创造性思维。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss imaginative thinking.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论创造性思维的材料。
collocations: imaginative thinking｜创造性思维 ; imaginative approach｜有创意的方法 ; imaginative solution｜有创意的解决方案
tip_zh: imaginative指有想象力；imaginary指想象中的。

meanings_zh: n. 康复；恢复 | n. 找回；收回
definition_en: A return to health or a normal condition. | The process of getting something lost or stolen back.
example1_en: Our professor circled economic recovery on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济复苏。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economic recovery.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济复苏的材料。
collocations: make a full recovery｜完全康复 ; economic recovery｜经济复苏 ; data recovery｜数据恢复
tip_zh: 康复常用make a recovery；recover是动词。

meanings_zh: n. 伤害；损害 | v. 伤害；损害
definition_en: Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition. | To injure someone or damage something.
example1_en: The professor explained harm with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了伤害。
example2_en: A reading on environmental policy uses harm when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于环境政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了伤害。
collocations: cause harm｜造成伤害 ; do more harm than good｜弊大于利 ; harm the environment｜危害环境
tip_zh: 名词不可数；用do harm to，动词harm直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 家禽 | n. 禽肉
definition_en: Birds such as chickens kept for their meat or eggs. | Meat from farmed birds such as chickens and turkeys.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about poultry farming.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于家禽养殖的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss poultry farming.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论家禽养殖的材料。
collocations: poultry farming｜家禽养殖 ; poultry feed｜家禽饲料 ; poultry products｜禽类产品
tip_zh: 不用a poultry；表示一只家禽可说a chicken等。

meanings_zh: n. 筋疲力尽；极度疲劳 | n. 耗尽；用尽
definition_en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness. | The complete use of an available supply or resource.
example1_en: The textbook introduces physical exhaustion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了身体极度疲劳。
example2_en: The author returns to physical exhaustion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了身体极度疲劳。
collocations: physical exhaustion｜身体极度疲劳 ; mental exhaustion｜精神疲惫 ; the exhaustion of resources｜资源耗尽
tip_zh: exhaustion不表示详述；exhaustive才表示详尽的。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻简报；公告
definition_en: a short official announcement or report of recent news
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on news bulletin.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论新闻简报。
example2_en: A campus survey used news bulletin to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用新闻简报来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: news bulletin｜新闻简报 ; weather bulletin｜天气简报 ; issue a bulletin｜发布公告
tip_zh: 强调简短、及时的消息；news bulletin常指广播新闻。

meanings_zh: n. 法律；立法
definition_en: Laws, or the process of making laws.
example1_en: New legislation changed what the lab may pour down the drain.
example1_zh: 新法规改变了实验室可以把什么倒进下水道。
example2_en: The lecture separated legislation from the court cases that later interpreted it.
example2_zh: 讲座把立法和后来解释它的法院案件区分开来。
collocations: pass legislation｜通过法律 ; environmental legislation｜环境法规
tip_zh: 统称法律时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 工作量；工作负荷
definition_en: The amount of work someone must complete within a particular period.
example1_en: Office hours began with heavy workload.
example1_zh: 答疑从繁重的工作量开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around heavy workload.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕繁重的工作量展开说明。
collocations: heavy workload｜繁重的工作量 ; manageable workload｜可应付的工作量 ; reduce the workload｜减少工作量 ; share the workload｜分担工作
tip_zh: 工作量大用heavy workload，而非hard workload。

meanings_zh: n. 特征；特点 | adj. 典型的；特有的
definition_en: A quality that is typical of a person or thing. | Typical of a particular person, thing, or group.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about distinctive characteristic.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于鲜明特征的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss distinctive characteristic.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论鲜明特征的材料。
collocations: distinctive characteristic｜鲜明特征 ; physical characteristics｜身体特征 ; characteristic of｜为……所特有
tip_zh: 形容词常用be characteristic of，表示是……的典型特征。

meanings_zh: n. 代理机构；中介公司 | n. 专门机构；政府部门 | n. 自主行动能力
definition_en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses. | An organisation responsible for a particular area of work. | The ability to make choices and act independently.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a travel agency in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了旅行社。
example2_en: The author returns to a travel agency when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了旅行社。
collocations: a travel agency｜旅行社 ; a recruitment agency｜招聘中介 ; a government agency｜政府机构 ; individual agency｜个人自主行动能力
tip_zh: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: conj. 只要；条件是 | v. 提供；供给
definition_en: Only if a particular condition is met. | Gave something needed; past tense and past participle of provide.
example1_en: Office hours began with services provided.
example1_zh: 答疑从所提供的服务开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss services provided.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论所提供的服务的材料。
collocations: provided that｜只要；条件是 ; services provided｜所提供的服务 ; information provided｜所提供的信息
tip_zh: 连词provided (that)表示条件；that可省略。

meanings_zh: n. 批发商
definition_en: a business selling large quantities of goods mainly to retailers
example1_en: I copied food wholesaler into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把食品批发商抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects food wholesaler with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把食品批发商和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: food wholesaler｜食品批发商 ; buy from a wholesaler｜向批发商采购 ; a wholesale supplier｜批发供应商
tip_zh: wholesaler主要向商家批量供货，而非直接零售。

meanings_zh: adv. 相对地；比较而言
definition_en: To a certain degree compared with something else.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to relatively low.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习相对较低。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will relatively low when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会相对较低。
collocations: relatively low｜相对较低 ; relatively easy｜比较容易 ; relatively speaking｜相对而言
tip_zh: 表示比较后的程度，不等同于very。

meanings_zh: v. 拍打；振翅；飘动 | n. 盖片；垂片 | n. 慌乱；紧张
definition_en: To move up and down repeatedly, or make something move. | A flat piece attached along one edge, often covering something. | A state of worry or unnecessary excitement.
example1_en: The assignment is to flap your wings, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先拍打翅膀，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to flap your wings.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来拍打翅膀。
collocations: flap your wings｜拍打翅膀 ; pocket flap｜口袋盖 ; get in a flap｜陷入慌乱
tip_zh: 过去式flapped，进行式flapping，均双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 名录；通讯录 | n. 计算机目录
definition_en: a list of people or organisations with their contact details | a location used to organise files on a computer
example1_en: The textbook introduces business directory in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了企业名录。
example2_en: A campus survey used business directory to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用企业名录来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: business directory｜企业名录 ; telephone directory｜电话簿 ; online directory｜在线名录 ; root directory｜根目录
tip_zh: 名录通常含联系方式；计算机中指文件目录。

meanings_zh: adv. 仅仅；只不过
definition_en: only, and nothing more or more important
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to merely a matter of.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习仅仅是……的问题。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to merely a matter of before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先仅仅是……的问题。
collocations: merely a matter of｜仅仅是……的问题 ; not merely｜不仅仅 ; merely because｜仅仅因为
tip_zh: 语气比only正式；通常置于实义动词前、be动词后。

meanings_zh: v. 辞职；辞去 | v. 使自己接受不如意的事
definition_en: To officially leave a job or position. | To accept an unpleasant situation because you cannot change it.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to resign from a job.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何辞去工作。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to resign from a job.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来辞去工作。
collocations: resign from a job｜辞去工作 ; resign as chair｜辞去主席职务 ; resign yourself to｜无奈接受
tip_zh: resign oneself to后接名词或动名词，表示无奈接受。

meanings_zh: n. 大炮；火炮
definition_en: a large heavy gun that fires powerful projectiles
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about cannon fire.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于炮火的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cannon fire.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论炮火的材料。
collocations: fire a cannon｜开炮 ; cannon fire｜炮火 ; a cannon ball｜炮弹
tip_zh: 复数可用cannon或cannons；勿与canon混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 拒绝；否决 | n. 排斥反应
definition_en: The act of refusing to accept someone or something. | The body's immune response against transplanted tissue or an organ.
example1_en: Office hours began with fear of rejection.
example1_zh: 答疑从害怕被拒绝开始。
example2_en: The reading connects fear of rejection with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把害怕被拒绝和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fear of rejection｜害怕被拒绝 ; rejection of a proposal｜否决提案 ; face rejection｜遭到拒绝 ; organ rejection｜器官排斥反应
tip_zh: rejection of后接被拒绝的人、提议或事物。

meanings_zh: n. 手艺；手工艺 | v. 精心制作 | n. 船；飞行器
definition_en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand | Make something carefully and skilfully | A boat, aircraft, or spacecraft
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on landing craft.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论登陆艇。
example2_en: The reading connects landing craft with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把登陆艇和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: traditional crafts｜传统手工艺 ; learn a craft｜学一门手艺 ; craft a proposal｜精心拟订提案 ; landing craft｜登陆艇
tip_zh: 表示船或飞行器时，craft的单复数形式相同。

meanings_zh: n. 香味；气味 | n. 气味踪迹 | v. 嗅到；闻出
definition_en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one. | A smell left behind that an animal can follow. | To detect something by its smell.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a delicate scent in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了淡淡的香味。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a delicate scent.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕淡淡的香味展开说明。
collocations: a delicate scent｜淡淡的香味 ; the scent of flowers｜花香 ; follow a scent｜循着气味追踪
tip_zh: scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。

meanings_zh: adj. 高尚的；崇高的 | adj. 贵族的 | n. 贵族成员
definition_en: showing strong moral qualities and concern for others | belonging to a family with high inherited social rank | a person belonging to a high-ranking hereditary social class
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about noble cause.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于崇高的事业的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to noble cause when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了崇高的事业。
collocations: noble cause｜崇高的事业 ; noble gesture｜高尚的举动 ; noble family｜贵族家庭
tip_zh: 表示“高尚的”时强调品德，而非社会地位。

meanings_zh: n. 歧视 | n. 辨别力；鉴别
definition_en: unfair treatment based on someone's identity or personal characteristics | the ability or process of noticing differences between things
example1_en: The textbook introduces racial discrimination in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了种族歧视。
example2_en: The author returns to racial discrimination when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了种族歧视。
collocations: racial discrimination｜种族歧视 ; age discrimination｜年龄歧视 ; discrimination against｜对……的歧视 ; visual discrimination｜视觉辨别
tip_zh: 歧视某群体用 discrimination against；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 中世纪骑士 | n. 爵士 | n. 国际象棋中的马
definition_en: a medieval soldier of high rank who fought on horseback | a man awarded a title of honour by a monarch | a chess piece shaped like a horse's head
example1_en: Office hours began with medieval knight.
example1_zh: 答疑从中世纪骑士开始。
example2_en: The reading connects medieval knight with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把中世纪骑士和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: medieval knight｜中世纪骑士 ; knight in armour｜披甲骑士 ; award a knighthood｜授予爵士头衔
tip_zh: k不发音，与night同音；爵士头衔常用Sir。

meanings_zh: n. 包装材料；包装
definition_en: Materials used to wrap and protect products.
example1_en: The textbook introduces recyclable packaging in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了可回收包装。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around recyclable packaging.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕可回收包装展开说明。
collocations: recyclable packaging｜可回收包装 ; excessive packaging｜过度包装 ; packaging materials｜包装材料
tip_zh: 表示包装材料时通常不可数；一件包裹用package。

meanings_zh: v. 暗示；含蓄表达 | v. 意味着；必然包含
definition_en: To suggest something without stating it directly. | To involve something as a necessary result or condition.
example1_en: The assignment is to imply that, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先暗示……，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to imply that.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们暗示……。
collocations: imply that｜暗示…… ; not necessarily imply｜不一定意味着 ; strongly imply｜强烈暗示
tip_zh: imply是说话者暗示；infer是听者推断。

meanings_zh: n. 酵母；酵母菌
definition_en: A fungus used to make bread rise and produce alcohol.
example1_en: I copied dried yeast into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把干酵母抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dried yeast.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论干酵母的材料。
collocations: dried yeast｜干酵母 ; fresh yeast｜鲜酵母 ; yeast fermentation｜酵母发酵 ; yeast cells｜酵母细胞
tip_zh: 烘焙中通常作不可数名词；不是baking powder。

meanings_zh: n. 打断；中断
definition_en: Something that briefly stops an activity, conversation, or continuous process.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on interruption to services.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论服务中断。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around interruption to services.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕服务中断展开说明。
collocations: without interruption｜不间断地 ; constant interruptions｜不断的打扰 ; interruption to services｜服务中断
tip_zh: 一次打断可数；without interruption表示不间断。

meanings_zh: n. 语言学家 | n. 精通多种语言的人
definition_en: a person who studies how language works | a person skilled at speaking or learning several languages
example1_en: Our professor circled applied linguist on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了应用语言学家。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of applied linguist.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得应用语言学家这个例子。
collocations: applied linguist｜应用语言学家 ; trained linguist｜受过专业训练的语言学家 ; gifted linguist｜有语言天赋的人
tip_zh: linguist 指人；linguistics 指语言学，作单数学科名。

meanings_zh: adj. 北极的 | adj. 极寒的 | n. 北极地区
definition_en: Relating to the region around the North Pole. | Extremely cold. | The region surrounding the North Pole.
example1_en: I copied the Arctic into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把北极地区抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used the Arctic to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用北极地区来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: arctic fox｜北极狐 ; arctic conditions｜极寒环境 ; the Arctic｜北极地区
tip_zh: 指北极地区时用the Arctic；南极是the Antarctic。

meanings_zh: adj. 显著的；明显的 | adj. 有记号的；有标记的
definition_en: Clearly noticeable and often substantial | Having a visible mark that identifies or distinguishes something
example1_en: I copied clearly marked into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把标记清楚的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around clearly marked.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕标记清楚的展开说明。
collocations: a marked increase｜显著增加 ; a marked improvement｜明显改善 ; a marked contrast｜鲜明对比 ; clearly marked｜标记清楚的
tip_zh: 学术写作中常表示“显著的”；词尾读/t/。

meanings_zh: adj. 大概的；近似的 | v. 近似；接近
definition_en: Close to the actual amount or value, but not exact | To be close to something in amount, quality, or character
example1_en: I copied approximate cost into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把大致费用抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used approximate cost to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用大致费用来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: approximate cost｜大致费用 ; approximate size｜大致尺寸 ; approximate figure｜概数
tip_zh: 形容词词尾读/mət/，动词词尾读/meɪt/。

meanings_zh: adv. 真正地；确实 | adv. 真诚地；由衷地
definition_en: Really or genuinely, rather than only apparently | With sincere feelings or intentions
example1_en: The professor told us to truly believe and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们真心相信，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will truly believe when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会真心相信。
collocations: truly believe｜真心相信 ; truly remarkable｜确实非凡 ; truly sorry｜由衷抱歉
tip_zh: true变truly时去掉e，不能写成truely。

meanings_zh: v. 分配；指派 | v. 赋予；确定归属
definition_en: To give someone a task, role, or resource | To give something a particular value or category
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to assign a task.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须分配任务。
example2_en: The reading asks you to assign a task and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你分配任务，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: assign a task｜分配任务 ; assign responsibility｜分派责任 ; assign someone to a team｜将某人分配到团队 ; assign a value｜赋值
tip_zh: 常用assign sth to sb，也可用assign sb sth。

meanings_zh: n. 谷仓；畜棚
definition_en: a large farm building for storing crops or keeping animals
example1_en: The textbook introduces wooden barn in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了木制谷仓。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wooden barn.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕木制谷仓展开说明。
collocations: store hay in a barn｜把干草存入谷仓 ; barn conversion｜谷仓改建房 ; wooden barn｜木制谷仓
tip_zh: 指农场里的大型建筑，可储存农作物或饲养牲畜。

meanings_zh: n. 蒸气；汽
definition_en: A gas formed when a liquid or solid changes state.
example1_en: Office hours began with water vapour.
example1_zh: 答疑从水蒸气开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss water vapour.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论水蒸气的材料。
collocations: water vapour｜水蒸气 ; vapour pressure｜蒸气压 ; release vapour｜释放蒸气
tip_zh: 英式拼写为vapour，美式为vapor。

meanings_zh: v. 拒绝接受；否决 | v. 剔除；丢弃 | n. 次品；不合格品
definition_en: To refuse to accept, approve, or believe something. | To remove something because it is faulty or unsuitable. | An item not accepted because it fails to meet standards.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to reject a proposal.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求否决提案。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to reject a proposal.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来否决提案。
collocations: reject a proposal｜否决提案 ; reject an application｜拒绝申请 ; reject a claim｜驳回说法 ; reject defective products｜剔除次品
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈriːdʒekt/。

meanings_zh: n. 敬神；礼拜 | v. 敬奉；做礼拜 | v. 极度崇拜；爱慕
definition_en: acts of showing respect and devotion to a god | to show respect and devotion to a god | to admire or love someone extremely strongly
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on place of worship.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论宗教礼拜场所。
example2_en: A campus survey used place of worship to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用宗教礼拜场所来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: place of worship｜宗教礼拜场所 ; freedom of worship｜宗教礼拜自由 ; religious worship｜宗教礼拜 ; hero worship｜英雄崇拜
tip_zh: 英式过去式worshipped，美式通常worshiped。

meanings_zh: n. 迷信；迷信观念
definition_en: An unsupported belief linking events or actions to supernatural forces.
example1_en: Office hours began with popular superstition.
example1_zh: 答疑从流行的迷信观念开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss popular superstition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论流行的迷信观念的材料。
collocations: popular superstition｜流行的迷信观念 ; out of superstition｜出于迷信 ; superstition about bad luck｜关于厄运的迷信
tip_zh: 泛指迷信用不可数；某种迷信观念可数。

meanings_zh: n. 评估；评价
definition_en: the process of judging something's quality, value, or effectiveness
example1_en: Office hours began with performance evaluation.
example1_zh: 答疑从绩效评估开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used performance evaluation to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用绩效评估来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: carry out an evaluation｜开展评估 ; performance evaluation｜绩效评估 ; critical evaluation｜批判性评价 ; evaluation criteria｜评估标准
tip_zh: 常接of；强调质量或效果，价格估值常用valuation。

meanings_zh: n. 违反；违背 | n. 侵犯；侵害
definition_en: an act that breaks a law, rule, or agreement | an act that disregards someone's rights or privacy
example1_en: Office hours began with a traffic violation.
example1_zh: 答疑从交通违章开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a traffic violation to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用交通违章来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: a violation of the law｜违法行为 ; in violation of｜违反 ; a violation of privacy｜侵犯隐私 ; a traffic violation｜交通违章
tip_zh: 用a violation of表示违反或侵犯某事物。

meanings_zh: n. 检查；检验
definition_en: A careful examination to check condition, quality, or safety.
example1_en: Our professor circled safety inspection on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全检查。
example2_en: The reading connects safety inspection with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把安全检查和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: carry out an inspection｜进行检查 ; safety inspection｜安全检查 ; on closer inspection｜经仔细检查
tip_zh: inspection指检查过程；检查某物用of连接。

meanings_zh: n. 领导能力；领导 | n. 领导层
definition_en: the ability or activity of guiding people towards shared goals | the people who direct an organisation or country
example1_en: Our professor circled strong leadership on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了有力的领导。
example2_en: The author returns to strong leadership when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有力的领导。
collocations: leadership skills｜领导技能 ; strong leadership｜有力的领导 ; under the leadership of｜在……的领导下
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。

meanings_zh: adj. 重要的；著名的 | adj. 显眼的；突出的
definition_en: Important, well known, or influential | Easily noticed because of position, size, or shape
example1_en: Our professor circled a prominent role on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了重要作用。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a prominent role.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕重要作用展开说明。
collocations: a prominent role｜重要作用 ; a prominent figure｜知名人物 ; a prominent position｜显眼的位置
tip_zh: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形显眼。

meanings_zh: n. 工资；劳动收入 | n. 企业利润；收益
definition_en: money received for doing work | profits made by a company during a particular period
example1_en: Office hours began with annual earnings.
example1_zh: 答疑从年收入开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of annual earnings.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得年收入这个例子。
collocations: annual earnings｜年收入 ; average earnings｜平均收入 ; company earnings｜公司利润 ; earnings growth｜收入增长
tip_zh: 以-s结尾的复数名词，作主语时谓语用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 飘动的；摇摆的
definition_en: Moving gently back and forth, often in the wind.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on waving branches.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论摇摆的树枝。
example2_en: The reading connects waving branches with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把摇摆的树枝和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: waving branches｜摇摆的树枝 ; waving flags｜飘扬的旗帜 ; gently waving grass｜轻轻摇曳的草
tip_zh: 多为wave的现在分词；静态的“波浪状”通常用wavy。

meanings_zh: n. 良心；道德感 | n. 内疚；愧疚感
definition_en: Your inner sense of what is right and wrong. | Guilt about something wrong you have done.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a clear conscience.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于问心无愧的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a clear conscience.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论问心无愧的材料。
collocations: a clear conscience｜问心无愧 ; a guilty conscience｜内疚 ; a matter of conscience｜良心问题
tip_zh: conscience是良心；conscious是有意识的。

meanings_zh: adj. 可疑的 | adj. 怀疑的；不信任的
definition_en: Making you think something is wrong, dishonest, or illegal. | Feeling that someone or something cannot be trusted.
example1_en: Office hours began with highly suspicious.
example1_zh: 答疑从非常可疑的开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly suspicious.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕非常可疑的展开说明。
collocations: suspicious behaviour｜可疑行为 ; suspicious circumstances｜可疑情况 ; suspicious of someone｜对某人心存怀疑 ; highly suspicious｜非常可疑的
tip_zh: 事物可疑用suspicious；怀疑某事用suspicious of。

meanings_zh: n. 卡路里；热量单位
definition_en: A unit measuring energy, especially energy in food.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on calorie intake.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热量摄入。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss calorie intake.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论热量摄入的材料。
collocations: burn calories｜消耗热量 ; calorie intake｜热量摄入 ; low in calories｜热量低 ; calorie content｜热量含量
tip_zh: 食品语境的calorie通常指千卡；物理学中指卡。

meanings_zh: n. 顺序；一连串 | v. 按顺序排列
definition_en: An ordered series of things, actions, or events. | To arrange things or events in a particular order.
example1_en: Office hours began with the correct sequence.
example1_zh: 答疑从正确顺序开始。
example2_en: The author returns to the correct sequence when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了正确顺序。
collocations: in sequence｜按顺序 ; a sequence of events｜一连串事件 ; the correct sequence｜正确顺序
tip_zh: a sequence of后接复数名词，表示一连串事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 灭绝的 | adj. 死的；不再喷发的
definition_en: having no living members left | describing a volcano not expected to erupt again
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about extinct species.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于已灭绝物种的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to extinct species when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了已灭绝物种。
collocations: become extinct｜灭绝 ; extinct species｜已灭绝物种 ; extinct volcano｜死火山
tip_zh: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

meanings_zh: adj. 较差的；劣等的 | adj. 级别较低的 | n. 下属；级别较低者
definition_en: Lower in quality, value, or ability than something else. | Having a lower rank or position. | Someone with a lower rank or position than another person.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on inferior to.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论不如……的。
example2_en: A campus survey used inferior to to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用不如……的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: inferior to｜不如……的 ; inferior quality｜较差的质量 ; feel inferior｜感到自卑
tip_zh: 比较用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。

meanings_zh: n. 指导原则；准则
definition_en: Advice or a principle explaining how something should be done.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize guideline in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出准则。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses guideline when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了准则。
collocations: follow guidelines｜遵循准则 ; issue guidelines｜发布指南 ; safety guidelines｜安全准则 ; clear guidelines｜明确的指导原则
tip_zh: 常用复数guidelines；通常指指导而非强制法规。

meanings_zh: n. 核桃 | n. 核桃树；核桃木
definition_en: An edible nut with a wrinkled kernel and hard shell. | A tree producing walnuts, or its wood used for furniture.
example1_en: Office hours began with walnut shell.
example1_zh: 答疑从核桃壳开始。
example2_en: The reading connects walnut shell with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把核桃壳和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: walnut shell｜核桃壳 ; walnut tree｜核桃树 ; walnut oil｜核桃油 ; walnut furniture｜核桃木家具
tip_zh: 指核桃或树时可数，指核桃木材时不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 招聘；招募 | n. 新员工；新成员；新兵
definition_en: to find and employ workers or attract new members | someone who has recently joined an organization or armed force
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to recruit staff.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何招聘员工。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to recruit staff.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来招聘员工。
collocations: recruit staff｜招聘员工 ; recruit volunteers｜招募志愿者 ; a new recruit｜新成员 ; recruitment agency｜招聘机构
tip_zh: recruit可作动词或可数名词；招聘活动用recruitment。

meanings_zh: v. 处理；应对 | v. 抢球；擒抱阻截 | n. 体育用具；渔具
definition_en: Make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem. | Try to stop an opponent or take their ball. | Equipment used for an activity, especially fishing.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to tackle a problem.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须处理问题。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to tackle a problem.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来处理问题。
collocations: tackle a problem｜处理问题 ; tackle inequality｜应对不平等 ; fishing tackle｜渔具 ; tackle an opponent｜阻截对手
tip_zh: tackle直接接问题，不加with；强调着手应对。

meanings_zh: n. 反派角色；恶棍 | n. 罪魁祸首
definition_en: an evil character in a story, or a cruel person | someone or something considered responsible for a problem
example1_en: The textbook introduces the real villain in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了真正的罪魁祸首。
example2_en: The reading connects the real villain with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把真正的罪魁祸首和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: play the villain｜扮演反派 ; the villain of the story｜故事中的反派 ; the real villain｜真正的罪魁祸首
tip_zh: 常指故事中的反派；别与villa“别墅”混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 入侵；侵略 | v. 侵犯；侵扰 | v. 大量涌入
definition_en: To enter another country by force to take control | To enter or affect someone's private space without permission | To arrive somewhere in large, often unwelcome groups
example1_en: The professor asked us to invade a country.
example1_zh: 教授让我们入侵一个国家。
example2_en: A lecture on historical change showed why researchers invade a country before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于历史变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要入侵一个国家。
collocations: invade a country｜入侵一个国家 ; invade someone's privacy｜侵犯某人的隐私 ; invade personal space｜侵入个人空间
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；名词形式是invasion。

meanings_zh: n. 分类；归类 | n. 类别；等级
definition_en: The process of arranging things into groups by shared features. | A category to which something is officially assigned.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about data classification.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于数据分类的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of data classification.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得数据分类这个例子。
collocations: classification system｜分类体系 ; classification of species｜物种分类 ; data classification｜数据分类
tip_zh: classify A as B表示“把A归为B类”。

meanings_zh: n. 模仿；仿效 | n. 仿制品 | adj. 仿制的；人造的
definition_en: The act of copying someone's behaviour or something's appearance. | An object made to look like another, often more valuable, object. | Made to resemble a natural or more expensive material.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a poor imitation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论拙劣的模仿；劣质仿品。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a poor imitation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论拙劣的模仿；劣质仿品的材料。
collocations: learn by imitation｜通过模仿学习 ; a poor imitation｜拙劣的模仿；劣质仿品 ; imitation leather｜人造革 ; in imitation of｜模仿……
tip_zh: 模仿行为通常不可数；一件仿制品用an imitation。

meanings_zh: n. 预防；防止
definition_en: Action taken to stop something unwanted from happening.
example1_en: The textbook introduces disease prevention in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了疾病预防。
example2_en: The author returns to disease prevention when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了疾病预防。
collocations: disease prevention｜疾病预防 ; crime prevention｜犯罪预防 ; fire prevention｜防火
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词搭配为prevent sb from doing。

meanings_zh: v. 拓宽；扩大 | v. 变宽；使变宽
definition_en: Increase the range of knowledge, experience, or available choices. | Become wider, or make something wider.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to broaden your horizons.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求开阔眼界。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to broaden your horizons.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得开阔眼界。
collocations: broaden your horizons｜开阔眼界 ; broaden your knowledge｜拓宽知识面 ; broaden access to｜扩大获得……的机会 ; broaden the scope｜扩大范围
tip_zh: 常用于抽象范围；broaden your horizons指开阔眼界。

meanings_zh: n. 核心；中心部分；果核 | adj. 核心的；最重要的 | v. 去除果核
definition_en: the central or most important part of something | central and essential to something | to remove the hard central part of a fruit
example1_en: Our professor circled apple core on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了苹果核。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of apple core.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得苹果核这个例子。
collocations: at the core of｜处于……的核心 ; core skills｜核心技能 ; apple core｜苹果核 ; the Earth's core｜地核
tip_zh: 果核指苹果等的中央硬部；桃核通常用stone。

meanings_zh: n. 泵；抽水机；打气筒 | v. 用泵输送；抽；打气
definition_en: a device that moves liquid or gas | to move liquid or gas using a pump
example1_en: I copied water pump into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把水泵抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss water pump.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论水泵的材料。
collocations: water pump｜水泵 ; bicycle pump｜自行车打气筒 ; pump water｜抽水 ; pump up a tyre｜给轮胎打气
tip_zh: pump up a tyre表示给轮胎打气；抽水用pump water。

meanings_zh: adj. 含糊的；不明确的 | adj. 模糊的；不清晰的
definition_en: Not clearly expressed or lacking specific details | Not clear in shape, memory, or feeling
example1_en: The textbook introduces vague idea in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了模糊的想法。
example2_en: A campus survey used vague idea to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用模糊的想法来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: vague idea｜模糊的想法 ; vague memory｜模糊的记忆 ; vague instructions｜含糊的指示 ; vague about｜对……说不清楚
tip_zh: be vague about表示对某事说不清或含糊其词。

meanings_zh: v. 提取；取款 | v. 退出；撤离 | v. 撤回；取消
definition_en: To take money out of a bank account | To leave an activity or move away from a place | To remove something offered or take back a statement
example1_en: The professor asked us to withdraw cash.
example1_zh: 教授让我们提取现金。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to withdraw cash.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们提取现金。
collocations: withdraw cash｜提取现金 ; withdraw from a competition｜退出比赛 ; withdraw an application｜撤回申请 ; withdraw support｜撤回支持
tip_zh: 过去式withdrew，过去分词withdrawn；退出用from。

meanings_zh: n. 猎物 | n. 受害者；受骗者 | v. 捕食；欺凌；坑害
definition_en: An animal hunted and eaten by another animal. | Someone targeted for harm or exploitation. | To hunt animals or exploit vulnerable people, usually with on.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about birds of prey.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于猛禽的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of birds of prey.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得猛禽这个例子。
collocations: birds of prey｜猛禽 ; prey on small animals｜捕食小动物 ; fall prey to fraud｜成为诈骗受害者
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；动词常用prey on；勿混pray。

meanings_zh: adj. 真诚的；诚挚的
definition_en: Honestly expressing what you really feel or believe
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sincere apology.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论诚恳的道歉。
example2_en: The author returns to sincere apology when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了诚恳的道歉。
collocations: sincere apology｜诚恳的道歉 ; sincere thanks｜诚挚的感谢 ; sincere desire｜真诚的愿望
tip_zh: sincere强调不虚假；sincerely常用于信件结尾。

meanings_zh: v. 使不知所措；使情绪难抑 | v. 使不堪重负 | v. 压倒；彻底击败
definition_en: To affect someone so strongly they cannot cope. | To give a system or person more than they can handle. | To defeat someone using much greater strength.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to overwhelm local services.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使当地服务不堪重负。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to overwhelm local services.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们使当地服务不堪重负。
collocations: feel overwhelmed｜感到难以应对 ; be overwhelmed by emotion｜情绪激动得难以自持 ; overwhelm local services｜使当地服务不堪重负
tip_zh: 人感到 overwhelmed；事物令人 overwhelming。

meanings_zh: v. 注册；报名；招收
definition_en: Officially join, or register someone for, a course or organisation.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer enrol on a course during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时报名课程。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to enrol on a course.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们报名课程。
collocations: enrol on a course｜报名课程 ; enrol in a programme｜报名项目 ; enrol students｜招收学生
tip_zh: 英式 enrol，美式 enroll；过去式均为 enrolled。

meanings_zh: n. 重聚；团聚；聚会
definition_en: An occasion when people meet again after time apart.
example1_en: The textbook introduces family reunion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了家庭团聚。
example2_en: The reading connects family reunion with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把家庭团聚和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: family reunion｜家庭团聚 ; school reunion｜校友聚会 ; a joyful reunion｜欢乐的重聚
tip_zh: 强调分别后的再相聚，不泛指任何聚会。

meanings_zh: adj. 长方形的；矩形的
definition_en: Having four straight sides and four right angles
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a rectangular table.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论长方形桌子。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a rectangular table.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论长方形桌子的材料。
collocations: a rectangular table｜长方形桌子 ; a rectangular shape｜矩形形状 ; a rectangular plot｜长方形地块
tip_zh: rectangle是名词；rectangular是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 农业
definition_en: The activity of growing crops and raising animals for food.
example1_en: Office hours began with sustainable agriculture.
example1_zh: 答疑从可持续农业开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used sustainable agriculture to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用可持续农业来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: sustainable agriculture｜可持续农业 ; intensive agriculture｜集约农业 ; organic agriculture｜有机农业
tip_zh: 不可数名词；形容词为agricultural。

meanings_zh: n. 大量；大团；大块 | n. 质量 | adj. 大规模的；大众的
definition_en: a large amount of something gathered together | the amount of matter in an object | involving or affecting very large numbers of people
example1_en: Office hours began with body mass.
example1_zh: 答疑从身体质量开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used body mass to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用身体质量来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a mass of｜大量；一大团 ; body mass｜身体质量 ; mass production｜大规模生产 ; mass media｜大众传媒
tip_zh: 物理学中mass指质量，weight指重量，二者不同。

meanings_zh: n. 租赁；租金 | adj. 租赁的；供出租的 | n. 租用的房屋或车辆
definition_en: The act of renting something, or the money paid for it | Relating to renting, or available to rent | A house, vehicle, or other item that someone rents
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on car rental.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论汽车租赁。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of car rental.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得汽车租赁这个例子。
collocations: car rental｜汽车租赁 ; rental agreement｜租赁协议 ; rental income｜租金收入 ; rental property｜出租房产
tip_zh: 租金常用rent；rental还可指租赁服务或作形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 隐私；隐私权 | n. 独处；不受打扰的状态
definition_en: Freedom from unwanted access to personal information or private life. | The state of being alone and free from disturbance.
example1_en: Office hours began with protect privacy.
example1_zh: 答疑从保护隐私开始。
example2_en: The author returns to protect privacy when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了保护隐私。
collocations: protect privacy｜保护隐私 ; invasion of privacy｜侵犯隐私 ; privacy settings｜隐私设置 ; in the privacy of your home｜在家中不受打扰地
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英美发音首音节差异明显。

meanings_zh: v. 注射；注入 | v. 投入；增添
definition_en: To put a substance into something using a needle or pressure. | To introduce money, energy, or something new into a situation.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer inject medicine during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时注射药物。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to inject medicine.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得注射药物。
collocations: inject medicine｜注射药物 ; inject funds into｜向……注入资金 ; inject new life into｜为……注入新生机
tip_zh: 常用inject A into B：将A注入B。

meanings_zh: n. 大学本科生 | adj. 本科的；本科生的
definition_en: a university student studying for a first degree | relating to study for a first university degree
example1_en: Office hours began with undergraduate student.
example1_zh: 答疑从本科生开始。
example2_en: The reading connects undergraduate student with a larger point about student life.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把本科生和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: undergraduate student｜本科生 ; undergraduate degree｜本科学位 ; undergraduate course｜本科课程
tip_zh: 指正在攻读首个大学学位的学生，不等于“肄业生”。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；结果
definition_en: as a result of something mentioned earlier
example1_en: Consequently, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
example1_zh: 因此，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。
example2_en: Consequently, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
example2_zh: 因此，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。
collocations: and consequently｜并因此 ; consequently lead to｜进而导致 ; consequently require｜因而需要
tip_zh: 是副词而非连词；连接独立句可在前面用分号。

meanings_zh: adj. 简陋的；粗糙的 | adj. 原始的；早期的
definition_en: Very basic, without advanced features or modern comforts. | Belonging to an early stage of development.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on primitive tools.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论原始工具。
example2_en: A campus survey used primitive tools to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用原始工具来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: primitive tools｜原始工具 ; primitive conditions｜简陋的条件 ; primitive life forms｜原始生命形式
tip_zh: 形容设施可指简陋；用于当代民族或文化可能含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 绝望 | v. 绝望；失去希望
definition_en: The feeling that there is no hope. | To lose all hope that things will improve.
example1_en: Office hours began with a sense of despair.
example1_zh: 答疑从绝望感开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of despair.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝望感展开说明。
collocations: in despair｜绝望地 ; a sense of despair｜绝望感 ; despair of doing something｜对做成某事不抱希望
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；动词常接of，不接直接宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 监测；监督 | n. 显示器；监测仪
definition_en: To regularly check something for changes, progress, or problems. | A screen displaying information, or a device checking conditions.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to monitor progress.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何跟踪进展。
example2_en: The reading asks you to monitor progress and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你跟踪进展，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: monitor progress｜跟踪进展 ; monitor air quality｜监测空气质量 ; computer monitor｜电脑显示器 ; heart monitor｜心脏监测仪
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接宾语：monitor changes监测变化。

meanings_zh: n. 跑步机 | n. 单调繁重的工作
definition_en: An exercise machine with a moving surface for walking or running. | A tiring routine that seems endless and brings little satisfaction.
example1_en: Our professor circled treadmill workout on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了跑步机锻炼。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of treadmill workout.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得跑步机锻炼这个例子。
collocations: run on a treadmill｜在跑步机上跑步 ; treadmill workout｜跑步机锻炼 ; the treadmill of daily life｜日常生活的单调忙碌
tip_zh: 在跑步机上用on a treadmill，不用in。

meanings_zh: v. 节约；避免浪费 | v. 保护；保存
definition_en: Use resources carefully to avoid wasting them. | Protect something valuable from damage, loss, or destruction.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to conserve energy.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何节约能源。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to conserve energy.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得节约能源。
collocations: conserve energy｜节约能源 ; conserve water｜节约用水 ; conserve wildlife｜保护野生动物
tip_zh: conserve强调节约或保护；reserve强调预留。

meanings_zh: n. 驻地记者；专题记者 | n. 通信者
definition_en: A journalist reporting from a particular place or on a subject. | A person who exchanges letters or messages with someone.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on foreign correspondent.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论驻外记者。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss foreign correspondent.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论驻外记者的材料。
collocations: foreign correspondent｜驻外记者 ; political correspondent｜政治记者 ; special correspondent｜特派记者
tip_zh: 记者义常指驻某地或负责某领域的记者。

meanings_zh: n. 寡妇；丧偶的女性
definition_en: a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an elderly widow.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论年长的寡妇。
example2_en: The reading connects an elderly widow with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把年长的寡妇和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an elderly widow｜年长的寡妇 ; a war widow｜战争遗孀 ; a young widow｜年轻的寡妇
tip_zh: widow指丧偶女性；丧偶男性用widower。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其好笑的
definition_en: extremely funny and likely to make people laugh
example1_en: Our professor circled absolutely hilarious on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了极其好笑的。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of absolutely hilarious.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得极其好笑的这个例子。
collocations: hilarious story｜令人捧腹的故事 ; hilarious comedy｜爆笑喜剧 ; absolutely hilarious｜极其好笑的
tip_zh: 强调“极其好笑”，不只是热闹或开心。

meanings_zh: v. 发痒 | n. 痒；痒感 | v. 渴望；迫不及待
definition_en: to feel an uncomfortable sensation that makes you want to scratch | an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you scratch | to want very much to do something
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to itch for a chance.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何渴望得到机会。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to itch for a chance.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们渴望得到机会。
collocations: scratch an itch｜挠痒 ; itch to do something｜渴望做某事 ; itch for a chance｜渴望得到机会
tip_zh: itch是发痒，scratch是挠；渴望常用be itching to。

meanings_zh: n. 赞助；资助
definition_en: Financial support for an activity, often in exchange for publicity.
example1_en: I copied corporate sponsorship into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把企业赞助抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to corporate sponsorship when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了企业赞助。
collocations: corporate sponsorship｜企业赞助 ; secure sponsorship｜获得赞助 ; sponsorship deal｜赞助协议
tip_zh: 核心是提供资金等支持，并不等于主办活动。

meanings_zh: n. 怜悯；宽恕
definition_en: Kindness shown by choosing not to punish or harm someone.
example1_en: Office hours began with beg for mercy.
example1_zh: 答疑从乞求宽恕开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss beg for mercy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论乞求宽恕的材料。
collocations: show mercy｜表示宽恕 ; beg for mercy｜乞求宽恕 ; at the mercy of｜任由……摆布 ; without mercy｜毫不留情地
tip_zh: at the mercy of意为“任由……摆布”。

meanings_zh: n. 限制；限制规定
definition_en: a rule or condition that limits what is allowed
example1_en: Office hours began with age restriction.
example1_zh: 答疑从年龄限制开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss age restriction.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年龄限制的材料。
collocations: impose restrictions｜实施限制 ; lift restrictions｜解除限制 ; restrictions on travel｜旅行限制 ; age restriction｜年龄限制
tip_zh: 对某事的限制用restriction on；具体规定常用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 惊叫；大声说
definition_en: to say something suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion
example1_en: I heard the lecturer exclaim in surprise during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时惊讶地叫道。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to exclaim in surprise.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来惊讶地叫道。
collocations: exclaim in surprise｜惊讶地叫道 ; exclaim with delight｜高兴地叫道
tip_zh: 强调因强烈情绪突然出声，常用于引述话语。

meanings_zh: adj. 经修改的；经调整的
definition_en: Changed partly to suit a purpose or improve how something works.
example1_en: The textbook introduces slightly modified in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了略作修改的。
example2_en: The author returns to slightly modified when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了略作修改的。
collocations: genetically modified crops｜转基因作物 ; modified version｜修改版 ; modified equipment｜改装设备 ; slightly modified｜略作修改的
tip_zh: 强调经过改变，不一定表示质量有所提升。

meanings_zh: n. 液体；流体 | adj. 不固定的；易变的 | adj. 流畅的；流动的
definition_en: a substance that flows, such as a liquid or gas | likely to change rather than remain fixed | moving smoothly and continuously
example1_en: The textbook introduces fluid intake in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了液体摄入量。
example2_en: The reading connects fluid intake with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把液体摄入量和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: body fluids｜体液 ; fluid intake｜液体摄入量 ; a fluid situation｜不断变化的局势 ; fluid movements｜流畅的动作
tip_zh: 日常语境多指液体；科学中的fluid也包括气体。

meanings_zh: n. 自传
definition_en: a book about someone's life written by that person
example1_en: The textbook introduces a bestselling autobiography in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了畅销自传。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a bestselling autobiography.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得畅销自传这个例子。
collocations: write an autobiography｜写自传 ; publish an autobiography｜出版自传 ; a bestselling autobiography｜畅销自传
tip_zh: autobiography是本人写的自传；biography是传记。

meanings_zh: adj. 微湿的；湿润的
definition_en: Slightly wet, rather than dry or soaked.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on moist soil.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论湿润的土壤。
example2_en: The author returns to moist soil when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了湿润的土壤。
collocations: moist soil｜湿润的土壤 ; keep something moist｜使某物保持湿润 ; moist cake｜松润的蛋糕
tip_zh: moist常指适度湿润；damp常带潮湿、不舒服之意。

meanings_zh: v. 理解；领会 | v. 抓牢；握紧 | n. 理解；紧握
definition_en: To understand something, especially a difficult idea. | To take and hold something firmly. | An understanding of something, or a firm hold.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to grasp a concept.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求理解概念。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to grasp a concept.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得理解概念。
collocations: grasp a concept｜理解概念 ; a firm grasp of｜对……的扎实理解 ; grasp an opportunity｜抓住机会 ; within reach or grasp｜力所能及
tip_zh: 表示理解时可作动词；名词常用a grasp of。

meanings_zh: n. 恶意；怨恨 | v. 故意使恼怒；刁难
definition_en: A desire to upset or hurt someone deliberately. | To deliberately upset someone, often because you feel angry.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on out of spite.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论出于恶意。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around out of spite.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕出于恶意展开说明。
collocations: out of spite｜出于恶意 ; in spite of｜尽管 ; pure spite｜纯粹的恶意
tip_zh: in spite of后接名词或动名词，不直接接句子。

meanings_zh: n. 激励；诱因
definition_en: something that encourages someone to act or work harder
example1_en: The textbook introduces financial incentive in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济激励。
example2_en: The author returns to financial incentive when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济激励。
collocations: financial incentive｜经济激励 ; provide an incentive｜提供动力 ; incentive to work｜工作的动力
tip_zh: 常用 incentive to do sth，表示做某事的动力。

meanings_zh: n. 选民；投票人
definition_en: Someone who votes or has the right to vote
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about registered voter.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于登记选民的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of registered voter.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得登记选民这个例子。
collocations: registered voter｜登记选民 ; eligible voter｜有投票资格的选民 ; voter turnout｜选民投票率 ; voter registration｜选民登记
tip_zh: voter指人，vote可指投票行为或一票。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争对手 | v. 与…匹敌；比得上 | adj. 竞争的；对立的
definition_en: Someone competing with another for the same goal or advantage. | Be as good or impressive as someone or something. | Competing for the same goal or advantage.
example1_en: Our professor circled a major rival on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了主要竞争对手。
example2_en: The author returns to a major rival when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主要竞争对手。
collocations: a major rival｜主要竞争对手 ; a rival company｜竞争公司 ; rival teams｜相互竞争的队伍 ; rival someone in quality｜在质量上与某人匹敌
tip_zh: rival作动词直接接宾语，无需加with。

meanings_zh: adj. 农村的；乡村的
definition_en: Relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities.
