example1_en: The textbook introduces rural areas in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了农村地区。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of rural areas.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得农村地区这个例子。
collocations: rural areas｜农村地区 ; rural communities｜乡村社区 ; rural development｜农村发展 ; rural population｜农村人口
tip_zh: rural修饰乡村事物，urban修饰城市事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 知识渊博的；很内行的
definition_en: knowing a lot about a particular subject
example1_en: The textbook introduces knowledgeable about in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……很了解。
example2_en: The reading connects knowledgeable about with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……很了解和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: knowledgeable about｜对……很了解 ; knowledgeable staff｜专业知识丰富的员工 ; a knowledgeable guide｜知识丰富的导游
tip_zh: 常用 knowledgeable about 表示对某领域了解很多。

meanings_zh: adj. 短期的
definition_en: lasting or having effects for only a limited time
example1_en: The professor explained short-term with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了短期的。
example2_en: Students who can explain short-term usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释短期的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: short-term solution｜短期解决办法 ; short-term contract｜短期合同 ; short-term memory｜短时记忆
tip_zh: 作定语常用连字符；in the short term不加。

meanings_zh: n. 铜 | n. 铜币
definition_en: a reddish-brown metal used for wires, pipes, and coins | a coin made of copper or a similar metal
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about copper wire.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于铜线的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to copper wire when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了铜线。
collocations: copper wire｜铜线 ; copper pipe｜铜管 ; copper mine｜铜矿
tip_zh: 表示金属铜时不可数；表示铜币时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 静脉 | n. 叶脉 | n. 矿脉
definition_en: a blood vessel that carries blood towards the heart | a thin tube carrying water and nutrients through a leaf | a narrow layer of mineral within rock
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a vein of gold.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一条金矿脉的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a vein of gold with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一条金矿脉和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: varicose veins｜静脉曲张 ; leaf veins｜叶脉 ; a vein of gold｜一条金矿脉
tip_zh: vein指静脉；artery指动脉，二者不是反义词。

meanings_zh: n. 珊瑚；珊瑚虫 | adj. 珊瑚色的
definition_en: tiny sea animals, or the hard structures they build | having a pinkish-orange colour
example1_en: Office hours began with coral reef.
example1_zh: 答疑从珊瑚礁开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around coral reef.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕珊瑚礁展开说明。
collocations: coral reef｜珊瑚礁 ; coral bleaching｜珊瑚白化 ; coral colony｜珊瑚群体 ; coral restoration｜珊瑚修复
tip_zh: 指珊瑚材料通常不可数；指种类或群体时可用corals。

meanings_zh: adj. 详细的；详尽的
definition_en: Including many facts or specific pieces of information.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on detailed description.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论详细描述。
example2_en: The author returns to detailed description when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了详细描述。
collocations: detailed description｜详细描述 ; detailed analysis｜详细分析 ; detailed instructions｜详细说明
tip_zh: 表示“详细地”用in detail，不用in detailed。

meanings_zh: n. 高管；主管 | adj. 行政的；执行的 | n. 行政部门；执行机构
definition_en: a person with important management responsibilities in an organisation | relating to managing an organisation or putting decisions into effect | the part of a government or organisation that implements decisions
example1_en: Office hours began with senior executive.
example1_zh: 答疑从高级管理人员开始。
example2_en: The author returns to senior executive when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了高级管理人员。
collocations: senior executive｜高级管理人员 ; chief executive｜首席执行官 ; executive power｜行政权 ; executive board｜执行委员会
tip_zh: 名词可指高管；形容词常修饰power、board等。

meanings_zh: adj. 国内的 | adj. 家庭的；家务的 | adj. 家养的；驯养的
definition_en: relating to activities within a particular country | relating to the home, family, or household tasks | kept by people rather than living in the wild
example1_en: Our professor circled domestic market on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了国内市场。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of domestic market.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得国内市场这个例子。
collocations: domestic market｜国内市场 ; domestic flight｜国内航班 ; domestic chores｜家务活 ; domestic animals｜家养动物
tip_zh: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。

meanings_zh: n. 彗星
definition_en: An icy object orbiting the sun, sometimes showing a bright tail
example1_en: Office hours began with a passing comet.
example1_zh: 答疑从经过的彗星开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a passing comet.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得经过的彗星这个例子。
collocations: a comet's tail｜彗星的尾巴 ; a passing comet｜经过的彗星 ; observe a comet｜观测彗星
tip_zh: comet是彗星；meteor是进入大气后发光的流星。

meanings_zh: adj. 神圣的；宗教的 | adj. 不可侵犯的；极珍视的
definition_en: Connected with religion and deserving deep respect | Considered too important or valuable to change or harm
example1_en: I copied sacred site into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把圣地抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sacred site.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论圣地的材料。
collocations: sacred site｜圣地 ; sacred music｜宗教音乐 ; hold something sacred｜视某物为神圣
tip_zh: sacred可指宗教上的神圣，也指极珍视、不可侵犯。

meanings_zh: v. 变暗；使变黑 | v. 脸色变阴沉；使忧郁
definition_en: to become darker or make something darker | to become or make someone look unhappy or angry
example1_en: I heard the lecturer darken the sky during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使天空变暗。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers darken the sky before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使天空变暗。
collocations: darken the sky｜使天空变暗 ; darken a room｜使房间变暗 ; someone's face darkens｜某人脸色阴沉下来
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：云使天变暗，天也可自行变暗。

meanings_zh: n. 不平等
definition_en: An unfair difference in wealth, opportunity, or treatment.
example1_en: The seminar traced inequality in who can afford unpaid internships.
example1_zh: 研讨课追溯了谁负担得起无薪实习这一问题中的不平等。
example2_en: The reading asks whether the policy reduced inequality or only moved it.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读问这项政策是减少了不平等，还是只是把它转移了。
collocations: income inequality｜收入不平等 ; social inequality｜社会不平等
tip_zh: 常用 income / social / gender inequality。

meanings_zh: v. 取笑；戏弄 | n. 爱逗弄别人的人
definition_en: Make jokes about someone, playfully or unkindly. | Someone who enjoys making jokes about other people.
example1_en: The professor asked us to tease out.
example1_zh: 教授让我们梳理出；逐步弄清。
example2_en: The passage says students who can tease out follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够梳理出；逐步弄清的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: tease someone about something｜拿某事取笑某人 ; gently tease｜温和地打趣 ; tease out｜梳理出；逐步弄清
tip_zh: 常用tease sb about sth；可亲昵，也可伤人。

meanings_zh: conj. 然而；尽管
definition_en: Used to compare two facts that differ.
example1_en: The first group improved, whereas the second did not.
example1_zh: 第一组有进步，而第二组没有。
example2_en: The lecture uses whereas to contrast a lab task with a real semester of study.
example2_zh: 讲座用 whereas 对比实验室任务和真实的一学期学习。
collocations: whereas others｜而其他人
tip_zh: whereas 连接两个完整分句，前面常用逗号。

meanings_zh: n. 大使 | n. 代表；推广使者
definition_en: A senior official representing their country in another country. | Someone who publicly represents or promotes a group or cause.
example1_en: Office hours began with goodwill ambassador.
example1_zh: 答疑从亲善大使开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around goodwill ambassador.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕亲善大使展开说明。
collocations: ambassador to｜驻……大使 ; appoint an ambassador｜任命大使 ; goodwill ambassador｜亲善大使
tip_zh: 驻某国大使用 ambassador to，不用 for。

meanings_zh: n. 香草；药草
definition_en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about herb garden.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于香草园的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects herb garden with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把香草园和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fresh herbs｜新鲜香草 ; dried herbs｜干香草 ; medicinal herbs｜药草 ; herb garden｜香草园
tip_zh: 英音h发音，美音通常不发；对应a herb和an herb。

meanings_zh: v. 取得资格；使符合条件 | v. 取得专业资格 | v. 限定；使措辞更准确
definition_en: To meet requirements, or make someone suitable for something. | To complete the training needed for a profession. | To limit a statement so it is more accurate.
example1_en: The assignment is to qualify for assistance, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先符合援助条件，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers qualify for assistance before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要符合援助条件。
collocations: qualify for assistance｜符合援助条件 ; qualify as a teacher｜取得教师资格 ; qualify a statement｜限定说法
tip_zh: qualify for接机会或待遇；qualify as接职业。

meanings_zh: n. 爬行动物
definition_en: a cold-blooded animal with scaly skin, such as a snake
example1_en: I copied reptile species into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把爬行动物物种抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around reptile species.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕爬行动物物种展开说明。
collocations: reptile species｜爬行动物物种 ; reptile eggs｜爬行动物的卵 ; reptile enclosure｜爬行动物饲养围栏
tip_zh: 蛇、蜥蜴、龟属爬行动物；青蛙不属此类。

meanings_zh: n. 国会议员；美国众议员
definition_en: A male congress member, especially in the US House of Representatives.
example1_en: Office hours began with local congressman.
example1_zh: 答疑从本选区国会议员开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around local congressman.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕本选区国会议员展开说明。
collocations: elect a congressman｜选举国会议员 ; local congressman｜本选区国会议员 ; former congressman｜前国会议员
tip_zh: 美国语境通常指男性众议员；性别中性可用国会议员统称。

meanings_zh: adj. 邪恶的；缺德的 | adj. 淘气的；恶作剧的
definition_en: Morally very bad and deliberately harmful. | Playfully naughty, often in an amusing way.
example1_en: Our professor circled a wicked act on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了恶行。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a wicked act.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕恶行展开说明。
collocations: a wicked act｜恶行 ; a wicked grin｜淘气的咧嘴笑 ; a wicked sense of humour｜爱捉弄人的幽默感
tip_zh: 通常比bad语气强；形容笑容时可指淘气而非邪恶。

meanings_zh: n. 倾盆大雨；暴雨
definition_en: a heavy fall of rain, often starting suddenly
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about heavy downpour.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于倾盆大雨的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used heavy downpour to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用倾盆大雨来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: heavy downpour｜倾盆大雨 ; sudden downpour｜突如其来的暴雨 ; torrential downpour｜猛烈的暴雨
tip_zh: 可数名词：一场暴雨用a downpour。

meanings_zh: v. 侮辱；辱骂 | n. 侮辱；无礼的言行
definition_en: Say or do something that treats someone with disrespect. | A remark or action that shows disrespect and causes offence.
example1_en: The professor explained insult with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了侮辱。
example2_en: Students who can explain insult usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释侮辱的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: a personal insult｜人身侮辱 ; feel insulted｜感到受辱 ; add insult to injury｜雪上加霜
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈɪnsʌlt/，重音在前。

meanings_zh: v. 产生；引起 | v. 发电；产生能量
definition_en: Cause something to exist or happen. | Produce electricity, heat, or another form of energy.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to generate electricity.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发电。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to generate electricity.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得发电。
collocations: generate electricity｜发电 ; generate income｜创造收入 ; generate interest｜引起兴趣 ; generate ideas｜产生想法
tip_zh: 及物动词，可接电力、收入、兴趣、想法等宾语。

meanings_zh: adv. 充分地；足够好地
definition_en: well enough or in sufficient amounts for a particular purpose
example1_en: The lab manual says to adequately funded before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先资金充足的，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will adequately funded when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会资金充足的。
collocations: adequately funded｜资金充足的 ; adequately prepared｜准备充分的 ; adequately address｜充分处理
tip_zh: 强调达到所需标准，不一定表示非常出色。

meanings_zh: adj. 驯服的；不怕人的 | v. 驯服；控制 | adj. 平淡乏味的
definition_en: Used to people and not wild or dangerous. | To train a wild animal or bring something under control. | Not exciting, adventurous, or impressive.
example1_en: Office hours began with tame animals.
example1_zh: 答疑从驯服的动物开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss tame animals.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论驯服的动物的材料。
collocations: tame animals｜驯服的动物 ; tame a horse｜驯服一匹马 ; tame inflation｜抑制通货膨胀
tip_zh: tame指不怕人或被驯服，不等于天生无害。

meanings_zh: n. 帮助；援助
definition_en: Help given to someone who needs it.
example1_en: I copied financial assistance into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把经济援助抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss financial assistance.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济援助的材料。
collocations: provide assistance｜提供帮助 ; financial assistance｜经济援助 ; seek assistance｜寻求帮助 ; with the assistance of｜在……的帮助下
tip_zh: 不可数名词；表示帮助时比help更正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 有资格的；能胜任的 | adj. 有限度的；有保留的
definition_en: having the training, skills, or experience needed for something | not complete or unconditional; involving limits or reservations
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fully qualified.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论完全具备资格的。
example2_en: The author returns to fully qualified when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了完全具备资格的。
collocations: fully qualified｜完全具备资格的 ; qualified to teach｜有资格任教 ; qualified for the job｜能胜任这份工作 ; qualified support｜有保留的支持
tip_zh: qualified for＋名词；qualified to do表示有资格做。

meanings_zh: n. 等级；军衔；地位 | v. 排名；把……分等级 | n. 一排；一列
definition_en: A position within an ordered system of importance or authority | To place or be placed in order of quality or importance | A line of people or things arranged side by side
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about rank highly.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于排名靠前的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of rank highly.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得排名靠前这个例子。
collocations: hold the rank of｜拥有……军衔 ; rank among the best｜跻身最优秀之列 ; rank highly｜排名靠前 ; in order of rank｜按等级顺序
tip_zh: rank可作名词或动词；ranking常指排名或榜单。

meanings_zh: v. 口述供记录 | v. 命令；强行规定 | v. 决定；支配
definition_en: to say words aloud for someone or something to record | to tell someone what to do without allowing disagreement | to determine how something happens or is done
example1_en: The professor asked us to dictate a letter.
example1_zh: 教授让我们口述信件。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to dictate a letter.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们口述信件。
collocations: dictate a letter｜口述信件 ; dictate terms｜强行规定条件 ; dictate policy｜支配政策
tip_zh: dictate是口述让别人写；“做听写”用take dictation。

meanings_zh: v. 抗击；遏制 | n. 战斗；搏斗
definition_en: to fight against something harmful | fighting between opposing forces or individuals
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to combat climate change.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何应对气候变化。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to combat climate change.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们应对气候变化。
collocations: combat climate change｜应对气候变化 ; combat poverty｜抗击贫困 ; combat disease｜抗击疾病 ; armed combat｜武装战斗
tip_zh: 作动词直接接问题或危害，不必加against。

meanings_zh: v. 改革；改进 | n. 改革；改良措施 | v. 改过自新；使改正
definition_en: to improve a system by changing how it works | a change intended to improve a system or institution | to improve your behaviour or help someone improve theirs
example1_en: I heard the lecturer reform the education system during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时改革教育制度。
example2_en: The reading asks you to reform the education system and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你改革教育制度，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: reform the education system｜改革教育制度 ; economic reform｜经济改革 ; introduce reforms｜推行改革 ; far-reaching reforms｜影响深远的改革
tip_zh: reform重在改进现有制度，不一定彻底推翻。

meanings_zh: n. 处方；处方药 | n. 解决方案；对策 | adj. 凭处方购买的
definition_en: A doctor's written order for medicine, or the medicine ordered | A suggested method for dealing with a problem | Available only with a doctor's written order
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about prescription medicine.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于处方药的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to prescription medicine when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了处方药。
collocations: write a prescription｜开处方 ; fill a prescription｜按处方配药 ; prescription medicine｜处方药 ; a prescription for success｜成功之道
tip_zh: 处方用for引出药物；on prescription指凭处方。

meanings_zh: n. 所有权 | n. 责任担当
definition_en: The legal right to possess something. | Responsibility for a task and commitment to its results.
example1_en: The textbook introduces private ownership in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了私人所有制。
example2_en: The author returns to private ownership when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了私人所有制。
collocations: private ownership｜私人所有制 ; transfer ownership｜转让所有权 ; home ownership｜住房所有权 ; take ownership of｜主动承担责任
tip_zh: 不可数名词；take ownership of也可指主动担责。

meanings_zh: n. 计算；计算结果 | n. 估计；权衡
definition_en: the process or result of working something out using numbers | a judgement about likely outcomes made after careful consideration
example1_en: Office hours began with accurate calculation.
example1_zh: 答疑从准确计算开始。
example2_en: The reading connects accurate calculation with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把准确计算和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: perform a calculation｜进行计算 ; accurate calculation｜准确计算 ; calculation error｜计算错误 ; by my calculations｜据我计算
tip_zh: 一次具体计算可数；指计算过程时可不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 生态系统
definition_en: Living things and their environment interacting as a connected system.
example1_en: The textbook introduces marine ecosystem in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了海洋生态系统。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around marine ecosystem.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕海洋生态系统展开说明。
collocations: marine ecosystem｜海洋生态系统 ; fragile ecosystem｜脆弱的生态系统 ; protect ecosystems｜保护生态系统 ; disrupt an ecosystem｜扰乱生态系统
tip_zh: 指生物与环境共同构成的系统，不只是生物群体。

meanings_zh: v. 宣布；声明 | v. 申报
definition_en: to announce something publicly or officially | to officially report goods, income or other required information
example1_en: The assignment is to declare a winner, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先宣布获胜者，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to declare a winner.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来宣布获胜者。
collocations: declare a winner｜宣布获胜者 ; declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态 ; declare goods｜申报物品 ; declare income｜申报收入
tip_zh: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

meanings_zh: n. 欺诈；诈骗 | n. 骗子；冒牌货
definition_en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain money or another advantage. | A person or thing pretending to be genuine.
example1_en: Office hours began with commit fraud.
example1_zh: 答疑从实施诈骗开始。
example2_en: The reading connects commit fraud with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把实施诈骗和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: commit fraud｜实施诈骗 ; identity fraud｜身份冒用诈骗 ; insurance fraud｜保险诈骗 ; a complete fraud｜彻头彻尾的骗子
tip_zh: 欺诈行为通常不可数；指骗子时用a fraud。

meanings_zh: adj. 有故障的；有缺陷的 | adj. 错误的；有漏洞的
definition_en: not working correctly because something is wrong | containing mistakes or based on incorrect reasoning
example1_en: Our professor circled faulty equipment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了有故障的设备。
example2_en: A campus survey used faulty equipment to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有故障的设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: faulty equipment｜有故障的设备 ; faulty wiring｜有问题的电线线路 ; faulty reasoning｜有漏洞的推理 ; faulty assumptions｜错误的假设
tip_zh: 既可形容设备故障，也可形容推理有误。

meanings_zh: n. 动物挖的地洞 | v. 挖洞；钻入
definition_en: A hole or tunnel dug by an animal for shelter | To dig a tunnel or push into something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a rabbit burrow.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论兔子洞。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a rabbit burrow.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得兔子洞这个例子。
collocations: a rabbit burrow｜兔子洞 ; burrow into the ground｜钻入地下 ; burrow under a blanket｜钻到毯子下面
tip_zh: burrow指挖洞或地洞；别与borrow（借入）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 防护的；保护性的 | adj. 关切保护的
definition_en: Intended to prevent injury, damage, or other harm | Wanting to keep someone safe from harm or trouble
example1_en: Office hours began with protective clothing.
example1_zh: 答疑从防护服开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of protective clothing.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得防护服这个例子。
collocations: protective clothing｜防护服 ; protective equipment｜防护装备 ; protective measures｜保护措施 ; protective of someone｜关切保护某人
tip_zh: 表示关切保护某人，用be protective of。

meanings_zh: adv. 本质上；基本上
definition_en: When considering the most important features or facts.
example1_en: The lab manual says to essentially the same before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先基本相同，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will essentially the same when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会基本相同。
collocations: essentially the same｜基本相同 ; essentially different｜本质上不同 ; essentially a matter of｜本质上是……的问题
tip_zh: 是副词，不是形容词；常用于概括核心事实。

meanings_zh: v. 仔细检查 | v. 视察；正式检查
definition_en: To examine something carefully for faults or other details. | To visit officially to check that required standards are met.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer inspect for damage during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时检查有无损坏。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to inspect for damage.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得检查有无损坏。
collocations: inspect for damage｜检查有无损坏 ; inspect the premises｜检查场所 ; inspect thoroughly｜彻底检查
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接检查对象，不加at。

meanings_zh: n. 饮料
definition_en: A drink, such as tea, juice, or coffee.
example1_en: Office hours began with hot beverage.
example1_zh: 答疑从热饮开始。
example2_en: The reading connects hot beverage with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把热饮和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: hot beverage｜热饮 ; alcoholic beverage｜酒精饮料 ; sugary beverage｜含糖饮料 ; food and beverages｜食品与饮料
tip_zh: beverage较正式，多用于餐饮或学术语境；日常用drink。

meanings_zh: adj. 口头的；非书面的 | adj. 言语的；与词语有关的
definition_en: spoken rather than written | relating to words or the use of language
example1_en: I copied a verbal agreement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把口头协议抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a verbal agreement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了口头协议。
collocations: a verbal agreement｜口头协议 ; verbal communication｜言语交流 ; verbal skills｜语言能力 ; a verbal warning｜口头警告
tip_zh: verbal也指用词语表达，不总与written对立。

meanings_zh: n. 金融；资金管理 | n. 资金 | v. 为…提供资金
definition_en: the management of money by people, businesses, or governments | money needed to support an activity or project | to provide money for something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on public finance.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公共财政。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of public finance.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得公共财政这个例子。
collocations: public finance｜公共财政 ; raise finance｜筹集资金 ; finance a project｜为项目提供资金 ; personal finances｜个人财务状况
tip_zh: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。

meanings_zh: n. 破坏；毁灭
definition_en: Damage so severe that something no longer exists or works.
example1_en: Our professor circled habitat destruction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了栖息地破坏。
example2_en: A campus survey used habitat destruction to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用栖息地破坏来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: habitat destruction｜栖息地破坏 ; widespread destruction｜大范围破坏 ; a trail of destruction｜沿途的破坏痕迹
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词是destroy，不是destruct。

meanings_zh: n. 情感；情绪
definition_en: a strong feeling such as joy, fear, or sadness
example1_en: Our professor circled express emotion on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了表达情感。
example2_en: A campus survey used express emotion to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用表达情感来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: express emotion｜表达情感 ; strong emotions｜强烈的情绪 ; mixed emotions｜复杂的情绪 ; control your emotions｜控制自己的情绪
tip_zh: 泛指情感时可不可数；具体的各种情绪常用emotions。

meanings_zh: n. 进化 | n. 演变；逐步发展
definition_en: Gradual changes in living things over many generations. | The gradual development of something over time.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the theory of evolution in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了进化论。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the theory of evolution.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕进化论展开说明。
collocations: the theory of evolution｜进化论 ; human evolution｜人类进化 ; biological evolution｜生物进化 ; the evolution of technology｜技术的演变
tip_zh: evolution指进化；进化论用the theory of evolution。

meanings_zh: v. 监督；指导；照看
definition_en: watch and guide people to ensure work or activities go properly
example1_en: I heard the lecturer supervise staff during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时监督员工。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers supervise staff before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要监督员工。
collocations: supervise staff｜监督员工 ; supervise children｜照看儿童 ; supervise a project｜监管项目
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接人或活动：supervise staff。

meanings_zh: v. 咧嘴笑；露齿笑 | n. 咧嘴笑；露齿笑
definition_en: To smile widely, usually showing your teeth. | A broad smile that usually shows the teeth.
example1_en: The professor asked us to grin broadly.
example1_zh: 教授让我们咧嘴大笑。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers grin broadly before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要咧嘴大笑。
collocations: grin broadly｜咧嘴大笑 ; a cheeky grin｜调皮的笑容 ; grin at someone｜朝某人咧嘴笑
tip_zh: grin比smile更强调咧嘴露齿；过去式为grinned。

meanings_zh: v. 插入；放入 | v. 添加；插入内容 | n. 插页；插入物
definition_en: to put something into something else | to add something within a document, recording, or piece of writing | something designed to be placed inside another thing
example1_en: The professor asked us to insert into.
example1_zh: 教授让我们插入……中。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to insert into.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来插入……中。
collocations: insert into｜插入……中 ; insert a card｜插卡 ; insert an image｜插入图像
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 市场营销
definition_en: activities that identify customers' needs and promote products or services
example1_en: Office hours began with digital marketing.
example1_zh: 答疑从数字营销开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used digital marketing to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用数字营销来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: marketing strategy｜营销策略 ; digital marketing｜数字营销 ; marketing campaign｜营销活动 ; market research｜市场调研
tip_zh: marketing通常不可数，范围比advertising更广。

meanings_zh: v. 重新开始；继续
definition_en: To start again after stopping or being interrupted.
example1_en: The professor asked us to resume work.
example1_zh: 教授让我们恢复工作。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers resume work before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要恢复工作。
collocations: resume work｜恢复工作 ; resume talks｜重启谈判 ; resume normal service｜恢复正常服务
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词；名词résumé意为简历。

meanings_zh: n. 铝
definition_en: A light, silvery metal used for cans, foil, and aircraft.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on aluminum foil.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论铝箔。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around aluminum foil.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕铝箔展开说明。
collocations: aluminum foil｜铝箔 ; aluminum cans｜铝罐 ; aluminum alloy｜铝合金
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写aluminium，读音也不同。

meanings_zh: n. 团队合作
definition_en: People working together effectively to achieve a shared goal
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about effective teamwork.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于有效的团队合作的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used effective teamwork to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有效的团队合作来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: effective teamwork｜有效的团队合作 ; teamwork skills｜团队合作技能 ; encourage teamwork｜鼓励团队合作
tip_zh: 不可数名词；强调团队成员共同协作。

meanings_zh: adj. 静止的；不变的 | adj. 静电的 | n. 静电干扰；静电
definition_en: not moving, changing, or developing | relating to electric charges that build up on surfaces | electrical interference or an electric charge collected on a surface
example1_en: Office hours began with static electricity.
example1_zh: 答疑从静电开始。
example2_en: The reading connects static electricity with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把静电和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: remain static｜保持不变 ; static electricity｜静电 ; static image｜静态图像
tip_zh: static强调不动或不变；静电用static electricity。

meanings_zh: n. 氧；氧气
definition_en: A gas needed by most living things for life.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lack of oxygen.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论缺氧。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of lack of oxygen.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得缺氧这个例子。
collocations: oxygen supply｜氧气供应 ; oxygen levels｜含氧量 ; lack of oxygen｜缺氧 ; oxygen mask｜氧气面罩
tip_zh: oxygen是不可数名词，不说an oxygen。

meanings_zh: n. 商人；交易员
definition_en: Someone who buys and sells goods or financial assets.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on market trader.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论市场商贩。
example2_en: A campus survey used market trader to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用市场商贩来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: market trader｜市场商贩 ; currency trader｜外汇交易员 ; independent trader｜独立商户 ; stock trader｜股票交易员
tip_zh: 可指实物买卖者，也可指金融市场交易员。

meanings_zh: n. 传说；传奇故事 | n. 传奇人物 | n. 图例
definition_en: an old popular story that may not be historically true | someone greatly admired for exceptional achievements | a guide explaining the symbols used on a map or chart
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on according to legend.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论据传说。
example2_en: The reading connects according to legend with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把据传说和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: according to legend｜据传说 ; local legend｜地方传说 ; a living legend｜当世传奇人物 ; map legend｜地图图例
tip_zh: legend可能有历史原型，不等于已证实的历史。

meanings_zh: n. 情况；条件；环境 | n. 经济状况；境遇
definition_en: a fact or condition that affects a situation | the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation
example1_en: After the lecture, we used circumstance in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了情况。
example2_en: Students who can explain circumstance usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释情况的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下 ; personal circumstances｜个人情况 ; unforeseen circumstances｜意外情况 ; under no circumstances｜绝不
tip_zh: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

meanings_zh: adj. 随机的；无规律的
definition_en: Chosen or happening without a fixed pattern or deliberate plan.
example1_en: Office hours began with random sample.
example1_zh: 答疑从随机样本开始。
example2_en: The author returns to random sample when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了随机样本。
collocations: random sample｜随机样本 ; random selection｜随机选择 ; at random｜随机地
tip_zh: random是形容词；作状语用randomly或at random。

meanings_zh: adv. 自愿地；乐意地
definition_en: By choice and without needing to be forced or persuaded.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to willingly agree.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习欣然同意。
example2_en: Students who willingly agree are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够欣然同意的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: willingly agree｜欣然同意 ; participate willingly｜自愿参与 ; willingly accept｜欣然接受
tip_zh: 强调自愿而非被迫；不等于单纯“开心地”。

meanings_zh: n. 大猩猩
definition_en: A large African ape with dark hair and powerful arms.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a mountain gorilla.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于山地大猩猩的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a mountain gorilla.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得山地大猩猩这个例子。
collocations: a mountain gorilla｜山地大猩猩 ; a silverback gorilla｜银背大猩猩 ; gorilla conservation｜大猩猩保护
tip_zh: gorilla是大猩猩；chimpanzee是黑猩猩。

meanings_zh: adj. 全面的；详尽的
definition_en: Covering all or nearly all important parts of something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about comprehensive guide.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于详尽指南的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to comprehensive guide when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了详尽指南。
collocations: comprehensive guide｜详尽指南 ; comprehensive review｜全面审查 ; comprehensive assessment｜综合评估
tip_zh: 强调涵盖范围全面，不是指容易理解。

meanings_zh: adv. 越来越；日益
definition_en: More and more as time passes
example1_en: Increasingly, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
example1_zh: 日益，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。
example2_en: Increasingly, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
example2_zh: 日益，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。
collocations: increasingly important｜日益重要 ; increasingly common｜越来越普遍 ; increasingly concerned｜越来越担忧 ; increasingly difficult｜越来越困难
tip_zh: 直接修饰原级形容词：increasingly popular。

meanings_zh: adj. 统计的；统计学的
definition_en: relating to collecting, studying, or interpreting numerical data
example1_en: Office hours began with statistical analysis.
example1_zh: 答疑从统计分析开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around statistical analysis.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕统计分析展开说明。
collocations: statistical analysis｜统计分析 ; statistical data｜统计数据 ; statistical significance｜统计显著性
tip_zh: statistical指与统计有关，不等于“显著的”。

meanings_zh: adj. 有能力的；能…的 | adj. 能干的；有才干的
definition_en: Having the ability or qualities needed to do something. | Skilled and effective at handling tasks or responsibilities.
example1_en: The textbook introduces highly capable in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了非常能干的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly capable.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕非常能干的展开说明。
collocations: capable of doing something｜有能力做某事 ; highly capable｜非常能干的 ; a capable leader｜能干的领导者
tip_zh: 用capable of doing，不用capable to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 相应的；对应的
definition_en: Matching or directly related to something else
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about corresponding increase.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于相应的增长的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss corresponding increase.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论相应的增长的材料。
collocations: corresponding increase｜相应的增长 ; corresponding period｜同期 ; corresponding figures｜对应的数据
tip_zh: 强调相互对应；correspond to表示与……相对应。

meanings_zh: n. 实况解说 | n. 评论；评述
definition_en: a spoken description of an event as it happens | an explanation or discussion expressing opinions about something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on running commentary.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论连续解说。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around running commentary.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕连续解说展开说明。
collocations: live commentary｜现场直播解说 ; running commentary｜连续解说 ; political commentary｜政治评论 ; commentary on｜对……的评论
tip_zh: commentary常指持续解说或深入评述，不只是单条评论。

meanings_zh: adj. 渴望的；热切的
definition_en: very interested and excited about doing or having something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on eager to learn.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论渴望学习。
example2_en: The reading connects eager to learn with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把渴望学习和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: eager to learn｜渴望学习 ; eager for success｜渴望成功 ; eager anticipation｜热切期待
tip_zh: 常用eager to do或eager for＋名词。

meanings_zh: n. 地狱 | n. 极其痛苦的处境
definition_en: A place of punishment after death in some religious beliefs. | An extremely unpleasant experience, situation, or place.
example1_en: I copied a living hell into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把人间地狱抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a living hell.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人间地狱的材料。
collocations: go through hell｜经历极大痛苦 ; make someone's life hell｜使某人的生活苦不堪言 ; a living hell｜人间地狱
tip_zh: 比喻义语气强烈；作咒骂或强调语时可能冒犯他人。

meanings_zh: v. 使现代化；实现现代化
definition_en: To update something using newer methods, equipment, or designs.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to modernize infrastructure.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求推动基础设施现代化。
example2_en: The reading asks you to modernize infrastructure and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你推动基础设施现代化，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: modernize infrastructure｜推动基础设施现代化 ; modernize the economy｜推动经济现代化 ; modernize production｜实现生产现代化
tip_zh: 英式英语也常拼作modernise。

meanings_zh: n. 声明；宣言；宣布 | n. 申报；申报单
definition_en: An official or public statement expressing a decision, belief, or intention. | An official statement of goods, income, or other required information.
example1_en: The textbook introduces joint declaration in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了联合声明。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss joint declaration.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论联合声明的材料。
collocations: joint declaration｜联合声明 ; declaration of independence｜独立宣言 ; customs declaration｜海关申报 ; make a declaration｜作出声明
tip_zh: declare是动词；海关申报用customs declaration。

meanings_zh: n. 多样性；差异性
definition_en: The presence of many different types of people or things.
example1_en: Office hours began with cultural diversity.
example1_zh: 答疑从文化多样性开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around cultural diversity.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕文化多样性展开说明。
collocations: cultural diversity｜文化多样性 ; biological diversity｜生物多样性 ; promote diversity｜促进多样性
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；a diversity of表示多种多样的。

meanings_zh: n. 创新；革新 | n. 新方法；新事物
definition_en: the introduction of new ideas, methods, or products | a new idea, method, or product that improves something
example1_en: Our professor circled technological innovation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了技术创新。
example2_en: A campus survey used technological innovation to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用技术创新来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: technological innovation｜技术创新 ; encourage innovation｜鼓励创新 ; product innovation｜产品创新 ; a major innovation｜一项重大创新
tip_zh: 表示创新过程时不可数；表示具体新成果时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 出价；投标 | n. 出价；投标 | n. 努力；尝试争取
definition_en: To offer a price or compete formally for a contract. | An offer of money or a proposal to do work. | An attempt to achieve or obtain something.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer bid for a contract during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时投标争取合同。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to bid for a contract.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来投标争取合同。
collocations: bid for a contract｜投标争取合同 ; submit a bid｜提交投标书 ; the highest bid｜最高出价 ; in a bid to｜为了争取
tip_zh: 表示出价时，过去式和过去分词均为bid。

meanings_zh: adj. 不确定的；怀疑的 | adj. 不大可能的；未必的 | adj. 可疑的；不可靠的
definition_en: Feeling unsure whether something is true or will happen. | Unlikely to happen or be true. | Not clearly good, honest, or reliable.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about doubtful about.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于对……不确定的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used doubtful about to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用对……不确定来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: doubtful about｜对……不确定 ; doubtful whether｜是否……尚不确定 ; of doubtful value｜价值存疑的
tip_zh: 人作主语常用 doubtful about；也可用 doubtful whether。

meanings_zh: v. 区分；辨别 | v. 成为…的特征；使有别于 | v. 看清；听出
definition_en: to recognize the difference between people or things | to make someone or something different from others | to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to distinguish between.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须区分两者。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to distinguish between.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们区分两者。
collocations: distinguish between｜区分两者 ; distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开 ; distinguish yourself｜使自己出众
tip_zh: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 药物；药物治疗
definition_en: Medicine used to treat illness, or treatment using medicine.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about prescribe medication.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于开药的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used prescribe medication to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用开药来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: take medication｜服药 ; prescribe medication｜开药 ; be on medication｜正在接受药物治疗
tip_zh: 泛指药物多不可数；具体多种药可用medications。

meanings_zh: n. 杂草 | v. 除草
definition_en: A plant growing where it is not wanted. | To remove unwanted plants from an area.
example1_en: The textbook introduces weed control in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了杂草防治。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss weed control.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论杂草防治的材料。
collocations: pull up weeds｜拔除杂草 ; weed the garden｜给花园除草 ; weed control｜杂草防治 ; weed out｜剔除
tip_zh: weed out可比喻剔除不合适的人或事物。

meanings_zh: n. 偶像；崇拜对象 | n. 神像
definition_en: someone greatly admired and often imitated | an image or object worshipped as a god
example1_en: I copied a sporting idol into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把体育偶像抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a sporting idol.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论体育偶像的材料。
collocations: a sporting idol｜体育偶像 ; a pop idol｜流行乐偶像 ; worship an idol｜崇拜神像
tip_zh: idol是偶像；idle是空闲的，两词发音相同。

meanings_zh: n. 州长；总督 | n. 机构主管；学校董事
definition_en: the official leader of a state or territory | someone who manages an institution or helps direct its policies
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about state governor.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于州长的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of state governor.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得州长这个例子。
collocations: state governor｜州长 ; school governor｜学校董事 ; prison governor｜监狱长 ; central bank governor｜中央银行行长
tip_zh: 具体职位看搭配：school governor指学校董事。

meanings_zh: n. 有孔小珠；珠子 | n. 小滴；水珠
definition_en: A small pierced ball used in jewellery or decoration. | A small round drop of liquid.
example1_en: I copied a bead of sweat into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把一滴汗珠抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a bead of sweat when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一滴汗珠。
collocations: glass beads｜玻璃珠 ; string beads｜把珠子串起来 ; a bead of sweat｜一滴汗珠
tip_zh: 液滴义常用a bead of sweat，指一滴汗。

meanings_zh: n. 反义词
definition_en: a word whose meaning is opposite to another word's
example1_en: The textbook introduces an antonym of in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了……的反义词。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of an antonym of.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得……的反义词这个例子。
collocations: an antonym of｜……的反义词 ; a pair of antonyms｜一对反义词
tip_zh: 常用an antonym of；synonym表示同义词。

meanings_zh: adj. 依赖的；依靠的 | adj. 取决于…的
definition_en: Needing someone or something for support or survival. | Decided or affected by a particular condition or factor.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about financially dependent.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于经济上依赖的的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of financially dependent.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得经济上依赖的这个例子。
collocations: dependent on｜依赖；取决于 ; financially dependent｜经济上依赖的 ; heavily dependent on｜严重依赖 ; dependent children｜需抚养的子女
tip_zh: 常接on；英式名词“受抚养者”通常拼作dependant。

meanings_zh: n. 空气湿度
definition_en: The amount of water vapour in the air
example1_en: Office hours began with high humidity.
example1_zh: 答疑从高湿度开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of high humidity.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得高湿度这个例子。
collocations: high humidity｜高湿度 ; relative humidity｜相对湿度 ; humidity levels｜湿度水平 ; low humidity｜低湿度
tip_zh: 通常不可数；湿度高低用high或low。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性；概率
definition_en: how likely something is to happen
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on high probability.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论很大的可能性。
example2_en: The reading connects high probability with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把很大的可能性和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: high probability｜很大的可能性 ; probability of success｜成功的概率 ; in all probability｜十有八九 ; probability theory｜概率论
tip_zh: 常接of加名词或动名词；也可接that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 减半 | v. 把…分成两半
definition_en: To reduce something to half its original amount. | To divide something into two equal parts.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer halve the cost during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时将成本减半。
example2_en: The reading asks you to halve the cost and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你将成本减半，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: halve the cost｜将成本减半 ; halve emissions｜将排放量减半 ; halve a lemon｜把柠檬切成两半
tip_zh: halve是动词，half可作名词；halve中的l不发音。

meanings_zh: n. 治疗；疗法
definition_en: Treatment intended to improve physical or mental health.
example1_en: I copied speech therapy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把言语治疗抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of speech therapy.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得言语治疗这个例子。
collocations: speech therapy｜言语治疗 ; physical therapy｜物理治疗 ; undergo therapy｜接受治疗 ; psychological therapy｜心理治疗
tip_zh: 泛指治疗通常不可数；具体疗法可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 麻雀
definition_en: A small brownish bird often found near people's homes
example1_en: Our professor circled house sparrow on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了家麻雀。
example2_en: The reading connects house sparrow with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把家麻雀和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a flock of sparrows｜一群麻雀 ; house sparrow｜家麻雀 ; tree sparrow｜树麻雀
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数直接加s；不泛指所有小鸟。

meanings_zh: n. 护理；护理职业
definition_en: The work of caring for people who are ill or injured.
example1_en: Office hours began with nursing care.
example1_zh: 答疑从护理服务开始。
example2_en: The reading connects nursing care with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把护理服务和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: nursing care｜护理服务 ; a nursing home｜养老护理院 ; nursing staff｜护理人员 ; a nursing degree｜护理学学位
tip_zh: nursing作护理专业或职业名时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 说服；劝说 | n. 信仰；派别
definition_en: The process of getting someone to agree or do something. | A particular religious or political belief or group.
example1_en: I copied powers of persuasion into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把说服能力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss powers of persuasion.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论说服能力的材料。
collocations: powers of persuasion｜说服能力 ; gentle persuasion｜温和的劝说 ; political persuasion｜政治信仰
tip_zh: 表示劝说时通常不可数；动词是persuade。

meanings_zh: n. 机制；运作方式 | n. 机械装置；机械结构
definition_en: a process or system through which something works or happens | a set of connected parts that performs a particular function
example1_en: Our professor circled coping mechanism on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了应对机制。
example2_en: The author returns to coping mechanism when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了应对机制。
collocations: coping mechanism｜应对机制 ; defence mechanism｜防御机制 ; monitoring mechanism｜监督机制 ; locking mechanism｜锁定装置
tip_zh: mechanism for doing表示“做某事的机制或办法”。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；作用 | n. 撞击；冲击 | v. 影响
definition_en: a strong effect on someone or something | the force or action of one object hitting another | to affect someone or something, often strongly
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on environmental impact.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论环境影响。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of environmental impact.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得环境影响这个例子。
collocations: have an impact on｜对……有影响 ; environmental impact｜环境影响 ; on impact｜在撞击时 ; impact on communities｜影响社区
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词通常读/ɪmˈpækt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 正在进行的；持续的
definition_en: Continuing to happen or develop, rather than being finished.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about ongoing research.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于持续进行的研究的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around ongoing research.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕持续进行的研究展开说明。
collocations: ongoing research｜持续进行的研究 ; an ongoing process｜持续的过程 ; ongoing support｜持续的支持 ; an ongoing investigation｜正在进行的调查
tip_zh: 强调尚在持续，不等于即将发生的upcoming。

meanings_zh: n. 哲学家
definition_en: Someone who studies fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, and values.
example1_en: The textbook introduces moral philosopher in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了伦理哲学家。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of moral philosopher.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得伦理哲学家这个例子。
collocations: moral philosopher｜伦理哲学家 ; political philosopher｜政治哲学家 ; ancient philosopher｜古代哲学家
tip_zh: philosopher指人，philosophy指哲学或理念。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何…的人；无论谁 | pron. 究竟是谁
definition_en: any person who, or no matter which person | used in questions to express surprise about someone's identity
example1_en: Office hours began with whoever you are.
example1_zh: 答疑从无论你是谁开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around whoever you are.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕无论你是谁展开说明。
collocations: whoever you are｜无论你是谁 ; whoever wants to｜任何想要…的人 ; whoever is responsible｜任何负有责任的人
tip_zh: 可引导名词性或让步从句；并非所有场合都能换成no matter who。

meanings_zh: adj. 真正的；正宗的 | adj. 真实可信的
definition_en: Genuine or traditional, rather than copied or invented | Accurately representing real events, experiences, or conditions
example1_en: Our professor circled authentic cuisine on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了正宗菜肴。
example2_en: A campus survey used authentic cuisine to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用正宗菜肴来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: authentic cuisine｜正宗菜肴 ; authentic experience｜真实体验 ; authentic account｜真实可信的叙述
tip_zh: authentic强调真品或正宗，不只表示事实正确。

meanings_zh: v. 使烦躁；惹恼 | v. 刺激；使不适
definition_en: To make someone feel annoyed or impatient. | To make skin or another body part sore or uncomfortable.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to irritate the skin.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求刺激皮肤。
example2_en: The passage says students who can irritate the skin follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够刺激皮肤的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: irritate the skin｜刺激皮肤 ; irritate the eyes｜刺激眼睛 ; really irritate someone｜着实惹恼某人
tip_zh: irritated形容人感到烦躁；irritating形容事物烦人。

meanings_zh: n. 真空；空缺 | n. 真空吸尘器 | v. 用吸尘器清扫
definition_en: A space without air, or a gap left by something missing. | An electric machine that sucks up dust and dirt. | To clean something using a vacuum cleaner.
example1_en: Office hours began with a political vacuum.
example1_zh: 答疑从政治真空开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a political vacuum.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论政治真空的材料。
collocations: vacuum cleaner｜真空吸尘器 ; a political vacuum｜政治真空 ; vacuum the carpet｜用吸尘器清扫地毯
tip_zh: 表示清扫时可直接作动词：vacuum the floor。

meanings_zh: adj. 担心的；忧虑的 | adj. 有关的；涉及的 | adj. 关注的；以…为内容的
definition_en: Worried about someone or something. | Involved in or affected by a particular matter. | Interested in or dealing with a particular subject.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the people concerned in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了相关人员。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of the people concerned.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得相关人员这个例子。
collocations: concerned about｜担心 ; the people concerned｜相关人员 ; concerned with｜涉及；关注 ; as far as I am concerned｜就我而言
tip_zh: about常接担忧对象；with常接涉及的主题。

meanings_zh: adv. 真诚地；由衷地
definition_en: In a way that expresses what you genuinely feel.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to sincerely hope.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习由衷希望。
example2_en: Students who sincerely hope are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够由衷希望的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: sincerely hope｜由衷希望 ; sincerely apologise｜真诚道歉 ; sincerely believe｜真心相信 ; Yours sincerely｜谨上
tip_zh: 英式书信称呼已知姓名者，结尾常用Yours sincerely。

meanings_zh: n. 范围；涉及面 | n. 机会；发挥余地
definition_en: The range of subjects or activities that something covers. | The opportunity or freedom to do or develop something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on scope for improvement.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论改进空间。
example2_en: The reading connects scope for improvement with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把改进空间和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: scope of the study｜研究范围 ; beyond the scope of｜超出……的范围 ; scope for improvement｜改进空间 ; broaden the scope｜扩大范围
tip_zh: 范围用scope of；做某事的余地用scope for。

meanings_zh: n. 物理学家
definition_en: A scientist who studies matter, energy, and their interactions.
example1_en: Our professor circled theoretical physicist on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了理论物理学家。
example2_en: The author returns to theoretical physicist when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了理论物理学家。
collocations: theoretical physicist｜理论物理学家 ; nuclear physicist｜核物理学家 ; experimental physicist｜实验物理学家
tip_zh: physicist是物理学家；physician是医生。

meanings_zh: n. 赞助者；赞助机构 | v. 赞助；资助
definition_en: A person or organisation providing support, often in return for publicity. | To support a person, event, or activity financially.
example1_en: Office hours began with a corporate sponsor.
example1_zh: 答疑从企业赞助商开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a corporate sponsor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了企业赞助商。
collocations: a corporate sponsor｜企业赞助商 ; the main sponsor｜主要赞助方 ; sponsor an event｜赞助活动 ; sponsor a team｜赞助队伍
tip_zh: sponsor可作名词或动词；赞助行为用sponsorship。

meanings_zh: n. 偏见；成见 | v. 使有偏见；损害
definition_en: An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge or experience. | To unfairly influence someone's judgement or harm their chances.
example1_en: Office hours began with racial prejudice.
example1_zh: 答疑从种族偏见开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around racial prejudice.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕种族偏见展开说明。
collocations: racial prejudice｜种族偏见 ; prejudice against｜对……的偏见 ; challenge prejudice｜质疑并反对偏见 ; prejudice someone's chances｜损害某人的机会
tip_zh: 表示对某群体的偏见，常用prejudice against。

meanings_zh: adj. 可耻的；丢脸的
definition_en: So bad or unacceptable that it deserves strong disapproval.
example1_en: Our professor circled absolutely disgraceful on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了极其可耻。
example2_en: A campus survey used absolutely disgraceful to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用极其可耻来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: disgraceful behaviour｜可耻的行为 ; disgraceful treatment｜令人愤慨的对待 ; absolutely disgraceful｜极其可耻
tip_zh: 表示强烈谴责；“名誉扫地的”常用disgraced。

meanings_zh: adj. 悲惨的；令人悲痛的 | adj. 悲剧的
definition_en: Causing deep sadness, especially through death or serious suffering. | Relating to a serious play or story with an unhappy ending.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a tragic accident.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于惨痛的事故的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a tragic accident when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了惨痛的事故。
collocations: a tragic accident｜惨痛的事故 ; a tragic loss｜令人悲痛的损失 ; a tragic ending｜悲剧结局 ; a tragic hero｜悲剧主角
tip_zh: 比sad程度更重，常涉及死亡或严重不幸。

meanings_zh: n. 缺点；不利因素
definition_en: A disadvantage that makes something less useful or attractive
example1_en: Office hours began with a major drawback.
example1_zh: 答疑从主要缺点开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a major drawback.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕主要缺点展开说明。
collocations: a major drawback｜主要缺点 ; the main drawback｜最大的弊端 ; a drawback of｜……的缺点
tip_zh: 可数名词，常用a drawback of加名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 专门从事；专攻
definition_en: to focus on a particular subject, activity, or service
example1_en: I heard the lecturer specialize in medicine during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时专攻医学。
example2_en: The reading asks you to specialize in medicine and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你专攻医学，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: specialize in medicine｜专攻医学 ; specialize in repairing cars｜专门修理汽车 ; highly specialized skills｜高度专业化的技能
tip_zh: 常用specialize in；英式也常拼作specialise。

meanings_zh: n. 收入；收益
definition_en: Money a government or organization receives.
example1_en: Ticket sales are a small part of the museum's revenue.
example1_zh: 门票只占博物馆收入的一小部分。
example2_en: The case study separates revenue from profit so students do not treat them as the same number.
example2_zh: 案例研究把收入和利润分开，以免学生把它们当成同一个数字。
collocations: tax revenue｜税收 ; annual revenue｜年收入
tip_zh: 收入是 revenue，利润是 profit。美式读音更接近 /ˈrevənuː/。

meanings_zh: adj. 灵活的；可调整的 | adj. 柔韧的；易弯曲的
definition_en: able to change to suit different needs or situations | able to bend easily without breaking
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about flexible working hours.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于弹性工作时间的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to flexible working hours when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了弹性工作时间。
collocations: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间 ; a flexible approach｜灵活的方法 ; flexible materials｜柔性材料
tip_zh: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

meanings_zh: n. 芽；花蕾 | v. 发芽；长出花蕾
definition_en: a small growth that develops into a leaf or flower | to produce new buds
example1_en: I copied a flower bud into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把花蕾抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a flower bud with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把花蕾和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a flower bud｜花蕾 ; a leaf bud｜叶芽 ; in bud｜含苞待放 ; nip something in the bud｜将某事扼杀在萌芽中
tip_zh: 动词过去式budded，现在分词budding，双写d。

meanings_zh: v. 低估；小看 | n. 偏低的估计
definition_en: To judge something as less important, capable, or large than reality | An estimate that is lower than the actual amount
example1_en: The professor asked us to underestimate the cost.
example1_zh: 教授让我们低估成本。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to underestimate the cost.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来低估成本。
collocations: underestimate the cost｜低估成本 ; underestimate the importance of｜低估……的重要性 ; seriously underestimate｜严重低估
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/ meɪt /，名词末尾读/ mət /。

meanings_zh: n. 旋转；转动 | n. 轮换；轮作
definition_en: Movement around a central point or axis | The regular replacement of one thing or person by another
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the Earth's rotation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于地球自转的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the Earth's rotation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕地球自转展开说明。
collocations: the Earth's rotation｜地球自转 ; crop rotation｜作物轮作 ; job rotation｜岗位轮换 ; in rotation｜轮流
tip_zh: rotation 可指绕轴旋转，也可指按顺序轮换。

meanings_zh: n. 满意；满足 | n. 满足；履行
definition_en: Pleasure felt when needs, wishes, or expectations are fulfilled. | The act of meeting a need, demand, or requirement.
example1_en: Our professor circled job satisfaction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了工作满意度。
example2_en: The author returns to job satisfaction when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了工作满意度。
collocations: job satisfaction｜工作满意度 ; customer satisfaction｜顾客满意度 ; a sense of satisfaction｜满足感 ; the satisfaction of basic needs｜基本需求的满足
tip_zh: 通常不可数；满意某事常说satisfaction with。

meanings_zh: n. 杂技演员
definition_en: A performer who does difficult balancing, jumping, or gymnastic movements.
example1_en: The textbook introduces skilled acrobat in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了技艺娴熟的杂技演员。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of skilled acrobat.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得技艺娴熟的杂技演员这个例子。
collocations: skilled acrobat｜技艺娴熟的杂技演员 ; circus acrobat｜马戏团杂技演员 ; professional acrobat｜职业杂技演员
tip_zh: acrobat指演员；acrobatics指杂技表演或技巧。

meanings_zh: n. 焦虑；担忧
definition_en: Worry or nervousness about something uncertain or threatening.
example1_en: Office hours began with reduce anxiety.
example1_zh: 答疑从减轻焦虑开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used reduce anxiety to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用减轻焦虑来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: anxiety about｜对……的焦虑 ; reduce anxiety｜减轻焦虑 ; severe anxiety｜严重焦虑
tip_zh: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

meanings_zh: n. 投入；奉献精神 | n. 承诺；保证 | n. 必须履行的责任
definition_en: A strong willingness to give time and effort to something. | A firm promise to do something. | A duty or arrangement requiring your time, money, or attention.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about long-term commitment.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于长期投入的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of long-term commitment.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得长期投入这个例子。
collocations: commitment to a cause｜对事业的投入 ; make a commitment｜作出承诺 ; family commitments｜家庭责任 ; long-term commitment｜长期投入
tip_zh: commitment to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 女主席；女董事长
definition_en: A woman who leads a meeting, committee, or organisation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on committee chairwoman.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论委员会女主席。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss committee chairwoman.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论委员会女主席的材料。
collocations: chairwoman of the board｜董事会女主席 ; committee chairwoman｜委员会女主席 ; appoint a chairwoman｜任命女主席
tip_zh: 复数为chairwomen；不强调性别可用chair。

meanings_zh: n. 导航；航行 | n. 网站或应用的浏览操作
definition_en: Finding and following a route to a destination. | Moving between pages or sections of a website or application.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on satellite navigation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论卫星导航。
example2_en: The author returns to satellite navigation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了卫星导航。
collocations: satellite navigation｜卫星导航 ; a navigation system｜导航系统 ; website navigation｜网站导航
tip_zh: 不仅指航海，也用于道路导航和网页浏览。

meanings_zh: adj. 更可取的；更合意的
definition_en: Better or more suitable than another option.
example1_en: I copied far preferable into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把好得多的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of far preferable.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得好得多的这个例子。
collocations: preferable to｜比……更可取 ; far preferable｜好得多的 ; a preferable alternative｜更可取的替代方案
tip_zh: 用A is preferable to B，不用than；通常不加more。

meanings_zh: v. 联想；联系 | n. 同事；业务伙伴 | adj. 副的；准的
definition_en: to connect people or things in your mind | someone connected with you through work or business | having a related position, often below the main or full rank
example1_en: The assignment is to associate A with B, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先把A与B联系起来，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to associate A with B.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们把A与B联系起来。
collocations: associate A with B｜把A与B联系起来 ; be associated with｜与……有关 ; business associate｜业务伙伴 ; associate professor｜副教授
tip_zh: 动词尾音/eɪt/；名词、形容词尾音/ət/。

meanings_zh: adj. 过量的；过度的
definition_en: Greater than is necessary, reasonable, or acceptable.
example1_en: Office hours began with excessive consumption.
example1_zh: 答疑从过度消费开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around excessive consumption.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕过度消费展开说明。
collocations: excessive consumption｜过度消费 ; excessive pressure｜过大压力 ; excessive noise｜过大噪声 ; excessive use of｜过度使用
tip_zh: 含超过合理限度之意，不等于extra（额外的）。

meanings_zh: v. 明确说明；具体指定
definition_en: To state exactly what is required or meant.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to specify requirements.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求明确要求。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to specify requirements.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们明确要求。
collocations: specify requirements｜明确要求 ; specify a date｜指定日期 ; specify conditions｜明确条件
tip_zh: 可接名词、that从句或疑问词引导的从句。

meanings_zh: n. 加班时间；加班费 | adv. 加班地 | n. 加时赛
definition_en: Extra working hours, or the money paid for them. | For longer than the usual working hours. | Additional playing time used to decide a tied game.
example1_en: I copied unpaid overtime into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把无偿加班抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to unpaid overtime when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了无偿加班。
collocations: work overtime｜加班 ; overtime pay｜加班费 ; unpaid overtime｜无偿加班 ; mandatory overtime｜强制加班
tip_zh: 加班用work overtime；over time意为随着时间推移。

meanings_zh: v. 欺骗；蒙骗
definition_en: to deliberately make someone believe something that is not true
example1_en: The professor asked us to deceive yourself.
example1_zh: 教授让我们自欺。
example2_en: The passage says students who can deceive yourself follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够自欺的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: deceive someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; deceive yourself｜自欺 ; deliberately deceive｜故意欺骗
tip_zh: deceive sb into doing sth表示骗某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 局限；不足 | n. 限制；限额
definition_en: a weakness that prevents someone or something from being fully effective | a rule or condition that controls how much is allowed
example1_en: The professor explained limitation with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了局限。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses limitation when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了局限。
collocations: limitations of a study｜研究的局限性 ; place limitations on｜对……加以限制 ; budget limitations｜预算限制 ; recognise your limitations｜认识自身的局限
tip_zh: “局限性”常用复数；对……的限制用limitation on。

meanings_zh: n. 冲突；争执 | n. 矛盾；抵触 | v. 相冲突；相抵触
definition_en: A serious disagreement or struggle between people or groups. | A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree. | To disagree with or be incompatible with something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces conflict with in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了与……相抵触。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around conflict with.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕与……相抵触展开说明。
collocations: resolve a conflict｜解决冲突 ; conflict with｜与……相抵触 ; a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 准时的；守时的
definition_en: Arriving or happening at the agreed or expected time
example1_en: The textbook introduces a punctual arrival in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了准时到达。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a punctual arrival.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论准时到达的材料。
collocations: be punctual for｜准时参加 ; a punctual arrival｜准时到达 ; punctual service｜准点服务
tip_zh: 表示准时参加会议，用be punctual for a meeting。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜悦的；令人高兴的
definition_en: Feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness.
example1_en: I copied a joyful occasion into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把喜庆的场合抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a joyful occasion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了喜庆的场合。
collocations: a joyful occasion｜喜庆的场合 ; joyful laughter｜欢快的笑声 ; a joyful reunion｜欢乐的重聚
tip_zh: 比happy更强调强烈喜悦，也可形容场合。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚拟的；通过网络进行的 | adj. 事实上的；几乎完全的
definition_en: Created by computers or experienced through an online connection. | Almost complete or effectively true, though not officially so.
example1_en: The textbook introduces virtual reality in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了虚拟现实。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss virtual reality.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论虚拟现实的材料。
collocations: virtual reality｜虚拟现实 ; virtual classroom｜虚拟课堂 ; virtual tour｜虚拟游览 ; a virtual monopoly｜事实上的垄断
tip_zh: virtual不只指电脑虚拟，也可表示事实上的、近乎的。

meanings_zh: n. 处理；管理；应对 | n. 搬运；用手操作 | n. 车辆操控性能
definition_en: The way someone deals with a situation, task, or person. | The act of moving, holding, or touching something. | How easily a vehicle responds to its driver's control.
example1_en: Our professor circled safe handling on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全操作。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of safe handling.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得安全操作这个例子。
collocations: handling of complaints｜投诉处理 ; safe handling｜安全操作 ; manual handling｜人工搬运 ; handling charges｜手续费
tip_zh: 表示处理方式时，常用handling of加所处理的事物。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；由此 | adv. 从现在起；之后
definition_en: For this reason; as a result | After a stated period measured from now
example1_en: Hence, the class checked the chart a second time.
example1_zh: 因此，全班又核对了一次图表。
example2_en: Hence, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
example2_zh: 因此，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。
collocations: hence the need for｜因此需要 ; hence the importance of｜由此可见……的重要性 ; years hence｜若干年后
tip_zh: 正式用语；表示“因此”时，后面也可直接接名词短语。

meanings_zh: v. 深爱；非常喜爱
definition_en: to love someone or like something very much
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to adore doing something.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须非常喜欢做某事。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to adore doing something.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得非常喜欢做某事。
collocations: absolutely adore｜极其喜爱 ; adore doing something｜非常喜欢做某事 ; adore someone｜深爱某人
tip_zh: 语气比like强；后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

meanings_zh: v. 使沮丧；使懊恼 | v. 阻挠；挫败
definition_en: Make someone annoyed because they cannot achieve what they want. | Prevent a plan or effort from succeeding.
example1_en: The professor asked us to frustrate efforts.
example1_zh: 教授让我们阻挠努力。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to frustrate efforts.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们阻挠努力。
collocations: frustrate efforts｜阻挠努力 ; frustrate a plan｜挫败计划 ; deeply frustrated｜极度沮丧的
tip_zh: 人感到沮丧用 frustrated；事情令人沮丧用 frustrating。

meanings_zh: n. 感染；传染病
definition_en: a condition caused by harmful organisms entering the body
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about prevent infection.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于预防感染的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects prevent infection with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把预防感染和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: prevent infection｜预防感染 ; risk of infection｜感染风险 ; bacterial infection｜细菌感染 ; spread of infection｜感染的传播
tip_zh: infection既可指感染过程，也可指一次具体感染。

meanings_zh: v. 合作；协作 | v. 配合；协助
definition_en: to work together to achieve a shared aim | to help by doing what someone asks
example1_en: I heard the lecturer cooperate with during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时与……合作；配合……。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to cooperate with.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与……合作；配合……。
collocations: cooperate with｜与……合作；配合…… ; cooperate on a project｜在项目上合作 ; cooperate closely｜密切合作
tip_zh: 不及物：与人合作用with，就某事合作用on。

meanings_zh: n. 罢工 | v. 击打；撞击 | v. 突然想到；给……印象
definition_en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions | hit someone or something with force | occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression
example1_en: After the lecture, we used strike in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了罢工。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses strike when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了罢工。
collocations: go on strike｜举行罢工 ; be on strike｜正在罢工 ; strike a balance｜取得平衡 ; strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip_zh: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

meanings_zh: n. 性别 | n. 语法性
definition_en: Being male, female, or another identity, especially socially and culturally. | A grammatical class of nouns affecting related word forms.
example1_en: I copied gender equality into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把性别平等抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects gender equality with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把性别平等和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: gender equality｜性别平等 ; gender roles｜性别角色 ; gender identity｜性别认同 ; gender gap｜性别差距
tip_zh: gender常侧重社会性别；sex常侧重生理性别。

meanings_zh: n. 航天器；宇宙飞船
definition_en: A vehicle designed to travel or operate in space.
example1_en: Office hours began with unmanned spacecraft.
example1_zh: 答疑从无人航天器开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around unmanned spacecraft.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕无人航天器展开说明。
collocations: launch a spacecraft｜发射航天器 ; unmanned spacecraft｜无人航天器 ; reusable spacecraft｜可重复使用的航天器
tip_zh: 单复数同形：one spacecraft，two spacecraft。

meanings_zh: adj. 背阴的；成荫的 | adj. 可疑的；不正当的
definition_en: Protected from direct sunlight by trees or other objects. | Seeming dishonest or possibly involved in illegal activities.
example1_en: Our professor circled shady spot on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了阴凉处。
example2_en: A campus survey used shady spot to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用阴凉处来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: shady spot｜阴凉处 ; shady dealings｜不正当交易 ; shady character｜可疑人物
tip_zh: shady指背阴或可疑；shadowy多指昏暗、模糊。

meanings_zh: n. 学士 | n. 未婚男子；单身汉
definition_en: Someone awarded a first university degree | A man who has never married
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about eligible bachelor.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于条件优越的未婚男子的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used eligible bachelor to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用条件优越的未婚男子来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; Bachelor of Arts｜文学学士 ; Bachelor of Science｜理学学士 ; eligible bachelor｜条件优越的未婚男子
tip_zh: 学士学位写作bachelor's degree，注意所有格。

meanings_zh: n. 疫苗接种
definition_en: Giving a vaccine to help protect someone against disease
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a vaccination programme.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论疫苗接种计划。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a vaccination programme.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论疫苗接种计划的材料。
collocations: a vaccination programme｜疫苗接种计划 ; vaccination against flu｜流感疫苗接种 ; vaccination coverage｜疫苗接种覆盖率
tip_zh: 接种以预防某病用vaccination against。

meanings_zh: n. 记笔记
definition_en: the activity of writing down important information while listening or reading
example1_en: After the lecture, we used note-taking in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了记笔记。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses note-taking when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了记笔记。
collocations: note-taking skills｜记笔记的技巧 ; effective note-taking｜有效记笔记 ; note-taking strategies｜记笔记的策略
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词短语用take notes。

meanings_zh: n. 民主；民主政体 | n. 民主国家
definition_en: A system of government in which people choose their leaders. | A country governed through representatives elected by its people.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on parliamentary democracy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论议会民主制。
example2_en: The reading connects parliamentary democracy with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把议会民主制和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: parliamentary democracy｜议会民主制 ; representative democracy｜代议民主制 ; strengthen democracy｜加强民主制度
tip_zh: 指制度通常不可数；指民主国家可数。

meanings_zh: n. 混乱；无秩序状态
definition_en: a state of complete confusion and lack of order
example1_en: Office hours began with complete chaos.
example1_zh: 答疑从彻底混乱开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around complete chaos.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕彻底混乱展开说明。
collocations: in chaos｜处于混乱中 ; cause chaos｜造成混乱 ; complete chaos｜彻底混乱 ; traffic chaos｜交通混乱
tip_zh: 不可数名词；ch发/k/，不是/tʃ/。

meanings_zh: n. 磁铁；磁体 | n. 有吸引力的人或事物
definition_en: an object that attracts iron and certain other metals | a person or thing that strongly attracts people or attention
example1_en: Office hours began with fridge magnet.
example1_zh: 答疑从冰箱贴开始。
example2_en: The author returns to fridge magnet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了冰箱贴。
collocations: fridge magnet｜冰箱贴 ; a powerful magnet｜强力磁铁 ; a magnet for tourists｜吸引游客的地方
tip_zh: 比喻吸引某类人时常用a magnet for。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂精密的；先进的 | adj. 见多识广的；品位高雅的
definition_en: highly developed and involving complex methods or technology | knowledgeable about culture and confident in social situations
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about sophisticated technology.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于先进技术的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sophisticated technology.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论先进技术的材料。
collocations: sophisticated technology｜先进技术 ; sophisticated equipment｜精密设备 ; sophisticated analysis｜精细深入的分析
tip_zh: 形容设备指精密先进；形容人可指见多识广。

meanings_zh: adj. 药草的；香草制的
definition_en: Relating to herbs or made from them.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on herbal tea.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论花草茶。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of herbal tea.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得花草茶这个例子。
collocations: herbal tea｜花草茶 ; herbal medicine｜草药 ; herbal remedy｜草药疗法
tip_zh: 英式发音读出h，美式通常不读h。

meanings_zh: adj. 手工的；手动的 | adj. 体力劳动的 | n. 使用手册；指南
definition_en: Done by hand or operated by a person, not automatically. | Involving physical work rather than mainly mental work. | A book giving instructions for using or doing something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about instruction manual.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于使用说明书的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to instruction manual when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了使用说明书。
collocations: manual labour｜体力劳动 ; manual control｜手动控制 ; instruction manual｜使用说明书 ; user manual｜用户手册
tip_zh: 作形容词指手动或体力的；作名词指手册。

meanings_zh: n. 专业知识；专门技能
definition_en: Specialist knowledge or skills gained through training and experience.
example1_en: The textbook introduces technical expertise in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了技术专长。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss technical expertise.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论技术专长的材料。
collocations: technical expertise｜技术专长 ; expertise in｜在某方面的专长 ; develop expertise｜培养专业技能 ; draw on expertise｜利用专业知识
tip_zh: 不可数；某领域的专长用expertise in。

meanings_zh: adj. 竞争激烈的；竞争性的 | adj. 好胜的 | adj. 有竞争力的
definition_en: Involving people or organisations trying to outperform each other. | Strongly wanting to win or be better than others. | As good as or better than what others offer.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly competitive.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论竞争非常激烈的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly competitive.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕竞争非常激烈的展开说明。
collocations: a competitive market｜竞争激烈的市场 ; competitive prices｜有竞争力的价格 ; a competitive advantage｜竞争优势 ; highly competitive｜竞争非常激烈的
tip_zh: 形容人常指好胜；形容价格指有竞争力。

meanings_zh: n. 山顶；顶峰 | n. 峰会；首脑会议
definition_en: The highest point of a mountain. | A meeting between national leaders or other senior officials.
example1_en: I copied a climate summit into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把气候峰会抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a climate summit.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论气候峰会的材料。
collocations: reach the summit｜登上山顶 ; a climate summit｜气候峰会 ; hold a summit｜举行峰会 ; summit talks｜首脑会谈
tip_zh: 山顶常用the summit of；峰会可用a summit。

meanings_zh: n. 精神；意志；气概 | n. 灵魂；幽灵 | n. 烈酒
definition_en: Inner strength, courage, or enthusiasm | A person's soul or a being without a physical body | A strong alcoholic drink made by distillation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about team spirit.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于团队精神的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of team spirit.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得团队精神这个例子。
collocations: team spirit｜团队精神 ; fighting spirit｜斗志 ; in good spirits｜心情愉快 ; a spirit of cooperation｜合作精神
tip_zh: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

meanings_zh: n. 财富；富有 | n. 大量；丰富
definition_en: a large amount of money and valuable possessions | a large supply of something useful or valuable
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on accumulate wealth.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论积累财富。
example2_en: The author returns to accumulate wealth when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了积累财富。
collocations: accumulate wealth｜积累财富 ; distribution of wealth｜财富分配 ; a wealth of experience｜丰富的经验
tip_zh: wealth通常不可数；a wealth of表示大量有价值的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 减少；降低；缩小
definition_en: a decrease in the amount, size, or level of something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a significant reduction.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论显著减少。
example2_en: The author returns to a significant reduction when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了显著减少。
collocations: a reduction in costs｜成本的降低 ; a significant reduction｜显著减少 ; emission reductions｜排放量的减少 ; price reduction｜降价
tip_zh: reduction in接减少的项目，of可接减少的幅度。

meanings_zh: adj. 期中的；任期中段的 | n. 期中考试
definition_en: Happening halfway through an academic term or period in office. | An examination taken halfway through an academic term.
example1_en: The professor explained mid-term with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了期中的。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses mid-term when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了期中的。
collocations: mid-term exam｜期中考试 ; mid-term assessment｜期中测评 ; mid-term elections｜中期选举
tip_zh: 也常写作midterm；作名词指期中考试，多见于美语。

meanings_zh: n. 义务；责任
definition_en: Something you must do for legal or moral reasons
example1_en: Our professor circled legal obligation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了法律义务。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of legal obligation.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得法律义务这个例子。
