collocations: legal obligation｜法律义务 ; moral obligation｜道德义务 ; fulfil an obligation｜履行义务 ; under no obligation｜没有义务
tip_zh: 常用have an obligation to do，表示有义务做。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；把……看作 | n. 尊重；关注 | n. 问候；致意
definition_en: To think of someone or something in a particular way. | Respect for someone or attention to something. | Friendly greetings sent to someone, expressed in the plural.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to regard as.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求把……看作。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to regard as.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们把……看作。
collocations: regard as｜把……看作 ; high regard for｜对……的高度尊重 ; with regard to｜关于 ; send my regards｜代我问好
tip_zh: “把A看作B”用regard A as B，不用to be。

meanings_zh: n. 水分；湿气
definition_en: Small amounts of water in the air or a material
example1_en: Our professor circled retain moisture on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了保持水分。
example2_en: A campus survey used retain moisture to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用保持水分来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: retain moisture｜保持水分 ; absorb moisture｜吸收水分 ; soil moisture｜土壤水分 ; moisture content｜含水量
tip_zh: 不可数；moisture指水分，不等于降雨量。

meanings_zh: adj. 多变的；可变的 | n. 变量；可变因素
definition_en: Likely or able to change rather than remain the same. | A quantity or factor that can take different values.
example1_en: Office hours began with independent variable.
example1_zh: 答疑从自变量开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around independent variable.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕自变量展开说明。
collocations: variable costs｜可变成本 ; variable weather｜多变的天气 ; independent variable｜自变量 ; dependent variable｜因变量
tip_zh: 作形容词指可变的；作可数名词指变量。

meanings_zh: n. 一项统计数据
definition_en: A numerical fact obtained by collecting and examining information.
example1_en: Our professor circled revealing statistic on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了说明问题的统计数据。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around revealing statistic.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕说明问题的统计数据展开说明。
collocations: revealing statistic｜说明问题的统计数据 ; alarming statistic｜令人担忧的统计数据 ; official statistics｜官方统计数据 ; unemployment statistics｜失业统计数据
tip_zh: statistics表数据用复数谓语，表统计学用单数谓语。

meanings_zh: adj. 体贴的；考虑周到的 | adj. 深思的；沉思的
definition_en: showing care for other people's needs and feelings | thinking carefully, or showing careful consideration
example1_en: Our professor circled thoughtful gesture on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了体贴的举动。
example2_en: A campus survey used thoughtful gesture to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用体贴的举动来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: thoughtful gesture｜体贴的举动 ; thoughtful of someone｜某人很体贴 ; thoughtful consideration｜深思熟虑 ; thoughtful expression｜沉思的神情
tip_zh: 体贴用thoughtful of someone；thoughtful不一定表示忧虑。

meanings_zh: v. 使极度害怕
definition_en: To make someone feel extremely frightened.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to terrify someone.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求使某人极度害怕。
example2_en: The reading asks you to terrify someone and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你使某人极度害怕，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: terrify someone｜使某人极度害怕 ; be terrified of｜非常害怕 ; be terrified by｜被……吓坏
tip_zh: 及物动词；terrified形容人，terrifying形容吓人的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 前缀
definition_en: A word part added at the beginning to change meaning.
example1_en: Our professor circled negative prefix on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了否定前缀。
example2_en: The reading connects negative prefix with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把否定前缀和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: negative prefix｜否定前缀 ; add a prefix｜添加前缀 ; common prefixes｜常见前缀
tip_zh: prefix放词首，suffix放词尾；两者统称affix。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性
definition_en: the chance that something will happen
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the likelihood of.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论……的可能性。
example2_en: The author returns to the likelihood of when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了……的可能性。
collocations: the likelihood of｜……的可能性 ; increase the likelihood｜增加可能性 ; reduce the likelihood｜降低可能性 ; in all likelihood｜十有八九
tip_zh: 常用likelihood of doing或likelihood that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 广播；播送 | n. 广播节目；播出
definition_en: To transmit programmes through radio, television, or the internet. | A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to broadcast live.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求现场直播。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to broadcast live.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来现场直播。
collocations: broadcast live｜现场直播 ; news broadcast｜新闻广播 ; broadcast a programme｜播出节目
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

meanings_zh: n. 俚语
definition_en: very informal words used by particular groups of people
example1_en: I copied internet slang into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把网络俚语抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects internet slang with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把网络俚语和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: use slang｜使用俚语 ; a slang term｜一个俚语词 ; internet slang｜网络俚语
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一个俚语表达用a slang term。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；取得
definition_en: To get something, especially through effort or a formal process.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to obtain permission.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须获得许可。
example2_en: The passage says students who can obtain permission follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够获得许可的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: obtain permission｜获得许可 ; obtain information｜获取信息 ; obtain a qualification｜取得资格 ; obtain consent｜取得同意
tip_zh: 比get正式；常用obtain sth from sb或某机构。

meanings_zh: n. 排放物；排放量 | n. 排放；发出
definition_en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas. | The process of releasing gas, heat, light, or other energy.
example1_en: Our professor circled emission standards on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了排放标准。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around emission standards.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕排放标准展开说明。
collocations: carbon emissions｜碳排放 ; exhaust emissions｜尾气排放 ; reduce emissions｜减少排放 ; emission standards｜排放标准
tip_zh: 指废气或排放量常用复数emissions；动词是emit。

meanings_zh: adj. 杰出的；出色的 | adj. 尚未处理的；未偿付的
definition_en: Extremely good and much better than average. | Not yet completed, settled, or paid.
example1_en: Office hours began with outstanding achievement.
example1_zh: 答疑从杰出成就开始。
example2_en: The author returns to outstanding achievement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了杰出成就。
collocations: outstanding achievement｜杰出成就 ; outstanding performance｜出色表现 ; outstanding debt｜未偿债务 ; outstanding issues｜尚未解决的问题
tip_zh: outstanding debt指未偿债务，不是“出色的债务”。

meanings_zh: adj. 邪恶的；恶毒的 | n. 邪恶；罪恶；祸害
definition_en: morally very bad and deliberately causing harm | serious moral wrongdoing or something that causes great harm
example1_en: I copied good and evil into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把善与恶抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss good and evil.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论善与恶的材料。
collocations: good and evil｜善与恶 ; an evil intention｜恶意 ; a necessary evil｜不得已接受的坏事
tip_zh: 比bad语气强得多，通常涉及严重的道德恶行。

meanings_zh: n. 自杀；自杀行为
definition_en: The act of intentionally causing one's own death.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about die by suicide.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于死于自杀的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used die by suicide to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用死于自杀来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: suicide prevention｜自杀预防 ; suicide risk｜自杀风险 ; die by suicide｜死于自杀
tip_zh: 中性表达常用die by suicide，避免污名化。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；查明 | n. 研究；探究
definition_en: a careful effort to discover facts about an event or problem | a systematic study intended to increase knowledge about a subject
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an investigation into.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论对……的调查。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an investigation into.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得对……的调查这个例子。
collocations: conduct an investigation｜开展调查 ; launch an investigation｜启动调查 ; an investigation into｜对……的调查 ; under investigation｜正在接受调查
tip_zh: 调查某事用investigation into；under investigation指正被调查。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；宜人的 | adj. 愿意同意的
definition_en: pleasant and enjoyable | willing to accept or agree to something
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about agreeable weather.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于宜人的天气的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects agreeable weather with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把宜人的天气和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: agreeable weather｜宜人的天气 ; agreeable company｜令人愉快的陪伴 ; agreeable to a proposal｜赞同某项提议
tip_zh: be agreeable to sth表示愿意接受某事，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 百科全书
definition_en: A reference work containing information about many subjects or one field
example1_en: Our professor circled online encyclopaedia on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了在线百科全书。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss online encyclopaedia.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论在线百科全书的材料。
collocations: online encyclopaedia｜在线百科全书 ; an encyclopaedia entry｜一篇百科全书条目 ; consult an encyclopaedia｜查阅百科全书
tip_zh: 英式拼写；美式通常写作encyclopedia。

meanings_zh: v. 用自己的话改述 | n. 改述；释义
definition_en: Express the same meaning using different words. | A version expressing the same meaning in different words.
example1_en: The assignment is to paraphrase a passage, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先改述一段文字，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can paraphrase a passage follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够改述一段文字的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: paraphrase a passage｜改述一段文字 ; accurate paraphrase｜准确的改述 ; paraphrase in your own words｜用自己的话改述
tip_zh: 改述须保留原意；summarize则侧重概括要点。

meanings_zh: n. 联盟；同盟
definition_en: A partnership between groups or countries pursuing shared goals.
example1_en: Office hours began with strategic alliance.
example1_zh: 答疑从战略联盟开始。
example2_en: The reading connects strategic alliance with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把战略联盟和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: form an alliance｜结成联盟 ; strategic alliance｜战略联盟 ; military alliance｜军事同盟
tip_zh: 常用form an alliance with，表示“与……结盟”。

meanings_zh: n. 生态学 | n. 生态；生态关系
definition_en: The study of relationships between living things and their environment. | The relationships between living things and their environment.
example1_en: I copied marine ecology into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把海洋生态学抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects marine ecology with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把海洋生态学和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: marine ecology｜海洋生态学 ; forest ecology｜森林生态学 ; study ecology｜研究生态学
tip_zh: ecology指生态学或生态关系，不等于environment。

meanings_zh: n. 鱼鳍；鳍状物 | n. 潜水脚蹼
definition_en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability | a flat rubber covering worn on a foot for swimming
example1_en: The textbook introduces dorsal fin in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了背鳍。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around dorsal fin.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕背鳍展开说明。
collocations: dorsal fin｜背鳍 ; tail fin｜尾鳍；尾翼 ; shark fin｜鲨鱼鳍 ; diving fins｜潜水脚蹼
tip_zh: 指潜水脚蹼时常用复数fins。

meanings_zh: v. 装备；配备 | v. 使具备知识或能力
definition_en: To provide someone or something with necessary tools or equipment | To give someone the skills or knowledge they need
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to equip students with skills.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使学生掌握技能。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to equip students with skills.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们使学生掌握技能。
collocations: equip something with｜为某物配备 ; equip students with skills｜使学生掌握技能 ; fully equipped kitchen｜设备齐全的厨房
tip_zh: 常用equip A with B；过去式equipped双写p。

meanings_zh: adj. 过时的；陈旧的
definition_en: No longer useful or suitable because things have changed.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about outdated equipment.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于陈旧设备的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around outdated equipment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕陈旧设备展开说明。
collocations: outdated equipment｜陈旧设备 ; outdated information｜过时的信息 ; outdated attitudes｜陈旧观念
tip_zh: 强调因时代变化而不再适用，不只是年代久远。

meanings_zh: n. 树木的花；花簇 | v. 开花 | v. 发展；兴盛
definition_en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush | to produce flowers | to develop successfully or become more confident
example1_en: I copied cherry blossom into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把樱花抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used cherry blossom to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用樱花来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: cherry blossom｜樱花 ; in blossom｜正在开花 ; blossom into｜发展成为
tip_zh: 多指树木的花；blossom into可比喻成长为。

meanings_zh: adj. 有抱负的；雄心勃勃的 | adj. 宏大的；艰巨的
definition_en: strongly wanting to achieve success | requiring considerable effort or resources to succeed
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about highly ambitious.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于极有抱负的的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly ambitious.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕极有抱负的展开说明。
collocations: ambitious goals｜宏大的目标 ; ambitious plan｜雄心勃勃的计划 ; highly ambitious｜极有抱负的 ; ambitious young people｜有抱负的年轻人
tip_zh: 形容人指有抱负；形容计划则强调目标宏大、难度高。

meanings_zh: v. 履行；完成 | v. 满足；符合 | v. 实现
definition_en: to do what a duty, promise, or agreement requires | to provide what is needed or meet a requirement | to achieve something hoped for or develop an ability fully
example1_en: I heard the lecturer fulfil a promise during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时履行承诺。
example2_en: The reading asks you to fulfil a promise and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你履行承诺，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: fulfil a promise｜履行承诺 ; fulfil requirements｜满足要求 ; fulfil your potential｜发挥潜能 ; fulfil a dream｜实现梦想
tip_zh: 英式fulfil，美式fulfill；过去式均为fulfilled。

meanings_zh: n. 专家；专科医生 | adj. 专业的；专门的
definition_en: Someone with detailed knowledge or training in a particular field. | Connected with a particular field requiring special knowledge.
example1_en: Our professor circled a specialist in on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了某领域的专家。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a specialist in.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得某领域的专家这个例子。
collocations: a specialist in｜某领域的专家 ; see a specialist｜看专科医生 ; specialist knowledge｜专业知识 ; specialist training｜专业培训
tip_zh: 名词后接in表示专长领域；形容词常修饰knowledge。

meanings_zh: adj. 致命的 | adj. 毁灭性的；导致失败的
definition_en: Causing someone's death. | Causing something to fail completely.
example1_en: Our professor circled prove fatal on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了最终致命。
example2_en: A campus survey used prove fatal to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用最终致命来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: fatal accident｜致命事故 ; fatal injury｜致命伤 ; fatal flaw｜致命缺陷 ; prove fatal｜最终致命
tip_zh: fatal强调致死或导致失败；fateful指影响重大的。

meanings_zh: n. 小说家
definition_en: A person who writes novels.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on historical novelist.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论历史小说家。
example2_en: A campus survey used historical novelist to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用历史小说家来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: historical novelist｜历史小说家 ; bestselling novelist｜畅销小说作家 ; aspiring novelist｜立志成为小说家的人
tip_zh: novelist通常指长篇小说作家，novel是长篇小说。

meanings_zh: n. 化石
definition_en: Ancient remains or traces of living things preserved in rock.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fossil fuels in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了化石燃料。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕化石燃料展开说明。
collocations: fossil fuels｜化石燃料 ; fossil record｜化石记录 ; fossil evidence｜化石证据
tip_zh: fossil fuels指煤、石油、天然气等化石燃料。

meanings_zh: n. 视力
definition_en: The ability to see
example1_en: The textbook introduces poor eyesight in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了视力差。
example2_en: A campus survey used poor eyesight to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用视力差来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: poor eyesight｜视力差 ; good eyesight｜视力好 ; damage your eyesight｜损害视力
tip_zh: eyesight是不可数名词，不说an eyesight。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；瑕疵 | v. 使有缺陷；损害
definition_en: a fault that makes something imperfect or less effective | to damage something or make it imperfect
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a fundamental flaw.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于根本缺陷的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a fundamental flaw.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论根本缺陷的材料。
collocations: a fundamental flaw｜根本缺陷 ; a design flaw｜设计缺陷 ; a fatal flaw｜致命缺陷 ; a flaw in the argument｜论证中的漏洞
tip_zh: 可数名词；某物的缺陷常用a flaw in sth。

meanings_zh: v. 指示；命令 | v. 教授；指导
definition_en: formally tell someone to do something | teach someone a skill or explain how to do something
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to instruct staff.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须向员工下达指示。
example2_en: The reading asks you to instruct staff and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你向员工下达指示，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: instruct someone to do something｜指示某人做某事 ; instruct someone in something｜教授某人某方面知识 ; instruct staff｜向员工下达指示
tip_zh: instruct sb to do是指示；instruct sb in是教授。

meanings_zh: n. 播音员；现场广播员
definition_en: Someone who presents information on broadcasts or at public events
example1_en: Office hours began with radio announcer.
example1_zh: 答疑从电台播音员开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss radio announcer.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电台播音员的材料。
collocations: radio announcer｜电台播音员 ; television announcer｜电视播音员 ; stadium announcer｜体育场现场广播员
tip_zh: announcer负责播报；journalist侧重新闻采访。

meanings_zh: n. 发票；付款清单 | v. 向……开具发票
definition_en: a document listing goods or services and the payment required | to send someone a document requesting payment for goods or services
example1_en: Our professor circled an outstanding invoice on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了尚未结清的发票。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an outstanding invoice.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论尚未结清的发票的材料。
collocations: issue an invoice｜开具发票 ; pay an invoice｜支付发票款项 ; an outstanding invoice｜尚未结清的发票 ; invoice someone for something｜就某项费用向某人开票
tip_zh: invoice 通常用于要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收据。

meanings_zh: n. 奖学金 | n. 学术研究；学问
definition_en: Money awarded to help someone pay for their studies. | Serious academic study or the knowledge gained through it.
example1_en: Our professor circled full scholarship on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了全额奖学金。
example2_en: A campus survey used full scholarship to explain a pattern in student life.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用全额奖学金来解释校园生活中的一种模式。
collocations: win a scholarship｜获得奖学金 ; full scholarship｜全额奖学金 ; academic scholarship｜学术研究
tip_zh: 指奖学金时可数；指学问或学术研究时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 大众传播媒介；媒体
definition_en: Organisations and channels that provide news and information publicly.
example1_en: Office hours began with mass media.
example1_zh: 答疑从大众传媒开始。
example2_en: The reading connects mass media with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把大众传媒和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: mass media｜大众传媒 ; media coverage｜媒体报道 ; social media｜社交媒体 ; the media｜新闻媒体
tip_zh: 统称新闻媒体常用the media；单一媒介用medium。

meanings_zh: n. 指挥官
definition_en: an officer responsible for directing a military unit or operation
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on military commander.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论军事指挥官。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of military commander.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得军事指挥官这个例子。
collocations: military commander｜军事指挥官 ; naval commander｜海军指挥官 ; commander-in-chief｜总司令
tip_zh: 泛指指挥官；作具体军衔时，级别因国家而异。

meanings_zh: n. 狂怒；暴怒 | n. 猛烈；狂暴
definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of anger. | Extreme force or violence, especially in weather.
example1_en: I copied shake with fury into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把气得发抖抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around shake with fury.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕气得发抖展开说明。
collocations: shake with fury｜气得发抖 ; provoke fury｜激起暴怒 ; the fury of the storm｜风暴的猛烈
tip_zh: 比anger语气强；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。

meanings_zh: adj. 便携式的；轻便的
definition_en: Easy to carry or move from place to place
example1_en: The textbook introduces portable device in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了便携设备。
example2_en: A campus survey used portable device to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用便携设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: portable device｜便携设备 ; portable charger｜便携式充电器 ; portable equipment｜便携式设备
tip_zh: 强调容易携带或移动，不一定能放进口袋。

meanings_zh: n. 君主统治时期 | v. 当政；统治 | v. 盛行；占主导地位
definition_en: the period when a king or queen rules | to rule as a king or queen | to be the strongest or most noticeable condition
example1_en: The textbook introduces a long reign in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了漫长的统治时期。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a long reign.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得漫长的统治时期这个例子。
collocations: during the reign of｜在……统治期间 ; a long reign｜漫长的统治时期 ; reign supreme｜占绝对优势 ; chaos reigns｜混乱笼罩
tip_zh: 与rain同音；reign指统治，rein指缰绳。

meanings_zh: n. 淤青；挫伤 | v. 使淤青；碰伤
definition_en: A dark mark caused by bleeding under the skin. | To injure skin or fruit without breaking its surface.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a nasty bruise.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于严重的淤青的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a nasty bruise with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把严重的淤青和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a nasty bruise｜严重的淤青 ; bruise easily｜容易淤青 ; a bruised knee｜淤青的膝盖
tip_zh: bruise通常不破皮；cut指割破皮肤的伤口。

meanings_zh: n. 使情况复杂的因素；难题 | n. 并发症
definition_en: An extra problem that makes a situation harder to manage | An additional medical problem arising during an illness or treatment
example1_en: Office hours began with an unexpected complication.
example1_zh: 答疑从意外的麻烦开始。
example2_en: The author returns to an unexpected complication when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了意外的麻烦。
collocations: an unexpected complication｜意外的麻烦 ; a serious complication｜严重并发症 ; avoid complications｜避免麻烦或并发症 ; postoperative complications｜术后并发症
tip_zh: 可指数额外难题，也可指疾病或治疗引起的并发症。

meanings_zh: n. 动物的爪；脚掌 | v. 用爪抓挠；用蹄刨
definition_en: the foot of an animal such as a cat or dog | to scratch or touch something repeatedly with a paw or hoof
example1_en: I copied front paw into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把前爪抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used front paw to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用前爪来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: front paw｜前爪 ; paw print｜爪印 ; paw at the door｜用爪子挠门
tip_zh: paw指整个脚掌；claw指尖锐的爪或爪甲。

meanings_zh: n. 基因
definition_en: A unit of inherited information that influences an organism's characteristics
example1_en: Our professor circled gene expression on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基因表达。
example2_en: The reading connects gene expression with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把基因表达和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: gene expression｜基因表达 ; gene therapy｜基因治疗 ; inherit a gene｜遗传某个基因
tip_zh: gene是可数名词；genetics指遗传学。

meanings_zh: n. 人类
definition_en: all human beings considered as one group
example1_en: I copied the future of mankind into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把人类的未来抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the future of mankind.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得人类的未来这个例子。
collocations: the future of mankind｜人类的未来 ; the history of mankind｜人类历史 ; for the benefit of mankind｜为了人类的福祉
tip_zh: 指全人类，不指男性；包容性表达可用humankind。

meanings_zh: adj. 优雅的；姿态优美的
definition_en: Moving or shaped in a smooth, attractive way.
example1_en: I copied graceful movements into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把优雅的动作抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used graceful movements to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用优雅的动作来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: graceful movements｜优雅的动作 ; graceful curves｜优美的曲线 ; a graceful dancer｜舞姿优美的舞者
tip_zh: graceful多形容姿态优美；gracious多指亲切有礼。

meanings_zh: adv. 仔细地；严密地 | adv. 紧密地；密切地 | adv. 近距离地
definition_en: with careful attention to details or changes | with a strong connection or much cooperation | with little space between people or things
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to closely monitor.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习密切监测。
example2_en: Students who closely monitor are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够密切监测的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: closely monitor｜密切监测 ; closely related｜密切相关的 ; work closely with｜与……密切合作 ; look closely｜仔细看
tip_zh: look closely指仔细看；stand close指站得近。

meanings_zh: n. 公式 | n. 方法；配方 | n. 婴儿配方奶
definition_en: a mathematical rule expressed using symbols | a particular method or mixture used to achieve something | specially prepared milk used to feed babies
example1_en: Our professor circled mathematical formula on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数学公式。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of mathematical formula.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得数学公式这个例子。
collocations: mathematical formula｜数学公式 ; formula for success｜成功之道 ; infant formula｜婴儿配方奶
tip_zh: 复数可用formulas或formulae；方法常接for。

meanings_zh: adj. 不合理的；不讲理的 | adj. 过分的；过高的
definition_en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons. | Greater than is fair or acceptable.
example1_en: Our professor circled unreasonable demands on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了过分的要求。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of unreasonable demands.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得过分的要求这个例子。
collocations: unreasonable demands｜过分的要求 ; unreasonable behaviour｜不讲理的行为 ; unreasonable expectations｜不合理的期望
tip_zh: 可形容人不讲理，也可形容要求或价格过分。

meanings_zh: n. 磨坊；磨粉机 | n. 工厂；制造厂 | v. 碾磨；磨成粉
definition_en: a building or machine where grain is ground into flour | a factory that processes materials such as paper or steel | to crush grain or other material into small particles
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about flour mill.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于面粉厂；磨坊的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss flour mill.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论面粉厂；磨坊的材料。
collocations: flour mill｜面粉厂；磨坊 ; steel mill｜钢铁厂 ; paper mill｜造纸厂 ; mill grain｜碾磨谷物
tip_zh: mill多指加工原料的工厂；普通工厂常用factory。

meanings_zh: adj. 压倒性的；极大的 | adj. 令人难以承受的
definition_en: So great or strong that little can oppose it | Too intense or difficult to deal with
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overwhelming majority.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论绝大多数。
example2_en: The author returns to overwhelming majority when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了绝大多数。
collocations: overwhelming majority｜绝大多数 ; overwhelming evidence｜确凿有力的证据 ; overwhelming support｜压倒性的支持 ; overwhelming pressure｜难以承受的压力
tip_zh: 强调程度极大；既可形容支持，也可形容压力。

meanings_zh: n. 部长；大臣 | n. 牧师 | v. 照料；帮助
definition_en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area. | A religious leader in certain Christian churches. | To care for someone or attend to their needs.
example1_en: I copied education minister into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把教育部长抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects education minister with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把教育部长和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: education minister｜教育部长 ; prime minister｜首相；总理 ; a church minister｜教会牧师 ; minister to someone's needs｜照顾某人的需要
tip_zh: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。

meanings_zh: v. 正式禁止 | v. 阻止；使不可能
definition_en: To officially forbid an action through rules or laws. | To prevent something by making it impossible or impractical.
example1_en: The assignment is to prohibit the use of, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先禁止使用，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to prohibit the use of.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们禁止使用。
collocations: strictly prohibit｜严格禁止 ; prohibit someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事 ; prohibit the use of｜禁止使用
tip_zh: 用prohibit doing或prohibit sb from doing。

meanings_zh: n. 水母
definition_en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting
example1_en: Our professor circled a swarm of jellyfish on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一大群水母。
example2_en: The author returns to a swarm of jellyfish when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一大群水母。
collocations: a jellyfish sting｜水母蜇伤 ; a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母 ; jellyfish populations｜水母种群
tip_zh: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

meanings_zh: n. 奇迹；不可思议的事
definition_en: An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a medical miracle.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医学奇迹。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a medical miracle.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕医学奇迹展开说明。
collocations: work miracles｜创造奇迹 ; a medical miracle｜医学奇迹 ; a miracle cure｜神奇疗法
tip_zh: work miracles指创造奇迹，也可夸张表示效果惊人。

meanings_zh: v. 建立；创立 | v. 确立；使获认可 | v. 查明；证实
definition_en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement | to make a position or reputation widely accepted | to discover or prove that something is true
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to establish a business.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须创办企业。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers establish a business before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要创办企业。
collocations: establish a business｜创办企业 ; establish a reputation｜树立声誉 ; establish the facts｜查明事实 ; establish a link｜确立联系
tip_zh: establish是及物动词，后接机构、制度或事实等。

meanings_zh: n. 标准；准则（复数）
definition_en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.
example1_en: Office hours began with selection criteria.
example1_zh: 答疑从筛选标准开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of selection criteria.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得筛选标准这个例子。
collocations: meet the criteria｜符合标准 ; selection criteria｜筛选标准 ; assessment criteria｜评估标准
tip_zh: criteria是复数，单数为criterion；用criteria are。

meanings_zh: v. 交流；互动 | v. 相互作用；相互影响
definition_en: To communicate or do things with other people. | To affect one another when combined or brought together.
example1_en: The assignment is to interact with, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先与……互动，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to interact with.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们与……互动。
collocations: interact with｜与……互动 ; interact socially｜进行社交互动 ; interact with each other｜相互交流
tip_zh: 不及物动词：与某人互动用interact with someone。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷信的
definition_en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on superstitious beliefs.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论迷信观念。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of superstitious beliefs.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得迷信观念这个例子。
collocations: superstitious beliefs｜迷信观念 ; superstitious about｜对……迷信 ; superstitious practices｜迷信做法
tip_zh: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。

meanings_zh: n. 国会；议会 | n. 代表大会；专题会议
definition_en: A national body of representatives that makes laws. | A large formal meeting of representatives or specialists.
example1_en: Office hours began with a national congress.
example1_zh: 答疑从全国代表大会开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a national congress with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把全国代表大会和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a national congress｜全国代表大会 ; an international congress｜国际大会 ; a member of Congress｜国会议员
tip_zh: 特指美国等国家的国会时，通常大写Congress。

meanings_zh: n. 恐慌；惊慌 | v. 惊慌失措；使恐慌
definition_en: sudden strong fear that makes clear thinking difficult | to feel or cause sudden fear and lose calm
example1_en: I copied panic attack into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把惊恐发作抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss panic attack.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论惊恐发作的材料。
collocations: in a panic｜惊慌失措地 ; panic attack｜惊恐发作 ; cause panic｜引发恐慌 ; panic buying｜恐慌性抢购
tip_zh: 过去式panicked、进行式panicking均须在c后加k。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；剧烈的 | adj. 严厉的；苛刻的
definition_en: Very bad, intense, or damaging. | Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.
example1_en: Office hours began with severe pain.
example1_zh: 答疑从剧痛开始。
example2_en: The author returns to severe pain when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧痛。
collocations: severe pain｜剧痛 ; severe weather｜恶劣天气 ; a severe shortage｜严重短缺 ; severe punishment｜严厉惩罚
tip_zh: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

meanings_zh: n. 功能；作用 | v. 运转；发挥作用 | n. 函数
definition_en: The purpose or job of something or someone. | To work or operate in the intended way. | A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.
example1_en: Our professor circled basic function on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基本功能。
example2_en: A campus survey used basic function to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用基本功能来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: perform a function｜发挥作用 ; function properly｜正常运转 ; function as｜起……作用 ; basic function｜基本功能
tip_zh: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

meanings_zh: adv. 想必；据推测
definition_en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to presumably because.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习大概是因为。
example2_en: Students who presumably because are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够大概是因为的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: presumably because｜大概是因为 ; presumably intended to｜想必是为了 ; presumably true｜据推测属实
tip_zh: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

meanings_zh: n. 协调；配合 | n. 身体协调能力
definition_en: Organising people or activities so they work effectively together | The ability to move different body parts smoothly together
example1_en: Our professor circled hand-eye coordination on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了手眼协调能力。
example2_en: The author returns to hand-eye coordination when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了手眼协调能力。
collocations: close coordination｜密切协调 ; coordination between departments｜部门之间的协调 ; hand-eye coordination｜手眼协调能力
tip_zh: 通常不可数；between引出需要协调的双方或多方。

meanings_zh: v. 使感染；传染 | v. 感染；影响情绪
definition_en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection | to spread a feeling or attitude to others
example1_en: I heard the lecturer infect a wound during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使伤口感染。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers infect a wound before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使伤口感染。
collocations: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒 ; become infected｜受到感染 ; infect a wound｜使伤口感染
tip_zh: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

meanings_zh: adj. 深爱的；深受喜爱的 | n. 心爱的人
definition_en: deeply loved by someone or many people | a person whom someone loves deeply
example1_en: The textbook introduces a beloved friend in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了挚爱的朋友。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a beloved friend.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕挚爱的朋友展开说明。
collocations: a beloved friend｜挚爱的朋友 ; a beloved pet｜心爱的宠物 ; a beloved institution｜深受喜爱的机构
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；作名词指爱人，语气较文学化。

meanings_zh: n. 木工活；木工技艺
definition_en: The work or skill of making and repairing wooden structures.
example1_en: The textbook introduces basic carpentry in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了基础木工。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around basic carpentry.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕基础木工展开说明。
collocations: carpentry skills｜木工技能 ; carpentry workshop｜木工车间 ; basic carpentry｜基础木工 ; carpentry tools｜木工工具
tip_zh: carpentry指技艺或工作；carpenter指木匠。

meanings_zh: adj. 不切实际的；不可行的 | adj. 不善处理实际事务的
definition_en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice | Not skilled at handling everyday practical tasks
example1_en: Office hours began with highly impractical.
example1_zh: 答疑从极不实用的开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly impractical.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得极不实用的这个例子。
collocations: an impractical solution｜不切实际的解决办法 ; highly impractical｜极不实用的 ; impractical for everyday use｜不适合日常使用
tip_zh: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。

meanings_zh: adj. 机械的；机器的 | adj. 机械呆板的；无意识的
definition_en: relating to machines or their moving parts | done without thought, interest, or feeling
example1_en: Office hours began with mechanical engineering.
example1_zh: 答疑从机械工程开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used mechanical engineering to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用机械工程来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: mechanical engineering｜机械工程 ; mechanical failure｜机械故障 ; mechanical parts｜机械零件 ; a mechanical response｜机械式的回应
tip_zh: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。

meanings_zh: n. 化合物 | n. 围墙内的场地或建筑群 | v. 加重；使恶化
definition_en: A substance formed from chemically joined elements. | An enclosed area containing buildings. | To make an existing problem or difficulty worse.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on chemical compound.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论化合物。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss chemical compound.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论化合物的材料。
collocations: chemical compound｜化合物 ; compound a problem｜使问题恶化 ; residential compound｜住宅院区 ; compound interest｜复利
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: v. 绑架；劫持
definition_en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive
example1_en: The assignment is to kidnap someone for ransom, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先绑架某人索取赎金，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to kidnap someone for ransom and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你绑架某人索取赎金，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: kidnap someone for ransom｜绑架某人索取赎金 ; a kidnapping victim｜绑架受害者 ; a kidnapping attempt｜绑架企图
tip_zh: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

meanings_zh: adj. 语法的 | adj. 符合语法的
definition_en: relating to the rules for forming words and sentences | following the accepted grammar rules of a language
example1_en: The textbook introduces grammatical accuracy in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了语法准确性。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of grammatical accuracy.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得语法准确性这个例子。
collocations: grammatical accuracy｜语法准确性 ; grammatical errors｜语法错误 ; grammatical structure｜语法结构
tip_zh: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；货品 | v. 推销；促销
definition_en: goods available for sale | to promote goods and encourage people to buy them
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sell merchandise.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论销售商品。
example2_en: A campus survey used sell merchandise to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用销售商品来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: sell merchandise｜销售商品 ; branded merchandise｜品牌商品 ; display merchandise｜陈列商品
tip_zh: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

meanings_zh: adj. 可食用的
definition_en: Safe or suitable to eat.
example1_en: Office hours began with edible plants.
example1_zh: 答疑从可食用植物开始。
example2_en: The reading connects edible plants with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可食用植物和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: edible plants｜可食用植物 ; edible flowers｜可食用花卉 ; edible oil｜食用油
tip_zh: edible表示能吃，不表示美味；勿凭外观判断野生植物。

meanings_zh: v. 扰乱；使中断
definition_en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to disrupt traffic.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求扰乱交通。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to disrupt traffic.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来扰乱交通。
collocations: disrupt traffic｜扰乱交通 ; disrupt services｜使服务中断 ; disrupt sleep｜干扰睡眠 ; disrupt learning｜扰乱学习
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 例子；事例；情况
definition_en: A particular example or occurrence of something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an isolated instance.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论个别事例。
example2_en: The reading connects an isolated instance with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把个别事例和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: for instance｜例如 ; in this instance｜在这种情况下 ; an isolated instance｜个别事例
tip_zh: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

meanings_zh: adj. 受威胁的；濒危的 | adj. 感到受威胁的
definition_en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction. | Feeling that someone or something may cause harm or loss.
example1_en: The textbook introduces threatened species in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了受威胁物种。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of threatened species.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得受威胁物种这个例子。
collocations: threatened species｜受威胁物种 ; feel threatened｜感到受威胁 ; threatened with extinction｜面临灭绝威胁
tip_zh: threatened指受到威胁；threatening指构成威胁。

meanings_zh: v. 嚎叫；呼啸 | n. 嚎叫声；怒吼声
definition_en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound. | A long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or another strong feeling.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to howl at the moon.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须对月长嚎。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers howl at the moon before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要对月长嚎。
collocations: howl at the moon｜对月长嚎 ; howl with laughter｜放声大笑 ; howls of protest｜愤怒的抗议声 ; the wind howls｜风呼啸
tip_zh: 既用于动物长嚎，也用于风声或人的强烈反应。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；首要的 | adj. 首席的；最高级别的 | n. 首领；负责人
definition_en: Most important among several things. | Having the highest rank in an organisation or profession. | The person who leads a group or organisation.
example1_en: The textbook introduces police chief in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了警察局长。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of police chief.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得警察局长这个例子。
collocations: chief concern｜首要关切 ; chief executive｜首席执行官 ; chief reason｜主要原因 ; police chief｜警察局长
tip_zh: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

meanings_zh: adv. 间接地 | adv. 含蓄地；拐弯抹角地
definition_en: Through another person, thing, or stage rather than directly | Without expressing something clearly or openly
example1_en: The professor told us to indirectly affect and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们间接影响，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: Students who indirectly affect are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够间接影响的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: indirectly affect｜间接影响 ; indirectly responsible for｜对……负有间接责任 ; refer indirectly to｜含蓄地提及 ; directly or indirectly｜直接或间接地
tip_zh: 是副词，不是形容词；修饰动词时用indirectly。

meanings_zh: adj. 人造的；人为的
definition_en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally
example1_en: After the lecture, we used man-made in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了人造的。
example2_en: A reading on environmental policy uses man-made when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于环境政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了人造的。
collocations: man-made lake｜人工湖 ; man-made materials｜人造材料 ; man-made disaster｜人为灾难 ; man-made fibres｜人造纤维
tip_zh: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。

meanings_zh: adj. 荒谬的；不合理的
definition_en: Completely unreasonable or silly.
example1_en: I copied completely absurd into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把完全荒谬的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used completely absurd to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用完全荒谬的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: an absurd idea｜荒谬的想法 ; an absurd claim｜荒谬的说法 ; completely absurd｜完全荒谬的
tip_zh: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

meanings_zh: n. 繁荣；迅速增长 | n. 隆隆声；轰鸣声 | v. 迅速发展；发出轰鸣
definition_en: a period of rapid growth or economic success | a loud, deep sound | to grow rapidly or make a loud, deep sound
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on economic boom.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济繁荣。
example2_en: A campus survey used economic boom to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经济繁荣来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: economic boom｜经济繁荣 ; a boom in tourism｜旅游业的迅猛发展 ; a booming industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
tip_zh: 表示某领域的迅速增长，常用a boom in。

meanings_zh: n. 人口迁移；移居 | n. 动物迁徙 | n. 数据或系统迁移
definition_en: The movement of people to live in another place. | The regular movement of animals between regions, often with the seasons. | The transfer of data or software to another computer system.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about rural-to-urban migration.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于农村向城市的人口迁移的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to rural-to-urban migration when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了农村向城市的人口迁移。
collocations: rural-to-urban migration｜农村向城市的人口迁移 ; seasonal migration｜季节性迁徙 ; bird migration｜鸟类迁徙 ; data migration｜数据迁移
tip_zh: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

meanings_zh: adj. 火山的；火山形成的 | adj. 猛烈爆发的
definition_en: Related to volcanoes or produced by their activity. | Sudden and extremely powerful, especially when describing anger.
example1_en: I copied volcanic eruption into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把火山喷发抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss volcanic eruption.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论火山喷发的材料。
collocations: volcanic eruption｜火山喷发 ; volcanic ash｜火山灰 ; volcanic activity｜火山活动 ; volcanic rock｜火山岩
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；“火山岩”用volcanic rock。

meanings_zh: adj. 公制的 | n. 衡量指标
definition_en: Using measurement units such as metres, litres, and grams. | A measurement used to judge performance, quality, or progress.
example1_en: Our professor circled performance metric on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绩效指标。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss performance metric.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论绩效指标的材料。
collocations: metric system｜公制 ; metric units｜公制单位 ; performance metric｜绩效指标
tip_zh: 形容词指公制的；名词指指标，常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 肥胖的
definition_en: having excessive body fat that may harm health
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about clinically obese.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于临床诊断为肥胖的的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects clinically obese with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把临床诊断为肥胖的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: clinically obese｜临床诊断为肥胖的 ; become obese｜变得肥胖 ; obese patients｜肥胖患者
tip_zh: 属医学用语，程度通常重于overweight；避免随意评价他人。

meanings_zh: n. 刺猬
definition_en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.
example1_en: I copied a baby hedgehog into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把刺猬幼崽抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a baby hedgehog.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得刺猬幼崽这个例子。
collocations: a hedgehog's spines｜刺猬的刺 ; hedgehog habitat｜刺猬栖息地 ; a baby hedgehog｜刺猬幼崽
tip_zh: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。

meanings_zh: n. 备忘录；内部通知
definition_en: A short written message, especially between people at work.
example1_en: I copied internal memo into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把内部通知抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to internal memo when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了内部通知。
collocations: send a memo｜发送备忘录 ; internal memo｜内部通知 ; a memo about something｜关于某事的备忘录
tip_zh: memo常指工作中的简短内部通知，复数为memos。

meanings_zh: n. 担忧；关切 | n. 令人担忧的事；关注事项 | v. 涉及；使担忧
definition_en: A feeling of worry about something important | An issue that matters or causes worry | To relate to someone or something, or cause worry
example1_en: Office hours began with a major concern.
example1_zh: 答疑从一个主要问题开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a major concern when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一个主要问题。
collocations: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧 ; raise concerns｜引发担忧 ; a major concern｜一个主要问题 ; concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip_zh: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

meanings_zh: v. 分析；细察
definition_en: to examine something carefully to understand its parts or causes
example1_en: The assignment is to analyse data, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先分析数据，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers analyse data before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要分析数据。
collocations: analyse data｜分析数据 ; analyse the results｜分析结果 ; analyse a problem｜分析问题
tip_zh: 英式拼写analyse，美式通常写analyze。

meanings_zh: adj. 技术的；科技的
definition_en: relating to technology and its practical development
example1_en: I copied technological advances into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把科技进步抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to technological advances when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了科技进步。
collocations: technological advances｜科技进步 ; technological innovation｜技术创新 ; technological development｜技术发展
tip_zh: technological侧重科技发展，technical侧重具体技术。

meanings_zh: n. 使用；使用量 | n. 词语用法；惯用法
definition_en: The way or amount that something is used. | The customary way words or phrases are used in language.
example1_en: The textbook introduces energy usage in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能源使用量。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around energy usage.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕能源使用量展开说明。
collocations: energy usage｜能源使用量 ; data usage｜数据使用量 ; common usage｜常见用法 ; usage patterns｜使用模式
tip_zh: usage重在使用量、使用方式或语言惯用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 强制的；必修的
definition_en: required by a law or rule, rather than optional
example1_en: Office hours began with compulsory education.
example1_zh: 答疑从义务教育开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around compulsory education.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕义务教育展开说明。
collocations: compulsory education｜义务教育 ; compulsory subject｜必修科目 ; compulsory attendance｜强制出席
tip_zh: compulsory强调规定必须做，与optional相对。

meanings_zh: n. 大众传媒
definition_en: communication channels that deliver information to very large audiences
example1_en: The professor explained mass media with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了大众传媒。
example2_en: Students who can explain mass media usually follow the rest of a lecture on public communication.
example2_zh: 能解释大众传媒的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共传播的讲座。
collocations: the mass media｜大众传媒 ; mass media coverage｜大众媒体报道 ; mass media influence｜大众传媒的影响
tip_zh: 泛指大众传媒常用the mass media，通常接复数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 芯片；集成电路 | n. 碎屑；缺口 | v. 碰掉一小块；使缺损
definition_en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits | a small broken piece or the mark it leaves | to break a small piece off something
example1_en: Our professor circled computer chip on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了计算机芯片。
example2_en: A campus survey used computer chip to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用计算机芯片来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: computer chip｜计算机芯片 ; silicon chip｜硅芯片 ; a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口 ; chip a tooth｜磕掉一小块牙齿
tip_zh: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

meanings_zh: adj. 神圣的；宗教上重要的
definition_en: Connected with a religion and treated with deep respect
example1_en: Our professor circled holy place on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了圣地。
example2_en: A campus survey used holy place to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用圣地来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: holy place｜圣地 ; holy book｜宗教经典 ; holy day｜宗教节日
tip_zh: holy强调宗教上的神圣，与wholly发音相同。

meanings_zh: n. 尴尬；窘迫 | n. 令人尴尬的人或事
definition_en: an uncomfortable feeling caused by awkwardness or fear of others' judgment | a person or thing that causes shame or awkwardness
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about blush with embarrassment.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于尴尬得脸红的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around blush with embarrassment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕尴尬得脸红展开说明。
collocations: to my embarrassment｜令我尴尬的是 ; blush with embarrassment｜尴尬得脸红 ; avoid embarrassment｜避免尴尬 ; a source of embarrassment｜令人尴尬的根源
tip_zh: 情绪义不可数；指令人尴尬的人或事时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 分发；分配 | n. 分布
definition_en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people | the way something is spread across an area or group
example1_en: The textbook introduces population distribution in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了人口分布。
example2_en: A campus survey used population distribution to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用人口分布来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: distribution of resources｜资源分配 ; population distribution｜人口分布 ; distribution network｜配送网络 ; uneven distribution｜分布不均
tip_zh: 既指分发过程，也指人口等的分布状态。

meanings_zh: n. 陪审团 | n. 评审团
definition_en: a group that decides facts in a court case | a group that judges entries in a competition
example1_en: I copied jury verdict into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把陪审团裁决抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects jury verdict with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把陪审团裁决和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: serve on a jury｜担任陪审员 ; jury verdict｜陪审团裁决 ; jury member｜陪审团成员
tip_zh: jury指整个陪审团；单个陪审员叫juror。

meanings_zh: adj. 有挑战性的；困难的 | adj. 挑衅的；表示质疑的
definition_en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination. | Expressing doubt or inviting disagreement or competition.
example1_en: Office hours began with intellectually challenging.
example1_zh: 答疑从考验智力的开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used intellectually challenging to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用考验智力的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: challenging task｜艰巨的任务 ; challenging environment｜充满挑战的环境 ; intellectually challenging｜考验智力的
tip_zh: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。

meanings_zh: v. 闪烁；闪耀 | n. 闪光；活力
definition_en: to shine with small, bright flashes of light | bright flashes of light, or a lively, exciting quality
example1_en: The lab instructions say to sparkle in the sunlight.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求在阳光下闪耀。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to sparkle in the sunlight.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得在阳光下闪耀。
collocations: sparkle in the sunlight｜在阳光下闪耀 ; eyes sparkle｜眼睛闪闪发亮 ; add sparkle to｜为……增添活力
tip_zh: sparkle强调点点闪光；shine泛指发光。

meanings_zh: v. 欣然接受；采纳 | v. 拥抱 | n. 拥抱
definition_en: to willingly accept an idea, change, or opportunity | to hold someone closely in your arms | an act of holding someone closely in your arms
example1_en: The professor asked us to embrace change.
example1_zh: 教授让我们欣然接受变化。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers embrace change before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要欣然接受变化。
collocations: embrace change｜欣然接受变化 ; embrace an opportunity｜欣然把握机会 ; a warm embrace｜热情的拥抱
tip_zh: 表示接受时，常接change、idea等抽象名词。

meanings_zh: adv. 此外；而且
definition_en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said
example1_en: Furthermore, the class checked the chart a second time.
example1_zh: 此外，全班又核对了一次图表。
example2_en: Furthermore, readers should separate what the passage proves from what it only suggests.
example2_zh: 此外，读者应当区分文章证明了什么，又仅仅暗示了什么。
collocations: furthermore, it is important｜此外，重要的是 ; furthermore, evidence suggests｜此外，证据表明
tip_zh: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。

meanings_zh: n. 情况介绍；简报会
definition_en: a meeting or explanation giving essential information or instructions
example1_en: Our professor circled safety briefing on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全说明会。
example2_en: A campus survey used safety briefing to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用安全说明会来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: safety briefing｜安全说明会 ; press briefing｜新闻简报会 ; attend a briefing｜参加简报会 ; briefing paper｜情况简介文件
tip_zh: 不只是书面简报，也常指口头说明或简报会。

meanings_zh: adj. 密集的；浓密的 | adj. 晦涩难懂的 | adj. 愚钝的
definition_en: Containing many things packed closely together | Difficult to understand because information is tightly packed | Slow to understand things
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on dense fog.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓雾。
example2_en: The reading connects dense fog with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把浓雾和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: dense fog｜浓雾 ; dense forest｜茂密的森林 ; dense population｜密集的人口 ; dense prose｜晦涩的散文
tip_zh: 形容人愚钝时有冒犯意味；密集地用densely。

meanings_zh: adj. 大量的；重大的
definition_en: Large in amount or importance.
example1_en: There was a substantial gap between the two groups.
example1_zh: 两组之间有很大的差距。
example2_en: The lecture called the improvement substantial, not merely statistically detectable.
example2_zh: 讲座称这一改进是实质性的，而不只是统计上能检测出来。
collocations: a substantial increase｜大幅增加 ; substantial evidence｜大量证据
tip_zh: 不要和 substantive（实质的、有内容的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 无助的；无力应对的
definition_en: Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation
example1_en: The textbook introduces a helpless victim in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无助的受害者。
example2_en: A campus survey used a helpless victim to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用无助的受害者来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: feel helpless｜感到无助 ; a helpless victim｜无助的受害者 ; helpless against｜面对……无能为力
tip_zh: helpless是无助的；unhelpful是不肯帮忙或无用的。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可避免的；必然的
definition_en: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent
example1_en: The textbook introduces almost inevitable in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了几乎不可避免的。
example2_en: The reading connects almost inevitable with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把几乎不可避免的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: inevitable consequences｜不可避免的后果 ; inevitable change｜必然的变化 ; almost inevitable｜几乎不可避免的
tip_zh: 常用it is inevitable that…表示“……不可避免”。

meanings_zh: n. 部落；部族
definition_en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties
example1_en: Our professor circled a nomadic tribe on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了游牧部落。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a nomadic tribe.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕游牧部落展开说明。
collocations: tribal traditions｜部族传统 ; a nomadic tribe｜游牧部落 ; members of a tribe｜部落成员
tip_zh: 指特定社群时，宜尊重其自称，避免泛称。

meanings_zh: v. 突出；强调 | n. 最精彩或最重要的部分 | v. 用荧光笔标出
definition_en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable. | The best or most memorable part of an experience. | Mark words with bright colour to make them noticeable.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer highlight a problem during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时突出一个问题。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to highlight a problem.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来突出一个问题。
collocations: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题 ; highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性 ; the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip_zh: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。

meanings_zh: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的 | adj. 醒目的；鲜明的 | adj. 粗体的
definition_en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence. | Strong and easily noticed in colour, shape, or design. | Printed with thicker, darker lines than ordinary type.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about bold decision.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于大胆的决定的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bold decision.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大胆的决定展开说明。
collocations: bold decision｜大胆的决定 ; bold colours｜鲜明的色彩 ; bold type｜粗体字 ; bold approach｜大胆的做法
tip_zh: in bold表示“用粗体”，常用于排版说明。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性；机会 | n. 投注赔率
definition_en: The likelihood that something will happen. | The ratio determining how much a successful bet pays.
example1_en: Office hours began with against all odds.
example1_zh: 答疑从尽管困难重重开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around against all odds.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕尽管困难重重展开说明。
collocations: the odds of success｜成功的可能性 ; against all odds｜尽管困难重重 ; at odds with｜与……不一致 ; improve the odds｜提高成功机会
tip_zh: odds用复数形式，常接of或that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 合作；协作 | n. 配合；协助
definition_en: the act of working together towards a shared goal | willingness to help or do what someone requests
example1_en: Office hours began with international cooperation.
example1_zh: 答疑从国际合作开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of international cooperation.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国际合作这个例子。
collocations: international cooperation｜国际合作 ; close cooperation｜密切合作 ; in cooperation with｜与……合作 ; full cooperation｜充分配合
tip_zh: 通常不可数；与……合作用in cooperation with。

meanings_zh: n. 小部分；少量 | n. 分数
definition_en: a small part or amount of something | a mathematical quantity representing part of a whole
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a small fraction.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论很小一部分。
example2_en: A campus survey used a small fraction to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用很小一部分来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a fraction of｜……的一小部分 ; a small fraction｜很小一部分 ; a fraction of a second｜极短的一瞬 ; simple fraction｜简单分数
tip_zh: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

meanings_zh: n. 灵活性；变通能力 | n. 柔韧性
definition_en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs | the ability to bend or stretch easily
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about greater flexibility.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于更大的灵活性的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects greater flexibility with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把更大的灵活性和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: offer flexibility｜提供灵活性 ; greater flexibility｜更大的灵活性 ; improve flexibility｜提高柔韧性 ; flexibility in working hours｜工作时间的灵活性
tip_zh: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。

meanings_zh: v. 批评；指责
definition_en: express disapproval of someone or something
example1_en: The professor asked us to criticize someone for something.
example1_zh: 教授让我们因某事批评某人。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers criticize someone for something before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要因某事批评某人。
collocations: strongly criticize｜强烈批评 ; criticize someone for something｜因某事批评某人 ; widely criticized｜受到广泛批评
tip_zh: criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。

meanings_zh: n. 完成；竣工
definition_en: The act or state of finishing something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces near completion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了接近完工。
example2_en: The author returns to near completion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了接近完工。
collocations: on completion｜完成时 ; near completion｜接近完工 ; successful completion｜顺利完成 ; completion date｜完工日期
tip_zh: 常用on completion of表示“在……完成时”。

meanings_zh: n. 胡说；无意义的话 | n. 愚蠢行为；胡闹
definition_en: words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning | silly or unacceptable behaviour
example1_en: I copied talk nonsense into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把胡说八道抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around talk nonsense.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕胡说八道展开说明。
collocations: talk nonsense｜胡说八道 ; complete nonsense｜一派胡言 ; a load of nonsense｜一堆废话 ; put up with nonsense｜容忍胡闹
tip_zh: 通常不可数；说一派胡言可用 complete nonsense。

meanings_zh: n. 专门学校；学院 | n. 学会；研究院
definition_en: A school providing training in a particular subject or skill. | An organization promoting scholarship, science, or the arts.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a music academy in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐学院。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a music academy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论音乐学院的材料。
collocations: a music academy｜音乐学院 ; a military academy｜军事学院 ; an academy of sciences｜科学院
tip_zh: 常指专业培训院校或学术机构，不一定是大学。

meanings_zh: v. 估计；估算 | n. 估计；估价
definition_en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size. | An approximate calculation of an amount, value, or cost.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to estimate the cost.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何估算费用。
example2_en: The reading asks you to estimate the cost and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你估算费用，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: estimate the cost｜估算费用 ; a rough estimate｜粗略估计 ; a conservative estimate｜保守估计 ; be estimated at｜估计为
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。

meanings_zh: n. 评论家；评论员 | n. 批评者；反对者
definition_en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally. | Someone who expresses disapproval of a person, policy, or idea.
example1_en: Office hours began with film critic.
example1_zh: 答疑从影评人开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss film critic.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论影评人的材料。
collocations: film critic｜影评人 ; literary critic｜文学评论家 ; an outspoken critic｜直言不讳的批评者
tip_zh: critic指人，criticism指批评或评论。

meanings_zh: adj. 显著的；值得注意的 | n. 名人；要人
definition_en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention | a famous or important person, especially in a particular community
example1_en: Office hours began with a notable achievement.
example1_zh: 答疑从显著成就开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a notable achievement with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把显著成就和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a notable achievement｜显著成就 ; a notable exception｜值得注意的例外 ; notable for｜以……而引人注目
tip_zh: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

meanings_zh: n. 硫；硫磺
definition_en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture
example1_en: Our professor circled sulphur dioxide on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了二氧化硫。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sulphur dioxide.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论二氧化硫的材料。
collocations: sulphur dioxide｜二氧化硫 ; sulphur content｜含硫量 ; sulphur deposits｜硫磺矿床
tip_zh: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

meanings_zh: v. 承担；着手进行 | v. 承诺；答应
definition_en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it | Promise to do something
example1_en: I heard the lecturer undertake research during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时开展研究。
example2_en: The reading asks you to undertake research and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你开展研究，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: undertake research｜开展研究 ; undertake a task｜承担任务 ; undertake to do something｜承诺做某事
tip_zh: 过去式undertook，过去分词undertaken。

meanings_zh: v. 孵化；孵出 | n. 舱口；小开口 | v. 秘密策划
definition_en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen | an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall | to develop a plan, often secretly
example1_en: The assignment is to hatch an egg, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先孵蛋，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to hatch an egg.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得孵蛋。
collocations: hatch an egg｜孵蛋 ; hatch a plan｜秘密策划 ; escape hatch｜逃生舱口
tip_zh: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。

meanings_zh: v. 移民入境；移居
definition_en: To move to another country to live there permanently.
example1_en: The professor asked us to immigrate to a country.
example1_zh: 教授让我们移居某国。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to immigrate to a country.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们移居某国。
collocations: immigrate to a country｜移居某国 ; immigrate from abroad｜从国外移入
tip_zh: immigrate to强调移入；emigrate from强调移出。

meanings_zh: v. 吠叫 | n. 狗叫声 | n. 树皮
definition_en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog | a short, loud sound made by a dog | the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to bark at someone.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何冲某人吠叫。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to bark at someone.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来冲某人吠叫。
collocations: bark at someone｜冲某人吠叫 ; a loud bark｜一声响亮的狗叫 ; tree bark｜树皮
tip_zh: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 森林砍伐；毁林
definition_en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.
example1_en: Office hours began with prevent deforestation.
example1_zh: 答疑从防止毁林开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of prevent deforestation.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得防止毁林这个例子。
collocations: prevent deforestation｜防止毁林 ; widespread deforestation｜大规模毁林 ; tropical deforestation｜热带森林砍伐
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常用于栖息地丧失和气候变化话题。

meanings_zh: n. 服务员；工作人员 | adj. 伴随的；随之而来的
definition_en: Someone employed to help people in a public place. | Occurring together with something, often as a consequence.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on flight attendant.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论航空乘务员。
example2_en: A campus survey used flight attendant to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用航空乘务员来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: flight attendant｜航空乘务员 ; car park attendant｜停车场管理员 ; attendant risks｜随之而来的风险
tip_zh: attendant常指服务人员；参会者通常用attendee。

meanings_zh: n. 悲伤；悲痛
definition_en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on deep sorrow.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论深切的悲痛。
example2_en: The reading connects deep sorrow with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把深切的悲痛和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: deep sorrow｜深切的悲痛 ; express sorrow｜表达悲伤 ; in sorrow｜悲伤地
tip_zh: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。

meanings_zh: v. 禁用；使停止运作 | v. 使伤残；使丧失能力
definition_en: to prevent a device or feature from working | to cause a condition that limits someone's activities
example1_en: The lab instructions say to disable notifications.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求禁用通知。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to disable notifications.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得禁用通知。
collocations: disable notifications｜禁用通知 ; disable an alarm｜关闭警报器 ; disable location tracking｜禁用位置追踪
tip_zh: 技术语境常指“禁用”，不表示删除或损坏。

meanings_zh: v. 回想起；记得 | v. 召回；收回 | n. 记忆力；产品召回
definition_en: to remember something from the past | to order someone back or request the return of products | the ability to remember, or an official request for returns
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to recall a detail.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何回想起一个细节。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to recall a detail.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得回想起一个细节。
collocations: recall a detail｜回想起一个细节 ; recall doing something｜记得做过某事 ; product recall｜产品召回 ; total recall｜完整的记忆能力
tip_zh: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 壮丽的；宏伟的 | adj. 极出色的
definition_en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive. | Exceptionally good or skilfully done.
example1_en: Our professor circled magnificent scenery on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了壮丽的景色。
example2_en: The author returns to magnificent scenery when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了壮丽的景色。
collocations: magnificent scenery｜壮丽的景色 ; a magnificent building｜宏伟的建筑 ; a magnificent achievement｜卓越的成就
tip_zh: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

meanings_zh: n. 感激；感谢 | n. 欣赏；理解 | n. 升值；增值
definition_en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness. | Recognition and understanding of something's value, quality, or importance. | An increase in the financial value of something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on currency appreciation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论货币升值。
example2_en: The reading connects currency appreciation with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把货币升值和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: show appreciation｜表达感激 ; in appreciation of｜为感谢 ; an appreciation of art｜对艺术的欣赏 ; currency appreciation｜货币升值
tip_zh: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。

meanings_zh: n. 负担；重担 | v. 使负担；使烦恼
definition_en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry | to give someone a heavy responsibility or worry
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial burden.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济负担。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of financial burden.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得经济负担这个例子。
collocations: financial burden｜经济负担 ; ease the burden｜减轻负担 ; bear the burden｜承担重担 ; be burdened with debt｜背负债务
tip_zh: 负担落在某人身上用a burden on someone。

meanings_zh: v. 振动；使振动
definition_en: To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to vibrate gently.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何轻轻振动。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to vibrate gently.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来轻轻振动。
collocations: vibrate gently｜轻轻振动 ; vibrate rapidly｜快速振动 ; vibrate mode｜振动模式
tip_zh: 指快速、小幅度振动，不等于大幅摇摆。

meanings_zh: n. 男孩；小伙子
definition_en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a young lad.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小伙子。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a young lad.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论小伙子的材料。
collocations: a young lad｜小伙子 ; a local lad｜本地小伙子 ; a teenage lad｜十几岁的男孩
tip_zh: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；身心失调 | n. 混乱；杂乱 | n. 骚乱
definition_en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning | a state in which things are not properly arranged | uncontrolled public behaviour that disturbs peace or safety
example1_en: I copied sleep disorder into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把睡眠障碍抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects sleep disorder with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把睡眠障碍和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: sleep disorder｜睡眠障碍 ; eating disorder｜进食障碍 ; in disorder｜杂乱无章 ; public disorder｜公共秩序混乱
tip_zh: 疾病义可数；杂乱或骚乱义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 迁徙；移居 | v. 迁移数据或系统
definition_en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there | to move data or software to a different computer system
example1_en: The professor asked us to migrate south.
example1_zh: 教授让我们向南迁徙。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to migrate south.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来向南迁徙。
collocations: migrate south｜向南迁徙 ; migrate to cities｜迁居城市 ; migrate data｜迁移数据
tip_zh: migrate强调迁移；immigrate移入，emigrate移出。

meanings_zh: adj. 社会主义的 | n. 社会主义者
definition_en: relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth | someone who supports socialism
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about socialist policies.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于社会主义政策的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects socialist policies with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把社会主义政策和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: socialist policies｜社会主义政策 ; socialist movement｜社会主义运动 ; socialist economy｜社会主义经济
tip_zh: socialist指社会主义的；social仅指社会的或社交的。

meanings_zh: n. 龙虾；龙虾肉
definition_en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lobster fishing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论龙虾捕捞。
example2_en: A campus survey used lobster fishing to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用龙虾捕捞来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: lobster fishing｜龙虾捕捞 ; lobster tail｜龙虾尾 ; lobster pot｜捕龙虾笼
tip_zh: 指动物时可数；指作为食物的虾肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 行业；部门；领域 | n. 区域；地段 | n. 扇形
definition_en: A particular part of an economy or area of activity. | A particular section of a larger area. | A circle's part enclosed by two radii and an arc.
example1_en: Our professor circled the public sector on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公共部门。
example2_en: The author returns to the public sector when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公共部门。
collocations: the public sector｜公共部门 ; the private sector｜私营部门 ; the manufacturing sector｜制造业 ; the service sector｜服务业
tip_zh: sector常指经济中的某个行业，不一定是公司部门。

meanings_zh: n. 埋葬；葬礼
definition_en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground
example1_en: Our professor circled burial site on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了墓葬遗址。
example2_en: The author returns to burial site when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了墓葬遗址。
collocations: burial site｜墓葬遗址 ; burial ground｜墓地 ; burial customs｜丧葬习俗
tip_zh: burial重在入土安葬；funeral泛指葬礼仪式。

meanings_zh: n. 瓦特（功率单位）
definition_en: a unit used to measure power
example1_en: Office hours began with a ten-watt bulb.
example1_zh: 答疑从十瓦灯泡开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a ten-watt bulb.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕十瓦灯泡展开说明。
collocations: power in watts｜以瓦特表示的功率 ; a ten-watt bulb｜十瓦灯泡 ; rated at fifty watts｜额定功率为五十瓦
tip_zh: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。

meanings_zh: adj. 受限制的；有限的 | adj. 仅限特定人员使用的
definition_en: limited in amount, range, or freedom | available or open only to people with permission
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on restricted access.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论受限的使用权限。
example2_en: The reading connects restricted access with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把受限的使用权限和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: restricted access｜受限的使用权限 ; a restricted area｜限制进入的区域 ; restricted movement｜受限的活动 ; restricted to members｜仅限会员
tip_zh: restricted to表示“仅限于”；也是restrict过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 分心的事物；干扰 | n. 分心；注意力分散 | n. 消遣；解闷的活动
definition_en: Something that takes your attention away from your main activity | The state of being unable to give something full attention | An activity that helps you forget worries or boredom
example1_en: I copied a welcome distraction into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把令人愉快的消遣抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a welcome distraction when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了令人愉快的消遣。
collocations: avoid distractions｜避免干扰 ; a welcome distraction｜令人愉快的消遣 ; a major distraction｜严重干扰
tip_zh: 具体干扰物可数；表示分心状态时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 抢劫；抢劫案
definition_en: Stealing from a person or place using force or threats.
example1_en: Office hours began with armed robbery.
example1_zh: 答疑从持械抢劫开始。
example2_en: The reading connects armed robbery with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把持械抢劫和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: commit a robbery｜实施抢劫 ; armed robbery｜持械抢劫 ; bank robbery｜银行抢劫案 ; attempted robbery｜抢劫未遂
tip_zh: robbery涉及暴力或威胁；theft泛指盗窃。

meanings_zh: n. 礁；暗礁
definition_en: A ridge of rock or coral near the sea's surface.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on coral reef.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论珊瑚礁。
example2_en: The reading connects coral reef with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把珊瑚礁和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: coral reef｜珊瑚礁 ; barrier reef｜堡礁 ; reef ecosystem｜珊瑚礁生态系统
tip_zh: reef指接近海面的礁体，不是海边的悬崖cliff。

meanings_zh: v. 咯咯地笑 | n. 咯咯的笑声
definition_en: laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way | a light laugh caused by amusement or nervousness
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to giggle at a joke.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何听到笑话咯咯笑。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers giggle at a joke before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要听到笑话咯咯笑。
collocations: giggle at a joke｜听到笑话咯咯笑 ; nervous giggle｜紧张的咯咯笑声 ; suppress a giggle｜忍住笑
tip_zh: 强调轻轻咯咯笑，可因好玩或紧张；笑某事用at。

meanings_zh: n. 争端；争执 | v. 质疑；对……提出异议 | v. 争论；争夺
definition_en: a serious disagreement between people or groups | to question whether something is true or correct | to argue about something or compete to control it
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a dispute over pay.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论薪酬争议。
example2_en: The reading connects a dispute over pay with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把薪酬争议和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: settle a dispute｜解决争端 ; a dispute over pay｜薪酬争议 ; dispute a claim｜质疑某项说法 ; in dispute｜存在争议
tip_zh: dispute a claim是质疑说法，不是讨论说法。

meanings_zh: n. 困惑；不明白 | n. 混淆；混乱
definition_en: A state of not understanding something clearly | A situation where things are mixed up or poorly organised
example1_en: Office hours began with clear up confusion.
example1_zh: 答疑从消除困惑开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of clear up confusion.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得消除困惑这个例子。
collocations: cause confusion｜引起困惑 ; avoid confusion｜避免混淆 ; clear up confusion｜消除困惑 ; confusion over｜对……的困惑
tip_zh: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。

meanings_zh: adj. 工业的；产业的
definition_en: Relating to factories and the production of goods.
example1_en: I copied industrial production into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把工业生产抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects industrial production with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把工业生产和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: industrial production｜工业生产 ; industrial waste｜工业废物 ; industrial area｜工业区 ; industrial development｜工业发展
tip_zh: industrial指工业的；industrious才指勤劳的。

meanings_zh: n. 程序；手续；步骤 | n. 医疗操作；手术
definition_en: an established series of actions for completing a task | a medical action performed to diagnose or treat a condition
example1_en: The textbook introduces standard procedure in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了标准程序。
example2_en: A campus survey used standard procedure to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用标准程序来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: follow a procedure｜遵循程序 ; standard procedure｜标准程序 ; a surgical procedure｜外科手术
tip_zh: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

meanings_zh: v. 应付；妥善处理
definition_en: To manage a difficult situation successfully.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer cope with stress during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时应对压力。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cope with stress.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得应对压力。
collocations: cope with stress｜应对压力 ; cope with change｜应对变化 ; cope well｜应付得当
tip_zh: cope是不及物动词，接困难或压力时用with。

meanings_zh: n. 建议 | n. 推荐；推荐信
definition_en: advice about the best thing to do | a statement supporting someone's or something's suitability or quality
example1_en: Our professor circled letter of recommendation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了推荐信。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around letter of recommendation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕推荐信展开说明。
collocations: make a recommendation｜提出建议 ; follow a recommendation｜采纳建议 ; on someone's recommendation｜经某人推荐 ; letter of recommendation｜推荐信
tip_zh: recommendation后的that从句常用should或动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 聪明；机灵；巧妙
definition_en: the ability to understand quickly or find effective, inventive solutions
