example1_en: Office hours began with remarkable cleverness.
example1_zh: 答疑从非凡的才智开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss remarkable cleverness.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论非凡的才智的材料。
collocations: remarkable cleverness｜非凡的才智 ; the cleverness of a design｜设计的巧妙 ; show cleverness｜表现出机智
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既可指人的聪明，也可指设计巧妙。

meanings_zh: v. 追查；追溯 | n. 痕迹；微量 | v. 描摹；沿轮廓描画
definition_en: find something's origin or location by following evidence | a small sign, mark, or amount left behind | copy a picture by drawing over its lines
example1_en: The professor asked us to trace the source.
example1_zh: 教授让我们追查来源。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to trace the source.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来追查来源。
collocations: trace the source｜追查来源 ; trace back to｜追溯到 ; without a trace｜不留痕迹 ; traces of｜微量的；……的痕迹
tip_zh: trace A back to B表示“追溯A至B”。

meanings_zh: n. 碳水化合物
definition_en: A substance such as sugar or starch that provides energy.
example1_en: Office hours began with carbohydrate intake.
example1_zh: 答疑从碳水化合物摄入量开始。
example2_en: The reading connects carbohydrate intake with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把碳水化合物摄入量和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: complex carbohydrates｜复合碳水化合物 ; carbohydrate intake｜碳水化合物摄入量 ; low-carbohydrate diet｜低碳水化合物饮食
tip_zh: 泛指营养成分可不可数；谈种类或总称常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 熟练的；有技能的 | adj. 需要专门技能的
definition_en: Having the training and ability to do something well. | Requiring special training or practical ability.
example1_en: I copied highly skilled into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把技艺高超的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects highly skilled with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把技艺高超的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: skilled worker｜技术工人 ; highly skilled｜技艺高超的 ; skilled at｜擅长 ; skilled labour｜技术劳动力
tip_zh: skilled at/in后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 稀缺的；不足的
definition_en: not available in large enough amounts to meet demand
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on increasingly scarce.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论日益稀缺。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around increasingly scarce.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕日益稀缺展开说明。
collocations: scarce resources｜稀缺资源 ; become scarce｜变得紧缺 ; increasingly scarce｜日益稀缺
tip_zh: scarce指供应不足；rare强调少见，不一定短缺。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓掌；喝彩 | v. 称赞；赞许
definition_en: Clap your hands to show enjoyment or approval. | Express strong approval of someone or something.
example1_en: The assignment is to applaud a performance, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先为表演鼓掌，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to applaud a performance.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来为表演鼓掌。
collocations: applaud a performance｜为表演鼓掌 ; applaud a decision｜赞许决定 ; applaud someone's efforts｜称赞某人的努力
tip_zh: 可直接接人或事；applause是不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 薄雾 | v. 蒙上水汽；使模糊
definition_en: tiny water drops in the air that reduce visibility | to become or make something covered with tiny water drops
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on thick mist.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓雾。
example2_en: A campus survey used thick mist to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用浓雾来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: thick mist｜浓雾 ; morning mist｜晨雾 ; mist over｜蒙上水汽
tip_zh: mist通常比fog稀薄；玻璃起雾可说mist over。

meanings_zh: n. 经度
definition_en: a place's angular distance east or west of the prime meridian
example1_en: Our professor circled latitude and longitude on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纬度和经度。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around latitude and longitude.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕纬度和经度展开说明。
collocations: latitude and longitude｜纬度和经度 ; degrees of longitude｜经度的度数 ; east longitude｜东经 ; west longitude｜西经
tip_zh: longitude是经度，分东西；latitude是纬度，分南北。

meanings_zh: n. 目标；目的 | adj. 客观的；不偏不倚的
definition_en: Something you aim to achieve. | Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.
example1_en: Our professor circled primary objective on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了首要目标。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of primary objective.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得首要目标这个例子。
collocations: achieve an objective｜实现目标 ; primary objective｜首要目标 ; objective assessment｜客观评估 ; remain objective｜保持客观
tip_zh: 名词指目标；形容词指客观的，反义词为subjective。

meanings_zh: n. 商品陈列室；展厅
definition_en: A room where goods are displayed for customers to examine.
example1_en: Office hours began with furniture showroom.
example1_zh: 答疑从家具展厅开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used furniture showroom to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用家具展厅来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: furniture showroom｜家具展厅 ; car showroom｜汽车展厅 ; showroom display｜展厅陈列
tip_zh: 可数名词；showrooming指先在实体店看货再网购。

meanings_zh: n. 山体滑坡 | n. 压倒性胜利
definition_en: a mass of earth and rocks sliding down a slope | an election victory by a very large margin
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on landslide risk.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论滑坡风险。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of landslide risk.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得滑坡风险这个例子。
collocations: trigger a landslide｜引发山体滑坡 ; landslide risk｜滑坡风险 ; landslide victory｜压倒性胜利 ; win by a landslide｜以压倒性优势获胜
tip_zh: 政治语境中常指选举中的压倒性胜利。

meanings_zh: n. 公司；商行 | adj. 坚固的；结实的 | adj. 坚定的；严格的
definition_en: a business that provides goods or professional services | solid and not easily moved or pressed out of shape | unlikely to change a decision or allow rules to be broken
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a law firm.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论律师事务所。
example2_en: The reading connects a law firm with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把律师事务所和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a law firm｜律师事务所 ; a firm belief｜坚定的信念 ; firm ground｜坚实的地面 ; take a firm stand｜采取坚定立场
tip_zh: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。

meanings_zh: v. 购买 | n. 购买；所购之物
definition_en: to obtain something by paying money for it | the act of buying something, or the thing bought
example1_en: The assignment is to purchase goods, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先购买商品，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to purchase goods.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来购买商品。
collocations: purchase goods｜购买商品 ; make a purchase｜购买 ; purchase price｜购买价格 ; proof of purchase｜购买凭证
tip_zh: purchase比buy正式；名词可指购买行为或买到的东西。

meanings_zh: v. 处理；丢弃 | v. 使倾向于；使愿意
definition_en: to get rid of something, used with of | to make someone likely or willing to do something
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to dispose of waste.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何处理废物。
example2_en: A lecture on environmental policy showed why researchers dispose of waste before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于环境政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要处理废物。
collocations: dispose of waste｜处理废物 ; dispose of unwanted items｜处理不需要的物品 ; be disposed to agree｜倾向于同意
tip_zh: 表示丢弃必须用dispose of，不能直接接物品。

meanings_zh: n. 体积；总量 | n. 音量 | n. 卷；册
definition_en: The space something occupies, or the total amount of something. | The level of loudness of a sound. | A book, especially one belonging to a larger set.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a companion volume in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了配套的一卷。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a companion volume.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论配套的一卷的材料。
collocations: a high volume of traffic｜很大的交通流量 ; turn down the volume｜调低音量 ; calculate the volume｜计算体积 ; a companion volume｜配套的一卷
tip_zh: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

meanings_zh: n. 缺席；不在 | n. 缺乏；不存在
definition_en: a situation in which someone is not present | a situation in which something does not exist or occur
example1_en: Our professor circled absence from work on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了缺勤。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss absence from work.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论缺勤的材料。
collocations: absence from work｜缺勤 ; in someone's absence｜在某人不在时 ; in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下 ; leave of absence｜获准休假
tip_zh: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

meanings_zh: adj. 昂贵的；费用高的 | adj. 造成重大损失的
definition_en: requiring a large amount of money | causing serious loss, harm or disadvantage
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on prove costly.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论结果代价高昂。
example2_en: The reading connects prove costly with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把结果代价高昂和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: costly repairs｜昂贵的维修 ; a costly mistake｜代价高昂的错误 ; prove costly｜结果代价高昂
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；也可指损失惨重。

meanings_zh: adj. 热情好客的 | adj. 适宜居住或生长的
definition_en: Friendly and generous towards guests or visitors. | Providing suitable conditions for people, animals, or plants to live.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a hospitable host.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于热情好客的主人的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a hospitable host when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了热情好客的主人。
collocations: a hospitable host｜热情好客的主人 ; hospitable to visitors｜热情接待访客 ; a hospitable environment｜适宜生存的环境
tip_zh: 形容人时指好客；形容环境时指适宜生存。

meanings_zh: adj. 不感兴趣的
definition_en: not wanting to learn about or take part in something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on uninterested in politics.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论对政治不感兴趣。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around uninterested in politics.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕对政治不感兴趣展开说明。
collocations: uninterested in politics｜对政治不感兴趣 ; seem uninterested｜显得不感兴趣 ; remain uninterested｜仍然不感兴趣
tip_zh: 接in；勿与表示“公正无私”的disinterested混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 来回摇摆 | n. 摇摆；摆动 | n. 爱说笑的人
definition_en: move repeatedly from side to side | a movement from side to side | someone who often makes clever or amusing remarks
example1_en: The professor asked us to wag its tail.
example1_zh: 教授让我们摇尾巴。
example2_en: The reading asks you to wag its tail and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你摇尾巴，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: wag its tail｜摇尾巴 ; wag a finger at someone｜向某人摇手指 ; a wag of the tail｜尾巴的一摆
tip_zh: 过去式wagged，现在分词wagging，均双写g。

meanings_zh: adj. 等值的；相当的 | n. 对应物；等值物
definition_en: Equal in value, amount, meaning, or function. | Something equal to another thing in value, meaning, or function.
example1_en: Office hours began with equivalent to.
example1_zh: 答疑从与……相当开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss equivalent to.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论与……相当的材料。
collocations: equivalent to｜与……相当 ; an equivalent qualification｜同等学历 ; the equivalent of｜相当于……的事物
tip_zh: 常用equivalent to；相当不代表完全相同。

meanings_zh: n. 区别；差别 | n. 卓越；杰出 | n. 优等成绩；荣誉
definition_en: A difference that separates one thing or group from another | The quality of being excellent and deserving respect | A special award or high grade recognizing excellent achievement
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a clear distinction.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于明显的区别的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a clear distinction with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把明显的区别和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: draw a distinction between｜区分……与…… ; a clear distinction｜明显的区别 ; with distinction｜以优异成绩 ; a person of distinction｜杰出人士
tip_zh: 表示两者区别，常用distinction between A and B。

meanings_zh: v. 使稳定；变得稳定
definition_en: make or become steady and less likely to change
example1_en: I heard the lecturer stabilize prices during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时稳定价格。
example2_en: The reading asks you to stabilize prices and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你稳定价格，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: stabilize prices｜稳定价格 ; stabilize the economy｜稳定经济 ; stabilize a patient's condition｜稳定患者病情
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。

meanings_zh: n. 实习岗位；实习期
definition_en: A temporary job providing practical experience in a particular field.
example1_en: Our professor circled paid internship on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了带薪实习。
example2_en: The reading connects paid internship with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把带薪实习和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: paid internship｜带薪实习 ; summer internship｜暑期实习 ; apply for an internship｜申请实习岗位
tip_zh: intern指实习生；internship指实习岗位或实习期。

meanings_zh: n. 役用牛；阉牛
definition_en: a large bovine, often a castrated male, used for work
example1_en: The textbook introduces an ox cart in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了牛车。
example2_en: A campus survey used an ox cart to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用牛车来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a pair of oxen｜一对役牛 ; an ox cart｜牛车 ; as strong as an ox｜健壮如牛
tip_zh: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。

meanings_zh: v. 洗澡；给……洗澡 | v. 清洗；浸洗 | v. 游泳；戏水
definition_en: To wash yourself or another person in a bath | To gently wash a body part with liquid | To swim or spend time in the sea or a lake
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to bathe a baby.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须给婴儿洗澡。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to bathe a baby.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得给婴儿洗澡。
collocations: bathe a baby｜给婴儿洗澡 ; bathe a wound｜清洗伤口 ; bathe in the sea｜在海里游泳
tip_zh: bathe读/beɪð/，勿与bath混淆；英式还可指海泳。

meanings_zh: adj. 向下的；下降的 | adv. 向下；往低处
definition_en: Moving or pointing towards a lower place, level, or amount. | Towards a lower place, level, or amount.
example1_en: I copied a downward trend into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把下降趋势抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a downward trend to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用下降趋势来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a downward trend｜下降趋势 ; downward pressure｜下行压力 ; a downward spiral｜持续恶化 ; move downward｜向下移动
tip_zh: downward可作形容词和副词；downwards只作副词。

meanings_zh: n. 合同；契约 | v. 收缩；缩小 | v. 感染；患上
definition_en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations. | To become smaller or make something smaller. | To catch or develop a disease.
example1_en: Our professor circled employment contract on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了劳动合同。
example2_en: The author returns to employment contract when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了劳动合同。
collocations: sign a contract｜签订合同 ; employment contract｜劳动合同 ; breach of contract｜违约 ; contract a disease｜感染疾病
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

meanings_zh: n. 坟墓；陵墓
definition_en: A structure or underground chamber where a dead person is buried.
example1_en: Our professor circled ancient tomb on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了古墓。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ancient tomb.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古墓的材料。
collocations: ancient tomb｜古墓 ; royal tomb｜王陵 ; burial tomb｜墓穴
tip_zh: b不发音，与room押韵；常指有建筑结构的墓。

meanings_zh: adj. 公民的；民用的 | adj. 民事的 | adj. 有礼貌的；客气的
definition_en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military. | Relating to private legal disputes rather than criminal offences. | Polite and respectful, though not necessarily friendly.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about civil rights.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于公民权利的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects civil rights with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把公民权利和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: civil rights｜公民权利 ; civil aviation｜民用航空 ; civil law｜民法 ; remain civil｜保持礼貌
tip_zh: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。

meanings_zh: adj. 很可能的
definition_en: Likely to happen or be true.
example1_en: Office hours began with highly probable.
example1_zh: 答疑从极有可能的开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly probable.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得极有可能的这个例子。
collocations: probable cause｜很可能的原因 ; probable outcome｜很可能的结果 ; highly probable｜极有可能的
tip_zh: 常用it is probable that；不用某人is probable to do。

meanings_zh: n. 排练；预演
definition_en: A practice session before a performance or important event.
example1_en: I copied dress rehearsal into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把彩排抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dress rehearsal.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论彩排的材料。
collocations: dress rehearsal｜彩排 ; in rehearsal｜在排练中 ; rehearsal room｜排练室
tip_zh: 一次排练可数；in rehearsal表示正在排练。

meanings_zh: adj. 谨慎的；小心的
definition_en: Careful to avoid danger, mistakes, or unnecessary risks.
example1_en: The textbook introduces cautious approach in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了谨慎的方法。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cautious approach.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论谨慎的方法的材料。
collocations: cautious approach｜谨慎的方法 ; cautious about｜对……谨慎 ; cautious optimism｜谨慎乐观
tip_zh: 常用be cautious about doing，表示谨慎做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 饥荒
definition_en: a severe shortage of food affecting many people
example1_en: I copied widespread famine into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把大范围饥荒抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around widespread famine.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕大范围饥荒展开说明。
collocations: widespread famine｜大范围饥荒 ; famine relief｜饥荒救济 ; prevent famine｜预防饥荒
tip_zh: famine指大范围粮食匮乏；个人饥饿用hunger。

meanings_zh: adj. 定性的；性质的
definition_en: Concerned with qualities and descriptions rather than numbers.
example1_en: The interview study used a qualitative method.
example1_zh: 这项访谈研究使用了定性方法。
example2_en: A qualitative comment can explain a number that the chart leaves bare.
example2_zh: 一句定性评论可以解释图表上光秃秃的数字。
collocations: qualitative research｜定性研究 ; qualitative data｜定性数据
tip_zh: 和 quantitative（定量的）成对出现，不要看错首字母。

meanings_zh: adv. 专心地；留意地 | adv. 体贴地；周到地
definition_en: with careful attention to what is happening | with care for another person's needs
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize attentively in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出专心地。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up attentively while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了专心地。
collocations: listen attentively｜专心听 ; watch attentively｜仔细观看 ; care attentively for｜悉心照料
tip_zh: 最常见于listen attentively，重在专心而非关心。

meanings_zh: n. 智慧；明智 | n. 智慧之言；公认看法
definition_en: The ability to judge well using knowledge and experience | Ideas or advice considered sensible and valuable
example1_en: Office hours began with conventional wisdom.
example1_zh: 答疑从普遍接受的看法开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of conventional wisdom.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得普遍接受的看法这个例子。
collocations: conventional wisdom｜普遍接受的看法 ; words of wisdom｜智慧之言 ; question the wisdom of｜质疑……是否明智 ; the wisdom to do something｜做某事的智慧
tip_zh: 不可数；knowledge重知识，wisdom重判断与运用。

meanings_zh: n. 分期付款的一期款项 | n. 连载的一期；系列的一部
definition_en: One of several payments made over time for something. | One part of a story or series released separately.
example1_en: I copied monthly installment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把每月分期款抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects monthly installment with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把每月分期款和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pay in installments｜分期付款 ; monthly installment｜每月分期款 ; the next installment｜下一期；下一部
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为instalment，分期用in。

meanings_zh: v. 展出；展览 | v. 表现出；显示 | n. 展品；证物
definition_en: to display objects or artworks for people to see | to show a particular quality, feeling or behaviour | an object displayed publicly or presented as evidence in court
example1_en: The assignment is to exhibit artwork, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先展出艺术作品，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can exhibit artwork follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够展出艺术作品的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: exhibit artwork｜展出艺术作品 ; exhibit symptoms｜显现症状 ; a museum exhibit｜博物馆展品
tip_zh: 英式英语中，exhibit 通常指单件展品，展览用 exhibition。

meanings_zh: n. 王国 | n. 生物分类中的界
definition_en: a country ruled by a king or queen | one of the largest groups used to classify living things
example1_en: Our professor circled animal kingdom on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了动物界。
example2_en: The reading connects animal kingdom with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把动物界和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: animal kingdom｜动物界 ; plant kingdom｜植物界 ; rule a kingdom｜统治王国
tip_zh: 政治语境指王国；animal kingdom指动物界。

meanings_zh: n. 氮；氮气
definition_en: A chemical element forming most of the gas in Earth's air.
example1_en: The textbook introduces liquid nitrogen in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了液氮。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss liquid nitrogen.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论液氮的材料。
collocations: liquid nitrogen｜液氮 ; nitrogen gas｜氮气 ; nitrogen cycle｜氮循环 ; nitrogen fixation｜固氮
tip_zh: nitrogen是不可数名词，化学符号为N。

meanings_zh: adj. 持续的；经常发生的 | adj. 恒定的；不变的 | n. 常数；恒量
definition_en: continuing or happening repeatedly | remaining the same over time | a value or quantity that does not change
example1_en: The textbook introduces constant pressure in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了持续的压力。
example2_en: The author returns to constant pressure when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了持续的压力。
collocations: constant pressure｜持续的压力 ; constant temperature｜恒温 ; remain constant｜保持不变
tip_zh: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

meanings_zh: v. 播种 | v. 散布；埋下祸根
definition_en: To put seeds in soil so they can grow. | To cause feelings or problems to begin and spread.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to sow seeds.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求播种。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers sow seeds before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要播种。
collocations: sow seeds｜播种 ; sow doubt｜引起怀疑 ; sow discord｜挑拨离间
tip_zh: 过去式sowed，分词sown或sowed；母猪读/saʊ/。

meanings_zh: adj. 人造的；仿造的 | adj. 不自然的；做作的
definition_en: Made by people rather than occurring naturally | Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour
example1_en: Our professor circled artificial intelligence on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了人工智能。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around artificial intelligence.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕人工智能展开说明。
collocations: artificial intelligence｜人工智能 ; artificial lighting｜人工照明 ; artificial sweeteners｜人工甜味剂 ; an artificial smile｜做作的微笑
tip_zh: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

meanings_zh: adj. 光的；光学的 | adj. 视觉的；视力的
definition_en: Relating to light or devices that use light. | Relating to sight or the way the eyes work.
example1_en: Our professor circled optical illusion on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了视错觉。
example2_en: The reading connects optical illusion with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把视错觉和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: optical illusion｜视错觉 ; optical fibre｜光纤 ; optical instrument｜光学仪器
tip_zh: optical涉及光或视觉；optical illusion指视错觉。

meanings_zh: v. 分发；分配 | v. 使分布；使散布
definition_en: to give or deliver something to several people or places | to spread something over an area
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to distribute food.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须分发食物。
example2_en: The reading asks you to distribute food and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你分发食物，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: distribute food｜分发食物 ; distribute resources｜分配资源 ; evenly distributed｜均匀分布的 ; widely distributed｜广泛分布的
tip_zh: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

meanings_zh: n. 礼貌；谦恭 | n. 好意；礼貌之举 | adj. 免费提供的
definition_en: polite behaviour showing respect and consideration for others | a polite or helpful act | provided free to customers as a service
example1_en: Our professor circled common courtesy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基本礼貌。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss common courtesy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论基本礼貌的材料。
collocations: common courtesy｜基本礼貌 ; as a courtesy｜出于礼貌 ; courtesy bus｜免费接送巴士 ; courtesy of｜承蒙……提供
tip_zh: courtesy of表示承蒙某方提供或允许使用。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；毛的 | adj. 严重的；极其恶劣的 | adj. 恶心的；令人厌恶的
definition_en: Calculated before taxes, costs, or other amounts are taken away. | Extremely serious and clearly unacceptable. | Very unpleasant or disgusting.
example1_en: Our professor circled gross income on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了总收入。
example2_en: The author returns to gross income when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了总收入。
collocations: gross income｜总收入 ; gross domestic product｜国内生产总值 ; gross negligence｜重大过失 ; gross profit｜毛利润
tip_zh: 财务中gross为扣除前总额，net为净额。

meanings_zh: v. 贡献；捐助 | v. 促成；是原因之一 | v. 投稿；撰稿
definition_en: To give money, time, or effort towards a shared purpose | To help cause a particular result | To write material for a publication or website
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to contribute to a discussion.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何参与讨论。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers contribute to a discussion before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要参与讨论。
collocations: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论 ; contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; contribute funds｜捐助资金 ; contribute an article｜撰写稿件
tip_zh: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 眼睑；眼皮
definition_en: a fold of skin that closes over the eye
example1_en: I copied upper eyelid into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把上眼睑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to upper eyelid when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了上眼睑。
collocations: upper eyelid｜上眼睑 ; lower eyelid｜下眼睑 ; swollen eyelid｜肿胀的眼皮
tip_zh: eyelid是眼皮；eyelash是睫毛。

meanings_zh: n. 橡树；栎树 | n. 橡木；栎木
definition_en: a large tree that produces acorns | the strong, hard wood of an oak tree
example1_en: The textbook introduces solid oak in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了实心橡木。
example2_en: The author returns to solid oak when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了实心橡木。
collocations: oak tree｜橡树 ; solid oak｜实心橡木 ; oak furniture｜橡木家具 ; oak woodland｜橡树林
tip_zh: 指树时可数，指木材时不可数；oak table中作定语。

meanings_zh: v. 征服；攻占 | v. 克服；战胜
definition_en: Take control of a country or place by force. | Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer conquer a territory during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时征服一片领土。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to conquer a territory.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来征服一片领土。
collocations: conquer a territory｜征服一片领土 ; conquer a fear｜克服恐惧 ; conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语：conquer a fear。

meanings_zh: n. 电子
definition_en: A tiny particle carrying a negative electric charge.
example1_en: The textbook introduces electron microscope in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了电子显微镜。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around electron microscope.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕电子显微镜展开说明。
collocations: electron microscope｜电子显微镜 ; electron flow｜电子流 ; electron beam｜电子束
tip_zh: electron是粒子；electronic意为电子的。

meanings_zh: adj. 完全的；彻底的 | adj. 绝对的；不受限制的
definition_en: complete or total | not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on absolute silence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论鸦雀无声。
example2_en: The reading connects absolute silence with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把鸦雀无声和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: absolute silence｜鸦雀无声 ; absolute certainty｜绝对肯定 ; absolute power｜绝对权力 ; an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip_zh: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 追踪；跟踪监测
definition_en: The process of following movements or monitoring changes over time.
example1_en: The textbook introduces satellite tracking in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了卫星追踪。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around satellite tracking.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕卫星追踪展开说明。
collocations: satellite tracking｜卫星追踪 ; parcel tracking｜包裹追踪 ; tracking device｜追踪装置 ; real-time tracking｜实时追踪
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数；也是track的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；全体适用的 | adj. 通用的
definition_en: Existing everywhere or applying to everyone in a group. | Suitable for use with many different devices or situations.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about universal access.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于普遍享有使用机会的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of universal access.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得普遍享有使用机会这个例子。
collocations: universal access｜普遍享有使用机会 ; universal healthcare｜全民医疗 ; universal appeal｜普遍吸引力 ; universal charger｜通用充电器
tip_zh: 指全体适用或普遍存在，语气通常强于common。

meanings_zh: adj. 共同的；联合的 | n. 关节；接合处
definition_en: Shared, owned, or done by two or more people or groups. | A place where bones or separate parts meet.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on joint effort.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论共同努力。
example2_en: The author returns to joint effort when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了共同努力。
collocations: joint effort｜共同努力 ; joint venture｜合资企业 ; joint decision｜共同决定 ; joint pain｜关节疼痛
tip_zh: joint作形容词指共同参与；作名词可指关节。

meanings_zh: n. 男发言人
definition_en: A man who speaks officially for a group or organisation
example1_en: I copied a government spokesman into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把政府男发言人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a government spokesman.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得政府男发言人这个例子。
collocations: a government spokesman｜政府男发言人 ; a company spokesman｜公司男发言人 ; a spokesman for｜……的男发言人
tip_zh: 特指男性；不强调性别时用spokesperson。

meanings_zh: n. 天体或卫星运行轨道 | v. 绕轨道运行；环绕
definition_en: the curved path of an object moving around another in space | to move around a planet, star, or other object in space
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about enter orbit.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于进入轨道的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects enter orbit with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把进入轨道和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: in orbit｜在轨道上运行 ; enter orbit｜进入轨道 ; a stable orbit｜稳定的轨道 ; orbit the Earth｜绕地球运行
tip_zh: 动词可直接接天体：orbit the Earth，无须加 around。

meanings_zh: n. 细菌
definition_en: A microscopic single-celled organism, sometimes responsible for disease.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a harmful bacterium in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了有害细菌。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a harmful bacterium.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕有害细菌展开说明。
collocations: a harmful bacterium｜有害细菌 ; disease-causing bacteria｜致病细菌 ; beneficial bacteria｜有益细菌
tip_zh: 单数bacterium，复数bacteria；复数作主语用are。

meanings_zh: n. 爆发；突然发生
definition_en: The sudden start of a disease or other harmful event.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a disease outbreak in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了疾病暴发。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a disease outbreak.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论疾病暴发的材料。
collocations: a disease outbreak｜疾病暴发 ; the outbreak of war｜战争爆发 ; contain an outbreak｜控制疫情
tip_zh: 名词outbreak写成一词；动词用break out。

meanings_zh: adj. 繁荣的；富裕的
definition_en: Financially successful and enjoying wealth or economic growth
example1_en: Office hours began with prosperous economy.
example1_zh: 答疑从繁荣的经济开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss prosperous economy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论繁荣的经济的材料。
collocations: prosperous economy｜繁荣的经济 ; prosperous nation｜富裕的国家 ; prosperous future｜富足的未来
tip_zh: 常修饰国家、地区或经济，强调经济上的兴旺。

meanings_zh: v. 移动；转变 | n. 转变；变化 | n. 轮班；轮班工作时间
definition_en: To move or change position, direction, or focus. | A change in position, direction, or emphasis. | A scheduled period of work in a rotating system.
example1_en: The professor asked us to shift the focus.
example1_zh: 教授让我们转移重点。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to shift the focus.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们转移重点。
collocations: shift the focus｜转移重点 ; a shift in attitudes｜态度的转变 ; work a night shift｜上夜班 ; shift responsibility｜推卸责任
tip_zh: shift作名词可指变化，也可指工作班次。

meanings_zh: n. 奴隶制度；奴役状态
definition_en: a system where people are owned and forced to work
example1_en: I copied abolish slavery into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把废除奴隶制抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss abolish slavery.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论废除奴隶制的材料。
collocations: abolish slavery｜废除奴隶制 ; modern slavery｜现代奴役 ; the abolition of slavery｜奴隶制的废除
tip_zh: slavery为不可数名词；abolish slavery指废除奴隶制。

meanings_zh: adj. 易爆的；爆炸的 | adj. 爆发性的；激增的 | n. 炸药；爆炸物
definition_en: able or likely to burst violently | increasing very rapidly or appearing with sudden force | a substance that can cause a violent burst of energy
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about explosive materials.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于易爆材料的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around explosive materials.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕易爆材料展开说明。
collocations: explosive materials｜易爆材料 ; explosive growth｜爆发式增长 ; explosive force｜爆炸力
tip_zh: explosive growth形容激增，并非真正发生爆炸。

meanings_zh: n. 植物的根 | n. 根源；起因 | v. 生根；使生根
definition_en: the part of a plant that absorbs water from soil | the basic cause or origin of something | to grow roots or cause a plant to grow roots
example1_en: The textbook introduces root cause in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了根本原因。
example2_en: The reading connects root cause with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把根本原因和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: root cause｜根本原因 ; take root｜生根；扎根 ; at the root of｜是……的根源 ; plant roots｜植物根部
tip_zh: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。

meanings_zh: n. 订阅；订购 | n. 订阅费；会员费
definition_en: An arrangement to receive a service or publication regularly. | Money paid regularly for a publication, service, or membership.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an annual subscription.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于年度订阅的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an annual subscription.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕年度订阅展开说明。
collocations: an annual subscription｜年度订阅 ; subscription fee｜订阅费 ; renew a subscription｜续订 ; cancel a subscription｜取消订阅
tip_zh: subscription是订阅或费用；用户是subscriber。

meanings_zh: n. 女神
definition_en: A female deity worshipped in a religion or described in mythology.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on harvest goddess.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论丰收女神。
example2_en: The reading connects harvest goddess with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把丰收女神和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: goddess of wisdom｜智慧女神 ; harvest goddess｜丰收女神 ; worship a goddess｜崇拜女神
tip_zh: goddess指女神，对应男性神祇通常用god。

meanings_zh: v. 背诵；朗诵 | v. 逐一叙述；列举
definition_en: Say a poem or passage aloud, often from memory | Say a series of facts or details aloud
example1_en: The professor asked us to recite a poem.
example1_zh: 教授让我们背诵诗歌。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to recite a poem.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来背诵诗歌。
collocations: recite a poem｜背诵诗歌 ; recite from memory｜凭记忆背诵 ; recite a list｜逐一念出清单
tip_zh: recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。

meanings_zh: adj. 悲观的
definition_en: Expecting bad results or focusing on possible problems.
example1_en: I copied a pessimistic outlook into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把悲观的看法抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a pessimistic outlook.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论悲观的看法的材料。
collocations: pessimistic about the future｜对未来悲观 ; a pessimistic outlook｜悲观的看法 ; a pessimistic forecast｜悲观的预测
tip_zh: 常用be pessimistic about；反义词是optimistic。

meanings_zh: n. 课程作业
definition_en: Work completed during a course, often contributing to final assessment.
example1_en: Office hours began with submit coursework.
example1_zh: 答疑从提交课程作业开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around submit coursework.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕提交课程作业展开说明。
collocations: submit coursework｜提交课程作业 ; complete coursework｜完成课程作业 ; coursework assessment｜课程作业考核
tip_zh: 不可数，不说 a coursework；一份用 a piece of。

meanings_zh: adj. 至关重要的；关键的
definition_en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something
example1_en: Our professor circled a crucial role on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了关键作用。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a crucial role.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得关键作用这个例子。
collocations: a crucial role｜关键作用 ; a crucial factor｜关键因素 ; crucial to success｜对成功至关重要 ; a crucial decision｜关键决定
tip_zh: 比important语气强；常用be crucial to。

meanings_zh: n. 顾问；咨询专家 | n. 高级专科医生
definition_en: An expert paid to provide specialist advice. | A senior hospital doctor specialising in a particular medical field.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a management consultant in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了管理顾问。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a management consultant.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得管理顾问这个例子。
collocations: a management consultant｜管理顾问 ; an environmental consultant｜环境顾问 ; hire a consultant｜聘请顾问 ; a consultant surgeon｜高级外科医生
tip_zh: 医疗语境中，英国的consultant指高级专科医生。

meanings_zh: v. 操作；运转 | v. 经营；运营 | v. 做手术
definition_en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine | to run a business or provide a service | to perform surgery on a patient
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to operate machinery.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何操作机器。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to operate machinery.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来操作机器。
collocations: operate machinery｜操作机器 ; operate a business｜经营企业 ; operate on a patient｜给病人做手术 ; operate efficiently｜高效运转
tip_zh: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。

meanings_zh: n. 同伴；伴侣 | n. 参考指南；手册
definition_en: a person or animal that spends time with someone | a book providing useful information about a particular subject
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a travelling companion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于旅伴的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a travelling companion to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用旅伴来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a travelling companion｜旅伴 ; a loyal companion｜忠实的伙伴 ; a companion to literature｜文学指南
tip_zh: companion强调陪伴，不一定是好友，也可指动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其愤怒的 | adj. 猛烈的；激烈的
definition_en: Feeling or showing extreme anger. | Done with great force, energy, or speed.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a furious debate.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论激烈的辩论。
example2_en: The author returns to a furious debate when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了激烈的辩论。
collocations: furious with someone｜对某人大发雷霆 ; furious about something｜因某事极其愤怒 ; a furious debate｜激烈的辩论
tip_zh: 对某人生气用with，因某事生气用about。

meanings_zh: n. 黏土；陶土
definition_en: Heavy earth that can be shaped when wet and baked hard.
example1_en: Office hours began with wet clay.
example1_zh: 答疑从湿黏土开始。
example2_en: The author returns to wet clay when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了湿黏土。
collocations: wet clay｜湿黏土 ; clay soil｜黏土土壤 ; a clay pot｜陶罐 ; shape clay｜塑造陶土
tip_zh: 通常不可数；a piece of clay表示一块黏土。

meanings_zh: v. 延长；扩大 | v. 伸出；伸展 | v. 给予；表示
definition_en: To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope | To stretch out a hand, arm, or other body part | To offer someone help, an invitation, or a welcome
example1_en: The lab instructions say to extend a deadline.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求延长截止期限。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to extend a deadline.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们延长截止期限。
collocations: extend a deadline｜延长截止期限 ; extend a network｜扩展网络 ; extend your hand｜伸出手 ; extend a warm welcome｜表示热烈欢迎
tip_zh: extend by接增加量；extend to接新的终点或期限。

meanings_zh: n. 摩擦；摩擦力 | n. 不和；冲突
definition_en: Resistance when one surface moves or rubs against another. | Disagreement or tension between people or groups.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on reduce friction.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论减小摩擦。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss reduce friction.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论减小摩擦的材料。
collocations: reduce friction｜减小摩擦 ; friction between surfaces｜表面之间的摩擦 ; cause friction｜引起不和 ; a source of friction｜冲突的根源
tip_zh: 物理摩擦与人际不和两义均通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 经济衰退 | n. 退缩；消退
definition_en: A period when economic activity falls and many businesses struggle. | The gradual movement of something backwards from its previous position.
example1_en: The textbook introduces economic recession in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济衰退。
example2_en: A campus survey used economic recession to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经济衰退来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: economic recession｜经济衰退 ; deep recession｜严重衰退 ; enter a recession｜进入衰退期 ; gum recession｜牙龈萎缩
tip_zh: 通常指整体经济衰退，不等于单纯价格下跌。

meanings_zh: n. 害虫；有害动物 | n. 讨厌的人；烦人精
definition_en: An insect or animal that damages crops, food, or property. | Someone who annoys others, especially repeatedly.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a garden pest.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于花园害虫的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of a garden pest.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得花园害虫这个例子。
collocations: pest control｜害虫防治 ; crop pests｜作物害虫 ; a garden pest｜花园害虫
tip_zh: pest不限于昆虫，也可指老鼠等有害动物。

meanings_zh: v. 给……投保；投保
definition_en: Arrange financial protection against loss, damage, illness, or injury.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to insure against theft.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何投保盗窃险。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to insure against theft.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得投保盗窃险。
collocations: insure against theft｜投保盗窃险 ; insure a vehicle｜给车辆投保 ; fully insured｜已足额投保
tip_zh: insure主要指投保；表示确保通常用ensure。

meanings_zh: v. 查明；确定 | v. 决定；影响结果 | v. 决定；下决心
definition_en: To discover or establish something through examination. | To control or strongly influence what happens. | To make a firm decision to do something.
example1_en: The assignment is to determine the cause, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先查明原因，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers determine the cause before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要查明原因。
collocations: determine the cause｜查明原因 ; determine whether｜确定是否 ; determine the outcome｜决定结果 ; be determined to｜决心做……
tip_zh: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

meanings_zh: n. 结果；成果
definition_en: The final result of an action, event, or process.
example1_en: I copied positive outcome into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把积极的结果抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects positive outcome with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把积极的结果和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: positive outcome｜积极的结果 ; learning outcomes｜学习成果 ; health outcomes｜健康结果 ; likely outcome｜可能的结果
tip_zh: 可数名词，常用the outcome of表示某事的结果。

meanings_zh: n. 兽群；畜群 | v. 驱赶；使聚集
definition_en: a group of large animals living or moving together | to guide animals or people together in a particular direction
example1_en: The textbook introduces a herd of cattle in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一群牛。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a herd of cattle.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一群牛展开说明。
collocations: a herd of cattle｜一群牛 ; herd animals｜群居动物 ; herd cattle｜驱赶牛群 ; herd instinct｜从众本能
tip_zh: 牛、象等成群用herd；羊群、鸟群通常用flock。

meanings_zh: n. 小器具；小装置
definition_en: A small device designed to perform a particular useful task
example1_en: I copied electronic gadget into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电子小装置抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss electronic gadget.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电子小装置的材料。
collocations: electronic gadget｜电子小装置 ; kitchen gadget｜厨房小器具 ; handy gadget｜实用的小器具
tip_zh: 指有特定用途的小装置，不一定是电子产品。

meanings_zh: n. 清醒状态；知觉 | n. 意识；认识
definition_en: The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings | Awareness or understanding of a particular issue or situation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about regain consciousness.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于恢复知觉的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to regain consciousness when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了恢复知觉。
collocations: lose consciousness｜失去知觉 ; regain consciousness｜恢复知觉 ; environmental consciousness｜环保意识
tip_zh: consciousness指意识或知觉；conscience指良心。

meanings_zh: n. 礼仪；礼节
definition_en: Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.
example1_en: I copied table etiquette into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把餐桌礼仪抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to table etiquette when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了餐桌礼仪。
collocations: table etiquette｜餐桌礼仪 ; business etiquette｜商务礼仪 ; social etiquette｜社交礼仪 ; rules of etiquette｜礼仪规范
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示礼仪规范，不指单个动作。

meanings_zh: v. 吼叫；轰鸣 | n. 吼声；轰鸣声
definition_en: to make a very loud, deep sound | a very loud, deep sound
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to roar with laughter.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何放声大笑。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to roar with laughter.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们放声大笑。
collocations: roar with laughter｜放声大笑 ; a roar of applause｜雷鸣般的掌声 ; the roar of an engine｜发动机的轰鸣声
tip_zh: 既可指狮子吼叫，也可指引擎轰鸣或人群欢呼。

meanings_zh: n. 纤维 | n. 膳食纤维
definition_en: a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue | plant material in food that helps digestion
example1_en: I copied dietary fibre into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把膳食纤维抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dietary fibre.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论膳食纤维的材料。
collocations: natural fibres｜天然纤维 ; dietary fibre｜膳食纤维 ; optical fibre｜光纤
tip_zh: 美式拼写为 fiber；膳食纤维义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 比较的；对比的 | adj. 相对的；比较而言的 | n. 比较级
definition_en: Examining similarities or differences between two or more things. | True to some degree when compared with something else. | An adjective or adverb form expressing a higher or lower degree.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about comparative study.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于比较研究的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to comparative study when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了比较研究。
collocations: comparative study｜比较研究 ; comparative advantage｜比较优势 ; comparative analysis｜对比分析 ; comparative form｜比较级形式
tip_zh: comparative还可指语法比较级，如better。

meanings_zh: v. 恢复；使复原 | v. 修复；整修 | v. 归还；交还
definition_en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation. | To repair something old or damaged to its earlier condition. | To return something to its rightful owner or place.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to restore confidence.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求恢复信心。
example2_en: The reading asks you to restore confidence and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你恢复信心，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: restore confidence｜恢复信心 ; restore power｜恢复供电 ; restore a historic building｜修复历史建筑 ; restore something to its owner｜将某物归还原主
tip_zh: restore A to B：使A恢复到B状态或归还给B。

meanings_zh: pron. 后者 | adj. 后半的；末尾的
definition_en: the second of two people or things already mentioned | closer to the end of a period or sequence
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the latter half.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论后半部分。
example2_en: The reading connects the latter half with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把后半部分和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the former and the latter｜前者与后者 ; the latter half｜后半部分 ; the latter stages｜后期阶段
tip_zh: the latter指两者中的后者，不等于later。

meanings_zh: adj. 强烈的；剧烈的 | adj. 投入的；情感强烈的
definition_en: very strong or extreme in degree | showing very strong feelings or serious concentration
example1_en: The textbook introduces intense heat in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了酷热。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around intense heat.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕酷热展开说明。
collocations: intense heat｜酷热 ; intense pressure｜巨大压力 ; intense competition｜激烈竞争 ; intense concentration｜高度专注
tip_zh: intense 强调程度强烈；intensive 强调密集投入。

meanings_zh: adj. 无辜的；无罪的 | adj. 天真的；单纯的 | adj. 无恶意的；无害的
definition_en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing. | Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life. | Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on innocent victims.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论无辜的受害者。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss innocent victims.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论无辜的受害者的材料。
collocations: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪 ; innocent victims｜无辜的受害者 ; an innocent mistake｜无心之失
tip_zh: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

meanings_zh: v. 腐烂；使腐烂 | n. 腐烂；腐朽
definition_en: to break down naturally, or cause something to do so | the process or condition of decaying
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rot away.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须逐渐腐烂。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to rot away.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得逐渐腐烂。
collocations: wood rot｜木材腐朽 ; rot away｜逐渐腐烂 ; dry rot｜干腐病
tip_zh: rot与decay都可指腐烂；rotting须双写t。

meanings_zh: n. 账户扣款；借记 | v. 从账户扣款；借记
definition_en: An amount recorded as money taken from a bank account. | To record money as taken from a bank account.
example1_en: I copied direct debit into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把自动扣款抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of direct debit.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得自动扣款这个例子。
collocations: debit card｜借记卡 ; direct debit｜自动扣款 ; debit an account｜从账户扣款
tip_zh: 借记卡用账户余额；信用卡使用授信额度。

meanings_zh: n. 簿记员；记账员
definition_en: Someone whose job is recording a business's financial transactions.
example1_en: Office hours began with part-time bookkeeper.
example1_zh: 答疑从兼职记账员开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used part-time bookkeeper to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用兼职记账员来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: employ a bookkeeper｜雇用记账员 ; part-time bookkeeper｜兼职记账员 ; experienced bookkeeper｜经验丰富的记账员
tip_zh: 主要负责日常记账；accountant职责通常更广。

meanings_zh: adj. 无限的；不限量的
definition_en: not restricted in amount, number, or extent
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on unlimited access.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论无限制使用权。
example2_en: The reading connects unlimited access with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把无限制使用权和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: unlimited access｜无限制使用权 ; unlimited potential｜无限潜力 ; unlimited resources｜无限资源
tip_zh: 表示没有限制；不等于 uncertain（不确定的）。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；协助
definition_en: To help someone do something.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer assist someone with something during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时帮助某人处理某事。
example2_en: The passage says students who can assist someone with something follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够帮助某人处理某事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: assist someone with something｜帮助某人处理某事 ; assist in doing something｜协助做某事 ; assist someone to do something｜帮助某人做某事
tip_zh: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

meanings_zh: n. 茎；梗 | v. 源于；由…造成 | v. 遏制；阻止
definition_en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit | originate or result from something | stop or reduce an unwanted flow or increase
example1_en: Office hours began with plant stem.
example1_zh: 答疑从植物茎开始。
example2_en: The reading connects plant stem with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把植物茎和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: plant stem｜植物茎 ; stem from｜源于 ; stem the flow of｜遏制…的流动 ; stem the tide of｜遏制…的势头
tip_zh: “源于”用stem from；大写STEM指理工科。

meanings_zh: v. 简化；使易懂
definition_en: To make something less complicated or easier to understand.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to simplify a process.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何简化流程。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to simplify a process.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来简化流程。
collocations: simplify a process｜简化流程 ; simplify procedures｜简化手续 ; simplify an explanation｜使解释更易懂
tip_zh: simplify强调减少复杂性；simple是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 安装；设置 | n. 大型设备；设施 | n. 装置艺术作品
definition_en: the process of putting equipment or software in place for use | equipment or buildings arranged for a particular purpose | an artwork made by arranging objects within a space
example1_en: Our professor circled software installation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了软件安装。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss software installation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论软件安装的材料。
collocations: installation costs｜安装费用 ; software installation｜软件安装 ; electrical installation｜电气设备安装 ; art installation｜装置艺术作品
tip_zh: 表示安装过程通常不可数；具体设施或作品可数。

meanings_zh: v. 复制；再现 | v. 繁殖；生育
definition_en: To make a copy or create the same result again. | To produce young animals, plants, or other living organisms.
example1_en: The assignment is to reproduce results, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先复现结果，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to reproduce results.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们复现结果。
collocations: reproduce results｜复现结果 ; reproduce an image｜复制图像 ; reproduce sexually｜进行有性生殖
tip_zh: 复制某物时及物；表示繁殖时常不及物。

meanings_zh: n. 大腿
definition_en: The upper part of the leg, above the knee.
example1_en: The textbook introduces inner thigh in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大腿内侧。
example2_en: A campus survey used inner thigh to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用大腿内侧来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: thigh muscles｜大腿肌肉 ; inner thigh｜大腿内侧 ; thigh injury｜大腿受伤
tip_zh: 指髋部到膝盖之间；小腿通常用lower leg。

meanings_zh: n. 截止日期；最后期限
definition_en: The latest time by which something must be completed
example1_en: Office hours began with a tight deadline.
example1_zh: 答疑从紧迫的截止期限开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of a tight deadline.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得紧迫的截止期限这个例子。
collocations: meet a deadline｜按期完成 ; miss a deadline｜错过截止期限 ; extend a deadline｜延长截止期限 ; a tight deadline｜紧迫的截止期限
tip_zh: 按期完成用meet a deadline，不用catch。

meanings_zh: n. 奴隶 | v. 苦干；辛苦工作
definition_en: a person owned by another and forced to work | to work extremely hard for a long time
example1_en: I copied the slave trade into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把奴隶贸易抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to the slave trade when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了奴隶贸易。
collocations: the slave trade｜奴隶贸易 ; free slaves｜解放奴隶 ; slave away｜拼命干活
tip_zh: 历史语境可用enslaved person，强调其人的身份。

meanings_zh: n. 抑郁症；抑郁 | n. 经济萧条 | n. 洼地；凹陷
definition_en: a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest | a long period of severely reduced economic activity | an area lower than the surface around it
example1_en: The textbook introduces suffer from depression in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了患抑郁症。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of suffer from depression.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得患抑郁症这个例子。
collocations: suffer from depression｜患抑郁症 ; severe depression｜重度抑郁症 ; economic depression｜经济萧条 ; treat depression｜治疗抑郁症
tip_zh: 抑郁症不等于短暂心情低落；经济萧条常用a depression。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；激发 | v. 刺激生理活动
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or become more active | to make a body part or biological process more active
example1_en: The professor asked us to stimulate growth.
example1_zh: 教授让我们促进增长。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to stimulate growth.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们促进增长。
collocations: stimulate growth｜促进增长 ; stimulate interest｜激发兴趣 ; stimulate demand｜刺激需求 ; stimulate the brain｜刺激大脑活动
tip_zh: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。

meanings_zh: adj. 公司的；企业的 | adj. 集体的；全体的
definition_en: Relating to a company or businesses in general. | Shared by a group acting together as one body.
example1_en: Office hours began with corporate culture.
example1_zh: 答疑从企业文化开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of corporate culture.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得企业文化这个例子。
collocations: corporate culture｜企业文化 ; corporate responsibility｜企业责任 ; corporate profits｜企业利润 ; corporate identity｜企业形象
tip_zh: corporate指企业的；cooperative指合作的。

meanings_zh: n. 供应商；供应者
definition_en: a person or company that provides goods or services
example1_en: Office hours began with local supplier.
example1_zh: 答疑从本地供应商开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss local supplier.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论本地供应商的材料。
collocations: local supplier｜本地供应商 ; reliable supplier｜可靠的供应商 ; energy supplier｜能源供应商 ; major supplier｜主要供应商
tip_zh: supplier of后接所供物品；supply为其动词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 研究结果；调查发现 | n. 裁定；判决
definition_en: Information discovered through research or an investigation. | An official decision made by a court after considering evidence.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a finding of fact.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论事实认定。
example2_en: The reading connects a finding of fact with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把事实认定和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: research findings｜研究结果 ; key findings｜主要发现 ; publish the findings｜公布调查结果 ; a finding of fact｜事实认定
tip_zh: 表示研究或调查结果时，常用复数findings。

meanings_zh: adj. 各自的；分别的
definition_en: Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.
example1_en: I copied respective roles into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把各自的角色抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to respective roles when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了各自的角色。
collocations: respective roles｜各自的角色 ; respective responsibilities｜各自的责任 ; respective countries｜各自的国家
tip_zh: 通常放在复数名词前；勿与respectful混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 基金；专用资金 | n. 资金；财力 | v. 为……提供资金
definition_en: money saved or collected for a particular purpose | money available to spend, usually expressed in the plural | to provide money for an activity, organisation, or project
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a pension fund.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于养老基金的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a pension fund.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得养老基金这个例子。
collocations: raise funds｜筹集资金 ; a pension fund｜养老基金 ; public funds｜公共资金 ; fund research｜资助研究
tip_zh: 专用基金可说 a fund；泛指可用资金常用 funds。

meanings_zh: v. 修改；调整 | v. 修饰（词语）
definition_en: To change something slightly to improve it or suit a purpose. | To describe or limit another word's meaning in grammar.
example1_en: The assignment is to modify a design, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先修改设计，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to modify a design.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得修改设计。
collocations: modify a design｜修改设计 ; modify behaviour｜调整行为 ; modify a plan｜调整计划
tip_zh: 通常指局部调整，不一定是彻底改变。

meanings_zh: n. 推测；猜测 | n. 投机买卖
definition_en: Ideas about something without enough evidence to be certain. | Risky buying and selling intended to produce quick profits.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about pure speculation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于纯属猜测的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects pure speculation with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把纯属猜测和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pure speculation｜纯属猜测 ; fuel speculation｜加剧猜测 ; speculation about｜关于……的猜测 ; property speculation｜房地产投机
tip_zh: 猜测内容常接about或that从句；也可指金融投机。

meanings_zh: n. 哮喘
definition_en: A condition that can narrow airways and make breathing difficult
example1_en: Office hours began with severe asthma.
example1_zh: 答疑从重度哮喘开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss severe asthma.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论重度哮喘的材料。
collocations: asthma attack｜哮喘发作 ; severe asthma｜重度哮喘 ; manage asthma｜控制哮喘 ; childhood asthma｜儿童哮喘
tip_zh: 不可数名词；th不发音，英美中间辅音不同。

meanings_zh: prep. 关于；有关
definition_en: On the subject of someone or something.
example1_en: Office hours began with information regarding.
example1_zh: 答疑从关于……的信息开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of information regarding.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得关于……的信息这个例子。
collocations: information regarding｜关于……的信息 ; questions regarding｜有关……的问题 ; concerns regarding｜对……的担忧
tip_zh: regarding直接接名词，不加to；比about正式。

meanings_zh: v. 编织 | v. 穿梭；迂回行进 | v. 编排；将…编入
definition_en: Make fabric or baskets by crossing threads or strips. | Move by repeatedly changing direction around obstacles. | Combine different elements into a connected story or whole.
example1_en: The professor asked us to weave a basket.
example1_zh: 教授让我们编篮子。
example2_en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers weave a basket before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要编篮子。
collocations: weave a basket｜编篮子 ; weave through traffic｜在车流中穿梭 ; weave into a story｜编入故事
tip_zh: 编织义过去式 wove，过去分词 woven。

meanings_zh: n. 测量 | n. 测量值；尺寸
definition_en: The process of finding the size, amount, or degree of something. | A size or quantity found by measuring something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces accurate measurement in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了准确测量。
example2_en: The reading connects accurate measurement with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把准确测量和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: take measurements｜测量尺寸 ; accurate measurement｜准确测量 ; a unit of measurement｜计量单位
tip_zh: 指测量过程常不可数；指具体尺寸时可数。

meanings_zh: conj. 假如；假使
definition_en: used to introduce an imagined situation or possibility
example1_en: Office hours began with supposing we could.
example1_zh: 答疑从假如我们能够开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used supposing we could to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用假如我们能够来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: supposing that｜假如 ; supposing we could｜假如我们能够 ; supposing you were｜假如你是
tip_zh: 相当于if，可接that从句，常用来提出假设。

meanings_zh: v. 保证；确保 | n. 保证；担保 | n. 保修承诺
definition_en: to promise something firmly or make an outcome certain | a firm promise that something will happen or be done | a promise to repair or replace a faulty product
example1_en: I heard the lecturer guarantee that during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时保证……。
example2_en: The passage says students who can guarantee that follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够保证……的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: guarantee that｜保证…… ; guarantee access｜确保获得使用机会 ; under guarantee｜在保修期内 ; money-back guarantee｜退款保证
tip_zh: 可接to do或that从句；保修期内用under guarantee。

meanings_zh: n. 木材；建筑用木料 | n. 用材林；用材树木
definition_en: wood prepared for building or making things | trees grown for wood used in construction or manufacturing
example1_en: Our professor circled sustainably sourced timber on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可持续来源的木材。
example2_en: A campus survey used sustainably sourced timber to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用可持续来源的木材来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: timber industry｜木材产业 ; timber frame｜木构架 ; sustainably sourced timber｜可持续来源的木材
tip_zh: 指木材时通常不可数；美式英语常用lumber指加工木料。

meanings_zh: adj. 不适合的；不合格的 | adj. 体能差的；不健康的
definition_en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose | not physically healthy or strong, often through lack of exercise
example1_en: I copied physically unfit into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把体能差抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to physically unfit when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了体能差。
collocations: unfit for purpose｜不符合用途要求 ; unfit for human consumption｜不宜供人食用 ; physically unfit｜体能差 ; unfit to drive｜不宜驾驶
tip_zh: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。

meanings_zh: n. 维生素
definition_en: A substance needed in small amounts for healthy growth and functioning.
example1_en: Our professor circled vitamin deficiency on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了维生素缺乏。
example2_en: The author returns to vitamin deficiency when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了维生素缺乏。
collocations: vitamin deficiency｜维生素缺乏 ; vitamin supplements｜维生素补充剂 ; rich in vitamins｜富含维生素
tip_zh: 英音首音节读/vɪ/，美音读/vaɪ/。

meanings_zh: n. 海拔；高度
definition_en: Height above sea level or above the ground.
example1_en: Office hours began with cruising altitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从巡航高度开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around cruising altitude.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕巡航高度展开说明。
collocations: at high altitude｜在高海拔地区 ; gain altitude｜升高 ; cruising altitude｜巡航高度
tip_zh: altitude指高度；attitude指态度，注意拼写区别。

meanings_zh: v. 提取；取出；获取 | n. 摘录；节选 | n. 提取物；浓缩物
definition_en: to remove or obtain something from a larger source | a short passage taken from a longer piece of writing | a substance obtained by removing it from its original source
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to extract information from.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何从……获取信息。
example2_en: The reading asks you to extract information from and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你从……获取信息，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: extract information from｜从……获取信息 ; extract a tooth｜拔牙 ; an extract from a novel｜小说节选 ; vanilla extract｜香草精
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈekstrækt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 有女性气质的 | adj. 阴性的（语法）
definition_en: Having qualities or styles traditionally associated with women. | Belonging to a grammatical gender class often associated with females.
example1_en: Our professor circled feminine style on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了柔美的风格。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss feminine style.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论柔美的风格的材料。
collocations: feminine style｜柔美的风格 ; feminine appearance｜女性化的外表 ; feminine noun｜阴性名词
tip_zh: feminine强调气质或语法性；female强调性别。

meanings_zh: n. 债务；欠款 | n. 人情债；恩情
definition_en: Money owed to a person, bank, or other organisation. | A feeling of owing gratitude for help someone has given.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on national debt.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论国债。
example2_en: The author returns to national debt when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了国债。
collocations: pay off a debt｜还清债务 ; be in debt｜负债 ; national debt｜国债 ; a debt of gratitude｜感激之情
tip_zh: b不发音；in debt表示负债。

meanings_zh: n. 外交官 | n. 善于交际的人
definition_en: An official who represents their country in relations with other countries. | Someone skilled at handling people and difficult situations tactfully.
example1_en: Our professor circled a senior diplomat on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了高级外交官。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a senior diplomat.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得高级外交官这个例子。
collocations: a senior diplomat｜高级外交官 ; a career diplomat｜职业外交官 ; a foreign diplomat｜外国外交官
tip_zh: diplomatic既可指外交的，也可指说话圆通的。

meanings_zh: n. 杠杆；操纵杆 | v. 用杠杆撬动 | n. 施加影响的手段
definition_en: A bar used to move something or control a machine | To move something using a bar as a lever | A means of influencing people or changing a situation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a lever for change.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于推动变革的手段的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a lever for change.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得推动变革的手段这个例子。
collocations: pull a lever｜拉动操纵杆 ; lever something open｜撬开某物 ; a lever for change｜推动变革的手段
tip_zh: 英式首音节读/liː/，美式通常读/lev/。

meanings_zh: n. 概要；大纲 | v. 概述；列出要点 | n. 轮廓；外形
definition_en: a short description covering the main points | to describe the main points without giving full details | the line showing the outer shape of something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on essay outline.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论作文提纲。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss essay outline.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论作文提纲的材料。
collocations: essay outline｜作文提纲 ; outline a plan｜概述计划 ; a brief outline｜简要概述 ; the outline of｜……的轮廓
tip_zh: 表示概要时强调主要内容，不包含详细论述。

meanings_zh: n. 图片说明；字幕 | v. 为图片配说明；加字幕
definition_en: Words accompanying an image or showing speech on a screen | To add explanatory words to an image or video
example1_en: The textbook introduces a photo caption in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了照片说明。
example2_en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a photo caption.
example2_zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得照片说明这个例子。
collocations: a photo caption｜照片说明 ; write a caption｜撰写图片说明 ; closed captions｜可开关字幕
tip_zh: caption配图片或视频；新闻报道标题通常用headline。

meanings_zh: adj. 有系统的；有条理的
definition_en: Following an organised plan or method rather than acting randomly.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a systematic approach in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了系统的方法。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a systematic approach.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕系统的方法展开说明。
collocations: a systematic approach｜系统的方法 ; a systematic review｜系统综述 ; systematic analysis｜系统分析
tip_zh: systematic指有条理；systemic指系统整体的。

meanings_zh: n. 大笔财富 | n. 运气；命运
definition_en: A very large amount of money | Luck or the events that shape someone's life
example1_en: I copied good fortune into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把好运抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of good fortune.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得好运这个例子。
collocations: make a fortune｜赚大钱 ; cost a fortune｜花费巨款 ; good fortune｜好运 ; tell someone's fortune｜给某人算命
tip_zh: 表示大笔财富时用a fortune；表示运气时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 考古学
definition_en: The study of past societies through objects and remains.
example1_en: Office hours began with an archaeology degree.
example1_zh: 答疑从考古学学位开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used an archaeology degree to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用考古学学位来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: study archaeology｜学习考古学 ; an archaeology degree｜考古学学位 ; an archaeology museum｜考古博物馆
tip_zh: 通常不可数；研究恐龙化石属于古生物学。

meanings_zh: n. 爆炸 | n. 激增；突增 | n. 情感的突然爆发
definition_en: a sudden violent release of energy, usually with a bang | a sudden and very large increase | a sudden strong expression of emotion
example1_en: The textbook introduces a gas explosion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了燃气爆炸。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a gas explosion.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论燃气爆炸的材料。
collocations: a gas explosion｜燃气爆炸 ; a population explosion｜人口激增 ; an explosion of anger｜怒气爆发
tip_zh: 表示数量激增时，常用an explosion in加名词。

meanings_zh: n. 紧张局势；紧张关系 | n. 紧张；焦虑 | n. 张力；拉力
definition_en: Strained relations between people or groups that may cause conflict | A feeling of worry that makes relaxation difficult | A force that stretches or pulls something tight
example1_en: I copied ease tension into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把缓解紧张抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to ease tension when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了缓解紧张。
collocations: ease tension｜缓解紧张 ; political tension｜政治紧张局势 ; muscle tension｜肌肉紧绷 ; surface tension｜表面张力
tip_zh: 关系紧张常用tension between；多方矛盾可用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 大量制造；生产 | n. 制造；生产
definition_en: to produce goods, usually in large quantities using machinery | the process of producing goods, especially in factories
example1_en: I heard the lecturer manufacture goods during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时制造商品。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to manufacture goods.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们制造商品。
collocations: manufacture goods｜制造商品 ; the manufacture of｜……的制造 ; manufacturing industry｜制造业 ; manufacturing costs｜制造成本
tip_zh: 多指工厂批量生产；名词制造商是manufacturer。

meanings_zh: v. 强制实行；征收 | v. 把…强加于 | v. 给人添麻烦；占用
definition_en: Officially introduce a rule, tax, punishment, or restriction | Force someone to accept something they do not want | Expect help or attention that causes someone inconvenience
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to impose restrictions on.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须对…施加限制。
example2_en: The passage says students who can impose restrictions on follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够对…施加限制的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: impose restrictions on｜对…施加限制 ; impose a tax on｜对…征税 ; impose one's views on｜把自己的观点强加于 ; impose on someone's time｜占用某人的时间
tip_zh: 常用 impose A on B，表示把A强加于B。

meanings_zh: n. 命运；天命
definition_en: A future believed to be fixed by forces beyond personal control.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on shape your own destiny.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论塑造自己的命运。
example2_en: The reading connects shape your own destiny with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把塑造自己的命运和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: shape your own destiny｜塑造自己的命运 ; fulfil your destiny｜实现命中注定的使命 ; a sense of destiny｜使命感
tip_zh: 常指注定的未来；shape your destiny强调主动掌握命运。

meanings_zh: n. 稳定；稳固性
definition_en: The ability to remain steady and resist unwanted change
example1_en: Our professor circled economic stability on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济稳定。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of economic stability.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得经济稳定这个例子。
collocations: economic stability｜经济稳定 ; political stability｜政治稳定 ; financial stability｜财务稳定 ; maintain stability｜维持稳定
tip_zh: 通常不可数；形容词为stable，反义词为instability。

meanings_zh: n. 职位空缺 | n. 空房；可用客房
definition_en: A job or position available for someone to fill. | A room available for someone to stay in.
example1_en: Our professor circled job vacancy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了职位空缺。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss job vacancy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论职位空缺的材料。
collocations: job vacancy｜职位空缺 ; fill a vacancy｜填补空缺 ; a vacancy for｜……的职位空缺 ; no vacancies｜客房已满
tip_zh: 职位、客房空缺均可数；复数为vacancies。

meanings_zh: n. 方式；方法 | n. 运行模式
definition_en: A particular way of doing something. | A setting that controls how a device or system operates.
example1_en: Our professor circled silent mode on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了静音模式。
example2_en: The author returns to silent mode when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了静音模式。
collocations: mode of transport｜交通方式 ; mode of communication｜交流方式 ; silent mode｜静音模式 ; sleep mode｜睡眠模式
tip_zh: 方式常用mode of；设备处于某模式用in ... mode。

meanings_zh: v. 概括；总结
definition_en: to state the main points briefly
example1_en: The assignment is to summarize the findings, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先概括研究结果，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to summarize the findings and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你概括研究结果，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: summarize the findings｜概括研究结果 ; summarize the main points｜总结要点 ; summarize an argument｜概述论点
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作summarise；总结时保留要点。

meanings_zh: adj. 中立的；不偏不倚的 | adj. 中性色的；素净的 | n. 空挡
definition_en: not supporting either side in a disagreement or conflict | having a colour that is not bright or strong | a gear position in which the engine does not drive wheels
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a neutral observer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论中立观察者。
example2_en: The reading connects a neutral observer with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把中立观察者和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: remain neutral｜保持中立 ; a neutral observer｜中立观察者 ; neutral colours｜中性色 ; in neutral｜处于空挡
tip_zh: 保持中立用remain neutral；车辆挂空挡用in neutral。

meanings_zh: adv. 主要地；首要地
definition_en: Mainly, or more than anything else
example1_en: The lab manual says to primarily responsible for before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先对……负主要责任，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who primarily responsible for are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够对……负主要责任的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: primarily responsible for｜对……负主要责任 ; primarily concerned with｜主要关注…… ; primarily due to｜主要由于
tip_zh: 通常表示“主要”，不是表示先后顺序的“首先”。

meanings_zh: n. 国歌；颂歌 | n. 宗教合唱曲；赞美诗
definition_en: A song expressing loyalty to a country or group | A religious song sung by a choir
example1_en: I copied national anthem into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把国歌抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects national anthem with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把国歌和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: national anthem｜国歌 ; sing an anthem｜唱颂歌 ; the national anthem plays｜国歌奏响
tip_zh: national anthem指国歌；宗教语境中可指合唱赞美诗。

meanings_zh: n. 乌鸦 | v. 鸡啼；打鸣 | v. 得意地夸耀
definition_en: A large black bird with a loud, rough call. | Make the loud call typical of a male chicken. | Talk proudly and annoyingly about your own success.
example1_en: The professor explained crow with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了乌鸦。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses crow when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了乌鸦。
collocations: a flock of crows｜一群乌鸦 ; a rooster crows｜公鸡打鸣 ; crow about a victory｜得意地夸耀胜利
tip_zh: 名词指乌鸦，动词却可指公鸡打鸣。

meanings_zh: n. 附录 | n. 阑尾
definition_en: An extra section containing supporting information at a book's end | A small tube attached to the beginning of the large intestine
example1_en: Our professor circled a ruptured appendix on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了破裂的阑尾。
example2_en: The author returns to a ruptured appendix when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了破裂的阑尾。
collocations: in the appendix｜在附录中 ; an appendix to a report｜报告的附录 ; a ruptured appendix｜破裂的阑尾
tip_zh: 附录复数可用appendices；阑尾常用appendixes。

meanings_zh: n. 咨询师；辅导员 | n. 顾问 | n. 律师；法律顾问
definition_en: Someone trained to help people with personal or emotional problems. | Someone who gives advice on a particular subject. | A lawyer, especially in American English.
example1_en: Office hours began with school counselor.
example1_zh: 答疑从学校辅导员开始。
example2_en: The reading connects school counselor with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把学校辅导员和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: school counselor｜学校辅导员 ; mental health counselor｜心理健康咨询师 ; career counselor｜职业顾问
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写作 counsellor。

meanings_zh: n. 生物；生命个体 | n. 存在；本质
definition_en: a living creature, especially a person | existence or the essential nature of a person or thing
example1_en: Office hours began with human being.
example1_zh: 答疑从人开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of human being.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得人这个例子。
collocations: human being｜人 ; living being｜生物 ; come into being｜形成；产生
tip_zh: 指生物时可数；表示“存在”时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；保存；维持 | v. 保藏食物 | n. 保护区
definition_en: Keep something safe, unchanged, or in good condition | Treat food so it stays safe to eat longer | An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected
example1_en: The assignment is to preserve cultural heritage, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先保护文化遗产，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on environmental policy showed why researchers preserve cultural heritage before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于环境政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要保护文化遗产。
collocations: preserve cultural heritage｜保护文化遗产 ; preserve biodiversity｜保护生物多样性 ; preserve food｜保藏食物
tip_zh: preserve强调保持原状；保藏食物也用它。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评定 | v. 估价；核定金额
definition_en: Judge the quality, importance, or condition of something. | Calculate the value of something or the amount owed.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to assess the impact.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何评估影响。
example2_en: The passage says students who can assess the impact follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够评估影响的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: assess the impact｜评估影响 ; assess the risk｜评估风险 ; assess performance｜评定表现 ; assess the damage｜评估损失
tip_zh: assess后直接接宾语；名词形式是assessment。

meanings_zh: n. 组成；成分 | n. 作文；乐曲 | n. 创作；作曲
definition_en: The parts or substances that something consists of | A piece of writing or music | The activity of creating music or written work
example1_en: Our professor circled chemical composition on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了化学成分。
example2_en: The author returns to chemical composition when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了化学成分。
collocations: chemical composition｜化学成分 ; soil composition｜土壤成分 ; musical composition｜音乐作品 ; write a composition｜写作文
tip_zh: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 广泛的；大量的 | adj. 辽阔的；大面积的
definition_en: covering many subjects or involving a large amount | covering a large physical area
example1_en: The textbook introduces extensive research in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了广泛研究。
example2_en: The reading connects extensive research with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把广泛研究和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: extensive research｜广泛研究 ; extensive damage｜大面积损坏 ; extensive experience｜丰富经验 ; extensive network｜庞大的网络
tip_zh: 强调范围广或数量多；intensive强调集中、强度高。

meanings_zh: n. 电缆；线缆 | n. 钢缆；缆绳
definition_en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals | a thick strong rope, usually made of metal wires
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about power cable.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于电源线的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss power cable.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电源线的材料。
collocations: power cable｜电源线 ; fibre-optic cable｜光缆 ; undersea cable｜海底电缆 ; steel cable｜钢缆
tip_zh: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。

meanings_zh: adj. 耗时的
definition_en: taking a lot of time to do or complete
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize time-consuming in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出耗时的。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses time-consuming when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了耗时的。
