collocations: time-consuming task｜耗时的任务 ; time-consuming process｜耗时的过程 ; costly and time-consuming｜费钱又费时
tip_zh: 强调花费大量时间，不一定表示浪费时间。

meanings_zh: n. 女主角 | n. 女英雄；杰出女性
definition_en: the main female character in a story | a woman admired for courage or remarkable achievements
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a national heroine.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论民族女英雄。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a national heroine.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得民族女英雄这个例子。
collocations: the heroine of a novel｜小说的女主角 ; a national heroine｜民族女英雄 ; a tragic heroine｜悲剧女主角
tip_zh: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。

meanings_zh: n. 捕食者；食肉动物 | n. 掠夺者；剥削者
definition_en: An animal that hunts and eats other animals. | A person or organisation that exploits others for personal gain.
example1_en: I copied natural predator into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把天敌抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects natural predator with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把天敌和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: natural predator｜天敌 ; apex predator｜顶级捕食者 ; predator population｜捕食者种群
tip_zh: predator是捕食者，prey是被捕食的猎物。

meanings_zh: n. 投资；投资款 | n. 时间或精力的投入
definition_en: Money put into something with the aim of future profit. | Time or effort spent on something expected to bring benefits.
example1_en: The textbook introduces foreign investment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了外国投资。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss foreign investment.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论外国投资的材料。
collocations: investment in infrastructure｜基础设施投资 ; foreign investment｜外国投资 ; return on investment｜投资回报 ; an investment of time｜时间投入
tip_zh: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；主要的 | adj. 最优质的；绝佳的 | n. 鼎盛时期；壮年
definition_en: most important or central | of the best quality or in the best position | the period of greatest strength, success, or ability
example1_en: Our professor circled prime concern on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了首要关切。
example2_en: The reading connects prime concern with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把首要关切和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: prime concern｜首要关切 ; prime example｜典型例子 ; prime location｜绝佳地段 ; in your prime｜处于鼎盛时期
tip_zh: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一个例子。

meanings_zh: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的
definition_en: not wanting or agreeing to do something
example1_en: Our professor circled unwilling to accept on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不愿接受。
example2_en: The author returns to unwilling to accept when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不愿接受。
collocations: unwilling to accept｜不愿接受 ; unwilling to cooperate｜不愿合作 ; an unwilling participant｜不情愿的参与者
tip_zh: 常用be unwilling to do；不愿做不等于unable不能做。

meanings_zh: v. 维持；保持 | v. 保养；维护 | v. 坚持声称
definition_en: To keep something at the same level or in existence. | To keep something working well through regular care and repairs. | To firmly state that something is true.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer maintain a balance during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时保持平衡。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to maintain a balance.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保持平衡。
collocations: maintain a balance｜保持平衡 ; maintain standards｜维持标准 ; maintain equipment｜保养设备 ; maintain that｜坚持声称
tip_zh: maintain后直接接宾语；表示坚持声称时可接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 年老的；上了年纪的
definition_en: old, especially when describing people
example1_en: Our professor circled elderly people on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了老年人。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss elderly people.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论老年人的材料。
collocations: elderly people｜老年人 ; elderly residents｜老年居民 ; elderly care｜老年护理
tip_zh: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

meanings_zh: v. 隔离；使孤立 | v. 分离；单独确定
definition_en: Separate someone or something from others. | Separate or identify one substance, factor, or problem for examination.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer isolate a variable during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时单独考察一个变量。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to isolate a variable.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来单独考察一个变量。
collocations: isolate someone from｜使某人与……隔离 ; isolate a variable｜单独考察一个变量 ; isolate the cause｜确定原因
tip_zh: 常用isolate A from B；形容词是isolated。

meanings_zh: v. 肿胀；膨胀 | v. 增加；增强 | n. 海面涌浪
definition_en: To become larger or rounder, or make something do so. | To increase in amount or strength, or cause this. | The movement of long, smooth waves across the sea.
example1_en: The professor asked us to swell up.
example1_zh: 教授让我们肿起来。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to swell up.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来肿起来。
collocations: swell up｜肿起来 ; swell with pride｜内心充满自豪 ; a heavy swell｜汹涌的涌浪
tip_zh: 过去式swelled；过去分词常用swollen。

meanings_zh: adj. 摄影的；照片的 | adj. 记忆极精确的
definition_en: relating to photography or photographs | able to remember visual details with great accuracy
example1_en: Office hours began with photographic equipment.
example1_zh: 答疑从摄影器材开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used photographic equipment to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用摄影器材来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: photographic equipment｜摄影器材 ; photographic evidence｜照片证据 ; a photographic memory｜过目不忘的记忆力
tip_zh: photographic memory指记忆极精确，并非照片存储。

meanings_zh: n. 幻想；想象 | n. 奇幻文学；奇幻作品
definition_en: An imagined situation that is unlikely to happen | Stories featuring magic, imaginary worlds, or impossible events
example1_en: The textbook introduces a childhood fantasy in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了童年的幻想。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a childhood fantasy.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得童年的幻想这个例子。
collocations: a childhood fantasy｜童年的幻想 ; fantasy fiction｜奇幻小说 ; a fantasy world｜幻想世界 ; indulge in fantasy｜沉浸于幻想
tip_zh: 具体幻想可数；表示奇幻文学类型时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 大多数；过半数 | n. 超出对方的票数
definition_en: the larger part of a group, exceeding half its members | the extra votes by which one candidate or side wins
example1_en: I copied a clear majority into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把明显多数抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a clear majority with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把明显多数和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the vast majority of｜……的绝大多数 ; a clear majority｜明显多数 ; win a majority｜赢得多数票
tip_zh: the majority of接复数名词时，谓语通常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 叙述者；旁白者
definition_en: The person or voice telling a story
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about first-person narrator.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于第一人称叙述者的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects first-person narrator with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把第一人称叙述者和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: first-person narrator｜第一人称叙述者 ; unreliable narrator｜不可靠的叙述者 ; documentary narrator｜纪录片旁白者
tip_zh: 叙述者不一定是作者；小说中可由虚构人物担任。

meanings_zh: n. 后缀
definition_en: A word part added at the end to change meaning or grammar.
example1_en: I copied a noun suffix into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把名词后缀抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a noun suffix when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了名词后缀。
collocations: add a suffix｜添加后缀 ; a noun suffix｜名词后缀 ; a plural suffix｜复数后缀
tip_zh: suffix加在词尾；prefix加在词首。

meanings_zh: adj. 团结的；一致的 | adj. 联合的；统一的
definition_en: Working together or sharing the same aims and opinions. | Joined together to form a single group or whole.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a united front.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于统一战线的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a united front.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论统一战线的材料。
collocations: a united front｜统一战线 ; a united response｜一致的回应 ; united in opposition｜一致反对 ; remain united｜保持团结
tip_zh: be united in后接共同立场；united front指一致阵线。

meanings_zh: n. 语言学
definition_en: The scientific study of language and how it works.
example1_en: Office hours began with applied linguistics.
example1_zh: 答疑从应用语言学开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around applied linguistics.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕应用语言学展开说明。
collocations: applied linguistics｜应用语言学 ; historical linguistics｜历史语言学 ; study linguistics｜学习语言学
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，作为学科名通常接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 谜语 | n. 谜；难解之事
definition_en: a puzzling question with a clever or unexpected answer | something mysterious that is difficult to understand or explain
example1_en: The professor explained riddle with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了谜语。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses riddle when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了谜语。
collocations: solve a riddle｜解开谜语 ; pose a riddle｜出谜语 ; remain a riddle｜仍是一个谜
tip_zh: 谜语的答案用answer；解谜可用solve a riddle。

meanings_zh: n. 工作狂
definition_en: Someone who works excessively and finds it hard to stop
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a self-confessed workaholic.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自认的工作狂。
example2_en: A campus survey used a self-confessed workaholic to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用自认的工作狂来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a self-confessed workaholic｜自认的工作狂 ; become a workaholic｜成为工作狂 ; a workaholic culture｜过度工作的文化
tip_zh: 强调工作过度、难以停下，不等于单纯勤奋。

meanings_zh: adj. 军事的；军队的 | n. 军队；武装力量
definition_en: relating to armed forces or their activities | a country's armed forces, considered as a group
example1_en: I copied the military into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把军队抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects the military with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把军队和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: military service｜兵役 ; military spending｜军事开支 ; military personnel｜军人 ; the military｜军队
tip_zh: 作名词指整体军队时，通常用the military。

meanings_zh: v. 使复杂化；使更难处理
definition_en: to make something harder to understand or deal with
example1_en: The lab instructions say to complicate matters.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求使事情复杂化。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to complicate matters.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们使事情复杂化。
collocations: complicate matters｜使事情复杂化 ; complicate the situation｜使局势复杂化 ; complicate the process｜使过程复杂化
tip_zh: 及物动词，后接被弄复杂的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 畅销书；畅销商品
definition_en: a book or product that sells in very large quantities
example1_en: I wrote best-seller on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把best-seller和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain best-seller usually follow the rest of a lecture on the humanities.
example2_zh: 能解释畅销书的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人文学科的讲座。
collocations: an international best-seller｜国际畅销书 ; become a best-seller｜成为畅销书 ; a best-seller list｜畅销书排行榜
tip_zh: 也常写作bestseller；形容词用best-selling。

meanings_zh: n. 困倦；睡意
definition_en: The feeling of being tired and wanting to sleep.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on daytime sleepiness.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论白天困倦。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss daytime sleepiness.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论白天困倦的材料。
collocations: daytime sleepiness｜白天困倦 ; excessive sleepiness｜过度嗜睡 ; shake off sleepiness｜驱散睡意
tip_zh: 不可数名词，指想睡的感觉，不等于已经入睡。

meanings_zh: n. 兴奋感；激动 | v. 使非常兴奋；使激动
definition_en: a sudden strong feeling of excitement and pleasure | to make someone feel very excited and pleased
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the thrill of discovery.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于发现的兴奋感的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects the thrill of discovery with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把发现的兴奋感和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the thrill of discovery｜发现的兴奋感 ; a thrill of excitement｜一阵兴奋 ; thrill an audience｜使观众激动
tip_zh: thrilled表示人很兴奋；thrilling表示事物令人兴奋。

meanings_zh: v. 脸红 | n. 脸红；红晕
definition_en: To become red in the face from embarrassment or shyness. | Redness in the face caused by embarrassment or shyness.
example1_en: The assignment is to blush with embarrassment, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先尴尬得脸红，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to blush with embarrassment and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你尴尬得脸红，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: blush with embarrassment｜尴尬得脸红 ; make someone blush｜使某人脸红 ; a deep blush｜满脸通红
tip_zh: 动词通常不及物；使某人脸红用make someone blush。

meanings_zh: n. 参赛者
definition_en: A person who takes part in a competition.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on quiz show contestant.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论问答节目的选手。
example2_en: The reading connects quiz show contestant with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把问答节目的选手和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: contestant in a competition｜比赛中的参赛者 ; quiz show contestant｜问答节目的选手 ; winning contestant｜获胜选手
tip_zh: contestant指参赛者；participant也可指普通活动参与者。

meanings_zh: v. 限制；限定
definition_en: to limit what someone can do or how much is allowed
example1_en: I heard the lecturer restrict access during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时限制进入或使用。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to restrict access.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来限制进入或使用。
collocations: restrict access｜限制进入或使用 ; restrict movement｜限制行动 ; restrict something to｜将某事物限定于
tip_zh: restrict A to B表示“把A限定在B范围内”。

meanings_zh: n. 油漆装潢工；室内装饰师
definition_en: Someone whose job is painting, wallpapering, or decorating rooms.
example1_en: Office hours began with painter and decorator.
example1_zh: 答疑从油漆装潢工开始。
example2_en: The reading connects painter and decorator with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把油漆装潢工和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: painter and decorator｜油漆装潢工 ; interior decorator｜室内装饰师 ; hire a decorator｜雇用装潢工
tip_zh: 英式英语常指刷墙、贴墙纸的工人，不仅是设计师。

meanings_zh: n. 居民；栖居动物
definition_en: A person or animal that lives in a particular place.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used inhabitant in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了居民。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up inhabitant while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了居民。
collocations: local inhabitants｜当地居民 ; the inhabitants of a city｜一座城市的居民 ; original inhabitants｜原住居民
tip_zh: 常用inhabitants of＋地点；不等于具有公民身份的citizens。

meanings_zh: n. 喜爱；偏好
definition_en: a feeling of enjoying or being fond of something
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a liking for.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于对……的喜爱的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a liking for with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……的喜爱和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a liking for｜对……的喜爱 ; take a liking to｜开始喜欢上 ; to your liking｜合你的心意 ; develop a liking for｜逐渐喜欢上
tip_zh: a liking for表示喜欢；to your liking表示合心意。

meanings_zh: adj. 艺术的；艺术创作的 | adj. 有艺术天赋的 | adj. 有艺术美感的
definition_en: Related to art or the creation of art | Good at creating or appreciating art | Beautiful or attractive in a way that shows creative skill
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on artistic expression.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论艺术表达。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around artistic expression.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕艺术表达展开说明。
collocations: artistic expression｜艺术表达 ; artistic talent｜艺术天赋 ; artistic freedom｜艺术自由 ; artistic value｜艺术价值
tip_zh: artistic指艺术或艺术天赋；artificial指人造的。

meanings_zh: adj. 意识到的；察觉到的 | adj. 神志清醒的 | adj. 有意的；刻意的
definition_en: aware of something or noticing that it exists | awake and able to notice and respond to your surroundings | done deliberately rather than automatically
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about conscious of.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于意识到的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to conscious of when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了意识到。
collocations: conscious of｜意识到 ; remain conscious｜保持清醒 ; a conscious effort｜有意识的努力 ; a conscious decision｜有意作出的决定
tip_zh: 意识到某事用be conscious of，勿与conscience混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 无家可归的
definition_en: Without a permanent place to live.
example1_en: Office hours began with homeless people.
example1_zh: 答疑从无家可归的人开始。
example2_en: The reading connects homeless people with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把无家可归的人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: homeless people｜无家可归的人 ; become homeless｜变得无家可归 ; leave someone homeless｜使某人无家可归 ; a homeless shelter｜无家可归者收容所
tip_zh: 不能说a homeless；应说a homeless person。

meanings_zh: n. 反馈；意见
definition_en: comments about performance or work that help someone improve
example1_en: Our professor circled constructive feedback on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了建设性的反馈。
example2_en: The reading connects constructive feedback with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把建设性的反馈和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: constructive feedback｜建设性的反馈 ; give feedback on｜对……给予反馈 ; customer feedback｜客户反馈 ; ask for feedback｜征求反馈
tip_zh: 不可数，不说a feedback或feedbacks；用some feedback。

meanings_zh: v. 使吓一跳
definition_en: To suddenly surprise or frighten someone
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to startle easily.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何容易受惊。
example2_en: The passage says students who can startle easily follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够容易受惊的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: startle someone｜吓某人一跳 ; be startled by｜被……吓一跳 ; startle easily｜容易受惊
tip_zh: 强调突然受惊，不等于长期感到害怕。

meanings_zh: v. 偿还；归还 | v. 报答；回报
definition_en: to pay back money that you owe | to give something in return for help or kindness
example1_en: The lab instructions say to repay a loan.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求偿还贷款。
example2_en: The reading asks you to repay a loan and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你偿还贷款，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: repay a loan｜偿还贷款 ; repay a debt｜偿还债务 ; repay someone's kindness｜报答某人的好意
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为repaid；不表示报复。

meanings_zh: n. 悲痛；哀伤
definition_en: Deep sadness, especially after someone you love has died
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about deep grief.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于深切的悲痛的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deep grief.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论深切的悲痛的材料。
collocations: deep grief｜深切的悲痛 ; overcome with grief｜悲痛欲绝 ; cope with grief｜应对悲痛
tip_zh: 表示悲痛时通常不可数，常与失去亲人有关。

meanings_zh: adj. 字面的；非比喻的 | adj. 逐字的
definition_en: using the basic meaning of words, without metaphor | following the exact words rather than the overall meaning
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about literal meaning.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于字面意思的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects literal meaning with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把字面意思和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: literal meaning｜字面意思 ; literal translation｜逐字翻译 ; literal interpretation｜按字面理解
tip_zh: literal指字面义；literary指文学的，注意区别。

meanings_zh: v. 澄清；阐明 | v. 使液体澄清
definition_en: To make something easier to understand by explaining it clearly. | To make a liquid clearer by removing unwanted substances.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer clarify a point during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时阐明一点。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers clarify a point before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要阐明一点。
collocations: clarify a point｜阐明一点 ; clarify the situation｜澄清情况 ; clarify the meaning｜解释含义 ; clarified butter｜澄清黄油
tip_zh: clarify直接接需要解释的内容，如clarify the rules。

meanings_zh: n. 合作；协作 | n. 通敌；与敌方合作
definition_en: Working together with others to achieve a shared goal | Helping an enemy that controls your country
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about international collaboration.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于国际合作的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of international collaboration.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得国际合作这个例子。
collocations: in collaboration with｜与…合作 ; close collaboration｜密切合作 ; international collaboration｜国际合作 ; collaboration between｜…之间的合作
tip_zh: 普通语境指合作；通敌义须结合战争背景。

meanings_zh: n. 步枪 | v. 翻找；搜寻
definition_en: A long gun held against the shoulder when fired. | To search through things quickly, often leaving them untidy.
example1_en: Our professor circled a hunting rifle on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了猎枪。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a hunting rifle.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕猎枪展开说明。
collocations: a hunting rifle｜猎枪 ; a rifle barrel｜步枪枪管 ; rifle through drawers｜翻找抽屉
tip_zh: 作动词时常用rifle through，表示匆忙翻找。

meanings_zh: n. 局外人；外来者 | n. 不被看好的竞争者
definition_en: Someone who does not belong to a particular group. | A competitor considered unlikely to win.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a rank outsider.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于极不被看好的竞争者的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a rank outsider.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕极不被看好的竞争者展开说明。
collocations: feel like an outsider｜觉得自己是局外人 ; an outsider's perspective｜局外人的视角 ; a rank outsider｜极不被看好的竞争者
tip_zh: 既可指圈外人，也可指不被看好的参赛者。

meanings_zh: v. 使分心；转移注意力
definition_en: To draw someone's attention away from what they are doing
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to distract attention from.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须转移对……的注意力。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to distract attention from.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们转移对……的注意力。
collocations: distract someone from｜使某人从……分心 ; distract attention from｜转移对……的注意力 ; easily distracted｜容易分心的
tip_zh: 常用distract sb from sth或doing sth。

meanings_zh: adv. 自由地；不受限制地 | adv. 坦率地；毫不隐瞒地 | adv. 自愿地；慷慨地
definition_en: without restrictions or anything preventing movement or action | openly and honestly, without hiding thoughts or facts | willingly and generously, without being forced
example1_en: The lab manual says to freely admit before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先坦率承认，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who freely admit are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够坦率承认的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: move freely｜自由移动 ; speak freely｜畅所欲言 ; freely admit｜坦率承认 ; give freely｜慷慨给予
tip_zh: freely主要指不受限制；免费用for free。

meanings_zh: v. 咒骂 | n. 诅咒；咒语 | n. 祸害；灾祸
definition_en: to use rude words because you are angry | words intended to bring someone bad luck through magic | something that causes serious trouble or suffering
example1_en: The assignment is to curse under one's breath, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先低声咒骂，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to curse under one's breath.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来低声咒骂。
collocations: curse under one's breath｜低声咒骂 ; put a curse on｜对……施加诅咒 ; a blessing and a curse｜既是福也是祸
tip_zh: curse可指咒骂或诅咒；swear也可指发誓。

meanings_zh: adj. 店内的 | adv. 在实体店内
definition_en: happening or available inside a physical shop | inside a physical shop rather than online
example1_en: After the lecture, we used in-store in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了店内的。
example2_en: Students who can explain in-store usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释店内的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: in-store shopping｜实体店购物 ; in-store services｜店内服务 ; in-store promotion｜店内促销 ; available in-store｜可在店内购买的
tip_zh: in-store指店内的；“有库存”通常说in stock。

meanings_zh: n. 生存；幸存；存续
definition_en: the state of remaining alive or continuing to exist
example1_en: Our professor circled long-term survival on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了长期生存。
example2_en: The author returns to long-term survival when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了长期生存。
collocations: survival skills｜求生技能 ; survival rate｜存活率 ; long-term survival｜长期生存 ; fight for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip_zh: survival指生存状态；幸存者用survivor。

meanings_zh: adj. 成熟的；明事理的 | adj. 发育完全的；成年的 | v. 成熟；发育成熟
definition_en: Behaving sensibly and showing good judgment | Fully grown or developed | To become fully developed or more sensible
example1_en: Our professor circled emotionally mature on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了情感成熟的。
example2_en: The author returns to emotionally mature when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了情感成熟的。
collocations: a mature attitude｜成熟的态度 ; a mature student｜成年后重返校园的学生 ; mature trees｜成年的树木 ; emotionally mature｜情感成熟的
tip_zh: 既可指身体发育成熟，也可指处事明智。

meanings_zh: n. 公民身份；公民资格 | n. 公民责任与行为
definition_en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country | responsible participation in the life of a community
example1_en: The textbook introduces apply for citizenship in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了申请公民身份。
example2_en: A campus survey used apply for citizenship to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用申请公民身份来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: apply for citizenship｜申请公民身份 ; dual citizenship｜双重国籍 ; grant citizenship｜授予公民身份 ; citizenship education｜公民教育
tip_zh: 通常不可数；区别于residency（居留资格）。

meanings_zh: n. 抗生素
definition_en: Medicines used to treat infections caused by bacteria.
example1_en: Our professor circled prescribe antibiotics on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了开抗生素。
example2_en: The author returns to prescribe antibiotics when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了开抗生素。
collocations: prescribe antibiotics｜开抗生素 ; a course of antibiotics｜一个疗程的抗生素 ; antibiotics resistance｜抗生素耐药性
tip_zh: 是antibiotic的复数；抗生素不能治疗病毒感染。

meanings_zh: v. 火山喷发；喷出 | v. 突然爆发
definition_en: To force out lava, ash, or gas from a volcano. | To begin suddenly with strong emotion, noise, or activity.
example1_en: The professor asked us to erupt into applause.
example1_zh: 教授让我们突然爆发掌声。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers erupt into applause before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要突然爆发掌声。
collocations: volcano erupts｜火山喷发 ; erupt into applause｜突然爆发掌声 ; erupt in anger｜勃然大怒
tip_zh: 通常作不及物动词；erupt into后可接掌声等。

meanings_zh: n. 贪婪；贪心
definition_en: a strong desire for more than one needs or deserves
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on corporate greed.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论企业的贪婪。
example2_en: A campus survey used corporate greed to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用企业的贪婪来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: corporate greed｜企业的贪婪 ; greed for power｜对权力的贪欲 ; driven by greed｜受贪欲驱使
tip_zh: 不可数名词；greed for后接金钱、权力等渴求对象。

meanings_zh: v. 产出；产生 | n. 产量；收益 | v. 屈服；让步；让行
definition_en: Produce crops, profits, or other results | The amount of a crop, product, or profit produced | Stop resisting, or allow someone else to go first
example1_en: I heard the lecturer yield results during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时产生结果。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers yield results before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要产生结果。
collocations: yield results｜产生结果 ; crop yield｜作物产量 ; yield to pressure｜屈服于压力 ; yield to pedestrians｜礼让行人
tip_zh: yield results指产生结果；yield to指向……让步。

meanings_zh: n. 委员会 | n. 佣金；提成 | v. 委托制作；委托开展
definition_en: An official group appointed to investigate or manage something | Payment based on the value of sales or services | To formally ask someone to produce work for payment
example1_en: Office hours began with an independent commission.
example1_zh: 答疑从独立委员会开始。
example2_en: The reading connects an independent commission with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把独立委员会和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an independent commission｜独立委员会 ; earn commission｜赚取佣金 ; commission a report｜委托撰写报告 ; commission a painting｜委托创作画作
tip_zh: 作委员会是可数名词；作佣金常用不可数形式。

meanings_zh: n. 拒绝；回绝
definition_en: an act of saying you will not do or accept something
example1_en: Office hours began with a firm refusal.
example1_zh: 答疑从坚决的拒绝开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a firm refusal.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕坚决的拒绝展开说明。
collocations: refusal to cooperate｜拒绝合作 ; a firm refusal｜坚决的拒绝 ; meet with refusal｜遭到拒绝
tip_zh: 表示拒绝做某事，用refusal to do，不用of doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 大胆的；勇于冒险的 | n. 胆量；勇气
definition_en: Willing to take risks or try unusually bold things. | The courage to take risks or attempt difficult things.
example1_en: Office hours began with courage and daring.
example1_zh: 答疑从勇气与胆量开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of courage and daring.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得勇气与胆量这个例子。
collocations: a daring rescue｜大胆的营救行动 ; a daring design｜大胆的设计 ; courage and daring｜勇气与胆量
tip_zh: 作形容词强调敢冒险；作名词时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 体系；基本框架 | n. 骨架；支架
definition_en: A basic structure of ideas or rules supporting something | A supporting structure that gives something its shape
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about legal framework.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于法律框架的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss legal framework.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论法律框架的材料。
collocations: legal framework｜法律框架 ; theoretical framework｜理论框架 ; provide a framework｜提供框架 ; within the framework of｜在……框架内
tip_zh: 常用a framework for sth，表示某事的基本框架。

meanings_zh: v. 吹嘘；夸耀
definition_en: to talk too proudly about your achievements or possessions
example1_en: I heard the lecturer brag about achievements during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时夸耀成就。
example2_en: The passage says students who can brag about achievements follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够夸耀成就的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: brag about achievements｜夸耀成就 ; brag to friends｜向朋友吹嘘 ; brag that you won｜吹嘘自己赢了
tip_zh: 常接 about 或 that；过去式 bragged 双写 g。

meanings_zh: adj. 乐观的；抱有希望的
definition_en: Expecting good things to happen or a situation to improve.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about cautiously optimistic.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于谨慎乐观的的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects cautiously optimistic with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把谨慎乐观的和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: optimistic about｜对……乐观 ; cautiously optimistic｜谨慎乐观的 ; optimistic outlook｜乐观的看法
tip_zh: 常用be optimistic about；反义词是pessimistic。

meanings_zh: n. 融资；资金筹措
definition_en: the provision of money for a purchase, business, or project
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on secure financing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论获得融资。
example2_en: The reading connects secure financing with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把获得融资和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: secure financing｜获得融资 ; project financing｜项目融资 ; financing costs｜融资成本
tip_zh: 指提供或筹措资金；金融学通常用finance。

meanings_zh: n. 文化遗产；传承
definition_en: Traditions, buildings, and values passed down from earlier generations.
example1_en: Our professor circled cultural heritage on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了文化遗产。
example2_en: The reading connects cultural heritage with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把文化遗产和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: cultural heritage｜文化遗产 ; preserve our heritage｜保护我们的遗产 ; heritage site｜遗产地 ; rich heritage｜丰富的历史文化遗产
tip_zh: 多指文化与历史传承；个人继承财产常用inheritance。

meanings_zh: n. 体力劳动者；劳工
definition_en: Someone whose job involves hard physical work.
example1_en: Our professor circled manual laborer on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了体力劳动者。
example2_en: The reading connects manual laborer with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把体力劳动者和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: manual laborer｜体力劳动者 ; construction laborer｜建筑劳工 ; farm laborer｜农场工人 ; unskilled laborer｜非技术劳工
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为labourer，强调体力劳动。

meanings_zh: n. 反对；异议；反对理由
definition_en: An expression of opposition, or a reason for opposing something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a strong objection.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论强烈反对。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a strong objection.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕强烈反对展开说明。
collocations: raise an objection｜提出异议 ; have no objection to｜不反对 ; a strong objection｜强烈反对
tip_zh: objection to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 宝石 | n. 精品；难得的好人或事物
definition_en: a valuable stone, often cut and polished for jewellery | a person or thing of exceptional quality or value
example1_en: Office hours began with precious gem.
example1_zh: 答疑从珍贵宝石开始。
example2_en: The reading connects precious gem with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把珍贵宝石和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: precious gem｜珍贵宝石 ; hidden gem｜鲜为人知的珍品 ; a gem of a book｜一本难得的好书
tip_zh: hidden gem常指尚未广为人知的好地方或精品。

meanings_zh: adj. 无报酬的 | adj. 未支付的
definition_en: Done or working without receiving money. | Not yet paid or settled.
example1_en: Office hours began with unpaid work.
example1_zh: 答疑从无偿工作开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around unpaid work.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕无偿工作展开说明。
collocations: unpaid work｜无偿工作 ; unpaid leave｜无薪假 ; unpaid bills｜未付账单 ; unpaid internship｜无薪实习
tip_zh: unpaid work指无偿工作；unpaid bills指未付账单。

meanings_zh: adj. 合适的；恰当的 | v. 擅自占用；挪用 | v. 拨款；拨出
definition_en: suitable for a particular situation or purpose | to take something for your own use without permission | to officially set aside money for a particular purpose
example1_en: Our professor circled appropriate for on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了适合于。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss appropriate for.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论适合于的材料。
collocations: appropriate for｜适合于 ; appropriate measures｜适当措施 ; appropriate behaviour｜得体的行为 ; appropriate funds for｜为……拨款
tip_zh: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 坚硬；硬度 | n. 水的硬度
definition_en: How strongly a material resists scratching, cutting, or denting. | The amount of dissolved calcium and magnesium in water.
example1_en: I copied surface hardness into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把表面硬度抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around surface hardness.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕表面硬度展开说明。
collocations: surface hardness｜表面硬度 ; water hardness｜水的硬度 ; hardness test｜硬度测试
tip_zh: hardness 指硬度；hardship 才指困苦。

meanings_zh: n. 期待；期盼 | n. 预期寿命；预计持续期
definition_en: A feeling that something pleasant or exciting will happen. | The expected length of life or duration of something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on life expectancy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论预期寿命。
example2_en: The author returns to life expectancy when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了预期寿命。
collocations: life expectancy｜预期寿命 ; an air of expectancy｜期待的气氛 ; eager expectancy｜热切的期盼
tip_zh: life expectancy指预期寿命，不等于实际寿命。

meanings_zh: n. 编辑；校订；剪辑 | v. 编辑；剪辑
definition_en: Preparing writing, images, or recordings by correcting and arranging them. | Correcting or arranging material to prepare it for use.
example1_en: Office hours began with video editing.
example1_zh: 答疑从视频剪辑开始。
example2_en: The reading connects video editing with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把视频剪辑和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: video editing｜视频剪辑 ; copy editing｜文字编辑 ; editing software｜编辑软件
tip_zh: 可作名词，也可作edit的现在分词。

meanings_zh: n. 申请人
definition_en: Someone who formally requests a job, place, or permission.
example1_en: Our professor circled job applicant on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了求职者。
example2_en: The reading connects job applicant with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把求职者和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: job applicant｜求职者 ; successful applicant｜获录取的申请人 ; applicant for a position｜职位申请人
tip_zh: 申请某职位的人用 applicant for a position。

meanings_zh: n. 意见不合；争执
definition_en: A difference of opinion or an argument about it.
example1_en: Our professor circled a disagreement between on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了…之间的分歧。
example2_en: A campus survey used a disagreement between to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用…之间的分歧来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a disagreement over something｜关于某事的分歧 ; a disagreement between｜…之间的分歧 ; resolve a disagreement｜解决分歧 ; be in disagreement｜意见不一致
tip_zh: 具体争执可数；泛指意见不合时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 富有成效的；高效的 | adj. 高产的；生产力强的
definition_en: achieving a lot or producing useful results | producing large amounts of crops, goods, or other outputs
example1_en: I copied a productive discussion into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把富有成效的讨论抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a productive discussion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了富有成效的讨论。
collocations: a productive discussion｜富有成效的讨论 ; a productive day｜高效的一天 ; productive farmland｜高产农田
tip_zh: 形容工作或讨论有成果；产量或效率用productivity。

meanings_zh: n. 痛苦；悲惨 | n. 穷困；悲惨的生活
definition_en: great unhappiness or suffering | extremely poor and uncomfortable living conditions
example1_en: I wrote misery on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把misery和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up misery while discussing evidence about human behavior.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人类行为的证据时提到了痛苦。
collocations: cause misery｜造成痛苦 ; live in misery｜生活悲惨 ; make someone's life a misery｜使某人苦不堪言
tip_zh: 通常不可数；a misery可指令人痛苦的处境。

meanings_zh: adj. 年龄较大的；年长的 | n. 长辈；长者
definition_en: Older than another person, especially within the same family | An older person, especially one respected within a community
example1_en: Our professor circled elder brother on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了哥哥。
example2_en: A campus survey used elder brother to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用哥哥来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: elder brother｜哥哥 ; elder sister｜姐姐 ; community elders｜社区长者 ; respect your elders｜尊重长辈
tip_zh: elder 多放在亲属名词前；比较年龄用 older than。

meanings_zh: n. 装饰品；饰物 | v. 装饰；点缀
definition_en: An object used to make something look more attractive. | To decorate something with attractive objects or details.
example1_en: Office hours began with glass ornament.
example1_zh: 答疑从玻璃饰品开始。
example2_en: The author returns to glass ornament when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了玻璃饰品。
collocations: glass ornament｜玻璃饰品 ; decorative ornament｜装饰物 ; ornament something with｜用……装饰某物
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词末音节读/ment/。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；绝妙的 | adj. 巨大的；惊人的 | adj. 传说中的
definition_en: Extremely good, enjoyable, or impressive. | Remarkably large in amount, value, or extent. | Existing in traditional stories rather than in reality.
example1_en: Office hours began with a fabulous time.
example1_zh: 答疑从极其愉快的时光开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a fabulous time when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极其愉快的时光。
collocations: a fabulous time｜极其愉快的时光 ; look fabulous｜看起来美极了 ; fabulous wealth｜巨额财富
tip_zh: 表“极好的”多用于非正式语境，语气较强。

meanings_zh: n. 战士；勇士
definition_en: A person experienced in fighting, especially in the past.
example1_en: Office hours began with ancient warrior.
example1_zh: 答疑从古代战士开始。
example2_en: The author returns to ancient warrior when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了古代战士。
collocations: ancient warrior｜古代战士 ; brave warrior｜勇敢的战士 ; warrior culture｜战士文化
tip_zh: 常用于古代战士；现代军人通常用soldier。

meanings_zh: adv. 按字面意思地 | adv. 确实地；真正地
definition_en: According to the exact, ordinary meaning of the words. | Used to stress that something is actually true.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to literally true.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习确实属实。
example2_en: Students who literally true are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够确实属实的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: take something literally｜按字面理解某事 ; translate literally｜直译 ; literally true｜确实属实
tip_zh: 口语可用于夸张；正式写作宜保留字面或确实义。

meanings_zh: n. 发现；探测；检测
definition_en: The act of discovering or noticing something difficult to find.
example1_en: Our professor circled early detection on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了早期发现。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of early detection.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得早期发现这个例子。
collocations: early detection｜早期发现 ; avoid detection｜躲避察觉 ; fraud detection｜欺诈检测 ; smoke detection｜烟雾探测
tip_zh: 通常不可数；detection of后接被发现或检测的对象。

meanings_zh: n. 一批货物 | n. 装运；运输
definition_en: A quantity of goods sent together to a destination. | The process of sending goods from one place to another.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on ready for shipment.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论准备好发运。
example2_en: The reading connects ready for shipment with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把准备好发运和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a shipment of goods｜一批货物 ; receive a shipment｜收到一批货物 ; ready for shipment｜准备好发运
tip_zh: 指一批货物时可数；指装运过程时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 幸存者
definition_en: Someone who remains alive after danger, illness, or disaster.
example1_en: Office hours began with sole survivor.
example1_zh: 答疑从唯一幸存者开始。
example2_en: The author returns to sole survivor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了唯一幸存者。
collocations: sole survivor｜唯一幸存者 ; earthquake survivor｜地震幸存者 ; cancer survivor｜癌症幸存者
tip_zh: survivor指人；survival指幸存或生存。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；看法 | n. 观景点
definition_en: a particular way of thinking about an issue | a place offering a good view of surrounding scenery
example1_en: After the lecture, we used viewpoint in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了观点。
example2_en: Students who can explain viewpoint usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释观点的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: from my viewpoint｜从我的角度看 ; express a viewpoint｜表达观点 ; opposing viewpoints｜对立的观点
tip_zh: 表示“从某人的角度看”时，搭配 from。

meanings_zh: n. 殖民地 | n. 群居动物群；菌落
definition_en: a territory governed by another country | a group of animals or microorganisms living together
example1_en: The textbook introduces a former colony in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了前殖民地。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a former colony.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论前殖民地的材料。
collocations: a former colony｜前殖民地 ; an ant colony｜蚁群 ; a breeding colony｜繁殖群落
tip_zh: 既可指殖民地，也可指蚁群、鸟群或菌落。

meanings_zh: adj. 简明扼要的
definition_en: Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.
example1_en: I copied clear and concise into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把清晰简洁的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to clear and concise when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了清晰简洁的。
collocations: clear and concise｜清晰简洁的 ; concise summary｜简明摘要 ; concise explanation｜简明解释
tip_zh: 不仅指短，还强调信息清楚且无赘述。

meanings_zh: n. 出席；到场 | n. 出席人数
definition_en: The act of being present at an event or place. | The number of people present at an event.
example1_en: Our professor circled school attendance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了到校出勤。
example2_en: The reading connects school attendance with a larger point about student life.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把到校出勤和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: school attendance｜到校出勤 ; attendance rate｜出勤率 ; poor attendance｜出勤率低 ; compulsory attendance｜强制出席
tip_zh: attend后直接接活动；attendance后常接at。

meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的；不同的
definition_en: Including many different kinds of people or things.
example1_en: Office hours began with culturally diverse.
example1_zh: 答疑从文化多元的开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss culturally diverse.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论文化多元的的材料。
collocations: diverse backgrounds｜不同的背景 ; diverse range｜多种多样 ; culturally diverse｜文化多元的 ; diverse needs｜多样化的需求
tip_zh: diverse强调种类多或差异大，常修饰群体或范围。

meanings_zh: n. 重复；反复
definition_en: Doing or saying something again, often several times
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on constant repetition.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论不断重复。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss constant repetition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论不断重复的材料。
collocations: constant repetition｜不断重复 ; avoid repetition｜避免重复 ; learn through repetition｜通过反复练习学习
tip_zh: repetition强调重复；rehearsal指演出前的排练。

meanings_zh: n. 进口商；进口国
definition_en: A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on major importer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论主要进口商；主要进口国。
example2_en: A campus survey used major importer to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用主要进口商；主要进口国来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: major importer｜主要进口商；主要进口国 ; net importer｜净进口国 ; food importer｜食品进口商
tip_zh: 既可指进口商，也可指进口商品的国家。

meanings_zh: n. 在场；出席 | n. 存在 | n. 气场；风度
definition_en: The state of being in a particular place. | The fact that something exists in a place or situation. | A quality that makes someone noticeable and impressive.
example1_en: I copied stage presence into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把舞台表现力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around stage presence.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕舞台表现力展开说明。
collocations: in someone's presence｜当着某人的面 ; the presence of｜……的存在 ; stage presence｜舞台表现力
tip_zh: in someone's presence指当着某人的面。

meanings_zh: n. 娱乐；消遣
definition_en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.
example1_en: Office hours began with outdoor recreation.
example1_zh: 答疑从户外休闲活动开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of outdoor recreation.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得户外休闲活动这个例子。
collocations: outdoor recreation｜户外休闲活动 ; recreation centre｜文娱活动中心 ; for recreation｜为了消遣 ; recreation facilities｜休闲设施
tip_zh: 表示休闲娱乐通常不可数；别与re-creation重新创造混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 洞察力；深入了解
definition_en: a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation
example1_en: The textbook introduces valuable insight in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宝贵的见解。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss valuable insight.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论宝贵的见解的材料。
collocations: insight into｜对……的深入了解 ; gain insight｜获得深入了解 ; provide insight｜提供深刻见解 ; valuable insight｜宝贵的见解
tip_zh: 常用insight into；泛指理解力时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 引用；引证 | v. 举出；列举
definition_en: To mention a source or example supporting a statement. | To give something as a reason or explanation.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer cite evidence during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时引用证据。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cite evidence.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得引用证据。
collocations: cite evidence｜引用证据 ; cite a source｜注明来源 ; cite an example｜举例 ; cite as a reason｜列为理由
tip_zh: cite是引用；site是地点；sight是视力，三者同音。

meanings_zh: n. 河边；河畔
definition_en: The area of land beside a river.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a riverside walk.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论河畔步道。
example2_en: The reading connects a riverside walk with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把河畔步道和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: along the riverside｜沿着河边 ; a riverside walk｜河畔步道 ; a riverside park｜河滨公园
tip_zh: 常作名词定语，如 a riverside park（河滨公园）。

meanings_zh: adj. 陡峭的 | adj. 急剧的；价格过高的 | v. 浸泡
definition_en: rising or falling at a sharp angle | describing a sharp change or an unusually high price | to leave something in liquid to release flavour or soften it
example1_en: The textbook introduces steep slope in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了陡坡。
example2_en: The reading connects steep slope with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把陡坡和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: steep slope｜陡坡 ; steep rise｜急剧上升 ; steep decline｜急剧下降 ; steep prices｜过高的价格
tip_zh: steep既形容坡陡，也形容价格高或变化剧烈。

meanings_zh: v. 剥夺；使丧失
definition_en: to prevent someone from having something they need or value
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to deprive someone of something.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何剥夺某人的某物。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to deprive someone of something.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们剥夺某人的某物。
collocations: deprive someone of something｜剥夺某人的某物 ; deprive someone of sleep｜使某人无法睡眠 ; deprive someone of opportunities｜使某人失去机会
tip_zh: 固定结构deprive sb of sth，介词用of。

meanings_zh: n. 行为；事迹 | n. 契据；产权证书
definition_en: an action, especially one that is notably good or bad | a legal document proving ownership or recording an agreement
example1_en: Our professor circled a good deed on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了善举。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a good deed.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论善举的材料。
collocations: a good deed｜善举 ; heroic deeds｜英勇事迹 ; title deeds｜产权契据 ; in word and deed｜在言语和行动上
tip_zh: 表示行为时较正式；房产契据常用复数deeds。

meanings_zh: v. 推出；发起 | v. 发射；使船下水 | n. 推出；发射；下水
definition_en: To introduce a product or start an organised activity. | To send something into space or put a boat into water. | The act of introducing something or sending it into motion.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to launch a campaign.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发起活动。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to launch a campaign.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发起活动。
collocations: launch a campaign｜发起活动 ; launch a product｜推出产品 ; launch a satellite｜发射卫星 ; product launch｜产品发布
tip_zh: 推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。

meanings_zh: adj. 尴尬的；令人不自在的 | adj. 笨拙的；难操作的 | adj. 棘手的；难处理的
definition_en: making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable | moving clumsily or difficult to handle | difficult to deal with or manage
example1_en: Our professor circled an awkward silence on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了尴尬的沉默。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of an awkward silence.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得尴尬的沉默这个例子。
collocations: an awkward silence｜尴尬的沉默 ; feel awkward｜感到不自在 ; an awkward question｜难回答的问题 ; an awkward position｜难堪的处境
tip_zh: awkward可指社交尴尬，也可指动作笨拙。

meanings_zh: n. 病房；病区 | n. 行政区；选区 | n. 受监护人
definition_en: a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care | a local district used for administration or elections | a person legally protected by a guardian or court
example1_en: The textbook introduces hospital ward in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了医院病房。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of hospital ward.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得医院病房这个例子。
collocations: hospital ward｜医院病房 ; maternity ward｜产科病房 ; electoral ward｜选区 ; ward off infection｜抵御感染
tip_zh: 作动词通常用ward off，表示抵挡、避开。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；提高 | n. 推动；促进；增加
definition_en: to increase or improve something | something that helps increase or improve something else
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to boost confidence.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须增强信心。
example2_en: The reading asks you to boost confidence and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你增强信心，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: boost confidence｜增强信心 ; boost the economy｜提振经济 ; boost sales｜提高销量 ; give something a boost｜推动某事
tip_zh: 作及物动词，直接接销量、信心等宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 表明；显示 | v. 指出；指示
definition_en: to show that something exists or is likely | to direct attention to something, often by pointing
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to indicate a need.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须表明有需要。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to indicate a need.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们表明有需要。
collocations: indicate a need｜表明有需要 ; clearly indicate｜清楚表明 ; indicate that｜表明……
tip_zh: 表示“表明……”时，常接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 杰出的；非凡的 | adj. 罕见的；特殊的
definition_en: far better than usual | unusual and outside normal circumstances
example1_en: I copied exceptional ability into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把非凡的能力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used exceptional ability to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用非凡的能力来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: exceptional ability｜非凡的能力 ; exceptional circumstances｜特殊情况 ; exceptional performance｜出色的表现
tip_zh: 常指特别优秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情况。

meanings_zh: n. 深度 | n. 深刻；深入程度
definition_en: The distance from a surface to the bottom. | The degree of detail, understanding, or seriousness.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on water depth.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论水深。
example2_en: A campus survey used water depth to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用水深来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: water depth｜水深 ; in depth｜深入地 ; depth of knowledge｜知识的深度
tip_zh: in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。

meanings_zh: n. 图标 | n. 代表性人物或事物；偶像 | n. 宗教圣像
definition_en: a small screen image representing a program, file, or function | a widely admired person or thing representing something important | a sacred image used in some Christian traditions
example1_en: Our professor circled desktop icon on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了桌面图标。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss desktop icon.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论桌面图标的材料。
collocations: click an icon｜点击图标 ; desktop icon｜桌面图标 ; cultural icon｜文化象征 ; fashion icon｜时尚偶像
tip_zh: 既可指屏幕图标，也可指有代表性的偶像或文化象征。

meanings_zh: adj. 有风险的；危险的
definition_en: involving a chance of harm, failure, or loss
example1_en: Our professor circled highly risky on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了风险很高的。
example2_en: A campus survey used highly risky to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用风险很高的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a risky investment｜高风险投资 ; risky behaviour｜冒险行为 ; a risky strategy｜有风险的策略 ; highly risky｜风险很高的
tip_zh: 常用It is risky to do sth表示做某事有风险。

meanings_zh: n. 保护；维护；保存 | n. 食品保藏
definition_en: The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss. | The process of treating food to prevent it from spoiling.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about heritage preservation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于遗产保护的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used heritage preservation to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用遗产保护来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: heritage preservation｜遗产保护 ; food preservation｜食品保藏 ; a state of preservation｜保存状况
tip_zh: 通常不可数；the preservation of后接保护对象。

meanings_zh: adj. 商业的；营利的 | n. 电视或广播广告
definition_en: Related to business or intended to make money. | An advertisement broadcast on television or radio.
example1_en: I copied a television commercial into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电视广告抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a television commercial to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用电视广告来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: commercial development｜商业开发 ; commercial success｜商业上的成功 ; commercial purposes｜商业用途 ; a television commercial｜电视广告
tip_zh: 作名词指电视或广播广告，不泛指所有广告。

meanings_zh: n. 伤亡人员 | n. 受害者；牺牲品
definition_en: Someone injured or killed in an accident, conflict, or disaster. | Someone or something harmed by a situation or change.
example1_en: The professor explained casualty with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了伤亡人员。
example2_en: A reading on public health uses casualty when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了伤亡人员。
collocations: civilian casualties｜平民伤亡 ; heavy casualties｜惨重伤亡 ; a casualty of the recession｜经济衰退的受害者
tip_zh: 包括受伤者和死者，不等于仅指死亡的fatality。

meanings_zh: n. 好奇心；求知欲 | n. 奇珍；稀奇物品
definition_en: a strong desire to learn or know about something | an unusual object that attracts interest
example1_en: I copied arouse curiosity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把引起好奇心抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to arouse curiosity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了引起好奇心。
collocations: arouse curiosity｜引起好奇心 ; satisfy your curiosity｜满足好奇心 ; out of curiosity｜出于好奇
tip_zh: 表示好奇心时不可数；表示稀奇物品时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 钢；钢材 | v. 使做好应对困难的准备
definition_en: A strong metal made mainly from iron and some carbon | To prepare yourself mentally for something difficult or unpleasant
example1_en: The textbook introduces stainless steel in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了不锈钢。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of stainless steel.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得不锈钢这个例子。
collocations: stainless steel｜不锈钢 ; steel production｜钢铁生产 ; steel yourself for｜做好应对……的心理准备
tip_zh: steel是钢，steal是偷；二者读音相同。

meanings_zh: v. 遗弃；抛弃；离弃 | v. 放弃；终止 | n. 放纵；无拘无束
definition_en: To leave someone or something without intending to return. | To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished. | A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer abandon a vehicle during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时弃车。
example2_en: The reading asks you to abandon a vehicle and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你弃车，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: abandon a vehicle｜弃车 ; abandon a plan｜放弃计划 ; abandon hope｜放弃希望 ; with abandon｜纵情地
tip_zh: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

meanings_zh: n. 皇帝
definition_en: A male ruler of an empire.
example1_en: I copied a Roman emperor into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把罗马皇帝抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a Roman emperor to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用罗马皇帝来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a Roman emperor｜罗马皇帝 ; the reigning emperor｜在位皇帝 ; crown someone emperor｜为某人加冕称帝
tip_zh: emperor统治empire；empress指女皇或皇后。

meanings_zh: n. 兄弟姐妹
definition_en: a brother or sister
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about older sibling.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于哥哥或姐姐的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used older sibling to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用哥哥或姐姐来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: older sibling｜哥哥或姐姐 ; younger sibling｜弟弟或妹妹 ; sibling rivalry｜兄弟姐妹间的竞争
tip_zh: 可数名词，单数指一个兄弟或姐妹，不区分性别。

meanings_zh: adj. 陌生的；格格不入的 | n. 外星生物 | adj. 外来的；非本地的
definition_en: Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts | A living creature believed or imagined to come from another planet | Coming from a different country or natural environment
example1_en: The textbook introduces alien to in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……陌生；与……不相容。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around alien to.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕对……陌生；与……不相容展开说明。
collocations: alien to｜对……陌生；与……不相容 ; alien species｜外来物种 ; alien environment｜陌生的环境 ; alien life｜外星生命
tip_zh: 称外国人为alien有疏离感；通常用foreign national。

meanings_zh: n. 短缺；不足
definition_en: a situation in which there is not enough of something
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about labour shortage.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于劳动力短缺的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used labour shortage to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用劳动力短缺来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a shortage of｜……的短缺 ; labour shortage｜劳动力短缺 ; severe shortage｜严重短缺 ; housing shortage｜住房短缺
tip_zh: 常用a shortage of；“缺少”也可说be short of。

meanings_zh: n. 黄蜂；胡蜂
definition_en: A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.
example1_en: The textbook introduces wasp sting in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了黄蜂蜇伤。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of wasp sting.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得黄蜂蜇伤这个例子。
collocations: wasp sting｜黄蜂蜇伤 ; wasp nest｜黄蜂巢
tip_zh: wasp是黄蜂，bee是蜜蜂；两者不是同一种昆虫。

meanings_zh: n. 中风 | n. 划动；击打；一笔 | v. 轻抚
definition_en: Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding. | One complete movement of a limb, tool, or brush. | To move your hand gently over a surface repeatedly.
example1_en: I copied a brush stroke into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把画笔的一笔抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a brush stroke.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕画笔的一笔展开说明。
collocations: have a stroke｜中风 ; a brush stroke｜画笔的一笔 ; a swimming stroke｜游泳划水动作 ; stroke a cat｜轻抚猫咪
tip_zh: 中风用have a stroke，勿与心脏病发作混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 牡蛎；蚝
definition_en: A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on oyster shell.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论牡蛎壳。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around oyster shell.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕牡蛎壳展开说明。
collocations: oyster shell｜牡蛎壳 ; oyster farm｜牡蛎养殖场 ; oyster reef｜牡蛎礁
tip_zh: the world is your oyster指你有无限机会。

meanings_zh: n. 妥协；折中方案 | v. 妥协；折中 | v. 损害；危及
definition_en: An agreement in which each side accepts less than originally wanted. | To reach agreement by accepting less than you originally wanted. | To weaken or put something valuable at risk.
example1_en: Office hours began with a reasonable compromise.
example1_zh: 答疑从合理的折中方案开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a reasonable compromise.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得合理的折中方案这个例子。
collocations: reach a compromise｜达成妥协 ; compromise on｜在……方面让步 ; compromise safety｜危及安全 ; a reasonable compromise｜合理的折中方案
tip_zh: compromise on表示在某事上让步；直接接宾语可表损害。

meanings_zh: v. 使最大化；充分利用
definition_en: to increase something as much as possible or use it fully
example1_en: The assignment is to maximize profits, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使利润最大化，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to maximize profits.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使利润最大化。
collocations: maximize profits｜使利润最大化 ; maximize efficiency｜最大限度提高效率 ; maximize space｜充分利用空间 ; maximize potential｜充分发挥潜力
tip_zh: 及物动词；英式也常拼作maximise。

meanings_zh: n. 学费 | n. 教学；辅导
definition_en: money paid for teaching at a school or university | teaching provided to an individual or a small group
example1_en: Our professor circled private tuition on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了私人辅导。
example2_en: The author returns to private tuition when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了私人辅导。
collocations: tuition fees｜学费 ; private tuition｜私人辅导 ; pay tuition｜支付学费
tip_zh: 不可数；英式谈学费常用tuition fees。

meanings_zh: adv. 令人满意地；合格地
definition_en: in a way that meets expectations or requirements
example1_en: I wrote satisfactorily on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把satisfactorily和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain satisfactorily usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释合格地的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: perform satisfactorily｜表现令人满意 ; resolve satisfactorily｜妥善解决 ; function satisfactorily｜运转良好
tip_zh: 表示达到要求，不一定是表现出色。

meanings_zh: adj. 传染的；有感染力的
definition_en: able to spread between people, like an illness or emotion
example1_en: I copied a catching illness into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把会传染的疾病抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a catching illness to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用会传染的疾病来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: a catching illness｜会传染的疾病 ; catching enthusiasm｜有感染力的热情 ; catching laughter｜有感染力的笑声
tip_zh: 多作表语；形容曲调朗朗上口用catchy，而非catching。

meanings_zh: v. 经历；接受；遭受
definition_en: to experience a process, change, or treatment
example1_en: The assignment is to undergo surgery, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先接受手术，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to undergo surgery.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得接受手术。
collocations: undergo surgery｜接受手术 ; undergo training｜接受培训 ; undergo significant changes｜经历重大变化 ; undergo tests｜接受检查
tip_zh: 过去式underwent，过去分词undergone；直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 抽筋；痉挛性疼痛 | v. 限制；束缚
definition_en: Sudden pain caused by a muscle tightening involuntarily. | To restrict someone's movement, freedom, or ability to act.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on muscle cramp.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肌肉痉挛。
example2_en: The reading connects muscle cramp with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把肌肉痉挛和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: muscle cramp｜肌肉痉挛 ; stomach cramps｜胃部绞痛 ; menstrual cramps｜痛经 ; cramp someone's style｜束缚某人的发挥
tip_zh: 表示空间狭窄用cramped，不用cramp作形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 动机；目的
definition_en: a reason for doing something
example1_en: Our professor circled underlying motive on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了深层动机。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around underlying motive.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕深层动机展开说明。
collocations: motive for doing something｜做某事的动机 ; underlying motive｜深层动机 ; profit motive｜盈利动机
tip_zh: motive强调行动背后的原因，常接for。

meanings_zh: n. 改正；修正
definition_en: A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.
example1_en: I copied error correction into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把纠错抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects error correction with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把纠错和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: make a correction｜作出修改 ; error correction｜纠错 ; minor correction｜小幅修正 ; correction of errors｜错误的改正
tip_zh: 具体一处修改可数；泛指纠正过程时常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评定
definition_en: Evaluated the quality, value, extent, or importance of something.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to assessed the damage.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何评估了损失。
example2_en: The reading asks you to assessed the damage and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你评估了损失，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: assessed the damage｜评估了损失 ; assessed the risk｜评估了风险 ; be assessed on｜根据……接受评估
tip_zh: 是assess的过去式和过去分词，词尾读/st/。

meanings_zh: adj. 视觉的；视力的 | n. 视觉材料；图片
definition_en: Relating to sight or things that can be seen. | An image used to explain something or attract attention.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about visual aids.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于视觉教具的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss visual aids.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论视觉教具的材料。
collocations: visual aids｜视觉教具 ; visual effects｜视觉效果 ; visual impairment｜视力障碍 ; visual information｜视觉信息
tip_zh: visual表示与视觉有关；“栩栩如生”通常用vivid。

meanings_zh: v. 捕获；俘获 | v. 拍摄；录制；捕捉 | n. 捕获；俘获
definition_en: to catch someone or something and prevent escape | to record an image, sound, or particular quality | the act of catching someone or something
example1_en: I heard the lecturer capture an image during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时拍摄影像。
example2_en: The reading asks you to capture an image and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你拍摄影像，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: capture an image｜拍摄影像 ; capture attention｜吸引注意力 ; capture the atmosphere｜捕捉氛围 ; capture a suspect｜抓获嫌疑人
tip_zh: 拍摄影像、捕捉气氛也可用capture。

meanings_zh: n. 课程单元；模块 | n. 组件；功能模块
definition_en: a separate unit within a larger course of study | a separate part of a machine, system, or software
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a compulsory module.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论必修模块。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a compulsory module.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕必修模块展开说明。
collocations: a compulsory module｜必修模块 ; an optional module｜选修模块 ; a software module｜软件模块 ; complete a module｜完成一个课程单元
tip_zh: 课程中的module是独立单元，通常包含多节课。

meanings_zh: n. 脾气；易怒的性情 | v. 缓和；节制 | v. 使金属回火
definition_en: A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood. | Make something less strong, extreme, or severe. | Treat metal with heat to give it suitable hardness and toughness.
example1_en: Our professor circled a short temper on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了急脾气。
example2_en: A campus survey used a short temper to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用急脾气来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: lose your temper｜发脾气 ; keep your temper｜忍住怒气 ; a short temper｜急脾气 ; temper enthusiasm with caution｜以谨慎节制热情
tip_zh: lose your temper 是发脾气；动词常用 temper A with B。

meanings_zh: adj. 会说两种语言的；双语的 | n. 熟练使用两种语言的人
definition_en: Able to use two languages, or involving two languages. | Someone who can use two languages fluently.
example1_en: The textbook introduces bilingual education in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了双语教育。
example2_en: A campus survey used bilingual education to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用双语教育来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: bilingual education｜双语教育 ; bilingual dictionary｜双语词典 ; bilingual speaker｜双语使用者
tip_zh: 表示精通哪两种语言，可用bilingual in A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 干涉；干预 | n. 妨碍；干扰 | n. 信号干扰
definition_en: unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions | an action or influence that disrupts an activity or process | unwanted signals that reduce the quality of electronic reception
example1_en: I copied political interference into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把政治干预抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects political interference with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把政治干预和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: interference in domestic affairs｜干涉内政 ; political interference｜政治干预 ; interference with sleep｜对睡眠的干扰 ; radio interference｜无线电干扰
tip_zh: in多接事务指干涉；with多接活动指妨碍。

meanings_zh: v. 削弱；变弱
definition_en: to become less strong, or make something less strong
example1_en: The assignment is to weaken the immune system, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先削弱免疫系统，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can weaken the immune system follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够削弱免疫系统的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: weaken the immune system｜削弱免疫系统 ; weaken an argument｜削弱论点的说服力 ; weaken demand｜使需求减弱
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：使变弱或自身变弱。

meanings_zh: n. 优雅；优美 | n. 宽限；恩惠 | v. 为…增色；使优美
definition_en: smooth, attractive movement or behaviour | extra time or kindness freely given | make a place or occasion more attractive by being present
example1_en: I copied a grace period into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把宽限期抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a grace period.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得宽限期这个例子。
collocations: with grace｜优雅地 ; a grace period｜宽限期 ; grace the occasion｜为活动增色
tip_zh: grace 表优雅通常不可数；grace period 指宽限期。

meanings_zh: n. 对比；差异 | v. 对比
definition_en: A clear difference between two people or things. | To compare in order to show differences.
example1_en: The slide put the two maps in contrast.
example1_zh: 这张幻灯片把两张地图放在一起对比。
example2_en: The passage draws a contrast between a short lab task and a semester-long study.
example2_zh: 文章对比了短时实验任务和长达一学期的研究。
collocations: in contrast to｜与…对比 ; a sharp contrast｜鲜明对比
tip_zh: 名词重音常在前；动词重音常在后：contrast the two claims。

meanings_zh: adj. 有影响力的
definition_en: Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.
example1_en: The textbook introduces highly influential in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了极具影响力的。
example2_en: The author returns to highly influential when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极具影响力的。
collocations: influential figure｜有影响力的人物 ; highly influential｜极具影响力的 ; influential in shaping policy｜对政策制定有影响力
tip_zh: 常用be influential in doing，表示对某事有影响。

meanings_zh: n. 慷慨；大方 | n. 宽宏大量
definition_en: Willingness to give money, time, or help freely. | Willingness to be kind and forgiving towards others.
example1_en: Office hours began with an act of generosity.
example1_zh: 答疑从慷慨之举开始。
example2_en: The reading connects an act of generosity with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把慷慨之举和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: show generosity｜表现出慷慨 ; an act of generosity｜慷慨之举 ; generosity towards others｜对他人的慷慨
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一次慷慨之举用an act of generosity。

meanings_zh: n. 百合；百合花
definition_en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.
example1_en: Our professor circled white lily on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了白百合。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around white lily.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕白百合展开说明。
collocations: white lily｜白百合 ; lily bulb｜百合鳞茎 ; water lily｜睡莲
tip_zh: 复数为lilies；water lily指睡莲。

meanings_zh: adj. 肌肉发达的；强壮的 | adj. 肌肉的
definition_en: Having large, strong muscles. | Relating to the muscles of the body.
example1_en: The textbook introduces muscular strength in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了肌肉力量。
example2_en: The reading connects muscular strength with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把肌肉力量和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: muscular strength｜肌肉力量 ; muscular pain｜肌肉疼痛 ; muscular build｜健壮的体格
tip_zh: 既可指肌肉发达，也可仅表示与肌肉有关。

meanings_zh: n. 孩子；年轻人
definition_en: A child or young person.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize youngster in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出孩子。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up youngster while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了孩子。
collocations: local youngsters｜当地青少年 ; talented youngsters｜有天赋的年轻人 ; a group of youngsters｜一群孩子
tip_zh: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。

meanings_zh: n. 着迷；强烈兴趣
definition_en: a very strong interest in someone or something
example1_en: The textbook introduces watch with fascination in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了看得入迷。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss watch with fascination.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论看得入迷的材料。
collocations: fascination with｜对……的着迷 ; watch with fascination｜看得入迷 ; hold a fascination for｜对……有吸引力
tip_zh: 对某物着迷用 fascination with；看得入迷用 with fascination。

meanings_zh: n. 幼儿园；学前班
definition_en: A school or class for children beginning their education
example1_en: Office hours began with attend kindergarten.
example1_zh: 答疑从上幼儿园开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used attend kindergarten to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用上幼儿园来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: kindergarten teacher｜幼儿园教师 ; attend kindergarten｜上幼儿园 ; kindergarten classroom｜幼儿园教室
tip_zh: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。

meanings_zh: n. 阶段；时期 | n. 月相 | v. 分阶段进行
definition_en: A distinct period in a process of change or development. | One of the changing shapes of the moon as seen. | To introduce or remove something gradually in planned stages.
example1_en: I copied an initial phase into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把初始阶段抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an initial phase.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕初始阶段展开说明。
collocations: an initial phase｜初始阶段 ; a phase of development｜发展阶段 ; phase out｜逐步淘汰 ; phase in｜逐步引入
tip_zh: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。

meanings_zh: n. 操作员 | n. 经营者；运营商 | n. 电话接线员
definition_en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment | a person or company that runs a business or service | a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about machine operator.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于机器操作员的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to machine operator when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了机器操作员。
collocations: machine operator｜机器操作员 ; tour operator｜旅游经营商 ; mobile network operator｜移动网络运营商 ; telephone operator｜电话接线员
tip_zh: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

meanings_zh: n. 令人惊叹的人或事物 | v. 感到惊叹
definition_en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise | To feel great surprise or admiration
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an engineering marvel.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论工程奇迹。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an engineering marvel.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕工程奇迹展开说明。
collocations: an engineering marvel｜工程奇迹 ; a technological marvel｜技术奇迹 ; marvel at｜对……感到惊叹 ; a marvel of nature｜自然奇观
tip_zh: 动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。

meanings_zh: v. 说脏话；咒骂 | v. 发誓；郑重保证
definition_en: to use rude or offensive words | to make a serious promise or insist something is true
example1_en: The professor asked us to swear an oath.
example1_zh: 教授让我们宣誓。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers swear an oath before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要宣誓。
collocations: swear at someone｜咒骂某人 ; swear to do something｜发誓做某事 ; swear an oath｜宣誓
tip_zh: 过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。

meanings_zh: n. 概述；综述
definition_en: A short account presenting the main features of a subject.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a brief overview in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了简要概述。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a brief overview.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得简要概述这个例子。
collocations: provide an overview｜提供概述 ; a brief overview｜简要概述 ; a general overview｜总体概述 ; an overview of｜对……的概述
tip_zh: 通常作可数名词；搭配an overview of。

meanings_zh: n. 招聘；招募
definition_en: the process of finding people to join an organisation
example1_en: I copied staff recruitment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把员工招聘抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around staff recruitment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕员工招聘展开说明。
collocations: recruitment process｜招聘流程 ; recruitment agency｜招聘中介 ; recruitment campaign｜招聘活动 ; staff recruitment｜员工招聘
tip_zh: 通常不可数；招聘某类人员用recruitment of。

meanings_zh: adj. 较小的；次要的；轻微的 | n. 未成年人 | adj. 小调的
definition_en: Not very serious, important, or large. | A person younger than the legal age of adulthood. | Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on minor injury.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论轻伤。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of minor injury.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得轻伤这个例子。
collocations: minor injury｜轻伤 ; minor changes｜小幅改动 ; minor issue｜次要问题 ; minor key｜小调
tip_zh: minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。

meanings_zh: v. 调查；查明 | v. 研究；探究
definition_en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why. | To study a subject carefully to learn more about it.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to investigate a complaint.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何调查投诉。
example2_en: The reading asks you to investigate a complaint and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你调查投诉，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: investigate a complaint｜调查投诉 ; investigate the cause｜调查原因 ; investigate a link｜探究关联
tip_zh: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

meanings_zh: v. 说明；举例阐明 | v. 为……配插图
definition_en: To make something clear through examples or evidence. | To provide pictures for a book or other publication.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to illustrate a point.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求说明一个观点。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers illustrate a point before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要说明一个观点。
collocations: illustrate a point｜说明一个观点 ; illustrate the importance of｜说明……的重要性 ; illustrate a book｜为书配插图
tip_zh: illustrate可用例子说明，不一定涉及图片。

meanings_zh: adj. 辉煌的；光荣的 | adj. 极其美好的；壮丽的
definition_en: Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride. | Extremely beautiful, enjoyable, or pleasant.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about glorious victory.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于辉煌的胜利的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to glorious victory when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了辉煌的胜利。
collocations: glorious victory｜辉煌的胜利 ; glorious sunshine｜明媚的阳光 ; glorious past｜辉煌的过去
tip_zh: glorious既可指值得荣耀，也可赞美天气或景色。

meanings_zh: n. 核对清单；检查表
definition_en: A list of things to check or do
example1_en: Office hours began with safety checklist.
example1_zh: 答疑从安全检查表开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around safety checklist.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕安全检查表展开说明。
collocations: safety checklist｜安全检查表 ; packing checklist｜行李清单 ; complete a checklist｜完成检查表
tip_zh: 可数名词；强调逐项核对，不只是罗列物品。

meanings_zh: adj. 简单易懂的；易做的 | adj. 坦率的；直截了当的
definition_en: easy to understand or do, without complications | honest and direct in expressing thoughts or intentions
example1_en: The textbook introduces relatively straightforward in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了相对简单的。
example2_en: The author returns to relatively straightforward when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了相对简单的。
collocations: a straightforward process｜简单的流程 ; a straightforward answer｜直截了当的回答 ; relatively straightforward｜相对简单的 ; straightforward advice｜明确易懂的建议
tip_zh: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。

meanings_zh: n. 温室；暖房
definition_en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm
example1_en: Office hours began with greenhouse gas emissions.
example1_zh: 答疑从温室气体排放开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used greenhouse gas emissions to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用温室气体排放来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: grow plants in a greenhouse｜在温室里种植物 ; greenhouse gas emissions｜温室气体排放 ; the greenhouse effect｜温室效应
tip_zh: greenhouse是名词，也可作定语，如greenhouse gases。

meanings_zh: n. 效率；效能
definition_en: The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources
example1_en: The textbook introduces energy efficiency in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能源利用效率。
example2_en: The author returns to energy efficiency when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了能源利用效率。
collocations: energy efficiency｜能源利用效率 ; improve efficiency｜提高效率 ; operational efficiency｜运营效率 ; fuel efficiency｜燃油效率
tip_zh: efficiency强调少浪费；effectiveness强调达到效果。

meanings_zh: n. 假说；假设
definition_en: A proposed explanation that can be tested through research
example1_en: State the hypothesis before you collect the data.
example1_zh: 收集数据之前先写明假说。
example2_en: The hypothesis predicted a larger effect in the group that slept less than six hours.
example2_zh: 这个假说预测，睡眠少于六小时的那一组会出现更大的效应。
collocations: test a hypothesis｜检验假设 ; formulate a hypothesis｜提出假说 ; support a hypothesis｜支持假说 ; reject a hypothesis｜否定假说
tip_zh: 复数为hypotheses；假说须经证据检验。

meanings_zh: adj. 有凝聚力的；紧密结合的
definition_en: united or closely connected as a whole
example1_en: Office hours began with cohesive team.
example1_zh: 答疑从有凝聚力的团队开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of cohesive team.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得有凝聚力的团队这个例子。
collocations: cohesive team｜有凝聚力的团队 ; cohesive society｜团结的社会 ; cohesive argument｜衔接紧密的论证
tip_zh: cohesive强调紧密结合；coherent强调条理清楚。

meanings_zh: n. 招生简章 | n. 招股说明书；项目介绍书
definition_en: a document describing a school or university for potential students | a document explaining an investment or business opportunity
