example1_en: Office hours began with university prospectus.
example1_zh: 答疑从大学招生简章开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of university prospectus.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得大学招生简章这个例子。
collocations: university prospectus｜大学招生简章 ; request a prospectus｜索取招生简章 ; issue a prospectus｜发布招股说明书
tip_zh: 教育语境常指招生简章，金融语境可指招股说明书。

meanings_zh: n. 十四行诗
definition_en: A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.
example1_en: Our professor circled sonnet sequence on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了十四行组诗。
example2_en: The author returns to sonnet sequence when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了十四行组诗。
collocations: write a sonnet｜写十四行诗 ; sonnet sequence｜十四行组诗 ; sonnet form｜十四行诗体
tip_zh: sonnet固定为十四行，但押韵格式不只一种。

meanings_zh: n. 男女同校教育
definition_en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about benefits of coeducation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于男女同校教育的益处的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to benefits of coeducation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了男女同校教育的益处。
collocations: benefits of coeducation｜男女同校教育的益处 ; support coeducation｜支持男女同校教育 ; introduce coeducation｜实行男女同校教育
tip_zh: 不可数名词；形容词形式为coeducational。

meanings_zh: n. 领事
definition_en: An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests
example1_en: Office hours began with honorary consul.
example1_zh: 答疑从名誉领事开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of honorary consul.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得名誉领事这个例子。
collocations: consul general｜总领事 ; honorary consul｜名誉领事 ; vice consul｜副领事
tip_zh: consul是领事；consulate是领事馆，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 操纵；控制 | n. 操作；处理
definition_en: Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage. | Moving or adjusting something carefully, often using hands or tools.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on emotional manipulation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论情感操控。
example2_en: The reading connects emotional manipulation with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把情感操控和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: emotional manipulation｜情感操控 ; data manipulation｜数据处理；数据篡改 ; market manipulation｜市场操纵
tip_zh: 指操控人时常含贬义；指操作工具时可中性。

meanings_zh: adj. 同时发生的；并行的
definition_en: Happening or existing at the same time
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about concurrent events.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于同时发生的事件的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to concurrent events when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了同时发生的事件。
collocations: concurrent events｜同时发生的事件 ; concurrent sessions｜同期举行的分会 ; concurrent with｜与…同时发生
tip_zh: 强调时间重叠；表示“与…同时”可用concurrent with。

meanings_zh: v. 奉承；讨好 | v. 使感到荣幸或高兴 | v. 使显得更好看
definition_en: Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour. | Make someone feel pleased or honoured through attention or praise. | Make someone look more attractive than they otherwise would.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to flatter someone's ego.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求满足某人的虚荣心。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to flatter someone's ego.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来满足某人的虚荣心。
collocations: flatter someone's ego｜满足某人的虚荣心 ; feel flattered｜感到荣幸 ; flatter yourself｜自以为是
tip_zh: be flattered常指受宠若惊，不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: v. 干涉；管闲事
definition_en: Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.
example1_en: The assignment is to meddle in someone's affairs, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先干涉某人的私事，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can meddle in someone's affairs follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够干涉某人的私事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: meddle in someone's affairs｜干涉某人的私事 ; meddle with something｜擅自摆弄某物
tip_zh: 常接in表示干涉事务；接with表示擅自摆弄。

meanings_zh: n. 沉思；深思 | n. 考虑；打算
definition_en: the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something | the act of considering a possible future action
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about quiet contemplation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于静静的沉思的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of quiet contemplation.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得静静的沉思这个例子。
collocations: quiet contemplation｜静静的沉思 ; deep contemplation｜深思 ; in contemplation｜在沉思中
tip_zh: 通常不可数；强调安静深思，不一定是痛苦思索。

meanings_zh: n. 阈值；界限 | n. 门槛 | n. 开端；起点
definition_en: the level at which something starts happening or changes | the bottom edge of a doorway | the point just before a new experience or period begins
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on pain threshold.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论痛觉阈值。
example2_en: The author returns to pain threshold when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了痛觉阈值。
collocations: pain threshold｜痛觉阈值 ; income threshold｜收入门槛 ; cross the threshold｜跨过门槛 ; on the threshold of｜即将进入
tip_zh: on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。

meanings_zh: v. 组成；构成 | v. 算作；构成 | v. 正式设立
definition_en: To be the parts that form a whole | To be considered a particular thing | To formally establish an organisation or governing body
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to constitute a majority.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何占多数。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to constitute a majority.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来占多数。
collocations: constitute a majority｜占多数 ; constitute a threat｜构成威胁 ; constitute a breach｜构成违反 ; constitute a committee｜正式成立委员会
tip_zh: 表组成时通常以部分作主语，整体作宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 手术前的
definition_en: Happening or provided before a surgical operation.
example1_en: Our professor circled preoperative assessment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了术前评估。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss preoperative assessment.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论术前评估的材料。
collocations: preoperative assessment｜术前评估 ; preoperative care｜术前护理 ; preoperative preparation｜术前准备
tip_zh: pre- 表示之前；postoperative 则表示手术后的。

meanings_zh: adj. 固有的；内在的
definition_en: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces inherent risks in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了固有风险。
example2_en: The author returns to inherent risks when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了固有风险。
collocations: inherent risks｜固有风险 ; inherent limitations｜固有局限 ; inherent in｜内在于；固有于 ; inherent value｜内在价值
tip_zh: 常用inherent in；强调本身具有，而非后来获得。

meanings_zh: adj. 实证的；基于观察的
definition_en: based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone
example1_en: The textbook introduces empirical evidence in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了实证证据。
example2_en: The author returns to empirical evidence when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了实证证据。
collocations: empirical evidence｜实证证据 ; empirical research｜实证研究 ; empirical data｜实证数据
tip_zh: 强调观察或实验依据，不等于个人经验之谈。

meanings_zh: v. 重新分配；重新分布
definition_en: To share out or spread something again in a different way.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to redistribute wealth.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何重新分配财富。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to redistribute wealth.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来重新分配财富。
collocations: redistribute wealth｜重新分配财富 ; redistribute income｜重新分配收入 ; redistribute resources｜重新分配资源
tip_zh: 强调改变原有分配，不一定意味着平均分配。

meanings_zh: n. 遵守；服从
definition_en: the act of following a rule, law, or request
example1_en: Office hours began with ensure compliance.
example1_zh: 答疑从确保合规开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of ensure compliance.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得确保合规这个例子。
collocations: compliance with regulations｜遵守规定 ; ensure compliance｜确保合规 ; in compliance with｜按照；遵照
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示遵守某规定时用compliance with。

meanings_zh: adj. 假的；虚伪的 | n. 骗子；虚伪的人
definition_en: Not genuine, or intended to deceive people | Someone who pretends to be something they are not
example1_en: I copied phony smile into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把假笑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used phony smile to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用假笑来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: phony smile｜假笑 ; phony excuse｜虚假的借口 ; phony claims｜虚假说法
tip_zh: 偏口语；英式英语也常拼作phoney。

meanings_zh: adv. 一丝不苟地；细致地
definition_en: with great care and attention to every detail
example1_en: The professor told us to meticulously planned and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们精心规划的，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: Students who meticulously planned are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够精心规划的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: meticulously planned｜精心规划的 ; meticulously documented｜详尽记录的 ; meticulously examine｜仔细检查
tip_zh: 强调关注每个细节，不表示“胆小地”。

meanings_zh: adj. 球形的；球状的
definition_en: shaped like a ball
example1_en: Office hours began with spherical shape.
example1_zh: 答疑从球形开始。
example2_en: The reading connects spherical shape with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把球形和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: spherical shape｜球形 ; spherical particles｜球形颗粒 ; spherical surface｜球面
tip_zh: spherical指立体球形；circular指平面圆形。

meanings_zh: n. 规格；技术要求
definition_en: A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on design specification.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论设计规范。
example2_en: A campus survey used design specification to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用设计规范来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: technical specifications｜技术规格 ; meet specifications｜符合规格要求 ; design specification｜设计规范 ; to specification｜按规定规格
tip_zh: 谈产品各项参数常用复数specifications，可简称specs。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；强烈的 | adj. 急性的 | adj. 敏锐的
definition_en: Very serious or intense. | Starting suddenly and lasting a short time, often severely. | Quick to notice or understand things.
example1_en: I copied acute shortage into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把严重短缺抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used acute shortage to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用严重短缺来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: acute shortage｜严重短缺 ; acute pain｜剧痛 ; acute illness｜急性疾病 ; acute awareness｜敏锐的意识
tip_zh: 疾病中acute与chronic（慢性的）相对。

meanings_zh: v. 使通风 | v. 公开表达；公开讨论
definition_en: To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere. | To express or discuss opinions and concerns openly.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to ventilate a room.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何给房间通风。
example2_en: The reading asks you to ventilate a room and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你给房间通风，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: ventilate a room｜给房间通风 ; well-ventilated buildings｜通风良好的建筑 ; ventilate grievances｜公开表达不满
tip_zh: 使通风是常用义；表示公开讨论时较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 缩影；微型世界
definition_en: A small system showing the features of a larger one.
example1_en: Office hours began with a microcosm of society.
example1_zh: 答疑从社会的缩影开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a microcosm of society.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得社会的缩影这个例子。
collocations: a microcosm of society｜社会的缩影 ; in microcosm｜以缩影形式 ; serve as a microcosm｜充当缩影
tip_zh: 常用a microcosm of，指缩影，不只是微小事物。

meanings_zh: n. 回顾；回想
definition_en: Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.
example1_en: The textbook introduces only in retrospect in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了只有事后回想才。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around only in retrospect.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕只有事后回想才展开说明。
collocations: in retrospect｜回过头看 ; only in retrospect｜只有事后回想才
tip_zh: 通常用于固定短语in retrospect，表示事后回想。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；使便利
definition_en: make an action or process easier
example1_en: The assignment is to facilitate communication, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先促进沟通，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to facilitate communication.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来促进沟通。
collocations: facilitate communication｜促进沟通 ; facilitate learning｜促进学习 ; facilitate access｜方便进入或使用
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不用facilitate somebody to do。

meanings_zh: v. 再次发生；反复出现
definition_en: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize recur in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出再次发生。
example2_en: Students who can explain recur usually follow the rest of a lecture on public health.
example2_zh: 能解释再次发生的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共卫生的讲座。
collocations: a recurring problem｜反复出现的问题 ; a recurring theme｜反复出现的主题 ; symptoms recur｜症状复发
tip_zh: 不及物动词；过去式recurred，分词recurring。

meanings_zh: v. 推翻；颠覆 | n. 推翻；政权覆灭
definition_en: to remove a ruler or government from power | the removal of a ruler or government from power
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to overthrow a government.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须推翻政府。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers overthrow a government before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要推翻政府。
collocations: overthrow a government｜推翻政府 ; overthrow a regime｜推翻政权 ; the overthrow of a ruler｜统治者被推翻
tip_zh: 过去式overthrew，过去分词overthrown。

meanings_zh: n. 伪造；伪造品
definition_en: Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about document forgery.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于文件伪造的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects document forgery with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把文件伪造和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: document forgery｜文件伪造 ; art forgery｜艺术品伪造 ; detect a forgery｜识别伪造品 ; a convincing forgery｜足以乱真的赝品
tip_zh: forgery是伪造或赝品；锻造作坊是forge。

meanings_zh: adj. 很可能遭受…的 | adj. 负有法律责任的
definition_en: Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant. | Legally responsible for something, especially damage or payment.
example1_en: I copied liable for damages into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把负有损害赔偿责任抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of liable for damages.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得负有损害赔偿责任这个例子。
collocations: liable to do something｜很可能做某事 ; liable for damages｜负有损害赔偿责任 ; be held liable｜被认定负有法律责任
tip_zh: liable to后接动词表可能；liable for表责任。

meanings_zh: v. 派遣；发送 | n. 发送；派遣 | n. 新闻报道；公文
definition_en: To send someone or something to a particular destination. | The act of sending goods, messages, or people somewhere. | An official message or a report sent by a journalist.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to dispatch goods.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发货。
example2_en: The reading asks you to dispatch goods and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你发货，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: dispatch goods｜发货 ; dispatch a team｜派出队伍 ; ready for dispatch｜备妥待发 ; a news dispatch｜新闻报道
tip_zh: despatch也是正确拼写，但dispatch更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 对齐；排列成直线 | n. 一致；协调 | n. 结盟；政治联合
definition_en: The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position. | Agreement between ideas, aims, or actions. | An association between groups sharing political aims or interests.
example1_en: Our professor circled wheel alignment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了车轮定位。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wheel alignment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕车轮定位展开说明。
collocations: wheel alignment｜车轮定位 ; in alignment with｜与……一致 ; political alignment｜政治结盟
tip_zh: in alignment with可指位置对齐或目标一致。

meanings_zh: n. 民主主义者 | n. 美国民主党党员或支持者
definition_en: Someone who supports government based on the people's choices | A member or supporter of the Democratic Party in America
example1_en: Our professor circled committed democrat on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了坚定的民主主义者。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around committed democrat.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕坚定的民主主义者展开说明。
collocations: committed democrat｜坚定的民主主义者 ; lifelong democrat｜终身信奉民主的人 ; liberal democrat｜自由民主主义者
tip_zh: 泛指民主主义者用小写；美国民主党人写作Democrat。

meanings_zh: n. 恶意；害人之心
definition_en: a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble
example1_en: Office hours began with out of malice.
example1_zh: 答疑从出于恶意开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used out of malice to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用出于恶意来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: with malice｜怀着恶意 ; bear no malice｜不怀恶意 ; out of malice｜出于恶意
tip_zh: 通常不可数；with malice 表示“怀着恶意”。

meanings_zh: n. 认证；资格证明
definition_en: Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.
example1_en: I copied professional certification into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把专业资格认证抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to professional certification when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了专业资格认证。
collocations: professional certification｜专业资格认证 ; obtain certification｜获得认证 ; certification body｜认证机构 ; certification process｜认证流程
tip_zh: certification重认证；certificate常指证书本身。

meanings_zh: adj. 必需的；必要的 | n. 必需品；必要条件
definition_en: needed for a particular purpose | something necessary for a particular purpose
example1_en: Our professor circled requisite skills on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了必备技能。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of requisite skills.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得必备技能这个例子。
collocations: requisite skills｜必备技能 ; requisite qualifications｜必要资历 ; a requisite for success｜成功的必要条件
tip_zh: 较正式；requisite 指必需，prerequisite 强调先决。

meanings_zh: n. 欺骗；欺诈
definition_en: Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.
example1_en: Our professor circled deliberate deceit on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了蓄意欺骗。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deliberate deceit.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论蓄意欺骗的材料。
collocations: deliberate deceit｜蓄意欺骗 ; an act of deceit｜欺骗行为 ; lies and deceit｜谎言与欺骗
tip_zh: deceit通常不可数；一次欺骗可用an act of deceit。

meanings_zh: adj. 起重要作用的 | adj. 器乐的 | n. 器乐曲
definition_en: playing an important part in making something happen | performed with musical instruments rather than voices | a piece of music performed without singing
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on instrumental music.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论器乐。
example2_en: The reading connects instrumental music with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把器乐和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: be instrumental in｜在……中起重要作用 ; instrumental music｜器乐 ; instrumental version｜器乐版
tip_zh: 表示“起重要作用”时，用 be instrumental in doing。

meanings_zh: n. 剥削；压榨 | n. 开发；利用
definition_en: Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work | Using resources or opportunities to gain an advantage
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on labour exploitation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论劳工剥削。
example2_en: A campus survey used labour exploitation to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用劳工剥削来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: labour exploitation｜劳工剥削 ; commercial exploitation｜商业开发 ; exploitation of natural resources｜自然资源的开发利用
tip_zh: 用于人常指剥削；用于资源指开发利用，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 镇静药；安定药
definition_en: A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.
example1_en: Office hours began with tranquilizer dart.
example1_zh: 答疑从麻醉飞镖开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used tranquilizer dart to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用麻醉飞镖来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: prescribe a tranquilizer｜开镇静药 ; take a tranquilizer｜服用镇静药 ; tranquilizer dart｜麻醉飞镖
tip_zh: 美式常拼tranquilizer，英式常拼tranquilliser。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；占主导的
definition_en: Most common or influential at a particular time or place.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about prevailing view.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于主流观点的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to prevailing view when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主流观点。
collocations: prevailing view｜主流观点 ; prevailing conditions｜当前普遍状况 ; prevailing wind｜盛行风 ; prevailing attitude｜普遍态度
tip_zh: 常置于名词前；prevailing wind指盛行风。

meanings_zh: adj. 极讨厌的；令人反感的
definition_en: extremely unpleasant or offensive
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about obnoxious behaviour.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于令人反感的行为的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around obnoxious behaviour.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕令人反感的行为展开说明。
collocations: obnoxious behaviour｜令人反感的行为 ; obnoxious remark｜令人厌恶的言论 ; obnoxious person｜讨厌的人
tip_zh: 语气比annoying强，常形容无礼的人或行为。

meanings_zh: v. 下垂；低垂
definition_en: Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.
example1_en: The professor explained droop with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了下垂。
example2_en: Students who can explain droop usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释下垂的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: drooping eyelids｜耷拉的眼皮 ; flowers droop｜花朵低垂 ; shoulders droop｜肩膀耷拉下来
tip_zh: 常形容花叶、眼皮或肩膀因缺水、疲倦而下垂。

meanings_zh: v. 出汗；流汗
definition_en: to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot
example1_en: I heard the lecturer perspire heavily during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时大量出汗。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to perspire heavily.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来大量出汗。
collocations: perspire heavily｜大量出汗 ; perspire freely｜汗流不止
tip_zh: 比sweat正式；通常作不及物动词。

meanings_zh: n. 灌溉
definition_en: The supply of water to land so crops can grow.
example1_en: I copied drip irrigation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把滴灌抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around drip irrigation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕滴灌展开说明。
collocations: irrigation system｜灌溉系统 ; drip irrigation｜滴灌 ; irrigation canal｜灌溉渠 ; irrigation water｜灌溉用水
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；动词形式是irrigate。

meanings_zh: v. 指定；指派 | v. 标明；命名
definition_en: To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose. | To give something an official name or identifying description.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to designate an area for.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何划定区域用于。
example2_en: The passage says students who can designate an area for follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够划定区域用于的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: designate someone as｜指定某人为 ; designate an area for｜划定区域用于 ; designated parking spaces｜指定停车位
tip_zh: designate A as B表示指定或认定A为B。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；减弱；降低 | v. 贬低；轻视
definition_en: to become smaller or weaker, or make something so | to make someone or something seem less important or valuable
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to diminish significantly.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何显著减少。
example2_en: The reading asks you to diminish significantly and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你显著减少，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: diminish significantly｜显著减少 ; diminish in importance｜重要性降低 ; diminish the impact｜减轻影响 ; diminishing returns｜递减的收益
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：信心可diminish，也可被削弱。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙
definition_en: The universe considered as a complete, ordered system.
example1_en: The professor explained cosmos with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了宇宙。
example2_en: Students who can explain cosmos usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释宇宙的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: explore the cosmos｜探索宇宙 ; the origins of the cosmos｜宇宙的起源 ; the vastness of the cosmos｜宇宙的浩瀚
tip_zh: 表示宇宙时通常用the cosmos。

meanings_zh: v. 执行；强制实施
definition_en: Make sure that people obey a law or rule.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to enforce the law.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求执法。
example2_en: The passage says students who can enforce the law follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够执法的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: enforce the law｜执法 ; enforce regulations｜执行法规 ; strictly enforce｜严格执行
tip_zh: enforce后接法律或规定；迫使某人做事用force。

meanings_zh: adj. 含蓄的；未明说的 | adj. 内含的；固有的 | adj. 完全的；无疑问的
definition_en: Suggested or understood without being directly stated. | Present as a necessary part of something. | Complete and without doubt, especially describing trust or confidence.
example1_en: Our professor circled implicit agreement on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了默契；未明说的协议。
example2_en: The author returns to implicit agreement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了默契；未明说的协议。
collocations: implicit agreement｜默契；未明说的协议 ; implicit in｜内含于…… ; implicit trust｜完全的信任 ; implicit assumption｜隐含的假设
tip_zh: implicit指未明说；explicit指清楚明确。

meanings_zh: n. 调解人；调停者
definition_en: Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement
example1_en: Office hours began with independent mediator.
example1_zh: 答疑从独立调解人开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of independent mediator.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得独立调解人这个例子。
collocations: independent mediator｜独立调解人 ; act as a mediator｜担任调解人 ; appoint a mediator｜任命调解人
tip_zh: 调解人促成双方协议，通常不直接作出裁决。

meanings_zh: n. 中间商；中介人
definition_en: Someone arranging deals or buying goods to sell to others.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used middleman in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了中间商。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up middleman while discussing evidence about economic policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了中间商。
collocations: cut out the middleman｜绕过中间商 ; act as a middleman｜充当中介人
tip_zh: 复数为 middlemen；中性表达可用 intermediary。

meanings_zh: n. 制裁；处罚 | v. 正式批准；许可 | v. 制裁；处罚
definition_en: An official penalty intended to enforce rules or change behaviour. | To officially approve or permit an action. | To impose an official penalty on someone or something.
example1_en: I wrote sanction on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把sanction和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain sanction usually follow the rest of a lecture on public institutions.
example2_zh: 能解释制裁的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共制度的讲座。
collocations: impose sanctions on｜对……实施制裁 ; lift sanctions｜解除制裁 ; economic sanctions｜经济制裁 ; sanction a proposal｜批准提案
tip_zh: 可指“制裁”或“批准”，含义相反，须看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 匕首；短剑
definition_en: A short pointed knife, usually with two sharp edges.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a ceremonial dagger.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于仪式用匕首的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a ceremonial dagger to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用仪式用匕首来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a ceremonial dagger｜仪式用匕首 ; a sheathed dagger｜入鞘的匕首 ; look daggers at someone｜怒视某人
tip_zh: look daggers at someone是习语，意为怒视某人。

meanings_zh: adj. 水力发电的
definition_en: Relating to electricity produced by the movement of water.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on hydroelectric power.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论水力发电。
example2_en: A campus survey used hydroelectric power to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用水力发电来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: hydroelectric power｜水力发电 ; hydroelectric dam｜水电大坝 ; hydroelectric power station｜水力发电站
tip_zh: 常修饰power或power station；名词为hydroelectricity。

meanings_zh: n. 坚持不懈；毅力 | n. 持续存在；存留
definition_en: continued effort despite difficulties or delays | the fact of continuing to exist over time
example1_en: I copied persistence pays off into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把坚持终有回报抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to persistence pays off when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了坚持终有回报。
collocations: show persistence｜表现出毅力 ; persistence pays off｜坚持终有回报 ; the persistence of poverty｜贫困的持续存在
tip_zh: 既可指人的毅力，也可指问题或现象持续存在。

meanings_zh: adj. 瞬间发生的；即时的
definition_en: Happening immediately, with no noticeable delay.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about almost instantaneous.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于几乎瞬间发生的的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around almost instantaneous.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕几乎瞬间发生的展开说明。
collocations: an instantaneous response｜即时反应 ; instantaneous communication｜即时通信 ; almost instantaneous｜几乎瞬间发生的
tip_zh: 强调几乎没有时间间隔，不等于同时发生。

meanings_zh: n. 日食；月食 | v. 使黯然失色；超越
definition_en: an event when one celestial body blocks another's light | make something seem less important or impressive by comparison
example1_en: I copied solar eclipse into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把日食抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss solar eclipse.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论日食的材料。
collocations: solar eclipse｜日食 ; lunar eclipse｜月食 ; total eclipse｜全食 ; eclipse previous achievements｜使以往成就黯然失色
tip_zh: 日食用solar eclipse，月食用lunar eclipse。

meanings_zh: v. 取回；收回 | v. 开垦；使土地可用 | v. 回收利用
definition_en: Get back something that belongs or previously belonged to you | Make damaged or submerged land suitable for use | Recover useful materials from waste for reuse
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to reclaim lost property.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何领回失物。
example2_en: The reading asks you to reclaim lost property and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你领回失物，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: reclaim lost property｜领回失物 ; reclaim land｜开垦土地；填海造地 ; reclaim materials｜回收材料
tip_zh: reclaim强调收回或恢复利用，不只是收集。

meanings_zh: adj. 相关的；切题的
definition_en: directly related to the matter being discussed
example1_en: Office hours began with pertinent question.
example1_zh: 答疑从切题的问题开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss pertinent question.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论切题的问题的材料。
collocations: pertinent question｜切题的问题 ; pertinent information｜相关信息 ; pertinent to｜与……相关
tip_zh: 常用pertinent to表示与某事相关，语体较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 动物突出的口鼻部
definition_en: the projecting nose and mouth of an animal
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a pig's snout.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于猪的口鼻部的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a pig's snout when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了猪的口鼻部。
collocations: a pig's snout｜猪的口鼻部 ; a long snout｜长口鼻部 ; a pointed snout｜尖口鼻部
tip_zh: 不只指猪嘴，也指其他动物突出的口鼻部。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻信的；易受骗的
definition_en: Too willing to believe what others say, even when untrue
example1_en: The textbook introduces gullible consumers in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了容易受骗的消费者。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss gullible consumers.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论容易受骗的消费者的材料。
collocations: gullible consumers｜容易受骗的消费者 ; gullible enough to believe｜轻信到竟然相信 ; seem gullible｜显得容易受骗
tip_zh: 带贬义，强调容易相信假话，不等于善良。

meanings_zh: n. 手术刀；解剖刀
definition_en: A small, very sharp knife used in surgery or dissection.
example1_en: Our professor circled surgical scalpel on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了外科手术刀。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around surgical scalpel.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕外科手术刀展开说明。
collocations: surgical scalpel｜外科手术刀 ; scalpel blade｜手术刀刀片 ; disposable scalpel｜一次性手术刀
tip_zh: 可数名词，指精细切割用的手术刀或解剖刀。

meanings_zh: n. 布道；讲道 | n. 说教；训诫
definition_en: a religious talk given during a service | a long talk telling someone how they should behave
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a sermon on kindness.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于关于善意的布道的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a sermon on kindness.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得关于善意的布道这个例子。
collocations: deliver a sermon｜进行布道 ; a sermon on kindness｜关于善意的布道 ; preach a sermon｜讲道
tip_zh: 本义为宗教讲道；比喻“说教”时常带不满。

meanings_zh: adv. 借以；通过这种方式
definition_en: By which a particular result is achieved.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize whereby in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出借以。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses whereby when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了借以。
collocations: a system whereby｜借以实现某事的制度 ; a process whereby｜借以实现某事的过程 ; an arrangement whereby｜据此实行的安排
tip_zh: 正式关系副词，常接在system等词后，相当于by which。

meanings_zh: v. 控制；抑制 | n. 限制；约束 | n. 路缘石（美式）
definition_en: to limit or control something unwanted | a limit on an activity or behaviour | the raised edge between a road and pavement
example1_en: The assignment is to curb spending, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先控制开支，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to curb spending and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你控制开支，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: curb spending｜控制开支 ; curb inflation｜抑制通货膨胀 ; a curb on emissions｜对排放的限制
tip_zh: 作动词指抑制；路缘石在英式英语中拼作kerb。

meanings_zh: n. 无穷；无限 | n. 无穷大
definition_en: The state of having no end or limit. | A mathematical concept greater than any finite quantity.
example1_en: The textbook introduces stretch into infinity in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了延伸至无穷远。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around stretch into infinity.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕延伸至无穷远展开说明。
collocations: stretch into infinity｜延伸至无穷远 ; approach infinity｜趋于无穷大 ; an infinity of possibilities｜无穷的可能性
tip_zh: 不是一般的“大量”；数学中常用趋于无穷大。

meanings_zh: v. 推断；推论
definition_en: to reach a conclusion using evidence rather than direct statements
example1_en: The assignment is to infer from evidence, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先根据证据推断，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers infer from evidence before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要根据证据推断。
collocations: infer from evidence｜根据证据推断 ; infer that｜推断…… ; reasonably infer｜合理推断
tip_zh: infer是听者推断，imply是说者暗示。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
definition_en: Extremely happy and excited, especially after success or good news.
example1_en: Office hours began with elated by success.
example1_zh: 答疑从因成功而欢欣鼓舞开始。
example2_en: The author returns to elated by success when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了因成功而欢欣鼓舞。
collocations: feel elated｜感到欣喜万分 ; elated at the news｜听到消息欣喜万分 ; elated by success｜因成功而欢欣鼓舞
tip_zh: 比happy语气更强，常用于成功或获悉好消息后。

meanings_zh: n. 偿付能力
definition_en: The ability to pay all the debts you owe.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about maintain solvency.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于维持偿付能力的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss maintain solvency.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论维持偿付能力的材料。
collocations: maintain solvency｜维持偿付能力 ; financial solvency｜财务偿付能力 ; solvency requirements｜偿付能力要求
tip_zh: solvency指偿债能力，不等于盈利能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 高山的；阿尔卑斯山的
definition_en: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about alpine plants.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于高山植物的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to alpine plants when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了高山植物。
collocations: alpine plants｜高山植物 ; alpine meadows｜高山草甸 ; alpine skiing｜高山滑雪 ; alpine ecosystem｜高山生态系统
tip_zh: 泛指高山环境用小写；专指阿尔卑斯山常大写。

meanings_zh: n. 一批运送的货物 | n. 寄售；委托代销
definition_en: A batch of goods sent to a person or place. | An arrangement where sellers pay suppliers only after goods sell.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a consignment of goods in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一批货物。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a consignment of goods.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得一批货物这个例子。
collocations: a consignment of goods｜一批货物 ; receive a consignment｜收到一批货物 ; on consignment｜以寄售方式
tip_zh: on consignment指寄售，卖出后再向供货方付款。

meanings_zh: n. 灵长类动物
definition_en: a mammal belonging to the group including humans, monkeys, and apes
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about primate species.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于灵长类物种的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of primate species.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得灵长类物种这个例子。
collocations: primate species｜灵长类物种 ; primate behaviour｜灵长类动物的行为 ; non-human primates｜非人灵长类动物
tip_zh: 包括人、猿和猴；并非只指猴子。

meanings_zh: adj. 使人想起的；类似的
definition_en: Reminding you of something because of a similarity.
example1_en: Office hours began with reminiscent of childhood.
example1_zh: 答疑从令人想起童年的开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss reminiscent of childhood.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论令人想起童年的的材料。
collocations: reminiscent of childhood｜令人想起童年的 ; strongly reminiscent of｜令人强烈联想到 ; vaguely reminiscent of｜隐约使人想起
tip_zh: 固定搭配be reminiscent of，介词不用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 深远的；强烈的 | adj. 深刻的；深邃的
definition_en: Very great in effect, degree, or intensity. | Showing deep thought, understanding, or insight.
example1_en: Office hours began with a profound impact.
example1_zh: 答疑从深远的影响开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a profound impact with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把深远的影响和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a profound impact｜深远的影响 ; profound changes｜深刻的变化 ; profound understanding｜深刻的理解 ; profound sadness｜深切的悲伤
tip_zh: 常修饰impact、change、understanding，不指物理深度。

meanings_zh: adj. 违法的；有不良行为的 | adj. 逾期未付的；拖欠的 | n. 违法者；少年犯
definition_en: Behaving illegally or antisocially, especially while young. | Not paid on time, or failing to pay on time. | A person, usually young, who breaks the law.
example1_en: I copied a juvenile delinquent into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把少年犯抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a juvenile delinquent.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论少年犯的材料。
collocations: delinquent behaviour｜违法行为 ; a juvenile delinquent｜少年犯 ; delinquent payments｜逾期款项 ; a delinquent borrower｜拖欠还款的借款人
tip_zh: 金融语境中指逾期未付；日常多指青少年违法。

meanings_zh: n. 独家权；专有性 | n. 排他性；仅限少数人享有
definition_en: the right to provide or use something without competitors | the quality of being available only to a select group
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on grant exclusivity.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论授予独家权。
example2_en: A campus survey used grant exclusivity to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用授予独家权来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: an exclusivity agreement｜独家协议 ; grant exclusivity｜授予独家权 ; a sense of exclusivity｜专属感
tip_zh: 既可指商业独家权，也可指仅少数人享有的特性。

meanings_zh: n. 动物学
definition_en: the scientific study of animals
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a degree in zoology.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于动物学学位的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a degree in zoology to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用动物学学位来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: study zoology｜学习动物学 ; a degree in zoology｜动物学学位 ; a zoology department｜动物学系
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；研究植物的学科是botany。

meanings_zh: n. 变体；变种 | adj. 变异的；不同的
definition_en: A form that differs slightly from other related forms. | Differing in some way from the usual or related form.
example1_en: Our professor circled genetic variant on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基因变异。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around genetic variant.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕基因变异展开说明。
collocations: a variant of｜……的一种变体 ; genetic variant｜基因变异 ; regional variant｜地区变体 ; variant spelling｜异体拼写
tip_zh: 名词常用a variant of；形容词可修饰spelling等。

meanings_zh: n. 公社；共同生活群体
definition_en: a group living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about farming commune.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于农业公社的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around farming commune.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕农业公社展开说明。
collocations: live in a commune｜在公社生活 ; farming commune｜农业公社 ; establish a commune｜建立公社
tip_zh: 名词指共同生活群体；动词 commune with 指心灵交流。

meanings_zh: v. 十分恼怒；生闷气 | n. 有害或刺鼻的烟气
definition_en: To feel or express strong anger. | Strong, unpleasant or harmful gas or smoke, usually plural.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to fume over something.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须为某事大发脾气。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to fume over something.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得为某事大发脾气。
collocations: fume over something｜为某事大发脾气 ; exhaust fumes｜汽车尾气 ; toxic fumes｜有毒烟气
tip_zh: 表示烟气通常用复数fumes；动词常指十分恼怒。

meanings_zh: adj. 最大的；极度的 | n. 最大努力；极限
definition_en: greatest in degree, amount, or intensity | the greatest effort or amount someone can achieve
example1_en: I copied utmost respect into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把最高敬意抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss utmost respect.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论最高敬意的材料。
collocations: of the utmost importance｜极为重要 ; with utmost care｜极其小心地 ; do your utmost｜尽最大努力 ; utmost respect｜最高敬意
tip_zh: do one's utmost意为尽最大努力，常接to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 辅助的；备用的 | n. 助动词
definition_en: providing extra help or support when needed | a verb used with another verb to form grammatical structures
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about auxiliary power.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于备用电力的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects auxiliary power with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把备用电力和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: auxiliary power｜备用电力 ; auxiliary engine｜备用发动机 ; auxiliary verb｜助动词
tip_zh: 语法中 auxiliary verb 指助动词，如 be、have、do。

meanings_zh: n. 手艺；精湛工艺
definition_en: Skill in making things, especially carefully by hand.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fine craftsmanship in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精湛工艺。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of fine craftsmanship.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得精湛工艺这个例子。
collocations: fine craftsmanship｜精湛工艺 ; traditional craftsmanship｜传统手艺 ; quality craftsmanship｜优质工艺
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调制作技艺或成品的工艺水平。

meanings_zh: n. 凿子 | v. 凿；雕刻
definition_en: A tool with a sharp edge for cutting wood or stone. | To cut or shape wood or stone with a chisel.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a wood chisel.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于木工凿的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a wood chisel to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用木工凿来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a wood chisel｜木工凿 ; a hammer and chisel｜锤子和凿子 ; chisel away｜逐渐凿去
tip_zh: 动词过去式英式常写chiselled，美式常写chiseled。

meanings_zh: n. 后裔；子孙 | n. 衍生事物；后继形式
definition_en: Someone related to a person who lived in an earlier generation. | Something developed from an earlier form of something similar.
example1_en: The textbook introduces direct descendant in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了直系后裔。
example2_en: The reading connects direct descendant with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把直系后裔和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: direct descendant｜直系后裔 ; descendant of｜……的后代 ; descendants of immigrants｜移民的后代
tip_zh: descendant是后代；ancestor是祖先。

meanings_zh: v. 主张；认为 | v. 应对；与……斗争 | v. 竞争；争夺
definition_en: To argue that something is true. | To struggle with a difficulty or challenging situation. | To compete for something against other people.
example1_en: The professor asked us to contend that.
example1_zh: 教授让我们主张……。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to contend that.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们主张……。
collocations: contend that｜主张…… ; contend with difficulties｜应对困难 ; contend for the title｜争夺冠军
tip_zh: contend that表主张；with接困难；for接争夺目标。

meanings_zh: n. 保管人；守护者 | n. 楼宇管理员
definition_en: A person or organisation responsible for protecting or managing something. | Someone employed to clean and maintain a building, especially in America.
example1_en: Office hours began with school custodian.
example1_zh: 答疑从学校楼宇管理员开始。
example2_en: The author returns to school custodian when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校楼宇管理员。
collocations: custodian of cultural heritage｜文化遗产守护者 ; school custodian｜学校楼宇管理员 ; legal custodian｜法定监护人
tip_zh: custodian of后接所保管或守护的对象。

meanings_zh: adj. 细微的；不易察觉的 | adj. 巧妙的；含蓄的
definition_en: Small or delicate enough to be difficult to notice | Expressed or achieved indirectly and skilfully
example1_en: The textbook introduces a subtle difference in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了细微差别。
example2_en: A campus survey used a subtle difference to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用细微差别来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a subtle difference｜细微差别 ; a subtle hint｜含蓄的暗示 ; subtle influence｜潜移默化的影响 ; a subtle flavour｜淡雅的味道
tip_zh: b不发音；常形容难以察觉的差别或影响。

meanings_zh: v. 暴跌；骤降 | v. 急速坠落
definition_en: To decrease very quickly and sharply. | To fall suddenly and quickly from a high position.
example1_en: The assignment is to plummet to a record low, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先跌至历史最低点，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to plummet to a record low and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你跌至历史最低点，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: prices plummet｜价格暴跌 ; temperatures plummet｜气温骤降 ; plummet to a record low｜跌至历史最低点
tip_zh: 常作不及物动词；to接终值，by接降幅。

meanings_zh: n. 刻板印象；成见 | v. 对……抱有刻板印象
definition_en: a fixed, oversimplified belief about a group of people | to judge people using fixed beliefs about their group
example1_en: After the lecture, we used stereotype in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了成见。
example2_en: Students who can explain stereotype usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释成见的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: gender stereotypes｜性别刻板印象 ; challenge a stereotype｜挑战刻板印象 ; reinforce stereotypes｜强化刻板印象
tip_zh: 常指对某类人的简单化看法，不等同于事实。

meanings_zh: n. 政治共同体；共和国 | n. 英联邦
definition_en: A politically organised community, especially one governed for public benefit. | An association of independent countries, mostly formerly under British rule.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the Commonwealth.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于英联邦的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of the Commonwealth.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得英联邦这个例子。
collocations: the Commonwealth｜英联邦 ; Commonwealth countries｜英联邦国家 ; Commonwealth membership｜英联邦成员资格
tip_zh: 指英联邦时首字母大写，通常与the连用。

meanings_zh: v. 享受；期待并乐于做 | n. 乐趣；享受 | n. 佐餐调味酱
definition_en: To enjoy something greatly or eagerly anticipate doing it. | Great enjoyment or enthusiasm when doing something. | A sauce of chopped vegetables or fruit eaten with food.
example1_en: The professor asked us to relish a challenge.
example1_zh: 教授让我们乐于接受挑战。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers relish a challenge before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要乐于接受挑战。
collocations: relish a challenge｜乐于接受挑战 ; relish the opportunity｜欣然把握机会 ; with relish｜津津有味地 ; tomato relish｜番茄调味酱
tip_zh: 动词后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 抑制；阻碍 | v. 使拘谨；使不敢表达
definition_en: To slow down or prevent a process or activity. | To make someone feel unable to act or speak freely.
example1_en: The assignment is to inhibit growth, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先抑制生长，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to inhibit growth.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得抑制生长。
collocations: inhibit growth｜抑制生长 ; inhibit development｜阻碍发展 ; inhibit enzyme activity｜抑制酶活性
tip_zh: inhibit侧重抑制或阻碍；prohibit指明令禁止。

meanings_zh: n. 帝国主义；帝国扩张政策
definition_en: A policy of extending a country's power over other countries.
example1_en: Office hours began with cultural imperialism.
example1_zh: 答疑从文化帝国主义开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of cultural imperialism.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得文化帝国主义这个例子。
collocations: cultural imperialism｜文化帝国主义 ; economic imperialism｜经济帝国主义 ; the legacy of imperialism｜帝国主义的遗留影响
tip_zh: 通常不可数；强调一国向外扩张统治或影响力。

meanings_zh: n. 散文作家；随笔作家
definition_en: a writer of short pieces exploring particular subjects
example1_en: Office hours began with a literary essayist.
example1_zh: 答疑从文学散文作家开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a literary essayist when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了文学散文作家。
collocations: a literary essayist｜文学散文作家 ; a celebrated essayist｜著名随笔作家 ; a novelist and essayist｜小说家兼散文作家
tip_zh: 指以散文或随笔创作为业者，不泛指写作文的学生。

meanings_zh: n. 专员；委员会委员
definition_en: an official responsible for a public service or commission
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about police commissioner.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于警务专员的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of police commissioner.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得警务专员这个例子。
collocations: police commissioner｜警务专员 ; high commissioner｜高级专员 ; appoint a commissioner｜任命专员
tip_zh: 通常指负有特定公共职责的官员，不泛指所有委员。

meanings_zh: n. 大毁灭；大屠杀 | n. 纳粹对犹太人的大屠杀
definition_en: Destruction or killing on a very large scale. | The Nazi murder of six million Jews during World War Two.
example1_en: Office hours began with nuclear holocaust.
example1_zh: 答疑从核毁灭开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss nuclear holocaust.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论核毁灭的材料。
collocations: nuclear holocaust｜核毁灭 ; Holocaust survivors｜纳粹大屠杀幸存者 ; Holocaust remembrance｜纳粹大屠杀纪念
tip_zh: 特指纳粹大屠杀时用the Holocaust，首字母大写。

meanings_zh: n. 就职典礼 | n. 正式启用；开幕典礼
definition_en: A ceremony formally marking someone's start in an important public office. | The formal opening or beginning of a facility or activity.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a presidential inauguration.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于总统就职典礼的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a presidential inauguration with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把总统就职典礼和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a presidential inauguration｜总统就职典礼 ; an inauguration ceremony｜就职或启用典礼 ; the inauguration of a new museum｜新博物馆的开馆典礼
tip_zh: 既可指领导人就职，也可指设施正式启用。

meanings_zh: n. 柑橘类果树；柑橘类水果 | adj. 柑橘类的
definition_en: Trees producing fruits such as oranges and lemons, or their fruits. | Relating to fruits such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruit.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on citrus fruit.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论柑橘类水果。
example2_en: A campus survey used citrus fruit to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用柑橘类水果来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: citrus fruit｜柑橘类水果 ; citrus trees｜柑橘类果树 ; citrus peel｜柑橘类果皮 ; citrus juice｜柑橘类果汁
tip_zh: citrus是总称，包括橙、柠檬、葡萄柚等。

meanings_zh: n. 热烈鼓掌；欢呼
definition_en: enthusiastic applause from an audience to show strong approval
example1_en: Office hours began with standing ovation.
example1_zh: 答疑从起立鼓掌开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around standing ovation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕起立鼓掌展开说明。
collocations: standing ovation｜起立鼓掌 ; receive an ovation｜获得热烈掌声 ; thunderous ovation｜雷鸣般的掌声
tip_zh: 可数名词；standing ovation指观众起立鼓掌。

meanings_zh: n. 脆弱性；易受伤害性 | n. 弱点；安全漏洞
definition_en: The state of being easily harmed, affected, or attacked. | A weakness that allows damage or an attack.
example1_en: Our professor circled security vulnerability on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全漏洞。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of security vulnerability.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得安全漏洞这个例子。
collocations: vulnerability to flooding｜易受洪水侵袭 ; security vulnerability｜安全漏洞 ; reduce vulnerability｜降低脆弱性
tip_zh: 泛指脆弱性时不可数；指具体漏洞时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 有教育意义的；有启发的
definition_en: providing useful knowledge or helping someone understand something
example1_en: Office hours began with an instructive example.
example1_zh: 答疑从有启发性的例子开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used an instructive example to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有启发性的例子来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: an instructive example｜有启发性的例子 ; an instructive experience｜有教育意义的经历 ; find something instructive｜觉得某事很有启发
tip_zh: 强调让人学到东西，不等于“发出指令的”。

meanings_zh: n. 星号
definition_en: A star-shaped symbol used to indicate a note or omission
example1_en: I copied an asterisk beside into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把旁边的星号抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to an asterisk beside when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了旁边的星号。
collocations: mark with an asterisk｜用星号标记 ; an asterisk beside｜旁边的星号 ; add an asterisk｜添加星号
tip_zh: 词尾是-risk，注意不要误读成-riks。

meanings_zh: v. 合并；融合
definition_en: Combine or join together to form a single whole.
example1_en: The assignment is to merge with another company, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先与另一家公司合并，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to merge with another company and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你与另一家公司合并，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: merge with another company｜与另一家公司合并 ; merge into one｜合为一体 ; merge two departments｜合并两个部门
tip_zh: merge with表示与……合并；merge into表示并入。

meanings_zh: n. 恶名；声名狼藉
definition_en: the state of being widely known for something bad
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on achieve notoriety.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论变得臭名昭著。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around achieve notoriety.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕变得臭名昭著展开说明。
collocations: gain notoriety｜落得恶名 ; notoriety for corruption｜腐败的恶名 ; achieve notoriety｜变得臭名昭著
tip_zh: 通常不可数，含贬义；中性的“名气”用fame。

meanings_zh: n. 微光；闪烁的弱光 | n. 一丝；微弱迹象 | v. 发出微光；隐约闪烁
definition_en: A faint light, often shining unevenly | A small sign of something, especially hope or understanding | To shine faintly or with an unsteady light
example1_en: Office hours began with a glimmer of light.
example1_zh: 答疑从一缕微光开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a glimmer of light with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把一缕微光和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a glimmer of light｜一缕微光 ; a glimmer of hope｜一线希望 ; a glimmer of understanding｜一丝领悟
tip_zh: a glimmer of hope是“一线希望”的常见表达。

meanings_zh: n. 官僚体制；行政体系 | n. 繁文缛节；官僚作风
definition_en: an administrative system run by officials following established rules | complicated official procedures that make tasks unnecessarily difficult
example1_en: Office hours began with government bureaucracy.
example1_zh: 答疑从政府行政体系开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss government bureaucracy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论政府行政体系的材料。
collocations: government bureaucracy｜政府行政体系 ; reduce bureaucracy｜减少繁文缛节 ; excessive bureaucracy｜过度繁琐的行政手续
tip_zh: bureaucracy指体制或繁琐手续；官僚个人是bureaucrat。

meanings_zh: v. 使协调；使一致 | v. 使和解 | v. 使接受不愉快的现实
definition_en: To make conflicting ideas, needs, or facts compatible | To restore friendly relations after a disagreement | To help someone accept an unpleasant situation
example1_en: I heard the lecturer reconcile A with B during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使A与B协调。
example2_en: The passage says students who can reconcile A with B follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够使A与B协调的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: reconcile A with B｜使A与B协调 ; reconcile differences｜调和分歧 ; be reconciled with someone｜与某人和解 ; reconcile yourself to｜使自己接受
tip_zh: 协调两者用with；接受现实用reconcile oneself to。

meanings_zh: n. 血浆 | n. 等离子体
definition_en: The liquid part of blood in which blood cells float | An ionised gas containing free electrons and charged particles
example1_en: The textbook introduces blood plasma in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了血浆。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss blood plasma.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论血浆的材料。
collocations: blood plasma｜血浆 ; donate plasma｜捐献血浆 ; plasma proteins｜血浆蛋白 ; plasma physics｜等离子体物理学
tip_zh: 通常不可数；医学中指血浆，物理学中指等离子体。

meanings_zh: v. 猛涨；飞速上升
definition_en: To increase extremely quickly to a very high level.
example1_en: The professor explained skyrocket with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了猛涨。
example2_en: Students who can explain skyrocket usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释猛涨的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: prices skyrocket｜价格猛涨 ; demand skyrockets｜需求激增 ; skyrocketing costs｜飞涨的成本
tip_zh: 通常作不及物动词，主语常为价格、成本或需求。

meanings_zh: adj. 大气的；大气层的 | adj. 富有氛围的
definition_en: Relating to the gases surrounding Earth or another planet. | Creating a strong and distinctive mood or feeling.
example1_en: Office hours began with atmospheric pressure.
example1_zh: 答疑从大气压开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of atmospheric pressure.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得大气压这个例子。
collocations: atmospheric pressure｜大气压 ; atmospheric conditions｜大气状况 ; atmospheric pollution｜大气污染 ; an atmospheric setting｜富有氛围的环境
tip_zh: 修饰pressure指大气的；修饰场所常指富有氛围的。

meanings_zh: n. 建立；设立 | n. 机构；营业场所 | n. 权势集团；当权派
definition_en: the process of starting an organisation or system | an organisation or place where business or public activities happen | the powerful people who control a society or profession
example1_en: I copied educational establishment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把教育机构抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used educational establishment to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用教育机构来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: the establishment of｜……的建立 ; educational establishment｜教育机构 ; business establishment｜营业机构 ; the political establishment｜政治权势集团
tip_zh: 表示建立时不可数；表示机构时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 内部通知；备忘录 | n. 正式备忘录
definition_en: A written message sharing information within an organisation | A formal document recording an agreement or shared intentions
example1_en: The textbook introduces an internal memorandum in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了内部备忘录。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an internal memorandum.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕内部备忘录展开说明。
collocations: an internal memorandum｜内部备忘录 ; issue a memorandum｜发布备忘录 ; memorandum of understanding｜谅解备忘录
tip_zh: 常简称memo；复数为memoranda或memorandums。

meanings_zh: adj. 合同规定的；契约的
definition_en: Relating to or required by a legal agreement.
example1_en: The textbook introduces contractual obligations in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了合同义务。
example2_en: The reading connects contractual obligations with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把合同义务和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: contractual obligations｜合同义务 ; contractual rights｜合同权利 ; contractual terms｜合同条款 ; contractual agreement｜契约协议
tip_zh: 强调合同规定的权利或义务，常置于名词前。

meanings_zh: v. 表扬；称赞 | v. 推荐
definition_en: to praise someone or something, often publicly | to recommend someone or something as worthy of consideration
example1_en: The professor asked us to commend someone for something.
example1_zh: 教授让我们因某事表扬某人。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers commend someone for something before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要因某事表扬某人。
collocations: commend someone for something｜因某事表扬某人 ; highly commended｜受到高度赞扬 ; commend something to someone｜向某人推荐某物
tip_zh: commend是称赞；command是命令，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: n. 冷漠；不关心
definition_en: A lack of interest, concern, or emotional response.
example1_en: The textbook introduces public indifference in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公众的冷漠。
example2_en: The reading connects public indifference with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把公众的冷漠和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: indifference to suffering｜对苦难的漠视 ; public indifference｜公众的冷漠 ; show indifference｜表现冷淡
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某事冷漠用 indifference to。

meanings_zh: v. 与……矛盾；相抵触 | v. 反驳；否认某人的话
definition_en: To be inconsistent with another statement, fact, or piece of evidence. | To say that someone else's statement is wrong.
example1_en: The professor asked us to contradict a claim.
example1_zh: 教授让我们与某一说法矛盾。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to contradict a claim.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得与某一说法矛盾。
collocations: contradict a claim｜与某一说法矛盾 ; contradict the evidence｜与证据相悖 ; contradict yourself｜自相矛盾
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接人或说法；无需加with。

meanings_zh: v. 讲述；叙述 | v. 为…作旁白
definition_en: To tell a story or describe a series of events. | To provide spoken commentary for a film or programme.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to narrate a story.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何讲述故事。
example2_en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers narrate a story before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要讲述故事。
collocations: narrate a story｜讲述故事 ; narrate a documentary｜为纪录片配旁白 ; narrate events｜叙述事件
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接故事或事件，无需加about。

meanings_zh: adj. 省的；省级的 | adj. 外省的；地方的 | adj. 狭隘守旧的
definition_en: relating to a province or its administration | relating to areas outside a country's capital | showing limited experience and unwillingness to accept different ideas
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on provincial government.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论省级政府。
example2_en: The author returns to provincial government when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了省级政府。
collocations: provincial government｜省级政府 ; provincial capital｜省会 ; provincial town｜外省城镇
tip_zh: 指省级时中性；形容人的观念时可含贬义。

meanings_zh: v. 设想；展望
definition_en: To imagine a possible future situation or event.
example1_en: The assignment is to envisage a future, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先展望未来，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to envisage a future.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来展望未来。
collocations: envisage a future｜展望未来 ; envisage doing something｜设想做某事 ; as originally envisaged｜按最初的设想
tip_zh: 后接名词、动名词或that从句，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 尊重；敬重 | v. 尊重；敬重
definition_en: Respect and admiration for someone. | To respect and admire someone highly.
example1_en: Office hours began with earn someone's esteem.
example1_zh: 答疑从赢得某人的敬重开始。
example2_en: The reading connects earn someone's esteem with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把赢得某人的敬重和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: hold someone in high esteem｜非常敬重某人 ; earn someone's esteem｜赢得某人的敬重 ; mutual esteem｜相互尊重
tip_zh: 常用hold someone in high esteem表示非常敬重某人。

meanings_zh: adj. 司法的；法院的
definition_en: relating to courts, judges, or the administration of justice
example1_en: Office hours began with judicial system.
example1_zh: 答疑从司法体系开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used judicial system to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用司法体系来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: judicial system｜司法体系 ; judicial review｜司法审查 ; judicial independence｜司法独立
tip_zh: judicial指司法；judicious指明智、审慎。

meanings_zh: v. 限制；使局限于 | v. 禁闭；使无法离开
definition_en: To keep something within particular limits | To keep someone in a place they cannot leave
example1_en: I heard the lecturer confine oneself to during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使自己局限于。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to confine oneself to.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使自己局限于。
collocations: confine something to｜将某事物限制在 ; be confined to bed｜卧床不起 ; confine oneself to｜使自己局限于
tip_zh: 常用confine A to B，表示将A限制在B内。

meanings_zh: n. 半导体
definition_en: A material that conducts electricity less easily than most metals.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about semiconductor chips.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于半导体芯片的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used semiconductor chips to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用半导体芯片来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: semiconductor chips｜半导体芯片 ; semiconductor manufacturing｜半导体制造 ; the semiconductor industry｜半导体产业
tip_zh: semi-表示半；半导体导电性介于导体与绝缘体之间。

meanings_zh: n. 缺乏；不足 | n. 缺陷；不足之处
definition_en: A lack of enough of something necessary. | A weakness that prevents something from working well.
example1_en: I copied iron deficiency into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把缺铁抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of iron deficiency.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得缺铁这个例子。
collocations: iron deficiency｜缺铁 ; vitamin deficiency｜维生素缺乏 ; nutritional deficiency｜营养不足 ; remedy a deficiency｜弥补不足
tip_zh: 缺某物用deficiency in；具体缺陷常用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 烧焦；烤焦；使枯萎
definition_en: To burn a surface slightly or damage it with heat
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to scorch marks.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何焦痕。
example2_en: The reading asks you to scorch marks and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你焦痕，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: scorch marks｜焦痕 ; scorch the grass｜使草地焦枯 ; scorching heat｜灼热
tip_zh: 常指表面烧焦，不一定烧毁；太阳也能scorch植物。

meanings_zh: n. 对称；对称性
definition_en: The matching arrangement of parts on opposite sides.
example1_en: Our professor circled perfect symmetry on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了完美对称。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of perfect symmetry.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得完美对称这个例子。
collocations: perfect symmetry｜完美对称 ; bilateral symmetry｜左右对称 ; radial symmetry｜辐射对称
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是symmetrical。

meanings_zh: n. 不识字；文盲状态 | n. 某领域的知识匮乏
definition_en: The inability to read and write. | A lack of basic knowledge in a particular subject.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on adult illiteracy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论成人文盲现象。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around adult illiteracy.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕成人文盲现象展开说明。
collocations: adult illiteracy｜成人文盲现象 ; illiteracy rate｜文盲率 ; combat illiteracy｜扫除文盲 ; financial illiteracy｜金融知识匮乏
tip_zh: illiteracy指不识字的状态；指人宜用描述性表达。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难；重大不幸
definition_en: An event causing severe damage, suffering, or distress.
example1_en: I copied a natural calamity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把自然灾难抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a natural calamity.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自然灾难的材料。
collocations: a natural calamity｜自然灾难 ; avert a calamity｜避免灾难 ; calamity strikes｜灾难降临
tip_zh: 比problem严重得多，常指造成重大损失的灾难。

meanings_zh: n. 外交；外交活动 | n. 交际手腕；圆通
definition_en: Managing relations between countries through discussion and negotiation. | Skill in dealing with people without upsetting them.
example1_en: I copied international diplomacy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把国际外交抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used international diplomacy to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用国际外交来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: international diplomacy｜国际外交 ; quiet diplomacy｜低调外交 ; use diplomacy｜运用交际手腕
tip_zh: 既指国家间的外交，也指避免得罪人的处事技巧。

meanings_zh: adj. 耐……的；有抵抗力的 | adj. 抵触的；抗拒的
definition_en: Not easily damaged or affected by something. | Unwilling to accept something or agree to a change.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about resistant to change.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于抵触改变的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of resistant to change.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得抵触改变这个例子。
collocations: resistant to change｜抵触改变 ; antibiotic-resistant bacteria｜耐抗生素细菌 ; water-resistant clothing｜防水服装
tip_zh: 常接to；water-resistant防水程度不及waterproof。

meanings_zh: n. 报销；费用偿还
definition_en: payment given back for money someone has spent
example1_en: I copied claim reimbursement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把申请报销抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used claim reimbursement to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用申请报销来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: claim reimbursement｜申请报销 ; reimbursement of expenses｜费用报销 ; full reimbursement｜全额报销
tip_zh: 多指已付费用的报销，不泛指偿还贷款。

meanings_zh: n. 贵族阶层 | n. 贵族统治
definition_en: the highest social class, traditionally holding inherited titles and privileges | government by people belonging to a privileged hereditary class
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the landed aristocracy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论土地贵族。
example2_en: The reading connects the landed aristocracy with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把土地贵族和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the landed aristocracy｜土地贵族 ; the hereditary aristocracy｜世袭贵族 ; a member of the aristocracy｜贵族成员
tip_zh: 指贵族阶层整体时通常用the aristocracy。

meanings_zh: n. 大批；一系列 | n. 阵列；数组 | v. 排列；布置
definition_en: a large collection of different things | an ordered arrangement of objects or data | to arrange things in a particular order or pattern
example1_en: Our professor circled a solar array on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了太阳能电池阵列。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a solar array.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论太阳能电池阵列的材料。
collocations: a wide array of｜种类繁多的 ; an impressive array of｜令人赞叹的大批 ; a solar array｜太阳能电池阵列 ; a data array｜数据数组
tip_zh: 常见a wide array of，强调数量多、种类丰富。

meanings_zh: n. 序幕；前奏 | n. 前奏曲
definition_en: Something that happens before and introduces a more important event. | A short musical piece, often introducing a longer work.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a piano prelude in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了钢琴前奏曲。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a piano prelude.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论钢琴前奏曲的材料。
collocations: a prelude to｜……的前奏 ; a piano prelude｜钢琴前奏曲 ; a brief prelude｜简短的序幕
tip_zh: 常用a prelude to，to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 使困惑；使费解
definition_en: To confuse someone because something is difficult to understand.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to perplex researchers.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须使研究人员困惑。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to perplex researchers.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使研究人员困惑。
collocations: perplex researchers｜使研究人员困惑 ; be perplexed by｜对……感到困惑 ; a perplexing problem｜令人费解的问题
tip_zh: 及物动词；人感到困惑用perplexed，事物令人困惑用perplexing。

meanings_zh: n. 吨数；总吨重 | n. 船舶吨位
definition_en: The total weight of something expressed in tons. | A measure of a ship's size or carrying capacity.
example1_en: Our professor circled total tonnage on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了总吨数。
example2_en: The reading connects total tonnage with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把总吨数和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: total tonnage｜总吨数 ; cargo tonnage｜货物吨数 ; gross tonnage｜船舶总吨位 ; shipping tonnage｜船舶总吨位量
tip_zh: 船舶总吨位衡量容积，不等于船的实际重量。

meanings_zh: v. 阻碍；妨碍
definition_en: To make progress or an activity more difficult.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to hinder progress.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求阻碍进展。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to hinder progress.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得阻碍进展。
collocations: hinder progress｜阻碍进展 ; hinder development｜阻碍发展 ; hinder efforts｜妨碍努力
tip_zh: hinder是使事情更困难，不一定像prevent那样完全阻止。

meanings_zh: n. 探索；追求 | v. 探寻；追寻
definition_en: a long, determined search for something valuable or important | search persistently for something difficult to find
example1_en: Our professor circled a quest for knowledge on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了对知识的追求。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a quest for knowledge.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论对知识的追求的材料。
collocations: a quest for knowledge｜对知识的追求 ; in quest of｜寻求 ; embark on a quest｜开始探索
tip_zh: 常用名词结构a quest for；动词用法较文学化。

meanings_zh: n. 彻底变化；改造；转型
definition_en: a complete change in the appearance or nature of something
example1_en: Office hours began with a dramatic transformation.
example1_zh: 答疑从巨大的转变开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a dramatic transformation.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得巨大的转变这个例子。
collocations: undergo a transformation｜经历彻底变化 ; a dramatic transformation｜巨大的转变 ; digital transformation｜数字化转型 ; transformation into｜向……的转变
tip_zh: 常用transformation from A into B表示由A变成B。

meanings_zh: adj. 窘迫的；难为情的
definition_en: Embarrassed because you have done something silly or wrong
example1_en: Our professor circled a sheepish smile on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了难为情的笑容。
example2_en: A campus survey used a sheepish smile to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用难为情的笑容来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: a sheepish smile｜难为情的笑容 ; a sheepish grin｜窘迫的咧嘴笑 ; look sheepish｜显得难为情
tip_zh: 通常因出错而难为情，不单指胆小或害羞。

meanings_zh: adj. 神话中的 | adj. 虚构的；并不存在的
definition_en: existing in or relating to traditional myths | imagined or widely believed in, but not actually real
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mythical creature.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论神话生物。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mythical creature.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论神话生物的材料。
collocations: mythical creature｜神话生物 ; mythical hero｜神话英雄 ; mythical kingdom｜虚构王国
tip_zh: mythical多形容神话中的事物，也可指根本不存在的。

meanings_zh: n. 细胞核 | n. 原子核 | n. 核心；中心
definition_en: The part of a cell containing most of its genetic material. | The central part of an atom, containing protons and usually neutrons. | The central group or part around which something develops.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about cell nucleus.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于细胞核的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of cell nucleus.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得细胞核这个例子。
collocations: cell nucleus｜细胞核 ; atomic nucleus｜原子核 ; form the nucleus of｜构成……的核心
tip_zh: 复数为nuclei；可指细胞核或原子核。

meanings_zh: v. 平稳滑行；轻盈移动 | v. 滑翔
definition_en: To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise. | To fly without engine power or without moving the wings.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to glide across.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须平稳滑过。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to glide across.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来平稳滑过。
collocations: glide across｜平稳滑过 ; glide smoothly｜顺畅滑行 ; glide through the air｜在空中滑翔
tip_zh: 强调移动平稳轻盈；空中滑翔也用glide。

meanings_zh: n. 誓言；郑重承诺 | v. 发誓；郑重承诺
definition_en: A serious promise to do or not do something | To promise firmly that you will do something
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize vow in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出誓言。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses vow when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了誓言。
collocations: make a vow｜立下誓言 ; keep a vow｜信守誓言 ; break a vow｜违背誓言 ; vow to do something｜发誓做某事
tip_zh: 动词常用vow to do或vow that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 不关心的；冷淡的 | adj. 平庸的；不出色的
definition_en: showing little interest or concern | not particularly good in quality
example1_en: The textbook introduces indifferent to in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……漠不关心。
example2_en: The author returns to indifferent to when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了对……漠不关心。
collocations: indifferent to｜对……漠不关心 ; remain indifferent｜仍然无动于衷 ; indifferent performance｜平庸的表现
tip_zh: 常用be indifferent to；这里的to是介词。

meanings_zh: n. 残余部分；遗迹 | n. 布头；零头布料
definition_en: a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed | a small piece of cloth left from a larger length
example1_en: I wrote remnant on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把remnant和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up remnant while discussing evidence about historical change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于历史变迁的证据时提到了遗迹。
collocations: a remnant of the past｜过去的遗存 ; forest remnants｜残存林地 ; fabric remnants｜零头布料
tip_zh: 常用a remnant of；复数remnants强调残留的各部分。

meanings_zh: n. 根除；彻底消灭
definition_en: the complete removal or destruction of something harmful
example1_en: I copied disease eradication into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把疾病根除抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of disease eradication.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得疾病根除这个例子。
collocations: disease eradication｜疾病根除 ; the eradication of poverty｜消除贫困 ; eradication programme｜根除计划
tip_zh: 强调彻底消除，常用eradication of。

meanings_zh: n. 性情；气质
definition_en: a person's usual emotional nature and way of reacting
example1_en: The textbook introduces a calm temperament in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了沉着的性情。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a calm temperament.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论沉着的性情的材料。
collocations: a calm temperament｜沉着的性情 ; an artistic temperament｜艺术家气质 ; by temperament｜天性上
tip_zh: temperament指惯常性情；temper常指脾气，尤指怒气。

meanings_zh: v. 为影视译制配音 | v. 给…起绰号；称…为
definition_en: To replace a film's original speech with another language. | To give someone or something a particular name or description.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to dub a film.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须为电影配音。
example2_en: The passage says students who can dub a film follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够为电影配音的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: dub a film｜为电影配音 ; dub into English｜配成英语 ; dubbed version｜配音版
tip_zh: 过去式dubbed；dub A B表示“称A为B”。

meanings_zh: n. 赔罪；补偿
definition_en: Something done to repair harm or show regret.
example1_en: I wrote amends on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把amends和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain amends usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释赔罪的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: make amends｜赔罪；补偿 ; make amends for a mistake｜弥补错误 ; make amends to someone｜向某人赔罪
tip_zh: 名词通常用make amends；不说an amends。

meanings_zh: v. 点燃；燃烧 | v. 激起；引发
definition_en: To start burning or cause something to burn. | To cause a strong feeling or situation to begin.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer ignite a fire during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时点起火。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers ignite a fire before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要点起火。
collocations: ignite a fire｜点起火 ; ignite interest｜激发兴趣 ; ignite a debate｜引发争论
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物；还可比喻激起兴趣或争论。

meanings_zh: adj. 机智幽默的；风趣的
definition_en: Using words in a clever and amusing way
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about witty remark.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于诙谐的话的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss witty remark.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论诙谐的话的材料。
collocations: witty remark｜诙谐的话 ; witty reply｜机智的回答 ; witty dialogue｜风趣的对白
tip_zh: witty强调语言机智幽默，不泛指好笑。

meanings_zh: n. 否决权；否决 | v. 否决；禁止
definition_en: Official power to reject a decision, or its use. | Officially reject a proposed decision or action.
example1_en: The textbook introduces veto power in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了否决权。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss veto power.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论否决权的材料。
collocations: veto power｜否决权 ; exercise a veto｜行使否决权 ; veto a proposal｜否决提案 ; override a veto｜推翻否决
tip_zh: 复数vetoes；动词过去式vetoed。

meanings_zh: v. 哀号；大声哭叫 | n. 哀号声；尖厉长鸣
definition_en: to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress | a long, high cry or sound expressing distress
example1_en: The professor asked us to wail in pain.
example1_zh: 教授让我们痛得大声哭叫。
example2_en: The reading asks you to wail in pain and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你痛得大声哭叫，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: wail in pain｜痛得大声哭叫 ; a piercing wail｜刺耳的哀号声 ; the wail of sirens｜警报器的长鸣声
tip_zh: 强调持续而尖厉的哭声，也可形容警报器长鸣。

meanings_zh: adj. 副词的；状语的 | n. 状语
definition_en: functioning as an adverb or relating to adverbs | a word or group expressing when, where, how, or why
example1_en: The textbook introduces adverbial phrase in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了状语短语。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss adverbial phrase.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论状语短语的材料。
collocations: adverbial phrase｜状语短语 ; adverbial clause｜状语从句 ; adverbial modifier｜状语修饰语
tip_zh: adverb是词类；adverbial可指单词、短语或从句的状语功能。

meanings_zh: n. 半身像；胸像 | n. 女性胸部；胸围
definition_en: a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest | a woman's chest, or its measurement
example1_en: Our professor circled a marble bust on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了大理石半身像。
example2_en: A campus survey used a marble bust to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用大理石半身像来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a marble bust｜大理石半身像 ; a bronze bust｜青铜半身像 ; bust measurement｜胸围尺寸
tip_zh: 指雕像时是可数名词，通常只有头、肩和胸部。

meanings_zh: n. 综合征
definition_en: a group of symptoms that occur together in a condition
example1_en: I copied chronic fatigue syndrome into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把慢性疲劳综合征抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to chronic fatigue syndrome when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了慢性疲劳综合征。
collocations: chronic fatigue syndrome｜慢性疲劳综合征 ; irritable bowel syndrome｜肠易激综合征 ; metabolic syndrome｜代谢综合征
tip_zh: 指一组共同出现的症状，不等同于单一症状symptom。

meanings_zh: n. 鸭嘴兽
definition_en: An Australian egg-laying mammal with a flat bill and webbed feet.
example1_en: I copied a duck-billed platypus into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把鸭嘴兽抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a duck-billed platypus.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得鸭嘴兽这个例子。
collocations: a duck-billed platypus｜鸭嘴兽 ; platypus habitat｜鸭嘴兽栖息地
tip_zh: 虽会产卵，鸭嘴兽仍属于哺乳动物。

meanings_zh: v. 交谈；谈话
definition_en: To talk with someone and exchange thoughts.
example1_en: The professor asked us to converse in English.
example1_zh: 教授让我们用英语交谈。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to converse in English.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们用英语交谈。
collocations: converse with someone｜与某人交谈 ; converse in English｜用英语交谈 ; converse about a topic｜谈论某个话题
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词“相反情况”重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 执行；实施 | n. 死刑的执行 | n. 表演；技艺的发挥
definition_en: the act of carrying out a plan, order, or task | the act of killing someone as a legal punishment | the way a skilled action or performance is carried out
example1_en: Our professor circled flawless execution on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了完美的发挥。
example2_en: A campus survey used flawless execution to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用完美的发挥来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: execution of a plan｜计划的执行 ; flawless execution｜完美的发挥 ; stay of execution｜暂缓执行死刑
tip_zh: 既可指执行计划，也可指执行死刑，须看语境。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎肯定地；想必
definition_en: Almost certainly, or as one confidently expects.
