example1_en: The professor told us to doubtless be aware and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们想必知道，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to doubtless be aware before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先想必知道。
collocations: will doubtless｜想必会 ; would doubtless｜想必会 ; doubtless be aware｜想必知道
tip_zh: 常表示有把握的推测，不一定是绝对确定。

meanings_zh: n. 推断；推论
definition_en: A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct statements.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on reasonable inference.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论合理的推断。
example2_en: A campus survey used reasonable inference to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用合理的推断来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: draw an inference｜作出推断 ; reasonable inference｜合理的推断 ; inference from evidence｜基于证据的推断
tip_zh: 常用draw an inference from，指根据证据推断。

meanings_zh: v. 减轻；缓解
definition_en: to make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe
example1_en: The assignment is to alleviate pain, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先缓解疼痛，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to alleviate pain.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来缓解疼痛。
collocations: alleviate pain｜缓解疼痛 ; alleviate poverty｜缓解贫困 ; alleviate pressure｜减轻压力 ; alleviate symptoms｜缓解症状
tip_zh: 直接接痛苦或问题；表示减轻，不一定彻底消除。

meanings_zh: adj. 文本的；与原文有关的
definition_en: relating to written words or the wording of a document
example1_en: I copied textual analysis into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把文本分析抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of textual analysis.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得文本分析这个例子。
collocations: textual analysis｜文本分析 ; textual evidence｜文本证据 ; textual criticism｜文本校勘 ; textual changes｜文字修改
tip_zh: textual指文本内容；textile指纺织品，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 表明……的；指示性的 | adj. 陈述语气的
definition_en: Showing that something exists or is likely to be true. | Describing verb forms used for statements of fact or questions.
example1_en: Office hours began with indicative of.
example1_zh: 答疑从表明……的开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used indicative of to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用表明……的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: indicative of｜表明……的 ; indicative figures｜参考数据 ; indicative mood｜陈述语气
tip_zh: 常用be indicative of，表示“是……的迹象”。

meanings_zh: n. 气压计 | n. 变化的指标；晴雨表
definition_en: an instrument that measures air pressure | something that indicates changes in a situation or condition
example1_en: I copied air pressure barometer into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把气压计抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects air pressure barometer with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把气压计和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: air pressure barometer｜气压计 ; a barometer of public opinion｜民意的晴雨表 ; economic barometer｜经济晴雨表
tip_zh: 比喻某种状况的指标时，常用a barometer of。

meanings_zh: v. 授权；正式批准
definition_en: To give official permission for someone to do something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to authorize a payment.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求批准付款。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers authorize a payment before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要批准付款。
collocations: authorize a payment｜批准付款 ; authorize someone to act｜授权某人行事 ; authorize access｜授权访问
tip_zh: 常用authorize sb to do；英式也写authorise。

meanings_zh: adj. 谨慎的；稳妥的
definition_en: Careful and sensible about risks and future consequences.
example1_en: The textbook introduces prudent decision in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了审慎的决定。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prudent decision.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕审慎的决定展开说明。
collocations: prudent decision｜审慎的决定 ; prudent financial management｜稳健的财务管理 ; prudent to do something｜做某事是明智的
tip_zh: 强调考虑风险和后果，不只是胆小或节俭。

meanings_zh: v. 增至三倍；使增至三倍 | adj. 三倍的；三重的 | n. 高音；高音声部
definition_en: To become three times as much, or cause this increase. | Three times as much, or consisting of three parts. | The high sounds in music or a sound system.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer treble in size during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时扩大到原来的三倍。
example2_en: The reading asks you to treble in size and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你扩大到原来的三倍，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: treble in size｜扩大到原来的三倍 ; treble the cost｜使成本增至三倍 ; treble clef｜高音谱号 ; treble and bass｜高音与低音
tip_zh: treble表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍；英式英语常用。

meanings_zh: adj. 狡猾的；诡计多端的 | adj. 巧妙的 | n. 狡诈；诡计
definition_en: Clever at getting what you want by deceiving others. | Cleverly planned or designed to achieve a purpose. | Skill in achieving goals through clever deception.
example1_en: Office hours began with a cunning plan.
example1_zh: 答疑从巧妙的计划开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a cunning plan to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用巧妙的计划来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a cunning plan｜巧妙的计划 ; a cunning trick｜狡猾的把戏 ; cunning tactics｜狡诈的策略
tip_zh: 形容人时通常含贬义，不等于单纯的聪明。

meanings_zh: n. 小海湾；水湾 | n. 入口；进气口；进水口
definition_en: A narrow stretch of water reaching into the land. | An opening through which liquid or gas enters.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a sheltered inlet.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于避风的小海湾的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a sheltered inlet when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了避风的小海湾。
collocations: a sheltered inlet｜避风的小海湾 ; a narrow inlet｜狭窄的水湾 ; air inlet｜进气口 ; water inlet｜进水口
tip_zh: 地理中指小海湾；设备中指流体入口，与outlet相对。

meanings_zh: v. 繁荣；茁壮成长 | v. 挥舞以引人注意 | n. 夸张动作；华丽装饰
definition_en: To grow strongly or develop successfully. | To wave something in a way that attracts attention. | A showy movement or decorative detail.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to flourish in.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求在……中蓬勃发展。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers flourish in before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要在……中蓬勃发展。
collocations: flourish in｜在……中蓬勃发展 ; a flourishing business｜生意兴隆的企业 ; with a flourish｜以夸张的动作
tip_zh: 表繁荣时是不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 反向的；成反比的 | n. 相反事物；逆运算
definition_en: Opposite in direction, order, or effect | The opposite of something, or an operation reversing another
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about inverse relationship.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于反向关系的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss inverse relationship.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论反向关系的材料。
collocations: inverse relationship｜反向关系 ; inverse proportion｜反比 ; the inverse of｜…的相反事物 ; inverse operation｜逆运算
tip_zh: inverse relationship指一方增加时另一方减少。

meanings_zh: n. 紧要关头；边缘 | n. 陡边；崖边
definition_en: A point just before something happens, especially something bad. | The edge of a cliff or steep drop.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize brink in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出边缘。
example2_en: Students who can explain brink usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释边缘的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: on the brink of collapse｜濒临崩溃 ; bring back from the brink｜从危急边缘挽回 ; push to the brink｜逼至危急关头
tip_zh: on the brink of后接名词或动名词，常指危机。

meanings_zh: adv. 仅仅；完全
definition_en: Only, with nothing or nobody else involved.
example1_en: The professor told us to solely responsible and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们全权负责的，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will solely responsible when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会全权负责的。
collocations: solely responsible｜全权负责的 ; solely based on｜仅基于 ; rely solely on｜完全依赖
tip_zh: solely强调仅限某人或某事，不等于独自。

meanings_zh: v. 刻意避开；回避
definition_en: To deliberately avoid someone or something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to shun publicity.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求回避公众关注。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to shun publicity.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们回避公众关注。
collocations: shun publicity｜回避公众关注 ; shun responsibility｜逃避责任 ; shun society｜避开社交
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；过去式shunned。

meanings_zh: n. 提名；推荐
definition_en: The act of formally proposing someone for a position or award.
example1_en: Our professor circled nomination process on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了提名程序。
example2_en: A campus survey used nomination process to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用提名程序来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: receive a nomination｜获得提名 ; nomination for an award｜奖项提名 ; nomination process｜提名程序 ; submit a nomination｜提交提名
tip_zh: 提名用nomination；最终任命通常用appointment。

meanings_zh: adv. 在……范围内；就……而言
definition_en: To the extent that something is true or possible.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to insofar as possible.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习在可能范围内。
example2_en: Students who insofar as possible are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够在可能范围内的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: insofar as possible｜在可能范围内 ; insofar as it affects｜就其影响……而言 ; insofar as we know｜据我们所知
tip_zh: 通常用于正式表达insofar as，后接从句。

meanings_zh: v. 再分；细分
definition_en: to divide something into smaller parts or groups
example1_en: The professor asked us to subdivide into groups.
example1_zh: 教授让我们细分成组。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to subdivide into groups.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来细分成组。
collocations: subdivide into groups｜细分成组 ; subdivide land｜细分土地 ; subdivide a category｜细分类别
tip_zh: 常用subdivide A into B，表示把A细分为B。

meanings_zh: n. 基因突变
definition_en: A change in the genetic material of an organism.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about genetic mutation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于基因突变的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects genetic mutation with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把基因突变和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: genetic mutation｜基因突变 ; spontaneous mutation｜自发突变 ; mutation rate｜突变率
tip_zh: 指遗传物质的改变，不一定有害。

meanings_zh: v. 解开；理顺 | v. 理清；摆脱
definition_en: To separate things that have become twisted or caught together. | To separate complicated issues or free someone from a difficult situation.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to disentangle cables.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何理顺缠绕的电线。
example2_en: The reading asks you to disentangle cables and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你理顺缠绕的电线，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: disentangle cables｜理顺缠绕的电线 ; disentangle the effects of｜厘清……的影响 ; disentangle yourself from｜使自己摆脱
tip_zh: 常用disentangle A from B，表示解开或分离。

meanings_zh: adj. 愤愤不平的；愤慨的
definition_en: Angry because something seems unfair or insulting.
example1_en: Office hours began with an indignant response.
example1_zh: 答疑从愤慨的回应开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an indignant response.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论愤慨的回应的材料。
collocations: indignant about something｜对某事愤慨 ; an indignant response｜愤慨的回应 ; indignant at the suggestion｜对这一提议感到愤慨
tip_zh: 强调因不公或受辱而生气，不泛指愤怒。

meanings_zh: adj. 缺乏的；不足的 | adj. 有缺陷的；不完善的
definition_en: not having enough of something necessary | not good enough in quality or performance
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on nutritionally deficient.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论营养不足的。
example2_en: The author returns to nutritionally deficient when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了营养不足的。
collocations: deficient in iron｜缺铁的 ; nutritionally deficient｜营养不足的 ; deficient in essential nutrients｜缺乏必需营养素的
tip_zh: 缺乏某物用be deficient in，常见于营养和能力描述。

meanings_zh: adj. 能读写的；识字的 | adj. 通晓某领域的
definition_en: Able to read and write. | Having practical knowledge of a particular subject or technology.
example1_en: Our professor circled fully literate on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了具备完整读写能力的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fully literate.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕具备完整读写能力的展开说明。
collocations: fully literate｜具备完整读写能力的 ; computer literate｜懂电脑操作的 ; digitally literate｜具备数字素养的 ; financially literate｜具备金融常识的
tip_zh: 常用作形容词；名词 literacy 表示读写能力。

meanings_zh: n. 胚胎；植物的胚
definition_en: An animal or plant at a very early developmental stage
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on human embryo.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人类胚胎。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around human embryo.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕人类胚胎展开说明。
collocations: embryo development｜胚胎发育 ; human embryo｜人类胚胎 ; plant embryo｜植物胚 ; in embryo｜在萌芽阶段
tip_zh: embryo是名词；形容词用embryonic。

meanings_zh: v. 歪曲；不实地描述
definition_en: Describe someone or something in a false or misleading way
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to misrepresent the facts.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何歪曲事实。
example2_en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers misrepresent the facts before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要歪曲事实。
collocations: misrepresent the facts｜歪曲事实 ; misrepresent someone's views｜曲解某人的观点 ; misrepresent something as｜把某事物不实地说成
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接事实、观点或人物作宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 吝啬鬼；守财奴
definition_en: Someone who hoards money and strongly dislikes spending it.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a wealthy miser.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于富有的守财奴的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a wealthy miser when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了富有的守财奴。
collocations: a wealthy miser｜富有的守财奴 ; an old miser｜老吝啬鬼 ; a notorious miser｜出了名的吝啬鬼
tip_zh: 含贬义，指不舍得花钱的人，不等于节俭者。

meanings_zh: v. 使氧化；氧化
definition_en: To react with oxygen, or lose electrons in a chemical reaction.
example1_en: The professor asked us to oxidize rapidly.
example1_zh: 教授让我们迅速氧化。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers oxidize rapidly before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要迅速氧化。
collocations: oxidize rapidly｜迅速氧化 ; oxidize in air｜在空气中氧化 ; readily oxidize｜容易氧化
tip_zh: 英式也拼作oxidise；氧化不一定涉及氧气。

meanings_zh: v. 计算
definition_en: To calculate an amount or result, often using a computer.
example1_en: The assignment is to compute the cost, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先计算成本，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to compute the cost and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你计算成本，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: compute the cost｜计算成本 ; compute an average｜计算平均值 ; compute a value｜计算数值
tip_zh: 比calculate更正式，常用于计算机或数学语境。

meanings_zh: v. 唤醒；使醒来 | v. 激起；鼓动
definition_en: Wake someone or make them more alert. | Make someone feel a strong emotion or take action.
example1_en: The professor asked us to rouse interest.
example1_zh: 教授让我们激起兴趣。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to rouse interest.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们激起兴趣。
collocations: rouse someone from sleep｜把某人从睡梦中唤醒 ; rouse interest｜激起兴趣 ; rouse someone to action｜激励某人行动
tip_zh: rouse sb from sleep表唤醒；rouse interest表激起。

meanings_zh: v. 补贴；资助
definition_en: Pay part of the cost of an activity or service
example1_en: I heard the lecturer subsidize public transport during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时补贴公共交通。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to subsidize public transport.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来补贴公共交通。
collocations: subsidize public transport｜补贴公共交通 ; heavily subsidized｜获得大量补贴的 ; subsidize the cost of｜补贴……的费用
tip_zh: 英式也写作subsidise；补贴通常只承担部分费用。

meanings_zh: v. 使负有义务；迫使 | adj. 专性的；必须依赖的
definition_en: To require someone to do something legally or morally. | Needing particular conditions or resources to survive.
example1_en: The assignment is to obligate parasite, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先专性寄生生物，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to obligate parasite.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们专性寄生生物。
collocations: obligate someone to do something｜使某人有义务做某事 ; legally obligated｜负有法律义务的 ; obligate parasite｜专性寄生生物
tip_zh: 形容词用于生物学，末尾读/ɡət/；有义务用obligated。

meanings_zh: adj. 慢性的 | adj. 长期存在的；反复发生的
definition_en: Continuing for a long time, especially a medical condition | Persisting or recurring over a long period
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on chronic disease.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论慢性疾病。
example2_en: A campus survey used chronic disease to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用慢性疾病来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: chronic disease｜慢性疾病 ; chronic pain｜慢性疼痛 ; chronic shortage｜长期短缺
tip_zh: 疾病语境中chronic指慢性，acute指急性。

meanings_zh: v. 使不满意
definition_en: To leave someone feeling that something is not good enough.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to dissatisfy customers.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使顾客不满。
example2_en: The passage says students who can dissatisfy customers follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够使顾客不满的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: dissatisfy customers｜使顾客不满 ; dissatisfy users｜使用户不满
tip_zh: 及物动词；日常更常用be dissatisfied with。

meanings_zh: n. 推断；演绎 | n. 扣除；扣除额
definition_en: A conclusion reached through reasoning, or the reasoning process itself. | An amount taken away from a total, or its removal.
example1_en: Our professor circled logical deduction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了逻辑推断。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of logical deduction.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得逻辑推断这个例子。
collocations: logical deduction｜逻辑推断 ; tax deduction｜税款扣除 ; deduction from pay｜工资扣款
tip_zh: 推断对应动词deduce；扣除对应动词deduct。

meanings_zh: n. 平衡；均衡状态 | n. 心情平静；心理平衡
definition_en: A stable state in which opposing forces or influences balance. | A calm and emotionally stable state.
example1_en: I copied maintain equilibrium into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把维持平衡抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used maintain equilibrium to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用维持平衡来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: maintain equilibrium｜维持平衡 ; restore equilibrium｜恢复平衡 ; market equilibrium｜市场均衡 ; dynamic equilibrium｜动态平衡
tip_zh: 通常不可数；常用于经济、生态或物理中的平衡。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；极其重要的 | adj. 纪念碑的；纪念性的
definition_en: Extremely large, impressive, or important. | Relating to monuments or serving as a lasting memorial.
example1_en: Office hours began with monumental task.
example1_zh: 答疑从艰巨的任务开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of monumental task.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得艰巨的任务这个例子。
collocations: monumental task｜艰巨的任务 ; monumental achievement｜非凡的成就 ; monumental architecture｜纪念性建筑
tip_zh: 常修饰task、effort，强调规模或难度极大。

meanings_zh: n. 忠诚；忠实 | n. 准确性；保真度
definition_en: continued loyalty to a person, belief, or duty | the accuracy with which something reproduces an original
example1_en: Our professor circled marital fidelity on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了婚姻中的忠诚。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss marital fidelity.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论婚姻中的忠诚的材料。
collocations: fidelity to principles｜忠于原则 ; marital fidelity｜婚姻中的忠诚 ; high fidelity｜高保真 ; fidelity to the original｜忠实于原作
tip_zh: 忠于某人或原则用fidelity to；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 简短而失礼的；生硬的
definition_en: Using very few words in a way that seems rude.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a curt reply.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于生硬简短的回答的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a curt reply.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得生硬简短的回答这个例子。
collocations: a curt reply｜生硬简短的回答 ; a curt nod｜冷淡的点头 ; a curt tone｜生硬的语气
tip_zh: 不仅指简短，还带不礼貌之意；brief通常中性。

meanings_zh: n. 全部演出曲目或剧目 | n. 全部技能；方法储备
definition_en: All the pieces a performer or group is prepared to perform. | The range of skills or methods someone can use.
example1_en: Our professor circled expand your repertoire on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了扩充曲目或技能储备。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around expand your repertoire.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕扩充曲目或技能储备展开说明。
collocations: expand your repertoire｜扩充曲目或技能储备 ; a wide repertoire｜丰富的曲目储备 ; a repertoire of skills｜一整套技能
tip_zh: 不只指演出曲目，也可指某人掌握的全部技能。

meanings_zh: n. 偏转；转向 | n. 转移注意力；回避
definition_en: A change in direction caused by contact or another force | The act of directing attention or criticism away from something
example1_en: I copied beam deflection into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把梁的挠曲抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of beam deflection.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得梁的挠曲这个例子。
collocations: deflection of light｜光的偏转 ; beam deflection｜梁的挠曲 ; deflection of criticism｜转移批评
tip_zh: 强调受力后改变方向；工程中也指构件挠曲。

meanings_zh: n. 货币贬值 | n. 价值降低；贬低
definition_en: An official reduction in a currency's value relative to other currencies. | A reduction in the worth or importance given to something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about currency devaluation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于货币贬值的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around currency devaluation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕货币贬值展开说明。
collocations: currency devaluation｜货币贬值 ; sharp devaluation｜大幅贬值 ; devaluation of care work｜对照护工作的贬低
tip_zh: 经济学中常指官方下调汇率；市场贬值多用depreciation。

meanings_zh: v. 摆动；振荡 | v. 摇摆不定；波动
definition_en: To move repeatedly backwards and forwards. | To keep changing between different feelings, opinions, or levels.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer oscillate between extremes during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时在极端之间摇摆。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to oscillate between extremes.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来在极端之间摇摆。
collocations: oscillate between extremes｜在极端之间摇摆 ; oscillate rapidly｜快速振荡 ; oscillating fan｜摇头风扇
tip_zh: 表示在两者间摇摆，用oscillate between A and B。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可或缺的 | adj. 内置的；一体的 | n. 积分
definition_en: Necessary for something to be complete or work properly. | Built into something rather than added separately. | A mathematical quantity calculated by integration.
example1_en: The textbook introduces an integral part of in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了……不可或缺的一部分。
example2_en: The reading connects an integral part of with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把……不可或缺的一部分和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an integral part of｜……不可或缺的一部分 ; integral to success｜成功所必需的 ; an integral component｜不可缺少的组成部分
tip_zh: 常用an integral part of或be integral to。

meanings_zh: v. 认真考虑；深思 | v. 考虑做；打算 | v. 凝视；端详
definition_en: to think carefully about something for a long time | to consider doing something in the future | to look at something quietly and thoughtfully
example1_en: The lab instructions say to contemplate the future.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求思考未来。
example2_en: The passage says students who can contemplate the future follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够思考未来的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: contemplate doing something｜考虑做某事 ; contemplate the future｜思考未来 ; contemplate a change｜考虑作出改变
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 使困惑；难倒 | n. 挡板；隔板
definition_en: To make someone unable to understand or explain something | A barrier controlling the flow of sound, light, or fluid
example1_en: The lab instructions say to baffle scientists.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求令科学家困惑。
example2_en: The passage says students who can baffle scientists follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够令科学家困惑的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: baffle scientists｜令科学家困惑 ; completely baffled｜完全摸不着头脑 ; a baffling mystery｜令人费解的谜团 ; a baffle plate｜挡板
tip_zh: 比confuse更强调完全不理解；常用be baffled by。

meanings_zh: n. 渴望；思念 | adj. 流露渴望的
definition_en: A strong desire for someone or something | Showing a strong desire for someone or something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a deep longing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论强烈的渴望。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a deep longing.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕强烈的渴望展开说明。
collocations: a longing for home｜对家的思念 ; a deep longing｜强烈的渴望 ; a longing look｜渴望的目光
tip_zh: 名词常接for；表示渴望做某事可接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 动员；调动 | v. 动员军队；备战
definition_en: To organize people or resources for a particular purpose | To prepare troops for military action
example1_en: I heard the lecturer mobilize resources during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时调动资源。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to mobilize resources.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来调动资源。
collocations: mobilize resources｜调动资源 ; mobilize support｜动员支持力量 ; mobilize volunteers｜动员志愿者 ; mobilize troops｜动员军队
tip_zh: 英式也拼作mobilise；常接资源、支持者或军队。

meanings_zh: n. 优越性；优势 | n. 优越感；高傲
definition_en: The state of being better or stronger than something else. | An attitude of believing yourself better than other people.
example1_en: I copied technological superiority into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把技术优势抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around technological superiority.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕技术优势展开说明。
collocations: technological superiority｜技术优势 ; superiority over｜相对于……的优势 ; a sense of superiority｜优越感
tip_zh: 表示相对优势用superiority over，不用than。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；流行的
definition_en: Common at a particular time or in a particular place.
example1_en: The habit is prevalent in first-year dorms.
example1_zh: 这个习惯在大一宿舍里很普遍。
example2_en: The passage asks why the belief became prevalent even though the evidence was thin.
example2_zh: 文章问为什么证据薄弱时，这种看法仍然变得普遍。
collocations: prevalent among｜在…中普遍 ; widely prevalent｜广泛流行
tip_zh: 名词是 prevalence，常用于流行病学或社会调查。

meanings_zh: n. 誓言；宣誓
definition_en: A formal promise to tell the truth or fulfil a duty.
example1_en: The professor explained oath with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了誓言。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up oath while discussing evidence about public institutions.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了誓言。
collocations: take an oath｜宣誓 ; swear an oath｜立誓 ; under oath｜在宣誓约束下 ; break an oath｜违背誓言
tip_zh: under oath指已宣誓说真话，常用于法庭语境。

meanings_zh: n. 下降；减少 | n. 送达；下客 | n. 陡降处；断崖
definition_en: A decrease in an amount, level, or activity. | The act of leaving someone or something at a place. | A place where the ground suddenly becomes much lower.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize drop-off in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出下降。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses drop-off when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了下降。
collocations: a sharp drop-off｜急剧下降 ; a drop-off in demand｜需求下降 ; drop-off point｜下客点
tip_zh: 名词带连字符；动词短语写作drop off。

meanings_zh: n. 嘲笑；奚落 | v. 嘲弄；奚落
definition_en: Unkind laughter or comments that make someone seem foolish. | To laugh at someone or something in an unkind way.
example1_en: The textbook introduces public ridicule in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公开嘲笑。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of public ridicule.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得公开嘲笑这个例子。
collocations: public ridicule｜公开嘲笑 ; face ridicule｜遭受嘲笑 ; subject someone to ridicule｜使某人遭到嘲笑
tip_zh: 作动词时及物，直接接宾语，不加at。

meanings_zh: adj. 尺寸的；维度的
definition_en: relating to measurements or dimensions of space
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about dimensional accuracy.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于尺寸精度的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used dimensional accuracy to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用尺寸精度来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: dimensional accuracy｜尺寸精度 ; dimensional stability｜尺寸稳定性 ; three-dimensional model｜三维模型
tip_zh: 常见于复合词three-dimensional，意为三维的。

meanings_zh: n. 折旧；价值下降 | n. 货币贬值
definition_en: A reduction in an asset's value over time. | A fall in a currency's value relative to other currencies.
example1_en: I copied annual depreciation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把年度折旧抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of annual depreciation.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得年度折旧这个例子。
collocations: annual depreciation｜年度折旧 ; currency depreciation｜货币贬值 ; depreciation rate｜折旧率 ; allow for depreciation｜考虑折旧
tip_zh: 资产折旧、货币贬值均可用；反义词为appreciation。

meanings_zh: adj. 高潮的；达到顶点的
definition_en: Forming the most exciting or important part of something.
example1_en: I copied climactic scene into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把高潮场景抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around climactic scene.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕高潮场景展开说明。
collocations: climactic scene｜高潮场景 ; climactic moment｜高潮时刻 ; climactic ending｜高潮式结局
tip_zh: 勿与climatic（气候的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 真正的；真实可信的 | adj. 善意的；真诚的
definition_en: Real or genuine, rather than false or pretended. | Made or done honestly, without intending to deceive.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize bona fide in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出真正的。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses bona fide when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了真正的。
collocations: a bona fide student｜具有真实身份的学生 ; a bona fide offer｜真诚的提议 ; a bona fide organisation｜真实合法的机构
tip_zh: 较正式，常置于名词前，强调真实或善意。

meanings_zh: n. 暗杀；行刺
definition_en: the deliberate murder of an important person, often for political reasons
example1_en: Our professor circled political assassination on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政治暗杀。
example2_en: The author returns to political assassination when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了政治暗杀。
collocations: political assassination｜政治暗杀 ; assassination attempt｜暗杀企图 ; assassination plot｜暗杀阴谋
tip_zh: 通常指针对重要人物、带政治目的的谋杀。

meanings_zh: n. 昏暗；幽暗 | n. 忧郁；悲观气氛
definition_en: Darkness or weak light that makes things difficult to see | A feeling of sadness or lack of hope
example1_en: Our professor circled economic gloom on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济低迷的悲观气氛。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around economic gloom.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济低迷的悲观气氛展开说明。
collocations: in the gloom｜在昏暗中 ; economic gloom｜经济低迷的悲观气氛 ; a sense of gloom｜悲观感 ; doom and gloom｜悲观绝望
tip_zh: 既可指光线昏暗，也可指心情或前景黯淡。

meanings_zh: n. 不悦；不满
definition_en: a feeling of annoyance or dissatisfaction
example1_en: I copied express displeasure into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把表达不满抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss express displeasure.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论表达不满的材料。
collocations: express displeasure｜表达不满 ; show displeasure｜流露不悦 ; displeasure at something｜对某事的不满
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，较正式；常接at或with。

meanings_zh: n. 金融家；融资者
definition_en: Someone who manages or provides large amounts of investment money
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on international financier.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论国际金融家。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of international financier.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得国际金融家这个例子。
collocations: international financier｜国际金融家 ; wealthy financier｜富有的金融家 ; leading financier｜主要金融家
tip_zh: 指提供或管理大笔资金的人，不等于普通银行职员。

meanings_zh: v. 污染；使受污染
definition_en: make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances
example1_en: The lab instructions say to contaminate drinking water.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求污染饮用水。
example2_en: The passage says students who can contaminate drinking water follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够污染饮用水的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: contaminate drinking water｜污染饮用水 ; contaminated food｜受污染的食物 ; contaminated with chemicals｜受到化学品污染
tip_zh: 常用be contaminated with表示被某物污染。

meanings_zh: v. 想象；展望
definition_en: to imagine a future situation or possibility
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to envision a future.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何展望未来。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to envision a future.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得展望未来。
collocations: envision a future｜展望未来 ; envision doing something｜设想做某事 ; envision a world｜设想一个世界
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 预言；预示
definition_en: to say or indicate what will happen in the future
example1_en: The assignment is to foretell the future, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先预言未来，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to foretell the future.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们预言未来。
collocations: foretell the future｜预言未来 ; foretell disaster｜预示灾难
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为foretold；比predict更文学化。

meanings_zh: v. 作证；提供证词 | v. 证明；表明
definition_en: To give evidence in court about what you know | To provide evidence that something is true or exists
example1_en: The lab instructions say to testify in court.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求出庭作证。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to testify in court.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们出庭作证。
collocations: testify in court｜出庭作证 ; testify against someone｜作出不利于某人的证词 ; testify to something｜证明某事
tip_zh: testify that接从句；testify to接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 校对 | v. 校对（现在分词）
definition_en: checking written material for errors before its final version | checking written material and correcting errors
example1_en: I copied careful proofreading into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把仔细校对抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss careful proofreading.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论仔细校对的材料。
collocations: careful proofreading｜仔细校对 ; proofreading skills｜校对技能 ; proofreading software｜校对软件
tip_zh: 校对侧重拼写、标点等错误，不等于重写。

meanings_zh: adj. 健谈的；乐于交流的 | adj. 交际的；交流的
definition_en: Willing to talk and share thoughts or information. | Relating to sharing information or expressing meaning.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about communicative skills.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于交际技能的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around communicative skills.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕交际技能展开说明。
collocations: communicative skills｜交际技能 ; communicative competence｜交际能力 ; communicative approach｜交际教学法
tip_zh: 形容人时指乐于交流；形容教学时指重视交际。

meanings_zh: adj. 无效的；无法律效力的 | adj. 零值的；空值的
definition_en: Having no legal force or effect. | Having a zero value or representing no stored value.
example1_en: I copied null and void into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把无效的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around null and void.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕无效的展开说明。
collocations: null and void｜无效的 ; null value｜空值 ; null hypothesis｜零假设；原假设
tip_zh: 法律中常用null and void；编程空值不一定等于零。

meanings_zh: adj. 合法的；法律允许的
definition_en: allowed or recognised by law
example1_en: The textbook introduces lawful owner in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了合法所有者。
example2_en: The reading connects lawful owner with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把合法所有者和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: lawful owner｜合法所有者 ; lawful authority｜合法权限 ; lawful means｜合法手段 ; lawful purpose｜合法目的
tip_zh: lawful指法律允许；legal还可表示“与法律有关的”。

meanings_zh: adj. 势利的；自命高雅的
definition_en: Treating others as inferior because of status, wealth, or taste.
example1_en: Office hours began with a snobbish attitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从势利的态度开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a snobbish attitude.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论势利的态度的材料。
collocations: a snobbish attitude｜势利的态度 ; snobbish about clothes｜在衣着上自命高人一等 ; snobbish behaviour｜势利的行为
tip_zh: 重在因身份或品味而看低别人，不一定谄媚。

meanings_zh: v. 努力；尽力 | n. 努力；尝试
definition_en: To try hard to achieve something | A serious effort to achieve a goal
example1_en: The assignment is to endeavor to do something, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先努力做某事，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers endeavor to do something before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要努力做某事。
collocations: endeavor to do something｜努力做某事 ; a joint endeavor｜共同努力 ; scientific endeavor｜科学探索
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为endeavour，动词常接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 挑衅；激怒
definition_en: behaviour intended or likely to cause anger or a reaction
example1_en: The textbook introduces deliberate provocation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了蓄意挑衅。
example2_en: The author returns to deliberate provocation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了蓄意挑衅。
collocations: without provocation｜无缘无故地 ; deliberate provocation｜蓄意挑衅 ; respond to provocation｜回应挑衅
tip_zh: 常指引起愤怒的挑衅，不宜泛译为普通刺激。

meanings_zh: v. 重申；再次强调
definition_en: to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it
example1_en: The assignment is to reiterate a point, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先重申观点，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to reiterate a point and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你重申观点，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: reiterate a point｜重申观点 ; reiterate a commitment｜重申承诺 ; reiterate that｜重申……
tip_zh: 是动词，不是形容词；可接名词或 that 从句。

meanings_zh: prep. 尽管；虽然 | adv. 尽管如此；仍然
definition_en: despite something that might prevent or contradict something else | despite what has just been mentioned
example1_en: I copied these concerns notwithstanding into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把尽管有这些担忧抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to these concerns notwithstanding when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了尽管有这些担忧。
collocations: notwithstanding the fact that｜尽管事实是 ; notwithstanding these difficulties｜尽管存在这些困难 ; these concerns notwithstanding｜尽管有这些担忧
tip_zh: 正式用语；作介词可放名词前或后，如the rain notwithstanding。

meanings_zh: adj. 不光彩的；可耻的
definition_en: deserving disapproval because of dishonest or unfair behaviour
example1_en: I copied dishonorable conduct into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把可耻行为抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used dishonorable conduct to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用可耻行为来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: dishonorable conduct｜可耻行为 ; dishonorable intentions｜不光彩的意图 ; dishonorable discharge｜不名誉退伍
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写作dishonourable。

meanings_zh: adj. 一丝不苟的；细致的
definition_en: Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.
example1_en: I copied meticulous attention to detail into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把对细节的一丝不苟抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to meticulous attention to detail when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了对细节的一丝不苟。
collocations: meticulous attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟 ; meticulous planning｜周密规划 ; meticulous records｜详尽准确的记录
tip_zh: 通常是褒义，强调认真关注每个细节。

meanings_zh: adj. 发荧光的；荧光灯的 | adj. 颜色鲜亮的；荧光色的
definition_en: Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting. | Having an extremely bright, noticeable colour.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fluorescent lighting in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了荧光照明。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fluorescent lighting.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论荧光照明的材料。
collocations: fluorescent lighting｜荧光照明 ; fluorescent tube｜荧光灯管 ; fluorescent yellow｜荧光黄
tip_zh: 注意拼写是fluorescent，常搭配lamp或tube。

meanings_zh: adj. 高等教育的 | adj. 第三位的；第三阶段的
definition_en: Relating to education at college or university level. | Third in order, level, or stage.
example1_en: Office hours began with tertiary education.
example1_zh: 答疑从高等教育开始。
example2_en: The author returns to tertiary education when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了高等教育。
collocations: tertiary education｜高等教育 ; tertiary sector｜第三产业 ; tertiary care｜三级医疗
tip_zh: tertiary education指中学之后的高等教育。

meanings_zh: v. 同意；意见一致
definition_en: to agree with someone or share the same opinion
example1_en: I heard the lecturer concur that during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时一致认为。
example2_en: The reading asks you to concur that and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你一致认为，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: concur with someone｜同意某人 ; concur that｜一致认为 ; concur in a decision｜赞同一项决定
tip_zh: 正式用词，常用concur with某人或concur that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 拖延的；旷日持久的
definition_en: Lasting longer than expected or desired.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on protracted negotiations.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论旷日持久的谈判。
example2_en: A campus survey used protracted negotiations to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用旷日持久的谈判来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: protracted negotiations｜旷日持久的谈判 ; protracted dispute｜长期争端 ; protracted delay｜长时间的延误 ; protracted illness｜久拖不愈的疾病
tip_zh: 比long更强调拖得过久，常含负面意味。

meanings_zh: n. 停滞；不发展 | n. 水或空气的不流动
definition_en: a state in which growth, activity, or development stops | the condition of water or air remaining still
example1_en: Office hours began with economic stagnation.
example1_zh: 答疑从经济停滞开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of economic stagnation.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得经济停滞这个例子。
collocations: economic stagnation｜经济停滞 ; a period of stagnation｜一段停滞期 ; prolonged stagnation｜长期停滞
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，常用于经济或发展停滞。

meanings_zh: v. 使受折磨；困扰
definition_en: Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty
example1_en: The assignment is to afflict communities, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先困扰社区，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to afflict communities.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来困扰社区。
collocations: be afflicted with｜受……折磨 ; afflict communities｜困扰社区 ; severely afflicted｜深受折磨的
tip_zh: 常用被动be afflicted with，后接疾病或困境。

meanings_zh: n. 满足感；成就感 | n. 履行；实现
definition_en: A feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful | The act of meeting a requirement or achieving something desired
example1_en: Our professor circled personal fulfillment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了个人满足感。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around personal fulfillment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕个人满足感展开说明。
collocations: personal fulfillment｜个人满足感 ; a sense of fulfillment｜成就感 ; fulfillment of obligations｜履行义务 ; order fulfillment｜订单履行
tip_zh: 这是美式拼写；英式通常写作fulfilment。

meanings_zh: n. 文具商
definition_en: A person or business that sells writing and office supplies.
example1_en: I copied a local stationer into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把当地文具商抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a local stationer to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用当地文具商来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a local stationer｜当地文具商 ; a high-street stationer｜商业街文具商 ; at the stationer's｜在文具店
tip_zh: 文具店常用stationer's；stationery是文具，勿混stationary。

meanings_zh: n. 微生物
definition_en: A living organism too small to see without a microscope
example1_en: The professor explained microbe with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了微生物。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up microbe while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了微生物。
collocations: soil microbes｜土壤微生物 ; harmful microbes｜有害微生物 ; beneficial microbes｜有益微生物
tip_zh: 不只指细菌，也不一定有害；germ常指病菌。

meanings_zh: n. 暮色；晨昏微光 | n. 衰落时期；暮年
definition_en: The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise | The final stage of something as its strength or importance fades
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize twilight in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出暮色。
example2_en: A reading on the natural sciences uses twilight when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了暮色。
collocations: at twilight｜在黄昏时分 ; in the twilight｜在暮色中 ; the twilight of a career｜职业生涯的末期
tip_zh: 多指日落后的暮光，也可指日出前的微光。

meanings_zh: n. 参赛者 | n. 新加入者；新入行者
definition_en: a person who takes part in a competition | a person or organisation newly joining an activity or field
example1_en: I copied competition entrant into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把参赛者抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to competition entrant when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了参赛者。
collocations: competition entrant｜参赛者 ; new entrant｜新加入者 ; market entrant｜市场新进入者
tip_zh: 新加入某领域用entrant to；不等于入口entrance。

meanings_zh: adj. 最重要的；基本的 | n. 天主教枢机主教 | n. 北美红雀
definition_en: Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity. | A senior Catholic official who helps elect the pope. | A North American bird whose male has bright red feathers.
example1_en: I copied cardinal rule into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把首要规则抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cardinal rule.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论首要规则的材料。
collocations: cardinal rule｜首要规则 ; cardinal principle｜基本原则 ; cardinal error｜重大错误 ; cardinal number｜基数
tip_zh: cardinal number是基数，ordinal number是序数。

meanings_zh: n. 谬见；错误观念 | n. 逻辑谬误
definition_en: A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false. | An error in reasoning that makes an argument unreliable.
example1_en: I copied a common fallacy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把常见谬见抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a common fallacy.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得常见谬见这个例子。

meanings_zh: adj. 尖刻的；伤人的 | n. 剪报 | n. 路堑
definition_en: Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks. | An article or picture cut out of a newspaper. | A deep passage dug through land for a road or railway.
example1_en: Our professor circled newspaper cutting on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了剪报。
example2_en: The reading connects newspaper cutting with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把剪报和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: cutting remark｜尖刻的评论 ; newspaper cutting｜剪报 ; railway cutting｜铁路路堑
tip_zh: 剪报在英式英语中叫cutting，美式常用clipping。

meanings_zh: v. 设法获得；采购
definition_en: to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements
example1_en: I heard the lecturer procure equipment during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时采购设备。
example2_en: The passage says students who can procure equipment follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够采购设备的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: procure equipment｜采购设备 ; procure supplies｜采购物资 ; procure funding｜筹措资金
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，直接接所获得的物品或资源。

meanings_zh: n. 姿势；体态 | n. 立场；态度 | v. 故作姿态
definition_en: the way you hold your body when sitting or standing | an attitude or position towards a particular issue | to behave artificially in order to impress others
example1_en: Office hours began with good posture.
example1_zh: 答疑从良好的体态开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around good posture.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕良好的体态展开说明。
collocations: good posture｜良好的体态 ; improve your posture｜改善体态 ; adopt a defensive posture｜采取防御姿态
tip_zh: 名词常指体态；动词常含“装样子”的贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚弱的；微弱的 | adj. 无说服力的；无效的
definition_en: Lacking physical strength, energy, or intensity. | Too weak to convince people or achieve a useful result.
example1_en: Office hours began with a feeble voice.
example1_zh: 答疑从微弱的声音开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a feeble voice when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了微弱的声音。
collocations: a feeble voice｜微弱的声音 ; a feeble excuse｜站不住脚的借口 ; a feeble attempt｜无力的尝试
tip_zh: 可形容身体、声音，也可批评借口或努力无力。

meanings_zh: n. 僵局
definition_en: A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about end in deadlock.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于以僵局告终的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss end in deadlock.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论以僵局告终的材料。
collocations: reach a deadlock｜陷入僵局 ; break the deadlock｜打破僵局 ; end in deadlock｜以僵局告终
tip_zh: 常与reach或break搭配；强调分歧导致无法推进。

meanings_zh: n. 毛细血管；毛细管 | adj. 毛细血管的；毛细作用的
definition_en: a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube | relating to tiny blood vessels or liquid movement through narrow spaces
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about capillary action.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于毛细作用的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used capillary action to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用毛细作用来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: capillary action｜毛细作用 ; capillary blood｜毛细血管血液 ; capillary tube｜毛细管 ; capillary network｜毛细血管网
tip_zh: 复数为capillaries；英美读音的重音位置不同。

meanings_zh: n. 刑事起诉；检控 | n. 控方
definition_en: The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime. | The lawyers trying to prove an accused person committed a crime.
example1_en: The textbook introduces face prosecution in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了面临起诉。
example2_en: A campus survey used face prosecution to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用面临起诉来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: face prosecution｜面临起诉 ; criminal prosecution｜刑事起诉 ; the prosecution case｜控方的案情陈述 ; prosecution witness｜控方证人
tip_zh: the prosecution指刑事案件控方，不是民事原告。

meanings_zh: adj. 开明的；思想开放的 | adj. 自由主义的 | adj. 大量的；慷慨给予的
definition_en: Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose. | Supporting political principles that protect individual rights and freedoms. | Given or used generously, often in large amounts.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on liberal attitudes.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论开明的态度。
example2_en: The author returns to liberal attitudes when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了开明的态度。
collocations: liberal attitudes｜开明的态度 ; liberal democracy｜自由民主制 ; a liberal amount of｜大量的
tip_zh: 政治含义随国家而异；也可表示开明或用量充足。

meanings_zh: v. 构思；设想 | v. 怀孕；受孕
definition_en: to form an idea or imagine something | to become pregnant or cause a baby to begin developing
example1_en: I heard the lecturer conceive an idea during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时构思一个主意。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to conceive an idea.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得构思一个主意。
collocations: conceive an idea｜构思一个主意 ; conceive of｜设想；想象 ; conceive a child｜怀上孩子
tip_zh: conceive an idea指构思；conceive of指设想。

meanings_zh: adj. 费时费力的；艰苦的
definition_en: requiring a lot of time and hard work
example1_en: The textbook introduces laborious process in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了费时费力的过程。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of laborious process.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得费时费力的过程这个例子。
collocations: laborious process｜费时费力的过程 ; laborious task｜艰苦的任务 ; laborious work｜繁重的工作
tip_zh: 通常形容任务或过程；形容人勤劳用industrious。

meanings_zh: n. 清楚；清晰易懂 | n. 清晰度；清澈
definition_en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand. | The quality of being easy to see or hear through.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about lack of clarity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于不够清晰的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects lack of clarity with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把不够清晰和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: clarity of thought｜思路清晰 ; for clarity｜为清楚起见 ; lack of clarity｜不够清晰 ; crystal clarity｜极高清晰度
tip_zh: 不可数名词；clarify是动词，意为澄清。

meanings_zh: adj. 感激的；感恩的 | adj. 负债的
definition_en: Grateful to someone for help or support. | Owing money to a person or organisation.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about heavily indebted.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于负债累累的的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of heavily indebted.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得负债累累的这个例子。
collocations: deeply indebted to｜深深感激 ; indebted to someone for｜因某事感激某人 ; heavily indebted｜负债累累的
tip_zh: be indebted to sb for sth表示因某事感激某人。

meanings_zh: n. 电信；远程通信
definition_en: Communication over a distance using electronic signals.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on telecommunication networks.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电信网络。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss telecommunication networks.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电信网络的材料。
collocations: telecommunication networks｜电信网络 ; telecommunication infrastructure｜电信基础设施 ; telecommunication services｜电信服务
tip_zh: 谈电信行业或技术时，通常用复数telecommunications。

meanings_zh: n. 支出；花费 | n. 精力或时间的消耗
definition_en: money spent on something | the use of time, energy, or effort
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on public expenditure.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公共支出。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of public expenditure.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得公共支出这个例子。
collocations: public expenditure｜公共支出 ; capital expenditure｜资本支出 ; energy expenditure｜能量消耗
tip_zh: 通常不可数；expenditure on后接花费对象。

meanings_zh: n. 保留；留住 | n. 记忆；记忆保持 | n. 滞留；潴留
definition_en: the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving | the ability to keep information in your memory | the accumulation of fluid that the body does not release
example1_en: Our professor circled staff retention on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了员工留任。
example2_en: The author returns to staff retention when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了员工留任。
collocations: staff retention｜员工留任 ; customer retention｜客户维系 ; knowledge retention｜知识保持 ; water retention｜水分潴留
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词形式为retain。

meanings_zh: n. 单调繁重的苦差事
definition_en: Hard, boring work that must be repeated regularly.
example1_en: The textbook introduces daily drudgery in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了日常苦差事。
example2_en: A campus survey used daily drudgery to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用日常苦差事来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: daily drudgery｜日常苦差事 ; domestic drudgery｜繁重乏味的家务 ; the drudgery of repetitive work｜重复工作的枯燥劳苦
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调工作既繁重又单调，而不只是困难。

meanings_zh: n. 检察官；公诉人
definition_en: A lawyer who presents a criminal case against an accused person.
example1_en: Our professor circled public prosecutor on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公诉人；检察官。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of public prosecutor.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得公诉人；检察官这个例子。
collocations: public prosecutor｜公诉人；检察官 ; chief prosecutor｜首席检察官 ; lead prosecutor｜主办检察官
tip_zh: 代表控方提出指控；不负责作出判决。

meanings_zh: adj. 后悔的；遗憾的
definition_en: Feeling sorry about something that happened or something you did.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a regretful smile.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于带着遗憾的微笑的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a regretful smile with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把带着遗憾的微笑和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: feel regretful｜感到后悔 ; a regretful smile｜带着遗憾的微笑 ; regretful about a decision｜对决定感到后悔
tip_zh: regretful指人感到遗憾；regrettable指事令人遗憾。

meanings_zh: n. 持有的资产；股份 | n. 一块农地；农场
definition_en: Property, shares, or other assets owned by someone. | An area of land owned or rented for farming.

example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了所持股份。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a share holding.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕所持股份展开说明。
collocations: a share holding｜所持股份 ; property holdings｜持有的房地产 ; an agricultural holding｜农业用地
tip_zh: 资产常用复数holdings；holding company指控股公司。

meanings_zh: n. 已决犯；服刑犯 | v. 判定…有罪
definition_en: Someone found guilty of a crime, especially someone in prison. | To officially find someone guilty of a crime in court.
example1_en: I copied a former convict into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把曾经服刑的人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a former convict to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用曾经服刑的人来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: a convicted offender｜被定罪的违法者 ; convict someone of theft｜判某人盗窃罪成立 ; a former convict｜曾经服刑的人
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，动词在第二音节；定罪用of。

meanings_zh: n. 猎犬 | v. 纠缠；不断骚扰
definition_en: A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight. | To repeatedly bother or pursue someone.

example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了猎犬。
example2_en: Students who can explain hound usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释猎犬的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: a pack of hounds｜一群猎犬 ; hound someone for answers｜追着某人要答案 ; hound someone out of office｜逼迫某人离职
tip_zh: 作动词强调反复纠缠，不只是普通的追赶。

meanings_zh: n. 制定；构想 | n. 表述方式 | n. 配方；配制品
definition_en: The process of developing a plan, policy, or theory. | A particular way of expressing an idea precisely. | A mixture prepared for a particular purpose.
example1_en: The textbook introduces policy formulation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政策制定。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss policy formulation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论政策制定的材料。
collocations: policy formulation｜政策制定 ; the formulation of a theory｜理论的构建 ; a precise formulation｜精确的表述 ; a new formulation｜新配方
tip_zh: 常用the formulation of，表示计划等的制定。

meanings_zh: n. 资本主义
definition_en: an economic system based on private ownership and profit

example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了自由市场资本主义。
example2_en: The reading connects free-market capitalism with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把自由市场资本主义和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: free-market capitalism｜自由市场资本主义 ; global capitalism｜全球资本主义 ; the rise of capitalism｜资本主义的兴起
tip_zh: 不可数名词；capitalist可指资本家或作形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 数量上的优势；主导地位
definition_en: The state of being most numerous, powerful, or influential.
example1_en: The textbook introduces economic predominance in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济上的主导地位。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around economic predominance.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济上的主导地位展开说明。
collocations: a predominance of｜……占多数 ; economic predominance｜经济上的主导地位 ; predominance over｜相对于……的优势
tip_zh: 强调数量、力量或影响占优，不等于“杰出”。

meanings_zh: n. 节俭；节约
definition_en: careful use of money and resources to avoid waste
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about practise thrift.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于厉行节约的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used practise thrift to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用厉行节约来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: practise thrift｜厉行节约 ; thrift shop｜慈善二手商店 ; habits of thrift｜节俭的习惯
tip_zh: thrift 是名词；形容词“节俭的”是 thrifty。

meanings_zh: v. 轻微颤抖；抖动 | n. 轻微的颤抖 | n. 箭袋；箭筒
definition_en: shake slightly with quick, small movements | a small, quick shaking movement | a container used for carrying arrows
example1_en: The lab instructions say to quiver with fear.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求吓得发抖。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers quiver with fear before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要吓得发抖。
collocations: quiver with fear｜吓得发抖 ; a quivering voice｜颤抖的声音 ; a quiver of excitement｜激动得一颤
tip_zh: 多指细微而快速的抖动；声音也可用quiver。

meanings_zh: adj. 持续不断的；永久的 | adj. 一再发生的；没完没了的
definition_en: continuing all the time or lasting forever | happening repeatedly, often in an annoying way
example1_en: Office hours began with perpetual motion.
example1_zh: 答疑从永动开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss perpetual motion.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论永动的材料。
collocations: perpetual motion｜永动 ; perpetual change｜不断的变化 ; perpetual conflict｜持续不断的冲突
tip_zh: 可指永不停止，也常夸张表示某事没完没了。

meanings_zh: v. 驳倒；证明错误
definition_en: to prove that a statement or argument is wrong

example1_zh: 实验说明要求驳倒某种说法。
example2_en: The passage says students who can refute a claim follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够驳倒某种说法的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: refute a claim｜驳倒某种说法 ; refute an argument｜驳倒论点 ; refute an allegation｜驳斥指控
tip_zh: 强调用证据证明错误，不只是表示不同意。

meanings_zh: adj. 无数的；数不清的
definition_en: Too many to count.
example1_en: The textbook introduces innumerable examples in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无数例子。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around innumerable examples.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕无数例子展开说明。
collocations: innumerable examples｜无数例子 ; innumerable opportunities｜无数机会 ; innumerable times｜无数次
tip_zh: 后接可数名词复数，语气比many强，较正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 神的；神圣的 | adj. 极好的；令人愉悦的 | v. 猜知；占卜
definition_en: Connected with a god or coming from a god | Extremely pleasant or wonderful | Discover through intuition or supposed supernatural powers
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about taste divine.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于味道好极了的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to taste divine when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了味道好极了。
collocations: divine intervention｜神的干预 ; divine power｜神力 ; taste divine｜味道好极了
tip_zh: 表示“极好的”时多用于非正式赞美。

meanings_zh: adj. 放任的；宽纵的

example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了放任式养育。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around permissive parenting.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕放任式养育展开说明。
collocations: permissive parenting｜放任式养育 ; permissive society｜风气开放的社会 ; permissive attitude｜宽纵的态度

meanings_zh: n. 传输；传播；传递 | n. 广播；电视播送 | n. 汽车传动系统

example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数据传输。

example2_en: The reading connects doctoral thesis with a larger point about student life.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把博士论文和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。

meanings_zh: v. 欣喜；欢庆
definition_en: Feel or show great happiness about something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to rejoice at the news.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求为消息感到欣喜。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers rejoice at the news before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为消息感到欣喜。
collocations: rejoice at the news｜为消息感到欣喜 ; rejoice in someone's success｜为某人的成功欢喜 ; rejoice that｜因……而欣喜
tip_zh: 较正式；常用rejoice at/in或接that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 开始；发作
definition_en: The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sudden onset.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论突然发作。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of sudden onset.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得突然发作这个例子。
collocations: the onset of symptoms｜症状的出现 ; the onset of winter｜冬季的来临 ; sudden onset｜突然发作 ; delay the onset｜延缓发生
tip_zh: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情况的开始。

meanings_zh: n. 核裂变 | n. 分裂生殖
definition_en: The splitting of an atomic nucleus, usually releasing energy. | Reproduction in which one organism divides into separate organisms.
example1_en: Our professor circled nuclear fission on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了核裂变。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of nuclear fission.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得核裂变这个例子。
collocations: nuclear fission｜核裂变 ; binary fission｜二分裂 ; a fission reaction｜裂变反应
tip_zh: 核物理中fission是裂变，fusion是聚变。

meanings_zh: n. 一窝幼鸟 | v. 忧思；闷闷不乐地想 | v. 孵卵；暖护幼鸟
definition_en: A group of young birds born to the same mother. | To keep thinking unhappily about something. | To sit on eggs or young birds to keep them warm.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a brood of chicks.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一窝雏鸟。
example2_en: A campus survey used a brood of chicks to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一窝雏鸟来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a brood of chicks｜一窝雏鸟 ; brood over a mistake｜对一个错误耿耿于怀 ; brood on the past｜为往事忧思
tip_zh: 作动词表忧思时常接over或on。

meanings_zh: v. 放弃；交出
definition_en: Give up control, possession or a right to something.
example1_en: The professor asked us to relinquish control.
example1_zh: 教授让我们放弃控制权。
example2_en: The reading asks you to relinquish control and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你放弃控制权，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: relinquish control｜放弃控制权 ; relinquish power｜交出权力 ; relinquish a claim｜放弃权利主张
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，直接接control、power、rights等。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓起；积聚 | v. 集合；召集 | n. 集合；集结
definition_en: Gather the courage, strength, or support needed to do something. | Bring people together, especially for military duties. | A gathering of people, especially soldiers, for inspection or duty.
example1_en: The assignment is to muster the courage, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先鼓起勇气，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers muster the courage before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要鼓起勇气。
collocations: muster the courage｜鼓起勇气 ; muster support｜争取支持 ; muster strength｜积聚力量 ; pass muster｜达到要求
tip_zh: muster courage指鼓起勇气；pass muster指合格。

meanings_zh: adj. 琐碎的；不重要的 | adj. 小心眼的；斤斤计较的 | adj. 轻微的；小规模的
definition_en: Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention. | Unkindly concerned with small, unimportant matters. | Relatively minor or small in scale, especially concerning crime.
example1_en: Our professor circled petty crime on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了轻微犯罪。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss petty crime.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轻微犯罪的材料。
collocations: petty crime｜轻微犯罪 ; petty theft｜小额盗窃 ; petty arguments｜无谓的争吵 ; petty cash｜小额备用金
tip_zh: 形容人时常含贬义，指小心眼，不只是小气。

meanings_zh: n. 正当理由；合理依据
definition_en: A good reason explaining why something is acceptable or necessary.
example1_en: I copied little justification into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把几乎没有正当理由抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around little justification.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕几乎没有正当理由展开说明。
collocations: justification for｜……的正当理由 ; provide justification｜提供合理依据 ; little justification｜几乎没有正当理由 ; economic justification｜经济上的合理依据
tip_zh: 常接for加名词或动名词，说明某事的合理依据。

meanings_zh: n. 石灰岩
definition_en: A rock mainly composed of calcium carbonate, often from marine remains.
example1_en: Our professor circled limestone cliffs on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了石灰岩峭壁。
example2_en: The author returns to limestone cliffs when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了石灰岩峭壁。
collocations: limestone cliffs｜石灰岩峭壁 ; limestone cave｜石灰岩洞穴 ; limestone quarry｜石灰岩采石场 ; limestone formations｜石灰岩地貌
tip_zh: limestone通常不可数；lime还可指石灰或青柠。

meanings_zh: n. 地球的半球 | n. 大脑半球
definition_en: one half of the Earth | either of the two halves of the brain
example1_en: Our professor circled northern hemisphere on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了北半球。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of northern hemisphere.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得北半球这个例子。
collocations: northern hemisphere｜北半球 ; southern hemisphere｜南半球 ; left hemisphere｜左脑半球
tip_zh: 地理中指地球的一半，也可指大脑半球。

meanings_zh: n. 风险项目；创业项目 | v. 冒险前往；大胆尝试 | v. 大胆提出；冒昧表达
definition_en: a new activity or business involving risk | to go somewhere or do something despite possible risks | to express an opinion despite uncertainty about the response
example1_en: Our professor circled joint venture on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了合资企业。
example2_en: The author returns to joint venture when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了合资企业。
collocations: joint venture｜合资企业 ; venture capital｜风险资本 ; venture into｜冒险进入 ; venture an opinion｜冒昧发表意见
tip_zh: venture本身不等于风险投资；风险资本是venture capital。

meanings_zh: v. 汇编；编制 | v. 编译
definition_en: Collect information from different sources and arrange it together. | Convert computer code into a form a computer can run.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to compile a report.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何编写报告。
example2_en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers compile a report before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要编写报告。
collocations: compile a report｜编写报告 ; compile data｜汇总数据 ; compile a list｜编制清单 ; compile code｜编译代码
tip_zh: 强调从不同来源收集并整理，不只是写作。

meanings_zh: adj. 脆弱的；易受伤害的
definition_en: Easily harmed, attacked, or negatively affected.
example1_en: Our professor circled vulnerable to disease on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了易患病的。
example2_en: A campus survey used vulnerable to disease to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用易患病的来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: vulnerable to disease｜易患病的 ; vulnerable groups｜弱势群体 ; feel vulnerable｜感到脆弱
tip_zh: 常用 vulnerable to，to 后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 公顷
definition_en: a unit of land area equal to ten thousand square metres
example1_en: Office hours began with a hectare of land.
example1_zh: 答疑从一公顷土地开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a hectare of land.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一公顷土地的材料。
collocations: a hectare of land｜一公顷土地 ; per hectare｜每公顷 ; cover several hectares｜占地数公顷
tip_zh: 公顷是面积单位；一公顷等于一万平方米。

meanings_zh: v. 塞满；挤入 | v. 考前突击学习
definition_en: To force many things or people into a small space. | To study intensively shortly before an examination.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer cram into a bag during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时硬塞进包里。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cram into a bag.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得硬塞进包里。
collocations: cram into a bag｜硬塞进包里 ; cram a room with people｜让房间挤满人 ; cram for an exam｜考前突击复习
tip_zh: 过去式crammed；复习考试用cram for。

meanings_zh: adj. 崇高的；雄心勃勃的 | adj. 高耸的 | adj. 高傲的；傲慢的
definition_en: Aiming for morally admirable or very ambitious achievements. | Rising to a great height. | Showing a belief that you are better than others.
example1_en: The textbook introduces lofty ideals in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了崇高的理想。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of lofty ideals.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得崇高的理想这个例子。
collocations: lofty ideals｜崇高的理想 ; lofty ambitions｜远大的抱负 ; lofty goals｜宏大的目标 ; lofty ceiling｜高高的天花板
tip_zh: 修饰理想时可表赞许，也可暗示目标过高、不切实际。

meanings_zh: v. 使成为；使处于 | v. 提供；给予 | v. 表现；呈现
definition_en: to cause someone or something to enter a particular state | to provide help, a service, or something needed | to represent something in artistic or visual form
example1_en: The lab instructions say to render assistance.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求提供援助。
example2_en: The passage says students who can render assistance follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够提供援助的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: render something useless｜使某物失去用途 ; render assistance｜提供援助 ; render services｜提供服务 ; render an image｜渲染图像
tip_zh: 表“使……”时常用render＋宾语＋形容词，语气正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的
definition_en: widely known for something bad or undesirable
example1_en: Our professor circled notorious for on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了因…而臭名昭著。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss notorious for.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论因…而臭名昭著的材料。
collocations: notorious for｜因…而臭名昭著 ; notorious as｜作为…而声名狼藉 ; a notorious reputation｜恶名
tip_zh: 通常含贬义；著名但非负面用famous，不宜用notorious。

meanings_zh: adj. 致命的
definition_en: able to cause death
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on potentially lethal.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可能致命的。
example2_en: The reading connects potentially lethal with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可能致命的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: lethal dose｜致死剂量 ; lethal weapon｜致命武器 ; potentially lethal｜可能致命的 ; lethal concentration｜致死浓度
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；lethal 强调具有致死能力。

meanings_zh: n. 对应的人或事物
definition_en: Someone or something with a similar role in another setting.
example1_en: Office hours began with a foreign counterpart.
example1_zh: 答疑从国外的对等人员开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a foreign counterpart when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了国外的对等人员。
collocations: a foreign counterpart｜国外的对等人员 ; a rural counterpart｜农村的对应对象 ; a digital counterpart｜数字化的对应版本
tip_zh: 强调在另一地区或机构中角色相当，不是对手。

meanings_zh: v. 阻碍；妨碍
definition_en: To make movement or progress slower or more difficult.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer impede progress during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时阻碍进展。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to impede progress.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得阻碍进展。
collocations: impede progress｜阻碍进展 ; impede development｜阻碍发展 ; impede movement｜妨碍移动
tip_zh: 强调使进展困难或缓慢，不一定完全阻止。

meanings_zh: adj. 自命不凡的；浮夸的
definition_en: acting or speaking as though more important than others
example1_en: Our professor circled sound pompous on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了听起来自大。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sound pompous.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕听起来自大展开说明。
collocations: pompous speech｜浮夸的讲话 ; pompous manner｜自命不凡的举止 ; sound pompous｜听起来自大
tip_zh: 含贬义，重点是自命不凡，不只是外表华丽。

meanings_zh: n. 提议；建议 | n. 主张；命题
definition_en: An idea or plan offered for consideration | A statement that can be examined as true or false
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a business proposition.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论商业提议。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a business proposition.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得商业提议这个例子。
collocations: a business proposition｜商业提议 ; an attractive proposition｜有吸引力的提议 ; support a proposition｜支持一项主张
tip_zh: 作主张讲可接 that 从句；提议常用 proposal。

meanings_zh: n. 石英
definition_en: a hard mineral common in rocks and used in electronics
example1_en: Office hours began with rose quartz.
example1_zh: 答疑从粉晶开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used rose quartz to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用粉晶来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: quartz crystal｜石英晶体 ; quartz watch｜石英表 ; rose quartz｜粉晶
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一块石英用 a piece of quartz。

meanings_zh: adj. 无理的；不必要的
definition_en: Unfair, unnecessary, or inappropriate in a particular situation.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize uncalled-for in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出无理的。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses uncalled-for when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了无理的。
collocations: uncalled-for remark｜无理的言论 ; uncalled-for criticism｜无端的批评 ; uncalled-for interference｜不必要的干涉
tip_zh: 常形容批评或言论无理，不只是数量多余。

meanings_zh: v. 占据心思；使无暇他顾
definition_en: to fill someone's thoughts, leaving little attention for other things
example1_en: The assignment is to preoccupy someone's mind, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先占据某人的心思，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to preoccupy someone's mind.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来占据某人的心思。
collocations: be preoccupied with work｜一心想着工作 ; preoccupy someone's mind｜占据某人的心思
tip_zh: 常用be preoccupied with，指心思被某事占据。

meanings_zh: v. 担保；保证属实
definition_en: to confirm someone is reliable or something is true
example1_en: The assignment is to vouch for the accuracy of, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先保证……的准确性，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to vouch for the accuracy of.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保证……的准确性。
collocations: vouch for someone｜为某人担保 ; vouch for the accuracy of｜保证……的准确性 ; vouch for the quality of｜保证……的质量
tip_zh: 通常用vouch for，不直接接担保的人或事物。

meanings_zh: v. 统一；使联合
definition_en: To bring separate parts or groups together as one.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to unify a country.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何统一国家。
example2_en: The reading asks you to unify a country and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你统一国家，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: unify a country｜统一国家 ; unify different groups｜使不同群体团结 ; a unifying force｜凝聚力量
tip_zh: unify强调把分散部分合成整体，可用于制度或群体。

meanings_zh: adj. 周期性的；定期的
definition_en: happening repeatedly, often at regular intervals
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on periodic checks.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论定期检查。
example2_en: The author returns to periodic checks when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了定期检查。
collocations: periodic checks｜定期检查 ; periodic review｜定期审查 ; periodic table｜元素周期表
tip_zh: periodic是形容词，不是名词；副词为periodically。

meanings_zh: adj. 常见的；平常的 | n. 常见事物；老生常谈
definition_en: Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary. | Something ordinary, or a familiar statement lacking originality.
example1_en: Our professor circled increasingly commonplace on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了越来越常见。
example2_en: The reading connects increasingly commonplace with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把越来越常见和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: become commonplace｜变得普遍 ; increasingly commonplace｜越来越常见 ; a commonplace occurrence｜常见的事情
tip_zh: 多指常见到不足为奇，不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 有利的；有益的
definition_en: Giving benefits or improving the chances of success
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mutually advantageous.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论互惠互利的。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mutually advantageous.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论互惠互利的的材料。
collocations: advantageous to someone｜对某人有利 ; mutually advantageous｜互惠互利的 ; advantageous position｜有利地位
tip_zh: 常用be advantageous to sb表示对某人有利。

meanings_zh: adj. 仁慈的；宽大的 | adj. 带来解脱的
definition_en: Showing kindness by choosing not to punish or hurt someone. | Providing welcome relief from suffering or discomfort.
example1_en: Office hours began with a merciful judge.
example1_zh: 答疑从宽大的法官开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a merciful judge.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得宽大的法官这个例子。
collocations: be merciful to someone｜对某人仁慈 ; a merciful judge｜宽大的法官 ; a merciful release｜令人解脱的结束
tip_zh: 对某人仁慈用be merciful to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 传教者；布道者 | n. 某种观念的鼓吹者
definition_en: someone who gives public talks about religious beliefs | someone who strongly promotes particular beliefs or behaviour
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a local preacher.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于当地布道者的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a local preacher.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论当地布道者的材料。
collocations: a local preacher｜当地布道者 ; a street preacher｜街头传教者 ; a preacher of peace｜和平的倡导者
tip_zh: preacher侧重讲道，missionary侧重传播宗教。

meanings_zh: adj. 倾向于的；愿意的 | adj. 倾斜的
definition_en: Likely or willing to think or act a certain way. | Sloping rather than horizontal or vertical.
example1_en: I copied an inclined plane into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把斜面抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used an inclined plane to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用斜面来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: be inclined to agree｜倾向于同意 ; feel inclined to｜想要做 ; an inclined plane｜斜面
tip_zh: be inclined to后接动词原形，表示倾向或意愿。

meanings_zh: n. 主权；最高统治权
definition_en: A country's independent authority to govern itself.
example1_en: The textbook introduces national sovereignty in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了国家主权。
example2_en: A campus survey used national sovereignty to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用国家主权来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: national sovereignty｜国家主权 ; territorial sovereignty｜领土主权 ; respect sovereignty｜尊重主权 ; exercise sovereignty｜行使主权
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某领土的主权用over连接。

meanings_zh: v. 模拟 | v. 假装；装出
definition_en: To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study. | To pretend to have a feeling or condition.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to simulate conditions.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何模拟条件。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to simulate conditions.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得模拟条件。
collocations: simulate conditions｜模拟条件 ; simulate an emergency｜模拟紧急情况 ; simulate the effects of｜模拟……的影响
tip_zh: 模拟环境用simulate；刺激发展用stimulate。

meanings_zh: v. 将行首缩进 | v. 使凹入；使成凹痕
definition_en: to start a line further inward than the surrounding lines | to make a hollow or notch in a surface
example1_en: I heard the lecturer indent a paragraph during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时缩进段落。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to indent a paragraph.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们缩进段落。
collocations: indent a paragraph｜缩进段落 ; indent the first line｜缩进首行
tip_zh: 指行首向内移动，不是把整行内容缩短。

meanings_zh: n. 意识形态；思想体系
definition_en: a system of beliefs shaping political or social views
example1_en: I copied political ideology into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把政治意识形态抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects political ideology with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把政治意识形态和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: political ideology｜政治意识形态 ; dominant ideology｜主导思想体系 ; share an ideology｜持有共同理念
tip_zh: 指成体系的社会或政治观念，不是单个想法。

meanings_zh: n. 禁忌 | adj. 禁忌的；忌讳的
definition_en: a social rule against discussing or doing something | considered unacceptable to discuss or do within a particular group
example1_en: I copied a taboo subject into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把忌讳的话题抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a taboo subject.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕忌讳的话题展开说明。
collocations: break a taboo｜打破禁忌 ; a taboo subject｜忌讳的话题 ; a taboo against｜对……的禁忌
tip_zh: 名词指禁忌；形容词可说a taboo subject。

meanings_zh: v. 加固；加强防御 | v. 增强体力或信心 | v. 给食品添加营养素
definition_en: to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage | to make someone physically or mentally stronger | to add nutrients to food to improve its nutritional value
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to fortify coastal defences.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何加强海岸防御。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to fortify coastal defences.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们加强海岸防御。
collocations: fortify coastal defences｜加强海岸防御 ; fortify food with vitamins｜给食品添加维生素 ; fortify yourself against｜增强自身力量以抵御
tip_zh: fortify A with B：用B增强A。

meanings_zh: n. 焚烧炉
definition_en: A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about waste incinerator.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于垃圾焚烧炉的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used waste incinerator to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用垃圾焚烧炉来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: waste incinerator｜垃圾焚烧炉 ; industrial incinerator｜工业焚烧炉 ; incinerator emissions｜焚烧炉排放物
tip_zh: 通常指废物焚烧炉；火葬场用crematorium。

meanings_zh: adj. 最高的；至高无上的 | adj. 极大的；极度的
definition_en: highest in rank, authority, or importance | of the greatest possible degree
example1_en: Our professor circled supreme court on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了最高法院。
example2_en: The author returns to supreme court when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了最高法院。
collocations: supreme court｜最高法院 ; supreme authority｜最高权力 ; supreme confidence｜十足的信心
tip_zh: 本身含“最高”之意，通常不用比较级或最高级。

meanings_zh: n. 大胆；勇气 | n. 醒目；鲜明
