definition_en: confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations | the quality of being visually strong and noticeable
example1_en: Office hours began with political boldness.
example1_zh: 答疑从政治勇气开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used political boldness to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用政治勇气来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: show boldness｜展现勇气 ; political boldness｜政治勇气 ; the boldness of the colours｜色彩的鲜明
tip_zh: 可指行动大胆，也可指设计或色彩醒目。

meanings_zh: adj. 分析的；善于分析的
definition_en: using careful examination of details to understand something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on analytic approach.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论分析方法。
example2_en: The reading connects analytic approach with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把分析方法和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: analytic approach｜分析方法 ; analytic skills｜分析能力 ; analytic framework｜分析框架
tip_zh: 与analytical意思接近；日常描述分析能力更常用后者。

meanings_zh: n. 不一致；差异
definition_en: A difference between things that should match.
example1_en: I copied a significant discrepancy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把显著差异抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a significant discrepancy with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把显著差异和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a discrepancy between｜……之间的差异 ; a significant discrepancy｜显著差异 ; explain a discrepancy｜解释差异
tip_zh: 常指本应一致却不符，搭配 between 或 in。

meanings_zh: n. 声音或信号的放大 | n. 扩大；增强
definition_en: the process of making a sound or signal stronger | an increase in the strength or effect of something
example1_en: Our professor circled sound amplification on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了扩音。
example2_en: A campus survey used sound amplification to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用扩音来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: sound amplification｜扩音 ; signal amplification｜信号放大 ; amplification equipment｜扩音设备
tip_zh: 常指声音、信号的增强，也可指影响被放大。

meanings_zh: n. 优先地位；优先权
definition_en: Greater importance that gives someone or something priority over others.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize precedence in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出优先权。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up precedence while discussing evidence about public institutions.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了优先权。
collocations: take precedence over｜优先于 ; give precedence to｜优先考虑 ; have precedence over｜比……有优先权
tip_zh: 常用take precedence over，表示优先于。

meanings_zh: n. 共鸣；情感上的呼应 | n. 声音的洪亮；回响 | n. 共振
definition_en: The power to evoke shared feelings, memories, or understanding. | The deep, full quality of a sound. | Stronger vibration caused by matching an object's natural frequency.
example1_en: Our professor circled emotional resonance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了情感共鸣。
example2_en: The reading connects emotional resonance with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把情感共鸣和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: emotional resonance｜情感共鸣 ; cultural resonance｜文化共鸣 ; magnetic resonance｜磁共振
tip_zh: 情感义常用have resonance for；物理义指共振。

meanings_zh: adj. 表示歉意的；愧疚的
definition_en: Showing that you are sorry for something.
example1_en: I copied an apologetic smile into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把歉意的微笑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an apologetic smile.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕歉意的微笑展开说明。
collocations: an apologetic smile｜歉意的微笑 ; an apologetic tone｜抱歉的语气 ; apologetic about｜对……感到抱歉
tip_zh: 常接about或for说明歉意的缘由。

meanings_zh: n. 尸体检验；验尸 | n. 事后分析；复盘 | adj. 死后的
definition_en: a medical examination of a body to determine death's cause | an examination of a completed event, especially an unsuccessful one | happening or performed after death
example1_en: Office hours began with postmortem examination.
example1_zh: 答疑从尸体检验开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around postmortem examination.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕尸体检验展开说明。
collocations: conduct a postmortem｜进行尸检 ; postmortem examination｜尸体检验 ; postmortem analysis｜事后分析
tip_zh: 英式也常写post-mortem；可比喻赛后或项目复盘。

meanings_zh: v. 正式证明；认证
definition_en: to confirm officially that something is true or meets standards
example1_en: The assignment is to certify that, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先正式证明……，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers certify that before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要正式证明……。
collocations: certify that｜正式证明…… ; certify as safe｜认证为安全 ; certified organic｜经认证的有机产品
tip_zh: 强调正式或权威证明，常用certify that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 增强；加剧
definition_en: to become stronger or make a feeling or effect stronger
example1_en: The lab instructions say to heighten awareness.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求提高意识。
example2_en: The reading asks you to heighten awareness and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你提高意识，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: heighten awareness｜提高意识 ; heighten tension｜加剧紧张 ; heighten concern｜加深担忧
tip_zh: 多用于情绪、意识或效果增强，不常指身高增长。

meanings_zh: v. 提倡；主张 | n. 倡导者；支持者
definition_en: To publicly support a policy, idea, or course of action. | Someone who publicly supports a cause or policy.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to advocate reform.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何提倡改革。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to advocate reform.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们提倡改革。
collocations: advocate reform｜提倡改革 ; advocate doing something｜主张做某事 ; a strong advocate of｜……的坚定支持者
tip_zh: 名词末尾读/kət/；动词可接动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 雌虎；母虎
definition_en: An adult female tiger.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a wild tigress in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了野生雌虎。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a wild tigress.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕野生雌虎展开说明。
collocations: a tigress and her cubs｜母虎和它的幼崽 ; a wild tigress｜野生雌虎
tip_zh: tigress专指雌虎；tiger可泛指老虎，不一定是雄虎。

meanings_zh: n. 天资；天赋
definition_en: A natural ability to learn or do something well
example1_en: The textbook introduces an aptitude for languages in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了语言天赋。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an aptitude for languages.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕语言天赋展开说明。
collocations: an aptitude for languages｜语言天赋 ; aptitude test｜能力倾向测试 ; show an aptitude for｜展现出某方面的天赋
tip_zh: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 羞辱；使丢脸
definition_en: to make someone feel deeply ashamed or foolish
example1_en: The assignment is to humiliate someone publicly, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先公开羞辱某人，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers humiliate someone publicly before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要公开羞辱某人。
collocations: humiliate someone publicly｜公开羞辱某人 ; feel humiliated｜感到受辱 ; deeply humiliating｜极其丢脸的
tip_zh: 比embarrass语气更重，强调受辱和尊严受损。

meanings_zh: n. 仔细审查；详细检查
definition_en: Careful examination of something, especially to find faults or problems.
example1_en: The textbook introduces public scrutiny in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公众监督。
example2_en: The author returns to public scrutiny when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公众监督。
collocations: under scrutiny｜受到审查 ; close scrutiny｜仔细审查 ; public scrutiny｜公众监督 ; subject to scrutiny｜接受审查
tip_zh: 不可数名词；under scrutiny表示受到严格审查。

meanings_zh: n. 两栖动物 | n. 水陆两用交通工具
definition_en: an animal, such as a frog, living in water and on land | a vehicle or aircraft able to operate on land and water
example1_en: The textbook introduces amphibian species in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了两栖动物物种。
example2_en: A campus survey used amphibian species to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用两栖动物物种来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: amphibian species｜两栖动物物种 ; amphibian populations｜两栖动物种群 ; amphibian conservation｜两栖动物保护
tip_zh: 动物名词用amphibian；两栖的常用amphibious。

meanings_zh: n. 加强；加固 | n. 强化；行为强化 | n. 增援人员；援军
definition_en: The process of making something stronger or more effective. | Encouragement that makes a behaviour more likely to happen again. | Extra people sent to support an existing group or force.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on positive reinforcement.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正向强化。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around positive reinforcement.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕正向强化展开说明。
collocations: positive reinforcement｜正向强化 ; structural reinforcement｜结构加固 ; send reinforcements｜派遣增援人员
tip_zh: 表示援军、增援人员时通常用复数reinforcements。

meanings_zh: v. 捏造；伪造 | v. 制造；装配
definition_en: To invent false information in order to deceive | To make a product or structure from separate materials
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to fabricate evidence.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须伪造证据。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to fabricate evidence.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得伪造证据。
collocations: fabricate evidence｜伪造证据 ; fabricate a story｜编造故事 ; fabricate an excuse｜捏造借口 ; fabricate components｜制造零部件
tip_zh: 既可指捏造信息，也可指工业制造，须看宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 悲伤的；令人悲伤的
definition_en: Feeling, showing, or causing deep sadness.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about sorrowful expression.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于悲伤的表情的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sorrowful expression.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕悲伤的表情展开说明。
collocations: sorrowful expression｜悲伤的表情 ; sorrowful voice｜悲伤的声音 ; sorrowful farewell｜伤感的告别
tip_zh: 比sad更正式，常用于表情、声音或告别。

meanings_zh: v. 使承担过多；过度扩张
definition_en: to commit more money or effort than can be managed
example1_en: The assignment is to overextend yourself, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使自己负担过重，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can overextend yourself follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够使自己负担过重的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: overextend yourself｜使自己负担过重 ; overextend financially｜在财务上超出承受能力 ; overextend resources｜过度耗用资源
tip_zh: 常用 overextend oneself，指承担超出能力的任务或开支。

meanings_zh: n. 偏离；背离 | n. 偏差
definition_en: a departure from an expected route, rule, or behaviour | the difference between a measurement and a reference value
example1_en: Our professor circled standard deviation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了标准差。
example2_en: A campus survey used standard deviation to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用标准差来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: deviation from the norm｜偏离常态 ; standard deviation｜标准差 ; significant deviation｜显著偏差
tip_zh: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“标准差”。

meanings_zh: n. 光学
definition_en: The scientific study of light and how it behaves
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about geometrical optics.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于几何光学的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around geometrical optics.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕几何光学展开说明。
collocations: geometrical optics｜几何光学 ; physical optics｜物理光学 ; fibre optics｜光纤技术
tip_zh: 表示光学这门学科时，虽以s结尾仍接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 疏忽；遗漏 | n. 监督；监管
definition_en: A mistake caused by failing to notice or consider something. | Responsibility for checking that activities are managed correctly.
example1_en: Office hours began with an unfortunate oversight.
example1_zh: 答疑从令人遗憾的疏忽开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an unfortunate oversight.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论令人遗憾的疏忽的材料。
collocations: an unfortunate oversight｜令人遗憾的疏忽 ; by an oversight｜由于疏忽 ; independent oversight｜独立监督 ; regulatory oversight｜监管
tip_zh: 作“疏忽”通常可数；作“监督”通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 时间的 | adj. 世俗的；非宗教的 | adj. 颞部的
definition_en: Relating to time or the order of events. | Relating to worldly affairs rather than spiritual matters. | Relating to the sides of the head near the temples.
example1_en: The textbook introduces temporal order in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了时间顺序。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of temporal order.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得时间顺序这个例子。
collocations: temporal order｜时间顺序 ; temporal variation｜时间变化 ; temporal power｜世俗权力 ; temporal lobe｜颞叶
tip_zh: temporal指时间的；temporary才表示暂时的。

meanings_zh: adj. 多余的；不必要的 | adj. 因岗位取消而被裁的
definition_en: unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something | having lost a job because the employer no longer needs it
example1_en: Our professor circled redundant information on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了多余信息。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of redundant information.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得多余信息这个例子。
collocations: make someone redundant｜裁掉某人 ; redundant information｜多余信息 ; become redundant｜变得不再需要
tip_zh: 英式英语中be made redundant指岗位取消而被裁员。

meanings_zh: adj. 正直的；正义的 | adj. 义愤的；自以为正当的
definition_en: morally right or acting according to strong moral principles | arising from a belief that you are morally right
example1_en: I copied righteous anger into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把义愤抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss righteous anger.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论义愤的材料。
collocations: righteous anger｜义愤 ; righteous indignation｜义愤 ; a righteous cause｜正义的事业
tip_zh: 语气较庄重；self-righteous指自以为正直。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽大的；不严厉的
definition_en: less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a lenient sentence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论从轻的判刑。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a lenient sentence.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得从轻的判刑这个例子。
collocations: lenient with someone｜对某人宽容 ; a lenient sentence｜从轻的判刑 ; lenient treatment｜宽大处理
tip_zh: 对人宽容用lenient with；常涉及规则或处罚。

meanings_zh: v. 危及；损害
definition_en: To put something at risk of harm, loss, or failure.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to jeopardise safety.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须危及安全。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to jeopardise safety.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们危及安全。
collocations: jeopardise safety｜危及安全 ; jeopardise a career｜损害职业前途 ; jeopardise chances｜损害成功机会
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；美式通常拼作jeopardize。

meanings_zh: v. 波动；涨落
definition_en: Rise and fall irregularly in level, amount, or value.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer fluctuate widely during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时大幅波动。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to fluctuate widely.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们大幅波动。
collocations: fluctuate widely｜大幅波动 ; fluctuate between｜在……之间波动 ; fluctuate with demand｜随需求波动
tip_zh: 通常是不及物动词；在两值间波动用between。

meanings_zh: n. 遵守；奉行 | n. 宗教或传统仪式
definition_en: The practice of following a rule, law, or custom | A ceremony performed as part of religion or tradition
example1_en: I copied strict observance into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把严格遵守抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of strict observance.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得严格遵守这个例子。
collocations: observance of the law｜守法 ; strict observance｜严格遵守 ; religious observances｜宗教仪式
tip_zh: observance指遵守或仪式；observation指观察。

meanings_zh: adj. 反讽的；说反话的 | adj. 出乎意料而讽刺的
definition_en: expressing a meaning opposite to the words used | strangely opposite to what would normally be expected
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an ironical remark.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于反讽的话的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects an ironical remark with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把反讽的话和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an ironical remark｜反讽的话 ; an ironical tone｜反讽的语气 ; an ironical twist｜讽刺性的转折
tip_zh: 与ironic基本同义，但ironic更常用；不一定含恶意。

meanings_zh: v. 散开；驱散
definition_en: To spread out or make people or things spread out
example1_en: The lab instructions say to disperse a crowd.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求驱散人群。
example2_en: The passage says students who can disperse a crowd follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够驱散人群的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: disperse a crowd｜驱散人群 ; disperse seeds｜传播种子 ; disperse rapidly｜迅速散开
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：驱散人群或人群散去。

meanings_zh: n. 真菌
definition_en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on soil fungus.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论土壤真菌。
example2_en: The reading connects soil fungus with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把土壤真菌和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: soil fungus｜土壤真菌 ; fungus growth｜真菌生长 ; edible fungi｜食用真菌
tip_zh: 复数常用fungi；真菌不属于植物。

meanings_zh: n. 前提；假定 | n. 房屋及附属场地
definition_en: an idea accepted as the basis for reasoning or action | the buildings and land used by a business or organization
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on basic premise.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论基本前提。
example2_en: The reading connects basic premise with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把基本前提和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: basic premise｜基本前提 ; on the premise that｜以……为前提 ; business premises｜营业场所 ; on the premises｜在该场所内
tip_zh: 表示房屋及场地时用复数premises。

meanings_zh: n. 纯净；纯度 | n. 纯洁；纯粹
definition_en: the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances | the quality of being morally good or unmixed in character
example1_en: I copied water purity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把水的纯净度抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used water purity to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用水的纯净度来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: water purity｜水的纯净度 ; high purity｜高纯度 ; purity of gold｜黄金纯度
tip_zh: 不可数名词；表示具体纯度常用the purity of。

meanings_zh: n. 自主权；自治权
definition_en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.
example1_en: I copied greater autonomy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把更大的自主权抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used greater autonomy to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用更大的自主权来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: greater autonomy｜更大的自主权 ; regional autonomy｜区域自治 ; individual autonomy｜个人自主权 ; grant autonomy｜给予自主权
tip_zh: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。

meanings_zh: n. 实用技能；专门知识
definition_en: Practical knowledge and skills needed to do something successfully
example1_en: After the lecture, we used know-how in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了实用技能。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses know-how when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了实用技能。
collocations: technical know-how｜技术知识 ; practical know-how｜实用技能 ; transfer know-how｜传授专门技术
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调实际操作能力，拼写保留连字符。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻快的；迅速有力的 | adj. 生意兴隆的；交易活跃的 | adj. 凉爽清新的
definition_en: Quick and energetic. | Involving a lot of buying and selling. | Cold and fresh in a pleasant, energising way.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a brisk walk.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论快步行走。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a brisk walk.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得快步行走这个例子。
collocations: a brisk walk｜快步行走 ; brisk trade｜兴隆的生意 ; a brisk breeze｜清凉的微风
tip_zh: brisk walk指轻快有力的快走，不是跑步。

meanings_zh: n. 聚合物；高分子
definition_en: A substance made of large molecules containing repeated smaller units.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on synthetic polymer.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论合成聚合物。
example2_en: The reading connects synthetic polymer with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把合成聚合物和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: synthetic polymer｜合成聚合物 ; biodegradable polymer｜可生物降解聚合物 ; polymer chain｜聚合物链
tip_zh: 聚合物不只包括塑料，也包括淀粉等天然物质。

meanings_zh: adj. 地道的；符合语言习惯的 | adj. 习语的；含习语的
definition_en: natural and typical of how fluent speakers use a language | containing or relating to expressions with nonliteral meanings
example1_en: Office hours began with idiomatic English.
example1_zh: 答疑从地道的英语开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used idiomatic English to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用地道的英语来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: idiomatic English｜地道的英语 ; an idiomatic expression｜习语表达 ; idiomatic usage｜惯用法
tip_zh: 地道不等于堆砌习语；自然搭配也体现idiomatic。

meanings_zh: v. 取代；替代
definition_en: To replace something older or no longer useful.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to supersede existing rules.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求取代现有规则。
example2_en: The reading asks you to supersede existing rules and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你取代现有规则，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: supersede existing rules｜取代现有规则 ; be superseded by｜被……取代 ; supersede earlier versions｜取代早期版本
tip_zh: 注意拼写结尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被动式。

meanings_zh: n. 人口普查
definition_en: an official count of people that collects information about them
example1_en: The textbook introduces a national census in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了全国人口普查。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a national census.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕全国人口普查展开说明。
collocations: conduct a census｜开展人口普查 ; census data｜人口普查数据 ; a national census｜全国人口普查 ; a census form｜人口普查表
tip_zh: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。

meanings_zh: n. 镍 | n. 美加五分硬币
definition_en: A hard, silvery metal used in alloys and batteries. | A coin worth five cents in the US or Canada.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about nickel mining.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于镍矿开采的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used nickel mining to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用镍矿开采来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: nickel mining｜镍矿开采 ; nickel alloy｜镍合金 ; nickel allergy｜镍过敏
tip_zh: 指金属时不可数；指五分硬币时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 侵犯；违反
definition_en: An action that breaks a law or violates someone's rights.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on copyright infringement.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论侵犯版权。
example2_en: The author returns to copyright infringement when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了侵犯版权。
collocations: copyright infringement｜侵犯版权 ; patent infringement｜侵犯专利权 ; infringement of rights｜侵犯权利
tip_zh: 常接of；infringement of rights指侵犯权利。

meanings_zh: v. 丰富；充实 | v. 使富有 | v. 增加养分；使肥沃
definition_en: To improve something by adding value, interest, or experience. | To make someone wealthier. | To improve food or soil by adding useful substances.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to enrich people's lives.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何丰富人们的生活。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to enrich people's lives.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来丰富人们的生活。
collocations: enrich people's lives｜丰富人们的生活 ; enrich understanding｜加深理解 ; enrich the soil｜使土壤肥沃
tip_zh: enrich是及物动词，常接life、experience或soil。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其巨大的；天文数字的 | adj. 天文学的
definition_en: Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts. | Relating to the scientific study of stars, planets, and space.
example1_en: Office hours began with astronomical costs.
example1_zh: 答疑从巨额成本开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss astronomical costs.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论巨额成本的材料。
collocations: astronomical costs｜巨额成本 ; astronomical sums｜天文数字般的金额 ; astronomical observations｜天文观测
tip_zh: 谈费用时常表示高得惊人；也可表示天文学的。

meanings_zh: adj. 名声不佳的；不可信的 | adj. 邋遢的；破旧的
definition_en: Having a bad reputation and not deserving trust or respect. | Looking untidy, worn, or unsuitable for respectable company.
example1_en: The textbook introduces disreputable company in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了名声不佳的公司。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss disreputable company.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论名声不佳的公司的材料。
collocations: disreputable company｜名声不佳的公司 ; disreputable behaviour｜不光彩的行为 ; disreputable character｜名声不好的人
tip_zh: 通常指名声或行为不佳，不只是外表破旧。

meanings_zh: adj. 凶猛的；残暴的 | adj. 恶毒的；恶意的
definition_en: likely to attack or cause serious harm | deliberately cruel and intended to hurt someone
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on vicious attack.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论凶残的袭击。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vicious attack.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕凶残的袭击展开说明。
collocations: vicious attack｜凶残的袭击 ; vicious circle｜恶性循环 ; vicious rumour｜恶意谣言 ; vicious comments｜恶毒评论
tip_zh: vicious circle指问题互相加剧的“恶性循环”。

meanings_zh: v. 苦苦思索；焦虑不已
definition_en: Worry intensely while trying to make a difficult decision
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to agonize over a decision.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为决定而苦恼。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers agonize over a decision before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为决定而苦恼。
collocations: agonize over a decision｜为决定而苦恼 ; agonize about the future｜为未来焦虑
tip_zh: 常用agonize over/about；英式也拼作agonise。

meanings_zh: n. 推进；推进力
definition_en: The force or process that moves something forward
example1_en: Office hours began with electric propulsion.
example1_zh: 答疑从电力推进开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of electric propulsion.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得电力推进这个例子。
collocations: propulsion system｜推进系统 ; electric propulsion｜电力推进 ; jet propulsion｜喷气推进
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，常用于船舶、飞机和航天器。

meanings_zh: adj. 和睦的；融洽的 | adj. 协调的；和谐悦耳的
definition_en: friendly and peaceful, without conflict | having parts that look or sound pleasing together
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about harmonious relationship.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于融洽的关系的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of harmonious relationship.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得融洽的关系这个例子。
collocations: harmonious relationship｜融洽的关系 ; harmonious society｜和谐社会 ; harmonious blend｜协调的融合
tip_zh: 既可形容人际关系融洽，也可形容色彩、声音协调。

meanings_zh: adj. 听觉的；听力的
definition_en: Relating to hearing or the sense of hearing
example1_en: The textbook introduces aural skills in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了听辨能力。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of aural skills.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得听辨能力这个例子。
collocations: aural skills｜听辨能力 ; aural training｜听力训练 ; aural comprehension｜听力理解 ; aural test｜听力测试
tip_zh: aural指听觉的；oral指口头的或口腔的。

meanings_zh: v. 嘲笑；嘲弄 | adj. 模拟的；仿制的 | n. 模拟考试
definition_en: To make someone seem foolish by laughing at or imitating them. | Made to imitate something real, often for practice. | A practice examination taken before the real one.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to mock someone's accent.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须嘲笑某人的口音。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to mock someone's accent.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来嘲笑某人的口音。
collocations: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音 ; mock exam｜模拟考试 ; mock interview｜模拟面试
tip_zh: mock作动词直接接宾语，不加at。

meanings_zh: n. 费力；体力或脑力消耗
definition_en: Physical or mental effort, especially when it makes you tired.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about physical exertion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于体力消耗的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around physical exertion.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕体力消耗展开说明。
collocations: physical exertion｜体力消耗 ; mental exertion｜脑力消耗 ; strenuous exertion｜高强度体力消耗 ; excessive exertion｜过度用力
tip_zh: 多指消耗体力或脑力，不等同于表示尽力的try hard。

meanings_zh: n. 种族灭绝
definition_en: Acts intended to destroy a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group.
example1_en: Office hours began with commit genocide.
example1_zh: 答疑从实施种族灭绝开始。
example2_en: The reading connects commit genocide with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把实施种族灭绝和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: commit genocide｜实施种族灭绝 ; prevent genocide｜防止种族灭绝 ; victims of genocide｜种族灭绝的受害者
tip_zh: 不泛指大规模杀戮，核心是蓄意毁灭特定群体。

meanings_zh: adj. 会犯错的；不完全可靠的
definition_en: Capable of making mistakes or being wrong
example1_en: I copied fallible human judgement into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把可能出错的人类判断抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fallible human judgement.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可能出错的人类判断的材料。
collocations: fallible human judgement｜可能出错的人类判断 ; a fallible system｜不完全可靠的系统
tip_zh: 强调可能犯错，并非一定错误；反义词为infallible。

meanings_zh: v. 办理业务；进行交易
definition_en: to conduct business or carry out a business deal
example1_en: The assignment is to transact business, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先办理业务，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers transact business before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要办理业务。
collocations: transact business｜办理业务 ; transact business with｜与……开展业务 ; transact online｜在线交易
tip_zh: 正式用语，常用transact business表示开展业务。

meanings_zh: v. 巩固；加强 | v. 合并；整合
definition_en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger. | To combine separate things into a single effective whole.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to consolidate knowledge.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须巩固知识。
example2_en: The passage says students who can consolidate knowledge follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够巩固知识的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: consolidate knowledge｜巩固知识 ; consolidate power｜巩固权力 ; consolidate gains｜巩固成果 ; consolidate debts｜合并债务
tip_zh: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。

meanings_zh: n. 粪肥 | v. 给土地施粪肥
definition_en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow. | To spread animal waste on land as fertilizer.
example1_en: Office hours began with animal manure.
example1_zh: 答疑从动物粪肥开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of animal manure.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得动物粪肥这个例子。
collocations: animal manure｜动物粪肥 ; spread manure｜撒施粪肥 ; well-rotted manure｜充分腐熟的粪肥
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；fertilizer泛指肥料，范围更广。

meanings_zh: adj. 最佳的；最适宜的
definition_en: Best or most effective for a particular purpose.
example1_en: I copied optimal conditions into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把最佳条件抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of optimal conditions.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得最佳条件这个例子。
collocations: optimal conditions｜最佳条件 ; optimal performance｜最佳表现 ; optimal solution｜最优解决方案
tip_zh: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。

meanings_zh: adv. 坚决地；坚定地
definition_en: In a determined way, without giving up or changing course
example1_en: The professor told us to resolutely oppose and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们坚决反对，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will resolutely oppose when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会坚决反对。
collocations: act resolutely｜坚决行动 ; resolutely oppose｜坚决反对 ; resolutely refuse｜断然拒绝
tip_zh: 这是副词；形容词形式为resolute。

meanings_zh: v. 使萦绕心头；不断困扰 | v. 鬼魂出没于 | n. 常去的地方
definition_en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress | for a ghost to appear repeatedly in a place | a place someone visits frequently
example1_en: I heard the lecturer haunt an old house during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时在老房子里出没。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers haunt an old house before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要在老房子里出没。
collocations: be haunted by memories｜被回忆困扰 ; haunt an old house｜在老房子里出没 ; a favourite haunt｜最爱常去的地方
tip_zh: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。

meanings_zh: v. 由…组成；包括 | v. 组成；构成
definition_en: to have particular people or things as parts | to be the parts or members that form something
example1_en: I heard the lecturer comprise several sections during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时包含几个部分。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to comprise several sections.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们包含几个部分。
collocations: comprise several sections｜包含几个部分 ; comprise a range of services｜涵盖一系列服务 ; comprise the majority｜占多数
tip_zh: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。

meanings_zh: n. 王室成员；王族 | n. 版税；特许权使用费
definition_en: people who belong to a royal family | a payment for using someone's work, invention, or property
example1_en: I copied a member of royalty into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把王室成员抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a member of royalty.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得王室成员这个例子。
collocations: a member of royalty｜王室成员 ; pay royalties｜支付版税 ; royalty payments｜版税款项
tip_zh: 指王族时不可数；指版税收入时常用复数royalties。

meanings_zh: v. 死亡；毁灭 | v. 老化；腐坏
definition_en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions. | To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to perish from cold.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须冻死。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers perish from cold before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要冻死。
collocations: perish from cold｜冻死 ; perish in a fire｜在火灾中丧生 ; rubber perishes｜橡胶老化
tip_zh: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。

meanings_zh: adj. 可转让的；可转移的 | adj. 可用于不同情境的
definition_en: able to be moved or passed to another person or place | useful in different jobs or situations
example1_en: Our professor circled transferable skills on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可迁移技能。
example2_en: The author returns to transferable skills when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可迁移技能。
collocations: transferable skills｜可迁移技能 ; transferable ticket｜可转让的票 ; transferable knowledge｜可迁移的知识
tip_zh: transferable skills 指换岗位或行业仍适用的技能。

meanings_zh: n. 恶习；不道德行为 | n. 台钳；老虎钳
definition_en: a bad habit or morally wrong behaviour | a tool that holds an object firmly between two jaws
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a minor vice.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小恶习。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a minor vice.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得小恶习这个例子。
collocations: a minor vice｜小恶习 ; vice and virtue｜恶与善 ; a bench vice｜台钳
tip_zh: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸道；气道 | n. 航路；航线
definition_en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs | an established route used by aircraft
example1_en: I copied upper airway into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把上呼吸道抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used upper airway to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用上呼吸道来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: keep the airway clear｜保持气道通畅 ; airway obstruction｜气道阻塞 ; upper airway｜上呼吸道
tip_zh: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 迫使；强迫
definition_en: to force someone to do something
example1_en: The lab instructions say to compel someone to act.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求迫使某人行动。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to compel someone to act.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们迫使某人行动。
collocations: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行动 ; feel compelled to｜觉得不得不 ; be compelled by circumstances｜为形势所迫
tip_zh: 常用compel sb to do，语气强且较正式。

meanings_zh: v. 迫使离开家园 | v. 取代；替代 | v. 移开；排开
definition_en: Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings. | Take the position or role previously held by something else. | Move something from its position, especially by occupying its space.
example1_en: The assignment is to displace workers, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先取代工人，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to displace workers.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得取代工人。
collocations: displaced people｜流离失所的人 ; displace workers｜取代工人 ; displace water｜排开水
tip_zh: displace常指被迫迁离；也可指新事物取代旧事物。

meanings_zh: v. 引诱；诱惑 | n. 诱惑力；诱饵
definition_en: To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively. | An attraction or object used to draw someone or something closer.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to lure customers.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求吸引顾客。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to lure customers.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得吸引顾客。
collocations: lure someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事 ; lure customers｜吸引顾客 ; the lure of wealth｜财富的诱惑 ; a fishing lure｜钓鱼假饵
tip_zh: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。

meanings_zh: n. 陆军中尉；海军上尉 | n. 副手；得力助手
definition_en: An officer holding a junior rank in the armed forces | A trusted assistant who helps a leader manage important work
example1_en: Our professor circled army lieutenant on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了陆军中尉。
example2_en: A campus survey used army lieutenant to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用陆军中尉来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: army lieutenant｜陆军中尉 ; naval lieutenant｜海军上尉 ; trusted lieutenant｜可信赖的副手
tip_zh: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。

meanings_zh: n. 积累；堆积；积聚物
definition_en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on gradual accumulation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论逐渐积累。
example2_en: The reading connects gradual accumulation with a larger point about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把逐渐积累和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: accumulation of wealth｜财富积累 ; accumulation of waste｜废物堆积 ; gradual accumulation｜逐渐积累 ; capital accumulation｜资本积累
tip_zh: 常接of，强调随时间逐渐增多。

meanings_zh: n. 预言 | n. 预言能力
definition_en: a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge | the supposed ability to know and describe future events
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a self-fulfilling prophecy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自我实现的预言。
example2_en: The reading connects a self-fulfilling prophecy with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把自我实现的预言和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我实现的预言 ; fulfil a prophecy｜使预言应验 ; the gift of prophecy｜预言天赋
tip_zh: prophecy是名词；动词prophesy词尾读/saɪ/。

meanings_zh: n. 教义；学说；信条
definition_en: A belief or set of principles taught by a group.
example1_en: Office hours began with religious doctrine.
example1_zh: 答疑从宗教教义开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around religious doctrine.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教教义展开说明。
collocations: religious doctrine｜宗教教义 ; economic doctrine｜经济学说 ; political doctrine｜政治信条
tip_zh: 不一定含贬义；可指宗教教义或政治、经济学说。

meanings_zh: adj. 宁静的；平静的
definition_en: calm and peaceful, without noise or disturbance
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a tranquil setting.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于宁静的环境的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a tranquil setting to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用宁静的环境来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a tranquil setting｜宁静的环境 ; tranquil waters｜平静的水面 ; a tranquil atmosphere｜宁静的氛围
tip_zh: 常描写环境或水面，比 quiet 更强调安宁感。

meanings_zh: v. 茁壮成长；兴旺发展
definition_en: To grow strongly or become successful.
example1_en: The professor asked us to thrive in warm conditions.
example1_zh: 教授让我们在温暖环境中茁壮成长。
example2_en: The reading asks you to thrive in warm conditions and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你在温暖环境中茁壮成长，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: thrive in warm conditions｜在温暖环境中茁壮成长 ; thrive on challenges｜遇到挑战更有干劲 ; a thriving business｜生意兴隆的企业
tip_zh: 不及物动词；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

meanings_zh: n. 促进因素；刺激 | n. 刺激物；刺激因素
definition_en: Something that encourages activity, growth, or change. | Something that causes a physical or mental response.
example1_en: I copied economic stimulus into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把经济刺激抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economic stimulus.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济刺激的材料。
collocations: a stimulus to growth｜促进增长的因素 ; economic stimulus｜经济刺激 ; respond to a stimulus｜对刺激作出反应
tip_zh: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。

meanings_zh: adj. 易生气的；敏感的 | adj. 敏感难处理的
definition_en: Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism. | Likely to cause upset or disagreement unless handled carefully.
example1_en: Office hours began with touchy about criticism.
example1_zh: 答疑从对批评很敏感开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used touchy about criticism to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用对批评很敏感来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: touchy about criticism｜对批评很敏感 ; a touchy subject｜敏感话题 ; a touchy issue｜棘手的敏感问题
tip_zh: touchy指易生气；touched指受感动。

meanings_zh: n. 做工；工艺水平
definition_en: The skill and quality shown in making something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fine workmanship.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论精细的做工。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fine workmanship.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕精细的做工展开说明。
collocations: fine workmanship｜精细的做工 ; poor workmanship｜粗劣的做工 ; quality workmanship｜优质工艺
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调成品的做工，而非工作态度。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；调集；整理 | n. 活动秩序员 | n. 元帅
definition_en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively | someone who directs people and maintains order at an event | a military officer holding a very high rank
example1_en: The assignment is to marshal resources, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先调集资源，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to marshal resources and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你调集资源，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: marshal resources｜调集资源 ; marshal the evidence｜整理证据 ; race marshal｜赛事秩序员 ; field marshal｜陆军元帅
tip_zh: 英式过去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。

meanings_zh: adj. 制药的；药物的 | n. 药品
definition_en: relating to medicines or their production | a drug used as medicine
example1_en: The textbook introduces pharmaceutical industry in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了制药业。
example2_en: The author returns to pharmaceutical industry when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了制药业。
collocations: pharmaceutical industry｜制药业 ; pharmaceutical company｜制药公司 ; pharmaceutical research｜药物研究
tip_zh: 作名词常用复数 pharmaceuticals，泛指药品。

meanings_zh: adj. 黯淡的；无望的 | adj. 荒凉的；阴冷的
definition_en: offering little hope of improvement or success | cold, bare, and unwelcoming
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on bleak future.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论黯淡的未来。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss bleak future.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论黯淡的未来的材料。
collocations: bleak future｜黯淡的未来 ; bleak outlook｜悲观的前景 ; bleak landscape｜荒凉的景色
tip_zh: 既可描述荒凉阴冷的环境，也可描述无望的前景。

meanings_zh: adj. 疲惫的；疲倦的 | adj. 厌倦的；不耐烦的 | v. 使疲倦；感到厌倦
definition_en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort | No longer interested in something because it continues too long | To make someone tired or become tired of something
example1_en: The textbook introduces grow weary in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了渐感疲倦。
example2_en: A campus survey used grow weary to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用渐感疲倦来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: weary travellers｜疲惫的旅人 ; weary of｜厌倦 ; grow weary｜渐感疲倦
tip_zh: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: n. 覆盖层；覆盖物 | n. 地幔 | n. 职责；衣钵
definition_en: A layer that covers a surface or area | The thick layer of Earth between its crust and core | An important role or responsibility passed to someone
example1_en: The textbook introduces Earth's mantle in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了地幔。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around Earth's mantle.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕地幔展开说明。
collocations: a mantle of snow｜一层积雪 ; Earth's mantle｜地幔 ; assume the mantle of｜承担……的职责
tip_zh: mantle也可指披风；壁炉架通常拼作mantel。

meanings_zh: adj. 仪式的；礼仪性的
definition_en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony
example1_en: Office hours began with ceremonial dress.
example1_zh: 答疑从礼仪服饰开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of ceremonial dress.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得礼仪服饰这个例子。
collocations: ceremonial dress｜礼仪服饰 ; ceremonial role｜礼仪性职务 ; ceremonial occasion｜礼仪场合
tip_zh: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。

meanings_zh: adj. 月球的；月亮的 | adj. 按月相制定的；阴历的
definition_en: Relating to the moon. | Based on the changing phases of the moon.
example1_en: The textbook introduces lunar eclipse in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了月食。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of lunar eclipse.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得月食这个例子。
collocations: lunar eclipse｜月食 ; lunar surface｜月球表面 ; lunar calendar｜阴历 ; lunar mission｜探月任务
tip_zh: lunar指月亮的；solar指太阳的。

meanings_zh: v. 管理；执行 | v. 给予药物；施行治疗
definition_en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation | to give someone medicine or medical treatment
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to administer a programme.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何管理项目。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to administer a programme.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得管理项目。
collocations: administer a programme｜管理项目 ; administer medication｜给药 ; administer first aid｜实施急救 ; administer a test｜组织测验
tip_zh: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 燃烧
definition_en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fuel combustion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了燃料燃烧。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fuel combustion.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论燃料燃烧的材料。
collocations: fuel combustion｜燃料燃烧 ; complete combustion｜完全燃烧 ; internal combustion engine｜内燃机 ; spontaneous combustion｜自燃
tip_zh: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。

meanings_zh: adj. 无名的；未透露姓名的 | adj. 难以形容的
definition_en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown | Too difficult to identify or describe clearly
example1_en: Our professor circled nameless fear on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了莫名的恐惧。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of nameless fear.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得莫名的恐惧这个例子。
collocations: remain nameless｜不透露姓名 ; nameless fear｜莫名的恐惧 ; nameless workers｜无名工人
tip_zh: remain nameless指不透露姓名，不一定真的没名字。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难；大祸
definition_en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering
example1_en: Our professor circled environmental catastrophe on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了环境灾难。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of environmental catastrophe.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得环境灾难这个例子。
collocations: environmental catastrophe｜环境灾难 ; humanitarian catastrophe｜人道主义灾难 ; avert a catastrophe｜避免一场灾难
tip_zh: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。

meanings_zh: n. 花环；花圈
definition_en: a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially
example1_en: The textbook introduces laurel wreath in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了月桂花冠。
example2_en: The author returns to laurel wreath when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了月桂花冠。
collocations: lay a wreath｜敬献花圈 ; a wreath of flowers｜鲜花编成的花环 ; laurel wreath｜月桂花冠
tip_zh: w不发音；复数wreaths；动词另用wreathe。

meanings_zh: adj. 字迹清楚的；易辨认的
definition_en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about clearly legible.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于清晰可辨的的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used clearly legible to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用清晰可辨的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: legible handwriting｜清楚的字迹 ; clearly legible｜清晰可辨的 ; barely legible｜几乎无法辨认的
tip_zh: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。

meanings_zh: adj. 亲切有礼的；宽厚的 | adj. 优雅舒适的
definition_en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously | elegant, comfortable, and associated with wealth
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gracious host.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热情有礼的主人。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a gracious host.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得热情有礼的主人这个例子。
collocations: a gracious host｜热情有礼的主人 ; gracious in defeat｜落败仍有风度 ; gracious living｜优雅舒适的生活
tip_zh: gracious重待人有礼；graceful重动作优美。

meanings_zh: n. 海员；水手
definition_en: A person who works on a ship at sea.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an experienced seaman.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经验丰富的海员。
example2_en: The author returns to an experienced seaman when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经验丰富的海员。
collocations: an experienced seaman｜经验丰富的海员 ; a merchant seaman｜商船海员 ; an able seaman｜一等水手
tip_zh: 复数为seamen；seafarer是常用的性别中性称呼。

meanings_zh: adj. 艰巨的；艰苦的
definition_en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work
example1_en: The textbook introduces an arduous task in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了艰巨的任务。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an arduous task.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论艰巨的任务的材料。
collocations: an arduous task｜艰巨的任务 ; an arduous journey｜艰苦的旅程 ; an arduous process｜艰难的过程
tip_zh: 强调长期费力，常修饰task、journey、process。

meanings_zh: adv. 明确地 | adv. 专门地；特意地
definition_en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt | for a particular purpose
example1_en: The professor told us to expressly prohibit and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们明令禁止，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions asks the class to expressly prohibit before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先明令禁止。
collocations: expressly prohibit｜明令禁止 ; expressly state｜明确说明 ; expressly for｜专门为了
tip_zh: 勿与expressively混淆，后者指富有表现力地。

meanings_zh: n. 推测；假定
definition_en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence
example1_en: The textbook introduces mere supposition in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯属推测。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mere supposition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纯属推测的材料。
collocations: on the supposition that｜假定…… ; mere supposition｜纯属推测 ; based on supposition｜基于推测
tip_zh: 可指一个假设，也可泛指推测；不等于已证实的事实。

meanings_zh: adj. 热的；与热量有关的 | adj. 保暖的；保温的 | n. 上升热气流
definition_en: Relating to heat | Designed to keep heat from escaping | A rising current of warm air
example1_en: I copied thermal energy into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把热能抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of thermal energy.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得热能这个例子。
collocations: thermal energy｜热能 ; thermal insulation｜隔热；保温 ; thermal imaging｜热成像 ; thermal underwear｜保暖内衣
tip_zh: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

meanings_zh: v. 区分；辨别 | v. 使有别于
definition_en: To recognize or explain the differences between things | To make something different from other similar things
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to differentiate between.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何区分两者。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to differentiate between.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们区分两者。
collocations: differentiate between｜区分两者 ; differentiate A from B｜区分甲与乙 ; differentiate products｜使产品差异化
tip_zh: 常用differentiate between A and B。

meanings_zh: v. 刺绣；绣上图案 | v. 添油加醋地讲述
definition_en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread. | To make a story more interesting by adding invented details.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer embroider a pattern during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时绣图案。
example2_en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to embroider a pattern.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们绣图案。
collocations: embroider a pattern｜绣图案 ; embroider flowers on cloth｜在布上绣花 ; embroider with silk thread｜用丝线刺绣 ; embroider a story｜给故事添油加醋
tip_zh: embroider是在布上绣花，不是用毛线织物的knit。

meanings_zh: n. 剪纸作品；刻纸作品
definition_en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper
example1_en: Office hours began with a traditional papercut.
example1_zh: 答疑从传统剪纸作品开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used a traditional papercut to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用传统剪纸作品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a traditional papercut｜传统剪纸作品 ; an intricate papercut｜精细的剪纸作品 ; papercut art｜剪纸艺术
tip_zh: 剪纸艺术常用papercutting；纸划伤通常写paper cut。

meanings_zh: adj. 同质的；均匀一致的
definition_en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar
example1_en: Office hours began with relatively homogeneous.
example1_zh: 答疑从相对同质的开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around relatively homogeneous.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕相对同质的展开说明。
collocations: homogeneous mixture｜均匀混合物 ; homogeneous group｜同质群体 ; relatively homogeneous｜相对同质的
tip_zh: 强调组成部分相似或一致，反义词为heterogeneous。

meanings_zh: n. 道德；道德准则 | n. 道德性；是否合乎道德
definition_en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong | The degree to which an action is right or wrong
example1_en: The textbook introduces public morality in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了社会公德。
example2_en: The reading connects public morality with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把社会公德和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: public morality｜社会公德 ; personal morality｜个人道德观 ; the morality of an action｜某一行为的道德性
tip_zh: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 共识；普遍一致的意见
definition_en: General agreement among members of a group.
example1_en: The textbook introduces broad consensus in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了广泛共识。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of broad consensus.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得广泛共识这个例子。
collocations: reach a consensus｜达成共识 ; broad consensus｜广泛共识 ; consensus on｜关于……的共识 ; build consensus｜凝聚共识
tip_zh: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。

meanings_zh: n. 情妇；婚外女伴 | n. 女主人 | n. 女能手；女专家
definition_en: A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person. | A woman who owns or controls a household, in older usage. | A woman highly skilled in a particular activity.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used mistress in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了情妇。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses mistress when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了情妇。
collocations: have a mistress｜有情妇 ; mistress of the house｜一家之女主人 ; mistress of her craft｜精通技艺的女性
tip_zh: 不可当作妻子或普通女友；女主人义较陈旧。

meanings_zh: n. 氨；氨水
definition_en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.
example1_en: I copied ammonia solution into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把氨水抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ammonia solution.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论氨水的材料。
collocations: ammonia solution｜氨水 ; ammonia emissions｜氨排放 ; ammonia production｜氨生产
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

meanings_zh: n. 忠诚；效忠
definition_en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.
example1_en: The textbook introduces political allegiance in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政治上的效忠。
example2_en: A campus survey used political allegiance to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用政治上的效忠来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: pledge allegiance to｜宣誓效忠于 ; political allegiance｜政治上的效忠 ; switch allegiance｜转而效忠
tip_zh: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

meanings_zh: n. 疲劳；疲乏 | n. 材料疲劳
definition_en: extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness | weakening of a material after repeated stress
example1_en: Office hours began with chronic fatigue.
example1_zh: 答疑从慢性疲劳开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss chronic fatigue.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论慢性疲劳的材料。
collocations: chronic fatigue｜慢性疲劳 ; mental fatigue｜精神疲劳 ; muscle fatigue｜肌肉疲劳 ; metal fatigue｜金属疲劳
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，比tiredness更正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 解释性的；说明的
definition_en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.
example1_en: Office hours began with explanatory notes.
example1_zh: 答疑从说明性注释开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around explanatory notes.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕说明性注释展开说明。
collocations: explanatory notes｜说明性注释 ; explanatory material｜说明材料 ; explanatory power｜解释力
tip_zh: 常修饰notes、material；self-explanatory指不言自明的。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；着手
definition_en: to begin something or start happening
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to commence work.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何开始工作。
example2_en: The passage says students who can commence work follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够开始工作的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: commence work｜开始工作 ; commence proceedings｜开始诉讼程序 ; commence with｜以……开始
tip_zh: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 空洞的辞藻；花言巧语 | n. 修辞；修辞学
definition_en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance. | The skill or study of using language to persuade.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about empty rhetoric.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于空洞的言辞的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used empty rhetoric to explain a pattern in public communication.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用空洞的言辞来解释公共传播中的一种模式。
collocations: empty rhetoric｜空洞的言辞 ; political rhetoric｜政治辞令 ; the art of rhetoric｜修辞艺术
tip_zh: 是名词；形容词为rhetorical，可含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 借口；托辞
definition_en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.
example1_en: The professor explained pretext with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了借口。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses pretext when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了借口。
collocations: under the pretext of｜以……为借口 ; a pretext for doing something｜做某事的借口 ; on some pretext｜以某种借口
tip_zh: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。

meanings_zh: v. 猛扑；突然袭击 | v. 立即抓住机会或错误 | n. 猛扑；突袭
definition_en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it. | To seize an opportunity or criticise a mistake immediately. | A sudden jump towards something to catch or attack it.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to pounce on prey.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须猛扑向猎物。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pounce on prey.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猛扑向猎物。
collocations: pounce on prey｜猛扑向猎物 ; pounce on an opportunity｜立即抓住机会 ; pounce on a mistake｜揪住错误不放
tip_zh: 常接on，既可指猛扑，也可指抓住机会或错误。

meanings_zh: adj. 开创性的；先驱性的
definition_en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.
example1_en: Office hours began with pioneering research.
example1_zh: 答疑从开创性研究开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of pioneering research.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得开创性研究这个例子。
collocations: pioneering research｜开创性研究 ; pioneering work｜开创性工作 ; pioneering approach｜创新方法
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；指先驱人物用名词pioneer。

meanings_zh: n. 重大任务；事业 | n. 正式承诺；保证
definition_en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort. | A formal promise to do something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a major undertaking.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论重大任务。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a major undertaking.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕重大任务展开说明。
collocations: a major undertaking｜重大任务 ; a joint undertaking｜共同承担的项目 ; give an undertaking｜作出正式承诺
tip_zh: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。

meanings_zh: v. 抵消；使失效 | v. 使中和
definition_en: to stop something from having an effect | to make an acid or alkali chemically neutral
example1_en: The assignment is to neutralize an acid, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先中和酸，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to neutralize an acid.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们中和酸。
collocations: neutralize an acid｜中和酸 ; neutralize a threat｜消除威胁 ; neutralize the effects｜抵消影响 ; neutralize odours｜消除异味
tip_zh: 英式也拼neutralise；强调抵消作用，不一定移除物体。

meanings_zh: n. 抱负；志向 | n. 送气
definition_en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something. | A breath of air released when pronouncing certain speech sounds.
example1_en: Office hours began with aspiration to succeed.
example1_zh: 答疑从成功的志向开始。
example2_en: The reading connects aspiration to succeed with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把成功的志向和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: career aspirations｜职业抱负 ; fulfil an aspiration｜实现抱负 ; aspiration to succeed｜成功的志向
tip_zh: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

meanings_zh: n. 概念；理解；构想 | n. 受孕 | n. 构思；创始
definition_en: an idea or understanding of what something is like | the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy | the formation of a plan or idea
example1_en: I copied a broad conception into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把宽泛的理解抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a broad conception.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宽泛的理解展开说明。
collocations: conception of｜对……的理解 ; from conception to completion｜从构思到完成 ; a broad conception｜宽泛的理解 ; the moment of conception｜受孕时刻
tip_zh: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

meanings_zh: adv. 认真负责地；尽职地
definition_en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.
example1_en: The professor told us to conscientiously carry out duties and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们认真履行职责，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to conscientiously carry out duties before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先认真履行职责。
collocations: work conscientiously｜尽职尽责地工作 ; conscientiously carry out duties｜认真履行职责
tip_zh: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。

meanings_zh: n. 派别；派系
definition_en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.
example1_en: Our professor circled political faction on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政治派别。
example2_en: The author returns to political faction when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了政治派别。
collocations: rival factions｜对立派系 ; political faction｜政治派别 ; a faction within the party｜党内派系
tip_zh: 常指大组织内意见对立的小集团，尤用于政治。

meanings_zh: adj. 原住民的；土著的 | adj. 澳大利亚原住民的
definition_en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region | Relating to Australia's Aboriginal peoples, cultures, or languages
example1_en: Office hours began with aboriginal peoples.
example1_zh: 答疑从原住民族开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of aboriginal peoples.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得原住民族这个例子。
collocations: aboriginal peoples｜原住民族 ; Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亚原住民文化 ; Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亚原住民社区
tip_zh: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

meanings_zh: v. 抵消；补偿
definition_en: to balance or reduce the effect of something
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to offset the cost.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抵消成本。
example2_en: The reading asks you to offset the cost and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你抵消成本，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: offset the cost｜抵消成本 ; offset carbon emissions｜抵消碳排放 ; offset the impact｜抵消影响
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词仍为offset；现在分词为offsetting。

meanings_zh: adj. 可耕的；种植作物的
definition_en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.
example1_en: I copied arable land into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把耕地抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around arable land.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕耕地展开说明。
collocations: arable land｜耕地 ; arable farming｜种植业 ; arable crops｜大田作物
tip_zh: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。

meanings_zh: n. 停战；休战协议
definition_en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a temporary truce.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论临时停战。
example2_en: A campus survey used a temporary truce to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用临时停战来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: call a truce｜宣布休战 ; agree to a truce｜同意停战 ; a temporary truce｜临时停战 ; break a truce｜破坏休战协议
tip_zh: 通常指暂时停止冲突，不等于永久和平。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴高采烈的；热情洋溢的 | adj. 繁茂的；丰富华丽的
definition_en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness | growing abundantly or richly decorated and imaginative
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on exuberant enthusiasm.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高涨的热情。
example2_en: The reading connects exuberant enthusiasm with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把高涨的热情和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: exuberant enthusiasm｜高涨的热情 ; an exuberant personality｜热情奔放的性格 ; exuberant growth｜繁茂的生长
tip_zh: 核心是活力或丰富程度高，不等于“华而不实”。

meanings_zh: n. 氧化物
definition_en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on zinc oxide.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论氧化锌。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of zinc oxide.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得氧化锌这个例子。
collocations: zinc oxide｜氧化锌 ; iron oxide｜氧化铁 ; nitrogen oxides｜氮氧化物
tip_zh: oxide为氧化物统称，dioxide指二氧化物。

meanings_zh: v. 题写；刻写
definition_en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to inscribe a name on.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须把名字刻在……上。
example2_en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers inscribe a name on before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要把名字刻在……上。
collocations: inscribe a name on｜把名字刻在……上 ; be inscribed with｜刻有；题有 ; inscribe a dedication｜题写献词
tip_zh: 常用inscribe A on B或inscribe B with A，非普通记笔记。

meanings_zh: n. 概括；笼统论断 | n. 概括过程；归纳
definition_en: A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence. | The process of forming general conclusions from particular examples.
example1_en: The textbook introduces sweeping generalization in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过于笼统的论断。
example2_en: The author returns to sweeping generalization when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了过于笼统的论断。
collocations: make a generalization｜作出概括 ; sweeping generalization｜过于笼统的论断 ; broad generalization｜宽泛的概括 ; hasty generalization｜草率的概括
tip_zh: 英式也写 generalisation；概括未必可靠。

meanings_zh: v. 移植器官；移栽 | n. 移植手术；移植器官
definition_en: To move an organ or plant into a new location. | An operation transferring an organ, or the organ transferred.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to transplant seedlings.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求移栽幼苗。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to transplant seedlings.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得移栽幼苗。
collocations: transplant seedlings｜移栽幼苗 ; a kidney transplant｜肾移植 ; an organ transplant｜器官移植 ; transplant surgery｜移植手术
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；既可指器官也可指植物。

meanings_zh: v. 维护；捍卫 | v. 维持原判；确认有效
definition_en: To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard | To confirm that an earlier decision remains valid
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to uphold the law.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何维护法律。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to uphold the law.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们维护法律。
collocations: uphold the law｜维护法律 ; uphold human rights｜维护人权 ; uphold a decision｜维持决定 ; uphold standards｜维护标准
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为upheld；常接权利或裁决。

meanings_zh: n. 遵从；从众
definition_en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.
example1_en: Our professor circled social conformity on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会从众。
example2_en: The author returns to social conformity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会从众。
collocations: social conformity｜社会从众 ; conformity to standards｜遵守标准 ; in conformity with｜符合；遵照 ; pressure for conformity｜要求一致的压力
tip_zh: in conformity with表示符合或遵照某规则。

meanings_zh: n. 例行手续；必要程序 | n. 正式；拘谨
definition_en: A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome. | The quality of following official rules or social conventions.
example1_en: Our professor circled a mere formality on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纯粹的例行手续。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a mere formality.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕纯粹的例行手续展开说明。
collocations: a mere formality｜纯粹的例行手续 ; complete the formalities｜办完手续 ; legal formalities｜法律手续
tip_zh: 手续常用复数formalities；正式、拘谨为不可数义。

meanings_zh: adj. 冗长乏味的；单调的
definition_en: boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions
example1_en: Office hours began with tedious task.
example1_zh: 答疑从乏味的任务开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of tedious task.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得乏味的任务这个例子。
collocations: tedious task｜乏味的任务 ; tedious process｜冗长乏味的过程 ; tedious paperwork｜繁琐的文书工作
tip_zh: 常形容因耗时长或反复重复而乏味的任务。

meanings_zh: n. 支出；开支
definition_en: Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.
example1_en: I copied initial outlay into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把初期支出抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss initial outlay.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论初期支出的材料。
collocations: initial outlay｜初期支出 ; capital outlay｜资本支出 ; a substantial outlay｜大笔开支
tip_zh: 常指启动项目时的开支，常搭配initial或capital。

meanings_zh: adj. 有棱角的；尖角的 | adj. 瘦削的；骨感的
definition_en: Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles. | Thin, with bones and joints that appear prominent.
example1_en: I copied angular shape into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有棱角的形状抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects angular shape with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把有棱角的形状和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: angular shape｜有棱角的形状 ; angular features｜棱角分明的五官 ; angular design｜棱角分明的设计
tip_zh: 形容外形棱角分明，也可形容人瘦削。

meanings_zh: v. 补充存货；重新进货
definition_en: To replace goods that have been sold or used.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to restock shelves.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须补充货架商品。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to restock shelves.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们补充货架商品。
collocations: restock shelves｜补充货架商品 ; restock the fridge｜补充冰箱食品 ; restock with fresh supplies｜补充新物资
tip_zh: 常用restock A with B，表示用B补充A的存货。

meanings_zh: n. 长期不和；世仇 | v. 长期争斗；结怨
definition_en: A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time. | To remain in a bitter, continuing conflict with someone.
example1_en: I copied family feud into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把家族纷争抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used family feud to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用家族纷争来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: family feud｜家族纷争 ; long-running feud｜长期争端 ; feud with someone｜与某人长期不和
tip_zh: 强调持续很久的敌对或争执，而非一次口角。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法药水；药剂
definition_en: A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.
example1_en: Office hours began with a magic potion.
example1_zh: 答疑从魔法药水开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a magic potion with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把魔法药水和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a magic potion｜魔法药水 ; a healing potion｜治疗药水 ; brew a potion｜熬制药水
tip_zh: 常见于奇幻故事；普通药物的一剂用dose。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评价 | v. 估价
definition_en: to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something | to estimate how much money something is worth
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to appraise performance.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须评估表现。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to appraise performance.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来评估表现。
collocations: appraise performance｜评估表现 ; appraise a property｜评估房产价值 ; critically appraise｜批判性评估
tip_zh: appraise是评估；不要与apprise（告知）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 关税 | n. 收费标准；价目表
definition_en: a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country | a set of charges for a service
example1_en: Office hours began with import tariff.
example1_zh: 答疑从进口关税开始。
example2_en: The reading connects import tariff with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把进口关税和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: impose tariffs on｜对……征收关税 ; import tariff｜进口关税 ; reduce tariffs｜降低关税 ; electricity tariff｜电价标准
tip_zh: 关税用tariff on goods；复数tariffs常指多项关税。

meanings_zh: adj. 讥讽的；挖苦的
definition_en: using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize
example1_en: Our professor circled a sarcastic remark on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了挖苦的话。
example2_en: The author returns to a sarcastic remark when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了挖苦的话。
collocations: a sarcastic remark｜挖苦的话 ; a sarcastic tone｜讥讽的语气 ; a sarcastic comment｜讥讽的评论
tip_zh: 常用反话挖苦人；ironic不一定含攻击或嘲弄。

meanings_zh: adj. 毁灭性的；破坏极大的 | adj. 令人极度悲痛的
definition_en: Causing extremely serious damage or destruction. | Causing overwhelming sadness or emotional shock.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on devastating consequences.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论灾难性后果。
example2_en: A campus survey used devastating consequences to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用灾难性后果来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: devastating consequences｜灾难性后果 ; devastating impact｜毁灭性影响 ; devastating news｜令人悲痛欲绝的消息 ; devastating earthquake｜破坏力极强的地震
tip_zh: 事物令人悲痛用devastating；人感到悲痛用devastated。

meanings_zh: adj. 荒凉的；无人居住的 | adj. 孤独凄凉的
definition_en: Empty of people and lacking signs of life | Feeling completely alone and deeply unhappy
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a desolate landscape.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论荒凉的景观。
example2_en: The author returns to a desolate landscape when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了荒凉的景观。
collocations: a desolate landscape｜荒凉的景观 ; a desolate village｜荒无人烟的村庄 ; feel desolate｜感到孤独凄凉
tip_zh: 形容地方指荒凉，形容人则指孤独凄凉。

meanings_zh: n. 啮齿类动物
definition_en: a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about rodent population.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于啮齿动物种群的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of rodent population.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得啮齿动物种群这个例子。
collocations: rodent population｜啮齿动物种群 ; rodent control｜啮齿动物防治 ; rodent infestation｜鼠患
tip_zh: 老鼠、松鼠和河狸都属啮齿动物。

meanings_zh: n. 正常化；恢复正常 | n. 标准化；归一化
definition_en: The process of making conditions normal or usual. | Adjusting data or values to a common standard.
example1_en: I copied data normalization into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把数据归一化抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss data normalization.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数据归一化的材料。
collocations: normalization of relations｜关系正常化 ; data normalization｜数据归一化 ; normalization process｜正常化进程
tip_zh: 英式也拼normalisation；数据语境常指归一化。

meanings_zh: adv. 徒劳地；白费力气地
definition_en: Without achieving the desired result despite effort
example1_en: After the lecture, we used vainly in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了徒劳地。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses vainly when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了徒劳地。
collocations: try vainly to do something｜徒劳地试图做某事 ; search vainly for｜徒劳地寻找 ; struggle vainly｜徒劳地挣扎
tip_zh: vainly侧重努力无果，常可换成in vain。

meanings_zh: v. 截肢；切除肢体
definition_en: To surgically remove all or part of a limb.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer amputate a limb during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时截肢。
example2_en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers amputate a limb before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要截肢。
collocations: amputate a limb｜截肢 ; amputate a leg｜截去一条腿 ; amputate below the knee｜进行膝下截肢
tip_zh: 主要用于手术切除肢体，不能泛指切除所有器官。

meanings_zh: adj. 可行的；行得通的
definition_en: possible and practical to achieve with available resources
example1_en: I copied economically feasible into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把经济上可行的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economically feasible.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济上可行的的材料。
collocations: a feasible solution｜可行的解决办法 ; economically feasible｜经济上可行的 ; technically feasible｜技术上可行的 ; a feasible alternative｜可行的替代方案
tip_zh: 指条件允许、实际可行，不等于“可信”。

meanings_zh: n. 钻井设备；钻井平台 | v. 操纵；作弊 | v. 装配；安装
definition_en: a large structure or machine used for drilling | to dishonestly arrange a process to obtain a desired result | to fit equipment into place for use
example1_en: Our professor circled an oil rig on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了石油钻井平台。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an oil rig.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕石油钻井平台展开说明。
collocations: an oil rig｜石油钻井平台 ; a drilling rig｜钻井设备 ; rig an election｜操纵选举 ; rig up equipment｜临时搭建设备
tip_zh: rig作动词既可指装配，也可指作弊操纵；注意语境。

meanings_zh: n. 侵蚀；风化剥蚀 | n. 逐渐削弱；损耗
definition_en: The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces. | The gradual loss of strength, value, or confidence.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on soil erosion.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论土壤侵蚀。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得土壤侵蚀这个例子。
collocations: soil erosion｜土壤侵蚀 ; coastal erosion｜海岸侵蚀 ; prevent erosion｜防止侵蚀 ; erosion of trust｜信任的逐渐削弱
tip_zh: 通常不可数；也可比喻信任、权利等逐渐受损。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的
definition_en: showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect
example1_en: The textbook introduces a scornful look in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了轻蔑的眼神。
example2_en: The author returns to a scornful look when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了轻蔑的眼神。
collocations: a scornful look｜轻蔑的眼神 ; scornful of advice｜对建议不屑一顾 ; a scornful laugh｜轻蔑的笑声
tip_zh: 常用 scornful of，表示对某人或某事不屑。

meanings_zh: adj. 不利的
definition_en: Making success harder or putting someone in a worse position.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about disadvantageous position.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于不利地位的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to disadvantageous position when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不利地位。
collocations: disadvantageous to someone｜对某人不利 ; disadvantageous position｜不利地位 ; disadvantageous conditions｜不利条件
tip_zh: 常用disadvantageous to sb表示对某人不利。

meanings_zh: v. 炫耀；招摇地展示
definition_en: To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer flaunt wealth during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时炫耀财富。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to flaunt wealth.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们炫耀财富。
collocations: flaunt wealth｜炫耀财富 ; flaunt success｜炫耀成功 ; flaunt possessions｜炫耀财物
tip_zh: flaunt指炫耀；flout指公然无视规则，勿混。

meanings_zh: adj. 强健的；结实的 | adj. 稳健可靠的
definition_en: strong, healthy, and unlikely to break or become weak | effective and reliable even under difficult conditions
example1_en: Office hours began with robust health.
example1_zh: 答疑从强健的体魄开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used robust health to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用强健的体魄来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: robust health｜强健的体魄 ; robust evidence｜可靠的证据 ; robust system｜稳健的系统 ; robust economy｜强劲的经济
tip_zh: 既形容身体或物品结实，也形容证据、系统可靠。

meanings_zh: adj. 默示的；心照不宣的
definition_en: Understood or accepted without being directly stated.
example1_en: Our professor circled tacit approval on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了默许。
example2_en: The author returns to tacit approval when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了默许。
collocations: tacit approval｜默许 ; tacit agreement｜默契 ; tacit understanding｜心照不宣的理解 ; tacit consent｜默示同意
tip_zh: tacit指未明说但已理解，并非明确表达的同意。

meanings_zh: v. （使）凝固 | v. 巩固；加强
definition_en: To become solid, or make something become solid. | To make an agreement, relationship, or position stronger and more secure.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to solidify into a mass.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求凝固成块。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers solidify into a mass before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要凝固成块。
collocations: solidify into a mass｜凝固成块 ; solidify an alliance｜巩固联盟 ; solidify support｜巩固支持
tip_zh: 既可指液体凝固，也可指关系或地位得到巩固。

meanings_zh: v. 渴望；迫切想要
definition_en: To want something very strongly.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to crave attention.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何渴望关注。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to crave attention.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得渴望关注。
collocations: crave attention｜渴望关注 ; crave approval｜渴望认可 ; crave sweet foods｜特别想吃甜食
tip_zh: 直接接宾语：crave something，不加 for。

meanings_zh: v. 尖叫；尖声说 | n. 尖叫声
definition_en: To make a sudden, loud, high sound with your voice. | A sudden, loud, high sound made by a person.
example1_en: The professor asked us to shriek with delight.
example1_zh: 教授让我们高兴得尖叫。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to shriek with delight.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们高兴得尖叫。
collocations: shriek with delight｜高兴得尖叫 ; let out a shriek｜发出一声尖叫 ; a piercing shriek｜刺耳的尖叫声
tip_zh: shriek强调声音尖而高，既可因恐惧也可因兴奋。

meanings_zh: adj. 紫外线的 | n. 紫外线
definition_en: Describing invisible radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light. | Invisible radiation beyond violet in the light spectrum.
example1_en: I copied ultraviolet radiation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把紫外线辐射抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used ultraviolet radiation to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用紫外线辐射来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: ultraviolet radiation｜紫外线辐射 ; ultraviolet rays｜紫外线 ; ultraviolet light｜紫外光
tip_zh: 常缩写为UV；紫外线本身肉眼不可见。

meanings_zh: adj. 永恒的；永久的
definition_en: Lasting forever or seeming never to end.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on everlasting love.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论永恒的爱。
example2_en: The reading connects everlasting love with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把永恒的爱和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: everlasting love｜永恒的爱 ; everlasting friendship｜永恒的友谊 ; everlasting life｜永生
tip_zh: 语气比long-lasting更强，常用于爱、友谊等抽象事物。

meanings_zh: n. 政治庇护；避难保护 | n. 旧时的精神病院
definition_en: Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country. | An old term for a hospital for people with mental illnesses.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on seek asylum.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论寻求庇护。
example2_en: A campus survey used seek asylum to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用寻求庇护来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: seek asylum｜寻求庇护 ; grant asylum｜给予庇护 ; asylum seeker｜寻求庇护者 ; political asylum｜政治庇护
tip_zh: 表示庇护时不可数；指精神病院是过时用法。

meanings_zh: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物 | n. 依赖他人过活者
