definition_en: an organism living on or inside another and taking nutrients | someone who takes from others without contributing anything
example1_en: I copied intestinal parasite into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把肠道寄生虫抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around intestinal parasite.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕肠道寄生虫展开说明。
collocations: intestinal parasite｜肠道寄生虫 ; host organism｜宿主生物 ; parasitic infection｜寄生虫感染
tip_zh: 指人时有强烈贬义；生物学中的宿主叫host。

meanings_zh: v. 腐烂；腐化 | v. 分解
definition_en: to decay naturally into simpler substances | to separate, or cause something to separate, into simpler parts
example1_en: The assignment is to decompose naturally, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先自然腐烂，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to decompose naturally.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来自然腐烂。
collocations: decompose naturally｜自然腐烂 ; decompose into｜分解为 ; decompose organic matter｜分解有机物
tip_zh: 既可不及物，也可及物；分解成某物用into。

meanings_zh: n. 殖民主义；殖民统治
definition_en: Control of another territory and its people by a country
example1_en: Office hours began with the legacy of colonialism.
example1_zh: 答疑从殖民主义的历史遗留影响开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of the legacy of colonialism.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得殖民主义的历史遗留影响这个例子。
collocations: the legacy of colonialism｜殖民主义的历史遗留影响 ; resistance to colonialism｜对殖民统治的反抗 ; the end of colonialism｜殖民统治的终结
tip_zh: 通常不可数；colony指殖民地，非殖民主义。

meanings_zh: n. 气象学家；气象专家
definition_en: A scientist who studies weather and atmospheric conditions.
example1_en: I copied a trained meteorologist into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把受过专业训练的气象专家抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a trained meteorologist.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕受过专业训练的气象专家展开说明。
collocations: a trained meteorologist｜受过专业训练的气象专家 ; a team of meteorologists｜气象专家团队 ; meteorologists predict｜气象专家预测
tip_zh: 研究天气与大气，不是研究流星的天文学家。

meanings_zh: adj. 戏剧的；剧场的 | adj. 夸张做作的
definition_en: relating to theatre or the performance of plays | exaggerated to attract attention or create a strong effect
example1_en: I copied a theatrical production into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把一部戏剧作品抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a theatrical production to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一部戏剧作品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: a theatrical production｜一部戏剧作品 ; a theatrical performance｜一场戏剧演出 ; a theatrical gesture｜夸张的手势
tip_zh: 既指戏剧相关，也可形容言行夸张做作。

meanings_zh: n. 焦虑不安；激动 | n. 鼓动；抗议活动 | n. 搅动；摇动
definition_en: A state of worry or excitement that prevents calm behaviour. | Organised efforts to persuade people to demand political or social change. | The action of shaking or stirring a substance.
example1_en: Office hours began with political agitation.
example1_zh: 答疑从政治鼓动开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around political agitation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕政治鼓动展开说明。
collocations: in a state of agitation｜处于焦躁状态 ; political agitation｜政治鼓动 ; gentle agitation｜轻轻搅动
tip_zh: 通常不可数；既可指情绪不安，也可指搅动。

meanings_zh: adj. 累积的；应计的
definition_en: built up over time, especially financially, but not necessarily paid
example1_en: The textbook introduces accrued interest in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了应计利息。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around accrued interest.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕应计利息展开说明。
collocations: accrued interest｜应计利息 ; accrued expenses｜应计费用 ; accrued income｜应计收入 ; accrued benefits｜累积福利
tip_zh: 也是accrue的过去分词；应计不等于已收付。

meanings_zh: adj. 直言不讳的 | adj. 嗓音的；歌唱的
definition_en: Expressing opinions or complaints openly and strongly. | Relating to the voice or to singing.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about vocal opposition.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于公开而强烈的反对的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of vocal opposition.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得公开而强烈的反对这个例子。
collocations: vocal opposition｜公开而强烈的反对 ; vocal critic｜直言不讳的批评者 ; vocal cords｜声带 ; vocal training｜声乐训练
tip_zh: be vocal about表示公开且强烈地表达对某事的看法。

meanings_zh: n. 耻辱；名誉受损 | v. 使蒙羞；使丢脸 | v. 违背；不履行
definition_en: Loss of respect caused by shameful or dishonest behaviour. | To cause someone or something to lose respect. | To fail to keep a promise or fulfil an agreement.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize dishonour in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出耻辱。
example2_en: Students who can explain dishonour usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释耻辱的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: bring dishonour on｜使……蒙羞 ; dishonour a promise｜违背诺言 ; dishonour an agreement｜不履行协议
tip_zh: 英式拼写为dishonour，美式为dishonor。

meanings_zh: adj. 不祥的；预示危险的
definition_en: suggesting that something bad or unpleasant may happen
example1_en: Our professor circled an ominous sign on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不祥的征兆。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an ominous sign.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论不祥的征兆的材料。
collocations: an ominous sign｜不祥的征兆 ; ominous clouds｜预示风暴的乌云 ; an ominous silence｜令人不安的寂静
tip_zh: 强调预示坏事将发生，而非坏事已经发生。

meanings_zh: v. 部分重叠；有共同之处 | n. 重叠部分；共同之处
definition_en: to partly cover something or share features with it | an area or feature shared by two things
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to overlap with.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何与……重叠。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to overlap with.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们与……重叠。
collocations: overlap with｜与……重叠 ; a significant overlap｜明显的重叠 ; overlapping responsibilities｜交叉重叠的职责
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；过去式overlapped。

meanings_zh: adj. 不稳定的；易突变的 | adj. 易怒的；情绪多变的 | adj. 易挥发的
definition_en: Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably. | Having emotions that change suddenly, especially towards anger. | Changing easily from a liquid into a gas.
example1_en: Office hours began with volatile market.
example1_zh: 答疑从波动剧烈的市场开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used volatile market to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用波动剧烈的市场来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: volatile market｜波动剧烈的市场 ; volatile prices｜不稳定的价格 ; volatile temper｜暴躁易变的脾气 ; volatile substance｜挥发性物质
tip_zh: 既可描述市场波动，也可指情绪易变或物质易挥发。

meanings_zh: v. 有关；适用于
definition_en: To relate to or apply to a particular subject.
example1_en: The assignment is to pertain to, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先与……有关；适用于，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to pertain to and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你与……有关；适用于，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: pertain to｜与……有关；适用于 ; matters pertaining to｜有关……的事项
tip_zh: 正式用语，通常接to；常见结构为pertaining to。

meanings_zh: n. 细丝；丝状物 | n. 灯丝
definition_en: A very thin thread or thread-like structure. | A thin wire that produces light when heated by electricity.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fine filament in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纤细的丝。
example2_en: The reading connects fine filament with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把纤细的丝和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fine filament｜纤细的丝 ; tungsten filament｜钨丝 ; filament bulb｜灯丝灯泡
tip_zh: 既指一般细丝，也指灯泡中通电发光的灯丝。

meanings_zh: v. 传授；告知 | v. 赋予；增添
definition_en: To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone | To give something a particular quality
example1_en: I heard the lecturer impart knowledge during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时传授知识。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers impart knowledge before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要传授知识。
collocations: impart knowledge｜传授知识 ; impart information｜传达信息 ; impart skills｜传授技能 ; impart flavour｜增添风味
tip_zh: 常用impart sth to sb，意为把某事传授给某人。

meanings_zh: v. 贬值；使折旧
definition_en: To lose value, or reduce an asset's recorded value.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer depreciate in value during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时价值下降。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to depreciate in value.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得价值下降。
collocations: depreciate in value｜价值下降 ; depreciate rapidly｜迅速贬值 ; depreciate assets｜对资产计提折旧
tip_zh: 常指货币或资产贬值；反义词appreciate可指升值。

meanings_zh: adv. 特此；据此
definition_en: By means of this statement or official action.
example1_en: The lab manual says to hereby declare before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先特此声明，再记下数字。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will hereby declare when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会特此声明。
collocations: hereby declare｜特此声明 ; hereby authorise｜特此授权 ; hereby agree｜特此同意
tip_zh: 用于正式声明，常置于主语后、主要动词前。

meanings_zh: v. 闪烁；闪耀 | n. 闪光；眼中愉快的神采
definition_en: To shine with small, quick changes in brightness. | A small flashing light, or a lively expression in someone's eyes.
example1_en: I wrote twinkle on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把twinkle和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up twinkle while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了闪烁。
collocations: stars twinkle｜星星闪烁 ; twinkling lights｜闪烁的灯光 ; a twinkle in someone's eye｜某人眼中愉快的神采
tip_zh: 作动词通常不及物，也可形容眼睛闪着笑意。

meanings_zh: adj. 鲜红的；猩红的 | n. 鲜红色；猩红色
definition_en: Having a bright red colour | A bright red colour
example1_en: Office hours began with a scarlet scarf.
example1_zh: 答疑从鲜红色围巾开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a scarlet scarf with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把鲜红色围巾和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a scarlet scarf｜鲜红色围巾 ; turn scarlet｜脸涨得通红 ; scarlet cheeks｜通红的脸颊
tip_zh: turn scarlet常形容因尴尬或生气而脸红。

meanings_zh: n. 领域；范围 | n. 王国
definition_en: An area of knowledge, activity, or experience. | A country ruled by a king or queen.
example1_en: Office hours began with the realm of science.
example1_zh: 答疑从科学领域开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used the realm of science to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用科学领域来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: the realm of science｜科学领域 ; within the realm of possibility｜在可能的范围内 ; beyond the realm of｜超出……的范围
tip_zh: 常用the realm of；表示领域时比area更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 留声机
definition_en: an old machine that plays sound from flat records
example1_en: I copied a wind-up gramophone into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把手摇留声机抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a wind-up gramophone to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用手摇留声机来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a wind-up gramophone｜手摇留声机 ; a gramophone record｜留声机唱片 ; play a gramophone｜播放留声机
tip_zh: 指老式唱片播放机；美式英语常称phonograph。

meanings_zh: n. 蜂群；成群的昆虫 | v. 蜂拥；成群移动
definition_en: A large group of insects moving or gathering together. | Move or gather somewhere in large numbers.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a swarm of bees in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一群蜜蜂。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a swarm of bees.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得一群蜜蜂这个例子。
collocations: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂 ; swarm into｜蜂拥进入 ; swarm with tourists｜挤满游客
tip_zh: be swarming with表示某处挤满人或昆虫。

meanings_zh: v. 努力；奋斗；力争
definition_en: To try very hard to achieve something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to strive to improve.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求努力改进。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers strive to improve before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要努力改进。
collocations: strive to improve｜努力改进 ; strive for excellence｜追求卓越 ; strive towards a goal｜为目标奋斗
tip_zh: 常用strive to do或strive for；过去式常为strove。

meanings_zh: v. 渴望；思念
definition_en: To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain
example1_en: The professor asked us to yearn for freedom.
example1_zh: 教授让我们渴望自由。
example2_en: The passage says students who can yearn for freedom follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够渴望自由的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: yearn for freedom｜渴望自由 ; yearn to return｜渴望归来 ; yearn for home｜思念家乡
tip_zh: 用yearn for sth或yearn to do，表达强烈渴望。

meanings_zh: v. 不情愿地承认 | v. 让步；让予 | v. 认输；承认失败
definition_en: To admit something is true, often unwillingly | To give up something or allow it after resistance | To accept that you have lost a contest
example1_en: The lab instructions say to concede that.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求承认……。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to concede that.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们承认……。
collocations: concede that｜承认…… ; concede defeat｜承认失败 ; concede a point｜承认对方某点有理 ; concede ground｜作出让步
tip_zh: 常含原本反对、后来不得不承认的意味。

meanings_zh: adv. 反过来；相反地
definition_en: used to introduce an opposite situation or relationship
example1_en: Conversely, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
example1_zh: 反过来，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。
example2_en: Conversely, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
example2_zh: 反过来，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。
collocations: and conversely｜反过来也一样 ; conversely, however｜然而反过来看
tip_zh: 用于引出相反情况，不是一般性的补充转折。

meanings_zh: n. 连贯性；条理性
definition_en: The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on logical coherence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论逻辑连贯性。
example2_en: The author returns to logical coherence when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了逻辑连贯性。
collocations: logical coherence｜逻辑连贯性 ; overall coherence｜整体连贯性 ; lack coherence｜缺乏条理 ; improve coherence｜增强连贯性
tip_zh: 侧重逻辑连贯；cohesion侧重语言或结构衔接。

meanings_zh: n. 君主；帝王
definition_en: A king or queen who serves as head of state
example1_en: Office hours began with constitutional monarch.
example1_zh: 答疑从立宪君主开始。
example2_en: The reading connects constitutional monarch with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把立宪君主和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: constitutional monarch｜立宪君主 ; reigning monarch｜在位君主 ; absolute monarch｜专制君主
tip_zh: 可指国王或女王，不限性别；制度称monarchy。

meanings_zh: n. 大量；众多 | n. 人群；大众
definition_en: A very large number of people or things | A large crowd or the ordinary public
example1_en: I copied a vast multitude into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把庞大的人群抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a vast multitude with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把庞大的人群和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a multitude of factors｜众多因素 ; a multitude of options｜大量选择 ; a vast multitude｜庞大的人群
tip_zh: a multitude of后接复数名词，表示大量。

meanings_zh: adj. 已故的 | n. 死者
definition_en: No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts. | A person or people who have died.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the deceased.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论死者。
example2_en: A campus survey used the deceased to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用死者来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a deceased relative｜已故亲属 ; the deceased｜死者 ; the deceased's estate｜死者的遗产
tip_zh: 正式用语；the deceased可指一位或多位死者。

meanings_zh: adj. 愤愤不平的；怨恨的
definition_en: angry because you believe you have been treated unfairly
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize resentful in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出怨恨的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up resentful while discussing evidence about human behavior.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人类行为的证据时提到了怨恨的。
collocations: feel resentful｜感到愤愤不平 ; resentful of someone｜对某人心怀怨恨 ; resentful towards someone｜对某人不满
tip_zh: 强调因自觉受到不公平对待而不满，不只是生气。

meanings_zh: adj. 根本的；彻底的 | adj. 激进的 | n. 激进分子
definition_en: Involving major changes to the basic nature of something. | Supporting major political or social changes beyond accepted views. | A person who supports major political or social change.
example1_en: Our professor circled radical change on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了根本性改变。
example2_en: The reading connects radical change with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把根本性改变和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: radical change｜根本性改变 ; radical reform｜彻底改革 ; radical ideas｜激进思想
tip_zh: radical change指根本性改变，不一定涉及政治。

meanings_zh: n. 重新评价；重新估计
definition_en: A fresh assessment of something, often leading to changed views.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a thorough reappraisal in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了全面重新评估。
example2_en: A campus survey used a thorough reappraisal to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用全面重新评估来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a thorough reappraisal｜全面重新评估 ; prompt a reappraisal｜促使重新评价 ; a reappraisal of priorities｜对优先事项的重新审视
tip_zh: 常用a reappraisal of，表示对某事重新评价。

meanings_zh: n. 蟾蜍
definition_en: A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on common toad.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论普通蟾蜍。
example2_en: The reading connects common toad with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把普通蟾蜍和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: common toad｜普通蟾蜍 ; cane toad｜海蟾蜍 ; toad spawn｜蟾蜍卵
tip_zh: toad指蟾蜍；frog通常指青蛙。

meanings_zh: v. 使遭受；造成（伤害）
definition_en: to cause someone or something to suffer harm
example1_en: The professor asked us to inflict damage on.
example1_zh: 教授让我们对……造成破坏。
example2_en: The reading asks you to inflict damage on and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你对……造成破坏，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: inflict damage on｜对……造成破坏 ; inflict pain on｜使……遭受痛苦 ; inflict suffering on｜使……受苦
tip_zh: 搭配为inflict伤害on对象，不能说inflict sb。

meanings_zh: n. 复制品；副本 | v. 复制；重复 | adj. 复制的；完全相同的
definition_en: An exact copy of something | To make an exact copy or repeat something unnecessarily | Exactly matching another item
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a duplicate key.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于复制的钥匙的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a duplicate key when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了复制的钥匙。
collocations: a duplicate key｜复制的钥匙 ; duplicate records｜重复记录 ; duplicate efforts｜重复付出努力 ; in duplicate｜一式两份
tip_zh: 名词、形容词结尾读/kət/；动词读/keɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 研究方法体系；方法论
definition_en: a system of methods and principles used in research
example1_en: The textbook introduces research methodology in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了研究方法体系。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss research methodology.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论研究方法体系的材料。
collocations: research methodology｜研究方法体系 ; develop a methodology｜制定方法体系 ; rigorous methodology｜严谨的方法体系
tip_zh: method是具体方法；methodology侧重整套方法及原理。

meanings_zh: n. 农场雇工
definition_en: A person employed to do practical work on a farm
example1_en: Office hours began with seasonal farmhand.
example1_zh: 答疑从季节性农场雇工开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used seasonal farmhand to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用季节性农场雇工来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: work as a farmhand｜当农场雇工 ; hire a farmhand｜雇用农场工人 ; seasonal farmhand｜季节性农场雇工
tip_zh: hand可指干体力活的人；farmhand是雇工而非农场主。

meanings_zh: n. 作品集 | n. 投资组合 | n. 部长职责；部长职务
definition_en: a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience | a collection of investments owned by a person or organization | a minister's position or area of government responsibility
example1_en: Office hours began with investment portfolio.
example1_zh: 答疑从投资组合开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around investment portfolio.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕投资组合展开说明。
collocations: a portfolio of work｜一套作品集 ; investment portfolio｜投资组合 ; hold a portfolio｜担任部长职务
tip_zh: 求职时常指作品集；金融语境指投资组合。

meanings_zh: v. 启发；使了解
definition_en: to give someone information that helps them understand something
example1_en: The assignment is to enlighten someone about, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使某人了解，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to enlighten someone about.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使某人了解。
collocations: enlighten someone about｜使某人了解 ; enlighten someone on｜向某人讲解 ; an enlightening discussion｜有启发性的讨论
tip_zh: 常用enlighten sb about/on sth，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 毛孔；气孔；孔隙 | v. 仔细研读；认真审视
definition_en: a tiny opening in skin or another surface | to read or examine something with great attention
example1_en: Our professor circled pore over documents on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了仔细研读文件。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around pore over documents.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕仔细研读文件展开说明。
collocations: clogged pores｜堵塞的毛孔 ; open pores｜张开的毛孔 ; pore over documents｜仔细研读文件
tip_zh: 动词常用pore over，勿与pour over混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 巨大程度；规模；重要性 | n. 震级
definition_en: The size, extent, or importance of something. | A measure of the energy released by an earthquake.
example1_en: Office hours began with an order of magnitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从一个数量级开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an order of magnitude.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一个数量级展开说明。
collocations: the magnitude of the problem｜问题的严重程度 ; an earthquake of magnitude six｜六级地震 ; an order of magnitude｜一个数量级
tip_zh: 谈规模常用the magnitude of；震级也用此词。

meanings_zh: n. 具有讽刺意味的情况 | n. 反语；讽刺
definition_en: A situation that is strikingly opposite to what is expected. | Using words opposite to your meaning, often for humorous effect.
example1_en: I copied a sense of irony into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把反讽意识抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a sense of irony.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得反讽意识这个例子。
collocations: the irony of the situation｜局面的讽刺之处 ; a sense of irony｜反讽意识 ; dramatic irony｜戏剧性反讽
tip_zh: irony不只是巧合，常指结果与预期形成讽刺性反差。

meanings_zh: n. 出现；到来
definition_en: The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period
example1_en: Our professor circled the advent of on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了……的出现。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the advent of.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论……的出现的材料。
collocations: the advent of｜……的出现 ; with the advent of｜随着……的到来 ; since the advent of｜自……出现以来
tip_zh: 常用the advent of，指重要新事物的出现。

meanings_zh: v. 调解；斡旋
definition_en: To help opposing sides reach an agreement.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to mediate between two sides.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求在双方之间调解。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers mediate between two sides before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要在双方之间调解。
collocations: mediate between two sides｜在双方之间调解 ; mediate a dispute｜调解纠纷 ; mediate a settlement｜调解达成和解
tip_zh: mediate侧重促成协议；arbitrate可指作出仲裁。

meanings_zh: n. 纬度 | n. 自主决定的自由；余地
definition_en: Distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees. | Freedom to choose how to act or decide.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used latitude in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了纬度。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up latitude while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了纬度。
collocations: high latitudes｜高纬度地区 ; low latitudes｜低纬度地区 ; give someone latitude｜给予某人自主权
tip_zh: latitude是纬度，longitude是经度。

meanings_zh: v. 倾向于；使倾向于 | v. 倾斜；低头 | n. 斜坡
definition_en: To tend towards a particular opinion or course of action | To lean or move something towards a sloping position | A surface that slopes upwards or downwards
example1_en: The assignment is to incline towards a view, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先倾向于某种观点，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers incline towards a view before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要倾向于某种观点。
collocations: incline towards a view｜倾向于某种观点 ; be inclined to agree｜倾向于赞同 ; a steep incline｜陡坡
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈɪnklaɪn/。

meanings_zh: adj. 类似的；可比拟的
definition_en: Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about analogous to.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于与…类似的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of analogous to.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得与…类似这个例子。
collocations: analogous to｜与…类似 ; an analogous situation｜类似的情形 ; an analogous process｜类似的过程
tip_zh: 常用be analogous to，强调某方面可作比较。

meanings_zh: v. 推广；使流行 | v. 使通俗易懂
definition_en: To make something widely known, liked, or used. | To explain specialist knowledge so ordinary people can understand it.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to popularize science.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何普及科学。
example2_en: When the class discussed public communication, the speaker told us to popularize science.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共传播时，讲者让我们普及科学。
collocations: popularize science｜普及科学 ; popularize an idea｜推广一种观念 ; help popularize｜帮助推广
tip_zh: 英式也常写popularise；不只是“宣传”。

meanings_zh: v. 描绘；描写
definition_en: to show or describe something in art, images, or words
example1_en: The professor asked us to depict daily life.
example1_zh: 教授让我们描绘日常生活。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to depict daily life.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得描绘日常生活。
collocations: depict daily life｜描绘日常生活 ; depict someone as｜将某人描绘成 ; accurately depict｜准确描绘
tip_zh: depict A as B：把A描绘成B。

meanings_zh: n. 牧场；牧草地 | v. 放牧
definition_en: Land covered with grass where farm animals feed. | To put animals on grassland so they can feed.
example1_en: Our professor circled rich pasture on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了丰美的牧草地。
example2_en: A campus survey used rich pasture to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用丰美的牧草地来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: rich pasture｜丰美的牧草地 ; pasture land｜牧场用地 ; put cattle out to pasture｜把牛赶到牧场放牧
tip_zh: pasture强调供牲畜吃草的土地，不是普通草坪。

meanings_zh: n. 传记作者
definition_en: Someone who writes an account of another person's life.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about an official biographer.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于官方传记作者的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an official biographer.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕官方传记作者展开说明。
collocations: an official biographer｜官方传记作者 ; a royal biographer｜王室传记作者 ; a renowned biographer｜著名传记作者
tip_zh: biographer写他人传记；自传是autobiography。

meanings_zh: n. 断言；明确主张 | n. 坚持；维护
definition_en: a confident statement that something is true | the act of firmly expressing rights, authority, or independence
example1_en: The textbook introduces unsupported assertion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了缺乏依据的断言。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of unsupported assertion.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得缺乏依据的断言这个例子。
collocations: make an assertion｜作出断言 ; unsupported assertion｜缺乏依据的断言 ; challenge an assertion｜质疑某项断言 ; assertion of rights｜维护权利
tip_zh: 常用the assertion that…；断言不代表已有证据。

meanings_zh: n. 牲畜饲料 | n. 素材；谈资
definition_en: Food such as hay or straw given to farm animals. | Material that can be used for a particular purpose.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about winter fodder.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于冬季饲料的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used winter fodder to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用冬季饲料来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: winter fodder｜冬季饲料 ; fodder crops｜饲料作物 ; fodder for gossip｜闲聊的谈资
tip_zh: 通常不可数；fodder for也可比喻供利用的素材。

meanings_zh: v. 使全球化；全球化
definition_en: to make something operate or spread across the world
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to globalize operations.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须使业务全球化。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers globalize operations before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使业务全球化。
collocations: globalize operations｜使业务全球化 ; globalize production｜使生产全球化 ; globalize markets｜使市场全球化
tip_zh: 英式英语也常拼作globalise。

meanings_zh: adj. 空间的；空间关系的
definition_en: relating to space and the positions of objects within it
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about spatial awareness.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于空间意识的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around spatial awareness.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕空间意识展开说明。
collocations: spatial awareness｜空间意识 ; spatial distribution｜空间分布 ; spatial reasoning｜空间推理
tip_zh: spatial指空间关系；spacious指地方宽敞。

meanings_zh: n. 麻醉性镇痛药；毒品 | adj. 麻醉性的；催眠的
definition_en: a sleep-inducing painkiller; also an illegal drug | causing sleep or reduced awareness
example1_en: The textbook introduces narcotic painkiller in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了麻醉性镇痛药。
example2_en: The author returns to narcotic painkiller when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了麻醉性镇痛药。
collocations: narcotic painkiller｜麻醉性镇痛药 ; narcotic drugs｜麻醉性药物；毒品 ; narcotic effect｜催眠作用
tip_zh: 医学常指麻醉性镇痛药；法律语境可泛指毒品。

meanings_zh: n. 阴谋；密谋
definition_en: A secret plan by several people to do something wrong.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on conspiracy theory.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论阴谋论。
example2_en: The author returns to conspiracy theory when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了阴谋论。
collocations: conspiracy theory｜阴谋论 ; uncover a conspiracy｜揭露阴谋 ; conspiracy to commit fraud｜实施诈骗的共谋
tip_zh: conspiracy to do sth指密谋做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 依赖；信赖
definition_en: The state of depending on or trusting someone or something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on self-reliance.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自立。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss self-reliance.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自立的材料。
collocations: reliance on｜对……的依赖 ; heavy reliance on｜对……的严重依赖 ; reduce reliance on｜减少对……的依赖 ; self-reliance｜自立
tip_zh: reliance是不可数名词，通常与on搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 克制；自制 | n. 限制；约束 | n. 约束装置
definition_en: control over your feelings, behaviour, or desires | a rule or measure that limits actions or freedom | a device that prevents someone or something from moving freely
example1_en: Office hours began with exercise restraint.
example1_zh: 答疑从保持克制开始。
example2_en: The author returns to exercise restraint when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了保持克制。
collocations: show restraint｜表现出克制 ; exercise restraint｜保持克制 ; restraints on spending｜支出限制 ; child restraint｜儿童安全约束装置
tip_zh: 表自制通常不可数；表限制常用restraints on。

meanings_zh: n. 云雀；百灵鸟 | n. 玩乐；嬉闹
definition_en: a small bird known for singing while flying | something done for fun rather than for a serious purpose
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a lark singing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论云雀鸣唱。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a lark singing.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得云雀鸣唱这个例子。
collocations: a lark singing｜云雀鸣唱 ; for a lark｜为了好玩 ; have a lark｜嬉闹玩乐
tip_zh: for a lark意为“为了好玩”，多用于英式口语。

meanings_zh: n. 修订；修正案
definition_en: A change made to a law, document, or proposal.
example1_en: Our professor circled constitutional amendment on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了宪法修正案。
example2_en: A campus survey used constitutional amendment to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用宪法修正案来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: make an amendment｜作出修改 ; propose an amendment｜提出修正案 ; constitutional amendment｜宪法修正案 ; amendment to a law｜对法律的修订
tip_zh: 表示对某文件的修改，用amendment to。

meanings_zh: v. 拉票；争取支持 | v. 征求意见；调查
definition_en: To approach people and ask for their votes or support. | To ask people about their opinions on a particular issue.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to canvass for votes.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何拉选票。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to canvass for votes.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得拉选票。
collocations: canvass for votes｜拉选票 ; canvass support｜争取支持 ; canvass opinions｜征求意见
tip_zh: canvass是拉票或征求意见；canvas指帆布。

meanings_zh: adj. 乐于助人的；热心的
definition_en: willing and happy to help other people
example1_en: Office hours began with friendly and obliging.
example1_zh: 答疑从友善又热心开始。
example2_en: The author returns to friendly and obliging when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了友善又热心。
collocations: obliging staff｜热心的员工 ; an obliging neighbour｜乐于助人的邻居 ; friendly and obliging｜友善又热心
tip_zh: obliging 指乐于助人；obliged 常表示被迫或感激。

meanings_zh: n. 笨拙；不灵活 | n. 尴尬；拘谨
definition_en: A lack of ease or control in physical movement. | Discomfort or embarrassment in a social situation.
example1_en: Our professor circled physical awkwardness on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了动作笨拙。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around physical awkwardness.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕动作笨拙展开说明。
collocations: physical awkwardness｜动作笨拙 ; social awkwardness｜社交拘谨 ; initial awkwardness｜最初的尴尬 ; a sense of awkwardness｜尴尬感
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可形容动作笨拙，也可表示社交尴尬。

meanings_zh: n. 女继承人
definition_en: A woman who inherits or expects to inherit substantial wealth.
example1_en: I copied a wealthy heiress into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把富有的女继承人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a wealthy heiress to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用富有的女继承人来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: heiress to a fortune｜巨额财产的女继承人 ; a wealthy heiress｜富有的女继承人
tip_zh: h不发音；heir如今也可泛指任何性别的继承人。

meanings_zh: adj. 热忱的；强烈的
definition_en: showing very strong and sincere feelings or beliefs
example1_en: The textbook introduces a fervent supporter in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了热情的支持者。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a fervent supporter.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕热情的支持者展开说明。
collocations: a fervent supporter｜热情的支持者 ; a fervent believer｜坚定的信奉者 ; a fervent hope｜热切的希望
tip_zh: 语气较正式，常修饰supporter、belief、hope。

meanings_zh: adj. 复合的；合成的 | n. 复合材料；合成物
definition_en: made by combining different parts or materials | something made from several different parts or materials
example1_en: Office hours began with composite material.
example1_zh: 答疑从复合材料开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used composite material to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用复合材料来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

meanings_zh: n. 入职或入学指导 | n. 朝向；方位 | n. 倾向；取向

meanings_zh: v. 断言；坚称 | v. 维护；坚持行使

meanings_zh: n. 流放；流亡 | n. 流亡者；被放逐者 | v. 放逐；流放

meanings_zh: n. 专题研讨会

meanings_zh: adj. 怀疑的；不轻信的

meanings_zh: v. 干预；介入 | v. 插话；打断 | v. 发生于其间；阻碍

example1_zh: 作业是先介入纠纷，再说明它为什么重要。

example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得介入纠纷。

tip_zh: 常用verification of，表示对身份、事实或结果的核实。

meanings_zh: adj. 专心的；留意的 | adj. 体贴的；关照的
definition_en: listening or watching carefully | taking care to notice and meet someone's needs
example1_en: Our professor circled an attentive audience on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了专心的听众。

example2_zh: 一项校园调查用专心的听众来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip_zh: attentive to后接关注的对象；也可形容服务周到。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐速度；节拍快慢 | n. 活动或发展的速度

collocations: exorbitant prices｜高得离谱的价格 ; exorbitant fees｜过高的费用 ; exorbitant rents｜过高的租金
tip_zh: 比expensive语气更强，含不合理、过高之意。

meanings_zh: n. 螺旋形；螺旋线 | adj. 螺旋形的 | v. 盘旋；急剧上升或恶化
definition_en: A curve winding around a centre or axis. | Curving around a centre or axis. | To move in curves, or increase or worsen rapidly.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about downward spiral.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于不断恶化的局面的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects downward spiral with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把不断恶化的局面和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: spiral staircase｜螺旋楼梯 ; downward spiral｜不断恶化的局面 ; spiral out of control｜急剧恶化至失控 ; spiralling costs｜急剧上涨的成本
tip_zh: 英式过去式spiralled；美式spiraled，双写规则不同。

meanings_zh: adj. 获豁免的；被免除的 | v. 豁免；免除
definition_en: Not required to follow a rule or fulfil an obligation. | To release someone from a rule, payment, or obligation.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about exempt from tax.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于免税的的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to exempt from tax when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了免税的。
collocations: exempt from tax｜免税的 ; exempt someone from｜免除某人的…… ; tax-exempt status｜免税资格
tip_zh: 固定搭配：be exempt from；exempt sb from。

meanings_zh: v. 主持；担任主席
definition_en: To lead a formal meeting, ceremony, or other official event
example1_en: I heard the lecturer preside over a meeting during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时主持会议。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers preside over a meeting before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要主持会议。
collocations: preside over a meeting｜主持会议 ; preside at a ceremony｜主持典礼 ; presiding judge｜审判长
tip_zh: 不直接接会议等宾语，通常用preside over。

meanings_zh: v. 扩散；传播；使漫射 | adj. 分散的；弥漫的 | adj. 冗长散漫的
definition_en: To spread widely, or make light scatter in many directions. | Spread over a wide area rather than concentrated. | Using too many words without a clear focus.
example1_en: The assignment is to diffuse light, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使光线漫射，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to diffuse light.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使光线漫射。
collocations: diffuse light｜使光线漫射 ; diffuse knowledge｜传播知识 ; diffuse through｜扩散到…之中
tip_zh: 动词词尾读/z/，形容词读/s/；勿混defuse（化解）。

meanings_zh: n. 挣钱养家的人
definition_en: Someone who earns money to support a family.
example1_en: The professor explained bread-earner with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了挣钱养家的人。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses bread-earner when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了挣钱养家的人。
collocations: main bread-earner｜主要养家者 ; sole bread-earner｜唯一养家者
tip_zh: 较少见；日常及考试写作通常用breadwinner。

meanings_zh: adj. 认真负责的；尽责的
definition_en: Careful to do duties thoroughly and correctly
example1_en: The textbook introduces a conscientious worker in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了尽责的员工。
example2_en: A campus survey used a conscientious worker to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用尽责的员工来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a conscientious worker｜尽责的员工 ; a conscientious student｜认真的学生 ; conscientious about your work｜对工作认真负责
tip_zh: conscientious是认真负责的；conscious是有意识的。

meanings_zh: v. 粉饰；掩盖过失 | n. 粉饰；掩盖 | n. 石灰浆；白色涂料
definition_en: To hide faults or wrongdoing so something appears acceptable. | An attempt to hide faults or wrongdoing. | A white liquid mixture used to coat walls.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to whitewash a scandal.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何掩盖丑闻。
example2_en: The passage says students who can whitewash a scandal follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够掩盖丑闻的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: whitewash a scandal｜掩盖丑闻 ; an official whitewash｜官方的粉饰 ; a coat of whitewash｜一层石灰浆
tip_zh: 比喻义带贬义，指掩饰问题，不是解决问题。

meanings_zh: n. 流行；时尚
definition_en: a style or practice popular at a particular time
example1_en: Office hours began with the vogue for.
example1_zh: 答疑从对……的热潮开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used the vogue for to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用对……的热潮来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: in vogue｜流行的 ; come into vogue｜开始流行 ; the vogue for｜对……的热潮
tip_zh: 常用in vogue表示“流行”；不是普通的可数物品。

meanings_zh: n. 努力；尝试 | v. 努力；力图
definition_en: A serious effort to achieve something. | To try hard to achieve a goal.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a joint endeavour in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了共同的努力。
example2_en: The author returns to a joint endeavour when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了共同的努力。
collocations: endeavour to do something｜努力做某事 ; make every endeavour｜尽一切努力 ; a joint endeavour｜共同的努力 ; scientific endeavour｜科学探索
tip_zh: 英式拼写；美式为endeavor；动词后接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 隔热；隔音；绝缘 | n. 隔热或绝缘材料
definition_en: protection that reduces the passage of heat, sound, or electricity | material used to limit heat, sound, or electricity passing through
example1_en: The textbook introduces thermal insulation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了隔热。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss thermal insulation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论隔热的材料。
collocations: thermal insulation｜隔热 ; sound insulation｜隔音 ; electrical insulation｜电气绝缘 ; insulation material｜隔热材料
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可指隔绝作用，也可指所用材料。

meanings_zh: v. 握紧；咬紧
definition_en: To close your hands or press your teeth together tightly.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to clench your fists.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何握紧双拳。
example2_en: The passage says students who can clench your fists follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够握紧双拳的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: clench your fists｜握紧双拳 ; clench your teeth｜咬紧牙齿 ; clench your jaw｜绷紧下颌
tip_zh: clench指握紧或咬紧；clin​​ch才可指赢得、敲定。

meanings_zh: v. 使了解；使熟悉
definition_en: Give someone knowledge of or familiarity with something.
example1_en: The assignment is to acquaint yourself with, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使自己熟悉，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can acquaint yourself with follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够使自己熟悉的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: acquaint yourself with｜使自己熟悉 ; acquaint someone with｜使某人了解 ; be acquainted with｜了解；认识
tip_zh: 较正式，常用acquaint sb/oneself with sth。

meanings_zh: v. 焊接 | n. 焊接处；焊缝
definition_en: To join metal parts by heating their edges until they fuse. | The joint formed when metal parts are welded together.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to weld metal.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何焊接金属。
example2_en: The passage says students who can weld metal follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够焊接金属的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: weld metal｜焊接金属 ; weld together｜焊在一起 ; a strong weld｜牢固的焊缝
tip_zh: weld A to B表示把A焊接到B上。

meanings_zh: n. 宁静；安详
definition_en: a state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sense of serenity in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宁静感。
example2_en: The reading connects a sense of serenity with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把宁静感和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a sense of serenity｜宁静感 ; inner serenity｜内心的平静 ; an atmosphere of serenity｜宁静的氛围
tip_zh: 通常不可数，既形容环境宁静，也指内心平静。

meanings_zh: adj. 口语的；非正式的
definition_en: used in informal conversation rather than formal writing
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about colloquial language.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于口语化语言的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used colloquial language to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用口语化语言来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: colloquial language｜口语化语言 ; colloquial expression｜口语表达 ; colloquial speech｜非正式口语
tip_zh: 指日常交谈中的非正式用语，不等于俚语。

meanings_zh: v. 理解；解释
definition_en: To understand a statement or action in a particular way.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer construe narrowly during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时作狭义解释。
example2_en: The passage says students who can construe narrowly follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够作狭义解释的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: construe something as｜将某事理解为 ; be construed as criticism｜被理解为批评 ; construe narrowly｜作狭义解释
tip_zh: 常用construe A as B，表示“把A理解为B”。

meanings_zh: v. 超越；突破界限
definition_en: To go beyond ordinary limits, differences, or expectations.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer transcend boundaries during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时超越界限。
example2_en: The reading asks you to transcend boundaries and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你超越界限，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: transcend boundaries｜超越界限 ; transcend cultural differences｜超越文化差异 ; transcend national interests｜超越国家利益
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语，不加beyond。

meanings_zh: v. 窥探；打探隐私 | v. 撬开；撬起
definition_en: To seek private information about someone in an intrusive way. | To force something open or loose using a tool.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer pry into someone's affairs during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时打探某人的私事。
example2_en: The passage says students who can pry into someone's affairs follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够打探某人的私事的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: pry into someone's affairs｜打探某人的私事 ; pry open a lid｜撬开盖子 ; prying eyes｜窥探的目光
tip_zh: 窥探用pry into；表示撬开时英式常用prise。

meanings_zh: n. 开始；开端
definition_en: The beginning of an activity, process, or period.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used outset in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了开始。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses outset when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了开始。
collocations: at the outset｜在开始时 ; from the outset｜从一开始 ; at the outset of｜在……之初
tip_zh: 常用于at/from the outset，不用于set outset。

meanings_zh: v. 是…的典型；例证 | v. 举例说明
definition_en: to be a clear example of something | to explain something by giving examples
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to exemplify a trend.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何是某种趋势的典型。
example2_en: The passage says students who can exemplify a trend follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够是某种趋势的典型的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: exemplify a trend｜是某种趋势的典型 ; exemplify a principle｜例证某项原则 ; exemplify the benefits of｜体现…的益处
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接名词；举例时也可用be exemplified by。

meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；至关重要的
definition_en: more important than anything else
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on paramount concern.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论首要关注的问题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of paramount concern.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得首要关注的问题这个例子。
collocations: of paramount importance｜极为重要的 ; paramount concern｜首要关注的问题 ; paramount consideration｜首要考虑因素
tip_zh: 常用be paramount或of paramount importance。

meanings_zh: n. 会议厅；大房间 | n. 体内的室；封闭腔室
definition_en: A room used for a particular, often official, purpose. | An enclosed space inside a body, machine, or structure.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on council chamber.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论市议会会议厅。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around council chamber.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕市议会会议厅展开说明。
collocations: council chamber｜市议会会议厅 ; heart chamber｜心腔 ; chamber of commerce｜商会
tip_zh: chamber多指专用房间或封闭腔室，不是普通卧室。

meanings_zh: adj. 细胞的 | adj. 蜂窝移动通信的
definition_en: Relating to the cells of living organisms. | Using a mobile network divided into local coverage areas.
example1_en: The textbook introduces cellular structure in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了细胞结构。
example2_en: A campus survey used cellular structure to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用细胞结构来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: cellular structure｜细胞结构 ; cellular respiration｜细胞呼吸 ; cellular damage｜细胞损伤 ; cellular network｜蜂窝移动通信网络
tip_zh: 生物学中指细胞的；通信中指蜂窝网络的。

meanings_zh: adj. 奢侈的；挥霍的 | adj. 过度的；夸张的
definition_en: Spending or costing much more money than necessary. | Going beyond what is reasonable or believable.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on extravagant spending.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论挥霍性支出。
example2_en: The reading connects extravagant spending with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把挥霍性支出和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: extravagant spending｜挥霍性支出 ; extravagant lifestyle｜奢侈的生活方式 ; extravagant claims｜夸大的说法
tip_zh: 既可指花钱无度，也可指言辞或要求过分。

meanings_zh: n. 肝炎
definition_en: Inflammation of the liver, sometimes caused by a virus.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on viral hepatitis.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论病毒性肝炎。
example2_en: The author returns to viral hepatitis when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了病毒性肝炎。
collocations: viral hepatitis｜病毒性肝炎 ; hepatitis B｜乙型肝炎 ; hepatitis screening｜肝炎筛查
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；并非所有肝炎都由病毒引起。

meanings_zh: adj. 谨慎的；能保密的 | adj. 低调的；不显眼的
definition_en: Careful not to reveal secrets or cause embarrassment. | Designed or chosen to avoid attracting attention.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a discreet enquiry.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论谨慎的询问。
example2_en: A campus survey used a discreet enquiry to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用谨慎的询问来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a discreet enquiry｜谨慎的询问 ; a discreet manner｜谨慎的态度 ; discreet about｜对……守口如瓶 ; a discreet entrance｜不显眼的入口
tip_zh: 勿混discrete（分离的）；discreet强调谨慎低调。

meanings_zh: n. 缩微胶片 | v. 把…拍成缩微胶片
definition_en: Film storing very small photographic copies of documents. | To photograph documents at a greatly reduced size on film.
example1_en: Office hours began with a microfilm reader.
example1_zh: 答疑从缩微胶片阅读器开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a microfilm reader with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把缩微胶片阅读器和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: on microfilm｜以缩微胶片形式 ; a microfilm reader｜缩微胶片阅读器 ; microfilm archives｜缩微胶片档案
tip_zh: 表示以缩微胶片形式保存，用on microfilm。

meanings_zh: n. 综合；融合 | n. 化学合成
definition_en: The combination of different ideas or elements into a whole. | The production of a substance by combining simpler substances.
example1_en: I copied chemical synthesis into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把化学合成抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to chemical synthesis when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了化学合成。
collocations: a synthesis of ideas｜思想的综合 ; chemical synthesis｜化学合成 ; protein synthesis｜蛋白质合成
tip_zh: 复数为syntheses；常用a synthesis of。

meanings_zh: adj. 清醒的；未醉的 | adj. 严肃冷静的；素淡的 | v. 使清醒；醒酒
definition_en: Not drunk or affected by alcohol. | Serious and sensible, or plain rather than bright. | To become or make someone less drunk or more serious.
example1_en: The textbook introduces sober assessment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了冷静的评估。
example2_en: A campus survey used sober assessment to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用冷静的评估来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: stay sober｜保持清醒 ; sober assessment｜冷静的评估 ; sober colours｜素淡的颜色 ; sober up｜醒酒
tip_zh: sober up表示醒酒；sober也可形容冷静的判断。

meanings_zh: n. 代表；代理 | n. 描绘；表现
definition_en: The act of speaking or acting on behalf of others. | A picture, description, or model showing someone or something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces legal representation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了法律代理。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around legal representation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕法律代理展开说明。
collocations: legal representation｜法律代理 ; political representation｜政治代表权 ; accurate representation｜准确呈现 ; visual representation｜视觉呈现
tip_zh: 既可指替他人发声，也可指图像或文字对事物的呈现。

meanings_zh: v. 依法驱逐租户等
definition_en: To legally force someone to leave a property
example1_en: I heard the lecturer evict a tenant during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时驱逐租户。
example2_en: The reading asks you to evict a tenant and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你驱逐租户，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: evict a tenant｜驱逐租户 ; evict someone from a property｜将某人逐出房产 ; face eviction｜面临被驱逐
tip_zh: 常用evict somebody from；尤其指依法逐出租屋。

meanings_zh: n. 永久性；持久性
definition_en: the quality of lasting indefinitely without significant change
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sense of permanence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论长久稳定感。
example2_en: The author returns to a sense of permanence when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了长久稳定感。
collocations: a sense of permanence｜长久稳定感 ; apparent permanence｜表面上的永久性 ; ensure permanence｜确保长久留存
tip_zh: 不可数名词；形容词是permanent。

meanings_zh: v. 预先设定 | adj. 预设的 | n. 预设选项
definition_en: To set a device or control before it is used. | Set or fixed before use. | A saved setting available for immediate use.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to preset the timer.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须预设定时器。
example2_en: The reading asks you to preset the timer and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你预设定时器，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: preset the timer｜预设定时器 ; preset temperature｜预设温度 ; factory presets｜出厂预设
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为preset；现在分词为presetting。

meanings_zh: n. 贸易保护主义
definition_en: Government policies restricting imports to protect domestic businesses from foreign competition.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on trade protectionism.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论贸易保护主义。
example2_en: A campus survey used trade protectionism to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用贸易保护主义来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: trade protectionism｜贸易保护主义 ; rising protectionism｜日益抬头的保护主义 ; resort to protectionism｜诉诸保护主义
tip_zh: 不可数名词，特指贸易政策，不是一般的保护。

meanings_zh: n. 精神病学；精神科医疗
definition_en: the medical study and treatment of mental illnesses
example1_en: The textbook introduces a career in psychiatry in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精神科职业生涯。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a career in psychiatry.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得精神科职业生涯这个例子。
collocations: a career in psychiatry｜精神科职业生涯 ; child psychiatry｜儿童精神病学 ; clinical psychiatry｜临床精神病学
tip_zh: 词首p不发音；精神科医生通常有医学资质。

meanings_zh: n. 游牧民；漂泊者
definition_en: Someone who moves between places rather than living permanently somewhere
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about digital nomad.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于数字游民的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects digital nomad with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把数字游民和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: digital nomad｜数字游民 ; desert nomad｜沙漠游牧民 ; a nomad's life｜游牧生活
tip_zh: nomad通常作名词；形容词用nomadic。

meanings_zh: adj. 可行的；可实施的
definition_en: able to be done successfully in the circumstances
example1_en: I copied reasonably practicable into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把合理可行的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of reasonably practicable.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得合理可行的这个例子。
collocations: practicable solution｜可行的解决办法 ; reasonably practicable｜合理可行的 ; as soon as practicable｜在可行情况下尽快
tip_zh: practicable强调可实施；practical还可指实用的。

meanings_zh: v. 恶化；退化 | adj. 道德败坏的；退化的
definition_en: Become worse in quality, condition, or behaviour. | Having declined morally or lost normal structure or function.
example1_en: The assignment is to degenerate into, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先恶化为；演变成，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to degenerate into.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来恶化为；演变成。
collocations: degenerate into｜恶化为；演变成 ; degenerate rapidly｜迅速恶化
tip_zh: 动词尾音/reɪt/，形容词尾音/rət/；常接into。

meanings_zh: adv. 从而；借此
definition_en: as a result of the action just mentioned
example1_en: The professor told us to thereby reducing costs and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们从而降低成本，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will thereby reducing costs when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会从而降低成本。
collocations: thereby reducing costs｜从而降低成本 ; thereby improving efficiency｜从而提高效率 ; thereby enabling｜从而使……成为可能
tip_zh: 常用逗号加thereby doing，说明前述行为的结果。

meanings_zh: n. 损害；不利影响
definition_en: Harm or damage caused to someone or something.
example1_en: I copied a detriment to health into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把对健康的不利因素抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a detriment to health when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了对健康的不利因素。
collocations: to the detriment of｜有损于 ; without detriment to｜不损害 ; a detriment to health｜对健康的不利因素
tip_zh: 最常见于to the detriment of，表示以损害……为代价。

meanings_zh: n. 职业失当；渎职
definition_en: careless, improper, or illegal professional conduct, especially in medicine
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on medical malpractice.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医疗失当。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medical malpractice.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论医疗失当的材料。
collocations: medical malpractice｜医疗失当 ; professional malpractice｜职业失当 ; malpractice lawsuit｜医疗失当诉讼
tip_zh: 多指专业人员失职，尤用于医疗，并非普通错误。

meanings_zh: adj. 确凿的；决定性的
definition_en: proving something clearly and leaving no reasonable doubt
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about conclusive evidence.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于确凿证据的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around conclusive evidence.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕确凿证据展开说明。
collocations: conclusive evidence｜确凿证据 ; conclusive proof｜确凿的证明 ; conclusive results｜确定无疑的结果
tip_zh: 常修饰evidence或proof，不等于“最后的”。

meanings_zh: n. 惰性；缺乏行动力 | n. 惯性
definition_en: A tendency to remain inactive or resist change. | Matter's tendency to resist changes in its speed or direction.
example1_en: I copied institutional inertia into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把制度惰性抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to institutional inertia when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了制度惰性。
collocations: institutional inertia｜制度惰性 ; overcome inertia｜克服惰性 ; the inertia of an object｜物体的惯性
tip_zh: 不可数名词：既指物理惯性，也指不愿改变的惰性。

meanings_zh: v. 商议；协商 | v. 授予；赋予
definition_en: Discuss something with others before making a decision. | Officially give someone an honour, right, or benefit.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer confer with colleagues during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时与同事商议。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to confer with colleagues.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与同事商议。
collocations: confer with colleagues｜与同事商议 ; confer a degree on someone｜授予某人学位 ; confer benefits on｜给……带来益处
tip_zh: 商议用confer with；授予用confer sth on sb。

meanings_zh: adj. 充满仇恨的；恶意的 | adj. 可恶的；令人厌恶的
definition_en: expressing strong hatred or a wish to hurt others | extremely unpleasant and deserving strong dislike
example1_en: Office hours began with hateful remarks.
example1_zh: 答疑从恶意言论开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hateful remarks.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论恶意言论的材料。
collocations: hateful remarks｜恶意言论 ; hateful behaviour｜充满恶意的行为 ; hateful speech｜仇恨言论
tip_zh: 可形容充满仇恨的言行，也可指令人厌恶的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 计策；花招
definition_en: A clever action intended to gain an advantage.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on marketing ploy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论营销花招。
example2_en: The reading connects marketing ploy with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把营销花招和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: marketing ploy｜营销花招 ; a clever ploy｜巧妙的计策 ; a tactical ploy｜战术手段
tip_zh: 常含耍花招之意，比普通的plan更有算计意味。

meanings_zh: n. 气雾剂；喷雾罐 | n. 气溶胶
definition_en: A pressurised container that releases liquid as a fine spray. | Tiny solid particles or liquid droplets suspended in a gas.
example1_en: Our professor circled an aerosol can on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了喷雾罐。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of an aerosol can.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得喷雾罐这个例子。
collocations: an aerosol can｜喷雾罐 ; an aerosol spray｜气雾喷剂 ; atmospheric aerosols｜大气气溶胶 ; aerosol particles｜气溶胶颗粒
tip_zh: 日常可指喷雾罐；科学语境指气体中的悬浮微粒。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦急万分的；慌乱的 | adj. 紧张忙乱的
definition_en: Extremely worried or frightened and unable to stay calm | Done very quickly with intense, often uncontrolled activity
example1_en: The textbook introduces a frantic search in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了焦急的搜寻。
example2_en: The author returns to a frantic search when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了焦急的搜寻。
collocations: a frantic search｜焦急的搜寻 ; frantic efforts｜紧张急切的努力 ; a frantic pace｜紧张忙乱的节奏 ; frantic with worry｜担心得心急如焚
tip_zh: 强调焦急失控或忙乱，不等于精神失常。

meanings_zh: n. 制品；器皿 | n. 待售商品
definition_en: Objects made from a particular material or for a particular use. | Goods offered for sale, usually called wares.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about ceramic ware.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于陶瓷制品的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to ceramic ware when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了陶瓷制品。
collocations: ceramic ware｜陶瓷制品 ; glazed ware｜上釉陶器 ; sell one's wares｜出售自己的商品
tip_zh: 指待售商品通常用wares；ware常见于复合词。

meanings_zh: adj. 严谨的；缜密的 | adj. 严格的；要求高的
definition_en: extremely careful and thorough | demanding strict effort or obedience to rules
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rigorous testing.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论严格测试。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rigorous testing.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严格测试的材料。
collocations: rigorous testing｜严格测试 ; rigorous analysis｜严谨分析 ; rigorous training｜严格训练
tip_zh: 研究、测试用它强调严谨；训练、标准强调严格。

meanings_zh: adj. 无正当理由的；无根据的
definition_en: not justified by the facts or circumstances
example1_en: Our professor circled unwarranted criticism on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了无端的批评。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around unwarranted criticism.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕无端的批评展开说明。
collocations: unwarranted criticism｜无端的批评 ; unwarranted assumptions｜无根据的假设 ; unwarranted interference｜无理干涉
tip_zh: 强调缺乏依据或正当理由，不只是“不需要”。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；享有盛誉的
definition_en: Widely known and admired for a particular quality or achievement.
example1_en: Office hours began with internationally renowned.
example1_zh: 答疑从享有国际声誉的开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around internationally renowned.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕享有国际声誉的展开说明。
collocations: renowned for｜以……闻名 ; internationally renowned｜享有国际声誉的 ; a renowned expert｜知名专家
tip_zh: renowned for接成就或特色；renowned as接身份。

meanings_zh: v. 谴责 | v. 判处刑罚 | v. 宣告建筑不宜使用
definition_en: To express strong disapproval of someone or something. | To officially give someone a severe punishment. | To officially declare a building unsafe to use.
example1_en: The assignment is to condemn a building, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先宣告建筑不宜使用，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to condemn a building.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得宣告建筑不宜使用。
collocations: strongly condemn｜强烈谴责 ; condemn someone to prison｜判某人入狱 ; condemn a building｜宣告建筑不宜使用
tip_zh: 词尾n不发音；别与表示“冷凝”的condense混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 船主；船舶所有者
definition_en: A person or company that owns ships.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about private shipowner.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于私人船主的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of private shipowner.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得私人船主这个例子。
collocations: private shipowner｜私人船主 ; shipowner liability｜船主责任 ; shipowners' association｜船东协会
tip_zh: 指拥有船的人或公司，不等于驾驶船的船长。

meanings_zh: n. 冰雹 | v. 下冰雹 | v. 称赞为；招呼
definition_en: small balls of ice that fall from clouds | to fall from the sky as small balls of ice | to praise someone publicly or call to attract attention
example1_en: Office hours began with heavy hail.
example1_zh: 答疑从猛烈的冰雹开始。
example2_en: The author returns to heavy hail when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了猛烈的冰雹。
collocations: heavy hail｜猛烈的冰雹 ; hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车 ; be hailed as a breakthrough｜被誉为一项突破
tip_zh: 下冰雹用it hails；hail A as B指称赞A为B。

meanings_zh: n. 枪支；火器
definition_en: A weapon that fires bullets using an explosive charge.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about firearm safety.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于枪支安全的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around firearm safety.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕枪支安全展开说明。
collocations: firearm safety｜枪支安全 ; firearm ownership｜枪支持有 ; firearm regulations｜枪支管理规定
tip_zh: 可数名词，常见复数firearms，语体较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 报酬；酬金
definition_en: payment received for work or services
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fair remuneration.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公平的报酬。
example2_en: The author returns to fair remuneration when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公平的报酬。
collocations: fair remuneration｜公平的报酬 ; remuneration package｜薪酬待遇 ; remuneration for services｜服务报酬
tip_zh: 正式用语，通常不可数，指工作报酬而非损害赔偿。

meanings_zh: n. 锌
definition_en: A bluish-white metal also needed in small amounts for health.
example1_en: Office hours began with zinc deficiency.
example1_zh: 答疑从缺锌开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used zinc deficiency to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用缺锌来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: zinc deficiency｜缺锌 ; zinc supplements｜锌补充剂 ; zinc coating｜锌涂层 ; zinc oxide｜氧化锌
tip_zh: 锌是化学元素，符号Zn；作物质名通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 达到；实现；获得
definition_en: To reach a goal or level, usually through effort.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to attain a goal.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求实现目标。
example2_en: The passage says students who can attain a goal follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够实现目标的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: attain a goal｜实现目标 ; attain a high standard｜达到高标准 ; attain independence｜获得独立
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，直接接目标或水平，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 露水
definition_en: Small water drops forming on cool surfaces, especially overnight
example1_en: Office hours began with morning dew.
example1_zh: 答疑从晨露开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss morning dew.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论晨露的材料。
collocations: morning dew｜晨露 ; heavy dew｜浓露 ; covered in dew｜覆着露水
tip_zh: dew通常不可数；一滴露水用a drop of dew。

meanings_zh: v. 抑制；忍住 | v. 镇压；压制 | v. 隐瞒；禁止发表
definition_en: To prevent a feeling or physical reaction from being expressed. | To stop an activity or opposition, often using force. | To prevent information from becoming known or being published.
example1_en: The professor asked us to suppress a smile.
example1_zh: 教授让我们忍住笑。
example2_en: The reading asks you to suppress a smile and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你忍住笑，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: suppress a smile｜忍住笑 ; suppress information｜隐瞒信息 ; suppress opposition｜压制反对意见 ; suppress appetite｜抑制食欲
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接情绪、反应、活动或信息。

meanings_zh: n. 低价倾销 | n. 倾倒；乱扔废弃物
definition_en: Selling goods abroad below normal value, often harming local producers | Leaving unwanted material somewhere, often illegally or carelessly
example1_en: Office hours began with illegal dumping.
example1_zh: 答疑从非法倾倒开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss illegal dumping.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论非法倾倒的材料。
collocations: anti-dumping measures｜反倾销措施 ; dumping allegations｜倾销指控 ; illegal dumping｜非法倾倒 ; waste dumping｜废物倾倒
tip_zh: 贸易中指低于正常价值的出口销售，并非所有降价促销。

meanings_zh: adj. 巧妙的；有独创性的
definition_en: Using clever, original ideas to solve problems or make things.
example1_en: Our professor circled an ingenious solution on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了巧妙的解决办法。
example2_en: The reading connects an ingenious solution with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把巧妙的解决办法和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an ingenious solution｜巧妙的解决办法 ; an ingenious device｜精巧的装置 ; an ingenious design｜巧妙的设计
tip_zh: 勿混淆：ingenious是巧妙的，ingenuous是天真的。

meanings_zh: v. 解放；使自由 | v. 使摆脱束缚
definition_en: To free people or places from control or imprisonment. | To release someone from restrictions that limit their life.
example1_en: The professor asked us to liberate a country.
example1_zh: 教授让我们解放一个国家。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to liberate a country.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们解放一个国家。
collocations: liberate a country｜解放一个国家 ; liberate someone from｜使某人摆脱 ; liberating experience｜令人感到自由的经历
tip_zh: 及物动词；liberate A from B表示使A摆脱B。

meanings_zh: n. 士气；集体信心
definition_en: the confidence and enthusiasm of a group
example1_en: The textbook introduces boost morale in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了鼓舞士气。
example2_en: The reading connects boost morale with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把鼓舞士气和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: boost morale｜鼓舞士气 ; low morale｜士气低落 ; staff morale｜员工士气
tip_zh: 不可数；morale指士气，moral指道德的。

meanings_zh: n. 学校教育
definition_en: Education received at school.
example1_en: Our professor circled formal schooling on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了正规学校教育。
example2_en: The author returns to formal schooling when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了正规学校教育。
collocations: formal schooling｜正规学校教育 ; compulsory schooling｜义务教育 ; years of schooling｜受学校教育的年数 ; complete one's schooling｜完成学业
tip_zh: schooling通常不可数，侧重在校接受的教育。

meanings_zh: adj. 即将发生的；迫近的
definition_en: Expected to happen very soon.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on imminent danger.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论迫在眉睫的危险。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around imminent danger.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕迫在眉睫的危险展开说明。
collocations: imminent danger｜迫在眉睫的危险 ; an imminent threat｜迫近的威胁 ; imminent collapse｜即将发生的倒塌
tip_zh: 强调即将发生，不等于urgent（需紧急处理）。

meanings_zh: adj. 应支付的；到期应付的 | adj. 应付给某人的
definition_en: Required to be paid at a specified time | Intended to be paid to a particular person or organisation
example1_en: Our professor circled payable in advance on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了须预付的。
example2_en: A campus survey used payable in advance to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用须预付的来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: payable in advance｜须预付的 ; payable on demand｜见索即付的 ; payable to｜应付给……的 ; payable in instalments｜可分期支付的
tip_zh: payable to后接收款人；payable in后可接币种。

meanings_zh: n. 小树林；果树林
definition_en: a small group of trees, often planted together
example1_en: Our professor circled olive grove on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了橄榄园。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss olive grove.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论橄榄园的材料。
collocations: olive grove｜橄榄园 ; orange grove｜橙园 ; a grove of trees｜一片小树林
tip_zh: grove是一小片树木，常用于橄榄、柑橘等果树林。

meanings_zh: adj. 勤奋的；认真尽责的
definition_en: Working carefully and consistently with strong effort
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about diligent student.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于勤奋的学生的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of diligent student.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得勤奋的学生这个例子。
collocations: diligent student｜勤奋的学生 ; diligent research｜认真细致的研究 ; diligent in one's work｜工作认真尽责
tip_zh: 不仅指努力，也强调认真、细致和持续投入。

meanings_zh: v. 传播；宣传 | v. 繁殖；使增殖
definition_en: To spread ideas, beliefs, or information among people. | To produce new plants or organisms from existing ones.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer propagate ideas during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时传播观念。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to propagate ideas.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来传播观念。
collocations: propagate ideas｜传播观念 ; propagate misinformation｜传播错误信息 ; propagate plants｜繁殖植物 ; propagate from cuttings｜通过扦插繁殖
tip_zh: 既可指传播观念，也可指繁殖植物；语体较正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 定量的；数量的
definition_en: relating to amounts that can be measured or counted
example1_en: Office hours began with quantitative research.
example1_zh: 答疑从定量研究开始。
example2_en: The author returns to quantitative research when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了定量研究。
collocations: quantitative research｜定量研究 ; quantitative analysis｜定量分析 ; quantitative data｜定量数据
tip_zh: quantitative 重数量测量；qualitative 重性质描述。

meanings_zh: adj. 冗长的；啰唆的
definition_en: Using more words than are needed to express something.
example1_en: Office hours began with overly wordy.
example1_zh: 答疑从过于冗长的开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used overly wordy to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用过于冗长的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: wordy explanation｜冗长的解释 ; wordy sentence｜啰唆的句子 ; overly wordy｜过于冗长的
tip_zh: 通常含贬义，指用词过多，而非词汇丰富。

meanings_zh: n. 核反应堆 | n. 反应器
definition_en: a device that controls nuclear reactions to produce energy | a container in which controlled chemical reactions take place
example1_en: Office hours began with nuclear reactor.
example1_zh: 答疑从核反应堆开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of nuclear reactor.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得核反应堆这个例子。
collocations: nuclear reactor｜核反应堆 ; reactor core｜反应堆堆芯 ; chemical reactor｜化学反应器
tip_zh: 能源话题中常指核反应堆；化工中也指反应器。

meanings_zh: n. 大屠杀 | v. 屠杀
definition_en: The deliberate killing of many people, especially those unable to defend themselves. | To deliberately kill many people, especially those unable to defend themselves.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a brutal massacre.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于残酷的大屠杀的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a brutal massacre to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用残酷的大屠杀来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a brutal massacre｜残酷的大屠杀 ; massacre victims｜大屠杀遇难者 ; commemorate a massacre｜纪念大屠杀事件
tip_zh: 指大规模残杀，语气极重；勿用于一般伤亡事件。

meanings_zh: v. 预示；宣告到来 | n. 先兆；传令官
definition_en: To signal that something new or important is coming. | A sign of something approaching, or an official messenger.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to herald a new era.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须预示新时代的到来。
example2_en: When the class discussed public communication, the speaker told us to herald a new era.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共传播时，讲者让我们预示新时代的到来。
collocations: herald a new era｜预示新时代的到来 ; herald the arrival of｜预示……的到来 ; be heralded as a breakthrough｜被誉为突破
tip_zh: 不是副词；be heralded as意为“被誉为”。

meanings_zh: adj. 纪律处分的 | adj. 学科的
definition_en: relating to punishment for breaking rules | relating to a particular field of academic study
example1_en: I copied disciplinary action into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把纪律处分抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects disciplinary action with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把纪律处分和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: disciplinary action｜纪律处分 ; disciplinary hearing｜纪律听证会 ; disciplinary procedures｜纪律处分程序 ; disciplinary boundaries｜学科界限
tip_zh: 常见于disciplinary action，指纪律处分措施。

meanings_zh: n. 种植园 | n. 人工林
definition_en: A large farm growing crops such as tea, coffee, or cotton. | An area where trees are planted together, often for timber.
example1_en: The textbook introduces tea plantation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了茶叶种植园。
example2_en: The author returns to tea plantation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了茶叶种植园。
collocations: tea plantation｜茶叶种植园 ; coffee plantation｜咖啡种植园 ; plantation workers｜种植园工人 ; forest plantation｜人工林
tip_zh: 通常指大面积种植单类作物的农场，不是普通花园。

meanings_zh: v. 模仿；模拟 | n. 善于模仿他人者
definition_en: to copy someone's behaviour or reproduce something's features | a person skilled at copying other people's voices or behaviour
example1_en: The assignment is to mimic someone's voice, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先模仿某人的声音，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers mimic someone's voice before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要模仿某人的声音。
collocations: mimic someone's voice｜模仿某人的声音 ; mimic natural processes｜模拟自然过程 ; a talented mimic｜有天赋的模仿者
tip_zh: 过去式mimicked，进行时mimicking，均加k。

meanings_zh: adj. 精心制作的；复杂的 | v. 详细说明；阐述
definition_en: Containing many carefully arranged details or parts. | To explain something further by adding more details.
example1_en: The textbook introduces an elaborate design in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精细的设计。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an elaborate design.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论精细的设计的材料。
collocations: an elaborate design｜精细的设计 ; an elaborate plan｜周密复杂的计划 ; elaborate on a point｜详细阐述某一点
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；elaborate on表示详细阐述。

meanings_zh: n. 力学 | n. 操作方法；技术细节
definition_en: The study of forces and how objects move | The practical details of how something works or is done
example1_en: The textbook introduces classical mechanics in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经典力学。
example2_en: A campus survey used classical mechanics to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经典力学来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: classical mechanics｜经典力学 ; fluid mechanics｜流体力学 ; the mechanics of voting｜投票的具体操作流程
tip_zh: 指力学时用单数谓语；指操作细节时用复数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 男技工；男手艺人 | n. 男店主；男商人
definition_en: A man skilled in practical work such as plumbing or carpentry. | A man who buys and sells goods, especially a shopkeeper.
example1_en: Office hours began with a skilled tradesman.
example1_zh: 答疑从熟练技工开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a skilled tradesman when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了熟练技工。
collocations: a skilled tradesman｜熟练技工 ; a qualified tradesman｜有资质的技工 ; a local tradesman｜当地手艺人
tip_zh: 复数为tradesmen；性别中性表达用tradesperson。

meanings_zh: adj. 英勇的；英雄般的 | adj. 极其艰巨的；奋力的
definition_en: Showing great courage, especially when helping others | Involving extraordinary effort or determination
example1_en: The textbook introduces heroic act in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了英勇行为。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss heroic act.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论英勇行为的材料。
collocations: heroic act｜英勇行为 ; heroic rescue｜英勇救援 ; heroic effort｜极大的努力
tip_zh: heroic effort强调付出极大努力，不一定涉及危险。

meanings_zh: n. 小提琴 | v. 摆弄；拨弄 | v. 篡改以作弊
definition_en: a violin, especially when used for folk music | keep moving or touching something without a clear purpose | dishonestly change information to gain an advantage
example1_en: After the lecture, we used fiddle in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了小提琴。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up fiddle while discussing evidence about the humanities.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人文学科的证据时提到了小提琴。
collocations: play the fiddle｜拉小提琴 ; fiddle with a pen｜摆弄钢笔 ; fiddle the accounts｜篡改账目
tip_zh: 指小提琴时较口语；fiddle with表示摆弄。

meanings_zh: v. 利用；使用
definition_en: to use something effectively for a particular purpose
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to utilise resources.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须利用资源。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to utilise resources.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得利用资源。
collocations: utilise resources｜利用资源 ; fully utilise｜充分利用 ; utilise technology｜利用技术
tip_zh: 英式拼写，也写作utilize；日常表达常用use。

meanings_zh: v. 大量消耗；使枯竭
definition_en: to greatly reduce the amount of something available
example1_en: The professor asked us to deplete resources.
example1_zh: 教授让我们消耗资源。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to deplete resources.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来消耗资源。
collocations: deplete resources｜消耗资源 ; deplete energy reserves｜消耗能量储备 ; deplete stocks｜消耗库存
tip_zh: 强调存量大幅减少，不一定完全耗尽。

meanings_zh: adj. 战略性的；策略性的 | adj. 具有战略意义的
definition_en: relating to plans for achieving important long-term goals | especially useful for gaining an advantage
example1_en: Our professor circled strategic planning on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了战略规划。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around strategic planning.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕战略规划展开说明。
collocations: strategic planning｜战略规划 ; strategic decision｜战略决策 ; strategic location｜战略要地 ; strategic investment｜战略性投资
tip_zh: strategic重整体长远规划，tactical重具体战术。

meanings_zh: v. 驱赶；击退 | v. 排斥；不吸收 | v. 使厌恶
definition_en: Force someone or something to move away. | Push something away or prevent it from being absorbed. | Make someone feel strong dislike or disgust.
example1_en: The assignment is to repel insects, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先驱虫，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to repel insects and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你驱虫，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: repel insects｜驱虫 ; repel an attack｜击退进攻 ; repel water｜防水 ; repel each other｜相互排斥
tip_zh: 过去式 repelled，动名词 repelling，双写l。

meanings_zh: n. 业主；经营者
definition_en: The owner of a business, such as a shop or hotel.
example1_en: Our professor circled sole proprietor on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了独资经营者。
example2_en: The author returns to sole proprietor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了独资经营者。
collocations: sole proprietor｜独资经营者 ; shop proprietor｜店主 ; hotel proprietor｜旅馆业主
tip_zh: 较正式，常指商店、旅馆等生意的所有者。

meanings_zh: v. 吸收并理解 | v. 融入；使同化
definition_en: To take in and fully understand new information or ideas. | To become, or make someone become, part of a cultural group.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to assimilate information.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何吸收信息。
example2_en: The passage says students who can assimilate information follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够吸收信息的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: assimilate information｜吸收信息 ; assimilate new ideas｜理解新思想 ; assimilate into society｜融入社会
tip_zh: 知识可直接作宾语；融入群体常用into。

meanings_zh: n. 营养不良
definition_en: poor health caused by insufficient or unbalanced nutrients
example1_en: Office hours began with suffer from malnutrition.
example1_zh: 答疑从患营养不良开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used suffer from malnutrition to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用患营养不良来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: suffer from malnutrition｜患营养不良 ; severe malnutrition｜严重营养不良 ; prevent malnutrition｜预防营养不良
tip_zh: 不可数；不仅指吃得少，也包括营养摄入失衡。

meanings_zh: n. 医务室；医院
definition_en: A hospital or room providing medical care within an institution.
example1_en: Office hours began with school infirmary.
example1_zh: 答疑从学校医务室开始。
example2_en: The reading connects school infirmary with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把学校医务室和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: school infirmary｜学校医务室 ; infirmary bed｜医务室病床
tip_zh: 常指机构内的医务室；英国部分医院也用此名。

meanings_zh: v. 点燃；开始燃烧 | v. 激起；唤起
definition_en: To start a fire or begin to burn. | To cause a feeling or interest to develop.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to kindle a fire.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求生火。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to kindle a fire.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来生火。
collocations: kindle a fire｜生火 ; kindle interest｜激发兴趣 ; kindle hope｜燃起希望
tip_zh: 较正式或文学化；既能点火，也能激起兴趣。

meanings_zh: adv. 遗憾地；惋惜地
definition_en: In a way that expresses sadness or disappointment about something.
example1_en: The professor told us to regretfully decline and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们遗憾地谢绝，然后比较笔记。
