example2_en: A lecture on human behavior asks the class to regretfully decline before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先遗憾地谢绝。
collocations: regretfully decline｜遗憾地谢绝 ; regretfully admit｜遗憾地承认 ; regretfully announce｜遗憾地宣布
tip_zh: regretfully强调人的遗憾；regrettably评价事情可惜。

meanings_zh: n. 宁静；平和
definition_en: a peaceful state without noise, worry, or disturbance
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sense of tranquility in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宁静感。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of tranquility.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕宁静感展开说明。
collocations: a sense of tranquility｜宁静感 ; peace and tranquility｜安宁与平静 ; enjoy the tranquility｜享受宁静
tip_zh: 美式常拼tranquility，英式常拼tranquillity。

meanings_zh: n. 英镑；英国货币 | adj. 优秀可靠的；杰出的 | adj. 标准纯度银制的
definition_en: the currency of the United Kingdom | excellent in quality and deserving admiration | made of silver containing at least 92.5 percent pure silver
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about pounds sterling.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于英镑的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects pounds sterling with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把英镑和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pounds sterling｜英镑 ; sterling silver｜标准纯银 ; sterling work｜出色的工作 ; sterling qualities｜优秀品质
tip_zh: sterling silver通常含银92.5%，并非百分之百纯银。

meanings_zh: adj. 可运转的；可使用的 | adj. 运营的；运作的
definition_en: ready and able to work or be used | relating to how an organization or system runs
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fully operational.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论全面投入运作的。
example2_en: The reading connects fully operational with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把全面投入运作的和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: fully operational｜全面投入运作的 ; become operational｜开始投入使用 ; operational costs｜运营成本 ; operational efficiency｜运营效率
tip_zh: 可指设备已能使用，也可指机构的日常运营。

meanings_zh: v. 分配；拨出
definition_en: To assign resources to particular people, activities, or purposes.
example1_en: The professor asked us to allocate resources.
example1_zh: 教授让我们分配资源。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to allocate resources.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来分配资源。
collocations: allocate resources｜分配资源 ; allocate funds to｜向…拨款 ; allocate time for｜为…安排时间
tip_zh: allocate sth to sb/sth表示将某物分配给某人或某项用途。

meanings_zh: v. 极力赞扬 | v. 愤怒叫嚷；胡言乱语 | n. 电子舞曲狂欢派对
definition_en: to speak with great enthusiasm about something | to speak wildly or angrily in an uncontrolled way | a large party where people dance to electronic music
example1_en: The professor asked us to rave about.
example1_zh: 教授让我们对……赞不绝口。
example2_en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers rave about before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要对……赞不绝口。
collocations: rave about｜对……赞不绝口 ; rave reviews｜热烈的好评 ; rant and rave｜怒气冲冲地叫嚷
tip_zh: rave about 多指赞不绝口，不是对某事咆哮。

meanings_zh: v. 抄袭；剽窃
definition_en: present another person's words or ideas as your own
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to plagiarize an essay.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何抄袭文章。
example2_en: The passage says students who can plagiarize an essay follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够抄袭文章的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: plagiarize an essay｜抄袭文章 ; plagiarize someone's work｜剽窃某人的作品 ; plagiarize from a source｜从某一来源抄袭
tip_zh: 英式也拼plagiarise；引用他人内容须注明来源。

meanings_zh: v. 起源；源自 | v. 创立；首创
definition_en: to begin or come from a particular place or situation | to create or introduce something new
example1_en: I heard the lecturer originate in during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时起源于。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to originate in.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来起源于。
collocations: originate in｜起源于 ; originate from｜源自 ; originate with｜由……首创
tip_zh: 表示起源常接in或from；不要误当作航行出发。

meanings_zh: n. 大片土地；地带 | n. 道；束等身体结构 | n. 宣教或政论小册子
definition_en: a large area of land | a connected system of organs or tissues with a shared function | a short publication expressing religious or political ideas
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the digestive tract.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论消化道。
example2_en: The author returns to the digestive tract when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了消化道。
collocations: a tract of land｜一大片土地 ; vast tracts of forest｜大片森林 ; the digestive tract｜消化道 ; the respiratory tract｜呼吸道
tip_zh: 土地义常用a tract of；勿与track“轨道”混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；知名的
definition_en: well known and admired for a particular quality or achievement
example1_en: Our professor circled a noted scholar on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了著名学者。
example2_en: A campus survey used a noted scholar to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用著名学者来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: be noted for｜以……闻名 ; a noted scholar｜著名学者 ; a noted expert｜知名专家
tip_zh: be noted for后接闻名的原因或特色。

meanings_zh: n. 矛盾；不一致 | n. 反驳；否认
definition_en: A difference between statements or facts that cannot both be true | The act of saying that a statement is wrong
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a contradiction between.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于……之间的矛盾的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a contradiction between.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕……之间的矛盾展开说明。
collocations: a contradiction between｜……之间的矛盾 ; in contradiction to｜与……相矛盾 ; a contradiction in terms｜用语上的自相矛盾
tip_zh: 常用a contradiction between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 原型；样机 | v. 制作原型
definition_en: An early model used to test and develop a product. | To create an early model for testing and improvement.
example1_en: Office hours began with a working prototype.
example1_zh: 答疑从可运行的原型开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a working prototype with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可运行的原型和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: build a prototype｜制作原型 ; test a prototype｜测试原型 ; a working prototype｜可运行的原型
tip_zh: 通常指用于测试改进的早期模型，并非最终产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 有罪的；违背宗教戒律的
definition_en: Morally wrong, especially according to religious beliefs
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about sinful behaviour.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于罪恶的行为的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects sinful behaviour with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把罪恶的行为和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: sinful behaviour｜罪恶的行为 ; sinful act｜违背宗教戒律的行为 ; sinful thoughts｜罪恶的念头
tip_zh: 常带宗教意味；一般的“违法”用illegal。

meanings_zh: adj. 颗粒状的 | adj. 细致的；详细的
definition_en: consisting of small grains or particles | including many small, specific details
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on granular material.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论颗粒状材料。
example2_en: The author returns to granular material when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了颗粒状材料。
collocations: granular material｜颗粒状材料 ; granular data｜细粒度数据 ; granular detail｜细致的细节
tip_zh: 既指颗粒状，也指数据或分析细致到小单位。

meanings_zh: v. 蒸馏；用蒸馏法提取 | v. 提炼；概括精华
definition_en: Purify a liquid by heating it and cooling its vapour. | Extract the most important ideas from something complex.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to distil water.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求蒸馏水。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to distil water.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得蒸馏水。
collocations: distil water｜蒸馏水 ; distil information｜提炼信息 ; distil something into｜将某物提炼为
tip_zh: 英式distil，美式distill；过去式均为distilled。

meanings_zh: n. 谨慎；审慎 | n. 自行决定权
definition_en: care in speaking or acting to avoid embarrassment or harm | the freedom to decide what should be done
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on exercise discretion.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论谨慎行事；行使酌处权。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of exercise discretion.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得谨慎行事；行使酌处权这个例子。
collocations: exercise discretion｜谨慎行事；行使酌处权 ; at your discretion｜由你酌情决定 ; professional discretion｜专业判断权
tip_zh: at someone's discretion表示“由某人酌情决定”。

meanings_zh: n. 补贴；补助金
definition_en: Money provided to support activities or keep prices lower.
example1_en: Office hours began with government subsidy.
example1_zh: 答疑从政府补贴开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used government subsidy to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用政府补贴来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: government subsidy｜政府补贴 ; agricultural subsidies｜农业补贴 ; receive a subsidy｜领取补贴 ; subsidy scheme｜补贴计划
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为subsidies；常与for搭配。

meanings_zh: v. 枯萎；使干枯 | v. 衰退；逐渐消失
definition_en: To become dry and weak, or cause plants to do so. | To gradually lose strength, importance, or effectiveness.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to wither away.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求逐渐衰败。
example2_en: The reading asks you to wither away and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你逐渐衰败，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: wither away｜逐渐衰败 ; wither in the heat｜在高温下枯萎 ; wither and die｜枯萎死亡
tip_zh: 植物枯萎或事业衰退均可用，常与away连用。

meanings_zh: n. 话语；言论 | n. 说出；发声
definition_en: Something spoken, such as a word, phrase, or sentence. | The act of expressing something through speech.
example1_en: I copied a single utterance into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把一句话语抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a single utterance.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一句话语的材料。
collocations: a single utterance｜一句话语 ; a spontaneous utterance｜自发的话语 ; give utterance to｜说出；表达
tip_zh: 语言学中指一次说出的话，不一定是完整句子。

meanings_zh: n. 海洋学
definition_en: The scientific study of oceans and their physical and biological processes.
example1_en: I copied physical oceanography into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把物理海洋学抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to physical oceanography when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了物理海洋学。
collocations: physical oceanography｜物理海洋学 ; biological oceanography｜生物海洋学 ; study oceanography｜学习海洋学
tip_zh: 学科名称，通常不可数；海洋学家是oceanographer。

meanings_zh: v. 估计；判断；测量 | n. 测量仪；计量器 | n. 标准宽度；轨距
definition_en: To judge or measure the amount, level, or nature of something | An instrument that measures an amount, level, or pressure | A standard width or thickness, especially between railway rails
example1_en: The professor asked us to gauge public opinion.
example1_zh: 教授让我们了解公众意见。
example2_en: The reading asks you to gauge public opinion and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你了解公众意见，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: gauge public opinion｜了解公众意见 ; gauge the impact｜评估影响 ; a pressure gauge｜压力计 ; a fuel gauge｜燃油表
tip_zh: 读音同gage；既可用仪器测量，也可凭信息判断。

meanings_zh: v. 表示；意味着 | v. 示意；表达
definition_en: to mean something or be a sign of it | to make a feeling or intention known through an action
example1_en: The professor asked us to signify a change.
example1_zh: 教授让我们意味着变化。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to signify a change.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们意味着变化。
collocations: signify a change｜意味着变化 ; signify approval｜表示赞同 ; signify that｜意味着
tip_zh: signify较正式，常接名词或that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 弥漫；遍布 | v. 渗入；渗透
definition_en: Spread throughout a place, group, or situation. | Pass into or through the tiny spaces in a material.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to permeate society.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须渗透社会各处。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to permeate society.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们渗透社会各处。
collocations: permeate society｜渗透社会各处 ; permeate every aspect of｜渗透……的各个方面 ; permeate through｜渗透穿过
tip_zh: 可直接接宾语；气味弥漫房间无需加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 偏执；被害妄想
definition_en: An unfounded belief that others intend to harm you.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on experience paranoia.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论出现偏执症状。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss experience paranoia.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论出现偏执症状的材料。
collocations: experience paranoia｜出现偏执症状 ; feelings of paranoia｜受迫害的疑惧感 ; paranoia about surveillance｜对被监视的过度疑惧
tip_zh: 通常不可数；指心理状态，不指患有此症的人。

meanings_zh: n. 征服者
definition_en: someone who takes control of a place through military force
example1_en: I copied a foreign conqueror into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把外来征服者抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a foreign conqueror when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了外来征服者。
collocations: a foreign conqueror｜外来征服者 ; a military conqueror｜军事征服者
tip_zh: 指通过武力征服的人，不泛指比赛获胜者。

meanings_zh: n. 海角；岬 | n. 披风；斗篷
definition_en: a piece of land extending into the sea | a sleeveless outer garment hanging loosely from the shoulders
example1_en: The textbook introduces a rocky cape in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了岩石海角。
example2_en: The author returns to a rocky cape when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了岩石海角。
collocations: a rocky cape｜岩石海角 ; round the cape｜绕过海角 ; a woollen cape｜羊毛披风
tip_zh: cape既可指海角，也可指无袖披风。

meanings_zh: v. 逐渐削弱；损害 | v. 侵蚀底部；破坏地基
definition_en: To gradually weaken someone's confidence, authority, or something's effectiveness | To weaken a structure by removing material beneath it
example1_en: I heard the lecturer undermine confidence during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时削弱信心。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to undermine confidence.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得削弱信心。
collocations: undermine confidence｜削弱信心 ; undermine authority｜损害权威 ; undermine public trust｜损害公众信任 ; undermine efforts｜使努力受损
tip_zh: 常搭配confidence、trust，强调逐渐或暗中削弱。

meanings_zh: n. 触手；触须
definition_en: a long flexible animal part used for touching or grasping
example1_en: I copied a long tentacle into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把长触手抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a long tentacle.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论长触手的材料。
collocations: a long tentacle｜长触手 ; octopus tentacles｜章鱼触手 ; extend a tentacle｜伸出触手
tip_zh: 章鱼、水母的触手用tentacle；昆虫触角用antenna。

meanings_zh: adv. 均匀地；一致地 | adv. 一律；无一例外地
definition_en: equally or in the same way throughout | in every case, without any exceptions
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to uniformly distributed.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习均匀分布的。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will uniformly distributed when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会均匀分布的。
collocations: uniformly distributed｜均匀分布的 ; apply uniformly｜统一适用 ; uniformly high｜一律很高的
tip_zh: 强调各处或各例相同，不只是时间上的经常。

meanings_zh: n. 生殖；繁殖 | n. 复制；再现 | n. 复制品
definition_en: The process by which living things produce young. | The process of copying an image, sound, or other material. | A copy of an original object or artwork.
example1_en: The textbook introduces sexual reproduction in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了有性生殖。
example2_en: A campus survey used sexual reproduction to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用有性生殖来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: sexual reproduction｜有性生殖 ; asexual reproduction｜无性生殖 ; sound reproduction｜声音重放 ; a reproduction of a painting｜一幅画的复制品
tip_zh: 指繁殖或复制过程时不可数；指一件复制品时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；视为
definition_en: To judge or consider someone or something in a particular way.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to deem necessary.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何认为有必要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to deem necessary and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你认为有必要，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: deem necessary｜认为有必要 ; deem appropriate｜认为合适 ; be deemed unsafe｜被认定为不安全
tip_zh: 正式用词，常用deem＋宾语＋形容词，多见被动式。

meanings_zh: n. 研究奖助金；研究员职位 | n. 友谊；伙伴情谊 | n. 协会；团体
definition_en: Funding or a position supporting advanced study or research. | Friendship and support among people with shared interests. | A group united by shared interests or beliefs.
example1_en: I copied research fellowship into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把研究奖助金或职位抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects research fellowship with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把研究奖助金或职位和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: research fellowship｜研究奖助金或职位 ; award a fellowship｜授予研究奖助金 ; a sense of fellowship｜伙伴情谊
tip_zh: 奖助金义通常可数；伙伴情谊义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 哀悼；服丧
definition_en: sadness expressed after someone's death
example1_en: Office hours began with a period of mourning.
example1_zh: 答疑从一段哀悼期开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a period of mourning.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一段哀悼期的材料。
collocations: in mourning｜在服丧中 ; a period of mourning｜一段哀悼期 ; national mourning｜全国哀悼
tip_zh: 与morning同音；in mourning表示正在服丧。

meanings_zh: n. 总理；首相；地区政府首脑 | adj. 首要的；最优秀的
definition_en: The head of a national or regional government. | Considered the best or most important of its kind.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the newly elected premier in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了新当选的政府首脑。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of the newly elected premier.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得新当选的政府首脑这个例子。
collocations: the newly elected premier｜新当选的政府首脑 ; a provincial premier｜省政府首脑 ; a premier research institution｜顶尖研究机构
tip_zh: premier可指政府首脑；premiere指首映或首演。

meanings_zh: n. 加速；加快 | n. 加速度
definition_en: the process of moving faster or happening more quickly | the rate at which velocity changes over time
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rapid acceleration.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论迅速加速。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of rapid acceleration.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得迅速加速这个例子。
collocations: rapid acceleration｜迅速加速 ; acceleration of growth｜增长的加速 ; constant acceleration｜恒定加速度
tip_zh: 物理中指速度变化率，方向改变也可产生加速度。

meanings_zh: v. 偏离；背离
definition_en: to move away from an expected route, standard, or plan
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to deviate from a plan.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何偏离计划。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to deviate from a plan.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来偏离计划。
collocations: deviate from a plan｜偏离计划 ; deviate from the norm｜偏离常规 ; deviate from a route｜偏离路线
tip_zh: 通常为不及物动词，用deviate from表示偏离。

meanings_zh: adj. 彬彬有礼的
definition_en: Polite and respectful towards other people.
example1_en: Office hours began with courteous service.
example1_zh: 答疑从礼貌周到的服务开始。
example2_en: The reading connects courteous service with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把礼貌周到的服务和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: courteous service｜礼貌周到的服务 ; courteous manner｜彬彬有礼的举止 ; courteous to customers｜对顾客有礼貌
tip_zh: 比polite更正式；对某人有礼貌用to。

meanings_zh: v. 责备；指责 | n. 责备；责备的话
definition_en: Express disappointment or criticism about someone's actions | An expression of disappointment or criticism
example1_en: I heard the lecturer reproach someone for during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时因……责备某人。
example2_en: The reading asks you to reproach someone for and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你因……责备某人，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: reproach someone for｜因……责备某人 ; beyond reproach｜无可指责 ; a look of reproach｜责备的眼神
tip_zh: 责备某人做某事：reproach sb for doing sth。

meanings_zh: n. 政权；政治体制 | n. 管理制度；生活安排
definition_en: a government or system of government, especially an authoritarian one | an organized system of rules or regular activities
example1_en: Our professor circled authoritarian regime on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了威权政权。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of authoritarian regime.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得威权政权这个例子。
collocations: authoritarian regime｜威权政权 ; tax regime｜税收制度 ; exercise regime｜锻炼计划
tip_zh: 指政权时常含贬义；也可指税制或锻炼安排。

meanings_zh: n. 二重唱；二重奏
definition_en: A musical piece or performance for two singers or players.
example1_en: Our professor circled a piano duet on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了钢琴二重奏。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a piano duet.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得钢琴二重奏这个例子。
collocations: sing a duet｜唱二重唱 ; a piano duet｜钢琴二重奏 ; perform a duet｜表演二重唱或二重奏
tip_zh: duet指两人合唱或合奏的作品或表演，不指两人组合本身。

meanings_zh: n. 提取；开采；拔除
definition_en: The process of taking something out of something else.
example1_en: The textbook introduces mineral extraction in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了矿物开采。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mineral extraction.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕矿物开采展开说明。
collocations: mineral extraction｜矿物开采 ; tooth extraction｜拔牙 ; oil extraction｜石油开采 ; data extraction｜数据提取
tip_zh: extract是动词；extraction指提取过程，不指摘要。

meanings_zh: v. 处理不当 | v. 粗暴搬动；不慎操作
definition_en: to deal with a situation or responsibility badly | to handle an object carelessly or incorrectly
example1_en: I heard the lecturer mishandle a complaint during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时投诉处理不当。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to mishandle a complaint.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们投诉处理不当。
collocations: mishandle a complaint｜投诉处理不当 ; mishandle a crisis｜危机应对不当 ; mishandle luggage｜搬运行李不慎
tip_zh: 既可指事情处理不当，也可指物品搬动不慎。

meanings_zh: n. 庄园宅邸 | n. 庄园；领地
definition_en: A large country house traditionally belonging to a wealthy landowner. | An estate historically controlled by a lord.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a medieval manor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论中世纪庄园。
example2_en: A campus survey used a medieval manor to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用中世纪庄园来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a manor house｜庄园宅邸 ; lord of the manor｜庄园领主 ; a medieval manor｜中世纪庄园
tip_zh: 强调乡间庄园背景；manor house指庄园主宅。

meanings_zh: adj. 可想象的；可能的
definition_en: Possible to imagine or believe.
example1_en: The textbook introduces every conceivable way in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了所有能想到的办法。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around every conceivable way.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕所有能想到的办法展开说明。
collocations: every conceivable way｜所有能想到的办法 ; every conceivable option｜所有可想到的选项 ; it is conceivable that｜有可能
tip_zh: 表示能设想或有可能，不等于很可能发生。

meanings_zh: n. 被告
definition_en: A person or organisation facing a legal claim or criminal charge.
example1_en: I copied a criminal defendant into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把刑事被告抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a criminal defendant.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得刑事被告这个例子。
collocations: a criminal defendant｜刑事被告 ; the defendant's lawyer｜被告的律师 ; the rights of defendants｜被告的权利
tip_zh: 被告不等于罪犯；原告plaintiff主要用于民事诉讼。

meanings_zh: v. 灌溉
definition_en: to supply land or crops with water
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to irrigate crops.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何灌溉作物。
example2_en: A lecture on environmental policy showed why researchers irrigate crops before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于环境政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要灌溉作物。
collocations: irrigate crops｜灌溉作物 ; irrigate farmland｜灌溉农田 ; irrigation system｜灌溉系统
tip_zh: 通常作及物动词，宾语是田地或作物，不是水。

meanings_zh: n. 残留物；残渣
definition_en: A substance left behind after a process or removal.
example1_en: The textbook introduces sticky residue in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了黏性残留物。
example2_en: A campus survey used sticky residue to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用黏性残留物来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: sticky residue｜黏性残留物 ; chemical residue｜化学残留物 ; pesticide residues｜农药残留 ; leave a residue｜留下残留物
tip_zh: 常指过程结束后的物质残留；不同种类可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 类比；相似之处
definition_en: A comparison used to explain something through a similar example
example1_en: Our professor circled a useful analogy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了有用的类比。
example2_en: The author returns to a useful analogy when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有用的类比。
collocations: draw an analogy｜作类比 ; an analogy between｜两者之间的类比 ; a useful analogy｜有用的类比
tip_zh: 常用draw an analogy between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 空气动力学 | n. 空气动力性能
definition_en: The study of air movement and its effects on objects. | The qualities affecting how efficiently an object moves through air.
example1_en: Office hours began with the principles of aerodynamics.
example1_zh: 答疑从空气动力学原理开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the principles of aerodynamics.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕空气动力学原理展开说明。
collocations: the principles of aerodynamics｜空气动力学原理 ; improve aerodynamics｜改善空气动力性能 ; vehicle aerodynamics｜车辆空气动力学
tip_zh: 指学科时虽以s结尾，通常仍接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 再次发生；复发
definition_en: the return of an event, problem, or illness
example1_en: I copied risk of recurrence into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把复发风险抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss risk of recurrence.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论复发风险的材料。
collocations: prevent a recurrence｜防止再次发生 ; risk of recurrence｜复发风险 ; recurrence of symptoms｜症状复发
tip_zh: 常接 of；疾病复发和问题重现都可用。

meanings_zh: n. 绿洲 | n. 宁静舒适之地
definition_en: A place in a desert where water and plants are found. | A peaceful, pleasant place surrounded by something difficult or unpleasant.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on desert oasis.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论沙漠绿洲。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss desert oasis.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论沙漠绿洲的材料。
collocations: desert oasis｜沙漠绿洲 ; an oasis of calm｜宁静之地
tip_zh: 复数为oases；也可比喻喧嚣中的宁静之地。

meanings_zh: v. 诈骗；骗取财物
definition_en: to obtain someone's money or property through dishonest actions
example1_en: The assignment is to defraud investors, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先诈骗投资者，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to defraud investors and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你诈骗投资者，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: defraud someone of money｜骗取某人的钱财 ; defraud investors｜诈骗投资者 ; conspiracy to defraud｜串谋诈骗
tip_zh: 常用defraud sb of sth，指骗取财物。

meanings_zh: n. 营业额；销售额 | n. 人员流动率
definition_en: the total value of a business's sales during a period | the rate at which employees leave and are replaced
example1_en: Office hours began with annual turnover.
example1_zh: 答疑从年营业额开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss annual turnover.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年营业额的材料。
collocations: annual turnover｜年营业额 ; staff turnover｜员工流动率 ; high turnover｜高流动率；高营业额
tip_zh: 营业额不等于利润；美式英语此义常用revenue。

meanings_zh: n. 刺绣；绣花 | n. 刺绣图案；绣品
definition_en: The craft of decorating cloth with needle and thread. | Decorative patterns sewn onto cloth using coloured thread.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about hand embroidery.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于手工刺绣的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects hand embroidery with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把手工刺绣和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: hand embroidery｜手工刺绣 ; embroidery thread｜绣线 ; embroidery hoop｜绣绷 ; intricate embroidery｜精细的刺绣
tip_zh: embroidery通常不可数；动词是embroider。

meanings_zh: adj. 可归因于……的
definition_en: caused by or explainable as the result of something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on attributable to.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可归因于。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss attributable to.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可归因于的材料。
collocations: attributable to｜可归因于 ; directly attributable to｜直接由……造成 ; largely attributable to｜主要归因于
tip_zh: 固定搭配be attributable to，to后接原因。

meanings_zh: adj. 徒劳的；无效的 | adj. 自负的；虚荣的
definition_en: failing to achieve the intended result | too proud of your appearance or achievements
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a vain attempt.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于徒劳的尝试的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a vain attempt.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕徒劳的尝试展开说明。
collocations: a vain attempt｜徒劳的尝试 ; in vain｜徒劳地 ; a vain hope｜渺茫的希望
tip_zh: in vain作状语，表示“徒劳地”；vain也可指虚荣。

meanings_zh: v. 肯定；明确声明
definition_en: To state firmly that something is true or supported.
example1_en: The assignment is to affirm a commitment, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先重申承诺，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to affirm a commitment.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们重申承诺。
collocations: affirm a commitment｜重申承诺 ; affirm support for｜明确表示支持 ; affirm that｜明确声明…… ; affirm the value of｜肯定……的价值
tip_zh: affirm语气正式，强调明确肯定；可接that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 表示；指代
definition_en: To represent or indicate something.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to denote a category.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须表示一个类别。
example2_en: The reading asks you to denote a category and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你表示一个类别，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: denote a category｜表示一个类别 ; denote a change｜表示变化 ; be denoted by｜由……表示
tip_zh: 常用于符号、颜色或词语表示某种含义。

meanings_zh: v. 落后；滞后 | n. 延迟；时间间隔
definition_en: Move or develop more slowly than others | A delay between related actions, events, or changes
example1_en: The professor asked us to lag behind.
example1_zh: 教授让我们落后于。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to lag behind.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们落后于。
collocations: lag behind｜落后于 ; time lag｜时间间隔 ; a lag in development｜发展滞后
tip_zh: 常用lag behind表示落后；过去式为lagged。

meanings_zh: v. 制定；构想 | v. 明确表达
definition_en: to develop a plan, policy, or idea carefully | to express an idea clearly and precisely
example1_en: I heard the lecturer formulate a plan during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时制定计划。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to formulate a plan.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来制定计划。
collocations: formulate a plan｜制定计划 ; formulate a policy｜制定政策 ; formulate a hypothesis｜提出假设 ; formulate a response｜组织回应
tip_zh: 比make正式，常搭配plan、policy、hypothesis。

meanings_zh: adj. 被俘的；受圈养的 | n. 俘虏；被囚禁者 | adj. 无法自由离开的
definition_en: kept somewhere and not allowed to leave | a person held prisoner | unable to leave or choose an alternative
example1_en: Our professor circled captive animals on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了圈养动物。
example2_en: The reading connects captive animals with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把圈养动物和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: hold someone captive｜囚禁某人 ; captive animals｜圈养动物 ; a captive audience｜无法随意离场的听众 ; captive breeding｜圈养繁殖
tip_zh: captive audience指无法随意离开的听众，非着迷者。

meanings_zh: v. 操纵；摆布 | v. 熟练操作；处理
definition_en: To control someone or something unfairly for your own benefit. | To handle or move something with skill.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to manipulate data.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何操纵数据。
example2_en: The reading asks you to manipulate data and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你操纵数据，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: manipulate data｜操纵数据 ; manipulate public opinion｜操纵舆论 ; manipulate someone into doing something｜操纵某人做某事
tip_zh: 操纵人做某事用manipulate sb into doing。

meanings_zh: n. 胆怯；缺乏自信
definition_en: A lack of courage or confidence in facing people or situations.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overcome timidity.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论克服胆怯。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of overcome timidity.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得克服胆怯这个例子。
collocations: overcome timidity｜克服胆怯 ; natural timidity｜天生的胆怯 ; timidity and hesitation｜胆怯与犹豫
tip_zh: 不可数名词；形容词为timid，指胆小、不自信。

meanings_zh: n. 陪审团裁决；裁定 | n. 评价；判断；定论
definition_en: An official court decision about whether someone is guilty. | An opinion or judgment reached after considering something.
example1_en: Our professor circled a guilty verdict on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了有罪裁决。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a guilty verdict.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕有罪裁决展开说明。
collocations: reach a verdict｜作出裁决 ; a guilty verdict｜有罪裁决 ; return a verdict｜宣布裁决 ; a verdict on something｜对某事的评价
tip_zh: verdict指裁决；sentence作法律名词指判处的刑罚。

meanings_zh: adj. 航空的；飞机的
definition_en: relating to aircraft or aviation
example1_en: I copied aero engine into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把航空发动机抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss aero engine.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论航空发动机的材料。
collocations: aero engine｜航空发动机 ; aero industry｜航空工业
tip_zh: 多用于名词前；aero-也常作航空相关前缀。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机化；电脑化
definition_en: the introduction of computers to perform tasks or manage information
example1_en: Our professor circled office computerization on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了办公电脑化。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around office computerization.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕办公电脑化展开说明。
collocations: computerization of records｜档案计算机化 ; office computerization｜办公电脑化 ; large-scale computerization｜大规模计算机化
tip_zh: 英式也写computerisation；通常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 提供；供应 | n. 条款；规定 | n. 预备；准备措施
definition_en: The act of supplying something needed. | A condition or requirement in a law or agreement. | Arrangements made to deal with future needs or events.
example1_en: Our professor circled a legal provision on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了法律条款。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a legal provision.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论法律条款的材料。
collocations: provision of services｜服务的提供 ; make provision for｜为……作准备 ; a legal provision｜法律条款 ; healthcare provision｜医疗服务的提供
tip_zh: 表“提供”不可数；表“条款”可数；provisions可指粮食。

meanings_zh: v. 核实；查证
definition_en: to check that something is true, accurate, or genuine
example1_en: The assignment is to verify information, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先核实信息，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to verify information and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你核实信息，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: verify information｜核实信息 ; verify someone's identity｜核实某人的身份 ; verify the accuracy of｜核实……的准确性
tip_zh: verify强调核实真伪或准确性，后接名词或从句。

meanings_zh: v. 列举；逐一列出
definition_en: To name things separately, one after another.
example1_en: The assignment is to enumerate the reasons, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先逐一列出原因，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to enumerate the reasons and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你逐一列出原因，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: enumerate the reasons｜逐一列出原因 ; enumerate the benefits｜列举好处 ; enumerate the main points｜逐一列出要点
tip_zh: 正式用词，强调逐项列出；日常表达常用list。

meanings_zh: v. 恐吓；威胁 | v. 使胆怯；使失去信心
definition_en: To frighten someone, often to make them obey | To make someone feel nervous or less confident
example1_en: I heard the lecturer intimidate witnesses during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时恐吓证人。
example2_en: The passage says students who can intimidate witnesses follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够恐吓证人的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: intimidate someone into doing something｜胁迫某人做某事 ; feel intimidated｜感到胆怯 ; intimidate witnesses｜恐吓证人
tip_zh: intimidate sb into doing sth表示胁迫某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 体格；体形
definition_en: The size, shape, and strength of a person's body.
example1_en: I copied muscular physique into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把肌肉发达的体格抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to muscular physique when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了肌肉发达的体格。
collocations: muscular physique｜肌肉发达的体格 ; slim physique｜纤细的体形 ; powerful physique｜强壮的体格
tip_zh: 可用于任何性别，常与描述体形的形容词搭配。

meanings_zh: v. 使听不见；震聋
definition_en: To make someone unable to hear, temporarily or permanently.
example1_en: I wrote deafen on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把deafen和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain deafen usually follow the rest of a lecture on public health.
example2_zh: 能解释震聋的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共卫生的讲座。
collocations: be deafened by｜被……震得听不见 ; almost deafen someone｜几乎把某人震聋 ; deafening noise｜震耳欲聋的噪声
tip_zh: 指使人听不见，不指给房间做隔音。

meanings_zh: n. 类似物；对应物 | adj. 模拟式的；非数字的
definition_en: something similar to another thing in function or structure | using continuously varying signals rather than digital information
example1_en: Office hours began with analogue signal.
example1_zh: 答疑从模拟信号开始。
example2_en: The author returns to analogue signal when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了模拟信号。
collocations: analogue of something｜某物的类似物 ; analogue signal｜模拟信号 ; analogue clock｜指针式时钟
tip_zh: 名词指对应物；形容词指模拟式，区别于digital。

meanings_zh: n. 特许经营权；加盟店 | n. 选举权 | v. 授予特许经营权
definition_en: permission to trade under another company's name, or that business | the legal right to vote in elections | to let others operate businesses using your company's name
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about franchise agreement.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于特许经营协议的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss franchise agreement.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论特许经营协议的材料。
collocations: buy a franchise｜购买特许经营权 ; franchise agreement｜特许经营协议 ; franchise fee｜加盟费 ; extend the franchise｜扩大选举权范围
tip_zh: 商业语境指特许经营；the franchise也指选举权。

meanings_zh: adv. 用机械；机械方面地 | adv. 机械地；不假思索地
definition_en: Using machinery, or relating to how a machine works | Without conscious thought, interest, or feeling
example1_en: The professor told us to mechanically operated and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们机械驱动的，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: Students who mechanically operated are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够机械驱动的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: mechanically operated｜机械驱动的 ; mechanically sound｜机械状况良好的 ; repeat mechanically｜机械地重复
tip_zh: 既可指通过机械，也可指做事不动脑筋。

meanings_zh: v. 创新；革新
definition_en: To introduce new ideas, methods, or products
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to innovate in healthcare.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何在医疗领域创新。
example2_en: The passage says students who can innovate in healthcare follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够在医疗领域创新的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: continue to innovate｜持续创新 ; innovate in healthcare｜在医疗领域创新 ; ability to innovate｜创新能力
tip_zh: 常作不及物动词；innovate in后接创新领域。

meanings_zh: n. 激发；刺激 | n. 促进；推动
definition_en: something that encourages mental, physical, or biological activity | the process of encouraging growth or increased activity
example1_en: The textbook introduces mental stimulation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了智力刺激。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mental stimulation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论智力刺激的材料。
collocations: mental stimulation｜智力刺激 ; sensory stimulation｜感官刺激 ; electrical stimulation｜电刺激 ; economic stimulation｜经济刺激
tip_zh: 通常不可数；stimulus指具体刺激因素。

meanings_zh: n. 疏忽；短暂失误 | n. 时间间隔 | v. 到期失效；终止
definition_en: a brief failure of attention, judgment, or memory | a period of time between two events | to end because something has not been renewed or maintained
example1_en: I copied a time lapse into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把时间间隔抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a time lapse when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了时间间隔。
collocations: a lapse in concentration｜一时走神 ; a lapse of judgment｜判断失误 ; a time lapse｜时间间隔 ; let a policy lapse｜任保单到期失效
tip_zh: 失误常用a lapse in；时间间隔用a lapse of。

meanings_zh: n. 实用性；效用 | n. 公用事业；公共服务 | n. 实用程序；工具软件
definition_en: the usefulness of something for a particular purpose | an essential service such as water, gas, or electricity | a computer program that performs a specific practical task
example1_en: The textbook introduces practical utility in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了实际用途。
example2_en: A campus survey used practical utility to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用实际用途来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: practical utility｜实际用途 ; public utilities｜公用事业 ; utility bills｜水电燃气账单 ; utility company｜公用事业公司
tip_zh: “效用”通常不可数；水电燃气等服务常用utilities。

meanings_zh: adj. 过早的；时机未到的 | adj. 早产的
definition_en: happening before the expected or appropriate time | born before the usual length of pregnancy is complete
example1_en: Our professor circled a premature baby on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了早产儿。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a premature baby.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得早产儿这个例子。
collocations: a premature baby｜早产儿 ; premature death｜过早死亡 ; premature ageing｜过早衰老 ; premature to conclude｜下结论为时过早
tip_zh: premature强调过早；immature常指不成熟。

meanings_zh: n. 大洞穴；大山洞
definition_en: A large natural underground cave.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a limestone cavern.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于石灰岩洞穴的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a limestone cavern.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕石灰岩洞穴展开说明。
collocations: a limestone cavern｜石灰岩洞穴 ; an underground cavern｜地下大洞穴 ; explore a cavern｜探索洞穴
tip_zh: cavern是大洞穴；酒馆是tavern。

meanings_zh: n. 前任 | n. 前身；上一代产品
definition_en: Someone who held a particular position before another person. | Something that existed before and was replaced by something similar.
example1_en: Our professor circled an immediate predecessor on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了直接前任。
example2_en: The author returns to an immediate predecessor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了直接前任。
collocations: an immediate predecessor｜直接前任 ; a predecessor in office｜职位上的前任 ; replace its predecessor｜取代其前身
tip_zh: 指某职位的前任或事物的前身，不泛指所有前辈。

meanings_zh: n. 封建制度
definition_en: A system exchanging land rights for service and loyalty to lords.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the decline of feudalism in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了封建制度的衰落。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the decline of feudalism.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕封建制度的衰落展开说明。
collocations: under feudalism｜在封建制度下 ; the decline of feudalism｜封建制度的衰落 ; European feudalism｜欧洲封建制度
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常用于讨论中世纪欧洲的土地与效忠关系。

meanings_zh: v. 腐蚀；被腐蚀 | v. 逐渐损害；侵蚀
definition_en: To gradually damage material chemically, or become damaged this way. | To gradually weaken something such as trust or confidence.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer corrode metal during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时腐蚀金属。
example2_en: The reading asks you to corrode metal and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你腐蚀金属，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: corrode metal｜腐蚀金属 ; corrode trust｜侵蚀信任 ; badly corroded pipes｜严重腐蚀的管道
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物；rust主要指铁生锈。

meanings_zh: n. 反复呼喊的口号；吟唱 | v. 反复呼喊；吟唱 | n. 圣歌；吟诵曲
definition_en: words or sounds repeated rhythmically, often by a group | to repeat words rhythmically or sing on a few notes | a religious song using a small range of notes
example1_en: Office hours began with a rhythmic chant.
example1_zh: 答疑从有节奏的吟唱开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a rhythmic chant.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕有节奏的吟唱展开说明。
collocations: chant slogans｜反复呼喊口号 ; a rhythmic chant｜有节奏的吟唱 ; a religious chant｜宗教吟诵曲
tip_zh: 不限于圣歌，也常指人群有节奏地反复喊口号。

meanings_zh: adj. 市政的；市政府的
definition_en: Relating to a town or city and its government.
example1_en: Our professor circled municipal government on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了市政府。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss municipal government.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论市政府的材料。
collocations: municipal government｜市政府 ; municipal services｜市政服务 ; municipal waste｜城市垃圾
tip_zh: 强调城镇政府管理的事务，不等于所有城市事物。

meanings_zh: n. 地牢
definition_en: a dark underground prison, especially beneath a castle
example1_en: The textbook introduces castle dungeon in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了城堡地牢。
example2_en: The author returns to castle dungeon when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了城堡地牢。
collocations: castle dungeon｜城堡地牢 ; dark dungeon｜阴暗的地牢 ; escape from a dungeon｜逃出地牢
tip_zh: 通常指城堡地下的阴暗牢房，不是普通地下室。

meanings_zh: n. 惊愕；沮丧 | v. 使惊愕；使沮丧
definition_en: Shock and disappointment caused by something unexpected and unpleasant. | To make someone feel shocked and disappointed.
example1_en: Our professor circled express dismay on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了表达失望。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss express dismay.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论表达失望的材料。
collocations: to someone's dismay｜令某人沮丧的是 ; express dismay｜表达失望 ; be dismayed at｜对……感到惊愕沮丧
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；to one's dismay意为令人沮丧的是。

meanings_zh: v. 压缩；压紧 | v. 精简；浓缩
definition_en: Press something into a smaller space or reduce its size | Make information shorter while keeping its main content
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to compress a file.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何压缩文件。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to compress a file.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们压缩文件。
collocations: compress a file｜压缩文件 ; compress air｜压缩空气 ; compress into｜压缩成
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词“敷布”重音在前。

meanings_zh: v. 把…归因于 | v. 认为…具有；认定出自
definition_en: To consider something to be caused by a particular factor | To assign a quality, work, or statement to someone
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to ascribe success to.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须将成功归因于。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to ascribe success to.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们将成功归因于。
collocations: ascribe success to｜将成功归因于 ; ascribe importance to｜认为…重要 ; ascribe a work to｜认定作品出自
tip_zh: 固定结构ascribe A to B：把A归因于B。

meanings_zh: n. 一阵；一次发作 | n. 拳击或摔跤比赛
definition_en: A short period of illness or intense activity | A boxing or wrestling contest
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a boxing bout.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一场拳击赛的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a boxing bout to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一场拳击赛来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: a bout of flu｜一次流感 ; a bout of coughing｜一阵咳嗽 ; a boxing bout｜一场拳击赛
tip_zh: 一阵病痛或活动用a bout of；也指拳击等比赛。

meanings_zh: n. 复兴；重新繁荣 | n. 文艺复兴时期
definition_en: a period of renewed interest, activity, or success | the European period of renewed classical learning and artistic development
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a cultural renaissance.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于文化复兴的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a cultural renaissance.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论文化复兴的材料。
collocations: a cultural renaissance｜文化复兴 ; enjoy a renaissance｜迎来复兴 ; the Renaissance｜文艺复兴时期
tip_zh: 指历史上的文艺复兴时通常大写并加the。

meanings_zh: adj. 遗传的 | adj. 世袭的
definition_en: Passed from parents to children through genes. | Passed within a family by established right or tradition.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on hereditary disease.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论遗传病。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of hereditary disease.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得遗传病这个例子。
collocations: hereditary disease｜遗传病 ; hereditary condition｜遗传性疾病 ; hereditary title｜世袭头衔 ; hereditary monarchy｜世袭君主制
tip_zh: 可指基因遗传，也可指头衔世袭；遗传不等于传染。

meanings_zh: n. 时代；纪元 | n. 世（地质时间单位）
definition_en: a period of history marked by distinctive events or changes | a division of geological time within a period
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a new epoch.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论新时代。
example2_en: The reading connects a new epoch with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把新时代和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a new epoch｜新时代 ; a historical epoch｜历史时期 ; mark an epoch｜标志一个时代的开启
tip_zh: 比 period 更强调时代特征；地质学中译为“世”。

meanings_zh: n. 帝国主义者 | adj. 帝国主义的
definition_en: Someone who supports extending a country's power over other countries. | Supporting or involving a country's control over other countries.
example1_en: I copied imperialist expansion into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把帝国主义扩张抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used imperialist expansion to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用帝国主义扩张来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: imperialist expansion｜帝国主义扩张 ; imperialist policies｜帝国主义政策 ; an imperialist power｜帝国主义强国
tip_zh: 既可作名词指人，也可作形容词修饰政策或国家。

meanings_zh: n. 攀登；上升 | n. 地位提升；崛起 | n. 上坡路
definition_en: the act of climbing or moving upwards | a rise to a higher position, rank, or level | a path or slope that leads upwards
example1_en: The textbook introduces a steep ascent in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了陡峭的上坡路。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a steep ascent.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论陡峭的上坡路的材料。
collocations: a steep ascent｜陡峭的上坡路 ; make an ascent｜进行攀登 ; ascent to power｜掌权之路
tip_zh: ascent指上升；同音词assent指同意。

meanings_zh: adj. 多国文化交融的；国际化的 | adj. 见多识广的；具有国际视野的
definition_en: Including people and cultural influences from many different countries. | Familiar with and comfortable in different countries and cultures.
example1_en: Office hours began with cosmopolitan city.
example1_zh: 答疑从国际化城市开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cosmopolitan city.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论国际化城市的材料。
collocations: cosmopolitan city｜国际化城市 ; cosmopolitan population｜来自世界各地的居民 ; cosmopolitan outlook｜国际化视野
tip_zh: 常形容城市或人，强调多元文化，而非单指全球范围。

meanings_zh: adj. 共和政体的；共和主义的 | n. 共和主义者
definition_en: Supporting government without a monarch, usually through elected representatives | Someone who supports a republic rather than a monarchy
example1_en: I copied republican government into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把共和制政府抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects republican government with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把共和制政府和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: republican government｜共和制政府 ; republican ideals｜共和主义理想 ; republican constitution｜共和制宪法
tip_zh: 小写指共和主义；大写常指特定共和党。

meanings_zh: v. 设法做到 | v. 巧妙谋划；设计
definition_en: to manage to do something difficult or unexpected | to create or arrange something through clever planning
example1_en: The assignment is to contrive a way, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先想出办法，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can contrive a way follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够想出办法的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: contrive to do something｜设法做成某事 ; contrive a way｜想出办法 ; contrive a plan｜巧妙制定计划
tip_zh: contrive to do表示设法做到；contrived常指刻意不自然。

meanings_zh: n. 熔炉；工业炉 | n. 暖气炉
definition_en: An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes. | A device that heats air or water to warm a building.
example1_en: Our professor circled a blast furnace on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了高炉。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a blast furnace.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕高炉展开说明。
collocations: a blast furnace｜高炉 ; an electric furnace｜电炉 ; a gas furnace｜燃气炉
tip_zh: 工业语境指熔炉；美式家居语境常指暖气炉。

meanings_zh: n. 近似值；粗略估计 | n. 近似物；近似表现
definition_en: An estimate that is close to the exact value. | Something similar to another thing but not exactly the same.
example1_en: Our professor circled a rough approximation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了粗略估计。
example2_en: The author returns to a rough approximation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了粗略估计。
collocations: a rough approximation｜粗略估计 ; a close approximation｜非常接近的估计或模拟 ; a reasonable approximation｜合理的近似估计
tip_zh: 常用an approximation of；强调接近但并不精确。

meanings_zh: adv. 此后；从那以后
definition_en: After the time or event just mentioned
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize thereafter in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出此后。
example2_en: A reading on historical change uses thereafter when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于历史变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了此后。
collocations: shortly thereafter｜不久之后 ; soon thereafter｜随后不久 ; for years thereafter｜此后多年
tip_zh: 正式用语，指前文时间点之后；日常常用after that。

meanings_zh: n. 合金 | v. 使成合金
definition_en: A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements. | To combine a metal with another element.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on aluminium alloy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论铝合金。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of aluminium alloy.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得铝合金这个例子。
collocations: aluminium alloy｜铝合金 ; lightweight alloy｜轻质合金 ; alloy steel｜合金钢
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词常读/əˈlɔɪ/。

meanings_zh: n. 河口；河口湾
definition_en: The wide tidal mouth of a river meeting the sea.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a river estuary.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论河口。
example2_en: The author returns to a river estuary when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了河口。
collocations: a river estuary｜河口 ; estuary wildlife｜河口野生生物 ; a tidal estuary｜潮汐河口
tip_zh: 强调受潮汐影响的入海河口，不等于delta三角洲。

meanings_zh: n. 前言；序言 | v. 以…作为开场白
definition_en: An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background. | To introduce something by saying or writing something beforehand.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about preface remarks with.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于以…作为讲话的开场白的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around preface remarks with.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕以…作为讲话的开场白展开说明。
collocations: in the preface｜在前言中 ; write a preface｜撰写前言 ; preface remarks with｜以…作为讲话的开场白
tip_zh: 书的preface通常由作者写；foreword常由他人撰写。

meanings_zh: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的
definition_en: Having a fault that prevents something from working properly.
example1_en: I copied defective product into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有缺陷的产品抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects defective product with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把有缺陷的产品和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: defective product｜有缺陷的产品 ; defective equipment｜有故障的设备 ; defective wiring｜有问题的线路
tip_zh: 常形容产品、零件或系统有缺陷，不能正常运作。

meanings_zh: v. 辨认；解读；破译
definition_en: work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information
example1_en: The lab instructions say to decipher a code.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求破译密码。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to decipher a code.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来破译密码。
collocations: decipher a code｜破译密码 ; decipher handwriting｜辨认笔迹 ; decipher a message｜解读信息
tip_zh: 只作动词；既可指破译密码，也可指辨认潦草字迹。

meanings_zh: adj. 权威的；可信的 | adj. 有威信的；有权威感的
definition_en: Trusted as accurate because of expert knowledge. | Showing confidence and an ability to command respect.
example1_en: I copied an authoritative source into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把权威来源抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used an authoritative source to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用权威来源来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: an authoritative source｜权威来源 ; authoritative advice｜权威建议 ; an authoritative tone｜威严的语气 ; an authoritative account｜权威论述
tip_zh: 勿混authoritarian：后者指专制的。

meanings_zh: adv. 普遍地；全体一致地
definition_en: by everyone or in every place or situation
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to universally accepted.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习普遍接受的。
example2_en: The reading shows why a careful writer will universally accepted when the evidence is thin.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会普遍接受的。
collocations: universally accepted｜普遍接受的 ; universally recognised｜公认的 ; universally available｜人人均可获得的
tip_zh: 语气强于generally，常强调人人或处处如此。

meanings_zh: adj. 寡言的；不愿透露的
definition_en: unwilling to talk openly about your thoughts or feelings
example1_en: I copied reticent about personal matters into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把不愿谈论私事抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to reticent about personal matters when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不愿谈论私事。
collocations: reticent about personal matters｜不愿谈论私事 ; remain reticent｜保持缄默 ; a reticent person｜寡言的人
tip_zh: 侧重不愿开口或透露信息，不等于一般的不情愿。

meanings_zh: n. 子女；后代；幼崽
definition_en: The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.
example1_en: Office hours began with produce offspring.
example1_zh: 答疑从繁育后代开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used produce offspring to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用繁育后代来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: produce offspring｜繁育后代 ; protect their offspring｜保护它们的幼崽 ; healthy offspring｜健康的后代
tip_zh: 单复数同形；谈人的子女时比children正式。

meanings_zh: v. 引起；激起 | v. 激怒；挑衅
definition_en: To cause a reaction, feeling, or event. | To deliberately make someone angry or likely to react.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer provoke debate during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时引发争论。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to provoke debate.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们引发争论。
collocations: provoke debate｜引发争论 ; provoke a reaction｜引起反应 ; provoke criticism｜招致批评 ; provoke someone into doing something｜激得某人做某事
tip_zh: provoke不只指激怒，也常指引发讨论或反应。

meanings_zh: v. 使恼怒；使不耐烦
definition_en: To make someone extremely annoyed or frustrated.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to exasperate commuters.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使通勤者恼火。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to exasperate commuters.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使通勤者恼火。
collocations: exasperate commuters｜使通勤者恼火 ; exasperate customers｜使顾客不耐烦 ; feel exasperated｜感到恼火
tip_zh: 勿混淆exacerbate：后者表示使问题恶化。

meanings_zh: n. 还价；反提议
definition_en: A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used counter-offer in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了还价。
example2_en: Students who can explain counter-offer usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释还价的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: make a counter-offer｜提出还价 ; accept a counter-offer｜接受反提议 ; reject a counter-offer｜拒绝反提议
tip_zh: 可写作counteroffer；不仅指还价，也指修改条件。

meanings_zh: n. 指定；任命；认定 | n. 正式名称；称号
definition_en: The act of officially choosing someone or something for a purpose. | An official name or title given to someone or something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on official designation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正式名称；官方认定。
example2_en: The reading connects official designation with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把正式名称；官方认定和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: designation as｜指定为；任命为 ; official designation｜正式名称；官方认定 ; job designation｜职位名称
tip_zh: designation as后接身份；也可指正式名称或职称。

meanings_zh: n. 人文学科
definition_en: subjects studying human culture, such as history, literature, and philosophy
example1_en: The textbook introduces arts and humanities in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了艺术与人文学科。
example2_en: A campus survey used arts and humanities to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用艺术与人文学科来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: study the humanities｜学习人文学科 ; humanities subjects｜人文学科课程 ; arts and humanities｜艺术与人文学科
tip_zh: 统称学科领域常用the humanities，按复数处理。

meanings_zh: n. 植被；植物群
definition_en: plants growing together in a particular area
example1_en: Office hours began with dense vegetation.
example1_zh: 答疑从茂密的植被开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dense vegetation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论茂密的植被的材料。
collocations: dense vegetation｜茂密的植被 ; native vegetation｜本土植被 ; vegetation cover｜植被覆盖 ; clear vegetation｜清除植被
tip_zh: 不可数名词，泛指某地区植物，不等于蔬菜。

meanings_zh: adj. 微小的；不重要的 | adj. 边缘的；非核心的 | adj. 勉强合格的
definition_en: very small in amount, effect, or importance | outside the main or central part of something | only just good enough for a particular purpose
example1_en: Our professor circled marginal improvement on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了微小改善。
example2_en: The reading connects marginal improvement with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把微小改善和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: marginal improvement｜微小改善 ; marginal difference｜细微差别 ; marginal role｜次要作用
tip_zh: 表示变化时指幅度很小，不是完全没有变化。

meanings_zh: n. 智力；理解力 | n. 才智出众的人
definition_en: The ability to understand ideas, think logically, and solve problems. | A person with exceptional intelligence and reasoning ability.
example1_en: I copied a sharp intellect into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把敏锐的头脑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a sharp intellect with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把敏锐的头脑和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a sharp intellect｜敏锐的头脑 ; a formidable intellect｜非凡的才智 ; develop the intellect｜发展智力
tip_zh: intellect侧重理解与推理能力，不等同于知识。

meanings_zh: n. 痛苦的经历；严峻考验
definition_en: A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a traumatic ordeal.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于造成心理创伤的经历的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to a traumatic ordeal when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了造成心理创伤的经历。
collocations: go through an ordeal｜经历磨难 ; a traumatic ordeal｜造成心理创伤的经历 ; a prolonged ordeal｜漫长的煎熬
tip_zh: 指令人痛苦或恐惧的经历，不用于普通的小麻烦。

meanings_zh: adj. 根本的；潜在的 | adj. 位于下面的
definition_en: causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious | lying beneath the surface of something
example1_en: The textbook introduces underlying cause in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了根本原因。
example2_en: The author returns to underlying cause when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了根本原因。
collocations: underlying cause｜根本原因 ; underlying problem｜潜在问题 ; underlying assumption｜基本假设 ; underlying health condition｜基础疾病
tip_zh: 通常放在名词前，强调表面现象背后的原因或基础。

meanings_zh: n. 变形；形变
definition_en: a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on plastic deformation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论塑性变形。
example2_en: The reading connects plastic deformation with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把塑性变形和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: plastic deformation｜塑性变形 ; elastic deformation｜弹性变形 ; resistance to deformation｜抗变形能力
tip_zh: 强调形状改变，不等同于泛指损坏的damage。

meanings_zh: n. 领域；范围 | n. 领地；管辖范围 | n. 互联网域
definition_en: a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility | an area controlled by a particular ruler or authority | an internet area identified by a shared name
example1_en: Office hours began with public domain.
example1_zh: 答疑从公有领域开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of public domain.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得公有领域这个例子。
collocations: the domain of science｜科学领域 ; public domain｜公有领域 ; domain name｜域名 ; exclusive domain｜专属领域
tip_zh: 领域义近field；in the public domain指公开可用。

meanings_zh: n. 肺炎
definition_en: An infection that inflames the lungs and makes breathing difficult.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about develop pneumonia.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于患上肺炎的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used develop pneumonia to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用患上肺炎来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: develop pneumonia｜患上肺炎 ; recover from pneumonia｜肺炎康复 ; bacterial pneumonia｜细菌性肺炎
tip_zh: 词首p不发音；通常不可数，不说a pneumonia。

meanings_zh: v. 旋转；使打旋 | n. 旋涡；螺旋状图案
definition_en: To move, or make something move, in flowing circles. | A circular movement or a shape that curves around itself.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to swirl around.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须绕着打旋。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to swirl around.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们绕着打旋。
collocations: swirl around｜绕着打旋 ; swirl a liquid｜使液体打旋 ; a swirl of smoke｜一缕盘旋的烟
tip_zh: 可作及物或不及物动词，强调流动中的旋转。

meanings_zh: v. 引出；诱发
definition_en: to cause someone to give information or show a reaction
example1_en: The professor asked us to elicit a response.
example1_zh: 教授让我们引出回应。
example2_en: The passage says students who can elicit a response follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够引出回应的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: elicit a response｜引出回应 ; elicit information｜获取信息 ; elicit sympathy｜引起同情
tip_zh: 常接response等宾语；勿与illicit（非法的）混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 遵守；符合 | v. 顺从；随俗
definition_en: to follow rules or meet required standards | to behave as others in a group expect
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to conform to standards.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何符合标准。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to conform to standards.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来符合标准。
collocations: conform to standards｜符合标准 ; conform to regulations｜遵守规定 ; pressure to conform｜要求随大流的压力
tip_zh: 常用conform to rules或standards，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 裁员；职位撤销 | n. 冗余；多余重复 | n. 备用配置；冗余备份
definition_en: Job loss because an employer no longer needs the position. | Unnecessary repetition or the presence of something not needed. | Extra components that keep a system working if others fail.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on compulsory redundancy.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论强制裁员。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss compulsory redundancy.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论强制裁员的材料。
collocations: redundancy pay｜裁员补偿金 ; compulsory redundancy｜强制裁员 ; voluntary redundancy｜自愿离职裁员 ; built-in redundancy｜内置冗余备份
tip_zh: 英式英语常指裁员；技术语境可指保障运行的备用配置。

meanings_zh: n. 理想主义 | n. 唯心主义
definition_en: belief in pursuing perfect standards, even when impractical | the philosophical view that reality depends on mind or consciousness
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about youthful idealism.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于年轻人的理想主义的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around youthful idealism.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕年轻人的理想主义展开说明。
collocations: youthful idealism｜年轻人的理想主义 ; political idealism｜政治理想主义 ; a sense of idealism｜理想主义情怀
tip_zh: 通常不可数；哲学语境译“唯心主义”。

meanings_zh: adj. 液压的；水力的
definition_en: Using liquid pressure to produce movement or power.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about hydraulic pressure.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于液压的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hydraulic pressure.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论液压的材料。
collocations: hydraulic pressure｜液压 ; hydraulic brakes｜液压制动器 ; hydraulic lift｜液压升降机 ; hydraulic system｜液压系统
tip_zh: hydraulic靠液体传压；pneumatic靠气体传压。

meanings_zh: adv. 免费地 | adj. 免费的
definition_en: without any payment being required | provided without requiring payment
example1_en: The lab manual says to gratis admission before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先免费入场，再记下数字。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to gratis admission before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先免费入场。
collocations: provided gratis｜免费提供 ; distributed gratis｜免费分发 ; gratis admission｜免费入场
tip_zh: 可作副词或形容词，较正式；日常通常用free。

meanings_zh: n. 减速；放缓
definition_en: A reduction in the speed of activity or growth
example1_en: Our professor circled an economic slowdown on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济放缓。
example2_en: The author returns to an economic slowdown when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济放缓。
collocations: an economic slowdown｜经济放缓 ; a slowdown in growth｜增长放缓 ; a sharp slowdown｜急剧放缓
tip_zh: slowdown是名词；动词短语写作slow down。

meanings_zh: v. 派遣；发送 | n. 发送；派遣 | n. 新闻报道；公文
definition_en: to send someone or something to a destination | the act of sending people or goods somewhere | a report sent by a journalist or official
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to despatch goods.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发运货物。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers despatch goods before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要发运货物。
collocations: despatch goods｜发运货物 ; despatch a rescue team｜派遣救援队 ; ready for despatch｜准备好发运
tip_zh: despatch是dispatch的英式变体，后者更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 黑豹 | n. 美洲狮
definition_en: A leopard or jaguar with a black coat. | A cougar, especially in North American usage.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about black panther.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于黑豹的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of black panther.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得黑豹这个例子。
collocations: black panther｜黑豹 ; Florida panther｜佛罗里达美洲狮
tip_zh: 黑豹通常是黑色的豹或美洲豹，并非独立物种。

meanings_zh: n. 悖论；看似矛盾的事物
definition_en: A statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about apparent paradox.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于表面上的矛盾的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of apparent paradox.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得表面上的矛盾这个例子。
collocations: apparent paradox｜表面上的矛盾 ; resolve a paradox｜解开悖论 ; present a paradox｜呈现看似矛盾的情况
tip_zh: 强调看似矛盾却可能成立，不等于普通错误。

meanings_zh: v. 再出口；转口出口
definition_en: to export goods that were previously imported
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to reexport goods.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须再出口商品。
example2_en: The reading asks you to reexport goods and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你再出口商品，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: reexport goods｜再出口商品 ; reexport imported products｜将进口产品再出口 ; reexport to neighbouring markets｜再出口至邻近市场
tip_zh: 也写作re-export，指进口后再出口。

meanings_zh: adj. 限制性的；约束的
definition_en: Limiting what people can do or what is allowed.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overly restrictive.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论限制过多的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around overly restrictive.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕限制过多的展开说明。
collocations: restrictive regulations｜限制性条例 ; restrictive measures｜限制性措施 ; overly restrictive｜限制过多的
tip_zh: 是形容词；restrictive强调施加限制。

meanings_zh: v. 润滑；给……加润滑油
definition_en: Apply oil or another substance to reduce friction between surfaces.
example1_en: The professor asked us to lubricate moving parts.
example1_zh: 教授让我们润滑活动部件。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to lubricate moving parts.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们润滑活动部件。
collocations: lubricate moving parts｜润滑活动部件 ; lubricate machinery｜润滑机械 ; lubricate with oil｜用油润滑
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接被润滑的部件；用with引出润滑剂。

meanings_zh: n. 商业巨头；大亨
definition_en: a wealthy and powerful person in a particular industry
example1_en: I copied a media magnate into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把媒体大亨抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a media magnate to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用媒体大亨来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: a media magnate｜媒体大亨 ; a shipping magnate｜航运业巨头 ; a business magnate｜商界巨头
tip_zh: 常与行业名连用；注意不要与magnet（磁铁）混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 逐渐积累；逐渐获得
definition_en: To increase gradually, or receive benefits over time
example1_en: The lab instructions say to accrue benefits.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求逐渐获得益处。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to accrue benefits.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们逐渐获得益处。
collocations: interest accrues｜利息逐渐累积 ; accrue benefits｜逐渐获得益处 ; accrue to｜归于；惠及 ; accrued income｜应计收入
tip_zh: 常用于利息、收益等逐渐累积；accrue to表示归于。

meanings_zh: v. 根除；彻底消灭
definition_en: To completely remove or destroy something harmful.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to eradicate disease.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须根除疾病。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to eradicate disease.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来根除疾病。
collocations: eradicate disease｜根除疾病 ; eradicate poverty｜消除贫困 ; eradicate illiteracy｜扫除文盲
tip_zh: 强调彻底消除，语气强于reduce，常用于疾病或贫困。

meanings_zh: n. 汇集；聚合 | n. 聚集体；集合
definition_en: the process of combining separate items into a larger whole | a group or collection of things brought together
example1_en: Our professor circled data aggregation on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数据汇总。
example2_en: The author returns to data aggregation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数据汇总。
collocations: data aggregation｜数据汇总 ; aggregation of results｜结果汇总 ; content aggregation｜内容聚合
tip_zh: 强调把分散项汇成整体；数据处理中常见。

meanings_zh: v. 察觉；辨认出
definition_en: To notice or recognise something that is difficult to detect.
example1_en: The professor asked us to discern a pattern.
example1_zh: 教授让我们察觉规律。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers discern a pattern before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要察觉规律。
collocations: discern a pattern｜察觉规律 ; discern a difference｜辨别差异 ; barely discern｜勉强辨认出
tip_zh: 较正式，强调费力看出或察觉不明显的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 纪念；缅怀
definition_en: To honour a person or event by remembering them publicly
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to commemorate an event.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须纪念事件。
example2_en: A lecture on historical change showed why researchers commemorate an event before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于历史变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要纪念事件。
collocations: commemorate an event｜纪念事件 ; commemorate an anniversary｜纪念周年 ; commemorate the victims｜缅怀遇难者
tip_zh: 直接接纪念对象；不一定含有庆祝的喜悦。

meanings_zh: v. 严重破坏；摧毁 | v. 使极度悲痛；使震惊
definition_en: To cause very severe damage to a place or thing | To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked
example1_en: The professor asked us to devastate a region.
example1_zh: 教授让我们重创一个地区。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to devastate a region.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来重创一个地区。
collocations: devastate a region｜重创一个地区 ; devastate the economy｜严重破坏经济 ; feel devastated｜感到悲痛欲绝 ; devastating impact｜毁灭性的影响
tip_zh: 比damage程度重；也可指使人精神上受到重创。

meanings_zh: n. 围场；围起来的区域 | n. 信函附件 | n. 围住；圈地
definition_en: An area surrounded by a fence, wall, or other barrier. | Something placed inside an envelope together with a letter. | The act of surrounding land with a boundary.
example1_en: Our professor circled an animal enclosure on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了动物围场。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an animal enclosure.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕动物围场展开说明。
collocations: an animal enclosure｜动物围场 ; a secure enclosure｜牢固的围场 ; the enclosure of land｜圈地
tip_zh: 纸质信函附件可用enclosure；邮件附件用attachment。

meanings_zh: v. 减弱；衰退 | v. 月亮渐亏 | n. 衰退；减弱
definition_en: gradually become weaker, smaller, or less important | show a progressively smaller illuminated part of the moon | a gradual decline, especially in the phrase on the wane
example1_en: The professor explained wane with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了减弱。
example2_en: Students who can explain wane usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释减弱的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: waning interest｜逐渐减退的兴趣 ; on the wane｜正在衰退 ; a waning moon｜渐亏的月亮
tip_zh: 动词通常不及物；on the wane表示正在衰退。

meanings_zh: n. 诱因；激励措施
definition_en: something offered to persuade someone to take a particular action
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial inducement.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济激励。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss financial inducement.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济激励的材料。
collocations: financial inducement｜经济激励 ; offer an inducement｜提供激励 ; inducement to invest｜投资诱因
tip_zh: 常指外部提供的奖励或好处，后可接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 物质主义；物质至上 | n. 唯物主义
definition_en: The belief that money and possessions matter most | The philosophical view that everything ultimately consists of matter
example1_en: Office hours began with consumer materialism.
example1_zh: 答疑从消费物质主义开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss consumer materialism.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论消费物质主义的材料。
collocations: consumer materialism｜消费物质主义 ; encourage materialism｜助长物质主义 ; philosophical materialism｜哲学唯物主义 ; historical materialism｜历史唯物主义
tip_zh: 消费话题常指物质至上；哲学语境指唯物主义。

meanings_zh: n. 立场；观点
definition_en: a position from which someone considers or judges something
example1_en: I wrote standpoint on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把standpoint和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up standpoint while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了立场。
collocations: from a practical standpoint｜从实际角度看 ; from an economic standpoint｜从经济角度看 ; from someone's standpoint｜从某人的立场看
tip_zh: 常用from a ... standpoint表示“从……角度看”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不利的；有害的；恶劣的
definition_en: Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.
example1_en: Our professor circled adverse effects on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不良影响。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of adverse effects.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得不良影响这个例子。
collocations: adverse effects｜不良影响 ; adverse weather conditions｜恶劣天气状况 ; an adverse reaction｜不良反应 ; adverse circumstances｜不利处境
tip_zh: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

meanings_zh: adj. 有秩序的；整齐的 | n. 医院护工；勤务兵
definition_en: well arranged or behaving in a controlled, organised way | a hospital worker doing practical tasks, or a soldier's assistant
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on hospital orderly.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医院护工。
example2_en: The reading connects hospital orderly with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把医院护工和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: orderly queue｜整齐的队伍 ; orderly manner｜有条不紊的方式 ; orderly evacuation｜有序疏散 ; hospital orderly｜医院护工
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，常作形容词；名词可指医院护工。

meanings_zh: adj. 热情友好的；诚挚的 | n. 浓缩果汁饮料
definition_en: Friendly and polite, often in a formal situation. | A sweet concentrated fruit drink usually diluted with water.
example1_en: Our professor circled lime cordial on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了青柠浓缩饮料。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of lime cordial.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得青柠浓缩饮料这个例子。
collocations: cordial welcome｜热情的欢迎 ; cordial relations｜友好关系 ; lime cordial｜青柠浓缩饮料
tip_zh: 形容友好态度较正式；名词在英国常指浓缩果饮。

meanings_zh: n. 鲤鱼 | v. 挑刺；吹毛求疵
definition_en: A freshwater fish with large scales, often kept in ponds. | To complain repeatedly about small or unimportant faults.
example1_en: Our professor circled common carp on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了普通鲤鱼。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of common carp.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得普通鲤鱼这个例子。
collocations: common carp｜普通鲤鱼 ; carp pond｜鲤鱼塘 ; carp at minor faults｜挑小毛病
tip_zh: 鱼名复数通常仍为carp；动词常接at。

meanings_zh: n. 秘书处；行政办事机构
definition_en: An office managing administrative work for a large organisation.
example1_en: Our professor circled a permanent secretariat on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了常设秘书处。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a permanent secretariat.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得常设秘书处这个例子。
collocations: a permanent secretariat｜常设秘书处 ; the committee secretariat｜委员会秘书处 ; establish a secretariat｜设立秘书处
tip_zh: 指负责行政工作的机构，不是单个秘书。

meanings_zh: v. 使恶化；降低质量 | v. 降解；分解 | v. 贬低；侮辱人格
definition_en: To reduce the quality or condition of something | To break down chemically into simpler substances | To treat someone as though they deserve no respect
example1_en: The assignment is to degrade soil quality, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先降低土壤质量，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed environmental policy, the speaker told us to degrade soil quality.
example2_zh: 全班讨论环境政策时，讲者让我们降低土壤质量。
collocations: degrade soil quality｜降低土壤质量 ; degrade the environment｜破坏环境 ; degrade over time｜随时间降解
tip_zh: 表示质量下降时可及物；化学降解也可不及物。

meanings_zh: v. 吊起；升起 | n. 起重装置
definition_en: lift something heavy, often using ropes or machinery | a device used for lifting heavy objects
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to hoist a flag.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须升旗。
example2_en: The passage says students who can hoist a flag follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够升旗的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: hoist a flag｜升旗 ; hoist a sail｜扬帆 ; hoist into position｜吊装就位 ; electric hoist｜电动起重装置
tip_zh: 强调费力抬起或借助绳索、机械吊起。

meanings_zh: n. 癫痫等疾病的突然发作 | n. 扣押；没收；夺取
definition_en: A sudden episode of abnormal electrical activity in the brain. | The act of taking something by force or legal authority.
example1_en: Office hours began with an epileptic seizure.
example1_zh: 答疑从癫痫发作开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used an epileptic seizure to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用癫痫发作来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: have a seizure｜癫痫发作 ; an epileptic seizure｜癫痫发作 ; seizure of assets｜资产扣押 ; seizure of power｜夺取政权
tip_zh: 医学义常搭配have；扣押某物用seizure of。

meanings_zh: adj. 不对称的 | adj. 不均衡的；不对等的
definition_en: having sides or parts that do not match | unequal between people, groups, or sides
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on asymmetric design.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论不对称设计。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of asymmetric design.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得不对称设计这个例子。
collocations: asymmetric design｜不对称设计 ; asymmetric information｜不对称信息 ; asymmetric distribution｜不对称分布
tip_zh: 既可指形状不对称，也可指信息或力量不对等。

meanings_zh: adj. 允许的；许可的
definition_en: Allowed by a rule, law, or accepted standard
example1_en: Office hours began with legally permissible.
example1_zh: 答疑从法律允许的开始。
example2_en: The author returns to legally permissible when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了法律允许的。
collocations: permissible limits｜允许的限度 ; legally permissible｜法律允许的 ; permissible levels｜允许的水平
tip_zh: 常用句型：It is permissible to do sth.。

meanings_zh: v. 使复兴；重新流行 | v. 苏醒；使恢复活力
definition_en: to become active or popular again, or make something so | to regain consciousness or energy, or help someone do so
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to revive the economy.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须振兴经济。
example2_en: The reading asks you to revive the economy and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你振兴经济，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: revive the economy｜振兴经济 ; revive interest in｜重新激起对……的兴趣 ; revive a tradition｜恢复传统
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：revive a tradition；hopes revive。

meanings_zh: n. 立体主义
