definition_en: able to express ideas clearly and effectively | to express thoughts or feelings clearly in words
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an articulate speaker.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论表达清晰的演讲者。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an articulate speaker.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论表达清晰的演讲者的材料。
collocations: an articulate speaker｜表达清晰的演讲者 ; articulate ideas｜清楚表达想法 ; articulate concerns｜明确表达担忧
tip_zh: 形容词词尾读/lət/，动词词尾读/leɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 货物；货运 | n. 运费 | v. 运输货物
definition_en: goods transported in bulk, or the transport of such goods | the money charged for transporting goods | to transport goods by ship, aircraft, train, or truck
example1_en: Office hours began with air freight.
example1_zh: 答疑从航空货运开始。
example2_en: The author returns to air freight when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了航空货运。
collocations: air freight｜航空货运 ; freight train｜货运列车 ; freight charges｜运费 ; rail freight｜铁路货运
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；cargo主要指货物，不指货运服务。

meanings_zh: v. 吞没；完全笼罩 | v. 使陷入；压倒
definition_en: to surround or cover something completely | to overwhelm someone or something with a powerful situation
example1_en: After the lecture, we used engulf in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了吞没。
example2_en: Students who can explain engulf usually follow the rest of a lecture on environmental policy.
example2_zh: 能解释吞没的学生，通常跟得上一节关于环境政策的讲座。
collocations: be engulfed in flames｜被火焰吞没 ; be engulfed by floodwater｜被洪水淹没 ; a crisis engulfs a country｜危机席卷一个国家
tip_zh: 常用被动结构be engulfed in/by，强调完全覆盖。

meanings_zh: n. 严重饥饿；饿死
definition_en: Extreme suffering or death caused by a prolonged lack of food
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on face starvation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论面临饥饿威胁。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around face starvation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕面临饥饿威胁展开说明。
collocations: face starvation｜面临饥饿威胁 ; die of starvation｜饿死 ; mass starvation｜大规模饥荒 ; on the brink of starvation｜濒临饿死
tip_zh: 比hunger严重，指长期缺食造成的极度饥饿或死亡。

meanings_zh: adj. 城市的；市政的 | adj. 公民的
definition_en: relating to a town or city and its administration | relating to citizens and their responsibilities within a community
example1_en: The textbook introduces civic centre in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了市政中心。
example2_en: The author returns to civic centre when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了市政中心。
collocations: civic centre｜市政中心 ; civic responsibility｜公民责任 ; civic pride｜市民自豪感 ; civic engagement｜公民参与
tip_zh: civic强调城市或公民事务；civil还可指民事的、礼貌的。

meanings_zh: n. 抽样；取样 | n. 试吃；体验
definition_en: Selecting a small part of something to study the whole. | Trying small amounts of something to discover what it is like.
example1_en: Our professor circled random sampling on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了随机抽样。
example2_en: The reading connects random sampling with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把随机抽样和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: random sampling｜随机抽样 ; sampling method｜抽样方法 ; sampling error｜抽样误差 ; water sampling｜水体取样
tip_zh: 抽样过程用sampling；抽出的样本用sample。

meanings_zh: n. 恶化；退化 | n. 降解 | n. 受辱；尊严丧失
definition_en: The process of becoming damaged or poorer in quality. | The breakdown of a substance into simpler substances. | The loss of dignity caused by humiliating treatment.
example1_en: I copied environmental degradation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把环境恶化抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss environmental degradation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论环境恶化的材料。
collocations: environmental degradation｜环境恶化 ; soil degradation｜土壤退化 ; microbial degradation｜微生物降解
tip_zh: 环境话题常指恶化，化学或生物语境可指降解。

meanings_zh: n. 正直；诚实 | n. 完整性；完好
definition_en: the quality of being honest and following strong moral principles | the condition of being whole, undamaged, or unchanged
example1_en: Office hours began with personal integrity.
example1_zh: 答疑从个人操守开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used personal integrity to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用个人操守来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: personal integrity｜个人操守 ; professional integrity｜职业操守 ; structural integrity｜结构完整性
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既指人的正直，也指结构的完整性。

meanings_zh: v. 阻碍；妨碍 | n. 有盖大篮；食品礼篮
definition_en: to make progress or an activity more difficult | a large basket, often holding food or laundry
example1_en: I heard the lecturer hamper progress during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时阻碍进展。
example2_en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to hamper progress.
example2_zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们阻碍进展。
collocations: hamper progress｜阻碍进展 ; hamper efforts｜妨碍努力 ; a picnic hamper｜野餐篮 ; a laundry hamper｜洗衣篮
tip_zh: 动词后直接接宾语；名词还可指食品篮或洗衣篮。

meanings_zh: v. 明确规定；约定
definition_en: To state a requirement clearly as part of an agreement
example1_en: The lab instructions say to stipulate that.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求明确规定……。
example2_en: The passage says students who can stipulate that follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够明确规定……的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: stipulate that｜明确规定…… ; stipulate conditions｜规定条件 ; stipulate a deadline｜规定截止日期
tip_zh: 正式用词，常用于合同；可接名词或that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 保税的 | adj. 紧密相连的；黏合的
definition_en: Stored under customs control until import duties are paid | Closely connected emotionally or firmly joined together
example1_en: I copied bonded warehouse into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把保税仓库抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to bonded warehouse when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了保税仓库。
collocations: bonded warehouse｜保税仓库 ; bonded goods｜保税货物 ; bonded labour｜债役劳动
tip_zh: 保税指暂缓缴纳进口税，并非永久免税。

meanings_zh: adj. 务实的；讲求实效的
definition_en: Choosing what works in practice rather than following ideals.
example1_en: Our professor circled pragmatic approach on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了务实的方法。
example2_en: The reading connects pragmatic approach with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把务实的方法和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pragmatic approach｜务实的方法 ; pragmatic solution｜切实可行的解决办法 ; pragmatic decision｜务实的决定
tip_zh: 强调实际可行和效果，而非理论或理想。

meanings_zh: v. 实现；成为现实 | v. 突然出现
definition_en: To happen or become real after being expected or planned. | To appear suddenly or unexpectedly.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used materialize in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了实现。
example2_en: Students who can explain materialize usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释实现的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: fail to materialize｜未能实现 ; never materialize｜始终未能实现 ; benefits materialize｜效益显现
tip_zh: 常作不及物动词，指计划实现；英式也写materialise。

meanings_zh: n. 墨盒；可更换盒 | n. 枪弹；弹药筒
definition_en: a replaceable container holding material needed by a machine | a case containing an explosive charge and usually a bullet
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about ink cartridge.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于墨盒的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to ink cartridge when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了墨盒。
collocations: ink cartridge｜墨盒 ; toner cartridge｜硒鼓；碳粉盒 ; replace a cartridge｜更换墨盒 ; spent cartridge｜用过的弹壳
tip_zh: 核心是可装入设备的筒或盒；打印机语境常指墨盒。

meanings_zh: v. 使工业化；实现工业化
definition_en: Develop industries and factories in a country or region
example1_en: The professor asked us to industrialize rapidly.
example1_zh: 教授让我们迅速工业化。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to industrialize rapidly.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得迅速工业化。
collocations: industrialize rapidly｜迅速工业化 ; a highly industrialized country｜高度工业化的国家 ; newly industrialized economies｜新兴工业化经济体
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物；英式也拼作industrialise。

meanings_zh: adj. 旋转的；转动式的 | n. 环形交叉路口
definition_en: Moving in circles, or operating through circular movement. | A circular road junction, called a roundabout in British English.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about rotary motion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于旋转运动的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of rotary motion.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得旋转运动这个例子。
collocations: rotary motion｜旋转运动 ; rotary engine｜转子发动机 ; rotary mower｜旋转式割草机
tip_zh: 常形容旋转式机械；不等同于表示轮流的rotating。

meanings_zh: n. 不专心；疏忽
definition_en: failure to give enough attention to someone or something
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a moment of inattention.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一时疏忽的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a moment of inattention to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一时疏忽来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a moment of inattention｜一时疏忽 ; driver inattention｜驾驶员注意力不集中 ; inattention to detail｜不注意细节
tip_zh: 不可数名词；inattention to表示对某事不留心。

meanings_zh: n. 暴雨；洪水 | n. 大量涌来的事物 | v. 淹没；使应接不暇
definition_en: An extremely heavy fall of rain or a severe flood. | An overwhelming quantity of things arriving at once. | Overwhelm someone or something with water or excessive quantities.
example1_en: Office hours began with a sudden deluge.
example1_zh: 答疑从突如其来的暴雨开始。
example2_en: The reading connects a sudden deluge with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把突如其来的暴雨和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a deluge of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉 ; be deluged with requests｜被大量请求弄得应接不暇 ; a sudden deluge｜突如其来的暴雨
tip_zh: 比喻大量涌来用a deluge of；动词常用be deluged with。

meanings_zh: v. 变硬；使僵硬 | v. 变坚决；加强
definition_en: to become or make something rigid or less flexible | to become or make something firmer, stronger, or more determined
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to stiffen with fear.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须吓得身体僵住。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to stiffen with fear.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们吓得身体僵住。
collocations: muscles stiffen｜肌肉变僵硬 ; stiffen with fear｜吓得身体僵住 ; stiffen resistance｜加强抵抗
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：stiffen muscles或muscles stiffen。

meanings_zh: v. 使瘫痪；使麻痹 | v. 使无法行动；使停顿
definition_en: to cause someone to lose the ability to move | to prevent someone or something from acting or functioning
example1_en: The assignment is to paralyse transport, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使交通瘫痪，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to paralyse transport and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你使交通瘫痪，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: be paralysed by fear｜吓得动弹不得 ; paralyse transport｜使交通瘫痪 ; be partially paralysed｜部分身体瘫痪
tip_zh: 英式拼写为paralyse，美式为paralyze。

meanings_zh: n. 搁浅事件 | v. 使滞留；使搁浅
definition_en: an event in which a boat or sea animal becomes stuck | leaving someone unable to travel or something stuck on shore
example1_en: Our professor circled a whale stranding on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了鲸鱼搁浅事件。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a whale stranding.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得鲸鱼搁浅事件这个例子。
collocations: a whale stranding｜鲸鱼搁浅事件 ; a mass stranding｜集体搁浅事件 ; a stranding event｜一次搁浅事件
tip_zh: 可作名词，也可作strand的现在分词；被困用stranded。

meanings_zh: n. 爱国精神；爱国主义
definition_en: Love for and loyalty to your country.
example1_en: Our professor circled a sense of patriotism on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了爱国情怀。
example2_en: The reading connects a sense of patriotism with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把爱国情怀和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a sense of patriotism｜爱国情怀 ; express patriotism｜表达爱国之情 ; inspire patriotism｜激发爱国精神
tip_zh: 强调爱国情感，不宜直接等同于nationalism民族主义。

meanings_zh: n. 改进；完善 | n. 精炼；提纯 | n. 优雅；文雅
definition_en: A small change that makes something better or more effective. | The process of removing unwanted substances from a material. | Polite behaviour and good taste in social or cultural matters.
example1_en: Office hours began with further refinement.
example1_zh: 答疑从进一步完善开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss further refinement.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论进一步完善的材料。
collocations: further refinement｜进一步完善 ; a refinement to the design｜对设计的一项改进 ; the refinement of raw materials｜原材料的精炼
tip_zh: 具体改进可数；改进过程、提纯或文雅通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 讲道；布道 | v. 宣扬；竭力倡导 | v. 说教
definition_en: To deliver a religious talk to a group of people. | To strongly encourage others to accept an idea or behaviour. | To give unwanted advice about how others should behave.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer preach a sermon during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时布道。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers preach a sermon before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要布道。
collocations: preach a sermon｜布道 ; preach tolerance｜倡导宽容 ; preach to someone｜对某人说教 ; practise what you preach｜身体力行
tip_zh: preach to someone常含“对某人说教”的贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 温顺的；逆来顺受的
definition_en: Quiet and unwilling to argue or resist others.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on meek voice.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论怯弱的声音。
example2_en: The author returns to meek voice when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了怯弱的声音。
collocations: meek voice｜怯弱的声音 ; meek acceptance｜逆来顺受的接受 ; meek and mild｜温顺柔和的
tip_zh: 常暗含不敢反抗，不等同于褒义的 humble。

meanings_zh: n. 伴奏 | n. 配菜；搭配物
definition_en: Music played to support a singer or main instrument. | Something served or provided together with something else.
example1_en: The textbook introduces piano accompaniment in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了钢琴伴奏。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around piano accompaniment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕钢琴伴奏展开说明。
collocations: piano accompaniment｜钢琴伴奏 ; musical accompaniment｜音乐伴奏 ; an accompaniment to｜与……搭配的事物
tip_zh: 指伴奏或搭配物；“同伴”应说 companion。

meanings_zh: n. 物流；后勤组织
definition_en: The organization of transporting goods, equipment, or people where needed.
example1_en: The textbook introduces transport logistics in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了运输物流。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around transport logistics.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕运输物流展开说明。
collocations: logistics management｜物流管理 ; handle the logistics｜负责后勤安排 ; transport logistics｜运输物流
tip_zh: 虽以-s结尾，但不表示多个；可指活动后勤。

meanings_zh: adj. 可察觉的；可感知的
definition_en: Noticeable through the senses or the mind.
example1_en: I copied barely perceptible into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把几乎察觉不到的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to barely perceptible when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了几乎察觉不到的。
collocations: barely perceptible｜几乎察觉不到的 ; perceptible change｜可察觉的变化 ; perceptible difference｜可察觉的差别
tip_zh: 指能察觉，不一定很明显；常与 barely 连用。

meanings_zh: adj. 熟练的；擅长的 | n. 能手；行家
definition_en: Very skilled at doing something. | Someone who is highly skilled in a particular activity.
example1_en: The textbook introduces technically adept in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了技术娴熟的。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of technically adept.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得技术娴熟的这个例子。
collocations: adept at solving problems｜善于解决问题 ; adept at handling｜善于处理 ; technically adept｜技术娴熟的
tip_zh: 常用be adept at doing，表示擅长做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 自命不凡的；故作高深的
definition_en: trying to seem more important or impressive than is justified
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sound pretentious.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论听起来装腔作势。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of sound pretentious.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得听起来装腔作势这个例子。
collocations: sound pretentious｜听起来装腔作势 ; pretentious language｜故作高深的语言 ; a pretentious attitude｜自命不凡的态度
tip_zh: 贬义：刻意显得高雅或重要，不只是有自信。

meanings_zh: adj. 次要的；非核心的 | adj. 外围的；末梢的 | n. 计算机外围设备
definition_en: Not central to the main issue or activity. | Situated away from the centre, towards the outer edge. | A device connected to a computer for additional functions.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on peripheral issue.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论次要问题。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of peripheral issue.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得次要问题这个例子。
collocations: peripheral issue｜次要问题 ; peripheral vision｜周边视觉 ; peripheral nerves｜周围神经 ; peripheral device｜外围设备
tip_zh: peripheral to表示对……而言次要或非核心。

meanings_zh: n. 恶化；退化；损坏
definition_en: The process of becoming worse in condition or quality.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about gradual deterioration.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于逐渐恶化的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss gradual deterioration.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论逐渐恶化的材料。
collocations: a deterioration in health｜健康状况恶化 ; gradual deterioration｜逐渐恶化 ; prevent further deterioration｜防止进一步恶化
tip_zh: 常用a deterioration in表示某方面的恶化。

meanings_zh: n. 疏离感；疏远 | n. 异化
definition_en: The feeling of being disconnected from other people or society. | Separation from meaningful work, personal identity, or human potential.
example1_en: Office hours began with a sense of alienation.
example1_zh: 答疑从疏离感开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a sense of alienation.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得疏离感这个例子。
collocations: a sense of alienation｜疏离感 ; social alienation｜社会疏离 ; alienation from society｜与社会的疏离
tip_zh: 日常多指疏离感；哲学、社会学中可指异化。

meanings_zh: n. 疏忽；失职；过失
definition_en: Failure to take proper care or fulfil a responsibility
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about professional negligence.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于专业失职的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used professional negligence to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用专业失职来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: professional negligence｜专业失职 ; medical negligence｜医疗过失 ; gross negligence｜重大过失 ; negligence claims｜过失索赔
tip_zh: 不可数名词，常指未尽应有注意义务的过失。

meanings_zh: adj. 陆生的；陆地的 | adj. 地球的 | adj. 地面广播的
definition_en: living on or relating to land rather than water | relating to Earth rather than other planets | broadcast using equipment on Earth rather than satellites
example1_en: The textbook introduces terrestrial animals in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了陆生动物。
example2_en: The author returns to terrestrial animals when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了陆生动物。
collocations: terrestrial animals｜陆生动物 ; terrestrial ecosystems｜陆地生态系统 ; terrestrial television｜地面电视广播
tip_zh: 陆生义与aquatic（水生的）相对。

meanings_zh: n. 淀粉 | v. 给衣物上浆
definition_en: A carbohydrate found in foods such as potatoes, rice, and bread. | To treat cloth with starch to make it stiff.
example1_en: Office hours began with rich in starch.
example1_zh: 答疑从富含淀粉开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rich in starch.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论富含淀粉的材料。
collocations: rich in starch｜富含淀粉 ; potato starch｜马铃薯淀粉 ; corn starch｜玉米淀粉 ; starch a shirt｜给衬衫上浆
tip_zh: 作“淀粉”通常不可数；starchy意为富含淀粉的。

meanings_zh: adj. 情境相关的；由环境引起的
definition_en: Related to or caused by the circumstances of a particular situation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on situational factors.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论情境因素。
example2_en: The author returns to situational factors when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了情境因素。
collocations: situational factors｜情境因素 ; situational awareness｜情境意识 ; situational anxiety｜情境性焦虑
tip_zh: 强调特定情境的影响，不等于暂时的。

meanings_zh: n. 垄断；独占 | n. 垄断企业
definition_en: complete control of a market or exclusive possession of something | a business that exclusively supplies a product or service
example1_en: Our professor circled state monopoly on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了国家垄断。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of state monopoly.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得国家垄断这个例子。
collocations: have a monopoly on｜垄断；独占 ; break a monopoly｜打破垄断 ; state monopoly｜国家垄断
tip_zh: 表示对某领域的垄断，常用monopoly on。

meanings_zh: n. 采石场 | v. 开采石料 | n. 猎物；追捕对象
definition_en: A large open pit where stone is dug from the ground. | To dig stone out of the ground. | An animal or person being hunted or pursued.
example1_en: Office hours began with stone quarry.
example1_zh: 答疑从采石场开始。
example2_en: The author returns to stone quarry when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了采石场。
collocations: stone quarry｜采石场 ; disused quarry｜废弃采石场 ; quarry limestone｜开采石灰岩
tip_zh: 采石场义可数；猎物义常用单数形式。

meanings_zh: n. 小袋鼠
definition_en: An animal resembling a kangaroo but generally smaller.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a rock wallaby.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于岩袋鼠的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a rock wallaby with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把岩袋鼠和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a wallaby population｜小袋鼠种群 ; wallaby habitat｜小袋鼠栖息地 ; a rock wallaby｜岩袋鼠
tip_zh: wallaby不是袋鼠幼崽；袋鼠幼崽叫joey。

meanings_zh: n. 外行；非专业人士 | n. 普通男信徒
definition_en: someone without specialist knowledge of a particular subject | a male religious member who is not a priest or minister
example1_en: The professor explained layman with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了外行。
example2_en: A reading on academic research uses layman when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了外行。
collocations: in layman's terms｜用通俗的话 ; explain to a layman｜向外行解释
tip_zh: 泛指非专业人士时，layperson更具性别包容性。

meanings_zh: v. 猛冲；飞奔 | n. 飞镖
definition_en: To move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction. | A small pointed object thrown at a target.
example1_en: The assignment is to dart across the road, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先飞快地穿过马路，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to dart across the road.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来飞快地穿过马路。
collocations: dart across the road｜飞快地穿过马路 ; dart a glance at｜迅速瞥一眼 ; throw a dart｜投飞镖 ; play darts｜玩飞镖
tip_zh: 飞镖运动用darts；作主语时谓语用单数。

meanings_zh: v. 克制；避免做 | n. 副歌；反复出现的话
definition_en: To deliberately stop yourself from doing something. | A repeated part of a song, poem, or speech.
example1_en: The assignment is to refrain from comment, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先不予置评，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to refrain from comment.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得不予置评。
collocations: refrain from doing something｜避免做某事 ; refrain from comment｜不予置评 ; a familiar refrain｜老生常谈
tip_zh: 动词常用refrain from doing，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 硝酸盐
definition_en: A salt of nitric acid, often used in fertilisers
example1_en: The textbook introduces potassium nitrate in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了硝酸钾。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of potassium nitrate.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得硝酸钾这个例子。
collocations: nitrate levels｜硝酸盐含量 ; nitrate pollution｜硝酸盐污染 ; potassium nitrate｜硝酸钾 ; nitrate fertiliser｜硝酸盐肥料
tip_zh: nitrate是硝酸盐；nitrite是亚硝酸盐。

meanings_zh: v. 减损；降低
definition_en: To make something seem less valuable, attractive, or impressive.
example1_en: The assignment is to detract from the appeal, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先削弱吸引力，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to detract from the appeal and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你削弱吸引力，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: detract from the appeal｜削弱吸引力 ; detract from the value｜降低价值 ; detract from the achievement｜使成就逊色
tip_zh: 通常用detract from，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 逆境；困境
definition_en: A difficult or unfortunate situation that causes hardship.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about face adversity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于面对逆境的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to face adversity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了面对逆境。
collocations: face adversity｜面对逆境 ; overcome adversity｜克服困境 ; in the face of adversity｜面对逆境时
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，常与face、overcome搭配。

meanings_zh: adj. 痛苦的；可怜的 | adj. 恶劣的；糟糕的
definition_en: Very unhappy, uncomfortable, or unfortunate. | Extremely bad in quality or condition.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on wretched conditions.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论恶劣的条件。
example2_en: The author returns to wretched conditions when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了恶劣的条件。
collocations: feel wretched｜感到难受 ; wretched conditions｜恶劣的条件 ; wretched existence｜悲惨的生活
tip_zh: 开头w不发音；词尾-ed在此读/ɪd/。

meanings_zh: v. 捐资设立；资助 | v. 赋予品质或能力
definition_en: give money to support an institution or position permanently | give someone or something a particular quality or ability
example1_en: The assignment is to endow a scholarship, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先捐资设立奖学金，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can endow a scholarship follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够捐资设立奖学金的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: endow a scholarship｜捐资设立奖学金 ; endow a chair｜捐资设立教授席位 ; be endowed with｜天生具有
tip_zh: be endowed with常指天生具备某种才能或品质。

meanings_zh: adj. 半透明的
definition_en: Allowing light through, but not a clear view of objects.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on translucent glass.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论半透明玻璃。
example2_en: The author returns to translucent glass when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了半透明玻璃。
collocations: translucent glass｜半透明玻璃 ; translucent material｜半透明材料 ; translucent panels｜半透明板材
tip_zh: 与transparent不同：能透光，但看不清后面的物体。

meanings_zh: n. 峡谷 | v. 狼吞虎咽；大吃
definition_en: a deep, narrow valley with steep sides | to eat a very large amount of food
example1_en: The textbook introduces a deep gorge in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了深峡谷。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a deep gorge.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得深峡谷这个例子。
collocations: a deep gorge｜深峡谷 ; a narrow gorge｜狭窄的峡谷 ; gorge on food｜大吃食物
tip_zh: 现代常用名词义为“峡谷”；动词常接 on。

meanings_zh: n. 负债；债务 | n. 感激；受恩
definition_en: The state of owing money, or the amount owed. | A feeling of gratitude for help received.
example1_en: The textbook introduces household indebtedness in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了家庭负债。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of household indebtedness.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得家庭负债这个例子。
collocations: household indebtedness｜家庭负债 ; a sense of indebtedness｜感恩之情 ; indebtedness to someone｜对某人的感激或欠债
tip_zh: 既可指负债，也可指感恩；b不发音。

meanings_zh: v. 使沉浸；使专心于 | v. 浸没；浸入
definition_en: to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience | to put something completely beneath the surface of a liquid
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to immerse yourself in.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使自己沉浸于。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to immerse yourself in.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使自己沉浸于。
collocations: immerse yourself in｜使自己沉浸于 ; fully immersed in｜完全沉浸于 ; immerse in water｜浸入水中
tip_zh: 沉浸于某事用immerse yourself in，注意反身代词。

meanings_zh: n. 老手；经验丰富的人 | n. 退伍军人；老兵
definition_en: Someone with extensive experience in a particular activity or profession. | Someone who has served in the armed forces, especially during war.
example1_en: Office hours began with a war veteran.
example1_zh: 答疑从参战老兵开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a war veteran when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了参战老兵。
collocations: a veteran of｜在……方面经验丰富的人 ; a war veteran｜参战老兵 ; a veteran journalist｜资深记者
tip_zh: a veteran of后接领域或经历；也可前置修饰职业名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 垂直的；成直角的 | adj. 直立的；陡直的 | n. 垂线
definition_en: Meeting another line or surface at a right angle | Rising straight up rather than sloping | A line forming a right angle with another
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on perpendicular to.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论与……垂直。
example2_en: The author returns to perpendicular to when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了与……垂直。
collocations: perpendicular to｜与……垂直 ; perpendicular lines｜互相垂直的线 ; a perpendicular cliff｜陡直的悬崖
tip_zh: 表示与某物垂直用perpendicular to，不用with。

meanings_zh: adj. 含盐的；盐的 | n. 生理盐水；盐溶液
definition_en: containing salt or relating to salt | a salt solution, especially one used in medical treatment
example1_en: I copied saline solution into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把盐溶液抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used saline solution to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用盐溶液来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: saline solution｜盐溶液 ; saline water｜咸水 ; saline soil｜盐渍土
tip_zh: 医学中saline常指生理盐水，不指盐湖。

meanings_zh: n. 让步；妥协 | n. 优惠；减价 | n. 特许经营权
definition_en: Something accepted or given up to help reach an agreement | A reduced price offered to a particular group of people | Official permission to operate a business or use particular resources
example1_en: I copied a major concession into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把重大让步抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a major concession.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得重大让步这个例子。
collocations: make a concession｜作出让步 ; price concessions｜价格优惠 ; a major concession｜重大让步 ; mining concession｜采矿特许权
tip_zh: make concessions表示让步；英式英语中也指票价优惠。

meanings_zh: n. 被迫迁离；流离失所 | n. 取代；替代 | n. 位移；排开量
definition_en: The forced movement of people away from their homes. | The replacement of someone or something by another. | Movement from a position, or fluid pushed aside by an object.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on population displacement.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人口被迫迁移。
example2_en: A campus survey used population displacement to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用人口被迫迁移来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: population displacement｜人口被迫迁移 ; forced displacement｜被迫迁离 ; job displacement｜岗位被取代 ; water displacement｜排水量
tip_zh: 指人常译被迫迁离；物理中指位移或排开量。

meanings_zh: n. 移居国外者；移出者
definition_en: someone who leaves their country to settle in another
example1_en: The textbook introduces emigrant workers in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了移居国外的工人。
example2_en: A campus survey used emigrant workers to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用移居国外的工人来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: emigrant workers｜移居国外的工人 ; emigrant community｜移居海外的群体 ; emigrant families｜移居国外的家庭
tip_zh: 从原籍国看是emigrant，从迁入国看是immigrant。

meanings_zh: adj. 可溶的 | adj. 可解决的
definition_en: Able to dissolve in a liquid. | Possible to solve, especially through thought or effort.
example1_en: Our professor circled highly soluble on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了溶解度高的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly soluble.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕溶解度高的展开说明。
collocations: soluble in water｜可溶于水 ; water-soluble vitamins｜水溶性维生素 ; highly soluble｜溶解度高的
tip_zh: 常用be soluble in；水溶性可写water-soluble。

meanings_zh: n. 膈；横膈膜 | n. 膜片；振动膜 | n. 光圈
definition_en: the muscle below your lungs that helps you breathe | a thin flexible sheet that vibrates in sound equipment | a camera part that controls how much light enters
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about camera diaphragm.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于相机光圈的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects camera diaphragm with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把相机光圈和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: diaphragm contraction｜膈肌收缩 ; relax the diaphragm｜放松膈肌 ; camera diaphragm｜相机光圈
tip_zh: 解剖学义也称膈肌；注意ph发/f/，g不发音。

meanings_zh: adj. 具备基本计算能力的
definition_en: able to understand and work with numbers
example1_en: Our professor circled highly numerate on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了计算能力很强的。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss highly numerate.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论计算能力很强的的材料。
collocations: numerate staff｜具备计算能力的员工 ; highly numerate｜计算能力很强的 ; literate and numerate｜具备读写和计算能力的
tip_zh: 现代常作形容词，指有计算能力；名词为numeracy。

meanings_zh: adj. 协同一致的；共同筹划的 | adj. 全力以赴的
definition_en: Planned and carried out together to achieve a shared goal. | Involving determined effort directed towards a particular goal.
example1_en: Office hours began with concerted effort.
example1_zh: 答疑从共同努力；全力投入开始。
example2_en: The reading connects concerted effort with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把共同努力；全力投入和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: concerted effort｜共同努力；全力投入 ; concerted action｜协同行动 ; concerted campaign｜联合开展的运动
tip_zh: 常修饰effort或action，强调协同或集中全力。

meanings_zh: n. 北美大草原
definition_en: A broad, mostly treeless grassland in North America
example1_en: Our professor circled native prairie on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了原生北美草原。
example2_en: The reading connects native prairie with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把原生北美草原和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: prairie grass｜草原牧草 ; native prairie｜原生北美草原 ; prairie conservation｜北美草原保护
tip_zh: 通常特指北美草原；泛指草地可用 grassland。

meanings_zh: adj. 强大的；巨大的 | adv. 非常；很
definition_en: Very strong, powerful, or large. | Very; used informally to make a description stronger.
example1_en: The textbook introduces mighty river in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大河。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mighty river.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论大河的材料。
collocations: mighty river｜大河 ; mighty empire｜强大的帝国 ; mighty effort｜极大的努力
tip_zh: 形容词常带文学色彩；副词义“很”较口语化。

meanings_zh: n. 鸦片
definition_en: An addictive substance from poppies, used to produce certain painkillers
example1_en: Our professor circled opium poppy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了罂粟。
example2_en: A campus survey used opium poppy to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用罂粟来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: opium poppy｜罂粟 ; opium trade｜鸦片贸易 ; opium addiction｜鸦片成瘾
tip_zh: 不可数名词，专指鸦片，不泛指所有麻醉剂。

meanings_zh: n. 隼；猎鹰
definition_en: a hunting bird with pointed wings and a curved beak
example1_en: Office hours began with peregrine falcon.
example1_zh: 答疑从游隼开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used peregrine falcon to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用游隼来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: peregrine falcon｜游隼 ; falcon nest｜隼巢 ; falcon population｜隼的种群
tip_zh: falcon指隼，不宜与泛指鹰的hawk完全等同。

meanings_zh: n. 效度；有效性
definition_en: The quality of being logically sound or of measuring what is intended.
example1_en: The professor questioned the validity of the online quiz.
example1_zh: 教授质疑这份在线小测的效度。
example2_en: A large sample does not by itself guarantee the validity of a measure.
example2_zh: 样本大本身并不能保证测量的效度。
collocations: validity of a test｜测验的效度 ; external validity｜外部效度
tip_zh: 效度是 validity，信度是 reliability。

meanings_zh: v. 抵制购买；拒绝参加 | n. 抵制行动
definition_en: Refuse to buy or participate in something as a protest. | An organized refusal to buy or participate as a protest.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to boycott a product.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抵制某产品。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to boycott a product.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得抵制某产品。
collocations: boycott a product｜抵制某产品 ; consumer boycott｜消费者抵制 ; call for a boycott｜呼吁抵制 ; boycott an event｜拒绝参加活动
tip_zh: 动词后直接接抵制对象；名词常用a boycott of。

meanings_zh: adj. 公平合理的；公正的
definition_en: fair to everyone involved, taking their different circumstances into account
example1_en: I copied equitable distribution into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把公平分配抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss equitable distribution.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论公平分配的材料。
collocations: equitable distribution｜公平分配 ; equitable access｜公平的获取机会 ; equitable treatment｜公正待遇
tip_zh: equitable强调按情况公平，不一定是equal的均等。

meanings_zh: adj. 标志性的；有代表性的
definition_en: widely recognised as representing a place, style, or idea
example1_en: I copied iconic landmark into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把标志性地标抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects iconic landmark with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把标志性地标和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: iconic landmark｜标志性地标 ; iconic design｜经典设计 ; iconic image｜标志性形象
tip_zh: 不只是“著名”，还强调鲜明的代表性和辨识度。

meanings_zh: n. 促成变化的人或事 | n. 催化剂
definition_en: A person or thing that triggers or accelerates change. | A substance that speeds up a reaction without being consumed.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a chemical catalyst.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于化学催化剂的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a chemical catalyst with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把化学催化剂和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a catalyst for change｜变革的推动因素 ; act as a catalyst｜起推动作用 ; a chemical catalyst｜化学催化剂
tip_zh: 比喻推动变化时常用a catalyst for。

meanings_zh: n. 果仁；谷粒 | n. 核心；要点 | n. 操作系统内核
definition_en: The edible inner part of a nut, or a grain seed. | The central or most important part of something. | The central software component that manages a computer's basic operations.
example1_en: The textbook introduces corn kernel in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了玉米粒。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around corn kernel.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕玉米粒展开说明。
collocations: corn kernel｜玉米粒 ; walnut kernel｜核桃仁 ; a kernel of truth｜些许事实 ; operating system kernel｜操作系统内核
tip_zh: kernel指壳内的仁或谷粒，不是桃子等的硬核。

meanings_zh: n. 梗概；概要
definition_en: A short account of the main points of a work.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a brief synopsis.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于简短概要的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a brief synopsis to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用简短概要来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a brief synopsis｜简短概要 ; a plot synopsis｜情节梗概 ; a synopsis of the report｜报告概要
tip_zh: 复数为synopses；常用a synopsis of表示某作品的梗概。

meanings_zh: n. 镇压；压制 | n. 隐瞒；封锁 | n. 抑制；控制
definition_en: The forceful prevention of an activity or expression. | The deliberate prevention of information from becoming known. | The reduction or control of a reaction or process.
example1_en: The textbook introduces immune suppression in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了免疫抑制。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around immune suppression.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕免疫抑制展开说明。
collocations: suppression of dissent｜压制异议 ; suppression of evidence｜隐瞒证据 ; immune suppression｜免疫抑制
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词为suppress，注意双写pp和ss。

meanings_zh: n. 复苏；重新流行 | n. 戏剧等的重新上演
definition_en: a return to activity, strength, or popularity | a new production of a play or other older performance
example1_en: Office hours began with economic revival.
example1_zh: 答疑从经济复苏开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used economic revival to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用经济复苏来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: economic revival｜经济复苏 ; a revival of interest｜兴趣的重新燃起 ; stage a revival｜重新上演
tip_zh: revival强调衰退或沉寂后重新活跃。

meanings_zh: v. 大量存在；充满
definition_en: To exist in large quantities or be very common
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to abound in wildlife.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何野生动物丰富。
example2_en: The passage says students who can abound in wildlife follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够野生动物丰富的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: opportunities abound｜机会众多 ; rumours abound｜传言四起 ; abound in wildlife｜野生动物丰富
tip_zh: 不及物动词；某地充满某物用abound in/with。

meanings_zh: v. 仔细考虑；沉思
definition_en: to think carefully about something for some time
example1_en: The assignment is to ponder a question, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先认真思考问题，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers ponder a question before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要认真思考问题。
collocations: ponder a question｜认真思考问题 ; ponder the implications｜仔细考虑可能的影响 ; ponder over something｜反复思量某事
tip_zh: 可直接接宾语，也可用ponder on/over。

meanings_zh: v. 注定；预定
definition_en: to determine someone's future or something's intended purpose
example1_en: After the lecture, we used destine in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了注定。
example2_en: Students who can explain destine usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释注定的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: be destined to do｜注定会做 ; be destined for success｜注定成功 ; goods destined for export｜预定出口的货物
tip_zh: 几乎总用被动：be destined for或to do。

meanings_zh: v. 超过；胜过
definition_en: to be greater or better than someone or something
example1_en: The assignment is to surpass expectations, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先超出预期，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can surpass expectations follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够超出预期的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: surpass expectations｜超出预期 ; surpass a record｜打破纪录 ; surpass previous levels｜超过以往水平
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语，不加than。

meanings_zh: v. 逐渐增加；加剧 | v. 安装；固定 | v. 组织开展；发起
definition_en: To increase gradually in amount, strength, or seriousness. | To attach something firmly to a surface or support. | To organize and begin an activity, campaign, or event.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to mount a campaign.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发起运动。
example2_en: The passage says students who can mount a campaign follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够发起运动的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: mounting pressure｜不断增加的压力 ; mount a campaign｜发起运动 ; mount on a wall｜安装在墙上
tip_zh: mount可指压力等上升；mount a campaign指发起运动。

meanings_zh: v. 利用；使用
definition_en: To use something effectively for a particular purpose.
example1_en: The assignment is to utilize resources, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先利用资源，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to utilize resources and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你利用资源，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: utilize resources｜利用资源 ; fully utilize｜充分利用 ; utilize available space｜利用现有空间
tip_zh: 比use正式；英式也常拼作utilise。

meanings_zh: n. 晶体管
definition_en: An electronic component that amplifies signals or switches electrical current.
example1_en: The textbook introduces silicon transistor in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了硅晶体管。
example2_en: The author returns to silicon transistor when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了硅晶体管。
collocations: transistor radio｜晶体管收音机 ; silicon transistor｜硅晶体管 ; transistor circuit｜晶体管电路
tip_zh: 指电子元件；transistor radio才是晶体管收音机。

meanings_zh: adj. 精美的；精致的 | adj. 极强烈的；极敏锐的
definition_en: Extremely beautiful and carefully made. | Describing a feeling or sensitivity of unusual intensity.
example1_en: The textbook introduces exquisite craftsmanship in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精湛工艺。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around exquisite craftsmanship.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕精湛工艺展开说明。
collocations: exquisite craftsmanship｜精湛工艺 ; exquisite beauty｜精美绝伦 ; exquisite detail｜精细的细节 ; exquisite pain｜剧痛
tip_zh: 常形容精美工艺；修饰pain时表示极其强烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 不兼容的；不相容的 | adj. 合不来的
definition_en: unable to work or exist together successfully | too different in character to have a good relationship
example1_en: The textbook introduces mutually incompatible in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了彼此不相容。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of mutually incompatible.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得彼此不相容这个例子。
collocations: incompatible with｜与……不相容 ; mutually incompatible｜彼此不相容 ; incompatible goals｜相互冲突的目标
tip_zh: 固定搭配为incompatible with，不用incompatible to。

meanings_zh: n. 参议院；上议院 | n. 古罗马元老院
definition_en: The upper chamber of parliament in some countries | The governing council of ancient Rome
example1_en: I copied senate election into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把参议院选举抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of senate election.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得参议院选举这个例子。
collocations: senate election｜参议院选举 ; senate committee｜参议院委员会 ; senate debate｜参议院辩论 ; a seat in the senate｜参议院席位
tip_zh: 指特定国家的参议院时，通常写作the Senate。

meanings_zh: adj. 连贯的；条理清楚的
definition_en: Logical and clear, with parts that fit together well.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a coherent argument.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于条理清楚的论证的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects a coherent argument with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把条理清楚的论证和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a coherent argument｜条理清楚的论证 ; a coherent explanation｜连贯清晰的解释 ; a coherent strategy｜协调一致的策略
tip_zh: 强调内容逻辑连贯；cohesive更强调各部分衔接紧密。

meanings_zh: v. 纠正；改正
definition_en: Correct something that is wrong or unsatisfactory.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to rectify an error.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求纠正错误。
example2_en: The reading asks you to rectify an error and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你纠正错误，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: rectify an error｜纠正错误 ; rectify a problem｜解决问题 ; rectify the situation｜纠正局面
tip_zh: 正式用词，常接error、mistake、situation。

meanings_zh: adj. 上述的；前面提到的
definition_en: Already referred to earlier in a piece of writing.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used above-mentioned in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了上述的。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up above-mentioned while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了上述的。
collocations: above-mentioned documents｜上述文件 ; above-mentioned measures｜上述措施 ; above-mentioned factors｜上述因素
tip_zh: 正式书面语，常置于名词前；写作中勿滥用。

meanings_zh: v. 透露；公开
definition_en: to make previously private or unknown information available
example1_en: The assignment is to disclose information, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先透露信息，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to disclose information.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来透露信息。
collocations: disclose information｜透露信息 ; disclose details｜披露细节 ; disclose something to someone｜向某人透露某事
tip_zh: 用disclose sth to sb；也可接that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 恼怒；忍无可忍
definition_en: strong annoyance caused by repeated problems or irritating behaviour
example1_en: The textbook introduces a sigh of exasperation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了恼火的叹息。
example2_en: The author returns to a sigh of exasperation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了恼火的叹息。
collocations: in exasperation｜恼怒地 ; a sigh of exasperation｜恼火的叹息 ; growing exasperation｜日益加剧的恼怒
tip_zh: 表示烦到失去耐心；勿与加剧混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 不和；纷争 | n. 不和谐音
definition_en: Disagreement or conflict between people or groups. | A combination of musical sounds that clash unpleasantly.
example1_en: Office hours began with social discord.
example1_zh: 答疑从社会不和开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of social discord.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得社会不和这个例子。
collocations: social discord｜社会不和 ; sow discord｜挑拨离间 ; a source of discord｜纷争的根源 ; marital discord｜婚姻不和
tip_zh: 表示不和时通常不可数，语气比disagreement正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 包容的；兼收并蓄的 | adj. 包含全部费用的 | adj. 包括首尾在内的
definition_en: welcoming people of different backgrounds and abilities | including all relevant costs | including both the first and last points of a range
example1_en: Office hours began with inclusive education.
example1_zh: 答疑从融合教育开始。
example2_en: The author returns to inclusive education when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了融合教育。
collocations: inclusive education｜融合教育 ; an inclusive society｜包容的社会 ; inclusive of tax｜含税 ; an inclusive price｜全包价格
tip_zh: inclusive of表示“包含”；日期范围后用它表示首尾均含。

meanings_zh: adj. 封建的；封建制度的
definition_en: Relating to a system exchanging land for service and loyalty.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the feudal system.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论封建制度。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of the feudal system.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得封建制度这个例子。
collocations: the feudal system｜封建制度 ; a feudal lord｜封建领主 ; feudal society｜封建社会
tip_zh: 主要描述土地换取效忠与服役的历史制度。

meanings_zh: n. 散文；非韵文
definition_en: Ordinary written language, rather than poetry
example1_en: I copied clear prose into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把清晰的行文抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects clear prose with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把清晰的行文和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: in prose｜以散文形式 ; clear prose｜清晰的行文 ; prose fiction｜散文体小说 ; a prose poem｜散文诗
tip_zh: 不可数；不限于文学散文，也包括小说等非韵文。

meanings_zh: v. 精简；提高效率 | v. 使成流线型
definition_en: to make a process simpler and more efficient | to shape something to move easily through air or water
example1_en: The assignment is to streamline operations, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先精简运营流程，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can streamline operations follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够精简运营流程的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: streamline operations｜精简运营流程 ; streamline a process｜简化流程 ; streamline administration｜精简行政管理
tip_zh: 通常作动词；“流线型的”用 streamlined。

meanings_zh: n. 方面；侧面 | n. 宝石等的切面
definition_en: One part or aspect of a complex subject. | A small flat surface on a cut stone.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about every facet.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于每个方面的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around every facet.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕每个方面展开说明。
collocations: a facet of life｜生活的一个方面 ; every facet｜每个方面 ; a different facet｜不同的侧面
tip_zh: 常用 a facet of，指复杂事物的一个方面。

meanings_zh: n. 速度；速率
definition_en: Speed of movement, including direction in physics.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about high velocity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于高速的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of high velocity.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得高速这个例子。
collocations: high velocity｜高速 ; constant velocity｜恒定速度 ; terminal velocity｜终端速度
tip_zh: 物理中velocity含方向，speed只表示快慢。

meanings_zh: adj. 固有的；内在的
definition_en: Belonging naturally to something, rather than coming from outside
example1_en: The textbook introduces intrinsic value in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了内在价值。
example2_en: A campus survey used intrinsic value to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用内在价值来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: intrinsic value｜内在价值 ; intrinsic motivation｜内在动力 ; intrinsic to｜为……所固有
tip_zh: intrinsic to表示“……所固有的”。

meanings_zh: v. 逐渐减少；逐渐缩小
definition_en: Gradually become smaller in amount, size, or number.
example1_en: The assignment is to dwindle to nothing, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先逐渐减至零，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to dwindle to nothing.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得逐渐减至零。
collocations: dwindling resources｜日益减少的资源 ; dwindling numbers｜不断减少的数量 ; dwindle to nothing｜逐渐减至零
tip_zh: 不及物动词，强调逐渐减少，不能直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 活塞
definition_en: a part that moves inside a cylinder in engines or pumps
example1_en: Office hours began with piston ring.
example1_zh: 答疑从活塞环开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss piston ring.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论活塞环的材料。
collocations: piston ring｜活塞环 ; piston engine｜活塞发动机 ; piston rod｜活塞杆
tip_zh: 活塞在 cylinder（气缸）内往复运动。

meanings_zh: v. 垄断 | v. 独占；包揽
definition_en: to control an entire market or supply of something | to use something so much that others cannot share it
example1_en: I heard the lecturer monopolize the market during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时垄断市场。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to monopolize the market.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得垄断市场。
collocations: monopolize the market｜垄断市场 ; monopolize the conversation｜独占话语权 ; monopolize someone's attention｜独占某人的注意力
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作monopolise；可指市场或注意力。

meanings_zh: adj. 终有一死的 | adj. 致命的 | n. 凡人；普通人
definition_en: unable to live forever | causing or likely to cause death | a human being who cannot live forever
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about mortal wound.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于致命伤的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mortal wound.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕致命伤展开说明。
collocations: mortal wound｜致命伤 ; mortal danger｜致命危险 ; mere mortals｜普通凡人
tip_zh: mortal指凡人；死亡率用mortality，不用mortal。

meanings_zh: n. 辞职；辞职信 | n. 无奈的接受；听任
definition_en: The act or written notice of leaving a job voluntarily. | Calm acceptance of something unpleasant that seems impossible to change.
example1_en: I copied hand in your resignation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把提交辞职信抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used hand in your resignation to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用提交辞职信来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: hand in your resignation｜提交辞职信 ; a letter of resignation｜辞职信 ; accept a resignation｜接受辞呈 ; with resignation｜无奈地
tip_zh: 辞职用resignation；另一义是无奈接受，不是反抗。

meanings_zh: adj. 得体的；圆通的
definition_en: Careful not to upset or offend people.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on tactful approach.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论得体的处理方式。
example2_en: The author returns to tactful approach when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了得体的处理方式。
collocations: tactful approach｜得体的处理方式 ; tactful response｜得体的回应 ; tactful criticism｜委婉的批评
tip_zh: 强调顾及他人感受、言行得体，不是反应机敏。

meanings_zh: n. 安培（电流单位）
definition_en: a unit used to measure electric current
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about one ampere of current.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一安培电流的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around one ampere of current.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一安培电流展开说明。
collocations: electric current in amperes｜以安培计的电流 ; one ampere of current｜一安培电流
tip_zh: 符号为A；口语常缩为amp，复数加s。

meanings_zh: v. 修订；修改
definition_en: To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to amend a law.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求修订法律。
example2_en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to amend a law.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们修订法律。
collocations: amend a law｜修订法律 ; amend a proposal｜修改提案 ; amend a contract｜修改合同
tip_zh: 常指修改文件或法律；修理实物通常用mend。

meanings_zh: n. 小农；佃农
definition_en: a poor farmer working a small plot of land
example1_en: Office hours began with peasant farmer.
example1_zh: 答疑从小农开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around peasant farmer.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕小农展开说明。
collocations: peasant farmer｜小农 ; peasant family｜农民家庭 ; peasant uprising｜农民起义
tip_zh: 多用于历史或传统农业语境；称呼他人可能带贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 强制性的；必须的
definition_en: Required by a law or rule.
example1_en: I copied mandatory training into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把强制培训抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used mandatory training to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用强制培训来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: mandatory training｜强制培训 ; a mandatory requirement｜强制性要求 ; mandatory attendance｜强制出席
tip_zh: 常用于法规或制度要求；反义词为optional。

meanings_zh: n. 接任者；继任者 | n. 后继事物；替代产品
definition_en: Someone who takes over another person's job or position. | Something that replaces an earlier thing of the same kind.
example1_en: The textbook introduces likely successor in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了可能的接班人。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around likely successor.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕可能的接班人展开说明。
collocations: successor to｜……的接任者 ; appoint a successor｜任命接班人 ; choose a successor｜选择接任者 ; likely successor｜可能的接班人
tip_zh: 用successor to sb；不专指财产继承人。

meanings_zh: n. 范围；系列 | n. 光谱；频谱
definition_en: A range of related ideas, qualities, or possibilities | A range of colours or waves arranged by wavelength or frequency
example1_en: Our professor circled the visible spectrum on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可见光谱。
example2_en: The author returns to the visible spectrum when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可见光谱。
collocations: a broad spectrum of｜广泛的各种…… ; across the spectrum｜涵盖整个范围 ; the visible spectrum｜可见光谱 ; the political spectrum｜政治光谱
tip_zh: 复数可用spectra或spectrums。

meanings_zh: n. 登记员；注册主任 | n. 专科培训医师（英国）
definition_en: An official responsible for keeping formal records. | A hospital doctor receiving advanced specialist training in Britain.
example1_en: Our professor circled university registrar on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了大学注册主任。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss university registrar.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论大学注册主任的材料。
collocations: university registrar｜大学注册主任 ; registrar's office｜注册办公室 ; specialist registrar｜专科培训医师
tip_zh: 既可指登记官，也可指英国接受专科培训的医生。

meanings_zh: n. 庇护；避难 | n. 避难所；庇护处
definition_en: protection from danger, trouble, or bad weather | a safe place offering protection from danger or difficulty
example1_en: I copied seek refuge into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把寻求庇护抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around seek refuge.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕寻求庇护展开说明。
collocations: take refuge｜躲避；寻求庇护 ; seek refuge｜寻求庇护 ; a refuge from｜躲避……的庇护处
tip_zh: take/seek refuge in表示“在……避难”；refuge通常作名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 俗艳的；花哨的
definition_en: Too brightly coloured or heavily decorated to look attractive.
example1_en: Office hours began with gaudy colours.
example1_zh: 答疑从俗艳的色彩开始。
example2_en: The author returns to gaudy colours when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了俗艳的色彩。
collocations: gaudy colours｜俗艳的色彩 ; gaudy decorations｜花哨的装饰 ; gaudy jewellery｜俗艳的首饰
tip_zh: 含贬义，指颜色或装饰过分抢眼，不只是鲜艳。

meanings_zh: adj. 多产的；成果丰硕的 | adj. 繁殖旺盛的
definition_en: Producing many works, results or achievements. | Producing many young, flowers, fruits or seeds.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a prolific writer.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于多产作家的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a prolific writer.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得多产作家这个例子。
collocations: a prolific writer｜多产作家 ; a prolific artist｜多产艺术家 ; a prolific goalscorer｜高产射手 ; a prolific breeder｜繁殖力强的动物
tip_zh: 强调产出多，不等于作品质量一定高。

meanings_zh: adv. 尽管如此
definition_en: In spite of what has just been said.
example1_en: The sample was small; the pattern was clear nonetheless.
example1_zh: 样本很小，尽管如此，模式仍然清楚。
example2_en: Nonetheless, the author treats the result as a reason to repeat the study.
example2_zh: 尽管如此，作者仍把这一结果视为重复研究的理由。
collocations: nonetheless important｜尽管如此仍然重要
tip_zh: 语气比 however 更书面，阅读里很常见。

meanings_zh: n. 草地；牧草地
definition_en: a field of grass, often containing wildflowers
example1_en: The textbook introduces wildflower meadow in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了野花草地。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of wildflower meadow.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得野花草地这个例子。
collocations: wildflower meadow｜野花草地 ; hay meadow｜干草生产草地 ; alpine meadow｜高山草甸
tip_zh: meadow多指乡间草地，不是修剪整齐的lawn。

meanings_zh: v. 赫然耸现；隐约出现 | v. 逼近；即将发生 | n. 织布机
definition_en: Appear as a large, often threatening or unclear shape. | Seem likely to happen soon, causing worry. | A machine or frame used to weave cloth.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to loom over.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求赫然耸立于……之上。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to loom over.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们赫然耸立于……之上。
collocations: loom over｜赫然耸立于……之上 ; loom large｜显得突出而令人担忧 ; weaving loom｜织布机
tip_zh: 动词常带压迫或担忧感；loom large指问题突出。

meanings_zh: adj. 超音速的
definition_en: Travelling faster than sound, or involving such speeds.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about supersonic speed.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于超音速的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to supersonic speed when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了超音速。
collocations: supersonic speed｜超音速 ; supersonic aircraft｜超音速飞机 ; supersonic flight｜超音速飞行
tip_zh: 指速度超过声速；“超声波的”通常用ultrasonic。

meanings_zh: n. 法律责任 | n. 负债；债务 | n. 累赘；不利因素
definition_en: Legal responsibility for something, especially damage or loss. | Money owed by a person or organisation. | Someone or something that creates problems or disadvantages.
example1_en: Office hours began with legal liability.
example1_zh: 答疑从法律责任开始。
example2_en: The reading connects legal liability with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把法律责任和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: legal liability｜法律责任 ; accept liability｜承担责任 ; limited liability｜有限责任 ; assets and liabilities｜资产与负债
tip_zh: 责任常不可数；债务常用复数liabilities。

meanings_zh: adj. 哲学的；哲学上的 | adj. 豁达的；泰然自若的
definition_en: relating to the study of knowledge, existence, and values | accepting difficulties calmly as a natural part of life
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about philosophical question.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于哲学问题的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used philosophical question to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用哲学问题来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: philosophical question｜哲学问题 ; philosophical debate｜哲学辩论 ; philosophical about setbacks｜对挫折持豁达态度
tip_zh: be philosophical about表示对不如意的事想得开。

meanings_zh: n. 间接后果；衍生影响
definition_en: An additional, often unexpected consequence of an action or decision.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize ramification in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出间接后果。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up ramification while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了间接后果。
collocations: have ramifications for｜对……产生后续影响 ; far-reaching ramifications｜深远的后续影响 ; legal ramifications｜法律后果
tip_zh: 通常用复数ramifications，常指复杂或意外后果。

meanings_zh: n. 放大器；扩音器
definition_en: a device that increases the strength of sound or electrical signals
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a guitar amplifier.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于吉他扩音器的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a guitar amplifier to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用吉他扩音器来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: a guitar amplifier｜吉他扩音器 ; a power amplifier｜功率放大器 ; a signal amplifier｜信号放大器
tip_zh: amplifier放大信号；speaker把信号转为声音。

meanings_zh: v. 使嵌入；使牢固置入 | v. 嵌入数字内容 | v. 使根植；使融入
definition_en: to fix something firmly inside a surrounding material | to place digital content within a webpage or document | to make something an established part of a system or culture
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to embed a video.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何嵌入视频。
example2_en: The reading asks you to embed a video and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你嵌入视频，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: be embedded in｜嵌在；根植于 ; embed a video｜嵌入视频 ; deeply embedded｜深深扎根的
tip_zh: 过去式embedded，分词embedding均双写d。

meanings_zh: n. 歪曲；曲解 | n. 变形；失真
definition_en: A misleading change in how facts or ideas are presented. | An unwanted change in shape, sound, or appearance.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about image distortion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于图像失真的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects image distortion with a larger point about public communication.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把图像失真和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a distortion of the facts｜对事实的歪曲 ; image distortion｜图像失真 ; sound distortion｜声音失真
tip_zh: distortion of the facts指歪曲事实。

meanings_zh: v. 猛烈抽打；猛烈冲击 | v. 捆扎；绑牢 | n. 睫毛；鞭打
definition_en: To strike forcefully, especially with a whip or like one. | To fasten things tightly together using rope or cord. | An eyelash, or a stroke delivered with a whip.
example1_en: The professor asked us to lash against the windows.
example1_zh: 教授让我们猛烈拍打窗户。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to lash against the windows.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猛烈拍打窗户。
collocations: lash against the windows｜猛烈拍打窗户 ; lash together｜捆在一起 ; lash out at｜猛烈抨击；攻击
tip_zh: lash out at可指突然攻击或猛烈抨击。

meanings_zh: n. 消耗；耗竭
definition_en: A reduction in the amount of something available
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about resource depletion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于资源耗竭的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to resource depletion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了资源耗竭。
collocations: resource depletion｜资源耗竭 ; ozone depletion｜臭氧损耗 ; depletion of reserves｜储备的消耗
tip_zh: 常接of，表示资源或储备减少，不一定已耗尽。

meanings_zh: adj. 胜利的；得意的
definition_en: successful or showing great happiness after winning
example1_en: The textbook introduces triumphant smile in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了得意的微笑。
example2_en: A campus survey used triumphant smile to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用得意的微笑来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: triumphant smile｜得意的微笑 ; triumphant return｜凯旋 ; triumphant victory｜辉煌的胜利
tip_zh: 既可指取得胜利，也可形容获胜后的得意神情。

meanings_zh: adj. 适应力强的；能复原的 | adj. 有回弹力的
definition_en: Able to recover quickly after difficulties or damage | Able to return to its original shape after being bent
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on resilient communities.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论适应力强的社区。
example2_en: A campus survey used resilient communities to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用适应力强的社区来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: resilient communities｜适应力强的社区 ; resilient economy｜有韧性的经济 ; resilient to shocks｜能抵御冲击的 ; resilient material｜有回弹力的材料
tip_zh: 既可形容人或经济的韧性，也可指材料回弹。

meanings_zh: v. 误用；滥用 | n. 误用；滥用
definition_en: To use something incorrectly or for a harmful purpose. | The incorrect or harmful use of something.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to misuse personal data.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须滥用个人数据。
example2_en: The passage says students who can misuse personal data follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够滥用个人数据的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: misuse personal data｜滥用个人数据 ; misuse of power｜滥用权力 ; misuse of resources｜资源的不当使用
tip_zh: 动词词尾读/ z /，名词词尾读/ s /。

meanings_zh: adj. 合法的；依法的 | adj. 正当的；合理的
definition_en: Allowed by law or accepted rules. | Fair, reasonable, and supported by good reasons.
example1_en: Office hours began with legitimate business.
example1_zh: 答疑从合法生意开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of legitimate business.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得合法生意这个例子。
collocations: legitimate business｜合法生意 ; legitimate concerns｜合理的担忧 ; legitimate reason｜正当理由 ; legitimate authority｜合法权力
tip_zh: 既可指法律允许，也可指理由或担忧合理。

meanings_zh: v. 合作；协作 | v. 与敌方勾结
definition_en: work with others to create or achieve something | help an enemy controlling your country
example1_en: The professor asked us to collaborate with colleagues.
example1_zh: 教授让我们与同事合作。
example2_en: The passage says students who can collaborate with colleagues follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够与同事合作的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: collaborate with colleagues｜与同事合作 ; collaborate on a project｜合作开展项目 ; collaborate closely｜密切合作
tip_zh: 与某人合作用with；合作做某项目用on。

meanings_zh: adj. 雄辩的；有说服力的 | adj. 意味深长的；传神的
definition_en: Expressing ideas clearly, powerfully, and beautifully. | Clearly expressing a feeling or meaning without words.
example1_en: The textbook introduces an eloquent speaker in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能言善辩的演讲者。
example2_en: The author returns to an eloquent speaker when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了能言善辩的演讲者。
collocations: an eloquent speaker｜能言善辩的演讲者 ; an eloquent defence｜有力的辩护 ; an eloquent silence｜意味深长的沉默
tip_zh: 不只形容口才，也可形容传达深意的眼神或沉默。

meanings_zh: v. 激起好奇心；引起兴趣 | n. 阴谋；密谋
definition_en: To make someone curious and eager to learn more. | Secret planning intended to gain power or an advantage.
example1_en: The professor explained intrigue with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了引起兴趣。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up intrigue while discussing evidence about academic research.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了引起兴趣。
collocations: be intrigued by｜对……感到好奇 ; political intrigue｜政治阴谋 ; a web of intrigue｜错综复杂的阴谋
tip_zh: 激起兴趣时是及物动词；常用 be intrigued by。

meanings_zh: n. 狂热爱好者 | n. 狂热信奉者
definition_en: Someone who is extremely enthusiastic about an activity or interest. | Someone whose extreme beliefs make them reject other views.
example1_en: The textbook introduces fitness fanatic in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了健身狂。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fitness fanatic.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论健身狂的材料。
collocations: fitness fanatic｜健身狂 ; football fanatic｜足球狂热爱好者 ; religious fanatic｜宗教狂热者
tip_zh: 爱好语境可轻松使用；信仰语境常含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 本质；精髓 | n. 香精；浓缩精华
definition_en: the most important quality that makes something what it is | a concentrated liquid containing a particular flavour or scent
example1_en: The textbook introduces vanilla essence in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了香草香精。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vanilla essence.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕香草香精展开说明。
collocations: the essence of｜……的本质 ; in essence｜本质上 ; vanilla essence｜香草香精 ; capture the essence｜抓住精髓
tip_zh: in essence 表示“本质上”，用于概括核心观点。

meanings_zh: adj. 符合常识的；明智的
definition_en: Showing practical judgment based on ordinary experience.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a commonsense approach in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了务实合理的方法。
example2_en: A campus survey used a commonsense approach to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用务实合理的方法来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: a commonsense approach｜务实合理的方法 ; commonsense advice｜符合常识的建议 ; commonsense precautions｜合乎常识的预防措施
tip_zh: 形容词也写作common-sense；名词common sense分写。

meanings_zh: v. 留意；听从 | n. 注意；留心
definition_en: To pay careful attention to advice or a warning. | Careful attention given to something, especially advice or warnings.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to heed a warning.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须听从警告。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers heed a warning before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要听从警告。
collocations: heed a warning｜听从警告 ; heed advice｜听取建议 ; pay heed to｜留意；重视 ; take heed of｜注意；听从
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用于pay heed to。

meanings_zh: v. 否决；驳回
definition_en: To use authority to reject or reverse a decision or objection.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer overrule an objection during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时驳回异议。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers overrule an objection before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要驳回异议。
collocations: overrule an objection｜驳回异议 ; overrule a decision｜推翻决定 ; be overruled by｜被……否决
tip_zh: 强调凭更高权力否决，不只是表示不同意。

meanings_zh: v. 必然涉及；需要
definition_en: To necessarily involve or require something
example1_en: The professor asked us to entail costs.
example1_zh: 教授让我们需要花费。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers entail costs before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要需要花费。
collocations: entail costs｜需要花费 ; entail risks｜伴随风险 ; entail doing something｜需要做某事
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：entail doing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 典型特征；标志 | n. 贵金属纯度检验印记
definition_en: A distinctive quality that characterises someone or something | An official mark showing the purity of a precious metal
example1_en: The textbook introduces a distinctive hallmark in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了鲜明特征。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a distinctive hallmark.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论鲜明特征的材料。
collocations: a hallmark of quality｜品质的标志 ; bear the hallmarks of｜具有……的典型特征 ; a distinctive hallmark｜鲜明特征
tip_zh: 常用a hallmark of，表示……的典型特征。

meanings_zh: n. 轮齿；齿轮 | n. 大机构中的小角色
definition_en: A tooth on a gear, or the gear itself | Someone with a small role in a large organisation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about broken cog.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于断裂的轮齿的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss broken cog.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论断裂的轮齿的材料。
collocations: cog wheel｜齿轮 ; a cog in the machine｜机构中的小角色 ; broken cog｜断裂的轮齿
tip_zh: a cog in the machine比喻机构中的小角色。

meanings_zh: n. 易感体质；患病倾向 | n. 性情倾向；偏好
definition_en: A natural tendency to develop a particular illness or condition. | A natural tendency to behave or think in a particular way.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about genetic predisposition.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于遗传易感性的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss genetic predisposition.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论遗传易感性的材料。
collocations: genetic predisposition｜遗传易感性 ; a predisposition to diabetes｜糖尿病易感体质 ; a predisposition towards anxiety｜焦虑倾向
tip_zh: 常接to；表示更易发生，不代表必然发生。

meanings_zh: v. 悲叹；哀悼 | n. 哀叹；挽歌
definition_en: To express sadness or regret about something. | An expression of grief, sometimes through a song or poem.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to lament the loss of.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须为失去……而悲叹。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to lament the loss of.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们为失去……而悲叹。
collocations: lament the loss of｜为失去……而悲叹 ; deeply lament｜深感惋惜 ; a lament for｜为……而作的哀歌
tip_zh: 较正式；动词可直接接宾语，也可接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；明确的
definition_en: clear, definite, and easy to notice
example1_en: Our professor circled a decided advantage on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了明显的优势。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a decided advantage.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论明显的优势的材料。
collocations: a decided advantage｜明显的优势 ; a decided improvement｜明显的改善 ; a decided preference｜明确的偏好
tip_zh: 形容词常指“明显的”；“果断的”通常用decisive。

meanings_zh: v. 证明……错误；证伪
definition_en: to show through evidence that something is not true
example1_en: The professor asked us to disprove a theory.
example1_zh: 教授让我们证伪理论。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to disprove a theory.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们证伪理论。
collocations: disprove a theory｜证伪理论 ; disprove a claim｜证明说法不实 ; disprove a hypothesis｜证伪假说
tip_zh: 不只是表示反对，而是用证据证明说法错误。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其必要的；迫切的 | n. 必须做的事；迫切需要 | adj. 祈使的
definition_en: Extremely important and needing to be done. | Something that must be done or given urgent attention. | Expressing a command or instruction in grammar.
example1_en: Our professor circled moral imperative on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道义上必须做的事。
example2_en: The author returns to moral imperative when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了道义上必须做的事。
collocations: it is imperative that｜……至关重要 ; imperative to act｜必须采取行动 ; moral imperative｜道义上必须做的事 ; imperative mood｜祈使语气
tip_zh: 常用It is imperative to do或that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 挖掘；开凿 | v. 发掘古迹或遗物
definition_en: to dig into ground and remove earth | to uncover ancient objects or buildings by carefully removing earth
example1_en: The lab instructions say to excavate a site.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发掘遗址。
example2_en: When the class discussed historical change, the speaker told us to excavate a site.
example2_zh: 全班讨论历史变迁时，讲者让我们发掘遗址。
collocations: excavate a site｜发掘遗址 ; excavate a trench｜挖沟 ; excavate ancient remains｜发掘古代遗存
tip_zh: excavate可用于工程挖掘，也可用于考古发掘。

meanings_zh: n. 最后通牒
definition_en: a final demand threatening consequences if it is not accepted
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize ultimatum in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出最后通牒。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up ultimatum while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了最后通牒。
collocations: issue an ultimatum｜发出最后通牒 ; give someone an ultimatum｜向某人下最后通牒 ; reject an ultimatum｜拒绝最后通牒
tip_zh: 常用give someone an ultimatum；复数常为ultimatums。

meanings_zh: n. 复原力；抗逆力 | n. 回弹性
definition_en: The ability to recover or adapt after difficulties | The ability of a material to regain its original shape
example1_en: The textbook introduces emotional resilience in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了情绪复原力。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss emotional resilience.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论情绪复原力的材料。
collocations: build resilience｜培养抗逆力 ; emotional resilience｜情绪复原力 ; community resilience｜社区韧性 ; show remarkable resilience｜展现非凡的复原力
tip_zh: 通常不可数，强调受挫后的恢复与适应能力。

meanings_zh: n. 战争；作战
definition_en: The activity of fighting wars, including methods and weapons used.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about modern warfare.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于现代战争的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of modern warfare.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得现代战争这个例子。
collocations: modern warfare｜现代战争 ; chemical warfare｜化学战 ; guerrilla warfare｜游击战
tip_zh: 不可数，强调作战活动或方式；war可指一场战争。

meanings_zh: n. 公开赞誉；高度评价 | v. 公开称赞；高度赞扬
definition_en: strong public praise for someone or something | to praise someone or something publicly and enthusiastically
example1_en: Our professor circled critical acclaim on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了评论界的赞誉。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around critical acclaim.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕评论界的赞誉展开说明。
collocations: critical acclaim｜评论界的赞誉 ; widespread acclaim｜广泛赞誉 ; receive acclaim｜获得赞誉 ; be acclaimed as｜被誉为
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；动词常用be acclaimed as被誉为。

meanings_zh: v. 装饰；使增色
definition_en: To make something more attractive by decorating it.
example1_en: The professor asked us to adorn the walls.
example1_zh: 教授让我们装点墙壁。
example2_en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to adorn the walls.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们装点墙壁。
collocations: adorn something with flowers｜用鲜花装饰某物 ; be adorned with｜装饰着 ; adorn the walls｜装点墙壁
tip_zh: 用adorn A with B表示“用B装饰A”。

meanings_zh: n. 法令；政令；裁定 | v. 颁令；裁定
definition_en: An official order issued by a ruler, government, or court. | To officially order or decide that something must happen.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize decree in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出法令。
example2_en: A reading on public institutions uses decree when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于公共制度的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了法令。
collocations: issue a decree｜颁布法令 ; by decree｜通过法令 ; decree that｜颁令规定
tip_zh: 动词可接that从句；名词指有权威的正式命令。

meanings_zh: v. 增加；增强
definition_en: To increase something by adding to it.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer augment income during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时增加收入。
example2_en: The passage says students who can augment income follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够增加收入的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: augment income｜增加收入 ; augment existing resources｜补充现有资源 ; augment capacity｜提升能力
tip_zh: 较正式，通常作及物动词，强调通过添加来增加。

meanings_zh: n. 压迫；压制
definition_en: Cruel or unfair control that denies people freedom and rights.
example1_en: Our professor circled political oppression on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政治压迫。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss political oppression.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论政治压迫的材料。
collocations: political oppression｜政治压迫 ; resist oppression｜反抗压迫 ; freedom from oppression｜免受压迫的自由
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；动词是oppress。

meanings_zh: n. 狂热；痴迷 | n. 躁狂
definition_en: an unusually strong enthusiasm for an activity or object | a mental health state involving extreme energy and elevated mood
example1_en: Our professor circled an episode of mania on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一次躁狂发作。
example2_en: A campus survey used an episode of mania to explain a pattern in public health.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一次躁狂发作来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。
collocations: a mania for｜对……的狂热 ; an episode of mania｜一次躁狂发作 ; acute mania｜急性躁狂
tip_zh: 日常可指狂热；医学上的躁狂不等于普通兴奋。

meanings_zh: adj. 易燃的
definition_en: Able to catch fire easily.
example1_en: I copied highly inflammable into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把高度易燃的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly inflammable.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕高度易燃的展开说明。
collocations: inflammable materials｜易燃材料 ; inflammable liquids｜易燃液体 ; highly inflammable｜高度易燃的
tip_zh: inflammable是易燃的；不易燃用non-flammable。

meanings_zh: n. 代理人；代表 | n. 替代指标；替代物 | n. 代理服务器
definition_en: someone authorised to act or vote for another person | something used to represent or measure something else indirectly | a server that passes requests between users and other servers
example1_en: Office hours began with vote by proxy.
example1_zh: 答疑从委托代理人投票开始。
example2_en: The author returns to vote by proxy when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了委托代理人投票。
collocations: vote by proxy｜委托代理人投票 ; act as a proxy｜担任代理人 ; a proxy for｜……的替代指标 ; proxy server｜代理服务器
tip_zh: by proxy指通过代理人；a proxy for可指替代指标。

meanings_zh: v. 制止；限制行动 | v. 克制；抑制
definition_en: to prevent someone or something from moving or acting freely | to control a feeling, reaction, or increase
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to restrain anger.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须克制愤怒。
example2_en: The passage says students who can restrain anger follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够克制愤怒的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: restrain someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事 ; restrain anger｜克制愤怒 ; restrain spending｜控制支出
tip_zh: 常用restrain sb from doing，表示阻止某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 软骨
definition_en: Strong, flexible tissue found in joints and other body parts.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on damaged cartilage.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论受损软骨。
example2_en: The reading connects damaged cartilage with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把受损软骨和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: damaged cartilage｜受损软骨 ; knee cartilage｜膝关节软骨 ; cartilage damage｜软骨损伤
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；不是骨头，而是有弹性的组织。

meanings_zh: v. 在脑海中想象 | v. 使可视化
definition_en: To form a clear picture of something in your mind. | To represent information using images, charts, or diagrams.
example1_en: The professor asked us to visualize a scene.
