example1_zh: 教授让我们想象一个场景。
example2_en: The reading asks you to visualize a scene and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你想象一个场景，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: visualize a scene｜想象一个场景 ; visualize data｜将数据可视化 ; visualize the outcome｜想象结果
tip_zh: 英式也写visualise；可接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 歪曲；曲解 | v. 使变形；使失真
definition_en: to present information in a misleading or inaccurate way | to change the natural shape, appearance, or sound of something
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to distort the truth.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何歪曲真相。
example2_en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers distort the truth before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要歪曲真相。
collocations: distort the truth｜歪曲真相 ; distort an image｜使图像变形 ; distort public perception｜扭曲公众认知
tip_zh: 既可指歪曲事实，也可指图像、声音失真。

meanings_zh: v. 体现；具体表现 | v. 包含；收录
definition_en: To clearly represent an idea, quality, or feeling. | To include something as part of a larger whole.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to embody an ideal.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须体现一种理想。
example2_en: The reading asks you to embody an ideal and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你体现一种理想，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: embody an ideal｜体现一种理想 ; embody the spirit of｜体现……的精神 ; embody core values｜体现核心价值观
tip_zh: embody是及物动词，直接接所体现的品质或理念。

meanings_zh: v. 使着迷；使陶醉 | v. 施魔法于
definition_en: To delight someone greatly and hold their attention. | To put someone or something under a magic spell.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to enchant an audience.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须使观众陶醉。
example2_en: The reading asks you to enchant an audience and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你使观众陶醉，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: enchant an audience｜使观众陶醉 ; be enchanted by｜被……迷住
tip_zh: 常用被动结构 be enchanted by，表示被深深吸引。

meanings_zh: n. 全部；整体
definition_en: the whole of something, with no part left out
example1_en: Office hours began with the entirety of.
example1_zh: 答疑从……的全部开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used the entirety of to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用……的全部来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: in its entirety｜完整地 ; the entirety of｜……的全部
tip_zh: 常用 in its entirety，表示完整地、无遗漏地。

meanings_zh: n. 政治集团；联盟
definition_en: A group of countries or people acting together for shared aims.
example1_en: Office hours began with trading bloc.
example1_zh: 答疑从贸易集团开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around trading bloc.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕贸易集团展开说明。
collocations: trading bloc｜贸易集团 ; political bloc｜政治集团 ; regional bloc｜区域集团 ; form a bloc｜组成联盟
tip_zh: 与block同音；bloc专指共同采取行动的集团。

meanings_zh: adj. 关乎最终利润的
definition_en: Relating to the final profit or financial outcome.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used bottom-line in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了关乎最终利润的。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses bottom-line when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了关乎最终利润的。
collocations: bottom-line results｜最终盈利结果 ; bottom-line performance｜最终盈利表现 ; bottom-line impact｜对最终利润的影响
tip_zh: 连字符形式常作定语；名词写bottom line。

meanings_zh: n. 鼠疫；瘟疫 | v. 不断困扰；使受折磨 | n. 大规模灾害；祸患
definition_en: A serious infectious disease, especially one caused by plague bacteria. | To cause repeated trouble or suffering. | A widespread problem or harmful invasion.
example1_en: I copied an outbreak of plague into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把鼠疫暴发抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of an outbreak of plague.
example2_zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得鼠疫暴发这个例子。
collocations: an outbreak of plague｜鼠疫暴发 ; be plagued by problems｜饱受问题困扰 ; a plague of locusts｜蝗灾
tip_zh: 动词常用be plagued by，表示长期反复受困扰。

meanings_zh: v. 混合；交融 | v. 交际；与人交谈
definition_en: mix together while remaining partly distinct | move around a group and talk to different people
example1_en: The professor asked us to mingle with.
example1_zh: 教授让我们与……混合；与……交往。
example2_en: The reading asks you to mingle with and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你与……混合；与……交往，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: mingle with｜与……混合；与……交往 ; mingle with guests｜与宾客交谈 ; mingle freely｜自由交往
tip_zh: mingle with既可指与某物混合，也可指与人交往。

meanings_zh: v. 渴望；立志
definition_en: To strongly want to achieve something important.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to aspire to greatness.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须追求卓越。
example2_en: The passage says students who can aspire to greatness follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够追求卓越的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: aspire to do something｜立志做某事 ; aspire to greatness｜追求卓越 ; aspire to a career in medicine｜立志从医
tip_zh: aspire to do表立志做；aspire to后也可接名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 本土的；原住民的
definition_en: Originating or living naturally in a place, rather than arriving later.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about indigenous peoples.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于原住民族的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of indigenous peoples.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得原住民族这个例子。
collocations: indigenous peoples｜原住民族 ; indigenous languages｜原住民语言 ; indigenous species｜本土物种 ; indigenous to an area｜原产于某地区
tip_zh: 常用indigenous to；修饰人群时常将首字母大写。

meanings_zh: adj. 鲁莽的；不顾后果的
definition_en: Ignoring danger or the possible harmful results of an action
example1_en: Office hours began with reckless driving.
example1_zh: 答疑从鲁莽驾驶开始。
example2_en: The author returns to reckless driving when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了鲁莽驾驶。
collocations: reckless driving｜鲁莽驾驶 ; reckless behaviour｜鲁莽行为 ; reckless spending｜不计后果的花钱 ; reckless disregard for safety｜对安全的肆意漠视
tip_zh: 比careless更强调明知有风险仍不顾后果。

meanings_zh: n. 焚化；焚烧
definition_en: The process of burning waste until it becomes ash.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on waste incineration.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论垃圾焚烧。
example2_en: A campus survey used waste incineration to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用垃圾焚烧来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: waste incineration｜垃圾焚烧 ; incineration plant｜焚烧厂 ; incineration process｜焚烧过程
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，常用于垃圾处理话题。

meanings_zh: v. 使文明；使有教养
definition_en: to make people behave more politely or develop organized societies
example1_en: The professor asked us to civilize society.
example1_zh: 教授让我们使社会文明化。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to civilize society.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使社会文明化。
collocations: civilize society｜使社会文明化 ; attempt to civilize｜试图教化
tip_zh: 谈论民族时易带优越或殖民色彩；英式也拼 civilise。

meanings_zh: n. 闲置；废弃不用
definition_en: the state of no longer being used
example1_en: The textbook introduces years of disuse in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多年的闲置。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss years of disuse.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论多年的闲置的材料。
collocations: fall into disuse｜逐渐废弃不用 ; through disuse｜由于闲置 ; years of disuse｜多年的闲置
tip_zh: 通常作不可数名词，词尾读/s/，不是/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 簇；群；聚集体 | v. 聚集；使聚集
definition_en: a group of similar things positioned or occurring close together | to gather closely together or make things gather together
example1_en: The textbook introduces industrial cluster in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了产业集群。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of industrial cluster.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得产业集群这个例子。
collocations: a cluster of｜一簇；一群 ; cluster together｜聚在一起 ; cluster around｜聚集在……周围 ; industrial cluster｜产业集群
tip_zh: 强调紧密聚集；a cluster of后常接复数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 勤奋好学的 | adj. 刻意的；认真谨慎的
definition_en: Spending much time studying and enjoying learning. | Done with deliberate care and close attention.
example1_en: Our professor circled a studious pupil on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了勤奋好学的学生。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a studious pupil.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕勤奋好学的学生展开说明。
collocations: a studious pupil｜勤奋好学的学生 ; studious attention｜认真专注 ; studious avoidance｜刻意回避
tip_zh: 形容人多指勤学；studious avoidance指刻意回避。

meanings_zh: v. 被罚失去；丧失 | n. 罚金；惩罚 | adj. 被罚没的；丧失的
definition_en: To lose something as a penalty for breaking a rule. | Something surrendered or done as a penalty, especially in games. | Lost or required to be surrendered as a penalty.
example1_en: The professor asked us to forfeit a deposit.
example1_zh: 教授让我们损失押金。
example2_en: The passage says students who can forfeit a deposit follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够损失押金的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: forfeit a deposit｜损失押金 ; forfeit the right to｜丧失……的权利 ; pay a forfeit｜缴纳罚金 ; forfeit a match｜被判比赛失利
tip_zh: 主语通常是失去财物者，而非执行没收的一方。

meanings_zh: n. 起源；词源 | n. 派生；推导
definition_en: the origin of something, especially a word | the process of forming something from an existing source
example1_en: The textbook introduces word derivation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了词的派生。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around word derivation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕词的派生展开说明。
collocations: the derivation of a word｜一个词的词源 ; word derivation｜词的派生 ; the derivation of a formula｜公式的推导
tip_zh: 动词搭配为derive A from B，意为A源自B。

meanings_zh: n. 不忠；背信弃义
definition_en: Failure to support someone or something you should remain faithful to
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an act of disloyalty.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论背信行为。
example2_en: The author returns to an act of disloyalty when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了背信行为。
collocations: an act of disloyalty｜背信行为 ; disloyalty to someone｜对某人不忠 ; accuse someone of disloyalty｜指责某人不忠
tip_zh: 是名词；形容词用disloyal，常接to。

meanings_zh: adj. 值得的；配得上的 | adj. 值得尊敬的；有价值的
definition_en: deserving a particular response, reward, or treatment | good and deserving respect or support
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about worthy of attention.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于值得关注的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of worthy of attention.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得值得关注这个例子。
collocations: worthy of attention｜值得关注 ; a worthy cause｜值得支持的事业 ; worthy of respect｜值得尊敬
tip_zh: 常用 worthy of；worth 后可直接接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 接受者；收件人
definition_en: a person or organisation that receives something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the intended recipient.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论预定接收人。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the intended recipient.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得预定接收人这个例子。
collocations: the intended recipient｜预定接收人 ; scholarship recipient｜奖学金获得者 ; aid recipient｜援助接受者 ; recipient of an award｜获奖者
tip_zh: 常用recipient of sth；通常指接受者，不指容器。

meanings_zh: n. 朗诵；背诵
definition_en: The act of saying a poem or passage aloud from memory.
example1_en: I copied poetry recitation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把诗歌朗诵抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of poetry recitation.
example2_zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得诗歌朗诵这个例子。
collocations: poetry recitation｜诗歌朗诵 ; recitation from memory｜脱稿背诵 ; give a recitation｜进行朗诵
tip_zh: recitation指朗诵活动；动词用recite。

meanings_zh: v. 迫使；使负有义务 | v. 帮忙；满足请求
definition_en: Require someone to act because of rules or circumstances | Help someone by doing what they ask
example1_en: After the lecture, we used oblige in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了迫使。
example2_en: Students who can explain oblige usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
example2_zh: 能解释迫使的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。
collocations: be obliged to do something｜不得不做某事 ; happy to oblige｜乐意帮忙 ; much obliged｜非常感激
tip_zh: be obliged to do表示被迫或有义务做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 装饰品 | n. 装饰；装点
definition_en: something worn or added to make something more attractive | the act or practice of making something more attractive
example1_en: I copied personal adornment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把个人装饰抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss personal adornment.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论个人装饰的材料。
collocations: personal adornment｜个人装饰 ; simple adornment｜简单的装饰品 ; without adornment｜不加装饰
tip_zh: 指具体装饰品时可数；指装饰行为或装饰整体时不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 精明的；判断敏锐的
definition_en: good at judging situations and making decisions that bring advantages
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a shrewd investor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论精明的投资者。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a shrewd investor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论精明的投资者的材料。
collocations: a shrewd investor｜精明的投资者 ; a shrewd judgement｜敏锐的判断 ; a shrewd investment｜精明的投资
tip_zh: 强调判断精明、善于谋利，不等于单纯聪明。

meanings_zh: n. 雪崩 | n. 突然涌现的大量事物
definition_en: A large mass of snow falling rapidly down a mountain. | A sudden arrival of an overwhelming amount of something.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about avalanche risk.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于雪崩风险的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss avalanche risk.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论雪崩风险的材料。
collocations: trigger an avalanche｜引发雪崩 ; avalanche risk｜雪崩风险 ; an avalanche of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip_zh: an avalanche of后接复数或不可数名词，表示大量涌来。

meanings_zh: n. 安慰；慰藉 | n. 令人宽慰的人或事
definition_en: comfort received when you feel sad or disappointed | someone or something that makes disappointment easier to bear
example1_en: I copied little consolation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把些许安慰抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects little consolation with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把些许安慰和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: find consolation in｜从……中获得安慰 ; a consolation prize｜安慰奖 ; little consolation｜些许安慰 ; some consolation｜一些慰藉
tip_zh: 安慰本身不可数；具体的安慰之事可用a consolation。

meanings_zh: adj. 迁徙的；迁移的
definition_en: Moving between regions regularly, often with the seasons.
example1_en: Office hours began with migratory birds.
example1_zh: 答疑从候鸟开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around migratory birds.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕候鸟展开说明。
collocations: migratory birds｜候鸟 ; migratory species｜迁徙物种 ; migratory routes｜迁徙路线 ; migratory patterns｜迁徙规律
tip_zh: 常形容鸟类等季节性迁徙，不等于漫无目的流浪。

meanings_zh: v. 滋养；为……提供营养 | v. 培养；助长
definition_en: to provide what a living thing needs to grow healthily | to support the growth of a feeling or idea
example1_en: The professor asked us to nourish the body.
example1_zh: 教授让我们滋养身体。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to nourish the body.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得滋养身体。
collocations: nourish the body｜滋养身体 ; nourish the skin｜滋养皮肤 ; nourish curiosity｜培养好奇心
tip_zh: 既可指提供营养，也可比喻培养希望、好奇心等。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；小病
definition_en: An illness, especially one that is not serious.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on minor ailment.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小病。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around minor ailment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕小病展开说明。
collocations: minor ailment｜小病 ; common ailments｜常见疾病 ; treat an ailment｜治疗疾病
tip_zh: 可数名词，通常指小病，常搭配 minor。

meanings_zh: v. 承受；抵挡；经受住
definition_en: To resist damage or remain strong under pressure
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to withstand pressure.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何承受压力。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers withstand pressure before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要承受压力。
collocations: withstand pressure｜承受压力 ; withstand extreme temperatures｜耐受极端温度 ; withstand strong winds｜抵御强风
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为withstood；后直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 貌似合理的；可信的
definition_en: Seeming reasonable or likely to be true
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about plausible explanation.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于看似合理的解释的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used plausible explanation to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用看似合理的解释来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: plausible explanation｜看似合理的解释 ; plausible excuse｜听起来可信的借口 ; plausible solution｜看似可行的解决方案
tip_zh: 表示听起来合理，不保证真实，也不一定暗指虚假。

meanings_zh: n. 独创力；巧思
definition_en: the ability to solve problems in clever, original ways
example1_en: The textbook introduces human ingenuity in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了人类的创造才智。
example2_en: A campus survey used human ingenuity to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用人类的创造才智来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: human ingenuity｜人类的创造才智 ; show ingenuity｜展现巧思 ; a feat of ingenuity｜独具匠心的成就
tip_zh: 对应形容词ingenious；别与意为天真的ingenuous混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 团结；相互支持
definition_en: Unity and mutual support among people with shared interests.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about social solidarity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于社会团结的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to social solidarity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会团结。
collocations: show solidarity with｜表示支持 ; in solidarity with｜与……团结一致 ; social solidarity｜社会团结
tip_zh: 常接with，表示与某人或群体团结一致。

meanings_zh: adj. 公然反抗的；不服从的
definition_en: Openly refusing to obey someone or accept their authority
example1_en: Office hours began with a defiant attitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从反抗的态度开始。
example2_en: The author returns to a defiant attitude when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了反抗的态度。
collocations: a defiant attitude｜反抗的态度 ; remain defiant｜仍不屈服 ; a defiant gesture｜反抗的姿态
tip_zh: 核心是不服从权威，不只是说话无礼。

meanings_zh: n. 鬃毛 | n. 浓密的长发
definition_en: long thick hair around an animal's neck or head | a person's long thick hair
example1_en: I copied a lion's mane into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把狮子的鬃毛抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used a lion's mane to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用狮子的鬃毛来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: a lion's mane｜狮子的鬃毛 ; a horse's mane｜马鬃 ; a thick mane｜浓密的鬃毛 ; a mane of hair｜一头浓密长发
tip_zh: mane与main同音；前者指鬃毛或浓密长发。

meanings_zh: n. 滋补剂；补药 | n. 使人振奋的事物 | n. 汤力水
definition_en: A medicine intended to improve general health or energy | Something that makes you feel happier or more energetic | A fizzy drink with a bitter taste from quinine
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a herbal tonic.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论草本滋补剂。
example2_en: The author returns to a herbal tonic when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了草本滋补剂。
collocations: a herbal tonic｜草本滋补剂 ; a tonic for the mind｜振奋精神的事物 ; tonic water｜汤力水
tip_zh: 比喻用法常见a tonic for，指让人振奋的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 雄伟；壮丽；威严 | n. 陛下
definition_en: Impressive beauty, grandeur, or dignity that inspires admiration. | A title used when addressing or referring to a monarch.
example1_en: I copied Your Majesty into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把陛下（当面称呼）抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects Your Majesty with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把陛下（当面称呼）和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the majesty of nature｜大自然的壮丽 ; Your Majesty｜陛下（当面称呼） ; His Majesty｜国王陛下
tip_zh: 表示“陛下”的称号时首字母大写：Majesty。

meanings_zh: adj. 振奋人心的；激动人心的 | n. 萌动；初现的迹象
definition_en: Causing strong feelings, especially excitement, courage, or admiration. | An early sign of a feeling, idea, or activity.
example1_en: I copied a stirring speech into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把振奋人心的演讲抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a stirring speech when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了振奋人心的演讲。
collocations: a stirring speech｜振奋人心的演讲 ; a stirring performance｜激动人心的演出 ; the first stirrings of hope｜希望的最初萌动
tip_zh: 名词表“萌动”常用复数，如stirrings of hope。

meanings_zh: n. 强烈谴责 | n. 判刑；宣告不宜使用
definition_en: An expression of strong disapproval | An official judgment imposing punishment or declaring something unsafe
example1_en: I copied widespread condemnation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把广泛谴责抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around widespread condemnation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕广泛谴责展开说明。
collocations: widespread condemnation｜广泛谴责 ; strong condemnation｜强烈谴责 ; draw condemnation｜招致谴责 ; condemnation of violence｜对暴力的谴责
tip_zh: 常用condemnation of sth；比criticism语气更强。

meanings_zh: v. 随后发生；因而发生
definition_en: To happen after something, often as its result.
example1_en: The professor asked us to ensue from.
example1_zh: 教授让我们因……而发生。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to ensue from.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得因……而发生。
collocations: chaos ensues｜随之陷入混乱 ; a debate ensues｜随后展开辩论 ; ensue from｜因……而发生
tip_zh: 正式用语，不及物；不表示“追求”。

meanings_zh: n. 气象学
definition_en: The scientific study of weather and the atmosphere.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a degree in meteorology in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了气象学学位。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a degree in meteorology.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论气象学学位的材料。
collocations: study meteorology｜学习气象学 ; a degree in meteorology｜气象学学位 ; advances in meteorology｜气象学的进展
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；研究天气，不是研究流星。

meanings_zh: n. 搜查令；逮捕令 | v. 使有必要；足以支持 | n. 正当理由；依据
definition_en: An official document allowing police to take a particular action. | To make a particular action necessary or reasonable. | A good reason or justification for something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a search warrant.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论搜查令。
example2_en: A campus survey used a search warrant to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用搜查令来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: a search warrant｜搜查令 ; an arrest warrant｜逮捕令 ; warrant further investigation｜值得进一步调查 ; without warrant｜没有正当理由
tip_zh: 动词常指值得或有必要，如warrant attention。

meanings_zh: adj. 军事的；战争的
definition_en: Related to war, soldiers, or military life.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about martial arts.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于武术的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of martial arts.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得武术这个例子。
collocations: martial arts｜武术 ; martial law｜戒严 ; martial music｜军乐
tip_zh: martial是军事的；marital是婚姻的，勿混。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；收获成果 | v. 收割庄稼
definition_en: to receive results or rewards from previous actions | to cut and gather a crop when it is ready
example1_en: The lab instructions say to reap the benefits.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求获得益处。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to reap the benefits.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得获得益处。
collocations: reap the benefits｜获得益处 ; reap the rewards｜收获回报 ; reap a harvest｜收获庄稼
tip_zh: 抽象义常搭配benefits或rewards，强调付出后的收获。

meanings_zh: n. 矿石
definition_en: rock containing metal or other valuable substances that can be extracted
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about iron ore.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于铁矿石的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around iron ore.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕铁矿石展开说明。
collocations: iron ore｜铁矿石 ; copper ore｜铜矿石 ; ore deposits｜矿床 ; extract metal from ore｜从矿石中提取金属
tip_zh: ore是含有可提取物质的矿石，不等于metal。

meanings_zh: adj. 殖民的；殖民地的
definition_en: relating to a territory controlled by a foreign country
example1_en: Office hours began with colonial rule.
example1_zh: 答疑从殖民统治开始。
example2_en: The author returns to colonial rule when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了殖民统治。
collocations: colonial rule｜殖民统治 ; colonial period｜殖民时期 ; colonial powers｜殖民列强 ; colonial legacy｜殖民遗产
tip_zh: colony是殖民地；colonial是对应形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 环绕；包围
definition_en: To form a circle around someone or something.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to encircle the city.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须环绕城市。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to encircle the city.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们环绕城市。
collocations: be encircled by mountains｜被群山环绕 ; encircle the city｜环绕城市 ; encircle with a fence｜用围栏围住
tip_zh: 及物动词；被环绕常用be encircled by。

meanings_zh: adj. 待定的；待处理的 | prep. 在等待…期间；直到…为止
definition_en: Waiting for a decision or for something to happen | Until something happens or while waiting for it
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on pending approval.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论等待批准。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss pending approval.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论等待批准的材料。
collocations: pending approval｜等待批准 ; a pending application｜待处理的申请 ; pending investigation｜等待调查
tip_zh: 核心是尚未决定或完成，不要误当作urgent（紧迫的）。

meanings_zh: v. 安慰；慰藉 | n. 控制台；游戏机
definition_en: To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed. | A control unit for equipment, or a machine for video games.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer console yourself with during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时用……安慰自己。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to console yourself with.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们用……安慰自己。
collocations: console someone｜安慰某人 ; console yourself with｜用……安慰自己 ; games console｜游戏机 ; control console｜控制台
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒnsəʊl/。

meanings_zh: v. 终止；结束 | v. 到达终点
definition_en: To end something, or to come to an end. | For a transport service, to reach its final stop.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to terminate a contract.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须终止合同。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to terminate a contract.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来终止合同。
collocations: terminate a contract｜终止合同 ; terminate employment｜终止雇佣关系 ; terminate at a station｜在某站终到
tip_zh: 正式用词；可及物或不及物，列车终到用at。

meanings_zh: n. 标本；样本 | n. 检验样本
definition_en: An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study. | A small amount of bodily material taken for medical testing.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a plant specimen.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论植物标本。
example2_en: The author returns to a plant specimen when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了植物标本。
collocations: collect a specimen｜采集标本 ; a plant specimen｜植物标本 ; a urine specimen｜尿液样本
tip_zh: specimen多指供研究或检验的样本，不泛指任何例子。

meanings_zh: adj. 冷酷无情的；残忍的
definition_en: Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.
example1_en: Our professor circled ruthless competition on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了残酷的竞争。
example2_en: The reading connects ruthless competition with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把残酷的竞争和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: ruthless competition｜残酷的竞争 ; ruthless ambition｜不择手段的野心 ; a ruthless leader｜冷酷无情的领导者
tip_zh: 比strict更强，强调为达目的而不顾他人感受或利益。

meanings_zh: n. 征税；税制
definition_en: The system or process of collecting money through taxes.
example1_en: I copied progressive taxation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把累进税制抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects progressive taxation with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把累进税制和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: progressive taxation｜累进税制 ; direct taxation｜直接征税 ; double taxation｜双重征税 ; taxation policy｜税收政策
tip_zh: taxation通常不可数，侧重征税制度或过程。

meanings_zh: n. 认知
definition_en: The mental processes of knowing, remembering, and reasoning.
example1_en: Sleep loss slows cognition on timed quizzes.
example1_zh: 睡眠不足会让限时小测中的认知变慢。
example2_en: The lecture treated language and memory as related parts of cognition.
example2_zh: 讲座把语言和记忆视为认知中相关的部分。
collocations: human cognition｜人类认知 ; social cognition｜社会认知
tip_zh: 形容词是 cognitive，重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 涡轮机；透平
definition_en: A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on wind turbine.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论风力涡轮机。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss wind turbine.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论风力涡轮机的材料。
collocations: wind turbine｜风力涡轮机 ; steam turbine｜蒸汽轮机 ; gas turbine｜燃气轮机 ; turbine blade｜涡轮叶片
tip_zh: 重音在首音节；wind turbine指风力涡轮机。

meanings_zh: n. 赤字；亏空 | n. 不足；缺额
definition_en: the amount by which spending exceeds income | a shortage of something needed
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about budget deficit.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于预算赤字的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects budget deficit with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把预算赤字和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: budget deficit｜预算赤字 ; trade deficit｜贸易逆差 ; reduce the deficit｜减少赤字
tip_zh: 赤字用deficit；债务用debt，二者不同。

meanings_zh: n. 进口；输入
definition_en: the process of bringing goods into a country from abroad
example1_en: Office hours began with restrict importation.
example1_zh: 答疑从限制进口开始。
example2_en: The reading connects restrict importation with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把限制进口和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: importation of goods｜商品进口 ; restrict importation｜限制进口 ; illegal importation｜非法进口
tip_zh: 较正式，通常不可数；常用the importation of。

meanings_zh: n. 意图；目的 | adj. 专注的；全神贯注的 | adj. 决意的；坚决的
definition_en: What someone plans or means to do. | Giving all your attention to something. | Firmly determined to do or achieve something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a statement of intent.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论意向声明。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a statement of intent.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得意向声明这个例子。
collocations: with the intent of｜怀着……的目的 ; intent on doing something｜决意做某事 ; an intent gaze｜专注的凝视 ; a statement of intent｜意向声明
tip_zh: intent on后接名词或动名词，表示专注或决意。

meanings_zh: adj. 任意的；无明确依据的 | adj. 专断的；武断的
definition_en: based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons | using power according to personal wishes rather than fair rules
example1_en: Our professor circled an arbitrary decision on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了武断的决定。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an arbitrary decision.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得武断的决定这个例子。
collocations: an arbitrary decision｜武断的决定 ; an arbitrary limit｜随意设定的限制 ; arbitrary power｜专断权力
tip_zh: 重点是缺乏合理依据，不只是“可以自由选择”。

meanings_zh: n. 独奏会；独唱会 | n. 详述；逐一列举
definition_en: A musical performance given by one person or a small group. | A spoken account describing a series of facts or events.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a piano recital.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于钢琴独奏会的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a piano recital.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得钢琴独奏会这个例子。
collocations: a piano recital｜钢琴独奏会 ; give a recital｜举办独奏会 ; a recital of facts｜事实的逐一陈述
tip_zh: 音乐语境多指独奏或独唱，不等于大型演唱会。

meanings_zh: v. 跛行；一瘸一拐地走 | n. 跛行 | adj. 无力的；软塌塌的
definition_en: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt | An uneven way of walking caused by an affected leg | Not firm or stiff; lacking strength or support
example1_en: The assignment is to limp along, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先跛行前进，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to limp along.
example2_zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们跛行前进。
collocations: walk with a limp｜一瘸一拐地走 ; limp along｜跛行前进 ; go limp｜变得软弱无力 ; a limp handshake｜无力的握手
tip_zh: 作动词指跛行；作形容词指无力或软塌塌。

meanings_zh: n. 回归线 | n. 热带地区
definition_en: Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries. | The hot region between these circles, called the tropics.
example1_en: Our professor circled Tropic of Cancer on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了北回归线。
example2_en: A campus survey used Tropic of Cancer to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用北回归线来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: Tropic of Cancer｜北回归线 ; Tropic of Capricorn｜南回归线 ; in the tropics｜在热带地区
tip_zh: 回归线用单数；热带地区固定用the tropics。

meanings_zh: v. 欺骗；使产生错觉
definition_en: Make someone believe something that is not true.
example1_en: The professor asked us to delude yourself.
example1_zh: 教授让我们自欺欺人。
example2_en: The passage says students who can delude yourself follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够自欺欺人的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: delude yourself｜自欺欺人 ; delude someone into believing｜使某人误信
tip_zh: 常用delude oneself into doing，指自欺欺人地做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 极有用的；极宝贵的
definition_en: Extremely useful or valuable.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about prove invaluable.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于证明极有价值的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used prove invaluable to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用证明极有价值来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: invaluable advice｜宝贵的建议 ; an invaluable resource｜极有用的资源 ; prove invaluable｜证明极有价值
tip_zh: invaluable意为极宝贵，不是没有价值。

meanings_zh: v. 停止；终止
definition_en: to stop happening or doing something
example1_en: The assignment is to cease operations, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先停止运营，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can cease operations follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够停止运营的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: cease operations｜停止运营 ; cease to exist｜不复存在 ; cease production｜停止生产 ; cease trading｜停止营业
tip_zh: 较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。

meanings_zh: v. 使高兴；使满意 | v. 满足欲望或需求
definition_en: to give someone pleasure or satisfaction | to satisfy a desire or need
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to gratify a desire.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须满足欲望。
example2_en: The passage says students who can gratify a desire follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够满足欲望的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: gratify a desire｜满足欲望 ; gratify curiosity｜满足好奇心 ; be gratified by｜因……而欣慰
tip_zh: 较正式；常用be gratified by表示因某事欣慰。

meanings_zh: n. 大羽毛；羽饰 | n. 柱状烟雾或水流
definition_en: a large feather, especially one used for decoration | a rising mass of smoke, water, or dust
example1_en: I copied a volcanic plume into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把火山喷出的烟柱抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a volcanic plume.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论火山喷出的烟柱的材料。
collocations: a plume of smoke｜一股浓烟 ; a plume of feathers｜一簇羽毛 ; a volcanic plume｜火山喷出的烟柱
tip_zh: 既指大羽毛，也指形似羽毛的烟柱、水柱。

meanings_zh: adj. 怀疑的；拿不准的 | adj. 可疑的；不可靠的
definition_en: feeling uncertain or doubtful about something | probably dishonest, unsafe, or not worth trusting
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on dubious about.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论对……存疑。
example2_en: The reading connects dubious about with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把对……存疑和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: dubious about｜对……存疑 ; dubious claims｜可疑的说法 ; of dubious value｜价值存疑的 ; dubious practices｜可疑的做法
tip_zh: 人感到怀疑用dubious about；事物可疑也可用dubious。

meanings_zh: n. 单调；枯燥乏味
definition_en: boring sameness caused by a lack of variety or change
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the monotony of daily life.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于日常生活的单调的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used the monotony of daily life to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用日常生活的单调来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: break the monotony｜打破单调 ; the monotony of daily life｜日常生活的单调 ; relieve the monotony｜缓解枯燥
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，强调缺少变化带来的乏味。

meanings_zh: n. 螺旋桨
definition_en: a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft
example1_en: Our professor circled aircraft propeller on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了飞机螺旋桨。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of aircraft propeller.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得飞机螺旋桨这个例子。
collocations: aircraft propeller｜飞机螺旋桨 ; ship's propeller｜船用螺旋桨 ; propeller blade｜螺旋桨叶片
tip_zh: propel是推进；propeller是提供推力的螺旋桨。

meanings_zh: n. 马力（功率单位）
definition_en: A unit used to measure the power of an engine.
example1_en: I copied engine horsepower into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把发动机马力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss engine horsepower.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论发动机马力的材料。
collocations: engine horsepower｜发动机马力 ; brake horsepower｜制动马力 ; high horsepower｜大马力
tip_zh: 数量后horsepower不加s；它衡量功率而非速度。

meanings_zh: n. 差异；不一致 | n. 方差
definition_en: A difference or disagreement between things. | A statistical measure of how widely values differ from their mean.
example1_en: Office hours began with population variance.
example1_zh: 答疑从总体方差开始。
example2_en: The author returns to population variance when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了总体方差。
collocations: at variance with｜与……不一致 ; variance between groups｜组间差异 ; population variance｜总体方差
tip_zh: at variance with 表示不一致；统计学中指方差。

meanings_zh: n. 民兵组织
definition_en: A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a local militia.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于地方民兵组织的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a local militia to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用地方民兵组织来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: a local militia｜地方民兵组织 ; form a militia｜组建民兵组织 ; militia members｜民兵成员
tip_zh: 指组织；单个成员用a militia member。

meanings_zh: n. 忠告；建议 | v. 提供咨询；劝告 | n. 律师；法律顾问
definition_en: advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable | to give someone advice or professional support | a lawyer or lawyers representing someone in a legal case
example1_en: Our professor circled seek counsel on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了征求意见。
example2_en: A campus survey used seek counsel to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用征求意见来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: seek counsel｜征求意见 ; legal counsel｜法律顾问 ; counsel someone against something｜劝某人不要做某事 ; wise counsel｜明智的忠告
tip_zh: counsel指忠告或律师；council指委员会。

meanings_zh: n. 丰富；充裕；大量
definition_en: a very large quantity of something
example1_en: The textbook introduces an abundance of in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大量的。
example2_en: The reading connects an abundance of with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把大量的和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: an abundance of｜大量的 ; in abundance｜大量；充裕地 ; an abundance of wildlife｜丰富的野生动物
tip_zh: 常用an abundance of＋名词，或in abundance。

meanings_zh: n. 竖井；升降机井 | n. 杆；轴；柄 | n. 一束光
definition_en: A vertical passage through a building or into the ground. | A long narrow part of a tool or machine. | A narrow beam of light.
example1_en: I copied lift shaft into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电梯井抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used lift shaft to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用电梯井来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: lift shaft｜电梯井 ; ventilation shaft｜通风井 ; drive shaft｜传动轴 ; a shaft of sunlight｜一束阳光
tip_zh: 井道用shaft；英式lift shaft对应美式elevator shaft。

meanings_zh: adv. 相应地 | adv. 因此；于是
definition_en: in a way that suits the particular situation | as a result of something
example1_en: Accordingly, the class checked the chart a second time.
example1_zh: 相应地，全班又核对了一次图表。
example2_en: Accordingly, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
example2_zh: 相应地，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。
collocations: adjust accordingly｜相应调整 ; act accordingly｜据此行事 ; plan accordingly｜据此规划
tip_zh: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 获得；习得 | n. 收购；购得物
definition_en: the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills | the purchase of a business, or something that has been obtained
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about language acquisition.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于语言习得的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects language acquisition with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把语言习得和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: language acquisition｜语言习得 ; acquisition of skills｜技能的掌握 ; mergers and acquisitions｜企业并购 ; make an acquisition｜进行收购
tip_zh: 习得过程通常不可数；收购交易或购得物可数。

meanings_zh: v. 减轻；缓和
definition_en: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to mitigate the effects of.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何减轻……的影响。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to mitigate the effects of.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来减轻……的影响。
collocations: mitigate the effects of｜减轻……的影响 ; mitigate risks｜降低风险 ; mitigate climate change｜缓解气候变化 ; mitigating circumstances｜可减轻处罚的情节
tip_zh: 正式用词，直接接风险、损害或影响，不表示彻底消除。

meanings_zh: n. 心智成熟；稳重 | n. 发育成熟 | n. 金融产品到期
definition_en: The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments. | The state of being fully grown or developed. | The time when an investment or debt becomes repayable.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about emotional maturity.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于情绪成熟的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to emotional maturity when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了情绪成熟。
collocations: emotional maturity｜情绪成熟 ; reach maturity｜达到成熟期 ; a maturity date｜到期日 ; show maturity｜表现出成熟稳重
tip_zh: 通常不可数；金融语境中at maturity表示到期时。

meanings_zh: n. 入职培训；正式就任 | n. 归纳推理 | n. 电磁感应
definition_en: training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation | forming general conclusions from particular observations | production of electrical effects by a changing magnetic field
example1_en: I copied electromagnetic induction into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把电磁感应抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used electromagnetic induction to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用电磁感应来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: induction programme｜入职培训计划 ; induction into office｜正式就任 ; electromagnetic induction｜电磁感应 ; inductive reasoning｜归纳推理
tip_zh: 入职常用induction；归纳与deduction演绎相对。

meanings_zh: n. 歌手；演唱者
definition_en: A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.
example1_en: The textbook introduces lead vocalist in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了主唱。
example2_en: A campus survey used lead vocalist to explain a pattern in the humanities.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用主唱来解释人文学科中的一种模式。
collocations: lead vocalist｜主唱 ; backing vocalist｜伴唱歌手 ; jazz vocalist｜爵士歌手
tip_zh: 常指乐队中的歌手；lead vocalist意为主唱。

meanings_zh: adj. 不严格的；松懈的 | adj. 松弛的；不紧的
definition_en: Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities. | Not firm, tight, or tense.
example1_en: I copied lax security into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把松懈的安保抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of lax security.
example2_zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得松懈的安保这个例子。
collocations: lax security｜松懈的安保 ; lax enforcement｜执法不严 ; lax standards｜宽松的标准 ; lax about rules｜对规则要求不严
tip_zh: 常指规则执行不严；不要用它表示日常的腹泻。

meanings_zh: adj. 易于遭受的；有倾向的 | adj. 俯卧的
definition_en: Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way | Lying flat with the face pointing downwards
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about accident-prone.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于易出事故的的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to accident-prone when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了易出事故的。
collocations: prone to injury｜容易受伤 ; prone to flooding｜易遭洪灾 ; accident-prone｜易出事故的 ; lie prone｜俯卧
tip_zh: prone to后接名词或动名词，通常指不好的情况。

meanings_zh: n. 独立实体；机构
definition_en: something that exists independently, especially an organization
example1_en: The textbook introduces a separate entity in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了独立的实体。
example2_en: The reading connects a separate entity with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把独立的实体和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a separate entity｜独立的实体 ; a legal entity｜法律实体 ; a commercial entity｜商业实体
tip_zh: 强调独立存在的单位，常用于机构、法律或商业语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 繁重的；造成负担的
definition_en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about financially burdensome.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于造成经济负担的的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects financially burdensome with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把造成经济负担的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: burdensome regulations｜繁重的监管规定 ; burdensome task｜繁重的任务 ; financially burdensome｜造成经济负担的
tip_zh: 多形容任务、费用或规定，不指物体重量。

meanings_zh: n. 事件的时间顺序；年表 | n. 年代学
definition_en: The order of events in time, or a record showing it. | The study of when past events happened.
example1_en: The textbook introduces an accurate chronology in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了准确的时间序列。
example2_en: The author returns to an accurate chronology when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了准确的时间序列。
collocations: establish a chronology｜确定时间顺序 ; a chronology of events｜事件年表 ; an accurate chronology｜准确的时间序列
tip_zh: chronology是名词；按时间顺序用chronologically。

meanings_zh: n. 奢侈；挥霍 | n. 奢侈品；奢侈之举
definition_en: Spending more money than is necessary or sensible. | Something expensive bought or done for pleasure rather than necessity.
example1_en: Office hours began with personal extravagance.
example1_zh: 答疑从个人挥霍开始。
example2_en: The reading connects personal extravagance with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把个人挥霍和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: personal extravagance｜个人挥霍 ; an unnecessary extravagance｜不必要的奢侈之举 ; a taste for extravagance｜对奢华的偏爱
tip_zh: 指挥霍行为通常不可数；指某项奢侈享受时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 开除；驱逐 | n. 排出；喷出
definition_en: The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place. | The process of forcing something out of a space or body.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on face expulsion.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论面临开除。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around face expulsion.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕面临开除展开说明。
collocations: expulsion from school｜被学校开除 ; face expulsion｜面临开除 ; expulsion of air｜空气的排出
tip_zh: 常用expulsion from；对应动词为expel。

meanings_zh: n. 标准；正常水平 | n. 票面价值 | n. 高尔夫标准杆数
definition_en: The usual or expected standard of quality or performance. | The stated value of a share or bond. | The expected strokes needed for a golf hole or course.
example1_en: I copied below par into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把低于正常水平抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects below par with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把低于正常水平和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: below par｜低于正常水平 ; on a par with｜与……不相上下 ; at par｜按票面价值 ; par value｜票面价值
tip_zh: on a par with表示不相上下；below par指状态欠佳。

meanings_zh: adv. 不论；不顾
definition_en: Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.
example1_en: The professor told us to irrespective of age and then compare notes.
example1_zh: 教授让我们不论年龄，然后比较笔记。
example2_en: A lecture on social change asks the class to irrespective of age before trusting a chart.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先不论年龄。
collocations: irrespective of age｜不论年龄 ; irrespective of income｜不论收入 ; irrespective of the outcome｜不论结果如何
tip_zh: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

meanings_zh: v. 招致；产生费用或损失
definition_en: to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to incur costs.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何产生费用。
example2_en: The passage says students who can incur costs follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够产生费用的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: incur costs｜产生费用 ; incur losses｜遭受损失 ; incur debt｜背上债务 ; incur a penalty｜招致处罚
tip_zh: 过去式 incurred，现在分词 incurring，均双写 r。

meanings_zh: n. 木材；锯好的木料 | v. 笨重地缓慢移动
definition_en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English. | To move slowly and awkwardly because of weight or size.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a stack of lumber.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一堆木料。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a stack of lumber.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕一堆木料展开说明。
collocations: a lumber yard｜木材场 ; a stack of lumber｜一堆木料 ; lumber along｜笨重地缓慢前行
tip_zh: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。

meanings_zh: n. 红树；红树林
definition_en: A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about mangrove forest.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于红树林的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used mangrove forest to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用红树林来解释环境政策中的一种模式。
collocations: mangrove forest｜红树林 ; mangrove roots｜红树根系 ; mangrove conservation｜红树林保护
tip_zh: 可指一棵红树；红树林常说mangrove forest。

meanings_zh: adj. 依赖的；依靠的
definition_en: needing someone or something for support or success
example1_en: The textbook introduces reliant on in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了依赖于。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss reliant on.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论依赖于的材料。
collocations: reliant on｜依赖于 ; heavily reliant on｜严重依赖 ; increasingly reliant on｜越来越依赖
tip_zh: 固定搭配reliant on；“自立的”是self-reliant。

meanings_zh: v. 无视；不理会 | n. 漠视；不顾
definition_en: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant. | A lack of attention or respect for something.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to disregard advice.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求不理会建议。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to disregard advice.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来不理会建议。
collocations: disregard advice｜不理会建议 ; disregard the rules｜无视规则 ; complete disregard for｜对……的完全漠视 ; disregard for safety｜对安全的漠视
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用disregard for。

meanings_zh: n. 正式讨论；论述 | n. 话语；语篇
definition_en: Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject. | Spoken or written language studied in its social context.
example1_en: The textbook introduces public discourse in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公共讨论。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of public discourse.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得公共讨论这个例子。
collocations: public discourse｜公共讨论 ; political discourse｜政治话语 ; discourse analysis｜话语分析
tip_zh: 语体正式；语言学中指话语或语篇，不等于论文。

meanings_zh: n. 巅峰；顶点 | n. 尖峰；尖塔
definition_en: The highest level of success, achievement or development. | A tall pointed rock or pointed structure on a building.
example1_en: I copied a rocky pinnacle into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把岩石尖峰抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a rocky pinnacle.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论岩石尖峰的材料。
collocations: the pinnacle of success｜成功的巅峰 ; reach the pinnacle｜达到巅峰 ; a rocky pinnacle｜岩石尖峰
tip_zh: 比喻义常用the pinnacle of，表示成就的顶峰。

meanings_zh: v. 消散；使消散 | v. 挥霍；浪费
definition_en: To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear. | To waste money, energy, or resources through careless use.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer dissipate heat during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时散热。
example2_en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to dissipate heat.
example2_zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们散热。
collocations: dissipate heat｜散热 ; tension dissipates｜紧张气氛消散 ; dissipate energy｜耗散能量
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：雾自行消散或风使雾消散。

meanings_zh: n. 严重危险；险境
definition_en: serious danger or a situation involving serious danger
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize peril in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出险境。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up peril while discussing evidence about environmental policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于环境政策的证据时提到了险境。
collocations: in peril｜处于险境 ; put someone in peril｜使某人陷入险境 ; the perils of｜……的种种危险
tip_zh: 比danger更正式，常用in peril表示身处险境。

meanings_zh: adj. 审美的；美感的 | n. 美学风格；审美理念
definition_en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things. | A particular style or set of ideas about beauty.
example1_en: Office hours began with aesthetic appeal.
example1_zh: 答疑从美感吸引力开始。
example2_en: The author returns to aesthetic appeal when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了美感吸引力。
collocations: aesthetic appeal｜美感吸引力 ; aesthetic value｜审美价值 ; aesthetic considerations｜审美方面的考量
tip_zh: aesthetic指审美的；aesthetics常指美学。

meanings_zh: n. 开始；开端 | n. 毕业典礼（美式）
definition_en: The beginning of something, especially an official activity | A ceremony celebrating students completing their studies in the United States
example1_en: The textbook introduces the commencement of work in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了工作的开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the commencement of work.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕工作的开始展开说明。
collocations: the commencement of work｜工作的开始 ; a commencement date｜开始日期 ; a commencement ceremony｜毕业典礼
tip_zh: 表示“开始”较正式；美式英语中也指毕业典礼。

meanings_zh: adj. 一流的；极好的
definition_en: Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize first-rate in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出一流的。
example2_en: Students who can explain first-rate usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
example2_zh: 能解释一流的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。
collocations: first-rate service｜一流的服务 ; a first-rate education｜一流的教育 ; a first-rate performance｜精彩的表现
tip_zh: first-rate表示质量一流，不是“第一次评价”。

meanings_zh: adj. 后部的；后面的 | n. 雌鹿
definition_en: At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs. | An adult female deer, especially a red deer.
example1_en: The textbook introduces hind legs in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了后腿。
example2_en: The reading connects hind legs with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把后腿和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: hind legs｜后腿 ; hind feet｜后脚 ; hind limbs｜后肢
tip_zh: 作形容词主要修饰动物后肢，不泛指后面的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 最适宜的；最佳的 | n. 最佳状态；最适量
definition_en: best suited to achieving a particular result | the most favourable level or condition for a particular purpose
example1_en: Office hours began with optimum conditions.
example1_zh: 答疑从最佳条件开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around optimum conditions.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕最佳条件展开说明。
collocations: optimum conditions｜最佳条件 ; optimum temperature｜最适温度 ; optimum performance｜最佳表现
tip_zh: 强调最适合目标，并非越多越好；通常不用most修饰。

meanings_zh: adj. 心情矛盾的；态度摇摆的
definition_en: having conflicting feelings about someone or something
example1_en: Our professor circled ambivalent attitude on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了矛盾的态度。
example2_en: The author returns to ambivalent attitude when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了矛盾的态度。
collocations: feel ambivalent about｜对……心情矛盾 ; ambivalent attitude｜矛盾的态度 ; remain ambivalent｜仍然举棋不定
tip_zh: 常接about；指好坏感受并存，不是毫不在意。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争力 | n. 好胜心
definition_en: The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity. | A strong desire to win or outperform others.
example1_en: Our professor circled international competitiveness on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了国际竞争力。
example2_en: The reading connects international competitiveness with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把国际竞争力和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: international competitiveness｜国际竞争力 ; enhance competitiveness｜增强竞争力 ; price competitiveness｜价格竞争力 ; economic competitiveness｜经济竞争力
tip_zh: 不可数；既可指市场竞争力，也可指个人好胜心。

meanings_zh: adj. 易受影响的；易患病的
definition_en: easily affected or harmed by something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly susceptible.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论极易受影响的。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss highly susceptible.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论极易受影响的的材料。
collocations: susceptible to infection｜容易感染的 ; susceptible to influence｜易受影响的 ; highly susceptible｜极易受影响的
tip_zh: 常用susceptible to，to后接名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 较小的；较不重要的
definition_en: Smaller in amount, degree, or importance
example1_en: I copied the lesser of two evils into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把两害相权取其轻抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of the lesser of two evils.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得两害相权取其轻这个例子。
collocations: to a lesser extent｜在较小程度上 ; of lesser importance｜较不重要的 ; the lesser of two evils｜两害相权取其轻
tip_zh: 通常放在名词前；不用于直接表示物体尺寸更小。

meanings_zh: v. 犯错；判断失误
definition_en: To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.
example1_en: The assignment is to err in judgement, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先判断失误，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to err in judgement.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来判断失误。
collocations: err in judgement｜判断失误 ; err on the side of caution｜宁可谨慎一些 ; err in assuming｜错误地假定
tip_zh: 较正式的不及物动词；常用err on the side of caution。

meanings_zh: adj. 下级的；次要的 | n. 下属；部下
definition_en: Lower in rank, authority, or importance. | Someone with a lower position under another person's authority.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about subordinate to.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于从属于；次于的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of subordinate to.
example2_zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得从属于；次于这个例子。
collocations: subordinate to｜从属于；次于 ; a subordinate role｜次要角色 ; subordinate staff｜下级员工 ; a subordinate clause｜从句
tip_zh: 表示“从属于”用subordinate to，不用than。

meanings_zh: adj. 衷心的；真挚的
definition_en: Deeply and sincerely felt.
example1_en: Office hours began with heartfelt thanks.
example1_zh: 答疑从衷心的感谢开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of heartfelt thanks.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得衷心的感谢这个例子。
collocations: heartfelt thanks｜衷心的感谢 ; a heartfelt apology｜真诚的道歉 ; heartfelt sympathy｜由衷的同情
tip_zh: 常修饰thanks、apology、sympathy，强调发自内心。

meanings_zh: v. 罢黜；赶下台；驱逐
definition_en: To force someone out of a position or place.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to oust a leader.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须罢黜领导人。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers oust a leader before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要罢黜领导人。
collocations: oust a leader｜罢黜领导人 ; oust someone from office｜将某人赶下台 ; be ousted as chair｜被罢免主席职务
tip_zh: 常用oust someone from office，强调被迫离职。

meanings_zh: n. 评价；评估 | n. 估价
definition_en: a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation | an expert estimate of how much something is worth
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about performance appraisal.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于绩效评估的简答题。
example2_en: The reading connects performance appraisal with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把绩效评估和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: performance appraisal｜绩效评估 ; critical appraisal｜审慎评估 ; property appraisal｜房产估价 ; appraisal process｜评估流程
tip_zh: appraisal是评估；别与approval（批准）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 兼容的；可并存的 | adj. 合得来的
definition_en: Able to work or exist together without problems | Having personalities or interests that allow a good relationship
example1_en: The textbook introduces fully compatible in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了完全兼容。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fully compatible.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕完全兼容展开说明。
collocations: compatible with｜与……兼容 ; fully compatible｜完全兼容 ; compatible software｜兼容的软件
tip_zh: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

meanings_zh: n. 物品清单；财产清册 | n. 库存；存货 | v. 为……编制清单
definition_en: A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere. | The goods a business keeps available for sale. | To make a detailed list of items.
example1_en: Our professor circled inventory management on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了库存管理。
example2_en: The reading connects inventory management with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把库存管理和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: make an inventory｜编制清单 ; inventory management｜库存管理 ; inventory levels｜库存水平
tip_zh: 表示库存时多见于美式英语，英式常用stock。

meanings_zh: n. 蚯蚓
definition_en: a long, soft worm that lives in soil
example1_en: Our professor circled earthworm populations on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了蚯蚓种群。
example2_en: The author returns to earthworm populations when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了蚯蚓种群。
collocations: earthworm populations｜蚯蚓种群 ; earthworm activity｜蚯蚓活动 ; earthworm castings｜蚯蚓粪
tip_zh: 可数名词；earth在这里指土壤。

meanings_zh: adj. 残留的；剩余的
definition_en: remaining after most of something has gone or been removed
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about residual heat.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于余热的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around residual heat.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕余热展开说明。
collocations: residual heat｜余热 ; residual chemicals｜残留化学物质 ; residual effects｜残余影响 ; residual income｜持续性后续收入
tip_zh: 常用于技术语境，强调处理后仍残留。

meanings_zh: n. 文字记录；转写稿 | n. 成绩单
definition_en: a written record of words spoken in a conversation or recording | an official record of a student's courses and grades
example1_en: Office hours began with interview transcript.
example1_zh: 答疑从访谈文字记录开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used interview transcript to explain a pattern in student life.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用访谈文字记录来解释校园生活中的一种模式。
collocations: interview transcript｜访谈文字记录 ; academic transcript｜学业成绩单 ; a full transcript｜完整文字记录
tip_zh: transcript可指录音转写稿，也可指学校成绩单。

meanings_zh: n. 配偶
definition_en: The person someone is married to.
example1_en: I copied surviving spouse into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把尚健在的配偶抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss surviving spouse.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论尚健在的配偶的材料。
collocations: surviving spouse｜尚健在的配偶 ; accompanying spouse｜随行配偶 ; spouse's income｜配偶的收入
tip_zh: 正式用语，指丈夫或妻子，不限定性别。

meanings_zh: adj. 猖獗的；泛滥的 | adj. 疯长的；蔓生的
definition_en: Spreading widely and uncontrollably, especially when harmful. | Growing quickly and spreading without control.
example1_en: Our professor circled rampant corruption on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了猖獗的腐败。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rampant corruption.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论猖獗的腐败的材料。
collocations: rampant corruption｜猖獗的腐败 ; run rampant｜肆虐；泛滥 ; rampant inflation｜失控的通货膨胀 ; rampant growth｜疯长
tip_zh: 常形容腐败、疾病等失控蔓延；run rampant指肆虐。

meanings_zh: v. 改进；完善 | v. 精炼；提纯
definition_en: Improve something by making small, careful changes | Remove unwanted substances from a raw material
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to refine a technique.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何改进技巧。
example2_en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers refine a technique before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要改进技巧。
collocations: refine a technique｜改进技巧 ; refine a proposal｜完善提案 ; refine crude oil｜精炼原油
tip_zh: 既可指完善方法，也可指提纯原材料。

meanings_zh: v. 使着迷；使困扰 | v. 念念不忘；过分纠结
definition_en: to fill someone's mind so they cannot think of anything else | to think about something constantly and excessively
example1_en: I heard the lecturer obsess over details during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时过分纠结细节。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to obsess over details.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来过分纠结细节。
collocations: obsess over details｜过分纠结细节 ; be obsessed with success｜痴迷于成功 ; obsess about appearance｜过分在意外表
tip_zh: 常用be obsessed with；主动式常接over或about。

meanings_zh: n. 执业人员；从业者 | n. 实践者
definition_en: someone who works in a profession, especially medicine | someone who regularly uses a particular skill or method
example1_en: Office hours began with general practitioner.
example1_zh: 答疑从全科医生开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used general practitioner to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用全科医生来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: general practitioner｜全科医生 ; medical practitioner｜执业医师 ; experienced practitioner｜经验丰富的从业者
tip_zh: general practitioner指全科医生，常缩写为GP。

meanings_zh: adj. 凶猛的；凶狠的 | adj. 猛烈的；激烈的
definition_en: very fierce, violent, or aggressive | extremely strong or intense
example1_en: I copied a ferocious animal into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把凶猛的动物抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a ferocious animal when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了凶猛的动物。
collocations: a ferocious animal｜凶猛的动物 ; ferocious competition｜激烈的竞争 ; a ferocious storm｜猛烈的暴风雨
tip_zh: 既可形容动物凶猛，也可形容竞争或风暴猛烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 动荡的；混乱的 | adj. 湍急的；气流紊乱的
definition_en: Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes. | Moving violently and irregularly, especially air or water.
example1_en: Office hours began with turbulent times.
example1_zh: 答疑从动荡时期开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss turbulent times.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论动荡时期的材料。
collocations: turbulent times｜动荡时期 ; turbulent waters｜湍急的水流 ; turbulent airflow｜紊乱气流
tip_zh: 既形容社会局势动荡，也形容水流或气流紊乱。

meanings_zh: v. 抵消；使无效 | v. 否定；否认
definition_en: Cancel the effect or value of something. | State or show that something is not true.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer negate the benefits during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时抵消益处。
example2_en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers negate the benefits before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要抵消益处。
collocations: negate the benefits｜抵消益处 ; negate the effects｜抵消影响 ; negate an argument｜否定一个论点
tip_zh: 正式用词；常表示抵消效果，不只表示口头否认。

meanings_zh: adj. 全体一致同意的
definition_en: agreed on by every person in a group
example1_en: I copied unanimous decision into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把一致通过的决定抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used unanimous decision to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用一致通过的决定来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: unanimous decision｜一致通过的决定 ; unanimous support｜全体一致支持 ; unanimous agreement｜全体一致同意 ; unanimous vote｜全票通过
tip_zh: 强调所有人都同意，不是仅指多数人赞成。

meanings_zh: n. 归因；归属认定 | n. 注明出处；署名
definition_en: the act of identifying something's cause, creator, or source | acknowledgement of the person who created or supplied something
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on causal attribution.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论因果归因。
example2_en: The reading connects causal attribution with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把因果归因和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: attribution of responsibility｜责任归属 ; causal attribution｜因果归因 ; source attribution｜注明来源
tip_zh: 不是普通的“属于”；常指认定原因、作者或来源。

meanings_zh: n. 可卡因；古柯碱
definition_en: A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on cocaine addiction.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可卡因成瘾。
example2_en: The reading connects cocaine addiction with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可卡因成瘾和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: cocaine addiction｜可卡因成瘾 ; cocaine use｜使用可卡因 ; cocaine dependence｜可卡因依赖
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，指一种强效成瘾性毒品。

meanings_zh: n. 蛤蜊；蛤
definition_en: A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on clam shell.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论蛤蜊壳。
example2_en: The reading connects clam shell with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把蛤蜊壳和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: clam shell｜蛤蜊壳 ; clam chowder｜蛤蜊浓汤 ; clam farming｜蛤蜊养殖
tip_zh: clam是蛤蜊；不要与calm（平静的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 供自主选用学习的 | n. 自主选材学习
definition_en: allowing learners to choose and use materials independently | independent learning using materials chosen by the learner
example1_en: I wrote self-access on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把self-access和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain self-access usually follow the rest of a lecture on academic research.
example2_zh: 能解释供自主选用学习的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于学术研究的讲座。
collocations: self-access centre｜自主学习中心 ; self-access materials｜自主学习材料 ; self-access learning｜自主选材学习
tip_zh: 主要用于教育，强调自主选择并使用学习资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 淫秽的；猥亵的 | adj. 多得离谱的；令人愤慨的
definition_en: offensively sexual in a way considered unacceptable | so excessive or unfair that it causes moral outrage
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about obscene language.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于淫秽语言的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss obscene language.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论淫秽语言的材料。
collocations: obscene language｜淫秽语言 ; obscene material｜淫秽内容 ; an obscene amount of money｜多得离谱的一笔钱
tip_zh: 比rude语气强；也可批评金钱或数量多得离谱。

meanings_zh: v. 使有能力；增强自主权 | v. 授权
definition_en: Give someone confidence or control over their own life. | Give someone official authority to take particular action.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to empower women.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何增强女性自主权。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to empower women.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得增强女性自主权。
collocations: empower women｜增强女性自主权 ; empower communities｜增强社区自主能力 ; empower someone to act｜授权某人采取行动
tip_zh: 常用empower sb to do sth，表示赋能或授权。

meanings_zh: v. 逐步侵占；侵犯
definition_en: To gradually take over another's space, time, or rights.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer encroach on land during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时侵占土地。
example2_en: The passage says students who can encroach on land follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够侵占土地的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: encroach on land｜侵占土地 ; encroach on privacy｜侵犯隐私 ; encroach on leisure time｜侵占休闲时间
tip_zh: 不及物动词，常用encroach on/upon，强调逐步侵占。

meanings_zh: n. 请愿书 | v. 向…请愿；正式请求
definition_en: A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures. | To formally ask an authority to do something.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on petition for reform.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论请愿要求改革。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss petition for reform.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论请愿要求改革的材料。
collocations: sign a petition｜在请愿书上签名 ; submit a petition｜提交请愿书 ; petition for reform｜请愿要求改革
tip_zh: 动词常用petition somebody to do something。

meanings_zh: n. 喧闹声；强烈呼声 | v. 大声要求；喧嚷
definition_en: Loud noise or strong public demands | To demand something loudly or insistently
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on public clamor.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公众的强烈呼声。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss public clamor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论公众的强烈呼声的材料。
collocations: clamor for change｜强烈要求变革 ; public clamor｜公众的强烈呼声 ; clamor to be heard｜吵着要求被听见
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为clamour。要求某物用clamor for。

meanings_zh: adj. 和蔼可亲的；友善的
definition_en: Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on amiable manner.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论亲切的态度。
example2_en: The reading connects amiable manner with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把亲切的态度和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: amiable manner｜亲切的态度 ; amiable personality｜随和的性格 ; amiable smile｜友善的微笑
tip_zh: amiable多形容人；amicable多形容关系或协议。

meanings_zh: n. 公证人
definition_en: An official authorised to witness signatures and certify documents.
example1_en: I copied notary public into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把公证人抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around notary public.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕公证人展开说明。
collocations: notary public｜公证人 ; consult a notary｜咨询公证人 ; before a notary｜在公证人面前
tip_zh: 也称notary public；具体职权因国家而异。

meanings_zh: n. 无所事事；懒散
definition_en: The state of not working or doing anything.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on enforced idleness.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论被迫闲着。
example2_en: The author returns to enforced idleness when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了被迫闲着。
collocations: enforced idleness｜被迫闲着 ; a life of idleness｜无所事事的生活 ; sheer idleness｜纯粹的懒惰
tip_zh: 不可数；既可指懒散，也可指被迫闲着。

meanings_zh: adj. 气候温和的 | adj. 克制的；适度的
definition_en: Having weather that is neither very hot nor very cold | Showing restraint rather than extreme behaviour or feelings
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about temperate climate.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于温和的气候的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around temperate climate.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕温和的气候展开说明。
collocations: temperate climate｜温和的气候 ; temperate zone｜温带 ; temperate language｜克制的措辞
tip_zh: 气候义指不太冷也不太热；不等于热带的。

meanings_zh: adj. 食草的；以植物为食的
definition_en: feeding on plants rather than other animals
example1_en: Our professor circled herbivorous animals on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了食草动物。
example2_en: A campus survey used herbivorous animals to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用食草动物来解释自然科学中的一种模式。
collocations: herbivorous animals｜食草动物 ; herbivorous mammals｜食草哺乳动物 ; herbivorous species｜食草物种
tip_zh: 不仅指吃草，也包括以树叶、果实等植物为食。

meanings_zh: n. 荒谬；荒唐 | n. 荒唐事；荒谬言论
definition_en: the quality of being unreasonable, ridiculous, or illogical | an action, situation, or statement that makes no sense
example1_en: Our professor circled sheer absurdity on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了完全荒谬。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sheer absurdity.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论完全荒谬的材料。
collocations: the absurdity of｜……的荒谬之处 ; sheer absurdity｜完全荒谬 ; expose an absurdity｜揭露荒唐之处
tip_zh: 表示荒谬性质时不可数；指具体荒唐事时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 球体；球形 | n. 领域；范围
definition_en: A perfectly round solid shape, like a ball. | An area of activity, knowledge, or influence.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a perfect sphere.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于完美球体的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a perfect sphere.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕完美球体展开说明。
collocations: a perfect sphere｜完美球体 ; sphere of influence｜影响范围 ; the public sphere｜公共领域
tip_zh: 球体用sphere，平面上的圆用circle。

meanings_zh: adj. 琐碎的；不重要的
definition_en: having little importance or seriousness
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on trivial matter.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小事。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of trivial matter.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得小事这个例子。
collocations: trivial matter｜小事 ; trivial detail｜无关紧要的细节 ; trivial complaint｜对小事的抱怨
tip_zh: 指重要性低，不等于容易；trivial matters指琐事。

meanings_zh: n. 保证；担保 | n. 自信；把握
definition_en: A promise intended to remove doubt or worry. | Confidence in your abilities or in what you believe.
example1_en: Office hours began with quality assurance.
example1_zh: 答疑从质量保证开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around quality assurance.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕质量保证展开说明。
collocations: give an assurance｜作出保证 ; quality assurance｜质量保证 ; speak with assurance｜自信地说 ; life assurance｜人寿保险
tip_zh: 表示具体保证时可数；表示自信时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 汞；水银
definition_en: A poisonous, silver-coloured metal that is liquid at room temperature.
example1_en: I copied mercury poisoning into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把汞中毒抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mercury poisoning.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论汞中毒的材料。
collocations: mercury poisoning｜汞中毒 ; mercury pollution｜汞污染 ; mercury thermometer｜水银温度计
tip_zh: mercury指汞，不可数；大写Mercury可指水星。

meanings_zh: adj. 潜在的；潜伏的
definition_en: Present but not yet active, visible, or fully developed.
example1_en: I copied latent talent into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把潜在天赋抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects latent talent with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把潜在天赋和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: latent talent｜潜在天赋 ; latent potential｜潜能 ; latent infection｜潜伏感染 ; latent demand｜潜在需求
tip_zh: 指已经存在但尚未显现或发挥作用。

meanings_zh: v. 激励；促进 | n. 刺激；推动力 | n. 马刺
definition_en: To encourage action or cause something to develop faster | Something that encourages action or further progress | A metal device on a rider's boot for urging a horse
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to spur economic growth.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何促进经济增长。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers spur economic growth before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要促进经济增长。
collocations: spur economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; spur someone into action｜促使某人行动 ; a spur to innovation｜创新的推动力 ; on the spur of the moment｜一时兴起
tip_zh: 常用spur sb to do；过去式spurred双写r。

meanings_zh: n. 剧烈痛苦；折磨 | v. 使痛苦；折磨；烦扰
definition_en: severe physical pain or mental suffering | to cause someone severe suffering or repeated distress
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about mental torment.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于精神折磨的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mental torment.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕精神折磨展开说明。
collocations: mental torment｜精神折磨 ; in torment｜处于极度痛苦中 ; tormented by guilt｜受内疚折磨
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 有歧义的；含糊的
definition_en: Having more than one possible meaning or interpretation
example1_en: Our professor circled ambiguous wording on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了含糊的措辞。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around ambiguous wording.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕含糊的措辞展开说明。
collocations: ambiguous wording｜含糊的措辞 ; ambiguous statement｜有歧义的陈述 ; remain ambiguous｜仍不明确
tip_zh: 侧重可作多种解读；vague侧重细节不清。

meanings_zh: v. 遵守；服从 | v. 容忍；忍受
definition_en: to follow a rule, agreement, or decision | to tolerate something, usually used with cannot
example1_en: The professor asked us to abide by the rules.
example1_zh: 教授让我们遵守规则。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers abide by the rules before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要遵守规则。
collocations: abide by the rules｜遵守规则 ; abide by an agreement｜遵守协议 ; cannot abide｜无法忍受
tip_zh: 表示遵守用abide by；表示忍受常用cannot abide。

meanings_zh: n. 电报通信系统；电报机 | v. 发电报 | v. 无意中流露；提前暴露
definition_en: A system or device sending messages electrically along wires. | To send a message using a telegraph. | To reveal intentions or feelings, often without meaning to.
example1_en: Our professor circled telegraph operator on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了电报员。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of telegraph operator.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得电报员这个例子。
collocations: telegraph operator｜电报员 ; telegraph wire｜电报线 ; telegraph your intentions｜提前暴露意图
tip_zh: telegraph 指通信系统或设备；telegram 指电报消息。

meanings_zh: v. 量化；确定数量
definition_en: to measure or express the amount of something
example1_en: The assignment is to quantify the impact, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先量化影响，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The passage says students who can quantify the impact follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够量化影响的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: quantify the impact｜量化影响 ; quantify the benefits｜量化效益 ; difficult to quantify｜难以量化
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语：quantify the impact。

meanings_zh: n. 芦苇；苇秆 | n. 簧片
definition_en: A tall grass with stiff stems growing near water | A thin strip that vibrates to produce sound in certain instruments
example1_en: Office hours began with clarinet reed.
example1_zh: 答疑从单簧管簧片开始。
example2_en: The reading connects clarinet reed with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把单簧管簧片和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: reed bed｜芦苇丛 ; reed warbler｜苇莺 ; clarinet reed｜单簧管簧片
tip_zh: 与read的原形同音；也指乐器中振动发声的簧片。

meanings_zh: adj. 勤劳的；勤奋的
definition_en: working hard and carefully over a sustained period
example1_en: Office hours began with an industrious worker.
example1_zh: 答疑从勤劳的工人开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an industrious worker.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕勤劳的工人展开说明。
collocations: an industrious worker｜勤劳的工人 ; an industrious student｜勤奋的学生
tip_zh: industrious 指勤奋的；industrial 指工业的。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；培养 | v. 寄养；代养 | adj. 寄养的；代养的
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or grow | to care for another person's child, usually temporarily | involving care for a child by someone other than their parents
example1_en: The lab instructions say to foster creativity.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求培养创造力。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to foster creativity.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们培养创造力。
collocations: foster creativity｜培养创造力 ; foster cooperation｜促进合作 ; foster a child｜寄养孩子 ; foster parents｜寄养父母
tip_zh: foster常指暂时代养；adopt指依法收养。

meanings_zh: n. 轻微地震；震动 | n. 颤抖；战栗
definition_en: A small earthquake or a brief shaking movement. | An involuntary shaking of the body or voice.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about earth tremor.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于轻微地震的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss earth tremor.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轻微地震的材料。
collocations: earth tremor｜轻微地震 ; hand tremor｜手部颤抖 ; a tremor in her voice｜她声音中的颤抖
tip_zh: 通常作名词；声音中的颤抖用a tremor in the voice。

meanings_zh: n. 医生；内科医生
definition_en: A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.
example1_en: Office hours began with qualified physician.
example1_zh: 答疑从合格的医生开始。
example2_en: The reading connects qualified physician with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把合格的医生和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: consult a physician｜咨询医生 ; qualified physician｜合格的医生 ; primary care physician｜初级保健医生
tip_zh: 美式常泛指医生；英式常指内科医生。

meanings_zh: v. 危及；使陷入危险
definition_en: To put something valuable at risk of harm or loss.
example1_en: The assignment is to jeopardize safety, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先危及安全，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to jeopardize safety.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得危及安全。
collocations: jeopardize safety｜危及安全 ; jeopardize prospects｜损害前景 ; jeopardize a relationship｜危及关系
tip_zh: 直接接宾语；英式英语也常拼作jeopardise。

meanings_zh: n. 澄清；进一步说明
definition_en: an explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand
example1_en: Our professor circled seek clarification on on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了就……寻求解释。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of seek clarification on.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得就……寻求解释这个例子。
collocations: ask for clarification｜请求说明 ; provide clarification｜作出说明 ; clarification of the rules｜对规则的澄清 ; seek clarification on｜就……寻求解释
tip_zh: 常用clarification of或on；通常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 热情；热忱
definition_en: great energy and enthusiasm for an activity or cause
example1_en: The textbook introduces missionary zeal in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了传教士般的热忱。
