example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of missionary zeal.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得传教士般的热忱这个例子。
collocations: zeal for learning｜学习热情 ; with great zeal｜满怀热忱地 ; missionary zeal｜传教士般的热忱
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常用zeal for表示对某事的热情。

meanings_zh: n. 期货；期货合约
definition_en: Contracts to trade assets later at prices agreed now.
example1_en: The textbook introduces trade futures in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了交易期货。
example2_en: A campus survey used trade futures to explain a pattern in economic policy.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用交易期货来解释经济政策中的一种模式。
collocations: futures market｜期货市场 ; futures contract｜期货合约 ; trade futures｜交易期货 ; oil futures｜石油期货
tip_zh: 金融义用复数形式；futures contract指期货合约。

meanings_zh: n. 惊人的发现；被揭露的事 | n. 揭露；披露
definition_en: A surprising fact that becomes known. | The act of making previously hidden information known.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a startling revelation.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论惊人的发现。
example2_en: The author returns to a startling revelation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了惊人的发现。
collocations: a startling revelation｜惊人的发现 ; revelations about｜关于……的披露 ; come as a revelation｜令人恍然大悟
tip_zh: 具体的新发现可数；指披露这一行为时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 多付的款项；超额支付
definition_en: Money paid beyond the amount owed, or paying too much
example1_en: The textbook introduces an overpayment of wages in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多发的工资。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an overpayment of wages.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论多发的工资的材料。
collocations: an overpayment of wages｜多发的工资 ; recover an overpayment｜追回多付款项 ; refund an overpayment｜退还多付款项
tip_zh: 款项用of引出：an overpayment of wages。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜气洋洋的；容光焕发的 | adj. 光芒四射的 | adj. 辐射的
definition_en: Showing great happiness through your face or appearance. | Shining brightly with light. | Transmitted as waves, especially heat or light.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a radiant smile.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论灿烂的笑容。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a radiant smile.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论灿烂的笑容的材料。
collocations: a radiant smile｜灿烂的笑容 ; radiant heat｜辐射热 ; radiant energy｜辐射能
tip_zh: 形容人常指幸福得容光焕发；radiant heat 指辐射热。

meanings_zh: adj. 连续的；接连的
definition_en: following one after another without a break
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about successive generations.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一代又一代的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of successive generations.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得一代又一代这个例子。
collocations: successive generations｜一代又一代 ; successive governments｜历届政府 ; successive years｜连续多年
tip_zh: successive指接连的；successful才是成功的。

meanings_zh: adj. 独立的；分离的
definition_en: Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.
example1_en: I copied discrete categories into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把独立类别抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects discrete categories with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把独立类别和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: discrete categories｜独立类别 ; discrete units｜独立单元 ; discrete data｜离散数据
tip_zh: 勿混 discreet（谨慎的）；两词读音相同。

meanings_zh: v. 迫害 | v. 纠缠；不断困扰
definition_en: To treat people cruelly because of their beliefs or identity. | To repeatedly trouble someone or treat them unfairly.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer persecute minorities during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时迫害少数群体。
example2_en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers persecute minorities before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要迫害少数群体。
collocations: religiously persecuted｜因宗教而受迫害 ; persecute minorities｜迫害少数群体 ; persecuted for their beliefs｜因信仰而受迫害
tip_zh: persecute指迫害；prosecute指依法起诉。

meanings_zh: n. 融合；结合 | n. 核聚变
definition_en: the joining of different things into a single whole | the joining of light atomic nuclei, releasing energy
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about nuclear fusion.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于核聚变的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of nuclear fusion.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得核聚变这个例子。
collocations: a fusion of styles｜多种风格的融合 ; fusion cuisine｜融合菜 ; nuclear fusion｜核聚变
tip_zh: 核聚变用fusion；核裂变用fission，注意区分。

meanings_zh: n. 广度；范围 | n. 宽度
definition_en: The wide range of things something includes. | The distance from one side of something to the other.
example1_en: The textbook introduces breadth of knowledge in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了知识的广度。
example2_en: The author returns to breadth of knowledge when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了知识的广度。
collocations: breadth of knowledge｜知识的广度 ; breadth of experience｜阅历的丰富程度 ; breadth and depth｜广度与深度
tip_zh: breadth强调广度；depth强调深度，二者常并列。

meanings_zh: v. 稀释；冲淡 | v. 削弱；减弱 | adj. 稀释的；浓度低的
definition_en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid. | To reduce the strength, quality, or influence of something. | Containing a relatively small amount of a substance in liquid.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to dilute with water.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何用水稀释。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers dilute with water before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要用水稀释。
collocations: dilute with water｜用水稀释 ; a dilute solution｜稀溶液 ; dilute the impact｜削弱影响
tip_zh: dilute A with B表示用液体B稀释A。

meanings_zh: n. 囚犯；服刑人员
definition_en: A person who is kept in a prison.
example1_en: The textbook introduces prison inmate in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了监狱服刑人员。
example2_en: The reading connects prison inmate with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把监狱服刑人员和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: prison inmate｜监狱服刑人员 ; inmate rehabilitation｜服刑人员改造 ; former inmate｜曾服刑者
tip_zh: 现代通常指囚犯，不可用来泛指室友或居民。

meanings_zh: n. 轻蔑；鄙视 | n. 藐视法庭
definition_en: A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect | Behaviour that disobeys a court or disrespects its authority
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on contempt for.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论对……的鄙视。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of contempt for.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得对……的鄙视这个例子。
collocations: contempt for｜对……的鄙视 ; treat someone with contempt｜轻蔑地对待某人 ; contempt of court｜藐视法庭
tip_zh: contempt for指鄙视某人或某事；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 诱人得难以抗拒的 | adj. 无法抵挡的
definition_en: so attractive that you cannot refuse or avoid it | too strong or powerful to resist
example1_en: I copied irresistible temptation into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把无法抗拒的诱惑抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects irresistible temptation with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把无法抗拒的诱惑和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: irresistible temptation｜无法抗拒的诱惑 ; irresistible urge｜难以抑制的冲动 ; irresistible charm｜难以抗拒的魅力
tip_zh: 常形容魅力、诱惑或冲动强烈得令人无法抗拒。

meanings_zh: n. 效率低下；低效现象
definition_en: failure to use time, money, or resources well
example1_en: The textbook introduces operational inefficiency in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了运营效率低下。
example2_en: The author returns to operational inefficiency when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了运营效率低下。
collocations: operational inefficiency｜运营效率低下 ; reduce inefficiency｜减少低效现象 ; administrative inefficiency｜行政效率低下
tip_zh: 指浪费时间或资源，不等于个人完全无能。

meanings_zh: n. 通信；往来信件 | n. 一致；对应关系
definition_en: Written communication between people, or the messages they exchange. | A close similarity or connection between two things.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on business correspondence.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论商务信函。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss business correspondence.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论商务信函的材料。
collocations: correspondence with someone｜与某人的通信 ; business correspondence｜商务信函 ; correspondence between｜……之间的对应关系
tip_zh: 表示往来信件时不可数；与某人通信用with。

meanings_zh: v. 厌恶；憎恨
definition_en: to dislike someone or something very strongly
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to detest violence.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须憎恶暴力。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to detest violence.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得憎恶暴力。
collocations: detest doing something｜厌恶做某事 ; detest violence｜憎恶暴力 ; absolutely detest｜极其厌恶
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：detest doing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 背叛；出卖
definition_en: An act that breaks someone's trust or loyalty.
example1_en: I copied a sense of betrayal into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把被背叛的感觉抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of betrayal.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕被背叛的感觉展开说明。
collocations: a betrayal of trust｜辜负信任 ; a sense of betrayal｜被背叛的感觉 ; an act of betrayal｜背叛行为
tip_zh: 通常指辜负信任；并非一般意义上的“暴露”。

meanings_zh: adj. 爱国的
definition_en: Showing love for and pride in your country.
example1_en: The textbook introduces patriotic pride in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了爱国自豪感。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around patriotic pride.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕爱国自豪感展开说明。
collocations: patriotic pride｜爱国自豪感 ; patriotic songs｜爱国歌曲 ; patriotic duty｜爱国责任
tip_zh: patriotic强调爱国，不必然含排斥他国之意。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗俗的；下流的 | adj. 俗气的；庸俗的
definition_en: Rude or offensive, especially in language or behaviour. | Lacking good taste, especially through excessive display.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on vulgar language.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论粗俗的语言。
example2_en: A campus survey used vulgar language to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用粗俗的语言来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: vulgar language｜粗俗的语言 ; vulgar joke｜下流的笑话 ; vulgar display of wealth｜俗气的炫富行为
tip_zh: 现代常用义带贬义，不宜用来表示“普通的”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不识字的；文盲的 | adj. 缺乏某领域知识的
definition_en: Unable to read or write. | Lacking basic knowledge or skills in a particular area.
example1_en: I copied computer illiterate into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把不懂电脑的抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of computer illiterate.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得不懂电脑的这个例子。
collocations: illiterate adults｜不识字的成年人 ; computer illiterate｜不懂电脑的 ; financially illiterate｜缺乏金融常识的
tip_zh: 名词用法易显贬义，宜用形容词客观描述。

meanings_zh: adj. 过度痴迷的；执念的
definition_en: Thinking about something constantly and finding it difficult to stop.
example1_en: I copied obsessive behaviour into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把执念行为抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around obsessive behaviour.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕执念行为展开说明。
collocations: obsessive behaviour｜执念行为 ; obsessive concern｜过度关注 ; obsessive about details｜过度纠结细节
tip_zh: 比interested强得多，常含过度、难以自控之意。

meanings_zh: n. 否定；否认 | n. 否定表达
definition_en: the act of denying something or stating its opposite | the grammatical expression that something is not true or present
example1_en: The textbook introduces complete negation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了彻底否定。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss complete negation.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论彻底否定的材料。
collocations: complete negation｜彻底否定 ; negation of a claim｜对某说法的否定 ; double negation｜双重否定
tip_zh: 偏正式；语法中指否定，日常说拒绝多用refusal。

meanings_zh: n. 发酵
definition_en: Microbial breakdown of sugars into substances such as acids or alcohol.
example1_en: Office hours began with lactic acid fermentation.
example1_zh: 答疑从乳酸发酵开始。
example2_en: The author returns to lactic acid fermentation when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了乳酸发酵。
collocations: the fermentation process｜发酵过程 ; lactic acid fermentation｜乳酸发酵 ; controlled fermentation｜受控发酵
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；动词是ferment。

meanings_zh: n. 消除；排除 | n. 淘汰
definition_en: the complete removal of something unwanted or unnecessary | the removal of a competitor from a competition
example1_en: Our professor circled process of elimination on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了排除法。
example2_en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of process of elimination.
example2_zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得排除法这个例子。
collocations: elimination of waste｜消除浪费 ; process of elimination｜排除法 ; face elimination｜面临淘汰 ; complete elimination｜彻底消除
tip_zh: 动词是eliminate；by elimination表示“用排除法”。

meanings_zh: v. 使疏远；使失去支持
definition_en: Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you
example1_en: I heard the lecturer alienate voters during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时失去选民的支持。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to alienate voters.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来失去选民的支持。
collocations: alienate voters｜失去选民的支持 ; alienate customers｜使顾客疏远 ; alienate someone from｜使某人与……疏远
tip_zh: 常指使人疏远或失去支持，不表示挪用。

meanings_zh: n. 熟练；精通
definition_en: A high level of skill or ability in something.
example1_en: I copied language proficiency into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把语言能力抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of language proficiency.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得语言能力这个例子。
collocations: proficiency in English｜英语熟练程度 ; language proficiency｜语言能力 ; proficiency test｜水平测试 ; demonstrate proficiency｜展示熟练技能
tip_zh: 常用proficiency in接语言、学科或技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 由此产生的 | n. 合力；合向量
definition_en: Happening or existing as a result of something else. | A single vector equivalent to two or more combined vectors.
example1_en: Our professor circled the resultant damage on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了由此造成的损害。
example2_en: The reading connects the resultant damage with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把由此造成的损害和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the resultant damage｜由此造成的损害 ; the resultant increase｜由此产生的增长 ; resultant force｜合力
tip_zh: 较正式，常置于名词前；日常更常用resulting。

meanings_zh: adj. 结构的；构造的
definition_en: Relating to how something is built or its parts are arranged.
example1_en: I copied structural damage into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把结构性损坏抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss structural damage.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论结构性损坏的材料。
collocations: structural damage｜结构性损坏 ; structural change｜结构性变化 ; structural engineering｜结构工程 ; structural reform｜结构性改革
tip_zh: 既可指建筑结构，也可指经济、制度等的结构。

meanings_zh: v. 隔离；实行种族隔离 | v. 分开；分类存放
definition_en: To keep people apart based on race or other characteristics. | To separate things into different groups or locations.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer segregate by race during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时按种族隔离。
example2_en: The reading asks you to segregate by race and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你按种族隔离，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: segregate by race｜按种族隔离 ; segregate waste｜将废物分类 ; racially segregated schools｜实行种族隔离的学校
tip_zh: segregate A from B指把A与B隔离。

meanings_zh: n. 一时的狂热；风靡
definition_en: an activity or fashion that becomes extremely popular briefly
example1_en: The textbook introduces the latest craze in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最新热潮。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the latest craze.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论最新热潮的材料。
collocations: the latest craze｜最新热潮 ; a craze for something｜对某事物的狂热 ; a fitness craze｜健身热潮
tip_zh: 强调短期风靡；常用a craze for加名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 严峻的；令人担忧的 | adj. 严肃冷峻的 | adj. 阴冷难受的；糟糕的
definition_en: very serious and giving little reason for hope | looking very serious, worried, or determined | unpleasant, depressing, or uncomfortable
example1_en: I copied a grim outlook into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把严峻的前景抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to a grim outlook when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了严峻的前景。
collocations: a grim outlook｜严峻的前景 ; a grim reality｜残酷的现实 ; a grim expression｜冷峻的表情 ; a grim reminder｜令人警醒的提醒
tip_zh: 常形容前景、现实或表情，强调沉重而非普通的不悦。

meanings_zh: n. 先驱；前身 | n. 前兆
definition_en: Someone or something that comes before and influences a later development. | Something that signals the arrival of a later event.
example1_en: Office hours began with an early forerunner.
example1_zh: 答疑从早期先驱开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an early forerunner.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论早期先驱的材料。
collocations: a forerunner of｜……的前身 ; a forerunner to｜……的先驱 ; an early forerunner｜早期先驱
tip_zh: 常用a forerunner of；不指比赛中领先的人。

meanings_zh: n. 一千年 | n. 千禧年；千年之交
definition_en: A period of one thousand years. | The point when one thousand-year period ends and another begins.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about the past millennium.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于过去的一千年的简答题。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the past millennium.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕过去的一千年展开说明。
collocations: the past millennium｜过去的一千年 ; the turn of the millennium｜千年之交 ; millennium celebrations｜千禧年庆祝活动
tip_zh: 注意双写l和n；复数常用millennia。

meanings_zh: adj. 陈旧过时的
definition_en: too old or outdated to be suitable for modern use
example1_en: I copied antiquated equipment into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把陈旧的设备抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used antiquated equipment to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用陈旧的设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: antiquated equipment｜陈旧的设备 ; antiquated system｜过时的系统 ; antiquated laws｜过时的法律
tip_zh: 含贬义，强调旧到不合时宜；antique可指珍贵古物。

meanings_zh: n. 军团；兵种部队 | n. 专业工作团体
definition_en: a large military unit or branch with particular duties | an organized group of people doing the same specialized work
example1_en: I copied medical corps into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把军队医疗部队抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medical corps.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论军队医疗部队的材料。
collocations: medical corps｜军队医疗部队 ; diplomatic corps｜外交使团 ; press corps｜记者团
tip_zh: 单复数拼写相同；单数不读ps，复数词尾读/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 啤酒厂
definition_en: A place where beer is produced commercially.
example1_en: Office hours began with local brewery.
example1_zh: 答疑从当地啤酒厂开始。
example2_en: The author returns to local brewery when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了当地啤酒厂。
collocations: local brewery｜当地啤酒厂 ; craft brewery｜精酿啤酒厂 ; brewery tour｜啤酒厂参观
tip_zh: 通常指啤酒厂；葡萄酒庄是winery。

meanings_zh: v. 发起；启动 | v. 使入门；接纳入会
definition_en: To cause a process or activity to begin. | To introduce someone to an activity or admit them to a group.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to initiate negotiations.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求发起谈判。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers initiate negotiations before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要发起谈判。
collocations: initiate negotiations｜发起谈判 ; initiate a project｜启动项目 ; initiate someone into｜使某人入门
tip_zh: 作动词较正式；initiate sb into指使入门。

meanings_zh: n. 学位论文；专题论文
definition_en: A long research paper written as part of a university degree
example1_en: The textbook introduces a doctoral dissertation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了博士论文。
example2_en: The reading connects a doctoral dissertation with a larger point about academic research.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把博士论文和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: write a dissertation｜撰写学位论文 ; submit a dissertation｜提交学位论文 ; a doctoral dissertation｜博士论文 ; a dissertation on education｜关于教育的学位论文
tip_zh: 主题用on引出；美式常指博士论文，英式范围较广。

meanings_zh: v. 哀悼；为失去而悲痛
definition_en: To feel or express deep sadness after a death or loss.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to mourn someone's death.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须哀悼某人的去世。
example2_en: The passage says students who can mourn someone's death follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够哀悼某人的去世的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: mourn someone's death｜哀悼某人的去世 ; mourn the loss of｜为失去……而悲痛 ; mourn for someone｜悼念某人
tip_zh: 可直接接逝者或损失，也可用mourn for sb。

meanings_zh: n. 局；处；办事机构 | n. 翻盖书桌；五斗柜
definition_en: an office or organisation providing information or managing particular activities | a desk with a folding cover, or an American chest of drawers
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about tourist bureau.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于旅游咨询处的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to tourist bureau when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了旅游咨询处。
collocations: tourist bureau｜旅游咨询处 ; statistics bureau｜统计局 ; news bureau｜新闻分社
tip_zh: 复数可用bureaux或bureaus；家具义有英美差异。

meanings_zh: n. 退款；退税；返还款
definition_en: Money returned after you pay for something or pay tax
example1_en: The textbook introduces a tax rebate in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了退税。
example2_en: The reading connects a tax rebate with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把退税和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a tax rebate｜退税 ; claim a rebate｜申请退款 ; receive a rebate｜收到返款 ; offer a rebate｜提供返款优惠
tip_zh: rebate通常是付款后返还，discount通常是付款时减价。

meanings_zh: n. 阀；阀门 | n. 瓣膜
definition_en: a device controlling the flow of liquid or gas | a body structure keeping fluid moving in one direction
example1_en: I copied a safety valve into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把安全阀抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects a safety valve with a larger point about technological change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把安全阀和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: open a valve｜打开阀门 ; a safety valve｜安全阀 ; a heart valve｜心脏瓣膜 ; a pressure relief valve｜泄压阀
tip_zh: 工程中指阀门，人体中可指心脏等部位的瓣膜。

meanings_zh: v. 飘动；振翅；颤动 | n. 颤动；心悸
definition_en: Move with quick, light movements, especially through air | A quick, light movement or brief uneven heartbeat
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to flutter in the breeze.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须在微风中飘动。
example2_en: The passage says students who can flutter in the breeze follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够在微风中飘动的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: flutter in the breeze｜在微风中飘动 ; flutter its wings｜振动翅膀 ; a flutter of excitement｜一阵激动
tip_zh: 强调轻而快的反复运动，可用于翅膀、布料或心跳。

meanings_zh: n. 等级制度；层级结构 | n. 统治集团；领导层
definition_en: A system arranging people or things by rank or importance | The people holding the highest positions in an organisation
example1_en: Our professor circled a rigid hierarchy on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了严格的等级制度。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a rigid hierarchy.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕严格的等级制度展开说明。
collocations: a rigid hierarchy｜严格的等级制度 ; organisational hierarchy｜组织层级结构 ; a hierarchy of needs｜需求层次 ; the top of the hierarchy｜等级体系的顶层
tip_zh: 既可指等级结构，也可指组织的最高领导层。

meanings_zh: adj. 放射状的；径向的
definition_en: Arranged along lines spreading out from a central point.
example1_en: The textbook introduces radial pattern in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了放射状图案。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of radial pattern.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得放射状图案这个例子。
collocations: radial pattern｜放射状图案 ; radial symmetry｜辐射对称 ; radial road network｜放射状道路网
tip_zh: 强调从中心向外延伸，不泛指与光线有关。

meanings_zh: v. 放大声音或信号 | v. 增强；扩大影响 | v. 详述；补充说明
definition_en: to make a sound or electrical signal stronger | to increase the strength or effect of something | to explain something further by adding details
example1_en: The lab instructions say to amplify sound.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求放大声音。
example2_en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to amplify sound.
example2_zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们放大声音。
collocations: amplify sound｜放大声音 ; amplify a signal｜放大信号 ; amplify the effect｜增强效果
tip_zh: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。

meanings_zh: n. 积压的工作；待处理订单
definition_en: work or orders waiting to be dealt with
example1_en: Our professor circled a growing backlog on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不断增加的积压。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a growing backlog.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕不断增加的积压展开说明。
collocations: clear a backlog｜清理积压 ; a backlog of orders｜积压的订单 ; reduce the backlog｜减少积压 ; a growing backlog｜不断增加的积压
tip_zh: 常用a backlog of，指本应处理却积压的事项。

meanings_zh: n. 起义；暴动
definition_en: An organised attempt by a population to resist those in power.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a popular uprising in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了民众起义。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a popular uprising.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕民众起义展开说明。
collocations: a popular uprising｜民众起义 ; an armed uprising｜武装起义 ; suppress an uprising｜镇压起义
tip_zh: 通常指反抗统治者的起义，不用于日常的起床或上升。

meanings_zh: n. 精密；复杂程度 | n. 老练；世故；高雅
definition_en: the quality of being advanced or carefully developed | knowledge of social situations, culture, and fashionable tastes
example1_en: Office hours began with technological sophistication.
example1_zh: 答疑从技术先进程度开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of technological sophistication.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得技术先进程度这个例子。
collocations: technological sophistication｜技术先进程度 ; a high degree of sophistication｜高度精密 ; social sophistication｜社交上的老练
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既指技术精密，也指处世老练。

meanings_zh: v. 为……报仇；雪耻
definition_en: to punish someone for harm done to yourself or others
example1_en: The professor asked us to avenge a defeat.
example1_zh: 教授让我们一雪败北之耻。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to avenge a defeat.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得一雪败北之耻。
collocations: avenge a defeat｜一雪败北之耻 ; avenge a wrong｜报复不公待遇
tip_zh: avenge是动词，常接所受伤害；revenge常作名词。

meanings_zh: v. 授予；赐予
definition_en: To formally give someone an honour, gift, or benefit.
example1_en: The assignment is to bestow an honour on, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先授予……荣誉，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to bestow an honour on.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得授予……荣誉。
collocations: bestow an honour on｜授予……荣誉 ; bestow a gift on｜向……赠礼 ; bestow a title upon｜授予……称号
tip_zh: 正式用语：bestow sth on/upon sb。

meanings_zh: v. 强烈谴责；痛惜
definition_en: To strongly disapprove of something or deeply regret it
example1_en: I heard the lecturer deplore violence during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时强烈谴责暴力。
example2_en: The reading asks you to deplore violence and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你强烈谴责暴力，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: deplore violence｜强烈谴责暴力 ; deplore the lack of｜对缺乏……深感遗憾 ; deplore the decision｜强烈反对该决定
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，后直接接所谴责或痛惜的事。

meanings_zh: n. 固定伤肢的夹板 | v. 用夹板固定
definition_en: A rigid support that keeps an injured body part still. | To support an injured body part with a splint.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a wrist splint in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了腕部夹板。
example2_en: The author returns to a wrist splint when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了腕部夹板。
collocations: wear a splint｜戴夹板 ; apply a splint｜上夹板 ; a wrist splint｜腕部夹板
tip_zh: 指固定伤处的夹板；不同于石膏固定用的cast。

meanings_zh: n. 步兵；步兵部队
definition_en: soldiers trained to fight on foot
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on infantry unit.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论步兵分队。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss infantry unit.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论步兵分队的材料。
collocations: infantry unit｜步兵分队 ; infantry division｜步兵师 ; infantry training｜步兵训练
tip_zh: 集合名词，指步兵整体，不用an infantry指一个人。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄球菌
definition_en: A round bacterium forming clusters, sometimes causing infections.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on strains of staphylococcus.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论葡萄球菌菌株。
example2_en: The reading connects strains of staphylococcus with a larger point about public health.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把葡萄球菌菌株和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: staphylococcus infection｜葡萄球菌感染 ; strains of staphylococcus｜葡萄球菌菌株 ; antibiotic-resistant staphylococcus｜耐抗生素葡萄球菌
tip_zh: 复数为staphylococci；常见简称为staph。

meanings_zh: v. 委派；授权
definition_en: to appoint someone to act or perform a task for you
example1_en: The assignment is to depute a representative, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先委派代表，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to depute a representative.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得委派代表。
collocations: depute someone to do something｜委派某人做某事 ; depute a representative｜委派代表
tip_zh: 正式用词，常用depute sb to do sth。

meanings_zh: v. 环绕；笼罩
definition_en: to surround or cover something, especially with smoke or mist
example1_en: After the lecture, we used wreathe in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了环绕。
example2_en: Students who can explain wreathe usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 能解释环绕的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。
collocations: be wreathed in smoke｜被烟雾笼罩 ; mist wreathes the hills｜薄雾环绕山丘 ; a face wreathed in smiles｜满面笑容
tip_zh: 偏文学用语；wreathe尾音/ð/，wreath尾音/θ/。

meanings_zh: n. 旋涡；涡流 | n. 困境的旋涡
definition_en: A spinning mass of fluid drawing things towards its centre | A situation that pulls people into increasing confusion or difficulty
example1_en: Office hours began with a swirling vortex.
example1_zh: 答疑从盘旋的涡流开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a swirling vortex.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论盘旋的涡流的材料。
collocations: a swirling vortex｜盘旋的涡流 ; a vortex of debt｜债务旋涡 ; be sucked into a vortex｜被卷入旋涡
tip_zh: 复数可用vortices或vortexes；也可比喻困境。

meanings_zh: v. 使不可能；阻止；排除
definition_en: to prevent something or make it impossible
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to preclude the possibility.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须排除可能性。
example2_en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to preclude the possibility.
example2_zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们排除可能性。
collocations: preclude the possibility｜排除可能性 ; preclude someone from doing something｜使某人无法做某事 ; preclude further discussion｜使进一步讨论无法进行
tip_zh: 正式用词；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

meanings_zh: v. 使烦恼；使恼怒
definition_en: To make someone annoyed, worried, or frustrated.
example1_en: The assignment is to vex policymakers, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先困扰政策制定者，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers vex policymakers before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要困扰政策制定者。
collocations: vex policymakers｜困扰政策制定者 ; a vexed question｜争议难题 ; be vexed by delays｜因延误而烦恼
tip_zh: 较正式的及物动词，日常多用annoy。

meanings_zh: n. 微妙细节；细微差别 | n. 礼节；礼仪细节
definition_en: A small detail or distinction requiring careful understanding | A small convention of polite social behaviour
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize nicety in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出微妙细节。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses nicety when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了微妙细节。
collocations: the niceties of｜…的微妙细节 ; social niceties｜社交礼节 ; legal niceties｜法律上的细微区别 ; to a nicety｜恰到好处地
tip_zh: 多用复数 niceties，勿直接理解为“美好”。

meanings_zh: v. 歪曲；败坏
definition_en: to distort something good or proper for harmful purposes
example1_en: The assignment is to pervert the course of justice, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先妨碍司法公正，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: The reading asks you to pervert the course of justice and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你妨碍司法公正，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: pervert the course of justice｜妨碍司法公正 ; pervert the truth｜歪曲事实
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前且常含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 小量偷窃；小额失窃
definition_en: The theft of small amounts or items, especially from workplaces.
example1_en: Our professor circled prevent pilferage on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了防止小额偷窃。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prevent pilferage.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕防止小额偷窃展开说明。
collocations: prevent pilferage｜防止小额偷窃 ; losses from pilferage｜小额失窃造成的损失 ; employee pilferage｜员工小额偷窃
tip_zh: pilferage是不可数名词，不是动词；动词为pilfer。

meanings_zh: adj. 有阳刚之气的；强健的
definition_en: showing strength and energy traditionally associated with men
example1_en: Our professor circled virile image on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了阳刚形象。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around virile image.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕阳刚形象展开说明。
collocations: virile image｜阳刚形象 ; virile young man｜强健的年轻男子 ; virile masculinity｜阳刚气概
tip_zh: 不只是“男性的”；强调传统观念中的男性力量与活力。

meanings_zh: n. 专题论著；专论
definition_en: a long, detailed piece of writing about a particular subject
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a philosophical treatise.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论哲学论著。
example2_en: The author returns to a philosophical treatise when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了哲学论著。
collocations: a treatise on｜关于……的专论 ; write a treatise｜撰写专论 ; a philosophical treatise｜哲学论著
tip_zh: 常用a treatise on，指系统详尽的专论而非短文。

meanings_zh: v. 推测；猜想 | n. 推测；猜想
definition_en: Form an opinion using limited evidence | An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to surmise that.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须推测……。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to surmise that.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得推测……。
collocations: surmise that｜推测…… ; surmise from｜根据……推测 ; pure surmise｜纯属猜测
tip_zh: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 可终止的
definition_en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions
example1_en: Our professor circled terminable contract on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可终止的合同。
example2_en: The reading connects terminable contract with a larger point about economic policy.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可终止的合同和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: terminable contract｜可终止的合同 ; terminable on notice｜通知后可终止的 ; terminable by either party｜任何一方均可终止的
tip_zh: 正式法律用语，常形容合同；不等于terminal。

meanings_zh: v. 预言；预告
definition_en: say what will happen, especially through claimed spiritual knowledge
example1_en: The lab instructions say to prophesy that.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求预言……。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to prophesy that.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来预言……。
collocations: prophesy that｜预言…… ; prophesy disaster｜预言灾难 ; prophesy the future｜预言未来
tip_zh: prophesy是动词，词尾读/saɪ/；名词为prophecy。

meanings_zh: n. 暗示；间接透露
definition_en: An indirect suggestion or indication of something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the first intimation in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最初的暗示。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the first intimation.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕最初的暗示展开说明。
collocations: an intimation of trouble｜麻烦的征兆 ; the first intimation｜最初的暗示 ; give an intimation｜作出暗示
tip_zh: 别与intimacy（亲密）混淆；常接of或that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 炫耀；摆阔
definition_en: An excessive display of wealth or importance to impress others.
example1_en: Office hours began with an air of ostentation.
example1_zh: 答疑从炫耀的气派开始。
example2_en: The reading connects an air of ostentation with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把炫耀的气派和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: without ostentation｜毫不铺张炫耀 ; an air of ostentation｜炫耀的气派 ; wealth and ostentation｜财富与摆阔
tip_zh: 不可数名词，通常含贬义，强调故意展示以引人注目。

meanings_zh: n. 子宫颈
definition_en: The narrow lower part of the uterus opening into the vagina.
example1_en: The professor explained cervix with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了子宫颈。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up cervix while discussing evidence about public health.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了子宫颈。
collocations: the cervix of the uterus｜子宫颈 ; cells of the cervix｜子宫颈细胞 ; cancer of the cervix｜子宫颈癌
tip_zh: 通常指子宫颈；cervical 也可表示颈部的。

meanings_zh: n. 暗杀者
definition_en: Someone who murders an important person, often for political reasons.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a would-be assassinator.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于企图行刺者的简答题。
example2_en: A campus survey used a would-be assassinator to explain a pattern in historical change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用企图行刺者来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: a would-be assassinator｜企图行刺者 ; the assassinator's motives｜暗杀者的动机
tip_zh: 此词罕见；通常用assassin表示暗杀者。

meanings_zh: n. 蒲式耳（干量单位）
definition_en: A unit of dry volume used especially for grain.
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about a bushel of wheat.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于一蒲式耳小麦的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bushel of wheat.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一蒲式耳小麦的材料。
collocations: a bushel of wheat｜一蒲式耳小麦 ; per bushel｜每蒲式耳 ; a bushel basket｜蒲式耳量篮
tip_zh: 是干量单位；英美容量不同，不能直接等同固定重量。

meanings_zh: adj. 俯卧的；伏地的 | adj. 精疲力竭的；悲痛难支的 | v. 使俯伏；使衰弱
definition_en: lying flat with your face towards the ground | overwhelmed by exhaustion, illness, or strong emotion | to make someone lie face down or become extremely weak
example1_en: I copied prostrate with exhaustion into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把疲惫得无法动弹抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to prostrate with exhaustion when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了疲惫得无法动弹。
collocations: lie prostrate｜俯卧 ; prostrate with exhaustion｜疲惫得无法动弹 ; prostrate oneself｜俯伏在地
tip_zh: 勿与prostate（前列腺）混淆；注意多一个r。

meanings_zh: adj. 特有的；典型的
definition_en: Showing the distinctive qualities of a person or thing.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on characteristical features.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论典型特征。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around characteristical features.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕典型特征展开说明。
collocations: characteristical features｜典型特征 ; characteristical qualities｜特有品质
tip_zh: 罕见旧式形式；现代写作应优先用characteristic。

meanings_zh: n. 赤贫；一贫如洗
definition_en: extreme poverty, with too little money for basic needs
example1_en: Office hours began with die in penury.
example1_zh: 答疑从在贫困中去世开始。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss die in penury.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论在贫困中去世的材料。
collocations: live in penury｜生活在赤贫中 ; die in penury｜在贫困中去世 ; reduce someone to penury｜使某人陷入赤贫
tip_zh: 正式或文学用词，程度重于poverty，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 迅速增长；蓬勃发展
definition_en: To grow or develop rapidly.
example1_en: The professor explained burgeon with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了迅速增长。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up burgeon while discussing evidence about economic policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了迅速增长。
collocations: burgeoning demand｜迅速增长的需求 ; a burgeoning industry｜蓬勃发展的行业 ; a burgeoning population｜迅速增长的人口
tip_zh: 现代常作不及物动词；burgeoning常用于名词前。

meanings_zh: adj. 反动的；极端保守的 | n. 反动派；极端保守者
definition_en: opposing social progress and wanting older political arrangements restored | someone who opposes progress and favours restoring older political arrangements
example1_en: Our professor circled reactionary policies on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了反动政策。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around reactionary policies.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕反动政策展开说明。
collocations: reactionary policies｜反动政策 ; reactionary views｜极端保守的观点 ; reactionary forces｜反动势力
tip_zh: 常含贬义，强调恢复旧制度；不等于reactive。

meanings_zh: v. 使极为恼怒；使发狂
definition_en: to make someone extremely angry or frustrated
example1_en: The assignment is to madden someone, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先使某人极为恼怒，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to madden someone.
example2_zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们使某人极为恼怒。
collocations: madden someone｜使某人极为恼怒 ; be maddened by delays｜因延误而抓狂
tip_zh: 通常是及物动词，表示使某人恼怒到抓狂。

meanings_zh: n. 词典编纂者
definition_en: someone who writes or edits dictionaries
example1_en: Our professor circled a bilingual lexicographer on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了双语词典编纂者。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a bilingual lexicographer.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得双语词典编纂者这个例子。
collocations: work as a lexicographer｜担任词典编纂者 ; a team of lexicographers｜词典编纂团队 ; a bilingual lexicographer｜双语词典编纂者
tip_zh: 指编写或修订词典的人，不泛指语言学家。

meanings_zh: adj. 傲慢无礼的
definition_en: Rude and disrespectful, especially towards someone in authority.
example1_en: I copied insolent behaviour into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把傲慢无礼的行为抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects insolent behaviour with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把傲慢无礼的行为和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: insolent behaviour｜傲慢无礼的行为 ; insolent tone｜无礼的语气 ; insolent reply｜傲慢的答复
tip_zh: 现代常用作形容词；对应名词是insolence。

meanings_zh: v. 裁决；裁定 | v. 担任评判；评定
definition_en: To make an official decision about a dispute | To judge performances or entries in a competition
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to adjudicate a dispute.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何裁决纠纷。
example2_en: The passage says students who can adjudicate a dispute follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够裁决纠纷的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: adjudicate a dispute｜裁决纠纷 ; adjudicate on a claim｜就索赔作出裁决 ; adjudicate a competition｜担任比赛评委
tip_zh: 可直接接争议，也可用adjudicate on；不专指宣判刑罚。

meanings_zh: v. 嘲笑；讥讽 | n. 嘲笑声；讥讽的话
definition_en: To shout or laugh at someone in an unkind way. | An unkind shout or remark intended to ridicule someone.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to jeer at someone.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须嘲笑某人。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to jeer at someone.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得嘲笑某人。
collocations: jeer at someone｜嘲笑某人 ; jeers from the crowd｜人群中的嘲笑声 ; a chorus of jeers｜一片嘲笑声
tip_zh: 动词常用 jeer at someone；名词常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 不情愿的；不愿意的
definition_en: Unwilling or reluctant to do something.
example1_en: The textbook introduces loth to admit in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了不愿承认。
example2_en: The reading connects loth to admit with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把不愿承认和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: loth to admit｜不愿承认 ; loth to leave｜不愿离开 ; loth to accept｜不愿接受
tip_zh: loath的较少见变体；常用be loth to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害的；有毒的
definition_en: harmful or poisonous to people or other living things
example1_en: I copied noxious fumes into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把有毒烟气抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to noxious fumes when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有毒烟气。
collocations: noxious fumes｜有毒烟气 ; noxious gases｜有毒气体 ; noxious substances｜有害物质
tip_zh: 常形容气体或物质；不只是气味难闻。

meanings_zh: n. 传真；传真机 | v. 发传真
definition_en: A system or machine sending document copies over telephone lines. | To send a document using a fax machine.
example1_en: The textbook introduces telefax machine in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了传真机。
example2_en: The author returns to telefax machine when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了传真机。
collocations: send by telefax｜通过传真发送 ; telefax machine｜传真机 ; telefax number｜传真号码
tip_zh: 较旧的说法；现代英语通常直接用fax。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽宏大量的
definition_en: generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival or weaker person
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on magnanimous in victory.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论胜而有雅量。
example2_en: A campus survey used magnanimous in victory to explain a pattern in human behavior.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用胜而有雅量来解释人类行为中的一种模式。
collocations: magnanimous in victory｜胜而有雅量 ; a magnanimous gesture｜宽宏大量的举动 ; a magnanimous response｜宽容的回应
tip_zh: 较正式，常形容对对手或冒犯者宽容大度。

meanings_zh: v. 违反；越过界限
definition_en: to break a law, rule, or moral boundary
example1_en: The lab instructions say to transgress the law.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求违法。
example2_en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers transgress the law before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要违法。
collocations: transgress the law｜违法 ; transgress moral boundaries｜逾越道德界限 ; transgress social norms｜违反社会规范
tip_zh: 正式用词，可直接接law、rules等宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 分枝；分叉；形成分支
definition_en: To divide or spread into branches or connected parts.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to ramify into branches.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求分成枝杈。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers ramify into branches before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要分成枝杈。
collocations: roots ramify｜根部分叉 ; ramify into branches｜分成枝杈
tip_zh: 正式且少见，常指根系、血管或网络分叉延伸。

meanings_zh: n. 办公位预约共享制
definition_en: a system where employees reserve shared workspaces instead of permanent desks
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about office hotelling.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于办公位预约共享制的简答题。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss office hotelling.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论办公位预约共享制的材料。
collocations: office hotelling｜办公位预约共享制 ; hotelling system｜工位预约共享系统 ; desk hotelling｜工位预约共享
tip_zh: 通常指预约共享工位；旅馆业用hotel industry。

meanings_zh: adv. 迄今；此前一直
definition_en: Until now or until the time being discussed.
example1_en: In the methods section, students learn to hitherto unknown.
example1_zh: 在方法部分，学生学习此前未知的。
example2_en: Students who hitherto unknown are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够此前未知的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: hitherto unknown｜此前未知的 ; hitherto unseen｜此前未见的 ; hitherto neglected｜此前被忽视的
tip_zh: 正式用语，常见于hitherto unknown等搭配。

meanings_zh: adj. 前述的；上述的
definition_en: Mentioned or presented earlier in a piece of writing.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the foregoing discussion in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了上述讨论。
example2_en: A campus survey used the foregoing discussion to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用上述讨论来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: the foregoing discussion｜上述讨论 ; the foregoing analysis｜上述分析 ; the foregoing remarks｜前述评论
tip_zh: 正式书面语，常用the foregoing修饰名词。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；拨付
definition_en: to pay out money, especially from an official fund
example1_en: The professor asked us to disburse funds.
example1_zh: 教授让我们拨付资金。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers disburse funds before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要拨付资金。
collocations: disburse funds｜拨付资金 ; disburse money｜支付款项 ; disburse a loan｜发放贷款
tip_zh: 正式用词，常以funds或money作宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 公愤；骚动；轰动
definition_en: A strong public reaction of anger or excitement.
example1_en: After the lecture, we used furor in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了公愤。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses furor when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了公愤。
collocations: cause a furor｜引起轩然大波 ; spark a furor｜激起公愤 ; a furor over something｜因某事引发的风波
tip_zh: 美式常用furor，英式常用furore；多指公众强烈反应。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；负担费用
definition_en: to pay all or part of a cost
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to defray costs.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何支付成本。
example2_en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers defray costs before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要支付成本。
collocations: defray costs｜支付成本 ; defray expenses｜负担费用
tip_zh: 正式用词，宾语通常是costs或expenses，不是人。

meanings_zh: v. 引逗；使可望不可即
definition_en: To excite desire for something that remains out of reach.
example1_en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to tantalize someone with.
example1_zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须用某物引逗某人。
example2_en: The reading asks you to tantalize someone with and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你用某物引逗某人，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: tantalize someone with｜用某物引逗某人 ; tantalizing glimpse｜勾起渴望的短暂一瞥 ; tantalizing prospect｜诱人却未实现的前景
tip_zh: 英式也写tantalise；强调勾起欲望却暂时得不到。

meanings_zh: v. 以某货币计价 | v. 命名；称作
definition_en: express a financial amount in a particular currency | give a particular name to something
example1_en: The quiz expected us to recognize denominate in a lecture clip.
example1_zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出以某货币计价。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up denominate while discussing evidence about economic policy.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了以某货币计价。
collocations: denominated in dollars｜以美元计价 ; foreign-currency-denominated debt｜外币计价债务
tip_zh: 金融中常用be denominated in＋货币；命名义较罕见。

meanings_zh: adj. 可锻的；易成形的 | adj. 易受影响的；可塑的
definition_en: Able to be hammered or pressed into a different shape. | Easily influenced or changed by other people or circumstances.
example1_en: Our professor circled highly malleable on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可塑性很强的。
example2_en: The reading connects highly malleable with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把可塑性很强的和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: malleable metal｜可锻金属 ; highly malleable｜可塑性很强的 ; malleable minds｜易受影响的心智
tip_zh: 金属义强调锻压成形；ductile强调可拉成丝。

meanings_zh: n. 适销性；可销售性
definition_en: The degree to which something can be sold easily.
example1_en: Office hours began with improve salability.
example1_zh: 答疑从提高适销性开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around improve salability.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕提高适销性展开说明。
collocations: improve salability｜提高适销性 ; product salability｜产品适销性 ; affect salability｜影响适销性
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写作saleability。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻报道；报道写作
definition_en: News reporting, especially detailed accounts based on direct observation
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about investigative reportage.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于调查报道的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to investigative reportage when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了调查报道。
collocations: investigative reportage｜调查报道 ; literary reportage｜报告文学 ; first-hand reportage｜第一手报道
tip_zh: 通常不可数，比reporting正式，常强调现场记录。

meanings_zh: adj. 陈腐的；老套的
definition_en: Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original
example1_en: I copied sound trite into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把听起来很老套抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects sound trite with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把听起来很老套和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: trite remark｜老套的话 ; trite phrase｜陈腐的措辞 ; sound trite｜听起来很老套
tip_zh: 强调因反复使用而失去新意，不只是年代久远。

meanings_zh: n. 本地话；日常用语 | adj. 本地语言的；本土风格的
definition_en: The everyday language spoken by people in a particular place. | Using local everyday language or traditional local building styles.
example1_en: The textbook introduces the local vernacular in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了当地日常用语。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the local vernacular.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得当地日常用语这个例子。
collocations: the local vernacular｜当地日常用语 ; in the vernacular｜用本地话 ; vernacular architecture｜乡土建筑
tip_zh: 强调当地日常语言，不等同于“本国的”。

meanings_zh: v. 使兴奋；使振奋
definition_en: To make someone feel excited, energetic, and very happy
example1_en: I wrote exhilarate on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把exhilarate和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain exhilarate usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
example2_zh: 能解释使兴奋的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。
collocations: feel exhilarated｜感到兴奋 ; exhilarated by the experience｜因这次经历而振奋 ; an exhilarating experience｜令人兴奋的经历
tip_zh: 及物动词；人感到兴奋用exhilarated。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其微小的 | n. 无穷小量
definition_en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure | a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number
example1_en: The textbook introduces infinitesimal amount in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了极微小的量。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of infinitesimal amount.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得极微小的量这个例子。
collocations: infinitesimal amount｜极微小的量 ; infinitesimal difference｜极微小的差别 ; infinitesimal change｜极微小的变化
tip_zh: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

meanings_zh: adj. 成分的；成分分析的
definition_en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole
example1_en: Office hours began with componential analysis.
example1_zh: 答疑从成分分析开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of componential analysis.
example2_zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得成分分析这个例子。
collocations: componential analysis｜成分分析 ; componential approach｜成分分析方法
tip_zh: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

meanings_zh: adj. 上述的；前述的
definition_en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement
example1_en: The textbook introduces the aforesaid conditions in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了上述条件。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the aforesaid conditions.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论上述条件的材料。
collocations: the aforesaid conditions｜上述条件 ; the aforesaid agreement｜上述协议 ; the aforesaid property｜上述房产
tip_zh: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

meanings_zh: adj. 亵渎的；粗俗的 | v. 亵渎
definition_en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language. | To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.
example1_en: Office hours began with profane language.
example1_zh: 答疑从粗俗的语言开始。
example2_en: The reading connects profane language with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把粗俗的语言和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: profane language｜粗俗的语言 ; profane remarks｜亵渎性言论 ; profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip_zh: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

meanings_zh: n. 胫骨
definition_en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle
example1_en: I copied a fractured tibia into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把骨折的胫骨抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a fractured tibia.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论骨折的胫骨的材料。
collocations: a fractured tibia｜骨折的胫骨 ; the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨 ; tibial fracture｜胫骨骨折
tip_zh: 即shinbone；复数可用tibias或tibiae。

meanings_zh: adj. 激烈的；强烈的
definition_en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about vehement opposition.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于强烈反对的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of vehement opposition.
example2_zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得强烈反对这个例子。
collocations: vehement opposition｜强烈反对 ; vehement denial｜坚决否认 ; vehement criticism｜激烈批评
tip_zh: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋白石；欧泊
definition_en: A gemstone often showing changing colours when light strikes it
example1_en: I copied precious opal into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把贵蛋白石抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of precious opal.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得贵蛋白石这个例子。
collocations: opal ring｜欧泊戒指 ; opal mining｜欧泊开采 ; precious opal｜贵蛋白石
tip_zh: 珠宝语境常称“欧泊”；并非所有蛋白石都有变彩。

meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的
definition_en: having many different kinds or aspects
example1_en: The textbook introduces multifarious activities in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多种多样的活动。
example2_en: The author returns to multifarious activities when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了多种多样的活动。
collocations: multifarious activities｜多种多样的活动 ; multifarious needs｜多方面的需求 ; multifarious responsibilities｜繁杂多样的职责
tip_zh: 正式词，强调种类多；日常多用varied或diverse。

meanings_zh: n. 推进剂；喷射剂 | adj. 起推进作用的
definition_en: A substance that drives something forward or forces liquid out | Providing the force that moves something forward
example1_en: I copied rocket propellent into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把火箭推进剂抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used rocket propellent to explain a pattern in technological change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用火箭推进剂来解释技术变革中的一种模式。
collocations: rocket propellent｜火箭推进剂 ; liquid propellent｜液体推进剂 ; propellent gas｜推进气体
tip_zh: 是propellant的较少见拼写；写作优先用后者。

meanings_zh: adj. 不情愿的；不愿意的
definition_en: Unwilling to do something.
example1_en: I wrote loath on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把loath和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: Students who can explain loath usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
example2_zh: 能解释不情愿的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。
collocations: be loath to admit｜不愿承认 ; be loath to leave｜不愿离开 ; be loath to accept｜不愿接受
tip_zh: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

meanings_zh: n. 万能药；万全之策
definition_en: Something believed to solve every problem or cure every illness.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on no panacea.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论并非万能之策。
example2_en: The author returns to no panacea when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了并非万能之策。
collocations: a panacea for｜解决……的万能之策 ; no panacea｜并非万能之策 ; a universal panacea｜包治百病的灵丹妙药
tip_zh: 常用a panacea for；多用于否定万能解法。

meanings_zh: v. 流产 | v. 失败；未达目的
definition_en: Lose a pregnancy before the baby can survive outside the womb. | Fail to achieve the intended result.
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to miscarry early in pregnancy.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何孕早期流产。
example2_en: The reading asks you to miscarry early in pregnancy and then check a second source.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读要求你孕早期流产，然后再核对第二个来源。
collocations: miscarry early in pregnancy｜孕早期流产 ; a plan miscarries｜计划失败
tip_zh: 通常指流产；表示计划失败时较正式且少见。

meanings_zh: n. 保险承保人；承保机构 | n. 证券承销商
definition_en: A person or organisation that accepts insurance risks. | An institution guaranteeing to buy securities not purchased by investors.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on insurance underwriter.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论保险承保人。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss insurance underwriter.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论保险承保人的材料。
collocations: insurance underwriter｜保险承保人 ; lead underwriter｜主承销商 ; mortgage underwriter｜抵押贷款审核员
tip_zh: 保险领域指承保人，证券领域指承销商。

meanings_zh: v. 转运；转船
definition_en: Transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer transship cargo during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时转运货物。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to transship cargo.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来转运货物。
collocations: transship cargo｜转运货物 ; transship goods｜转运商品 ; transship containers｜转运集装箱
tip_zh: 过去式为transshipped，现在分词双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 桉树
definition_en: a tree mainly native to Australia, with strongly scented leaves
example1_en: The textbook introduces eucalyptus tree in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了桉树。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around eucalyptus tree.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕桉树展开说明。
collocations: eucalyptus tree｜桉树 ; eucalyptus oil｜桉树精油 ; eucalyptus leaves｜桉树叶
tip_zh: 指树种；eucalyptus oil指从桉树叶提取的精油。

meanings_zh: adj. 天真坦率的
definition_en: Honest and trusting, often through a lack of worldly experience.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an ingenuous smile.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论天真无邪的微笑。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an ingenuous smile.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得天真无邪的微笑这个例子。
collocations: an ingenuous smile｜天真无邪的微笑 ; an ingenuous question｜天真坦率的提问 ; ingenuous optimism｜天真的乐观态度
tip_zh: 勿与ingenious（巧妙的）混淆；本词强调天真坦率。

meanings_zh: n. 前事；先例 | n. 先行词 | adj. 先前的；先行的
definition_en: Something earlier that influenced or resembled a later thing. | A word or phrase that a later pronoun refers to. | Existing or happening before something else.
example1_en: I copied a pronoun's antecedent into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把代词的先行词抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a pronoun's antecedent.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得代词的先行词这个例子。
collocations: historical antecedents｜历史先例；历史根源 ; antecedent conditions｜先前条件 ; a pronoun's antecedent｜代词的先行词
tip_zh: 语法中指代词所指的先行词；不宜直接等同祖先。

meanings_zh: adj. 树栖的 | adj. 树木的
definition_en: living mainly in trees | relating to trees
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on arboreal species.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论树栖物种。
example2_en: Students compared two sources that both discuss arboreal species.
example2_zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论树栖物种的材料。
collocations: arboreal species｜树栖物种 ; arboreal habitat｜树上栖息地 ; arboreal mammals｜树栖哺乳动物
tip_zh: 常用于动物学，描述主要生活在树上的动物。

meanings_zh: v. 赔偿；保障免受损失
definition_en: To compensate for loss or provide financial protection against it.
example1_en: The assignment is to indemnify someone against loss, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先保障某人免受损失，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to indemnify someone against loss.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保障某人免受损失。
collocations: indemnify someone against loss｜保障某人免受损失 ; indemnify someone for damage｜赔偿某人的损害
tip_zh: 法律正式用语：for接已受损害，against接防范风险。

meanings_zh: n. 评分标准；评分细则 | n. 题目说明；指示 | n. 标题；类别
definition_en: A set of criteria used to assess work. | Instructions explaining how to complete a task or examination. | A heading or category under which something is grouped.
example1_en: I copied an assessment rubric into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把评估细则抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an assessment rubric.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕评估细则展开说明。
collocations: an assessment rubric｜评估细则 ; a scoring rubric｜评分标准 ; under the rubric of｜归入……类别
tip_zh: 教育中常指评分细则，也可指试题作答说明。

meanings_zh: n. 婚姻；结婚
definition_en: The state of being married, especially in formal or religious language.
example1_en: I copied joined in matrimony into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把结为夫妻抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The author returns to joined in matrimony when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了结为夫妻。
collocations: joined in matrimony｜结为夫妻 ; holy matrimony｜神圣婚姻 ; the bonds of matrimony｜婚姻的纽带
tip_zh: 正式或宗教用语；日常谈婚姻通常用marriage。

meanings_zh: adj. 一丝不苟的；严谨的 | adj. 正直的；恪守道德的
definition_en: extremely careful to do things correctly and thoroughly | careful to act honestly and avoid doing anything wrong
example1_en: Office hours began with scrupulous attention to detail.
example1_zh: 答疑从对细节的一丝不苟开始。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scrupulous attention to detail.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕对细节的一丝不苟展开说明。
collocations: scrupulous attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟 ; scrupulous care｜极其细致的照料 ; scrupulous honesty｜绝对诚实
tip_zh: 既可指做事严谨，也可指恪守道德。

meanings_zh: n. 大树枝；主枝
definition_en: a large branch of a tree
example1_en: The textbook introduces a low bough in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了低垂的大树枝。
example2_en: The reading connects a low bough with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把低垂的大树枝和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: a low bough｜低垂的大树枝 ; a spreading bough｜向外伸展的大树枝
tip_zh: 读音与cow押韵；通常指大枝，小枝用twig。

meanings_zh: n. 硫化物
definition_en: A compound containing sulphur combined with another element or group
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about iron sulphide.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于硫化铁的简答题。
example2_en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of iron sulphide.
example2_zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得硫化铁这个例子。
collocations: iron sulphide｜硫化铁 ; hydrogen sulphide｜硫化氢 ; sulphide minerals｜硫化物矿物
tip_zh: 美式及国际化学命名常写sulfide；勿混同硫酸盐。

meanings_zh: v. 探究；深入查明 | v. 测量水深 | n. 铅锤
definition_en: examine something closely to understand it fully | measure how deep water is | a weight on a string used to check vertical alignment
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to plumb the depths of.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何深入探究；达到低谷。
example2_en: The passage says students who can plumb the depths of follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够深入探究；达到低谷的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: plumb the depths of｜深入探究；达到低谷 ; plumb line｜铅垂线 ; plumb bob｜铅锤
tip_zh: 词尾 b 不发音；plumb the depths 常用于比喻。

meanings_zh: adj. 和平的；爱好和平的
definition_en: Peaceful in nature or intended to avoid conflict
example1_en: Office hours began with pacific approach.
example1_zh: 答疑从和平的处理方式开始。
example2_en: The author returns to pacific approach when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了和平的处理方式。
collocations: pacific approach｜和平的处理方式 ; pacific settlement｜和平解决 ; pacific intentions｜和平意图
tip_zh: 小写pacific是正式形容词；the Pacific指太平洋。

meanings_zh: v. 波动；呈波浪状起伏
definition_en: Move or rise and fall in a smooth, wave-like pattern.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer undulate gently during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时轻轻起伏。
example2_en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers undulate gently before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要轻轻起伏。
collocations: undulate gently｜轻轻起伏 ; undulating hills｜连绵起伏的丘陵 ; undulating terrain｜波状起伏的地形
tip_zh: 描述地形起伏时，常用形容词undulating。

meanings_zh: n. 名声；声誉 | v. 认为；据说
definition_en: the general opinion people have of someone or something | to consider someone or something to have a particular quality
example1_en: I wrote repute on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把repute和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: The sample listening brings up repute while discussing evidence about social change.
example2_zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了名声。
collocations: of international repute｜享有国际声誉的 ; of good repute｜声誉良好的 ; be reputed to be｜据说是
tip_zh: 动词多用被动式be reputed to be，意为“据说是”。

meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；流行的
definition_en: Following the styles that are currently fashionable.
example1_en: I copied modish clothes into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把时髦的服装抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of modish clothes.
example2_zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得时髦的服装这个例子。
collocations: modish clothes｜时髦的服装 ; modish design｜时尚设计 ; modish interiors｜时髦的室内装潢
tip_zh: 较书面，有时暗含“追逐潮流”的意味。

meanings_zh: adj. 暴虐的；专横的
definition_en: Using power cruelly and unfairly to control others.
example1_en: Our professor circled a tyrannical ruler on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了暴虐的统治者。
example2_en: A campus survey used a tyrannical ruler to explain a pattern in public institutions.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用暴虐的统治者来解释公共制度中的一种模式。
collocations: a tyrannical ruler｜暴虐的统治者 ; tyrannical rule｜暴政 ; a tyrannical boss｜专横的老板
tip_zh: 不仅指政治暴政，也可形容老板等人的专横行为。

meanings_zh: adj. 不肯通融的；不配合的
definition_en: Unwilling to help others or adjust to their needs.
example1_en: Office hours began with an unaccommodating attitude.
example1_zh: 答疑从不肯通融的态度开始。
example2_en: A campus survey used an unaccommodating attitude to explain a pattern in social change.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用不肯通融的态度来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。
collocations: an unaccommodating attitude｜不肯通融的态度 ; an unaccommodating employer｜不肯通融的雇主
tip_zh: 指不愿帮助或迁就他人，不表示没有住宿。

meanings_zh: adv. 在本文中；在此
definition_en: In this document, statement, or situation.
example1_en: The lab manual says to herein lies the problem before you record the number.
example1_zh: 实验手册要求先问题就在于此，再记下数字。
example2_en: Students who herein lies the problem are less likely to misread the lecture.
example2_zh: 能够问题就在于此的学生不太会误读这场讲座。
collocations: contained herein｜包含于本文中 ; described herein｜在本文中描述的 ; herein lies the problem｜问题就在于此
tip_zh: 正式或法律用语，常指“在本文件中”。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人厌恶的
definition_en: Causing strong dislike or a feeling of sickness.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on disgustful smell.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论令人作呕的气味。
example2_en: The author returns to disgustful smell when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了令人作呕的气味。
collocations: disgustful smell｜令人作呕的气味 ; disgustful sight｜令人厌恶的景象
tip_zh: 此词罕见且偏旧；现代英语通常用disgusting。

meanings_zh: v. 刺激；激将；唆使 | n. 赶牲畜的刺棒 | n. 刺激因素；驱动力
definition_en: to provoke someone into acting through persistent pressure or annoyance | a pointed stick used to make animals move | something that strongly pushes a person to act
example1_en: In office hours we practiced how to goad someone into doing something.
example1_zh: 答疑时我们练习如何激某人做某事。
example2_en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to goad someone into doing something.
example2_zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来激某人做某事。
collocations: goad someone into doing something｜激某人做某事 ; goad someone on｜不断刺激某人行动 ; a goad to action｜行动的驱动力
tip_zh: 常用goad sb into doing，通常含负面刺激。

meanings_zh: n. 西方；欧美国家
definition_en: the Western world, especially Europe and North America
example1_en: The textbook introduces the Occident in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了西方世界。
example2_en: The reading connects the Occident with a larger point about historical change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把西方世界和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: the Occident｜西方世界 ; the Orient and the Occident｜东方与西方
tip_zh: 旧式用语，通常写作the Occident；现代多用the West。

meanings_zh: adj. 依照的；依据的
definition_en: in accordance with a law, rule, or agreement
example1_en: Office hours began with pursuant to regulations.
example1_zh: 答疑从依照法规开始。
example2_en: The reading connects pursuant to regulations with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把依照法规和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: pursuant to an agreement｜根据协议 ; pursuant to regulations｜依照法规
tip_zh: 几乎总用于pursuant to，常见于法律等正式文本。

meanings_zh: v. 使膨胀；胀大
definition_en: To swell or become larger because of pressure from inside.
example1_en: I wrote distend on a note card with its meaning.
example1_zh: 我把distend和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。
example2_en: A reading on public health uses distend when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了胀大。
collocations: a distended abdomen｜胀大的腹部 ; a distended stomach｜胀大的胃 ; distended with gas｜因气体而膨胀
tip_zh: 多用于医学，强调内部压力导致胀大。

meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的；多方面的 | n. 歧管；多支管
definition_en: Numerous and varied | A pipe system distributing or collecting gas or liquid
example1_en: I copied exhaust manifold into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把排气歧管抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around exhaust manifold.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕排气歧管展开说明。
collocations: manifold benefits｜多方面的好处 ; manifold challenges｜多方面的挑战 ; exhaust manifold｜排气歧管
tip_zh: 形容词用法较正式，常修饰benefits、problems等复数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴趣广泛的；兼收并蓄的 | adj. 天主教的 | n. 天主教徒
definition_en: Including or appreciating a wide variety of things. | Relating to the Christian church led by the Pope. | A member of the Christian church led by the Pope.
example1_en: The textbook introduces a practising Catholic in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了践行信仰的天主教徒。
example2_en: The reading connects a practising Catholic with a larger point about social change.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把践行信仰的天主教徒和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: catholic tastes｜广泛的兴趣 ; Catholic Church｜天主教会 ; a practising Catholic｜践行信仰的天主教徒
tip_zh: 小写指广泛包容；指天主教或其信徒须大写Catholic。

meanings_zh: v. 误解；错误理解
definition_en: to understand something in the wrong way
example1_en: I heard the lecturer misconceive someone's intentions during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时误解某人的意图。
example2_en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to misconceive someone's intentions.
example2_zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得误解某人的意图。
collocations: misconceive someone's intentions｜误解某人的意图 ; misconceive the purpose｜误解目的
tip_zh: 较正式；日常表达“误解”更常用misunderstand。

meanings_zh: v. 杀死；杀害
definition_en: To kill someone or something, especially violently.
example1_en: The assignment is to slay a dragon, then say why it matters.
example1_zh: 作业是先杀死恶龙，再说明它为什么重要。
example2_en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers slay a dragon before they publish.
example2_zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要杀死恶龙。
collocations: slay a dragon｜杀死恶龙 ; slay a monster｜杀死怪物
tip_zh: 过去式slew，过去分词slain；常见于文学或新闻。

meanings_zh: n. 自由意志主义者 | adj. 自由意志主义的
definition_en: Someone favouring individual freedom and minimal government control | Favouring individual freedom and minimal government control
example1_en: I copied libertarian views into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把自由意志主义观点抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects libertarian views with a larger point about public institutions.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把自由意志主义观点和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: libertarian views｜自由意志主义观点 ; libertarian principles｜自由意志主义原则 ; a libertarian approach｜自由意志主义的做法
tip_zh: 强调个人自由和有限政府，不等同于liberal。

meanings_zh: adj. 感染的；脓毒性的
definition_en: infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to such infection
example1_en: The textbook introduces a septic wound in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了感染的伤口。
example2_en: The author returns to a septic wound when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了感染的伤口。
collocations: a septic wound｜感染的伤口 ; septic shock｜脓毒性休克 ; a septic tank｜化粪池
tip_zh: septic tank 指化粪池；septic 不作“腐烂物”名词。

meanings_zh: n. 补偿；报酬 | v. 补偿；酬谢
definition_en: Payment or a reward for work, loss, or inconvenience. | To pay or reward someone for work, loss, or inconvenience.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fair recompense.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公平的报酬。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fair recompense.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕公平的报酬展开说明。
collocations: fair recompense｜公平的报酬 ; recompense for｜对……的补偿 ; recompense someone for something｜因某事补偿某人
tip_zh: 较正式；动词用recompense sb for sth。

meanings_zh: n. 个人特有的习惯；特性
definition_en: an unusual habit or feature particular to someone or something
example1_en: The professor explained idiosyncrasy with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了特性。
example2_en: A reading on social change uses idiosyncrasy when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了特性。
collocations: personal idiosyncrasies｜个人特有的习惯 ; individual idiosyncrasies｜个体特性 ; linguistic idiosyncrasies｜语言上的独特之处
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为idiosyncrasies，常指独特习惯。

meanings_zh: adj. 热忱的；积极投入的
definition_en: Showing great enthusiasm and commitment to a cause or activity.
example1_en: The textbook introduces overly zealous in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过分热心的。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around overly zealous.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕过分热心的展开说明。
collocations: a zealous supporter｜热忱的支持者 ; zealous in their efforts｜努力而热忱 ; overly zealous｜过分热心的
tip_zh: 语气比enthusiastic强，有时暗示热心得过头。

meanings_zh: n. 纠正；修正 | n. 整流
definition_en: The process of correcting an error or putting something right | The process of converting alternating electric current into direct current
example1_en: The quiz had a short question about half-wave rectification.
example1_zh: 小测里有一道关于半波整流的简答题。
example2_en: The author returns to half-wave rectification when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了半波整流。
collocations: rectification of errors｜错误的纠正 ; rectification work｜整改工作 ; half-wave rectification｜半波整流
tip_zh: 正式名词；日常说“纠正”常用correction。

meanings_zh: adv. 随同；与此一起 | adv. 随即；于是
definition_en: with that thing or together with it | immediately after that
example1_en: The professor explained therewith with a short example from campus.
example1_zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了随同。
example2_en: Students who can explain therewith usually follow the rest of a lecture on public institutions.
example2_zh: 能解释随同的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共制度的讲座。
collocations: documents submitted therewith｜随同提交的文件 ; costs associated therewith｜与此相关的费用
tip_zh: 古旧或法律用语；日常用with it或along with it。

meanings_zh: n. 牛轭 | n. 束缚；压迫 | v. 给…套轭；使强行结合
definition_en: A wooden frame joining two animals to pull a load. | A condition of being controlled or oppressed. | Join animals with a frame, or force things together.
example1_en: Our professor circled a wooden yoke on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了木轭。
example2_en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a wooden yoke.
example2_zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得木轭这个例子。
collocations: a wooden yoke｜木轭 ; the yoke of oppression｜压迫的枷锁 ; yoke together｜套轭连在一起
tip_zh: 与 yolk（蛋黄）同音；比喻义常指压迫的枷锁。

meanings_zh: v. 坚决否认；拒绝接受 | v. 拒绝履行；拒付
definition_en: To firmly reject a claim, belief, or association. | To refuse to honour an agreement or pay a debt.
example1_en: I heard the lecturer repudiate an allegation during the example.
example1_zh: 我听到讲者在举例时坚决否认指控。
example2_en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to repudiate an allegation.
example2_zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们坚决否认指控。
collocations: repudiate an allegation｜坚决否认指控 ; repudiate a claim｜驳斥某种说法 ; repudiate a contract｜拒绝履行合同 ; repudiate a debt｜拒付债务
tip_zh: 是正式动词，不是名词；名词为repudiation。

meanings_zh: n. 偶然事件；偶然性
definition_en: An event happening by chance, or chance itself.
example1_en: I copied an element of fortuity into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把偶然因素抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: A campus survey used an element of fortuity to explain a pattern in academic research.
example2_zh: 一项校园调查用偶然因素来解释学术研究中的一种模式。
collocations: by sheer fortuity｜纯属偶然 ; an element of fortuity｜偶然因素
tip_zh: 较罕见的正式词；日常表达多用chance或coincidence。

meanings_zh: n. 冲突；纷争
definition_en: serious disagreement or conflict between people or groups
example1_en: Office hours began with social strife.
example1_zh: 答疑从社会冲突开始。
example2_en: The author returns to social strife when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会冲突。
collocations: social strife｜社会冲突 ; civil strife｜内乱 ; industrial strife｜劳资纠纷
tip_zh: 不可数名词，语气正式，比一般争论更严重。

meanings_zh: n. 小规模战斗；短暂冲突 | n. 小争执；短暂争论 | v. 发生小规模冲突
definition_en: A brief fight between small groups of opposing forces. | A brief argument, often within a larger disagreement. | Fight or argue briefly without a major confrontation.
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on border skirmish.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论边境小规模冲突。
example2_en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of border skirmish.
example2_zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得边境小规模冲突这个例子。
collocations: border skirmish｜边境小规模冲突 ; minor skirmish｜小冲突 ; skirmish over something｜围绕某事的争执
tip_zh: 强调规模小、时间短；也可比喻口头争执。

meanings_zh: adj. 滑溜的；蜿蜒滑行的
definition_en: slippery or moving smoothly with a twisting motion
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a slithery snake.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论蜿蜒滑行的蛇。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a slithery snake.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕蜿蜒滑行的蛇展开说明。
collocations: a slithery snake｜蜿蜒滑行的蛇 ; a slithery eel｜滑溜溜的鳗鱼
tip_zh: 常形容蛇、鳗鱼等滑溜或扭动滑行的动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 小巧精致的 | adj. 文雅的；小心翼翼的
definition_en: small, delicate, and attractive | showing delicate or careful movements and manners
example1_en: I copied dainty jewellery into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把小巧精致的首饰抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects dainty jewellery with a larger point about the humanities.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把小巧精致的首饰和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: dainty jewellery｜小巧精致的首饰 ; dainty cups｜精巧的杯子 ; dainty bites｜小口进食
tip_zh: 常形容杯具、首饰等小而精致，不泛指高档。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的
definition_en: showing that you consider someone or something unworthy of respect
example1_en: The seminar spent a few minutes on contemptuous of.
example1_zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论鄙视……的。
example2_en: The reading connects contemptuous of with a larger point about human behavior.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把鄙视……的和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: contemptuous of｜鄙视……的 ; a contemptuous glance｜轻蔑的一瞥 ; a contemptuous tone｜轻蔑的语气
tip_zh: contemptuous是鄙视人的；contemptible是可鄙的。

meanings_zh: adj. 照相复制的
definition_en: Relating to copies of documents made by a photographic process.
example1_en: Office hours began with a photostatic copy.
example1_zh: 答疑从照相复制件开始。
example2_en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a photostatic copy.
example2_zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得照相复制件这个例子。
collocations: a photostatic copy｜照相复制件 ; photostatic reproduction｜照相复制
tip_zh: 旧式技术用语，指照相复制，并非静电复印。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可撤销的；无法改变的
definition_en: Impossible to change, cancel, or take back.
example1_en: Office hours began with an irrevocable decision.
example1_zh: 答疑从不可撤销的决定开始。
example2_en: The author returns to an irrevocable decision when explaining the conclusion.
example2_zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不可撤销的决定。
collocations: an irrevocable decision｜不可撤销的决定 ; irrevocable consent｜不可撤销的同意 ; an irrevocable commitment｜不可撤回的承诺
tip_zh: 常修饰决定、同意或承诺，强调无法撤回。

meanings_zh: n. 属（生物分类单位）
definition_en: a biological group containing closely related species
example1_en: Our professor circled the same genus on the slide.
example1_zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了同一个属。
example2_en: The reading connects the same genus with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把同一个属和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
collocations: belong to a genus｜属于某个属 ; the same genus｜同一个属 ; a new genus｜一个新属
tip_zh: 复数为genera；属低于科、高于种。

meanings_zh: v. 售货时缺斤少两
definition_en: Give a customer less weight of goods than paid for
example1_en: After the lecture, we used short-weight in a sentence of our own.
example1_zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了售货时缺斤少两。
example2_en: A reading on economic policy uses short-weight when the author sets up the main claim.
example2_zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了售货时缺斤少两。
collocations: short-weight customers｜向顾客售货时缺斤少两 ; short-weight a buyer｜给买家不足分量的货
tip_zh: 动词指缺斤少两；名词通常分写为 short weight。

meanings_zh: adj. 轴的；轴向的
definition_en: relating to an axis or extending along it
example1_en: The textbook introduces axial tilt in the first chapter.
example1_zh: 教材在第一章介绍了轴倾角。
example2_en: The listening passage defines the discussion around axial tilt.
example2_zh: 这段听力材料围绕轴倾角展开说明。
collocations: axial tilt｜轴倾角 ; axial rotation｜绕轴旋转 ; axial load｜轴向载荷
tip_zh: axial与轴有关；radial指沿半径方向的。

meanings_zh: v. 监督；主管
definition_en: To oversee and take responsibility for work or an activity.
example1_en: The lab instructions say to superintend construction.
example1_zh: 实验说明要求监督施工。
example2_en: The passage says students who can superintend construction follow the argument more easily.
example2_zh: 文章说，能够监督施工的学生更容易跟上论点。
collocations: superintend construction｜监督施工 ; superintend the work｜监督工作 ; superintend operations｜主管业务
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，直接接工作或活动；日常多用supervise。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的；根本的 | adj. 自然力的 | adj. 元素态的
definition_en: Relating to the most basic features or forces of something. | Relating to powerful natural forces such as wind and water. | Consisting of a chemical element rather than a compound.
example1_en: I copied elemental forces into my lecture notes.
example1_zh: 我把自然力量抄进了课堂笔记。
example2_en: The reading connects elemental forces with a larger point about the natural sciences.
example2_zh: 这篇阅读把自然力量和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。
